mangas.title: Please Lock Me Up!
mangas.synonyms: Please Confine Me! | Please Let Me Be Locked Up!
mangas.description: Ever since he started dating Tae-Geon, Yuan has been drowning in constant anxiety. Driven by the desperate fear of losing him, Yu-An finally snaps and does the unthinkable: he kidnaps Tae-Geon and locks him away. But when Yu-An is bracing himself for rage, tears, and disappointment, his mature, gentle boyfriend just smiles softly instead. With the doors locked, they drop their masks, revealing their true selves—one full of anxiety, and one full of obsession.

mangas.title: BLUE PARADOX
mangas.description: In this era rife with infectious diseases, Preston is a pharmaceutical company leading the world with unrivaled new drug development. One day, its sole heir, Mio Preston, is kidnapped due to a conspiracy by a rival corporation. What they demanded was CRADLE, the vaccine the Preston company is secretly developing. In this desperate moment, a mysterious man appears before Mio, and with his arrival, massive hidden truths begin to surface one by one…

mangas.title: Late Bloomers
mangas.description:
One day, out of the blue, mutants appeared on Earth, and at the same time, the “late bloomers”—individuals who had awakened to these supernatural abilities—emerged.

They were all quarantined at the same time in a different dimension known as Naraka. Seowoon, the deputy guildmaster of the Fallen Angels (FA), was once regarded as one of the highest-ranking among the “late bloomers” due to his outstanding combat skills; however, after being quarantined in Naraka, he lost all his abilities. Instead, a “messenger” appeared in his mind, alerting him to the presence of mutants and impending danger.

Whilst on the run, hiding the fact that he had lost his powers, Seowoon encounters Cahaya, a top-tier “late bloomer” whom he least wanted to face, and finds himself in a difficult situation as Cahaya keeps drawing closer to him.

…Because he had been hiding his feelings for him ever since high school.

mangas.title: That's My Ideal Type
mangas.description:
A student in the Department of Magic Tools at the Royal University, falls in love the moment he sees Kazail's penis in the restroom. Driven by a desire to possess it, Boniren decides to create a magic tool modeled after his penis.

“Could you possibly make a magic tool for me to use as well?
“You, you use one too?”
“Although what I need isn't a penis, but an ass.”
 Surprisingly, Kazail asks him to make a magic tool for him as well.

“Haa... I just had a good idea.”
“Hmph, what, what is it?”
“I think the magic tool would become even more perfect if we used your semen and mine.”
The story of two people who engage in secret masturbation together using a magic tool that synchronizes their senses.

mangas.title: Breeding Campus
mangas.description:
Park U-Ri, the illegitimate beta child of Irae Financial Loans, had only one goal: to graduate from college without incident, just as his father and older brother had ordered. But on his first day back on campus, his goal is thrown off course when he ends up paired with a perverted alpha who was groping a girl in the cafeteria as his partner for a general education class. He threatens the pervert to drop the class, but Lee Yeon instead orders him to withdraw from the course. Just as he was resorting to a last-ditch effort to blackmail Lee Yeon, U-Ri suddenly manifests as an Omega…

“I can smell Omega on you.” “No, whoa! No, I’m, I’m a Beta!” “What kind of Beta drips pre-cum from his hole, Park U-Ri?”
Lee Yeon whispered cruelly, savoring the sight of his face turning deathly pale.

“Do other people know you’re an Omega?”

mangas.title: Can't I Set It Up During The Interview?
mangas.description:
Do-Hyeon, who has been suffering from erectile dysfunction due to a year-long streak of job rejections, and Yu-An, who has long suppressed her desires to accommodate his pace. Their relationship, which had seemed so calm, begins to take a twisted turn after they discover an Aneros in a trash can…?!

“Applicant Lee Do-Hyeon, did you get an erection during the interview?”

mangas.title: Unlucky Dream
mangas.description: Jeong-Hyeon’s life falls into utter ruin after losing his apartment and all his belongings in a fire. Plagued by extreme misfortune and erotic dreams about his close friend Jin, Jeong-Hyeon discovers a shocking truth: his good luck is being drained away whenever they are apart. However, physical contact with Jin slowly restores his stolen luck, with greater intimacy proving even more effective. Forced to stay close to Jin to escape his relentless bad luck, Jeong-Hyeon must navigate their changing dynamic and intense physical encounters to reclaim his normal life.

mangas.title: Yamagami-sama to Okiniiri
mangas.description:
A completely ordinary young man named Souichirou works as a repairman. One day, while lost in the mountains, he is saved by a mysterious man. This man, who kisses Souichirou’s hand without warning and even flies through the air, possesses otherworldly powers.

To repay him for his help, Souichirou ventures back into the mountains. However, after meeting the man several times, he eventually finds that the man has lost his memory...?

mangas.title: Trash Will Always Be Trash
mangas.synonyms: I Won’t Pick Up The Trash I Threw Away Again | Don’t Pick Up What You’ve Thrown Away
mangas.description:
After a lifetime of devotion to you, I refuse to be taken for granted any longer!

Six years of patient waiting for my fiancé, Phillen, ended when he returned with a woman carrying his child. I now reside with her, feeling neglected as he showers her with attention. I'm left questioning my place in this household, facing a tough decision: stay or bid this place farewell.

mangas.title: The Alpha Is Going Too Far
mangas.synonyms: The Alpha Is Going Too Much
mangas.description:
Hyeon Yi-Jae, is a dominant Alpha, was humiliated in a stinging defeat by his passionate Alpha junior, Kang Ji-Uk, at the school sports festival. With the mocking sneer "Dominant?" still vivid in his memory, an opportunity for revenge has arrived..

A part-time job as a clinical trial subject for a new drug aimed at Alpha couples? Why don’t you try being an Omega under my command for once!

mangas.title: Ghosts Really Exist!
mangas.description: For the past few days, Seong-Won has been suffering from a mysterious headache. One thing is certain: this isn’t something that can be cured at a hospital... Seong-Won meets Nu-Ri, a senior who is rumored to be the son of a shaman, and desperately asks him for help. But just as Nu-Ri helps resolve the problem, a ghost who has fallen for Seong-Won latches onto him. Seong-Won, who had been hoping to get closer to Nu-Ri, ends up spending time with him after asking him to keep an eye on a new ghost named “Mari.” A romance between a man possessed by a ghost and a man who can see ghosts!

mangas.title: Hidden Fire
mangas.description: Seo Do-yoon welcomes a young and alluring stepmother, Lee Yeon-woo, due to his father's remarriage. On the surface, they are a perfect family, but Do-yoon hasn't been able to take his eyes off her since the moment they first met. A hidden fire begins to quietly burn through the cracks of their once-perfect family.

mangas.title: Irreplaceable Guy Friend
mangas.description:
“I don't think just once will be enough.”
“Hey, mmm...”

National swimmer, Moon Tae-gyeom. He has a secret behind his spectacular comeback after a long slump. The reason he finally broke his stagnant record is none other than his friend of 20 years, Yoo Seo-hae. Every time he sleeps with Seo-hae, his performance improves like magic. At first, it was just for the records. But soon, he starts to get annoyed by every single guy around her.

“Yoo Seo-hae's body belongs to me, but there are too many bastards trying to covet it.”

...Are we really just friends?

mangas.title: Good Night, Neighbor
mangas.synonyms: The Gloomy, Sexy Guy Next Door
mangas.description: Yeo-Eul despises thugs and womanizers, but her next-door neighbor, Un-Gyeol, seems to be both. Plagued by excess yin energy that attracts dangerous spirits, Un-Gyeol needs a woman's yang energy to save him. Realizing Yeo-Eul is the one who can solve his supernatural problem, he initiates a passionate physical relationship. While Yeo-Eul tries to keep their relationship casual, fearing he is a deceitful, rotten playboy, Un-Gyeol grows deeply, obsessively devoted. Is this fling bound for a friendly ending? Or will Un-Gyeol not allow it to end at all?

mangas.title: This Is Me
mangas.description:
Baek Ju-Ho, who lost his family to the Crown Prince Ghost as punishment for answering a ghost’s question. Cha Ju-Yul, the son of Cha Seon-Ho, the man who took Baek Ju-Ho in. Their brief childhood together came to an end with Cha Seon-Ho’s death, and for many years, Baek Ju-Ho lived with a deep-seated sense of guilt toward Cha Ju-Yul.

“Freshman? What’s your name?”

That is, until he realized that the man he had met again had completely forgotten him. But does Cha Ju-Yul really not remember Baek Ju-Ho?

mangas.title: Another Edgelord
mangas.description:
Yun I-seo was living an ordinary life—far removed from the fantasies of his childhood.
After winning the lottery by chance, he was celebrating wildly on a rainy, moonlit night when he was struck by a truck and transported to another world...

Wait, what? I’m the god of this world?! And to make matters worse, the cringeworthy novel I wrote during my awkward teenage years has become the state religion's holy scripture?!

Furious at the thought of the fortune he left behind in the real world, I-seo soon finds himself mired in a sticky predicament—until a man with a dazzling smile appears, plants a kiss on him, and saves him. Will I-seo ever be able to return to the real world?

mangas.title: Lucky Mia!
mangas.description: Nam Eun-ho, a college student living alone with his younger sister, has lived a life of extreme misfortune, beginning with a childhood car accident. Eun-ho's sole goal is to live an ordinary life, remaining unnoticed. Then, one day, a campus goddess, unexpectedly entangled with him, strikes him with a sudden urge! Is this a stroke of luck, or the start of yet another misfortune?!

mangas.title: Something About You
mangas.description: Because of a difficult family background, Ji-U enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else. There is one person she cannot help noticing, U-Yeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Ji-U feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him. To Ji-U, U-Yeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain. But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Ji-U stumbles upon U-Yeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty. In that moment, Ji-U realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

mangas.title: XX's Fairy
mangas.description:
“A magical dildo that grants your wishes! Summon Jin-hwi, the dildo fairy, and she’ll make your three sexual fantasies come true.”
“How to use: Cup the base of the dildo with both hands and rub it up and down to summon Jin-hwi.”

“You didn’t actually take me out, did you?”
“Huh…?”
“It’s been a thousand years since someone took me out.”

The man’s eyes shone with what seemed like deep emotion as he grabbed Sol’s hand. His eyes sparkled like those of a mischievous young demon, but his muscular, imposing physique was that of an adult, and his face was beautiful enough to perfectly suit the title of “fairy.”

Sol found herself admiring his figure and swallowed hard without realizing it. Then, suddenly, Jin-hwi kissed the back of her hand.

“Nice to meet you, Master. Since you woke me up, now make a wish.”
“What… what do you mean?”
“Didn’t you read the manual? I’m talking about three sexual fantasies.”

mangas.title: [Beyond Humanity: Short Stories] What Happens When You Rescue a Baby Dragon
mangas.titleNative: [인외 단편선] 아기 드래곤을 구해주면 생기는 일
mangas.description: Flora Dain is a noble young lady who dreams of a fairy tale romance. She meets Ion by chance at a party and finds out that he is not human, but she falls for his appearance, which is her style, and asks him out of the blue. However, Ion tells her to “marry me” and takes her to his mansion. Before she knows it, Ion and her have sex, and while they enjoy it, Ion reminds her of the young dragon she saved in the past…?!

mangas.title: An Unusual Fish
mangas.description: Cheryl, determined to escape from her boring rural island, works hard every day to earn money. Then one day, she encounters a mermaid-like creature born from a 'stone' she found(?) and hopes that selling the child will make her money... From that day on, for some reason, she keeps having lewd dreams with a man.

mangas.title: Bite-Sized Pure Love Training
mangas.description:
Adrian, a vampire who accidentally bit a witch while trying to suck blood and broke his fangs, ends up living with the witch Hilda, who loves lust, against his will until his fangs fully grow back.

"I'll have to cater to your style of play. I'll use all those disgusting tools to make sure you're taken down."

"I won't let a pervert like you get away with it, even if I die!"
Despite these words, Adrian begins to crave for a more intense... play…

mangas.title: You Can't Come, Sir!
mangas.synonyms: Hero-nim, You Can't Go There | Sir Warrior, You Shouldn't Go There
mangas.description: Guster Smith has dedicated 17 years of his life to being a hero - only to remain a penniless nobody in the grand scheme. So when the esteemed archmage, Lord Angel Romero, offers him a mission to once again save the world, he accepts without hesitation. But all is not as it seems, and Guster is about to find about that the archmage has quite the “staff” he uses to work his magic…and a plethora of special techniques bound to blow the knight's mind.

mangas.title: How to Deliciously Eat Your Childhood Friend
mangas.description:
"No. You'll regret it. You and I... It doesn't make sense."

"Engagement? That's ridiculous. Is it some kind of arranged marriage or something?"

It's not like it's a chaebol family or some unavoidable business merger or anything. They're just neighbors who lived in the same apartment building. How could she have gotten involved with a guy like this? It wasn't her intention. It was entirely her parents' will! With the campus romance she'd been dreaming of right in front of her, Da-Kyung suddenly gets engaged to her childhood friend. Huh? An engagement at this age? And to Ma Seong-Jae, who's her testicle friend and a notorious slut?

mangas.title: My Scheming Junior
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description:
“You took my virginity, so you better take responsibility.”

One night of drunken mistakes with her younger brother’s friend, and now Ji-Woo is completely trapped! Wait, weren't you always the quiet one? Weren't you the guy who had zero interest in women, let alone me? From acting out of character to suddenly playing the role of her "boyfriend," Seung-Hyun’s behavior is driving Ji-woo crazy. She’s realizing all too late—it only takes a single moment for your life to spiral out of control.

mangas.title: It's Not Your Baby!
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description: Callia Taxicate was a mere commoner until she saved the life of Simon Tereloane, the son of a duke. In return, the duke helps make her commander of the emperor's knights and she becomes a war hero. Though she only sees Simon as a friend, the two unexpectedly spend the night together and she ends up pregnant! Terrified that he and his noble family won't accept a child out of wedlock, Callia runs away to raise the baby on her own. But how long can she hide this secret, especially from the father?!

mangas.title: Living With My Villainous Uncle
mangas.synonyms: I Live With My Villain Uncle | I'm Living With My Yncle, the Villain
mangas.description:
Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.

Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?

mangas.title: The Dying Villainess Denies Adoption
mangas.synonyms: A Terminally Ill Villainess Refuses to Be Adopted | The Villain Refuses Adoption
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description: After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

mangas.title: The Circumstances of Being Chosen as the Villainess's Favorite
mangas.synonyms: How I Ended Up as the Villainess’s Favorite | I Became the Villainess’s Favorite
mangas.description:
I’ve been reincarnated as Lariette, a lowly sidekick destined to be the female lead’s errand girl. Tired of being a doormat, I decide to switch sides and suck up to the empire’s most powerful villainess, Evangeline. But the “vicious” villainess is actually a total sweetheart! Not only is she showering me with gifts, she’s now insisting I marry her brother so we can be family forever. There’s just one problem: her brother is the original male lead, a man supposed to be obsessed with the original heroine. I’ve tried my best to keep my distance, but he won’t stop pursuing me.

“What makes you think I’m not interested in you, My Lady?”

mangas.title: Arelyn Is Sick and Tired
mangas.synonyms: Male Lead Is Obsessed With My Health | The Male Lead is Unhealthily Obsessed With My Health
mangas.description: The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

mangas.title: Marchioness Maron
mangas.description: Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she’s alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge?

mangas.title: RE: Author, This Is Your Last Work?
mangas.synonyms: RE: Author, You're Retiring from Writing? Seriously?
mangas.description:
“Hey, editor. I have a scene in my head. Should I try it?”

I tried to keep it dry because it was just a show, but he was too hot. He blurted out that he would be able to write without any problems if he just tried it before penetration before sex and left. In contrast to his plain reaction, Dasulgi’s body got all heated up and she secretly masturbated. Then, when she raised her head because of a strange feeling, she saw him leaning against the wall and looking directly at the scene. She was caught, as an editor, masturbating while calling the writer’s name. He leaned against the wall and quietly watched her, then leisurely asked, “Should I help you?”

mangas.title: Trash Recipe
mangas.description:
Baek Seo-Chan, leader of WE-AZ, once the biggest flop among flops. Leaving behind his past of pandering to wealthy housewives in his quest to become a successful idol, he ends up taking advantage of Cheon Ha-Yun, a genius composer who approached him claiming to be a fan.

"Don’t worry, hyung. If you just listen to me, I’ll listen to you too."

It seems he might have stepped on a landmine.

mangas.title: The Tiger and the Cat’s Spooky Escape Room
mangas.description: Does this make sense?! You said it was a horror escape room game! Why is it suddenly turning into a ‘sex-free’ room?!” Baek San-ho is big in size but lives on the reputation of being a toothless tiger. Go Young -shin has protected him and played with him since childhood. The two childhood friends plan a trip to celebrate their college graduation, but while shopping for swimsuits, they stop by an escape room and end up trapped inside! They discover a hidden trick. It turns out it wasn't an ordinary horror escape room game, but a ‘sex-free’ room. A brief confrontation ensues, but as Baek San-ho reveals his true colors, the situation begins to change…

mangas.title: How to Become a Better Man
mangas.description:
Jae-hee, an international student facing both an academic warning and a breakup at the same time, picks up a suspicious self-help book to become a better man.

The first to notice this change in Jaehee is Miles, who is acting like a hot guy.
Miles buys the exact same book, wanting to be like Jaehee. Although reading it in Korean is difficult, he thinks he can do this much if it means becoming a man like Jaehee.

However, the book demanded physical 'development,' and the two end up crossing a line of no return.

mangas.title: Ice On Me
mangas.description:
After retiring from figure skating due to an injury, Gyueon now works as a chef.

One day, Eunhyung, the junior who walked away leaving behind cruel words, reappears before him.

"It's obvious you'll fail no matter what you do..."

Gyueon tries to keep his guard up and push away the one who scarred him so deeply, but he soon finds his eyes constantly drawn back to Eunhyung.

mangas.title: Do I Smell?
mangas.description: The story of Ji Ho-Jae, who was cursed with an unidentifiable smell, and his friend who's followed him like a sunflower for 10 years, Han Geon-U. Because of a strange professor, Ho-Jae begins to feel self-conscious and suspicious of Geon-U, as though he has never known him before. Soon, he ends up having a very lewd dream, however…

mangas.title: Shh, You'll Wake the Baby!
mangas.synonyms: Shh, You'll Wake Up the Child!
mangas.description:
Hwan, a college student, is introduced to a part time job of babysitting.
To his surprise, Nabi, his employer, makes a move on him on his first night of work.
He is even more surprised when Nabi seems to casually brush off this encounter and signs him on for work.

So begins a peculiar working environment, as Hwan starts to care for Yoojoo, Nabi's son, and things get more personal and complicated between Hwan and Nabi.

mangas.title: Percentage of Love
mangas.description: An Alpha named Tae-Yoon reminisces the night he had together with Omega Eun-Hoo before he disappeared. As if by fate, the two meet once again; and Eun-Hoo has a child, making Tae-Yoon believe he's taken. Tae-Yoon decides to just be friends with Eun-Hoo and his son, but will he let go of his love for him?

mangas.title: It's My Baby!
mangas.description:
'I had an one night stand with the first person I met, but I got pregnant.'

Everytime this omega had a boyfriend, the relationship always ended up with him being cheated on and in the end, he even got crushed by hearing the words, “You are an omega, but I’m not attracted to you". Hae-Su, who was chugging alcohol while raging to his friend who comforted him, got wasted on a drug, and to make matters worse, his heat cycle started. Alpha Do-Geon, who was in the same pub, notices Hae-Su's condition and tries to help Haesoo and get him away from the place but he is seduced by Hae-Su's pheromones and they end up spending the night together.

In the morning, as soon as he wakes up, Hae-Su hastily ran away and finds out that he is pregnant 4 weeks later. Hae-Su decides to raise and make the child happy by himself. After 4 years, Hae-Su and Do-Geon are reunited…

mangas.title: Striking Gold
mangas.description: Lee Chan has spent his entire life chasing the shadow of Kwon Taesan, the legendary Olympic Taekwondo star who saved him when no one else would. But just as Chan’s feelings deepen into something deeper, Taesan vanishes into thin air, leaving behind a single text: “Don’t look for me.” Years later, Chan finally tracks his first love down to a sleepy countryside town, only to find his once-savior living as a single father to a baby who is surely his own. Worse yet, Taesan has absolutely no memory of who Chan is. Now, Chan must navigate the secrets of Taesan’s sudden disappearance and figure out how to reclaim a spot in the broken life of the man he never stopped loving.

mangas.title: My Meddler in Love
mangas.description: Ji-Yu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Ji-Yu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app starts “meddling” in her love life, Ji-Yu is left wondering how an AI understands her so well. The thing is, perhaps it’s not AI at all and rather someone who has recently re-entered her life…

mangas.title: One-Room TA
mangas.synonyms: One Room Ta | Apartment Assistant-nim | One-Room Assistant
mangas.description: When college student U-Yun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jin-Hyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jin-Hyeong moves in with him, and that’s when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He’s thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having U-Yun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jin-Hyeong’s ideas are, U-Yun doesn’t entirely hate it...?

mangas.title: The White Tiger Clan's Baby Cotton Ball
mangas.synonyms: The White Tiger Clan's Little Fluff
mangas.description:
Soya was the beloved youngest daughter of the Vermilion Bird family—at least, until her first transformation. Instead of the red feathers that all true descendants possess, she sprouted snow-white fluff.

"Extract her spirit core and lock her in the cold palace."

After that day, Soya became the family's disgrace, facing neglect and abuse. When the real daughter, Liri, finally returned, Soya was thrown away. Right at the brink of death—

"What is this fluff?"

She was rescued by the head of the White Tiger family.

"I think I'll steal you, you little fluff."

Soya accepts his suspicious offer and moves to the land of the White Tigers. She just wants to live quietly without drawing attention to herself, but the people of the White Tiger family are being way too nice to her!

mangas.title: I’m The Only One Who Doesn’t Know That Villainess Is A Man
mangas.synonyms: I’m the Only One Who Didn’t Know the Villainess Was a Male
mangas.description:
Vivian awakens to find herself possessed into the body of a terminally ill female lead, doomed to a tragic ending. Refusing to accept her doom, Vivian seeks out Rahel, the story’s infamous villainess and the only person capable of curing her. What begins as a desperate gamble slowly turns into a genuine bond, and against all expectations, the two become close, true friends. But…

"Not for a single moment did I ever consider you my friend, Vivian."

"Do you really think you could enter a contract marriage with anyone else?"

...Wait. Wasn’t Rahel supposed to be a villainess?! My best friend just turned out to be a male?!

mangas.title: Don't Mind Me, Daddy
mangas.description: Jayna’s life is a parade of misfortunes: born to a dragon mother who dies early, bullied by other dragons throughout her childhood, disregarded by her human father, and murdered as a teenager. At least, according to the novel she’s been reborn in. At 10 years old, she’s given the chance to live with her father, the Master of the Magic Tower, Diamid. She’s aware her father and destiny will not be kind to her, so her only goal is to enjoy the small luxuries of life until she dies at 17. But will this life truly be the same tragedy?

mangas.title: I Will Save My Father
mangas.synonyms: I Will Try to Save My Dad, I'll Save My Dad
mangas.description:
Seven-year-old Berry lived a quiet life in the countryside with her father. Her world changes overnight when she discovers her father is actually the long-lost son of the wealthy Count Travel.
Upon moving to the grand mansion, Berry is overwhelmed by cold glares from greedy relatives. Suddenly, strange memories of a "future" flash through her mind like a storm. In these memories, her father dies a tragic, meaningless death.
When Berry realizes these visions are coming true, she vows to change fate. To save her father from the vultures in the family, she decides she needs a powerful ally. She sets her sights on the young Crown Prince, Theon Phil Excellona, who is currently ignored by everyone.
Berry’s mission is clear: Win over the Prince and save her father at all costs!

mangas.title: I Am the 5-Year-Old Spy Who Kidnapped the Villain
mangas.synonyms: I'm a 5 Year Old Spy Who Kidnapped the Villain
mangas.description: After losing her parents at a young age and working herself to death because of the cruel adults around her, a woman wakes up to find herself inside a novel. Unfortunately, she has become a minor character destined to die before the main story even begins—a child spy from a family known for its cruelty. Her mission is to pose as the fake daughter of the story’s main villain. Refusing to die again by following other people’s orders, she decides to use her knowledge of the novel to change her fate, side with the villain instead, help prevent his downfall, and find a way to protect herself and finally achieve happiness in this new life.

mangas.title: One Coin Closer to Holiness
mangas.synonyms: I Will Buy Divine Power With Money!
mangas.description: When a former detective wakes up as Ordelle Kyris, the villainess and fake saint of the novel "Idella the Holy," she is entrusted with the task of saving the Sun God and this world from disappearing forever. However, being a fake, her divine power is close to nothing. And the only way to increase it is... money! From securing rich followers to starting a new business, Ordelle strives to gather funds and gain more power. Will this fake yet fiery saint successfully climb the ladder of holiness?

mangas.title: My Favorite Character Wants a Divorce
mangas.synonyms: Loving My Husband While Bracing for Divorce | It Feels Like I'm About to Be Divorced, but My Husband Is My Favorite | My Husband Is My Ultimate Bias, But I Feel Like I'm About to Be Divorced
mangas.description: When I realized I had transmigrated as the woman destined to marry my favorite character, Duke Euclid Ludion, I was over the moon. Only cloud on the horizon: I'm a villainess, and based on the storyline, we're headed straight for a divorce. But I won't let that happen! Time to undo all of my character's evil deeds, clear my reputation, use my generous dowry to save Euclid's house from ruin, and win over his beloved wards. Surely, this will be enough to guarantee our happily-ever-after... right?

mangas.title: Run and Hit!
mangas.description:
Koh Yang-Seo, the star center fielder for the Servals, always treated his junior teammate, Kang Ha-Joo, like a younger brother—until he discovered Ha-Joo’s secret: he’s gay. When Yang-Seo catches him using a dating app, he becomes overly protective, determined to keep an eye on his innocent junior. But his watchful eye leads to unexpected closeness: the same team, the same field, and now... the same bed?!

Wait a second. Something’s definitely off here...!

mangas.title: Hanakin Love Accident!
mangas.titleNative: 花金ラブアクシデント！

mangas.title: In Bed With the Male Lead
mangas.synonyms: Rolling In Bed With The Male Lead | Rolling Around in Bed with the Male Lead
mangas.description: Richard, the second male lead, has failed to win the heroine's heart across dozens of regressions. Every time, the heroine ends up with the trashy male lead, leaving Richard—destined to be the second male lead—discarded and alone. Unable to watch her choose the male lead once more, Richard decides after forty-eight regressions to try one final method: seducing the male lead himself

mangas.title: A Cute Guy
mangas.description: Kenzaki is a delinquent who saves her classmate Nakajima from some bullies one day, but Kenzaki still has yet to tell him that she has a crush on him.

mangas.title: A Mouthful of Sweet Cream Baguette
mangas.description: Roah Egleydon is an avid lover of bread, so when a conference takes her to the home of the famous Everrose Bakery, she is determined to get her hands on some delicious baked goods. After a day of waiting in line in the sweltering sun, she finally makes it to the bakery, only to find them all sold out! That's when she meets Klimt, a mysterious, sexy baker who offers her a sample of his sweet cream baguette. Roah is intrigued by this handsome stranger, but is she biting off more than she can chew?

mangas.title: Three Thousand Nights
mangas.description: 19th Century, Great Britain. The time when the foundations for the Opium Wars were laid. McQueen Leicester, in charge of England’s largest trading company, ‘Klaus Divison’, and a big player in opium trafficking, seeks to achieve his ambition to gain more power by jumping on the bandwagon of the upper-class society through war. McQueen chances upon Aaron Wisfield, a debauchee in the high society of London, at a salon he attends for the purpose of lobbying. Contrary to his refined appearance, he despises men who habitually travel around whilst high on opium. The successor of the ducal family, who vehemently opposes the scheme to dispatch troops to war. A man of abundant wealth, honor, and power from birth. All he does is stand on top and look down at the mud under his shoes. McQueen, while perceiving him as a terribly detestable target, loses all his memories after suffering from a fall off a horse during a hunting competition. When he manages to open his eyes in an old cottage, the glamorous handsome man claims to be England’s best artist and that McQueen is his servant. The owner of the cottage, only slick at face value, was temperamental, arrogant, and violent. However, in an isolated cottage where only the two of them co-exist as human beings, McQueen Leicester begins to harbor indefinable feelings for his master, who always returns back full of wounds and injuries.

mangas.title: Fantasy Love Line
mangas.description:
“I really like this actor, you know.”

Oh Yoonsang has been cast in N-flix Korea’s new drama, ‘Aftermath’. His character’s love interest is Jeong Do-hwan, a genius actor from the independent film scene whom he has secretly admired.

However, when they actually meet, he turns out to be a man who is completely impossible to figure out…?! Yoonsang, a hopeless romantic, finds himself completely at the mercy of Do-hwan—a free spirit who is playful yet serious, affectionate yet rude—rendering his nickname “Prince Alpha” utterly meaningless.

Do-hwan seems to harbour feelings yet never quite crosses the line. Even whilst playing arch-enemies on screen, the moment they turn their backs, he asks Yoonsang out on a date. Yoonsang plays the role of Do-hwan’s Omega, but in reality, pheromones have no effect on him. Love over defiance and pride! Will he be able to win the heart of this impregnable acting genius?

Yoonsang may have the reputation of a Hollywood Casanova, but he’s determined to make Do-hwan beg for him!

mangas.title: Just Grow Up Healthy
mangas.description: A mysterious package of potatoes arrives for Park Tae-Ho, a hungry unemployed man. Following a single letter from his grandfather, he ends up in the rural village of “Hongwol-ri,” where he reunites with his arch-rival, Hyeon Seung-Ju, the son of a chaebol tycoon. A potato-farming showdown between the two men begins with the mysterious potatoes found in a secret warehouse. But as they plow the fields together, fight, tumble around, and even weather a typhoon... For some reason, his heart keeps acting strange. A chaotic country life with his arch-rival, where not a single day goes by without a commotion. But why… does his heart keep fluttering?

mangas.title: Self-Inflicted Trap
mangas.description:
Kang Hyeon-Su, who got dumped after asking his girlfriend for a prostate massage. Hyeon-Su, a dopamine addict, was wondering if there was anyone who could satisfy his desires when he happened to run into Kwon Seo-Hyeok, a college junior who had come to his company to request a remodeling project. As the two shared drinks during their long-awaited reunion, they naturally ended up at Seo-Hyeok’s place...

What Hyeon-Su encountered there was none other than a walk-in closet filled with “adult toys”?! His initial shock was short-lived, and as Hyeon-Eu showed interest, Seo-Hyeok, as if he’d been waiting for this moment, made a suggestive remark.

”I collected all of this to share with you, Senior.”

mangas.title: Chance of Meeting Your Ex on a Hetero Dating Show
mangas.synonyms: Probability of Meeting Your Ex in a Hetero Dating Show
mangas.description: Gi Seo-jeong unexpectedly reunites with Cha Yoon, his ex of seven years, on a heterosexual dating show. However, after an accident, Cha Yoon has lost all memories of their relationship and returned to the difficult personality he had seven years ago. Unaware that Seo-jeong is his former lover, Cha Yoon constantly argues with him and even considers him a romantic rival. Exhausted by their repeated conflicts, Seo-jeong decides to ignore him until filming ends. But Cha Yoon gradually begins acting strangely. He becomes jealous, repeatedly asks why Seo-jeong never sends him messages, and starts choosing him on the show. As Cha Yoon’s forgotten feelings begin to resurface, Seo-jeong must figure out what his mentally seven-years-younger ex truly wants before their time on the program runs out.

mangas.title: Spring Dancing With a Drunken Shadow
mangas.description:
Cheonghyeon – A mage born with the disability of being unable to speak. Aside from that, however, he is exceptional in every way, with outstanding looks and remarkable talent. He is the king's second legitimate son and is also a distinguished scholar, renowned throughout the nation as an unparalleled statesman.

Sim Ji-an – The youngest child of the influential Sim family, who grew up living freely and without restraint. A mage famous for both his exceptional ability and fiery temperament. His only complaint is that Cheonghyeon, his respected senior disciple whom he deeply admires still treats him like a child and calls him "Ani.”

mangas.title: Countdown to Graduation
mangas.description: The end is in sight! With three months left till graduation, Muyoung is on the high-school home straight. And it’s gone pretty well! He’s student body president, gets good grades, and has never strayed from the straight and narrow. Then out of the blue, the mysterious transfer student, Chanhee, confesses his feelings to him! Muyoung is so taken aback that he barely manages to turn him down… But with 92 days left until graduation, there’s still plenty of time for love to blossom!

mangas.title: The Heat Between Us
mangas.description:
Opposites attract, but can they handle the heat?

Guide Ye-Hyun must oversee the volatile Aesper, Hae-Sung, or face suspension after a drunken mishap. With Hae-Sung’s fiery temper and drug issues, their partnership is off to a rough start—but their synergy is unmatched. Can these polar opposites find common ground before everything falls apart?

mangas.title: The Villainous Stepsister Is Being Hypocritical Today Too
mangas.titleNative: 恶役继姐今天也在口是心非
mangas.synonyms: E Yi Jijie Jintian Ye Zai Koushixinfei
mangas.description: Lin Anan was forced to bind to a villain system, reincarnating as Hera, the malicious stepsister in a Western fantasy novel. According to the plot, she must torment the kind-hearted “Cinderella” Duoliya, but each act of “bullying” secretly hides her protection of her. One day, an accident occurs: Duoliya’s tears trigger a system glitch—whenever Hela comes into contact with Duoliya’s bodily fluids, she loses control and speaks her true feelings. Though Duoliya appears fragile, she is actually a yandere. After discovering Hela’s secret, she deliberately uses her tears and saliva to force Hela to confess her true feelings. As the two become increasingly entangled in the tug-of-war between “villain” and “yandere,” they join forces with the original “antagonist” to expose a royal conspiracy, break free from the shackles of fate, and secure a happy ending for everyone.

mangas.title: My Heart Isn't Stone
mangas.synonyms: My Heart Is Not a Stone | Wo Xin Fei Shi
mangas.description: In order to rebel, Jiu Jin sneaked into the marriage team from the Western Regions to the Central Plains, and her identity was exposed on the first day. But what is gratifying is that the marriage princess seems to be a fake? For their own purposes, the two relied on each other while being hunted by multiple forces. In close contact, they gradually developed a love for each other.

mangas.title: Your Body Is Lying
mangas.description: Inspector General of the Special Division, has been hunting the serial killer Zero for years, and her pursuit has become an obsession. But who could have known that Jiang Tan, the brilliant doctor who is always by Xia Zhi’s side and enjoys her complete trust, is actually Zero’s other face. When her lover turns out to be two-faced, both an angel and a devil stand before her… Genius Doctor: “I need to use bodily fluids to control your mind and calm your hormonal activity. I’ll need to take a deep sample. I’m a doctor—surely the Inspector General won’t think too much of it?” Serial Killer: “The hormones the Inspector General is secreting—is it because I’m making you happy? I’m so glad~”

mangas.title: Hidden BL Special Lecture: How to Use Rice Cakes in Classics ~ Focusing on Tigers ~
mangas.titleNative: 숨어 보는 BL 특강 : 고전에서의 떡 활용법 ~호랑이를 중심으로~
mangas.description:
“If you let me make rice cake, I won’t eat you.”

While crossing the mountain in the middle of the night to find medicinal herbs for his sick mother, the filial son Park Dal-Jae encounters a fearsome thousand-year-old tiger and the mountain master, Baek-Ho. When he suddenly gave rice cake to the tiger who was looking for rice cake, wow! What it bit was not my neck or the rice cake I held out, but a large pepper(?) hanging between its legs.

“Oh, oh. The pepper is gone!”
“Stop. I’ll suck it out and return it to its original state.”

Where did something so delicious come from!

mangas.title: Perfect Error
mangas.description: Ji Sun-Jeong knows exactly how cruel the world can be, especially for an omega scraping by at the absolute bottom. But nothing prepares him for the night he steps into a dark alley and watches the city’s most beloved billionaire philanthropist, Beom Seong-Heon, brutally beat a man half to death. Disgusted by the alpha’s saintly facade, Sun-Jeong decides to leverage the secret in order to secure his freedom. Surprisingly, Seong-Heon easily plays along, opening his wallet and pulling Sun-Jeong into his orbit. But Seong-Heon isn't without his own reasons. Both believe they hold the leash in this toxic game of mutual exploitation, but as their cold-blooded transaction spirals into a breathless attraction, the line between hunter and prey begins to vanish…

mangas.title: Fetish On Stage
mangas.description:
Choi Woo-Ju, who has been imagining his first love for a long time because he couldn't forget it, suddenly sees his first love, Yu Hye-Sung, in front of him after 8 years. Hye-Sung expresses his interest in Woo-Ju's being a band member, and this gives Woo-Ju a chance to realize his imagination that he has always had...

The moment the stage lights turn on, all the truth is revealed?!

mangas.title: Dissolve: His Last Choice
mangas.description:
Dissolve: A film editing technique where one scene gradually overlaps another on the same screen as transition occurs.

Song Hyunsoo, an unknown actor who makes a living as a bartender.
He gets cast in a famous director’s film and ends up acting alongside the nation’s famous actor, Yoon Juho.

He drinks only water that costs 400,000 won.
He replaces managers as casually as eating a meal. —Yoon Juho, a man surrounded by countless rumors.

“Where do you live?”
“It’s okay. I can take the bus.”
“I asked where you live. I didn’t say I’d take you home.”
“…Bogwang-dong.”
“I will take you there.”

Though his words are mean, Hyunsoo becomes curious about the unexpectedly gentle side hidden in his past, and a strange tension begins to form between the two.

“I fail to live up to expectations, leave people alone, hurt them… and every moment I’m reminded that I’m a defective product who only looks fine on the outside. When it comes to relationships, those are the only memories I have.”

But it doesn’t seem easy to conquer a prince who has lived his entire life as a top star…

The past he never even properly began to face fades away, and a new love approaches.
Change and growth to create a final love—and the final choice.

mangas.title: Rise of Moonsoo
mangas.description: A battle to top! Betting leads to smutty times…

mangas.title: Dog and Bird
mangas.description: After a wild night at the club, Gyuha wakes up to a surprise. He's tangled in the sheets with none other than his childhood friend, Chayoung. The more Gyuha thinks about it, the more he realizes that Chayoung is actually his ideal type, maybe a tad too tall. Despite their rendezvous becoming a regular thing, and the chemistry between them getting steamier, Chayoung is still dead set on marrying an omega. Too bad he doesn't know Gyuha is not the beta he's pretending to be.

mangas.title: Tarou no Manimani
mangas.description: Taro is handsome, his gestures are cunning, and he's just so cute. I want to protect him...! But keeping a pet isn't "right," is it? "Taro, come live with me." A clumsy office lady who's obsessed with what's right and a good-for-nothing kept man live together in this strange romantic comedy.

mangas.title: One Shot One
mangas.description:
"I'm pregnant."
"Jeong-Won, I'm an omega…?"

Ye Jeong-Won, who has been like a real sibling to Lee Gyeon-Woo since they were young, appears in front of Lee Gyeon-Woo. The two have a one-night stand at a freshman welcome party while drunk, and Jeong-Won reveals that he is pregnant. Gyeon-Woo, an omega, is flustered because he has no memory of that night, but soon comes to his senses and says that he will take responsibility for Jeong-Won and the child. However, Jeong-Won smiles meaningfully when Gyeon-Woo tells him to come into his house.

'But hyung, I wish we could be together even if we don't have a child. Because the pregnancy story is a lie.'

mangas.title: Rabbits Don't Bite
mangas.description:
Standing nearly 190 cm tall, he had broad shoulders that drew people’s gaze and a solid chest that exuded a commanding presence.
Beom Tae-yoon was popular with everyone in his department, regardless of gender.

“Why do you run away whenever you see me? It makes me want to hunt you down.”

But whenever Ha-rin saw Beom Tae-yoon, her body would flinch with the urge to run away at once.
Whenever his intense gaze fell upon her, her whole body would freeze as if turned to ice, and she couldn’t move a muscle.

“Just as I thought. You really are a rabbit.”

A voice laced with a low chuckle drifted into her ear.

“Ah, no… Huh, no. Huh!”
“Don’t tell me it isn’t. But wait, there’s a tail sticking out here?”

He grabbed her fluffy tail without hesitation.

“Well then… shall we check it out?”

Beom Tae-yoon spat out the words, his voice cracking with excitement.

“They say rabbits pee in three seconds, don’t they?”

mangas.title: Elegant Aubrey
mangas.description: Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

mangas.title: Lend Me Some Sugar
mangas.description: After flunking the civil service exam, Kim Youngsoo spends his days working part-time at a pork cutlet restaurant, struggling to make ends meet. He plans to give the exam another shot down the line, but for now, his small moments of happiness in his mundane life come from treating the cute guy who drops by the restaurant to pork cutlets every now and again. Amidst the routine of his simple and peaceful life, an unexpected disruption arrives in the form of his neighbor, Lim Joongdo: a rude and conceited jerk who hurls insults at Youngsoo from the moment they meet. Frustrated and disheartened, Youngsoo chooses to just ignore Joongdo completely. But then...out of the blue, Joongdo does a complete 180 and starts acting all sugary and sweet. Did Joongdo genuinely have a change of heart, or is he sugarcoating his words to hide a bitter motive?

mangas.title: Caregiving Alliance
mangas.description:
"Sunshine Human". "The Beloved Youngest Daughter". "Hothouse Flower".

Thanks to her gentle, bright personality and an adorable appearance that wins over everyone she meets, Juwon has earned nicknames like those above and enjoys a vibrant, popular campus life. However, the reality is quite the opposite. Every day at sunset, the place she heads to is a nursing hospital on the outskirts of the city. There, she finds her mother — who is waiting for death — and herself: a short-tempered daughter caring for her. Juwon is currently maintaining a grueling double life to fulfill her mother's final wish: to be surrounded by plenty of people in her final days.

Meanwhile, in stark contrast to Juwon, there is Hangyeol — a student living as a total loner after returning to school. Despite his handsome looks, his intimidating aura and taciturn personality keep everyone at a distance, leaving him to lead a solitary college life. Then, one day... the two cross paths in a hospital room. And Hangyeol appears in the guise of a "Magical Girl" — clad in a loud, tight-fitting pink character T-shirt, sporting twin "apple-top" ponytails adorned with colorful hairpins, and even wielding a magic wand. It turns out that Hangyeol, just like Juwon, was there to care for a sick younger sister. Having stumbled upon each other's secrets — and simultaneously formed a "caregiving alliance" — the two embark on a precarious double life balancing their campus days with their caregiving duties!

mangas.title: Summoning a Demon With a Sign
mangas.description:
Cho-Ah, who was running a peaceful and ordinary cafe, gets summoned by a demon just by signing a bank statement. Jin-Hyeok, the demon who was summoned in an absurd manner, demands that Cho-Ah make a contract to receive his soul in exchange for giving him his life through sexual intercourse...

"If it's sexual intercourse... how far...?"

"Shall we check?"

The passionate life exchange with the mischievous demon and the sudden visit of the demons change her ordinary daily life completely!

mangas.title: I Asked My Sex Friend to Break Up
mangas.description:
"I won't have sex with you anymore."

A long-time sexual partner is about to end their relationship. I can't do this kind of relationship where I only have sex with the person I have a crush on.

mangas.title: The Octopus Game
mangas.description: Every Sunday, Hong-Joo and Chung play board games together. But the new Octopus Game Hong-Joo brings turns out to be adults-only. Embarrassing missions pop out, but they are forced to keep playing, thanks to an old pact, and what starts as a game quickly turns dangerously personal.

mangas.title: XXX Succubus Hunter XXX
mangas.description:
Nia, a succubus who only seeks sympathy. One day, she approaches Kwon Dong-Hae, a man who is more sympathetic than anyone else... But for some reason, she, a succubus, is conquered. After that night with Dong-Hae, Nia is not satisfied no matter how many nights she sleeps with, so she eventually goes to see Dong-Hae again…

Will Nia be able to conquer Dong-Hae?

mangas.title: The Succubus Wants to Be Naughty
mangas.synonyms: The Succubus Wants to be Lewd!
mangas.description: Cho-A is a succubus who sneaks into the human world with the hope of collecting enough life force to become human herself. Just when she reels in her first victim to consume, she becomes the one in trouble, as she ends up in the clutches of an archangel named Sa-Bin. But instead of immediately sending Cho-A back to the demon world, Sa-Bin offers to give the starved succubus exactly what she needs...!

mangas.title: Seriously, I'm Not a Succubus!
mangas.description: After a long job search, the demon 'Cream' finally passed the final interview as an intern for the contract team at Devi Corporation. She happily went to work for the first time, only to find that the contract team was nonexistent, and she ended up on an unexpected 'Sensual Encounter Team' due to employment fraud. Tasked with gathering energy from a certain priest, Cream, who had no choice but to enter his dream, starts to tempt him... "This is amazing, isn't it? It feels like the whole world is helping my desires." This man is no ordinary pervert! The thrilling physical struggle(?) between a priest faithful to his desires and a naive, clumsy demon! "Ah~ this dream is truly the best.”

mangas.title: Fill Me With Your Lust!
mangas.description: Jeong A-Yeong has been prone to getting possessed by spirits since she was little. But just when she thinks she’s been freed of her unwanted ghostly interactions, she breaks the protective talisman given to her by her shaman grandmother. Now left totally vulnerable, A-Yeong is quickly taken over by a new spirit. And this one gives her quite an appetite for desire, leaving A-Yeong hungry for the two closest men in her life, the Kwon brothers, Seo-Chan and Yi-Chan.

mangas.title: Someone Else's Oppa
mangas.synonyms: Brother From Another Family | The Other Younger Brother
mangas.description:
"She's not my girlfriend. You know I don't do relationships."

I've been seeing a lot of Kang Juno against my will for a long time now. Others say he's a sweet brother from another family, and my real brother says he's like our long-lost brother. Considering all that, Kang Juno really is like my blood brother. But it's not like he can talk to me about all sorts of things he did with a woman he's not even dating.

"Do it with me, too, then."

What's stopping him from doing it with me? He treats me well. He even smells nice. ... And I probably like him.

"I clearly tried reasoning with you. But you asked for this. I can't stop now."

mangas.title: Recipes for a Ravenous Succubus
mangas.description: It’s Baekyoung’s 10th day as a succubus and she’s hangry for a meal. As a matter of fact, she’s getting downright desperate. Of course, a gourmet meal would be preferred but at this point any man will do, she just needs some sustenance. Ah, that guy right there! He looks a little nerdy but he’ll do for now. But it turns out that this meal will be much juicier than Baekyoung ever anticipated and now she can’t get this human off of her mind. The ravenous succubus has found her perfect meal, now she just has to make him all hers!

mangas.title: Haunted Desire
mangas.description:
“Forget the haunting. From now on, your only job is to make me climax. Got it?”

Exhausted by endless overtime, Yeon-Hee’s love life is non-existent. Was picking up that discarded mattress on her way home drunk a mistake? Because ever since that night, a mysterious virgin ghost has been crawling into her bed, pinning her down. But behind his chilling aura lies a touch that’s unexpectedly searing. As his inexperienced yet persistent hands find her most sensitive spots, Yeon-Hee feels herself melting into a pleasure she’s never known before. Her initial terror soon shifts into a wicked anticipation. She decides it’s time to properly train this ‘useful’ spirit….

mangas.title: From Sandbox to Bed
mangas.description: After catching her fiancé cheating, all Seo-Ha wanted was to drink the pain away. Drunk and heartbroken, she shouted she'd sleep with another man too – only to wake up in a stranger’s room, in just her underwear. But the man isn’t a stranger at all… it is Do-Hyeon, her childhood friend turned longtime nemesis. What the hell is he doing here?

mangas.title: Milk My Strawberries
mangas.description: After spending a lifetime drinking an absurd amount of strawberry milk, Song Seol-Ah thought the worst she’d ever have to face was a stomachache. Until her chest started leaking the stuff, that is! As strange new urges overtake her body and mind, she tries to deal with it alone…until an ill-timed encounter with Kim Yushin, her childhood friend turned national medalist, throws everything into chaos. When he offers to help relieve her unbearable desire, she’s thrust into a dangerously sweet arrangement that’s quickly spiraling out of control.

mangas.title: His Rose-Colored XXX
mangas.description:
“How can it be that pink…?”

One accidental glance was all it took. Ever since catching a glimpse of her younger brother’s friend... down there, Yoo Eunha can’t look away from Seo Woogyum’s very rosy member. But when her guilty secret is exposed, Woogyum doesn’t back off. Oh no, he leans in.

"You’re the only one who’s seen my body, right? Don’t you think it’s only fair I see yours too?"

From one wrong look to a very, very wrong turn… things are about to get heated.

mangas.title: Yurameku Aki no Koigokoro
mangas.titleNative: ゆらめく秋の恋ごころ
mangas.description:
"I just want you to hold me, even if you're drunk... You don't have to say 'I love you'."

Igarashi, who works as a photographer, has a sex-friend relationship with the popular stylist, Shida, who only fucks him when he's drunk. The truth is, he's had an unrequited love for Shida ever since they were classmates in high school, but he'd rather just have the memories of holding him in his arms than confess his true feelings and be rejected. But Shida keeps whispering things like "I love you" and "You're so cute" in a casual tone...?

mangas.title: Love's Cream
mangas.titleNative: 이제 그만 내려가 주면 안 될까?
mangas.synonyms: Can't You Please Just Decrease Now?
mangas.description: Yun Si-Ho has one goal: to survive university without becoming one half of the school’s first official gay couple. But his best friend and classmate, Ji Seung-Hyeon, is making that impossible with his relentless, daily advances. Just as Si-Ho hits his breaking point, a mysterious app appears on his phone, claiming to show the "affection levels" of handsome men. Si-Ho sees his chance. He’ll use the app to systematically lower Seung-Hyeon’s feelings and finally get his peace! There’s just one problem: no matter what Si-Ho does, Seung-Hyeon’s meter keeps rising... and it’s not just his affection that’s standing tall.

mangas.title: Warrior's Afterlife
mangas.description:
A warrior who was slaughtered at the hands of his comrades after having saved the world from monsters, wakes up in an unknown world after his death.

After attaining a second chance at life, he vows to live his life in debauchery, but the way his savior gazes at him... is somewhat strange.

mangas.title: The Night of Awakening
mangas.description:
Mia has always been fascinated by kinky behavior. But because of her social status, appearance, and demeanor, no one is willing to talk to her about such things. Even the occasional flirtation she receives instinctively feels like an insult to her, so she ends up treating people harshly—only to regret it later—in a never-ending cycle. Realizing she can’t go on like this, Mia decides to seek out Claude, who is famous among women…

“Excuse me, I’m Mia Triang, and I’m here to win Claude over.”

mangas.title: The Neighboring Husband
mangas.description: When Ji-eun notices her husband's infidelity, she hides the fact and deceives herself by pretending to be happy with her empty family. However, when she was struggling to see her husband cooling down day by day, she witnessed the scene of her husband kissing his mistress with Seong-ho, who moved next door. "They say that the wind is forgotten by the wind, but isn't it better for me to be a cheating husband?" After that, she is swayed by the man next door, Seong-ho, who is getting closer...!

mangas.title: Love Recycling
mangas.description:
Lim Mun-Yeong runs into his high school first love, Yeon Hae-Jeong, in an unexpected place. And not just anywhere—as an executive at a major corporation and a janitor at that same company. It’s been ten years since he gave up on his unrequited love. Whether Hae-Jeong recognized Mun-Yeong, who was hiding his name and pretending not to know him or not, Hae-Jeong drags him around, making him do odd jobs under all sorts of childish pretexts. Although Hae-Jeong’s strange behavior, as if he somehow remembered him, made him uncomfortable, Mun-Yeong didn’t care because he no longer had any feelings for him.

“You don’t still like me, do you, Lim Mun-Yeong?”

That is, until he heard those words from Hae-Jeong.

mangas.title: At the End of Resentment, Pure Love Remains
mangas.synonyms: The End of Spite Is Pure Love
mangas.description:
Seo Yu-ju, the owner of Café Sallang, is kind to everyone in the world—except for the Do family.
Do Kang-hyun, the fourth-generation heir to a conglomerate, is a devil with a kind heart.

Kang-hyun, who went to acquire a painting by an unknown artist at his grandfather’s request, and Yu-ju, who was determined not to let anyone take the painting her grandmother had created, crossed paths.

“Why do you hate me?”

Faced with Yu-ju’s cold shoulder, Kang-hyun changes his plan to simply buy the painting and leave, and seizes the opportunity to even make his way into her home.

“Hey, Do Kang-hyun. Just because my hand touched you a little…”
“My hand touched you a little? You were kneading my body like dough, and you’re saying it was just a little touch?”
“When did I ever knead you like dough—”
“You did! Seo Yu-ju, with your own hands, to your heart’s content!”

Not a single day passes peacefully under the same roof.

Until these sworn enemies become each other’s one and only.
A story where petulance turns into interest, and ultimately leads to true love.

mangas.title: The Mouse Caught the Dragon's Tail
mangas.synonyms: A Mouse Biting a Dragon's Tail RSS Feed
mangas.description: After being thrown out into the streets at age 18, orphan Larin takes shelter at Saltator Manor and poses as a distant relative. Soon, she finds herself whisked away to the imperial palace, substituting for her adoptive sister as the emperor's new concubine. But Larin's noble disguise is not enough to hide her street rat past, and the imperial family threatens to have her killed for deceit. With the emperor vowing to protect Larin through marriage, can the pair overcome their doomed fate?

mangas.title: Before the Flowers Wither
mangas.description:
The sole legitimate heir of the Hwasin Group. Jung E-Geon. He's sick of his family trying to marry him off to the girl who saved his life as a child. But his interest lies elsewhere—in Ha Yeon-Ju, the family's secret and shame. The shadow-like Ha Yeon-Ju begins to irritate him. He proposed a contract relationship to deceive his family, using her, but finds himself increasingly fixated on her…

“I suppose I was the one who wavered. Not you, Ha Yeon-Ju.”

The man, leaning on the table with his chin resting on his hand, frowned and smiled bitterly.

“So, let's date. Ha Yeon-Ju.”

mangas.title: Their Obsession Will Ruin Me
mangas.description: I woke up in a strange place, with only a phone to guide me. To recover my memories and return home, I had to raise my targets’ affection levels and unlock a special ending. But once a target has over five hearts, it triggers overheat—and a dangerous, unhinged ending awaits. It's a delicate balance!

mangas.title: The Beast I Chose
mangas.description:
Viola, living alone in a remote countryside, accidentally rescues and treats a badly wounded man named Caliban. The two feel an inexplicable attraction accompanied by a sweet scent, leading to a passionate first night together... Afterwards, Caliban suddenly vanishes without a trace. Left alone, unaware of Caliban's whereabouts, Viola leaves her hometown to seek work as a maid. In the basement of her new workplace, she discovers Caliban, imprisoned in the form of a beast…

A tale of fated love disguised as chance—between the ‘Calibans’, a monstrous clan with latent beastly instincts, and Viola, the half-human who alone can calm them.

mangas.title: Copy-Paste Romance
mangas.description: 24-year-old web novel writer Yeong Won isn’t interested in love, but she can’t help admiring her roommate’s handsome boyfriend, Mu-Il Shin. But Mu-Il suddenly dies, and Yeong receives a mysterious package containing a robot vacuum. The vacuum introduces itself as an AI copy of Mu-Il, and claims that he was murdered. Now, Yeong must navigate life with a digital version of the one man she couldn’t resist, as she’s pulled into a mystery far stranger and more personal than any of her novels.

mangas.title: Give Me a Pat
mangas.synonyms: Bang Wo Pai Pai | Pat Me Please
mangas.description:
Amidst the chaos of a shattered life, Yu Zhou faces a crisis: discouragement that threatens her career as a writer. Everything seems to be falling apart — until an unexpected encounter changes her course. Xiang Wan, a mysterious and resilient woman who claims to have traveled back in time from Imperial China, appears in her life as a breath of hope.

With her ancestral courage and peculiar vision of the modern world, she helps Yu Zhou find the strength to move forward. However, fate has another surprise in store: Yu Zhou's literary work is adapted into an audio drama, and the protagonist chosen to give voice to the story is none other than Su Chang, her ex-girlfriend. The reunion of the two rekindles dormant memories and feelings, creating a delicate emotional triangle.

mangas.title: If It's Remorse You Desire
mangas.description: Catherine Caliburn, a duke’s daughter marked by tainted blood, desperately tries to end her engagement to Grand Duke Deimos Pendragon to keep her true origins a secret, but the Grand Duke has no intention of letting her go as he seeks revenge for her betrayal in his past life.

mangas.title: This Wretched Junior
mangas.description:
“An office romance where you find yourself hopelessly entangled with the exact type of junior colleague you hate.”

Han Song-I, who, despite her outstanding work performance, constantly has her credit stolen by a clique within her team. But another source of stress arises for her. Kim Ji-Hun, a hopelessly unprofessional rookie who’s been a thorn in her side since his first day on the job. When Ji-Hun moves into Song-I’s neighborhood, the two start running into each other more often. In the process, Ji-Hun helps Song-I get rid of her clingy ex-boyfriend and even takes down a man she considered her sworn enemy. As a result, Song-I begins to develop a personal fondness for Ji-Hun…

Is romance even possible with a junior colleague who’s as stubborn as a dog—biting when provoked and turning fierce when you try to protect her?

mangas.title: Becoming Best Friends With the Icy Male Lead
mangas.synonyms: Becoming Bestfriends With the Cold Male Lead
mangas.description: After meeting a sad death as a Korean teenager in her past life, nothing could be better than being reincarnated as Livia Hote, a beloved princess of the fire kingdom. A life of only luxury and peace awaited her as the novel's supporting character. However, she eventually realizes that she must learn to control her ever-growing fire powers and she can only do so with the prince of the ice kingdom. Thus, Livia will now have to deal with new uncertainties and relationships that could disrupt her plans to live a peaceful new life…

mangas.title: Dear Anonymous Benefactor
mangas.description: Judith, a war orphan with supernatural powers, survives thanks to an anonymous benefactor. He showers her with gifts but never replies. When she finally receives a reply, she travels to meet him. But who is her benefactor out of the charming rogue, successful businessman, and snarky gang leader?

mangas.title: Soul Sealer's School Life
mangas.synonyms: Sealed Special Eugenics, Feng Ling Te Yousheng
mangas.description: Qin Jing can’t remember when he first realized it, but it seems that everyone who falls for him ends up being targeted by misfortune. So Qin Jing came up with a plan: by acting cold and cruel when they confessed their feelings, he always managed to push them away and keep them safe from his “curse.” But… why doesn’t this strategy seem to work on the new transfer student? With Qi Yu—a mysterious boy who has just arrived at the school—misfortune strikes far more violently than it ever did with the others. What will Qin Jing have to come up with this time to protect him too?

mangas.title: Lost in the Cloud
mangas.description: Ha-Neul has a secret hobby: taking photos of his crush, Chan-Il. But when Hyeon-Un stumbles upon Ha-Neul's cloud storage with its impressive collection of Chan-Il's photos, things escalate pretty quickly. At first confident his secret is safe with Hyeon-Un, Ha-Neul continuously finds himself in compromising situations, making him question Hyeon-Un's true motives.

mangas.title: Blue Monster's Shell
mangas.description:
The Monster Who Fell in Love with Its Prey, and the Child Who Fell in Love with That Monster.

A blue-gray monster born in the forest. He discovers a child abandoned in his territory and brings it to his lair. Not to care for it—but to devour it. The child, Fernin, survived under that monster. Years later, the grown child stands before the monster once more... The monster who came to love the child that was its prey, and the child who grew fond of such a monster. Time begins to flow again for the two reunited after over a decade.

mangas.title: No Reverse Harem for the Demon Lord
mangas.titleNative: 魔王様は逆ハーレムが嫌い
mangas.synonyms: The Demon Lord Hates Reverse Harem
mangas.description: After nine thousand years in the demon realm, Horang Baek returns to Earth as the Demon Lord and reunites with her only surviving family member. Time amongst demons taught her to act swiftly without mercy, but looking monstrous to her brother scares her more than death. As Horang reacquaints herself with earthly customs, she finds one thing hasn’t changed–random guys throwing themselves at her. And if she thinks any left behind in the demon realm are history, she’s in for a surprise.

mangas.title: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity
mangas.synonyms: A Quiet and Crazy Winter Cabin
mangas.description: Roelle’s life has been nothing but tragic at the hands of her abusive family. But the worst tragedy of all occurs when she kills her cousin after he tries to take advantage of her. In order to avoid being put to death for the murder, Roelle runs away deep into the winter forest, where she encounters the lone Kayden in his cabin. When Kayden allows Roelle to stay with him for a while, the hopeless cold quickly turns into passionate heat. Will this cabin become Roelle’s haven? Or will it be the start of a new hell?

mangas.title: The Cruelty of Atonement
mangas.description:
From the moment she set foot on a foreign continent, Seo-ah was given no respite. With just a single “key” in her hand, her life is thrown into a world of endless pursuit and threats.
And then there is Oscar Reinhardt, a man who desperately wants that key. Known for his coldness and cruelty, he was wary of Seo-ah from the start, but at some point, the look in his eyes begins to change subtly. A relationship where they must use each other to survive. Yet as they spend more time together, their hatred and obsession transform into an inexplicable attraction.

A dangerous contract, an uneasy coexistence. Political conspiracies that could erupt at any moment, and forbidden emotions that slowly spread. The shadow of yet another person looms over them, further unsettling their hearts.

The closer they get to the hidden truth, the deeper their doubts grow—and the more inescapable their fatal fascination becomes.

At the end of this tangled web of hatred and love, atonement and betrayal, who will ultimately survive?

mangas.title: The Idol Is Obsessed with Me
mangas.synonyms: An Idol Is Obsessed With Me
mangas.description:
“What if a harmless, big-dog-like idol turned into a predatory, obsessive guy?”

Haruna is a perfectionist office worker who has always lived her life on a set path. When she runs into Seo Ha-Ru, a top Korean idol fleeing a stalker, she mistakes him for just another “good-looking bar employee”!

“You're the first woman who hasn't recognized me.”

A series of mishaps begins with this ridiculous misunderstanding. She thought it was over, but then their phones get swapped, and he even moves in next door?!

On stage, he’s a genius superstar who captivates the whole world. But in front of me, he’s a harmless puppy of a younger man who follows me around like a shadow.

However, when another man starts hanging around Haruna, the gentle giant’s gaze begins to change...

The harmless younger man’s dark transformation—the unleashed predator’s relentless obsession begins!

mangas.title: The Serpent's Shaman
mangas.description: After suffering frightening spiritual symptoms, Park Sin-Wu undergoes a shamanic ritual and meets Bi-Yeon, the spirit he’s destined to serve. Bi-Yeon is beautiful, demanding, oddly affectionate… and insists that their “union” is the only way to protect Sin-Wu. But as Bi-Yeon grows clingier and Sin-Wu’s doubts deepen, he can’t tell if this god is his guardian or something far more dangerous.

mangas.title: Pick Up Love
mangas.description:
Meet Leo, a stray cat who accidentally picks up an abandoned dog, Milky.

To avoid a bad reputation from the other stray cats, Leo teaches Milky how to survive in the streets... But can he keep his cool through Milky's adorable demeanor?

mangas.title: Love Drop
mangas.description: Campus couple Sung-Eun and Tan. Fed up with Tan's macho act, Sung-Eun breaks up with him, and contrary to his usual demeanor, Tan ends up shedding tears. Sung-Eun's heart wavers at Tan's unexpected side…

mangas.title: A Friend's Tiddies are a Burden to an Otaku
mangas.description:
Lee Jung, who has long harbored a secret crush on his childhood friend and track athlete, Lim Yui. Having braced himself for their gradual drifting apart after entering university, Yui suddenly confesses that milk is coming out of his chest... And now he wants me to give him a massage too?!?

“Well then, I'll be counting on you, Jung-Ah!”

For someone who's lived his whole life as an otaku, a friend's chest is overwhelming!!

mangas.title: Comfort Rewinder
mangas.description: By a strange twist of fate, Jin Yi Kwon, a photographer in need of a part-time assistant, ends up hiring Beom Jisoo, his first love. The two meet in a café after 13 years but instead of the tiny and adorable Beom Jisoo Jin Yi Kwon fell in love with, a muscular hunk shows up. Unlike Jin Yi Kwon who immediately recognizes Beom Jisoo, Beom Jisoo doesn’t seem to remember Jin Yi Kwon. What will happen to these two? Will Jin Lee Kwon finally confess his feelings towards Beom Jisoo after all these years?

mangas.title: Blessings to the Outcasts
mangas.description: Jonak is on his way to find a fabled dragon god said to aid humans so that he can save the village that he comes from. Finally, as Jonak stands before the god, Adain, he asks only for Jonak's body in exchange. The dragon god known to many as a tragic and passionate has come to be quite high and mighty in attitude... and Jonak is now his mate...?!

mangas.title: Ookii Kimi ga Ichiban Kawaii
mangas.titleNative: おおきいきみがいちばんかわいい
mangas.synonyms: The Giant is Super Cute!, Your Large Body Makes You The Cutest

mangas.title: Swolemates: Toying with the Buff Newbie
mangas.synonyms: Sex Toys: How to Educate Newcomers with Big Breasts
mangas.description: Lee Hyeon-Seo had only just started working at a small company that sells sex toys when he was faced with a crisis. The sex toy tester suddenly quit and there was no one to fill his position. Hyeon-Seo was asked to take over the job, but there’s one big problem- Hyeon-Seo’s still a virgin! Luckily, Hyeon-Seo happens to know Jang Seong-Ho, a rising star in the gay porn industry, who is willing to show him the ropes.

mangas.title: Hidden Beneath His Wings
mangas.synonyms: Underneath His Wings, The One Under The Wing
mangas.description: Lee Junghyuk, an incubus, relies on vitality obtained through intimate encounters in people's dreams to survive. However, past trauma has left him emotionally numb, suffering from sexual anhedonia until he meets Yoo Seohee. Their chance encounter at a club leads to an unexpectedly fulfilling night together. Yet, as Junghyuk discovers Seohee's reputation as a notorious playboy at their university, he questions whether their connection can evolve beyond mere partners…

mangas.title: The Demon Leader’s Lover
mangas.description: Born under the ominous sign of "Ultimate Yang Obstruction," Dang Soun faced a turbulent life from the outset, destined to die before the age of thirty. Abandoned by his father and orphaned, he endures harsh conditions, resorting to begging and eventually gambling for survival. Despite narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions, Soun's fate takes a drastic turn when he is suddenly informed by his long-lost father and younger brother that he will become the concubine of the Demonic Sect. With his life constantly in jeopardy, survival becomes Soun's sole focus, even if it means becoming the Demonic Sect's Leader's concubine for a chance at a peaceful end.

mangas.title: Kiss Me if You Can
mangas.description:
"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

mangas.title: Electric Reverse Love
mangas.description:
