For years, Park Ji-Woon has been quietly in love with Kang Soo-Hyuk. Soo-Hyuk notices Ji-Woon’s feelings and begins to use him like a toy, indulging his own desires without restraint. As long as he can stay close to Soo-Hyuk, Ji-Woon tells himself that being used is better than nothing. But Soo-Hyuk’s cold and careless treatment slowly wears him down. Then one day, Ji-Woon receives a mysterious package. Inside the box, he finds a strange cord and a note. Taking it as his last hope, he decides to try using the cord on Soo-Hyuk. From that moment on, something feels different.

“Trash like you deserves to be punished and taught a lesson. So obey me.”

mangas.title: Tied to You
mangas.synonyms: The Use of a Necktie, Purpose of the Tie
mangas.description: Inha has lived a carefree life, dating his way through his youth and breaking hearts in his wake. Nowadays, though, he can't be quite as carefree when he's working an ordinary office job under a stiflingly strict boss, Sun-woong. Inha is convinced that his boss is cold as ice, right until he witnesses Sun-woong in a compromising position out in public. Turns out, Sun-woong likes it hot and rough. However, when Inha tries to use this to his advantage, it backfires spectacularly in a way he never expected. Farewell, carefree days! Now, Inha is about to be tied down in more ways than one…

mangas.title: The Sword-Bearing Flower
mangas.description:
Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Forgotten Field
mangas.description:
"I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead."

Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point....

mangas.title: Be a Bad Boy!
mangas.description: Su-Yeon has a weakness for bad boys, a lingering habit from her toxic ex, Hui-Ju. While her current boyfriend, Je-Hyeon, is sweet and gentle, Su-Yeon feels a strange sense of dissatisfaction. When Hui-Ju suddenly reappears as her new team leader, Su-Yeon makes an impulsive wish—and the impossible happens. Overnight, Je-Hyeon transforms into the edgy bad boy of her dreams. But there's a twist: when she arrives at work the next day, her "bad boy" ex has turned into a perfect gentleman. Between her bad boyfriend and good ex, Su-Yeon's life gets complicated.

mangas.title: I'm a Homebody, but I Transmigrated Into a Dark Captivity Novel
mangas.synonyms: ひきこもりは優雅な監禁ライフを守りたい
mangas.description:
After dying from overwork, a woman is reincarnated as April Salt, a minor character forced to serve the demanding princess. Doomed to another life of endless labor, her fate changes when she is accidentally kidnapped by the undeniably handsome Grand Duke Kaian Braille. Instead of dying again, she is confined in luxury, with every need met. What should be a prison starts feeling like paradise. If only everyone would stop bothering her and let her do nothing!

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Diana's Dearest Is the Family's Favorite
mangas.titleNative: 막내 공녀의 총애를 독차지했더니, 모두 내게 집착한다
mangas.synonyms: Everyone Was Obsessed With Me After I Became the Youngest Princess' Favorite
mangas.description: After traveling back in time, Lia finds herself in the orphanage where she spent her childhood just before Diana, the lost daughter of Duke Ellad, arrives. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

mangas.title: For Your Perfect Ending
mangas.description: After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending. But to her shock, she meets Haewon Lee, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon's kindness-- so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew-- Haewon hides his true intentions, carefully shaping himself into someone Sum would love. What awaits them in the future?

mangas.title: IDOL x IDOL STORY!
mangas.synonyms: アイドル×アイドル ストーリー！
mangas.description:
Meet Mimi, a college grad working part-time at a convenience store. Once an aspiring idol, she abandoned her dream when her group failed to make it big. Enter Ibuki, a rising star inspired by Mimi's past. Their unexpected encounters reignite Mimi's passion for the spotlight. Together, they decide to audition for a high-stakes idol competition show. Can they achieve their dreams and forge an unbreakable bond, or will the intense rivalry tear them apart?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Her Merry Obsession
mangas.description: For two blissful years, So-Ryung's world revolved around her husband—until he vanished without a trace. In her search for answers, she learns the heartbreaking truth that he was never hers to begin with. But she's not about to let him slip away, even if he is a black ops agent with a hundred faces…

mangas.title: The Cruelty of Salvation
mangas.description:
Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations. Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family's popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: One Husband is Enough
mangas.description:
A girl who has been alone her whole life stumbles upon a VR fantasy dating simulator that allows her to be who she always wanted to be — someone loved by everyone. She chooses a character named Crocetta Gaetani, who grew up neglected by others just like her. Now she's stuck permanently in the video game world until she can win over one of the game's male leads and beat the game. Will Crocetta be able to marry one of the male leads and finally return to her reality, or will she be stuck in this VR nightmare forever?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The 100 Curses of Illeston Manor
mangas.description: A hungry tree, a shapeshifting rat, and a forgotten boy... These are just three of the 100 curses that haunt Illeston Manor. House Illeston thinks they'll be plagued by their curses forever until Simone the necromancer shows up to break them. All she asks for in return is a lavish life and protection from anyone who might harm her. But with every ghoul she defeats, Simone realizes that the true dangers lie within the manor itself. Can Simone save House Illeston? Or will she die trying...?

mangas.title: Pawprints on Her Heart
mangas.titleNative: 악녀 언니를 구하러 온 용감한 강아지입니다
mangas.synonyms: I'm The Brave Puppy That Will Save The Villainess
mangas.description: When Coco dies after five happy years with her owner Chloe, she thinks her tail-wagging days are over. But Coco can't bear to stay in the afterlife as she watches Chloe's world crumble. Taking pity on her, the Puppy God grants Coco's wish to return. Now, she's a human child who gets adopted into Chloe's family. Unfortunately, she discovers that reaching Chloe's heart is harder than any trick she's ever learned. Can she fetch the joy Chloe has lost, or has their bond slipped away like a leash?

mangas.title: A Bride's Story
mangas.description: A Bride’s Story tells the tale of a beautiful young bride in nineteenth-century Asia. At the age of twenty, Amir is sent to a neighboring town to be wed. But her surprise at learning her new husband, Karluk, is eight years younger than her is quickly replaced by a deep affection for the boy and his family. Though she hails from just beyond the mountains, Amir’s clan had very different customs, foods, and clothes from what Karluk is used to. As the two of them learn more about each other through their day-to-day lives, the bond of respect and love grows stronger.

mangas.title: Your Ryan
mangas.description: In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

mangas.title: Anything But Marriage, Mr. Villain!
mangas.synonyms: Hidden Villain, I'll Do Everything for You Except Marriage!
mangas.description: How is the reincarnated heroine supposed to survive as Enrica, a powerless noble lady who gets killed by her archduke husband on her wedding night? Fortunately, a mysterious but kind Count Belbrington hears Enrica's plight, suggests that she find another man to marry, and even says yes to her following proposal! Everything seems strangely smooth sailing from there. Not only is Enrica's power-hungry father surprisingly cool with her marrying a man of lower status, but the murderous archduke isn't retaliating at her for breaking off their engagement, either. Something's not adding up, but what could it be...?

mangas.title: Destined To Be an Outcast
mangas.description: As a fellow aspiring saint with healing powers, Belze spent her whole childhood being compared to the ever-so-perfect Diana. So when offered the chance to expose her rival's family for treason, she doesn't think twice... But it all turns out to be a trap that only gets herself and her benevolent sponsor framed and executed! Luckily, she's given a second shot: She wakes up at the age of 5 again, determined to repay her benefactors this time. But turning a new leaf is easier said than done...

mangas.title: Behind His Kind Mask
mangas.synonyms: If You Remove the Kind Protagonist's Mask
mangas.description: As the #1 stalker of Pope Ulysses, the kind male lead, Yoidel was to be executed for her crimes. Just minutes before her end, Yoidel escapes her cell to ask Ulysses for help, only to come across a bloody madman... who turns out to be the male lead himself! In a desperate attempt to survive, Yoidel binds herself to him in a magical contract, dooming the two to share their lives and deaths. Now stuck with a two-faced psycho, will Yoidel find a way to break their bond before it breaks her?

mangas.title: Shards of a Broken Glass Slipper
mangas.synonyms: Shards of a Broken Glass Slipper
mangas.description:
Siché lost everything to her stepsister, Roena. Love, reputation, and family all shattered like a broken glass slipper. She was framed as Cinderella's evil stepsister, hated for merely existing in high society. Her resentful last words should have been the end of her suffering... But the reality was far more devastating. Siché had traveled back in time to the day she met Roena. This time, Siché will quench her thirst for vengeance. After all, the glass slippers were never meant for her anyway.

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: A Wicked Husband
mangas.description: When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew—he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

mangas.title: This Wasn't in My Adoption Plan!
mangas.synonyms: I Found a Family That Wasn't in My Adoption Plan
mangas.description:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno's mess only to be murdered by him? Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she's horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she's determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Duchess in Ruins
mangas.description: Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus' maid?

mangas.title: I Became the Squirrel That Saves the Villain
mangas.synonyms: I Became a Squirrel Seeking for the Villain
mangas.description:
Of all the things to wake up as, a squirrel is the last thing she expected. Sure, she's technically a divine beast from a novel, but she's a squirrel all the same. Determined to make the best of it, Momo—Inky—whatever her name is now—gets to work. And while she thought a little kindness would be enough to keep Yohan from villainy, she didn't think it would lead to a new human life as Yurika, a caring family, love... or the kind of secrets that could change everything the world has ever known.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Duke's Obsession With His Wife
mangas.description:
Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem
mangas.synonyms: I Saved You, but I'm Not Responsible
mangas.description:
After being cast out as a child over suspicions of illegitimacy, Perrianne was adopted by the queen of the neighboring kingdom and has been her loyal spy ever since. She's very happy with her new life when she suddenly hears perplexing news: Duke Exer's long-lost daughter has finally returned... except that's supposed to be her! Tasked with unmasking the imposter posing as herself, she's determined to just get the job done and get out of there. But will her family let her go so easily this time?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Sheltering Eaves
mangas.description:
At the age of ten, Yoru was sent to live in a children's home due to abuse from her mother. Tenjaku, a boy who is the same age, takes Yoru under his wing. Now in their second year of high school, Yoru and Tenjaku only have a year left before they must leave the children's home.



From the creator of Perfect World, this story follows a pure romance that has blossomed in an unfair and cruel world as it explores Japanese society's treatment of those who are most innocent.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Miss Pendleton
mangas.description:
If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid's arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city's finest matchmaker. When Laura's self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: All for My Dearest Juliet
mangas.description: Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered?

mangas.title: Must the Reincarnated Mother Always Die?
mangas.description:
Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. However, her mission's greatest obstacle is her new husband, Emperor Helio. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. Thus begins the battle of wills between wife and husband. Will Lilliana be able to defy destiny and Helio's affections?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Onee-chan no Midori-kun
mangas.description:
Sui doesn't like her older sister's boyfriend, Midori-kun. She was annoyed by his attitude, always making fun of her and treating her like a child. But in the winter of her last year of junior high, her mom asked him to help tutor her for her high school entrance exam...?



(Source: Betsuma, translated)

mangas.title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
mangas.synonyms: The Male Leads Trapped in My House
mangas.description:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she's determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Price Is Your Everything
mangas.description:
Transported back to her first academy days, Nerys Truydd revisits a life marred by betrayal and torment. Exploited and poisoned by her own family and husband, her demise was met with a vow to curse those who wronged her. Now granted a second chance, Nerys vows to rewrite her fate. As she navigates her past, memories of those who hurt her flood back. Determined and fueled by retribution, she seeks to reclaim all she lost. Can she overturn her tragic past and emerge victorious from the shadows of her betrayal?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
mangas.description:
Konoha Satou has a dark history. After all, she spent her teen years writing self-indulgent fantasy romance fics-like her Dark History. But since she's become its most despicable villainess, remembering every last detail is now a matter of life-and-death. Having avoided the first couple of death flags, Satou's suddenly left in the dark when a mysterious stranger returns from the Lily Kingdom-a character she doesn't recall writing in the original script. Although Yomi claims to be her ally, can Satou really trust a character she knows nothing about in such a dangerous world?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be
mangas.synonyms: The Villainous Family Is Against Independence
mangas.description: A distant echo from a life long-forgotten; shattered shards of an ominous future. When her late mother's heirloom pendant is broken, Elodie Perdia regains the memories of Ga-Eul Yun, a girl from our world who realizes she's landed in the body of a villainess from a fantasy novel. In the story, Elodie serves as the dark foil to the virtuous heroine and is destined for an early grave – a dark fate that can perhaps be avoided with Ga-Eul's knowledge of future events!

mangas.title: Magical Girl Dandelion
mangas.titleNative: 魔法少女ダンデライオン
mangas.description:
Magical girls and villains are enemies, but can neophyte Tanpopo's bond with the villain Shade topple that destiny?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: The Archduke's Adopted Saint
mangas.synonyms: A Saint Who Was Adopted by the Grand Duke
mangas.description: After being abused, tortured, and exploited by her best friend Lavienne for 14 lifetimes, Saint Dinah swears to get revenge. And luckily for her, she manages to capture the attention of Archduke Tersia, who adopts and renames her "Esther" to honor his late wife's wishes. With her new status and knowledge of Lavienne's true nature, Esther embarks on the long journey toward vengeance. But will she succeed? Or will her 15th life meet its demise due to Lavienne's greed?

mangas.title: It Takes More than a Pretty Face to Fall in Love
mangas.titleNative: 顔だけじゃ好きになりません
mangas.synonyms: 只靠臉的話才不會喜歡上你呢
mangas.description:
A high-speed romantic comedy featuring a senior with dangerously good looks and an incredibly resilient junior with a serious face fetish!



Sana, a fan of the influencer Kanato, who is rumored to attend the same high school, finally encounters him only to find out he's on the verge of expulsion! Determined to prevent this, Sana takes on the role of managing his social media. From holding hands to hugs and almost kisses... Days filled with an excessive supply of sweet thrills beyond his handsome face are about to begin.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Unintentionally Ideal Adopted Daughter
mangas.synonyms: I Played the Role of the Adopted Daughter Too Well
mangas.description:
Transmigrating into the main character of your favorite book sounds like a dream come true, but knowing Viola Vellatoux grows to be disappointed in her ending, Arin Han sets out to rewrite the story. However, her adoptive family will not hesitate to assassinate one another in their fight for control. The new Viola needs to use her wits to convince everyone that she has what it takes while remaining true to her goal. Further complicating her schemes, the male lead looks eerily familiar and has a strange effect on her when she gets too close.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Regina Rena: To the Unforgiven
mangas.description: Rena Rubel is a beautiful woman who has faced her share of hardships, as she was offered as a sacrifice by her own father, Marquis Rubel. She manages to survive and one day encounters a man named Lin, who belatedly discovers she is a powerful warrior who can hold her own. Rena gifts him with the elusive altar stone, and he promises to pay her back. They agree to meet again, and she continues to travel with her maid Yuni, seeking her father for his sins of the past. Can he be forgiven?

mangas.title: The Duke's Darling Daughter-in-Law
mangas.synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Duke's Adopted Daughter-In-Law
mangas.description:
When an accident shows Ellie what bullying the male lead, Damian, would do to her in the future, she tries to stay away from him at all costs. But after seeing everyone else mistreat the poor boy, she decides to protect him until he meets Duke Schuetz, his future adoptive father. However, there's one thing Ellie doesn't expect when she helps them reunite: the duke's offer to bring her with them as his daughter-in-law! How will this new plot twist change her fate and the course of the story?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: My Girlfriend's Child
mangas.description:
Sachi and her boyfriend Takara are a young couple in high school. They go to school together, hang out, and even engage in the more intimate side of dating. However, after a recent evening of sex, Sachi gets the feeling that something isn't right and buys a pregnancy test. Later, in the bathroom of a family restaurant far from her home, she sees the two red lines that will change her life forever.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Nina the Starry Bride
mangas.description:
Nina had a rough start to life, stealing to survive—and eventually being sold into slavery by her own brother. But to her surprise, her captor, Prince Azure, ordained that she would live the life of a princess...specifically, that of the recently deceased princess-priestess, Alisha. But despite her changing fortune, Nina won't give up her old life without a fight...and Azure might just be the one to finally match her wits. But how much can she trust Azure? And can she stop the feelings budding in her heart, knowing she must eventually marry another...?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Won the 46th Annual Kodansha Manga Award for Best Shoujo Manga.

mangas.title: I Became a Doting Father
mangas.synonyms: I Become a Fool When It Comes to My Daughter
mangas.description:
24-year-old Juwon Lee works part-time at a convenience store and lives alone in his small apartment. One day his uncle passes away and leaves behind a 4-year-old daughter, the cute little Yeondu. Instead of letting her be sent to an orphanage, Juwon steps up and decides to be her new guardian.



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting
mangas.description:
Kirishima Tooru is the right-hand man of the Sakuragi crime family. For him, the job is a perfect excuse to let his violent instincts run wild, earning him the nickname "the Demon of Sakuragi". It seems like nothing will stand in the way of his vicious nature.

But then one day, he receives an assignment like never before from the boss—babysitting his daughter!

This is the heartwarming (or is it bloodcurdling?) story of a little girl and her yakuza caretaker!

(Source: Kaiten Books)

mangas.title: Song of the Long March
mangas.synonyms: Chang Ge Xing, The Chinese Princess
mangas.description:
Chang An in the Tang Dynasty of China (618-907): The demon star is passing through the sky, clamity is about to befall the Tang Dynasty - because of a woman.

The story is set in early Tang Dynasty, after the Xuanwu Gate Incident, in which Li Shimin the prince of Qin, killed the crown prince and usurped the throne soon after. It is under such background that our female protagonist set out to discard her former identities and seek revenge against the most powerful man in her world.

Note: This story was put on hiatus on March 2016. The author's contract with SUMMERZOO ended in Sept 2017 and she has since founded her own studio. Until she is able to get the rights back to Chang Ge Xing (and Zi Bu Yu), she won't continue publishing it, but she has promised and reassured that it lives on somehow.

mangas.title: My Little Secret With the Demon Lord
mangas.description:
"Aunt, when I grow up… will you marry me?" No… No way! The kid was already thinking about making her his wife, but she is a minor immortal from the Immortal Yin World. She could not get together with a young human boy, no matter how ordinary she was. Yet, 500 years later, she was sent to congratulate the Yang Demon World's young lord, Li Ye on his wedding. Wait a minute, the young lord looks familiar. Also, that woman he's marrying is the physical body she left behind in the human world. To make things worse, he did not recognize her, and was trying to get her killed… Should she tell him the truth and clobber the brat's handsome and immaculate face?



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Honey Lemon Soda
mangas.description:
Middle school left Uka Ishimori with nothing but scars—to the point where she's forgotten how to laugh or cry or even say "hello." But a chance reencounter with a boy with lemon-colored hair invigorates her, giving her hope that maybe, just maybe, life can be that much sweeter if she finally reaches out for help.



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Nominated for the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shoujo Category in 2021.

mangas.title: Shadows House
mangas.description:
In the depths of a murky mansion lives a group of enigmatic nobles known as...the Shadow family. With no visible features to speak of, these mysterious aristocrats employ living dolls to act as their "faces." Kate and Emilico are one such pair of mistress and servant, dwelling in their own little world and learning from each other bit by bit with every new day. But in a house of locked doors, living according to rules from no apparent source—how long can their blissfully peaceful existence truly last...?




(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Daifuku-chan to Ouji-sama
mangas.titleNative: 大福ちゃんと王子さま
mangas.description: For the first time, 19-year-old Setoya Kinari is striking out on her own, swapping life in the countryside for the bright city lights of Tokyo before her first semester of college begins. She has a few goals for her new life. Among them is goal one: move into the rowdy but lovable Kitten Blue Boarding House. Goal two: find a new love in Tokyo. But this boarding house has one problem—an extremely hot resident named Towa who totally mistakes her for a stalker. Yikes!

mangas.title: Maou no Migiude ni Natta no de Gensaku Kaiaku Shimasu
mangas.titleNative: 魔王の右腕になったので原作改悪します
mangas.synonyms: Maou no Migiude ni Nattanode Gensaku Kaiaku Shimasu
mangas.description: Office lady falls from a building is reincarnated into another world and ends up at the Devil Kings castle. Can she save him from the bad ending?

mangas.title: Mahoujin Chrono Canon
mangas.description:
Karino, a girl who had been imprisoned, was finally allowed out into the world where magic was the norm. Karino possessed magic power, but she didn't know the proper incantations. So she enrolled in a magic academy with Touma, the boy who rescued her, in order to learn how to use her magic.



(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Revenge on the Real One
mangas.description:
Ever since Helga Yutrit found out that she was switched at birth with her half-sister, she has tried her best to shake off the stigma of being a fake by building up her reputation as the perfect daughter of House Yutrit. Helga's efforts all go to waste, though, when her half-sister Hillianne is discovered alive. Now that the real daughter has returned to take her rightful place, Helga is plotting her revenge on the family that never appreciated her and the half-sister who is stealing her life.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Wished You Were Dead
mangas.synonyms: The Time I Wished You Were Dead
mangas.description:
King Karloi of Croisen finds himself at odds with his position in life. His wife's father, Duke Deluah, is angling for the throne, and as an outsider to the family, Karloi fears for his position. His frustrations have affected his marriage, though he finds himself questioning his cold approach to his wife, Evonne. He may no longer recognize her, but Evonne saved his life long ago and was his first love. This is but one of many secrets Evonne bears the weight of, having fallen victim to a curse that prevents her from telling any secrets...



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Chapter count includes an 8-chapter side story.

mangas.title: It's Not Fun Being the Empress of the Empire
mangas.synonyms: Diguo Huangfei Bu Hao Dang | Becoming an Empress is Hard
mangas.description: Clara is a renowned romance witch. When the crown prince fell into a perpetual sleep, people speculated that she cast a spell on him because of jealousy. But she never even touched him! It was the crown prince who fell in love with her at first sight when she snuck into the palace, and insisted on marrying her! So one day, the crown prince led his troops into the forest: "Clara, I'm here to take you home."

mangas.title: Villains Behind the Curtains
mangas.synonyms: I Lost the Leash of the Yandere Male Lead
mangas.description:
She has long lashes, radiant crimson eyes, and silver hair like an angel's... but she's no angel—she's the villainess Syriana Malforte... and I've been isekaied into her body! The House of Malforte has many gifted mages, but none at the level of Duke Azester. My evil mother brainwashed him into falling in love with me, and I coldly used him until his final breath. But with this second chance, I vow to set him free and return him to a sound state of mind. But how? And my heart aches to know… will Az still love me once he's free?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Don't Hire My Brother, Your Highness!
mangas.synonyms: I Am Worried Because My Brother Is Too Gentle | My Oppa Is Too Innocent
mangas.description: I had my share of working overtime for an evil employer. It's no surprise that I died from it! But as if being reborn as Irene Werber, a minor character in a romance novel, wasn't shocking enough, it turns out that my kind older brother is destined to work for the world's most evil superior, Crown Prince Ervin Manuel Terence! It's up to me to stop my brother from being exploited! The only problem is… I don't even know what this prince looks like!

mangas.title: Long Live My Queen
mangas.description:
As a hapless modern girl, Xi Yuan travels in time to another world at the end of her life. Unexpectedly, she is stabbed to death on the moment she wakes up. However, owing to this accident, she acquires immortality and captivates the eyes of various exceedingly handsome boys, and that domineering and arrogant princess with golden hair seems also...


(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: The Matchmaking Baby Princess
mangas.description:
Young baby Amelia moves into the palace of her tyrant uncle, Tessa Illuminas, for her aunt Lucinda's sake. As part of her new life, Amelia must now deal with conspiracies and court intrigue on top of trying to be a matchmaker of love for her aunt. Can the baby princess overcome all of this and have a happy ending?


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: I Don't Love You Anymore
mangas.description:
What happens after you fall out of love? Nevaeh Solene was engaged to the Duke, Baler Eustache. But for ten long winters, she endured in a relationship that was not meant to be. After calling off her engagement, Nevaeh moves to another country, hoping to lead a quiet life. But there she meets Emperor Arendt, who wants to give her the love she's never had. Will Nevaeh's eternal winter finally melt into the blossoms of spring?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Villainess is Retiring
mangas.synonyms: I'll Just Live on as a Villainess
mangas.description: After an office worker is reborn as Everia Oberon, a romance novel villainess destined for an evil life and a tragic death, she decides to skip the drama by retiring to the countryside. Having moved to a frigid region full of nonflammable wood, Everia calls on archmage Theoharis to warm her home with his azure flame… not realizing that she's bound herself to a lifelong contract! Now that she's master of a bloodthirsty (but breathtakingly handsome) demon dog, can she kiss the quiet life goodbye?

mangas.title: Elizabeth of Velpera
mangas.synonyms: Pure White Elizabeth, Snow White Elizabeth
mangas.description: In "The Tale of the Land of Velpera," Elizabeth Lily is said to be the most brilliant sorceress of the century. But in real life, little Ellie is abused and enslaved for her ability to summon demons. That is until she's rescued by the powerful sorcerer Ashelotte Vayne, Elizabeth's sworn enemy in the story! Now, this unlikely pair must work together so that Ellie can overcome the dark forces which threaten her and fulfill her destiny as the one and only Elizabeth Lily!

mangas.title: My Journey to Her
mangas.synonyms: In order for me to be me
mangas.description:
After graduating university, Yuna spent several years going through the motions and working an office job. Until one day, while in pursuit of an essential missing piece of her life, she receives a diagnosis of gender dysphoria, which opens up new doors for her. As she takes on medical treatments and tries out new makeup and outfits, she sees just how lonely and difficult the process of transitioning can be. But in 2015, when Yuna travels to Thailand for her gender-affirming surgery, the support of her siblings, new strangers, and documenting her experience through manga helps her begin to heal in more ways than one. Told in an honest and, at times, humorous tone, this memoir is a blend of manga and detailed prose that does not shy away from sensitive topics, such as suicidal ideation, transphobia, and the simultaneously harrowing, yet joyous, experience of gender-affirming surgery.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ai wo Kataru nara Hisoyaka ni
mangas.titleNative: 愛を語るなら密やかに
mangas.description: The cold-hearted mafia and the maid who works for him - but for some reason, their relationship is a bit strange. In truth, he's actually a gentleman who is infatuated with his maid! Be it an expensive gift or the perfect date, he makes full use of everything he has to express his love... Is he aware of their social standings? A flashy, fun, and slightly dangerous romantic comedy.

mangas.title: Isso, Koi Dattara Yokatta no ni
mangas.titleNative: いっそ、恋だったらよかったのに
mangas.synonyms: I Wish it Had Just Been Love

mangas.title: Magical Girl Tsubame: I Will (Not) Save The World!
mangas.titleNative: 対世界用魔法少女つばめ
mangas.description:
The world is in danger! Who will rise to protect it? Introducing Tsubame, an ordinary high school student who dreams of becoming a magical girl. But if she has to choose between the world and her friends... A new adventure from Mapollo 3, the creator of PPPPPP! Buckle up for some passion, magical girls, and a dash of madness!



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: Boukansha no Koi
mangas.description:
"I want to be by her side until the very last moment..."

In the autumn of her twentieth year, Rachel marries her childhood friend Noah, her long-time crush. Even though she knows that the person Noah truly loved is his sister and Rachel's best friend, Alicia... Bright and beautiful Alicia was born with a heart condition, and her remaining time is limited. Rachel's marriage with Noah is built on on a lie, just to allow them to stay close to Alicia in what little time she had left. Rachel has moments of incredible happiness, but also feels guilt and heartache at the same time. However, before she knew it, she begins to notice Noah's passionate gaze looking her way… Who is the real "bystander" in this love triangle?

The long-awaited manga adaptation of a heart-wrenching story of unrequited love, irreplaceable friendship, and mutual misunderstandings!

mangas.title: Girl in the Birdcage
mangas.description: Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi's charms, Yumi's got a hidden agenda.

mangas.title: Failed Princesses
mangas.titleNative: できそこないの姫君たち
mangas.description:
Opposites attract in this new high school yuri manga!

Fujishiro Nanaki is super cute, super popular, and super annoyed with anyone as plain as her classmate Kurokawa Kanade. When Nanaki finds out her boyfriend's cheating on her, however, her life makes a complete 180—as does her relationship with Kanade. This all-new yuri manga series explores the budding romance between the cool girl in school and the "plain" girl she once brushed off!

mangas.title: Madoka's Secret
mangas.description:
Madoka Yamada loves to play with dolls and looks so cute in custom made dresses. But Madoka is a boy. Afraid that he will be made fun of again for being "girly," Madoka decides to hide that part of himself when he moves to his new town and school. He fits right in, and all his classmates like him, except for one, Itsuki Tanonaka, whose seat is right next to his. Madoka thinks that Itsuki is cool and "manly" and says so, only to be met with his classmates' snickers. What's the big deal?! Will Madoka be able to keep his secret for long?


(Source: Manga Planet)

mangas.title: Inside Mari
mangas.description:
College dropout Isao Komori wakes up one morning to find himself in the body of a high school girl. How did this happen and what happened to the girl whose body his is possessing?



(Source: Denpa)

mangas.title: This Vampire Won't Give Up!
mangas.titleNative: ヴァンパイア様があきらめない！
mangas.description: Minami has awful luck with men—she falls for their looks only to find that they're the worst of the worst. So when she finds out that her next work assignment involves a good-looking, rude-off-the-bat man, she feels just fine about kissing any feelings for him goodbye...that is, until she finds out he's the son of the author of her favorite childhood picture book series, Bride of the Vampire. But the rude son soon changes his tune, and Minami doesn't have long before she discovers the secret his gorgeous lips hide...

mangas.title: Wonderful Precure!
mangas.titleNative: わんだふるぷりきゅあ!

mangas.title: Tears of Thorn
mangas.description: The thorn inside the apple that made a princess sleep pricks inside Maki's heart. Even while carrying that thorn as an adult, Maki has a premonition of a new love…. that girl who looks a little like her first love makes Maki's heart beat a little faster. However… in the end it was futile… again. That time, this time, it's always the same. Why can't she grab on to love? But, there may be another love that waits for her... Rikachi crafts a whole new fairy-tale for Romeo's best friend Maki in Ibara no Namida. Will she ever find a princess of her own?

mangas.title: Koori no Joou
mangas.description: Nika is a 3rd-year middle-school student with social anxiety. One day she drops her eraser in class, and slacker Akira picks it up. After school, Nika follows Akira to an ice rink in pursuit of her eraser. There, she discovers Akira's beautiful figure skating and her own love of the ice. Alternatively, Kiwako is a brash young champion ice skater and Akira's childhood friend. Akira tells Kiwako that one day Nika will become her rival. Which genius ice skater will become The Ice Queen?

mangas.title: Sky-colored Girlfriend
mangas.description: My name is Juliet, her name is Romeo... Enchanting rogue Juli puts a spell of love on Hiromi. Even though she relishes being tantalized by unhibited Juli, Hiromi's heart is filled with fragments of doubt. When two girls' feelings intersect, in which direction will they turn?

mangas.title: Fumi-chan no Rakuen
mangas.description:
Eat, sleep, sex.

Fumi is a novelist who has lost her passion for writing. Now she lives with her man in an old house in the countryside. Nighttime picnics, a dip in the river, harvesting vegetables - they eat delicious food, sleep well, and have sex whenever and wherever they feel like it. It's like a never-ending summer vacation.

mangas.title: Perfect Girl
mangas.titleNative: パーフェクト・ガール
mangas.description:
Kujou Yuriko's nickname is "The Perfect Girl" due to her stellarness, beauty, athletic ability, and academic acumen. She is the school idol everyone adores. But she has one fatal flaw: she is madly in love with Apollon, a fictional manga character. Nothing will stop her from collecting Apollon merch, not even the mysterious creatures called "Creysheres" which appear from a person's insecurities.


How will Yuriko defeat the Creysheres? And who are the mysterious girls that hunt them? Find out in Aoki Ippei's "Perfect Girl"!

mangas.title: You Can't Live All on Your Own!
mangas.titleNative: ひとりで生きるはままならぬ
mangas.description:
What is considered "normal" for a 30 year old? Should she be married, have a carreer, live independently...?



Shuko Maeda, 28, is a single office worker who lives in a shared house with her three friends. One of them is Eika Matsuki, a career woman whose life revolves around work. Then, there's Misaki Kawaseda, a musician, singer and hopeless romantic. Finally: Shio Momoyama, who works freelance and is laid back in her professional and personal life. Together, they navigate the stresses and joys of daily life as women approaching 30, in a society that has certain expectations for them, while they all try to find their own unique way to thrive!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Love Me Like I Do!
mangas.titleNative: 愛したぶんだけ愛してほしいっ！
mangas.description: Mutsurugi Nana, who leads a self-indulgent, unemployed life, is still waiting for her ideal prince to come one day while satisfying her need for approval by uploading doctored selfies on the Internet. Then, Tsukasa, a candidate for the "ideal prince" appears, praising Nana as "cute" and escorting her home gently. Nana is so impressed by Tsukasa's words and acts that she couldn't help herself from falling for Tsukasa.

mangas.title: Stellar Witch LIP☆S
mangas.description:
Miku Hoshino is a just a regular girl who thinks of nothing but her favorite idol, Rei, from the totally popular group M.A.G. When her school duties make her miss the concert she was desperately hoping to go for, she does what any girl would do—takes the help of a witch! But when the witch turns Miku into a witch, too, her life becomes anything from ordinary...and a certain keen-eyed detective seems determined to keep it that way!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Yuureijou no Danna-sama
mangas.description: A spoiled noblewoman, who was declared dead after supposedly getting executed, marries the not-so-sane ghost castle's master to stay there and hide the truth about her execution. With everyone thinking she's underground by now, she seemingly has no choice but to live with this ghost-like castle master... right?

mangas.title: My Androgynous Boyfriend
mangas.titleNative: ジェンダーレス男子に愛されています。
mangas.synonyms: I Am Loved By Genderless Boy
mangas.description:
His makeup is flawless! The daily ins-and-outs of an office lady and her beautiful boyfriend.



Wako and her androgynous boyfriend don't exactly have the most traditional of relationships. She spends her days working hard in the world of publishing, while he spends his time obsessing over fashion and makeup—all with the goal of making himself beautiful just for her. This romantic slice-of-life story is about love, relationships, and breaking with tradition!


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: R.I.P.
mangas.description: Transylvania Rose is a bored angel who descends to Earth to clean a few souls. When she witnesses a depressed undertaker slitting his wrists, Rose rips off one of her wings and gives it to the undertaker, trapping them both somewhere between heaven and hell -- and life and death!

mangas.title: Miyuki-chan in Wonderland
mangas.titleNative: 不思議の国の美幸ちゃん
mangas.description: There are many worlds in the universe outside of our own, connected by doors that are hidden to the eye. But if you chance upon those doors, you can be transported to a place where supple beauties reign supreme and all of your fantasies come alive. Should you pass through the doorways, be most careful, for the creatures you will meet can be as dangerous as they are beautiful. Many would die for a glimpse at those worlds - Miyuki would do anything to have them go away.

mangas.title: The Dressmaker and the Fairy
mangas.description:
A mysterious fairy suddenly appears before Kyouko Fujino, who runs a dressmaking business.


And so begins a heartwarming exchange between human and fairy as they explore a world of beautiful clothes.

mangas.title: Rainy Day Serenade
mangas.description:
On rainy days, Hina has dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy in a garden she's never seen before—until, by chance, she stumbles upon the place. There's a young man there, Takaaki, who mistakes Hina for his fiancée Hinako. He whisks her back to what he thinks is her home, where Hina's doppelganger is waiting, and Hina realizes this isn't the Tokyo she left behind but Japan in the year 1907! Is this all a dream or something much stranger?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Crown Princess Scandal
mangas.description:
Victimized by her little sister's trick, Hwa-Yeong heads to the imperial palace to participate in the crown princess selection process. Now she'll have to put up with… six months of palace stay?! No way! As a last resort, Hwa-Yeong tries to do everything wrong to get disqualified and sent home early but instead finds herself in the royals' favor. What's worse, coincidence keeps bringing Shin-Yeong, the Crown Prince, in her way, and now things are becoming more intense and personal for both of them. "You wish to get kicked out now? I'll do everything in my power to see the opposite happen!" Will Hwa-Yeong see her way through these obstacles and return home before six months?



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: How About a Cosmic Horror?
mangas.description:
Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he's the perfect man, but to her, he's a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Eurydice's Coffin
mangas.description: Poor Eurydice is cursed to go back a year in time if she dies before turning 20. Although she has died 14 times and woken up again as a 19-year-old woman, all her loved ones have aged normally. That includes her now 34-year-old husband, Orpheus, who thinks he's the only one with memories of Eurydice's past lives. However, Eurydice also remembers every futile attempt to survive. Despite their love for each other, the tragic couple can feel their hearts growing numb with each forboding death. Will Eurydice finally make it to her 20th birthday and break this cycle of pain?

mangas.title: Gyaru to Nekura no Kyuuketsu Kankei
mangas.titleNative: ギャルとネクラの吸血関係
mangas.synonyms: The Bloody Relationship Between Nekura and Gal
mangas.description: Hadekawa Iyone failed her high school debut as a wannabe gal. Desperately trying to break out from her outcast status, she tries talking to the girl sitting next to her, Chisui Makuru, who turns out to be the vampire rumored about town! Although Makuru isn't like your typical vampire... And thus begins the slightly strange high school life of a gal in search of a friend, and a vampire in search of an underling.

mangas.title: Suna no Miyako
mangas.description:
What is the difference between something that is quickly forgotten and something that cannot be forgotten? This is a story about memories and buildings of people living on a mysterious isolated desert island.



(Source: Kodansha)

mangas.title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!
mangas.titleNative: 一度だけでも、後悔してます。
mangas.synonyms: Even If It Was Just Once, I Regret It
mangas.description:
Twenty-four-year-old Koduka Chiyo quit her job and is wallowing in self-pity in her apartment. She's also three months behind on her rent. Then her landlady proposes an unusual solution: have sex with her, and she'll help with the debt, the filthy apartment, and the loneliness driving Chiyo to beer and escapism. After a one-night stand, the two women decide to keep up the arrangement. Their growing relationship leads to questions of identity, getting one's life together, and if something tender can develop from an arrangement that started with a bang.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Notes:

- Chapter count includes 1 extra.

- Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

mangas.title: Out of the Cocoon
mangas.titleNative: アウト・オブ・ザ・コクーン
mangas.description:
Yuriko Hara, author of the atmospheric, eerily beautiful yuri Cocoon Entwined, brings us five haunting stories of love and attachment. Ranging from horrific to wistful, these captivating tales, featuring both yuri and Boys Love, are sure to ensnare readers. Fans of her previous work will be especially delighted by the final piece, which provides an extra chapter of Youko and Hana's story.



(Source: Yen Press)

Sweet Dreams Zombie (スウィート・ドリームス・ゾンビ); Comic Beam 2023-12, 2024-01
Moshimo, Ashita Sekai ga Owaru nara (もしも、明日世界が終わるなら); Comic Beam 2019-04
Dog Eat Dog (ドッグ・イート・ドッグ); J.GARDEN 45
52 Hertz no Kujira (52ヘルツの鯨); Éclair Orange
Out of the Cocoon (アウト・オブ・ザ・コクーン); COMITIA 145

mangas.title: Mon Seul
mangas.description:
After their parents divorced, mother remarried, and father ran away, the remaining two members of Ikeuchi family -- college student Masaki and his younger sister, elementary schooler Minami -- along with Masaki's roommate and best friend Kanda, barely support themselves under the same roof. While the difficult yet happy life seemed to continue forever, all hell broke loose when Masaki one day returned home from his part-time job earlier than Minami expected.



(Source: Anime News Network)



The volume contains 5 non story chapters.

mangas.title: Ryouko no Shinrei Jikenbo
mangas.synonyms: A Record of Ryoko's Psychic Events | Ryouko's Case-Book of Spirits
mangas.description: Ryouko Midorikawa is a girl in her first year of high school. One day she finds her pet cat Pow drowned in the bathtub. Ryouko knows that he hated water, so she doesn't believe he died by accident. The same night strange things start happening around her. This is the beginning of her strange encounters with spirits, but also the path, which leads to the man she loves.

mangas.title: SHIBUYA: Gal Yuri Anthology
mangas.titleNative: SHIBUYA ギャル百合アンソロジー
mangas.description:
Fashionable girls fall for fashionable girls in this Yuri anthology from Ichijinsha!



1. Reverse Line by Yorumo

2. Oshiete ageru (I'll teach you) by Pesotaro

3. Romantic Delinquency by Mashimaru

4. Kino no tomo wa kyo no × × (Yesterday's friend is today's XX) by Ameno

5. Koisuru no usagi (Love Rabbits) by Neji

6. Suppin Kataomoi (Spin Love) by Mintaro

7. Shiranai watashi mo sukidesu ka? (Don't you like me too?) by Kashikaze

8. Anata no watashi (You&me) by Oriko Potos

9. Aien ki en (Predetermination) by Kabayama

10. Kimi wo Aisaba ana Futatsu (I love you too) by Haru Inabe

11. Haru wo Matsu aka Iro (I'll wait for the Spring) by Yoriko

mangas.title: Maid in Heaven
mangas.description:
An orphan, Sherl Watson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion.

Rumors and a cloud of mystery surround the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up.

Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed, to begin with?



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Yumemiru Maid no Tea Time
mangas.titleNative: 夢見るメイドのティータイム
mangas.description:
In the spring of her second year of high school, Fuyuka Yukinoshita starts working part-time at a maid cafe.
She dreams of becoming someone who can make people smile, like the manager she admired, but she is always getting flustered by her idiosyncratic co-workers!



It is the magic that makes you smile. A fluffy and sweet moment.



(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

mangas.title: Star Clock Liddell
mangas.description: Hugh is haunted by a dream of a strange Victorian house that he doesn't remember ever seeing in life. This dream, while not at all unpleasant, is becoming more vivid every time he enters it. His close friends, affluent Vladimir and clothes designer Vi, are concerned for his well-being, and they reach out to their wider circle of acquaintances in an effort to make sense of Hugh's predicament before it is too late.

mangas.title: Kimi no Tamenara Nando Demo
mangas.titleNative: 君のためなら何度でも
mangas.description: Yuugo is deeply in love with Shiina-chan and has witnessed her death countless times. His abnormal love for her has granted him a "gun" with the power to transcend space and time. However, every reset comes at a cruel cost: causing her memories to fade one by one. Even so, the burning flame of his love never goes out. To save Shiina-chan from her untimely demise, and until Yuugo can reach the one irrefutable "proof of love"—a kiss—he won't stop pulling the trigger.

mangas.title: Watashi no Gochisou wa, Kimi.
mangas.description:
A new series of kinky and cute stories about a boy with glasses who is popular in class and a girl who has the desire to devour him.



(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

mangas.title: Yoru no Sakana
mangas.description: Kaoru has second sight: he sees things other people can't. At the funeral of a murder victim, he runs into two people. One is out for vengeance, and the other is the murderer…

mangas.title: Kodoku no Kochou wa Donna Yume wo Miru no ka?
mangas.titleNative: 蠱毒の胡蝶はどんな夢を見るのか？
mangas.description:
This world has been invaded by bugs.

With the appearance of the "Armored Bugs," mutating insect monsters that can overcome all modern weapons, humanity has been robbed of much of its living space. The only ones who can stand against such adversaries are the "Noble Butterflies," girls who harbor "Insects" that have gone through evolutions differing from the armored bugs.

One of the candidates to become a Noble Butterfly, Odamaki Ayumi, still suffers from the fact that she is unable to become one. Her best friend, who was supposed to be with her and was her object of admiration, has left her and no longer seeks her company.

Those days of despair came to an end when she was on the verge of death in a battle with armored bugs.
"Don't think that I... will die without doing anything!"

With the end near, the girl's body transformed into a butterfly one. And the flapping of her wings will bring about a revolution in the world...!

mangas.title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Haru Urara Ganbaru!
mangas.titleNative: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー-ハルウララがんばる!-
mangas.description: A comedy series based off the real life story of Haru Urara.

mangas.title: Potion Witch
mangas.description:
Vanna is an ordinary pharmacist who runs a small herb shop in Blalock City. Yet, when night falls, the mysterious "Witch Raven" emerges in this seemingly serene city, casting curses upon her targets before vanishing into the shroud of darkness. Consequently, Vanna often receives requests to make potions to lift the witch's curse. However, her days are disrupted when a policeman approaches her, and the two ultimately form a partnership in the hopes of unveiling the truth behind "Triplet Academy." Will the unlikely duo succeed in uncovering the mysteries of the Academy?



(Source: WEBTOON)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hoteru Watashi ni Koi wo Oshiete
mangas.titleNative: ほてる私に恋を教えて
mangas.synonyms: Teach Me Love as I Burn with Desire
mangas.description:
Miku is a high school girl who likes to fantasize about boys but has no real experience with them. At school, she acts like a pure, good girl, but one day her childhood friend, Shida, finds out that she's been reading erotic manga!
She thought that her life was over… but then Shida-kun asks her, "Would you like to gain some experience with a guy...?"
It's a romantic comedy between a girl full of romantic daydreams and a mischievous boy who likes to tease, set in a public bathhouse!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Madame Petit
mangas.description: It's the 1920s and Mariko, age 16, is married to a man 30 years her senior. She is honestly happy to be his wife and really excited to board the Orient express in Turkey on their honeymoon trip. But her life takes a rapid turn when her husband is discovered dead after the first night on board... And that's only the start of Mariko's great adventure.

mangas.title: Yomei Ichinen to Senkokusareta Boku ga, Yomei Hantoshi no Kimi to Deatta Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: 余命一年と宣告された僕が、余命半年の君と出会った話
mangas.description:
It was the happiest day in the world."
Our sad and fleeting "love with a deadline" has begun.



In the winter of his freshman year of high school, Akito Hayasaka is diagnosed with a heart disease and told that he has little time left to live. In the midst of despair, Akito meets Sakurai Haruna, who is hospitalized at the hospital. Haruna, too, is seriously ill and has only a few days left to live. Akito begins to talk with her, hiding his illness, and becomes interested in Haruna, who says she is not afraid of dying. Can I still be in love with her?　 The days that pass by as he asks himself these questions begin to change?



The story is the ultimate story of pure love, with a sense of fragile beauty and tenderness in their daily lives, which are depicted in a lighthearted manner.

mangas.title: Shinyuu ni Sukina Hito ga Dekitarashii
mangas.titleNative: 親友に好きな人ができたらしい
mangas.description:
Ayame was dumped by her boyfriend and decides to move in with her best friend, Emma. On the day of the move, Emma cut her hair short, saying, "I want to do everything I can for the person I love." This is the story of Ayame, who longs for "ordinary" happiness, and Emma, who is more of a free spirit.



(Source: Pixiv, translated)

mangas.title: Majo no Mago to Shichinin no Maid
mangas.titleNative: 魔女の孫と七人のメイド
mangas.synonyms: The Witch's Granddaughter and Seven Maids
mangas.description:
A high school girl inherits her grandmother's estate—only to find a massive mansion and a staff of maids awaiting her! It turns out her grandmother was a "witch," and the maids are all non-human beings: werewolves, vampires, succubi, Medusas…



Experience the sweet romance between a young lady and her maids, unfolding in the mansion and at school, alongside various supernatural girls.

mangas.title: My Twisted Eating Disorder
mangas.titleNative: これはゆがんだ食レポです
mangas.synonyms: Straying Warrior Kabi Nagata: Go Gourmet!
mangas.description:
This diary comic details the complexities of Nagata Kabi's fraught relationship with food, from eating disorders and habits to food preparation, with unflinching and detailed honesty. This short manga (originally 50 pages long) was written after My Wandering Warrior Existence and was only released on digital platforms in Japan. Seven Seas initially published the manga in English as an ebook exclusive before the release of the book written after it – My Pancreas Broke, But My Life Got Better– in order to preserve the chronological timeline of new entries in Nagata Kabi's powerful autobiographical series. Now, the anticipated release of the printed edition is here!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Notes:

- The series went on hiatus on April 16th, 2021 and resumed on October 4th, 2024 with a brand new name.

- Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hana to Rakurai
mangas.description:
A bunch of love problems surround her life. Futamura Umiho is a girl with a weak personality. A new flower is about to bloom! A fresh and inspirational story is blooming. A love between flower and thunder!



Includes two bonus chapters added to the volumes' release.

mangas.title: Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray Gaiden - The mermaid left behind
mangas.titleNative: ウマ娘 シンデレラグレイ 外伝 -The mermaid left behind-

mangas.title: Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray Gaiden - "Enrai"
mangas.titleNative: ウマ娘 シンデレラグレイ 外伝 "遠雷"
mangas.description:
A short story depicting the past of Tamamo Cross and Trainer Komiyama.



Source: Official Account, translated.

mangas.title: Magical Girl Incident
mangas.description: As a little boy, Sakura Hiromi once dreamed he could be a hero. Now...he's simply your everyday office worker, toiling away for his company. Though he longs for his childhood dream, it seems so far out of reach—until he decides to step up and save a child one fateful day. Suddenly, fantasies become reality as Hiromi finds himself transformed into...a magical girl?!

mangas.title: Is Love the Answer?
mangas.titleNative: きみのせかいに恋はない
mangas.description:
A poignant coming-of-age story about a young woman coming into her own as she discovers her identity as aromantic asexual. A complete story in a single volume, from the creator of Mine-kun is Asexual.



When it comes to love, high schooler Chika wonders if she might be an alien. She's never fallen for or even had a crush on anyone, and she has no desire for physical intimacy. Her friends tell her that she just "hasn't met the one yet," but Chika has doubts... It's only when Chika enters college and meets peers like herself that she realizes there's a word for what she feels inside--asexual--and she's not the only one. After years of wondering if love was the answer, Chika realizes that the answer she long sought may not exist at all--and that that's perfectly normal.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Witch's House: The Diary of Ellen
mangas.titleNative: 魔女の家 エレンの日記
mangas.description:
"I know all too well...the beginning of that diary I never wrote-"



Ellen, who has been plagued by sickness her whole life, heavily relies on her mother's care and love. When the bond between them decays in a horrific turn of events, Ellen despairs that she'll never get the love she so desperately craves and thinks she's done for-that is, until she crosses paths with a mysterious black cat. The cat offers her powers and a house to live in, which seems to change Ellen's life for the better. But the new witch soon discovers the gruesome secrets within this ever-changing house...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Majo Maid wa Joou no Himitsu wo Shitteiru
mangas.titleNative: 魔女メイドは女王の秘密を知っている
mangas.description:
Liz, who has the ability to see the future, lost her fiancee for fear of her mysterious power. That was when Her Noble Majesty Queen Shuriez of Linfilia came along and hired her as a maid! Around Her Majesty, who has never married and has no heir, a struggle for succession has already begun among her five brothers. But then Liz finds out... that the queen, who needs to get married as soon as possible to maintain peace in the kingdom, has a big secret!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Mermaid Line
mangas.description:
Mermaid Line is a collection of stories that ran in Yuri Hime magazine. They are collected together as short mini-series, done in an episodic, almost soap-opera-y way.

In "Megumi and Aoi " Megumi confesses to her friend Aoi that, despite her ungainly swimming, she feels as if she is a mermaid. Aoi finds herself fantasizing about being the prince to Megumi's mermaid, but Megumi runs to the arms of a boy, trying to put a beard on her feelings.

Ayumi, in "Ayumi and Aika," wants to get married to her boyfriend so naturally, she's shocked when he tells her that he wants to become a woman.

"Yukari and Mayuko" are both OLs. Mayuko's between boyfriends and bored, so she asks Yukari to pretend to be her girlfriend. It works out well, until Yukari realizes that her feelings for Mayuko are more than just pretend.

And finally, in "Miura-san and Me" Okabe loves Miura's beautiful hair. When Miura-san cuts it all off, Okabe learns to love her for herself.

mangas.title: Hoshigari JK Ria
mangas.description:
Same scenery, same everyday... A rural girls' school is idyllic, peaceful, and boring. Ichikawa is an art teacher who is very popular with the girls at the school because of his refreshing smile. Why has he come to such a rural area? Because it's the best hunting ground. Girls are simple, easy, and cute, and he's going to… with a female student today, too!? The next target is Ria Koda. Even if she says no at first… the feeling of defiling a pure white canvas is irresistible!



"I'm tired of holding back."



What kind of debauchery will Ria choose next…?



(Source: &Flower, translated)

mangas.title: Coppelia's Coffin
mangas.description: On a snowy day, a beautiful transfer student named Anna, joined the boarding school. With Anna's captivating beauty, she became the object of everyone's envy. While Colette, who was the opposite of Anna in every way, builds a delicate love-hate relationship with her. All of a sudden, Anna leaves the school. A long time passes before Colette reunites with Anna, at the place where she starts working as a tutor for a noble family...

mangas.title: Torikagosou no Kyou mo Nemutai Juunintachi
mangas.titleNative: 鳥籠荘の今日も眠たい住人たち
mangas.description: With a group of friends, 16 year old Kizuna stalks the city at night, flirting with middle-aged men and coercing them out of their money. The thrill should be enough to satiate her, but Kizuna remains unsatisfied with her everyday life… until a beautiful woman named Inoue Yuki, a fellow resident of “Birdcage Manor” approaches her with a job proposition- to model in the nude for her cousin, a painter and fellow resident named Yuusei Asai!

mangas.title: My Wandering Warrior Existence
mangas.titleNative: 迷走戦士・永田カビ
mangas.description:
The newest diary manga from the Harvey Award-winning creator of My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness.



Nagata Kabi's groundbreaking autobiographical work has captivated audiences around the globe, starting with the viral online comic about identity that would become the graphic novel My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness. Readers from all backgrounds have been moved by the author's ability to capture complex emotions through her art and text, giving insight into feelings they may have struggled to articulate themselves. Nagata Kabi's memoirs, including the Eisner-nominated My Solo Exchange Diary and new release My Alcoholic Escape From Reality, have explored themes of physical and mental illness, sex and sexuality, family, and independence. Follow the newest installment of this trailblazing series with My Wandering Warrior Existence, Nagata Kabi's exploration of longing for love and marriage.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: She Looks Like the Love Doll
mangas.titleNative: 彼女はラブドールに似ている
mangas.synonyms: Kanojo wa Love Doll ni Niteiru
mangas.description:
What would you do if you ran into a woman who looked just like your love doll? A bachleor named Saitou, and his lovedoll "Haru" bought via mail order, live a quiet yet enjoyable life. Then one day, a new person joins Saitou's work.

Toujyou—a woman with big eyes and black hair. No matter where I look—she was just like "Haru." The very love doll I embrace all the time. When I look at her, thirst grows like Pavlov's dog. But then—"I want to be with you a bit longer, Saitou-san." An unidentified doll and a beautiful girl. Who am I embracing: the girl, or the doll...?

mangas.title: Watashi no Muchi na Watashi no Michi
mangas.titleNative: 私の無知なわたしの未知
mangas.synonyms: My Ignorance of a World Yet Unknown
mangas.description:
Minato was living an ordinary but slightly suffocating kind of life. The one who changes all that for her is her senpai at work, Maya Asami. When Minato is left bewildered by her boyfriend of 20 years' proposal, Maya sets Minato's heart free. What will come of this peculiar love triangle?


(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: The Redemption of Earl Nottingham
mangas.description:
Is my cursed husband's fate up to me?



Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Qian Mu Li
mangas.description:
The Thousand-Eyed Carp, a monster that lives forever, has a desire to leave this world. However in her attempts to do so, she keeps getting saved again and again by humans. Because of the acts of kindness displayed by humans, she gradually dispells this idea, fully integrating into the human society.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Stardust Family
mangas.description:
In a future world, children hold the authority to determine who may become parents. Having children is illegal—unless a couple first passes a strict examination, conducted by a child, that certifies them as capable providers. It is a veritable utopia with no child abuse...or at least, so it may seem. Hikari is one such examiner in this system, spending his days evaluating prospective parents. But one day, he comes across a couple that isn't quite like the others...


(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Lord Hades's Ruthless Marriage
mangas.titleNative: ハデスさまの無慈悲な婚姻
mangas.synonyms: 哈迪斯大人的無情婚姻
mangas.description:
Hades—the powerful and terrifying King of the Underworld...and a bachelor! Despite his retainers' wishes, Hades refuses to give up his life as a single god, unconvinced that love and marriage are worth the hassle. But when Eros suddenly shoots him with an arrow of love, will he be able to successfully avoid falling head over heels with the next person he sees?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Atashi no Senpai
mangas.description: Tsukamoto is an average girl who, for no particular reason, is drawn to Okazaki-senpai – a girl who might as well have a sign above her head that says "I am in an abusive relationship."

mangas.title: Ura mo Omote mo Kimi ga Suki
mangas.titleNative: ウラもオモテも君が好き
mangas.description:
A dreamy senior boy is actually a fellow shoujo manga otaku…!?

A tough-looking delinquent classmate thinks you're sexy…!?

A cute junior from your club aggressively comes on to you...!?

A secret night out with the top honor student of the class…!?



Portrayals of a "secret" face that only I know.

A heart-pounding series of short stories!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Subaru to Suu-san
mangas.description:
Mio and Subaru live together in a small apartment avoiding attention. While they masquerade as siblings with an age gap, Subaru holds a secret.



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Haru's Curse
mangas.description:
After Natsumi's younger sister and best friend Haru dies at the age of 19, she begins dating Haru's fiancee Tougo - on the condition that he take her only to places he had taken her sister. Their relationship deepens as the seasons pass, but Haru's Curse lies between them... Will there be happiness after Haru's Curse is broken?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Mother of the Bloody Male Lead
mangas.description:
The newly reincarnated Sheriel learns she has become the mother of Karthizel Roperam, the male lead of a dark romance fantasy novel. All the neglect Karthizel faces as a child leads him to become a crazy and obsessive man who's willing to kill anyone to get what he wants, even his own mother! Then the only way for Sheriel to keep herself alive in this timeline is to have him be raised right under loving parents, which means she'll also need to make amends with her cold, estranged husband. Will Sheriel be able to save herself and this broken family?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Finder Goshi no Ano Ko
mangas.titleNative: ファインダー越しのあの子
mangas.description:
Hajime, a girl who can't seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There's always been things she's wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she's given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do.

That's when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her schoolー

mangas.title: Aria of the Beech Forest
mangas.description: The witch Aria is a little shy. She's good at cooking and knitting. And she's a real wiz at growing herbs. As for what she's bad at? Why, that's magic! One fateful day, the sheltered girl encounters a talking wolf, who becomes her very first friend. Watch the witch and wolf snuggle up in this comfy story with a touch of mystery set in the forests of Ireland!

mangas.title: My New Friend Wasn’t What I Expected
mangas.titleNative: 新しくできた友達が思ってたのと違った話
mangas.synonyms: Atarashiku Dekita Tomodachi ga Omotteta no to Chigatta Hanashi
mangas.description:
My new friend has an absolutely beyond super cool sense of style!

One day, just after becoming a second-year high school student, Hinata found herself captivated by a lovely beauty named Yuzuki and called out to her. They hit it off and agreed to meet outside of school. But when Yuzuki showed up at the meeting spot, she was decked out in a fiercely rock-inspired fashion. Even her words and actions stood in stark contrast to the school's soft, fluffy atmosphere, radiating a smart, handsome charm... While tossed about by this intense gap, Hinata found herself increasingly drawn to Yuzuki's unwavering commitment to her own style. However, Yuzuki harbored a complex about her inability to conform to others...

mangas.title: Yuri-Ota ni Yuri wa Gohatto Desu!?
mangas.titleNative: 百合オタに百合はご法度です!?
mangas.synonyms: Yuri is Forbidden for Yuri Ota!?
mangas.description:
Watanabe Fuyu is a diehard fan of yuri, so she studied hard to get into an all-girls private school and quietly observe the S-class setting of her fantasies. At first, it seems like heaven... until she meets Yoshiokari Rika, a cheery gyaru who reads more like an otaku's dream girl than the refined, demure ladies she's used to reading about. Thrown off by the outlier, Fuyu is reluctant to become friends with Rika - and with their clashing archetypes, she's hoping this odd couple doesn't graduate into a rarepair.



Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Pet Shop of Horrors
mangas.titleNative: ペットショップ オブ ホラーズ
mangas.description: A smoke-filled alley in Chinatown harbors Count D's Pet Shop. The pets sold here aren't your everyday variety and the Count prides himself on selling Love and Dreams in the form of magical creatures that come with an exclusive contract. But buyers beware. If the contract is broken the Count cannot be held accountable for whatever may happen. A fascinating and macabre look into the very soul of human nature.

mangas.title: Oshiegoto: Doujin Kyoushi to Tensai Gal
mangas.titleNative: おしえごと 同人教師と天才ギャル
mangas.synonyms: Oshiegoto: Doujin Kyoushi to Tensai Gyaru
mangas.description:
Sachi Kurokawa, a doujin artist in her private life, is hired to be the new art teacher at a high school, where she meets Koihaku, a gal who happens to be a talented portrait artist. Koihaku is a fan of Kurokawa's doujinshi work, and her praises make Kurokawa happy, but trying to keep her doujin work a secret, she lies and tells Koihaku that it is her older sister "Sachi" who draws the doujinshi.
