Now Koihaku wants Sachi to teach her how to draw like "Sachi"?



(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

mangas.title: Mr. Mallow Blue
mangas.description: A story about high school students and reclusive NEETs at a boarding school. A mysterious beauty x reclusive NEET x aloof ikemen. Those who find it difficult to live in a cruel society meet by chance and a strange story begins.

mangas.title: Ookami to Revolver
mangas.description:
The protagonist is Oto, a young police woman. Around the village of Blume, where she lives, werewolves have started to appear, blending in with the village people. One day, Oto follows some village children into the forest, and unluckily, she encounters a werewolf. Just as the werewolf attacks her, another werewolf suddenly appears and saves her life. That werewolf apparently knows her somehow...



(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

mangas.title: See You There, Beyond the Ocean
mangas.description:
In third grade, Wu Xiaorong was the class outcast, an introverted girl who hated going to school. But all that changed when she met Tong Kewei, the cheerful and outgoing popular girl. The two couldn't be more different, and Wu Xiaorong assumed they'd never interact—but to her surprise, they began bonding over their shared love for drawing comics. Thus begins the story of a beautiful, bittersweet friendship, the ups and downs of childhood, and a project left forever unfinished...



(Source: Yen Press)



Notes:


- Silver Award winner in the 16th Japan International Manga Award.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: QQ Sweeper
mangas.description:
One day, Kyutaro Horikita, the tall, dark and handsome cleaning expert of Kurokado High, comes across a sleeping maiden named Fumi Nishioka at school… Unfortunately, their meeting is anything but a fairy-tale encounter! It turns out Kyutaro is a "Sweeper" who cleans away negative energy from people's hearts—and Fumi is about to become his apprentice!



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Komomo Confiserie
mangas.titleNative: こももコンフィズリー
mangas.description:
As a little girl, Komomo Ninomiya delighted in picking on Natsu Azumi, the son of her family's pastry chef. Ten years later, when the family fortune is lost and she has no place to live, Komomo encounters Natsu again in her hour of need. Now that Natsu is a master pastry chef in his own right, he'll help Komomo—but only if she works for him at his new confiserie!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: A Brief Moment of Ichika
mangas.description:
At the age of 16, Ichika Sendawara learned that she only had two years left to live. Now a sophomore college student, she lives a busy, upbeat life, despite never knowing when the end will come.

Everything changes when Ichika meets Professor Yurugi—for the first time, she feels she has something to live for. But then Yurugi quietly leaves the university, and Ichika is left wondering why, and what could have been...

A gentle love story that grapples with the deepest existential questions we face in life. As the Shuji Terayama poem quoted in the text says, "If life is nothing but goodbyes, who needs life?"

mangas.title: My Alcoholic Escape from Reality
mangas.titleNative: 現実逃避してたらボロボロになった話
mangas.synonyms: A Story of Me, Trying to Escape from Reality Just to Be Worn Out
mangas.description:
Nagata Kabi's downward spiral is getting out of control, and she can't stop drinking to soothe the ache of reality. After suffering from unbearable stomach pains, she goes to the hospital, where she is diagnosed with pancreatitis—and is immediately hospitalized. A new chapter unfolds in Nagata Kabi's life, as she struggles to find her way back to reality and manga creation in the wake of her breakdown.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: If You Could See Love
mangas.titleNative: もし、恋が見えたなら
mangas.synonyms: หากว่ารักมองเห็นได้ด้วยตา
mangas.description:
Mei Haruno was born with the troublesome ability of being able to see pink arrows indicating who people were in love with. In order to escape, she chooses to enroll in an all-girls' boarding school in the hopes of never getting involved in romance again…only to discover not one, but two arrows directed right at her!



(Source: Yen Press)




Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

mangas.title: Miss Time
mangas.description:
Lee Gaon is a successful personal trainer who has always had a personal rivalry with Jiho, a famous romance novelist known for his badmouthing attitude. Gaon went to her frenemy Sera's wedding ceremony and somehow ended up helping her escape(?). And the unlucky groom? It was Jiho, the man who had always insulted her over the years.



As they argued, they finally realized they were from the same high school class, and that he wished things could've turned out differently...



That was when the two were suddenly transported twelve years into the past... "That soft writer was the badass delinquent in high school?! And he liked me as well?!"



How will their incompatible personalities turn out, when given a second chance for romance?



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Virgin Love
mangas.description:
Successful, well-liked, and beautiful, twenty-six-year-old working woman Shoko Shoji seems to have it all. But behind her picture-perfect exterior is a secret that haunts her: to her chagrin, Shoko is still a virgin. Tired of making excuses for her total lack of dating experience, she signs up to live in the Love House, an experimental program seeking to test if six young singles can find romance under one shared roof. But will this change of pace be enough to help Shoko ditch her v-card for good, or will the trauma of her first broken heart jinx her forever to a life without love?



(Source: Kodansha)

mangas.title: Takopi's Original Sin
mangas.description:
Takopi travels from his home of Happy Planet to spread happiness across Earth, but meets the unsmiling Shizuka upon landing. Her friends at school and home life seem to be the source of her somber expression—and the pure-hearted Takopi is determined to change things for the better! But what truths await him when the curtains rise in this shocking drama?!



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: DOLL
mangas.description: Muriel takes a chance and hurries over to try out for a casting. On her way there, she is knocked off her bike by the dance prodigy, Aleksiej. Somehow, she is cast into a musical as his partner!

mangas.title: Whoever Steals This Book
mangas.description:
Descended from a long line of book collectors, high school student Mifuyu is surrounded by books in every aspect of her life. Her great-grandfather established the famous Mikura Hall, a library in the heart of town, and even the townspeople are all avid readers. There's just one problem—Mifuyu hates books! But when a thief in Mikura Hall triggers an ancient curse, she's left with no choice but to reclaim the stolen books herself…by entering the very stories she despises! With the help of the mysterious Mashiro, will she be able to restore her great-grandfather's collection and save her town from a magical doom?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Natsu to Lemon to Overlay
mangas.titleNative: 夏とレモンとオーバーレイ
mangas.description:
Sayaka Konno, a stunning office worker for a large company, asks voice actress YUNIMARU, who struggles to find work in her day job, to read her will at her funeral. Despite her reservations, YUNIMARU is intrigued by the sum of money and accepts the invitation. Dreams, daily life, and the wealth of life... Two people from different "layers" spend only one summer together, touching each other's wounds.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Tomie: Again
mangas.description: Tomie Kawakami is a femme fatale with long black hair and a beauty mark just under her left eye. She can seduce nearly any man, and drive them to murder as well, even though the victim is often Tomie herself. While one lover seeks to keep her for himself, another grows terrified of the immortal succubus. But soon they realize that no matter how many times they kill her, the world will never be free of Tomie.

mangas.title: Your Fetters
mangas.description:
Sun-Hee is intrigued by the arrival of the indifferent new girl from Seoul and wants to befriend her. Eun-Byeol puts up a cold exterior and ignores Sun-Hee, who attempts to make friends! When the two finally become friends, Sun-Hee soon starts to question her own feelings for Eun-Byeol



(Source: INKR, edited)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Naisho no Ofutari-sama.
mangas.titleNative: ないしょのおふたりさま。
mangas.description:
Don't you think about anything else other than food…??



Eliza is a young lady who is only interested in "food." One day, a delinquent girl named "Misaki" shows up offering "delicious local specialties" for her.
Misaki seems scary, but... Eliza just can't resist those delicious snacks!



(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

mangas.title: Koroshi Korosare Sankaku Kankei ni Watashi ga Ima kara Hairun desu ka?
mangas.titleNative: 殺し殺され三角関係に私が今から入るんですか？
mangas.synonyms: Am I About to Join a Kill-Or-Be-Killed Love Triangle?
mangas.description:
Kohaku was a loner in junior high school, and she dreams of a more fulfilling social life in high school. However, on her first day of school, she falls down the stairs and ends up hospitalized for a month! This means that everyone else has already made friends and formed groups at school...



In order to avoid being left all alone, she summons up the courage to talk to the only odd-numbered clique in her class. But it turns out that they are at the top of the school social caste, and they are caught up in a blood-splattered yuri love triangle...!?



A suspenseful high school comedy about trying to fit in!



(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

mangas.title: Searching for My Perfect Brother
mangas.titleNative: 私の正しいお兄ちゃん
mangas.description: Rize, who's a university student, met Kairi at her part-time job at the supermarket. While lending her shoulder to Kairi who has trouble sleeping, she is reminded of her older brother who left her when she was young, and Rize starts to feel affection towards him. However, she was shocked when she saw Kairi's diary in his apartment saying that he had killed someone. What is the truth behind the person she likes? As the truth slowly comes to light, Rize starts chasing after her love for Kairi! This is Morie Satoshi's roller coaster work that has crime, mystery and love!!

mangas.title: Seasons in Bloom
mangas.description:
Two young girls at a renowned boarding school depend on and despise each other for the attention they both desperately want—and the love they cannot sustain. Every rose has its thorns, each dazzling flame burns in this period thriller set in turn of the century Seoul, during Japan's colonial occupation of Korea.


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Yoarashi ni Warau
mangas.description: Ogino, a high school teacher, is persecuted by the students of her homeroom class, who call her "sludge". The only place where Ogino can be an ideal teacher is in the letters she writes to a truant girl named Yoarashi. One morning, she receives a reply to her letter from Yoarashi!

mangas.title: Kono Ai wo Owarasete Kurenai ka
mangas.titleNative: この愛を終わらせてくれないか
mangas.description: Yuzu is Hayami Madoka's ardent fan. Having no friends or family that care for her, Madoka is her only solace. Being that Sachiko is Madoka's best friend, she is Yuzu's most hated existence. To vent, she opens a secret account where she posts malicious comments about Sachiko. When she discovers this, she instead attempts to befriend Yuzu and offers her a chance to talk to Madoka. However, an accident occurs and they end up switching bodies with Sachiko being left in coma.

mangas.title: Yume no Hashibashi
mangas.description:
Kyoko is at the autumn of her life.


She can barely recognise her own family member. But one day, someone she remembers perfectly comes to visit. Her name is Mitsu, the woman Kiyoko had a love story with. Just after the war, when they were still teenagers, they nearly did the irredeemable out of passion.

Despite a few meetings from time to time, life ups and downs separated them, but the story draws us back in the time when they couldn't imagine life without each other.


(Source: Atelier Akatombo, translated)

mangas.title: Star ☆ Twinkle Precure
mangas.titleNative: スター☆トゥインクルプリキュア
mangas.description:
The story begins when the protagonist Hikaru meets aliens Lala, Prunce, and Fuwa while watching the night sky. She learns of the "Star Palace," where the 12 Star Princesses of the constellations kept the balance of the universe until they were attacked. Lala is searching for the legendary Precure warriors to help find the 12 scattered "Princess Star Color Pens" and revive the princesses. When Fuwa is captured by an enemy, Hikaru wishes to save Fuwa, and a Star Color Pendent and a Star Color Pen appear to allow her to transform into Cure Star. From then on she works to collect the pens and raise Fuwa, who is the key to reviving the princesses.



Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mahoutsukai Precure!
mangas.titleNative: 魔法つかいプリキュア！
mangas.description:
Mirai is a 13-year-old girl who lives in the human world. One day she witnesses a mysterious object fall from the sky into the park. Excitedly, she brings her stuffed bear Mofurun with her to see what it was. When she gets there she sees a girl named Riko flying on a broom. Riko is of the same age and from the magical world. Mirai has a lot of questions, and Riko explains that she's searching for a jewel with strong powers called "Link Stone Emerald."



Then Batti, an ally of the dark magic users Dokurokushi, appears before them and demands that Riko hand over the "Link Stone Emerald," which Riko herself had been looking for. To make things worse, Batti uses dark magic to create a monster known as a Yokubaru! Mirai and Riko join hands and with the magic words "Cure-up Rapapa!" they transform into the legendary Pretty Cure.



(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: Itoshi no Ko, Charlotte
mangas.titleNative: 愛しの故・シャーロット
mangas.description:
Orphans Charlotte and William finally confess their feelings for each other and promised to be together forever. Yet, Charlotte is suddenly killed in a motor accident, leaving William devastated. Death is usually the end of most relationships, but it seems that Will has other plans...


Includes 1 bonus chapter.

mangas.title: Kono Kakegae no Nai Jigoku
mangas.titleNative: このかけがえのない地獄
mangas.description:
Collection of one-shots.


1. Kono Kakegae No Nai Jigoku (このかけがえのない地獄, This Irreplaceable Hell)

2. Shindeiru Kimi (死んでいる君, Dead You)

3. 4 Ban Me no Heroine (４番目のヒロイン, Fourth Heroine)

4. Damare NEET (黙れニート, Shut Up NEET)

5. Boku wa Kanojo no Kanojo (僕は彼女の彼女)

mangas.title: Boku wa Konyaku Haki Nante Shimasenkara ne
mangas.titleNative: 僕は婚約破棄なんてしませんからね
mangas.synonyms: I Won't Be Breaking Off This Engagement. You Know That, Right?
mangas.description: The one who's become the Crown Prince's fiancée is the Duke's daughter Serea, but during their first meeting, she screamed and collapsed! Had she remembered something from her previous life? Are you an evil villainess? Am I going to break you if I fool around too much? A me that's programmed to be like that, is so horrible. Isn't that right~ An "event" and those "program settings" have no connection to me though. Let's go back to my place and I'll slowly and sweetly make you fall desperately in love with me!

mangas.title: Kanjuten
mangas.description:
An anthology of horror stories. Please enjoy the "sensation" of everyday life going haywire.



(Source: Cycomi, translated)

mangas.title: A Timid Lady was Turned into an Ugly Cat, but on the Verge of Fainting Is Picked Up by the Most Fearsome Military Duke
mangas.titleNative: ブサ猫に変えられた気弱令嬢ですが、最恐の軍人公爵に拾われて気絶寸前です
mangas.synonyms: Busaneko ni Kaerareta Kiyowa Reijou desu ga, Saikyou no Gunjin Koushaku ni Hirowarete Kizetsu Sunzen desu
mangas.description: Marie's life as a viscount's daughter is snatched away when her own sister curses her to become a cat...and then steals her betrothed! Forsaken, she collapses from hunger, when tender hands reach out—and on the other side is the undefeated duke with a reputation for being cruel and unfeeling?! Marie's turn from misfortune to a comfortable cat life begins here!

mangas.title: Hikikomori-hime to Dokuzetsu Kishi-sama
mangas.titleNative: 引きこもり姫と毒舌騎士様
mangas.description:
A heartwarming (?) romantic comedy with a sweet but poisonous tongue...



The handsome knight is given the task of enticing the reclusive princess out of her room. But behind his princely smile is another face!?



(Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

mangas.title: Hinatsugimura
mangas.description:
While looking for the ruins of a pre-WWII village deep in the mountain wilderness, a group of college students find themselves stuck thanks to a sudden thunderstorm. With no phone service, they decide to wait out the rain in a mansion. But little do they know, a ghastly fate awaits them...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The One I Love
mangas.description: This unique and romantic 12-story anthology dives into the heart of the matter of insecurity and honesty, marriage and independence, and, of course, the single subject CLAMP seems to know best: love.

mangas.title: Kyou wa Mada Futsuu ni Narenai
mangas.titleNative: 今日はまだフツーになれない
mangas.description: Takahashi, a 27-year-old freelancer who likes cute girls, and Yamashita, a fast-paced but sensitive manga artist. At the end of their high school years, the two, who had no desire to find a job or go on to higher education, have been together ever since they got detention for their desired career path. Going on to higher education, getting a job, getting married...they are troubled by the "futsuu" they often encounter in their lives, but somehow manage to stay positive. Two girls. A just-right relationship that loosely fits their hearts.

mangas.title: Slow Jet Coaster
mangas.titleNative: スロー・ジェットコースター
mangas.description:
Hiyori, a hidden fujoshi, spends her days fantasizing online about two of her classmates.

"Sweet" and "Bitter" will meet in this love story !



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: The Resourceful Little Consort
mangas.synonyms: The Baby Concubine Wants to Live Quietly
mangas.description: In the nation of Seora, Yehwa Aryun is the Empress Regnant, and her court is full of consorts with special powers. The newest member of the imperial court is 8-year-old Sanya Yeoran. And although she has no powers, Sanya actually has the mind of an adult who knows exactly what will happen in this fantasy world, because she already read about it in her past life. Thanks to that, she comes up with a plan to avoid her tragic execution: stay away from Yehwa and her jealous consorts at all costs!

mangas.title: Rinko-chan to Himosugara
mangas.titleNative: 凛子ちゃんとひもすがら
mangas.description:
An elementary school girl is paying a young man to spend time with her so she isn't lonely anymore.



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories
mangas.synonyms: My Husband Hates Me, But He Lost His Memories
mangas.description:
In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore's memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Futari no Arcadia
mangas.description:
After being coerced into attending a mixer by her friends, Kotoko finds herself enamoured with another girl there, the mysterious and radiant Tsutsuji.

1. The Girls' Arcadia: Erosion

2. The Girls' Arcadia: Elysium

3. The Girls' Arcadia: Emotional

4. Ribbons Untie, Frills Melt (リボンはほどけるフリルは溶ける)

5. What is Love? (愛とか恋とかわからない)

6. Afterwards (その後)

7. Remembrance of Arcadia (追憶のアルカディア)

8. Becoming Cute, Becoming Clean (かわいくなって、きれいになって)

9. Narumi and Kashiwagi (なるみと柏木)

mangas.title: Aoi-kun ni wa Kanawanai
mangas.titleNative: 蒼井くんにはかなわない
mangas.description:
High school freshman, Aoi Rio, has a secret that can't be told to anyone. He actually watches "Magical Girls" anime!
On his way back home after secretly buying anime merchandise as usual, he saves a girl named Sumire who fell from the sky.
Sumire is disheartened because she believes her powers are not good enough. After Aoi encourages her by explaining the value of Magical Girls, Sumire asks him to become her Magical Girl instructor!

mangas.title: Foam of the Sea
mangas.description: Despite the war raging between the North and South, Margaret is a northerner who holds an unwavering love for her southern lover, Squall... until he cruelly betrays her and pushes her off a seaside cliff. Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold...

mangas.title: Hisokana Hana Emi
mangas.description:
Because of her eye-catching looks, there are rumors that Yohira Shino plays around with men. Thus, she is both treated as a nuisance and feared by those around her. One day, she meets Yozakura Yuui, a sophomore upperclassman who Shino remembers disliking due to the former being an honors student. Howeover, due to some circumstances, they start to live together in the same dorm room. Though Shino initially opposes, she finds that there's something about Yuui that separates her from everyone she's encountered until now.


Includes chapter 0.

mangas.title: Alice Kara Mahou
mangas.description: When Alice was little, her late mother foresaw that when Alice turns 13, an event will change her life forever. Now a spirited 13 year old, Alice plays and bickers with her friends, has a boy she's interested in and, like her mom, loves to foretell the future using Tarot cards. One day, Alice is watching the stars with her classmates when a meteor shower passes. Only, it's not "stars" that are falling, but magic jewels! These gems can be absorbed by human bodies, causing various side effects, most of them not pleasant. And so Alice, armed with a key to open human hearts and a magical bunny for a sidekick, sets out to extract all the gems before they cause too much damage, healing hearts along the way.

mangas.title: (Kari) Hanayome no Yangotonaki Jijou: Rikon Dekitara Ikkaku Senkin!
mangas.titleNative: (仮)花嫁のやんごとなき事情 ～離婚できたら一攫千金!～
mangas.description: Ferdia, a girl from the orphanage, is a working woman with 29 jobs. One day she was asked to marry the prince of the enemy country Erland, Poison Dragon Prince Crow, Clovis Kurwach Erland?! In addition, the mission given to Ferdia is "peaceful" divorce with Crow...!?

mangas.title: 2.5D Boyfriend
mangas.description: Koino Tsumugi is a sixteen year old otaku who only has eyes for "Tokki"—a 2D character in her favorite otome game! She has no interest in real boys... Then one day she's rescued by a guy who's the spitting image of Tokki...?!

mangas.title: The Splendid Work of a Monster Maid
mangas.titleNative: 怪物メイドの華麗なるお仕事
mangas.description:
Once upon a time, there was an elderly woman. She lived alone, save for a darling black cat that she doted on. After many years, the cat finally gained the ability to transform-"Look, mistress! I've turned into a human. Now I can repay your kindness!" Alas, the kitty was just a little too late to help her owner. Legend has it she now wanders the Demon Realm, looking for a place where she belongs…And so begins the tale of Sumire the nekomata and her splendid work as a monster maid!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Witch of Thistle Castle
mangas.synonyms: La Sorcière du château aux chardons
mangas.description:
The last in a long line of Witches of the Black Wood, Marie Blackwood lives a quiet life in Edinburgh – away from the scrutiny of the Church. But when the Church thrusts 13-year-old Theo into her hands for safekeeping, Marie suddenly gains the responsibility not just of taking care of a teenager – but protecting the world, and Theo himself, from the amazing power that lives inside of him.



(Source: Titan Manga)

mangas.title: Fuhoni desu ga, Ryukishidan ga Kahogo desu
mangas.titleNative: 不本意ですが、竜騎士団が過保護です
mangas.synonyms: Sorry, but the Dragon Knight Order Is Just Too Overprotective!
mangas.description: The second princess of the Kingdom of Lybra, Leonora, decides to venture the perilous undertaking of infiltrating as "Nora" into the Dragon Knight Order of the neighboring kingdom, Wahnrein, to watch over the apple of her eyes, her little sister who was married off to the crown prince of Wahnrein! However, she soon gets into a tight spot as the commander of the Dragon Knight Order, Harvey, who is known throughout the continent as "Dragon Slayer," finds out about her real identity!! Furthermore, she seals a contract with the dragon "Aksel"?!

mangas.title: The Girl with the Sanpaku Eyes
mangas.titleNative: 三白眼ちゃんは伝えたい。
mangas.synonyms: The Feelings of a Girl with Sanpaku Eyes
mangas.description:
Meet Amane Mizuno a girl with fierce sanpaku eyes and a pure heart! She has recently fallen for a boy named Katou, who has the exact opposite attitude! Will the tender-hearted Amane ever tell him how she feels?!


(Source: Denpa)


Notes:

- Chapter count includes a bonus chapter.

- Originally self-published on Twitter, after six chapters it was serialised by GANGANpixiv.

mangas.title: Wrapping up the Imperial Harem
mangas.description:
Her favorite novel was set in the imperial harem. Now she gets to solve its mysteries! When Xiao Ling took a job at a bookstore, she had no idea she'd be working with her favorite author. Arriving at the palace she'd only read about in stories, Xiao Ling finds not the seasoned authoress she expected, but...the Crown Prince, Ryuhou?!



(Source: MANGA UP!)

mangas.title: Joou Ophiria yo, Onore no Shi no Nazo wo Toke
mangas.titleNative: 女王オフィーリアよ、己の死の謎を解け
mangas.description:
On the verge of death, Queen Ophelia wished, "I want to know who killed me." Then, in accordance with an "ancient promise" given only to the owner of the crown, the Fairy King Leah brought her back to life for just ten days!



"I died once, so this time, I will do whatever I want."



Ophelia's husband, who tried to use her to seize power... Her brother, who is unreliable and tends to be swayed by those around him... A knight of the royal guard who has fallen in love with her... The list of possible culprits is endless. Who killed the queen?!



A royal mystery begins in the palace with a strong slap that will clear the queen's name before her death!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Magical Girl Raising Project
mangas.description:
Sugar and spice--but not playing nice! The manga based on the hit novel series!

Magical girls like Snow White and La Pucelle have dreamed of the day they'd become one of the lucky few chosen to protect N City. But their dreams quickly turn into a nightmare when the Magical Girl Raising Project Management Office issues a decree--there are simply TOO MANY magical girls! Oops! Time to cull the number by...half? Half sounds good. Don't worry, retirement just means...you die. Good luck, girls!



(Source: Yen Press)


Chapter count includes chapter 5.5

mangas.title: My Gemini
mangas.synonyms: La Désastreuse Histoire des Jumeaux Stevenson
mangas.description:
Plain, redheaded, and freckled John has nothing going for him, except his two friends who are incredibly popular at school—twins Jekyll and Hyde. The twins, indistinguishable, have always enjoyed taking each other's places for fun. But when the pair is fragmented by an untimely death, it's up to John to find out…which twin is left? 



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Shinu Hodo Sukitte Ittajan.
mangas.titleNative: 死ぬほど好きって言ったじゃん。
mangas.synonyms: I Said I Love you to Death, Didn't I?
mangas.description:
Aoi Asumori is a high school boy with a peculiar constitution that allows him to see spirits.
He has a secret crush on his classmate Ai Ichinose.



Ai has a cheerful personality and is very popular.
However, there are always a lot of vengeful spirits lurking behind her—.



Why do the spirits come to her?



And what about the mysterious accidents that are gradually creeping up on her?
What will happen when Aoi decides to become a hero to protect her…?



(Source: Comic Pool, translated)

mangas.title: Merit and the Egyptian God
mangas.titleNative: メリトあいきゅうごっど
mangas.description:
Despite being very much alive, Merit finds herself lost in the Realm of the Dead! To get back home, she'll need help from the god Anubis. Only one problem...he's been cursed and wants nothing to do with humans or his job anymore. But the handsome, good-for-nothing god may care more than he lets on, and Merit is no quitter!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Romantic Dark
mangas.titleNative: ロマンティック・ダーク
mangas.description: Neo, who is about to make his major debut in the band, gets constantly injured. A traffic accident that happened for three days in a row, a mysterious high fever and him constanly falling down the stairs... The manager ordered me to remove the curse, and the one I was heading towards was a pretty girl- "Yoyo". "I'll help you find the mystery of your destiny", the girl spoke, while stepping into my life----- A bandman with a mysterious attraction, musician x a spirit, who only seeks to find the mystery of fate. The most terrifying mix of love and horror!?? The duo's occultic love has begun

mangas.title: Tenshi Dattara Yokatta
mangas.titleNative: 天使だったらよかった
mangas.description:
Kako, a first-year high school girl, has been friends with Taisei and Yuna since elementary school, and she wished they could always be "the three best friends" forever.
But the fragile and precariously balanced relationship crumbled when Taisei got injured, and Taisei and Yuna became a couple during his recovery.
And then, a mysterious boy who met Taisei while he was in the hospital appeared...



(Source: Betsuma, translated)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Nui ni Koishite Ii desu ka?
mangas.titleNative: ぬいに恋していいですか？
mangas.description: Ikumi is a high school girl whose hobby is making stuffed toys. When she is rescued by Ayato, the most popular boy at her school, she decides to give him a handmade stuffed doll as a thank-you, but she witnesses him secretly throwing it into the garbage. That was when the "curse" of the stuffed animal is activated and Ayato is turned into a doll himself…

mangas.title: Mushroom Girls in Love
mangas.description:
Our story begins on an all-woman planet of intelligent fungi, where Ariella and Eriella are about to get married! But they've got a long road ahead of them: illness, surgery, and even a dastardly royal plot that seeks to split them apart. Is their love strong enough to weather any storm? This offbeat, adorable, and dramatic one-shot is sure to please fans of yuri, monster girls, and enduring romance!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Jinsei 2-shuume wa Yandere Kareshi wo Amayakashite Happy End ni Narimasu!!
mangas.titleNative: 人生２周目はヤンデレ彼氏を甘やかしてハッピーエンドになります!!
mangas.synonyms: Jinsei Nikaime wa Yandere Kareshi wo Amayakashite Happy End ni Narimasu!!
mangas.description:
Must avoid the death route! ?? Route selection romantic comedy ☆



On the day of the high school graduation ceremony, Himari Ichinose was pushed down by her boyfriend, Shion Taniguchi, and died ... or she thought, but when she woke up, time was back in the second year of high school!!
In order to avoid the route where she is killed by Shion, the struggle for the second lap of Himari's life begins!!



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Vampeerz
mangas.description:
Ichika's life has taken a sudden turn. Her grandmother has passed away, so as family and friends come from far and wide to pay their respects, she finds herself in the spotlight as many of these old faces have taken an interest in her youth. As a fourteen-year-old Ichika could be dating. She could be participating in extra-curricular activities. She could be looking to her future. ...But she hasn't done any of that. All of that will change, when a young guest who she does not recognize visits her home. Aria seems to know quite a bit about her family and property, and while she may be there to say goodbye, she may have found her way into Ichika's heart.

(Source: Denpa)

mangas.title: Betrayal of Dignity
mangas.description:
Would you sacrifice your honor to marry a Duke?

In order to save her family from ruin, Chloe Verdier must find a groom for her sister, Alice. She soon runs into the handsome but arrogant Duke Tisse who makes a proposal that could save them. When Alice flees with a mysterious man, Chloe must seek out the Duke in the biggest gamble of her life.

mangas.title: Himitsu no Otsukiai wo Shiteimasu.
mangas.titleNative: ひみつのお付き合いをしています。
mangas.description:
Dating is exciting every day.


Takase, a second-year high school student, is dating a popular person in the same class, Togawa. However, the relationship between the two remains a secret to everyone. They're cool in front of their friends, but Takase is always thrilled by Togawa, who becomes lover-like when he's alone.


However, one day, Kurono, a senior in the third grade, finds out that they are dating! Moreover, Kurono is interested in Takase.


A wholesome story of a doting boyfriend and a slightly ditzy girlfriend ♪

mangas.title: I Guess I Became the Mother of the Great Demon King's 10 Children in Another World
mangas.titleNative: 異世界で最強魔王の子供達10人のママになっちゃいました。
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Mother of the Strongest Demon Lord's 10 Children in Another World
mangas.description:
Akari was a typical game-loving 16-year-old girl who lived with her mother, until a fateful accident left her an orphan. A year later, she makes a fateful wish on a game cartridge to be a great mother for a family of her own—only to be swept through a portal into another world! She finds she's been summoned as the "priestess from another world"...whose role is to become mother to the children of the demon king himself?!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Nurarihyon no Hanayome
mangas.description: "Nurarihyon's Bride" is a Japanese-style fantasy romance featuring Tsukiyo, a lonely girl who works in the Yukaku district. She has a burn scar on her face wich she covers with a mask. One day, a mysterious man suddenly chooses Tsukiyo. He is a youkai king named Oboro, who says he is looking for a stone to become a complete youkai. Oboro seems to think that Tsukiyo may have the stone ...

mangas.title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Irotoutoshi-hen
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に令 色尊し編
mangas.synonyms: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Variety-Respecting Chapter
mangas.description:
It is the third and final arc of the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei series.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Hero's Savior
mangas.synonyms: It's My Destiny To Be The Hero's Saviour
mangas.description:
After years of torture at the hands of her own father, young elementalist Ariadne Eldier sees her chance to escape when her mother's untimely death prompts a visit from her grandfather, a powerful archmage. Once whisked away to safety, Aria begins her plans to not only distribute an elixir for the contamination plaguing the land, but also save the protagonist and prevent this novel's tragic ending. But with her own fated death looming, will Aria be able to become the hero this tale needs?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Tiger and Dragon
mangas.titleNative: たいがー＆どらごん ～幼馴染3人のおたわむれ日和～
mangas.description:
When Konomi was five years old, her best friend and neighbor Kagetora moved away. After ten years with no communication, Konomi decides it's time to finally move on from her childhood crush. Luckily, with her other childhood friend Tatsuomi waiting in the wings, it looks like romance is right around the corner. That is, until Kagetora suddenly reappears, and Konomi's love life is thrown into chaos!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Chapter count includes one bonus chapter.

mangas.title: An Easy Introduction to Love Triangles (To Pass the Exam!)
mangas.titleNative: 合格のための！やさしい三角関係入門
mangas.synonyms: Goukaku no Tame no! Yasashii Sankaku Kankei Nyuumon
mangas.description: In pursuit of Akira, the senpai she admires and loves, Mayuki Yukishita does her best to pass her exams and get into the same school as her, only to end up dead last on a mock test. To help her out, her mom gets her a private tutor, Rin Mochizuki, a polyamorous girl from the same school as her senpai who ends up taking Mayuki's first kiss, and who is closer to Akira than Mayuki knows...

mangas.title: HIRAETH -The End of the Journey-
mangas.titleNative: ヒラエスは旅路の果て
mangas.synonyms: Hiraeth is the End of the Journey
mangas.description:
After the death of her best friend, Mika is determined to follow her into the grave. But her suicide attempt introduces her to a world unlike any she's ever seen...full of gods and spirits and entities of which she could never have dreamed. But even with this world of wonder, can she find a way out of her sorrow?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: My Darling Next Door
mangas.description:
Ririka thinks she must be missing out—after all, what high school girl isn't obsessed with romance? But when a young, handsome salaryman moves in next door, she realizes she may just be able to understand the appeal of crushes, after all…



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Husband and Wife in Training: I Got Married to an Elite Heir
mangas.titleNative: 見習い夫婦～エリート御曹司に娶られました～
mangas.synonyms: The Couple in Training ~The Elite Noble Took Me as His Bride~
mangas.description:
Kisa, who works hard at the family business, is a country girl that has never once been in love. One day, Amane, a young CEO who is the descendant of an old noble family, visits her family home on business and suddenly proposes to her. "I'd like to marry you." When Kisa asks why, he confuses her even more by simply stating, "I can just feel it." Eventually, his straightforward words win over her heart, and she agrees to live together with the premise of marriage. Despite his cool and collected exterior, his sweet and gentle actions bring them closer, but their new life together may encounter more trouble than expected...?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: The Villainess Becomes a Mom
mangas.titleNative: 悪女なのにママになりました
mangas.synonyms: I'm a Villainess, but I Became a Mother
mangas.description:
Reborn into a novel, Lulu Ekray knew that she was destined to become the villainess and that she would fall in love with the male protagonist, her obsession with him eventually leading to her execution. Nonetheless, she falls in love with Grand Duke Carlix Rochester anyway, but now, the obsessive one is him! After a night of passion, Lulu gets pregnant, but to avoid becoming the villainess, she decides to leave Carlix. But Lulu has no idea just what lengths Carlix will go to get her back!



(Source: Tapas)



Note: chapter count includes 18 side stories.

mangas.title: Talented Baby Squirrel
mangas.synonyms: Baby Squirrel Is Good at Everything
mangas.description:
When squirrel-shifter Beaty Aslan tells her fiancé, Prince Retter, that she plans to flee her abusive aunt, he unexpectedly kills her with his snake fangs. Upon opening her eyes, she finds herself in the past, before she met that rotten prince. With her knowledge of the future, she sets off to her father's duchy to strike a deal and change her fate, but is surprised to find her lion family welcoming her with open arms. Will the stars be on her side so she can rewrite history and get her revenge?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: What It Means to Be You
mangas.description:
Princess Violet always played by the rules—right down to marrying the hot-tempered Winter, an illegitimate noble, to save her family from ruin. Though Violet fell head over heels for Winter at first sight, her dream of happiness was shattered when her family lost its royal standing on their wedding day, leaving her branded a swindler and an outcast. Three years later, Violet endures endless shame, convinced even her husband wouldn't care if she died. Desperate, she attempts to take her own life… only to wake up in Winter's body! Now, trapped in each other's lives, they're forced to see the world through the other's eyes. Could this strange twist be their one chance to truly understand—and love—each other?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Writing My Male Lead's Happily Ever After
mangas.synonyms: I Will Take Responsibility for the Welfare of the Male Lead
mangas.description:
A madman with a tragic childhood and a disease that brings on insanity, destined to fall obsessively in love with the saintess of the holy nation… This was the male lead of the melodramatic novel I wrote. He is also the very person who kills Laria Sherwood, the villainess I possessed, and whom I must stay away from to survive… or so I thought, until I saw the terrible reality I created. I suppose, as the author, it wouldn't hurt to teach him how to love, then leave right when the female lead appears, right? But will it be as easy as I thought?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Duchess in the Glass House
mangas.synonyms: The Duchess of the Glass Greenhouse
mangas.description: Rayna Vinosht was always known as the cursed one. Unloved by her father, she's married off to the handsome Duke Edgar Heathvilian, but he soon becomes cold to her, taking away her son, and giving him to the seductive Monica Espert. But Rayna has a second chance at life thanks to Ondine, an adorable water spirit, who forms a contract with her. Soon Rayna has supernatural powers and the confidence to rule over her estate like a strong duchess, but what will happen now that Edgar is falling in love with her?

mangas.title: Yamamoto Zenjirou to Moushimasu
mangas.titleNative: 山本善次朗と申します
mangas.description: Hotate is a 10 year old girl who was living at her grandmother's house since her mother died. One day her grandmother tells Hotate that she can't care for her anymore because of her age and that she's going to have to live at her uncle's house. After moving to her uncle's house, she attends a new school, but things aren't easy because of her special ability to see the dead. Can she make friends with students in her new class? And what's the secret behind the bond between her and her uncle...?!

mangas.title: Sekisei Inko
mangas.description: A young man, Kaneda, is inflicted with trauma-induced amnesia after discovering the body of his classmate and friend, Hiwako Shima. After being picked up from the hospital by a mysterious benefactor, he resumes school, and tries to piece together his memories of the incident. To make matters more confusing, his buried memories have manifested in the form of a surreal being, whose head is shaped like a crescent moon. Together, they set off to solve the mystery of Hiwako's murder.

mangas.title: Sekai de Ichiban Itaranu Koi
mangas.titleNative: 世界で一番いたらぬ恋
mangas.synonyms: The Most Immature Love in the World
mangas.description: Despite being very pretty, fifteen-year-old Mirai-chan doesn't have any friends due to her pessimistic personality. Tooru-kun is very handsome, elegant, and bright but he doesn't even have a friend, but is it because of his social status? They both want friendship but since it is the first time for them, will it be the beginning of the most immature love in the world?

mangas.title: Aqua
mangas.description: After 150 years of Terraforming, Aqua, the formerly planet known as Mars, now has more than 90 percent of its surface covered in water. A young girl named Akari Mizunashi arrives at the city of Neo-Venezia, an exact replica of the old Italian city of Venice, hoping to become an Undine, the most coveted job on Aqua.

mangas.title: Fiancée of the Wizard
mangas.description: When a woman is reborn into a world of swords and sorcery as a young girl, her new life takes a turn for the fantastic as she meets an impossibly handsome yet surly son of a wizard. A future of magic, adventure, and romance awaits!

mangas.title: Star⇄Crossed!!
mangas.titleNative: ヲタ⇄ドル 推しが私で 私が推しで
mangas.description:
Azusa lives for only one man: Chika-kun, of the idol group Prince 4 U. But when she accidentally dies trying (and failing) to save him, she can't believe her luck—to be in literal Heaven with the man she loves! But never one to lie, God says this one is on him, and sends them both back to continue their lives … but there's just one little problem. Their souls have been sent to the wrong bodies! And not only that—they can switch back and forth by kissing? What on Earth does fate have in store for them?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes:

- Contains an extra chapter.

- Contains two "Watashi ga Motete Dousunda" side stories.

mangas.title: I'm not a villainess!! Just Because I Can Control Darkness, Doesn't Mean I'm a villain
mangas.titleNative: 私は悪役令嬢なんかじゃないっ!! 闇使いだからって必ずしも悪役だと思うなよ
mangas.synonyms: I'm Not a Villainess!! Just Because I Can Control Darkness Doesn't Mean I'm a Bad Person!
mangas.description:
A certan incident caused Sakura's life to end. Just when she was feeling down thinking that her life has ended, she suddenly found that she had reincarnated into the world of a novel she once read!... But she had reincarnated as the villanous noble lady Claudia. She possessed the blessing of Spirit King of Darkness and is hated by those around her; what's more, she was fated to die a tragic death! There's no way I'd let both my previous and present lives end in tragedy! She had began to change the future, but...



(Source: Alpha Manga)



Note: The total chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

mangas.title: How to Hide the Emperor's Child
mangas.synonyms: วิธีซ่อนทายาทของจักรพรรดิ
mangas.description:
Astelle, the empire's one-day empress brought with her a secret when she left the palace after the divorce: she was pregnant with Emperor Kaizen's child. Six years later, Astelle is living a peaceful life in the countryside with their son until the imperial guards come knocking. Kaizen requires Astelle's consent to receive the key territory of Meilen. With the empire still in turmoil from a rebellion, will Astelle be able to hide her son's identity from these threatening forces, and more importantly, from his father, the emperor?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Three Days of Happiness
mangas.titleNative: 寿命を買い取ってもらった。一年につき、一万円で。
mangas.description:
Kusunoki used to believe he was destined for great things. But now, approaching the age of twenty, he's a completely mediocre college student with no motivation, no dreams, and no money. After learning he can sell his remaining years, he chooses to divest himself of all but his last three months. Spending this remaining time with his monitor, Miyagi, has Kusunoki truly destroyed his final chance to find happiness…or has he somehow found it?



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Blissful Land
mangas.description: Khang Zhipa is a 13-year-old doctor's apprentice living in a mountain village in 18th-century Tibet. One day, when he gets back from collecting medicinal herbs, he finds a bride-to-be and her wedding party will be resting at his home for the night. The bride's name is Moshi Rati and it turns out she's actually Khang Zhipa's fiancee from another land, here to stay! Enjoy this heartwarming slice-of-life tale woven by a kind-hearted boy and his mysterious bride.

mangas.title: Rental Onii-chan
mangas.titleNative: レンタルおにいちゃん
mangas.description: After the death of her parents, Kanami Tachibana's once kind older brother suddenly changes for the worse, leaving her to fend for herself. When Makoto Asahi finds her like this, he offers up to become a brother to her. Kanami, feeling the kindness she once felt with her brother and scared to forget her sibling, offers to pay him money for this deed. As their bond strenghtens and Kanami gets to see more of the world than ever, will she get back the kind brother she once loved?

mangas.title: For Better or For Worse
mangas.synonyms: Is It a Fortune or Is It a Woe?
mangas.description: The spunky Lady Dillion didn't realize she was the villain of a romance novel until she encounters Marquess Cedric. Seeing him jogs a dormant memory of the novel's plot, in which her beloved younger sister dies in childbirth after marrying Cedric. Determined to prevent this, Dillion marries him herself, but what fate awaits her when she knows he's meant to fall in love with the real female lead later? In this marriage of convenience, it seems nothing turns out quite how either of them expects...

mangas.title: Kiss Me at the Stroke of Midnight
mangas.titleNative: 午前0時、キスしに来てよ
mangas.description:
At school, Hinana is an honors student, respected by all her classmates. She's totally above things as juvenile as crushes and dating. Secretly, though, she has but one wish: to have a fairy-tale romance. One day, a super-hot celebrity named Kaede shows up at Hinana's high school to shoot a movie, and it becomes difficult to keep up her act. By pure chance—or y'know, fate!—Kaede reveals his own ridiculous personality to Hinana, and her ordinary life turns breathtakingly romantic! Or just really, really … weird?!


(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: A Kind Goblin's Bird
mangas.description: "Would you like to be the bride of a goblin?" Xi'an, the capital of the great Shun. There is a rumor, that at a local apothecary, there is a holy maiden can sing inside your dream and grant wishes to come true. To check if the rumor is true, Prince Sa Heon-Young disguises himself and visits this holy maiden. After listening to her song, as if under an illness, he seeks out the girl...

mangas.title: Tsuiraku JK to Haijin Kyoushi
mangas.synonyms: Lieb mich noch, bevor du stirbst
mangas.description:
Mikoto Ochiai is ready to jump off the rooftop of her high school's building after she got rejected by the boy she loves. However, her physics and home room teacher Jin Haiba suddenly appears on the rooftop for a smoke, talked to her and saved her from falling down. He even asked her to go out with him which made her confused. How will things go between the smart and calm Mikoto and her seemingly carefree teacher Jin?



Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Higurashi When They Cry: GOU Anthology Comic
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業 コミックアンソロジー
mangas.description:
June 1983. While it normally signifies an inescapable doom for Rika and her closest companions, a crew of guest artists bring its cheerful vitality to life! Join the gang in their early summer adventures!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Wizard and His Fairy
mangas.synonyms: The Princess of the Mist Cage and The Magician
mangas.description:
Deep in the forest, in a tower shrouded in mist, there lives a reclusive wizard by the name of Nebelhaut. When he happens across a beautiful fairy who's being held captive and made a public spectacle, he knows he has to take her with him. He names the creature Sti and orders her to call him his master, but her heart remains closed to him. But as time goes on, she sees a different side of him—a side that's both caring and awkward. The distance between the eccentric wizard and strong-willed fairy grows shorter day by day!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Jigoku no Enra
mangas.description: Sixteen-year-old Komachi Takamura is the daughter of a lawyer and a public prosecutor, which makes her a die-hard enthusiast about the law. Komachi does everything by the book and tries her best to help others, whether they ask for it or not. Her high school was perfect until she was branded a future offender by the youngest son of Enma (Yama), Enra from Hell. Who is this Enra and how will Komachi prove herself innocent if she doesn't even know what she did wrong? Only time will tell in the amazing manga Jigoku no Enra.

mangas.title: Kono Kyoushi, Zettai Wazato.
mangas.titleNative: この教師, 絶対わざと.
mangas.synonyms: 這個老師絕對是故意的
mangas.description:
The beautiful Mio Saeki may seem like a proper young lady. But when she's in the language-arts classroom she acts like an old man, eating squid sticks and talking about horse-racing. Only her teacher Shirokawa knows her true nature and despite his slightly sadistic teasing, they get along so well that she finds herself falling for him.



Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Oniokoshi-hen
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に令 鬼熾し編
mangas.description:
As the era changes from Showa, to Heisei, and now Reiwa, the curtain rises once again on a tragedy for the steadily declining population of Hinamizawa. This year, again, one will die and one will go missing on the night of the Watanagashi festival...



(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

mangas.title: The Villainess Who Became a Nightingale
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢は夜告鳥をめざす
mangas.synonyms: Villain Lady Wishes To Be Like Nightingale
mangas.description: After an unfortunate accident, a lonely woman in her thirties finds herself reincarnated as Leysritt Von Lotus, a beautiful, young noble lady. Instead of worrying about boring things like meetings, her biggest problems now include which snacks she wants served with her tea. But something feels off... This world looks an awful lot like the ones in the stories she liked to read in her past life! What if she's not the protagonist, but actually the villainess?! Watch as Leysritt navigates her brand new life, using her education as a nurse to overcome challenges and capture the hearts of those around her!

mangas.title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Hoshiwatashi-hen
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に令 星渡し編
mangas.description:
In the first year of Reiwa, Keitarou Maebara moves from Tokyo to Hinamizawa. He is excited about his new life in Hinamizawa as he gets to know the children of the former club members. Then one day, he meets a mysterious girl named Inori, and another girl who calls herself Kururu contacts Keitarou... Oyashiro-sama's curse transcends time and generations, and will happen again in the world of Reiwa...?



(Source: Big Gangan, translated)

mangas.title: Miniamaru Kareshi
mangas.description:
Iroha Aoyagi is a normal 16 year old girl, except, she's never fallen in love. She suspects there might be something wrong with her; until she meets her classmate Kusakabe-kun who seems well-versed and cynical about matters of love. Will Iroha be able to handle someone like Kusakabe-kun?



Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Flower Dances and the Wind Sings
mangas.synonyms: The Flowers Dance and the Wind Sings
mangas.description:
As Ersella lies on her deathbed, she has only one regret: never being a good mother to her son, Vicente. When fate sends her back three years, she gets a chance to make things right. While reflecting on her past as a young bride and reluctant mother, Ersella begins to untangle years' worth of heartache. But as familial, marital, and even political issues enter the picture, she realizes there's more to her second life than she thought. Will Ersella's change of heart be too little, too late?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Fox's Trap
mangas.description:
Since the age of ten, high school girl Yan has been plagued by a dream in which a fox brutally devours her heart,

Her nightmare almost comes true when Ran, a beautiful demon fox, approaches her during a school field trip when she's left alone. Much to her surprise through, instead of harming Yan, Ran insists on returning her the favor for finding his lost tail. And in exchange for this tail, the omnipotent demon fox grants a wish to the girl.



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Can We Become Family?
mangas.description: Adopted from a poor, rural orphanage by a wealthy duke, Naviah Agnus wanted nothing but to win her new father's heart. Despite her best efforts, the calculating Duke only sees Naviah as a pawn, a mere stand-in for his terminally ill daughter Vivian, who was set to marry the crown prince. But when Vivian miraculously recovers, Naviah is pushed aside and driven to her own death. When she wakes up, she is 8 years old again, but this time, Naviah is done playing nice. Can they ever really become family?

mangas.title: Higurashi When They Cry: MEGURI
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に 巡
mangas.synonyms: Higurashi Meguri : le sanglot des cigales
mangas.description:
June 1983...has passed. At long last, through many trials and tribulations, Rika and her friends have finally escaped the tragedy! The gameboard has been cleared, the pieces scattered, and all that remains is the rest of her life. Or so Rika believes, until she gets pulled into yet another fragment...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Tricked into Becoming the Heroine's Stepmother
mangas.synonyms: Éminence Grise Female Lead Is Trying to Make Me Her Stepmom
mangas.description:
After her death, Daisy Heidi is reincarnated into the world of "Why Did the Duke's Daughter Roll Across the Pumpkin Patch?", a so-called "tragedy" novel where the beautiful heroine Pierta indulges in reckless lust and hedonism with ten ardent suitors to a bitter end. Though Daisy is reborn as a poor commoner in this world, she has one distinct advantage over others in her second chance at life -- she's the author of the original novel! When fate brings Daisy into the lives of the novel's heroine Pierta and her dashing father Duke Henstone, Daisy vows to do everything she can to prevent Pierta's future of despair.


(Source: WEBTOON)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Higurashi When They Cry: GOU
mangas.titleNative: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業
mangas.description:
Life couldn't be better for Keiichi Maebara. Sure, not much happens in the sleepy mountain village of Hinamizawa…but in the three short weeks since moving here, he's already found some amazing new buddies—who are all cute girls! However, when he discovers hints of Hinamizawa's violent history, his dear companions insist on keeping him in the dark. Keiichi can't escape his growing unease—will it be enough to shake his faith in his best friends?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: My Lucky Star
mangas.description:
The cute and bubbly Star Mu has been childhood friends with popular and athletic Austin Si since they were five. The pair know each other like the back of their hands, but as they hit their teen years, they're beginning to think of holding hands…! Despite their close and sweet bond, these fresh feelings can't help but spark issues. Star begins to pull away, and the usually perceptive Austin finds himself at a loss. With new friends on the horizon with their own goals in sight, perhaps things are no longer so clear and simple as they once were…



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Find Me in the Dark
mangas.description: When a young Ran Tang thwarted a kidnapping attempt on her friend, it left her blind and shunned by her family. A chance encounter brings Zhan Luo into her life and their surprising connections (including being engaged to her horrible sister!) keep pulling them back together. She wants nothing to do with this bad boy and yet the usually cold and standoffish Zhan can't help but be drawn to her. He'll basically do anything, yes, ANYTHING, to stay in her life! But how can he get closer to her if he constantly keeps her in the dark?

mangas.title: Sweet Bite Marks
mangas.description:
A noble vampire prince falls for a menial human blood servant... from refusal to acceptance, she begins to worry about him and solve problems for him... However, there are gaps of status, classes and hatred between them, in this confrontation between vampires and humans, will they finally break the rule and be together?



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: Includes 5 prologues, 7 extra, and 11 side story chapters

mangas.title: Tensei Shite Yandere Kouryaku Taishou Chara to Shujuu Kankei ni Natta Kekka
mangas.titleNative: 転生してヤンデレ攻略対象キャラと主従関係になった結果
mangas.synonyms: The Result of Being Reincarnated is Having a Master-Servant Relationship with the Yandere Love Interest
mangas.description:
I was reborn as a Viscount's daughter, Cecil, in a very unexpected otome game where all of the love interests are Yanderes. However, Cecil, being the rival character in the game, was killed in every route by the chosen love interest. Furthermore, wishing to have a long life, Cecil meets Ashley who will be her servant and.... he's one of the Yandere love interests...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Flowers in the Secret Place
mangas.synonyms: Follow You to the Edge of the World | Hua Yu Yinni Zhi Wu
mangas.description: To find her best friend who was caught by ghosts, a girl sneaked into the world of ghosts and provoked the quirky prince of ghosts, there is actually smell of her missing friend on him? ! What's the relationship between him and the girl? The secret hidden in the world of ghosts is about to be revealed...

mangas.title: Cierra
mangas.description: Cierra Elburke and Claude LeSpencer, both sharing backgrounds of illegitimacy, find refuge from the scorn of their family and society in each other's arms. But when Cierra is forced to marry someone other than her beloved, she begs for another chance at life with a happier ending. Through the power of the "key" to the throne that is gifted by Claude, Cierra is given a chance to start over. Yet this time, she chooses to leave everything behind, including Claude, with hope for a better life. Has she made the right choice, or will this second chance prove more disastrous than her original fate?

mangas.title: The Deathless
mangas.description:
An ordinary girl as she is, she possesses the eyes of death which can make her see the death rate of others. Even if she's troubled, she has no access to death! Hearing her calling, the god of death comes for her. However, it's useless? What will happen between a girl who desires death and the god of death who cannot kill the girl? What's the secret of the girl's superpower...



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: 92 mainline chapters + 12 extras chapters, not counting character intro and merchandising announcements.

mangas.title: Searching for My Father
mangas.synonyms: I Only Came to Find My Dad
mangas.description:
The cruel chains of destiny threaten to condemn Louise to a life of slavery. Benjamin, an evil man obsessed with her mother even after her tragic death, takes Louise into his custody, intent on marrying her. Louise tries to escape this horrid fate and awakens eight years in the past. She's set on making things right but is unable to stop tragedy once again. Determined to not give up, Louise embarks on a journey to find her father. What discoveries await her in this fight for freedom? Will her father be the key to her happiness... or her demise?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Queen in the Shadows
mangas.description:
This is not a fairytale. No, this is a story of what lurks beyond the "happily ever after." Once upon a time, Elena assumed the role of Princess Veronica, married the crown prince, and lived happily... until her dutiful knight plunged his sword into her back and the true Veronica stepped out of the darkness. Now, Elena finds herself at the beginning of her cautionary tale. However, this time she intends to do more than play the star of the show. This time, Elena will direct the downfall of everyone who played a part in wronging her.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Love and Heart
mangas.description:
After a messy breakup, college freshman Yoh Yagisawa returns home only to find she has an unexpected male roommate! Introducing himself as her old childhood friend who moved abroad, handsome Haruma Hirose is back to do a homestay. He's totally hot, super nice, and always there when Yoh's in trouble... but could Haruma's timing be a little too perfect? Plus, the house next door, where he claims to have lived-didn't the family there all commit suicide...?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Little Princess and Her Monster Prince
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Wife of the Monstrous Crown Prince
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description: Heroine has traveled back in time and entered the universe of "Lady and the Beast," a 19th century soft porn trashy novel. She finds herself in the body of Anthea, child bride of the Monster Crown Prince Blake, who has been cursed to die at the age of 18 due to this sins of his ancestor. In the novel, Anthea should have committed suicide after looking at the horrible cursed birth marks on Prince Blake's body. But she tries to rewrite a part of the story by instilling confidence in Blake and showering him with unconditional love, just until he is ready to meet his "real" true love, Diana.

mangas.title: Just Leave Me Be
mangas.synonyms: I Want You to Throw Me Away
mangas.description:
Adele was a hapless orphan until a duke gave her a choice: live as a substitute for his dead daughter, or die on the streets. Despite playing this role to the best of her ability, an order for her assassination was given shortly after he married her off. Miraculously, she is sent back in time and decides to make up for the years wasted living a lie. As ancient ruins call to her, can she use her past knowledge and unexpected help from the Black Knight to defeat the dangers ahead and change fate?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: What's Wrong with You, Duke?
mangas.synonyms: Why Are You Doing This, Duke?
mangas.description:
The cruel Duke Rowan Alexei Peruka is a lovestruck puppy around Erin — all thanks to a random magic spell that was cast just as he was about to execute her. But with the spell's power now waning and on the fritz, his shifting moods zip from dramatic professions of eternal love to cold threats of death. Exhausted from the emotional whiplash, Erin must find a magic spell to not only save herself but also her enchanting fairytale marriage before she loses her beloved and bewitched "Ru" forever.



(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: Lady Baby
mangas.description:
Calliope Rustichel's family dies one by one in a series of tragedies. Just when she had given up all hope, a mysterious woman grants Calliope a second chance at life. Little did she know that chance would literally start from birth! Now stuck as an adult in a baby's body, Calliope must uncover the conspiracy behind the death of her family and use her memories of the past to change the future… all while learning how to walk and talk! Who said being a baby was all naps and diaper changes?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

mangas.title: I Belong to House Castielo
mangas.synonyms: I Am a Child of This House
mangas.description:
Sold off by her mother, a young girl winds up in the house of the empire's most feared duke, Ein Castielo. Given the name Estelle, she must come to terms with her family, demon-lineage, and new standing in high society. But what will happen to the innocent Estelle when the enemies of the duke learn of her existence? Does she really have what it takes to be a child of the great and powerful Castielos?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Yuri na Watashi to Akuma na Kanojo (?)
mangas.titleNative: 百合な私と悪魔な彼女(?)
mangas.description:
As a child, Yashiro Nonoyama developed an intense fear of men due to boys constantly bullying her. Now in high school, she dreams of being reunited with her first love: a girl who protected her one day from her bullies. Yashiro is in disbelief when a transfer student named Mikoto Saionji arrives who looks a lot like her first love, but she later discovers that Mikoto is actually a guy, and that he was her first love. Yashiro learns that Mikoto is rapidly turning into a girl, and the only way to counteract this change is for them to passionately make out with each other every day.



(Source: Kiss Manga)

mangas.title: Shouri no Akuma
mangas.description: Today is Asami Tanakamori’s first day at her new school… but it isn’t exactly what she expected. In fact, it seems really strange right from the beginning!! Asami is finding it incredibly difficult to adjust to this party school, but luckily she has her new friend, a pretty “girl” named Akira Kinoshita. Akira seems to have the entire school at “her” command…but there’s a bit more to Akira than Asami would have ever imagined!

mangas.title: Imperfect Girl
mangas.description:
An aspiring novelist witnesses a tragic death, but that is only the beginning of what will become a string of traumatic events involving a lonely elementary school girl.


"Looking back on it now, I realize that incident is what turned me into the novelist I am today. An author is someone who creates tales, but an aspiring author is someone who lies, and nothing more. This incident happened ten years ago, when I was in college, and merely an aspiring author. If those events never took place I wouldn't have become much of anything at all, which is why I think I need to thank her, thank that girl …"



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: prism
mangas.description: School girl Megumi, suffering from an uneventful life after a fleeting grade school romance, hopes to end such boring days with her entrance into high school. Still dreaming about the peaceful days with her past love, Hikaru, she encounters a stunningly beautiful girl on her way to the entrance ceremony. Suddenly, the girl calls out for Megumi and gives her a hug! Hikaru enters back into Megumi's life not only as a classmate, but as a girl. How will Megumi handle the shocking revelation?

mangas.title: Miku-4
mangas.description:
Miku-4 is originally a doujin web comic written by an amateur writer Nagimiso. Crypton authorized him and East Press to publish this manga.

This is a sad and touching story of Hatsune Miku, a shy android created by Crypton. She grew up with the help of the people she met during her journey and gained a human mind by the devotion of an engineer.

mangas.title: Scum's Wish
mangas.description:
Mugi and Hanabi are the perfect high school couple...but their relationship is built on a single shared secret: They're each in love with someone else.


(Source: Yen Press)


Note: Includes one extra chapter and the one-shots "Nyan Nyan Prelude (Meow Meow Prelude)", "Nyan Nyan Serenade (Meow Meow Serenade)", "Nyan Nyan Oratorio (Meow Meow Oratorio)", "Nyan Nyan Cantata (Meow Meow Cantata)" and "Nyan Nyan Andante (Meow Meow Andante)".

mangas.title: I Am Here!
mangas.description:
Invisible to her classmates, Hikage Sumino is an eighth grader with no self-esteem. Her only friends are the visitors to her Internet blog. One day, the most popular boy in the grade suddenly talks to her. Encouraged by this twist of fate, Hikage determines to transform her life and declare to the world, I Am Here!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ibitsu
mangas.description: There's an urban legend that says late at night, sometimes a young girl dressed in gothic lolita clothing will appear by garbage dumps to ask a question. Any who answer will, without fail, die a twisted death. And tonight, another young boy will find himself enveloped by this horror...

mangas.title: Darling Only You!
mangas.titleNative: ダーリンオンリーユー！
mangas.description: Yuzuki has a crush for her super kind and cool brother, but she has her heart broken when he brings his girlfriend home one day. The next day, by chance, she bumps into a guy who looks exactly like her brother! What is this feeling that she has for him? Is it just because he looks like her brother, or is it...?

mangas.title: I'm In Love and It's the End of the World
mangas.titleNative: 地球のおわりは恋のはじまり
mangas.synonyms: 恋してみたからわかるんだ
mangas.description:
Mahiru Yanase's twin sister, Mayo, has it all—she's cute, sweet, and popular. Mahiru, on the other hand … has always been the other Yanase. All her life, Mahiru's reminded herself that every time something good happens to her, something bad comes along to balance it out. She never gets her hopes up … but no sooner does she arrive for her first day of high school than Aoi Satomi, her handsome, mysterious classmate, takes an interest in her—and by the end of the day, he's already asked her out! If things don't balance out for Mahiru soon, the world's going to come to an end!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Je Type Anindeyo?
mangas.description:
"You're here to meet Joogeon-ah, right? …I'm Joogeon-ah."



*Ding* Lately there are many messages from people who mistake Geon-ah for his friend Hyesung. Usually, he would think of it as a prank from Hyesung and try to ignore it... However, the messages were pouring out that day! A message from "Hyundal" came when his work stress was at its peak. Geon-ah suddenly replies to the message sent by Hyundal, who still thought he was Hyesung. The more they talk, the closer they get, and the first encounter between the two, which seemed to never come, is approaching... and so is the illusion.

mangas.title: Starstruck
mangas.description: Seo Han-Jun and Cho Yu-Jae have been best friends since they were young. Han-Jun has secretly been in love with Yu-Jae for a long time but doesn't dare to confess his feelings since he knows they won't be reciprocated. As long as Yu-Jae stays his best friend, that is all that Han-Jun needs to be happy. But as the university entrance exams approach and Yu-Jae becomes more open about his feelings, Han-Jun begins to wonder if it would be okay to reach for that star he thought he could never have.

mangas.title: Yume no Owari de Machiawase
mangas.titleNative: 夢の終わりで待ち合わせ
mangas.description:
After an awkward farewell, childhood friends reunite six years later at university…!?



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Straight Guys Like Yaoi, Too
mangas.titleNative: 春川くんとユキ先生の腐男子事情。
mangas.synonyms: Furachi na Inma ni Ai no Shioki wo!
mangas.description:
Toshiyuki Harukawa loves yaoi and is a major fan of Yuki Tanita, a popular manga artist. Toshiyuki manages to get a job as Yuki's assistant, but despite the cute drawings, the artist themself is actually a buff middle-aged man...! The surprising twist is driving Toshiyuki wild! In addition to this series about an awkward fanboy who falls for an older, male manga artist, this book also contains a fantasy story about a helpless incubus who can only get energy from men, but one day crosses paths with a gorgeous, arrogant exorcist!!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Hate Girl
mangas.description: Unrequited love. A feeling as miserable as a damn sandstorm. Just like how you know you’re breathing in fine dust but do it anyway, so it is with unrequited love. It’s been 5 years and 120 days since I’ve had a crush on my childhood friend. I’ve been rejected as naturally as I breathe every day, but I vow to finally confess my feelings on the day the college entrance exams end. Then one day, I catch my own older sister having a secret rendezvous with the guy I’ve been in love with—what’s going on!?

mangas.title: Soulmate
mangas.description:
Qi went to sleep embraced by her girlfriend, Yuanzi. However, when she opened her eyes she realized that she had been transported 10 years back to the past, back when she was still in high school. While she sees this as an opportunity to save the love of her life, what she doesn't realize is that her teenage self is in her adult body, 10 years into the future, and has no clue about the life Qi has built or how precious the time she has left with Yuanzi is. No matter the time, no matter the age, their love resonates as they stand by each other's side. Will they be able to conquer fate?



(Source: Monogatari Novels)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Isle of Farewell And Reunion
mangas.synonyms: Libie de Dao, Chongfeng de Dao
mangas.description: Giving up her top job to live alone on the island, the writer Elly meets her younger schoolmate Rhea, thus their story starts... Check out how the scheming junior courts her reserved dream lover!

mangas.title: Help! Because Of A BUG, I'm Getting Pestered By The Game's Babes!
mangas.titleNative: 救命！因为出了BUG，我被游戏美少女缠上了
mangas.description:
Game characters come to life because of a bug?! Blossom, the ancient-style girl with an ancient mindset; Cthylla, the mature girl who comes from a mysterious world; Gumi, an idol of the Meow Country, Gumi; II, the mischievous, petite magical girl, and No.7, the AI-powered agent who loves money...


A group of beautiful girls appears and pesters the female game producer. Is this the beginning of a wonderful harem life? No, this is the beginning of a chaotic cohabitation life.


(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Ni Shi Wo De Mingyun
mangas.description: Yuan Bao, a sweet hardworking girl and Zhao Qingwen, a genius girl with high coldness, got married because of taekwondo. The two of them are like Mozart who is dazzling talented and Salieri who is inferior to Mozart, attracking and repelling each other, and gradually developed a deep bond from the initial disgust of two things. Just when the feelings are quietly budding, the successive changes have caused them to fall into unpredictable distress...

mangas.title: Almost Friends
mangas.titleNative: 绝不和狐狸做朋友的兔子
mangas.synonyms: Jue Bu He Huli Zuo Pengyou de Tuzi
mangas.description: One is a rabbit girl with a congenital defect, and the other is a fox girl that's super popular but has a lonely heart. Despite their differences, they are each other's precious 'The Other Me in This World'. When they meet, a story of mutual healing and mutual growth begins...

mangas.title: Liuxing Hua Guo Zhi Ri
mangas.synonyms: The day the shooting star passed
mangas.description:
Chen Xin and Lin Anyun were looking up at the sky at the same time on an ordinary night after work. They both saw three shooting stars pass by at the same time and made their respective wishes. When they woke up the next day, the two found that their souls have switched bodies, the beginning of a wondrous journey. During this time, the everyday things they overlooked, the things they didn't realize because of their personalities, the things they wanted but couldn't have, and the things they had to settle for… every problem seemed to miraculously resolve themselves. The two women meet and they immediately felt a mutual attraction. They grew together as a couple, and became inseparable companions. On a night when three shooting stars pass by once again, will they be returned to their original state?



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Season of Roll
mangas.description: An Juan, 20 years old, dreams of being a cartoonist. This year she finally achieved her dream of being accepted to the studio of the cartoonist she admired the most.
