But she didn't expect the teacher to be the anti-fan she argued with a few days back?! Ji Nian and An Juan have a long road ahead of them. What kind of sparks will fly between the lively and honest assistant and the cold veteran cartoonist?

mangas.title: Qin Ai De Siduitou
mangas.description:
Everyone in the company knows those two women as fierce competitors who fight all the time. But at the company new year's party, they managed to break the ice after a few too many drinks! After that accidental encounter, the sworn enemies begin to have strange feelings about each other…



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Embers and Petals
mangas.synonyms: The Garden of Ashes | Huijin Huayuan
mangas.description: In the Inquisitor Panel of medieval witch hunts, a military leader who only slaughters alien races is assigned to take care of an experimental subject, a vampire who is suspected to kill her father...

mangas.title: Her Tale of Shim Chong
mangas.description:
Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: Re Sou Shua Ping! Ben Yu Tang Ping De Wo Yi Ye Hei Hong
mangas.titleNative: 热搜刷屏！本欲躺平的我一夜黑红
mangas.synonyms: Hot Search is Flooding! I Just Want to Lie Flat, Instead I Get a Black Red Night
mangas.description:
Tied to a Massive Popularity System, she will die if she doesn't become popular? Gu Xiangyi was planning to play the sycophant, riding the coattails of the big star to popularity. But what she got instead was a screenful of haters, who accused her of being a blood-sucking parasite. That was when the beautiful idol pulled in Gu Xiangyi by her waist, bit her playfully on the neck, and whispered in her ear.



"Don't listen to their nonsense."

"I'm the one who wants to suck your blood."



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: He Xixiegui Jiejie Tongju Le
mangas.description:
On the day Song Yu moved into her new place, she was bitten by a beautiful lady vampire who was sealed within the strange stone statue in the yard. Verelle was awakened by the mysterious power within Song Yu, and her desire for blood made her instinctively bite Song Yu. Now she will make Song Yu do her bidding, by tempting her with money. This is the start of a cohabitation life between two girls who don't get along with each other.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Savior
mangas.description:
Wohn Ku is a vampire that needs human blood to survive. As a tenderhearted child, she led a tortured existence until a girl named Seyeon willingly became her steady blood source. Seyeon stood by Wohn throughout their school years, defending her from bullies. Fast forward to the present where they move in together ahead of their freshman year of college. Seyeon remains fiercely protective of her friend, but Wohn is ready for a fresh start. When a devoutly religious sophomore girl named Juyi showers her with kindness, Wohn emerges from her shell only to realize that Juyi had once been her father's kidnapping victim, a potential blood source she had refused to bite. Juyi grows closer to Wohn without remembering the incident, fueling jealousy in Seyeon. Will Juyi prove to be a savior washing away Wohn's guilt, or will she ruin a vampire's dream of redemption?



(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Wei Xian Qing Ren
mangas.description:
I knew you were up to no good!



Huang Yun'er, a D-list actress, deliberately tries to seduce the CEO Ou Chenxi, hoping to investigate the Ou-clan's involvement in her cousin's death. Ou Chenxi sees through Huang Yun'er's scheming right away, but she feels like she's in control of the situation, and Huang Yun'er looks like just her type, so she doesn't reject her potentially dangerous advances. At the same time, she also wants to find out Huang Yun'er's true motives.



One is plotting a seduction but falling in love for real, while the other is irresistibly captivated despite the danger... These two cunning ladies fall for each other, even while fully aware, parrying each other's moves while desperately trying to suppress their growing feelings. As they struggle with their emotions, they gradually uncover the truth behind the secrets from the past.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Xiao Gu Niang
mangas.description:
"I think I could fall in love with you."


"You're cute like a little pony."


A love story between the cute but flighty elder girl "Little Fox" and the younger but more mature "Young Pony." See how they flourish both in love and in life!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Tou Xiang
mangas.description:
Two women hidden away deep in a mansion, who save each other through their roller coaster of a relationship!



Bai Yuetao, the wife of a rich businessman, blames herself for her husband's skirt-chasing. After getting all dressed up, only to spend another night alone in their lavish residence, she sees a graceful woman appear in her new mirror. This woman calls herself "Mengdie" and says that she can teach Bai Yuetao how to "hook" her husband's heart, but the price will be— Bai Yuetao's body.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Heavenly Roommates
mangas.description:
As a rabbit who lost her baby to a tiger, Myo-Ryeong is infuriated by the cruel ways of the jungle. She delves into spiritual training to become divine and create an ideal world, but her resolve weakens with time. Just when she's settled for the status quo, the god she serves sends her down to earth with an impossible quest: finding the "udumbara," a mythical flower that will save the human world. Her partner is none other than Han-Ho, the very tiger responsible for her baby's death! Will the two enemies set aside their past conflict and rescue humanity?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: My Otherworldly Marriage
mangas.synonyms: 政略結婚が嫌でサブ主人公に逃げたのに
mangas.description:
Determined to escape her fate in the novel of being sold off to a loathsome man by her father, Beatrice Arosha runs off to the second male lead, Duke Ruslan Etenas, and proposes a contract marriage. After he immediately agrees, Beatrice moves into Etenas Castle, built on a sealed spirit gate and staffed by ghosts! But as she grows closer to the duke and experiences visions of the original Beatrice, she begins to realize the haunted castle may not be the strangest thing about her marriage…

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Sacred One Speaks
mangas.description:
The evil enemies of the Holy Empire of Cairon must be purged. With the superhuman Nox of Yipon already dealt with, the only ones left to destroy are the Witches of Tempey. After a long search, Cairon's greatest protector, Sir Macklart, finally tracks down their leader, the infamous Grand Witch called Vienie. They say just one look into her bloodred eyes will immediately entrap you into her wicked spell. Though Sir Macklart brushes it off as nonsense, perhaps there is something mysterious behind Vienie's crimson stare, as he certainly can't seem to read the witch's intentions when she suddenly offers to help him eradicate her own kind…



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid
mangas.description:
The year is 1926 in this retelling of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid", and Joseon (present-day Korea), is under colonial Japanese rule. Su-A Heo is a handmaiden who spends her days working and swimming in the sea. Her work is her whole life, until one day, when she discovers a wounded independence fighter named Ui-Hyeon Kang washed up on the shore. She nurses him back to health, only to lose her ability to speak in a botched murder attempt by Ui-Hyeon's comrade, Hae-Su Song. As she travels to the capital, Gyeongseong (present-day Seoul), to get revenge, she finds herself growing more and more intertwined with a strange, brave new world and the people within it.

(Source: WEBTOONS)



Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

mangas.title: Sadistic Beauty: Epilogue
mangas.description:
Gyerin decides to leave behind her ill-fated first love with Doona and start anew. She quickly meets a woman who looks like her ideal type from head to toe... Is Juyeon, full of armor-piercing amounts of charm, her fortune or woe?



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Parent-Teacher Conflict
mangas.synonyms: There Are Always Teachers Who Want to Invite Parents
mangas.description:
One fateful night, Yan, an attractive and free-spirited young woman, meets a lone sheep in a club, Zhiqiao. Like a wolf after its prey, Yan approaches her and is immediately charmed by her beauty. After a passionate night together, Yan wakes up alone in the hotel bed. She thinks they will never meet again... but fate has other plans. As it turns out, Yan is not only Zhiqiao's daughter's teacher, but also her new neighbor! Their parent-teacher meetings are about to get interesting!

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Fuchou Airen
mangas.description: Yan Shuangshuang watched her lover die in front of her. An angel appeared and offered her a second chance. But after she was reborn, everything seemed to be a little bit off.

mangas.title: Perfect Girlfriend Online
mangas.description:
It's the year 2035. Caught in a mid-life crisis, Xu Youyuan decides to put down her pride and experience love so she can make a dating game. Except... she gets a bit more than she's bargained for: the troublemaker Shiyue! Shiyue means business in both the real world and the game world, and her one-minded pursuit is quickly overwhelming Xu Youyuan!



This comic is adapted from the novel "Love Patch for the Middle-Aged."



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Originally published under the title "中年恋爱补丁".

mangas.title: Twin Flames of Destiny
mangas.description:
"I'm actually doing this because of you, Miss Gu."



Top actress Qu Xizhi makes an unconventional decision to take on a male lead role so she can work with Gu Xizhi, another actress who shares her name. The talented yet envious Gu Xizhi worries that Qu will once again outshine her in this new drama, but is determined to give her all to the show. Once the filming begins, Gu must shoot numerous intimate scenes with Qu, whose cross-dressing is remarkably convincing. Can Gu keep up the act, or will it lead to something more... real?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Law of Attraction
mangas.description:
Nan Zhi's day life life is riddled with success and admiration. After work hours, however, her search for a romantic connection of any kind runs rampant. Bored by every encounter she's had, the entertainment company CEO is shocked when a one-night stand imprints itself on her mind. And she's even more shocked when she learns the subject of her infatuation is her best friend's younger sister.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: My Feelings Can Wait
mangas.description:
Even as acclaimed actress Jing Xiu's wedding was going on, Weibo was flooded with news about the rising star Ji Youyan's death from alcohol poisoning. Then, another piece of news hit the headlines: Jing Xiu's wedding had been called off due to unforeseen circumstances. When Ji Youyan woke up, she found herself transported back in time. Three years ago, to be exact — two years after her breakup with Jing Xiu. This time, she swears she'll never lose Jing Xiu again...



(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ta De Shan, Ta De Hai
mangas.description:
Chi Tang and You Yu are both shunned outcasts in Year 1 Class 2 of high school. They are desk-mates, roommates, and each other's salvation, keeping each other warm. Their relationship gradually grow, from just a feeling into something unforgettable, an epic story of young love.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Yuworui Bada
mangas.description:
Busan, 1936. Yeon Jeong lives her life without fitting in anywhere, until she meets a mermaid by fate. The mermaid tells her that she has come to pick her up as promised, and asks her to follow her to the place where eternal happiness lies.


"Can I be happy there at last, living as myself?


(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: The Ki Sisters
mangas.description: In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome… to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don't judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary-- I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who's out to find love! The problem is… everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in "kiss" or "kill"?

mangas.title: Supsogui Dam
mangas.description:
Dam, who at some point stopped growing, avoids people and leaves to the forest.



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: To Drown In You
mangas.description:
Hye-Seong, a boy living on a remote island, and Yun-Hae, a mysterious mermaid, become each other's only friend. But soon after they meet, they're separated after Hye-Seong moves away. Six years later, Yun-Hae develops a mysterious power and finds Hye-Seong again. Unfortunately, too much has changed, and Hye-Seong can no longer dedicate all his time to her as he did in their childhood. He tells her they are too different, but Yun-Hae's attachment to Hye-Seong slowly transforms into an obsession...



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: I Became the Dying Female Lead's Sister
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Sister of the Time-Limited Heroine
mangas.description:
In a twist of fate, a girl wakes up as Lynzelle, twin to her favorite novel's dying female lead, Lykke. To secure Lykke's happiness, she volunteers to wed the fearsome prince, Hernan, in her sister's stead. But hold on... The scary prince turns out to be super cute, sparking unforeseen feelings! Everything seems perfect until Lynzelle's health mysteriously deteriorates more than Lykke's, and the story takes an unexpected turn. Is this cute twin tale hiding more secrets than meets the eye?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: My Girlfriend's Ex-Boyfriend
mangas.description: I was never curious about my girlfriend's past...until that incident! Now I'm just dying to know! Who is this ex-boyfriend? Why is he acting so friendly? What happened between them in the past?! It sure isn't your typical love triangle.

mangas.title: The Tyrant's Tranquilizer
mangas.synonyms: แม่มดน้อยของนายทรราช
mangas.description:
Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the "calamity" sealed inside Serwin's body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie. As she grows closer to Serwin, Amelie must hone her magic to subdue his violent impulses, but can she defeat calamity once and for all?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: My Husband Changes Every Night
mangas.description:
Following the death of the World Tree, all that stands between the apocalypse and salvation is the Divine Maiden, prophesied to restore peace and prosperity. But never mind all that. Princess Teriella Rufeon has more pressing issues at hand: her family keeps trying to kill her, she's got a secret healing power to keep under wraps, and she's just found out she's being sent off to marry the infamous tyrant Emperor Rivanfel von Leonharta! But there's more to Rivanfel than meets the eye, and Teriella discovers she isn't the only one with a grave secret to hide…


(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: She May Not Be Cute
mangas.description:
Betrayed by her fiancé, Anran Xia (Ariana) flees her wedding, her heart broken and frozen to even the thought of love. Still she rises to the top, as this charismatic beauty buries herself in work. But when her childhood friend suddenly moves back to town, he cheekily creates ripples in her otherwise peaceful life—and in her own home! She's never imagined being with him, while he's never imagined being with anyone but her. Can he melt the ice of her long-guarded heart? Sweet romance is on its way!



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Chapter count includes two prologues and two epilogues, one per season, and 18 extra chapters.

mangas.title: I'm Not the Final Boss' Lover!
mangas.description:
When protagonist Jun Karentia enters a game as a support mage, she's all set to guide hero Fabian to success. But, oops! The game throws her a curveball when Fabian ditches her in round two, and Mayer Knox, Fabian's rival and secret final boss, recruits her as vice-captain for his corps. The problem? He's the final boss and now everyone thinks they're dating! Now, Jun's mission is to outwit Fabian, transform the final boss into the game's new hero, and put an end to those pesky romance rumors.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Mystical
mangas.description:
Garam has always loved to draw, but his dreams of being an artist have been on hold ever since his mother passed away. Wanting to become more independent and focus on his art, he moves into his grandmother's empty house by the ocean. There, he meets his greatest muse: a mystical water creature with no memories of her past. Now it's up to Garam to help her uncover what she has forgotten.



(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: My Universe
mangas.description:
As a socially awkward college student, Hayeon lives a pretty boring life -- except she can communicate with outer space. One day, she meets Ujun, an alien who is curious about human nature. When she rejects his request to "borrow" her body, he takes over the body of her crush! As Hayeon helps Ujun adjust to human life, their friendship blossoms into something more. However, their love story faces many obstacles, including an alien plotting to invade Earth. What will be the fate of these star-crossed lovers?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Admiral's Monstrous Wife
mangas.description:
They call her a monster… but to this admiral, she's a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she's met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Secret Playlist
mangas.description:
Han-Ju is your ordinary university student… except for the fact that she's also the up-and-coming Metube cover artist, PLII. When popular boy group member Levi takes notice of PLII and requests to collaborate, Han-Ju will do anything to hide her secret identity. But as the two grow closer working on a class project, Han-Ju's cover begins to unravel. Will Levi discover her secret?



(Source: WEBTOONS)


Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Degree of Love
mangas.description: Ye-Jin, a smart girl from a poor family who gets into a top university, has zero dating experience. Now that she's in college, she wants to find love, so she puts herself out there, but... Enter Hyeon, an elite Taekwondo athlete, her only guy friend from childhood, who masquerades as her "bestie," but is he really? Ye-Jin is determined to support her family through academic achievement, but she also wants love. Can she have both? How will Ye-Jin navigate the journey of having it all?

mangas.title: I'm Nobody's Shadow
mangas.synonyms: When I Stopped Being Your Shadow
mangas.description:
Behind every great man is a great woman, but that is only half true when it comes to Lancaster's famed painter, Count Ryan Bryerton. In fact, his wife, Ennis, is the talented one, but submits her paintings under his name to give him the honor and status he desires. However, Ennis makes the shocking discovery that Ryan's been cheating on her with her best friend, and is almost sent to a mental institution by the traitorous pair! Once an accident sends her back to the past, Ennis is determined to expose Ryan as the talentless sham he is...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Little Lady Mint
mangas.description:
For little Mint, every day is hell at the Merigold orphanage. One day, Master Yulius, the Grand Duke of Elkedonia, offers to take her in as the little lady of Elkedonia! However, Mint is extremely shy and nervous, and such a huge transformation doesn't happen overnight. Join Mint as she grows from a meek girl to a daring, outspoken lady while magical and religious tensions unfold!



(Source: Webtoons)

mangas.title: Wolhwa x Mokgeum
mangas.description:
Two women finally met at the end of the runaway game.

Fragments of their ordinary high school life, where they had to fight a lot of people, pass through their memories.

mangas.title: If You Can't Kill Me, Love Me
mangas.description: In a kingdom scarred by a historical rebellion, Penny, an assassin masquerading as a servant, aims to break free from Queen Nyla's grasp by executing a perilous mission: the theft of the king's ring from Princess Cher, known as the wicked Princess of Death. Yet her intentions take a turn as she slowly becomes captivated by the princess. As their destinies become entwined, Penny grapples with a dilemma, torn between her pursuit of freedom and the unexpected connections she forges with Cher.

mangas.title: Aegyo On Duty
mangas.synonyms: School-Loving Duty, On Duty School Love
mangas.description: Ji-Yun is a girl with long straight hair that has a crush on So-Yeon, the friendly class leader. But one day, So-Yeon told her: "Why didn't I know about a pale-skinned, tall, and pretty student like you?" And the unexpectedly quick opportunity (?) was only for the two of us...

mangas.title: The Sea Painted by the Moonlight
mangas.description:
Nalanda, a country where mermaids lived in the sea once upon a time. Yeon-Ji, who has been dreaming of mermaids since she was little, entered as an intern at the Nalanda History Research Institute to prove the existence of mermaids. She meets the team leader Hae-Rang who looks like a mermaid.

Yeon-Ki, who wants to look good in front of Hae-Rang, tries her best, but Hae-Rang keeps being cold...

mangas.title: Seasons of Canvas
mangas.description: Soo Ah gave up her dream of becoming an artist due to her parents' opposition, Jade came to Korea to find her mother who had never seen her face since her father's death. She works as Butler at the Yuchae School, a noble school attended by Soo Ah. Looking for traces of her mother, Jade meets Soo Ah, who hangs on her dreams, helping her out, the developing feelings of love.

mangas.title: Blooming Out
mangas.description: A GL short story collection. Women from different walks of life realize what's missing in their lives through chance encounters or unexpected realization of ties with kindred spirits at crossroads in life, or a period of self reflection.

mangas.title: Attacking the Girls' Dormitory of Demon King
mangas.description: The modern-day lady-assassin found herself transmigrated into a trashy European-fantasy otome game, where she has to make the Demon Lord fall in love with her in order to save the world. Instead, she trained the villainess Lady Lisa in assassin's skills, hoping that Lisa would eventually kill her and allow her to return to the real world. But all that intimate physical contact and her own earnestness during the training caused Lisa to fall in love with her instead?

mangas.title: The Barefoot Nina
mangas.description:
When shy and timid Eunseo was forced to transfer to the elite Stella Academy of the Arts, she expected lonely school days filled with cutthroat competition. So she's taken by surprise when the free-spirited Ina takes a sudden liking to her. The two girls become closer as they secretly meet on the rooftop after classes, and Eunseo's friendly admiration grows into something more. Luckily, Ina returns her feelings as well... but they seem to border on a dark obsession that grows larger by the day. What will happen when Eunseo discovers the hidden reason behind Ina's mysterious love?


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Straight Girl Trap
mangas.description:
Despite her notoriety as a tough boss, Ms. Zhou has a soft spot for Zhan Ying. And it's not like Zhan is complaining! On paper, Ms. Zhou is her perfect partner. There's only one problem: nobody in the office can quite nail down whether Ms. Zhou is straight or actually interested in Zhan. Desperate to find the answer for herself, Zhan begins traversing the minefield that is courting her superior.

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Baili Jin Among Mortals
mangas.description:
Baili Jin, a fairy who was living in heaven, eating and drinking without a care, broke her Majesty's colourful, stained-glass plate at her birthday and got banished to the mortal realm. Now she has to begin her adventures in the mortal realm with all of her spiritual powers gone! In order to survive, the former fairy has to deliver take-out....

An endearingly silly fairy, a gentle restaurant manager, a reserved top student, and a hard to resist two-faced girl, let the story of their beautiful friendship and youthful days begin!

mangas.title: I Got Blackmailed by the Green Tea Bitch in Class
mangas.titleNative: 关于被班上绿茶威胁那件事
mangas.synonyms: That Time I Was Blackmailed By the Class's Green Tea Bitch
mangas.description:
Green Tea Bitch (n.): A woman who pretends to be pure and innocent but in fact is manipulative and calculating.



After school ends, a good honor student is threatened by the class's green tea bitch.



"I never thought you wide-eyed goody-two-shoes would do something like this."

"If you don't want me to expose your shameful secret..."



A cute romance that stems from a misunderstanding begins in That Time I Was Blackmailed By the Class's Green Tea Bitch!



Note: Originally completed with 41 chapters (including extras and bonus chapters) on 2022-02-28. A second season was announced on 2024-09-14.

mangas.title: Spring and Winter
mangas.description:
Outed in high school?!


In the middle of the night, high schooler Jung-Yoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Do-Young, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?!

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: How to End an Unrequited Love
mangas.description: Kim Bok-Sil, is better known for having no success at love having gone with unrequited love for 20 years now. She's now on her 9th failure of unrequited love since graduating from high school. Bok-Sil, who vows that she will have a wonderful relationship when she becomes a college student, falls for her kind and handsome sunbae, Do-Yun.

mangas.title: Informality Romance
mangas.description: Informal! And their special love begins. The love story between two girls that first met through an online avatar-creation community.

mangas.title: The Girl in Shoes, The Girl in Sneakers
mangas.description: The story of a friendship between two teenage girls in their third years of high school — 'Dong-ah' who likes to simplify things and 'Hoo' who tends to overthink.

mangas.title: Nae Choeaeneun Agyeogyeongae: Another Revolution Story
mangas.description:
A woman is reincarnated as the main character Rae Taylor in her favorite otome game Revolution. Given all the princes to romance, Rae's true favorite isn't any of them, but rather… the villainous lady Claire François!
Leaving behind her cold and lonely past life,
she will become the heroine of Revolution and adore Claire François to her heart's content! Will Rae be able to befriend and save Claire, using all of her wits and game knowledge of Revolution?



"No matter what happens, I will protect Lady Claire!"



(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: The Newlywed Diary of a Witch and a Dragon
mangas.synonyms: The Newly-Wed Life of a Witch and a Dragon
mangas.description:
After spending the night with a recent hire of the Tower of Magic, Wendy Blanchett, a talented young leader of the Rune Research Division, is faced with an impossible dilemma. She fears for her position and reputation when the newbie, Aiden Winters, asks her to marry him. Unbeknownst to Wendy, Aiden seems to have secrets of his own. Will their love blossom, or will his secrets tear them apart?


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Ranju's Race to Romance
mangas.synonyms: Fly Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Bee
mangas.description:
Ranju has had a massive crush on Jiha, the school's most popular girl, with her angelic beauty and kind nature. But when Ranju hears the shocking news that Jiha is going on a group date, she's thrown into a panic. Determined not to let her chance slip away, Ranju hatches a bold plan to win Jiha's heart before anyone else can. Will Ranju's daring moves lead to the romance of her dreams, or will she get stopped on her way to the finish line?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: There's No Use Hanging On
mangas.description:
Kaira willingly risked her life to make her beloved Prince Reagan emperor. But when the man she sacrificed it all for crowns her cousin as empress instead of her, she loses the will to live. It's only when she's finally succumbed to a lethal dose of poison that she's met with the tears of a heartbroken Prince Faylon, and she realizes her love was wasted on the wrong person. Vowing to exact revenge if ever given the chance, Kaira is thrust back in time to right the wrongs committed against her and reclaim the title that is rightfully hers. As she joins hands with Prince Faylon and sets out to punish those who conspired against her, she'll discover a world she once took for granted and seek to correct the course of her fate.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Peach Sorbet
mangas.description:
Moa's in a pinch. Her friends are asking about her nonexistent sex life, but she'd rather die than admit that she's a virgin. In a hurry, she makes up a haphazard lie: yeah, she's had sex before. With a really hot imaginary guy called Yura! Not only is he ripped, well-hung, but he also…happens to be very, very real. When faced with the real Yura, there's only one thought in Moa's mind. She needs to make her lie become a truth!


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Crow's Prince
mangas.synonyms: Of all things, I Became a Crow.
mangas.description:
Life is about survival of the fittest... But what do you do when you're reborn as a crow? Find someone big and strong to take you in, of course! After saving Prince Camute's life, Rainelle is brought to the imperial palace to live as his pet. However, just as she believes she's set to live a life of comfort, she finds herself caught at the center of a dangerous power struggle between Prince Camute and his brother. Now that her survival depends on his, will Rainelle find a way to help her prince?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sherbet Above the Sea of Fog
mangas.description:
Sherbet knows she might run into pirates or sea monsters on her voyage, but what spooks her most is the ghost ship rumored to kidnap people. Although she's relieved to hear that it only takes them for a special reason, she soon wakes up on the infamous vessel without any clue why! Despite her initial despair, however, Sherbet is delighted to find the grumpy but hot pirate, Granita, on board with her. On the other hand, Granita finds hell in the form of the bubbly little terror who can't seem to keep her hands and innuendos to herself...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: She Is Also Cute Today
mangas.titleNative: 今天的她也是如此可爱
mangas.synonyms: She Is Cute Today As Well
mangas.description:
"I'm into someone." Cang Shu, a straight-A student who always indulges in learning and has no passion for social contact, actually announces in public that she likes the poor student Qi Lin?! Thanks to a misunderstanding, the two of them begin to get to know each other. When a girl who disdains to make friends meets another girl who desires to be loved, what will occur between them?


(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: My Sweet Enemy, Thy Name Is Husband
mangas.synonyms: Political Marriage With a Friendly Enemy | Forced Into Wedlock With An Affectionate Enemy
mangas.description:
My husband, my nemesis. Till death do us part.

Canach Riadon — a slave who rose to emperor and the man I wed in my first life. Yet our ill-fated marriage left my family murdered and my homeland destroyed at his hands. Now given a second chance, I vow to succeed in this political marriage and save all I love... Or will his love save me first?

mangas.title: Reporting for Duty, Duchess!
mangas.description:
As a successful captain in the military, Yun-A is an icon of success and power. But after an accident on the battlefield, she finds herself trapped in a romantic fantasy novel. Stuck in a supporting role as the best friend of the main protagonist, Yun-A is determined to overturn the plotline. Will she be able to change Rosalie's fate and find happiness in the new world? Will she ever be able to return home?



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: When the Black Moon Rises
mangas.description: Ju Sehwa lived a blessed life as a daughter of the mystic realm's most powerful clan, until she was framed for treason and executed by those she trusted most. But when the power of a divine wish grants her a second chance, she knows that she must use it to save her family and take down the corrupt clan leaders. With the handsome head of the rival Baek clan as her unlikely ally, Sehwa is set on revenge, but with those closest to her still plotting against her, is history doomed to repeat itself?

mangas.title: I Became a Sitter for the Obsessive Villains
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Obsessive Villain's Babysitter
mangas.description:
When Meia realizes she's woken up in the story "The Flower of Shakir," she immediately busts out of the temple and runs for her life. After all, she has no intention of becoming the side character who is sacrificed just for the sake of the male protagonist! But during her grand escape, Meia runs into Duke Rakha Aintia, the story's villain, and his two younger siblings. In an unexpected turn of events, Meia is hired as the twins' sitter, but she also happens to attract the duke's attention due to something magical in her touch...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Kiss & White Lily for My Dearest Girl
mangas.titleNative: あの娘にキスと白百合を
mangas.synonyms: A Kiss and a White Lily
mangas.description: Two girls, a new school, and the beginning of a beautiful friendship. In middle school, Ayaka Shiramine was the perfect student: hard-working, with excellent grades and a great personality to match. As Ayaka enters high school she expects to still be on top, but one thing she didn't account for is her new classmate, the lazy yet genuine genius Yurine Kurosawa. What's in store for Ayaka and Yurine as they go through high school...together?

mangas.title: Your Scent is a Little Sweet
mangas.synonyms: Your Taste Is a Little Sweet
mangas.description:
Due to past psychological trauma, Tang Chao never developed secondary sexual characteristics, so she lived life as a beta working as a magazine model. After an accidental one-night stand with an omega, she found out that she felt strongly attracted to that omega. The next day she met a new colleague Li Zhixu, who seemed to be that omega. But... this Li Zhixu was suppose to be a beta?



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Omega Heroine Wants Her Alpha Villainess
mangas.titleNative: 白月光女主总想独占我
mangas.synonyms: Perfect Heroine Wants to Possess Me
mangas.description:
After a biking mishap, Willow Ji lands in an Omegaverse novel as a doomed Alpha villainess. To avoid a shark-infested fate, she navigates cautiously around Serena Wei, the Omega heroine, aiming to win her heart with kindness. Initially suspicious, Serena gradually warms up to Willow, even harboring feelings for her. As the lines between protagonist and antagonist blur, the question arises: when will Willow realize that their feelings are mutual, and her "foe" has also fallen deeply for her?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: When the Villainess is in Love
mangas.description:
When a young girl wakes up in the body of her favorite character, villainess Princess Libertia, the very first thing she decides to do is... fangirl her heart out! And why not? In a novel where all of her favorite characters are doomed to die, this is her chance to give them all a happy ending. But will the story play out as she expects when people start to see Princess Libertia in a new, forgiving light? One fangirl's love might be what it takes to turn this villainess into a heroine!



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes six side story chapters.

mangas.title: Your Eternal Lies
mangas.description:
Infamous jailbreaker Rosen Walker is finally being transferred to the Isle of Monte, the most notorious maximum security prison in the world. Her guard? It's none other than the beloved war hero of the empire himself — Ian Connor. Now Ian must unravel the truth. Did Rosen really commit the murder? Or is there more to the story?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Zhui Lan
mangas.description:
Ling Lin is a girl with terrible luck, who can't seem to do anything right. Until she went to college, met the beautiful and kind senpai Fang Wan, and fell for her before she knew it. In this vast universe, there is someone out there connected to you, who will make sure you will never be alone.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Zhe Hunjun De Hei Yueguang Wo Dang Ding Le
mangas.titleNative: 这昏君的黑月光我当定了
mangas.synonyms: Fall in Love With the Empress
mangas.description:
Duan Weiying transmigrated into the body of a new concubine on a harem mission. Her goal was suppose to beat out all the other girls to become the Emperor's favorite. But she had no interest in some unfaithful playboy Emperor, and she was going to just go through the motions and abuse her cheats to finish her assignment. That was until she found out the Emperor was actually a cool, beautiful Empress, who fell in love with Duan Weiying at first sight. Now both are caught up in each other…



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Let's Hide My Little Brother
mangas.synonyms: First Let's Hide My Younger Brother
mangas.description:
The fate of a girl in a BL novel is a tragic one. Girls are either vaguely helpful, evil, or add nothing to the plot. So what happens when you turn into the older sister of a BL novel protagonist? The older sister who dies a tragic death at the hands of a madman who's infatuated with your younger brother? You go with your gut instinct: hide him. Hide your brother from everything, especially men, that could harm him and you. That's the task that Kyla Vesta is set with in this life, and a task that she's determined to complete.



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: The Emperor's Partner
mangas.description:
After learning that her younger sister sacrificed herself for her, Shin-Joo dies in an accident after saving a child that reminded her of her sibling. She wishes that if there is a god, may he give her a life that she can spend for her younger sister, and her prayers are seemingly answered, she is resurrected as the Pope by the name of "Charles Hildegarde!" But before she even realizes what's happening, she is kissed by a man.



(Source: Copin Comics)

mangas.title: The Princess's Spaceship
mangas.description:
"Is this how I'm gonna die?" At the height of battle, a space sergeant meets her unfortunate end and enters the body of the cursed Miola de Langtree! Now this soldier-turned-princess's only mission is to locate her spaceship and escape this fantasy world of frilly dresses and haughty manners. But the shuttle is nowhere to be found, a suspicious masked man is hounding her, and her own sister wants her dead?! Time for this sergeant to fight for survival the only way she knows how… by joining the prestigious Knights Order! Will she make it back to the stars she came from? Based on the hit novel.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Dawn the Teen Witch
mangas.description:
Have you ever had your dreams laughed at?

In a society that values magic above all, Dawn Hill is accepted into the most prestigious magic academy on all five continents. Although she is full of expectations, Dawn is categorized as the school's "worst student." Facing ridicule, belittlement, and exclusion, can this stubborn little witch fight back?

mangas.title: K-On!
mangas.description: When their high school's pop-music club is about to be disbanded due to lack of interest, four girls step up to fill the membership quota. Unfortunately, lead guitarist Yui Hirasawa has never played an instrument in her life. Ever. And although she likes the idea of being in a band, standing in front of the mirror posing with her guitar is a lot easier than actually playing it. It's gonna be a while before this motley crew is rocking out, but with their spunk and determination cranked to 11, anything is possible!

mangas.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
mangas.description:
This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path!



(Source: K Manga)

mangas.title: Gal-Loving JK Wants to Be a Gal
mangas.titleNative: ギャル推しJKはギャルになりたい
mangas.synonyms: Gal Oshi JK wa Gal ni Naritai
mangas.description:
"Living as a gal is seriously the best!!"

Mimiru was an introvert in middle school, but when she entered high school, she made her long-awaited debut as a gal, thinking, "Maybe I can become a gal too!?" She made friends with three girls: Yuuhi, a cool beauty with a calm and pretty look; Fuuka, a cute gal with a soft and fluffy look; and Kurumi, a cheerful and energetic gal who is good at sports. Now she has joined the gal group she has always admired! While she lives the sparkling life she has always dreamed of, she also pushes herself too hard to keep up with her friends. And she also notices new feelings growing within her...

mangas.title: Futari Escape
mangas.description: Two young women–one an overworked manga artist, the other a complete slacker–try to escape the realities of adult responsibilities. Whether it's running off on a day trip instead of being productive or going into debt for an epic meal, the two always have fun when they're together! Enjoy this delightful (and relatable) slice-of-life tale about the little pleasures in ducking away from the hard stuff.

mangas.title: AYAKA is in LOVE with HIROKO!
mangas.titleNative: 彩香ちゃんは弘子先輩に恋してる
mangas.synonyms: Ayaka-chan wa Hiroko Senpai wo Otoshitai
mangas.description: Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other...

mangas.title: Ichigo no Haitta Soda-sui
mangas.titleNative: いちごの入ったソーダ水
mangas.description:
Mannenrou Ladies' Academy is famous for its upper class and posh students. Despite knowing how out-of-place she'd be, the former yankee, Hanaizumi Luna, decides to enroll there. Moreover, according to her underling: "Girls' schools means yuri!! Add in school dormitories? Now that's a world of girl on girl action!!"



And with those words in mind, Luna's new school life begins with a rough start.



And how exactly will her relationship develop with her socially inept roommate, Miyota Kohime...?

mangas.title: Kiss the Scars of the Girls
mangas.titleNative: 少女たちの痕にくちづけを
mangas.synonyms: A Kiss for the Girls' Scars
mangas.description:
"I'm sure someday, I'll get you to look my way."



Danger and uncertainty are common for a young vampire, which is why Emille will be assigned a "Big Sister" on her fourteenth birthday, like all the girls at her school. Deep within a secluded forest, her sister will teach her how to hunt and safely feed on humans. Learning to rely on each other for survival cultivates a deep relationship comparable to that between family-but does theirs have the potential to evolve into something more?



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes two bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Odoriba ni Skirt ga Naru
mangas.titleNative: 踊り場にスカートが鳴る
mangas.synonyms: The Skirt Sings at the Landing
mangas.description: Kiki Haruma always dreamed of doing ballroom dance as the feminine "partner" role, but as she aged she grew taller and taller, eventually causing her to give up ever looking good in a dress or anything girly. Now in the second-year of high school, she specializes in the masculine "leader" role—until one day, her partner suddenly leaves her. When Michiru Toribami, a petite and pretty first-year student, comes to join the ballroom dance club, Kiki asks her to be her new partner, but Michiru told her that she only dances the leading role—and she wants none other than Kiki to be her partner.

mangas.title: The Foreigner and the Insensitive Tomboy
mangas.titleNative: 外人ちゃんと無神経ボーイッシュちゃん
mangas.description: A foreigner girl who has to deal with sterotypes.

mangas.title: Cheerful Amnesia
mangas.synonyms: Bright and Cheery Amnesia | Akarui Kioku Soushitsu
mangas.description: When Arisa loses her memories from the past three years, her girlfriend, Mari, worries it might mean the end of their budding relationship. A needless concern, it turns out, because when Arisa lays eyes on her, she falls in love all over again! Arisa's not about to let a little severe brain damage get her down, because she has a chance to relive all their firsts for a second time—from dates, to kisses, and even beyond…!!

mangas.title: Kitai Fuku ga Aru
mangas.synonyms: I show my true colors shining through.
mangas.description:
University student Mami is seen by everyone as the fashionable cool model-type but she secretly just wants to wear Lolita fashion.



While she tries occasionally to be more cute & less "stylish", she can't overcome the imagine others have of her. When she watches a new coworker at the cafe she jobs part-time leave in a extremly flashy outfit, it sparks the courage in her to express herself more truthfully too!

mangas.title: The Simple Life of an Ex-Villainess (With a Fluffy Friend?!)
mangas.titleNative: 追放された悪役令嬢ですが、モフモフ付き⁉スローライフはじめました
mangas.synonyms: 轉生遊戲的反派千金擅自展開戀愛支線！？和毛茸茸的他度過鄉村慢活
mangas.description:
Thrust into the world of her favorite romance simulation game, our protagonist is reborn as the female villain character, Eileen. However, all is not as it seems. Liliana, the story's heroine turns out to be two-faced! Through her scheming, Eileen is ultimately expelled from the academy, just like in the game. However, Eileen becomes overjoyed, excited to finally leave the academy and begin a life of quiet and leisure. Eileen decides to move to Myberry Village, famous for their strawberries. However, ending up tagging along are her classmates Luke, and Kargo, a handsome young man who appears to carry with him many mysteries, hiding within his heart a secret wish, and beneath his hair skin so delicate and... fluffy?! Join Eileen as she puts her "villainous" role behind her and embarks on her new, sweet and simple life!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Lady Rose Just Wants to Be a Commoner!
mangas.titleNative: レディローズは平民になりたい
mangas.synonyms: Lady Rose Wants to be a Commoner
mangas.description:
When Felicia Schwarose's engagement to the crown prince is broken off due to false charges, you'd expect her to be torn to pieces...but instead she's jumping for joy! She may have been reincarnated as the protagonist of an otome game, but she wants nothing to do with high society. Thus, she becomes Fii Crow, a humble commoner earning her daily bread at a village bakery. All's well that ends well? Not yet—the game's love interests just won't leave her alone! Can Fii clear up misunderstandings, avoid triggering romantic (and dangerous) events, and get everyone out of her hair so she can live the peaceful commoner life of her dreams? Witness the story of a former noblewoman who won't sit by and wait for happiness to come riding in on a white horse!



(Source: J-Novel Club)



Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters and 1 epilogue.

mangas.title: Kase-san and...
mangas.description: Yamada may be shy and rather clumsy, but the flower gardens at her school have always brought her happiness. Suddenly, a different sort of beauty catches her eye–the vivacious track star, Kase-san. Although the two girls don't seem to have much in common, they soon start a romance where each must learn an important lesson in tending their budding relationship. Can the two girls, so different from each other, learn how to make their first love blossom?

mangas.title: Swing!!
mangas.description:
Miyasato Haruka, lover of video games and sweets, was going to spend her school days immersed in video games, when Ibuki, determined to bring back the Golf Club, appeared! Ibuki then dragged Haruka into playing golf....


And so, the story of the high school girls of the Golf Club unfolds, a cute and youthful slice-of-life comedy!



Note: Chapter count includes five volume-bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Hige to Suzu to Shabondama
mangas.titleNative: ヒゲと鈴としゃぼん玉
mangas.synonyms: Râu, chuông, bong bóng xà phòng
mangas.description:
28-year-old Suzutaro who can't do housework at all, loves being spoiled! and Santa, (who spoils Suzutaro,) is a 32-year-old with a gentle beard who handles all household chores.
A fun, sometimes a little salty, but very happy, series of shorts that show casual everyday life is lovely ☆



(source: Kodansha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: When the Villainess Seduces the Main Heroine
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢が正ヒロインを口説き落とす話。
mangas.description:
When the crown prince announces he's breaking off his engagement to the infamous Akuya, his spurned fiancée wastes no time turning her seductive words of passion to her actual target—Sei, a commoner who worked her way up through the ranks with her wit and charm alone…and the very girl the prince dumped Akuya for! Sei's about to get a taste of what a real lover is like in this steamy tale of two girls who traded in their Prince Charming for each other!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Let's Do It Already!
mangas.description:
His rule: No sexual relations until age 18! Her rule: No rules.



Free-spirited Yuri Hasegawa and straitlaced Keiichiro Katsuragi have fallen in love. But his elite political family—which has produced a long line of prime ministers—does not allow male descendants to engage in any sexual relations until they are 18. Can the physically affectionate Yuri and rule-abiding Keiichiro keep their relationship strictly chaste?



Yuri and Keiichiro have gotten to know each other on their daily commute to their respective high schools. Yuri makes a passionate love confession to Keiichiro, and he feels the same! As a new couple, Yuri rushes in to kiss her new boyfriend, but...!



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Bloom Into You
mangas.description: Yuu has always loved shoujo manga and awaits the day she gets a love confession that sends her heart aflutter with bubbles and hearts, and yet when a junior high classmate confesses his feelings to her…she feels nothing. Disappointed and confused, Yuu enters high school still unsure how to respond. That's when Yuu sees the beautiful student council president Nanami turn down a suitor with such maturity that she's inspired to ask her for help. But when the next person to confess to Yuu is Nanami herself, has her shoujo romance finally begun?

mangas.title: Black Sesame Salt and Custard Pudding
mangas.description: One morning, HARUHI wakes up to find that she's married to an old man she doesn't know!? Haruhi works as a heavy machinery operator at a construction site full of men.One night, Haruhi meets a middle-aged man with grey hair at a pub, and submits a marriage certificate under the influence of alcohol. She had taken him straight into her room! Don't judge a man by the colour of the hair. Love comedy by a silver fox and a girl physical worker.

mangas.title: Princess Jellyfish
mangas.description: Tsukimi Kurashita has a strange fascination with jellyfish. She's loved them from a young age and has carried that love with her to her new life in the big city of Tokyo. There, she resides in Amamizukan, a safe-haven for girl geeks who regularly gush over a range of things from trains to Japanese dolls. However, a chance meeting at a pet shop has Tsukimi crossing paths with one of the things that the residents of Amamizukan have been desperately trying to avoid—a beautiful and fashionable woman! But there's much more to this woman than her trendy clothes! This odd encounter is only the beginning of a new and unexpected path for Tsukimi and her friends.

mangas.title: Mitsuboshi Colors
mangas.description:
Hark! The city is in peril! Who you gonna call? Colors!



Sacchan, Yui and Kotoha are here to protect the city, solving mysteries and battling enemies with help from their friends.

But their quest isn't an easy one as their arch-nemesis Saitou, the violent police officer of Ueno, meets them at every turn.

mangas.title: Villain Classroom
mangas.description: Heo Jeong-U, a high school student who is bullied by a girl in his class for his weakness. Han Bo-Ra, a transfer student, comes to Jeong-U's class, where he was spending his miserable days. Jeong-U feels a strong sense of déjà vu when he sees the child with straight black hair and stains on his legs. Sure enough, Han Bo-Ra, who has subdued the arguing classmates, asks them, "Have you ever seen a child similar to me?" Jeong-U decides to approach Bo-Ra, who might be able to correct what is wrong...

mangas.title: Inu mo Arukeba Hime ni Ataru
mangas.titleNative: 犬も歩けば姫に当たる

mangas.title: Friend Girlfriend
mangas.titleNative: フレンドガールフレンド
mangas.description: Yuki and Asaka are best friends who've known each other since childhood. One day, after a boy confesses his feelings to her, Asaka announces, "I'll give it a try just for the experience." Yuki isn't happy about her best friend being snatched up by some random guy…?

mangas.title: Koharu and Minato: Happy Life with My Girlfriend
mangas.titleNative: 小春と湊 わたしのパートナーは女の子
mangas.synonyms: Koharu to Minato: Watashi no Partner wa Onnanoko
mangas.description:
Koharu and Minato are two women who met online. Despite there being a ten-year age gap between them, the two fall hard and fast. Before long, they decide to load up the moving van and move in together!

Relationships aren't always easy, but Minato and Koharu find a way to work things out. Whether it's having a celebratory feast, taking a late-night stroll, or just enjoying their domestic bliss, the two make every minute together count!

mangas.title: Kimi no Sei Nan Dakara, Sekinin Totte yo ne.
mangas.titleNative: 君のせいなんだから、責任とってよね。
mangas.synonyms: You Started This, So You Better Finish It.
mangas.description:
I'm an office lady, and a part-time rental girlfriend. I'm good at getting along with people and can do anything. I'm not particularly interested in romance right now, but I imagine I'll get married and have kids someday...



Then I met Sui-chan, my first rental girlfriend client. At first, I was hesitant because we're the same sex and she's younger than me... but then I thought, wow, I'm good with women too!?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Ano Ko to Futari de.
mangas.description: Yuna Satou and Emma Satou work at the same part-time job, share the same last name, and come from similar family backgrounds, but other than that, they have nothing in common. Due to a strange turn of events, they end up living together. They fight sometimes, but it is precisely because they are opposites that they can stay together. A new generation's story about girls who live freely!

mangas.title: Osananajimi BIG LOVE
mangas.synonyms: 天使だった幼なじみ、再会したらギャルだった
mangas.description:
I once had a childhood friend who was a cute angel. However, when we met again, many years later, she had become a flamboyant gal. A yuri story between two childhood friends.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Originally self-published, it was collected for a commercial volume release on 2024-09-26.

mangas.title: Aashi to Watashi. Gal x Yuri Anthology
mangas.titleNative: あーしとわたし。ギャルｘ百合アンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: Me and, I. Gal x Yuri Anthology
mangas.description:
A collection of Gal Yuri stories by various popular artists.

Volume 2:

ダチ越え?ピ越えだし by きいやん

良い子悪い子 by BirdHatter

あたしの好きな香り by 桜木蓮

合コン行ったら ゲットされた話。 by かいばしら

語る指先 by 柚木がオ

針と深爪 by スズオ

抜間茶目は 駄目すぎる by ねる

逃げた先に あるものは by みかん氏

mangas.title: Nekomimi Maid-san to Ojou-sama
mangas.titleNative: 猫耳メイドさんとお嬢様
mangas.description: A young lady employs the services of a feline maid, but they both come to realize that the lines dividing them between "mistress" and "servant" are becoming increasingly blurry.

mangas.title: "Duo Duosuo Suo" Taoli Ni
mangas.description:
An Ultimate Showdown Between an Introvert and an Extrovert.

Ai Xu, a designer of trendy toys, suffers from extreme social anxiety and despises socializing and teamwork. Once she became an adult, she did her best to find a job where 90% of the time, she only has to be accountable to herself. However, there is one drawback to being a designer for original IP: She still has to attend and speak at a weekly team meeting. Thankfully, she could simply play a presentation without saying much. Today, however, she was paired with the beautiful and dazzling extrovert Zhiyi from marketing to work as partners on a project.

mangas.title: After School Adventure
mangas.description: She has a crush on her. So, she makes the first step and leaves her with a cute kiss. Except, they're both clueless about each other's intentions!

mangas.title: My Ex-Girlfriend Became My Boss
mangas.titleNative: 前女友成了我的顶头上司
mangas.synonyms: My Immediate Supervisor | Qian Nüyou Cheng Le Wo De Dingtou Shangsi
mangas.description:
Ji Yu is a lowly temp, the kind who gets bullied by her boss every day. Luckily, the department is getting a new boss returning from overseas, who is said to be beautiful and kind to her subordinates. But she didn't expect that this new boss is actually an ex-girlfriend who has a grudge against her!

Ji Yu was young and reckless in school, so when she fell in love with a timid junior girl, she harassed the younger girl with hugs and kisses even when she refused. Eventually, Ji Yu even forced Le Churan to go out with her. But when she graduated, Ji Yu felt guilty and decided to give the junior girl back her freedom by writing a long breakup letter, deleting her contact info, and going far away.

Nowadays, nobody would believe it if Ji Yu said that she used to bully Le Churan around. When Ji Yu writes, a report, Le Churan says, "This doesn't make sense. Rewrite it." When Ji Yu glanced at someone else, Le Churan threatens her, "I can fire you for having an improper relationship at work."

Gradually, their conversations became a little strange.

"Kiss me and I'll write the report for you," Le Churan said with a serious expression.

"Let's hold hands for an hour and you can have a day off tomorrow."

"Come home with me... and I'll do anything you want me to."

mangas.title: Summer Trend
mangas.description:
After her parents divorced, Lu Yang lived at her mother's best friend's house and lived with her daughter, Su Gui. Su Gui, bright and gentle, like the warm winter sun, easily illuminated Lu Yang's life, but also her heart. Lu Yang looked at her, like a sister, like a friend...

Later, Lu Yang didn't want to be her sister, she wanted to be with her. But after discovering that her feelings for Su Gui had deteriorated, Lu Yang did not want to break the harmony of the moment, and even more afraid of losing her "sister" identity, she could only tolerate dependence and move away from Su Gui.

However, after reuniting with Su Gui because of her work, the feelings she had been suppressing grew wildly, like branches of roses, wrapping herself and Su Gui tightly. Is it a long-planned plan or is it fate?

mangas.title: Jifeng Wen Yueguang
mangas.description:
One is an ambitious actress who dreams of starring in showbiz. The other is an up-and-coming fashion designer known as "a gentle flower" due to her delicate beauty.
One sees through the cool facade to sense the thirst for success, the other recognizes the desire for something real behind the grand ambition. When one advances, like the wind brushing a rose, the other retreats, like a moonbeam on the edge of her skirt. Their back and forth is a seductive dance taken to the limit. Until finally she becomes the rose that blooms in her blood, and they reach the pinnacle of success together.



Tang Wanting: "I will pluck the moon out of the sky for you."

Shang Yi: "You are the moon I want."



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Jiang Cuo: Bu Jin Ze Tui
mangas.synonyms: Make the Best of It: Advance or Fall Behind
mangas.description: In order to avenge her sister, the Demon King sneaked into the God Realm alone, but was rescued by the enemy's fiancee by accident. I wanted to get close to the enemy through his fiancee, but discovered that this fiancee was hiding a secret that could subvert everything.

mangas.title: Weixian Xintiao
mangas.description:
"If you don't want your fake identity exposed to the world, then complete my seven little demands, Qi ChaoYue."

[Dominant Sadistic Queen True Heiress X Submissive Masochistic Tsundere Fake Heiress]


Despite how much she hates these outrageous demands, her body seems to be falling deeper into this world...

mangas.title: Jinwan Bu Jiewen
mangas.description:
Xu Jiajia and Duan Xi have been bitter rivals for over a decade, yet once night falls, they tacitly maintain a casual sexual relationship. After a heated argument, their intimate encounter unexpectedly sends Xu Jiajia back in time to Duan Xi's innocent youth. Seeing the young and naive Duan Xi, Xu Jiajia decides to first seduce her, then cast her aside, forcing her into complete submission! Possessing the soul of a 27-year-old, she faces the brooding, sensitive 20-year-old Duan Xi. What begins as revenge and teasing gradually reveals the other's hidden vulnerability and pain…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: About Summer
mangas.synonyms: Hu Yu She Zhi Wu | Dance of Fox and Serpent
mangas.description: The aloof, top-tier stylist of the entertainment world versus the down-to-earth, third-rate celebrity with a hidden dark side. An unexpected red carpet "revenge" sees Chu Xia "reborn" into the limelight under a new identity. Yet, the game of cat and mouse between 'prey' and "predator" has only just begun... Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

mangas.title: Kase-san and Yamada
mangas.description:
Yamada is in heaven at her school's horticulture department, and Kase-san is training hard at the sports university. With classes and a long train ride to keep them apart, hanging out together is tough. Can they beat their busy schedules and find time for one another?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: The Star Next Door
mangas.synonyms: The Star Next Door Who Bewitched Me
mangas.description:
Soo-Jung hates romance—she'd rather spend her nights fangirling in her room. When a noisy neighbor is tests her patience she goes upstairs ready to fight, but the last person she expected is the scandalous celebrity she's supposed to hate. Love and hate, different sides of the same coin. Which will win?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Shi Wen Lun Xian
mangas.synonyms: Surrendering to My Enemy's Cold Embrace
mangas.description:
In a world populated by beastmen, the down-and-out actress, Shen Youqing, happens to be a chinchilla-girl. During an audition, she was nearly sexually assaulted by the assistant director. But she's saved in the nick of time by someone she hadn't seen in years: Shi Ruolin, who was her first love, arranged marriage partner, fiancée, and mortal enemy. Shen Youqing was looking for a chance to escape, not even bothering to thank her savior, but Shi Ruolin makes her an unexpected offer. Facing dire straits, Shen Youqing gives in to temptation and agrees to endure the humiliation of becoming the pet of the cold-blooded snake, in exchange for a large sum of money. As they spend more time together, they manage to resolve their long-standing misunderstandings, and their mutual feelings grow until they finally agree to spend the rest of their lives together.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Tayutau Koi no Chirigiwa ni
mangas.titleNative: たゆたう恋の散り際に
mangas.description:
A girls' school, Hibiscus Academy, where only selected young women can attend.
At this academy, there is a princess and a prince.



The "Princess of Hibiscus," student council president Suzuran,
and the "Prince of Hibiscus," vice president Emma.



In public, they both play their roles as prince and princess perfectly, loved by everyone,
but when they are alone, they are two trusted friends who joke around and talk naturally.



However, their relationship takes a sudden turn due to a certain event. That event is... Suzuran's heartbreak.



This twisted yuri story begins at an all-girls school!



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: #Gal x Gal Yuri
mangas.description: When flashy high school gals Yua and Reina casually decide—on a whim—to date each other for a year, their spontaneous choice kicks off a wild and heart-thumping ride of laughs, love, and gyaru energy! A vibrant, youthful gyaru x gyaru couple comedy explodes onto the scene!!

mangas.title: I See You, Aizawa-san!
mangas.titleNative: 見えてますよ! 愛沢さん
mangas.description: Michi has a gift: she can see ghosts! But this ability is more of a plague than a bragging right, so she does her best to pretend she can't see them to avoid interacting with lingering spirits. Unfortunately, a new ghost has entered her life: one who really demands attention. Aizawa Honami was a former classmate and member of a famous idol group before she died, and it seems she's still not ready to move on. Michi is determined not to get involved, but Honami's bizarre antics and displays of fan service are making it hard to ignore her—especially when it makes Michi's heart go crazy!

mangas.title: After School Etude
mangas.description: When Minobe Chihiro is admitted to a private arts academy to study ballet, the last person he expects to train with is surly second-year student Ichinomiya Shun. Yet by some stroke of luck, the two are paired up for their school's mandatory pas de deux practice. While Minobe has fallen at first sight for Ichinomiya's superior dance sense, the second-year's attitude leaves a lot to be desired. For Ichinomiya, being paired with Minobe as a dance partner is just one of the ways he'd like to be together with his new partner. It's not just grades that have Ichinomiya dancing with Minobe—he's head over heels, and he's after Minobe's heart!

mangas.title: The Noble Student and His Cinderella
mangas.description:
Tokyo, the 10th year of the Taisho period (1921). Fuki, a 24-year-old maid working at the manor house of the distinguished Tachibana family, is reunited with their son Yugo, who has returned home to enroll at The First Imperial University. With Fuki's engagement having been dissolved and Yugo having been charged with finding himself a suitable wife, she accepts his proposal of marriage. In an era when parents' consent is necessary for marriage, and despite the gap between the two in both age and social standing, the admirable maid and elite student's married life is about to begin.



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: When the Villainess Meets the Crazy Heroine
mangas.synonyms: Dang E Yi Yu Dao Bing Jiao
mangas.description: A yuri story about a yandere commoner × villainess lady. When the arrogant noblewoman He Sha tried to bully the commoner girl Qiao Lin out of jealousy, the yandere Qiao Lin turned the tables and took her first kiss instead. At first, He Sha just wanted to get back at Qiao Lin by playing pranks on her, but eventually it became an excuse to try to attract Qiao Lin's attention… The more the villainess tries to mess with the yandere, the more the yandere returns the favor, which only makes the villainess more tsundere.

mangas.title: The Two-Faced Heroine is Obsessed with Marking Me
mangas.titleNative: 黑月光女主总想标记我
mangas.synonyms: Hei Yueguang Nü Zhu Zong Xiang Biaoji Wo | Black Moonlight Heroine Always Wants to Mark Me | The Protagonist Of The Black Moon Always Wants To Mark Me
mangas.description:
A manipulative and calculating Alpha (Disguised as an Omega) × A cold-on-the-outside fearful Omega (Disguised as an Alpha)!

When designer Gu Yu transmigrates into an ABO romance, she becomes the villain who will be killed by the protagonist, Su Yue. In order to survive, she decides to flatter the 'fragile Omega', creating stunning looks and helping her dominate showbiz. But Su Yue is not an Omega… she is an Alpha in disguise! And now, with intoxicating wine pheromones, she demands: 'Ready to be marked and be mine?'"

mangas.title: Kiss Me in The Dark of Night
mangas.description: Clark, a vampire who had been sleeping for 800 years, was dug out by the young Taoist Jiang Lai and successfully bound to a contract. Trying to find a way to kill this vampire, Jiang Lai starts living with her and tries various methods, but she ends up falling for Clark's seductive charm. A chance encounter turns out to be an inevitable reunion… In that past life and in this one, the one who hated her is reborn. Love and hate are like the two sides of the moon. "Clark, come to me."

mangas.title: Falling
mangas.description: When lifelong criminal Seung-Ji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeong-Won is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeong-Won is working in her aunt's stead as Seung-Ji's superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seung-Ji's desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can't afford...

mangas.title: The Villainess' Bride
mangas.description:
One day, Carina, a lady who has been groomed to be queen, suddenly has her engagement annulled by her fiancee, the prince. Now he is sending Carina into exile while standing beside her sister Aurora instead. Exiled to the far north, where demons are said to dwell, Carina ventures out to investigate the identity of a disturbing sound and has a fateful encounter in the snow…? A predatory love fantasy between a lady sworn to revenge and a strange girl seeking love!



(Source: Comic Seasons, translated)

mangas.title: Seal My Lips With a Kiss
mangas.titleNative: キスでふさいで、バレないで。
mangas.description:
"You're so turned on for someone trapped in this situation…"

My sensitive spots are getting rubbed harshly over my shirt and a finger is slowly creeping inside of me
How can I suppress my voice so that we won't get found out…!

One night, Kaede was accidentally locked out in the corridor of her workplace. She's helped by her unrequited love, Shioya, who happened to pass by. He then lets her stay overnight at his house. Surprised by Shioya's roommate, they hide in the closet. Kaede's thrilled by how close his body is to her... At that moment, his lips touch her chest.

mangas.title: Please Sleep With Me, Tachibana!: My First Sexual Partner is My Hot Coworker?!
mangas.titleNative: 橘くん 抱いてください！ ハジメテの相手は同僚王子!?
mangas.synonyms: 타치바나 군, 안아 주세요! 첫 상대는 훈남 동료?!
mangas.description:
"I... want you to... have se-sex with me...!"


The office lady Sumire is not good with men, because she grew up in an environment surrounded mostly by women.
So she has never had a boyfriend in her whole life! But she wants to experience it at least once... to have sex!
That's a tough hurdle for someone who has trouble dealing with men. So she asks Tachibana, who is the only man she can speak to normally at work. He says he'll have sex with her, with some conditions...?


A sweet story between a [Popular and handsome colleague] x [Beautiful but unpopular virgin OL] that will keep your heart throbbing... This is a romance of sexual awakening!



(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

mangas.title: Hibiscus and Bamboo
mangas.description: A rich little heiress runs away from home and meets a swordswoman in seclusion deep in the mountains. What sort of story will unfold between the two of them? (Probably a simple and sweet little love story).

mangas.title: Ta Haoxiang Zai Liao Wo
mangas.synonyms: She Seems to Be Teasing Me
mangas.description:
The starlet Yu Chaoyan made herself famous through all sorts of antics and gossip, but in reality she's just a mouthy virgin. Tired of the rumors tying her her to another male actor, she angrily said live on camera, "If he were the last man on Earth, I would rather become a lesbian before I'd go out with him!" The outburst made waves online, and she shot to the top of the hot topics list. But in the aftermath, a crazed fan of the actor ambushed Yu Chaoyan in the parking lot and tried to disfigure her. Faced with danger, that was when Yin Zhou stumbled on the scene and stepped in to save her from the attack…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: The Demon of Vengeance
mangas.description:
In a prosperous city, there are many races- which are beyond the understanding of humans- hidden in society. The strength and the prosperity of these races not only depends on their own growth, but also on human belief and worship of them.


However, as more people in modern society believe less in them, the more their numbers and strength diminish. Although there are still some powerful and ancient beings, they can only try their best to hide in corners of the world or pretend to be human.


On the other hand, there are other races with dark purposes who call themselves the "Devil Hunter Association". In order not to be discovered by the demon hunters and not targeted by humans, various races worked hard to integrate into human society.

mangas.title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
mangas.synonyms: The Song That Transcends This World
mangas.description:
During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father's death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other's life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu's fate will forever be rotating together.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Whirlpool in Vernal Reverie
mangas.description:
Introverted high schooler Xuting is used to being the target of bullies, but her life takes a dramatic turn when a new, mysteriously handsome repairman intervenes. Captivated by his quiet strength and grateful for his protection, Xuting feels an undeniable pull towards him. Yet, her world shatters when she stumbles upon his terrifying secret: he's a werewolf. Now, caught between burgeoning feelings and monstrous danger, Xuting must navigate a terrifying new reality where her protector might just be her greatest threat.



(Source: WebComics)

mangas.title: Tsurenai Kanojo no Hitorijime
mangas.titleNative: つれない彼女のひとりじめ
mangas.description:
Nachi Shinohara is a popular high school boy who gets along with everyone, but he found himself attracted to Takizawa Yuuri, a beautiful loner girl. A chance exchange of words leads to a relationship that no one else knows.



(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

mangas.title: Nengara Nenbyaku Ansatsu Renka
mangas.synonyms: Nen Gara Nen Hyaku Ansatsu Renka
mangas.description: The Haiboshi family's line of work is assassination. Takatori, their princess, picks up a boy named Raika who swore to dedicate everything.

mangas.title: Watashi wo Koroshita Wanko-kei Kishi-sama ga, Yandere ni Job Change shite Kyou mo Inochi wo Neratte Kuru
mangas.titleNative: 私を殺したワンコ系騎士様が、ヤンデレにジョブチェンジして今日も命を狙ってくる
mangas.synonyms: The Loyal Knight Killed Me. After Changing to a Yandere, He Is Still Fixated on Me
mangas.description:
Tiana's engagement was broken off by the prince of her own country, and she was sentenced to exile. However, the knight of a neighbouring country, who was an aide to that country's prince, suddenly proposed to her. Since he was her type, Tiana accepted the marriage proposal and traveled with him to his country, but what awaited her was an unjust death. However, although she should have died, Tiana finds herself back when her engagement was broken and she was proposed to by the knight!

"Now... Now it's too late... I'll have to kill her."

The last words the knight spoke before killing her lingered in her mind. But Tiana doesn't want to die again! Terrified, she tries to refuse the marriage proposal, but she can't escape from the knight who has gone completely crazy! A cat-and-mouse rom-com about Tiana, whose memories construe murderous intent, and a knight who refuses to let her escape and gets more and more yandere...

mangas.title: She Loves to Cook, and She Loves to Eat
mangas.titleNative: 作りたい女と食べたい女
mangas.description:
Cooking is how Nomoto de-stresses, but one day, she makes way more than she can eat by herself. And so she invites her neighbor Kasuga, who also lives alone. What will come out of this dinner invitation?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Fiancée Chosen by the Ring
mangas.description:
Aurora el la Porta is a noblewoman with one love -- the art of embroidery. While she attends the lavish evening parties her peers so adore, she's not looking for a dance but inspiration for a new design! On one such night, distracted by the many beautiful dresses on display, she's struck in the face by a mysterious wedding ring. When she picks it up, one of the finest knights in the kingdom approaches, declaring her his new fiancée!
