Aurora has no idea what's going on, but one thing's for sure -- she's got a big decision to make...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: I Met the Male Lead in Prison
mangas.synonyms: ฉันเจอพระเอกนิยายในห้องขัง
mangas.description:
As if waking up in an R-rated dark romance wasn't surprising enough, it turns out that Ianna is in the prison where the cursed male lead, Rikedoran, is also being held! Despite having no memories of her own, Ianna thankfully has full knowledge of the story, which leads her to visit Rikedoran out of curiosity. In his cell, she discovers rather shocking truths about the reality of his curse and his past. It doesn't take long for her to wonder whether she'll be able to leave him and the plot be...



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Pink Candy Kiss
mangas.description:
Can Takara find happiness with the girl she loved in middle school? Or is she 20 years too late?



After 20 years apart, Takara reconnects with Ema, the girl she nearly kissed in middle school—who's now a beautiful, married woman.



Takara's world turns upside down when her best friend from middle school reenters her life. She's bewildered by how the shy, quiet girl she once knew has grown into a charming woman with an air of mystique. Despite Ema being married, Takara can't help but think there's something special about Ema's cool, soft hands against her skin...



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: The Problematic Prince
mangas.description:
Erna Hardy is the daughter of a ruined noble family, and she's a fish out of water among the elites of Lechen's high society. But this country bumpkin makes a giant splash when her official debut is interrupted by Prince Björn Dniester, the kingdom's "Royal Poisonous Mushroom." Suddenly, Erna is the hot topic on everyone's lips, and Prince Björn decides that courting the young lady will help him thwart persistent reconciliation attempts from his pining ex-wife. It's not until Erna unwittingly finds herself becoming a pawn in the prince's toxic game that she realizes how he's earned himself such a venomous title. And despite her best attempts to steer clear of his royal mess, an innocent mistake leaves her indebted to the prince indefinitely. Now, she's at his mercy as she works to pay off her debt. But is this royal mushroom really as deadly as everyone says?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
mangas.titleNative: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ~雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝~
mangas.synonyms: 我是不才惡女~雛宮蝶鼠互換傳
mangas.description:
In a kingdom inspired by historical China, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts–but only one will be crowned empress. The frail and beautiful Kou Reirin, the so-called "butterfly" of the imperial court, is a shoo-in to marry the crown prince. But when "court rat" Shu Keigetsu lashes out at her during the glittering Lantern Festival, it's Reirin who wakes up in the dungeons! Body-swapped by her assailant to steal her position at court, Reirin's plight seems dire…to everyone else! Now that she's got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: The Holy Grail of Eris
mangas.synonyms: ผีนางร้ายจับคู่สาวซื่อ รื้อคดีใหญ่
mangas.description:
The Grail family has a single guiding principle in their lives—Thou Shalt Be Sincere. However, sincerity alone can only get a lady so far in the twisted world of high society...as meek Constance Grail soon learns after she is framed for petty theft and loses her fiancé and reputation in a matter of minutes. But one gaze on her isn't quite as chilling as the others, though the woman's uncanny resemblance to Scarlett Castiel must be a coincidence. After all, Scarlett isn't just extremely wicked…she's also very much dead.


(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Happiness Rides a Broomstick
mangas.description: Dan-Jo is a freshman in a university and lives a monotonous life. On orientation day she goes to the warehouse on an errand for her senior and witnesses a broom that transforms into a human. From that day on, the Broom Ghost persistently asks for help from Dan-Jo, who she has never met, saying she has nowhere to go. In the end, Dan-Jo accidentally gives the Broom Ghost, the name 'Eundohae', and they live together in a small gosiwon. In return the Broom Ghost promises to make Danjo happy.

mangas.title: My Precious Little Villains
mangas.description: I don't know how it happened, but I was reborn into a novel as Hannah, the caregiver and teacher at the temple's orphanage. To make matters worse, the children I care for will become my murderers and the villains of this novel. In order to survive, I attempted to escape, but these cute little rascals couldn't bear to see me leave. Since they are still young, maybe I can raise them to become good people instead of bad ones. How hard could it be to raise a few villains?

mangas.title: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?
mangas.description:
Alice was a chef living in Korea when an explosion transported her into a novel. Having worked so hard in her previous life only to die young, Alice wants to live this new life in peace. There's only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Don't Want To Play Matchmaker!
mangas.synonyms: I Don't Want to Be an Ojakgyo
mangas.description:
After being reborn into a novel, Shuryna, knowing her ultimate fate, plans to become a magic knight and retire rich. However, her biggest obstacle is the four men in love with her best friend, Hestia. They're supposed to chase after Hestia but want Shuryna to be their matchmaker. She refuses since that role was what led to her banishment, but the boys are relentless. Can Shuryna grasp the wealthy retirement she desperately desires? Or will Hestia's love interests lead to her downfall again?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?
mangas.description: Nadia Valajit thought she had nothing more to lose until her family and fiancé betrayed her. After she finds herself thrust back in time prior to the events that ultimately led to her death, Nadia kicks off her plans for payback by marrying Glenn Winterpel, the icy marquess to the north and the Valajit family's favorite punching bag. Armed with knowledge of the future, Nadia sets the table to serve up her ice-cold revenge, but she might end up melting the marquess's heart instead…

mangas.title: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
mangas.synonyms: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
mangas.description:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he's the perfect man, so who wouldn't want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I'd rather save my honey! His Highness's special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I've only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I'll make him notice me!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Shokubutsu Monster Musume Nikki: Seijo datta Watashi ga Uragireta Hate ni Aruraune ni Tensei Shite Shimatta node, kore kara wa Kougousei wo Shinagara Shizuka ni Shoukubutsu Life ni Sugoshimasu
mangas.titleNative: 植物モンスター娘日記 ～聖女だった私が裏切られた果てにアルラウネに転生してしまったので、これからは光合成をしながら静かに植物ライフを過ごします～
mangas.description:
Who knew that even a stationary plant could be surprisingly capable?!



Our protagonist is a saint—or was, until she was betrayed by one of her fellow saint apprentices as well as her fiancé, a hero.

In her final moments, she recalls her previous life, when she was just a normal Japanese high school girl, but that doesn't help the fact that she's being eaten alive by a massive plant monster.



And yet, by a stroke of luck, she doesn't die for good, but instead reincarnates as said plant monster. With the upper half of a human and the lower half of a plant, she must now spend her life as an Alraune.



And so, she tries to live the peaceful life of a plant, photosynthesizing all day!

Welcome to the diary of a plant girl who just wants some peace and quiet, but something always gets in her way!

mangas.title: The Ice Guy and the Cool Girl
mangas.titleNative: 氷属性男子とクールな同僚女子
mangas.synonyms: Koori Zokusei Danshi to Cool na Douryo Joshi
mangas.description:
Sparks fly between the handsome descendant of a snow spirit and the oblivious coworker he has a crush on! A romantic comedy in an office setting that takes coworkers to lovers to new heights within a winter wonderland of emotions!



Himuro is a modern-day ice god, an ordinary office worker who just so happens to be the descendant of a snow spirit. He's also besotted with his coworker Fuyutsuki, who's a little unusual herself. At first glance, the pair both seem to be calm, cool, and collected. But beneath Himuro's icy good looks rages a passionate blizzard of love! On the other hand, his coworker's cool facade belies nothing about any feelings she might have for Himuro in return⁠-because she's too oblivious to realize anything! What's a snowman in love to do?



(Source: Square Enix)


Note: Originally uploaded to Twitter, after nine chapters it was serialized by GANGANpixiv, where it is being republished and now continues.

mangas.title: Kuuki ga "Yomeru" Shinnyushain to Buaiso na Senpai no Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: 空気が「読める」新入社員と不愛想な先輩の話
mangas.synonyms: 「看得懂」氣氛的新人和臭臉前輩
mangas.description:
New employee Shiho Satoko has a special skill. Rather than being able to read the mood, it would be better to say she can "see" it. With this special skill, what kind of hidden side can she see behind her senior's unfriendly exterior?


Note: Sixteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

mangas.title: Yamaguchi-kun Isn't So Bad
mangas.titleNative: 山口くんはワルくない
mangas.description:
Shy Satsuki Shinohara's plan for a big high school debut are almost ruined by a pervert on the train, but she's saved by none other than the "gangster" student in her class, Yamaguchi-kun. He's already got a bad rap with the other students, and though Satsuki tries to approach him, he seems to always weasel out of her grasp. But she's not one to let a challenge daunt her, and she's out to prove that Yamaguchi-kun is so much more than he's cracked up to be.


(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Hirayasumi
mangas.description:
With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward.

At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old granny who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house, but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin Natsumi moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

mangas.title: Kono Oto Tomare!
mangas.description: Since the graduation of the senior members of the club, Takezou ends up being the sole member of the "Koto" (traditional Japanese string instrument) club. Now that the new school year has begun, Takezou will have to seek out new members into the club, or the club will become terminated. Out of nowhere, a new member barges into the near-abandoned club room, demanding to join the club. How will Takezou be able to keep his club alive and deal with this rascal of a new member?

mangas.title: The Falcon Princess
mangas.description:
After losing consciousness while fleeing the war raging in Roymund Kingdom, Princess Zeline wakes up in the body of a messenger falcon! She's now the bird in charge of delivering information for Commander Valhyle and his army, who are searching for the remaining royal descendants. She may be tiny and feathered, but Zeline is determined to use her missions to find out what happened to her family. Can this little birdie gain the skeptical commander's trust and give her kingdom new wings?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Moon on a Rainy Night
mangas.synonyms: La luna en una noche de lluvia
mangas.description:
One day, while rushing to a piano lesson, a girl named Saki collides with someone on the street. As Saki collects herself, the stranger picks up the sheet music Saki dropped, hands it to Saki together with a band-aid, and continues on her way—all without saying a word. Saki is left wondering about the identity of the tall, lovely stranger, only to discover the next day that she is one of her classmates at her new high school. The girl's name is Kanon, and though she is hearing impaired, she refuses any kind of support or "special treatment" from her teachers or classmates. Over the course of the year, Saki slowly grows closer to Kanon and begins to chip away at her cold exterior.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Laid-Back Camp
mangas.description:
Setting up a tent, starting a fire, and eating noodles with Mt. Fuji in view...Rin and Nadeshiko absolutely love to camp! Enjoy their zest for travel and maybe even pick up a tip or two about roughing it in the great outdoors. You might just want to go camping yourself!

(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: With You and the Rain
mangas.description:
If it looks like a dog and acts like a dog and insists it's a dog, it's...a dog? Probably? She adopted it anyway, and her life with this "dog" will never be boring!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
mangas.titleNative: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命
mangas.synonyms: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
mangas.description: Princess Anisphia may not be able to use magic, but she didn't let that stop her from developing "magicology," a unique theory based on memories from her past life. While testing out her new flying broom, she happens across Euphyllia, a magical genius, having her engagement unjustly and publicly broken off. Seeing the tears in Euphyllia's eyes, Anisphia takes the obvious course of action—kidnapping the girl for herself!

mangas.title: Inkya Gyaru Demo Ikigaritai!
mangas.titleNative: 陰キャギャルでもイキがりたい！
mangas.description:
Ichiko and Kulan are members of the pop-culture research club.

They like pop culture.

They like cute.

These two "gals in the shadows" spend their days in a new kind of youthful moratorium.



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Yunhai Zhi Ji
mangas.description:
In a world with only the sky and the sea, there exist two opposing tribes. After Iona from the winged sky tribe meets Helen from the scaled water tribe by happenstance at the water's edge, a deep bond starts to form between the two.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: The Mermaid I Met by Getting Fired
mangas.titleNative: 失业后我在海边遇见了人鱼小姐
mangas.synonyms: After Losing My Job, I Met Miss Mermaid at the Beach
mangas.description:
After the pandemic passed, our protagonist lost her job and decided to join a tour group to the seaside to relax. Only to meet a mermaid in the ocean?! The mermaid acted strangely and quickly disappeared. But the next day, she saw the mermaid again, and her jaw dropped in astonishment…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Watashi Dake ni Misete Hoshii
mangas.titleNative: 私だけに見せて欲しい
mangas.description:
After moving to big city, small town high school girl Tano-San finds the culture shock immense and only wishes to go back to the countryside.



That is until she meets the beautiful yet mysterious Rurika Towa, a girl who is super popular with boys and yet has no female friends.



Will an unlikely friendship begin between the two girls or will it turn into something more?



(Source: Galette, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Azumi-chan to Kochou-chan
mangas.titleNative: 亜澄ちゃんと胡蝶ちゃん
mangas.description: Asumi, whose earnest nature makes her a pillar of support for everyone, is dating Kocho, the most beautiful girl in their grade. However, the one thing he realised after getting together with her was that she was actually a "queen bee" type who is utterly self-centred and totally agressive. Asumi, who finds herself constantly at Kocho’s mercy, can’t stop her heart from racing at her every word and action! But is it actually Kocho who’s getting all flustered?

mangas.title: Oshi wo Aisuru Watashitachi: Oshi × Fan - Anthology Comic
mangas.titleNative: 推しを愛する私たち～推し×ファン～アンソロジーコミック
mangas.description:
1. Dependence; Kinoshi Wata

2. Watashi wo Shirazu ni Mawattete (私を知らずに回ってて); Hoshi

3. Mumei no Kimi ga Sukidatta (無名の君が好きだった); Yukito Haruno

4. Otaku no Yomeiri (オタクの嫁入り); Momokichi Shirai

5. Kamisama (神様);

mangas.title: Keep Holding On
mangas.description:
8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mengdong Jing Yuan
mangas.description: Jiang Xiaoman, a university student and online writer, inherits a mysterious job from her father. Working as the archdemon Qin Lan's assistant, she begins to tackle strange cases with Qin Lan. As the two clashing personalities band together to solve each bizarre yet heart-rending case, they develop special feelings towards each other.

mangas.title: Wanmei Idol Lunxian Shouce
mangas.synonyms: The Perfect Idol's Handbook of Falling in Love
mangas.description:
The girl group Mystyle, which has had a tepid career so far, announces on their third anniversary that they're going to split up in two. One team will be continue to be led by the original leader, the hot and sexy Windy. While the other team will be led by the cute and energetic newcomer Wang Shu. Wang Shu seems like a well-behaved girl, and she tries hard to get along with Windy day-to-day. But in fact, she seems to more than just friendly feelings for her senpai...



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Zhangguan, Ni De Weiba Cang Bu Zhu Le
mangas.titleNative: 长官，你的尾巴藏不住了
mangas.synonyms: Officer, You Can No Longer Hide Your Tail
mangas.description:
A war has upended the world's strict social order. The beast-woman Qing Shilun, a former high-ranking military officer, now finds herself banished to the lowest caste, given to her long-time rival Shen Xilan as a plaything. Everyone thought that Qing Shilun will be tortured and humiliated, but the game is just beginning, to see who will be the master and who will be tamed…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Tao Li Bu Yan
mangas.description:
Years later, Tao Anzhi is glad that she went ahead and opened that door. It was like a blessing from god, for her to meet Yan Xi, grow up with her, and fall deeply in love with her. Yan Xi never thought she'd feel this kind of love, especially not with the girl she grew up with. Even though they live in different timelines, their lives are inextricably bound together over the years. Even when they were so young, they were so in love, without even realizing.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Yume to Koi dewa Tsuriawanai
mangas.titleNative: 夢と恋ではつり合わない
mangas.description:
"I like you, now please reject me!"



Hikaru Kurata, a diligent girl who dreams of good grades leading to a good job, falls in love at first sight with Kira Kairi, another girl in her class, on their first day of high school.
Hikaru is so infatuated with her first love that she can't stop thinking about Kira all day, and her grades, which were at the top of the class when she started high school, drops to the point where she is on the verge of failing. So Hikaru boldly confesses her love to Kairi, hoping to get rejected so she could get back to studying. But Kairi's answer is very different from what she expected…



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Meeting My Ex-Girlfriend
mangas.description: What are the odds of running into an ex-lover at a recycling center? A new story written by two women who reunite as apartment residents.

mangas.title: Midnight Waltz
mangas.description: A girl makes the acquaintance of a monstrous creature who believes himself to be quite human.

mangas.title: The White King
mangas.description: An albino boy and a white lion form a unique bond.

mangas.title: See You Tomorrow, Daisy
mangas.description: A frail girl recovers with the help of an unlikely friend.

mangas.title: Love on the Other Side: A Nagabe Short Story Collection
mangas.titleNative: ながべ短編集 ーヘンテコな愛ー
mangas.description:
Love comes in many forms. A magnificent bird comforts a struggling girl; a vampire waltzes with a young lady at night; a blind girl lives with a monster of whom there is more than meets the eye. This six-story manga collection by masterful manga creator Nagabe explores fascinating relationships that refuse to be confined.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Jintian Yiding Yao Dui (Rang) Ni Gaobai
mangas.titleNative: 今天一定要对（让）你告白
mangas.description: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety and confess to Lin Daixue. On the other side Daixue keeps leaving openings for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other's feelings but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

mangas.title: Remina
mangas.description: An unknown planet emerges from inside a wormhole, and its discoverer, Dr. Oguro, christens the body "Remina" after his own daughter. His finding is met with great fanfare, and Remina herself rises to fame. However, the object picks up speed as it moves along in its curious course, eliminating planets and stars one after another, until finally Earth itself faces extinction… Is the girl Remina the true cause of the catastrophe? A masterwork of horror from Junji Ito, unfolding on a universal scale.

mangas.title: Voices in the Dark
mangas.description:
Horror comic all the way spreading over different 7 stories:

Story 1: Blood-sucking Darkness / The Dark Drinks Blood

Story 2: The Ghosts of Golden Time

Story 3: Roar of Ages

Story 4: Mystery of the Haunted House

Story 5: Glyceride

Story 6: The Earth-bound People

Story 7: The Call of the Condemned

mangas.title: Shin Yami no Koe: Kaidan
mangas.synonyms: New Voices in the Dark (Ghost Stories)
mangas.description:
More horror stories from master Junji Ito.

THE SOICHI FRONT is a direct continuation of "Secret of the Haunted Mansion" from the first Yami no Koe.

SOICHI’S BELOVED PET is about Soichi, the devilish boy that Ito has written about in a number of his other stories, and the events that unfold when his family adopts an abandoned cat.

IN THE VALLEY OF MIRRORS- "There is bitter enmity between two villages, facing each other across a river. But instead of erecting walls and battlements, they both decided to put up mirrors. What could this mean? And where did all the people disappear to, all those years ago?"

ANYTHING BUT A GHOST- "While driving on a mountain road one night, Shigeru finds a girl covered in blood."

LIBRARY OF ILLUSIONS- "Koko lives with her husband Goro in a giant mansion full of books. The books are a family heirloom, and he’s fiercely protective of them, so it would really suck if something were to happen to them …"

SONGS IN THE DARK- "Ever had a song stuck in your head? Of course you have, there’s probably one there now. But what if it didn’t go away? Days, weeks, months, the same song 24/7."

SPLATTER FILM- "A bunch of stoned slackers get hooked on delicious honey, with delicious [read: grotesque] results."

mangas.title: Fragments of Horror
mangas.description:
A new collection of delightfully macabre tales from a master of horror manga.

An old wooden mansion that turns on its inhabitants. A dissection class with a most unusual subject. A funeral where the dead are definitely not laid to rest. Ranging from the terrifying to the comedic, from the erotic to the loathsome, these stories showcase Junji Ito's long-awaited return to the world of horror.

1. Futon (布団)

2. Mokuzou no Kai (木造の怪, Wooden Spirit)

3. Tomio • Akai Hainekku (富夫・赤いハイネック, Tomio: Red Turtleneck)

4. Yuruyakana Wakare (緩やかな別れ, Gentle Goodbye)

5. Kaibou-chan (解剖ちゃん, Dissection Girl)

6. Kuroi Tori (黒い鳥, Blackbird)

7. Nanakuse Magami (七癖曲美)

8. Mimikosuri Suru Onna (耳擦りする女, Whispering Woman)

mangas.title: Venus in the Blind Spot
mangas.titleNative: 伊藤潤二短編集 BEST OF BEST
mangas.synonyms: Vênus Invisível – Coleção de Histórias Curtas: O melhor de Junji Ito
mangas.description:
A "best of" collection of creepy tales from Eisner award winner and legendary horror master Junji Ito. This ultimate collection presents the most remarkable short works of Junji Ito's career, featuring an adaptation of Rampo Edogawa's classic horror story "Human Chair" and fan favorite "The Enigma of Amigara Fault." In a deluxe presentation with special color pages and color illustrations from his most recent long-form manga No Longer Human, every page invites readers to revel in a world of terror.



Contains:

1. Okuman Bocchi (Billions Alone)

2. Ningen Isu (The Human Chair) [Story: Edogawa Ranpo]

3. Kono Yo no Hoka no Koi (An Unearthly Love) [Story: Edogawa Ranpo]

4. Mouten no Venus (Venus in the Blind Spot)

5. Name Onna (The Licking Woman)

6. Umezu-sensei to Watashi (Master Umezz and Me)

7. Miirareta Kirida Kyouju (How Love Came to Professor Kirida)

8. Ashura no Dansou no Kai (The Enigma of Amigara Fault)

9. Daikokubashira Hiwa (The Sad Tale of the Principal Post)

10. Wasuregatami (Keepsake)


(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: The Liminal Zone, Vol. 2
mangas.titleNative: 幻怪地帯 Season2 エーテルの村
mangas.description:
Welcome to the liminal zone, where things beyond your wildest imagination await. What fate awaits when death is not the end?


A group of four university students stumbles upon a deserted, decaying village deep in the mountains only to find an enormous perpetual motion machine still at work there. Before they can answer the questions of who made it and to what end, the friends begin to disappear, one after the other. Another story sees the return of the strange Hikizuri siblings! A girl weighed down since birth by an invisible burden meets the odd siblings and moves in with them in order to understand the truth about herself. But after a string of bizarre occurrences, the siblings' uncle appears on the scene…



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: Mui, Alien of the Famous Pleasure Race
mangas.synonyms: Mui Is Truly a Famous Hedonistic Race
mangas.description: Earth leaves a lot to be desired when Mui the Alien first arrives. She was promised a planet full of lustful women, only to end up learning humans are nothing but perpetual working machines. Just when Mui feels pressured to become a productive member of society herself, she meets Hayan, a timid recluse with an interesting way of relieving tension that Mui and her alien appendage can most definitely help with...!

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: Young at Heart
mangas.description:
Former actress Seon-Yeong is shocked when she finds out about her husband's affair with a younger woman. When a fortune teller says she needs to receive youthful energy from younger women to stop his cheating, the desperate Seon-Yeong concludes that she has to sleep with a younger woman to get what she wants. So when an innocent young housekeeper named Min-Seo comes to work for her, it's not long before their relationship takes a steamy turn...

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Women at Work: A Pinch of Love
mangas.description:
Ra-On is a top idol on professional hiatus after several scandals. During her time off, she's tasked with training Ho-Rang, a member of a girl group on the verge of their debut. For reasons Ra-On cannot figure out, Ho-Rang is adamant on dropping out of her chance at stardom, and it's up to Ra-On to get Ho-Rang's singing and mindset back in the game. However, it isn't easy to get Ho-Rang's spirits and vocals high enough…until Ra-On discovers the perfect trick: pinching her in just the right place.


(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: The Demon Princess's First Love
mangas.description:
As a child, Lulu the demon princess yearns for the love described in novels from the human world, but is scorned by the heartless demons around her. So she searches for love in the human world and meets Ha-Yeon, a cheerful girl who offers to draw her. Lulu instantly falls for Ha-Yeon's supportive nature and artistic passion, which prompts her to seek her out again as an adult ten years later. Although Ha-Yeon is now a disillusioned ex-artist who barely remembers Lulu, the demon princess is determined to make her first love come true, no matter what!

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Xi Wang Ni, Zhen De Hen Kuaile
mangas.description:
The recent graduate Yu Zhou has just joined the workforce, when she runs into the cool lady Su Chang at the hospital. The two immediately hit it off, and after some teasing and flirting, they eventually come to recognize their feelings for each other. But what Yu Zhou doesn't know is that Su Chang isn't only beautiful and well-off, she's also a highly acclaimed voice actress. How will the self-proclaimed ordinary girl "Xiao Zhou" ever be able to bridge the distance to the "Bright Moon"?



(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: Yoiko no Shouzou
mangas.description:
Hana is a college girl lacking ambition and motivation, when she meets a beautiful woman named Yoiko, who calls her self a "vengeful spirit" and tells Hana, "You have been cursed and you will die." To lift the curse, Hana must investigate the mystery behind this beautiful ghost, and her only clue is a sooty painting. The more Hana looks into Yoiko's background, the more she falls under Yoiko's captivating spell.



(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

mangas.title: Asahi to Satsuki
mangas.description:
Cool x Cool = Super Cute

Rumor has it that there are two students at a high school's basketball team known as the "Top Two."

mangas.title: Beauty and the Beast Girl
mangas.titleNative: ぼっち怪物と盲目少女
mangas.synonyms: Lonely Monster and Blind Girl | Bocchi Kaibutsu to Moumoku Shoujo
mangas.description: A lonely monster, living in seclusion in the forest, wishes she could live amidst humans despite her frightening appearance. Everything changes when she starts getting a visitor–a blind human girl who's fascinated with her mysterious forest friend. As the monster and the girl grow attached in their secluded world, their love proves that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

mangas.title: The Boy I Loved Became the Jaded Emperor
mangas.titleNative: 無口な公爵令嬢と冷徹な皇帝 ～前世拾った子供が皇帝になっていました～
mangas.description:
After witnessing the death of the woman who saved him as a child, Prince Alexei vows revenge and turns bitter and jaded, eventually taking the throne and becoming Emperor. Little does he know, the woman who saved him was reborn as the daughter of a duke, a taciturn young lady with a secret. When fate throws them together, will they recognize each other, or will their jaded pasts keep them apart?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Kazeyobi no Makana
mangas.description:
The "wind people" bring fruitfulness and prosperity to the land, and the "wind callers" are the humans who have the power to call upon the wind people. Makana, a wind caller, was told by the village chief that it was time for her to find her own "companion." Makana did not want to be tied down to a "companion" yet because it would take away her freedom, but when she meets a selfish and uninhibited wind person by chance, she is forced to sign a pact of companionship with him...



(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Rock it, GIRL!!
mangas.description:
Kaname likes playing her guitar and singing by the streets and can't believe her ears when a strange girl who's actually a music producer suddenly offers her a contract for a debut CD.

However she tells Kaname that her voice is completely worthless and that she'll have to debut within a band and just be the guitarist. Furthermore, the vocalist who will sing the songs in her place is an arrogant girl full of herself who immediately starts bullying her; however...

mangas.title: Jishinka Succubus to Tachi no Warui Otoko
mangas.titleNative: 自信家サキュバスと勃ちの悪い男
mangas.synonyms: The Succubus is Confident But Her Target is Impotent
mangas.description:
Mary just finished Succubus School and it's taking her final exam to graduate. However her exam parter has a little problem.

"I can't get it up."

mangas.title: Makoto no Momoka
mangas.description:
A love story between two frustrating adult women.



Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime November 2021 issue.

mangas.title: Yowangnime Majimak Teatime
mangas.description:
At the exclusive Saint Adela Girls' School for upper-class girls, a student's dead body has been discovered. While Emily, who was the victim's best friend, is certain that this is murder, it initially appears to be a suicide. Irene, the smartest kid in the class and now a distant childhood friend of Emily's, is asked to investigate the issue.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

mangas.title: Please Hug My Star
mangas.description: Ha-soo since she was young has had a long term crush on her best friend, Set-byeol, but she's satisfied with her current position as her best friend. Ha-soo, who thinks that she knows everything about Set-byeol, knew that she always liked someone as whenever she was asked out, she gave the same response, "I already have someone I like.", so she didn't give it much thought. But Ha-soo's mind becomes anxious when she sees her close, face-to-face with a boy in class after school.

mangas.title: Kkotjumeok
mangas.description:
Choi Yoon-Seo, the weakest high school girl at Kol-tong School, meets Son Kwon-Hwa, a transfer student wearing strange flower-decorated gloves. Kwon Hwa, who uses violence that does not forgive violence, is slightly crazy. It's okay! Everyone is insane anyway!



(BOMTOON, translated)

mangas.title: Ikai no Himemiko wa Pâtissière
mangas.titleNative: 異界の姫巫女はパティシエール
mangas.synonyms: The Saintess of Another World Is a Pâtissière
mangas.description:
One day, Emi, an apprentice pâtissière, suddenly found herself in another world where evil spirits were abound. As she was about to be attacked by a beast, she was saved by a handsome knight. She makes some pudding to thank him, and by chance it was discovered that the sweets made by Emi were able to purify evil spirits! Dumbfounded by this, a shrine was set up in her name and she became known as the legendary purification princess?!



(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

mangas.title: Koi no Iroha wo Oshiete
mangas.titleNative: 恋のいろははを教えて
mangas.synonyms: Teach Me the ABCs of Love
mangas.description:
Rin's first boyfriend thinks she is being too guarded and dumps her after just one week of dating. Rin is heartbroken, but she is consoled by Matsukaze, a popular boy at school, who offers to be her "practice partner." They are suddenly too close to each other! Can she really trust him? A young love story between a flirtatious senior and a pure JK!



(Source: Comic Days, translated)

mangas.title: Meteor Prince
mangas.description:
Strange accidents always seem to happen around Hako Natsuno—so much so that she's been dubbed the "Queen of Bad Luck." It's hardly surprising then that a naked alien prince falls from the sky to tell her that out of all the girls in the universe, he's come to Earth to mate with her. Does this mean Hako's luck has changed, or…?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Tokyo Mew Mew a La Mode
mangas.titleNative: 東京ミュウミュウあ・ら・もーど
mangas.description: With Mew Ichigo studying abroad in London, the remaining four girls from Cafe Mew Mew are one too few. Luckily, a new Mew is about to emerge. Berry just transferred to a different junior high because she thought their school outfits were cute. Little does she know she's about to become the first Mew Mew with TWO sets of animal genes in her blood. Half cat, half rabbit, she's joining the Mew Mew team just in time. A new gang calling itself the Crusaders has appeared, and its leader just happens to love wild game like rabbit - well done and served for his dinner! When Mew Ichigo returns from London she's going to be very, very surprised!

mangas.title: Heroine for Hire
mangas.titleNative: ヒロインはじめました。
mangas.description:
Shuko Kodakamine is strong—too strong, by the standards of some. She hopes to make a good high school debut, but that plan goes up in smoke almost immediately when she injures the attractive, charismatic Serizawa-kun...and later suplexes him, to boot! But when Serizawa-kun finds himself in hot water with a jealous boyfriend, it's Shuko who comes to his aid...and he comes up with a ridiculous proposition: If Shuko becomes his bodyguard, he'll make her the most important girl in his world!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Shitsuren Onna no Yomeiri
mangas.description:
"Don't forget that I, too, am a man."

A chance encounter during a trip to heal a broken heart…?!

Watch as a Japanese-style romance in an unusual setting unfolds!

mangas.title: Atashi, Kiss Shita.
mangas.description: "What can I do to change our relationship status quo?"

mangas.title: Yasashii Hikari
mangas.description:
"Maybe, if I were to live faraway..."


Miyake, a salaryman who had been living his life without a break, arrives for a new job on Tsukinowa island, where time flows gently. With a high school girl, Hiyoko, as his guide, a new life will begin!

mangas.title: Sensor
mangas.description:
A woman walks alone at the foot of Mount Sengoku. A man appears, saying he's been waiting for her, and invites her to a nearby village. Surprisingly, the village is covered in hairlike volcanic glass fibers, and all of it shines a bright gold. At night, when the villagers perform their custom of gazing up at the starry sky, countless unidentified flying objects come raining down on them—the opening act for the terror about to occur!


(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Handsome Girl and Sheltered Girl
mangas.titleNative: イケメン女と箱入り娘
mangas.synonyms: Przystojna dziewczyna i panna spod klosza
mangas.description:
When Okuma Satomi's friend seeks her help wrangling guys for a crossdressing cafe, Satomi winds up with a boyfriend! Sort of. After asking her handsome and aloof classmate, Kanda Mizuki, to help out in the cafe, Mizuki agrees, but on one condition: the two of them must go on a date. Satomi eagerly agrees, delighted to have such a good-looking guy interested in her, but Mizuki realizes that Satomi has completely misunderstood something crucial: Mizuki is a girl! Will this case of mistaken identity blossom into something beautiful, or will the truth leave both girls brokenhearted?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Chapter count includes five bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Tatta Hitokoto
mangas.description: Story of a estranged married couple who slowly reconcile their differences.

mangas.title: Mousou OL wa Incubus to XXX Shitai
mangas.titleNative: 妄想OLはインキュバスと×××したい
mangas.description:
A secret I can't tell anyone! I have "erotic dreams".



Because her standards are too high, Saito Chihiro, 27 has no boyfriend. This is the story of how she escapes reality in erotic dreams. In reality, she's hopeless with men but in her dreams, she can act freely. She's been enjoying her dreams like usual when a new employee, Sakuma Remu, shows up. And for some reason, he knows about her erotic dreams! Suddenly Remu sprouts horns and a tail.



"Sign a contract with me in exchange for your erotic dreams," he says. Is it ok to accept the lure of an Incubus and sign a contract?



Thus starts the love of an Incubus x Office Lady that began with a contractual relationship.



(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: Miirareta Souichi
mangas.description: A short crossover chapter between Souichi and Tomie.

mangas.title: Me no Tsukedokoro ga Deep Desho
mangas.titleNative: 目の付けどころがディープでしょ
mangas.synonyms: I Like Your Point of View
mangas.description:
Mina is a girl who has a strong hope of finding her destined person. With that goal in mind, she tries her best with different types of guys wishful of finding the right person. Even when her childhood friend, a yankee named Yuito, is already by her side. Will she ever find her destined person? A romantic comedy, coming-of-age tale of love and friendship.



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
mangas.titleNative: 呪術廻戦 0 東京都立呪術高等専門学校
mangas.description:
Yuta Okkotsu is a nervous high school student who is suffering from a serious problem—his childhood friend Rika has turned into a curse and won't leave him alone. Since Rika is no ordinary curse, his plight is noticed by Satoru Gojo, a teacher at Jujutsu High, a school where fledgling exorcists learn how to combat curses. Gojo convinces Yuta to enroll, but can he learn enough in time to confront the curse that haunts him?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: My Way with You
mangas.synonyms: The Last Step on the Way
mangas.description:
Some wounds are slow to heal. Giran's been alone ever since his grandmother died, and he has no intention of letting anyone into his life. But one day, out of nowhere, he meets an exceptionally pretty face…who's also exceptionally good in bed. This one-night fling turns into something more when Giran finds out that his meeting with Seon-gyeong was more than just a coincidence. The two have similar pasts that are stained with painful losses. Trauma can be all-consuming, but every walk through life is made better with someone by your side.


(Source: Lezhin)


Note: The chapter count follows that of Ridibooks and includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Hana wo Meshimase
mangas.description: After Shion's mother passed away, she was left with her father who loves to gamble and evade his responsibilities as a father. Due to that continuous pattern, Shion moves in to live as a live-in employee with 25-year-old florist Shun Mamyuuda. As she begins to learn the value of flowers and life, will she also find her place in love?

mangas.title: I Adopted a Villainous Dad
mangas.description: One day, a girl awakens as 6-year-old St. Priscilla, the heroine of her most cherished novel. The catch? She is destined to suffer with an abusive adoptive family! To avoid this, she adopts her ultimate bias, the ruthless Emperor Melkiades, as her father instead. Although spending her days fangirling and redeeming her bias's tarnished name seems like a dream come true, with so many foes still lurking in the shadows, can this young saint protect Melkiades and find happiness for them both?

mangas.title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up
mangas.titleNative: 親がうるさいので後輩（♀）と偽装結婚してみた。
mangas.synonyms: I decided to fake a marriage with my junior (♀️) to shut my parents up
mangas.description:
Morimoto, a young professional woman in Japan, is tired of fending off her parents' questions about her being single. They want her to marry a man and settle down, and they'll insist on nitpicking her choice of groom to death. In an unexpected move, another woman in the office - who has a crush on her - offers to be her wife in a sham marriage, which might make her parents back off. But this "fake" marriage could unearth something very real!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes the extra chapters "Anaerobic Love" and "Fake Married Life".

mangas.title: A Model Advisory
mangas.description:
"It looks the same as the ideal type in your imagination!"

One spring day when cherry blossoms are in full bloom, "Bo-Mi," a freshman in high school who was alone in an empty art department, she pours all her ideals and draws a fictional character, surprised to learn that the person in my imagination looks the same as Hae-Yoon, a handsome, tall, athletic senior in the nation's rankings for the practice test. Hae-Yoon appears in front of Bo-Mi, who is worried about the infringement of her portrait rights, and Bo-Mi is thrilled at Hae-Yoon's request to continue drawing herself...

mangas.title: BoiGyaru
mangas.description: A boyish girl and a gyaru are dating.

mangas.title: Lunolita
mangas.description: University student Shiho stumbles into a lolita café, "Melty Lily." There, she befriends Kohaku, one of the boys working there, and is dazzled by the oodles of cute outfits. But something from Shiho's past is holding her back... Can she find love beyond the fairytale? Find out in this bittersweet tale of true love!

mangas.title: Pairing Gear
mangas.description:
Shin-O Ward—a city ruled by androids. One day, Miyamoto, a scientist plotting to exterminate androids, encounters Ribbon-chan, a mysterious android dressed in a Lolita outfit. In a city where humans are oppressed by machines, the two girls take up arms to win their freedom!



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

mangas.title: Boku no Apple Iro Alien
mangas.titleNative: 僕のアップル色エイリアン

mangas.title: Goddess of Fortune
mangas.description: Ji-Yun, who had always been second in her class, suddenly found herself in possession of a "lucky notebook." While the notebook granted her the good fortune of becoming first in her class, it also completely disrupted her peaceful daily life. To focus on her studies, she must solve the strange problems it presents. Amidst all the chaos, love blossoms—even though it's a romance Ji-Yun never asked for...!

mangas.title: To My Darling
mangas.synonyms: To My Dearest | To My Affection | To My Da-jeong
mangas.description:
Back at school after a year. On her first day back, she thought it would be fun, but a miraculous turn of events landed her in the same class as her younger sibling. Then, a stranger caught her embarrassingly...! And why did that man have to be Seo Jin-Young?! Why am I getting involved with Jin-Young, whom I haven't spoken to all school year, now?

Da-Jung's school life is going haywire... Please, let her graduate safely!

mangas.title: You're the Only One I Can See
mangas.synonyms: You're the Only One I Can See | I'm Telling You, I Only See You
mangas.description: Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn't look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl's face sends Jinyong's happy little circuits into overdrive...

mangas.title: Baba Diary
mangas.description:
When did my male friend start looking good?

Fifteen years old, a turbulent time. Baba Middle School is full of bewildered children with rapidly changing bodies and minds, and our protagonist, Dan A-Eun, is the most confused of them all. She's starting to have feelings for Han Dong-U, her classmate of 10 years...? It's my heart, but even I'm not sure!

mangas.title: Love Rehab for a Gangster
mangas.synonyms: Adjusting the Gangster Male Lead's Intensity
mangas.description:
Ihae's life is turned upside down when she wakes up in the dark underworld of her favorite dating sim. To survive as an unnoticed background character, she must stop Dokyeom, heir to a powerful crime family, from becoming the obsessive gang boss who destroys everyone in the original story. But the more time they spend together, the more his fixation falls on her. Between school life, hidden quests, and dangerous secrets, can Ihae reach a happy ending, or is she already on the path to tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Parenting First, Love Later
mangas.synonyms: Love Starts with Parenting | A Romance That Begins With Childcare
mangas.description: After unexpectedly becoming the non-biological mother of her nephew Ji-Ho at a young age, Na-Eun builds a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher. But everything changes when Gang-u, the uncle of Minho, a child with selective mutism, offers her a high-paying live-in tutor job after discovering the boy only speaks around her. As they care for the children together, their unusual living arrangement slowly grows into something more than co-parenting.

mangas.title: Date a Ranker
mangas.description: All Seong-A Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Han-Jun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-Ui An, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Han-Jun from discovering who she really is?

mangas.title: My Clueless Love Diary
mangas.description:
"I'm gonna live a normal life!"

Cho-Eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university. Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?

"Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?"

Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-Eun finally achieve the campus life she's always dreamed of?

Long straight hair, a white dress, his first love—these three words linger faintly in Baek-gu's mind as he promptly passes out. When a mysterious woman appears at his doorstep amidst a pouring rainstorm, Baek-gu is shocked to his core. Not because she faintly reminds him of someone he knew long, long ago, but because he mistakes her for a ghost. With their relationship already starting off on an awkward foot, the question looms: what will become of the story between these two?

mangas.title: Mr. Delivery Knight
mangas.description:
Binge-reading my favorite romantasy novel is my one and only solace after late-night shifts at my part-time job. I was just reading my novel while walking home from yet another long shift, when suddenly a truck…! Huh? Delivery truck driver Taek-Jin's struggle to return back to Korea after waking up in a strange world begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Older Women's Club
mangas.description: Three friends, all twenty-seven years old. By a strange twist of fate, they all fall in love with younger men one after another and form the "Older Women's Club"! This is our deeply personal yet at the same time, universally relatable story of real-life romance.

mangas.title: Horeta Hareta Panda
mangas.description: Will my love destroy the peace of this town?! After discovering to have incredible stamina, Hanna begins working part-time as a mascot in a costume. Although she is sometimes bullied by children, she was meant to do her best as the mascot hero "Panbuu" to protect the peace of the town - but her true identity is about to be discovered by Ubukata-kun, who is in the class next to her!?

mangas.title: Daytime in the Bunker
mangas.description: Seo-U always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Won-Hyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seo-U must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he's been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

mangas.title: Stray Cat & Wolf
mangas.description: Following the death of her father, Tamaki leaves her village to attend high school in the capital. Although she had intended to live alone, when she's offered a place at a stranger's apartment after collapsing in the street, well...did she mention he's pretty hot?!

mangas.title: Goth Loli-chan to Mondaiji-kun
mangas.titleNative: ゴスロリちゃんと問題児くん
mangas.description: The high school girl Ayame's love of gothic lolita style is found out by Mizuno Hiro, a boy known as the school's biggest delinquent. Ayame fears that her hobby will become exposed at school, or suffer some other terrible consequence, but for some reason, Hiro invites her on a date instead. As they spend time together, Ayame begins to feel that he is not as bad as he is rumored to be.

mangas.title: Our Guild's Idol
mangas.description: Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world's top MMORPG, using her brother's account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she's mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who's secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

mangas.title: Strawberry♯Chord
mangas.description:
One day, the JK influencer Komomo finds an inexperienced streamer playing guitar in his closet. Even though he was totally new to streaming, she though that his songs might be pretty good. Just to discover that the streamer was her seatmate: the gloomy prince, Irino!
!

When she told Irino that she was a fan, he asked her to teach him a way to increase his followers... The goal is 100,000 followers?!!
!

A romcom produced by a gloomy, handsome diamond in the rough!

mangas.title: Strawberry Cake
mangas.titleNative: ストロベリィ・ケイク

mangas.title: Yamazu ni Koishite, Koroshiya-san!
mangas.titleNative: 病まずに恋して、殺し屋さん！
mangas.description:
A love comedy about a yandere assassin and a totally innocent girl who avoids danger! The main character, Sumika, has always been unable to read the mood of a situation, and people have always kept their distance from her. One day, when she handed a handkerchief to someone she was fighting with on the street, the next day that person transferred to her school...? "I quit being an assassin for you. Please fall in love with me." Her first confession was a terrifying signal that her life was being targeted by an assassin organization.



(Source: Manga Park, translated)

mangas.title: Sweeten the Deal: Believe in Love
mangas.description: Jaeyeon has been in love with Nana ever since she started looking after him as a kid, but he's always kept it a secret. One drunken slip-up finally exposes his feelings, turning playful teasing into something far more real. On a warm summer night, a one-sided crush spirals into a sweet, chaotic rom-com romance neither of them saw coming.

mangas.title: Yang Can't Live Alone
mangas.titleNative: ヤン先輩はひとりで生きていけない
mangas.description:
Hardworking, diligent, and serious college student Yuu can do anything with ease—which causes most guys to find her far too intimidating. Longing to become someone's "number one," she wonders if she'll have to change who she is to find love. That's when she meets Yang, an attractive and friendly Chinese exchange student. But looks can be deceiving, as she discovers his life-altering secret! What began as a "professional" arrangement between a headstrong girl and puppy-like boy blossoms into a heart-pounding pure romance!



(Source: Manga UP!)

mangas.title: Living with Romeo
mangas.description: Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he's Mi-ae's boyfriend, but it turns out they're just housemates. Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn't like Romi at all. She believes he's too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him…

mangas.title: Yamada's Class Diary
mangas.description:
High schooler Nina Yamada is serious, studious—and the only girl in her class at a formerly all-boys school. She doesn't exactly get along with her classmates, but she'll work her butt off for a good college recommendation no matter what! So one day, when her teacher asks her to get the truant Murata to come back to school, she puts aside her reservations and braves the local arcade…only to find Murata surrounded by girls waiting on him hand and foot! Can Nina get through to this absentee playboy, or will it prove to be the one thing her hard work won't help with?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Yeonhaui Mat
mangas.description: Gong In-Ju was dumped by her boyfriend, Ahn Geu-Rim, for no reason. In-Ju, who has been living while depending on Ahn Geu-Rim all this time, feels the emptiness of losing Geu-Rim and plans to get him back. The first thing in the plan is to arouse Geu-Rim's jealousy! To do this, she tries to seduce Seo-Yun, a handsome junior she met during a volunteer work, but Seo-Yun had a crush on someone else... What will the end be for the two people who form an alliance to win over love...?

mangas.title: You At First Sight
mangas.description:
Quiet girl Yechan can see a person's inner thoughts instead of their face. But this ability and its troubles keep her distant from others. When a boy with not a thought but a proper face appears, he's the one person she just can't read. Yechan's world, and heart are about to turn inside-out!

(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: Threads of Love
mangas.description:
Sa-Rang Park has only one mission in life: to save her cousin, Pyeong-Gang, from a life-threatening illness. The only way to do so is to find Pyeong-Gang's "Ondal" -- the person Pyeong-Gang has been fated to be with since her previous life. But on her journey to connect her cousin with her other half, Sa-Rang just might get tangled up in a romance of her own.



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: Introverted Us
mangas.description:
Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That's what wallflower Ja-Yu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Ja-Hyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost. Underneath Ja-Hyeok's persona is a secret super-introvert who would rather just stay home, except his charming good looks keep forcing him into social situations. Together, Ja-Yu and Ja-Hyeok begin to learn a little something about friendship and maybe more…



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: This is a Campus Romance Series
mangas.description:
My name is Ha-Yun Lee, and I'm an ordinary college student. I decided to go on a spontaneous trip before school resumed and met this guy named Kang-On. He asked me out on the first day we met, but of course, I rejected him. I thought I'd never see him again, but guess what? I ran into him during the school club recruitment event! And wait… What? Even Ji-Il, the president of the student club "You," also has a crush on me?! I swear I'm not delulu. I swear!



(Source: WEBTOONS)


Note: Includes four side story chapters.

mangas.title: Ghost Romance
mangas.description: Seonwoo Yoo, a senior in the photography department, is working as a photographer. One day, he receives a collaboration proposal from a famous overseas magazine.For a while, such a fluttering heartRecently, a jokjok ghost taking a picture is taken together'Seon-woo', who suffered from a psychic phenomenon, tries in various ways to solve it, but it is not easy.In the meantime, the psychic picture was not taken.They find the only subject... It is none other than the most famous playboy on campus, 'Choi Moo-young! "Model? Let me do it. Go out with me instead."Will 'Seonwoo' be able to take a picture of 'Mooyoung' and debut safely in a famous overseas magazine?!The dilemma of a horror romance with him, who never wants to be involved, begins!

mangas.title: Iro wa Shimare do
mangas.description:
Hotori has always tried to be a "good girl" and live her life without making waves. When she forgot to bring the survey book for her teacher Enjou, she tried to sneak back into the classroom at night, only to find a man asleep, surrounded by painting supplies.



"So it was you!"



Hotori ran away when the sleepy man suddenly kissed her. But the next day at school, she is reunited with that man Kodo, who claimed to be the new substitute art teacher... He is not the type you would usually call a teacher, with his impudent and slovenly attitude. At Enjou-sensei's request, Hotori is pushed into modeling for Kodo's paintings......



A pure but inappropriate after-school romance between a lazy art teacher and a "nice" high school girl.



(Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes four volume-bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Uchi no Futeki na Gangster
mangas.titleNative: うちの不敵なギャングスター
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Love in Focus
mangas.description:
Mako's always had a passion for photography. When she loses someone dear to her, she clings onto her art as a relic of the close relationship she once had…Luckily, her childhood best friend Kei encourages her to come to his high school and join their prestigious photo club. With nothing to lose, Mako grabs her camera and a fresh take on life - plus a mysterious new muse - and everything begins to come into focus!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Uchi no Otoutodomo ga Sumimasen
mangas.titleNative: うちの弟どもがすみません
mangas.description:
The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.



(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: Nee-chan no Tomodachi ga Uzai Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: 姉ちゃんの友達がうざい話
mangas.synonyms: A story about Nao Misumi and Sena Ikuta
mangas.description:
High school freshman Hisashi Misumi has known Sena Ikuta, his sister Rio's best friend, since elementary school.
Sena treats him like a little brother, which annoys him, for some reason...?



(Source: Comic Pool, translated)

mangas.title: Hana-kun Can't Live without Me
mangas.titleNative: ヒモクズ花くんは死にたがり
mangas.description: "I'll die with you. Promise." In her second year since she started working, Kaede Yoshino has hit her limit, feeling completely burned out from working every day. Then, on the worst day of her life, under a beautiful moonlit sky, a totally wasted Kaede picks up a warm, black haired, fluffy...boy who's like a cat?! As "Hana-kun" claims he has no home to go back to, they end up living together on a temporary basis. However, in doing so, Kaede starts to realize how it warms her heart to live with someone. Then, a certain event leads to a shocking revelation of who Hana-kun really is...?! A clingy, good-for-nothing boy meets a tender-hearted overworked girl in this deadly romance?!

mangas.title: The Otaku Love Connection
mangas.titleNative: オタクも恋も連鎖する
mangas.description:
Life has its simple joys, and for geeky fanboy Wataru Otonari, that's admiring his gorgeous classmate Yuzuru Kakoi and her equally gorgeous boyfriend, Chihiro Kawai Luckily for Wataru, his classroom seat next to Yuzuru gives him a perfect view of his OTP. But this self-professed NPC doesn't seem to know he's just as beautiful himself! As Wataru encounters other students who stan his favs just as much as he does—although some have very, very different takes on their dynamic—every day turns into a rollercoaster of emotions for this obliviously beautiful boyfailure!



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
mangas.titleNative: どうせ、恋してしまうんだ。
mangas.synonyms: Anyway, I Love You | Douse, Koishite Shimaunda
mangas.description: Mizuha's 17th birthday is the pits. Her parents totally forgot, and the senpai she likes isn't interested in her. But when her longtime childhood friend asks her out, Mizuha has to sort out what this change in relationship could mean. And her feelings may not be the only ones changing...!

mangas.title: Nee Isshiki-kun, Watashi no Koto Suki deshou?
mangas.titleNative: ねぇ一色くん、私のこと好きでしょう？
mangas.synonyms: Hey Isshiki-kun, You Like Me, Don't You?
mangas.description:
She is about to turn 30 years old.

Just when she thought her marriage was going smoothly at, her boyfriend cheated on her on the day of her birthday and she was thrown into the bottom of her life.



On the way home from the wedding, she was crying because she was so fed up with herself that she couldn't even be happy for her friend's happiness, when her business partner, Ren Isshiki, appeared...Waka thought that a boy too young for her was out of the question.



A love story about an older female office worker who dreams of a safe marriage, but is charmed by, dropped by, and doted on by a younger man.

mangas.title: My First Love Hate
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Eun-Ha and Seung-Min used to be inseparable until Seung-Min started running with a bad crowd in middle school. That marked the end of their friendship, or so Eun-Ha thinks until she runs into Seung-Min again in college! As if that wasn't jarring enough, his appearance has done a complete 180, and Eun-Ha can't figure out why. Everyone thinks the former delinquent is a quiet nerd because of the way he dresses and behaves. But once Eun-Ha starts talking to Seung-Min, she gets the feeling that he hasn't changed as much as his glasses and plaid flannel would suggest...



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

mangas.title: Youth Diary
mangas.description:
After overcoming a miserable life, she entered the university full of excitement. Da-Bom, who had countless dreams and desires about university, encountered a villain on her very first day... And it's somewhat awkward from the start!

"Is my campus life going to be okay?!"

mangas.title: The Marriage of the Unseen Duke
mangas.description:
Alfred, the head of the Duc de Besculey family, is known as the "Bandaged Duke" and is feared by everyone for the mummy-like wrappings all over his body. One day, the king suddenly orders him to get married. Even more shocking—his blind bride-to-be, Sierra, is somehow head-over-heels for him! The story of the marriage between a lonely duke and a songstress with the blessing of a goddess begins!

(Source: Manga UP!)

mangas.title: Koisuru Lip Tint
mangas.titleNative: 恋するリップ・ティント
mangas.description:
When Ako accidentally got lipstick on a handsome boy's shirt at school, he doesn't get angry. Instead, he tells her to "take this shirt and throw it away"!



(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

mangas.title: Sweethearts in the Spotlight
mangas.synonyms: The Top Couple Is a Bit Sweet
mangas.description:
Song Yan and Wen Li are a well-known contract couple in the entertainment industry. Even though they are married, they don't make a big deal out of it and they each do their own thing professionally. Most people are pessimistic about their marriage, yet many fans ship them together, too. The two of them finally started acting like a loving pair in public, but only reluctantly, when they officially announced their participation in a nationally televised reality show about married couples. But as they spend time together in front of the camera, the two of them gradually realized that the bonds of their marriage had already been firmly tied long before.....



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Utsumi-kun no Koi no Uta
mangas.description:
"Would you like to hear my new song?"



Shiori had trouble making friends in high school, and she spends most of her time alone by herself. Her only support is the music of her favorite musician "Kanade," and she eagerly awaits the release of each new song. Then, by chance, she finds out that "Kanade" is actually her classmate, Utsumi!



She was feeling so excited, "I can't believe I'm meeting my idol in real life..." and then he asked her "Will you be my girlfriend"?!



A pure, heart-pounding love story that will make your heart skip a beat!



(Source: Comic Days, translated)

mangas.title: Kissing the Flower in Bloom
mangas.description: Left homeless, Kasumi decides to fix the situation on her own to not be an inconvenience to her busy family. But through a misunderstanding, she meets this handsome flower artist, who... despite being older, seems to be very interested in her.

mangas.title: Seasons of Blossom
mangas.description:
Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter -- love blossoms in all seasons.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: So I Married the Anti-Fan
mangas.description:
How far would you go to take down the person you hate most? With no house, no job, and nothing left to lose, Geun-Yeong Lee is willing to risk it all to bring down the country's national treasure, Korean superstar Who-Joon. But once the two really get to know each other, bringing him down suddenly becomes a lot harder. Will she be able to ruin him once and for all after she learns the truth about the man behind the popstar?



(Source: WEBTOONS)



Note: Includes prologue and special epilogue chapters.

mangas.title: Tama no Gohoubi
mangas.description:
Kanoko has never had the chance to interact with boys, which has made her secretly curious about what it's like to "touch a boy (blush)"! And so Kanoko enters high school, where she meets the strange genius, Tamao, whom she gradually becomes attracted to...? Delusions on full blast! Explosion of hidden desires? A story about a beginner's learning process of "male-female relationship"!



(Source: Shueisha, translated)



Note: Originally completed with four volumes and 16 chapters on 2019-11-10, the serialization restarted on Manga Mee on 2024-01-02.

mangas.title: Watch Out for Watarase
mangas.titleNative: とことんクズな渡良瀬なのに
mangas.synonyms: Even Though Watarase Is the Biggest Red Flag
mangas.description:
Nonoka, newly arrived in the big city for university, goes to her comedian brother's home where she is to live. But when she gets there, she is greeted by none other than her brother's comedy partner, the famously shameless playboy Watarase, who is also living there! A lady-killer with no sense of personal space, he's definitely someone she doesn't want to get too close to but…! A story about sharing a home with the comedy world's hottest playboy, who you know you shouldn't, but just can't help falling head over heels for!

(Source: K Manga)

mangas.title: Electrifying Confession
mangas.description: Hari Jeon is a high school student with a heart condition. One day, she is struck by a curse that causes her to zap everything and everyone around her whenever her heart races for Jeong-won, her secret crush. Yura Baek, a brash and sharp-tongued classmate who mysteriously knows about her curse, offers her a deal—he'll help her keep it under control if she lets him use it. Can Hari find the courage to confess her feelings to her crush? Or will she stay in the safe zone of friendship? Get ready for Hari's electrifying first love story!

mangas.title: My Secret Crush
mangas.description:
Zhi Sang has a secret crush: her brother's college friend Jiaxu Duan. She does everything she can to hide her feelings only to discover he's already noticed. Will she finally find her happy ending when she grows up?



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Imperfect Cinderella Story
mangas.description: Jung Eon is a maid who works in the house of a rich and powerful family. She dreams of escaping a life of servitude and saves every penny she earns. One day, she receives an unexpected proposal from her childhood friend and boss, Hyun Mae-hwa. He's as pretty as a flower, but has a horrible personality. Mae-hwa says he wants to marry her because of a prophecy that says Jung Eon has six benefactors in his destiny. He thinks she is the source of his financial luck. She accepts, thinking it's a chance to change her life.

mangas.title: Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Arc
mangas.titleNative: カードキャプターさくら クリアカード編
mangas.description: It is spring, with cherry trees in full blossom, and Sakura is just entering middle school. Her beloved Syaoran has returned from Hong Kong, and life couldn't be better. But when she awakens from a strange dream to find her Sakura Cards powerless, how can she protect Tomoeda from disaster?!

mangas.title: Ao Haru Ride
mangas.description: Futaba Yoshioka thought all boys were loud and obnoxious until she met Kou Tanaka in junior high. But as soon as she realized she really liked him, he had already moved away because of family issues. Now, in high school, Kou has reappeared, but is he still the same boy she fell in love with?

mangas.title: Anlian
mangas.description:
"I've recently come to like someone. He's my classmate."

The short and sweet snapshots of a blossoming romance between two unsuspecting students! Packed with fluffy interactions between adorable (not to mention handsome!) characters, this series is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth~

mangas.title: Trust Me, I'm Lying
mangas.description:
Getting ghosted is the worst way to break up, no contest. After years of heartbreak, Eun-Kyo finally gets to enjoy a quiet life running a café with her best friend. But peace shatters when Jae-Heon, their new basement tenant, barges into her life. Wild, handsome, and maybe a bit of trouble, he begins to test Eun-Kyo's resolve to swear off dating.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: My Aggravating Sovereign
mangas.description:
Aria's world is thrown into chaos when Crown Prince Julius, the brilliant but insufferable royal she's sworn to protect as Captain of his Guard, announces her as his future bride. Stunned, Aria confronts him, and Julius offers a way out: if she can defeat him in any competition before the wedding in six months, he'll cancel the engagement. But with Julius' unmatched skills, winning won't be easy. Can Aria outsmart the talented prince and reclaim her life?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Ex-Love Review
mangas.description:
Gi-Ju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy. This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs. When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious 'relationship reviews' of others! 'Love reviews written by their former exes…?'

Could this strange phenomenon be able to save Gi-Ju's love life?

mangas.title: Wakarinikui ne Sano-kun wa
mangas.titleNative: わかりにくいね佐野くんは
mangas.description: Two classmates sit next to each other every day, but they've never spoken even once. One day, after a haircut mishap, one of them finally gathers the courage to start a conversation…!? A heart-fluttering love story between two innocent souls! ♡♡

mangas.title: Eternal Love
mangas.synonyms: Endless Devotion | Difficult to Coax | Hard to Coax | First Frost
mangas.description: When Wen Yifan returns to her hometown for work, she runs into the super hot guy everyone's talking about. However, this super hottie turns out to be Sang Yan, the guy whose feelings she crushed when she rejected him back in high school! In a twist of fate, two paths that remained separate all that time now seem to be intertwined as they keep bumping into each other. What's more, they coincidentally end up renting the same apartment and becoming roommates! Watch how Sang Yan, dubbed the "perfect boyfriend", navigates his way through love amidst a whirlwind of unspoken feelings and strong emotions!

mangas.title: Make-Up shite, Kiss shite, Sono Saki wa.
mangas.titleNative: メイクして、キスして、その先は。
mangas.description:
29-year-old Sumire is chasing her dream by moving from the sales department to hair and makeup. However, she got into a big pinch and is in danger of losing her job!! Until a genius makeup artist Ryusei came to her rescue. Now she is in an exclusive XX relationship with the younger man!?



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: The World of Dating
mangas.synonyms: The World They're Dating In | The World Where They Date
mangas.description: The day Se-Ul declares that she will stay single, three attractive men suddenly decide to pop into her life all at once. A man who matches her ideal type, a childhood friend she's known for twenty years, and a man who checks off all the right boxes. Will Se-Ul be able to hold firm to her declaration of staying single?

mangas.title: My Lucky Strike
mangas.synonyms: What Kind of Rice Cake Is This
mangas.description:
Si-Ru is devastated when her crush, the dreamy Gi-Baek Seol, effectively friendzones her. She goes out that night to drown her sorrows, but after one too many drinks, ends up accidentally kissing someone. The next day, two people in her class show up with a swollen lip. One is Gi-Baek, and the other is Cheong, a tall and quiet guy who's always been a bit of an enigma to her. In just one day, Si-Ru's non-existent dating life takes a sharp turn and she suddenly finds herself with two love prospects. Will she finally be able to get her happy ending with Gi-Baek? Or start something new with the mysterious Cheong?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Melting Slowly
mangas.description:
Yeomin Chae has been living in the shadow of her stepsister, Nari Chae, ever since they were kids. One day, Seungjae, Yeomin's ex-boyfriend, tells her that he's marrying Nari out of the blue. After being betrayed by the person she trusted most, she runs into Hwan Yun, who is the grandson of Taeju Group's chairman. Frustrated with her life, she suggests to Hwan that he marry her. As the two decide to get married, what exciting events and struggles will they encounter?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Hitting Rewind With You
mangas.description:
Wakaba Kayano is a 20-year-old college student who was too busy studying in high school to experience the quintessential personal milestones of her teenage years, like going on an afterschool date. In a moment of desperation, she goes out on Halloween in her old high school uniform in an effort to take back some of those heart-fluttering experiences she never had, and in doing encounters Fumito, a boy clad in the quintessential high school boy uniform. Whisked away on the date of her dreams, she panics when forced to reveal her true age—only to find out that Fumito is in college, too!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ran the Peerless Beauty
mangas.description:
Ran is beautiful and stylish, with leading scores in her class. No boy on Earth would have the gall to try their hand with her, and no one would think that she's so entirely innocent… except Akira. Join us in this innocent love story about Ran the "mountaintop flower" and Akira, whose parents own a flowershop.



(Source: Kodansha USA)
