mangas.synonyms: 先輩、僕太りましたか？〜秘密のダイエット大作戦〜
mangas.description:
"That chubby dude will never know what he's in for."


Hye-Sung happened to eavesdrop on a conversation amongst his boyfriend's classmates. But does that mean Hye-Sung's fashion design major boyfriend, Jung-Won, will eventually move on to skinnier pastures? He can't let that happen! Hye-Sung is determined to lose weight and keep his lover. If only he knew that Jung-Won actually loves him exactly the way he is…


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Wouldn't It Be Nice
mangas.description: Hyobin and Gichan have been best friends for a decade, so Hyobin naturally thought he knew everything about Gichan. He always knew that Gichan was sweet and gentle and super dependable. But when he witnesses Gichan kissing another guy, Hyobin realizes that he doesn't know his best friend as well as he thought. In fact, he somehow completely missed the fact that he's Gichan's first (and current) crush. Now, it's up to Hyobin to make a move and figure out whether this friendship is going to tank entirely or get a hell of an upgrade.

mangas.title: Harinezumi to Contrast
mangas.description:
The cool-looking handsome man's true feelings are actually full of thorns!?

Akashi, a lonely virgin college student, starts working part-time to fix his timid personality, but from the very first day, his coworkers have a bad impression of him. Meanwhile, Akashi's coworker, Kagei, who has a personality completely opposite to his, treats him strangely kindly, but his true intentions are a mystery...

A comedy BL about a somewhat suspicious, cheerful handsome man and a gloomy virgin who pretends to be cool.

mangas.title: Narukawa-kun wa Nakasaretakunai
mangas.titleNative: 鳴川くんは泣かされたくない
mangas.synonyms: Narukawa-kun Doesn't Want to Be Made to Cry.
mangas.description:
A new kind of adolescent love story between an innocent but dominant girl and a submissive tsundere boy!



(Source: Shogakukan, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes three extras and two epilogue chapters.

mangas.title: My Sneaky Childhood Friend Won't Let Me Get Away
mangas.titleNative: 黒猫おさななじみが逃がしてくれない。
mangas.description:
Moegi Mizutani is a hard-working office worker who has decided to start her new life in Tokyo.

One day, when she comes back home, a guy in the buff hugs her from behind! She has no idea who it is until she turns around and sees a man with black hair, cat eyes, and a big grin on his face.

He's Haruka, the boy she played with back in her hometown!

He's been teasing and using her as his toy for as long as she can remember, and before she left for Tokyo, they even spent an intimate moment together. That moment made Moegi insecure and completely at a loss to define their relationship.

Things were supposed to be better, but he's back now?and she has no idea why!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Fatale Game
mangas.description:
"If it means that I can read your work again, I'll even chase you to the ends of the earth."

Seri Tainaka, writing under the pen name Nanakusa, is a mid-career manga artist living in the shadow of her only one-hit-wonder. Her series "To Hell and Back" was adored by fans, but despite now being a ten-year veteran, her successes ended there. So when Seri is told that she is being assigned a new editor, it only fuels her insecurities. When Seri meets the quirky Sumire Futami, she's both creeped out and captivated by the strange and overly forthright woman, who claims she'd go to hell and back to make her a success again. But just when Seri starts to think she and Futami might be an unstoppable duo, she meets the other manga artists Futami is assigned to, and a dangerous game of jealousy, envy, and femme fatales begins. It turns out that Futami has no qualms about going back and forth between which of her artists capture her attention the most, and they'll stop at nothing to win the number one spot in their fickle editor's heart!

mangas.title: Our Home
mangas.description:
Ho-Yun, a cynical, jaded office drone, is roped into housing Ju-Ho, an annoyingly upbeat college freshman he once knew as the kid next door. Now, instead of quiet mornings, Ho-Yun wakes up to home-cooked meals and a giant puppy of a housemate who can't stop looking at him like he's the best view in the house.

(Source: Manta, edited)


Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: I'd Rather Take the Father
mangas.synonyms: Rather Than The Son, I'll Take The Father
mangas.description:
After a once-dormant contract requiring descendants of House Morgana and House Kalakis to wed resurfaces, Meivia Morgana receives a shoddy proposal from the ever-miserable eldest son, Gilbert Kalakis. Determined not to settle for less, Meivia decides to marry the single and mysteriously alluring family head, Grand Duke Edis Kalakis. Between a volatile son always knocking at her door and an enticingly enigmatic father who leaves her wanting more, will Meivia be able to sign her way to happiness?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Summer Heat
mangas.description:
Chae Yeon runs a quiet little pension on a remote island—but with her painfully shy personality, dealing with guests is more stress than success. Just as she's contemplating closing up shop, an unexpected guest checks in: Baek Sanho, her high school classmate…and the guy she once rejected. Now all grown up and annoyingly charming, Sanho seems determined to turn up the heat—on the island and in Yeon's heart. With old sparks beginning to flicker back to life, this getaway is about to get way too hot to handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Creating Hidden Endings
mangas.description: After beating "The Return of the D-Rank Hunter," the game, Seon-Woo wakes up as the game's NPC, kidnapped by the insomnia-ridden protagonist Jae-Hwi, who demands Seon-Woo become his Mentalist via a one-sided contract. To return to reality, Seon-Woo must unlock the game's secret ending. Will he make it?

mangas.title: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
mangas.description:
Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé's love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: On Your Knees, Your Highness!
mangas.description: Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

mangas.title: Lessons in Love
mangas.synonyms: セックスも練習が必要だ！〜ただいまレッスン中〜
mangas.description:
After his parents remarry, Na-Rim finds himself harboring a forbidden crush on his new stepbrother, Se-Wun. One day, he overhears Se-Wun's "ideal type" is someone who knows their way around the bedroom - which causes Na-Rim, who doesn't even have any experience with love or relationships, to panic. Hoping he can teach himself, he impulsively buys a box of sex toys. But when his friend Tae-Hyeon discovers them during a visit, he's baffled by Na-Rim's plan…only to make an outrageous offer instead: "Why not practice with me?" Does practice really make perfect, or is Na-Rim's hope for some action a lost cause?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Monster Male Lead Living Under My Bed
mangas.titleNative: 내 침대 밑에 괴물 남주가 산다
mangas.synonyms: The Monster Male Lead Lives Under My Bed
mangas.description:
Waking up as a character destined to be killed by her family, Irina Sordier refuses to follow the script. She plans to survive by escaping after her father marries her off to Archduke Alexei Ruslan. That is until she is saved from her abusive circumstances by a slime! The two bond quickly, but the slime suddenly vanishes, and Irina laments its loss. Years later, she meets Alexei, but he seems to know things about her that only the slime would! Can Irina save herself and the slime after all?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Heungmak Gongjagui Monnani Buin
mangas.synonyms: The Ugly Wife of the Shady Duke
mangas.description:
"Please, do not leave me."


"We should get a divorce. You don't love me, do you? We... only got married for our families' sake."


"Why… Why are you saying such things? Did I do something wrong to you? If you want me to kneel, I will. If you don't like my face, I will wear a mask for the rest of my life. So, please… please, do not leave my side."


My husband, whom I married through an arranged marriage, is the second male lead who harbors an unrequited love for the heroine of The Saintess' Wish, the novel I have possessed. And I, his lawful wife, am destined to endure a lonely marriage before meeting a mysterious death. For my own survival—and for his love—I decided to cleanly end our marriage. But…


"Why is he holding onto me? Aren't you supposed to love Aria???"


"This novel's world… is different from what I knew. What is the truth?"


(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

mangas.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All
mangas.titleNative: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
mangas.synonyms: The Person She Fell For Wasn't A Boy
mangas.description:
Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince!
mangas.titleNative: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す ～公爵家の落ちこぼれ令嬢、嫁ぎ先で幸せを掴み取る～
mangas.synonyms: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Forget My Sister! Turns Out I Was the Real Saint All Along!
mangas.description: Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation's next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable "Bloodthirsty Prince" of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

mangas.title: My Friend's Hidden Charm
mangas.synonyms: How I Came to Like My Male Friend
mangas.description:
Hae-Sung and Ji-Woon were childhood friends that grew apart after Ji-Woon moved away. Reunited at college years later, the friendship is rekindled - but there's no sexual chemistry to speak of. However, that all changes when Hae-Sung catches a glimpse of Ji-Woon's package as he's getting dressed. After the "big" reveal, Hae-Sung begins to view her hunky childhood friend in a new light!.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

mangas.title: Turning the Mad Dog into a Genteel Lord
mangas.synonyms: 狂犬な彼を貴公子に変えてみせます!
mangas.description:
Diarin, a priestess without any noteworthy family background or connections, always gets the toughest assignments. So when her boss tells her to help Ceres, a war hero, reintegrate into society, she decides to stop being a pushover and get as much as she can out of it, including a juicy promotion. But upon reaching Ceres' manor, she's greeted by a growling hound instead of a human. Tasked with the impossible job of turning the mad dog into a proper gentleman, she dedicates herself to caring for him. But his unexpected obsession with her was never part of her plan.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Kurosaki Wants Me All to Himself ~The Intense Sweetness of First Love~
mangas.titleNative: 黒崎くんは独占したがる～はじめての恋は甘すぎて～
mangas.description:
"I want you, Moka..." There's a popular guy in class, and he can't stand the way the other girls look at him. The only girl he wants all for himself... is the plain girl sitting in the seat in front of him?! Moka Asano is your average high school girl, and sitting behind her is Izumi Kurosaki. Kurosaki is the captain of the soccer team, and he's so popular that the neighboring schools have fan clubs for him! The girls always crowd around his desk, so Moka can never get a chance to sit down at her desk in the morning... but everything changes when Moka gets the chance to be close to Kurosaki when they see each other in the old school library. Even though Kurosaki hates being around girls, and tends to give everyone these cold stares, he looks at Moka with a bright smile and asks her "do you wanna date for real?" It's like he's a completely different person!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Ore no Oppai Suki Nandesho?
mangas.titleNative: 俺のおっぱい好きなんでしょ？
mangas.synonyms: You like my b**bs, don't you?
mangas.description:
Pleasure corruption via indecent muscles!? Me? No way!

When Akane returns home, Okada, the Tsugaru dialect speaking university student who lives next door is always waiting for her due to having "forgotten" the key to his apartment.
It all started from a mere coincidence... At first she took pity on him and let him stay at her place...
But over time, the frequency of his visits have increased... and so too, the boldness of his requests!

"You Love My Muscles (THIS), Right?"
Even in the presence of his gorgeous sculpture like muscles, she had somehow managed to resist the urge to stay in control of her senses... (Past Tense.)

"Akane, I earnestly want to have sex with you." !!?
If his mountain range like ripples weren't enough, the explosively direct request he makes was sure to push her over the edge.

Okada, self-centered and cute, but more erotic and cool than anyone she knows...
But Akane isn't aware that Okada has a "certain something" he has been keeping secret...?

mangas.title: Kitsch Wedding
mangas.description:
Laehwa Lee lost all her childhood memories after a terrible incident, and now that she's an adult, she's on a mission to recover them. But some people, like her rich and powerful stepfather, will stop at nothing to keep Laehwa under control. Out of options, Laehwa hires mercenary Itae Gwon to enter into a contract marriage with her. Though Itae is her shield, he also has an intense bloodlust. Will Laehwa be able to keep her cool as sparks begin to fly?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Philomel the Fake
mangas.synonyms: No Place for the Fake Princess
mangas.description:
After finding a mysterious book in the imperial garden, Princess Philomel not only discovers that the book's villain shares her name, but that other events in the story are coming true too. Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Serena
mangas.description: Welcome to Wellenberg, Meuracevia at the turn of the 19th century. The fate of Serenity Hotel, an opulent hotel in the nation's capital, hangs by a thread as its headstrong heiress Serena and her stern husband Eiser struggle to turn its fortune around. Their loveless marriage of convenience takes a twisted turn following Serena's jealous attachment to her stoic and handsome servant, Frederick. At a time when happiness takes a back seat to one's sense of duty, will Serena be able to protect her love and ensure the survival of her family and her business?

mangas.title: I Became the Villain's Mother
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Mother of the Villain
mangas.description:
Summoned into her favorite novel as the infamous Duchess Roselia Chade, Haena is bathed in riches, power, and a family of her own. Life couldn't be better, save for the small detail that her beloved stepson, Einspanner Chade, is also the evil mastermind destined to kill her. At this point in the story Ein is still just an adorable child yet to reach his cruel awakening, and so Roselia is determined to stop him from becoming a ruthless killer. But with the duke getting in her way and trying to poison his own son, safely raising a child that was primed for villainy may prove harder than she originally thought. The survival of both mother and child depends on whether Roselia can successfully rewrite their tragic ending!



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes one prologue and 24 side story chapters.

mangas.title: XXX Buddy
mangas.description:
Seo Hyunsoo is sure of one thing: people are scum and they will always disappoint you. Sure enough, at his very first company dinner after his transfer to a new department, he finds his coworker, the obnoxiously upbeat Baek Youngchan, performing an unsavory deed in the men's bathroom. As much as Hyunsoo would like to avoid Youngchan from that point on, Youngchan seems intent on not letting him out of his sight... Will Hyunsoo be able to evade the encroaching chaos of his new work neighbor? Or will these two clashing coworkers find that opposites really do attract?



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels
mangas.titleNative: 恋せよまやかし天使ども
mangas.description: All sugar, no spice, and everything nice… that's the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and "heartthrob angel" class president Otogi Katsura gives to those around her. In reality, Otogi is brash, assertive, and has no problem calling out a jerk when she sees one—the complete opposite of her soft spoken vice presidential counterpart, the equally beautiful and seemingly perfect Toki Ninomae. One day, when a group of boys try to hit on her at the train station, Otogi doesn't hold back and gives them a piece of her mind—and, to her surprise, Toki enjoys seeing this side of her. Not only that, it turns out the seemingly polite, put-together vice president has a hidden side of his own… and Otogi now finds him more attractive than ever! Now "partners-in-crime," Otogi and Toki agree to keep their hidden sides a secret from the rest of their classmates—but could this shared, dark secret also bring them closer together…?!

mangas.title: After School Lessons for Unripe Apples
mangas.synonyms: The End of the Century Green Apple Tutoring School
mangas.description: Mi-Ae is just a normal middle school girl trying to survive school. She likes reading comics, the pop group "The Fire Boys", and karaoke. One day, a boy she used to know transfers to her school and begins to stir up trouble. No matter what she does, it seems he just doesn't appreciate her efforts to get to know him. What's up with that?

mangas.title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
mangas.description:
Yoi Takiguchi has long legs, a deep voice, and a handsome face…in other words, Yoi is such a good-looking guy that most people don't notice or care that she is, in fact, a girl. Indeed, she's had the nickname "Prince" as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai…the only person who's really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she's not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that).



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Nominated for the 46th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shoujo Category in 2022.

mangas.title: Kyuuketsu Doutei, Chichi wo Suu.
mangas.synonyms: The Virgin Vampire Only Drinks Milk
mangas.description:
A fantasy romance about a vampire who can't suck blood and a cow beast-girl.



The vampires, who once threatened the lives of people, are now being monitored and managed by the church. One day, Bell, a beast girl cow, is partnered with Yuki, a vampire who can't drink blood. Since Yuki can't drink blood as a source of nourishment, he is so weak that he can't defeat monsters. However, in a desperate situation, he asks Bell for milk...! Instead of blood, breast milk.



An unconventional breastfeeding smut begins!

mangas.title: Assassin & Cinderella
mangas.description:
A sexy spy and an elite assassin enter into the world's sweetest, deadliest marriage of convenience!

Neneko is a spy blessed with catlike charms. Her mission? Seduce the ace assassin of a rival organization and expose his weaknesses. The problem? She's blown her cover before learning a thing! But rather than dispose of her, the target makes an indecent proposal: marry him and take their relationship to the next level, since he can't keep his hands off her body! Is his clinginess an act, or could there be genuine love behind his murderous gaze?!

mangas.title: The Countess Makes a Comeback
mangas.description:
Rebecca once believed her husband, Count Zeppelin Devonshire, truly loved her. However, that changed when he took in a second wife and left Rebecca to die. Now she's back in the past, once again his beautiful countess that he meticulously trapped in a suffocating life for their entire marriage. Fully aware of how he drove her to isolation and ruin, she's determined to escape his cage and exact her revenge on him. With the help of Duke Julian Johannes, Rebecca is about to teach her captor what it's like to be captured and destroyed.

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: All I Want is My Dream Home
mangas.titleNative: 전 그냥 내 집 마련이 꿈인데요?
mangas.synonyms: My Dream Is to Get My Own House
mangas.description: Isabel lived and died as a doormat. After waking up in the past, she gets to work on dumping her terrible boyfriend and escaping her abusive household. However, financial and legal limits stop her from gaining total independence on her own. There is one potential solution: a policy that provides housing for newlyweds! This means Isabel has to find a man to marry. Enter Sir Dylan, the perfect catch. For reasons unknown, he volunteers to become her fake husband, and they earn Ishael's dream house. But can they turn it into a real home together?

mangas.title: No More Prince
mangas.description:
This is the legendary tale of valiant princes, devoting their lives to rescue the princess from the evil drake that has been terrorizing the nation…


"Here I am, my damsel in distress, I will smite the dragon and return you back to the golden castle!"


when the brave prince roars his promise, our beautiful princess Mikaella asks the question to drake.


"Xeno, I don't want to be saved by him... Please take care of him."


The mighty "evil" dragon responds,

"Anything for my sweet Mikaella."



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: I Became the Tyrant's Chambermaid
mangas.description:
When Lee Chae-Rin kicks the bucket, she's whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?



(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: How To Ride the Hero's Coattails
mangas.synonyms: How to Get On the Main Character's Flower Path | How to Walk the Protagonist's Path to Glory | How to Get on the Protagonist's Road to Success
mangas.description: Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

mangas.title: The Villain's Daughter-In-Law Rules by Nature
mangas.synonyms: The Villain's Daughter-in-law is Inherently Powerful
mangas.description: After six short, measly lives as insignificant items of a novel, Florine finally wakes up in the body of a shapeshifter. The problem? She's a tiny sable without enough power to turn into a human. While spending her days as a servant, she crosses paths with Kiraxus, the original novel's villain. She thinks her short life as a shapeshifter is over, but instead, he makes her the daughter-in-law of his family! Will Florine finally live the long life she desires? Or is it all too good to be true?

mangas.title: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun
mangas.description:
Golden Toldran is the wealthiest realm on the continent. Princess Charlotte, after years of religious devotion, is thrust into a public courtship she never desired. When Skadi, a singular suitor from the distant land of Nuanar, enters her life, boredom gives way to something far more dangerous.

(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
mangas.synonyms: Even If I Fall Into a Ghost Story, I Still Have to Go to Work
mangas.description:
I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of a certain modern fantasy I loved so much. And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world. As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation! A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors. Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask? Please, let me go back home.

mangas.title: On the Way to Meet Mom
mangas.synonyms: On My Way to See My Mom
mangas.description:
One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron. But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every child, and decides to embark on a journey to find his own. But what sort of obstacles wait along the way?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Dawn of Vengeance
mangas.synonyms: The Dawn That Twists Your Neck | Dawn That Snaps Your Neck
mangas.description: Arsinoe knows a few things about redos. Her first three lives all followed the same tragic script: born the scorned daughter of an enslaved queen, married to a crown prince as charming as he is cruel, and driven to death by the very man she trusted. But in her fourth, Arsinoe refuses to play the doomed princess. Determined to claim her own destiny, she forms an unexpected alliance with Walter Heibergh, the kingdom's most formidable commander — one powerful enough to change fate itself.

mangas.title: June and Alice
mangas.description:
June, an oriental girl in a foreign country, becomes the queen's dress-up doll to make a living! June wants to escape once she earns enough money, but she gets caught up in a bigger conspiracy struggle for power.



(Source: WebComics)



Note: Chapter count includes 2 bonus chapters.

mangas.title: The Villainess and Miss Demon Lord
mangas.synonyms: The Daughter of Evil and Miss Devil
mangas.description:
Transmigrated as the doomed villainess Aida Mortemer, Yao faces a peculiar challenge in a magical world. Enrolled in a magic academy without magical abilities, her plans to charm the main characters are slightly derailed when she encounters the demon lord's reincarnation. Desperate to survive and avoid her painful demise, Aida also befriends the formidable Miss Demon Lord, only to find her behavior increasingly...odd? Can Aida navigate this magical minefield and get these characters on her side?



(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 8 extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Food Looks Very Cute
mangas.titleNative: 我的食物看起来很可爱
mangas.synonyms: My Food Seems to Be Very Cute
mangas.description:
A vampire that has been asleep for almost two hundred years, Maria, has been awakened by a wolf girl passing by, Xing Lan. When the casket was opened, a curse fell upon Xing Lan. Instead of being scared, the naïve Xing Lan instead believes she has found an amazing companion, and the two embark on a journey to the city. The story begins like this.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Princess Naihe Is Too Black-Bellied
mangas.synonyms: Nai He Gongzhu Tai Fu Hei
mangas.description:
Chu Qitong thought that she would spend her whole life in the palace plotting shady schemes, until she met Ning Zhuangyan. That girl in the red dress broke into her heart like a ray of light from the scorching sun, and she realized that in this world, love can be more important than power.

Chu Qitong: In the past, I schemed to help win the throne for Aze, but now everything I do is so you can live a peaceful life.

Ning Zhuangyan: My sweetheart is the most beautiful woman in the kingdom. She can't buy me jewels and gowns, and she won't be taking me away on a high horse. But on that day at the Golden Luan Hall, when she took my hand with all eyes on her, I realized that she meant more to me than any man in this world.

mangas.title: I'll Enjoy My Route Even If I Can't Change It
mangas.description: I've possessed the protagonist of a visual novel where the heroine dies at the hands of the villainess. But the villainess isn't quite what I expected...?

mangas.title: Ru Hai
mangas.description: Once the closest of lovers, Ji Lingyue and Lan Wu, were forced apart by their identities as human and demon. Lan Wu, the mermaid princess, chose to leave Ji Lingyue, subjecting her to countless days and nights of agony. When they reunited at a cultivation gathering, Ji Lingyue swore never to let Lan Wu leave again.

mangas.title: A Strong Child is Looking for a Father
mangas.synonyms: Secretly Strong and Searching for My Daddy | The Secretly Strong Child is Looking for Her Dad | A Secretly Capable Child Is Seeking For Her Dad
mangas.description:
Jongno-Gu. One day when I was four, my father's death notice arrived. My father, who claimed to come from an empire called Talochium and was the strongest paladin, left me behind.

"If you wish, I'll send you back. To where you were born. To where you should have been. To where that man still lives."

The last chance offered by the mysterious lifeform that appeared from my father's keepsake box. Now I can save him, right? But...

The father from the past I finally reunited with seems a little off somehow.

mangas.title: The Tyrant's Crush
mangas.description:
The tyrant who ruined my life is suddenly kind?!


Bland and unexciting Yui Shinohara had lived a mediocre life until one day, she suddenly died and reincarnated into a heroine in a romance novel. Although she got to live her second life as Marilyn, a beautiful girl born into a noble family, her life gets ruined by a tyrant and a villainess. Just before dying a wrongful death, Marilyn is saved by the guardian deity of the Imperial family, Goddess Antia. She claims the world will end if Marilyn does not go back in time to stop the tyrant. Not only that, Marilyn now has to face her destiny to love the cruel tyrant Rael because of this stupid ring she owned...!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
mangas.description:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow:


"I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: School of Romance Fantasy
mangas.description:
Sanho suddenly finds herself as the academy's only commoner after her school transforms into the world of a romance fantasy novel. Armed with memories of reality, she's thrown into chaos when a strange mission appears: win over three potential male leads and uncover the truth behind this altered world. Amid dazzling nobles and hidden dangers, can Sanho complete her mission and face the secrets waiting for her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Married His Brother and Now He's Obsessed
mangas.synonyms: 余命僅かで結婚した男主人公の兄が私に執着する
mangas.description:
How lucky can one girl be? The cure to my illness is to marry a handsome duke, and I don't even mind his half-demonic bloodline. I love his family, my family loves me, and once society gets to know the Blightons, I'm sure they'll love them, too. Now, if I remember the novel's storyline correctly, all I have to do is stop his little brother from getting bullied and make sure he meets his one true love… and then we'll all get our happily ever after, right?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: That's Not What My Will Said
mangas.titleNative: 遺書を残して隠居するつもりがなぜか溺愛されてます
mangas.description:
Vivian wakes up as a dying villainess, engaged to a cursed prince feared across the continent. Her only goal is to escape the tragic fate she knows is coming, but the more she tries to stay out of the story, the deeper she's pulled into it. And the closer she gets to the prince, the more he misreads her intentions. Now caught between survival and obsession, Vivian must navigate a romance she never asked for.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

mangas.title: Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life
mangas.synonyms: Tsumiki Ogami & the Strange Everyday Life.
mangas.description:
Yutaka Shinso is constantly worried about what other people think of him. Hoping to turn over a new leaf, he changes high schools, but there's something strange afoot: vampires, ogres, and all manner of supernatural beings walk the halls! Yutaka is particularly drawn to Tsumiki Ogami, a confident and popular werewolf. Will Tsumiki be the one to help Yutaka overcome his insecurities?



(Source: VIZ Media)



Note:

- Placed third in the Tsugimanga 2024 Award in the Print Manga Category.

mangas.title: The Taming of the Tyrant
mangas.synonyms: I Tamed a Tyrant and Ran Away
mangas.description:
All Charlize Ronan ever wanted was to bring honor to her family. But instead, she is forced into becoming a "living sword" -- a mere tool for the emperors. It is from this hell that she prays for justice… and awakens in her former body. Now, determined to tear down this horrible empire, Charlize seeks out the young prince, Dylan Blade. She will put him on the throne, not as an honorable ruler, but as a tyrant. It is time for Charlize to tame the one who will bring forth her revenge.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Not Your Typical Reincarnation Story
mangas.synonyms: I Thought It's a Common Possession
mangas.description:
When Su-Na Choi wakes up in the body of the villainess Edith Rigelhof, she's confident that she's got this! After all, she knows how this is typically supposed to go: A girl dies, reincarnates into a romance novel as the villainess, uses her wits and foreknowledge to avoid death, and lives happily ever after (and maybe even wins over a hot guy or two). Except...saying that things aren't working out as she'd hoped would be putting it lightly. Killian Rudwick, her new husband and the second male lead, seems hellbent on finding every reason under the sun to despise her, and any attempt to fix her reputation appears to be futile. It's almost as if some higher power is refusing to let her change Edith's place in the narrative—but with her life on the line, she must find a way to break the story's hold before it's too late!

(Source: Ize Press)


Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Hopeless Desire of a Witch
mangas.description:
A charitable count offers to adopt young Kaidel into a life of nobility, and the orphan boy only has to pledge one thing in return: follow the "ember" and seek out the witch that set fire to his childhood village. Raised as a skilled fighter in a family of alchemists, Kaidel now sets out to find the white-haired witch. When he finally encounters a woman with flowing white hair, she is kind and gentle--contrary to the rumors spread by other villagers. Could the sweet Eleanor be the same witch from his nightmares? Between love and vengeance, which will Kaidel choose?



(Source: Tappytoon Comics)

mangas.title: Death to Lady White Ferret!
mangas.synonyms: Death to the Ferret Sheep | Death to the Ferret Weasel
mangas.description:
A thousand years have passed since the last princess of Balhalla destroyed her own country... and the price she had to pay for doing so? Live an immortal life in the body of a little, white ferret!

One day, she meets a young man in a series of rather dire and tense events, and discovers that despite being human, he can understand her as a ferret. Not only that, the man claims that she is his first love, and he constantly and endlessly professes his love for her too, nothing but blissful that his dreams came true in meeting her. However, despite his gushing love for her, she decides to use him to finally bring an end to her cruel, undying life of one thousand years.

A story full of ups and downs, twists and turns, as Soaz, King of Pallirod, and Noel, ex-sorceress and last princess of Balhalla, dive deep into a curse-breaking journey!

mangas.title: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
mangas.titleNative: 悪食令嬢と狂血公爵 ～その魔物、私が美味しくいただきます！～
mangas.description:
Like any proper noble lady, one must have certain acquired tastes. For Melphiera Marchalrayd, she just happens to crave a rather exotic protein—monsters! But do not judge! Despite its bad reputation, monster meat can be used in exquisite cuisine and Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom's opinion of it! Unfortunately, since debuting in society, Melphiera has been struggling to find her perfect match…until she meets the fearless "Blood-Mad Duke" of Galbraith!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Soundless Cosmos
mangas.description:
Despite loving music, Xiaochao avoids playing the piano because bad things happen whenever she does. One day, however, she gives into temptation and plays the piano at her school. Not only does her melody shatter a window, but it also attracts two boys, Michael and Tod... who happen to be an angel and a grim reaper! Xiaochao learns that they're both on a mission to restore the shattered genesis piano, a powerful treasure of the cosmos that keeps the world moving. What's more, her music has the power to awaken the genesis piano's keys that have scattered throughout the world and lie dormant in people. Both Michael and Tod want Xiaochao's help in restoring the piano, but Xiaochao isn't sure she wants the crazy responsibility of saving the cosmos. Will she decide to step up to the keyboard, even if it means attracting superhuman enemies in the process?


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: High Society
mangas.description:
Sell me! I'll be the most expensive lady to obtain.
While scheming to get out of an arranged marriage, Cesare runs into Adele, a shoeshine girl from the slums. The two make a 3-month deal to help Cesare elude marriage. However, Adele is so different from the women he's met before that he can't help but be drawn to her.

mangas.title: Most Wanted Wife
mangas.synonyms: I Am Being Chased by My Husband
mangas.description:
My husband is hot on my trail!



Eloise, a fugitive with a dark past, and Lord Johannes, the temple's relentless hound, enter a marriage built on lies. With one year to live, Eloise must steal the Stone of Time from Johannes without revealing her identity. Can she survive this deadly game of deception?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: My Girlfriend Is Devilishly Sweet
mangas.titleNative: あくまであまい私の彼女
mangas.description: Amatsuka Mai, a girl who loves sweets, is heartbroken after being dumped by her girlfriend. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Kurosaki Riri, a beautiful girl who has just arrived as a new waitress at the cafe she works at. However, Riri turns out to be a demon called a succubus? Mai shouldn't fall in love with her, but she can't forget her super sweet kiss! A cute and devilish Girls' Love comedy begins!

mangas.title: Joou Heika to Yobanaide
mangas.titleNative: 女王陛下と呼ばないで
mangas.description:
A recluse becoming Queen?! In a contest for the throne with scions of noble families, I'll do everything in my power to avoid getting embroiled in it!



In the Kingdom of Lindtor, renowned for being governed by a wise ruler, I, Francesca, am the King's granddaughter—a homebody who delights in chess and staying indoors. However, in the wake of my grandfather's sudden demise, it's revealed that he nominated me in his will as a Queen candidate.



While I was stricken with panic, several young noblemen competing to become sovereign appeared before me: the radiant yet overbearing Stewart, the highly intelligent Cyan, and the captain of the knights, Irwine. "Please choose the King from amongst them!" I struggle hard against it, but my efforts are futile. Furthermore, "I pledge my allegiance to you, my Queen." Is that supposed to be an oath, or a marriage proposal?



I'll get back my peaceful and tranquil days!



What will result from this shut-in princess's desperate resistance?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Secrets of the Mystic Moonlit Library
mangas.description:
In an empire where women are forbidden from learning the ancient language, Luna cross-dresses as "Lou" to work as an ancient language translator. Sure, her actions are punishable by death, but what haunts her more are the depressing details of her future self's diary from the mysterious library in her dreams. Making money as a translator is the fastest way she can leave her uncaring uncle's house and change her dismal future. However, Luna's main client happens to be her cousin's fiance, Duke Rothenbern, who gets drugged with a potent love potion and needs her "assistance" detoxifying it...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby
mangas.synonyms: Baby Snow Leopard of the Black Leopard Family
mangas.description: The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

mangas.title: Please Obsess Over Me
mangas.description:
Just before Princess Arabella Strovna's 24th birthday, she and the entire imperial family die at the hands of the rebel army. Thanks to a magical blessing, though, she wakes up and she's… 20 again? Trapped in a loop of rebirth, Arabella continues to repeat the same four years, only to be killed every time. To break the cycle, she must befriend her own murderers, the three rebel leaders. But as she gains their trust, Arabella realizes that they may not be the true villains of this tale…



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Fortune-Telling Lady
mangas.synonyms: A Princess Who Reads Fortune | A Fortune-Telling Princess
mangas.description: Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors?

mangas.title: Lulu no Hell House
mangas.synonyms: ルルの亡霊屋敷（ヘルハウス）
mangas.description:
A notorious property with a hidden past is now in the hands of Dan, a sharp and talented real estate agent.


The place? A manor that once belonged to the affluent Midnight family—whose bloodline vanished over a century ago.



(Source: Square Enix, translated)

mangas.title: Thicker Than Memory
mangas.description:
When orphan Rosie learns of her brother Julian and that they are a part of the esteemed House Noart, she gains both riches and the greatest treasure of all—the pure love of family. But after an accident causes Julian to lose all memory of recent years, including Rosie's existence, she discovers House Noart has many hidden enemies. Preventing her family from falling to ruin is one thing, but will these siblings be able to prove that blood is not just thicker than water but lost memories as well?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Don't Want to Be a Lady
mangas.description:
I'll be the one calling the shots.

After enduring an upbringing full of torment, Lady Arianne refuses to be used as a means to anyone's end but her own. When her father moves to have her sold off as an additional mistress to the crown prince, she takes matters into her own hands by proposing a contract marriage with a duke instead!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Fake Saintess Awaits Her Exit
mangas.synonyms: 堕落聖女に転生した私、3人の従者たちに抱かれて困ってます
mangas.description:
I've already died once, I won't die again!
I've been reincarnated as Evelina, a saint in a fantasy novel who has lost her powers. The only problem is, this wicked saint is supposed to meet her end by burning at the stake! To escape her fate, I must use my powers of seduction to win over the three men who drove me to my demise!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: How to Send Your Husband to Hell
mangas.synonyms: How to Send My Husband to the Abyss
mangas.description: Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love. To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne. As Helena begins her life in an arranged marriage, one thing becomes clear—there is indeed far more to this man than it seems. So she swears: she will bring her husband to ruin, no matter the cost.

mangas.title: The Duke Needs His Coffee
mangas.synonyms: I Didn't Lull You to Sleep Only for You to Be Obsessed
mangas.description:
Beauty, brains wealth—Duke Claude Winterville had it all, except one thing: sleep. Then April Renoen, a healer-barista, walks in and cures his insomnia with a single cup of her coffee. As they grow closer, Claude discovers that it's not just her coffee that captivates him, but the woman herself...

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún
mangas.description: In a world split between the Inside and the Outside, those living in both realms are told never to cross over to the other side, lest they be cursed. A young girl named Shiva lives on the other side, in a vacant village with a demonic guardian known only as "Teacher." Although the two are forbidden to touch, they seem to share a bond that transcends their disparate appearances. But when Shiva leaves Teacher's care to seek out her grandmother, the secret behind her mysterious living arrangement comes to light.

mangas.title: The Villainess Tames the Crazed Devil
mangas.titleNative: 黒幕悪女は悪魔を手懐ける
mangas.description:
Making a deal with a demon is a small price to pay for a chance to enact revenge on the man who accuses you of having been seduced by one. This is the choice Isabella makes when her father unjustly has her and her mother burned at the stake for being witches. After returning three years into the past, Isabella starts fulfilling her half of the bargain: freeing the demon queen's tragically beautiful son, Kaiden, and unleashing his inner demon. Isabella has one year to avenge her mother's honor, and she'll definitely make good use of her new demon husband.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Villainess's Maker
mangas.description:
Yoon Haneul has always been a pushover, someone who would never say no. Then one day, she opens her eyes and realizes that she has become Aila Mertensia, the antagonist of a novel she had written ten years ago. Haneul is content to live the life of a rich couch potato and binge-read novels. But to her dismay, she soon finds herself stuck in a time loop where her day repeats endlessly, and the only way to escape the loop is to act like Aila Mertensia! Haneul doesn't know the first thing about acting like a villainess. Luckily for her, a mysterious warlock by the name of Killian offers to help her become a true villainess. Her only option is to make a deal with him, but can Haneul really trust this devilishly handsome man?


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Villainess's Blind Date Is Too Perfect
mangas.synonyms: The Villainess's Match Is Too Perfect
mangas.description:
An overworked girl strikes gold, waking up as wealthy noblewoman Yvonne Argentrose in a novel. Once a jealous villainess one-sidedly obsessed with the crown prince, now all she wants is a peaceful and opulent life. Still unconvinced of her transformation, her family tries to set her up with the empire's perfect man, Duke Ehels. But when the once uninterested crown prince catches wind of this, he becomes jealous, and drama ensues! Can Yvonne escape the drama and enjoy her new life in peace?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Villainess Needs Her Tyrant
mangas.description:
Orphaned at the age of seven, I was naïve to think my uncle took me in out of love. He promised to return the House of Edenbarre to me once I was of age, but he kept my father's title and wealth. Not to mention my sweet cousin poisoned me after I learned of my uncle's plans against the emperor. But with a second chance at life, I vow to take it all from them, as they did to me! Some may call me a villainess, but I'll gladly use the tyrant emperor for my selfish interests. I'll have my vengeance... as long as these suitors don't get in my way!


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Tyrant Wants to Be Good
mangas.synonyms: The Tyrant Wants to Live a Virtuous Life
mangas.description:
Nothing was ever handed to Dorothea Millanaire. No attention, no love, no power. So she decided to take them for herself… with her sword! She accepts her fate when she is executed for being a bloodthirsty tyrant, only to wake up... as a child?! This is her second chance. She must not repeat history. She must be good.



(Source: WEBTOON)


Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Tyrant's Translator
mangas.description:
After leaving her abusive home to work as a maid, Leticia Woods ends up in the imperial palace, serving the young prince Mikael Devrant. But having read the story in her past life, she knows that Mikael will one day turn into the empire's bloodiest tyrant! As the only one who can understand Mikael's strange speech pattern, Leticia becomes his translator and advocate in a house where everyone is against him. But can she change the future tyrant's fate, or will it all end up lost in translation?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: He's Just My Brother, Your Grace!
mangas.description:
After losing her parents and ending up on the streets with her brother, Astel realizes she is actually in a novel where she and her loved ones die at the hands of a mysterious villain. Determined to change this, she decides to infiltrate the castle of Duke Anais and uncover the villain's identity! The first step of the plan succeeds, but now there's just one issue: she is bound to the shapeshifter duke as his mate! Will Astel be able to fulfill her goal while dealing with this new relationship?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: For My Derelict Favorite
mangas.description: What happens after the story ends with a "happily ever after"? When Hestia enters her favorite novel as a side character, she happily fangirls from the sidelines. Thinking she'll return home when the story reaches its end, Hestia finds that the only thing awaiting her is the tragic death of her favorite character. Now miraculously restored to the day of the ending, Hestia decides that she'll no longer spectate from the sidelines – instead, she'll save her derelict favorite!

mangas.title: The Daughter of Duke Doesn't Want to Be Spoiled
mangas.synonyms: The Ducal Lady Refuses to Be Pampered
mangas.description: Yvette Winchworth is worshipped like a deity for her grace and beauty. Little do the people know, she's spoiled to the core and can hardly feed herself much less fight for the throne that's now up for grabs! Desperate to keep her away from conflict, her mother ships her away to a group of mercenaries who can keep her safe. Can this spoiled noble last amongst a group of cold-blooded soldiers?

mangas.title: The Merman Trapped in My Lake
mangas.synonyms: The Mermaid Trapped In My Lake
mangas.description:
Servaine Noxirel grew up hearing stories from her great-grandfather—tales of the grandeur their noble house once enjoyed and the madness and obsession that ran through their bloodline. The strangest story of all, however, was about his sickly young niece and the merman she owned—a boy whose beauty and allure inspired a possessiveness that kept him locked away in a tank. Despite bearing a striking resemblance to her namesake, Servaine dismisses everything as just a fairy tale. That is, until Servaine's return to her ancestral manor dredges up Mel, the merman—who believes his Servaine has finally come back for him. But has he been waiting all this time out of love? Or for revenge…?

(Source: Ize Press)

mangas.title: Moralless Scandal
mangas.description:
Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There's only one way to win: a scandalous divorce.


"I need a wild dog… because I'm going to hunt down a hound."


A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Kuru Kuru Kuruma Mimura Pan
mangas.titleNative: くるくるくるまミムラパン
mangas.description: A mysterious mobile bakery, Mimura Bread, is making it's way around town! Bread so fluffy and golden brown that you'll never forget the taste. The owner, Mimura, seems to have a nose for people in trouble and bakes just what they knead to soothe the heart. What recipes and troubles await?

mangas.title: Diabolic Garden
mangas.titleNative: デｲアボリックガーデン
mangas.description: In the corner of a certain town, there is a teashop where the master, Tsukasa, obtains and cares for plants from the depths of hell.

mangas.title: The Urban Legend Files
mangas.description: Mokume is a first-year college student and occult fanatic! She hunts down an older student, Kugutsu, who is rumored to attract urban legends of all kinds... What will happen when she joins the Occult Club? The long-awaited occult comedy from the creator of "Janji", Kazuki Hiraoka!

mangas.title: The Ghost Doesn't Show Up
mangas.description: A lonely high school boy suffers from seeing creepy things that shouldn't exist. He encounters an enthusiastic girl from the school's occult research club who would die to see ghosts herself. Used to dealing with the burden of the supernatural all by himself, the boy might have finally found an unexpected ally in her. And possibly... a friend?

mangas.title: I Became the Tyrant's Dishonest Adviser
mangas.description:
A customer service employee one moment, then an adviser to the tyrannical emperor, Cardan Zeon, the next. Our heroine was suddenly transmigrated into the body of Duchess Erina Valois, a side character who dies a tragic death at the emperor's hands in a novel she was reading the night before. So despite all the confusion and chaos, one thing is for sure. If Erina is to survive under this tyrant, she will have to get her act together ASAP! Though, strangely enough, she gets a sense that there is more to their relationship than what was described in the novel...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Villainess is a Marionette
mangas.description:
I woke up as Kayena Hill, the novel's villainess, praised as the greatest beauty in the empire. Who knew that her story would catch my attention because I was her in my past life? Destined for terrible ends, I've died twice—but I refuse to die a third time as a pawn in someone else's scheme. I'm no longer the vain and naïve princess. Now that I know how the story will unfold, I'll turn the tables around and have everyone dancing to my tune. This time, I'll be the one pulling the strings.

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Raising My Fiancé with Money
mangas.description: Money can't buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge. Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden's table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the "Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield'' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire. Tea and crumpets will be served!

mangas.title: From a Knight to a Lady
mangas.synonyms: The Way That Knight Lives as a Lady
mangas.description: When Estelle meets her untimely death, she is a valiant knight of the Kingdom of Ersha. But death is not the end for Estelle - four years after her demise, she finds herself reincarnated in the body of Lucifela Aydin, the spoiled and cold-hearted daughter of a count in the Empire of Jansgar. To her dismay, she finds that her country fell to Jansgar years ago, and that she is now betrothed to Zedekiah Heint, the son of a count and her adversary in her previous life. Can Estelle discover the truth behind her death while attempting to navigate her new life as Lucifela?

mangas.title: The Villain's Daughter-In-Law
mangas.description:
Luciel, a Crystal Fairy skilled in crafting jewels from her emotions, returns to the past after a life cut short by betrayal. Armed with the knowledge of a grim future, she proposes a contract marriage to the empire's most villainous family. What begins as a desperate strategy to escape her fate soon becomes an adventure filled with unexpected warmth. Can Luciel rewrite her story, or will her past come back to haunt her?



(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
mangas.description:
Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
mangas.titleNative: 피폐 역하렘 남주들의 막내 처제가 되었다
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Youngest Sister-in-Law of the Ruined Reverse Harem's Male Leads
mangas.description:
One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time… or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Rearing Rebecca
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Stepmother of an Irrevocable Dark Family
mangas.description:
After dying in an accident, Leona wakes up in a novel as the third stepmother of the story's future villainess, Rebecca Petry. As Duke Ian Petry's only child, Rebecca is resentful, rowdy, and rebellious, terrorizing those around her. The duke orders Leona to raise his daughter, and she rises to the challenge, but the little girl is a formidable foe. To preserve the family's peace, Leona uses childrearing knowledge from her past life, but will she be able to turn this rugrat into a little lady?



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: His Majesty's Proposal
mangas.description:
A broken engagement and one too many drinks are the catalysts for a mistake that will change Penelope Zecalion's life forever, as she finds herself waking up in bed with the emperor! Grouchy, foul-mouthed Penelope is reluctant to let the emperor into her heart after her first engagement went so wrong. Can the emperor change her mind and win her heart?



(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: The Villainess Makes Amends
mangas.synonyms: A Strange but Effective Villainess Life
mangas.description:
After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. That is, until her family is wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to death! In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Happily Ever Afterwards
mangas.synonyms: I Picked Up the Second Male Lead After the Ending
mangas.description: What would you do if you were reborn as a character from your favorite romance novel? For Peony, an avid fan of "The Song of Askar," the answer is simple: Marry her favorite character, of course! Reincarnated as the princess of the Kingdom of Garten, Peony is determined to marry Richt, the second male lead of "The Song of Askar" and former prince of the Fairspren Empire, who was banished to an inhospitable land after the novel's happy ending (which didn't end so well for him). Amidst trials and tribulations, can Peony and Richt make the most of their second chance at life and love?

mangas.title: I've Become the Devil's Master
mangas.description:
After countless reincarnations as doomed villainesses, Ms. Transmigrator gets her final chance to rewrite fate–as Ciani Felicité, the woman who drove the male lead to madness! Instead, she plans to rescue Redian, the male lead trapped in her family's Subterranean Castle, nurture him, and then escape. But why is his intense gaze fixed on her? With so much attention, can she really navigate this reincarnation to a happy ending?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
mangas.description:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she'll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel's hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona's dangerous past, and the grand duke's affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Older Brother
mangas.synonyms: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Siscon Brother
mangas.description:
After transmigrating into her favorite novel as Ethel Wallace, she realizes how ridiculous everyone is to fawn over Riena Cassius, her sister-in-law and the original female lead who regressed in the story. Ignored by the family and unable to endure the nonsense any longer, she is determined to divorce her husband and turns toward the marquis, Riena's future enemy, for help. Will Ethel escape House Cassius? Or will regression trump transmigration? And why does the marquis seem… like a gentleman?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I'm Finding a New Husband
mangas.synonyms: I'm Looking for a New Husband
mangas.description:
After being returned to the past multiple times, Lyatte finally succeeds in escaping execution by murdering her treasonous husband. The only catch is that each time she returned, it cost her half of her remaining lifespan, and now she has less than two years left. Determined to live the rest of her short life to its fullest, Lyatte decides to hold a contest to find a new husband. Will the competition be a success, or will Lyatte's time run out before she can experience true love?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
mangas.synonyms: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
mangas.description: Eunha Park was just a regular girl desperate to get into college, but when she finally does, her elation is cut short as she's pushed off a roof—only to wake up as Raeliana McMillan, a character from a novel whose death serves as the catalyst for the story's events. But Raeliana refuses to die a second time and is determined to change her fate, no matter what!

mangas.title: A Merman's Affair
mangas.synonyms: The Cunning Princess and the Shark
mangas.description: Stunt double Yu Bei fell into a merman's territory by accident. To stay out of trouble, she disguised herself as a princess. The merman prince, who had not seen humankind for a long time, suggested a marriage of state just so he could meet the human emperor and save his kind from exploitation. He then visited earth with Yu Bei but later fell into a trap that Yu Bei set up for him...

mangas.title: When Fate Finds Us
mangas.titleNative: 신의 눈을 가린 채 입을 맞추면
mangas.synonyms: 神の目が届かぬ場所でキスをして
mangas.description:
One kiss could save my life.



As a prophetess, Noemi can see the futures of those she touches. Yet sadly, as the wife of a god, she sees only death in her own fateful future. But then, a sudden kiss with an unruly merchant brings a vision of life. Could he be Noemi's key to survival? Or will she be unable to escape her destiny?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Archduke's Magical Business Partner
mangas.synonyms: The Time-Limited Villain Supports My Broken Engagement
mangas.description:
Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Will the original Daphne's past misdeeds ruin her plans, or can she dodge her untimely death?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Apothecary Diaries
mangas.description:
Maomao, a young woman trained in the art of herbal medicine, is forced to work as a lowly servant in the inner palace. Though she yearns for life outside its perfumed halls, she isn't long for a life of drudgery! Using her wits to break a "curse" afflicting the imperial heirs, Maomao attracts the attentions of the handsome eunuch Jinshi and is promoted to attendant food taster. But Jinshi has other plans for the erstwhile apothecary, and soon Maomao is back to brewing potions and…solving mysteries?!



(Source: Square Enix)


Note: Won the Grand Prize in the Printed Manga category at the Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Award 2019.

mangas.title: Shinyuu Ouji to Koshiginchaku: Oshi no Ouji ni Kyuukon sa Rete Komattemasu
mangas.titleNative: 親友王子と腰巾着～推しの王子に求婚されて困ってます～
mangas.synonyms: 摯友王子和隨從～被追隨的王子求婚了正在苦惱中～
mangas.description:
Lenoir has been attached to Prince Vincent as his friend and personal servant since childhood. When he stepped in to take on a curse meant for the prince, the curse turned Lenoir into a woman. The prince wants to take responsibility. By proposing marriage. Surely he can't be serious about that!



A doting love story between a prince and his loyal servant.



Note: Original serialization ended on 2021-11-15 with two volumes and 11 chapters. The continuation started on 2023-04-26.

mangas.title: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat
mangas.titleNative: 매일 밤 집착폭군과 잠드는 고양이가 되었다
mangas.synonyms: 執着暴君の愛猫になりました
mangas.description:
I've found myself trapped in a mature-rated novel as a cursed cat, whose mere existence is believed to be harmful to the empire. This place has killed every cat in every alley all because of one prophecy... The moment anyone finds me will be my last moment in this life.



"What's this?"



Before I could even think of escaping, the male lead, who's fated to become a mad tyrant, effortlessly snatches me up.



(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
mangas.titleNative: 透明男と人間女～そのうち夫婦になるふたり～
mangas.description:
Yakou Shizuka, a quiet and bashful woman, works at a detective agency. Her boss Tounome owns the company and is the gentlemanly type–kind and dapper–though he also has an unusual trait: he's invisible! This is perfect for detective work, but he quickly comes to find it doesn't work on Yakou, who is blind and always knows if he's near. Charmed, Tounome is determined to get her to date him and isn't against using his many "skills." Yakou's quirky coworkers–a contrarian human man and a sisterly beastwoman–kindly watch over her as she stumbles and blushes through the uncharted waters of office romance.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: The manga was licensed by the publishing editorial Futabasha on August 20, 2021 and its first volume was published on November 28, 2021.

mangas.title: The Hidden Muse
mangas.description:
Riv Roydes, a tutor turned secret nude model, poses to pay for her sister's medicine, believing her identity to be safe. But when a painting reveals her profile, she is drawn into a forbidden romance with the enigmatic marquis Dimus Ditrion.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The S-Class Lady
mangas.titleNative: S급 헌터는 악역 공녀가 되기 싫습니다
mangas.synonyms: The S-Class Hunter Doesn't Want to Be a Villainous Princess
mangas.description: S-class Hunter Kim Yi-Yeong can't wait to leave the novel she woke up in. She gets the chance after defeating the story's final boss, but instead of returning home, she's sent into another novel! Yi-Yeong becomes Lady Renee Markious, a petty villainess who's just been framed for murder. Fortunately, Yi-Yeong has a secret weapon nobody knows about… her skills from her past life! Can Yi-Yeong clear Renee's name and find her way back to her own world? Or will she be trapped in this tale for good?

mangas.title: Girls x Vampire
mangas.titleNative: ガールズ×ヴァンパイア
mangas.description:
"Yes! Yes! I finally bit one!"

Luluna Von Bettelheim, four-hundred-year-old vampire of noble lineage, wakes from her long slumber, and on a whim, enrolls in a human school. There she bites a girl and gains a servant. "Shower me with praise!" she orders. But her command leads to even more affection an she expected. Teren Mikami (prose) and Minori Chigusa (manga) team up to bring you a sensual girls' comedy about a vampire and her cute, high-school servant Wakana.

mangas.title: Outei Denka no Okiniiri Tensei shite mo Tenteki kara Nigerarenai you desu?!
mangas.titleNative: 王弟殿下のお気に入り 転生しても天敵から逃げられないようです!?
mangas.description:
Countess Ashley recalled her previous life as a black rabbit under the rule of the demon lord, callously killed by the hero as he passed through.
She was reincarnated in the land of Tolfa, ruled by the descendants of the hero who killed her. As she was making her debut in the capital, she tripped and almost fell, but she was saved from embarrassment by Prince Clyde, who looked exactly like the hero from her previous life…

And for some reason, Clyde seemed to be enjoying himself as he approached the frightened Ashley!



(Source: Comic Ride, translated)

mangas.title: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
mangas.synonyms: For Those of You for Whom Regret Is a Luxury
mangas.description:
Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez--until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what's rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Please Kill My Husband
mangas.description:
Brienne Lutengard knew that her parents were selling off their daughter and their status in exchange for money. Still, she thought she'd be able to live a relatively happy life with her husband, but it's not long until the new duke of House Lutengard shatters her dreams. Eight years later, the duke is found murdered in his residence, and Brienne is named the main suspect, along with three potential accomplices. All three are skilled swordsmen, none have an alibi for the night of the murder, and they're all young men recently caught up in a scandal with the duchess! Did the duchess really kill her husband? And if so, what could've been her motive?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Seeking a Beauty in the East Sea
mangas.synonyms: Dong Hai Xun Mei Ren | Searching for the Beauty in the East China Sea
mangas.description:
In a past life, the mountain goddess took in a quiet child, only to find that the little one didn't want to be her servant, but instead aspired to become her intimate companion! But fate played its cruel hand, turning the once inseparable pair into bitter enemies?

In this life, a cute, water-fearing mermaid happens upon an aloof beauty with no memories of her past. A chance kiss during their first meeting is just the start of their chaotic relationship. However, what had seemed to be a serendipitous meeting turns out to be a long-fated reunion with roots reaching deep into the past...

From lifetimes past to present, an obsessive love flourishes...

mangas.title: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night
mangas.synonyms: Deputy Empress, but Spent the First Night
mangas.description:
Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda's heart is torn-- will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Savior's Book Cafe Story in Another World
mangas.titleNative: 異世界に救世主として喚ばれましたが、アラサーには無理なので、ひっそりブックカフェ始めました。
mangas.synonyms: I Was Summoned to Another World as a Savior, but Because I'm a Woman in My Thirties That's Impossible, so I Quietly Started a Book Café
mangas.description:
When a "god" tells Tsukina that she is to be transported to another world to become its savior, Tsukina isn't interested. As a bookish thirty-something, she has zero desire to go on some big adventure…so when she arrives in the strange new land, she decides to use her magical powers to create a cozy little book café instead. But when a fellow "savior" starts causing trouble, Tsukina might just have to play the hero, after all!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Want to Be a Receptionist in This Magical World
mangas.titleNative: 魔法世界の受付嬢になりたいです
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Be a Receptionist of The Magic World!
mangas.description:
Nunnally's always wanted to be a receptionist of the Hall. She enrolls in the kingdom's magic academy to hone her skills, but she feels out of place amid a classroom of nobles—including a genuine prince.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Perks of Being an S-Class Heroine
mangas.description:
On the outside, Ailette Rodeline is an adorable child prodigy. Cooking, brewing tea, alchemy; you name it, she can do it. But this little girl has a big secret: Ailette is a transmigrator! After dying prematurely in her past life, she becomes a character whose world is destined for destruction. With all odds stacked against her, Ailette must figure out how to survive before her life is ripped from her again. Fortunately for her, she finds her salvation in… an insurance package?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Treat Your Friends With Respect
mangas.synonyms: Please Treat Your Friends Preciously | Please Take Care of your Friend
mangas.description: The fragile but cheeky Laviette is not here to save the plot of the novel she transmigrated into. Instead, her goal is to escape her fate of a short life through her best friend, Ahckard, and his healing powers. The novel says he'll fall for her brother, so she sees him as just a friend. However, it doesn't seem like Ahckard plans to follow the original plot either. Will Laviette have to look elsewhere for her happy ending, or will she realize that what she needed has been beside her all along?

mangas.title: You've Got the Wrong Girl
mangas.synonyms: I Seduced the Sickly Male Lead
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description: Evelyn Monstera knows two things. First, she's been reborn as a mean girl in a fantasy novel, and second, if nothing changes, her cruelty to the main characters will be her undoing. So when the male lead of the novel, Casis Urquio, comes to stay at her manor, all she has to do is stay out of his way. Unfortunately, Evelyn not only causes a fight between the protagonists, but also wins the affection of the male lead too! Can Evelyn set the story straight and get the happily ever after she wants?

mangas.title: An Extra Stole the Male Leads
mangas.synonyms: The Male Leads Were Stolen by the Extra
mangas.description: Reborn as Selonia Bessin, the heroine of a romance fantasy novel, a girl is thrust into a demon-slaying mission with the novel's three male leads. They successfully defeat the demon lord, but Selonia falls unconscious for three months on the journey back. Upon awakening, she discovers the trio is now enamored with Grace Benet, an unknown extra. Moreover, the supposedly defeated demon lord is back in hot human form! Why has he returned, and who is this mysterious Grace stealing the limelight?

mangas.title: I Swear We're Just Friends
mangas.description: When Rienne transfers to the elite Alena Academy, she never expects Karcion, the most popular mage in school, to recruit her into his club... and she definitely doesn't think he'll fall for her! But the grumpy Karcion soon makes it clear how much he adores her, and she starts finding him too cute to ignore. Still, he's a future duke and she's a commoner, so Rienne knows his feelings won't last. Can Karcion magic his way out of the friendzone? Or will Rienne prove they're just friends after all?

mangas.title: Trapped in a Game That Flopped
mangas.synonyms: Trapped in a Cursed Game as an NPC
mangas.description: Apothecary Shari Azrael's life turns upside down when she suddenly realizes she's actually an administrator trapped in the RPG game "Save the Earth."
