Her only shot at returning to reality before her real body expires is to finish the game... which could've been possible were it not for the fact that "Save the Earth" is notoriously difficult in every single way! Can Shari successfully manage to use the perks of knowing the plot and gameplay to reach the ending before her time runs out?

mangas.title: Kamisama Kiss
mangas.description:
Nanami Momozono is alone and homeless after her dad skips town to evade his gambling debts and the debt collectors kick her out of her apartment. So when a man she's just saved from a dog offers her his home, she jumps at the opportunity. But it turns out that his place is a shrine, and Nanami has unwittingly taken over his job as a local deity!

Nanami has all kinda of new responsibilities she doesn't understand, dangers she's unaware of, and a cranky ex-familiar who's...actually pretty hot. What's a new-fledged godling to do?

mangas.title: I'm the Corrupted Side Character's Wife
mangas.description:
What would you do if your fiance holds the demon's power inside him and could kill you with it? The answer is clear for the reader who wakes up as Lucian's fiancee, Pernia. That is, she must help Lucian confess to the novel's heroine, Estelle, so his unrequited love won't trigger the demon! Whether it's teaching Lucian to dance or inviting Estelle to her own engagement ceremony, the plucky Pernia is willing to do whatever it takes to get them together. So why is the deadly Lucian turning his eyes toward her instead...?


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: I'm the Queen in This Life
mangas.synonyms: Sister, I Am the Queen in This Life
mangas.description:
The Etruscan Kingdom is stained with blood when the king's illegitimate son Cesare conspires with his fiancée Ariadne to usurp the throne from his half-brother Alfonso. Despite Ariadne's devotion to the new king, her faith is shattered when she is betrayed by him and eventually murdered by her own sister, who wishes to be queen. To her surprise, Ariadne finds herself sent back in time to her 17-year-old self. As she navigates the perils and opportunities of palace intrigue, Ariadne must make the most of her guile and grit to ensure that her tragic future does not repeat itself.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Predatory Marriage
mangas.description:
"Remember? I promised to ruin your life."



When Leah, a devoted princess, faces a tragic downfall, she plots one final revenge against the royal family by becoming an impure bride. Later, when her one-night stand unexpectedly appears, Leah finds herself unable to resist him as he brings madness into her once orderly life.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Sea Captain's Bride
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Madam of the House
mangas.description:
Arsel de Leahr knew her fate as soon as she realized she was inside the world of a novel. To prevent her eventual tragic death, she turns to the secret pirate of the empire, Duke Gael von Zenat. Arsel proposes marriage to him in exchange for access to her family's valuable sea territories, and he gladly agrees. But even though Arsel thinks their union is a mere formality, Duke Zenat falls deeper in love with her. Can their marriage stay afloat? Or is it doomed to sink to the bottom of the ocean?



(Source: Tapas)


Note: includes three extra chapter.

mangas.title: Rosen Blood
mangas.description:
Levi-Ruin and the mysterious men who took Stella in have a bare kitchen…and a moaning box in the storehouse. After discovering mansion dweller Gilbert's lifelike sculptures, the new maid faces a sinister reality. Can she survive the bloodlust? Stella must distinguish danger from passion as fear begins to feed on her!



(Source: VIZ Media)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I've Become a True Villainess
mangas.description:
I have to survive, no matter what!


I've died and been reincarnated as the villain of a romance novel! In order to avoid the hideous fate that awaits me, I've righted her wrongs and even gotten engaged. I should be home free, but strange things have started happening ever since the heroine appeared. Why won't her fiancé leave me alone?



(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Night Without Shadows
mangas.description:
When junior knight Roselyn is rescued from the bottom of a cliff after an ambush by an enemy kingdom, her brother Calix is relieved – that is, until he learns that she's lost her memory. Now, she behaves like a child, eats like a horse, and wields unbelievable strength. But something's not quite right...



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: My Numbered Days of Happiness
mangas.synonyms: I Was Just Having Fun With The Time Limit
mangas.description:
A terminally ill orphan is gifted a second chance when she is reborn into her favorite novel as Princess Isabelle Bilothian. Despite being born with a curse that will kill her at age 21, she eagerly embraces the opportunity to relish two decades with her loving family and friends. However, as she tries to cherish her borrowed time, the story takes unexpected turns, putting her in a series of dangers. Can she overcome these threats and make the most of her limited days to live in happiness?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Just the Male Lead's Friend
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Male Lead's Female Friend
mangas.description: Dahlia Averin would've been just fine living as a pretty, loaded extra... were it not for the fact that she's destined to fall for Rudrik, the male lead, and be used to better his love life! Determined not to go down that path, Dahlia swears to just remain a friend and stay out of his romantic relationships. But upon discovering that Rudruk is not quite like she had imagined, she finds herself caring for him more. Will Dahlia's resolve stay strong, or will they end up as more than just friends?

mangas.title: Izuki-kun wa Tadasaretai
mangas.titleNative: 伊月くんは正されたい
mangas.description:
Izuki-kun has a senpai he's interested in—none other than the strict Disciplinary Committee President, Ririko-senpai! To talk to her, even just a little, Itsuki-kun deliberately tries wearing his uniform improperly and makes various efforts, but Ririko is always one step ahead of him!?


(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: I Think I've Been Possessed Somewhere
mangas.titleNative: 제가 어딘가 빙의를 한 것 같은데요
mangas.synonyms: I Think I Have Transmigrated Somewhere
mangas.description:
Transmigration is easy. Step one: Figure out which novel you're in. Step two: Expertly navigate the complex web of political relationships, ensnaring the heart of your male lead. Step three: Live happily ever after. Or that's how it's supposed to go, unless you're avid-reader Elena Sevess and can't get past step one! Unless she can figure out where this story is going, Elena is in a world of trouble... or is it the world that's in trouble because of her?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Status Window to the Soul
mangas.synonyms: Baby Princess Through the Status Window
mangas.description: Princess Chervianne Aerveldote has lived a lonely life, and now she's being put to death for a crime she didn't commit. However, her execution turns out to be a fresh start when she wakes up as her 5-year-old self with an ability to read people's thoughts with status windows. Chervianne quickly learns how badly she misjudged everyone in the past, finding affection and betrayal in unexpected places. But will her newfound insight be enough to change her story and finally find love in her life?

mangas.title: I'll Protect You, Daddy!
mangas.synonyms: How to Protect My Sub Male Lead Dad
mangas.description:
Hanelope knows her dad, Prince Hart von Reinhart, is a good person, it's just that the world doesn't know it! The cunning Saint Asta has fooled everyone into thinking the prince is a cruel monster, so Hanelope is determined to put a stop to it once and for all! Hiding her quick wits behind a cute smile, she fights against pesky vassals, malicious rumors, and the manipulative Asta for her dad's happiness. Can Hanelope give her dad a happy ending? Or is this too much for a little girl to handle?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Maou-sama ni Parfait wo Tsukuttara Yorokobaremashita
mangas.titleNative: 魔王様にパフェを作ったら喜ばれました
mangas.synonyms: I was Pleased to Make a Parfait for the Demon King
mangas.description:
Cruz was reincarnated as a low-class demon into Makai, the underworld. In her past life, she aimed to become a top pâtissière, so now she's bewildered by the dank food of this world! However, she is touched by the kindness of the demons around her. She declares, "I will make the citizens of Makai happy with sweets!" Cruz starts by creating the underworld's very first "parfait" with limited materials. When the demons taste her desserts, they're instantly captivated! Eventually, even the powerful Demon Lord hears the rumors of her exploits and summons Cruz to attend him…?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Former Vet Lady Has Had Her Engagement Called Off, but Is Very Popular with the Fluffies!
mangas.titleNative: 元獣医の令嬢は婚約破棄されましたが、もふもふたちに大人気です!
mangas.synonyms: The Former Veterinarian Turned Duke's Daughter Has Had Her Engagement Broken Off, but She's Still Very Popular with Fluffy Beings! | Moto Juui no Reijou wa Konyaku Haki Saremashitaga, Mofumofu-tachi ni Daininkidesu!
mangas.description: Shiori, a former veterinarian, died in a car accident and reincarnated as a duke's daughter named Luna. She discovers that unknown creatures from her former world exist in the place where she was reincarnated, and happily lives her life in the hope of meeting them. But one day, her engagement was called off! Even though she was banished from her country, the prospect of embarking on a journey to meet new fluffies made her heart race! Wait for me, my lovely fluffies! Luna's affection for the fluffies is uncontrollable! This is a heartwarming fantasy about Luna and her adorable fluffy companions!!

mangas.title: Since I Became the Decorative Queen, I Decided to Secretly Go to Work
mangas.titleNative: お飾り王妃になったので、こっそり働きに出ることにしました ～うさぎがいるので独り寝も寂しくありません！～
mangas.synonyms: Okazari Ouhi ni Nattanode, Kossori Hataraki ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita: Usagi ga Iru node Hitori Ne mo Sabishiku Arimasen!
mangas.description:
I'm just a decorative wife... But I love being a waitress during the day and playing with the fluffy pet rabbit at night!

Roseline has been married to King Sieghart Luberia for six months, but she was called the "decorative queen" because she has been untouched for all that time. That was because Sieghart has been cursed, so they couldn't spend the night together! Not knowing that, Roseline doted on the rabbit who came to her bed every night instead. By chance, she also got the chance to work as a waitress at a restaurant in town?!

mangas.title: Midori no Mahou to Kaori no Tsukaite
mangas.titleNative: 緑の魔法と香りの使い手
mangas.synonyms: The Wielder of Green Magic and Scent
mangas.description:
Misuzu, a female college student who loves herbs, suddenly woke up in a lush forest. Which was located in a different world where magical powers and monsters actually exist! And it was Alex the hunter who helped her when she was about to be attacked by a boar monster.


Out of gratitude, Misuzu offers to treat his injury. But when a compress with herbs is applied, his arm, which had been immobile due to a curse, immediately starts moving!?


A reincarnation fantasy that heals a different world with the magic of herbs given by the goddess, the long-awaited comicalization!

mangas.title: Opening a Café in Another World
mangas.titleNative: 異世界でカフェを開店しました。
mangas.description:
Risa's been suddenly transported to another world where the food is terrible! It's so bad, it's unbearable! In order to improve the culinary situation in her new world, she decides to open her own café. People hear about this new place, and it becomes a great success. With the help of a sweet little fairy, Basil, and the support of her new friends, she starts enjoying her new life. An another world fantasy about a girl and her cooking skills!



(Source: Alpha Manga)

mangas.title: The Villainess Wants to Marry a Commoner!!
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢は、庶民に嫁ぎたい！！
mangas.synonyms: Akuyaku Reijou wa, Shoumin ni Totsugitai!!
mangas.description:
After reincarnating, I found myself as the Villainess in an Otome game I often played in my past life, the world of "Love☆Magical"?!

Although I reincarnated as the Villainess Isabella…having memories of my past life, if I let the scenario play out as it did in the game, I'd be going down the execution route…?! To free myself from the worst possible ending, my noble battle begins, however…

Can this overly unusual Villainess rewrite the ruin route awaiting her?

mangas.title: My Lady Just Wants to Relax
mangas.titleNative: 令嬢はまったりをご所望
mangas.description:
After being overworked to death, Ronia was reincarnated as a villainess in a certain novel world. She knows that her engagement will be cancelled and she will be banished from the center stage. However, she wants to spend a peaceful and relaxing time in this world! After being banished according to the novel, Ronia opens a coffee shop in the countryside with the help of small fairies called Loto. Then, unique beastmen come to her shop one after another...? This is a relaxing life of a former villainess!!



(Source: Alpha Manga)

mangas.title: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
mangas.titleNative: 自称悪役令嬢な婚約者の観察記録。
mangas.synonyms: Fiance's Observation Log of the Self-proclaimed Villainess
mangas.description: Crown prince Cecil was so brilliant that everything in life was easy to the point of boring him, then one day, his fiancée Bertia suddenly said "Prince Cecil, I am a villainess!" Claiming that this world is the same as that of an "otome game" from her past life and that she is playing the role of the "villainess" in it, she aims to play her part well and have their engagement annulled. With that goal in mind, she sets about causing turmoil in Cecil's daily life.

mangas.title: The Condemned Villainess Goes Back in Time and Aims to Become the Ultimate Villain
mangas.titleNative: 断罪された悪役令嬢は、逆行して完璧な悪女を目指す@COMIC
mangas.synonyms: The Condemned Villainess Goes Back in Time and Aims to Become the Ultimate Villain
mangas.description:
Claudia, daughter of a duke, is tricked by her wicked half-sister and sold off to a brothel. Unwilling to accept defeat, Claudia uses the tools at her disposal and becomes one of the most successful sex workers in her new home. That's when she dies–only to be thrust back in time to age fourteen! Gone is the gullible girl of her academy days now that she's got street savvy and hard-won seductive skills. It's Claudia's turn to play the evil villainess, and there's nothing she won't do to protect what's hers!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: I Accidentally Tamed the Duke
mangas.synonyms: Somehow, My Tyrant Husband Has Became Cautious
mangas.description:
Caught up in her parents' political scheme, Yurania is forced to lose her sight and voice in order to marry Duke Casius Euclid and betray him. After being imprisoned for her treachery and despised by all, she makes one dying wish to turn back time and freely live her own life. When Yurania miraculously awakens mere days before the betrayal, she seizes the opportunity to right everything... only to discover that her past relationships and all that she had known weren't what they seemed.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Will Not Return to My Family
mangas.synonyms: I Won't Go Back to My Family Who Abandoned Me
mangas.description:
In a world where she's shadowed by her siblings' brilliance, Letitia Leroy stands out for her lack of extraordinary powers that the members of the Leroy family are known to have. Unbeknownst to her, her very existence embarrasses her family, which leads her to heart-wrenching abandonment. But in the darkness of rejection, Duke Enoch Achilles and his siblings become her unwavering pillars of support, providing Letitia with the love and belonging her family denied her. Will these newfound bonds prove stronger than the ties of her own blood?


(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Emperor Thinks I'm Dying
mangas.synonyms: I'm in Trouble Because the Emperor Thinks My Time Is Limited
mangas.description:
As his strongest knight, Lindelle helped the emperor ascend the throne. But at his coronation, she coughs up blood–a side effect of her contract with the dragon Laroque, who promised to grant Lindelle any wish if she can find the dragon's real body. Meanwhile, Laroque's magic is destroying Lindelle's body, and the only way to heal is to fulfill the contract. But the emperor's word is law–and he says Lindelle can't leave until he finds a cure!



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Magical Angel Creamy Mami and the Spoiled Princess
mangas.titleNative: 魔法の天使クリィミーマミ 不機嫌なお姫様
mangas.synonyms: Mahou no Tenshi Creamy Mami Fukigen na Ohimesama
mangas.description:
Life gets super rough for idol Megumi Ayase when starlit (and magical!) Mami joins her agency and inadvertently usurps the top spot. Rather than backing down, Ayase leans into her jealousy and will stop at nothing to reclaim her throne…all while still doing her best to be a good senpai!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: A Reincarnated Witch Spells Doom
mangas.titleNative: 転生魔女は滅びを告げる
mangas.synonyms: In Which a Witch casts the curse of Death | The Reborn Witch Foretells Destruction
mangas.description: On her eighteenth birthday, shut-in Sena Shirai gathers her resolve and steps out into the world for the first time in a long while—only to be hit by a truck! Reborn as a witch in another world, she is only able to master two spells: Explosion and Destruction. With the nearby villagers fearful of her powers, she resigns herself to an isolated life once more...that is, until a mysterious boy collapses on her doorstep!

mangas.title: Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion
mangas.titleNative: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
mangas.synonyms: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! | Doumo, Suki na hito ni Horegusuri wo Iraisareta Majo desu | I'm a Witch Whose Crush Requested a Love Potion
mangas.description:
"Make me a love potion."

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake's secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she'd normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

mangas.title: The Archvillain's Daughter-In-Law
mangas.synonyms: My Time Was Limited So I Became the Villain's Daughter in Law | The Archvillain's Daughter in Law
mangas.description: After losing her parents, Laria Losstree is saddled with a mountain of bills. Enter the archvillain, Duke Icardes, who agrees to pay off her debt, but only if she'll marry his son, Evan. Cool and distant, he's not exactly ideal husband material, but that's okay, since Laria plans to secretly stash his money, then bounce! But when the duke starts acting suspiciously nice to her, Laria begins to wonder if he's on to her plan, and a battle of wits between archvillain and daughter-in-law begins!

mangas.title: Trust Me, Little Duke!
mangas.synonyms: Hey, Just Trust This Big Sister, Little Duke
mangas.description:
After a tragic life spent in the shadow of her superior Duke Senoc Blacknight, the powerful Dame Aspyn Soir is sent back in time and given a lucky second chance at life. She's thrilled, at least until she runs into the very same Senoc! However, this frightened boy is very different from the cool, composed sword master Aspyn knew. Even though Senoc nearly killed her, she can't help taking pity on his younger self. If nobody stops her, Aspyn just might end up helping out her greatest enemy.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Another Typical Fantasy Romance
mangas.description: After the gods dropped her in the world of her favorite fantasy romance novel, Lithera was quick to realize that happily-ever-afters were never easy to get. Given another shot at happiness, she is now determined to avoid the mistakes of her previous life, starting by meeting the sweet and caring Grand Duke she spent years exchanging letters with… Another typical female lead, with another typical Duke, promised to Wed. Will this story go the typical path we all expect?

mangas.title: Reverse the Crazy Curse
mangas.synonyms: The Baby Dragon Tames the Crazy People
mangas.description:
Tarassa Neptunos Atlantiz was once all-powerful and truly happy as she ruled the Atlantiz Empire alongside her lover, Kaortan. But after he betrayed her and sealed her away for 1,000 years, she vowed vengeance. The next time she opens her eyes, she finds herself reincarnated as a baby, Nisefor Ruseiyan, the future Dragon Princess of the Kaortan Empire. Now, she is expected to marry the descendant of the man who betrayed her and lift a mysterious curse that has caused his lineage to go mad!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Tired of Living in Fiction
mangas.synonyms: The Exhausting Reality of Novel Transmigration
mangas.description:
After being reborn three times as a book character and reviving a fourth time as a villainess in a dark romance, Rosetta Valentine has had enough. Instead of fulfilling her given role, Rosetta decides to live a normal life. The one thing holding her back? The fact that Elisha, her sister and the story's heroine, is destined for a tragic ending. In order to save Elisha, Rosetta swears to use everything at her disposal... including the male lead's brother. But will this villainess's plan succeed?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Was Summoned to Be a Saint, but Was Robbed of the Position
mangas.titleNative: 聖女のはずが、どうやら乗っ取られました
mangas.description:
"Will you save us? YES or NO?"



In standard dating sim style, "Anise" was summoned as a Saint into the world of "Garden of Salvation". However, Hime, another girl who was also summoned alongside her, stole the title of "Saint" for herself! Without being allowed to use the "healing magic" that she had learned, Anise was exiled to a remote village. If things stick to the script, a general from the neighboring kingdom of Farglow will die before long and Hime will reign supreme as the Saint in the bad ending. For Anise, that means death. In order to find her own path for survival, she decides to save the general and rewrite the story, but…



(Source: MangaUP!)

mangas.title: Jimi de Medatanai Watashi wa, Kyou de Owari ni Shimasu.
mangas.titleNative: 地味で目立たない私は、今日で終わりにします。
mangas.synonyms: Me Being Plain and Inconspicuous End Today
mangas.description: Elaine Lana Norris, who was born at the top of the aristocratic ladder, was suddenly abandoned by her fiancé for another and had her engagement to him broken off. Made out to be a villainess by her ex-fiancé's lover and her entourage, she is subsequently driven out of her home by the strict grandfather who raised her. With this exiled life however, Lana's true skills and desires can finally bloom as the owner of an inn!

mangas.title: The Demon King is Way Too Overprotective!
mangas.titleNative: 世にも過保護な魔王サマ
mangas.synonyms: The World's Most Overprotective Demon King
mangas.description:
Yamada Seina's life is already teetering on the edge—between juggling high school, managing her friendships, and covering her rent solo, she barely has time to breathe. But when she nearly falls prey to a scammer and loses her hard-earned rent money, things go from bad to worse. Just when it seems like she's hit rock bottom, a mysterious (and incredibly handsome) stranger with horns swoops in, claiming he's a demon king who's crossed dimensions just to be with her. Why? Because, according to him, Seina is the reincarnation of his lost love!



Skeptical but unable to shake him off, Seina finds herself with a new, otherworldly roommate who's hellbent on keeping her safe, whether she wants his protection or not. What's a girl to do when her biggest problem suddenly becomes a supernatural—and superhot—roommate?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: This Is the Wrong House, Mr. Villain!
mangas.synonyms: You Have Got the Wrong House, Villain
mangas.description: What do you do when a murderous villain ends up unconscious at your front door? For Yuri, the answer is simple: leave his body outside protagonist Anne-Marie's house and then live in peace as a background character! But for some reason, Yuri can't bring herself to let him ruin sweet, innocent Anne-Marie's life as is written in the original story, so she takes him in and slowly nurses him back to health. Little does Yuri realize the consequences of letting a villain inside her house...

mangas.title: Shall We Bathe, Your Grace?
mangas.synonyms: Let's Take a Bath, Duke! | Let's Take a Bath Together, Duke!
mangas.description:
Marry me, and we can bathe twice a day!

Unwashed hair, dirty fingernails, and the sickening stench of body odor mixed with perfume! Nadia is horrified to wake up in a romance fantasy novel where bathing is abhorred. Her only hope lies in Duke Cartane, the one man who doesn't stink. Will he help her get her squeaky-clean happy ending?

mangas.title: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
mangas.description: The last survivor of the Grezekaiah royal family is biding her time as a prisoner waiting to die… too bad everyone finds her absolutely adorable. When Clarisse became the youngest prisoner of Duke Maximilian Sheridan, she never expected her captors to be the family she'd always wished for. With an execution date set for her eighteenth birthday, will her emerging powers, bubbly personality, and cute face save her from her fate?

mangas.title: The Villainess's Stationery Shop
mangas.synonyms: Please Don't Come to the Evil Lady's Stationery Store!
mangas.description:
What's a girl to do when she wakes up in the body of a villainess? Meldenique Babelloa is a supporting character in a romance novel starring her fiancé, Duke Lennox Hessman, and… her sister, Sheria! Heartbroken, she eventually dies a tragic death as a villainess… or so the original story goes. Determined not to follow the script, Meldenique resolutely abandons her old life and sets out to open… a stationery shop! Will she succeed in defying fate and building the stationery shop of her dreams?



(Source: Tapas)


Note: includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Baby Pharmacist Princess
mangas.description: When Yun Chae-Ri gets sucked into her favorite game because of a strange scam, she finds herself as Princess Cherishe, a mastermind who must make one of her kin the Castalia Empire's next ruler. But this time, she's given a different mission: become the heir to the imperial throne and pay off her game debts! The only catch? She's stuck as a 4-year-old with no particular perks except her apothecary skills! Can this former kingmaker succeed in seizing the crown as a baby pharmacist?

mangas.title: The Rewards of Marriage
mangas.synonyms: I Found a Husband When I Picked up the Male Lead
mangas.description: Notorious for her extravagant spending, Wilhazelle Fossier drove her house to complete financial ruin. To pay her family's debt, she resolves to collect a bounty from the wealthy Duke Heillos by finding his missing nephew. Although her search is successful, until the skeptical duke can confirm the young boy's identity, Wilhazelle must spend one month living at the Heillos manor. But when one month turns into one year and a contract marriage, she starts to wonder if the money is worth it!

mangas.title: The White Cat's Revenge as Plotted from the Dragon King's Lap
mangas.titleNative: 復讐を誓った白猫は竜王の膝の上で惰眠をむさぼる
mangas.synonyms: A Vengeful White Cat Lounges Around on the Dragon King's Lap
mangas.description:
Ruri just can't get away from Asahi! Her clingy, oblivious childhood friend is beloved by absolutely everyone, making Ruri the target of resentment and jealousy from Asahi's horde of groupies. When Asahi is summoned to another world to be their "Priestess Princess," of course Ruri gets dragged along for the ride—and branded a traitor who must be exiled to the woods! But now that Ruri is finally out of Asahi's shadow, she may just find that a new world is the perfect place for a new beginning...


(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Siella's Revenge Affair
mangas.synonyms: The Heroine Had an Affair With My Fiance
mangas.description:
To avoid her predetermined death by guillotine, Siella Labyrinth befriended Tirielle, the female lead. But their friendship only lasts until Siella discovers that Tirielle is in an affair with her fiancé! Reeling from the shock and betrayal of this plot twist, Siella decides to get back at the adulterous pair by proposing a revenge affair to the male lead, Crown Prince Raynous, who accepts her offer. Will this new affair help ensure Siella's survival or bring her an ending she never expected?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Your Ultimate Love Rival
mangas.synonyms: I Have Become the Heroes' Rival
mangas.description:
Naturally charming, Irene attracts women like a magnet, even when she doesn't mean to. Enter her best friend, Claudia, who refuses to marry any of her three suitors because of her affection for Irene. As a result, these powerful and mentally unstable men declare Irene as their rival in love and threaten her life. She knows none of them deserve to be with Claudia, but she doesn't want to die! To save both her friend and herself, Irene must prove she's their ultimate rival, but will she succeed?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Lout of Count's Family
mangas.description:
Kim Rok-Su has one life motto: "Let's not get beat up." But after dozing off somewhere midway through the novel "Birth of a Hero," he wakes up as Cale Henituse - one of the minor villains in the novel who gets the beating of a lifetime from soon-to-be hero Choi Han. Only time will tell how much longer he has before that dreadful encounter. Can Kim Rok-Su change the course of this story so he can enjoy a long and lavish life free of the soon-to-be hero?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: I Married the Male Lead's Dad
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Male Lead's Mother | I Became the Hero’s Mom
mangas.description: In my real life, I was happy simping and fawning over Abel Louvremont, the main character of my favorite book 'Persona.' But after a fateful car accident, I woke up in 'Persona,' but when Abel is still a precious child. Now, as Aisha Heathcliff, I can simp the adorable Abel up close, squee!! I'll do anything I can to make sure he gets what he needs! And, somehow, that means I'm engaged to... his dad?!

mangas.title: My Sister Picked Up The Male Lead
mangas.description:
Amy is currently living a pleasant life as a character in a novel she read in her previous life. She already knows how the story goes, so when her sister gifts her a strange boy she found in the Night Woods for her 16th birthday, she panics. He is none other than Lennox Iberich, the male lead who lost his memories. And now that they've met, Amy will either have to accept her own death that's been foretold or do what she can to change the ending of her story.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Villainess Flips the Script!
mangas.synonyms: It's Time to Change the Genre
mangas.description:
I woke up inside my favorite novel, not as the protagonist, Luca Winterwald, but as Judith, his abusive aunt and the first character to die—time for a rewrite! I'll hand Luca off to his loving, long-lost uncle as scripted, and then live my own life far from danger. At least, that was the plan. When his uncle arrives, Luca suddenly calls out, "Don't leave!" Now, I must protect Luca from impending family tragedy, raise him to become the hero, and turn this villainess's ending upside down!



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Please Marry Me Again!
mangas.description:
As a so-called "half-noblewoman," Shurya Littenheim was shunned by all in high society except her husband, Grand Duke Kardi Esperand. So when the powers Kardi inherited from his family start to slowly kill him, Shurya gladly makes a deal to sacrifice her own life instead. Upon her death, she's reborn as her younger, single self, and this time... she's doing it all over again! Shurya's on a mission to make Kardi her hubby once more, but is there any hope of avoiding yet another tragic ending?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Baroness Goes on Strike
mangas.description: Although Baroness Cassia is on her deathbed, she's relieved that it means she's finally free from her loveless marriage to her mercenary husband, Zester. Oh, how she regrets her tireless efforts to keep his territory afloat! If only she had taken more time for herself. Her wish becomes reality when Cassia wakes up to find herself ten years back in the past. With this second chance, she's determined to live a stress-free life. But can Cassia find the courage to rebel against Zester? Or is she doomed to repeat her nightmare of a past life?

mangas.title: The Crimson Lady
mangas.description: Karen Heyer thought that a happy ending with the male lead, Raymond Sayerteth, would help her escape the romance novel she had entered. Unfortunately, fate had other plans. Karen soon discovers that regardless of how the story ends, she always dies tragically and returns to when she was 17. After being forced to relive the story for 117 years, Karen's sanity finally reaches a breaking point... as she decides to change her destiny by killing everyone who has wronged her.

mangas.title: Kageki Shojo!! The Curtain Rises
mangas.description:
Like the Takarazuka Revue, the young women who go to the arts academy Kouka Kageki High School play all the parts of musical theater, be they female or male. Narada Ai is a jaded former idol performing female roles—her roommate, playing male roles, is bright-eyed country girl Watanabe Sarasa. From the school to the stage to the rest of their lives, there is no challenge these young women can't face with their passion for performance.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



The series was renamed to Kageki Shoujo!! Season Zero (かげきしょうじょ!! シーズンゼロ) in 2019.

mangas.title: A Stepmother's Märchen
mangas.synonyms: The Fantasie of a Stepmother, A Stepmother's Fairy Tale
mangas.description: The marchioness Shuri Von Neuschwanstein is no stranger to hardship: her husband dies when she's still a teenager, leaving her to manage his lands and raise his semi-grown children herself. Her stepchildren never warm up to her, and other nobles disparage her behind her back. Years later, however, it seems her efforts have finally paid off: her eldest stepson is to be married and take over the estate, freeing her of many responsibilities. But shortly after learning the cruel truth that she's not invited to his wedding, she dies and wakes up on the day of her husband's funeral seven years earlier! If Shuri is to live these seven difficult years all over again, she's going to do things differently. Can she write her own fairy tale ending this time around?

mangas.title: Otaku Vampire's Love Bite
mangas.description: Hina Alucard is a modern vampire who drinks blood from bags instead of from humans. But she's also a complete shut-in who hasn't left the house in 30 years. In an effort to reach her, Hina's dad does something that changes her life—he gives her a DVD of the Vampire Cross anime! Hina is instantly obsessed, especially with the character Mao. But it's difficult to fangirl as hard as she wants from her bedroom in Romania, so now Hina is out of the house and off to Japan to live her otaku dream!

mangas.title: The Taste of a Childhood Friend
mangas.description: Seo-eun, who broke up with her ex-boyfriend after being shocked by his small penis, drowns her sorrows at Yoon-do's shop. There, she accidentally glimpses Yoon-do's impressive endowment and becomes convinced she'll never see such a size again. "Let's sleep together. I'll make you feel good," she brazenly proposes. Yoon-do, taken aback, succumbs to her unexpected provocation, and overnight, their relationship transforms. How will the connection between these two childhood friends, who have now shared a bed, continue to evolve?

mangas.title: I'm From Next Door
mangas.description: Jooa has a secret fetish—she gets aroused by secretly listening to the private life of her ideal man. Fully aware of her abnormal desire, she isolates herself from society to live quietly. But everything changes when her “ideal man” moves in next door. After successfully eavesdropping on him for over six months, she is suddenly caught. Accused of industrial espionage due to his high social standing, Jooa confesses in desperation that she simply enjoys listening to the private lives of people she likes. Instead of reacting with shock, the man proposes an absurd counteroffer, smiling down at her and promising he won’t do more than what was done to him. The man she thought was ideal turns out to be far stranger than expected—and by the time she realizes she’s in trouble, it’s already too late.

mangas.title: This is a Snail Maiden?!
mangas.description:
“I can do it… So please… Can’t you let me stay here?”

A young woman I’d helped out of pity back when I was a detective came to me, saying she wanted to repay the favor. As she clung to me, crying and begging to at least do housework, Taeshin deliberately scared her off so she’d run away.

“I don’t need a woman to do housework. There’s only one thing I need.”
“Huh…?”
“A woman who’ll sleep with me. Is that how badly you want to stay?”

He figured she’d get the hint by now, but she said something completely unexpected.

“I… I can do it. I’ll do exactly as you say, Detective!”
“Song Yeon-hee, if you want to stay here that badly, take your clothes off right here, right now.”

He’d ended up with a ridiculous, pushy woman on his hands.

mangas.title: Rules for Rehabilitating Trash
mangas.description:
“What’s that bastard going to get after he’s had his fill of sex?”

In an old apartment building, even the slightest lack of maintenance would attract swarms of cockroaches and ants. Because of this, the trash had to be taken out promptly, without delay.

“What are you doing?”

Seo-eun froze at the languid voice coming from beside her. With his eyes half-closed, the man exhaled cigarette smoke as he stood right next to her, his arm resting on his knee, staring at her.

“I was… taking out the trash. Recycling.”
“Oh, really? Every time I have sex, I hear the door next door open, so I thought you wanted to say something to me.”
“Uh, yeah…?!”

A large hand that had been resting there casually slid downward and cupped Seo-eun’s breast.

mangas.title: Vivian's Circumstances
mangas.description:
Vivian, the Empire's only spirit mage. While studying abroad to master spirit magic, she engages in a scandalous affair for three years with a man who suddenly appeared in her dreams. She thought she would part ways with her dream sex partner upon returning home after her studies ended.

“Ah, Father. The person behind His Majesty… who is it?”

“Who do you mean? Ah, are you talking about Sir Orpheus?”

“What? O-Sir Orpheus?”

Is he the 'Mad Dog' Sir Roger Orpheus I’ve only heard about? What am I supposed to do every time I meet him? No, wait. I won't be meeting him again in the future, so what? However, as if mocking Vivian’s delusion, the two gradually become entangled.

“Are you alright, Young Lady?”

mangas.title: My Brother's Sultry Friend
mangas.description:
A handsome face and broad shoulders. A man who is prickly to the world but gentle only to her. Yet, he still sees her as just a child. Tonight, Jena is determined to make Woo Tae-kyung fall for her, one way or another.

"Doing this in front of a man leads to trouble."
"Even for you, Oppa?"

Tae-kyung’s expressionless eyes finally curved into a slight smile. The corners of his mouth rose slowly and meaningfully.

"Yeah, me too."
"I told you I wouldn't be able to handle you."
"I also said I wouldn't be able to stop halfway."

It was on a completely different level from what she had seen in her dreams. Seeing him pulse and move with such intensity, Jena swallowed hard without realizing it. This... This is...

"It's... it's even bigger..."

At that moment, Tae-kyung’s brow furrowed deeply.

"What?"

The gentle adult who had been coaxing her was gone.

"Our little Jena has grown quite bold. Who exactly are you comparing me to right now?”

mangas.title: The Leader Has Disappeared
mangas.description:
Sa Baek-Min, the guildmaster of the "From" Hunter Guild, has gone missing in a dungeon. Deputy Guildmaster Baek Sin-A enters the dungeon, which is currently in the midst of its breeding season, to find him. There, she encounters an unknown incubus monster named Glitch...

"I'll protect you until we find that hunter. In return, give me your life force."

To make matters worse, she has to calm the boss's heat before she can proceed to the next floor? The sizzling tale of B-rank hunter Baek Sin-A and the incubus monster Glitch as they take down the boss♥

mangas.title: Married Woman Complex
mangas.description: A woman raised under strict expectations of obedience appears to live a flawless life, until she discovers her husband’s affair two years into their marriage. Confronting him, she learns the union was never love but a calculated transaction. Disillusioned, she finds solace at a familiar bar and meets a charming bartender who survives on discreet arrangements with wealthy women. In a moment of reckless defiance, she proposes a night that could change everything.

mangas.title: Swimming Lesson Record
mangas.description: Na-Hyeon joins a dawn swim class to conquer her water phobia—and crushes hard on her hot instructor, Jae-Hwan. She shuts it down fast. No point eyeing a tree she can't climb. But what if that tree wants to be climbed? Before she knows it, Jae-Hwan is insisting she take responsibility for taking his virginity!

mangas.title: Hyodong, the Filial Piety
mangas.description:
“My little Hyodong! When are you going to grow up and show me some filial piety?”

Kim Da-hyo, an ordinary cat owner taking care of her jet-black kitten, Hyodong. And the guy next door—who lives just one wall away—a rough-around-the-edges but devastatingly sexy guy.

A single ring of the doorbell, pressed on a whim, and a casual joke…

“If you keep doing that, I’m going to get the wrong idea.”
“I don’t think you’ll misunderstand.”

She thought she could reel him in quickly with a little flirtatious back-and-forth.

“Guess you like being teased. You’re all hard.”
“Look at you, spitting out water bit by bit...”

...This guy is way more dangerous than she thought.

mangas.title: Cheating, Chatting!
mangas.description: After visiting a bar with her classmates, Yebin signs up—half-drunk—for a dating app one of them recommended. The next morning, she realizes it isn’t an ordinary dating app but an adults-only platform. Just as she considers deleting it, she receives an unexpectedly normal message from a user named “westpants.” As their conversations continue, Yebin feels a strange attraction toward him. What begins as casual chatting gradually turns more intimate, and before she knows it, she finds herself drawn deeper into their private exchanges. Her curiosity grows day by day—who is he, really? Eventually, she even begins to want to meet him in real life.

mangas.title: Diary of a Dine-and-dash Criminal XX
mangas.description:
Ryu Yeong-Won: the top starting pitcher—and the worst scammer in history, who took 1 billion won and vanished.
While in the midst of a terrible slump and keeping a low profile, a delivery mix-up leads him to meet his fan, Jeong Ji-Min.

"If you have time, would you like to grab some chicken before you go?"

It started as a drunken fling, but he realized that whenever he slept with this woman, his slump would disappear.

"So I just need to do this for you regularly, right?"

"Yeah, yeah?"

"Let's give it our all. For the Hounds!"

Driven by his desperate desire to return to the league and his fervent hope for the Seoul Hounds' revival, they joined forces.
As their relationship deepens, so do their feelings, but the more it does, the more their roles as fan and player hold Ryu back…

mangas.title: See You in the Chili Pepper Field!
mangas.description:
Tae-Mi, the spoiled daughter of a chaebol family, not only repeatedly botched new ventures but also caused a major scandal with her clueless social media posts. Ultimately, at her furious father's command, Tae-Mi is demoted to Sunchang-ri, the chili pepper capital. A city girl through and through, Tae-mi screams at the sight of the remote village before her. But meeting Kang-Hun, a young farmer and breathtakingly handsome man living in a watermill at the edge of a chili field, instantly recharges her motivation. Soon, after accidentally witnessing Kang-Hun's well-built lower body and striking beauty, she throws caution to the wind and begins aggressively pursuing him... .!

A spicy-sweet, farm-fresh romance straight from the countryside!

mangas.title: Our Temperature!
mangas.description:
Yujeong has a naturally hot body temperature, and she tends to overheat during sex, so she’s never really able to fully enjoy it—and she even ends up breaking up with her boyfriend because of it.

Then one day, at her high school reunion, she runs into Hanseo, her longtime childhood friend. Unlike Yujeong, Hanseo has a naturally cold body temperature.

Even a little bit of skinship between them sparks a quiet tension, and before they know it… they end up spending the night together.

mangas.title: Touch Your Body
mangas.description:
Yoon Seo-ho, the fourth-generation only son of the Yoon family. Believing he was the only one in the world and living solely for his own self-importance, he eventually ended up banished to a rural school. There, he meets Lee Bo-deum, who hovers around him like a stalker with her soft appearance . To get rid of this annoying senior, Yoon Seo-ho does not hesitate to use harsh words and actions…

“I’ll take a selfie for you; will you take that and leave me alone?”
“My face in it? I don’t need it…”

Ha. No matter how much he pretends not to be interested, he can’t fool that face that clearly wants something. But why is it? As time goes by, Bo-deum keeps appearing in his dreams, and he feels like he will go crazy if he can’t see that blank face. So, after much deliberation, he decided to give Bo-deum a chance to confess.

“Be my model for the sports massage competition.”
“I have no intention of dating anyone… Senior, are you kidding me??”

This pathetic stalker has only wanted my body all this time?!

mangas.title: My Possession Became a Ghost Story
mangas.synonyms: I Possessed Someone, and It Turned Into a Ghost Story
mangas.description:
A monster lives in the Rohanson manor. It wears the skin of the dead Lady Evangeline. While she believes she is the heroine of a romance story, to everyone else, she is a haunted nightmare.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Doku wo Kurawaba Ai Made
mangas.synonyms: As well be hanged for a poison like love
mangas.description:
Luciana, the son of the Arcadia family who rules the underworld.



The peaceful days of running the orphanage are completely changed by the summoning order from the current head of the family to all the siblings.That's because it was a "wiping" warning that if he didn't come forward as the next head of the family with his fiancee, he would be permanently expelled.
She was desperately looking for a temporary partner, but what appeared in front of her was Lal, a man as dangerous as "poison"...?



"Do you prefer to swear eternal love with me or be killed?"



An immoral love depicting the crazy love between a mafia's outcast daughter and a young master of a hostile organization!

mangas.title: Muse on Fame
mangas.description:
"I'm an unknown actress who cleans houses as a side gig. Ironically, my name means fame." Struggling actress Myeong stumbles upon a photo exhibition filled with photos of her younger self, when she was filled with hope. Can she become a star as this mysterious photographer's muse?

(Source: WEBTOON)


Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Noises Through the Wall
mangas.description:
"Watch out... the guy next door... no, wait."

That jerk next door who shows up the moment I type a single key!

mangas.title: Tutoring Scandal
mangas.description:
“Is it okay to do this with a student I’m tutoring?”
“Is it okay to do this with my tutor?”

Dae-hyuk ended up tutoring his friend’s younger sister after a drinking game bet. He started out thinking it was no big deal, remembering they’d lived in the same neighborhood as kids, but when he found himself face-to-face with Eun-byeol—who had grown up so much—he was flustered by his body’s reaction to her.

“If you don’t want to do this, just say so now. I still have some sense left.”
“You’re hard. Can you really drive all the way to Seoul like this? You used to say it would hurt if it didn’t go down…”
“I’ll drive even if it hurts.”
“Don’t go. I missed you too, Mr. Dae-hyuk…”

Eun-byeol couldn’t finish her sentence. His lips pressed against hers even more urgently than before, silencing her words.

mangas.title: A Guide to Mating: Snakes and Rabbits
mangas.description:
Because rabbit beastfolk enter their heat soon after coming of age, Shuna, a rabbit demi-human, faces the threat of an arranged political marriage immediately after graduation. To avoid it, she makes a bold proposal to Kyrel, a senior she knew during her academy days: that they spend her first heat together.

“My heat… isn’t over yet.”

He pressed his lower body against her abdomen.

“That doesn’t make any sense—”

Yet the unmistakable warmth she felt made it impossible to dismiss. Recalling pleasure so intense it bordered on violence, Shuna spoke with a pale, shaken face.

“Snake beastfolk have long heats.”
“……”
“Do you know what happens when a snake shares a heat with another species… once the other side’s heat ends?”

Their lips parted again, tongues tangling. This time, she clearly felt the split tongue she’d been too overwhelmed to notice before.

“Mm. You swallow it well.”
“Ah—mm.”

Her body trembled. Though she was sure it had already ended, her heat seemed to ignite again, a tickling sensation low in her belly. Despite the lewd words, his eyes curved into an almost innocent smile.

“Should we have a baby… so Shuna can’t run away?”

mangas.title: I Like Beautiful Women!
mangas.description:
Ma Su-Ri, a man who is only good-looking, is suddenly kicked out of his apartment. As Su-Ri sits on the sidewalk worrying about his future, a unique otaku woman named "Kang Ji-Yu" approaches him. Ji-Yu proposes that if Su-Ri works as a housekeeper at her home and fulfills her "request," she will not only provide meals and lodging but also pay him a massive monthly salary.

"You... you're a pervert."

However, after visiting Ji-Yu's house, Su-Ri can't even last an hour and ends up packing his bags...

Just how will Su-Ri's life as a housekeeper turn out?

mangas.title: Strings Attached
mangas.description:
Once a top-tier idol, Ju-Won is now forced to watch as his juniors steal the spotlight. Desperate to save his dying career, he tracks down the high-profile sponsor backing the industry's rising rookies: Madam Noh. But the woman behind the power isn't interested in the usual games. Stripped of his pride and faced with her cold, direct demands, Ju-Won must decide how far he's willing to go to stay in the limelight. The stage has changed, and the only audience that matters now is her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Betise de ROSE
mangas.description: In this soft-erotic tale, a mysterious lady thief has her way with the young officer on guard.

mangas.title: Doggy Lovey
mangas.description:
At work, she has an angelic smile, and at night, she reigns over everyone, regardless of gender or age, like the goldfinger queen Si-Eun. Si-Eun, who enjoys living a double life, is harassed by her team leader as usual, and one evening, she heads to her hotel room with her play partner, whom she matched with on the BDSM dating app 'Doggy Lovey'. When Si-Eun opens the door, she is startled to see Min-Gyu, the scoundrel team leader who had tormented her a few hours ago, sitting there with his eyes covered...

"Should I tease you just a little bit?"

mangas.title: Scripting Seduction
mangas.description:
Yu Eunha is the unfortunate heroine of the erotic BDSM novel The Demon's Vivace, where she endures daily beatings from the male leads. Her miserable existence seems never-ending—until the author suddenly announces an indefinite hiatus. Desperate to keep her story going, Eunha decides to take matters into her own hands: if the male leads won't continue to torment her, she'll make them suffer instead. But when the Demon King, who's supposed to be her cruel master, refuses to harm her, Eunha flips the script and embarks on a mission to train him into the perfect sadistic lord. Can she turn this reluctant villain into the ruthless master she needs, or will her twisted plan backfire spectacularly?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Duchess at the Butler's Mercy
mangas.synonyms: The Duchess Crawled to Her Butler
mangas.description: Duchess Ines, married to the Duke of Edward, a man more affectionate than anyone else. However, Ines harbors a secret she cannot tell. It is that she is more aroused by men who would humiliate her than by affectionate men. When her butler Leon learns this secret, he begins to abuse Ines to his heart's content while the Duke sleeps...

mangas.title: The Saintess is Stuck in a Wall!
mangas.synonyms: The Saint Is Stuck in the Wall!
mangas.description:
Saintess Liliana wants just one thing out of her second marriage: to finally be satisfied in the bedroom. However, her marriage to the kingdom's biggest playboy, Prince Riverre, isn't exactly welcomed by her modest first husband, the holy knight commander Altus. What's more, Liliana's unholy wish lands her a divine punishment of being stuck in the wall between her two husbands' bedrooms. But perhaps this unconventional three-way might be just what the saintess needs to spice up her marriage!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: A Maid's Playful Duties
mangas.description: After a failed marriage, Camilla returns to the grand estate where she once worked as a maid—only to find that Mika Aberdeen, the young master she used to care for, has grown into a flirtatious playboy, constantly surrounded by women. He teases her relentlessly, igniting a desire in her to turn the tables and toy with him instead. But just as she's about to strike, she stumbles upon a shocking secret—Mika is still a virgin?! As Camilla finds herself caught in a whirlwind of teasing and temptation, things take an even messier turn when her ex-boyfriend, Felix, suddenly returns to the estate…

mangas.title: How to Love Ma Do-ae
mangas.description: Ma Do-ae was born with a curse that plunges the other person into misfortune the moment she loves or is loved. There is only one way to break this curse: finding a "fated partner" who is immune to it. But of all people, the only candidate turns out to be the delinquent Gong Seon-hwa? Forced into a relationship with the worst kind of man just to end the curse, will Do-ae finally be able to find the "real deal" this time?

mangas.title: Shinkan de Me wo Tsuketa Ko wa, Shiotaiou no Seme Joshi deshita.
mangas.titleNative: 新歓で目をつけた子は、塩対応の攻め女子でした。
mangas.synonyms: The girl I had my eyes on at a new student party was a dominant top with a cold attitude.
mangas.description:
The story of a playboy that loves to fool around with girls...
getting topped by a younger woman with an unfriendly attitude.



No role reversals, no turning the tables, no switching.
She teases him from start to end, and he moans and groans in the throes of passion.

mangas.title: Sweet Lies Layered Like a Mille Feuille
mangas.description:
Akane Kinuta, an office lady who lies about getting married to keep her job station and otaku hobbies safe. She gets caught by her hot, perfect gentleman boss Kuroki Tsuneyasu… who orders her to do a fake wedding!! They practice having sex to keep their marriage lies from being found out, but Akane's naive body is at the mercy of sexual pleasure...



(Source: Manga Club)

mangas.title: Friday Night Baby Violet
mangas.titleNative: 金曜日のベイビーヴァイオレット
mangas.description: Ms. Sumire Mizuno, an efficient office worker has a secret hobby... She wears cute and very erotic lingerie and posts sexy selfies on social media! To relieve the stress of everyday work, she does it on her secret account. But one day, Murasaki, a designer of the company's supplier has identified her by chance. In exchange for keeping it a secret, he makes an unexpectedly serious proposal. He wants Sumire to model the lingerie he designs so he can get feedback and test the texture and functionality of the product in real situations. Puzzled as she has imagined much worse, but mixed with such shame and confusion, she spontaneously asks him to "Have sex with me"!!!

mangas.title: Ladies on Top
mangas.titleNative: 女の子が抱いちゃダメですか？
mangas.synonyms: Is It Wrong to Get Done by a Girl?
mangas.description:
Mizuki seems like an ordinary office lady–tidy, cute, quiet, and looking for Mr. Right–but while she yearns for love, she's left cold by traditional romances where men take the lead. Then, at the age of 24, Mizuki discovers Shinomiya, a seemingly perfect guy at the office who likes aggressive women, and something awakens within her. Together, Mizuki and Shinomiya learn that reversing traditional gender roles can be both liberating and exciting, especially in bed!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: My First XXX: The Marquess is Wild for His Princess
mangas.description:
Princess Elena is devastated when her hand in marriage is rewarded to war hero Marquess Lupus Bernardo against her will. Her dreams of marrying the kind Count Favio are dashed, and she has no choice but to wed the rumored brute who demanded her as a trophy. Trapped in a seemingly loveless marriage, both her heart and body ache for true love and warm affection. But as it turns out, Lupus may be hiding some heat beneath his cold exterior...!

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note:

- Includes three extra chapters.

- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Usapyon
mangas.description:
One day, a mysterious creature calling itself "Usapyon" appears in the room of Soma, a college student leading an empty life. This being, which looks human but isn't, calls Soma "older brother" and forces him to play video games with it... Before he knows it, his room is filled with pink things!?



Involving those around them, something that had been stagnant begins to move. A strange and cute cohabitation comedy!



(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

mangas.title: One Night After 19 Years
mangas.synonyms: คืนเร่าร้อนของมิตรภาพ 19 ปี
mangas.description:
Eun-Seol Jeong and Yu-Sin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yu-Sin is often sought after by girls in Eun-Seol's orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eun-Seol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eun-Seol and Yu-Sin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they'll have to decide – what if their relationship was never just friendship?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Fatal Indulgence
mangas.synonyms: Fatal Favoritism | Zhi Ming Pian Chong
mangas.description: Chiara, the youngest Li, is the apple of her family's eye. When she first meets her ex-fiance's brother, Everett, who's rumored to be a harsh and ruthless mafia boss in Cidginia, she falls hard. And he falls harder.

mangas.title: Martina Will Tame the Heroes
mangas.description:
Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Onsaemiro: Never Changing
mangas.description:
Hae-Ri Jin is an aspiring actress who hasn't had the best of luck. But this time, she has a good feeling about the show she's about to audition for. Since it's a period piece, she decides to stop by a historical museum and comes across a beautiful incense burner from the Baekje era. Mesmerized, she prays for good luck, but little does she know that she has awoken a god named Onsaemiro who was trapped in the incense burner. How was she able to free him? Because she is the reincarnation of a princess of Baekje who was once Onsaemiro's lover...!



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Your Secret Keeper
mangas.description:
Sun is determined to make a good impression at her new job. The only problem is, her boss is an old classmate from high school - the notoriously stuck-up Do-Yeong - and he's making her life hell. But the tables turn when Sun discovers her boss' scandalous secret. After all, if word got out about Do-Yeong's night time naughtiness, it could ruin his career. Will Sun make him get on his knees and beg for mercy? Or will they come to a steamy agreement?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: The Timid Succubus and Her Handsome Meal
mangas.titleNative: 俺に注がせてください｡～奥手サキュバスとごちそう美青年
mangas.synonyms: The Timid Succubus and Her Handsome Meal
mangas.description:
"I'll teach you the pleasures of sex." He made me melt with his caresses... and I was satiated for the first time as a succubus.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Perfectly Fine on My Own, So My Fiancé Can Twist in the Wind
mangas.titleNative: おひとり様には慣れましたので。 婚約者放置中!
mangas.synonyms: Enjoy My Solitude! Leave My Fiancé Alone
mangas.description:
Noble young lady Nicole has had her heart broken more times than she can count. Her fiancé Keios is so devoted to Princess Caroline, his childhood friend and the unrivalled belle of their aristocratic academy, that he seems to forget Nicole even exists. But no longer. Tired of waiting around and conforming to Keios' needs, Nicole makes a most liberating decision: I'll give up on love and go it alone. Her arranged marriage may be unavoidable, but that doesn't mean she can't enjoy her own life, right? Emboldened and excited, Nicole begins to shine as she never had before—so brightly, in fact, that even the clueless Keios can't help but notice…



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ore no Koe ni Ochite Kudasai
mangas.titleNative: 俺の声に堕ちてください
mangas.synonyms: oh my god what a charmer of a voice
mangas.description:
Akari, a 30-year-old office worker, is troubled by her lack of male experience. One day, she discovers that Yanagida, a junior colleague who is famous for his quietness, actually has a good-looking voice. She is very excited when Yanagida-kun, whom she thought was quiet, starts to sweetly come on to her with a low voice...and she is very nervous!



This is an office love story where you will be sweetly loved from the ear by a younger man!

mangas.title: Kaylen's Vengeance and The Fox's Redemption
mangas.synonyms: My Benefactor Is Not a Scholar
mangas.description:
Kaylen came across a major setback in her life and headed back to the countryside to run away from all of this, one day she rescued a fox when she wandered around in the forest after she got drunk. But she didin't know that she will meet this "fox" again soon!


Kaylen's works were taken away by the powerful men, so she tried to take her revenge through her new novel. Just when her revenge was blocked, she met her strongest alliance, a little dumb and beautiful man with a strong and a smuggling body! Wait, why does he look so familiar?



(Source: Pocket Comics)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Beastly Things
mangas.description: In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he "accidentally" hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again "by chance," one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail. Ji-u wants Yuseung's rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they're after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

mangas.title: How Far Is Too Far?
mangas.synonyms: How Far Are You Okay With? | To What Extent Is It Okay For You?
mangas.description: After a painful breakup with her first love, Eunpyeong returns to campus still haunted by the past and burdened by a secret fantasy she's afraid to reveal. When Nyeok, a younger guy, discovers her secret by chance, he responds with unexpected acceptance. Their bond deepens, but complications arise when another girl enters the picture, and Eunpyeong learns Nyeok has been denying their relationship. What will become of their romance, trust, and life on campus?

mangas.title: In Between
mangas.description:
Eun-Seo Lee and Si-Hwa Kang have been friends all their lives. One day, Eun-Seo shatters their comfortable relationship by asking Si-Hwa out, and Si-Hwa moves away soon afterward. Eun-Seo tries her best to forget him until they meet in a college class six years later. He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eun-Seo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Si-Hwa loves her back?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Having an Idol-Loving Boyfriend is the Best!
mangas.titleNative: オタ友が彼氏になったら、最高、かもしれない
mangas.synonyms: 宅友变男友说不定也超赞
mangas.description:
Akari Tachibana, and her coworker, Onda-san, are more than just friends...they're both hardcore idol fans! But when Onda-san confesses to Akari out of the blue, she's floored. Of course it would be great to date someone with whom she shares so many interests, but can she navigate this new dimension to their relationship?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Margrave's Daughter & the Enemy Prince
mangas.titleNative: 売られた辺境伯令嬢は隣国の王太子に溺愛される
mangas.description:
Anna, daughter of the Margrave of Halmich, is tired of the expectations placed on women in court. She has no interest in marrying a nobleman because society expects it of her. Instead, she works hard on her swordsmanship and dreams of joining her father on the battlefield someday. Unfortunately, fate deals her a heavy blow: when the hostile forces of the Kingdom of Albion invade and take the Halmich heir prisoner, she is given to the enemy prince in exchange for her brother's life.



But even in the face of these tragic circumstances, Anna still has plans of her own: "I'll infiltrate their ranks as a tribute, and then... I'll defeat the man who killed my father."



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: The Dragon King's Imperial Wrath: Falling in Love with the Bookish Princess of the Rat Clan
mangas.titleNative: 竜王陛下の逆鱗サマ ～本好きネズミ姫ですが、なぜか竜王の最愛になりました～
mangas.synonyms: Die Geliebte des Drachenkönigs - Eine Leseratte an der Seite Seiner Majestät
mangas.description:
Princess Ruiying of the Rat Clan, the weakest of the thirteen animal clans, was summoned to the palace of the Dragon Clan, as the Dragon King sought a bride. But instead of competing with the other princesses, her goal was to check out the library of the dragon palace, the largest in the world. Seven days after arriving, Ruying was reading alone in the library when she was caught by a handsome man from the Dragon Clan. He suddenly kissed her and said, "I've finally found you," as Ruiying's life was about to change forever.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Kawaii no wa Ore de Aru
mangas.titleNative: かわいいのは俺である
mangas.description:
Yuki is the lead member of a popular dance group with a million online followers, but he has a problem. He can't seem to make any relationship last...! He gets labeled as a playboy, accused of cheating, and gets dumped… over and over, even though he's innocent. He only dated them because he truly liked them! One day, Yuki notices Yurino, a demure girl trying to leave a drinking party early, and follows her out of the bar. Little did he know, this marks the beginning of an unexpected relationship.



(Source: Comic Days, translated)

mangas.title: The Hate Trap
mangas.synonyms: Trapped With Male Leads Who Hate Me
mangas.description:
Yoo Sera, who once secretly indulged in the R-rated, grimdark captivity reverse-harem game "Who Trapped Our Lady?", suddenly finds herself thrown into the world of that very game. Not only is she forced into the body of the villainess Sera Ebott, but she's also trapped under the same roof as the male leads who despise her. The condition for escape? Uncover the identity of the one who imprisoned her. To survive and gain the information she needs, Sera must seduce those very men with her own body…!! Will Sera find a way out and return safely?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Perfect Contract
mangas.description:
Jun-Won, a perfect man, and Ju-I, a woman who knows her abilities and charms, strike an unusual deal: they will date with one strict condition—no falling in love. What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free.


(Source: WEBTOON)


Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Boo-tiful Nightmare
mangas.description: Kim Gitae looks like your typical college student—aside from his killer looks and strangely eerie vibe. But there's one thing that sets him apart: he can see ghosts. Spirits swarm him day and night, desperate to possess his body, and the only way he can fend them off... is by jerking off every night. Yeah, it's as exhausting as it sounds. All Gitae wants is a normal life—but things take a wild turn when a naked ghost named Lee Serin suddenly appears with an offer he can't ignore. If he agrees to sleep with her, she'll use her powers to protect him from other spirits. A ghostly hookup for a shot at peace—what could possibly go wrong? Gitae's not-so-average college life just got a whole lot weirder.

mangas.title: Locked Onto You
mangas.description:
Detective Gang-Hui encounters Ha-Jun, a world-famous designer who looks exactly like her late boyfriend, Yu-Jin. He even wears the matching ring Gang-Hui and Yu-Jin had shared. Ha-Jun seems to know what's bothering her but won't tell her the secret behind the uncanny resemblance. Instead, he keeps persuading her to date and later marry him. Now Gang-Hui has two options: follow her heart and fall in love with that man or follow her head to find out the truth about him. Oh, wait. Maybe, just maybe… she'll be able to choose both.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: In the Doghouse
mangas.synonyms: A Dog Lives in the Imperial Palace Garden
mangas.description: The Devon family sits on a mountain of debt and they are on the brink of bankruptcy. This is no fault of hers of course, but Courtney Devon has always been the one painted as the villain in her family. However, the family is in dire straits and they have to do something, anything, to raise some money and get out of this situation. But then one day, news arrives from the Imperial Palace that His Royal Highness the crown prince has decided to make Courtney the crown princess. Seemingly a typical prince on the outside, His Royal Highness is actually quite a troublemaker with a dark side. Will this arrangement end up solving Courtney Devon's problems or just complicating things further? Will a love against all odds bloom or will someone end up in the doghouse...?

mangas.title: Fake It to Break It! I Faked Amnesia to Break off My Engagement and Now He's All Lovey-Dovey?!
mangas.titleNative: 婚約破棄を狙って記憶喪失のフリをしたら、素っ気ない態度だった婚約者が「記憶を失う前の君は、俺にベタ惚れだった」という、とんでもない嘘をつき始めた
mangas.synonyms: When I Faked Amnesia to Break off My Engagement, My Fiancé Casually Told Me a Ridiculous Lie - "You Were in Love With Me Before You Lost Your Memory" | Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
mangas.description: Viola, the daughter of a viscount, is engaged to Philip Laurenson, the charming and popular heir to a duke. But the two are far from a match, and their silent tea parties do little to help them bond. In a desperate bid to escape the engagement, Viola feigns amnesia after a minor accident. However, Philip's reaction is not at all what she expected, as he starts telling her how much they used to love each other and how she used to call him..."Phil"? Which is far from the truth! And yet, from the brink of a crumbling engagement, a romance begins to blossom between the inexperienced lord and the oblivious lady.

mangas.title: Firefly Wedding
mangas.description: On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes "until death do we part" seriously.

mangas.title: Veil
mangas.description:
A chance encounter. A handsome soldier. A beautiful woman. A tentative love affair smolders on the snowy cobblestone streets, out of sight of those that might keep them apart.



Veil is a beautifully illustrated full-color romance manga, told in stylish short vignettes, beautiful illustrations, and secret moments.



(Source: Udon Entertainment, edited)

mangas.title: The Shut-in Lady Is an Understanding Sacred Beast Caretaker
mangas.titleNative: 引きこもり令嬢は話のわかる聖獣番
mangas.synonyms: Hikikomori Reijou wa Hanashi no Wakaru Seijuuban | The Shut-in Lady Is a Reasonable Sacred Beast Caretaker | The Shut-In Lady Meets the Holy Beast Keeper Who Actually Listens
mangas.description:
"We need money for your bedridden mother. So please, work at the Royal Palace!"

This is what the daughter of a Count, Muriel, was told by her father one day, which she firmly refused.

That's because she's a shut-in whose weakness is socializing, simply immersing herself in books. No way am I going to work at the Royal Palace!, is what she thought, but her father proposed she work as a librarian. Thinking that she might be able to work there if it's that, Muriel immediately went for an interview, but--

Why is she being interviewed by Commander Silas who exudes sensuality!? And why is it that when she came to, she was already employed as the "Sacred Beast Caretaker," someone who takes care of the sacred beasts!? A very popular work from Ichijinsha's Iris Collection!!! The long-awaited comicalization of the Sacred Beast love comedy between a shut-in lady and the commander of the Sacred Beast Order!!

mangas.title: Tensei-saki de Suterareta node, Mofumofutachi to Oryouri Shimasu: Okazari Ouhi wa My Pace ni Saikyou desu
mangas.titleNative: 転生先で捨てられたので、もふもふ達とお料理します～お飾り王妃はマイペースに最強です～
mangas.synonyms: I Will Cook with the Fluffy Ones who Were Abandoned Where I Was Reincarnated ~The Queen of Decorating is the Best at Keeping Things at Her Own Pace~
mangas.description: At the very moment the Prince cancels their engagement, the Duke's daughter, Letícia Gramwell, recalls her former life as a culinary lover. Much as she hates being run out of her own country, the abandoned Crown Princess resolves to go to the kingdom next door, spending her days in the royal palace with the king, surrounded by fluffiness! But one day, after meeting and feeding a beautiful silver wolf, the King's attitude gradually started to change...

mangas.title: Within The Villainess
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢の中の人〜断罪された転生者のため嘘つきヒロインに復讐いたします〜
mangas.description:
A girl who had reincarnated as Remilia, the villainess of an otome game tries to clear her name. However, the real Remilia who had been watching all along inside awakens.



Now it's time for the true villainess' revenge to begin!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Our Sweet First Blooms Before Love -I'm The Only One For Him-
mangas.titleNative: 恋の前に、あまくハジメテ。 控えめエリートくんが私にだけ発情しています
mangas.description:
Rui Sasaki, age 25, is single and has never been with anybody. People often tell her how young for her age she looks, but even she wants a chance at romance.

Luckily for her, a night out with a childhood friend leads her to meet the calm and very handsome Ritsu. Though most of the night ends in a blur, when Rui wakes up with Ritsu in her bed, she can only draw one conclusion... she's finally done the deed!

Ritsu, meanwhile, confesses that he has a problem... she's the only woman he's ever been able to sleep with!

Will their one-night fling blossom into romance? And can two people, each with their own complicated feelings about love, find a happy ending together?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Iseop's Romance
mangas.description:
With her outstanding business acumen, Min-Gyeong Kang climbed the corporate ranks of TK Group, Korea's top conglomerate, to become a senior manager in record time. But after 10 years at the company, she's been assigned to be the secretary of I-Seop Tae, the successor to TK Group. The two entered the company at the same time, but ever since he came second place to her at new employee training, I-Seop's never taken kindly to Min-Gyeong. She's better than him in every way and trampled all over his ego… so why can't he stop thinking about her?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Black Winter
mangas.description: One cold winter night, Haesa seeks shelter in an old house in the mountains, where she meets a slumbering stranger named Yuan. That's when tragedy begins to befall Haesa's friends, plunging the young girl into a sad and lonely youth. Ten years later, as Yuan starts to regain his lost memories, he realizes that this cursed fate goes back much further, to a time only he can recall. But with sinister forces at play, will they be able to break the toxic cycle and step into the warmth of spring?

mangas.title: Virgin Marriage: A Maiden Voyage into Passion's Embrace
mangas.titleNative: ショジョ婚 ～小日向夫婦はシてみたい～
mangas.description:
Kurumi and Keiichirou have been married for a full year, but have yet to actually consummate the relationship! Though matched through an arranged marriage, the two share common interests and enter into a lovely relationship.
