But both are completely inexperienced when it comes to having more intimate relations, and can't even bring the subject up without becoming completely flustered. Can they muster up the courage to share their desires, or will it all become a pent-up mess?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Undercover at Chaebol High
mangas.description:
Dakyung Lee, an elite member of a criminal organization, learns of the death of her beloved boss. Upon discovering that Chairman Lee was behind it, she vows to take revenge. Yet, since he's protected by the Sa Yeong Group, all her attempts appear futile. Just as Dakyung is about to give up, she uncovers details about the chairman's son. In a final bid for revenge, she infiltrates his son's school, Chaebol High School.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: That Beauty Is a Tramp
mangas.titleNative: その美人（オトコ）ふしだらにつき
mangas.description:
Cool and tomboyish Nagi wants a boyfriend, but has one big problem—ever since an incident in college, her body reflexively rejects the touch of any man. That is, until she encounters the beautiful male model Aran, who uses his androgynous look to effortlessly model both masculine and feminine styles. She's shocked to discover that she can touch him without having a reaction, and when he asks her to join him in an upcoming photo shoot with a famous photographer, she agrees, on one condition—be her practice boyfriend for one month, and help her conquer her aversion once and for all. By the author of Such a Treacherous Piano Sonata!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me
mangas.description: Pereshati Jahardt is a count's daughter who got remarried after her mother's passing. When her father died, he left her all his fortune. Then, Pereshati's greedy stepmother and stepsister conspire with Pereshati's lover to kill her. However, under mysterious circumstances, Pereshati is brought back to life and travels back in time before her murder. To buy some time before getting her revenge, Pereshati visits the handsome yet notorious grand duke, Therdeo Lapileon, to marry him. During her visit, she uncovers a horrifying secret of his family. How will Pereshati deal with it? Will she be able to take her revenge?

mangas.title: When The Day Comes
mangas.description:
No-Rang and Pa-Ran are known at school to be the perfect couple — minus the fact that they've already broken up. But unable to back out of a promise to participate in their school's dance festival as their class's representative couple, they decide to keep their split a secret, just until the competition is over. As the day of the festival — and their "official" break-up —approaches, the two begin to realize that ending their relationship may not be as simple as they thought.



(Source: WEBTOONS)



Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Fake Lady and Her Rabbit Duke
mangas.description:
Grand Duke Hadelrune de Strelitz is the hero of the empire and Lady Zernoa de Rhanterra is the "golden flower" of high society. What commonalities could they share besides their glowing reputations? Apparently, secrets. One day, Zernoa comes across an unassuming pile of clothes under which she is startled to find an adorable rabbit who also happens to be… Grand Duke Hadelrune. An ancient family curse and a fictitious upbringing… What else could these two be hiding?!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Raised a Black Dragon
mangas.description:
Did you just imprint with me?!

After dying from overwork, Noa ends up possessing the body of Eleanora, the villainess from a novel. Noa simply wants to lead a peaceful life and tries not to interfere with the original story. That is, until a baby dragon that's meant to imprint with the heroine imprints with her instead...



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: My Cocky Neighbor
mangas.description:
Ji Soon-yi's always been the type to keep to herself. All her hobbies are things she can enjoy alone, and she's the happiest when she's at home by herself. Except…her neighbor certainly isn't the same. Nam Changlim may be a stud, but he has a different girl over every night and each time, Soon-yi can hear everything that's going on between him and his female companion. Annoyed, she curses Changlim and wishes that he be turned into a cock if that's all he can think about. Alas, she'd forgotten that she'd purchased a magic candle holder earlier on that day… And the very next morning, she wakes up to find a very disgruntled, very animate dildo at her door. Uh-oh. Soon-yi did think her neighbor was too cocky, but she didn't mean for the curse to be so literal…


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Summer Solstice Point
mangas.synonyms: 濡れた夏～年下男子と背徳に溺れる～
mangas.description:
"I've never kissed anyone before… so help me out. Please?" Seo-Ha's divorce is still fresh in her mind when 20-year-old Ji-Hoo begins working at her café. Ji-Hoo's unassuming beauty immediately draws her in, and his desire for Seo-Ha burns too bright for her not to notice. Seo-Ha decides it wouldn't hurt to shake him up a bit… but Ji-Hoo's not the only one stepping into unfamiliar territory this summer.



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes nine extra chaptes.

mangas.title: Lucia
mangas.synonyms: ลูเซีย เจ้าหญิงผู้ถูกลืม
mangas.description:
Lucia, the sixteenth princess of the kingdom, has seen her future through a strange dream. But it was a vivid nightmare of a terrible marriage that continues to haunt her. To change her dreadful fate, she suggests a contract marriage to Duke Hugo Taran, a well-known womanizer. Can this setup break Lucia from her fate? Or will her choice lead down a path even she couldn't foresee?! Based on the hit novel.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Between Close Friends
mangas.description:
“You look delicious, Dana.”

The moment she heard Hangyeol say those words, a sudden rush of sensation washed through her.
This was it. Dana, who had given her heart away after a single careless remark from such an innocent boy, nodded gently.

“You can… taste it.”

Hangyeol’s lips cautiously moved downward. His kiss was a little impatient—but tender. Hangyeol never forgot what he was taught. If he was told to touch there, then surely using his tongue there too must be the right thing to do. As expected— Hangyeol was smart.

mangas.title: Childhood Friends and Bad Deeds
mangas.description:
“No, no. As a birthday present… let me see it.”
“Do you think it’ll wear out just from looking at it?”

Woo Shin-jae looked at Na-young, who was muttering with her lips puckered in disbelief. The corner of his mouth twitched in exasperation.

But when her voice burst out immediately, his face crumpled in a flash.

“Or is it because it’s so tiny? Right. There’s no way it’d be a baseball bat. A tumbler? Come on.”
“Uh… uh…”

Why is this so big?

mangas.title: My Next-Door Oppa's Rearing Diary
mangas.synonyms: The Brother Next Door's Breeding Diary
mangas.description:
It’s already been 10 years since I started having a crush on the handsome guy next door.
I’m sick of this unrequited love! It’s time to put an end to it!
Eun-ha, who was planning to confess her feelings with the help of alcohol, accidentally witnesses a shocking secret about her next-door neighbor…

“Just explain to me what the heck is going on here.”
“Did you hallucinate or something?”
“What are you talking about? I just saw him with my own two eyes—he was masturbating while wearing a dog collar.”

Unable to hide his bright red ears, Seo-kyung finally confesses every detail of his twisted sexual fetish.

“I’m sorry, Eunha.”

The truth was that he was a pervert who’d been stroking his hard cock while fantasizing about becoming Eunha’s dog.
If it meant winning her love, wouldn’t it be okay to be a little perverted?
Eunha willingly volunteers to become his “master.”

“A naughty dog needs to be punished.”

But surprisingly, this unexpected role as “master” seems to suit her just fine…

mangas.title: Do or Die: You Got a Tentacle Too?!
mangas.synonyms: Are You a Tentacle There Too? | Is That a Tentacle Down There Too?
mangas.description: Childhood friends Nam-Ju and Yeo-Ju find themselves stuck in a dungeon, where the only way to escape is to lose their virginity to each other. They're hesitant at first, until they end up spawning a tentacle monster to help get things started. And get started they do when Nam-Ju sees something squirming in Yeo-Ju's pants that simply leaves her saying, "You got a tentacle too?!"

mangas.title: Even a Hopeless Romantic Wants to Be Loved!
mangas.description: Tae Young-woon, a hopeless romantic who always ends up getting dumped. Then, a woman with unbelievable beauty appears before her! Things going strangely well only makes it even more suspicious?! Will she really be able to get a girlfriend this time…?

mangas.title: Chu's Secret
mangas.description:
“Right there in the same place, as if to show me, she was kissing another girl! And on top of that… while looking me straight in the eye!”

A fresh, secret story created by Chu Gaeul and Han Yeoreum!

mangas.title: Obscene Neighbors
mangas.description:
Yoo-Joo has a specific taste when it comes to men: they must have broad, beautiful chests. She's never met her ideal chest before, until she finds it on Dojin, her next door neighbor since childhood. After a drunken night where Yoo-Joo gets to have a taste of Dojin's deliciously perfect pecs, she earns his forgiveness by being his errand girl and promising to let him do the same to her if she ever lays hands on his chest again. But there's no way it will happen again, obviously. Or so she thought…

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Doyou no Yuugata, Ano Eki de
mangas.description: There's a man on my train I desire... I can't stop having lewd thoughts about him..." On the weekdays, almost no one uses the train station. However, Miharu continues to use it. Because, every Saturday evening, she sees him riding the same train. Although we've never spoken, my fantasies are only getting worse... I don't think I can control myself anymore...

mangas.title: Toegeungire Baemeul Juwotseumnida
mangas.description:
The main character, No Seona, impulsively picks up a snake on her way home from work. However, it turns out that the snake is actually a member of the Suin Clan.

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: The Liminal Zone
mangas.synonyms: ดินแดนลวงหลอน
mangas.description:
What destiny awaits them after the screaming?



After abruptly departing from a train in a small town, a couple encounters a "weeping woman"—a professional mourner—sobbing inconsolably at a funeral. Mako changes afterward—she can't stop crying! In another tale, having decided to die together, a couple enters Aokigahara, the infamous suicide forest. What is the shocking torrent they discover there?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Kyoufu no Juusou
mangas.description:
A one-shot about a strange curse visited on a family after an archaeological dig.



One-shot in celebration of 30 years of Itou Junji's career.

mangas.title: We Can't Continue To Play Best Friends
mangas.titleNative: このままじゃ私たち、親友らしくいられない
mangas.description:
"I can come stay with you."



I was supposed to share an apartment with my friend. But when the arrangement fell through, I was at a loss.



"We're friends, so aren't we supposed to help each other?"

"It'll be only for a limited time."



Kitazawa is a handsome guy, and even though he's a bit of a jerk, we hit it off right away from the moment we met. It was special and comforting to have a "best friend" like him even after I graduated. So we move in together, but we each have our own rooms, so it's not like we're really living together.
As long as we're just friends and we keep our distance, it'll be fine…



…but it's not fine.



I have always loved Kitazawa.
I thought I had it under control until now.
I should have been able to control these feelings, and not say those things I shouldn't have said.
But if we do this, we can't live together like this anymore.



"…why don't you just be with me?"



The moment I told him that we can't "live together" anymore, Kitazawa suddenly kissed me…



(Source: DLSite, translated)

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: A Very Naughty Girl
mangas.description:
Despite being a pretty and talented film student, Yeo-Woo is brutally rejected after flirting with her cocky underclassman, Jin-Yeong. As if that wasn't humiliating enough, Jin-Yeong accidentally sees Yeo-Woo's racy video of herself wearing a dog collar when they're exchanging files for a film project! What Yeo-Woo doesn't expect is for this to turn on Jin-Yeong's dominant side and spur a series of secret BDSM hookups between them. And Yeo-Woo soon finds out that there's more to their relationship than their heated master-dog dynamic...

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: Giving You My All
mangas.description:
Hershe is a brave hero who saves Princess Mel when she's kidnapped and taken to the demon world. Once the king assigns Hershe to Mel as her bodyguard, they fall in love. But because their kingdom is weak, Mel is fated to be married off to a powerful emperor and treated like a hostage. So Hershe sets out on the king's orders to bring back the demon king's sword and bolster the kingdom's military power. Although Hershe is determined to save Mel, can she thwart the demon king's mind games that try to use her desires against her?.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: 2023 These Days Love Special
mangas.description:
'Something is SNS, dating lightly, ex-lovers like friends' These days, dating is like this? Haha Really? lol. A spring day full of excitement.. I will be satisfied with the webtoon again this time. ^^

Stories Featured:

1) Chajatda! Kiss Zone (찾았다! 키스존 - Found! Kiss Zone) by Lee Dong-Geon
