20) Biroso Pieonan (비로소 피어난 - Blooming at Last) by Youngmo

21) Analogy Naming (아날로지 네이밍 - Analogy Naming) by Sam

22) F-wa T-sai (F와T사이 - Between F and T) by Olive-yu

mangas.title: Hajimari no Oto.
mangas.description: A beautifully-illustrated story of a deaf girl and the words and feelings she want to express.

mangas.title: Itoshii Namida
mangas.description: This is the story of an otaku girl who is interested in a 3D boy for the first time. The trigger is a crying face!

mangas.title: Living Will
mangas.description: Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74, took care of the fallen Janet. Jeanne wants to be friends with Janet, but Janet tries to get information out of her.

mangas.title: Katasumi no Heartbeat
mangas.description:
All my life I've always played a supporting role, and I thought that's where I'll always be…



(Source: Margaret, translated)

mangas.title: Women at Work: Love Extraction
mangas.description:
Chan-Hee is a fierce gangster who is unexpectedly hit with wisdom tooth pain after beating up a rival gang. When she goes to a dental clinic to get it removed, she falls head-over-heels for Ha-Jin, the beautiful dentist who happens to be on the night shift. Although Ha-Jin rejects Chan-Hee when she asks her on a date, it doesn't stop Chan-Hee from bringing her fancy lunches and gifts to woo her. One thing leads to another and they hook up at the clinic, but can their new relationship last when they're from two completely different worlds?

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Lily of the Valley
mangas.description:
Lily's family chose to sacrifice her freedom, but the infamous Duke Blake has set a trap to ensnare her heart instead. Lily is sent to the duke's estate like an innocent lamb for slaughter...although Lily's love already belongs to a handmaid named Anna. At the estate, an uneasiness gnaws at her mind...is there anyone in the world who truly loves her back?

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Struck by an Obscene Curse
mangas.synonyms: I Was Caught By An Obscene Curse
mangas.description:
The inseparable three princesses of the Ernst Kingdom each had their own vice. Cecile was obsessed with her slender figure, and Charlotte was plagued by insomnia. But Abelle's vice was comparatively tame: having the occasional lewd fantasy. That was until they were all cursed by a witch who sought vengeance on their father. Now, Cecile can't stop eating, Charlotte can't stop sleeping, and as for Abelle... Well, she can't stop craving sex! As the only one capable of breaking the curse, the wanton princess must find a way to quench her desire or risk ruining her reputation!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: 500CC
mangas.description:
Sang-Eun is greeted by a pretty sunbae, Jian, who she meets in her first university class! When Jian leaves momentarily during their freshmen welcome meeting, Sang-Eun follows...

But while comforting the upset Jian, she ended up confessing?!!

mangas.title: Henyoku no Drops
mangas.description:
The year is 3015. Humanity has evolved to "fly". Except for her, Tsubasa Shinkai, the only girl around who cannot fly, what people call a "Drop," Because of this, her life has been a complete disaster. Tsubasa wants to reset her past, but on her first day at her new school, her "inability to fly" is revealed to Ren Takatsuki, another transfer student! Their encounter will change the fate of the human race...!



(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: The Rabbit Hole
mangas.description:
Whatever her employer asks, Hee-Yeon, the maid, does it perfectly without any mistake. A beautiful yet twisted maid enters a complicated household. How far down the rabbit hole will Hee-Yeon go?



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Living-Room Matsunaga-san
mangas.description:
After her parents leave to care for her ailing grandmother, high schooler Miko "Meeko" Sonoda moves into her uncle's boarding house. There, she meets its rather unusual residents, including the oldest of the bunch: the grumpy mother hen, Matsunaga-san. With the help of her housemates, Meeko begins to adjust to her new life away from her parents, but she soon learns that no matter how far away from home she is, she's still a young girl at heart—especially when she finds herself falling for Matsunaga-san…


(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Evening and The Sea
mangas.description:
"I never really wanted good friends. I always thought I'd rather have things I'd be okay with leaving behind."



Tsukiko is the new girl in school. One day, she catches a glimpse of her classmate, Utsumi, swimming in the school's pool. She becomes fixated. Tsukiko knew they were classmates, but beyond that, the two girls had no reason to cross paths. However, one rainy day turns all of that around. An emotional story about the everyday lives of the enigmatic new girl and the girl with no filter who happens to love swimming!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Watashi no Angela
mangas.description: On her way home, a young woman discovers a human-looking angel, whom she decides to welcome into her home.

mangas.title: Vitamin C Vitamin D
mangas.description:
A strange current between the mysterious transfer student 'Do Won-kyung' and the girl 'Choi Kang' who is mistaken for a man?


(Source: Toomics)

mangas.title: Prayers of the Vulgar
mangas.description:
The servant of God, Saharo, breaks the biggest rule for an angel when she momentarily sympathizes with Evil. After letting Evil escape from heaven's grasp, Saharo loses her angelic wings and won't be able to reascend until she destroys the dark enemy once and for all. There's just one problem: her target is reincarnated as a human boy named Yannick Unbrey. While angels have the power to eliminate Evil, they are forbidden from ever killing a human being. Thus, Saharo's only choice is to watch over the boy and make sure the darkness within him never awakens. But the older Yannick gets, the more he becomes tainted by the wicked nature of the world. Will Saharo be able to protect Yannick from his slumbering demon, or will she end up giving in to its sinful call with him?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Raishuu, Ame ga Futtara
mangas.description: A story where two women meet on a rainy day.

mangas.title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
mangas.description:
University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There's the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she's so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi's movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day?

Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito!

Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole

Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door

Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass

Chapter 4: Grave Placement

Chapter 5: Seashore

Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us

Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle

Chapter 8: Sign in the Field

Chapter 9: Monster Prop

mangas.title: Kokoro no Mama de
mangas.description:
Kokoro Katayama, a high school student, spends days unfamiliar with the class. She wears makeup every day to give her confidence, but her face seems to be scared by her classmates.

One day, when she picks up her younger brother Shinta, she meets her classmate Kuroki. They talked for the first time, but the distance gradually shortened and their feelings changed little by little.

mangas.title: The Story of Our Unlikely Love
mangas.synonyms: A story of an unlikely love
mangas.description:
Good-natured Chihiro Hiyoshi takes being the class rep seriously, but her partner, Haruka Kisaragi does not. He's got too many rumors swirling around him, but when a chance meeting brings them into each other's lives for just a moment, they form an unsteady bond. But bad boy Haruka may be too much for a good girl like Chihiro to handle...but something in her may have just awoken a hidden softness in him, too.



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: The chapter count includes an extra story.

mangas.title: She and Her Cat
mangas.description:
This is the story of Miyu, a woman who lives alone with her cat, Chobi. As Miyu navigates the world of adulthood, she discovers both the freedom and loneliness that come with living independently, and Chobi learns of the outside world through her actions. Time drifts slowly for Miyu and her cat, but the harsh realities of the world soon catch up …



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Run Away With Me, Girl
mangas.description:
Maki's first love was her high school classmate, a girl named Midori. But Midori broke up with Maki at graduation, saying they were now "too old to be fooling around dating girls." Ten years later, Maki still can't get Midori off her mind, and when the two women reconnect after a chance encounter, Maki realizes that, while her feelings haven't changed, Midori has long moved on—in fact, she's engaged. Yet the more Maki hears Midori talk about her soon-to-be-husband, the more red flags she notices. And Midori has another secret, one she hasn't yet shared with Maki. Will it be the last blow to Maki's hopes that their romance might be rekindled? Or will it be the push that sets them on a new path—one they'll travel together?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!
mangas.synonyms: This Is An Obvious Fraudulent Marriage
mangas.description:
After the Delpice Empire unifies all kingdoms with brutal subjugation, all the noblemen who stood up to the empire had to relinquish their titles. As her father's only child, Leyrin Efran becomes a countess overnight, but to secure her family's title and estate, legally she must be wed! She enlists info from the infamous Nine Night Guild to find a man of lower rank to keep the empire at bay. They deliver as requested (eep! he's SO hot!), but things don't completely seem as advertised...



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Fell in Love After School
mangas.synonyms: I've Been in Love After School | Houkago, Koishita
mangas.description: Kao has no interests, no hobbies, and no friends… so when she's pushed by her brother to become the manager for the boys' volleyball team, she reluctantly accepts. But her future as manager is contingent on roping in the equally reluctant Kuze-kun, who, despite his passion and talent, seems intent on leaving volleyball behind...

mangas.title: My Gently Raised Beast
mangas.description:
Blondina is living a real-life Cinderella story. After growing up poor and enduring a difficult childhood, she discovers that she is a princess of the Ates empire. However, her estranged father and half-siblings give her the cold shoulder when she moves into the palace, and Blondina must keep a low profile. That all changes when she befriends Amon, a cat-like creature with mysterious intentions. For years, creatures like Amon and humans have struggled to live in harmony. Can Blondina and Amon's friendship bring peace, or will it deepen the rift between their people?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Beware the Villainess!
mangas.description: Sit back and take in this romantic tale of an angelic heroine and her devoted suitors as they vie for the depths of her love... or not. This story's about to go through some edits! After an accident, a modern-day college student awakens as the story's villainess, Melissa Foddebrat. She's far from anyone's favorite, but she IS the daughter of the duke. Determined to live it up, this new Melissa is doing things her way — antiquated society, be damned! All idiots, prepare to step aside or perish!

mangas.title: Who Made Me a Princess
mangas.synonyms: Suddenly Became A Princess One Day
mangas.description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she's stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn't kill her again!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Dallae
mangas.description:
Bo-Eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-Eun can't seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Sae-Yeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-Eun started having recurring dreams of Sae-Yeon...

This story has two (or is it three?) main characters, and they're all hiding a secret from each other.

mangas.title: Chocolate to Kase-san.
mangas.titleNative: チョコレートと加瀬さん。
mangas.description: It's Valentine's Day and Yamada has baked chocolates for Kase-san, but so have the rest of the girls in school!

mangas.title: Black Paradox
mangas.description: It follows four people who meet for a group suicide, but their attempt to die instead makes them aware of a bizarre phenomenon that could change the world.

mangas.title: Tightrope
mangas.description:
Cho-eul and Ju-ah have been BFFs since childhood. In high school, they shared a kiss, but it was only because Cho-eul said she was bored. They've continued to be inseparable, but only as friends. Deep inside, Ju-ah wants things to be different and even Cho-eul senses - and toys with - this unspoken tension. So how close is too close? What would happen if besties crossed the fine line between friends... and desire?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Two Steps Away
mangas.description:
Hosu is an average, carefree high school student who isn't particularly special in any kind of way. Danwoo is the attractive, untouchable top student of the class. There shouldn't really be any reason for them to interact at all. But one day, Danwoo announces that he wants Hosu to sit next to him in class. In fact, he wants to be within her presence as much as possible, and he's willing to do whatever it takes to stay by her side. Not too close, but not too far. Just two steps away is enough. However, will they be able to maintain that distance? Come take a closer look, from just a couple steps away…


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Father, I Don't Want this Marriage
mangas.titleNative: 아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!
mangas.synonyms: Dad, I'm Not Getting Married | Daddy, I Don't Want to Marry!
mangas.description: Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she's about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father's love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he'll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father's student.

mangas.title: Positively Yours
mangas.description:
To Hui-Won's dismay, the BFF she crushed on and her other BFF are now dating! Seriously bummed, Hui-Won decides to go wild just one time, and find solace with a handsome stranger. A very satisfying one night affair has now turned into more — she's pregnant! Fate brings them together again, and now the regimented Du-Jun is determined to do the right thing and marry her. But they're basically strangers! Except... their bodies have been very intimately acquainted. What's this mother-to-be to do?

(Source: Tapas, edited)


Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Little Rabbit and the Big Bad Leopard
mangas.synonyms: A Symbiotic Relationship Between a Rabbit and a Black Panther
mangas.description:
Vivi is a... wererabbit?! As a creature that's supposed to transform into a human, Vivi is a failure, demonized as cursed and sent off to her doom. Luckily, her demise is cut short as Ahin of the Black Leopard Clan saves her. But with every threat and command this temperamental heir tosses at Vivi, she's questioning her safety (and sanity). Surrounded by carnivores and their strong pheromones, she'll try to survive the chaos while stuck in her rabbit form. Will she figure out how to transform and tap into the power within her cute, furry self?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 56 extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Secretly Hot Husband
mangas.description:
Another lifetime, another hard life—Letitia's misery continues as her uncle sends her off to the "Monster Lord" to fulfill an old pledge. Imp attacks! The three witches! A hideous masked devil hunter husband! Terrifying is an understatement. But as she becomes the lady of Halstead, the rumors fall apart. Lord Erden is caring, he likes bunnies, and that *gasp* perfect face under the mask! How can he not know he's HOT? Can she help protect the castle from devils and help Erden see his true self?


(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Pheromone Fetish
mangas.description:
Seong-Ha seeks a big man to fulfill his desires. At a freshman retreat, he meets Mu-Beom — a big guy with glasses that make his eyes tiny. Impervious to seduction and a total square, Mu-Beom puzzles Seong-Ha. Seong-Ha hates alphas, and Mu-Beom has a thing for pheromones. How will this odd pair turn out?



(Source: Manta)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Dragon's Love
mangas.description: On a stormy night, hardened mobster Cha San is limping home when he stumbles upon Shin Ro, a dragon bleeding out on the pavement. It's love at first sight, pulling two entirely different worlds together in an instant. Fast forward to the present, and the unlikely couple is officially navigating newlyweds bliss. To support his beloved, Shin Ro hilariously adapts to human life by taking a job as a car salesman, while Cha San completely leaves his criminal syndicate behind to become a dedicated, apron-wearing stay-at-home husband. Relying entirely on each other, they dive headfirst into a chaotic, sweet, and incredibly steamy new chapter together.

mangas.title: House Call
mangas.description:
Seo-Hyun, who is masturbating as usual in his trash-filled apartment, is caught in the act by Min-Jun, a cleaning service employee who has come into the house at his sister's request...

I really want to do it with a real person..."

"Then do you want to do it with me?"

Seo-Hyun finds himself unable to resist MinJun, who is far more skilled at handling his body than he is with cleaning tools.

mangas.title: RACK
mangas.description:
Lee Ja-Hyeon, a new secretary at a law firm, is intrigued by the contradictory nature of lawyer Jung Min-Seok, who, despite his outward appearance, harbors violent tendencies and secretive hobbies, and decides to get closer to him...

"I can handle pain pretty well."

"It's not really my place to say this, but... you have some strange tastes too, Ja-Hyeon."

mangas.title: Mute Off
mangas.description:
Aiden is a die-hard fan of the unknown band Chasm. Just before a show, he witnesses the band's leader walk out right before his eyes, leaving the group on the brink of breaking up.


"Shit! How are we supposed to play without a bassist?"


"I, I'll play bass!"



He was thrust into the role of Chasm's bassist on the spot, but Aiden's playing skills were nothing short of disastrous... Seth, already on edge from a breakup and financial struggles, acts recklessly toward Aiden, and the fate of the two of them and the band hangs in the balance.


"Hey, if you can't play that song all the way through by next week, I'll bite off your lips and fingers. Got it?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: Sweet Sugar Candyman
mangas.description:
Kwon Sa-Heon, the older guy next door who's practically lived under the same roof as me since we were kids. With his good looks and sweet personality, he's the perfect guy who's never been without a girlfriend. Cheong-Myeong, who once confessed to him only to be rejected. He'd been avoiding him ever since, but when he starts college, he ends up living with her next-door neighbor, half by choice, half by circumstance... But this time, the vibe feels a little off.

"Good job. Now spread your legs."

"You're still a kid, so I have to be gentle with you, right?"

Is he acting this way because he likes me too... or has he just become more affectionate? He keeps pulling me into the world of adults. All these sudden and confusing emotions are buried deep within the heat he radiates.

mangas.title: New World Order
mangas.description:
Errand service owner Wu Hyeon-Do never expected his first love to walk back into his life, especially not like this. Seong Su arrives clutching a flyer for a suspicious cult, claiming his dead son might still be alive. Reeling from the sudden mention of a child he never knew about, Hyeon-Do assumes Seong Su must have moved on and built a family after he left the island. But the truth is far more shocking than he could have realized...

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Vanilla Sundae
mangas.description:
Harvey scrapes by working part-time at a fast-food joint. His only escape from this grueling life? Watching band performances!
Then one day, through some incident, he gets tangled up with Logan, the vocalist of his idol band Vanilla Sunday...

mangas.title: Of Curse And Tide
mangas.description:
After a brutal war between humans and merfolk, a dark curse settled deep within the royal bloodline. Plagued by agonizing phantoms, Crown Prince Wook flees to a remote coastal temple, only to be lured over the cliff's edge by the relentless voices. Against all odds, he survives the fall - only to wake up facing an impossible reality, and a mysterious savior who promises to break the royal curse.
Can this stranger truly save him, or is Wook simply diving into a deeper deception?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Only Virgins Left Alive
mangas.synonyms: Die If You Aren't A Virgin
mangas.description:
Choi Gyutae is a French high schooler who comes to Korea as a transfer student. On his first day of class, he meets Lin Seok: a handsome student who just so happens to be in the same class. Lin Seok's friendly disposition and irresistible charm leads Gyutae to fall head over heads the moment he lays eyes on him. However, on their way back home Seok says something that makes Gyutae lose all hope of the two of them ever dating: "Guys who don't keep their virginity...should really just go die." Taken aback by this unrealistic condition for love, Gyutae decides to settle for the two of them remaining platonic for the rest of their lives. Six years later, they've become good roommates and even better friends. But when Gyutae witnesses something that shocks him to his core, their relationship might be in danger. Will a misunderstanding cause their friendship to be dead in the water? Or will their relationship be able to survive the competition?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes ten extras

mangas.title: Brother Friend Complex
mangas.titleNative: ブラザーフレンドコンプレックス
mangas.description:
Naoto made his high school debut after his popular older brother and his friend, Aoshi, gave him a makeover.
When Aoshi came over to hang out at his house as usual and started flirting with him, Naoto was just thinking, “It’s not so bad to get attention from Aoshi-san, whom I’ve always admired…” when suddenly, Aoshi kissed him, saying, “Your brother asked me to help you lose your virginity”—!?
Even though he’s a guy, and even though he’s my older brother’s friend, for some reason it’s incredibly erotic and my heart won’t stop racing—!!!!

mangas.title: Boku no Niina
mangas.description:
Shinme, a bookstore clerk, mistook Tomi—a customer who had come to buy a shōjo manga magazine—for a suspicious person and threw him so hard that he passed out.
Tomi, who is exceptionally good-looking, apparently ended up looking like a suspicious person because he was so desperate to hide his love for girls’ anime.
What’s more, it seems Tomi’s favorite character is “Nina,” and he even started saying that Shinme looks like that character…?

mangas.title: Heatwave
mangas.description: Manny, a member the Seven Sins gang and a secret informant for the police, loses his partner to a brutal serial killer. Before he can even process the shock, his boss assigns him a new partner - Sean, the one colleague he can't stand. To make matters worse, his contact at the police asks him to dig into Sean's past, suspecting he's hiding something. With no choice but to get close, Manny turns to the method he knows best: seduction.

mangas.title: Unholy Communion
mangas.description: The priest Benz, who was about to turn his back on the world due to intense guilt and despair, is stopped in his tracks by a blinding white light at the moment he pulls the trigger of a rifle. He believes it to be a god, hanging from the attic ceiling. Surrendering his body and mind to this 'god' with serpent-like tongues and glowing tentacles, Benz becomes increasingly dependent and fully dominated by it.

mangas.title: In the Shadow of the Serpent
mangas.description:
In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Having witnessed countless evil entities since childhood, he believes that ignoring the supernatural is the only way to survive. That fragile resolve shatters when he becomes entangled in a mission led by the Disaster Squad and loses his life in the process.
Or so he believes.Jeong Wol awakens to find himself alive once more, bound by a mysterious pact with Sa Hyeon, a black serpent whose presence radiates both danger and allure. Granted immortality in exchange for an unknown price, he is forced to confront the very world he tried so desperately to deny.



Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent's shadow?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street
mangas.description: A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 Sunset Street. The prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seem to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin?

mangas.title: Hug Me When the Full Moon Rises
mangas.synonyms: Hold Me When the Full Moon Rises
mangas.description:
Blair, known for being promiscuous, is cursed to suffer from a fever if he does not have sex on the day of the full moon. The curse started when he was young and was captured by wolves in the forest and returned, and Blair believes it was the young wolf he met at that time who did it. While searching for someone to relieve his fever as usual, but coming up empty-handed, Blair is hugged from behind by a strange man. With his shirt off, his long hair, and his obvious suspiciousness, this man claims to be Blair's companion...?

"I found you, my companion."

mangas.title: Please Watch Your Mouth!
mangas.description:
I met the love of my life at a secondhand trade I went to on behalf of a friend? Despite being the top student in the hotel culinary department, I pretended to be pitiful, saying I couldn't cook, just to get Yoo-Seong a meal. A tidal wave of things to hide began to pile up. You want me to be honest? I'd rather die than let my brother hate me even a little! How on earth am I going to repay this karma...

I should watch my mouth a little~~

mangas.title: Lunar Rabbit Prince
mangas.description:
According to prophecy, only wisdom—or "Ji-Hye"—can heal the division tearing the Moon Kingdom apart. Doo-Shik, the youngest prince of the rabbits, leaves the moon to find Ji-Hye and save his kingdom. Immediately upon arriving on Earth, he encounters Ji-Hye Seo, a young man on a quest of his own. Ji-Hye's quest... is to find big D. Can the duo overcome lies, disapproving family, and constantly getting distracted by the bedroom to rescue the moon?!

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Magician-gwa Course Live
mangas.description:
Dan-Ho, who needed money due to his ex-boyfriend's threats, inadvertently participates in a cosplay competition that he told her about.
The host of the competition, streamer Magikun, senses Dan-Ho's talent for broadcasting the moment he sees him and offers him as a guest on his channel. Dan-Ho is tempted by the 5 million won per appearance fee, but...? When he visits Magikun's house for rehearsal, all he finds are adult products, restraints, and cosplay costumes!


"Was this by any chance an adult broadcast?!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Tipping Point
mangas.synonyms: ティッピング・ポイント〜僕と先輩の転換点〜
mangas.description:
San-ho has been crushing on Eui-Hyun since their high school days, so ending up at the same college as him feels like fate. The problem is, Eui-Hyun doesn't remember him at all. Still, San-Ho's not about to give up that easily. But how long can his one-sided puppy love last if Eui-Hyun keeps looking the other way?

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes four side story chapters.

mangas.title: Take Me High
mangas.description: Arts major Il Yoo is trying to force his way into music major Lee-Won On's proximity, but little does he know that he was inadvertently the cause of Lee-Won's heartbreak three years prior. One thing leads to another and the two begin to draw inspiration from each other for their respective graduation projects.

mangas.title: My Dandelion Observation Log
mangas.synonyms: タンポポ観察日記～愛するオメガくん～
mangas.description:
Eun-Seom is the transfer student everyone is talking about. With his striking blonde hair and the dangerous rumors that follow him, he's impossible to miss. But Iseo, with a gentle nature, doesn't judge people by their looks or rumors, and finds Eun-Seom rather interesting. When they are assigned seats next to each other, Iseo tries to be friendly, but Eun-Seom remains on high alert. However, between shared desks and stolen glances, a quiet bond begins to form.

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Virgin Hunter
mangas.description:
Tae-Beom, the campus custodian, is a self-proclaimed expert at spotting - and "handling" - the sexually inexperienced. With a 100% success rate and dashing good looks, he sets his sights on Chae-Yi, a hunky physical education student who seems like the perfect target. But when his usual charms lead to a hilariously dramatic breakdown instead of a smooth conquest, Tae-Beom realizes he's met his match. Now, the hunter becomes the pursuer as Tae-Beom chases the elusive Chae-Yi to protect his flawless reputation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: My Secret XXX Fanfic
mangas.description:
After years of training, Kim Ryeo-Dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jin-Won. One night, alone at home, Ryeo-Dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jin-Won. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jin-Won, who had returned early and seen everything. Jin-Won didn't get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-Dam's mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.


"What if we tried it... for real?"


Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jin-Won didn't laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-Dam's cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-Dam's thigh wasn't just Jin-Won's leg. He was hard.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three side story chapters.

mangas.title: Weather Forecast Killer
mangas.description:
Having lost his parents at a young age, Se-Hyun finds his life endlessly miserable. But when he meets Yu-No, a mysterious boy who magically appeared before him, the two quickly find solace in one another. As Yu-No visits Se-Hyun every week, their feelings gradually become more complex as they grow up. With rain pouring down on Se-Hyun's dating life and dark clouds shrouding Yu-No's family life, will they each find what they need once the skies clear? Or will the storm wash away what could have been?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Operation Leo
mangas.description:
Undercover cop Im Sae-Byeok has one job: use his baby-faced charm to infiltrate a university and get close to Ma Leo, the elusive grandson of a notorious gang boss. But on day one, he gets blackout drunk and wakes up next to a mystery man he definitely doesn't remember. Things only get messier when he discovers he'll be living under the same roof as both Leo and Leo's overly clingy best friend, Son Yi-Gang. With cockblocks, close calls, and suspiciously attractive housemates at every turn, Sae-Byeok's mission quickly spirals into chaos. Operation Leo might just be his wildest assignment yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: First Kiss, First Love
mangas.description: To treat his sensitivity issues, Do-Won agrees to be part of the blindfolded kissing booth at the school festival. He thought he'd only get a few meaningless pecks, but ends up making out with a mysterious guy whose kiss is so intense, it makes him hard! Do-Won becomes obsessed with finding the other man, but he never imagined it'd be Jun-Hyeon, the otaku nerd from school who's a total jerk! Will Do-Won be able to accept that his body reacts to this nerd, or will Jun-Hyeon's secretly sexy side be his undoing?

mangas.title: The Art of Sculpture
mangas.description:
Sung Nam-Gung can't hold down a job, and he's lost yet another one after injuring artist Min-Tae Kyeon during a routine package delivery. But Sung's in luck—Min-Tae's been looking for a new model, and Sung has the perfect combo of gloomy personality and chiseled body. As Sung spends night after night under the hands of Min-Tae, both their families begin to suspect the other's motives. Will the artist and his muse be able to escape the destinies their families have laid out for them?

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: BDSM 101
mangas.description:
Song Jeong-Won is an active member of the BDSM community, offering guidance and advice to newcomers. One day, he comes across a distressing post from Kang Hoseob, a beginner who has fallen into the hands of an abusive dom and is seeking help. Realizing that Hoseob lacks even the most basic knowledge of BDSM, Jeong-Won steps in—not just to rescue him but to personally guide him as his temporary dom.

"Master, I'll be good...I promise."

Jeong-Won takes on the challenge, but can he truly teach Hoseob the foundations of trust, consent, and desire before it's too late?

mangas.title: My Robot Is Weird!
mangas.description:
A 34-year-old single man, Cheol-Su, who has never had a proper conversation with the opposite sex, receives a mysterious box while spending Christmas alone like any other. However... what jumps out of it is none other than a large man wearing a maid outfit?! The man, who introduces himself as a companion robot, not
only calls Cheol-Su 'master' out of the blue, but also offers to take care of not only housework but also erotic services...

Wait a minute, but why are you good at all these things(!)?

mangas.title: Love Me Better Than
mangas.description:
Dennis keeps getting dumped. He's popular and sexy, but his girlfriends always fall for his classmate, Evan. They're not the only ones charmed by Evans's handsome face and thoughtful ways, though. Even Dennis is having a hard time remembering he hates Evan, and Evan seems way too flirty for a rival.



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Report My Boss!
mangas.description:
Gi-Woo just needs a job, and almost any job will do…but he gets more than he bargains for when he stumbles into a position at Cha Seon-Jo's Battle Cafe. Not only is the owner of this top-tier PC cafe so handsome it's nearly criminal, he's also hiding a secret that's actually criminal…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Order Up!
mangas.description:
After a disastrous office romance, Hyojun quits his job in a fit of rage and opens a café…only to find himself serving more dust than drinks. Business is dead, and desperation sets in; with no other option, he decides to sell the matching couple ring from his ex. The sale goes through quickly, but on the day of the meetup, something unexpected happens: the café is suddenly packed. It turns out the buyer is a stunningly handsome student, and word of his looks has drawn a crowd. Watching people fawn over the mystery heartthrob, Hyojun makes a snap decision that will change his life forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kabukicho Bad Trip: Ikeda and Rio
mangas.titleNative: 歌舞伎町バッドトリップ 池田とリオ
mangas.description:
Café manager Ikeda is highly focused on his job, but one of his regular customers, the flaky host Rio, always ruins his day whenever he drops by. The way Rio acts reminds Ikeda of someone from his past who he'd rather forget, so things would be better if he would stop coming around. But one thing leads to another, and Ikeda ends up spending the night at Rio's place! Neither man has any intention of getting serious anytime soon, but they may find that the best way to get over their respective past traumas is to open up and face them together...



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kabukicho Bad Trip
mangas.titleNative: 歌舞伎町バッドトリップ
mangas.description:
Toru Miyama has a special ability: he can read other people's minds! One day, he randomly bumps into Mizuki Hikawa, a stunning male model that he secretly adores. So what other choice does Toru have but to read Mizuki's thoughts? Turns out that Mizuki is really into BDSM, and he wants Toru to be his partner. He's willing to put Toru to the test to find out whether he makes the cut or not, but turns out that getting into BDSM isn't as easy as Toru had thought...



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: Perfectly Broken Love
mangas.description: Business student Ma Dongjae is cursed with only ever falling for ultra-straight dudes, so you can just imagine the luck he's had with love. All he really wants is a relationship of his own, but his own poor taste keeps getting in the way! Finally, Dongjae is propositioned, but…it's by a weirdo in the campus changing rooms. It doesn't matter how sexy he is, Dongjae has to turn him down, obviously! That should be the end of it, but fate just loves messing with Dongjae, and so they end up not only sharing a class but also being assigned to work on the same project! The thing is, the cool and aloof man who introduces himself is nothing like the creep Dongjae met before. One minute he's hot, the next minute he's cold, and half the time he seems to forget they've ever even spoken. It's almost like he's two different people…

mangas.title: Love Tractor
mangas.description: When family obligations force Sun-Yool, a stressed-out law school student, to the countryside, it seems like a great opportunity to escape the chaos of the city. After all, the great outdoors promises fresh air, sunshine… and a new romance?! Soon after arriving, Sun-Yool is thrown into a series of strange encounters and misunderstandings with his 20-year-old neighbor, Ye-Chan. But in spite of Ye-Chan's bumbling first impression and Sun-Yool's prickly exterior, the two find themselves drawn to each other… Will this tractor-driving stud's rustic charm be enough to melt this cold city boy's heart?

mangas.title: Don't Build My Hopes Up
mangas.description: Rule one of harboring a secret crush: never get your hopes up. Especially if your crush is the nicest person you've ever seen. Yeon-U's kind, thoughtful, and gentle—everything that Gyu-Yeong wants his significant other to be. The problem is that Yeon-U's nice to everyone, not just Gyu-Yeong. Gyu-Yeong knows that he's not special to Yeon-U, but sometimes he wants to give in to the little voice in his heart. Maybe all of this does mean something, maybe Yeon-U thinks that he's special, maybe Gyu-Yeong will be allowed to build his hopes up, just this once.

mangas.title: Crushing On My Collab Partner
mangas.titleNative: 相方にガチ恋しています
mangas.description:
Kio has a crush on his streaming partner, the incredibly attractive model Kira!

It was love at first sight when Kira stepped in to save him from two guys at a club. Kio couldn't believe his luck when Kira agreed to pair up with him, leading the two to start the KiraKio Channel. Though Kio knows his love is unrequited, he wants to at least try to convey his feelings to Kira...! Thus, he decides to do a prank video where he confesses his feelings to Kira while livestreaming. Much to his surprise, though, during the prank Kira kisses him!

A precious love story between a "business couple" whose one-sided feelings aren't as one-sided as they seem!

mangas.title: Cleaning Is Done
mangas.description:
Do-Yeong, a handsome but ordinary university student, falls in love at first sight with Chun-Sik, who works part-time near his school. Do-Yeong makes advances towards him, but Chun-Sik is completely unaware of Do-young's feelings...
Will Do-Yeong be able to win Chun-Sik's heart?

mangas.title: Trapped... with His Majesty
mangas.description:
“Damn it… every time I meet His Majesty, something messed up happens.”

One day, Ariel goes to meet Emperor Kalad, but because of a mysterious spell, the office door disappears, leaving them trapped with no way in or out. To make matters worse, the only way to restore the door is to have a “physical conversation” with Kalad, who is trapped there with Ariel…?

mangas.title: Love Me With Hypnosis
mangas.description:
Baek Hyeon-Woo harbors a secret he must never let his childhood friend Lee Seo-Hun discover. That secret is that he's been secretly in love with Seo-Hun since the moment they first met. As soon as he turned 20, he was practically forced into living together with Seo-Hun, and all he can do is masturbate with a dildo while thinking of him. Living in torment, Hyeon-Woo finds a suspicious app called "Hypnosis" installed on his phone. A sentence he typed in as a joke becomes reality. "Baby." The hypnosis begins with that one word. Torn between irresistible temptation and guilt, Hyeon-Woo sinks deeper into turmoil.

This dangerous game started with hypnosis. Can Hyeon-Woo ever tell Seo-Hun the truth?

mangas.title: Please Be Considerate!
mangas.description:
PD Kim Seongyun produces a show that introduces children to different professions by inviting people from various career fields. This time, he is looking to cast hoteliers and people who run hotels and resorts. Among his target list is Seo Hanhee, the CEO of SC Hotel & Resort, and Seongyun struggles to secure him.

“I have no intention of appearing on television.”
“Could you at least give us one interview? We’ll come to you in person.”

After endless pleading, Seongyun finally manages to go interview the difficult Hanhee. At least, that is what Seongyun thought at the time. He had no idea Hanhee would end up clinging to him.

After the interview, Hanhee not only agrees to appear on the show but also starts contacting Seongyun on his own. Filming and editing wrap up smoothly, and Seongyun wants to cut off contact now that everything is done, but…

Why does this man keep calling me? Why is he sending so many messages?

The unhinged, straight-ahead pursuit of a younger Alpha man begins, aimed squarely at an aloof older Omega man.

mangas.title: Omega Dong-Sik
mangas.description:
Facing death, the scenes of his life flashed before his eyes—and every single one was miserable and sordid. Park Dong-Sik, a thug working as a debt collector for loan shark Moon Ho-Cheol. With no mercy, compassion, or loyalty when it comes to overdue debts, Dong-Sik fulfills his duties admirably once again today. He'll even go so far as to pull down his pants and urinate in someone else's shop to collect money. His only hobby is watching porn featuring men in suits. Just as he's getting fully aroused while enjoying the video alone in his car, a stranger suddenly approaches him. The man, hunched over, asks to borrow a light. This man, so beautiful and elegant that Dong-Sik has never even seen his like on TV, takes Dong-Sik's lighter and walks away. As Dong-Sik watches him go, he witnesses the man, who had been standing uneasily at the end of the breakwater, suddenly jump into the sea. Without a moment's hesitation, Dong-Sik jumps into the sea after him. But in the pitch-black darkness, the man is nowhere to be found. Just as Dong-Sik is about to surface in the pitch-black sea where he can see nothing, something begins to pull at his ankle...

During his time in an orphanage, after being abandoned by his parents and unable to endure the abuse, he had run away on his own. When he finally managed to reunite with his father, the joy of their reunion was short-lived; his father took all the money Dong-Sik had saved and disappeared again. Dong-Sik then ended up working under a loan shark, taking on all sorts of dangerous jobs and narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions. Dong-Sik's last memory was a plea: "Please let me be born into a wealthy family in my next life, so I can live without a single worry." When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a top-tier private hospital room—neither heaven nor hell. And in the mirror stood not Park Dong-Sik, but the man Dong-Sik had been trying to save. As Dong-Sik stood bewildered by this utterly incomprehensible phenomenon, another man appeared, volunteering to be his guardian. The man, who suddenly kissed him while asking, "How could you forget me?" was calling Dong-Sik "sister-in-law."

mangas.title: Shepherd-kun wa Akiramenai
mangas.titleNative: シェパードくんはあきらめない
mangas.description:
"Please use me..."



As a child, Naoki Inuzuka, a shepherd dog-boy, was ostracized by his carnivorous classmates for his father being an herbivore. He has never been able to forget the high school wolf-boy, Masaki Hoezaki, who listened to Inuzuka and supported him during that time. Now more than a decade later, he is finally reunited with Masaki by chance.

Masaki, beautiful and intelligent as ever, runs his own detective agency.

Inuzuka is invited to join the agency and decides to work with Masaki out of a desire to be of help to him...?

This is a love story between a wolf and a sheep-dog who is single-minded in his devotion!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Samsam's House
mangas.description:
After a recent divorce, Seung-Gyu takes in an abandoned human–animal hybrid lingering outside his home, unable to ignore the quiet loneliness they share. As they begin living together, Seung-Gyu names him Samsam and tries to care for him properly, but their gentle cohabitation soon deepens into an intimate bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Woof Wolf
mangas.description:
Min-woo and Jae-min have been eyeing one another across the classroom for ages, but so far they've only gotten hot and steamy together in their imaginations. Just as the sexual tension reaches a boiling point, Jae-min makes a shocking discovery: Min-woo is a werewolf! And this only excites him more! Will Min-woo be a good pup and make Jae-min howl in bed? The fangs and claws will surely come out this semester!


(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: includes six extras.

mangas.title: The Archmage Doesn't Want to Be a Hero
mangas.description:
For nearly 300 years, the three kingdoms of the Carectia Peninsula have been locked in a series of exhausting territorial wars.

Following a peace treaty aimed at rebuilding the nations and restoring peace, two individuals once hailed as "war heroes"—the Archmage Yures and his companion, the swordsman Karca—have settled in a forest near a small village far from the kingdom's capital. Yures suffers from agoraphobia, and Karca worries about him. One day, as the two were living their quiet lives, a young brother and sister who had gotten lost in the forest burst into their home. But soon, Yures discovers a strange pattern on the back of the children's necks…

mangas.title: Yoake ga Ichiban Kurai: to repeat
mangas.titleNative: 夜明けがいちばん暗い to repeat
mangas.synonyms: The darkest hour is the dawn special story
mangas.description: Note: Published in Cheri+ July 2025 issue.

mangas.title: Natsu Kuyuru Sukimono no Yado
mangas.description:
Miharu, an otaku boy who works at a ryokan in a shabby hot spring resort town, is living with Fujio, the son of the ryokan's heir and a former porn actor. While Miharu wants to rebuild the ryokan, Fujio does not seem very interested. One day, when Miharu is planning to attend Comiket, he is invited to Fujio's other house in Tokyo for the first time...? A sexual love diary of an ex-porn actor and an otaku boy.



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hatsukoi no Kaeru Shima
mangas.description:
"I've been in love with you for so long that I can't even remember when it started..."



Tatsunoshin, an aspiring cook, and Nanami, a diver, are close childhood friends who, before they knew what happened, were even masturbating together. For the sake of changing how he's always doted on by Nanami, Tatsunoshin decides to leave the island. However, Nanami replies, "Leaving won't change a thing, You'll always be dearest to me," and refuses to give up.



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kimi to Kanaderu Love Song
mangas.titleNative: 君と奏でるラブソング
mangas.description:
After the passing of his parents, Koutarou finds himself managing their coffee shop alone. His only companion is a cat and, despite concerns from those around him about his loneliness, Koutarou struggles to forge deep connections with others. One day, a self-proclaimed angel appears before him—Rudy.



"I've been waiting. I want to hear you sing," Rudy says. Koutarou's heart skips a beat—he had abandoned music a long time ago. Rudy decides to move in with Koutarou—not that Koutarou agreed to anything—and, from there, their life as housemates begins…



(Source: Futabasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sweet Angel and Spicy
mangas.titleNative: あまくち天使とスパイシー
mangas.description:
A demon as an angel's tutor?!

As punishment for a certain incident, veteran demon Mark was assigned work in the human world. Then, pure and bubbly newbie angel Ten was sent to him! Though bewildered by the order that being this angel's "tutor" was part of his job, Mark found himself unexpectedly doting on the rather unreliable Ten. Then one night, they end up having a private lesson in 'purifying sins' using Mark's body...?!

Naughty, sweet and spicy! The tale of an angel and a devil living together in the human world ♪

mangas.title: Last Note ga Kaoru Toki
mangas.titleNative: ラスト・ノートが香るとき

mangas.title: Call My Squall
mangas.description: Ten years of unreturned feelings left Kanta a bit wary of love. So it's pretty ironic when Ryou, whose older brother is now dating Kanta's former crush, grows attached to him. They easily bond over their shared passion for gaming and hang out together quite often. Kanta finds himself enjoying Ryou's cheerful and honest personality, not even bothered by the family connection to his past heartbreak. But then, out of the blue, Ryou admits that he might be falling for him!

mangas.title: Roommate I Don't Know About
mangas.description:
Returning student U Hui-Ram is bursting with excitement as he begins him first stint in the dorms, dreaming of having a great time with his roommate! However, when his roommate vanishes, leaving behind only a doll of Hui-Ram's favorite manga character, Hui-Ram finds himelf unexpectedly starting a "fun" roommate life (?) with the doll. Then one day, while half-asleep, he ends up hugging and even groping something he mistook for the doll…

But starting the very next day, a suspicious upperclassman from his class begins to avoid him with an oddly cold demeanor…?
Will Hui-Ram be able to uncover the truth hidden within his "dream"?

mangas.title: ONE-NIGHT TRUE STAND
mangas.titleNative: ワンナイト・トゥルー・スタンド
mangas.description:
Drug related criminal activity has been on the rise within a new app marketed for gay dating. That's when Shiraishi, a police officer in the area, decided to start investigations on his own posing as a submissive masochist. It didn't take long for Shiraishi to find a lead in his first match, a man named "K" who seems suspicious with a mask and cap to hide his identity. One thing led to the next and Shiraishi found himself in a hotel room with this guy. Not only that, but he figured out quickly enough that he's a cop! Now Shiraishi is stuck having to play along with K's sexual games so that no one finds out what he's done... but at the same time it turns out Shiraishi's actually an incredibly talented Masochist?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shibari Ai: Joushi to Buka no Henai Kiroku
mangas.titleNative: 縛りアイ -上司と部下の偏愛記録-
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Scene Stealer
mangas.description:
Gu Jae-Hui, once an unknown actor, skyrocketed to stardom overnight after his drama 'The Sub-Man's Situation' achieved a 30% viewership rating. Subsequently, offers poured in for films, commercials, and variety shows, propelling him into the public spotlight. But off-camera, his reality was...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Spicy Vanilla Essence
mangas.titleNative: スパイシー バニラ エッセンス
mangas.description:
Ryoutarou and Keisuke, a lovey-dovey college couple, are finally having their memorable first night together. The exciting mood quickly changes when Keisuke suddenly starts to play hard SM porn videos to Ryoutarou and reveals "I'm into this"! Shocked at first, Ryoutarou decides to accept it "For the sake of my dear, Kei-chan!"
And so begins the start of their SM play days: bondage, wax play, spanking, and more! For the sake of his beloved, Ryoutarou will become an SM master!



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Forget My Wife, Try Me
mangas.synonyms: What About Me, Besides My Wife?
mangas.description:
Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new "puppy" to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That's how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

mangas.title: Delivery Complete
mangas.description: If the sexy toys you ordered for "research" end up at your neighbor's house, and your neighbor happens to be a gorgeous actor willing to help you test them out, well… It'd be a waste not to, right? Shy BL author, Eujae Lim, just wanted to live a quiet life, but Jinhoo Park wants to be his male lead.

mangas.title: Sekdareuge Haeyo
mangas.description:
Yu-Jun and Geon-U have been a couple for 3 years. While Yu-Jun worries that Geon-U might have gotten tired of their time together, he looks for ways to spice up their relationship in colorful ways. A feast of a couple's sweet play!



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Leash Me Up
mangas.description: Meet Noel, a part-time worker at a pet store who's completely and utterly obsessed with puppies. Noel loves puppies so much that he decides to join a chat app to find a friend who likes them as much as he does. Just his luck, he manages to find "J," a user that seems to match Noel's passion for cuddly creatures. After Noel decides to send J a collar as a gift, J suggests they meet in person. When J shows up wearing the collar around his own neck, it's evident there has been some sort of misunderstanding between the two…

mangas.title: My Partner's Tastes and Fetishes
mangas.description: Jun, who lives a perfect life. He was full of confidence that he would take first place this semester as well, but it got taken over by the over motivated Cha Si Won. Even on the day of the farewell party, Jun gets drunk and kisses Si Won. To cover the dark story, he takes a leave of absence and goes to the army. But after 2 years, Jun and Si Won have returned to school together. They seem to have a lot in common, they have the same classes, they continue to meet each other and they also have the same phone model. Jun shudders at the constant feeling of being associated with Si Won. He tries to relax his stress with the Phone Sex, but due to the accidental change of cell phones, Si Won discovers Jun's sexual preference (SM) ...

mangas.title: Love Me, Doctor!
mangas.description:
Hyuk is a happy-go-lucky college student who's dating the girl of his dreams. But there's one issue: when it's showtime in the bedroom, he gets massive performance anxiety. Desperate to keep his girlfriend, Hyuk works up the courage to go see a urologist. He prepares for the worst, but his first prostate exam actually feels…amazing?! Thanks to one smooth Dr. Han and his masterful hands, Hyuk is now on the path to recovery through regular massage sessions! How lucky of him to have found such an attentive doctor, one who'll even take him out for drinks to listen to his woes. But as the treatments unfold, Dr. Han has a way of slipping into Hyuk's mind, not just his bum…



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes five extras.

mangas.title: Alien Energy Thief
mangas.synonyms: Alien Semen Bandit | Alien Periodic Blade Robbery
mangas.description:
Baek Mir, a boy barely scraping by with part-time jobs, appears before him one day, a naked man falling from the sky. He's revealed to be Won-Byul, an alien who crash-landed on Earth. However, after coveting Mir's belongings, Won-Byul, with no place to go, begins calling him "Sexy" and approaches him, offering to replenish his energy...!

"You're looking for an alien sex worker? Who is that woman?"

From that moment on, an unpredictable alien sex scene begins!

mangas.title: Alien in My Wardrobe
mangas.description: "Hey you, Livestock, I need a subject for my alien probe" are not words Haesung expected to ever hear. He spends his days spacing out, hopelessly fantasizing about being tied up by his office crush, Shiwon. But his secret BDSM fantasies come to life as a brutally sexy alien crash-lands on Earth and ropes in Haesung as his research subject (and roommate). Things heat up when Haesung submits to the experiment—in exchange for sexual favors that are out of this world!

mangas.title: Jjukkujjukku Yeohaenggi
mangas.description:
"Jjukku Jjukku" (Hyeon-U), an alien drifting through space, crashes-lands on Earth after running out of fuel. But to collect fuel, he absolutely must have sex with a human...


"Can't you have sex with someone else instead of me?"


"No, human!!"


Ki-Beom, who accidentally picks up the alien Jjukku Jjukku (Hyeon-U) as he's rambling about sex, will their first sexual encounter go smoothly?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: pit-a-pat
mangas.description:
Lapis fled to Earth during the planetary war, and without anyone to help him, he was on the verge of collapse when Do-Yul appeared. Lapis fell in love with him at first sight and went back to space and won. Lapis returned to Earth under the pretext of breeding his species and sought out his first love, Do-Yul. Will his first love come true?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: Oegyehaengseong Wangjanimui ♥♥♥
mangas.description:
Kim Pyeong-Beom is an ordinary person who lives a common life, but one day an alien with the appearance of a teddy bear lands in his room! From that moment on, he will accept that intercultural exchange with BR, the fifth prince of Planet KKRY… But how will he end up becoming the prince's sex education manager too?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: Hooked and Cooked
mangas.synonyms: The First Love of the Sushi Restaurant Owner is a Mermaid
mangas.description:
The restaurant owner fell in love at first sight with... A mermaid!



Hae-Beom is often mistaken for a gangster due to his stern appearance.
Sang-A, a customer who helped Hae-Beom, is a mermaid. Sang-A needs human saliva in order to get legs, so Hae-Beom selflessly offers a kiss... Once a day, every day.



Sang-A just needs legs... But will he like me someday?



(Source: Lezhin, translated)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mulgeopume Ppajin Goemul
mangas.description:
The third prince, Rainier, whom the Mermaid King loves the most. Obsessed with the desire to become human and see beautiful flower fields, he goes to the deep sea magician Baller, and the magician offers to use his energy to turn him into a human... But the tummy is full of turmoil. This is the human body the prince wanted. Can he trust him, who somehow gives off an ominous aura?



(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

mangas.title: Tentacles Appeared!
mangas.description:
Han-Seo is plagued by nightmares of a tentacle-being assaulting him, so he desperately seeks help online. To his surprise, Tae-Geon Lee, a famous CEO, responds. As if that weren't odd enough, he learns his dream attacker belongs to a spirit race and turns Han-Seo into an omega. Tae-Geon, an alpha of the same spirit race, offers to protect him and help him manage his new reality. Despite some initial hesitance, Han-Seo finds comfort in Tae-Geon—tentacles and all! But are his nightmares truly over...?

(Source: Tapas)

(Source: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Good Teacher
mangas.description: Ho-Jun's recent breakup was pretty rough. His partner told him it wasn't him, per se… Ho-Jun just wasn't good in bed. But it turns out Drunk Ho-Jun is surprisingly resourceful; singlehandedly managing to find and set himself up with a sex tutor by the name of Mr. An. An Seung-Hyeon was only half serious when he posted the sex tutor ad, but he quickly finds himself in too deep to call the lessons off. And the more he sees Ho-Jun, the more he can't help but notice how much attractive he is. Seung-Hyeon is making it up as he goes along, so what will the final exam look like?

mangas.title: Unauthorized Access!
mangas.description:
As a skilled hacker, Gyeon Woo-Min is hired by a criminal organization to infiltrate Taeyoung Corporation and steal data. However, when the security system goes off, he's caught by no other than the CEO, Tae Beom-Hyun. Instead of calling the cops, Beom-Hyun offers him a deal that's little better than a slave contract. Left with no other choice, Woo-Min signs the contract and finds himself carrying out all sorts of risky and provocative errands ordered by Beom-Hyun.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: Visitor in the Night
mangas.description:
Please, just let me sleep! Every night, the devil who haunts my dreams turns out to be... an upperclassman from my club? Who is he? No—what is he?!

(Source: Lalatoon)


Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Pinky Nightmare
mangas.description:
The dim-witted, virgin Aichi Tachibana has a one-sided rivalry with Suou, a popular, nonchalant, handsome classmate. One day, Aichi happens to pick up a plushie from the trash — except it was actually a demon!? The demon named Pinky tricks Aichi into a "Succubus Substitute Contract," tasked with collecting semen from men. His target: the guy that grinds his gears, Suou! When Aichi makes his move… it seems that Suou isn't opposed to his advances?



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Even Demons Can Experience True Love?
mangas.synonyms: What? Even Demons Can Love wHOLEsomely?!
mangas.description:
Demon.

Though it signifies the devil, Satan, and all evil in the world, here it's just a stable, high-paying, popular job. Woo-Hyuk, a convenience store part-timer struggling daily to pass the Incubus exam, held only once a year, one day receives a startling proposal from Si-Woon, his long-time, ever-helpful friend...

"You want to pass the incubus exam that badly? Then practice with me."

A sex class begins for incubus exam prep... It feels good, but between friends... Is this okay...?!

mangas.title: Eye Contact
mangas.description: Jong-Pil is a returnee student who keeps running into Jae-Hyeong, a rude, pink-haired guy at school. One night, in an attempt to retrieve his laptop, he winds up in a drunken encounter with Jae-Hyeong. Follow Jong-Pil as he hilariously tries to sort his feelings out about his rude but handsome junior.

mangas.title: Sono Gap ni Yowai: Gap Danshi BL Anthology

mangas.title: Undercover Darling
mangas.description:
Yi-Jae, an ambitious small town cop, discovers that his first love, Jun-Hyuk, is involved in the band of criminals known as the Black Goat Gang. Forced to pose as lovers, they must navigate danger and desire. Can their fake romance help put the bad guys behind bars, or will their tangled past blow their cover?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Campus Secret Girlfriend ♡
mangas.description: Returning student, Junseob, boasts in front of his juniors about dating the campus goddess, Seryeong. However, Seryeong's true identity unravels, revealing a cross-dressing man who, instead of playing along as Junseob's pretend girlfriend, demands a real relationship.

mangas.title: Boiling Frog Syndrome
mangas.description: Jeh Yillo has a highly specific, twisted fetish: he's obsessed with guys who have terrible personalities and wear glasses. Enter Gwak Changhyeok, the school's most hated grade-level head teacher. When Yillo accidentally witnesses the notoriously toxic teacher speaking softly to his girlfriend, his obsession ignites. He decides to reel him in like a frog in a pot, heating the water so slowly Changhyeok won't even realize he's being boiled alive…until Yillo has the opportunity to devour him whole.

mangas.title: Hotel Pharus
mangas.description:
After he loses his job and gets dumped by a former flame, Daniel longs to break away from the constant noise of the city. Little does he know that a sudden inheritance in the form of a countryside hotel could be just the quiet escape he needed. But as he works to breathe life into the old hotel, he quickly realizes that it's anything but ordinary. With ghosts supposedly lurking the halls, a mysterious wing that no one is allowed into, and secret dealings behind closed doors, Daniel has his work cut out for him. Still, he's determined to uncover the mysteries of Hotel Pharus, and with the help of a handsome and willing guest upstairs, he may get more than he bargained for. Will he find the answers he's looking for or come to realize that some secrets should stay buried?



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)



Note: Includes five epilogue chapters.

mangas.title: The Guy Behind The Strange Rumors
mangas.description:
NTR (Neighborhood Therapeutic Recreation), a volunteer club at Korea University's College of Physical Education. Though formed for service, rumors say it's full of weirdos...

Unaware of this reputation, our protagonist Kim I-Ban joined. He tried to leave, disgusted by the crazy members who claimed they could make Ban Seon-Woo, the club member with sexual numbness, only get aroused by nipples. But something's off... I'm not gay, and I don't want to get mixed up in weird stuff... I really don't... Why the hell is my usually quiet dick standing up?!

mangas.title: Magnetic Love
mangas.description:
Ga-Ram, a promiscuous student on the Korea University campus, yearns to hook up with Jin-Hun, a classmate. He's always eager to get close, but Jin-Hun consistently ignores him...


While trying to figure out how to get Jin-Hun's pants off, Ga-Ram dreams of a strange old woman giving him a wish-granting magnet.
The next day, when he encounters Jin-Hun, they're instantly hooked?! The two try various methods to break up...


"Hey, try it with me. Then we might break up."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

mangas.title: The Fox's Failed Feast
mangas.synonyms: The Outside and Inside Are So Different
mangas.description:
Despite his kind face and good reputation, Ha-Yun's hobby are one-night stands. One day, he becomes captivated by Seo-Jin, a new member of his club, and decides to try sleeping with him. Contrary to his thuggish appearance, with his tanned skin, muscular build, and bright yellow hair, Seo-Jin is the epitome of innocence. Ha-Yun manages to break through his innocence and have a one-night stand with him, but the next day, he tries to sort things out...

"I agreed because I like you, hyung."

"This is my first time dating."

How can he get this out of his head...?

mangas.title: Feel! Ring
mangas.description:
Jewelry designer Park Eun-Hyeon is looking for someone to help him make a ring when an acquaintance introduces him to a craftsman with quick hands.
Eun-Hyeon, who desperately needs help with an urgent deadline, goes to meet him right away... The person who appears in front of her is Kang Yu-Chan, his junior and partner from college. He worries for a moment that Yu-Chan will cling to him like he did back then, but the collaboration between the two seems smooth...

"Senior, it's been a while since you've written something, right?"

Eun-Hyeon is helplessly falling for him who seduces him with his perfect face..! In the meantime, the deadline is approaching!

mangas.title: Shadow Monster and Groom
mangas.synonyms: The Shadow Monster and His Groom
mangas.description:
Dion gets married for the sake of his family and says his final goodbyes to his first love, the child of his dreams. However, after that, ominous things start to happen around him one after another like an epidemic, and eventually, someone saves him from taking his own life.

"I am your groom."

You can't see anything and you don't know his identity, but your relationship with him feels familiar and comfortable... What on earth are you..?

mangas.title: Bewitched
mangas.description:
Doggy-younger man Nam-Hyeok X Grumpy older man Ho-Su.

Ho-Su, a returning student who had always been lucky no matter what he did, ends up spending a night with Nam-Hyeok, a freshman he met at a drinking party, while drunk. However, he was only satisfied with the amazing relationship for a moment, and when a shining pattern appeared on Ho-Su's stomach, Nam-Hyeok screamed as if he fainted...

"I, I think I accidentally put a curse on my senior!"

It was shocking that the person he spent a night with turned out to be a witch, but isn't it a bit strange that the way to lift the curse is to receive the witch's semen periodically? Wait, is this really effective?!

mangas.title: Ireon Gwaoeneun Sireo!
mangas.synonyms: I Hate This Kind of Tutoring!
mangas.description:
Do-Young, a repeat student looking for a private tutor to help him get into a Korean university, decides to take lessons from his class president, who was introduced to him by a high school friend. However, Ha-Jin, the class president from the first semester who disliked him, joins as his tutor...



Do-Young is constantly distracted by Ha-Jin, and Ha-Jin suggests canceling the tutoring.



"If I misbehave again, you can hit me, punish me, or whatever you want!"


Do-Young, unable to give up on the tutoring, says these urgent words, sending the class into a completely different direction.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: LOVE COUNTDOWN
mangas.synonyms: นับหนึ่งถึงรัก
mangas.description:
"You're going to fall to your death?"
"Huh?"
"I'd prefer you to live if possible. Because if you die, I'll die too."


Seo Hae-Won met a man on a bridge while drunk. He thought they'd accidentally spent a night together, but he told him he'd known Ji-Hun for a very long time. And that's all? At the edge of a cliff in his life, which had seemed so bleak, he nonchalantly reached out.

"What I want isn't your gratitude, Ji-Hun."
"So... are you saying we should date?"
"Dating won't do. That won't satisfy me. Love me. Just like I love you, Ji-Hun."

Hae-Won, seemingly stunned by the passionate confession of love from a stranger, simply added refreshingly.

"Shall we break it down into five stages?"
"... Stages?"
"Stage one is sex, stage two is kissing."

He'd already had sex and kissed. So what are the remaining stages three, four, and five? And, who on earth is that man in Seo Hae-Won?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Control, Freak, Love
mangas.description:
In-Suh, Yeon-Ho, and Da-El, were always together during their school days. In-Suh, who injured his hand in an accident, gives up his dream of becoming a pianist and goes into hiding, but Yeon-Ho suddenly appears in front of In-suh. In-Suh pushes Yeon-Ho away because he is compared to him, but somehow he continues to be swayed by Yeon-Ho

"I've hated you since high school, if it weren't for Da-El..."

"Kim Da-El, who you were desperate for, is getting married to another woman."

In-Suh suddenly hears the news of Da-El, whom he liked, is getting married. And...

"...I endured it for 8 years-"

I get to know Yeon-Ho's hidden feelings...

mangas.title: The Fairy Bath Theft Case (Side Story)
mangas.synonyms: The Boy Who Stole From the Fairy Lake
mangas.description: After remembering his past life, Beom-Ryeong spends his time at the house of the chief of the household while training to ascend to heaven. However, there was something more important than training: the wedding. Will Beom-Ryeong be able to successfully complete the wedding with the chief of the household and spend their first night together?

mangas.title: You Can Blame It All on Me ♡
mangas.description:
Seong-Yoon, a true otaku who only enjoys Dating Sims, falls for the beautiful Dalsa who looks just like his favorite and ends up entering a motel while drunk...

Why... does my behind hurt like it's been stabbed in the back?

"You were the one who got stabbed. I'm also a man who's into it...^^"

That Dalsa is actually a man...? This cross-dressing man is the most popular kid in our department, Woo Soo-Hee...?! A sweet and cute love story between the scheming master Woo Soo-Hee, who will cross-dress to win over Sung-Yoon, and the nerdy, otaku Sung-Yoon,

"You can blame it all on me ♡"

mangas.title: A God Is Better Than a Ghost
mangas.description:
As the second son of a shaman family, Su-Ho was born with insufficient yang energy and has been plagued by ghosts since childhood. He was able to be free from ghosts as long as he wore the family heirloom ring he received from his grandmother. However, on the first day of college, he lost the ring. He ran away from the ghosts that had started appearing again and found himself in an alley. There, he encountered a man wearing his ring…

"Give me back the ring."

"I can't give you the ring. I have to be with you."

Su-Ho is flustered by Shin-Woo, who uses the ring as a hostage and manipulates him as he pleases. It seems clear that they shouldn't get involved any further—but why does he keep getting drawn to Shin-Woo? What will be the end of this strange relationship that started over a single ring?

mangas.title: Amulet Advisory
mangas.description:
Han Gyeol and Ho-Young are childhood friends who share a secret crush, but they're both unaware of it. Wanting to end his crush, Gyeol uses a talisman to connect with Ho-Young, but the talisman, which promises to grant love, keeps getting them into strange situations. Not only is Gyeol trapped in a closet alone with Ho-Young, but their "places" touch on the subway and he even gets an erection...

"Ho, Ho-Young. This isn't-"

"Hey, Han Gyeol, you... are you really that big?"

A bumbling romantic comedy where the two, oblivious to each other's presence, have bodies overtake their minds!

mangas.title: Keeping it Brief
mangas.description:
Cha Yun-Ho can't shake the feeling that a suspicious man in sunglasses is following him, shameless eyes glued to his bodacious backside. Just as Yun-Ho tries to get away, the man suddenly makes an outrageous offer. He wants Yun-Ho to become the model for his brand. To Yun-Ho's shock, the stranger turns out to be Kwon Wu-Hyeok, his first love from fourteen years ago. Before he knows it, Yun-Ho finds himself working at what might be the best job imaginable, spending all day with Wu-Hyeok. There's just one problem: Wu-Hyeok's brand's clothing is a little short, tight, and triangular for Yun-Ho's liking…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Ruddy Cheeks
mangas.description: Eun-San and Hae-Gyeong, who have known each other since childhood, begin to hold each other in childhood memories after Hae-Gyeong's manifestation. Yun-San, who has now manifested as an omega, accidentally reunites with Hae-Gyeong at an amusement park and continues to secretly communicate with him without the adults knowing. After a time when they felt each other through messenger messages and pheromones on clothes due to the pheromones of their still-imperfect adolescence, the two, now fully grown adults, meet again on Jeju Island...!

mangas.title: How Did That Happen?
mangas.synonyms: How Did That Relationship Come About?
mangas.description:
Have you ever had sex?

As soon as he becomes an adult, Sung-Hyun spends the night with his childhood friend Ji-Won at his request. Sung-Hyun, who has been secretly in love with Ji-Won, tries to make things work out with him, but Ji-Won sleeps with other people as if nothing happened. Then one day, he discovers a rough mark on Ji-Won's body...

mangas.title: Wouldn't You Know If I Did XX?
mangas.synonyms: Maybe We'll Know If We Do XX?
mangas.description:
Jae, leader of the group Runners High, and rapper Beom-Jun boast chemistry that's recognized not only within the group but also among fans. However, Beom-Jun realized he liked Jae more than just as a friend, and he ended up turning that feeling into a solo song. Beom-Jun was curious about Jae's reaction to his self-composed song, but he didn't really have any particular expectations. But then... when Beom-Jun asks about his feelings, Jae suddenly drops a bombshell.

"Wouldn't you know if you did XX?"

mangas.title: The Symbiotic Relationship Between Insomnia and Mysophobia
