mangas.description: Jin-Ha and Young-Jae of the group Runners High are known to be arch-rivals. Amidst this, an accident occurs where Jin-Ha, who has OCD, pushes Young-Jae. Rumors begin circulating among fans that the members don't get along, and with a dormitory-style self-produced content project looming, an emergency is declared... After much deliberation by the agency and manager, Jin-Ha and Young-Jae end up sharing a dorm room to prepare for the dorm-style self-produced content shoot! Will the two of them be okay...?!

mangas.title: To Abyss
mangas.description:
Despite belonging to a family of esteemed knights, Felice has talent for magic and becomes the youngest imperial archmage in history. But his brilliance leaves someone in the shadows: Aeris, the heir to a renowned family of mages who was expected to become the next archmage. Driven by a bitter inferiority complex, Aeris casts a dark curse on himself. When Felice arrives to save his childhood friend, he discovers that he can only lift the curse by sleeping with him. In this twisted game of lust and obsession, can Felice heal the heart he inadvertently broke?

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Plaything Senior
mangas.description:
Sung-Bin, a serial philanderer and public enemy number one of the male students at his university, is confessed to by Ju-Won, a gloomy young man who has recently returned from a leave of absence. Sung-Bin initially plays along to sate his boredom, but things start to develop in a way he doesn't expect.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: What's With Your Taste?
mangas.description: Su-Young, who is a premarital chastity advocate, is a rich third-generation chaebol. Although he faced many dangers(?) while growing up, Su-Young, who kept her beliefs, falls in love at first sight with Ha-Joon at a party one day after returning to Korea. He didn't intend to, but when he came to him senses, Su-Young found out that Ha-Joon had stolen him first love. Just as he was thinking about not only dating Ha-Joon but also marriage and children, the next morning, he comes face to face with an empty bed next to him. So he goes to Ha-Joon's university entrance and confidently shouts... "Me! I ate it, so take responsibility!" But what happened? Ha-Joon cleanly refuses, saying that being a chaebol is not him taste. Being rich is not him taste? What the heck is wrong with your tastes?!?!!

mangas.title: The Glass Menagerie
mangas.description:
After the fall of his noble family, Damon drifts from place to place until he hears of an open position as a private tutor for a sheltered young heir named Eden. From their very first meeting, Eden blushes easily and wears his emotions openly, a lonely young master who seems far too easy to manipulate. Damon convinces himself that if he plays his cards right, he can settle here comfortably for the rest of his life. But life in the mansion takes a turn Damon never expected, and he begins to suspect that his arrival was part of a carefully laid trap.

As Eden longs for beauty and Damon clings to what never changes, the walls of the mansion close in, and the truth behind their bond slowly comes to light.

mangas.title: Cheater Meter
mangas.description: Workaholic Tae-Sung Kim quits his corporate job to drive a taxi. After helping his first passenger catch her cheating husband, he turns his cab into a makeshift detective agency. That's when gangster Jin-U Hwang gets in, seeking help to find his unfaithful missing boyfriend.

mangas.title: Hot-to-Go Bakery: Whipped and Sprayed
mangas.description:
Baek Hwi-Soo has an embarrassing bedroom secret that has earned him the nickname "Cream Can." But his uncontrollably big load of vitality is just what the starved incubus, Prince Amon, needs to come out of his century-long hibernation. Motivated by a reward of curing his cancer-stricken cat, Pancake, Hwi-Soo comes to the demon world to offer up all the cream from his can to fill the prince's sweet tooth!

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Cherry Boy's Graduation Log
mangas.description:
Lee Hyun, a lifelong single who could only dream of romance, was hopping from one part-time job to another just to pay off his debts and medical bills. One day, while delivering coffee as usual, he bumped into the famous model Si-An and suddenly found himself robbed of her first kiss!!

"Let's make a deal."

Not content with just stealing someone's precious first kiss, Si-An abruptly proposes a contract relationship to Lee Hyun. But his true identity is... an incubus?! Will Lee Hyun, a virgin and lifelong single guy, manage to graduate from his virginity?

mangas.title: Incubus Days
mangas.description:
Su-Hyeon, a lifelong bachelor for 30 years, dies in a traffic accident and encounters a mysterious figure claiming to be 'God'. 'God' offers him another chance at life, but in exchange, proposes he become an incubus, a non-human entity that survives by draining men's vitality...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: SOS: Sleep or Sex
mangas.description: Sleepless nights, haunting dreams, and a desperate wish bring college student Choi Woo-hyuk face-to-face with an unexpected visitor—an impossibly handsome incubus who claims to have been summoned by his own desires. But when fantasy and reality blur, Woo-hyuk's restless nights take a steamy, surreal turn he never saw coming!

mangas.title: Keomyurado Gwaenchana!
mangas.description:
Chatting game app where you can talk to strangers, act out situations, and create virtual families to form relationships. This simple game where you create an avatar and interact with others has become very popular in today's harsh society. Job seeker Han Jae-Woon also relieved his anxiety about the uncertain future through this community... And then he met his soulmate!? Is it okay to be attracted to someone you met in the community?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: OOTD: A Poisoning Love
mangas.description: Luce has had a huge crush on Kevin since their police school days, but hasn't had the chance to confess his feelings. Right when the two of them are about to wrap up an illegal aphrodisiac case, Luce accepts some donuts from a seemingly harmless admirer and gives them to a hungry Kevin. Unfortunately, these donuts are laced with the same aphrodisiac that's been plaguing the public! Poor Kevin has to climax ten times to get it all out of his system, and there's only one person around who can help him with the job...

mangas.title: Occult Romantic Comedy!
mangas.description:
Tim Owelly always showed an interest in the occult, though nothing he's ever reported on as an occult blogger has convinced him the supernatural actually exists. But when strange and paranormal reactions to the horror movie star Johnathan McStars begin bubbling up online, Tim's curiosity gets the better of him and sends him down a disastrous road towards the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Nugu Complex
mangas.description:
After leaving behind his past as a failed idol from Meteor Boys, Seok-Wu returns to university hoping for a fresh start. Unfortunately, his timing could not be worse…because rising star Yeo-Wun, a rookie actor with a glittering career, also reenrolls. Seok-Wu is used to the contrast in how people treat them, but when Yeo-Wun starts provoking him in ways that feel far too deliberate, irritation turns into wounded pride. Just how far does Yeo-Wun plan to trample on Seok-Wu's dignity - and why does it feel so personal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener
mangas.synonyms: 我的花枝鼠是S級覺醒者
mangas.description:
Soul is dropped into a dimension where everyone's screaming about a status window he can't see. On top of that, his pet rat, who also got dropped in with him, turns out to be a beastman and a powerful awakener... And in love with him?! Will Soul and Rio accept each other and make it back home safely?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Nest
mangas.description:
A quiet rural village. Alec, a handsome transfer student from the city, spots So-Ho, shunned by everyone for "shooing away even forest monsters." Alec, who was trying to unravel his own hidden, twisted complexes toward So-Ho, is overcome by an inexplicable emotion the moment he meets So-Ho's eyes behind his glasses. The forest he and So-Ho went to escape his father becomes their private nest.

"You will become my monster."

mangas.title: Quo Vadis, Domine?
mangas.synonyms: クォ・ヴァディス・ドミネ〜主よどこへ行かれるのですか？〜
mangas.description:
To pay off his parents' debt, Hyeon-Do is sold into an arrangement as the fake fiancé of a powerful conglomerate heir. His supposed partner, Yi-Sak, is an infamous alpha known for his volatility, a man others call mad. Yet when Yi-Sak realizes his uncontrollable pheromones only calm in Hyeon-Do's presence, their dangerous charade begins to blur into something else. As secrets pile up and emotions tangle, Hyeon-Do must keep his true identity hidden long enough to survive the wedding or risk being devoured by the man he's bound to marry.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: In My Bad
mangas.description:
Actor Gyeong Wu-Hyeon is a devoted fan of painter Do Han-Ah. When a treasured piece of Han-ah's artwork is stolen from him, Wu-Hyeon is devastated, but fate steps in when he unexpectedly runs into Han-ah again at a charity event. To his surprise, Han-ah doesn't remember him at all, and a small misunderstanding quickly snowballs into the two of them falling into bed. Determined not to let the moment slip away, Wu-Hyeon sets out to show Han-ah just how much he truly values his work. As Han-Ah slowly begins to open up, he finds himself drawn to Wu-Hyeon… yet every now and then, he catches a cool, unreadable side to Wu-Hyeon that he just can't figure out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Do or Die: A Holey Mission
mangas.description: Kim Gyo-Joo is a cult leader, a scammer, and a man who likes his money easy and his work easier. But one day, a bizarre quest is dropped on him by the heavens: get ravaged by ten of his own believers in three days or die. He has no interest in men, but he has even less interest in dying. Now he's bargaining, scheming, and gritting his teeth for the most humiliating survival mission of his life.

mangas.title: Do or Die: Work On Hold
mangas.description: Ahn Si-Young has waited for years for the day he becomes old enough to ask out his crush, Seo Do-Hyun. That day finally comes when Si-Young starts interning at Do-Hyun's company, albeit with a strange mission: "Have sex with your crush in the office, or you will die." Even though this is Si-Young's long-awaited chance at love, is this really the right way to go about it...?

mangas.title: Do or Die: Play to be Gay
mangas.description: Woo-Un is a member of an unsuccessful idol group about to end their contract for good. As a final bid to save their careers, the group resorts to enacting gay fanservice to boost their popularity. When Woo-Un is paired with fellow group member Jae-Sam to play-act as a couple, he's secretly delighted. He has a crush on Jae-Sam, and this is the perfect opportunity to sneak in some justified physical affection. However, Jae-Sam seems reluctant to play along. Will they be able to save their careers this way? And is there more at stake than Woo-Un is aware of?

mangas.title: 7 Sexy Days With 8 Sexy Men
mangas.description: When Han Jun-Woo discovers his favorite football player twins are going to play in the same match, he absolutely has to go watch them in person. But after his normal part-time job closes down, Jun-Woo desperately signs up for all the lucrative one-day gigs he can find. Little does he know, money won't be the only thing he gets from these quick and easy jobs. Will Jun-Woo be able to see his beloved twins play football? Or will his seven wildly different jobs leave an undeniable mark on his body?

mangas.title: Bite to Unlock
mangas.description: Hyeon-Seung has gone his entire life without anyone realizing he's a vampire - until Tae-Hee, his teammate for a group project, uncovers his secret. What's worse, Tae-Hee is a hardcore vampire otaku, so try as he might to hide his identity, Hyeon-Seung's identity has been laid bare. Tae-Hee promises to keep quiet, but only after bombarding Hyeon-Seung with endless questions and enthusiastic fanboying. Dazed and cornered, Hyun-Seong finally agrees to help fuel Tae-Hee's obsession, forming a strange symbiotic relationship fueled by blood and fandom. But as the two grow closer, their relationship grows into something more…giving bloodlust a whole new meaning.

mangas.title: A Homeless Vampire
mangas.description: After waking from a long slumber, the vampire Isle discovers his home has been taken, leaving him with nowhere to go. Taken in by Loan, he puts his extraordinary talent for identifying counterfeit wine to use, while slowly recovering fragments of a past he thought was lost. As his memories resurface and their unequal relationship deepens, desire, power, and fate begin to intertwine in ways neither of them expected.

mangas.title: Housemate from Hell
mangas.synonyms: Living with the Devil Begins | Living With the Devil | Beginning of Cohabitation With the Devil
mangas.description: Rigid and blunt college student Kwon Jeong-Ha can't stand Gwak Hyeon-Wu, a handsome, popular classmate who casually toyed with the senior Jeong-Ha secretly loved. The two clash every time they meet… until Jeong-Ha picks up a mysterious necklace and their relationship flips overnight. Claiming he's a demon, Hyeon-Wu reveals that all the magic he'd stored in the necklace has been absorbed by Jeong-Ha. To make matters worse, Jeongha will die unless it's returned. But the only way to transfer the magic back? Physical contact. Forced into an uneasy cohabitation with a demon he despises, Jeong-Ha's quiet life quickly descends into chaos.

mangas.title: Black Flame Garden
mangas.description: In Hwayeon Kingdom, there is a guardian god called 'Garden' that has served the king for generations. Legend has it that a king who is loved by the guardian god will live forever, so many kings long for the love of Garden. Bodyguard Black Young, who admires Garden, begins to gradually become greedy for it...

mangas.title: Into the Blue
mangas.description:
Seok is a jovial manservant for a noble family. One day, while out on an errand, he gets a glimpse of a mysterious and alluring performer that has arrived at the market. But a fleeting look won't suffice. He can't get his mind off of this enigmatic figure. Will he ever see them again?



As fate would have it, their paths will certainly cross again. But the complications of their lives and the entanglements of their relationships will mean that things will unfold in ways that are anything but easy. Who will risk it all and dive deep into the blue for a chance at love?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Missing Master
mangas.description:
"Please don't push your disciple away anymore, Master.."



Ryu Jang-Jin lives an ordinary life, finding his only escape in web novels during his daily subway commute. But one evening, on his way home, a mysterious man suddenly breaks through his apartment window—from the third floor, no less! The intruder, Sa Wi-Hyeon, claims to be Jang-Jin's disciple, insisting that their true home isn't Earth, but a place called Honwon. He has come to take Jang-Jin back where he belongs. As an avid reader of isekai and wuxia novels, Jang-Jin is tempted by the fantastical idea—but reality calls, and he has work in the morning. Ignoring his protests, Sa Wi-Hyeon insists that Jang-Jin is only refusing because he has lost his memories. Before Jang-Jin can argue, he finds himself kidnapped and dragged into another world…

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Yunhoeui Gilmok
mangas.description:
Su-Ho, the youngest son of a noble family, is sickly and useless. After his miserable death, he is guided by a large, silver-haired man, Ryu-Seon. However, Su-Ho, who is excited by his overflowing strength unlike his life, climbs a tree and eats its fruit, but is bewildered when he fails to pass through the gate of reincarnation led by Ryu-Seon... Ryu-Seon kisses him, saying that he needs to remove the strong energy that has taken hold of his soul. But this feeling... is something... good?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)


Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Hero-ui Namchinindeyo?
mangas.description:
The most famous hero x ordinary person couple at the moment, Devil M and Jung Na-na, also enter a period of inevitably boredom after 10 years of dating. But one day, the love bead containing the will of the villain who has been tormenting Devil M bears fruit in Jung Na-na's body, and their boredom flows in a new direction.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)


Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Houjuuibo
mangas.description:
No matter how much things can be like that, I never thought I would lock lips with my old rival whom I haven't seen in eight years. Andodam, who was so curious about the past that he ended up summoning the door of time.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)


Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Love Note
mangas.description:
"Make a mess of me!"


Do-Yoon, drunk and intoxicated by a broken heart, picks up a notebook with the words [Love Note] written on it while walking down the street. When he returns home, he begins to write down his fantasies about his unrequited love for Han-Gyeol, as if he were burning with desire. And then the next day, Han-Gyeol suddenly comes to his house??!

"This is what I wrote in my notebook!!! If that's the case... then I can do more?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: The Boss I Love
mangas.description:
Seung-Tae, the executive with a gangster past whom everyone fears. His loyal secretary, Su-Ho, has secretly harbored a crush on Seung-Tae for a long time. One day, Su-Ho is summoned by Seung-Tae and receives a suggestive request.

"Su-Ho, hit me just once."

Seung-Tae lies face-down on a chair, taking the blows to his buttocks, while Su-Ho grows increasingly aroused. The tension in the office continues to rise...

"Executive, are you satisfied with this?"

mangas.title: Unsealed Desire
mangas.description:
Lim Chan-Yeong was often physically punished by his teachers as a student, causing him to believe that he was masochistic. At the academy where he works part-time, he meets Goo Dong-Ha, a teacher with massive masochistic tendencies. Due to a drunken encounter, Dong-Ha mistakes Chan-Yeong for a sadist and the two embark on a whirlwind BDSM adventure together.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three side story chapters.

mangas.title: Museounge Joa
mangas.synonyms: เรื่องน่ากลัวเนี่ย ชอบจัง
mangas.description:
"I'm scared... Can't you hug me?"

Su-Im, whom he has had a crush on for a long time, makes a dangerous request. A dark room. The two bodies pressed together. Will Kang Tae-Han be able to suppress his desires and maintain their friendship?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Whispering Tiger
mangas.description:
After receiving a scathing text from his roommate, Geon-Pil is puzzled but unperturbed when said roommate returns radically changed. The new "Yeon-Seung," driven by a primal, insatiable hunger, takes his friends-with-benefits relationship with Geon-Pil to the extreme to sate himself. As their physical encounters grow increasingly intense and feral, Geon-Pil slowly realizes that something is amiss. Even as whispers of danger warn him to back off, Geon-Pil finds himself growing comfortable with this strangely honest, dangerous new version of his partner… who just might devour him whole.


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: My First XXX: Fan In Denial
mangas.description:
Geon-Woo is a bodyguard who works on the security team for the idol group Magnum. He doesn't really have any complaints about his job, except for one person who keeps getting on his nerves: Do-Yoon. Throughout his career in the industry, Geon-Woo has never met a more irritating idol who seems ungrateful to his fans. Do-Yoon is simply a brat with a pretty face, in Geon-Woo's opinion, which is why he never intended to get mixed up with Do-Yoon in any personal way… So how did they end up in bed together?

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: How That Guide Is Loved
mangas.description: Guide Yoo-young has had enough of dating espers after being burned by ex-lovers. Determined to stick to a relationship with an ordinary person, he enjoys an amazing night with a charming man… only to discover the next morning that the man was an esper too, and he flees in panic. But the next day at work, Yoo-young finds out that top-tier S-class esper Jeong Si-ho has requested to be his pair. And the match rate? A staggering 99%!

mangas.title: Rapport
mangas.description:
S-class Esper Eunhyeon is forced into a rural transfer and paired with a male Guide, Jaewoo. Bored and biding time until he can return, he's shocked to find Jaewoo tangled up with another Esper. Could there be more to this "dull" partner than meets the eye?



(Source: Manta)



Note: Includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Behold, the Tiger
mangas.synonyms: It's a Tiger! | He Is the Tiger
mangas.description: t's Ju-Ho Doh's first day of college, and it's like an unbreakable curse has been lifted at last. After a childhood of being overlooked and ignored, he's finally starting to make friends! But attracting attention is a dangerous game when hungry ghosts start to take notice. And if running from spirits wasn't enough, there's a strange man who just can't get enough of him. Will Ju-Ho be able to live a normal life? Or will he be devoured by those closest to him?

mangas.title: Shout it
mangas.description: Jaeho initially misinterprets Taein as a criminal, but they are forced to work together on a film project. As they get to know each other, Jaho finds himself drawn to Taein's straightforward personality. Will their opposing personalities - one a perfectionist, the other a chronic mess-up - doom the film or spark an unexpected romance?

mangas.title: GOAT's Island
mangas.description: While on a school trip aboard a ship, Teacher Jihan has a strange dream about a goat man. He steps onto the deck to clear his head, only to be swept away by a huge wave. When he comes to, he finds himself on "Goats Island," where he meets Sea Bass and his friends—who all can’t remember a thing. As Jihan and Sea Bass fall head over hooves for each other, it becomes clear that their friends are “kidding” around with the truth, leaving Jihan to wonder what billy-big secrets they’re hiding.

mangas.title: The Gates of Paradise
mangas.description:
“So you’re back after three years.”

While suffering from severe trauma and nightmares, Jae-jun learns of the death of Father Ha, who had cared for him when he was an orphan, and returns to “True Jerusalem,” the cult he had fled from three years earlier.

There, he reunites with Raphael, whom he had lived with for a long time and had always admired...

“Why would you... commit the same sin as Father Ha...”
“This is absurd...! How could you... How could you do this?”

To his shock, the Raphael he met after so long had sunk to the depths of depravity, engaging in repeated promiscuous sexual encounters.

A distortion of desire, unleashed under the guise of faith and the “Eucharistic Rite.” Although Jae-jun feels repulsed, he experiences a paradoxical sense of peace as he no longer has nightmares since returning to True Jerusalem and begins to feel sexually attracted to Raphael.

“Jaejun, before you leave… I want to share God’s grace with you.”
“Is there really such a thing as God’s grace, just like you said, hyung?”

After engaging in a relationship with Raphael under the guise of “God’s grace,” Jaejun finds he can no longer endure a daily life without Raphael. Eventually, Min Jae-jun voluntarily re-joins the Church of Jerusalem, dedicated solely to Raphael. It seemed as though he would become a blind follower, captivated by his physical relationship with Raphael while pretending not to know any better... But something feels off about the church’s leader, Park Tae-chon.

“Do you really believe in the Leader, bro?”

The orgy masquerading as the “Eucharist” is not Raphael’s choice. And Leader Park Tae-chon’s actions are making his presence felt in a bizarrely conspicuous way. To protect Raphael, Min Jae-jun resolves to immerse himself even deeper into “True Jerusalem”…

mangas.title: Jemureun XX-ro Badeulgeyo
mangas.description: Note: Part of Luscent's X-mul Danpyeonseon (X물 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: I Don't Want to Get Absorbed!
mangas.synonyms: I Don't Want To Get Immersed!
mangas.description:
① One Top, Two Bottoms (Comic)
Campus idols Lee Yoon and Cha Hyun, who seem perfect on the surface, have one fatal flaw…They’re both firmly “bottoms”!
To overcome their sexless crisis, Ji-eon is forcibly(?) brought into the picture?!

A chaotic 1:2 hardcore romance service story where Ji-eon ends up yielding to desire and circumstance!

② I Don’t Want to Get Immersed!
College student Min-woo accidentally breaks an expensive bottle of liquor while working part-time, leaving him with a huge debt.
A regular customer—and top actor—Si-hwan offers to settle it, but in return proposes a “contract relationship”…
However, Si-hwan turns out to have tastes beyond imagination, leaving Min-woo constantly overwhelmed.

③ Subordination
Hyun, unable to endure the relentless harassment of Manager Mu-young, notorious as the “rookie crusher,” finally reaches his limit.
Prepared to quit his job, he instead takes extreme revenge—by imprisoning Mu-young.

mangas.title: Observation Subject for 7 Days
mangas.description: Balance Game Work at a company for 30 years and get 1 billion won VS Be observed by an alien and get 100 million won. A balance game caught the eye of Se-Hyun, who was working late. Without much hesitation, Se-Hyun chose the latter. What appeared before his eyes was none other than an alien... Trapped, Se-Hyun was forced to endure seven days of observation by the alien. But this alien was strangely handsome. Will Se-Hyun be able to return safely to Earth after seven days?

mangas.title: Do You Not Really Like This Kind Of Snake?
mangas.description:
Ho-jun, who was dumped by his girlfriend once again simply because he’s a “quirky tiger shapeshifter” who longs to be held by someone.

While lamenting his plight, completely drunk at his regular bar, Ho-jun catches the eye of Sa-hyun, who happens to walk in at that very moment.

Intrigued by Ho-jun—who is sniffling and wallowing in self-pity with his ears and tail exposed—Sa-hyun naturally takes the seat next to him…

mangas.title: A Night When Stars Fell
mangas.description:
On a rainy night, Yu-Seong wakes up alone amidst a pile of trash. Unable to remember who he is or where he came from, he begins a new life at Café NOAH. As Yu-Seong spends his days in a state of peaceful yet precarious existence, Kim U-Hyeon, the owner of a hardware store, appears before him. Observing Yu-Seong's every move with a gaze that is seemingly indifferent yet piercing, U-Hyeon exudes a dangerous aura. Yu-Seong assumes their encounter is merely a passing connection, but when U-Hyeon rescues him from an attack, he makes an unexpected remark.

"We've met before, haven't we? Don't you remember?"

"Want to be friends?"

Yu-Seong, indifferent to his own wounds, and U-Hyeon, who relentlessly probes that tremor. What will the two of them face at the end of this night?

mangas.title: A Strange Day
mangas.description:
Do-Yun, who moved to a quiet village in the countryside, accidentally found a white fox collapsed on the road and brought it home, naming it Haru. That very night after bringing the fox home, Do-Yun dreams of having relations with a mysterious white-haired man.
Startled awake, Do-Yun finds a small child sleeping soundly beside him...

"Could it be... you're Haru...?"

"Huh?"

mangas.title: Hyung! Can't You Take a Half Day Off?
mangas.description: “Hyung… did you nag that person like this too?” The older guy I’ve had a crush on since childhood says he’ll take in a jobless bum with nowhere to go. Then I should behave and quietly stay home like a good dog, but— Without realizing it, I keep messing with him. “Did you beg that bastard to do you too, clinging and crying like this?” What am I supposed to do when I get jealous every time he goes to work?

mangas.title: FIX
mangas.description:
Ho-Su harbors a desire to collect "crying faces" that match his taste. Hiding this fact, he maintains a precarious friendship with his roommate, Woo-Young. Then, one day, he finds himself witnessing an unexpected scene...

"The look on Woo-Young's face while he's doing XX..."

Was it an impulse, or a long-simmering desire? By the time he came to his senses, he had already crossed a line he shouldn't have.

"Woo-Young... Can I film you crying?"

mangas.title: Handle With Special Care!
mangas.description:
Gu Je-heon: a handsome, wealthy senior who grants every single one of my requests.J u Song-woo feels smug, believing that the kindness of this hyung—who seems to have been born just for him—is 'special treatment.' However, the moment he discovers that Je-heon has a boyfriend, he falls into an uncontrollable spiral of jealousy and confusion...

'If there's someone Hyung likes... shouldn't that person be me?'

mangas.title: Dogs At The Graveside
mangas.synonyms: Dogs at the Graveyard | Dogs at the Gravesite
mangas.description:
In the American West of the 1900s, Richard, who had been hiding his criminal past while making a life for himself on a rural ranch,
discovers Theo, a young man left for dead in the desert. Under normal circumstances, he would have walked away, but something about Theo's plight tugged at his heart, so he took him in. Richard begins to realize that Theo, who seems to be hiding a secret, is just like himself... As their shared sense of suffering turns into an unexpected attraction, and the moment they realize they feel the same way, the two are forced to confront a truth about their past that they never wanted to know.

mangas.title: made by devil
mangas.description:
Seo In-U, a once-genius fashion designer now in decline. Having lost everything, he arrives at a run-down hotel, where he reunites with Noah, a top model he once discovered. Noah, a demon who has been hiding his true identity while pretending to be human, proposes a sweet yet dangerous deal to In-U, promising to restore his former glory…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: Part of Lucent's Cheunggan X-eum Danpyeonseon (층간X음 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Even A Lonely Squirrel Has Its Own Burrow
mangas.description:
Kang Ga-Ram, a squirrel shapeshifter, lost both his guardian and his home in an instant. While living in the park in his squirrel form to escape loan sharks demanding money he never borrowed, he meets Samu-Heon, a suspicious yet handsome man. Feeling at ease with his kindness as he hands him nuts and cranberries every day, Ga-Ram unexpectedly finds herself destined to become his pet squirrel.

"Shall we eat, my little squirrel?"

"Are squirrels usually this smart?"

Unaware that he is a shapeshifter, Ga-Ram finds Samu-Heon's treatment of him as a pet both burdensome and
yet he finds himself tamed by his sweet touch. Then one day, he is shocked to discover that the man who had been so kind is actually the director of the loan shark company that had been tormenting her…

"Squeak! (I'm a male! An adult man, no less!)"

mangas.title: Uraaka-kun no Ecchi na Yume Haishin
mangas.titleNative: 裏アカくんのえっちな夢配信

mangas.title: Let's Go to My House!
mangas.description: Lim Su-Ho becomes entangled with Ju Chan-Mi due to the Korea University Student Council embezzlement scandal. Unlike Chan-Mi, who lives alone in a large apartment, Su-Ho faces eviction from his dormitory. Chan-mi offers him a place to stay in her apartment, and their cohabitation begins...

mangas.title: X Shot Method
mangas.description: Eun Seo-U, once a promising shooting star in his school days, had to give up his athletic career after suffering an eye injury in a traffic accident and ended up working as a police officer in his hometown. One day, amid a string of trivial complaints and reports, he hears the sound of a shower running in a house where no one should be... Mistaking the sound for a burglar, he swings a frying pan—only to hit his ex-boyfriend, Yeon Ha-Neul, who is standing there naked?! Unlike Seo-U, who had pushed him away out of guilt over the accident, Ha-Neul approaches him again as if nothing had happened.

mangas.title: Stop, Stop!!
mangas.description: Ha-seong possesses a family lineage passed down through generations that allows him to hear the inner thoughts of anyone he comes into contact with! However, there is a "series of conditions" underlying the activation of this ability. First, the other person must be someone he has sexual feelings for! Second, he must have a sexual relationship with that person! Third, he can only hear thoughts related to sexual fantasies! While preparing to propose to his best friend Cheon to put an end to his long-standing unrequited love, Ha-seong becomes so distraught after his plans go awry that he ends up having sex with Cheon while drunk. "I want to shove my dick into that face and cum all over his mouth until he throws up..." From that day on, he begins to hear Cheon's dirty talk, which is too vulgar to even mention?! A hyper-realism romance unfolds as the foxy Cheon, who is two-faced, meets Ha-seong, who lives harboring fantasies about love.

mangas.title: Can I Rate Your Body, Too?
mangas.synonyms: Can I Give the Boss a Rating?
mangas.description: Min-Hyeok is a dessert influencer who always finishes his day by ordering a comforting, fiery-hot bowl of kimchijjim. On a night with heavy rain, delivery complications present Min-Hyeok with an unexpected opportunity when the owner of his favorite kimchijjim spot offers to drive the food over himself. Hooked by the owner's surprisingly charming voice, Min-Hyeok hatches a plan to lure this mysterious, helpful man right into his apartment. Will this rainy night be a recipe for a steamy romance, or will the spice come back to bite Min-Hyeok?

mangas.title: Written In The Shadows
mangas.synonyms: As if Someone Had Set It
mangas.description: Dr. Jin Ae-Gyeom returns to Gangchun, the rural village where he spent his childhood with his beloved hyung Pil-Ju, to open a clinic. Just as he arrives, Pil-Ju appears, as if he had been waiting for him. But the affectionate, endearing Pil-Ju from his memories is nowhere to be found; instead, the man standing before him has become a host at a bar. Even so, Ae-Gyeom's pure love, his dream of becoming a devoted husband, remains unchanged. He is prepared to do anything to ensure he never has to part with Pil-Ju. Even if that "anything" means…

mangas.title: Disk Solution
mangas.description: Na-Ji, known throughout the industry as the 'Legendary Developer,' is a notorious workaholic who routinely overworks himself until his herniated disc finally gives out. Amidst this, he ends up attending a colleague's birthday party at a gay club for the first time in his life. There, he meets Ki Sung-Geun, a man dubbed the 'Legendary Healer,' and spends the night with him... The next day. More surprising than sleeping with a stranger was the fact that his aching back had miraculously healed! He needs this man, Ki Sung-Gun, to meet tomorrow's deadline.

mangas.title: Alpine
mangas.description:
Nam Seon-woo, a former ski athlete and an Alpha.
One night, after getting completely drunk to ease the heartache of learning that his childhood friend—whom he’d had a crush on for a long time—was in a relationship, he meets Eun Hyun-chae, a man so handsome he can’t take his eyes off him.

Seon-woo, who flirted with Hyun-chae while drunk, blacked out, and thought it was just a one-night fling…

The next day, he runs into Hyun-chae at school and discovers that Hyun-chae is a junior at the same school—and, to his surprise, is also an Alpha.

“I don’t date Alphas. You must have been a hallucination because you’re so pretty.”

Even though he tries to push Hyun-chae away, he joins Seon-woo’s ski club, “Schufur,” takes a total of 40 credits—including cross-enrollment courses— and follows Seon-woo around like glue.

He can’t understand why Hyun-chae won’t back off no matter how much he pushes him away,

“It’s because you always… look at me like that.”
“…How do I… look at you?”

“With a look that says you think I’m drop-dead gorgeous.”

Seon-woo’s gaze keeps drifting back to Hyun-chae….

mangas.title: The Perfect Breakup
mangas.synonyms: The Perfect Way to Break Up
mangas.description: Tae Jeong-Ha and Baek Ho-Su, who have been friends for over ten years, have been living together for a year, but Ho-Su tells Jeong-Ha, who seems to have no feelings for him, that he wants to break up. However, Ho-Su had forgotten that he and Jeong-Ha used to be a campus couple! From the day after they broke up, he feels uncomfortable seeing Jeong-Ha everywhere he goes on campus, but the more he tries to end their relationship, the more entangled they become. Will they ever be able to break up completely?
mangas.link: The Perfect Way to Break Up

mangas.title: Psyche
mangas.description:
Psyche, an imprisoned royal, emerges after years in a tower to find his kingdom destroyed by rebellion and his family's rule condemned as cruel and corrupt. Grieving his brother Michele, Psyche is seized by the Liberation Army that is led by Anteros, who proposes marriage to exploit an oracle and "destroy the kingdom" completely. Forced into this dangerous marriage, Psyche hides his hatred and plots revenge… But soon he discovers that perhaps his resentment is aimed towards the wrong man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Is it Okay for a Murderer to be an Idol?
mangas.description:
Lee Yu-Min began his career with an unwavering determination to succeed. While practicing for an important year-end awards ceremony, he witnesses his leader, Han Se-Gye, committing murder. Although he blackmails him into keeping it a secret for the sake of the group, Se-Gye showers him with even more aggressive physical affection than before, leaving Yu-Min both flustered and deeply confused...

"I must be losing my mind… Why is my heart racing for a murderer?!"

A ruthless killer or the affectionate leader and older brother of the team— which of these is Se-Gye's true self?

mangas.title: Double Dating
mangas.description: On the very day he decided to confess his feelings to his female friend Ju-Yeong, whom he had a crush on, he suddenly comes out to him. Flustered, Jae-Won not only lied, saying, "Actually, I like guys too!" but also ended up arranging a double date on the spur of the moment. To save face, he asks his friend Yu-Won to pretend to be his boyfriend, but… on the day of the date, when he finds out that the girlfriend Ju-Yeong brought along is actually Yu-Won's ex, the double date spirals into chaos…?

mangas.title: My Ghost Diary
mangas.description:
Today too, he tried hard to strike up conversations, but due to his faint presence, Ha-Woon returned home without speaking to anyone. Lying in bed, tears streaming down his face from loneliness, he suddenly felt a hand patting him gently from above his head.
That's how Ha-Woon became aware of the ghost Kwon Gi-Jin. At first, he pretends not to know, but so lonely, he ends up spending the night with Gi-Jin, who is always affectionate toward him...

"Hey... Can't you just stay by my side forever?"

mangas.title: Winter Field
mangas.description:
At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

mangas.title: An Ode to Youth
mangas.description:
"I'm different from that person, too different!"

Cheong-Uk and Un-Ho have been living together for three months due to unavoidable circumstances. The two people who don't match at all end up clashing and fighting over trivial things. Their anger towards each other builds up and before they know it, they're on the verge of exploding, but Un-Ho ends up revealing his secret to Cheong-Uk...!

Will Cheong-Uk and Un-Ho be able to get along without any problems in the future?

mangas.title: Love Me Dramatically
mangas.description:
When I told him my feelings, he replied, "I've always dreamed of a love straight out of a drama." I thought he was just telling me to be a good boyfriend, but as we got closer, I finally understood what he meant — He wanted us to live out a true romance drama. But can I really play my part in his script called life?

(Source: Manta)

Forced to live as a high school student due to his stepfather's gambling debt, Jeong Hui-Jae flees to a remote island to live with his grandmother so he can escape the pursuit of loan sharks. But just when he thinks he's safe, Hui-Jae runs into trouble in the form of the local gangster squad: Bowlcut, Hatchet, and Cha Beom-Joon. But when Hui-Jae becomes Beom-Joon's errand boy, the two find themselves stuck not only on the island, but in a complicated love affair that leaves them both stranded in love…

mangas.title: Puppy Hubby
mangas.description:
Woof! Life sure has gotten tough for Ho-San...but just when he's about to end it all, his savior comes knocking. When his fluffy-eared, tail-wagging guest offers the answer to all of his problems, all Ho-San needs to do is say yes...to the dress?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Erratic Muse
mangas.description:
During his school days, Gio accidentally discovered a rock band called Aurora, which became his muse. Inspired by them, he pursued a career in music and became a skilled composer. However, Aurora couldn't survive in the overwhelming digital music market and eventually disappeared. Gio could never forget the voice of Aurora's vocalist—until one day, a mysterious man named Seon-Gyu appeared before him. Their first encounter was suspicious, but through his best friend Hee-Seop, Gio learned an astonishing fact: Seon-Gyu's voice resembled that of Aurora's vocalist.

"Hyung, please, just sing once!"

"No."

All he wanted was to hear a single note—why was it so difficult?

mangas.title: Desire Me If You Can
mangas.description: Grayson Miller's life goal is to find his soulmate. A fortune-teller told him that his destiny lies with "someone with a big heart who's connected to fire." Then, Grayson lost consciousness after accidentally encountering an Extreme Omega firefighter in the midst of a blaze! When Grayson entered the fire station to find him, he got into a huge fight with firefighter Dane and ended up getting entangled with him...

mangas.title: Call 0 to Connect to a Counselor
mangas.description:
Yu Jeong-Won, a customer service representative, is overwhelmed by calls from abusive clients when he finds comfort in a kind word from a customer. Thanks to this, Jeong-Won, who has regained his energy and finished his day, hears the voice of Lee Kyu-Hyuk, a waiter at a restaurant after work, and realizes that he is the person who comforted him earlier in the day. Unaware, Jeong-Won leaves the restaurant, clutching a sense of regret, just as Kyu-Hyuk calls out to him...

"My part-time job is ending soon, and... um... I thought I'd regret it if we just broke up."

Jeong-Won can't resist Kyu-Hyuk, who approaches him with a voice as affectionate as his...

mangas.title: The Ex-orcist
mangas.synonyms: Falling for X | To Love Ex
mangas.description:
Once sorta passionate lovers, Ha-Sol and Jin-Yul are now nothing more than each other's "exes." After completing his mandatory military service and returning to university, Jin-Yul unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha-Sol on campus. Uncomfortable with the awkward baggage of their shared history, Jin-Yul does everything in his power to avoid his former flame. However, destiny takes a bizarre and terrifying turn when a malicious ghost—one that had been relentlessly stalking Jin-Yul—takes complete possession of Ha-Sol's body.

Driven by the spirit's dark, uninhibited desires, the boundary between the supernatural and the carnal quickly dissolves. Trapped together by this paranormal anomaly, the former couple finds themselves pushed into an intense, feverish intimacy, crossing boundaries and indulging in raw, physical acts they never even dared to attempt back when they were actually dating. Their unresolved past colliding with possession sparks an uncontrollable, forbidden fire between them.

mangas.title: Double-Edged Shooter
mangas.description:
"How about sleeping with me whenever I want? Sounds like it'd be fun."

By day, he's a capable assistant manager at a major corporation; by night, he's a famous gay streamer living a perfect double life. But his routine starts to crumble when a parachute hire joins the company.

"Manager, you seem to be living quite an interesting life."

"Are you threatening me right now?"

mangas.title: Are You Here For Eggplant?
mangas.description:
Han Kang-woo impulsively got accepted into the business school at Korea University after being told his father would buy him a Lamborghini.
When his father failed to keep his promise, Kang-woo listed his father’s collection of luxury watches on Gaji Market, a secondhand marketplace, and at the meeting spot, he encountered “Ju-young,” a buyer who was so beautiful it took him by surprise.
“Gaji… right?”

But this beautiful buyer doesn’t seem to have much interest in the watch itself.

“Want to grab a drink?”
“Sure…!”

Still confused, Kang-woo ends up drinking with Ju-young and spending a steamy night with him. But the next day, Ju-young disappears, leaving behind only a pair of white socks….

‘This can’t be happening. We’re totally meant to be!’

After searching high and low for the pretty older guy who took his virginity but didn’t buy the “Sagara” watch, Kang-woo finally reunites with Ju-young at school.

“Hyung! Waaah! It’s me! Han! Kang! Woo!”

For some reason, Ju-young recoils in disgust and runs away, but Kang-woo remains undeterred. Kang-woo is the kind of person who sees things through, and Lady Luck is always on his side.

Who said anything about dating? I just want him to let me chase after him!

mangas.title: My Ex-Boo
mangas.description:
Two years ago, Lee Gyudam abruptly ended his relationship with Shin Myeongjin right before enlisting in the military. When destiny finally brings them face-to-face on their college campus, Myeongjin is eager to reconnect, only to be utterly devastated. Due to a bizarre spiritual affliction, Gyudam is haunted by ghosts and literally cannot recognize his former lover's face.



Reeling from the trauma that his beloved hyung has completely forgotten him, a distracted Myeongjin wanders into traffic and gets hit by a car. Now trapped in a state of out-of-body astral projection, his spirit appears directly before Gyudam, who can see the dead. Refusing to let his tragedy go to waste, Myeongjin desperately clings to his ex, wailing, "How can I pass on to the afterlife without even getting to stick it inside me, hyung?!"



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kabukicho Cat Honey
mangas.titleNative: 歌舞伎町キャットハニー
mangas.description:
Haru, a super popular "top" among the gay nightlife crowd, gets dragged to a host club after work by one of his regulars. There, he meets the overfamiliar (and super hot) Number 2 host, Shinya, who's exactly his type. He's super aggressive, even though he's straight! Fearing he might fall in love with the silver-tongued playboy, Haru tries to get out of there as soon as he can, but ends up forgetting his cell phone at the club! Is this for real, or is Haru just getting fooled by this smooth-talking hottie?



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: F-Class Love Story
mangas.description:
Born with incredible luck, Jeong-Yeon always has good things happening to him. Then, the most perfect-looking guy, Lee Yun-Seong, appears before him. Yun-Seong, who had always received attention for his good looks since birth, didn't like people who only approached him for his face. So, he wasn't thrilled when Jeong-Yeon expressed his interest right after meeting him.

"Can I call you hyung? Yun-Seong: "Heeeey~ I hope we see each other often from now on."

After their awkward first encounter, Yun-Seong gets annoyed whenever he keeps bumping into Jeong-Yeon wherever he goes. But Jeong-Yeon, completely unfazed by his irritation, keeps pestering him. Before he knows it, Yun-Seong finds himself quietly falling for him...

"Were you satisfied with my role as your living dildo last night?"

The story of Jeong-Yeon and Yun-Seong, who bicker and clash every time they meet.

mangas.title: Sunshine in Hades
mangas.titleNative: 地獄犬は司祭に喰らい付く
mangas.description:
Cerberus, a coliseum gladiator, has been ordered to become a stud for breeding a new generation of powerful warriors. For political reasons, Phaethon, a handsome priest of the sun god, has agreed to give the virgin gladiator lessons in sex. At first, Phaethon underestimates the reserved Cerberus, but the gladiator's eyes hold a smoldering love that borders on raging inferno. Can the love between two lonely souls break the chains of social status that bind them?



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Sonna Mura nara Daiteshimae
mangas.titleNative: そんな村なら抱いてしまえ

mangas.title: Streaming ♡ Love Addiction
mangas.titleNative: ストリーミング♡ラブアディクション

mangas.title: Koisuru Mellow Milk
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: IN Seoul
mangas.description:
Seoul, a second-year medical student at Korea University, was relieving academic stress in a secretive way he couldn't tell anyone about—


"Huh, hmm... right here feels so good..."


...masturbating his prostate while listening to sticky slime ASMR in his single dorm room. But when the dorm undergoes remodeling, he suddenly becomes roommates with Jin-Hu, a physical education major. His alone time vanishes, and Seoul's pent-up frustration reaches its limit....


"From now on, you're my dildo."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: Kayce's Secret
mangas.description:
In a small town called Leo. Ruben, the wizard who isn't just known for his title as the 'Rising Star' or for his powerful potions. He's also beloved by the ladies in town for his gentle nature, charming looks, and single status. But one day, a rare creature suddenly rolls into his life. Ruben, thrilled by the thought of wealth and fame, even gives it a cute nickname: Squishy. But the next morning…

What he finds in his bed isn't squishy, but a beauty?!

"From now on, I'm calling you Squishy. If you don't like it, remember your real name."

mangas.title: Resurrection Merit
mangas.description:
Mission: Break the Curse of Your Favorite Idol with Your Own Body!

A voice actor who secretly adores the virtual YouTuber "Yu-Won." The real Yu-Won suddenly bursts into the voice actor's home!
"Jeong-Han," Yu-Won's true identity, claims to be in a ghostly state! To become a normal person, he must receive love…
But he has to release that love through physical contact?! That's a total win-win, isn't it…?

mangas.title: Bai Ze Zhi Ming
mangas.synonyms: In the Name of Bai Ze | The Name of White Marsh
mangas.description: Several decades ago, the young boy Bai Ze wandered into the mountains of the immortal realm and formed a bond with a young immortal. Back in the present day, the college student Bai Ze once again comes to the immortal realm, only to find that the handsome immortal of his dreams has become a pitiful figure, forgotten by the mortal realm. In a world where demons and monsters wreak havoc, the source of the trouble turns out to be this pitiful thing. Trying to make things right, Bai Ze forcefully brings the immortal back to the mortal realm with him, looking for his help to restore the peace. After all, who could resist someone so beautiful, powerful, yet pitiful?

mangas.title: Hot-to-Go Bakery: Cooking the Dead
mangas.description:
In a ruined world where the dead rise as monsters, Johan survives in the outskirts by baking bread and bartering at the local village. One day, he's chased by undead monsters back to his home, and he unleashes a blazing fire upon them… only to find two scorchingly hot men alive and well. Calion and Alexis, returned to their human selves, spend their time testing Johan's limits on curing the undead… and the limits of what he can take into his delicious buns.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Let Me Be Your Dog
mangas.synonyms: A Dog and a Kind-hearted Boiler
mangas.description: Thirty-year-old Gang Nak-Kyeong is a boiler repairman by day and a dog-loving shelter volunteer in his free time. He's more than happy to enjoy his simple, ordinary life until twenty-four-year old Nam Ji-Ha comes crashing into his life, calling him out for late night repairs and animal advice. Is Nak-Kyeong ready to let another stray into his heart, or will Ji-Ha have to keep searching for his forever home…?

mangas.title: Garnet in the Rough
mangas.titleNative: ゴミ溜めのガーネット
mangas.synonyms: The Garnet that Sparkles in the Junk | Gomidame no Garnet | Scrap Heap Garnet
mangas.description: Kanae, a hitman, is attacked by Sara, a half-vampire, near a trash dump. With no attachment to life, Kanae is apathetic to having his blood sucked or being followed home. Sara was treated as a defective vampire and discarded by his progenitor. Starving for blood, he makes Kanae a proposal: "I'll take care of your degenerate life, and in return, you'll be my food supply!" Because of the arousing effects of bloodsucking, the two begin a physical relationship. As they discover the warmth of touch, they begin to melt each other's loneliness... This is their tale of finding love in a brutal and despicable world.

mangas.title: Amagami wo Kimi ni
mangas.description:
In the present day where humans and werebeast are living in harmony, there is something that has been bothering Matsumoto, a Kishu weredog, who actually likes cats. It's about a male calico cat that kept appearing when he was feeding the cats near the school as part of his daily routine. And… there's also the fact that he finds Sasaki, a student from the same seminar, to be cute.

One day, he found out that Sasaki is a werecat as well as that calico cat. And from then on, he can cuddle and pet Sasaki's cat form all he wants! But the more time they spend together, the more Matsumoto's feelings for Sasaki go in a direction other than friendship...

This is a fluffy sweet werebeast love story between a quiet Kishu weredog who likes to take care of others and an honestly sweet werecat who start out as friends.

mangas.title: Love Traps
mangas.description:
Love is... capturing! The Cat Prince's Secret Puppy Capture! Lee Ye-Won was suddenly evicted overnight due to dorm expansion. He drifted between friends' houses for a while, but as a shapeshifter, Ye-Won faced a desperate situation with nowhere to stay as his heat approached. That's when Ji Seung-Hu, a classmate and fellow shapeshifter, invited Ye-Won to stay in an empty room at his place. Staying at Seung-Hu's place, Ye-Won treats him to a meal and drinks as a token of gratitude... Only to wake up naked in the same bed the next morning.Instead of repaying the homeowner's kindness, he's in heat and caused a proper mess?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Diamond Dust
mangas.description: Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yee-Hyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun - someone so far above his world it, felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega…coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it's a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yee-Hyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible…

mangas.title: Zero Centimeter
mangas.synonyms: ゼロセンチメートル〜10年ぶりに再会した初恋のあいつ〜
mangas.description:
Back in high school, Hyeon Ji-Woo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seon-Ho.
But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seon-Ho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Ji-Woo without warning. Fast forward 10 years: Ji-Woo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life… until Seon-Ho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand! Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Ji-Woo's first love, first heartbreak… and possibly, his newest headache.



Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes five side story chapters.

mangas.title: The Ghost In The Doorway
mangas.description: Han Tae-Oh's return to Korea was supposed to be a brief, somber visit to bury his father. Instead, he finds himself trapped in a web of suspicion centered on Yun Gyeong-Seo, the man who stayed behind to serve his family while Tae-Oh was away. Gossip whispers of Gyeong-Seo's involvement in his father's decline, and the more Tae-Oh investigates, the less he recognizes his former first love. Within the walls of the sprawling mansion, Tae-Oh begins to piece together a fragmented past, uncovering a cycle of revenge that has been decades in the making. Every truth he unearths brings him closer to a terrifying realization: the person he wants to trust most may be the one who has everything to lose.

mangas.title: The Leashed
mangas.description:
“I love that you can't leave my side.”

Doyul, the heir to a prestigious gumiho (nine-tailed fox) clan, and Jaehyun, the second son of a powerful wolf clan, have grown up together since childhood.They share a secret.

Doyul forcibly made Jaehyun swallow a fox bead so that he would never be able to leave him. As a result, Doyul can obtain life energy only through Jaehyun, while Jaehyun suffers in silence, hiding his unrequited love for Doyul as he remains by his side.

Before Doyul chooses a mate as the future head of the clan, Jaehyun resolves to put his feelings behind him. Meanwhile, the wolf and gumiho clans—the two most influential beastfolk families—maintain a friendly relationship on the surface, but in reality they constantly keep each other in check.

Sensing something suspicious about Councilman Lee, Doyul's father, Jaehyun decides to investigate. To uncover the truth, he enters the gumiho clan's research institute...

mangas.title: The Taming
mangas.description: As the son of the fallen House Anatold, Michel's only duty is to help his family's social standing by marrying the prominent Duke Shelleg of the north. However, upon his arrival, he is met with the servant Ain, who is acting as the duke's stand-in to teach Michel what it means to be a northern husband. To his surprise, his most important duties take place in the bedroom! Michel is determined to be a proper partner, but what will he do when his newfound feelings for Ain start to get in the way?

mangas.title: Nice to See You
mangas.description: Ko I-Deum is a total shut in who knows how to do one thing, and one thing only: write passionate BL smut. There's just one small problem: I-Deum is a complete and total virgin. To try and stimulate his brain (among other things), I-Deum takes to…well, "taking care of himself" in front of the window, imagining all sorts of sensual scenarios to jumpstart his creative juices. Sure, there may be an apartment right across from him, but nobody's lived there for years…until now! Mid self-love session, he looks up to see a man staring at him from across the street - and not just any man, but the bisexual icon and surely soon-to-be celeb, acting major Kwon Jae-Yi. Some might say their situation is a little too close for comfort…but maybe it's just the right distance for something more.

mangas.title: No Love Zone
mangas.description:
It's been about a year since Lee Eun-Kyum started working at his office job. He's outgoing and gets along well with his co-workers, but his success with romantic relationships is less than stellar, especially since he tends to fall hard and fast based on looks alone. History seems poised to repeat itself in the form of his new boss, Han Ji-Hyuk.



The handsome Han Ji-Hyuk is exactly Lee Eun-Kyum's type, but his personality is a total turn-off as he proceeds to work Lee Eun-Kyum to the bone. The more aggravated Lee Eun-Kyum feels, the more he can't get Han Ji-Hyuk off his mind. Could this heated attraction be mutual?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Haunted Tales
mangas.synonyms: 4 Strange Tales | Deathly Strange Tales | Four Seasons Ghost Tales
mangas.description: Yang Gi-Dam, a freshman at Soleum College, has always been fascinated by and drawn to the occult. It is only natural, then, that he finds himself joining the on-campus Ghost Story Club. Unbeknownst to him, however, his involvement in such activities has already been noticed by Seo Neul-Ham, an upperclassman with a cold aura who can see ghosts. One day, as if by fate, the two become entangled and are drawn into a spooky turn of events. How will this unlikely pair fare when the ghost stories that Yang Gi-Dam so enjoys are no longer just tales?

mangas.title: Romance in a Romance-less Era
mangas.description:
Yoon I-Gyeong slept with a man. With Cha Seon-Ho, his landlord who changes men every week like clockwork. Seon-Ho seems to represent non-romance on the surface, casually moving from one affair to the next, yet secretly dreams of romance. Watching Seon-Ho exhausted from his one-sided love, I-Gyeong began to want something more than just one night with him.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Ghost-Be-Gone
mangas.description: Born seeing ghosts, Jong-Eon grew up in a world of shadows. His grim reality flips when he pairs up for a college project with Hye-Seong, a cheerful underclassman who somehow acts as a literal human ghost repellent. Desperate for a peaceful life, Jong-eon starts following Hye-Seong everywhere to keep the spirits at bay. But when he gets caught red-handed, Jong-Eon panics and blurts out the first excuse he can think of: he's hopelessly in love.

mangas.title: Wide Open
mangas.description:
Lee Hu-Young, a special rookie of the professional basketball team 'HG Big Whales'. He was living a difficult life day by day to pay off his father's loan debt.
When everything was burdensome and burdensome, a man appeared.


"Are you trying to seduce me now?"


"What you just did was seducing me, and I'm just trying to see."



The short break he spent with the man was sweet, but in the harsh reality, Lee Hu-Young chose to disappear instead of continuing his relationship with the man.
And he didn't know that he would meet him again a year later. And that too as the owner of HG Big Whales and a player. He thought he would be caught without anyone knowing, but the owner Eun Jun-Wook's reaction was unexpected.


"If you need anything, tell me. I'll help you in any way I can. I'll be a bonus to you, not a flaw."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Backdoor Neighbors
mangas.description: The small town farmer life is all Gi-Tae has known his whole life. He's never been into mystery, intrigue, or complications. But all of that appears in the form of his newly hired helper Hae-Un—who is absolutely useless at farming. But Hae-Un's true talents lay somewhere else. Mainly in the bed…if only they could actually get into a bed, somehow.

mangas.title: Yoru to Futari
mangas.description: Mitsuru came to live in a remote village where, legend has it, "vampires live." He started living in the villa his late grandfather left behind when one day, he met Naoji, who claimed to be an acquaintance of his grandfather. Since Naoji's face was his type, Mitsuru just wanted a taste, but a half asleep Naoji kissed him instead!? In the end, Mitsuru becomes friends with Naoji but...??

mangas.title: LOVE UPSET
mangas.description:
The owner, a former scout for a once-promising baseball team, meets Ki-Jeong, a high school student who dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. While everyone else talks about Ki-Jeong's limitations, the owner is the only one who immediately recognizes his genius and offers sincere advice to keep him from giving up on baseball. To Ki-Jeong, the owner was the only person in his entire life who believed in him just as he was.

"Ki-Jeong, your hands and feet are bigger than mine. That means you could end up taller than me, too."

But the happiness was short-lived; without a word, the owner resigned from his scouting position and vanished completely. Five years later the owner returns to his former team with a new title as a performance analysis manager, where he is reunited with Ki-Jeong, now a professional baseball player who has grown beyond recognition. Though taken aback by Ki-Jeong's changed appearance, the owner finds himself unable to look away...

"The number I never got back then... can I get it now?"

The time that had stood still for the two of them, frozen in longing, begins to move again on the scorching mound.

mangas.title: Bound by Sin
mangas.description: After being reborn, an elite police officer becomes a prisoner and is taken in by his nemesis. Amidst suspicion and entanglement, the two eventually become accomplices in their shared fate.

mangas.title: Sunjinmuguneun Gollan
mangas.description:
On the day of the high school graduation party, Woobin receives a confession from Hyunho, a male student at the same school. Woobin finds it absurd that the first confession he received as soon as he turned 20 was from a guy, but he feels sorry for Hyunho who is weeping... so he ends up dating him...



(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: Sugarcoat de Kowashite
mangas.titleNative: シュガーコートで壊して

mangas.title: Kuchi no Naka ni Amaku Furete
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kuro Rekishi ni Yoroshiku
mangas.description:
"You're just what our club needs!!"



Tsubaki Kouichirou is a freshman drowning in fame: girls want to date him, guys want to be him. Just a few months back, in middle school, it was the complete opposite, until an encounter with a mysterious girl changed everything. Falling in love at first sight, he undergoes a makeover and enrolls in the same school as her, determined to make this love blossom… But now where is she?!?



(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Dr. V and His Three Lovers
mangas.description: Devastated by his lover Henry's sudden death, Victor gets drunk and steals his coffin from his grave. The last thing he remembers is bringing it back to his lab before blacking out. But when Victor wakes up, he's confronted by three men who claim that he revived them from the dead using Henry's head, heart, and crown jewels! Although none of them are Henry, all of them are drawn to Victor in different ways... Can Victor's three new lovers fill the hole in his life that Henry left behind?

mangas.title: Touch Within the Abyss
mangas.description:
"When you get to know the real me… you will be disappointed."



Chinatsu, a hitman, meets his destiny again. His name is Kasumi. He was the boy who reached out to Chinatsu when he lost his brother in front of his eyes.



A few years later, Chinatsu rescues Kasumi from a snatcher by chance. Kasumi is blind, and Chinatsu can't leave him alone in the street… although he knows he shouldn't get close to him, the distance between them gets shorter day by day…



A story of redemption, in which two young men trapped in darkness slowly soothe each other's loneliness.



(Source: ShuCream BL)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Reborn As A Character In A Dating Sim On Hard Mode
mangas.titleNative: 転生モブの恋愛ハードモード
mangas.description:
Why are this dating sim's characters into an NPC!?



After being hit by a truck, Tomoya Miyuki wakes up in the world of "Dokimelo High School," a popular dating simulation game. He is the female main character's best friend, who helps her end up with one of the potential matches in the story.

Just when Tomoya's made up his mind to enjoy the kind of high school experience he never had in his previous life, he realizes he's attracted an unusual amount of attention from one of the romance options... the ever-popular Yukito Sakakibara. To top it off, Yukito ends up helping Tomoya remove a capsule item stuck inside him...!

A romantic comedy between a handsome, mysterious otome game character and an average Joe who was supposedly reincarnated as an NPC!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Singwan-nimi A Ya!hae
mangas.synonyms: The Priest-nim Is Ah Ya! Hey
mangas.description:
The scorching sun. The golden desert and the blue sea! After working hard for 3 years, Kyu-Hyun goes on a trip to the African desert as a gift to himself. While trying to enjoy a healing life, Kyu-Hyun gets caught in a huge sandstorm and gets seriously injured, losing consciousness, and Neferti saves him. After a dreamlike kiss, he comes to his senses and wonders where he is?! And the animals are talking?!! Kyu-Hyun despairs when he hears that no one has returned to where they were, but he starts to get excited, wondering if he might meet the mysterious man who saved him...

(Source: Peenutoon, translated)


Note: Chapter count includes 11 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Usotsuki na Kiss de Kyou mo Bye Bye
mangas.titleNative: 嘘つきなキスで今日もバイバイ
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Past Friendship
mangas.description:
Kwon Woo-young and Ko Tae-sung were always the closest of friends—inseparable and unbreakable.



Their relationship took a drastic turn when Lee Soo-hwa, a timid classmate from high school, grew closer to Woo-young. Tension and jealousy began to simmer between the two friends, eventually erupting in a mysterious incident that shattered their bond.



Even after enrolling in university, they couldn't repair their friendship. Struggling with his unresolved emotions, Woo-young chose to enlist in the army, hoping to bury his feelings for Tae-sung. But neither time nor distance could erase the complexity of his emotions. After his discharge, he moved into a new apartment—only to discover that Tae-sung was living in the same building.



What began as innocent friendship now burns with an intensity Woo-young can no longer deny.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: On My Own
mangas.synonyms: 天才主厨先生的恶魔小奶狗~求你不要碰我~
mangas.description:
Genius chef and restaurant owner Heemin hates relying on others so much that he's called "Mr. On My Own". Being known as a no-fluff, values-over-looks guy is all good in the workplace, except it means he has to hide an integral part of who he is… The fact that he's a diehard fan of the K-pop group, Emotion! To be specific, Heemin is obsessed with Jeong-woon, but at a meet-and-greet, one of the other members, Yiyeon, keeps chatting him up. There's no room for another #1 in Heemin's heart…or is there?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Secretive XX
mangas.description:
"You smell."

One day, Tae-Gyeol, a 20-year-old returning student, is suddenly told by a classmate he's never met before that he smells. Though flustered by this remark he's never heard before, he tries to brush it off as a minor incident. Offended by a teacher's remark comparing him to another returning student from a different class, Tae-Gyeol impulsively heads to the classroom. There, he encounters none other than Mu-Won, the very person who had told him he smelled. When Tae-Gyeol confronts him about the earlier comment, Mu-Won evades the question with an ambiguous, half-hearted response. Annoyed by this, Tae-Gyeol finds himself strangely unable to look away from Mu-Won. Finally, Tae-Gyeol approaches first and proposes they become friends.

"Want to hang out with me later?"

"No..."

Even though he clearly said no, Mu-Won is waiting for Tae-Gyeol at the school gate after class. What exactly is this guy's true intention?

mangas.title: Hygieia
mangas.description: In a remote, insular village devoted to the goddess Hygieia, Tauser lives a monotonous life, never having left its borders. One day, a journalist named Hereis arrives, stirring doubts about everything Tauser once believed and unraveling secrets long buried...

mangas.title: What Happens if a Driver Is Unmarried
mangas.synonyms: What Happens When the Single Coachman Becomes the Substitute
mangas.description: Hardy works as a proxy driver of magic carriages until a shady request sends him to the wedding of Hysterion's infamous young heir. Forced to crash the ceremony, Hardy is stunned when Abel Hysterion, the center of every scandal, points straight at him and declares, "Here comes my bride."

mangas.title: Third Ending
mangas.description:
Seo Yun-Seul has had life easy—everyone likes him, he's good at his job, basically, everything has always worked out as smooth as butter. However, there's something that brings all of his good luck down, and it's the infrequent dreams he has of Kang Jun. Who knew that rejecting a guy once would hang so heavy on your life? To make things worse, after he runs into Jun the dreams keep on coming daily. At his wit's end, Yun-Seul takes some advice from a friend so that he can free himself from this jinx. It's simple. Make Kang Jun think that he's a nice person. That can't be hard, right?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)



Note:

- From season 2 (chapter 36) this becomes Mature (R19), Season 1 is All-Ages (R15).

- Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: In the Air: Be, be
mangas.description:
I thought I was a beta all my life, but it turns out I'm an omega! And not just any omega, but one who's about to become the crown princess. Not only am I confused by shattered images of my past and the cumbersome imperial etiquette…most of all, I'm confused by my supposedly destined union with the so-called "golden alpha," crown prince Wookyung. Besides, I'm a man - how am I supposed to get pregnant?! But my desperation to avoid carrying his baby is only making the crown prince more and more upset…

Something is in the air, and it's not just love…



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Stranger
mangas.description:
"A stranger changed my life."



While struggling to survive his troubled life with no one to rely on, Ji-Ho Kim stumbles into Woojung Yeon and follows him. "Favors are not free." Ji-Ho's way of seeing the world paints Woojung as an untrustworthy character, but Woo-Jung's continuous kindness finally begins to open Ji-Ho's heart.

(Source: Manta, edited)


Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Taming the Tiger
mangas.description: Ahn Geum-hoo needs a butcher to provide fresh animal blood for his sickly brother's medicine. While most of the butchers seem reluctant to provide him with what he needs, Nobody is willing to do Geum-hoo's bidding. With striking features and a strong build, Nobody has quite a reputation amongst the village folk. Yet, Geum-hoo finds a way to tame this wild tiger. First, he gives him a name—Beom. Then, he invites him to a world that this nobody's never experienced...

mangas.title: Ghostly Connection
mangas.description: When skeptic Je-Hyeon and paranormal-obsessed Yeong-Hu become unlikely roommates, they think they've lucked into the deal of the century: a huge apartment for an unbelievably cheap price. But they soon learn why the rent was so low... You see, something else is living there, and it's very interested in them! Now the two opposites must survive a nosy, perverted ghost and the bizarre mysteries of their new home…together.

mangas.title: Blossoms of the White Night
mangas.description: To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries' royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom's hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

mangas.title: OOTD: Return to Me, That's Mine!
mangas.description:
Ordinary office worker Hae-Seo has remained a fanboy of a certain singer for a decade. During his overseas trip to attend a concert, he runs into Sae-Hyeon, a bodyguard, while preventing a malicious incident. Amidst the chaos, he leaves his prized fan merchandise with Sae-Hyeon. Hae-Seo is resigned to never seeing it again… only to have Sae-Hyeon show up at his hotel door. Hae-Seo is eager to have his merch returned to him, but there's something familiar about this man. Will Sae-Hyeon not only bring back his beloved merch, but some nostalgic memories as well?

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Nebula
mangas.description:
Han Seo grew up hearing that he was worthless unless he came in first. Just as he was being consumed by the realization that no matter how hard he tried, he could never satisfy his father, he encountered an extraordinary killer on an ordinary commute home.
In a panic, he even kicked the man in the groin before running off, but the killer tracked him down to his home and introduced himself as a creature from the alien planet "Agape."
