What's more, he claims that Han Seo himself is a "flowerpot" for the alien race, and that a "seed" has been planted inside his body...


"Do you know the easiest way to germinate the seed? It's pleasure."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: Date Me, Too!
mangas.synonyms: Please Go Out With Me Too
mangas.description:
At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

"Go out with me too!"

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong's profession isn't just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he's been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong's long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

mangas.title: Sun Behind the Shadows
mangas.description:
Drifting through orphanages, Mun-Young lives with a nameless fear and a longing he can't explain... until a black fox only he can see appears and quiets it. But once he's adopted—more like imprisoned—by the powerful Chunsung group, the fox disappears. Years later, it returns with one offer: freedom, for a price.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Talisman
mangas.description:
At a remarkably young age, Choi Mu-Jin has already ascended to the prestigious position of second-in-command within the notorious national syndicate, 'Weolha Organization.' While he is a figure of intense envy and admiration among his subordinates, Mu-Jin carries a burden no one else suspects, a hidden, degrading mission assigned by the Chairman himself. Every week under the cover of darkness, he is sent to extract semen from Baek Wu-Yeon, the Chairman's secluded "human talisman" kept hidden away from the world.

Inside the suffocating luxury of a high-end penthouse, the command is always the same:

”Suck it.”

The moment Wu-Yeon's lips part, Mu-Jin's autonomy vanishes entirely. Faced with an order he is powerless to refuse, Mu-Jin finds himself trapped in a cycle of duty and desire. Can he successfully carry out his visceral task tonight, or will the weight of this secret finally break him?

mangas.title: First Love Hertz
mangas.description:
Im So-Ri, a genius voice actor who had enjoyed immense popularity with the public thanks to his star-quality looks and melodious voice, developed a fetish where he becomes aroused only by specific sounds after suffering trauma from a certain incident. Having degenerated into a person with a dark personality and perverted tendencies, he would occasionally engage in secret arousal games in public. One day, while doing just that, he discovered that the man standing behind him on the subway had the most stimulating voice he had ever heard...

"So-Ri, show me how you react to my voice."

"You only get turned on by me, right?"

This man has an angelically beautiful face and a gentle yet somehow intense aura. His gaze and tone suggest he's known me for a long time... it's suspicious.

mangas.title: Scent Spark
mangas.description: When defective omega and skilled mercenary Erad Nox is hired to find a runaway alpha mage and bring him back to the Tower of Mages, he thinks it'll be the easiest job he's ever done in his life. Little did he expect that upon meeting Lucian, the mage in question, he'd suddenly enter his heat cycle - something that hasn't happened in the past 11 years. Intrigued by this strange phenomenon, Lucian asks him to stay and become his research subject. As they spend time together, Nox finds himself drawn to Lucian's compassion and bashful kindness, while Lucian begins to fall in love with Nox's fearless strength and integrity.

mangas.title: The Purrfect Match
mangas.description:
Kwon Jiwu is a top actor blessed with perfect looks and talent, but there's one strange problem: every male animal seems to be in love with him.
After yet another chaotic day on set fending off animal admirers, he's ready to snap when his cheeky junior co-star Ju Yeongwon starts picking a fight.
Just as Jiwu is about to put him in his place, something catches his eye. Cat ears?
Wait a second, was Yeongwon one of those "male animals" all along?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Milk & Cream
mangas.description:
Jin-Hyuk, blessed with the ability to sense non-human beings thanks to his shaman father, is astonished when Doey, a playful and curious fairy, falls in love with him and begins to visit his dreams. What starts as innocent and harmless fun quickly evolves into intimate encounters, blurring the boundaries between dreams and reality. As their bond deepens, Jin-Hyuk's initial uncertainty turns into an insatiable longing for Doey's enchanting presence. Together, they embark on a whimsical romantic journey, navigating the complexities of love in a dreamscape as fresh as milk and as sweet as cream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Pygmalion
mangas.synonyms: พิกเมเลียน
mangas.description:
Max, a now-former captain of the Royal Knights, went on the quest to slay the great monster Medusa. Unfortunately for Max, it ended in great failure, and he ended up being turned to stone. At first, everyone celebrated his great sacrifice, and his statue was placed in the center of the town square. However, after just one week, the town was ready to throw him away. That's when Eden, an Elf from the mountains, steps in and decides to care for the frozen Max. Eden had always been cold and aloof to him, so what exactly are his intentions with this unexpected kindness…?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes 31 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Breathtaking Alliance
mangas.description:
It is the first freshman club retreat—the kind of night meant for excitement and budding romance. However, Kim Seon-Wu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he's been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-Yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seon-Wu and Sang-Yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness.

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seon-Wu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-Yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seon-Wu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

mangas.title: Winsseom Oranda
mangas.description:
Despite his musical success, Do-Geon finds himself moving into a shabby attic room. As he heads to the bathroom to try to shake off his gloom, what does he find on the toilet seat? A goldfish?! His cohabitation with the "Oranda" goldfish seemed to be going smoothly, but one night, Do-Geon woke up to find his back damp and a person flapping their legs right in front of him.

"Human, I feel weird."

mangas.title: Rusty Nail
mangas.description:
Isaac Carter, the underboss, and soon to be the next leader of the mighty outfit "Rustynail", is informed that he is going to be training Phil Rustynail, the Boss's secret son. What he couldn't tell was that he was Isaac's one-night stand... To make matters worse, the Boss is considering Phil as the successor to the crown of the world's most powerful crime family...!

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note:Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

mangas.title: A Rookie From the Above
mangas.description:
Sung Hye-Min, a senior associate at B-SAM (Bureau of Supernatural Ability Management), is on the verge of completing his final task for promotion when he's suddenly assigned a rookie, Lee Jee-Yoon.

"I pulled a few strings to get in here so I could see you."

"...You pulled strings to land this job? Why?!"

With his long-awaited promotion at stake, Hye-Min must navigate the chaos of mentoring this unexpected rookie from the above...!

mangas.title: Dream or Trick
mangas.description:
Kang Chan, an ordinary part-time café worker, begins experiencing strange things from the day he collapsed from overwork.
It's one erotic dream after another—so intense it feels like he's sexually frustrated— but he can't remember a thing except that it felt absolutely amazing... But... he can see the figure from his dreams, and it's licking and touching him...? Who the heck are you?!

[The chaotic story of the mysterious yet affectionate Mr. Dulle and Kang Chan, a mess on the inside despite his perfect exterior♥]

mangas.title: Story Time: A Ghost Confessed to Me
mangas.description:
Seong-Ho, a former boxer, develops his spiritual sight by chance, and because of the hallucinations he keeps seeing, he ends up quitting boxing. And then he becomes a YouTuber who experiences abandoned houses...

Hello, subscribers! This is Ghost Punch-✩ Today, I came to experience an abandoned house at XX o'clock, and I feel a strange energy here, so I'm going to try to talk to him.

"Hello, are you there? If you have anything to say, just say it and I'll listen."

"...... I love you, I love you Seong-Ho."

The bachelor ghost(?) in the abandoned house follows Seong-Ho around, and his ordinary daily life becomes more and more noisy.

"Get out! You ghost!"

mangas.title: Don't Ghost Me
mangas.description: Do-Hwa has spent his whole life seeing ghosts, but turning thirty brings a terrifying new "gift": a body that acts as a magnet for possession. His birthday wish for a quiet life goes up in smoke when a virgin lust-demon hitches a ride in his body and immediately goes on the hunt for a "good time." The target? Mu-Yeong, a man with looks to die for and a temper to match. Unfortunately for the demon, Mu-Yeong isn't just a bystander, he's a Grim Reaper. After a swift exorcism, Do-Hwa is left mortified and staring into the eyes of a Reaper who suddenly finds this "human magnet" very interesting.

mangas.title: You Can't Have My Blood
mangas.description:
Down-on-his-luck Si-Yun is prone to fainting and has a mountain of bills to pay. When he wins the "Vampire Lottery," he gets matched with a vampire named Jin-U and becomes his blood donor. The two of them move in together, and although their relationship is strictly contractual, Si-Yun and Jin-U soon begin to fall in love. Things are finally looking up for Si-Yun--until his rare blood type starts drawing the attention of other vampires…



(Source: Tapas)



Note: The chapter count includes 3 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Don't Poke The Plum
mangas.description: Friendly, popular Hong Yi-Jeong is drawn to Gi Tae-Rim, the department's biggest outcast. Tae-Rim rocks the classic loner look with thick glasses and messy hair, but Yi-Jeong spots the luxury designer brands hiding underneath. Despite vowing to stay away, Yi-Jeong ends up trying his best to get on Tae-Rim's good side at a party. Sensing easy prey, Tae-Rim decides to tease his overly-kind classmate - but what started as a joke leads to something neither of them were expecting. They say you should never poke the bear, but what happens when you poke the plum?

mangas.title: Meet Me Halfway
mangas.description:
Moo-Gyum Kim, soccer superstar and troublemaker, takes a pay cut to join K-League's City Seoul, repaying a debt to his middle school teacher. There, he meets Ha-Joon Lee, a rookie coach who avoids him despite their shared past. Moo-Gyum soon uncovers Ha-Joon's strange secret.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Am I Too Alpha for You?
mangas.synonyms: Do You Hate Me Because I'm an Alpha?
mangas.description: Alphas belong with omegas. Everyone knows that. Songs, poems, and fairy tales all say the same: only love between an alpha and omega is natural. Love between an alpha and a beta? Unthinkable. But Geon-Woo can't seem to help himself. Is Geon-Woo too alpha for love...or just too stubborn to give up?

mangas.title: Non-editable Partner
mangas.description:
Mo Chan-Young is a single dad living a busy life raising his daughter. One day, Ryu Seok, his first love who disappeared without a word nine years ago, moves in next door. Seeing Seok, who has become even more brazen and promiscuous, Chan-Young finds himself increasingly bothered by him, and he even discovers that Seok is "Yoon-Su," the writer he used to admire. On top of that, Seok casually brings up their past and even makes a provocative request, asking Chan-Young to help him physically for his writing…

"I liked it best when I was with you."

mangas.title: We're On Our Own From Here
mangas.synonyms: Just the Two of Us, Looking Forward
mangas.description:
Haruki is a second year in high school, and is secretly in love with his best friend, Ryusuke. He swears he's content with their relationship, but when a girl starts showing interest in Ryusuke, Haruki's feelings spin out of control. He confesses, and to his surprise, Ryusuke responds…?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Melt in Your Color
mangas.description:
Hojo, a motorcycle courier, picks up a delivery order and goes to an apartment, where he meets Aranami, a popular novelist. Hojo happens to witness Aranami's male partner, and realizes that Aranami is gay. Hojo thinks he will never see Aranami again. But a few days later, he receives another mail order. Feeling a bit embarrassed about seeing Aranami again, Hojo discovers that Aranami loves cats and when he asks Hojo to set a cat meowing as his ringtone, Hojo thinks Aranami is cute. A certain casual remark by Hojo unsettles Aranami. The words Hojo says remind Aranami of his past... When they meet by chance at a yakitori bar, in the flow of the conversation, Hojo tells him that he is also gay. Aranami suggests, "if you are willing, would you keep me company tonight?" It is simply a comprehensive decision for Aranami, but the world around them starts to change color...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: OOTD: On the Bit
mangas.synonyms: [OOTD 단편선] 온 더 빗 (On the Bit)
mangas.description:
To Lord Vincent, his favorite servant, Adonis, has always appeared weak and fragile. This thought is further reinforced when Adonis becomes permanently injured in a horse-riding accident. In order to protect him, Vincent starts to keep his distance from Adonis, but that only triggers the servant to desire his master even more. Although the two of them can't ride horses together anymore, with his whip in hand, Vincent might be willing to ride something else...

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note:
- Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

- Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Take Responsibility For My First Time
mangas.description:
After returning to school after his military service, Tae-Geon drinks at a welcome party and blacks out. The next day, he dreams of spending a night with his friend Kang-San… But this doesn't seem to be a dream?! The moment Tae-Geon tries to revive his fragmented memories to check if it's San, he notices San's ear. But didn't you originally not have earrings? As the situation gets more complicated, he runs into Kang-Dan, who looks just like his brother. As soon as they meet, Dan asks Tae-Geon to buy him a meal and Tae-Geon is led there where he hears a shocking story…

"Senior, you attacked me yesterday. Are you going to take responsibility for me?"

mangas.title: Sarangeun Metabeoseureul Tago
mangas.description:
U-Rim's whole world used to revolve around the popular idol Ga-Ron. But after meeting Ju-Yeol in college, he fell head over heels for him so much so that he was on the verge of dropping out of school. With his good looks, sharp mind, and talent for playing in a band, Ju-Yeol is simply perfect! U-Rim, thrilled to accept his invitation to a band practice, encounters a suspicious figure loitering outside the door. But this suspicious stranger was actually my favorite idol, Ga-Ron?! Just as he found himself with Ga-Ron, U-Rim noticed an alert for Ga-Ron's live stream. He was puzzled by the stark contrast between his dazzling appearance on the live feed and the shabby-looking Ga-Ron standing right in front of him. Ga-Ron manages to escape the crisis with a flustered excuse, but, fearing that U-Rim might expose his secret, he stubbornly insists on staying at U-Rim's house. U-Rim grows even more suspicious of Ga-Ron's behavior… Ga-Ron's true identity is slowly revealed! What secret does my favorite idol on the other side of the screen have…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: The Transfer Student Wants to Eat
mangas.description:
On the surface, he's always smiling. But no one knows. That Jung Chae-Min is attracted to men instead of women. And that at home, instead of laughter, his wounds are piling up.
Early summer of his sophomore year. That's when transfer student Ian appeared before Chae-Min. A sullen guy who, despite his pretty face, is blunt and doesn't get close to anyone. A creepy guy who glares at me every time he turn his head. Then one day, Chae-Min discovers Ian's secret. Strangely enough, as Chae-Min shares this secret with Ian, he begins to feel a growing sense of liberation.

"I'll help you fit in with everyone. The fact that you're different. I don't mind it."

"You're not the only one who's strange. I'm strange too."

Now, Chae-Min doesn't mind Ian's gaze. He begins to enjoy spending time with Ian. But Ian becomes particularly sensitive to Chae-Min's wounds and even appears in his dreams:

"The smell of blood always seeps out of you. That's why, from the very beginning… it bothered me."

"Strangely… I can't stand the scent you give off."

The edge of light, where darkness and light flow together. The two boys standing at the boundary began to seep into each other's worlds. And so, their summer began.

mangas.title: First Love Makeover Log
mangas.description:
Hae-Jin and Ki-Hyeok met at the same taekwondo dojo when they were children. They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin's expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin's feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in,
and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin's inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began.

mangas.title: Summers ~Fellows in Love~
mangas.description:
Sitting on the school yard, gazing at the sky, outside the window during class, waiting for a friend at the bus stop—love came unexpectedly. A sweet love story of two boys who are having a fling.

1. Jin-Woo and Young-Won: Jin-Woo, a good cook, a conceited, affectionate prisoner, and tactless, has grown listless in his dull daily life. Then, he falls in love at first sight with Young-Won, a senior he meets on school yard. However, Young-Won, everyone's idol, is already famous for his sharp rejection of confessions. It's only natural that if he, a stranger, confesses, he'll be 100% rejected! Jin-Woo decides to use his specialty, cooking, to tame Young-Won's stomach. Jin-Woo's "From Everyone's Senior to My Young-Won Project" ends in a mess.

2. Tae-Heon and Ah-Seong: A conscious, introverted, tactless, and a gold digger. Tae-Heon's childhood friend Ah-Seong has a penchant for falling in love easily, regardless of gender. Falling in love faster than anyone else, feeling heartbroken faster than anyone else. Tae-Heon, who knew every detail of Ah-Seong's love life, suddenly had a question.

"Hey, but why do you fall for everyone but not me?"

Tae-Heon confidently offered to make Ah-Seong fall for him, despite Ah-Seong's disapproval. Ah-Seong couldn't understand why he was acting like that...

mangas.title: Pizza and Dough
mangas.description:
"Marry me!"


As children, Pija-Hyun and Do-Woon promised to marry each other. But after hearing from his mother that two men couldn't marry,
Pija-Hyun resolved to let go of his feelings for Do-Woon. Years later, while pursuing ordinary relationships, Pija-Hyun kept getting dumped by his girlfriends for strange reasons. He eventually discovered that all his failed romances were due to Do-Woon's sabotage...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Conveyed Our Hearts
mangas.description:
A transfer student who transferred at a suspicious time.

No matter how you look at him, he looks like a punk, but for some reason, he only approaches Woorim, the class president.

"Lee Woorim, I want to sit next to you."

Woorim is faced with a choice: as the class president, should he take care of the transfer student, or as an honor student, should he distance himself from the seemingly delinquent?

mangas.title: No Open Flame
mangas.description:
A burst water pipe, skyrocketing rent, and a cheating boyfriend. Not a single thing is going right. On a whim, Yi-Seon brings a drunk man sleeping on the street back to her place to let him sleep over. It turns out he's a junior in his department at university, comes from a wealthy family, and has a secret crush on him…?!

"We've been living together, and now you're suddenly regretting that you never got to sleep with me?"

"Yeah."

A mysterious man bursts into the daily life of college student "Na Yi-seon," whose life motto is "Safety First"!! A crazy romance between a psycho beauty and a junk car collector!

mangas.title: Today's Declaration of Severance of Ties
mangas.description: The one person who always finds fault with model student Lee Se-Hyeon's perfect day is Jeong Nam-In. Se-Hyeon, who has been declaring a breakup for months, ends up discovering his only weakness through Nam-in.... Se-Hyeon vows today as well that he will quickly get rid of this idiot who keeps coming back no matter how much he tries to push him away. Will Se-Hyeon be able to break up with Nam-in today?

mangas.title: Houjuuibo
mangas.description:
One rainy day, Ji-Oh's childhood friend and crush, Woo-Jin, becomes possessed by a ghost in an accident. Ji-Oh couldn't just sit by and watch, for Woo-Jin had been his savior, holding him back from his straying ways. So, Ji-Oh teams up with the psychic Gyeon-Woo to restore Woo-Jin's body. After a series of twists and turns, they temporarily succeed in exorcising the ghost, but the ghost and Woo-Jin's soul begin to interact...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Friends Forever After?
mangas.synonyms: If We Would Determine Our Relationship, XOXO
mangas.description: Woo-Jung was a child star who had to give up his dreams because of some malicious rumors. Carrying that trauma with him, he's now just a normal high school student. When some bullies confront Woo-Jung on the first day of school, a majestic figure, like a hero from a video game, magically comes to Woo-Jung's rescue...

mangas.title: The Law of First Love
mangas.description:
There's a such moment in your life. All of a sudden, you happen to look the world through a pastel tone filter from a high-teen romance film, and the moment when the sunlight through leaves gets brighter. The moment when a blink of an eye clearly reflects one single person for a long time.

In other words, this is a story about recognizing our first love and a process of telling the feeling.

mangas.title: Show Me Some Love!
mangas.description:
Eden Jang's often been mistaken for a foreigner or a Korean who's lived abroad due to his appearance. One day, on his way to school in a new neighborhood he's just moved to, a 10-year-old Eden is confronted by foreigners who seem to think he's just like them. But being also lost and tired, he gets flustered and goes into a state of panic. It's then when a total stranger, Sarang, shows up and saves him. Coincidentally, Sarang lives next door to Eden, and the two become close like real brothers. To Eden, Sarang is the older brother-like figure he looks up to. He tags along Sarang wherever he goes, just like a puppy would its owner. But as Eden grows older, he realizes his feelings for Sarang were far more than just brotherly love. Unable to suppress his feelings any further, Eden ends up kissing Sarang on a live internet channel when he's drunk. The dynamics between the two change, and Eden becomes bolder, making sure Sarang knows how he feels. Will Sarang reciprocate his love? Is Eden merely like a younger brother to Sarang, or does he also have feelings for who?



(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: My Sweet Dear
mangas.description:
Burning fingers or mending hearts?


There are too many cooks in the kitchen! Dogun Yoon's head chef spot is threatened by total stranger Jung-Woo Choi. As they battle it out, Dogun's phobia of being touched is as strong as ever… But why is it okay with him? Will their saucy arrangement lead to love, or will things boil over?

(Source: Manta, edited)

mangas.title: The Hound Behind the Mask
mangas.description:
Lee Jae-Ha knows it's absurd for him to ask for Jang Tae-Geon's hand in marriage. While Jae-Ha is the heir to Korea's most prestigious corporation, Tae-Geon is a violent gangster. But above all, both of them are dominant alphas. So when they inevitably do get married, Jae-Ha doesn't dare to ask for anything more, instead drawing lines in the name of respecting the man he selfishly fell in love with. But these lines only end up aggravating Tae-Geon, who's actually had his eyes on Jae-Ha just the same...

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Bias Wrecker
mangas.description: Rookie actor Yeo Jeong-Won just landed a spot on the healing reality show A Month in Europe. There's just one problem: his ultimate celebrity crush, Kwon Hae-Woon, is his co-star! To survive the trip, Jeong-Won has two simple rules: don't let anyone know he's a superfan, and don't get too close to Hae-Woon. But when Hae-Woon insists on being roommates and claims they've met before, Jeong-Won's "professional" act begins to crumble. Between shared rooms and constant filming, he's one $5-a-month fan-app notification away from being outed as the world's biggest fanboy.

mangas.title: Biscuit
mangas.description: For years, Ho-Yeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction. Then one day, Tae-Bum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence. Ho-Yeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully. But Tae-Bum, already prepared, meets him without fear and gives himself over completely. Fine. If he wants to play that game, then Ho-Yeon will take him to the very end. Let him see if he can handle it.

mangas.title: Master From Another World
mangas.synonyms: The Slave Master from Another World
mangas.description:
Ye-Ju, an ordinary alpha college student, is cast into another world—mistaken for a slave and claimed by a nobleman. But the task awaiting him is not labor. As the nobleman's true nature begins to surface, Ye-Ju finds himself trapped between desire, danger, and a longing to return home.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: He Craves to be Teased by His Favorite ASMR Streamer
mangas.titleNative: 南くんはその声に焦らされたい
mangas.synonyms: Minami-kun Wants to be Teased by That Voice
mangas.description:
Karasuma Kodai is a university student with a sexy secret: he's an ASMR streamer who specializes in spicy roleplays! And though he's been at it for a while, his view counts have remained low, making him think it may be time to call it quits.



Just before he makes the final decision, he's given a confession that shocks him! Minami Masaya, one of his most avid fans, confesses that he can only get turned on by Karasuma's voice. Surprised by such a claim, Karasuma offers to help Minami with some private sessions. But what starts as a fun ego boost quickly turns into a need for something more. Karasuma doesn't want to just be a voice for Minami, he wants to touch him too!

Can this go from online to IRL or is Karasuma nothing more than a pleasing voice to Minami?

mangas.title: Transmigrated as an Omega Who Snags His Alpha
mangas.synonyms: Transmigrated as the Alpha Boss' Golden Goose
mangas.description:
Quinton Lewis was once a ruthless mafia boss until a fatal gunshot ended his life. When he reopens his eyes, he wakes up in a stranger's bed, dressed in lingerie. Acting on instinct, Quinton attempts to attack the stranger only to uncover a shocking truth: he's transmigrated into an omegaverse world as a pampered Omega and the stranger turns out to be his supposed Alpha lover, Cain Lloyd. Trapped in a body and role he never chose, Quinton must navigate power, desire, and danger once again.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: A Golden Pair
mangas.description:
When a drug made from the blood of alphas, rumored to have an aphrodisiac effect, begins circulating widely, ace narcotics agent Jess is assigned to temporarily protect Lily, one of the world's rare dominant alphas.
While begrudgingly playing babysitter to the pretty and pampered Lily, an unexpected rut strikes.
"I'm just trying to save his life. There's nothing more to it."
But as the lines blur between duty and desire, Jess and Lily discover they might be the perfect match in more ways than one.

mangas.title: How to Win over Your Crush
mangas.synonyms: The Secret to Winning Over Unrequited Love
mangas.description:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled. That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand. A son. Disgust and irritation flare up all at once.
A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place? But fine. It doesn't matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know. If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world.

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

mangas.title: Nagi & Hayasaki
mangas.description:
What's a pent-up punk to do when his mortal enemy gives him an unexpected #@%&?$! in the school restroom...? Freak the #$!& out, of course!



Certified slacker Nagi wants absolutely nothing to do with "mature" and "diligent" class president Hayasaki—especially after what happened in the bathroom. But Hayasaki won't leave him alone! And worse yet, Nagi can't even get himself off anymore without Hayasaki's help...



What the %&$# is happening?! And why did it have to be Hayasaki of all people?!



Nagi's gay panic only intensifies when Hayasaki confesses to him. Enemies-with-benefits is one thing, but a full-blown rivals-to-lovers romance might be more than Nagi can handle...!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ri Yu Ye
mangas.description:
Sheng Xi is an elite CEO by day, but by night, he leads a double life as a barely safe-for-work streamer… One day, the company sends a handsome and cheerful second-gen wealthy idiot his way to serve as his assistant. Now, he has no choice but to juggle between hiding his secret identity and putting up with this foolish rich heir. Except… this seemingly clueless golden-retriever-like assistant seems to have a few secrets himself~



(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

mangas.title: Love is an Illusion! - Superstar
mangas.description:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.



As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Orca Mansion
mangas.description:
"Should I eat him?"


Orca Ware, the young master of the killer whale family "Ware," returns from a slaughter-ridden battlefield. He prefers slaughter to peace, and finds the battlefield more comfortable than comfort, so the Orca Mansion is simply boring. Then, a lowly and foolish servant, Nia, appears before Orca. Nia, who has been bullied by the other servants because he is a goldfish beastman, fills his hungry stomach by the lakeside of the mansion in the middle of the night... and encounters Orca.

"Master, I was wrong... Please, please, save me..."

"You are more insignificant and weak than anyone else, and yet you try to live... It really bothers me."


I try not to pay attention, but my eyes keep going to the small and fragile Nia... The once boring mansion is soon filled with an inexplicable thrill.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: One Plus Two
mangas.description:
How can one ever be satisfied with just one? That's Haru's life motto. As usual, he lures a younger guy who enters his strike zone and devours him whole. Not bad for a hetero guy being his first~ he thinks for a split second, Did this guy just eat me up??!!

The more he thinks about it, the more infuriating it gets—that big-dicked, handsome, cute, infuriating bastard! He happens to run into him again in a college liberal arts class, but this time he claims not to know him... His speech and behavior are completely different. Is this some kind of concept thing...?

What...? He's a twin...? That's a lie, right...?

mangas.title: Yuseonguwa Haengbogui Sanggwangwangye
mangas.synonyms: The Correlation Between Shooting Stars and Happiness
mangas.description:
I like stars. They say that if you see a shooting star, your wish will come true. Although my wish of having the same feelings as the person I like has never been granted... ..But this wish has never been granted?! I didn't mean to bring a sex-crazed alien into my house!!

"Yo-Han's emotional energy is especially delicious. If you let me feed it until I have enough energy to return to my home planet... I'll grant Yo-Han what he wants, too."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Between the Stars
mangas.description: Yun Byeol's world is turned upside down when his brother, Hye-Seong, gets into an accident. But when Byeol visits him in the hospital, he's surprised to find him in an expensive private room and learns that Hye-Seong received compensation for the incident. When he goes to confront Seong Un, the person who pushed his brother down the stairs, Byeol is met with another surprise: Un knows about a dark side of Hye-Seong that is hard to believe. What is their relationship, and why would Un push him?

mangas.title: Alpha Equation
mangas.description: In a world where Omegas are almost nonexistent, childhood friends Jun-Hyeok and Hyeon-Ho are both labeled Alphas. But as they grow closer in their final year of high school, Jun-Hyeok begins reacting to Hyeon-Ho's pheromones in ways that shouldn't be possible. As confusion turns into longing, the two must navigate feelings that defy instinct, classification, and everything they've been taught about love.

mangas.title: Sweetie, Sweetie, Sweetie
mangas.description:
After being hit by the fateful truck of transmigration, Jeong Yujin wakes up in the world of a fantasy novel as Lord Eugene Linweisen. Eugene's main role may be to marry the story's antagonist, Grand Duke Ivilaron, but Yujin has an even bigger job to fulfill: saving the world! But how is he supposed to achieve this feat when the Gods won't even give him a simple status screen to help on his quest? Plus, what's only supposed to be a loveless contract marriage seems to be turning into something more the longer Yujin stays with the supposed villain...!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Shall I Write Your Love Letter?
mangas.synonyms: Should I Write You a Love Letter Instead?
mangas.description:
Employee-of-the-Month champion and service-industry all-rounder Lim Seongshik thought he'd seen everything, until he wakes up inside a bleak BL novel as none other than Elliot Brown, a minor villain doomed to die. In the original story, everyone meets their end at the hands of the protagonist, Arzen Theron. So Elliot decides to keep his past life as a writer hidden, lie low, and quietly avoid the one event that triggers the tragedy: ghost-writing a love letter.

But life—and his cat—have other plans. A desperate situation forces him into becoming Arzen's personal bed attendant, of all things. To make matters worse, his "secret identity" as a writer gets exposed to the novel's original love interest. Before he knows it, Elliot is back to ghost-writing letters… this time for Arzen himself! But something's off. The Arzen in front of him doesn't match the cruel lead he remembers...

Can Elliot keep faking those letters just enough to dodge his scripted death ending? Or has the story already started to change?

mangas.title: The Light I Give You
mangas.description: Once a promising athlete, Yoon-Bin is ready to give up after repeated injuries shatter his dreams. At his lowest point, a mysterious man with a tiger tattoo gives him the strength to stand again. Years later, after retiring as a gold medalist and becoming a taekwondo instructor, Yoon-Bin unexpectedly reunites with Kwon Young, an underworld boss and the man who saved his life. Haunted by his past, Young pushes Yoon-Bin away, convinced he brings only harm. But Yoon-Bin refuses to let go, because now it is his turn to become Young's light.

mangas.title: Melting Flirting Cookie
mangas.description: Han-Byuk isn't thrilled when his new neighbor turns out to be the cold, aloof Yeo-Min. After hearing Yeo-Min moaning through their too-thin apartment walls and having an awkward interaction the next day, Han-Byuk gets a glimpse of his neighbor with his guard down. He's shy. Cute, even. Han-Byuk decides to double his efforts to befriend his neighbor and, surprised by each other and themselves, they grow closer until the lines of their friendship blurs into something... more.

mangas.title: The Management Strategy of Unrequited Love
mangas.description:
At his first job, Ji-Won encounters Yeon-Su, his childhood friend's older brother and his first love. Seeing this as an opportunity, Ji-Won actively expresses his feelings for Yeon-Su, but he grows increasingly anxious about the lack of progress. Then, in a moment of inconsistency, he accidentally has a one-night stand with Yeon-Su. Yeon-Su misunderstands him as a slut, and their relationship becomes increasingly strained. Unconcerned, Ji-Won approaches Yeon-Su, who has misunderstood him.

"I like you, Manager."

Gu Ji-Won, a clumsy employee, embarks on a grand plan to win over Manager Baek Yeon-Su's heart!

mangas.title: Another Sunny Day
mangas.description: Do-Bin, the handsome art student, finds himself in the midst of heartbreak and wonders if he'll ever be able to get a good night's rest since his breakup. Jae-Hui, the flower shop owner, has never fallen in love in his life and is uncertain if he'll ever find the one. What will happen when these two unlikely people cross paths? Will they find the answers in each other?

mangas.title: Ireumpyoreul Butyeo
mangas.description:
"It doesn't have to be me..."


In the spring of his 18th year, An Ju-Ho had the name of his destined partner tattooed on his wrist. Whether it's the power of fate or not, he keeps getting entangled with Yun Jae-Hui, the owner of that name. I didn't care about fate, first love, or any of that nonsense,
so why do I keep worrying about him and wondering about him? Is it because of the name on my wrist? Or is it just that…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)


Note: The third story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

mangas.title: Heart Trigger Off
mangas.synonyms: [소프트 BL 단편선] 사춘기 : 너를 생각하는 봄
mangas.description:
"I've been seeing ghosts since I was a kid. And only male ghosts, at that."


Young Jae-Yeong has a secret. It's that he enjoys reading BL manga with his "ghost brothers." When his father finds out, Jae-Yeong is forced to leave his neighborhood and begins attending shamanistic rituals. Eventually, he succeeds in making the ghosts disappear,
but due to repeated school transfers and spiritual rituals, Jae-Yeong becomes physically and emotionally exhausted, feeling empty inside. When Jae-Yeong returns to his neighborhood, he is greeted by Do-Ha. Do-Ha, who used to be a timid younger brother who cried at the drop of a hat, had grown tall enough to look down on Jae-Yeong. But the joy is short-lived, as Do-Ha begins to gradually disrupt Jae-Yeong's daily life.


"Hyung, my feelings for you… have never faded."


Do-Ha keeps bringing back memories of a past Jae-Yeong had tried to forget. Is Do-Ha Jae-Yeong's salvation, or his trial?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)


Note: The eleventh story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

mangas.title: Do You Have a Dog You Like?
mangas.description:
Seo-Kyung, who has had a crush on his childhood friend Jae-Ha for a long time, has lived his life believing that this love would never be reciprocated. Consumed by jealousy toward Jae-Ha, who was kind to everyone, Seo-Kyung even pretended to dislike him.
Then one day, he came across a post on an anonymous college forum.

"Does anyone know the name of the guy working at the library starting at 1 PM on Fridays? He's the textbook definition of a puppy face… He's so handsome… If you know him, please send me a DM ㅜㅜ"

Seo-Kyung, who didn't even expect Jae-Ha, who turns heads wherever he goes, to notice him, falls asleep that night,
in a fit of pique, imagining the childish fantasy that Jae-Ha might as well be a real dog. And when morning comes, an unidentified brown dog is sleeping right next to him.


Seo-Kyung's desperate struggle to break the curse that turned his secret crush into a dog begins!

mangas.title: Who Screwed Who?
mangas.synonyms: So, Who Was on Top? | So, Who Got Screwed?
mangas.description: Kang Hyo-in has been secretly in love with his best friend of eight years, Jin Ye-geon, nd he's finally ready to turn that crush into something more. Armed with a meticulous plan to win Ye-geon's heart, Hyo-in is determined to confess the "right" way. But one drunken night he can't even remember throws everything off track, and suddenly they're dating before he can make sense of what happened. Now there's just one burning question he can't ignore: what exactly did they do… and which one of them ended up on the bottom?!

mangas.title: Kiss wa Sousa no Ato de
mangas.synonyms: love is too far away, kissing is too close.
mangas.description:
An age-gap office romance set at a police station in the countryside, featuring the 38-year-old, well-liked detective Takoi and the 28-year-old, cool cybersecurity expert Shiono. How will this constantly bickering duo move from hating to loving?



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Unrequited Love Finale
mangas.description:
When Su-Hyeon, who was just a kid back then, had a look on his face as if he was tired of the world, Ji-Ho couldn't just leave him like that. Their unexpected meeting was followed by a reunion seven years later, at Su-Hyeon's father's funeral. Despite the seven-year gap, they quickly grew close as if they were always brothers. However, even with the eight-year age difference, Ji-Ho, who found himself attracted to Su-Hyeon, started pushing him away out of guilt...

"Hyung. You kept staring at me earlier outside."
"..."
"I can show you more closely."

mangas.title: Sketch: Season 2
mangas.description:
The second season of Sketch.



Note: Chapters 36-103.

mangas.title: Chiguhagu na Kiss: mix
mangas.description: The sequel to the wildly popular “Hug Kiss” series is here! Sasahara and Haruto have finally become a real couple. After graduating from high school, they each went their separate ways—Haruto headed to college, while Sasahara enrolled in a culinary school. As their new lives begin, the two continue their relationship smoothly, but watching the always-cool Sasahara, Haruto sets his sights on a new goal—. A love story depicting what happens next for the “super-popular heartthrob” and the “shy, pure-hearted boy” now that they’ve become a real couple.

mangas.title: TOKYO SEOUL LOVE
mangas.description: Taiga is a part-time DJ and model who rose to popularity with his old hits. After a club show, he spots someone who's his exact type. Fully expecting it to be just a one-night thing, Taiga finds himself in an unexpected situation when a language barrier causes a misunderstanding. To make matters more complicated, his casual hookup left out one key detail about who they really are… A story between a trashy DJ/Model and an overwhelmingly beautiful stranger.

mangas.title: Heat Stroke
mangas.titleNative: 아기 삵을 낳아줘, 나 미치는 꼴 보기 싫으면!
mangas.synonyms: Give Me a Wildcat Cub Unless You Wanna See Me Go Crazy! | Give Birth To a Baby Wildcat For Me, Unless You Want To See Me Go Insane!
mangas.description:
Goh Yu-Min, the eldest son of an endangered black-footed wildcat clan, has never even met a female of his own kind and is doomed to a lifelong single status. Now freshly in heat and losing his mind to breeding instinct, he catches wind of a secret rumor: a male wildcat can perfectly pair with a human man and impregnate him without fail. Determined to continue his family line, Yu-Min sneaks into Hanguk University in search of the most beautiful and brilliant man he can find, and that is where he meets Beom Tae-Jun, a stunning senior with an irresistible body. Yu-Min sets aside his pride and desperately attempts to court him, only to end up pinned beneath Tae-Jun on his own bed. To his shock, Yu-Min realizes he is the one being "bred," not the other way around. Even as he tries to escape, he finds himself addicted to Tae-Jun's touch.

Can Yu-Min break free, or will he lose himself completely before he can secure the baby wildcat needed to carry on his family's bloodline?

mangas.title: Xiao Yang Xiangdao Cong Bu Zuoyou Weinan
mangas.titleNative: 小羊向导从不左右为难
mangas.description:
The twin brothers love me too much. What should I do?

D-class guide Qiao Yang, because of a drunken accident, discovered that he could use the two A-class sentinels, his childhood friends Zheng Jia and Zheng Yan, to enhance his own class. In order to retain this rare S-class status, he chose to conceal his exploitation of them. However, during the repeated interaction with the two, he gradually becomes aware of their feelings towards him…

mangas.title: Proceed With Caution
mangas.description: Former kendo prodigy Jae-Hyeok has lost his way, spiraling far from his golden days. The only person capable of reining him in is Yeong-Won, a steadfast police officer with a heart of gold. Though they couldn't be more different, these single fathers find their back into each other's lives. As Jae-Hyeok moves in to learn the ropes of parenting, his Alpha instincts awaken, blurring the lines between duty and desire in a domestic whirlwind romance.

mangas.title: SAHAN
mangas.description: Despite Earth's advanced space industry, Sa-Han's moonbound spaceship crashes, leaving him stranded out in space for a year. When he's rescued and brought back to Earth, he finds that 11 years have already passed there. While struggling to overcome his space trauma and adjust to the many changes on his home planet, Sa-Han finds himself leaning on Hee-Geon, the little boy next door who is now an adult and hasn't forgotten him. Hee-Geon might be the only one who can help Sa-Han find his place in a world that has long moved on without him...

mangas.title: Love Under the Influence
mangas.synonyms: แย่แล้วครับ ผมเมารักเพื่อน!
mangas.description:
College life should have been simple, but living with Woo-Hee is torture for Jin-Ha. His closest friend is now the object of every forbidden thought, and the walls of their dorm can no longer keep his desire at bay. When one reckless night strips away the safety of silence, the truth between them comes alive in heat and hunger. What was once friendship transforms into something far more intimate, where every touch carries the weight of years of longing.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Wake-up Call
mangas.description:
Im Si-Hyuk had everything going for him, looks, confidence, and a life that ran exactly the way he wanted. That is, until his trendy Gen-Z girlfriend dumps him without mercy, leaving cracks in the perfect image he built for himself. Drowning his pride at a company dinner, Si-Hyuk somehow gets drunk off a single cocktail and ends up spending the night with Do Geon-Woo, a part-time worker who just happened to find him in that state. What should have been a one-time mistake quickly turns complicated.



"I only kiss someone I am dating."


"…Fine, just don't push me away."



Geon-Woo is nothing like the people Si-Hyuk usually deals with, calm, firm, and impossible to read. As he keeps appearing in Si-Hyuk's life, that once predictable routine starts to spiral into something far less controlled. In the middle of this unexpected romance alert, can Si-Hyuk really go back to the life he had before?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Lovestruck
mangas.description:
College student Yeonwu can't stand Ohn, a campus senior wrapped in dark rumors...but fate keeps forcing them together. When Yeonwu rescues a vulnerable, intoxicated Ohn from a dangerous situation, their dynamic shifts overnight. Intrigued by the only guy who treats him with icy disdain, Ohn launches a relentless, seductive charm offensive. Yeon-Wu tries to resist, but Ohn's intoxicating flirting soon has his heart racing. Can Yeon-Wu guard his heart, or will has love struck far too fast?


(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Fever
mangas.description:
Seung-Ju has had a long-standing crush on Jun-Hyuk, the student council president. One summer day, just as he was suffering from the pangs of unrequited love, the person who appeared before him was none other than Jun-Hyuk's younger brother, Je-Hyun.
Seung-Ju, who had a crush on his older brother, and Je-Hyun, who approached him. Will Seung-Ju ever be able to escape this agonizing unrequited love?

mangas.title: Check Out My Manager
mangas.description: Kwak Eun-Ho has spent 11 years as Ji Hyeon's friend and 7 years as his manager, all the while hiding his huge crush for him. But his secret partially comes to light when the two of them shoot a variety show called "Check Out My Manager," and Eun-Ho drops a bombshell during the interview: "There is someone I'm interested in." This greatly irks Hyeon, who believes there is someone in Eun-Ho's life that he doesn't know about. But that "someone" would have been so obvious if only Hyeon could have checked out his manager just a little more...

mangas.title: Step on Me, My Prince!
mangas.description:
Han-Sol, a 24-year-old kindergarten teacher, has one ultimate goal in life: to snag a wealthy Prince Charming. Enter Yu-Shin—the tall, handsome, and successful father of one of Han-Sol's students. After an awkward first date, the two are soon caught up in a fairytale romance with a kinky twist!

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: PLAYMATE
mangas.description:
I can't do anything for him... Why is he being so nice to me?

"Dan-U, did you hate hanging out with me?"

Heo Dan-U, a maxed-out survivalist and timid nerd, is being obsessively pursued by the dazzlingly popular prince Ji Ha-Jun. Ji Ha-Jun cooks, does laundry, and cleans just to spend time with Heo Dan-Woo... Something's fishy, right?

mangas.title: Bittersour
mangas.description: Ji-Won just wants to enjoy a steamy one-night stand, but the neighbor from hell keeps killing the mood. After nights of listening to a heartbroken stranger wail breakup anthems through the walls, Ji-Won finally storms next door to demand silence. Instead of a typical nuisance, he finds Hyeon watching a cringey, viral video of Ji-Won's most cringe college memory. Now that his secret "black history" is out, things are about to get a lot more sour - and a little bit spicy.

mangas.title: Love Loop
mangas.description:
Choi Hyeon-Gyeol is trapped in a hellish temporal prison. Every time the clock strikes midnight on the 15th, he is ripped back to the start of the previous day. Forced to repeat the exact same university assignments twenty times over, his sanity has worn dangerously thin. Pushed to his absolute breaking point by the monotony, Hyeon-Gyeol decides to abandon all caution and indulge in a wild, impulsive escape from his scripted life. This leads him to an unexpected, heated one-night stand with his fellow classmate, Lim Yeon-Jeong.



He falls asleep expecting to wake up to the same familiar nightmare once again. However, against all odds, the loop finally breaks. For the first time in what feels like an eternity, Hyeon-Gyeol opens his eyes to the fresh, uncharted morning of the 15th... with Yeon-Jeong right beside him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Mignon
mangas.description:
In the gritty, neon-lit backalleys of central Seoul, a vampire hides in plain sight. Mignon survives a brutal double life: a mechanic by day and an underground cage fighter by night. Trapped in a cycle of violence, his only solace is Dr. Oh, the mysterious ringside doctor who watches over him. But when Mignon witnesses the doctor's bloodthirsty secret, instead of running, he offers himself up completely. As their dark bond deepens, Mignon dangerous reality threatens to drag them both into hell.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Hot-to-Go Bakery: How to Tame a Wolf
mangas.description: Chan-Woo's neighbors are all nervous when a scary wolf named Eun-Jae moves into their villa. Being a friendly big dog, Chan-Woo tries to be a good neighbor to the cold and gruff wolf, even giving him cream puffs from his favorite bakery. But when Eun-Jae goes into heat for the first time, Chan-Woo's about to get stuffed with a different kind of cream for trying too hard to help...!

mangas.title: Cat Therapy
mangas.description:
Yong-U, a tiger-superhuman working as an actor in the superhuman community, rescues a cat abused on a film set for being an unlucky black cat and takes it
in. He names it Dodong and grows attached to it, but one day, when he wakes up from a nap, Dodong has vanished without a trace. He's even robbed Yong-U of his wallet and valuables! The media is abuzz with reports that Yong-U abandoned his cat, and to quell the controversy, Yong-U proposes a roommate to Hae-Dong, the cat-superhuman who tricked him into thinking he's a cat...

mangas.title: Day Off Season 2
mangas.description: At work, Shi Chunlei is a strict but fair boss; at home, he's a loving single father. But everyone has something they're not good at. The New Year's Party is coming up soon! And it looks like Vice President Shi's only hope lies in the unexpected, yet well-timed, support of a young intern…

mangas.title: Whispers of Love With an Immoral Saint
mangas.titleNative: ふしだら聖者と睦言を。
mangas.description:
"Curse me all you want if it feels this good!"



A sinful secret love between two who are unable to repent! Vio accidentally spent a night with a witch and ended up cursed. He seeks help from the saint of the church, Arelka, to break the curse but she rejects him and belittles his lower half as trash. Later, Vio attends a masked ball where he meets a mysterious and beautiful man. Their eyes meet and seem to say, "You're going to entertain me, aren't you?" Never having been interested in men before, he finds himself surprisingly drawn to the man's seductive and innocent reactions. The next morning...



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Lucky Dice
mangas.description:
"I have erectile dysfunction."

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

"Then why don't we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you."


Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what's happening, he's suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon's "scientific experiment." What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20?
Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn't physical after all…

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

mangas.title: Autobahn Romance
mangas.description: For 10 years, Pyung-Hwa Gong and Sae-Byuk Shin have kept their love a secret from family and friends. But then, the alpha and omega pair invite their old classmates to their daughter's first birthday party, ready to reveal their unbelievable love story. Strap in for the romance of a lifetime!

mangas.title: Nose Nothing
mangas.description: After losing his sense of smell, genius perfumer Si-Bon tries to end his life but is saved by Ha-Eoon, the owner of a small antique shop. Planning to stay just 3 months before returning to France, Si-Bon takes a live-in job there and finds himself slowly drawn into Ha-Eoon's world with no escape.

mangas.title: Not What the Doctor Ordered
mangas.titleNative: 공진단 먹고 나의 알파 시대 시작됐다
mangas.synonyms: My Alpha Era Began After Taking Gongjin-dan
mangas.description:
Yeong-Ha is a talented practitioner of traditional Korean medicine, but ever since word got out that he's an omega, business has been at an all-time low. Meanwhile, his teenage neighbor, Pureum, is also struggling to stay afloat in the midst of college entrance exams… and a devastating crush on his hot, older neighbor. But after one of Yeong-Ha's energy-boosting tonics turns Pureum from a beta into an alpha, the doctor will have to take responsibility for this medical miracle… in ways he never imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Love Me, Revive Me
mangas.description:
For his entire life, Chae Jeong-Hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-Hyeon's long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything. But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-Hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-Hwa offers Jeong-Hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-Hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-Hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-Hwa extends. Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-Hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-Hwa's enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

mangas.title: Senza Replica
mangas.description:
Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Dolly In, Dolly Out
mangas.synonyms: This Is How You Take Revenge
mangas.description: A rising young director sets out to cast his next project and becomes fixated on a particular actor who refuses to be easily won over. A bold casting offer turns into an even bolder counterproposal, pulling the two into a delicate negotiation where ambition and attraction collide. As their collaboration moves forward, the line between work and romance begins to blur, setting the stage for a relationship neither of them planned.

mangas.title: Fanfiction
mangas.description: Failed horror writer Gong Chan-Hyuk's BL webtoons are wildly popular—but he hates writing them. Then superstar Lee Hyeok-Su, his secret crush, shows up to pitch a drama adaptation. When an old tablet with steamy fanfic about Hyeok-Su falls out of Chan-Hyuk's closet, things get… complicated. Hyeok-Su suggests they reenact the story—and their "casual" affair begins. But when Chan-Hyuk overhears a suspicious conversation, everything threatens to unravel.

mangas.title: Blood and Love
mangas.description: Since childhood, Jiwon has been captivated by stories of vampires. He promised himself that if he ever encountered a real one, he would go out of his way to befriend them. Finally, during Jiwon's college years, the opportunity strikes when he witnesses a handsome vampire indulging in a feeding session. Filled with indescribable excitement, Jiwon attempts to approach and even offer his own blood to the vampire. However, to his dismay, the mysterious bloodsucker vanishes in an instant. Disappointed and brimming with unanswered questions, Jiwon attends class the next day only to discover that the man from the previous night is none other than Yoon Seong-hyun, a sunbae in the same class. Will this unexpected revelation set the stage for Jiwon's ultimate dream of forging an extraordinary friendship or, perhaps…something more?

mangas.title: Reality Lover
mangas.description: By day, Cheong-Hyeon is the picture of professionalism: calm, composed, and the ideal boss. To his assistant Tae-in, he's the definition of cool. But behind the scenes? Cheong-Hyeon is a full-blown BL otaku! One day, something unexpected happens: Tae-in starts to resemble the main character from Cheong-Hyeon's favorite series a little too closely... As fantasy and reality begin to blur, Cheong-Hyeon finds himself falling - and feeling - hard for his real-life leading man.

mangas.title: Let Me Tag Along
mangas.description: The gold dragon has taken many human forms over the years in his games. His last game ended in "death." But when the human he'd befriended in his last game summons him, both are surprised. Mikhail can't unsee his dead friend Adrian in the dragon, while the dragon feigns ignorance, agreeing to help Mikhail find Adrian's body. While pondering his past lives, the dragon lingers on memories with Mikhail at the academy. But Mikhail isn't the only one from a past game to catch up with him.

mangas.title: I Am a Scarecrow
mangas.description:
Lee Ho-Yeon, known in-game as "White Jack," starts playing the MMORPG Lunatic with a skilled friend but quits after struggling with controls and losing motivation. Years later, frustrated by repeated university entrance exams, he logs back in for stress relief and unexpectedly meets the game's top-ranking player, Kim Hee-Ho ("Monaka").Despite his foul temper and aloof reputation, Hee-Ho helps Ho-Yeon improve. When Hee-Ho leaves his guild due to conflicts and joins "21," the small guild Ho-Yeon inherited, their ranking quickly rises. Rumors spread that they are dating since Hee-Ho is uncharacteristically warm toward Ho-Yeon.


To gain a game bonus, they register as an in-game couple, but no one believes it is just for the rewards. When a rival guild challenges them to a war, even the usually support-focused Ho-Yeon is forced to fight. He agrees to meet Hee-Ho offline for training but instead receives a real-life confession. They begin dating.
The twist is that Ho-Yeon has been using a female avatar. When Hee-Ho proudly introduces his in-game partner, the truth comes out, sparking rumors that Ho-Yeon was pretending to be a girl.


What started as a game partnership turns into a real relationship. But between guild conflicts, public scrutiny, and real-life pressures, Ho-Yeon struggles to keep up. With Hee-Ho's unwavering support, he fights to protect both their guild and their growing bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Peak&Pick
mangas.description:
Kim Yu-I, who has a minor taste and a fierce impression. Because of that, he always played music alone, but he ended up forming a band with his friend Min-Jun. One day, Yu-I meets Bae Yeong-Yeon, who says he fell in love with his performance at first sight, and he gradually opens his heart to Yeong-Yeon, who follows him around and helps him like a manager. And Yu-I, who had been worried about housing issues, ends up living in Yeong-Yeon's house, who has become a friend rather than a fan...?

A story of love blossoming quietly between a Born to be Locker and a Seong-Deok!

mangas.title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
mangas.description:
Sold off as a male bride to Marquis Oderic, who rules over the territory of Trufinnen, Everard expects to be treated as a prsioner—but in Oderic's quiet care, he finds peace and freedom. Can love blossom in these austere halls?

(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love on a Loop
mangas.description:
Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship.

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Chapter count includes a prolouge and two side story chapters.

mangas.title: Today's Sexual Review
mangas.description:
"I'm a fan of Haeun-nim!"

Hyun-Ho, who works a delivery job, happens to deliver food to the house of Hae-Un-nim, a mukbang YouTuber he was subscribed to. Haeun unexpectedly invites Hyun-Ho, who is a fan, into his house, and Hyun-Ho, who came to the house of his favorite YouTuber, is excited to look around Haeun-nim's house.
And Hyun-Ho touches Haeun-nim's body, which has a firm body unlike his own...

"Tongue, Hyunho-nim, where is..."

"Haeun-nim, can I take it out?"

mangas.title: Leave Room For Love
mangas.description: Kang Yui lost his parents in an accident, and has been blaming himself ever since. As bad things keep happening to those who try to get close to him, he decides to shut himself off from the rest of the world and live a life of solitude. But then comes the effervescent Lee Hyun, his new roommate at university: with his motto of "never give up," Hyun is determined to wiggle his way into Yui's heart, one way or another. But is Hyun bound to be beaten in this battle? Or is there still room for love in Yui's life?

mangas.title: Love Derailed
mangas.description:
For years, basketball player Lee Ahn has kept his feelings for his older friend Geon-U locked away. But when he hears the sudden news of Geon-U's divorce, his heart starts racing all over again. When Geon-U reaches out to ask him to model for his company, Lee Ahn knows he has to take his shot.

"I'm too horny to focus on basketball... Could you help me out?"

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Wo de Wanghong Nanyou
mangas.description:
Nan-ge is a popular Youtuber about to reach 300,000 subs. But there's a problem plaguing him... his subscriber count is stalling at 299,000! At his wit's end, he takes up a friend's suggestion and tries collaborating with another popular influencer - Prince Mengtai. On-screen, Mengtai's pretty face and cute personality has captured the hearts of young girls everywhere. But in reality, Mengtai's personality is...!?

(Source: Tong Li, translated)



Note: Includes four bonus chapters (two in each volume).

mangas.title: How to Escape the Clutches of an Obsessive Top
mangas.titleNative: 그 가이드가 집착광공의 품에서 벗어나는 방법
mangas.synonyms: How the Guide Escapes the Obsessive Gong | How the Guide Escapes the Obsessive Lover
mangas.description: Yeon-Soo wakes up as a doomed, bratty guide in "The Guide's Abyss." He avoids Seung-Hyuk, an S-rank esper, but one accident later, they're involved. His careful plans are ruined, and though he pulls away, Seung-hyuk sticks to him more. Will Yeon-Soo survive, or will Seung-Hyuk's possessiveness prevail?

mangas.title: Dazzling Breath
mangas.description: In a world where only Guides can stabilize Espers, Wonwoo, a soldier and Purifier, is swept into a parallel world through a mysterious fog, where he faces his dying self and gets a second chance at life. As he starts anew, he encounters the ruler of the North, Yoon, who seems strangely familiar...

mangas.title: Problematic Student Patrol
mangas.description:
When delinquent transfer student Ban Tae-Hyeon, rumored to be the brawler at the center of a schoolyard fight, walks into class, the strict and upright Kang Hyeon-Beom makes it his mission to keep him in check. Determined to reform Tae-Hyeon into a model student, Hyeon-Beom starts watching his every move… only to find himself slowly drawn into Tae-Hyeon's orbit. As the line between discipline and friendship starts to blur, could Hyeon-Beom really be the one getting "reformed" instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: While You Weren't Watching
mangas.description:
After a messy breakup, beta Hae-Min swore off alphas for good… until a reckless one-night stand with dominant alpha Seong-Han turns him into an omega overnight. Now stuck needing a regular partner (doctor's orders!), Hae-Min bites the bullet and proposes a deal with Seong-Han, who just so happens to be his newest coworker. One weekly "appointment" turns into sparks flying - but just when things start to look sweet, who should show up as their new boss but Jin-Tae, the ex who dumped Hae-Min for being a beta?! From awkward office deals to tangled love triangles, Hae-Min's love life is about to get a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Lights, Camera, Action!
mangas.description:
Actor Geum Ki-Yool has been secretly in love with his roommate Seo-Moon Hyung since their school days. When Ki-Yool takes on an adult-themed music video, he tries to set the mood by experimenting with a toy, only to get caught in the act by Hyung himself! But instead of being shocked, Hyung unexpectedly offers to help him out. As the lines between fiction and reality begin to blur, both Ki-Yool and Hyung have to find the courage to step into the spotlight.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Mingling Phase
mangas.description:
Seo Yeon-Woo is in love with his best friend, Cha Do-Jin, and he's afraid of letting his feelings slip, knowing it could ruin their lifelong friendship forever. But when Yeon-Woo slowly distances himself from Do-Jin and makes friends with a new student named Baek Ha, Dojin starts developing feelings he's never experienced before. Is it simple jealousy over losing his best friend? Or is it something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes three side story chapters rated R19.

mangas.title: Don't Get Me Wrong, Boss!
mangas.synonyms: It's Not Like That | You've Misunderstood Me
mangas.description: Lim Iro is a BL writer, and a pretty successful one at that! His last project was lavished with praise by everyone… Well, almost everyone. Under pressure from his unimpressed parents, Iro is forced into applying for a "real" job. But instead of a cover letter, he accidentally submits an unreleased extract from his book instead! Disaster! Or maybe not…? Faced with Iro's unconventional application, Baek Ho-ryung, the dashing CEO of Beus drinks company, is intrigued. But once Iro joins Beus, will his office life begin to emulate his steamy writing…?

mangas.title: Newlywed Special Admission
mangas.description:
The first year of university is hard, but so is registering a fake marriage to a random alpha to score admission to a top university. It's even harder keeping that marriage a secret from your classmates while doing just enough sexy stuff with your fake husband/roommate to prove your marriage is legit. But for Yidam, the hardest part of all is keeping his hands off the stranger he married.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Olympian
mangas.description:
Short track speed skater Yeo-Jun Lee joins the National Team, only making it by sheer dumb luck. Dejected, he walks into his new room to find gold medalist Ji-Hun Nam, his long-time crush! With the Olympics just 6 months away, can Yeo-Jun make history in the rink? Or will his face flush ever more pink?

(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Masked by Love
mangas.description:
After chatting with a flower shop's mascot part-time worker, Do-Hui suddenly finds himself on the radar of the school delinquent, Yang-Hyeon. Seeking comfort, he confides in the gentle person inside the bear costume, never suspecting it's actually Yang-Hyeon himself. As misunderstandings and hidden crushes collide, a shy first love begins to bloom in the most unexpected way.


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Your Skin Is Tinged Red as if Burning With Heat
mangas.description:
The moment I saw that milky-white skin of his turn red all over with heat, I couldn't help myself -- I was absolutely incensed.

This is a story about a regular-old hard-worker and a good-for-nothing genius and the hot college summer these polar opposites spend together.

Seto's a first year in college and the ace of the beach volleyball team. He's hard on himself and everyone around him. The new guy, Umimoto, just can't help but pick a fight with him. They end up in a beach volleyball face-off. Umimoto doesn't practice -- that's clear from how pale his skin is. Seto's sure he's got this one in the bag. But Umimoto's agility and grace absolutely beguile. Umimoto started the match with a promise: "If I lose, I'll give you head!" After the match, Seto hits the showers... what happens when Umimoto follows him in?



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Virtual-kun wa Otonari-san kara Nigetai
mangas.titleNative: バーチャルくんはお隣さんかから逃げたい
mangas.description:
"He isn't nice at all!!!"



Haru, a university student and a virtual streamer, moves into a completely soundproof apartment he longed for a long time. On his moving day, he meets his next-door neighbor Tsukasa and is relieved when he finds out that Tsukasa is a stylish nice young man. However, that night, Haru thoughtlessly steps out to the balcony during his stream and gets caught by Tsukasa! Haru asks him not to tell anyone about him being a streamer, but Tsukasa threatens him with a sneer, saying, "I'll keep it a secret, so go out with me."......!?



(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: V Yattetara Aikata ni Kokuhaku Saremashita
mangas.titleNative: Vやってたら相方に告白されました
mangas.synonyms: My partner who streams VTuber with asked me out.
mangas.description:
Kanade Hosonami, a high school honor student with the appearance of an angel, has a dark side.



That being… his tenshi-kei VTuber alternate identity, Belle Ariane.



Kanade has a hard time showing his true personality at school, but when he is Belle, he can truly be himself.
One day, Belle and his partner Dia, a demon-kei VTuber, decide to collaborate IRL for the first time.
The one who shows up at the meeting turns out to be his loner classmate, Amaya, who is rumored to be a delinquent!
Kanade is put off at first, but Amaya asks if he would go out with him...?



(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Fake Fiction
mangas.titleNative: フェイクフィクション
mangas.description:
Up-and-coming actor Arashi Hinami is wildly jealous of the more popular actor Tooru Ootaki. After watching Tooru's most recent movie, Arashi goes to his usual members-only gentleman's club to clear his head.

At this club everyone hides their face, and don't pry into private matters. Here Arashi is instantly drawn to a mysterious and alluring man, and they spend a passionate night together.

The next morning Arashi sees that the man he had a perfect physical connection with is none other than... Tooru Ootaki? Not only that, they're about to star in a drama together!

mangas.title: Point of No Return
mangas.titleNative: ポイントオブノーリターン
mangas.description:
Ao, with a cool and kind personality, is known as the most handsome prince in school. His childhood friend Haru, is one year older than him. However, Ao, who's secretly in love with Haru, feels lonely because they're in different grades.



Meanwhile, summer vacation begins, and when the two boys are curious about a kissing scene they see on TV; Haru suddenly blurts out, "I wonder what kissing feels like?"... Their relationship begins to change.



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Fukagyaku Montage
mangas.description:
Yomi Kanade, a university student, is a smart guy.

That's how others see him, and that's how he sees himself.

His life is smooth sailing.

That's what Yomi thought, until he meets Kenichi Hamano, a fellow student from another department.
It all started when Kenichi picked up Yomi's cell phone, which he had dropped at a drinking party, and returned it to him.
Thinking Kenichi seemed nice, Yomi invites him into his home.

"Can you help me with my assignment?"

During a comfortable moment, Hamano asks Yomi to appear in his photography project.
The theme of the assignment is "love."

"Oh, so that's what this is."

With that cold realization, Yōmi refuses Hamano's request—but... ?

What is "love"? What does it mean to "like" someone?

A story about the vivid changes of the heart during the moratorium of college life.

A cynical, resourceful, poor college student × a demi-sexual, innocent genius.

A faintly sweet slice-of-life BL.

mangas.title: Natsu Hate no Unknown
mangas.synonyms: The UNKNOWN at the end of summer

mangas.title: Hanarerarenai, Nigashite Yarenai
mangas.titleNative: 離れられない、逃がしてやれない
mangas.description:
Ginga and Ruka, are childhood friends.

Ginga had always loved Ruka, who was strong and dazzling, and who had always protected him when he was a crybaby.
