As childhood friends and best friends, he was satisfied with always being close to him.

Even when a friend urged him, "Someone else will snatch him away," Ginga couldn't bring himself to take that first step.
He didn't want someone else to take him, but he also lacked the courage to express his feelings... One day, while drunk, his suppressed feelings are revealed...?



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Run Wild
mangas.description:
As soon as Jiang Cheng finds out he's adopted, he's abandoned by his adoptive family and sent to live with his deadbeat father, who has a gambling addiction. Everything about his new life, from his pathetic father to the unfamiliar environment, makes Jiang Cheng depressed. But then he meets Gu Fei, who's like a shining bright light in this run-down city, and the two become each other's salvation and hope.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Oegyeineul Saranghaneun Bangbeop
mangas.synonyms: The Way to Love an Alien
mangas.description:
"Would you mind showing me... masturbating?"

The owner, who became the temporary president of the alien club instead of a friend. Coco claims that she is an alien and demands masturbation.

"Sex is for people who love each other."
"Then how about loving me?"

The way alien(?) Coco and the temporary president owner love!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)


Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.

mangas.title: Triple Twist
mangas.synonyms: Reversal of the Twist of the Inversion
mangas.description:
At a formal marriage meeting, omega Seo-Ho drops a shocking bombshell... he's pregnant. But there's a twist: the father isn't his fiancé, but a complete stranger he only met the night before. That stranger is Eun-Hyun, a wealthy alpha from a powerful family. With no time to backtrack, Seo-Ho is forced into a fake engagement with him, a contract bound by secrets, lies, and complicated emotions. As they navigate family expectations, public scrutiny, and their own tangled feelings, tension simmers between them. Can this accidental couple survive the chaos they've unleashed, or will their carefully built house of cards come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Look at Me.
mangas.description:
"Sorry I'm not a girl." Turns out, I knew nothing about Saku. Kyosuke had always thought that his childhood friend was a girl. And he was likely already in love by the time he realized that Saku was a guy. Thinking that this kind of attention from another guy would only annoy him, Kyosuke decided not to pursue Saku. But one day, he noticed hickeys on Saku's back... Thus began a tale of earnest love that would take a turn for the worse.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Senpai is Bad for My Heart
mangas.titleNative: 俺のセンパイが心臓に悪い
mangas.description:
Inohara, a scary-looking university student with zero friends, has his life thrown around by his handsy senpai, Maki. "I've got a lot of moles all over my body... Wanna count them sometime?" His suggestive attitude, his seductive gestures... Why is it that Inohara's heart acts so strangely around Maki? A pure love story between a tough virgin university student and a caring graduate student ☆



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: When Fortune and Fate Meets
mangas.synonyms: If the Stars Align | When the Stars Align
mangas.description:
At his grandfather's funeral, Aaron meets a man named Joseph, who claims to have been his grandfather's student. Drawn to the mysterious charm of Joseph, Aaron ends up dating him, but soon after, he begins to have recurring dreams featuring a strange man...

And he can't shake the feeling that the man in his dreams somehow resembles Joseph?!

mangas.title: Ninhao! Guiren Xitong Wei Nin Fuwu
mangas.titleNative: 您好！贵人系统为您服务
mangas.synonyms: Hello! The Nobleman System Is at Your Service
mangas.description:
Jiang Ruo, who specializes in giving gold coins to the sons of destiny, is facing the biggest challenge of his career. All his support for the protagonist has been misinterpreted as love...

I only gave money, not people!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Our Youth
mangas.description:
Jin-Hyuk is a model student. Studious. Hardworking. He can't wait till the day he has his own place and his own car. He knows that the only way he can achieve his dreams is to go to a top-tier university. He's fine with his repetitive daily routine of school and studying. That is, until one day, while taking a shortcut through a rougher neighborhood, he sees a kid that looks familiar. That kid… they're in the same homeroom together, aren't they? But he's not the kind of person Jin-Hyuk would get mixed up with. He's the kind of person that grows up to be a lowlife. Jin-Hyuk was raised better than that. But… that kid, what's his name… Hee-Chan was it? He's getting beat up by his dad. No, just keep walking. He should have nothing to do with Hee-Chan, but something seems to keep making their paths cross…

This feeling of ennui that Jin-Hyuk has, is Hee-Chan what he needs to shake it?



(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: My First XXX: The Black Knight Under the Red Curse
mangas.description:
Ratan the mage is being pursued by the knights of the inquisition for studying the forbidden Red Curse. When he seeks refuge in The Black Forest, he runs into its deadly resident knight in steel armor who happens to be the curse's victim. Thankfully, Ratan's offer to lift the curse keeps the knight from killing him. But the solution involves some heated action in the bedroom, and Ratan isn't so sure that he'll survive to see another day...



(Source: Tappytoon)


Notes:

- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.

- Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Fate Mate
mangas.description: Kwon Sehyeon is both an alpha and omega who enters the beta dorm at his university to hide his unusual trait. Since his omega side awakened late and is unstable, he needs to avoid alphas at all costs. But as it turns out, his kind roommate and old friend, Seo Junhoo, also entered the beta dorm hiding the fact that he is an alpha. Once he learns the truth, Sehyeon knows he should change rooms and stay away from Junhoo. However, an unexpected heat cycle has the two friends crossing the point of no return...

mangas.title: Alpha Boyfriends
mangas.description: Kwon Ju-Shin gets a candle that can reproduce omega pheromones with 90% accuracy. Using this candle, he tries to think back to his first love, but for some reason, he thinks of his alpha acquaintance Sung Je-Won rather than an omega. Ju-Shin decides to have fun with the candle instead of getting rid of it, so he has a bet with Je-Won to see who can withstand the candle's effect. However, the candle unlocks Ju-Shin's desire to be with Je-Won, and try as he might, he can't stop wanting him, a fellow alpha.

mangas.title: Gentle Forest
mangas.description: Aiden is a quarterback and Seo-Won is a chronically-ill forest boy. Could it be any more obvious? Seo-Won can't quite bring himself to believe that a popular football player has been crushing on him for years, but Seo-Won's remote forest home might be the perfect place for romance to take root. But Aiden is only visiting Korea–is two weeks enough time to establish a relationship, or…a family?

mangas.title: Be the Good to My Bad
mangas.description: All the world's a stage – and that includes Lee Hyesung's love life! A former child star, Hyesung exited the limelight after a traumatic incident left him unable to continue. But he is thrust back into the public eye when a fateful trip to Hawaii leads him to get caught up in dating rumors with A-list actor Shin Yoo-il: the nation's bad boy with looks that deserve a standing ovation. Though there is seemingly nothing between them at first, the two decide to pursue things further in the interest of their careers; after all, all press is good press, right? But when business mixes with pleasure, Hyesung and Yoo-il's method acting begins to blur the lines between fantasy and reality. Will the two find their happy ending together? Or are they destined to star in a real-world tragedy…?

mangas.title: Love Meter 100%
mangas.description:
Yihan is obsessed with one thing and one thing only: Mikaros, the really hot mint-haired hunk who exists only in the world of Yihan's favorite BL game, Love Meter 100%. Wherever Yihan goes, his hefty stash of Mikaros merch goes—the limited edition tote bag, the special key ring, and the myriad of adorable plushies that he somehow manages to keep on his person. Being the ultimate stan isn't something Yihan is ashamed of, that is, until he runs into Mikaros in real life. Mikaros-in-the-flesh is called Park Há, and he is everything that Yihan didn't know he needed. There's only one catch. Park Há hates otakus…but Yihan is literally the biggest otaku ever.


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Ao to Midori
mangas.description:
"I've wished for a morning like this for eight years."

Top scorer of the midterm, winner of the relay race. For the academic-and-sports genius Ao, this is the first time he's wanted something from the bottom of his heart. And that thing is Midori, the one always comes in second, who saw himself as Ao's rival. Ao can't control his feelings for him, and when he sees Midori, he's so happy that he can't help but run up to him. But, afraid to ruin their relationship, he carries the pain and longs for him late at night...

"I want your eyelashes to be the first thing I see when I wake up."

mangas.title: How To Send a Friend to Nirvana
mangas.synonyms: S'envoyer en l'air pour te sauver
mangas.description:
After the tragic death of their childhood friend, Kang Chung-Woo, Ha Se-Jun, and Eun Bin decide to grant Myung Yu-Hyeon's last wish by performing a séance so they all can hang out for the final time. Much to their surprise, the séance works, and Yu-Hyeon's spirit comes back. But he wasn't exactly honest about his steamy last wish... Now, he has to possess one of his friends to make it come true. Will fulfilling Yu-Hyeon's last lusty desire send him to nirvana? Or does he have even more wishes?!

(Source: Tapas)


Note:
- Includes eight extra chapters.

- Winner of the 14th Mr.Blue Contest.

mangas.title: Koi mo Sugireba
mangas.description: At a craft fair, Woodworker Suou Takizawa meets the overly friendly Leatherworker Sei Shirakawa. Initially skeptical of Sei's outgoing nature, Suou surprisingly finds himself enjoying Sei's company over drinks. After taking a drunken Sei home, Suou thoughtlessly undresses him, only to be caught off guard by Sei's suggestive behavior and they end up getting intimate. The next morning, Suou is troubled with how Sei is treating him as if nothing had happened, but...?

mangas.title: Well-hung Hero
mangas.description:
When portals to other worlds unleash monster-filled dungeons across Earth, humanity awakens to new supernatural powers. Meet Ash: an S-Class hero cursed with a truly massive gift. Blessed (or burdened) with a radiant, colossal holy member, Ash has become the ultimate solo player. After all, who could possibly handle him? Enter Roose: a mysterious villain with the power to nullify abilities…and apparently, the only one capable of taking Ash on (and in)! Ash's holy sword is ready, but can he win Roose's heart as well as save the day?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Circuit Breaker
mangas.description: Jae-Won, a small-time DIY trader, wins the lottery, but wakes up inside a web novel after a car crash. To return home to his prize money, he must help the male and female leads get their happily ever after, but why do all the handsome male lead candidates seem more interested in him than the heroine?

mangas.title: Love Gym
mangas.description:
Geon is a personal trainer in desperate need of new clients or else he'll be fired. So when he encounters the overweight Gyu-Won decked out in designer brands, he sees it as a golden opportunity. Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of heeding Gyu-Won's request to go on a date with him once he achieves his dream body. When Gyu-Won transforms into Geon's ideal type a year later, Geon finds himself slowly drawn to him. Will Geon be able to resist the seemingly perfect younger, rich, and hot guy? Or will he succumb to temptation and fall for him?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes three side story chapters.

mangas.title: Sugar Trap
mangas.description: If there was a closet inside a closet, Joohwan would hide there. He's that desperate to hide that he's gay. Still, he's doing a pretty good job at hiding his sexual orientation, on his way to a promotion at his job, and has everything going great...right until he crosses paths with Sihyun during a major presentation for work. Unfortunately, Sihyun is devastatingly attractive. Perhaps attractive enough to drag Joohwan out of the closet...

mangas.title: In Cold Love
mangas.synonyms: อสูรเลือดเย็น
mangas.description:
Chae-Wool's world shatters when his boss - and the man he's been in love with for ages - Chae-Heon, unexpectedly dies. Struggling to cope, Chae-Wool fights to maintain his composure whilst going about daily life…until a familiar figure appears before his teary eyes. Chae-Heon is back. Alive. But something is different; his memories are fragmented, his gaze unfamiliar, and his touch colder than before. What is this mysterious force lurking beneath the flawless exterior of Chae-Heon? And is that…hissing I hear…?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)


Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Plum Candy Love
mangas.description:
Yeong-Hyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Dae-Han, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeong-Hyeon tries to sneak past him, Dae-Han drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeong-Hyeon's immediate refusal, Dae-Han walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeong-Hyeon...

They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Countdown to Love
mangas.description:
If only I could be the one to reach you...

After an ankle injury dashes Hoon's hopes of becoming a basketball star, he begins to see a timer in the sky. He believes it's a countdown to the day he dies, until he discovers one day that his classmate Haedam can see it too...

mangas.title: Ore no Polaris
mangas.description:
"I want to proudly stand next to Minami-san, not as one of his juniors...!"

Wanting to change his lack of initiative, college student Meguru starts a part-time job as a "substitute traveler." He is asked to do unexpected things, from finding someone's first love to taking a stuffed animal along on a trip. Everything is a bit of a challenge, and things don't always go as planned, but Minami, his training supervisor, is always there to gently guide him through the process.

But he realizes his feelings toward Minami gradually changed from admiration to love...



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Seven Sundays
mangas.description: Tae-Yang thought he'd never see Ji-Wan again after their messy breakup, but fate and the media have other plans. Now a heroic firefighter with a documentary deal, Tae-Yang reunites with his producer ex at the broadcasting station... except Ji-Wan is doing everything he can to avoid him. But then, why does he have a seven-year-old kid with the same name as Tae-Yang? Once he secures seven dates with Ji-Wan as "payment" for using his name, it's up to Tae-Yang to do some detective work and win over his reluctant ex in seven Sundays.

mangas.title: Aiou Futari
mangas.description: A young man discovers that his mother has been going out with a sugar baby for a while. But is that really what is happening? A heartfelt story of finding love and family.

mangas.title: Do You Really Want Only a Meal?
mangas.titleNative: 満たすのは空腹だけですか？
mangas.synonyms: Mitasu No Wa Kuufuku Dake Desuka?
mangas.description: Masamune Hanzawa, a 27-year-old office worker with no time for love or cooking, reluctantly tries a housekeeping service at his section chief's suggestion. Enter Natsuki, a charming college student and his boss's son, who quickly captures Masamune's heart. After their first meeting, Natsuki boldly confesses his feelings, leaving Masamune torn. Though undeniably attracted to Natsuki, Masamune hesitates due to their age difference and the potential complications of dating his superior's son. As they navigate meals and growing emotions, Masamune must decide whether to embrace this unexpected chance at love—or let it slip away.

mangas.title: My Noons and Midnights Are for You
mangas.description:
#MAHIRUTIME

Mayo hides behind the screen as "Mahiru"—but how long can he hide his true self?



Compared to his radiant online alter ego—Mahiru, a bubbly VTuber beloved by thousands of fans—the real Mayo is gloomy, shy and plagued by self-doubt. And the more love Mahiru receives, the more Mayo feels the sting of isolation. Even Mr. Ogino—Mayo's affectionate, doting manager—seems to care more for the persona, not the real Mayo behind the mask.



So even when Mr. Ogino tells him, "I love you," how could Mayo ever believe his words...? Yet Mr. Ogino might see more than Mayo realizes. Sensing Mayo's secret longing and unable to resist, Mr. Ogino utters the words that will change their relationship forever: "In that case... shall I bully you instead?"



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Evil Baby
mangas.description: Yu Yang had never thought that there were evil babies in the world. His fate changed because of meeting Zhang Cheng. This person who took care of him in every way turned out to be his greatest enemy in this life. Should he kill him?

mangas.title: Smoky Nectar
mangas.description:
Mitsuru Hasegawa is a reporter looking into an incident suspected to involve a vampire. Yusei Annaka, or Anna, a friend he's known since they were kids, warns him not to stick his nose in too deep. He should know―he's a vampire himself. Mitsuru agrees to let Anna suck his blood as part of his research, and one thing leads to an incredible experience. Mitsuru's about to learn a secret about himself he had never imagined...!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Nocturnal Dogs
mangas.titleNative: ノクターナルドッグズ
mangas.description: The soldiers of 'Nox', a police unit, tasked with fighting against the spread of the Rufsol Virus.Veteran Rille has a new partner, Zein, an ex-elite police officer and survivor of the virus.Two men who are always at each other's throats, and their steamy romance.

mangas.title: How to Deal When Your Intimidating Neighbor is Actually an Omega
mangas.titleNative: コワモテの隣人がΩだった時の対処法
mangas.synonyms: Kowamote no Rinjin ga Ω datta Toki no Taishohou | Kowamote no Rinjin ga Omega datta Toki no Taishohou
mangas.description:
"He looks like a cold and handsome Alpha…who'd ever think he was actually a twisted and sexy Omega!"

Kota is a college student, and an Alpha. Still, he dreads bumping into his neighbor, a super-intimidating hunk with big, black tattoos. He always assumed this mystery man was an Alpha, too, and avoided him like the plague...until, one day, a scent wafts in so powerful it puts even the dull-headed Kota in a daze. It's the scent of Omega pheromones, from next door! He assumes his neighbor's brought an Omega home, but when he tries to leave, what should he find but the source of the pheromones: his hot neighbor! How will he get out of this situation unscathed, and without his neighbor finding out he's a virgin?!

mangas.title: Master's Lesson
mangas.description: When Mr. Joo and Mr. Young tried to have sex, things went awry due to Mr. Young being too big down there. Eventually, Mr. Joo gave him a second chance due to how besotted Mr. Young seemed to him. The meticulously prepared Master's Lesson is finally starting!

mangas.title: Blaze
mangas.description:
The young master of flames, Yeom-Ju, carries a rare blue fire—one that once scorched the heart of his beloved teacher, Ban-Ui, the very man who first taught him what love meant. Ban-Ui, cursed with immortality as punishment for sins in a past life, cannot die no matter how deeply he longs for release. Wracked with guilt over Yeom-Ju's pain, he disappears without a trace, hoping distance will lessen the burden for them both. But Yeom-Ju, unwilling to let go, chooses to walk through his own personal hell to find him again. Years of longing, suffering, and searching finally lead him to Ban-Ui once more. Even now, the fire within Yeom-Ju still burns only for him. But will Ban-Ui allow himself to be found… or is the wound between them too deep to heal?

Some flames never fade. Some love never dies.

mangas.title: Sparkling Baby
mangas.description:
While in New York, Yujin, a talented young photographer, is captivated by Hanjoon, a renowned fashion magazine director. They share a few drinks and a hotel bed, but Hanjoon leaves in the morning without a word, not expecting to see Yujin again. Years later, Yujin, now a prominent figure in his field, lands a job at Hanjoon's magazine in Korea. As Yujin's feelings for Hanjoon grow, Hanjoon can't seem to get over his ex. Will Hanjoon be able to move past his previous heartbreak and find new love?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Love is a Sport: Victory, Gold Hunters!
mangas.description:
Sun-Woo is an Olympic gold medalist and Korea's pride in air shooting. He has everything under control until fencing rookie Seong-Han asks for a handshake to "borrow his winning energy." After that, Seong-Han takes gold, and Sun-Woo crashes spectacularly. Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. What begins as a heated rivalry between two athletes quickly turns into something far more dangerous. In the Olympic Village, competition is not the only thing raising the tension.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

mangas.title: I Became the Lousy Side Top
mangas.description:
Seo Jaewoo wakes up to find himself in the world of a BL novel. But he isn't just any random person. He's actually the lousy side-top character who's meant to torment the main bottom, Yoo Hyeonjin. What's worse is that by the novel's conclusion, all of Jaewoo's despicable actions catch up to him, and he is killed by the story's crazy main top and Hyeonjin's love interest, Choi Mujin. In order to avoid his death, Jaewoo decides to change his original role and get on Hyeonjin's good side. His method: lure him in with food, of course! While his tactic proves effective and he slowly befriends Hyeonjin, that doesn't become the only major change to the plot. After an unexpected encounter with Mujin, Jaewoo's position as the "lousy side top" gets completely flipped upside down…



(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: Ex Boyfriend Reports
mangas.description:
Min Jae-Won is attracting attention at the company for his excellent work skills and good looks. He suddenly receives a breakup notice from his older lover, Hwang-Chan, whom he thought he was getting along with. Jae-Won, dealing with the sadness and depression of parting, meets Chan's 'ex-boyfriend' while looking back over his memories.

Not long after we broke up, I met a new boyfriend... ?! But he broke up with his boyfriend too? The two search for traces of Hwang-Chan and find an 'ex-boyfriend report' he has written. Why did you write and collect these things...?

mangas.title: Soulbound
mangas.description:
Mu-Ryoung, a prodigy exorcist born into a famous family, begins taking small jobs in high school. But when he meets Hwan-Young, a classmate cursed with misfortune, their bond drags him into a dangerous exorcism unlike any other.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Moksumeul Dahae Kkosyeora
mangas.synonyms: Seduce Me With All Your Might
mangas.description:
Ho Yeon-Woo is a perfect man with looks, abilities, and even aura. However, he is the worst as a romantic partner, only pursuing casual encounters and mercilessly rejecting serious partners. Despite knowing this, he is called a 'fox' instead of 'Yeon-Woo' because there are many people who are attracted to him. In fact, he is... a real fox! The fox-like 'Hoin-Jok' gains life from the hearts of humans towards him. The deeper and greater the feelings, the better, but Yeon-Woo for some reason avoids deep hearts and instead rejects them when they become serious. Yeon-Woo, unable to absorb good life force, eventually falls ill and collapses. If this continues, he will die within a year. There is only one solution: find someone with a huge heart and make them fall in deep love to gain that power. Yeom-Hwa, the leader of the Hoin-Jok, injects Yeon-Woo with divine power into his eyes, allowing him to see the hearts of each person. However, the owner of the huge heart that he found after searching hard enough is a man...? And he is a judo player with broad shoulders, a college student, and a famous blunt and stubborn Go Jeong-In! Heterosexual? The other person just can't stand it? You don't need anything else. If you want to live, "Turn your life around!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

mangas.title: Our Dishonesty
mangas.description: Eun Seong-Bin, who has finally found his dream home, never wants to go back to his boring home! In order to do so, he is advised to become friends with the class president, Jin-Woo Ha, who is considered the real power in the class, but when he actually watches, Jin-Woo Ha is a total pushover. Seong-Bin, who had let his guard down around Jin-Woo Ha, accidentally witnesses Jin-Woo Ha kissing a man.

mangas.title: Do Not Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge
mangas.synonyms: Don't Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge
mangas.description:
For as long as he can remember, Ha Na-Deul has been tangled up with Ju Seok in everything he does. Tests, competitions, group projects, student rankings, you name it. And every single time, Na-Deul loses first place to him by just a hair. All Na-Deul wants is freedom, counting down the days until high school graduation so he can finally escape his infuriating rival. But fate has other plans.
As a fortune teller once warned, "He is someone who will stick to you even in death." Sure enough, the two end up at the same university. One night, while Na-Deul is working a part time shift at a convenience store, Ju Seok shows up looking teary eyed and suddenly confesses. From that day on, Ju Seok launches an all out, shameless love offensive. And the more Na-Deul tries to run, the more the two become hopelessly intertwined.

mangas.title: A Second Chance for the Outcast Prince
mangas.synonyms: How the Sidekick Prince Lives Again
mangas.description: In a nation where alphas and omegas hold all the power, being born as a beta is a terrible fate for Prince Renato El Fleuret. His life is a string of tragedies leading to a cruel end… until he is reawoken in the past! Determined to make the most of this second chance at life, Renato enlists the help of Kalid, a prince from a neighboring kingdom with a complicated backstory of his own. Together, they must do everything in their power to fight for their own happily-ever-after…

mangas.title: Your Memes Are Better Looking Than You
mangas.titleNative: 你的表情包比本人好看
mangas.description:
Gu Wei. the popular yet controversial lead dancer of a boy band. Jiang Xun, a god-tier professional esports player.One day, after a variety show aired, these two complete and utter strangers became a trending topic together.

Gu Wei's anti-fans: Do these two people have anything in common? Gu Wei is absolutely shameless, even leaching on the popularity of esports and buying paid posts left and right!

Fans of Jiang Xun's skills: Our God Xun is as rich as a nation. If he wanted to, he could play around with any nameless celebrity and dump them after getting bored.

However, an expected trending topic emerged not long after.

"Jiang Xun slacks off during livestream to promote a celebrity and fight against anti-fans."

"Jiang Xun's younger brother Jiang Ying complains that he's been forced to defend his nemesis Gu Wei against anti-fans."

Netizens: ???

Although they have an arranged marriage between them, what Gu Wei fell for first was not Jiang Xun, but Jiang Xun's memes. The first time Jiang Xun met Gu Wei, he thought he liked him. He could never have imagined that Gu Wei only liked his memes.

Gu Wei: I think your memes are better looking than you.

Jiang Xun: Little kid, you're a little rebel, aren't you.

Later, affection gradually grew between the both of them until Gu Wei eventually mustered up the courage to confess to Jiang Xun.

Gu Wei: Jiang Xun, I've become a fan of our ship.

Jiang Xun replies ruthlessly: It's too late, I'm now your solo fan.

mangas.title: FOG [GAMING]
mangas.description: After a catastrophic falling out, professional E-sports competitors Shi Luo and Yu Sui parted ways. Shi Luo knows better than to open himself up to the man who broke his heart but, when that man approaches him with a proposal for a new team, familiar feelings begin to bubble up to the surface.

mangas.title: Confessions of the Night
mangas.description: Enoch is a priest that has lost the love of his life. One day, he comes across a familiar face in the church where he preaches. The man, also called Ray like his beloved, pursues him posing as his late lover and Enoch decides to go along with his ruse. Will Enoch be able to resist temptation? Or will he end up making a pact with the devil?

mangas.title: Stay Alive
mangas.description: When a zombie outbreak overruns Seoul, the government abandons the city to its fate. Amid the chaos, ex-special forces bodyguard Shin-U fights to protect his skittish charge, Te-Bek. But as every day brings them closer to death, their bond grows harder to resist. Can love survive an apocalypse?

mangas.title: My Bias Is Showing?!
mangas.description:
When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that's exactly what happens!



If that's not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his "co-teacher." Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Get Out Of My House!
mangas.description: Hong Yo-Han has finally realized his dream of owning his own home. On the first day of moving in, he invites his friends over for a housewarming party and spends his first night in his new home with excitement, but unexpectedly sees a ghost. Thinking it was just a nightmare, Yo-Han is tormented by the ghost appearing at random times. By chance, he discovers that the clue to solving the ghost problem lies with his awkward colleague, Go Philip, and in desperation, he invites Philip into his home...

mangas.title: Ask and You Will Receive
mangas.titleNative: そんなに言うなら抱いてやる
mangas.description:
Shinobu Urakawa is a dull office worker in the daytime, but at night, he turns into a playboy who can seduce any guy with a glance. He's a top enjoying his double life… until Hikaru Omoteya, the detestable narcissistic "prince" of the sales department, turns up at his favorite gay bar. Even though Hikaru is straight, he seems to enjoy the bar and keeps coming back, preventing Shinobu from enjoying his usual nightlife. But Shinobu realizes that Hikaru looks interested in him, and decides to use his charm as a weapon to regain his night oasis!

"I bet you were actually waiting for me to approach you."

mangas.title: The Perfect
mangas.description:
"Heartless," former humans devoid of emotions, have turned the world and Jemyeong Han's life upside down. Jemyeong, now facing termination over an unresolved Heartless case, turns to Heartless hunting company 4K for help. But it's not long before he's inextricably entangled with its problematic co-CEO, Guk. "What if you start wanting me over everything?" Those sappy words belong to a webnovel prince, not a shameless man like you!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Nurturing Our Natures
mangas.synonyms: Mr. Tiger, Thank you for the meal
mangas.description: In a world that expects carnivore hybrids to be fierce and herbivores to be pure, Lee Tae-Jun is a timid tiger who never quite fits the mold. Working quietly at his childhood friend's convenience store, he lives weighed down by self-doubt and the pressure to suppress his true self. One night, he meets Hwa Seo-Yun, a sheep model whose drunken visit leads to Tae-Jun's first time. While Tae-Jun shyly longs for another meeting, Seo-Yun finds himself drawn to the tiger's gentle, self-effacing nature. As they grow closer, the two discover comfort and kinship in choosing to live true to themselves.

mangas.title: Ashita ni Tsuzuku Tadaima wo
mangas.titleNative: 明日に続くただいまを
mangas.description:
University students Saeki Yosuke and Yano Junya were once mere classmates in high school, not particularly close. However, after Yano—a promising track and field athlete—was forced to give up his dreams due to an injury, Saeki found himself unable to just ignore him. On a whim, he invited Yano to live together while they attended the same university.

"What exactly is this feeling?" As they navigate their unspoken emotions and awkward boundaries, the two gradually find their distance shrinking…

mangas.title: Love, To Us
mangas.description:
After years of devotion, Si-Woo's boyfriend betrays him; then, the company he worked so hard at goes under. Feeling totally defeated, Si-Woo escapes into a game world just to take a break from reality. There, he meets a newbie named Woo-Jin, whose kind advice and hard-working attitude inspire Si-Woo to move on from his past and start living with purpose again. Determined never to fall for someone who'll hurt him again, Si-Woo makes a vow to his friend: No love, no dating. Ever again! But when he meets his new boss, Si-Woo's willpower will be put to the ultimate test…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Wolf in White
mangas.description:
After a traumatic incident in high school left Se-Jin with emotional scars (and a three-year delay), all he wants now is to quietly graduate from Korea's top university with decent grades. But what was supposed to be his easiest class turns into a paired project from hell, and who just so happens to be his teammate? The overly friendly, overly handsome Wu-Hyeon, of course! Not only is this guy clingy like lost puppy, but there's something about him that puts Se-Jin on edge… Why does Wu-Hyeon seem so familiar, and how does he know so much about Se-Jin…?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Miss You, Lucifer
mangas.description:
An A-list star has a crush on a rookie idol.



Jung-Woo 'Lucifer' Lee, a member of the obscure idol group Sweet Devils, dreams of making it big. His one claim to fame — an accidental pants-ripping on air — leads to a chance encounter with A-list star Kwon-Jun Kang. Turns out, Kwon-Jun has been harboring an intense crush on Lucifer. What will happen when an unexpected one-night stand leads to an ambiguous romance? How will this A-list star and D-list idol navigate their relationship?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Please, Just This Once!
mangas.description:
Known as the weirdo of the Early Childhood Education Department, Ju-Yeong starts reviewing adult toys for cash—and gets caught mid-act by his junior and crush, Min-Hwan. Panicking, he blurts out, "Can you put it in? Please, just this once?" Surprisingly, Min-Hwan agrees…

Could he like Ju-Yeong too?

mangas.title: The Evolution of Species
mangas.description: Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the "platform," he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shin-Woo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform… and each other..

mangas.title: The Ideal Relationship
mangas.description:
Sanghwa is a shy introvert with a longtime crush on his handsome friend Ryeohan, but then again, EVERYONE likes him. Feeling like he can't compete for Ryeohan's affections, Sanghwa dives into The Legend of Saga, an online game where he plays as "idealize." He befriends "thegreatmirae," a cute healer who clearly has a soft spot for Sangwha… and who just so happens to be a real-life gangster. Could this tough guy be the ideal lover Sanghwa's been looking for after striking out in the real world?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Please Draw me, Love!
mangas.description:
Aiden ends up working with his favorite novelist, but when he meets him, things start to take a different turn...



(Source: Toomics)

mangas.title: Someone Else's BL Comic
mangas.description:
Seunghee may seem like a regular high school boy, but he's got a few secrets: he loves to cross-dress and read BL comics. He's looking for a match that will accept him, but it's classmate Seungtaek who spies him on a date gone bad. Now that someone at school knows he's gay, can Seunghee's life remain ordinary the way he likes it?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Housekeeper
mangas.description: After the death of his mother, his younger brother keeps bullying him. A short story about family from Tan Jiu.

mangas.title: The Monsoon in June
mangas.description: Seungwoon has decided that it's time to leave his lonely days behind to adopt a newer more cheerful Highschool life which is when he meets Hae-in. The two are seemingly different but Seungwoon can't help but be drawn to him. Throw in monsoon, fights, and the task of growing up, will their friendship survive?

mangas.title: Fools Remaster
mangas.description: Eun-Gi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeong-Woo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that's both easy and difficult.

mangas.title: Make a Pet Out of a Cactus
mangas.description:
"If you're coming, then just come. You missed me didn't you."

"Understood, 'Master'."

A florist and his regular customer...

On the surface, they seem normal but they have a very special relationship... Restraints, handcuffs, toys, SM... The florist is a master and the other is a dog who listens obediently... However, things take an interesting turn when their already unusual relationship grows into something more.

mangas.title: Room to Room
mangas.description:
Despite having a secret crush on Chamin, Dowan lets him move into his spare room, and the two become housemates. Until one night, Chamin comes into Dowan's room and wants... to have sex? The problem is, Chamin doesn't remember a thing each morning after. Turns out he has something called sexsomnia?! What is Dowan supposed to do now?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Window to Window
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Ginu and Yubin live in separate apartments in separate buildings right next to each other – so close, in fact, they can talk to each other and see into each other's apartments through their windows. But Yubin's long-held secret is revealed one day when Ginu sees him doing something naughty through the window...



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: The manhwa resumed publication in 2020 on Bomtoon with a series of side stories.

mangas.title: Near and Dear
mangas.description: Yoo Hae-Young was a child star with a bright future, but now, at 29, he just drifts through life. However, everything changes when the famous actor Jung Yeo-Woon asks Hae-Young to be his manager and even suggests that they live together! Though Hae-Young has spent his life avoiding the spotlight due to his past successes, he accepts the job and things seem to go well until he catches Yeo-Woon touching himself. Now, Hae-Young can't get Yeo-Woon off his mind, and it doesn't help that they're together all day and night long.

mangas.title: Teach Me!
mangas.description: They say third time's a charm, but what Jaehong needs is a miracle. After failing the notorious college entrance exam twice, he's determined to succeed and finally experience the ultimate campus life. However, he can't do it alone. His new math tutor, Han Eunsung, looks like he'll be Jaehong's best ally. The thing is…Eunsung isn't actually Jaehong's tutor! The misunderstanding gets cleared up quickly, but that doesn't change the fact that Eunsung was the best tutor Jaehong's ever had. Now Jaehong has a new objective: to persuade Eunsung to teach him. However, Eunsung doesn't seem too keen...

mangas.title: Banana Scandal
mangas.description: Studying abroad in the US, Do-Jin has experienced his fair share of unexpected surprises. New schools, new people, new roommates. However, of all the surprises, Do-Jin never expected to catch his roommate's handsome younger brother, Tae-Hui, jerking off to him in his sleep?! That's when the scandal began…

mangas.title: The Grudge
mangas.synonyms: Fly Over the Sea | Jing Wei
mangas.description: After being betrayed and murdered by his fiancée, the gang's young leader, Charles Ji, accidentally time-traveled back thirty years, ending up in the body of a 19-year-old boy. This fallen young Alpha is then rescued by a gentle, kind-hearted young Beta. Yet this angelic savior bears the exact same face as the fiancée who murdered him in his past life...

mangas.title: Scent and Sensibility
mangas.description:
"Become his therapist, and you'll earn 500,000 a year!"



When Moon Dobin, a dominant omega, goes for a job interview, he's baffled by the CEO's proposal: have sex with her son as a form of therapy. His client? Seo Tae-oh, a dominant alpha who can't sense pheromones. Dobin has worked hard to protect his virginity, but for that salary… anything goes! So, Dobin leads a secret double life as Tae-oh's secretary by day and his therapist by night. As the two spend more time together, something is in the air - and not just pheromones!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Private Call
mangas.synonyms: นัดรักเซอร์วิสลับ
mangas.description:
In a world where alphas and omegas are the stuff of urban legends, Do-Ha is a rare dominant omega who usually deals with his heat cycle through casual one-night stands. One day, he uses a matching service and gets paired up with an alpha named Ji-Hwan. Things get unexpectedly intense. Overwhelmed by pheromones, Do-Ha forgets about precautions and ends up knotted, leaving him in shock. However, Ji-Hwan seems entirely unfazed by the situation and boldly suggests they meet again, saying, "Don't tell me you're scared because I'm an alpha..."

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Caught in the Act
mangas.synonyms: Love Story at Starry Night | Mingri Xing Cheng
mangas.description: Up-and-coming actor Xia Xingcheng just got the break of a lifetime—a film with superstar Yang Youming and a famed director! This drama is deeper than anything he's ever worked on before. He's already almost quit and almost been fired. (Note: an unscripted slap is never a good idea). With Yang Youming's advice, he works hard on getting into character, but how far is too far? As these heartthrob actors grow closer, can Xia Xingcheng separate fact from fiction, or will these emotions he's tapped into take center stage?

mangas.title: Kill My Love
mangas.synonyms: Ai Yu Sha Yi Zhi Ye, Night of Love and Murder
mangas.description: Ten years ago, the beta was at his peak as a hit-man, when he was seriously injured while trying to save an alpha child. Having lost his edge as a killer, he retired to the countryside with a new identity to start a new life. Until an unexpected visitor showed up one day. That boy he saved has grownup to become the leader of his own gang, and now he's come looking for him with crazed intentions.

mangas.title: Silent Heartbeat
mangas.description:
Lin Mu grew up with his sister, Lin Chao, who is congenitally deaf. He is the "little sun" that illuminates the lives of those around him. Meanwhile, the tall and handsome Lu Rong lost both his parents at a tender age and had since been living with his grandmother who has Alzheimer's disease. He was forced to grow up quickly at an age when he should have been ignorant and oblivious.



Kunqian, an institution that provides learning opportunities for the special community, is where their worlds collide. One a silent soul, and the other a blazing firecracker. With a bunch of schoolmates—a deaf-mute, a visually impaired person, a cerebral palsy patient—they embark together on their chapter of youth.



"Lu Rong, you don't have to put your guard up around me as if I'm some kind of a thief. I have a sister. I get it."

"Okay."



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: There Goes Your Cover Again, Your Highness
mangas.titleNative: 太子殿下你的马甲又掉了
mangas.synonyms: Your Royal Highness, Your Vest Is off Again | Your Highness the Crown Prince, Your Mask Has Dropped Again
mangas.description: While under the cover identity "Murong Yan," the crown prince became smitten with the palace guard, Gu Lang, after a fated encounter. The two had to part ways after "Murong Yan" died, but the crown prince couldn't resist trying to get close to his beloved once again... this time under a different cover identity.

mangas.title: Mian Yu Wo Shu Zhong
mangas.description:
Xu Su, a novelist suffering from a mental disorder, somehow managed to summon Zhong Ye, an evil spirit from his novel. Despite Xu Su's best efforts to eliminate Zhong Ye, he was pushed to the edge of insanity again and again. To free himself from this torment, Xu Su finally fulfilled Zhong Ye's wish and unlocked the seal. But his life did not return to the peaceful days that Xu Su had hoped for. "Surely you know, that if you make a deal with the devil, sooner or later you'll lose yourself to him…"

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

mangas.title: It's Never Too Late For Sweetness
mangas.description:
On one side, the school tyrant, Chi Yu, wishes to dispel the gossip regarding him being in a same-sex relationship. On the other side, the academic tyrant, Fu Zhian, wishes for the gossip between them to turn into truth. Who will succeed?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: The Snake Demon Wants to Flee
mangas.description: Due to an unexpected mishap, the Snake Demon King was forced into a bonded contract with a (perverted) prodigal Taoist priest. This is the story about how the Snake Demon King tries to undo the contract and take back his throne, only to lose his heart in the process.

mangas.title: Life Going Wild With Plugins
mangas.description:
He was the high creator of the world who had his memories stripped away in order to live as a mortal. To protect himself, he bought a cheap guard who was dumb, naive, and didn't know any martial arts. But why do the rumors make his little guard sound like a cruel and bloodthirsty monster?



(Source: INKR)



Note: Chapter count includes 17 extras.

mangas.title: Dragon In Distress
mangas.synonyms: AoAo Waiting to Be Eaten (Caught!!) | Ao Ao Waiting to Be Caught
mangas.description: This is the story of an eastern blue dragon and a western black dragon playing together.

mangas.title: Heartthrob
mangas.description:
Being the new kid in school is never easy. Especially not for a wallflower like Eun-jae, who has spent most of his childhood in and out of hospitals because of his weak heart. Now, his only wish is to live and experience life as a normal high schooler. Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren't all bad. Not when you consider his regular encounters with Jin-hyeon, the popular kid in school. As accidents and coincidences keep bringing them together, Eun-jae realizes he had met Jin-hyeon a long time ago… even if the latter doesn't remember. And although a throbbing heart has always been a cause for concern, Eun-jae discovers a heart can throb for sweeter reasons too.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Keai Guominyuan
mangas.description:
Yue Zhishi and Song Yu are brothers, but not related by blood. Yue Zhishi, who was fostered with the Song family since childhood, loves to cling to Song Yu, who is three years older than him, like a big brother. While Song Yu deliberately keeps him at arms length. Song Yu acts like an indifferent brother to his clingy puppy dog younger brother, but what others don't realize is that it is because he knows his own feelings so he has to restrain himself and keep away... Because Yue Zhishi is Song Yu's only allergen.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Intoxicated
mangas.description:
A gorgeous Omega transmigrated into a normal society, and he collapsed on the street after getting intoxicated by the pheromone he released.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 10 extras.

mangas.title: How'd You Two Become a Couple While Gaming?
mangas.titleNative: 你们打个游戏怎么就交到男朋友了
mangas.synonyms: How Did I End up With a Boyfriend While Gaming?
mangas.description:
The male protagonist goes on a business trip and coincidentally shares a love-themed room with a famous e-sports player. What's with the transparent bathroom door and vibrating bed? The next day, the two go their separate ways. When the male protagonist gets frustrated with work and goes to drink at a roadside stall, the man who shared a room with him suddenly appears and calls him his idol. Wait a minute? What's going on? I already quit e-sports three years ago! Don't you dare try to tempt me back into playing!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Defective Lovers
mangas.description: The short-tempered captain of the criminal brigade, Qian Cuo, and the sophisticated cold-blooded detective, Teng Ruiyu, had been partners in breaking countless queer cases. But two years ago, they were involved in serial crimes related to soothsaying art...

mangas.title: Hatsukoi made no Shouten Kyori
mangas.synonyms: Focal Length to my First Love
mangas.description:
Haruto, a university student, has been harboring a one-sided love for his childhood friend Tsubasa. Tsubasa, a popular guy admired by girls and working as a fashion model, has always prioritized Haruto above anyone else. But now, their time together might be running out... In just six months, Tsubasa will be leaving the dorm to live on his own. Feeling increasingly lonely, Haruto ends up talking to Tsubasa about a confession he received from a junior student...



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Xing Tian Feiwen
mangas.description:
A hot-tempered Taoist priest finds himself entangled with an arrogant vampire, drawn into a whirlwind of love and hatred fueled by karmic ties from their past lives. In the present day, he's barely scraping by, working odd jobs on a film set. But one day, he senses a powerful, ominous energy. When he looks up, he's shocked to find that the source is none other than the nation's biggest movie star, Shen Zhuo?! The charming and sophisticated actor the world admires—is actually a thousand-year-old vampire?

"You're not getting away from me this time!"

mangas.title: A Lover's Contract
mangas.description: Company employees Yanaka and Moriyama are lovers...... Well, pretend lovers. After being repeatedly approached by women he had no interest in, Yanaka was at his wits end and asked his friend and colleague, Moriyama, to pretend to be his lover. In exchange, he'd do whatever Moriyama asked for. Well, what Moriyama asked for was... Yanaka's body! Moriyama, showing this side of himself, flusters Yanaka, but Yanaka does eventually surrender himself... How will a relationship started from a lie pan out?

mangas.title: Bursting with Love
mangas.description: Half human and half alien, Shio Kuno's body has a rather interesting quirk—anytime he finds himself even slightly aroused, he bursts into goo! Concerned over how he delights in gooping his female classmates, his parents secretly enroll him in an all-boys boarding school in the hope of curbing his bad behavior. But things don't go as planned at the new school, and when Shio face-plants into the bare chest of his dreamy class rep, he unexpectedly goops him too!

mangas.title: Barefoot Angel
mangas.description: One winter day, Turner, a shoemaker in modern-day England, comes across Benny, a seemingly homeless young man barefoot and shivering on a park bench. Concerned about this stranger who claims to be a former angel, Turner decides to invite him into his home to avoid the bitter English winter. As the two get closer, Turner decides that he wants to make shoes for Benny, who's putting his all into learning about the human realm. Benny ends up living with Turner during the months-long shoemaking process, but will their arrangement come to an end when the shoes are complete?

mangas.title: Shinigami wa Korosenai
mangas.description:
Since childhood Eiji has always had accidents that would have been fatal, but he always survived unscathed. Because he sees things that normal people don't see, he realizes that there's a mysterious shadow that always saves him. But what is it? So he decided to find out what this mysterious shadow was and wanted to thank that shadow. And to call him, he tried to jump off the balcony of his apartment.



Here comes the handsome God of Death appearing before him. Will Eiji be able to thank him?



Note: includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: FANGS
mangas.description:
Bitten by a vampire at a club, nineteen-year-old En barely survived. Taken under the wing of Ichii — a member of the health and welfare division of the vampire rights organization known as FANGS — En learns he's to be taught about this new "world" he must survive in.

In order to control the urge to suck blood and attack innocents, FANGS established a "pairing system", where two vampires support one another with regular meals. As a young, virginal vampire, En is highly sought after by many senior vamps. That is, until he declares his intention to pair with his guardian, Ichii...

mangas.title: Love in the Palm of His Hand
mangas.titleNative: カメレオンはてのひらに恋をする。
mangas.description:
Through sign language and acting, two young men seeking their places in the world discover a connection that transcends the spoken word.



"To think that just what I've always wanted to hear would come from someone I just met."



Fujinaga is a university student who dreams of becoming an actor so he can do what he loves best--conveying emotion and story through physical expression. But after failing multiple auditions, his hopes are dashed and his confidence crushed. When he meets Keito, a fellow student with congenital hearing loss, Fujinaga is suddenly introduced to the world of sign language. Although clumsy at first, Fujinaga quickly picks up signing and surprises Keito with his astonishing talent of expressing emotions through action.



Is it that only in a place beyond all verbal limitations can two people, both yearning to be understood, forge a bond they never expected?



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Hoshi wo Tsukamaeru
mangas.description:
One night, while working part-time at a bar, Leo encounters an absolutely wasted customer. At the end of Leo's shift, he finds the customer slumped at the entrance to the bar and reluctantly decides to bring him home to let the man sleep it off. The next thing he knows, he has a lapful of drunken stranger making out with him.



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kiss Me like You Did that Day
mangas.titleNative: あの日のキスをもう一度
mangas.synonyms: Kiss of That Day Again | Ano Hi no Kiss wo Mou Ichido
mangas.description:
"What would've happened to us, if we hadn't kissed that day?"

Miho, who's never been good at making friends, shows up to an alumni meeting in hopes to see his old former friend, Hiroya, one more time. They fell out of touch due to certain reasons, but Miho's determined to put his fleeting crush past him and rekindle their friendship. But when Hiroya says that was married and got divorced, Miho can't suppress his shock. Taken aback by the fact that there is much of Hiroya he doesn't know, he sneaks out of the rowdy reunion venue only to be chased after by Hiroya...!

mangas.title: White Liar
mangas.description:
Shiraishi Kei is a talented freelance beautician who's experienced more downs than ups when it comes to past relationships, and so has decided to swear off love. However, when the mysterious up-and-coming actor Taiga Jinnouchi enters his life, their casual one-night stand turns into much more. Unbeknownst to Kei, Taiga has been harboring a secret for years—something that changes the meaning behind "fooling around" as the line between lies and sincerity are blurred in this whirlwind showbiz love story!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Terano-kun & Kumazaki-kun
mangas.synonyms: เทราโนะคุงกับคุมาซากิคุง
mangas.description:
Student council president Terano is confident and smart. On the other hand, the good-looking, but scary Kumazaki has been failing classes for the past few years. One day, a friend catches Terano texting someone. Terano remains quiet on the subject... No one would have guessed that the rebellious Kumazaki is actually quite shy, and is completely wrapped around Terano's finger...



(Source: KUMA)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: What's Wrong With Being Innocent?
mangas.description:
I want to be sweetly embraced like a cherished treasure for my first time. That's when I thought to call a male escort service and make my dreams come true. What I got was a nightmare instead! Ryota would be the call boy who took my virginity, full throttle and nothing like how I wanted my first time to be. To make matters worse, turns out he's a student at my university. Wanting to try my luck again, I call the same escort service only to be sent Ryota a second time. Somehow he manages to make up for the last time and gives me the "sweet lover's special" I've always wanted...?! Love grows in between the lines of aloofness and passion on this clumsy heart-throbbing pendulum.



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: The original serialization ran for five chapters until 2022-06-25. The serialization was restarted on 2023-12-25.

mangas.title: Kimi no Sumire: Your Spring Flower
mangas.description:
Sumire Kimino has transferred to a new school, and is eager to jump into his new surroundings. What stands out the most to him are rumors about Suguru Tojo, an upperclassman who is known as the most beautiful boy in school. Sumire expects that such a legendary student would want nothing to do with him, but through coincidence, the two of them end up getting closer, spending time together and delving into past trauma.



(Source: Animate International)



Note: The original serialization ran for six chapters until 2020-08-21. The serialization was restarted on 2021-12-22.

mangas.title: Gattsuki Ecchi BL: Comic Anthology
mangas.titleNative: がっつきエッチBL コミックアンソロジー
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Chihaya Aki

1. Pink ni Kyun Shite Ii desu ka: XXXXtte Itte (ピンクにきゅんしていいですか-××××って言って-) [Touno]

2. Before It Melts (ビフォーイットメルス) [Neru Orihara]

3. Shimekiri no Ato no Gohoubi wa? (締め切りのあとのご褒美は？) [Ameda]

4. Shio-kun to Shitai: Kuttsuite Sawatte Amaetai (志央くんとしたい -くっついて 触って 甘えたい-) [Ubu Ubukata]

5. Okitsune Hokora de Dousei Shitemasu (おきつね祠で同棲してます) [Kokoro Namino]

6. Game to Kiss to Amai Wana (ゲームとキスと甘い罠) [tomomo]

7. Chotto Matte Toshishita-kun (ちょっと待って年下くん) [Komachi Inukai]

8. Chou Nega-kun no Himitsu (重ネガくんの秘密) [Hanada]

mangas.title: After Midnight Skin
mangas.titleNative: アフター・ミッドナイト・スキン
mangas.description: The hidden secret of the serious office worker Toraya is that he has a strong sexual desire. He's always looking for the perfect guy for him, although lately he's been working hard and hasn't get any sex at all. One day after a series of hard work, he's masturbating in the office's toilet because of the stress working overtime. But he accidentally gets caught by his boss Saikawa...!?

mangas.title: My Beautiful Man
mangas.description:
Hira has always dreaded the first day of new classes. Ever since he was little, he's had a stutter that only worsens when he's anxious, causing Hira to always sink to the bottom of the social pyramid. This year of his high school career might not have been any different if it weren't for him: Kiyoi, the most beautiful and kingly man Hira has ever seen. Normally, their lives would never intersect, but Hira suddenly gets a chance to grow closer with Kiyoi when he's made the popular group's gofer and gets Kiyoi's phone number! Hira treasures every order Kiyoi gives him and every bit of change he's handed to run errands... Is this what they call love?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: The Fox's Favorite
mangas.description:
Koyomi's parents passed away, his job is draining, and he's endured a life full of hardship. He lives his days apathetically, with no hope for a brighter tomorrow. One day, his friends invite him to visit a shrine known for matchmaking. He prays for a life where there's someone he can come home to, with whom he can happily eat together. When Koyomi returns home that night, mundane wish still on his mind, he receives an unexpected visitor: a fox who can make his wishes come true! And so begins the loving and happy cohabitation story between a corporate slave and a gorgeous, adorable fox ♪



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Buried Injustice
mangas.description: To investigate a kidnapping case, Xue Zhao, a profiler, went deep into a village of a foreign race, but was haunted by the villager's worship of [Him]. The pale face of Ji Li was looming, and his cold and wet long hair followed him like a shadow. Is the grace He bestowed a gentle killing intent or a bloody love word? The sacrifice He demanded was Xue Zhao's arrogant mind or his cold heart? Is the ghost you... or me?

mangas.title: Touch Your World
mangas.description:
Xie Cheng, who was born unable to see any color, had been living in a black and white world for many years. Until the day he met Bai Lu, who was being chased, he accidentally discovered that he had brilliant colors. What kind of sparks would be created between two very different people together?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Global Examination
mangas.description: This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where there's only dust left, you're still the first person I met. What's so great about this system? We'll just destroy it. The world is brilliant and grand still, so welcome home.

mangas.title: Gui Ling
mangas.description: An unknown virus broke out worldwide, degenerating humanity. Andy Biya had unfortunately died from the sudden disaster, but he unexpectedly awakened the power of reincarnation and even met Eno Edison, a proud and aloof person who exuded a dangerous aura. Following the fateful experience of birth and death with Eno, the both of them gradually learn the secrets of each other and the world.

mangas.title: Saturday's Special Is Fried Shrimp
mangas.description:
It's been three years since Weon met Toram at his restaurant and they hit it off as friends. Despite his bad luck in love, Weon always has Toram's sympathetic ear and tasty fried shrimp to cheer him up. However, their friendship is threatened when Weon discovers Toram is a divine snail masquerading as a human! Once the divine world finds out Toram got caught by a human, he'll be demoted to a regular snail and Weon will never see him again... unless he helps Toram earn enough good karma to offset his punishment in just two weeks!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Itoshi no Underdog
mangas.titleNative: 愛しのアンダードッグ

mangas.title: Kore de Saigo no Koi ni Shitai
mangas.titleNative: これで最後の恋にしたい
mangas.description:
Kore de Saigo no Koi ni Shitai

Ibuki's type is a rich older man, but why does it always turn out that whoever he falls for is married…? After getting his heart broken yet again by a married man, he decides he's had enough. At work, though, there's an unsociable and somewhat impertinent new hire, Touma, who keeps stealing glances at him. Touma is younger and a far cry from his type, but when Ibuki teasingly asks whether he likes him, his response…?!



Saiaku ni Oboreruna!

To relieve the stress from his job, Houjou requests a 'delivery boy' service, but… the one sent to him is none other than his senpai at work and the very source of his stress, Minato?! Houjou won't let this chance to overthrow his superior slip by!!

mangas.title: Heal, Heal, Heal!
mangas.description:
At a bar on the first day of school, Go Shinjae, a tall and handsome dance major student from a prominent family, hears drunk Baek Hanbin, a pale photography student with huge tacky glasses, confessing his love towards a person he met online in a game. The drunken love confession Go Shinjae would've normally laughed off, was a bit strange. For some reason, the person that drunk guy likes seems to be him. The next day, Go Shinjae decides to shrug it off but Baek Hanbin walks into the classroom of an elective Go Shinjae's taking. On top of that, Go Shinjae and Baek Hanbin end up becoming a group for the rest of the semester. What will happen to these two both offline and online?



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Vanilla Soda Sky
mangas.description:
Taeha Oh loves to write smutty BL stories online. Why? 'Cause it's fun. Though he insists he's definitely not gay himself. But will things change after a surprise reunion sparks something inside of him…?



(Source: POCKET COMICS)



Note: Chapter count includes two special chapters.

mangas.title: You Get Me Going
mangas.description:
Despite being thirty-three, Young-won sure is gullible. He falls in love way too easily, comes on way too hard, and still believes that he'll meet "Mr. Right" sooner or later. Not that he knows who "Mr. Right" is, but he sure does know about "Mr. Wrong," a.k.a. Kang Hyun-woo. Young-won swears that he'll never, ever get together with this polar opposite of his, but the universe sure seems to think different. One drunken night, they end up in the same bed and Hyun-woo proposes an intriguing deal… Will Young-won end up with a broken heart yet again, or will he end up finding what he's been looking for this whole time?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: The True Scandal
mangas.description:
Xu Sheng x Tang Zhi Using all of one's brain power and pawning away one's life.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Does Love At First Sight Exist in E-Sports?
mangas.titleNative: 电子竞技存在一见钟情吗？
mangas.synonyms: Dianzi Jingji Cunzai Yijianzhongqing Ma? | Is There Love at First Sight in E-Sports?
mangas.description:
Having nothing better to do, Asia’s champion decided to carry a girl in the game. With great difficulty, he finally convinced the girl he carried to turn on her mic, only to discover that the other party was actually a boy?! This online love affair that had ended before it even began was tossed away to the back of the champion’s mind. Unexpectedly, when his club went to train in another city, they encountered a mishap and had a small conflict with another team. When the other team’s vice captain showed up, the champion was so moved that he started doubting life, but as soon as the other opened his mouth, it turned out that this was the “girl” that he had personally carried with his own hands that day.

Does love at first sight exist in e-sports? It does.

mangas.title: Suiyue Jian
mangas.description:
He was the boy I loved; the one who walked with me through my salad days and our beautiful, fleeting years.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Lookout for Love
mangas.description:
Suho has a problem. No, it's not the fact that he has severe social withdrawal. It's that he's head over heels for Sanghyeok, the hot new security guard working at Suho's apartment complex. After falling in love at first sight, Suho starts scheming and making excuses to hover around Sanghyeok at all times. The thing is, this only causes Sanghyeok to misunderstand Suho as a creep. Sanghyeok is already quiet and cautious for reasons unknown, and Suho's antics are not helping! Can Suho clear up the misunderstanding and ask him out?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Quan Da Qi Zhu
mangas.synonyms: The Grown Dog Bullies Its Owner
mangas.description:
[Black-bellied top student x Two-faced school grass]



"You there, be mine!"



School grass Xia Zhixing, unwilling to reveal his identity as a streamer, borrows the face of the mysterious top student Lin Lang.



Unexpectedly, the student that resembled a cute little puppy had actually desired him for a long time...



"Senior, the reward I want is you."



(Source: Tencent, translated)



Note: "School grass" (校草) is a term for the most handsome boy in school.

mangas.title: Involuntary Romance
mangas.description: Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

mangas.title: Dreaming of the Dokkaebi
mangas.description: Ju Min-Chan had always suffered from frequent fevers as a kid because of some unfortunate curse. Now as a young adult, his condition has worsened into seizures which he can only keep at bay by hunting spirits. As if things couldn't get any worse, the effectiveness of this method starts diminishing as his seizures become more recurrent. Then, he learns about a powerful being who could lift his curse. Despite the risk that comes with hunting down this being, Min-Chan readily jumps at this chance to finally escape his harsh fate only to find out that he was never destined to live a normal life…

mangas.title: The Director Who Buys Me Dinner
mangas.synonyms: The President Who Always Treats Me to Meals
mangas.description:
Reincarnated a 4th time after accidentally naming a child of god, which is a sin, then falling in love with them, Min Yu Tan does not remember his 1st life & failing his 2nd & 3rd life of capturing the person he loves. Will he be able to succeed in his 4th life now that the person he loves is now a man?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Fake Fact Lips: BREAK
mangas.titleNative: フェイクファクトリップス break
mangas.description: At odds with each other since their high school days, corporate salesmen Ryo and Zen have finally become lovers. The transition has not been a smooth one however, with each man still baiting the other into petty competitions as they struggle to navigate their new dynamic. And with their hectic work schedules cutting into their time together, it isn't long before anxiety and jealousy begin to creep into their hearts. Yet just when it seems that positive progress is being made, their coworker, Futami, returns to the main office from Osaka and tries to insert himself into Ryo and Zen's rivalry! But is some friendly competition all he's after?

mangas.title: Fake Fact Lips
mangas.titleNative: フェイクファクトリップス
mangas.description: Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose–especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited.One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?

mangas.title: The Essence
mangas.description:
To claim his family's title, Rael—a hidden omega posing as an alpha—uses pheromone perfume made by a mysterious perfumer. But when he's told to produce an heir or lose everything, he makes Hyde an unthinkable offer… one only Hyde can fulfill.



(Source: Manta)



Note: Includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Worth the Wait
mangas.synonyms: The Struggles of a Younger Top
mangas.description:
Never again, Juhyun thinks. I'll never fall for Shin Heeju again. But what do you know, he ends up running into Heeju again in college, his friend's older brother whom he's had a crush on for as long as he can remember. And this time Heeju's all drunk and slamming his head against a telephone pole. And from what he drunkenly tells Juhyun… he's just been turned down by another guy?! Juhyun knows he shouldn't start, that he shouldn't get his hopes up. He tells himself they're just friends. But maybe, just maybe, this time will be different and he'll get the only guy who he thinks is worth the wait.



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: From season 2 this becomes Mature (R19), Season 1 is all-ages (R15).

mangas.title: The Dirtiest High
mangas.synonyms: สะอาดแล้วครับคุณทนาย
mangas.description:
A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.

Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?



(Source: Manta)



Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: What's Wrong with Pure Love?
mangas.description:
Ahn Jaeha, a national judo athlete, is invited as a temp instructor to Lim Seojin's training center. Despite Seojin's warm demeanor, Jaeha's cold and stoic attitude creates an awkward tension between them. On his way home, Seojin unexpectedly runs into Jaeha, and in a spur-of-the-moment decision, they end up drinking together. But when Seojin wakes up from his drunken stupor, he finds Jaeha calling his name…while masturbating right in front of him!!



(Source: Lezhin)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Homerun Hearts
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Ahn Do-Hun and Woo Ik-Su have been inseparable since elementary school, bonded by their shared love for the mid-tier baseball team, the Dolphins. But when Ik-Su decides to go to the team's home opener with someone other than Do-Hun, the foundations of their friendship begin to crack. With this curveball, their relationship takes an unexpected turn…and as the Dolphins edge closer to a championship, Do-Hun and Ik-Su can't seem to get one another off their minds. Will their relationship be able to make a comeback in the final inning? Or did Ik-Su's foul play ruin his chance at scoring with Do-Hun forever…?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes eight side story chapters.

mangas.title: The Sea's Nocturne
mangas.description:
College student-cum-pianist Su-yeon goes into a destructive spiral after he messes up his piano performance. And he's decided getting into bed with strangers is the best way to cope with his anxiety. When he's sleeping with someone, it's like all his troubles just melt away—like he's underwater. During one of his meltdowns, he ends up sleeping with Hae-su, a student-athlete. Except Su-yeon has no memory of the incident. Hae-su remembers it all however, and when the two end up working together on a group project, he is determined to break down Su-yeon's walls. Hesitant at first, Su-yeon gradually discovers that there's more to life than just being surrounded by shades of blue. Will Hae-su be able to pull Su-yeon from the water he's submerged himself in or will the current be too strong to...resist?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Onward
mangas.description:
Sometimes one splash is all it takes to make waves. Swimming prodigy Woo Seungwon, whose very being is vast and endless like the ocean, runs into former a-list singer Doh Si-on. Si-on, now a businessman trying to stay afloat, is doing his best to move forward with his life; but the weight of the world only drags him down, as if he is struggling to crawl through a swamp. Taking an interest in Seungwon, Si-on offers him the opportunity to make some extra money as his housekeeper…and perhaps do a little extra work on the side…


(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 40 extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!
mangas.description: Yeon-Woo's an author but his work isn't going so well and there's the slight problem of his stalker (aka his ex). When he looks for a new place to live, the landlord of the apartment is suspiciously young and way too handsome...but desperate times call for desperate measures!

mangas.title: Office Mates
mangas.description:
There's a rumor on the internal office messageboard that there's a handsome stud in the office who's a serial hit-it-and-quitter. Manager Yoon Heedae just so happens to run into a guy who seems to fit the bill described in the post… Could Kim Siwon from operations be the serial homewrecker? After a slightly heated run-in, Heedae and Siwon's relationship seems to have gotten off on the wrong foot. But as the need for the operations and sales teams to collaborate has grown, their paths are inevitably going to cross more. Plus, in a fit of panic, Heedae blurted out about his tremendous "experience" in relationships when the truth is anything but! Well, after a company outing for dinner and drinks, the time to put up or shut up has come. Will mutual curiosity get these office mates in bed or should they keep things strictly business?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Chapter count includes one Aprils Fools Special, four side story chapters and three Omegaverse AU chapters.

mangas.title: On or Off
mangas.description:
Yiyoung is building a startup with his college friends. They get a chance to present their proposal to SJ Corporation, one of the leading companies in the country.
