But in the meeting room he sees Kang Daehyung, the extremely handsome company big shot that's so very much his type, and Yiyoung's heart starts to race...!



Can pretty-faced Yiyoung win both in love and his career?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: I Seriously Can't Believe You...
mangas.titleNative: 君ってやつはこんなにも
mangas.description:
"I don't think you've realized your true nature yet." That's what Kon tells Iida, the hottest guy at school, wondering how anyone could be so proper. As popular as he is, Iida doesn't seem interested in any of the girls who come after him. Kon and his buddies try to look into the matter by flipping a coin and having Kon approach him with his confession of love, just to see if he's really interested in guys. "I've... never looked at guys like that..." says Iida, falling for Kon's ruse. Kon takes him home, hoping to straighten out the misunderstanding, when Iida suddenly grabs him by the shoulder, and... A story about a mysterious hottie at school and a prince of a certain kind.

(Source: Renta!)


Includes an extra.

mangas.title: Kimi ni Furu Kotonoha wa
mangas.description:
One day, Komatsu Hinata, a high school boy who loves books, meets a blond-haired delinquent on the commuter train. Hinata was delighted that the delinquent seemed to show interest in his beloved novel. However, the delinquent ended up saying something unexpected, and harsh words were exchanged. Just when Hinata thought they would never meet again, he discovered the delinquent was Yukito Igarashi, a classmate who had not come to school since classes started.



A clumsy and bittersweet young romance unfolds between two boys who know nothing about love.



(Source: Media Soft, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Lovely Troublemaker
mangas.synonyms: Có bản lĩnh thì hung dữ nữa đi
mangas.description:
The school bully, Shen Yichen, picked a fight with the genius student, Ji Yuming?! Despite their paths never crossing before, their lives were suddenly entangled due to a particular "diary". As Shen Yichen continued to goad Ji Yuming, he realized that this top student didn't seem like someone who would do "such a thing" to his younger cousin. Meanwhile, Ji Yuming gradually mastered how to calm down Shen Yichen after he observed this school bully who got angry easily...



(Source: Webnovel)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 11 extras.

mangas.title: Shanhai High School
mangas.description:
Lin Jing was your average model student: serious, diligent and polite. However, after transferring to a new school for his sophomore year, his life took a sudden turn when he was forced to become a minion for the bottom-ranked delinquent.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Falling to Where I Belong
mangas.description:
Cheng Fei Chi: Gentle, introverted, bookish.

Ye Ming: Tsundere, proud, and hotheaded.

A young love never dies- it always falls where it belongs!

mangas.title: My Delicious Dream Boy
mangas.description:
Yi Kui's got everything you could dream of... good looks, charisma, and style. After all, he's secretly a demon on the hunt for the best dreams to feast upon. Yi Kui can't believe his luck when he stumbles upon the new student—shy, sweet Lin You, who also happens to dream the most delectable nightmares. He immediately tries to charm Lin You, but none of his spells are working! Now Yi Kui's gotta beguile him the old-fashioned way... What happens when the boy of your dreams is actually here to devour them?



(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: Don't Say You Love Me
mangas.description: I treated you like a brother, so how could you confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but I ended up hurting you through an accident. I'm sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely won't run away again. However… That chance came so fast. I suddenly traveled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn't yet know me.

mangas.title: No Kidding
mangas.synonyms: This Joke is Serious | Serious Joke
mangas.description: The new school year brings with it a myriad of new encounters. Han-Seok's first meeting with Ki-Un involves snow, an obese calico cat, and a lingering sweet scent. As it turns out, the two are now classmates, and Han-Seok finds himself slowly drawn to Ki-Un. Han-Seok wants to grow closer to Ki-Un, but he proves to be a tough nut to crack. He's amiable enough, but Ki-Un soon senses an invisible wall between him and his target. Will Han-Seok manage to charm his way through to Ki-Un's heart?

mangas.title: Checkmate! Capture My Heart
mangas.description: Xiaotao likes his college senior Bo, and Bo likes Xiaotao, but neither of them is smooth enough to tell the other how they feel! Luckily, Bo's sister is a popular BL writer and knows every romance trick in the book. Xiaotao, on the other hand, has an overenthusiastic BL-reading sister in his corner. Each new day means a different strategy to bring the lovebirds together. With such good intentions and expertise on their side, it should be smooth sailing from here… right?

mangas.title: Mr. Snail
mangas.description:
As September comes, a new semester has begun at Shan Ming Highschool. The school doctor, Song Yue, has also welcomed a new roommate - canteen chef, Xu Xiaodao. Mr. Song thinks Xu is like the "Snail Girl". Every since he starting living here, the dorm has been super clean. Not only does he clean, he also cooks all the meals and does all the laundry! This is truly suspicious! Things get even weirder when Mr Song realises Xu Xiaodao knows a little bit too much about him and is a little bit too clingy. Furthermore, Xu Xiaodao cares for him way too much?? Things are not as simple as they seem...

(Source: BiliBili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

mangas.title: I Want a Painting Brush
mangas.description:
Cheng Quian loved art, so he entered the prestigious Academy of Arts despite his family's opposition. Penniless, he works to support his studies, and he meets Xu Qiujin, who is his exact opposite. Despite their differences, Cheng Quian and Xu Qiujin can't seem to get enough of each other.

(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Body of Crime
mangas.synonyms: In The Dark | Zai Hei An Zhong
mangas.description: After years undercover it can be hard to regain your real identity... Lanshan's a cop who just emerged from his work infiltrating the Golden Triangle's big boss for years. Integrating back into regular life as a cop is disorienting, and Lanshan can't shake loose these strange memories of murder and pain. And now there's a handsome forensic artist he's forced to work with... just who is this guy who seems irresistibly intertwined with his life? If he can't trust his mind, can he trust his body?

mangas.title: Social Temperature
mangas.description:
Song Yuan Xun is a homophobe with a cold personality. He matched with Fang Zhao Mu on a dating app, but he absolutely detests him. He discovers that Fang Zhao Mu is more clingy than he thought!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Mounting!
mangas.description:
Upon entering high school, You freeloads in Yuzuru's home, a childhood friend he proposed to in the past. You recalls Yuzuru being an adorable crybaby and vows to protect him as his boyfriend, but instead finds out that Yuzuru has grown to be an incredibly handsome man with no trace of his former self! Taken aback from this unexpected turn of events, he then finds out that Yuzuru wants to top him...?! The battle (?) between two people who want top each other and won't let up begins!



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Kigurumi-kun
mangas.description:
The handsome dog who's attached to only me.



Every Wednesday, there's a man in an animal costume who hands out balloons to kids in the park. The man also hands a balloon to a university student, Shimaki Yuudai, who is on his way to his part time job. Shimaki, while feeling inconvenienced, was unable to refuse. One day, however, he finds the words "I like you" written on a piece of paper attached to the balloon...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)


Note: Kigurumi-kun began as a web comic on the author's Twitter account on April 9, 2016. The series was published in book format with extras by Ichijinsha on February 15, 2018.

mangas.title: Hayama-sensei no Dakimakura
mangas.titleNative: 葉山せんせいの抱きまくら
mangas.description: Rookie editor Amemiya takes over the responsibility of handling the popular mystery author Hayama Yaichi. However, he finds out that the author he admires is actually not good at cleaning up after himself and always has dark circles under his eyes. When Amemiya, worried about Hayama's health, forces him to get some sleep, Hayama suddenly hugs him and says, "...Then, let's stay like this for a while," and uses him as a pillow...?! A healing love story between a gloomy author and a puppy-like junior editor!

mangas.title: The Prince's Body Pillow
mangas.titleNative: 王子さまの抱きまくら
mangas.description:
Asuma is the sleepiest boy in school—and the tardiest. He's either late or completely missing class, which means he's now become Mahiro's problem. As head of the disciplinary committee, Mahiro is responsible for ensuring his classmates follow school rules and order, but he never imagined that meant he'd have to be someone's personal alarm clock!



Forced to room with Asuma, Mahiro quickly learns that Asuma is something more than a deep sleeper—he's practically catatonic! Not even a world-ending disaster could wake this snoozing student. Except, a surprising solution presents itself when the sleepy Asuma suddenly pulls Mahiro into his arms and bed. Somehow, some way, Asuma wakes up! Looks like the secret to waking the school's sleeping prince is to share a bed. But this definitely isn't what Mahiro signed up for! Can these two total opposites share sweet dreams or will this end in a nightmare?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: I Want to See Me in Your Eyes
mangas.titleNative: 振り向いてつかまえて
mangas.description:
Hinata has harbored unrequited love for his childhood friend, Makoto, for years. After Hinata finally decides to move on, Makoto's younger brother, Toki, barges in to stay at his place, and stirs up Hinata's feelings. Little does he know, Toki is in love with him and actually wants to sleep with him?!



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: That's the Guy!
mangas.description: Ji-Han Yoo played Hero of Legends but always lost to pro-gamer, Gamgak. Fed up, he jumps ship to a new game, but the guild master, Yoo-Chae, picks a fight over his gamer ID. But when Yoo-Chae finds out Ji-Han used to play HoL, he becomes obsessed. Can Ji-Han withstand Yoo-Chae's relentless pursuit?

mangas.title: Ni Yue Jie Le
mangas.description:
His beloved crush was snatched up by the nerdy new student. Furious, Ren Zhichu tries to harass that nerd at every chance he gets. Unexpectedly, during their interactions with each other, Ren Zhichu actually develops feelings for that nerd...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Salt Friend
mangas.description:
The delinquent Tong Yang was suspended after getting into a fight on the first day of school. Upon return, he was shunned by all his classmates. The top-scorer Xiao Zhen ran into Tong Yang hidden away crying by himself. Tong Yang tried to act tough, but his bluster only got him beat up instead. But for some reason, Xiao Zhen began to tutor Tong Yang after school, until Tong Yang found out that the boy who fought him that day was Xiao Zhen's little brother...



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)



Note: The series was originally self-published on Jing Jian's Weibo blog. Currently releasing on Kuaikan Manhua and Bilibili Manhua since July 31, 2021.

mangas.title: Wo Xi Huan Ni De Xin Xi Su
mangas.description:
As a good-looking Beta boy from a good family, Duan Jiayan's life has been smooth sailing for many years, until he runs into Lu Xingci in high school. Lu Xingci's family is richer, he's taller, he's a better basketball player, and their grades aren't even close. Even his own friends can't help but praise Lu Xingci sometimes.
What's worse, that girl Duan Jiayan had set his sights on admitted that she has had a crush on Lu Xingci for years. Ever since then, Duan Jiayan has disliked Lu Xingci. But during a medical exam, he was told that he is a late-blooming Omega, and because he became an Omega so late, it came with serious side-effects. Any Alpha who comes near him will feel a painful sensation and become violent. And Duan Jiayan is allergic to the pheromones of all Alphas, all except for Lu Xingci.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: My Half-Baked Esper
mangas.description:
In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides. Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there's a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a "half-baked" Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

"Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please."

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode.

"Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet..."

"But sir, your erection says otherwise."

Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it's with the one person he never expected.

mangas.title: Plot Twist!
mangas.description:
Ha-Won, known for his good looks and numerous passionate encounters, suddenly finds himself facing an unexpected problem—erectile dysfunction—after receiving harsh criticism during a one-night stand. Shocked and embarrassed, he tries to drown his sorrows at a bar, where he ends up venting his frustrations to the bartender and anyone who'll listen. That's when Seo-Kjun, who was singing at the bar, steps in to help drunk Ha-Won.

"Hey…can you get up...?"

"No! I can't get it up!!!"

As Ha-Won desperately pleads for help with his ""technique,"" Seo-Kjun offers to teach him through hands-on practice at a nearby motel. What begins as a night of comfort and guidance leads to an unexpected mix of motives and misunderstandings in this unlikely encounter.

mangas.title: Mitsuki-kun Chotto Matte!
mangas.titleNative: ミツキくんちょっと待って！
mangas.description: Note: The original serialization ran for six chapters until 2022-05-30. It was restarted on 2023-08-30.

mangas.title: Amagami to Hakuchuumu
mangas.synonyms: A Playful Cat and a Daydream
mangas.description: The introverted architect, Michishita, has a crush on his mysterious apartment neighbor, Kase. Kase always hides his face behind a mask, and rarely makes conversation with anyone, leaving Michishita with no intention of pursuing his unrequited love, content to just admire him from afar. One day, Michishita found himself in a near-fatal accident, only to be saved in the nick of time by Kase. However, Kase is seriously injured while shielding Michishita and is taken to the hospital in critical condition, unconscious. When Kase finally wakes up, to Michishita's surprise, he starts calling him "big brother" and begins acting adorably toward him…?

mangas.title: It Was The End Of Spring
mangas.synonyms: Sore wa Haru no Owari ni
mangas.description:
In his second year at his job, Haru Amakawa is transferred to a different office. On his first day there, he meets Seiji Nakahara, an older, friendly, and seemingly mature colleague. Upon their encounter, Haru, who has never been strongly moved by anything or anyone, experiences strong emotions for the first time. Haru attempts to get closer to Seiji, but he is met with a kiss and an invitation to fool around...

A cute romance featuring two characters truly falling in love for the first time!

mangas.title: In Love's Key, Reprised
mangas.titleNative: くりかえしあいのおと
mangas.synonyms: In the Key of Love, Reprised
mangas.description:
Forced by poor health to take a leave of absence, curmudgeonly conductor Kiri returns to his rural hometown for some much-needed rest. But on his very first night back, he comes dangerously close to freezing to death—until local grocer Osamu scoops him up out of the cold and into the warmth of his embrace. Can this younger man, a years-long fan of Kiri's work, thaw out the ice in the maestro's heart? Or will Kiri be doomed to a life of frigid loneliness forever?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Amagami no Evidence
mangas.description:
Hasuike, a publishing clerk with a fearful face, is assigned to work for a popular mystery writer known for his misanthropy.
Novelist Mori Joji, true to his reputation, is a difficult man with a reclusive personality, prompting Hasuike to reject him.

However, after Mori collapses from malnutrition, Hasuike and Mori begin to bond.

Pampered and praised, Hasuike asks to be left by his side. Mori, impressed by Hasuike's puppy-like honesty, begins to teach him "etiquette."
"Wait. I'll give you a reward when I'm done."

An editor eager to be educated, and a novelist who acts like his master.
A sweet, sometimes bittersweet, master-servant day.

mangas.title: Rairairaise
mangas.description:
Nanasei, a high school boy, keeps having dreams of a previous life,
where he was a knight serving his master.
Nanasei doubted whether those dreams were real or not, until
one day, when Leo, his previous master, appears in front of him as a transfer student, Rao.
Rao also has similar memories of the past life, and he innocently rejoices at the reunion with Nanasei.
However, he forgot the most important thing.
For Nanasei, Leo was someone he never wanted to see again.



(Source: ihr HertZ, translated)

mangas.title: Kingin Sasameku Himitsu wa Yoru
mangas.titleNative: 金銀ささめくひみつは夜
mangas.synonyms: Twinkling Secret Told Us Tonight Is The Night
mangas.description:
Serious and formal Mikado x Alloy adored by everyone.



Alloy uses magic to support the nation's lifeline and is the active leader of the operational department. With his beauty and friendly personality, that does not take advantage of his noble lineage, he is adored by everyone around him. On the other hand, Mikado, a blank-faced workaholic does not communicate well with Alloy like everyone else. They are on opposite wavelengths. But the two are actually in a secret relationship?



(Source: Pixiv, translated)

mangas.title: Koigokoro Kaihatsu Jikkyou
mangas.description:
"What should I do… when I want to touch you?"


Ichigo has always built comfortable, well-balanced relationships without much trouble.

But then, he meets Ritsu—who seems to be off-limits to touch...?



(Source: Gentosha, translated)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Jombiui Geosigineun BiXbik
mangas.description: W Electronics, where everyone turns into zombies while working overtime! Trapped in the office, Park Hee-Woon decides to light a last spark with his rival colleague who is turning into a zombie in a situation where he can either starve to death or die. But when he turns around, his handsome colleague's zombie penis resembles a B.X.Big...?

mangas.title: Romance Not Romantic
mangas.description: Jin-Ha, an overworked developer, gets the worst news of his life—he's a recessive Omega! He's now extra sensitive to alphas, and the only thing that calms him is his boss Hyun-Joon's pheromones. This is a nightmare, especially since Jin-Ha's been stashing money in a "murder for hire" account to cope with how annoying Hyun-Joon is. As if that's not enough, a creepy stalker starts showering him with pheromones. Now, Jin-Ha's stuck under the protection of his infuriatingly handsome boss!

mangas.title: Romantic Graffiti
mangas.synonyms: 我把暗恋对象变成了涂鸦小人？
mangas.description:
There's nothing more shocking than your crush turning into a meaningless doodle you scribbled in class. That's what happened to normal college student Do-Yun Lee, who has feelings for his handsome roommate Ji-Won Woo. One day, Do-yun confesses to Ji-Won, who doesn't exactly respond the way Do-Yun had hoped he would. The heartbroken Do-yun draws an "ugly" version of Ji-Won, and when he gets home, he's stunned to find Ji-Won looks exactly like his drawing. To end the unexpected curse, the two will have to face chaotic obstacles - and their undeniable attraction to each other.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)



Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love at First Voice
mangas.synonyms: 青春テンプテーション
mangas.description:
Jo Ajin, a sophomore studying economics, gets excited whenever he hears Sahyuk's voice. Despite his efforts to avoid Sahyuk at all costs, they end up working together on a group project. To Ajin's surprise, Sahyuk confesses his feelings for Ajin in a sweet, melodic tone. What's the secret behind Sahyuk's captivating voice?



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Tears by Day, Love by Night
mangas.description:
Eunsoo Seo's love life was always in turmoil. People always used him to get what they want, but not one thought about what Eunsoo wanted.
When Eunsoo was about to be abused by his boy friend, a stranger named Hajoon Kim swoops in to save the day. Saved by the stranger, Eunsoo began his complicated relationship with Hajoon... literally, "Day" and "Night".



(Source: Pocket Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes five side stories and three extras.

mangas.title: Swing Baby
mangas.synonyms: ベイビー・スウィング・ウィズ・ミー
mangas.description:
Baby can't get promoted. He's been languishing as the most junior member of his team for years. When he gets a new boss, he'll do anything to suck up to him and get noticed. But this new boss is awfully sweet and charming, and somehow, he even perfectly matches the love interest of the dating sim Baby's playing...! If Baby can play the game right, he may just win both his way up the corporate ladder and into his boss's heart!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The New Recruit
mangas.description:
Seunghyun spent his 20s following his crush through college and grad school, only to wind up totally single and with no idea where to go in his career. When he manages to land an internship at a competitive marketing company, he's ready for a fresh start without worrying over unrequited love. Except he's put under the handsome workaholic Kim Jongchan, whose hot and cold attitude leaves Seunghyun flustered. And worse yet, his crush from school works in the same company too! Will Seunghyun survive his first job and a potential first relationship?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ileum-eul Allyeojuseyo
mangas.description: A stern student volunteer responsible for attendance and adherence to school rules is kissed on the forehead by a mysterious delinquent! Despite repeat violations, he has yet to learn the delinquent's name.

mangas.title: Break A Leg
mangas.synonyms: Juyeon's Jinx | Jinx of the Lead Role | Jinx of the Main Character
mangas.description: Ordinary high schooler Kim Hangyeol Kim can't shake the feeling that his bad days are always linked to his encounters with Seo Jooyeon, a quiet classmate who hides behind his messy bangs and a trail of eerie rumors. The more their paths cross, the worse Hangyeol's luck seems to get—almost like a jinx. But after glimpsing a hidden side of Jooyeon, Hangyeol finds himself unexpectedly intrigued. Now, every glance they share sends his heart racing, and he starts to wonder if this so-called jinx might actually be something more.

mangas.title: Just Like You
mangas.description:
Chungho thinks it's unfair how Jun gets away with everything. Why should he be the one labeled as a troublemaker, when his best friend is clearly the one not sticking to the dress code? But then again…how could anyone not fall for Jun's charms? He's smart, popular, nice, and to top it all off…extremely handsome. It's really no surprise Chungho himself's been crushing on the guy for as long as they've known each other. Chungho tells himself that this is just enough, that he's satisfied with liking Jun from a safe distance. But little does he know, his crush might not be so unrequited as he'd thought, and someone might be feeling the same way…



(Source: Lezhin US)



The first sixteen chapters (Season 1) are R15. From chapter 17 (season 2) they are R19. Chapter count includes 5 extras and one special episode.

mangas.title: Error Detected
mangas.description: Oh Seung-Pyo has always been at the top of his class, but once he enters high school, his spot gets stolen by Ryu Jae-Min. No matter how hard Seung-Pyo tries, he can't seem to reclaim his place and is stuck in second. For the first time in his life, he develops an inferiority complex and, without realizing it, he starts keeping an eye on Jae-Min. One rainy day, the two accidentally swap phones. Though it seemed like a minor accident, what Seung-Pyo discovers on Jae-Min's phone leaves him in shock, complicating their relationship beyond expectation.

mangas.title: My Egocentric Boss is Obsessed With Me
mangas.description:
For the chronically single and overworked Soohan, thirsting over his boss's firm booty is his greatest guilty pleasure. It's sad and pathetic, but after a long string of lousy exes and an even longer dry spell, the handsome and talented Mr. Woo seems just that much hotter. Sure, he comes with blazing red flags like his egocentric personality, his bizarre preferences, and his sadistic tendency to overwork his employees. But as off-putting as these qualities are, they aren't enough to deter Soohan's massive crush - especially when the man keeps calling him "babe" and giving him special attention outside the office. Why on earth is his demonic yet charming boss asking him to pick out his bedroom sheets and cooking him his favorite dinner when they aren't even dating? Though he doesn't want to get his hopes up, Soohan can't help but wonder whether his self-centered boss is actually obsessed with him...!



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: includes six side story chapters.

mangas.title: Don't Forget These Feelings
mangas.synonyms: Don't Forget That I Like You
mangas.description: Jungmin is a sucker for hotties. Boy or girl, he doesn't care - he goes all weak in the knees when he sees a pretty face. At the freshmen welcome party, a guy catches his eye from across the room. Tall, cool and drop dead gorgeous, Jiho is just his type. But he's a freshman while Jungmin's a sophomore, and a returning student at that. Little does Jungmin know that from the moment he lays eyes on this irresistible freshman, his ordinary life will slowly begin to change!

mangas.title: My Favorite Glasses Holder
mangas.description:
"I like that sunbae who looks good in glasses!!!"

Sungbin, who has a glasses fetish, has a one-sided crush on his sunbae, Ahn Gyunghoon, who looks good in glasses. Gyunghoon mistakes Sungbin to be a stalker as he suspiciously lingers around him.

The moment Gyunghoon throws Sungbin out, a drunk Sungbin confesses his feelings. To Sungbin who clings onto him saying he likes sunbae who looks good in glasses, Gyunghoon gives a headbutt but...

mangas.title: Drawn Deep
mangas.description: Feeling like a fish out of water after moving to his mother's sleepy seaside hometown, Yukiya is on his own one day when he hears agonizing moans coming from a secluded cove by the shore. Ignoring locals' warnings about the so-called murderous monster said to haunt the sea, he goes to investigate and finds a beautiful young man in pain. The man, though unable to speak, seems to have the power to transform into all sorts of animals and sizes and quickly shrinks himself into a boy of Yukiya's stature. A sweet relationship soon begins to blossom between the two lonely souls, but little does Yukiya know, this beautiful creature is hiding dark, hideous secret…

mangas.title: SOS! Fledgling Report
mangas.description:
Cheong-Yeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Su-Han, the school's most notorious troublemaker. Su-Han earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheong-Yeon only wants his college recommendation, Su-Han just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Side stories are rated adult.

mangas.title: Lucky in Love
mangas.synonyms: 你是我命中注定的幸運
mangas.description:
Stepping in a puddle, slipping and falling, getting pooped on by a bird—Hwi-Bum seems to attract misfortune like a magnet. Universally acknowledged as the unluckiest guy on Earth, he finds himself partnered with Yeon-Woo, a student with the gloomiest aura he's ever seen, for a group project. Initially attributing it to his typical luck, Hwi-Bum is surprised when Yeon-Woo not only takes on the project single-handedly but also brings an unexpected twist to Hwi-Bum's fortune. As Hwi-Bum starts to revel in his newfound luck, he dismisses the subtle signs of Yeon-Woo's seemingly growing obsession. Is Hwi-Bum truly starting to turn his luck around with this relationship, or is there more to Yeon-Woo's fixation than meets the eye?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Luck Of My Life
mangas.description:
Wooju's obsessed with fortunes and superstitions. Dojin is a psychiatrist who happens to be gay but is still stuck in the closet. When Dojin gets set up with Wooju's older sister on a blind date, she immediately understands the situation and strikes up a deal with Dojin. She'll keep the ruse going to keep Dojin's mom happy in return for Dojin's help in treating Wooju's condition. Could Dojin be just the lucky charm that Wooju needed...?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Tell Me You Love Me
mangas.synonyms: Tell Me You Can Hear It
mangas.description:
Do-kwon has a secret: he has a huge weakness for pretty faces. One look at the face of a pretty boy gets him internally screaming. And lo and behold, Ryeo-soo is one of the prettiest boys he's ever seen in real life. Do-kwon is busy mentally drooling over him every time they interact. Man, it's a good thing nobody can hear his silent fanboying, right? Except, Ryeo-soo has a secret, too. He can hear other people's thoughts. And he's really having a blast listening to Do-kwon's. In fact, there's something else he wants to hear from Do-kwon…



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Darling Signed In
mangas.description:
Jaehyun may be the composed upperclassman on campus, but he secretly plays the hottest elven diva online with a love of pricey costumes. He meets Eunsung, a handsome first-year with deep pockets guarding his own secrets, at a school event. They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: A Forgotten Frolic
mangas.description: All Yeon-Woo wanted was to befriend the cute underclassman sitting next to him in class. But when his friendly gesture is met with an icy glare, he's left baffled. Things only get worse: elevator doors slammed in his face, sticky notes slapped on his back… What is this, elementary school?! Fed up with the childish pranks, Yeon-Woo decides he's had enough. But just as tensions peak - bam! They're assigned to the same group project. And in the middle of Yeon-Woo's fury...he suddenly bursts into tears?! What does this kid have against Yeon-Woo, and what will Yeon-Woo have to do to make things right?

mangas.title: Leaves Dancing on a Melody
mangas.description:
Seol Ipsae likes to keep things simple and clean: relationships never go further than physical, and one night per guy is the standard, and only the best will do. So when he runs into the big, bumbling himbo Jeong Han-Eum, he can't believe his eyes; at first, it's because the dude's such a nerd, but then it's because this nerd is hiding a big, uh, "secret." Huge, in fact. Massive. One of the biggest Ipsae has ever seen. Y'know, maybe nerdy boys aren't so bad after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Chapter count includes six side story chapters.

mangas.title: Love from the Tip of the Tongue
mangas.synonyms: Love from the Tip of the Tongue
mangas.description:
In this world, there are two special categories of people known as "forks" and "cakes." Forks—the predators, normal humans who lack a sense of taste. Cakes—the prey, the one thing forks find irresistibly delicious, often luring them to commit heinous crimes. High school hottie Tatsunari has spent his whole life hiding the fact that he's a fork, but all that changes when he accidentally gets a taste of a cute, glasses-wearing junior. The explosion of sweetness has him falling head over heels for the flavor...and for the boy himself!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: HOME5
mangas.description:
When Do-ha has been kicked out of his parents' house and is in dire need of a place to live in, he finds his sanctuary in a beautiful, brag-on-social-media-worthy shared house in Home5. It's the perfect place for him! There's exactly one catch: the owner of the place is Si-woon, his first love from high school. It should be fine, though. They're cool with each other now, they both have their own lives, and there's no lingering feelings whatsoever, right? …Right?



(Soruce: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Don't Lie to Me
mangas.description: Five years ago, academy teacher Song Yeo-Dan looked out for troubled student Yun Jae-Won. But when Jae-Won began mistaking that concern for something more, Yeo-Dan knew he had to draw a firm line. Now, Jae-Won is back, and he's older, sharper, and more relentless than ever. As time goes by, Yeo-Dan can no longer ignore how much has changed. The boy who once trailed after him like a shadow now stands before him as a man, and Yeo-Dan isn't quite sure how long he can keep denying the spark.

mangas.title: Jumping the Geon
mangas.description: From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon's teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

mangas.title: Shining Summer
mangas.description:
After parting ways nine years ago, Youngmin and his first love, Jihoon, have been reunited in the same homeroom class. There's just one problem… that's not really Jihoon. When the boys were young, a traumatic car accident landed Jihoon with an entirely new soul! To avoid suspicion, the fake Jihoon enlists his old friend's help in fooling the rest of the world about his identity. This arrogant new guy is nothing like the old sweet, polite Jihoon… so why is Youngmin still getting butterflies?


(Source: Tapas)


Note: Season 2 is rated R19.

mangas.title: Geon and Suo's Unholy Love Affair
mangas.synonyms: Love Strongly, Surprise! | Love Strong and Stay Tough! | This Love Is Intense, So Come On! | Love Hard, Try Hard!
mangas.description: Geon is a strict top known as the "Sexergizer" who will only sleep with someone once. But his promiscuous life comes to a halt when his fed-up mom drags him to church, where he thoroughly gets his manhood exorcised! After four years of seeing no action down south, Geon seems doomed to live an impotent life... until a chance encounter with his high school crush, Suo, has his vigor soar back high to heaven! But it isn't all up from here, as bottoming turns out to be Geon's only solution to overcoming his (un)holy intervention and finding true love...!

mangas.title: Never Mind, Darling
mangas.description: After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon's heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—"We just kissed"—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart's desires.

mangas.title: Love in Kitsch
mangas.description:
The Mandarin House, a kitschy B&B on Jeju island. Lured in by an ad featuring a hot guy, first-timer Yeon-U is a bright-eyed and bushy-tailed 23 year old that has come to work here, looking for a little fun and excitement over the summer.



The hot guy in the photo? Tae-Hun, your classic tsundere. Hard(body) on the outside, but you know he's got that soft, gooey interior that just needs to be coaxed out. But things aren't all soju and sun in paradise. Insatiable front desk manager, Hyeon-Su, wants to get to know the newbie too. Soon, Yeon-U is smack dab in the middle of a love triangle he had never anticipated. This is no reality show! Who will find love, who will get over the past and who will just get their rocks off this summer in "Love in Kitsch"?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Insatiable Man
mangas.description:
After food critic Ji-Ho's first meeting with novelist In-Woo ends in disappointment, he vows never to work with him. That is until In-Woo offers to buy him dinner. It's then that he learns that In-Woo is unable to experience one of life's basic joys – taste – and needs someone to describe flavors to him for his next novel. The more they meet, the more Ji-Ho finds himself being drawn to In-Woo... but why? Is it because he too harbors a secret of his own?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hello Again!
mangas.description:
Ever since he was young, Hee-Min has always liked his neighbour, Seon-Woo-hyung. Hee-Min had given up on Seon-Woo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, while Seon-Woo is searching for a roommate, Hee-Min is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of Hee-Min now is none other than his older brother, Yoo-Min!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Runway Hit
mangas.description:
After a promising debut, Seohyun's fallen out of the fashion world spotlight with his latest designs. His short career's practically over as the industry writes him off. Yet even as people refuse to work with him, Hyowon Lee agrees to be his model. While this playboy troublemaker doesn't seem serious enough for Seohyun's liking, he does have a certain allure to him. Will Hyowon be more trouble than he's worth or will their partnership give rise to something more tantalizing... and pleasurable?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes one prologue, one epilogue, three extras and five side story chapters.

mangas.title: Forest of the Rabbits
mangas.description: Shunta and Tamaki are one year apart, but they've kept up their friendship even as they attend different schools. Shunta loves to see his friend happy, but one day, he comes across Tamaki crying, and something fundamental changes within him, awakening sexual feelings he doesn't know what to do with. Shunta realizes that his feelings are not right. They're monstrous. Impure. As the two navigate high school, the lines they cross increase, leaving them to contend with Shunta's growing feelings and Tamaki's own desires.

mangas.title: My Dearest Patrolman
mangas.synonyms: Boku no Omawarisan, My Pretty Policeman
mangas.description: Seiji Tajima runs a convenience store in a small town, and thanks to his easygoing attitude toward much of life, he's still single. Tall, muscular patrolman Shin Nakamoto is a frequent visitor to Seiji's rather desolate shop, and although the two met ten years earlier, they only recently reconnected after Shin was assigned to the police box nearby. Despite the years apart, they start interacting like nothing has changed—that is, until Seiji offhandedly remarks that maybe he should try his luck with men, unwittingly restoking the flame Shin has held for him for years.

mangas.title: Kaichou, Iiko wa Mou Owari
mangas.titleNative: 会長、イイコはもう終わり
mangas.description:
Asahi, the student council president who is smart, has a good personality, and is loved by everyone has a secret he can't tell anyone. That is to be "embraced by a man." He wants to have "experience" by the time he graduates, so he looks up a dating site but he gets found out by Hida, who always had an unfriendly attitude towards him! I know that he's just teasing me and thinking "I'm interested in seeing the real face of senpai who's always acting like a goody-two-shoes," but my body can't help but feel good...



(Source: Overlap, translated)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Yearning Fox Lies in Wait
mangas.description:
In 1920s Tokyo, prodigy Kiyo has finally made it to university, only to find himself in a tough spot. He happens upon Ozaki, who invites him to live in his mansion. But is Ozaki just an eccentric recluse, or something far stranger? And what kind of relationship did he have with Kiyo's grandfather?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Note: Love's Luster
mangas.description:
Ayumu pays a visit to the culture festival hosted by the school that Tsubame, his former classmate and first love, now attends. But their reunion doesn't last long--Ayumu hears some harsh truths from Tsubame's friend Ryuu, who can tell at glance that he still has feelings for his old flame.Heartbroken, Ayumu tries to search for a new romance...only for his online match to come with a gang of kidnappers. But a hero comes to save him in the nick of time, and it's...Ryuu?!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Spicy Milk Candy
mangas.titleNative: スパイシーミルクキャンディ
mangas.description:
A hidden sadist x an unaware masochist.

The prim and proper student council president, Izumi, is secretly dating his loving, caring, and all-smiles boyfriend, Ichii. Every day is like a blessing being loved and cared for by his prince. But as time goes on, Izumi uncovers a dangerous secret about his beloved boyfriend... When an unexpected incident leads to a sexy "punishment" in the student council office, Izumi is subjected to a rush of excitement he has never felt before.

mangas.title: Eighth Time's The Charm
mangas.description: A one night stand becomes so much more when Yeon Subin and Jin Hoyeon begin spending more and more time together…until one day, out of the blue, Subin asks to break up for reasons unbeknownst to Hoyeon. But the two just can't stay away from each other, and so they get back together again…and again…and again. But each time, Subin suddenly breaks things off without telling Hoyeon why. Until finally, after their seventh breakup, Hoyeon is determined to find the reason why.

mangas.title: Shen Sheng
mangas.description:
Shen Sheng was taught to be nice and obedient, he was gentle and tolerant, people called him "Moral Model". One day, he found a secret, and because of the secret, his peaceful life drifted away, he got braver, he released himself from the rules and started to make decisions for himself.


(Source: Pocket Comics)


Note: The chapter count includes 5 special chapters.

mangas.title: Let Me Love You
mangas.description: When a junior boldly confesses his feelings and asks permission to stalk him, Jeong-Hyeon is intrigued by the audacity. Amused, he agrees on one condition, turning desire into a secret, physical arrangement meant to be nothing more than fun. But as the relationship continues, Jeong-Hyeon begins to develop real feelings, just as Ji-Wu starts pulling away, leaving them both caught between obsession, vulnerability, and emotions neither intended to face.

mangas.title: Hello Morning Star
mangas.titleNative: ハローモーニングスター
mangas.description:
"I didn't want to realize this... I'm still in love with you."


Atsuto is a core member of a 5-man boy band called "L Planet" and Yuki is a charismatic vocalist in another band at the same company named "Realis." These two studs are rumored to be rivals vying for the top spot as the next big superstar, but when they were still training to be stars, they used to be - lovers. They began to drift apart when Atsuto made his debut before Yuki and now their relationship is but a mere shadow of what it once was. Their relationship is awkward at best and yet the flame of desire still flickers within Atsuto's heart...



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Toshishita Joushi wa Homeraretai
mangas.titleNative: 年下上司は褒められたい
mangas.description:
Kashiwagi, in his 30s, has just moved into a new industry. His brilliant younger boss and mentor, Amamiya, seems a bit uncomfortable interacting with him, an older subordinate. Concerned about their relationship, Kashiwagi waits for an opportunity to have a relaxed conversation with him, but catching up with the very busy Amamiya proves difficult. One day after work, Kashiwagi runs into Amamiya who is working overtime. He offers to help, hoping to improve their relationship even if just a little, but...? What surprising suggestion comes from Amamiya, the capable younger boss...!?



(Source: Bunendo, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ga Kemono ni Nareru made
mangas.titleNative: キミが獣になれるまで
mangas.description:
Aki, a swinger college student who is a Sub, feels an unidentified strong gaze during his play. It is Dom's "eyes of a beast" that make Subs kneel from their dominating glare. Since then, he has not been able to forget those eyes.

Mitsuru, Aki's younger childhood friend who is a Normal, has always had feelings for Aki, even if he's aware that "Subs and Normals won't make a balanced relationship."

Aki decides to do a part-time job for a clinical trial of a suppressant drug to pay for his college tuition and begins to look for a Dom who will live with him for two months. Mitsuru finds out and asks him to stay, but he's looking at Aki with the unforgettable "eyes of a beast"...!?



"...I said it, didn't I? I'm going to make you obey me."



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Traces of the Sun
mangas.description:
I can help you kill your friends.



Strange dungeons have started appearing all over the world and wreaking havoc. I-Seon, a guy with the power to rebuild cities, witnesses his friends being turned into the undead. Hyeon, a powerful hunter, comes to him with an interesting proposition. I-Seon has no choice but to accept his offer.



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Uncanny Charm
mangas.synonyms: The Art of Taming a Tiger
mangas.description:
Yoon-Jae is just a normal college student who lives alone...until his new neighbor, Beom-jin, moves in one floor below him. Then, things get weird. Namely, Yoon-Jae starts seeing ghosts everywhere, and they start stalking him. Turns out, a mysterious bell that belongs to Beom-jin is now tied to Yoon-Jae's wrist, and it summons ghosts wherever he goes. Unable to remove the cursed thing, Beom-jin suggests that Yoon-Jae help out with his work until they find a way to remove it. Oh, what kind of work? Sending ghosts to the afterlife, of course.



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Fallen Lamb
mangas.description: In 1960s America, stoic and solitary ranch hand Dennis is hired for a summer of shepherding under a strange warning: trust nothing but the sheep. A month in, a stranger named Tod appears, claiming to be a hunter passing through. Though Dennis is wary, he finds himself slowly drawn to the man, unsettled by the pull between suspicion and desire. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can't name, Dennis must choose. Will he hold on to his doubt, or take a chance on the one thing he's been told not to trust?

mangas.title: Koi no Nioi, Kawaikute Motto
mangas.titleNative: 恋のにおい、かわいくてもっと
mangas.description:
While helping out at a flower shop, high school student Kisshou meets a mysterious customer. Haruka, a man with a relaxed vibe, kisses Kisshou through his mask, saying he "smells nice!" Although he thought he would never see Haruka again, he finds himself caught up in Haruka's funky-paced love story!



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Puppy Ever After
mangas.description:
Gyu-Jin is special. He's the only son of the legendary blue-eyed German shepherd family…and he's a 26-year-old virgin. To carry on the family lineage, his parents organize an arranged marriage. However, Gyu-Jin cannot think of getting married to a stranger, let alone a female shepherd. He impulsively decides to ruin his parents' scheming by preemptively announcing that he prefers smaller dogs. In order to cover up his lie, Gyu-Jin asks his childhood friend Young-Woon, a small breed, to act as his boyfriend in front of his parents. Young-Woon agrees under one condition: Gyu-Jin must act like he really has feelings for him! With such a strange demand, could Gyu-Jin be barking up the wrong tree?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters

mangas.title: The King of Home Cooking
mangas.description:
Broke college student Ji-Ho is determined to win the grand cash prize on the TV show "The King of Home Cooking," where culinary mastery alone isn't enough to become popular with the audience voters. After a wild night of research, he concludes that faking a gay relationship with another contestant is the surest way to victory. The handsome and good-natured Woo-Hyuk could be the perfect partner -- but the instant he hears Ji-Ho's plan, Woo-Hyuk turns into a complete jerk! The two somehow agree to team up, but will their rocky "ship" be enough to beat the other attention-hungry contestants?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: OMG!
mangas.description:
Kang Yohan, plagued by endless misfortune, turns to the supernatural to change his luck. Too broke for a proper summoning ritual, he settles for a ""Do it Yourself"" version and ends up with Chung—a so-called ""cost-effective"" god.But life doesn't come cheap. Yohan is about to learn two hard truths: you get what you pay for, and nothing comes without a price. Now, he must fulfill Chung's bizarre conditions to finally escape his cursed fate!

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

mangas.title: Till Our Lips Touch
mangas.description:
Seo-U Jeong (Sebastian Jung) was the hottest teacher, that is, until I-Geon Han (Isaac Han) arrived. Tall, intelligent, and beautifully brooding, I-Geon has it all and Seo-U knows this all too well. In the past, they had shared a sultry after school romance. Now, I-Geon is back. Can Seo-U resist falling for I-Geon again or will his lips yearn for his touch?


(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: The Regular Loves My Cooking
mangas.titleNative: 常連さんは今日も俺のごはんが好き
mangas.description:
Igarashi, who spends his days running the teishoku-ya (Japanese food combo restaurant) and tavern he inherited from his father, secretly has a crush on Sora, an apprentice carpenter and regular customer. One day, Sora asks Igarashi to come hang out with him on his day off...! Despite the joy of being asked out, a certain thing in Igarashi's past makes it hard for the day to go in a hoped for direction....? This is a heart-throbbing story of a down-on-his-luck nice guy and a younger puppy-like guy.



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Takara's Treasure
mangas.description:
Taishin has moved to Tokyo from his hometown of Fukuoka in order to reunite with Takara, a stranger who had consoled him in his grief the year prior. However, despite finally getting a chance to express his gratitude to Takara at college, he is given the cold shoulder! But Taishin, undeterred, decides to pursue Takara anyway, and Takara finds himself becoming more and more enchanted by Taishin's straightforward and earnest gaze.



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Kogarete Kogashite
mangas.titleNative: 焦がれて焦がして
mangas.description: Yuuji's childhood friend Souichi is an office worker who is extremely busy with work. After meeting again, Yuuji begins to feed Souichi, healing his friend in the process. As these nights come by more and more often, the love that Yuuji has been keeping asleep within him slowly starts to simmer and reawaken.

mangas.title: Agattetanse
mangas.description:
It's the middle of winter in the northern region.

A young man who came all the way from Tokyo, Haruki arrived and collapsed during a snowstorm.

Haruki, by chance, ended up under the care in the house of three brothers (the straight-laced eldest son and his twin brothers who are high school students).

However, rumors spread that he turned up to be the bride of Kentarou, the eldest among the three brothers, and the bride is completely acknowledged throughout town…!?

mangas.title: Old-Fashioned Cupcake
mangas.titleNative: オールドファッションカップケーキ
mangas.description:
At 39 years old, Nozue lives a routine, if not melancholic, life of sleep and work. Togawa, his younger subordinate, finds it troubling and takes it upon himself to shake up Nozue's routine. During a lunch outing, the two go to a pancake shop full of exuberant young ladies to "do what girls do," and it's just the thing to breathe life into Nozue. The two men start an unlikely friendship—and perhaps something a little sweeter!



(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Fox and Puppy
mangas.titleNative: ラブミー・ラブマイドッグ
mangas.description:
A sweet & spicy spinoff of Star and Hedgehog, featuring Harukiyo's big brother, Akihiko!

Laid-back novelist Akihiko and his earnest new editor, Aiichirō (a.k.a. Ai-chan), are faced with an unexpected dynamic shift when Ai-chan walks in on Akihiko in bed with a man— and bursts into tears. Ai-chan confesses his feelings for Akihiko, but since Akihiko has no interest in anything serious, the best he can offer Ai-chan is a steamy, semi-professional friendship with decidedly unprofessional benefits. In spite of Akihiko's efforts to keep things casual, Ai-chan slowly begins to unearth the details of Akihiko's mud-caked romantic past, doggedly pawing his way to the wounded heart of the elusive fox he fell in love with...

mangas.title: Diss Love
mangas.description: E-Yan is a Korean songwriter who has been struggling with a slump. Despite wanting to write love songs, he can't force himself to. Due to his job, E-Yan starts working with the hottest rising star in the K-hiphop industry, Cha Hyun-Ho, who is famous for writing psycho songs despite being a good person in real life. Though he catches E-Yan's eye, E-Yan forces himself to brush off his growing feelings for Hyun-Ho, for the sake of both of their careers, but, because they're signed on the same label, E-Yan and Hyun-Ho keep ending up together...

mangas.title: Bocchan, Oikomi Ai desu yo.
mangas.titleNative: ぼっちゃん、追い込み愛ですよ。
mangas.description:
"Hiyori-kun, I need your help with the final mission, and that is—"

Hiyori's part-time coworker, the delinquent high schooler Rennosuke, is full of contradictions. One moment, he's furiously sketching adorable drawings with a terrifying expression, the next, he's silently petting an "imaginary cat" when no one's around…

Hiyori has always wanted to befriend Rennosuke, but he hasn't even managed a proper conversation with graduation approaching.

Then, one day, by sheer coincidence, he finally gets to talk to him! Overjoyed, Hiyori thinks he's finally making progress—

But wait!!! What is even happening right now—!?!?!?

mangas.title: Baburasete, Motto
mangas.description: Amamiya Kiri may seem like a diligent honor student, but the truth is that he's very insecure, and he can't stop sucking on a pacifier when he feels anxious. Kiri used to be able to enjoy his pacifier time in secret in his dorm room, until he started sharing the room with Enami Yukimura, a pleasant and cheerful junior. Then one night, Yukimura sees Kiri sucking on his pacifier...?!

mangas.title: Stay Out of My Head!
mangas.description:
Moon Ah-Rim has a secret. One accidental touch, and he can hear exactly what you're thinking. So when he accidentally brushes against his longtime crush, Tae-Hun, he expects butterflies…not full-blown NSFW fantasies! Sweet, gentle Tae-Hun isn't supposed to have those kinds of thoughts, and especially not about him! Ah-Rim is horrified...and maybe just a little intrigued. Because no matter how much he tells himself not to feel anything...his body's saying otherwise.



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Guide's Treasure
mangas.description:
The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that's exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.


"Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we'll get along fine."


Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.


"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?"


From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin's in danger.


"If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds."


What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Oneurui Reokki Aitemeun Ajeossiimnida
mangas.synonyms: ลักกี้ไอเทมของวันนี้คือคุณนั่นแหละครับ
mangas.description:
Moon Geun-Young has the worst luck imaginable, relying entirely on fortune apps to navigate life. His world takes an unexpected turn when he meets Team Leader Kang Joon-Suk, a man blessed with incredible luck.

Every time Geun-Young tries to get intimate, strange interruptions seem to arise. However, with Joonsuk, he finds himself having surprisingly enjoyable nights... that is, until he learns.... "Who knew he was married?"

Will Geun-Young be able to resist the subtle temptations of Kang Joon-Suk, who keeps inching closer—even at work?

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

mangas.title: Not a Peep!
mangas.description:
With the press of a button, Yu Sol's life is about to turn upside down. When a mysterious post with the power to transport the user to their favorite fictional universe pops up on his feed, Sol clicks "share" and falls asleep…only to awake the next day as a round, winged puffball! Try to speak as he might, he can only mutter one word- er, sound: "Peep!" With his new avian appearance, Sol must navigate the land of Sevon under the guiding hand of his new (strikingly handsome) owner, Karhan Barthés, while trying to find a way back to world from which he came.

(Soure: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Studio Serendipity
mangas.description:
Jae-Yoon Kang has finally decided to find a new place to live because he just can't keep up with the noise. But little did he know, it was quite challenging to find the perfect place in his budget. His last hope is Young-Han Seo, competent realtor with the looks. When Mr. perfect is helping for studio apartment hunt, Jae-Yoon realizes that he's more interested in him than the property hunting. Now, Jae-Yoon is ready to attract Young-Han's attention, by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: The chapter count includes 3 side stories.

mangas.title: Yoake no Joshou
mangas.description:
Three connected two-part oneshots.



Third Term, Someone Else's Right Hand: When Kai Kiichi's older brother is temporarily transferred to India, Kiichi moves in with the landlord's family, including their son, Niina. Kiichi and Niina are high school classmates, but they're from two different worlds.



Farewell, Faraway Right Hand: Kiichi is working now, and an obnoxious coworker makes his life miserable when he asks Kiichi to give a speech at his wedding.



Daylight Prologue: Kiichi's older brother Koichi is finally back from India. Why won't he see Kiichi?

mangas.title: Tortured Love
mangas.description: One sees humans as dirty animals, the other protects humans with his own life. Can these two people who meet change the world as they wish?

mangas.title: Short Circuit Love
mangas.description:
Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha's unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha's personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What's worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha's coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them…



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Merry Marbling
mangas.description:
Ian is seemingly the perfect student – kind, trustworthy, and handsome to boot, he became known as "the Angel of Christmas" thanks to an innocent act of kindness from when he was a child. So when Yugun returns to school after an extended sick leave, no one is surprised when Ian is there to help him get through the day. Thanks to Ian's cherubic persona, Yugun thinks he can trust him - that is, until he overhears a conversation between the boy and his mother that reveals it was all a plan to maintain Ian's image. Incensed at the betrayal, Yugun confronts Ian and threatens to reveal his true colors to everyone. However, Ian's unexpected response confuses Yugun even more: "Go ahead. But whatever happens after is not my responsibility." After all, who could hate the supposed "Angel of Christmas?" Will the two remain like oil and water? Or will they learn to blend together to create something more beautiful than either of them could have ever imagined?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Ship My Rival x Me
mangas.description:
Wei Yanzi and Gu Yiliang burst onto the acting scene together, igniting a rivalry fueled by their shared debut. But while Gu Yiliang dazzles with his acting prowess and idol-worthy looks, Wei Yanzi finds himself in the shadow with only his striking appearance to boast. Amid the barrage of online hate from Gu Yiliang's fervent admirers, Wei Yanzi's patience wears thin.



When Wei Yanzi stumbles upon an online community totally convinced there's a romantic entanglement between the two actors, he is initially shocked but soon finds solace in their speculation as he immerses himself in their discussions.



Though their relationship is purely professional, Wei Yanzi can't shake the growing sense that maybe the shippers are onto something. As he spends more time with Gu Yiliang, lines blur, and Wei Yanzi begins to wonder if there might, after all, be truth behind the fan-fueled fantasies!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Note: Chapter count includes 7 extra chapters.

mangas.title: HEALING PARADOX
mangas.titleNative: ヒーリングパラドックス
mangas.synonyms: 運命仕掛けの癒されナイトアワー
mangas.description:
Totally exhausted from many days overtime work, Naoto Kuroiwa, advertisement salesman (as well as a corporate slave) goes to Kishibe Chiropractic Lab following his colleague's recommendation. It has high reputation and the doctor, Kazuma Kishibe is a young handsome man of the same age with Kuroiwa. With his too much friendliness and proactivity, Kuroiwa is overwhelmed first, but the technique of chiropractic is fantastic and he feels too good like in heaven. "I'll make you...feel so good that you'll positively melt." Skillful handlings and accurate finger pressures make him sleep until next morning. Kuroiwa starts going to the lab but the doctor's treatment becomes more and more sexually aroused and at the same time, Kuroiwa feels more and more unable to resist as if his body has been changed from deep inside. When he finds that Kishibe avoids touching his right shoulder where he injured at the baseball team in his youth, Kishibe's true character begins to show up.



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Give Me a Hug, Mr. Frog!
mangas.synonyms: Hug Shite! Kaeru-san | Hug Me! Frog-san
mangas.description: Takanashi is the capable student council president admired by his classmates for his perfection, but recently, he's been hiding quite a secret. Lately, he's been secretly visiting a frog-themed milk tea cafe and indulging in an odd habit. For every cup he buys, he gets a hug from the adorable frog mascot that works in the cafe! He has no idea who inhabits the suit, only that the soothing hug seems to relieve him of the pressures of everyday life. But after so many visits, he starts to get curious: who is the person inside?! Will knowing who they are ruin his reputation as the perfect student council president, or could this be the start of a totally new relationship? Grab a lilypad and jump into this adorable manga about two total opposites!

mangas.title: How to melt
mangas.description:
Yukimi is the art director for a dating-sim at a game production company, even though he does not believe in "eternal love" or "happy endings." One day, the team's main illustrator is out sick, and Mebuki, a junior member of another team, comes over to help out. Yukimi thought that the only connection between them was that they went to the same school, but suddenly Mebuki asks him, "So, are you available?" This is a melty love story between a single-minded younger man and the handsome art director who is distrustful of love!



(Source: Homesha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Noisy Roommate: The Roof Over My Head Comes With Monsters and a Hottie
mangas.titleNative: ノイジールームメイト ～家ナシになったのでイケメンと怪異つき物件で同居始めました～
mangas.synonyms: 不安分的室友 ~因為無家可歸，只好和帥哥同居在發生靈異現象的房子裡~
mangas.description:
Osuke's excited about finally getting to live on his own, but on his first day in his new apartment, he finds himself kicked out onto the street! So, when a real estate agent appears out of nowhere offering him a beautiful, new place (with just a couple conditions), he jumps at the chance. But when he opens the door, a drop-dead gorgeous blond guy pops out! It turns out living with him is one of the conditions! His name is Nanami, and he tells Osuke that, not only are ghosts real, but Osuke himself is a magnet for all things supernatural...



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Koi no Ghost
mangas.description:
One day, high school student Aragaki notices that a ghost is haunting him. Aragaki thought he was the only person who can see the ghost, until his crush and classmate, Asahikawa, points it out! What's more, Asahikawa says that the ghost told him that Aragaki likes him...? Could this eerie situation actually lead to Aragaki finding love through the help of this ghost?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes two extra chapters, both not included in the volume.

mangas.title: Ghoul Work, Kurose
mangas.titleNative: お憑かれさま、黒瀬くん
mangas.description:
I feel like I've forgotten someone important…

Yuuma Kurose, a lonely boy who can see ghosts, is plagued by a recurring nightmare. As if drawn by some unseen force, he returns to the hometown that haunts his dreams. There, he meets a boy named Kaito, who is surrounded by terrifying spirits. "I'll always protect you," Kaito says with an unexpectedly serious look. But the moment they touch, the spirits surrounding Kaito suddenly possess Yuuma…?! A cool, obsessive seme and a brave, unlucky uke. Their reunion stirs time, once frozen, into motion once more.

mangas.title: Love at First Fright
mangas.synonyms: ¿Por qué esta Casa es tan Barata
mangas.description:
Yeo Eun-Seong has always been popular—too popular. With his striking looks, he attracts attention from everyone, regardless of age or gender. But constant gossip and misunderstandings have left him deeply distrustful of people. The last thing he needs is to be popular amongst ghosts too!



After moving into a new home for his job, Eun-Seong finds himself tormented by eerie paranormal activity night after night. One evening, while cowering outside his own apartment, he meets Seo Tae-Jeong, a passing office worker who—much to Eun-Seong's surprise—can see and talk to ghosts. Desperate for peace, Eun-Seong enlists Tae-Jeong's help to rid his house of its unwelcome guests. As the two work together, an unexpected and curious friendship begins to take shape… but is there more to Tae-Jeong than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes two side story chapters.

mangas.title: Our Paradise
mangas.description:
So you've decided to forget about your high-school crush after graduation, going on to college without ever telling them how you felt. That's the plan for quiet college freshman Mae-Hwa Yang. But even the best laid plans can go astray, as Mae-Hwa discovers when he learns that his crush, Jae-Won Myeong, goes to the same college! As their lives begin to intertwine through the hustle and bustle of college life, old feelings get stirred up and new feelings start to emerge.



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: Love Interest Zone
mangas.synonyms: Love Supremacy Zone | Love Supremacy Area
mangas.description: Myungha Tae is going to die in 300 days. Well… maybe. After getting sucked into his friend's novel, "Love Interest Zone," 29-year-old Myungha becomes a 19-year-old high schooler again with one mission—make Yeowoon Cha happy or die. With only 300 days to succeed, Myungha must break past Yeowoon's barriers and prevent him from experiencing the same tragic fate as he did in the novel. But with Yeowoon's favorability toward him in the negatives, will he be able to survive?

mangas.title: PUNKS TRIANGLE
mangas.synonyms: パンクストライアングル
mangas.description:
Fashion student Chiaki dreams of seeing his designs on the runway, worn by none other than Ai—the charismatic male model who changed his life. When a prestigious competition promises to make that dream come true, Chiaki is fired up to win. But his hopes are dashed when he's paired with the clumsy and unfashionable Enaga for the project. One fateful night, after a run-in with some delinquents, Chiaki is unexpectedly saved by his idol Ai. Even more shocking, Ai seductively offers to teach him how to have fun at night… Caught between the alluring, mysterious model he worships and a clumsy, rough-around-the-edges classmate who can't seem to stay out of trouble (but may be hiding a surprising secret), Chiaki faces a heart-pounding, pure boy's love dilemma that will turn his world upside down!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Dysfunctional Family Theory
mangas.description: Sentarou and Touma are two total opposites who have found themselves in an awkward situation: for the next three months, they have to live together with six-year-old Meguru so she can pick one of them to be her papa! After the death of her mother, both Sentarou and Touma were listed as Meguru's potential father, along with strict instructions that she would get to pick who she wanted to live with. But neither of them is ready to be a parent, let alone live together! Now, cramped in Sentarou's apartment, the three of them must figure out how to navigate this situation. Between Sentarou and Touma's constant squabbling and Meguru's surprising maturity, will they be able to survive? And just who will Meguru pick to be her papa?

mangas.title: Unlucky Cupid Messenger
mangas.description: Kyuhyun accidentally comes out when he unintentionally sends a photo of himself kissing his (ex-)boyfriend to a group chat. Panicked, he thinks, "I'm screwed. Someone already saw it." Unable to sleep properly and filled with fear, he walks into the lecture hall, only to meet Kibum's intense gaze. "Hey, what time does your class end today?" That simple question marks the beginning of more frequent encounters between them. As they spend more time together, Kyuhyun's fear gradually turns into excitement, and the atmosphere between them starts shifting in an unexpected direction. "Go out with me. I'll become the person you love."

mangas.title: I've Gone Viral Thanks to My Crush
mangas.synonyms: Hottest Topics | I Got Teased By Mr. Wonderful On Hot Search Again | He's Been Searched By the God | Mr. Mcdreamy Makes Me a Trending Topic Again | You Bei Nanshen Liao Shang Resou
mangas.description: Yu Bei has had a crush on Gu Yiming for 8 years and he is always there for Gu as his good "bro", only to find out the gossip between Gu and an actress. So, Yu decides to give up the secret love and he swears not to sleep with Gu anymore! But the obtuse straight man Gu Yiming seems to notice something suddenly! What will happen to Yu Bei after all these years?

mangas.title: Define the Relationship
mangas.description: Alphas lust for Omegas, and Omegas want Alphas. That's the way of the world, but Karlyle isn't your typical Alpha. He doesn't thirst after every Omega he sees—well, let's say that things are complicated. Karlyle feels no need to change, but when troubles occur with his sex life his doctor suggests something surprising. Try sleeping with Alphas, instead of Omegas. Karlyle finds this solution strange, but the doctor says he knows just the person to help him out. Ash comes into Karlyle's life just like that, and Karlyle finds himself thinking about Ash more and more. More than friends, but not quite lovers—how can we define this relationship?

mangas.title: Adam no Rokkotsu
mangas.description: Yuuma works and live at the amuesment park called "Dream Park". His days are normally filled up with kids tackling him and chatting with coworkers. Well, this is until his new coworker/roommate appears.

mangas.title: Let's be a family
mangas.description:
The kind, smitten Chiaki and the scary yet reliable Kazuma are a long-term gay couple. Tomoe, the tomboy who knows of their relationship, asks to see them, and they find her with a large tummy and another life growing inside her. The father is unknown, and although Chiaki and Kazuma are exasperated with the chipper Tomoe, they help her out. Before they know it, the baby is born. The two men are relieved that Tomoe is acting like a proper mother, but one day, Tomoe comes to them with tears in her eyes and says, "Take care of her for me.......!" The bubbling motherly instincts, the increasing motherly skills, and the interrupted sex!?
New territory for Tomo Kurahashi, author of "I want to do what lovers do.", this is a heart-warming story about the bond between two men, and familial love.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Dear Zero
mangas.description: After humanity triumphs over the dangerous gates, a fragile peace is restored, yet the immense powers of espers become a dangerous double-edged sword. At the heart of this turmoil is Esper Zero, Michael, teetering on the edge of destruction. Enter Adam, a retired soldier haunted by the fractured bonds between espers and their guides. In a bold act of redemption, Adam offers Michael a second chance and a new identity: "Eve," symbolizing a fresh start and a spark of hope. But is peace truly possible for a person created for war…?

mangas.title: The Awkward Steps of Love
mangas.titleNative: ヘタクソラブステップ
mangas.description:
At the spring season in college sophomore, Kotaro should be enjoying his youth, freedom and his campus life. But without a girlfriend or any close friends, his life has been rather unspectacular. One day, Miyako, Kotaro's female friend from his childhood asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend so that she can blow off a boy, Aoi who is making an unwanted move to her. Before Kotaro can make a decision, he accidentally meets Aoi and they happen to have teas together. It looks that Kotaro successes in making Aoi give up Miyako, but Aoi easily spots his lie and says, "Instead of giving up her, get along with me". He takes Kotaro into the bathroom of the college, saying that he can teach many things...



A philanderer boy with a modest boy who wants to spend a quiet life... A pure love story, stepping up awkwardly from a normal friendship.



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Entangled with You: The Garden of 100 Grasses
mangas.description: Once upon a time, Marcel's sister fell in the forest while gathering herbs. Her injuries were grave and Marcel was at a loss for what to do, until a fearsome horned man appeared, offering help–in exchange for a promise. Now, ten years later, Marcel returns to the woods, steeling himself for death. Instead, he finds something quite different: a gentle soul, friendship…and perhaps something more.

mangas.title: Lack of Love
mangas.description:
Hajin Park doesn't have much beyond a pretty face. He's jobless, lives with an annoying roommate who watches porn on max volume, and has modest aspirations of opening an online store. His sister will help him achieve his dreams on one condition: if he gets autographs from the famous all male idol group Eight Nine. When he finds mega pop star Hangyum Lee pleasuring himself in a bathroom stall, it's not just Hajin's memories of their past together that gets stirred. A twisted romance lacking anything but love begins.


(Webtoon Database)

mangas.title: Howling Under the Moonlight
mangas.description:
Yoon works at an animal hospital. Eun-Woo comes every so often to the vet to get treated which gets on Yoon's nerves. In order to treat Eun-Woo's wounds, Yoon takes off his mask and is absolutely captivated by his good looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Kids Sitter
mangas.description:
Being a "good neighbor" is just not enough anymore!



After school, the third-year high school student Mitsuki's daily routine is to play with the neighborhood kids. As he was playing as usual, a scary-looking man with a scar on his face approached him!
