He said he wanted to know how to interact with small children for his new brother who will be a new family member due to his mother's remarriage. The scary-looking man turns out to be Kyohei, who lives nearby and is one year younger than Mitsuki. As they spend time together, he discovers Kyohei's clumsy kindness, which is contrary to his look...?



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Boy Who Stole From the Fairy Lake
mangas.description:
My name is Hyosin Lee, and I just want to get one thing straight: I am not a thief! I ran away from home to escape my stifling household but ended up lost in the mountains where I found a pile of clothes. How was I supposed to know that they belonged to the very handsome half-fairy, San Baek? He has (reluctantly) let me stay with him because I was badly injured. He doesn't talk much, but he's kind and I like being with him… However, I know it won't be long until my family finds me and when that happens… I'll never be able to see San again!



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 12 side story chapters

mangas.title: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey
mangas.description:
Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn't be an issue since the guild's kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don't handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Lover Boy
mangas.description:
"From my earliest memory until now, there wasn't a single moment where I didn't like you." Eunho Jung proposed to Jaeha Yoo, the older boy next door, for the first time when he was three. It stopped being cute when he confessed his feelings again in high school, and once Jaeha got married, the two lost touch. They're reunited by chance years later, Eunho as a university student, and Jaeha, a jaded divorcee. Eunho's determined to prove he's not a kid anymore, but does Jaeha's self-destructive spiral allow for feelings?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

mangas.title: If It's You, I Might Try Falling in Love
mangas.titleNative: 君となら恋をしてみても
mangas.description:
Amane hadn't seriously liked anyone since middle school. He learned how painful it was to be laughed at for sharing your feelings and had sworn off ever since. Now, he's just transferred to a new high school in Enoshima, where he meets Ryuuji, a boy in his class. Fast friends, the jaded Amane quickly warms up to the eager Ryuuji—but that warmth continues to grow into feelings much deeper than friendship. Follow the boys as they navigate a frustratingly authentic journey through high school romance.



(Source: Yen Press)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

- Includes 57 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Please Refund This Imprint!
mangas.description:
When Jeong-In hears that his long-time crush is getting married, he ends up having a one-night stand to forget the pain of his heartbreak. But he remembers having sex with a handsome man... What's this strange pattern on his tongue? The man Hwa appears again to Jeong-In, who is confused, and makes a bombshell announcement. He says that he is a vampire and that he has imprinted on Jeong-In. But more than anything...

"You will continue to feel excited because of the imprint. So... Won't you meet me until you find a way to release it?"

mangas.title: The Duke's Plush Obsession
mangas.synonyms: Possessing the Obsessive Maniac's Cotton Doll
mangas.description:
When Yul finds himself dropped into a BL novel, reincarnated as a stuffed toy that has ended up in the hands of an obsessive, tyrannical duke, he's sure he is done for. If the truth gets out, Yul will be burned at the stake! Can he find a way to get back to his real body or is he doomed to be stuck in this fantasy land?

(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Red Candy
mangas.synonyms: ปฏิบัติการชิงหัวใจ
mangas.description:
Shi-Hyeon, aka "Red Candy," is a secret agent whose code name comes from bathing in the blood of his marks on dangerous missions. Shi-Hyeon's tasked with seducing and obtaining intel from Ha-Jun, a hot college professor. Shi-Hyeon can disarm enemies, but didn't expect to be disarmed himself by Ha-Jun's own tight body. Now Shi-Hyeon's caught between loyalty to his spy agency and Ha-Jun. Can Red Candy survive the incoming wave of enemies and still indulge in the sweet ecstasy of Ha-Jun's embrace?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Red Thread Quest
mangas.description:
As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush — the charming upperclassman Hong Ki-Hoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest.

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate — and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Ki-Hoon begins to take an unpredictable turn.

What started as a game might just lead them to something real…if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

mangas.title: Serenity Film
mangas.description: Brow, a photographer, has a wonderful breath of fresh air come into his life.

mangas.title: Sketch
mangas.description:
First impressions are everything, right? But it doesn't seem that way when Yi-Kyung comes across Joo-Bin. When they first meet, Joo-Bin is just a handsome stranger with an exciting air of mystery. Yi-Kyung itches to draw him, to sketch out his beauty on paper like the artist he is… But at their next encounter, Joo-Bin is a completely different person. Sensitive, outspoken, and passionate about his own work as a photographer, he proposes that Yi-Kyung become his model. And drawn to this other side of his, Yi-Kyung says yes. Between lens and paper, who'll be the first to sketch out the other to perfection?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Smyrna and Capri
mangas.description: What if your sworn enemy holds the key to your future? Theo Peserus: an alpha of the mighty Peserus clan, called forth to provide the clan with a child. For a tree to bear fruit, a worthy Capri must be chosen to inseminate him. Seram Marita: a revolutionary army soldier hailing from the Langeres clan. Having escaped from his imprisonment, he now weaves through the maze-like halls of the Peserus castle, looking for a way out. But a tempting odor permeates the air and leads Seram straight to the enemy. Intoxicated on pheromones, the two adversaries are now engaged, not in a battle for their lives, but in a war of lust... What fruit will come to bear when these foes, this Smyrna and this Capri, become entangled in a decadence that they both cannot resist…?

mangas.title: Spinach Bouquet
mangas.description:
Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn't it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That's what Ji-Woo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dong-Chan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dong-Chan isn't the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn't want Ji-Woo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Ji-Woo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 48 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Summer Sparks
mangas.synonyms: A Small Place: The Beginning of Summer
mangas.description:
Joon-hwi has always been a beta. Which is a relief, given how his best friend and nationally beloved actor Seok-hyun hates omegas, and there's no way Joon-hwi's crush on him would be requited otherwise. But one day, when Joon-hwi discovers he might be the exact thing Seok-hyunh hates, everything spirals out of control…



(Source: Lezhin US)




Note: Includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Surge Towards You
mangas.description: Cheong-Ho is a national swim team member who has been struggling with poor records. As an alpha, his physical condition could be improved greatly through sex with an omega, but he has a fear of omega pheromones. His hopes of being a top swimmer seem to be sinking, but that all changes when he meets Yi-Rim, an omega whose pheromones don't give off any scent. Yi-Rim is only too happy to help Cheong-Ho out, and thus the two of them start a purely physical relationship. It's almost like they're a match made in heaven. But…why is it so hard for them to close the distance between each other?

mangas.title: The Guy Inside Me
mangas.description:
At Linzhen High, Sheng Xu is the resident bad boy, while Zhan Shao is the by-the-book school genius. They're polar opposites and butt heads every chance they get! But one day, their worlds get turned upside down when they mysteriously switch bodies. While navigating life trapped in an unfamiliar body and learning to work as a team to maintain their respective tough-guy image and perfect GPA, they discover hidden truths and deeper feelings for each other. But can opposites attract when the guy you like is... you?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes two bonus chapters and two epilogue chapters.

mangas.title: The Tiger That Swallowed the Moon
mangas.synonyms: The Tiger Who Swallowed The Moon
mangas.description:
Taebom Gwak, an Olympic gold medalist of the national shooting team, suffers a dangerous hit-and-run accident. The person who he used to call "Daddy-Long-Legs" suddenly appears in this life-or-death situation, ten years after he's disappeared from Taebom's childhood. But he is actually… a vampire?!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Sweeten the Deal
mangas.description: Han-Eul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror. Fate, however, has other plans. Han-Eul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Da-Jeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place! A fluffy, sweet whirlwind romance between the slightly airheaded Han-Eul and the unexpectedly charming Da-Jeong unfolds!

mangas.title: Veil Blue to Kuchinashi no Hanataba
mangas.titleNative: ベールブルーと梔子の花束
mangas.description:
Mugi Hinata has had a physical relationship with Suku Oumi, a popular professional Go player, since their school days. They can only meet when in heat and have yet to become lovers. Even so, they are happy just to be together. Then one day, he witnesses shocking news about Oumi...?



(Source: Fusion Product, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: You Should Be The One To Come Kiss Me
mangas.titleNative: お前のほうからキスしてくれよ
mangas.description:
The cool and capable Kou from Accounting, and Eito, the company's upbeat top salesman, star in a heart-throbbing story of mutual unrequited love! Kou, who's really serious about his job and a bit feared by his colleagues, and Eito, who's being eyed for the next managerial position, are total opposites at first glance. However, unbeknownst to their colleagues, the two are actually close buddies, and Eito stays over at Kou's place all the time. Even though he's already come out as gay, Kou starts to feel restless as their relationship grows more intimate and vulnerable with each passing day. Eito, on the other hand, feels conflicted since Kou's already told him that he's not his type, and that nothing could ever happen between them. A slow-burn romance between two hardworking friends who both yearn for something more!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Unfair Love Affair
mangas.description:
Actor Yoo Haek-Yeong has been in love with his spoiled friend Seo Kwon-Yeong for more than 10 years. Not only is it a hopeless love, but it's downright abuse as Kwon-Yeong takes complete advantage of Haek-Yeong's feelings to constantly boss him around. Haek-Yeong just can't help letting Kwon-Yeong string him along… until he connects with his crush's older brother, Kwon-Lim, the top actor in Korea. Unlike his manipulative brother, Kwon-Lim is thoughtful and kind—and incredibly handsome. As Haek-Yeong grows closer to Kwon-Lim, the dynamic between him and his old friend begins to shift—and so do Haek-Yeong's long-harbored feelings…



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Taming the Tyrant
mangas.description:
Betrayal, rebirth, and second chances.



Jae-Ryun seduced and betrayed the tyrannical emperor before being discovered and executed. Now he's woken up 20 years in the past and crossed paths with the emperor once again. Is this his chance to atone for his sins by reforming the man he loves, or are some romances fated to end in tragedy?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Stay With Me
mangas.description:
"Are you prepared to handle what I'm about to do to you?"



For Choi Bom, running into Kang Doha for the first time seven years causes him great emotional unrest. On the one hand, he's glad that Doha is safe and sound, but on the other, he's angry. Angry at Doha for disappearing for so long, and angry at himself for still caring. So when Doha says he wants to apply for the position as Bom's housekeeper, Bom wonders if this might be the perfect chance to sort through his tumultuous emotions. Except, Doha refuses to answer any personal questions, leaving Bom more confused than ever. Just why did Doha disappear, and what is it that's brought him back? Any most importantly, how can Bom be sure that Doha will stay?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Rehearsal
mangas.synonyms: ซ้อมบทรัก มัดใจนาย
mangas.description:
Jun-U and Eun-Seo. Best friends since childhood. Jun-U, an artist and Eun-Seo, an actor. One day, Eun-Seo presents an offer to Jun-U that he just can't refuse, an opportunity to meet his celeb crush Park Eden! All Eun-Seo asks for in return is a partner to go over some lines with. Sure, sounds harmless enough. That is until Jun-U realizes these scenes are much steamier than he'd anticipated… And when feelings start to get involved…are these rehearsals becoming practice for something more?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Perfect Propose
mangas.titleNative: パーフェクトプロポーズ
mangas.description:
Hiro's so stressed out at work that he can barely have proper meals or get some well-earned sleep. When he passes out on the sidewalk after yet another stressful day, an unfamiliar face calls out to him—apparently, they once promised to marry each other? What's Kai Fukaya's deal, and why is he so insistent on assuming the role of Hiro's fiancé?



(Source: Manga Planet)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I Can't Stand Being Your Childhood Friend
mangas.titleNative: 幼馴染じゃ我慢できない
mangas.synonyms: I Can't Stand It With My Childhood Friend
mangas.description: Aoi and Ryouta have been friends for as long as they can remember, so when it comes time to head off to college, it only makes sense for them to room together! Practically joined at the hip, they are convinced that their relationship will stay the same forever...until one day, Aoi wakes up to find Ryouta leaning in to kiss him! Now Aoi must unpack this bewildering development, but he just can't seem to forget Ryouta's touch...

mangas.title: Night of Muheun
mangas.description: The Seo family is cursed with short lives, but Seungjoo seems to defy fate. That is, until a drunken night with his lifelong neighbor, Kim Muheun, changes everything. Awakening beside Muheun, Seungjoo discovers he can suddenly see ghosts. As the eldest son of a prestigious exorcist family, Muheun vows to protect Seungjoo at all costs, even if it means facing deadly spirits. Bound by a deep connection that feels almost predestined, their intertwined fates lead them on a perilous journey of exorcism, danger, and the fight against an ancient curse.

mangas.title: My Breast Friend
mangas.description: Tae-Yang and Hee-Tae have grown up alongside each other their whole lives. Hee-Tae's feelings for Tae-Yang are so strong that all of their close friends are aware of them. But Tae-Yang, the subject of his affection, is oblivious. The two are so close they live together in the same house, but one day Hee-Tae notices something strange about Tae-Yang. He's hiding something from him! Out of curiosity and sadness, Hee-Tae barges into Tae-Yangs locked room and sees…Tae-Yang's chest!..But something's coming out of them?!

mangas.title: Love is like the Weather Forecast
mangas.synonyms: สภาพอากาศวันนี้มีความ รัก
mangas.description:
It's all rainy days for Ban Dong-Wook. Haunted by ghosts, he is unable to fall asleep no matter what he does. But one night, with Lee Do-Hyun by his side, he is able to clear his mind and drift off into dreamworld. Dong-Wook is convinced he needs Do-Hyun, but the latter is scared to love him in return. Will the two be able to work through the storm and find sunny days ahead? Or is the hurricane that is love destined to tear them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Non-refundable Alpha
mangas.description:
Choi Jae-Won was living a carefree life abroad, surrounded by playful alphas and chasing nothing but pleasure. But when his father lures him back to Korea, he's blindsided by a wedding—his own. The groom turns out to be Yang Joon-Hee, a childhood friend who's grown into everything Jae-Won's ever wanted. And before he can make sense of it, the vows are already said. Joon-Hee insists they once made a promise. Jae-Won doesn't remember it... but something in him starts to respond anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Fake Romance
mangas.description:
"Do you want to sleep with me?"

Baek Kwon-Young doesn't like Nam Ju-Ha, no, not at all! But desperate times come for desperate measures especially when Kwon-young's father announces that he wants Ju-Ha to become part of the Baek family. If Ju-Ha says yes to that proposal, that means Juha'll basically inherit Ilbi Group, the Baek family's conglomerate. Kwon-Young has to do anything to stop this from happening. Will Kwon-Young's fake romance be successful? What will Ju-Ha become? The stepson or the sex partner?

mangas.title: Confessions Of A Male Celeb
mangas.description: In a suspicious car accident, Seo Jiwoon's sister dies while top actor Cha Taehyuk walks off unscathed. While trying to uncover the truth, Jiwoon is also hit by a car. However, when he opens his eyes, Jiwoon realizes he has traveled back in time to his first day of work. Will this opportunity to work together with Cha Taehyuk be the perfect opportunity to avenge his sister's death?

mangas.title: A Ridiculous Drama
mangas.description: Piljoo poured his life into supporting Taejoon. Growing up as orphans, all their firsts were together. So when Taejoon announces he's marrying a woman—in the middle of sex—Piljoo is devastated. Taejoon's convinced marrying rich will finally bring them safety and stability, but Piljoo breaks in the face of his lover's betrayal. When he meets rich, sexy Seungpyoo, maybe it's time Piljoo finally does something for himself.

mangas.title: Cottage Garden
mangas.description:
Burnt out and buried in work, Isaac Schrader drowns his stress in drinks with his only friend, James. The next morning, he wakes up in a hotel bed—hungover, disoriented, and far from alone. Lying next to him is Theodore Donovan, his charming yet insufferable roommate from their boarding school days… a man who vanished without a word years ago. Their reunion is anything but ordinary—and Theodore's sudden return feels far from innocent.

What is he really after?

mangas.title: Virtual Strangers
mangas.description: After a stalking incident, Yoon Ji-gu has become understandably wary of strangers. So when an odd man moves in next door, he immediately suspects the worst. Little does he know, Yeowoon is just a regular guy trying to land a job and enjoy his free time—until he finds himself dealing with a hostile neighbor. As their real-life misunderstandings escalate, the two unknowingly team up in their favorite online game, forming an unexpected duo. Get ready to log in to a new adventure full of hilarious mix-ups, a distrustful tsundere, and an unwitting flirt with a heart of gold.

mangas.title: Fukutsu no Zono
mangas.description: Deto and delinquent Zono are merely opponents. But then Deto discovered Zono's weakness. If his neck is touched, Zono will let out erotic sounds. Hearing Zono's erotic moans, Deto's lower-body reacted and left him confused. One day, Deto ran into Zono, who was beaten into a pulp by his father, despite being very strong in fighting. Deto rushed in to rescue Zono. And why was Zono wearing fancy, cute-looking clothes?

mangas.title: Love on Hold
mangas.synonyms: Why Are You So Kind to Everyone Except Me?
mangas.description:
Jeong-Yoon has harbored a crush on Chae-Heon all through high school and now college. Despite 'fate' always bringing them together, Jeong-Yoon hasn't been able to become close to Chae-Heon, much less tell the latter about his feelings. This is mainly because he is convinced that Chae-Heon doesn't like him. But unbeknownst to Jeong-Yoon, Chae-Heon is not without his own complaints. Will the two resolve ever their misunderstandings and will love, which has been put on hold for so long, finally begin?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Romantic Captain Darling
mangas.synonyms: ロマンチック・キャプテン・ダーリン
mangas.description:
Rafael Heinsworth might be the most adorable recruit Captain Dante has ever had. Sure, Dante likes him. Who wouldn't like someone so beautiful and sweet? And if Rafael wants to profess his eternal love for Dante, that's fine too. Dante doesn't date his recruits. Even when they're no longer recruits. Even when they're in his bed most days. Dante will absolutely not budge on this, no matter how romantic or skillful Rafael becomes. Absolutely, probably… not.


(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Clumsy Kiss
mangas.description: With graduation on the horizon, pure-hearted Kumai has only one thing on his mind—getting a girlfriend! He hasn't been able to put himself out there due to a past heartbreak, but seeing all his fellow classmates beginning relationships, Kumai's decided it's time to take a step forward. He shoots his shot with a mutual over text, and to his delight, she agrees! They even plan to have a lunch date the very next day! But, uh...why did Sasahara, the hottest guy in school, show up instead? And why's he acting like they're dating...?

mangas.title: The Love Song of the Cracker Ball
mangas.titleNative: かんしゃく玉のラブソング
mangas.description:
Since they were kids, Takeo has looked after his next-door neighbor Wako. Though they are the same age, Wako was very sensitive to the cold and would often fall so sick he had to miss school, days at a time. But now, Wako is stronger than before, perhaps thanks to Takeo's incessant care... or perhaps because Wako has been fighting a silent battle every single day... Being next door neighbors with the love of your life, having them sneak into your room at night and sleep in your bed, walking to school together every day, and watching them date others while having to support them would make anybody stronger... Wako wants to stay by Takeo's side for as long as possible. He doesn't mind if Takeo finds a girlfriend and has mentally prepared himself for when Takeo finds a wife. But Wako's world flips upside down when Takeo says something unexpected like, "I could go for a guy, too."



(Source: Futekiya)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Didn't Mean to Fall in Love
mangas.titleNative: 恋をするつもりはなかった
mangas.description:
Inexperienced Yoshino is about to turn thirty. He's nearly given up on ever falling in love, let alone having decent sex—until one day he steels himself and goes to a gay bar. There he meets Rou, a charming, silver-haired college student who is everything that Yoshino isn't: mysterious, assertive, and experienced with both men and women. Yoshino finds himself hopelessly attracted to Rou, as their awkward courtship simmers into something more. But is it love?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Midsummer Night's Kiss
mangas.description: Cha Yoon and Kim Seo-Jin have known each other since childhood. And try as he might to avoid him, Seo-Jin always seems to end up being around Yoon, which only makes Yoon's feelings for him grow fonder. So much so that Yoon has to steal kisses from Seo-Jin every night! But now through high school and beyond, what will become of their whirlwind romance?

mangas.title: Unintentional Love Story
mangas.synonyms: ปั้นรักฉันด้วยใจนาย
mangas.description:
Won-Young gets unjustly suspended from work after getting caught up in a corruption scandal. But when he accidentally discovers the chairman's favorite artist Yoon Tae-Jun living under an alias, he is tasked with a tricky new mission. Could this be Won-Young's chance to get his job back?


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Behind the Scandal
mangas.description: Chan's always been the one to blend in, unlike his friend Dowoon the celebrity. From the States, Dowoon's always gotten attention wherever he goes for his height and his looks. It's really no surprise Chan fell for him at first sight… but he's been keeping his feelings a secret since high school. But then one day, just like that, Dowoon asks Chan to be his boyfriend. Bewildered, Chan tries to laugh it off as a joke but he can't seem to stop thinking about it. Then on the very same day, Chan comes across an article saying Dowoon is romantically involved with some other woman. Was Dowoon being serious about what he said, or was he simply playing a mean prank? Just what could his mixed signals mean? What's going on behind the scandal?

mangas.title: Two Tigers, Too Close
mangas.description: When brawler Kang Ji-Hwan is forced to transfer schools, the last thing he expects is to rely on the top student in class. But after accidentally tearing model-student Han Yu-Seong's uniform, and discovering the fierce tiger tattoo hidden on his back, Ji-Hwan offers a deal: he'll keep Yu-Seong's secret if Yu-Seong becomes his tutor. To push Ji-Hwan away, Yu-Seong turns up the heat with bold, intimate teasing… but the closer he gets, the more Ji-Hwan finds himself drawn in. Between hidden claws and rising tension, two boys with tiger hearts may be getting far too close for comfort.

mangas.title: The Dangerous Convenience Store
mangas.description:
Danger can come in many shapes and sizes, and the kind of danger Yeo Eui-joon has to deal with comes in the form of buff, brash, belligerent gangsters. He knew that working nights in a shifty neighborhood wouldn't be the safest job on the planet, but reality sure does exceed expectations. However, Eui-joon's days as the neighborhood punching bag look like they're coming to a close when Gunwoo steps into this small store. Gunwoo, gruff as he is, genuinely seems to care about Eui-joon's well-being, so it doesn't take long for Eui-joon to fall for this charismatic giant.



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Release Your Persona
mangas.description:
As a top-tier film star, Jae-Gyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheong-Rok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheong-Rok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jae-Gyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jae-Gyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing?


(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Deepest Confession
mangas.description:
Do-Hun has been secretly in love with Ye-Jun since middle school. They were always together through high school and college, and Do-Hun believed they would stay by each other's side forever. But one day, Ye-Jun suddenly got married, shattering Do-Hun's quiet hopes. Even after years of trying, he couldn't shake off his endless, frustrating one-sided love. Determined to move on, he decides to take a solo trip. Just as he's about to leave, he hears the news, Yejun is getting divorced after just three years of marriage. That very night, Ye-Jun unexpectedly shows up at Do-Hun's door and asks him...

"Can you take me on that trip?"

mangas.title: Nerd Project
mangas.description:
Luke is having a rough time in college, and his breakup with his girlfriend Stacy is not helping. This is all because of that nerdy stud, Andrew! If only Stacy didn't obsess over Andrew's dorky charms, then Luke wouldn't have had to break their relationship off! To make matters worse, Luke is then forced to live in the same dorm room as Andrew! But with nowhere else to go and no money to his name, Luke resolves to make it his project to befriend Andrew, whether the nerd likes it or not!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Hounds of Sisyphus
mangas.description:
The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Jazz for Two
mangas.description:
Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can't help but hope, maybe, just maybe...it's his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can't control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother's song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? "If I ever catch you playing the piano again...that'll be the end of you." And with that begins their story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: All 'Cause I'm Cute
mangas.description: To most people, being called "cute" is a compliment…but to U-Ju, it's just about the worst thing imaginable! Haunted by his adorability even in adulthood, U-Ju puts up a barrier pretending to be a badass so that he won't have to hear the dreaded 'C' word any longer. But this facade can only last so long when Koh Han-Gyeol asks him to prove just bad he can be - in the bedroom!

mangas.title: Too Close
mangas.description:
Tianyu Lin is the leader of the student council's Discipline department. Meanwhile, Ze Xu is a new first year senior high student. During a routine inspection, Tianyu discovers someone sleeping in the last row near the window. He walked over and have him a demerit. Who knew that this demerit would result in them giving their lives to each other...

(Source: WebComics)

mangas.title: Part-time Partner
mangas.description: Kyu-Ho has become smitten with new club member, Yun-Geon. Not only is Yun-Geon's face gorgeous but there's something about the way he stands his ground confidently. As the two classmates get to know each other, Kyu-Ho starts falling for Yun-Geon even harder. But when, out of the blue, Yun-Geon says, "you're not my style," to Kyu-Ho, the two start a love-hate relationship for the ages.

mangas.title: I Wanna Love You, Kiss You, Bite You
mangas.titleNative: 恋して キスして かんじゃいたい
mangas.description:
When Omega Akihiro and Alpha Reiya are pushed into an engagement arranged by their parents, they're doubtful they can ever be happy together. But as they get to know each other, their reluctance shifts into… something else. Their passion verges on obsession: Every moment apart is spent yearning to be together again, affecting their ability to concentrate on the rest of their studies and relationships. As their feelings grow, they will have to push past the fears and expectations they have for each other (and themselves) to discover a love they never thought possible.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: OmegaComplex
mangas.description:
Yoon-Woo and Tae-Gyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoon-Woo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he's an omega… and he's in love with Tae-Gyeom.



When a traumatic event leads Tae-Gyeom to despise all omegas, Yoon-Woo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Tae-Gyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoon-Woo's carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed…



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Paws & Claws
mangas.description:
Life sure is ruff, especially when you're Gyeon Hui-Seong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Hui-Seong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-Young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?


(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Tashiro-kun, Why're You Like This?
mangas.titleNative: 鯛代くん、君ってやつは。
mangas.description:
Is it because you're a member of the Manga Research Club?

Is it because you're obsessed with a certain rhythm game?

Is it because your family is filthy rich?

Is it because you're awkward af?



I don't know the reason, so tell me:

Tashiro-kun, why're you like this?



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: The Priest Dreaming Of A Dragon
mangas.titleNative: 神官的梦想是骑上千古恶龙
mangas.synonyms: The Priest's Dream Is to Ride the Evil Dragon of Eternity
mangas.description:
Ten years ago, an evil dragon left a message saying that he would take away the princess after a decade unless he was given ten tons of gold. When the kingdom fails to meet the condition, the dragon swoops in and snatches the beautiful, golden-haired princess—Or priest. The dragon has actually kidnapped Father Ivor, who willingly put himself up to escape the stuffy and celibate life within the church. And as if freedom isn't sweet enough, Ivor now has himself a handsome and rich dragon-man! All that's left is to trick his captor into keeping him by his side forever...!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Rogue Prince Is Secretly an Omega
mangas.synonyms: Hiding That The Damn Prince Is An Omega
mangas.description:
Prince Etienne de Frederick was born a dominant omega, but in a world where omegas can't become the emperor, he must pretend to be a beta due to the empress's greed. When his childhood friend, Grand Duke Rishar von Eckhart, returns after three years as a war hero, there's no time to share a happy reunion as Rishar is a dominant alpha and his rival in the fight for the throne. The two continue to maintain a precarious relationship until, one day, Etienne has a sudden heat cycle, and Rishar finds out the truth. "Etienne de Frederick. You were... an omega?"



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Season 1 is R15 while Season 2 is R19.

mangas.title: Ore no Kiss dake Oboete yo
mangas.titleNative: 俺のキスだけ覚えてよ
mangas.description: Nao is a popular guy who is always surrounded by girls. Kosei is like an oasis of the school and is kind to everyone. For some reason the two popular people in the class gets close to each other!?? But Nao keeps on kissing random people. And love is a topic that Kosei is still not good at. An exciting love story that deepens over kisses.

mangas.title: I'm Yours, Blood and Soul
mangas.description:
Fellatio in the bathroom and a wild night of sex after clubbing? What more could anyone ask for? Well, a meal for starters. For a vampire like Bokhee, that'd be blood from a living human. Too bad he hooked up with Mariam, an undead demon. So, what do you get when you combine unquenchable thirst and deviant appetites?



A sexual fantasy of epic proportions from the creator of "The Baker on the First Floor."



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

mangas.title: Futari Hyakkei: Kaze no Owari Haru no Hajimari
mangas.titleNative: ふたり百景 ～風邪のおわり春のはじまり～
mangas.description: Ryou, who is taciturn and Keisuke, who is always energetic. This is the story of the two polar opposite lovers who live together. Keisuke is down with a bad cold and lost his voice became unable to talk to to Ryou. For the first time, together in a quiet room, Ryou realized how important the words that Keisuke regularly says to him are. And that's the words of sweet love.

mangas.title: Aitai Jou to Usagi no Yamai
mangas.titleNative: 愛たい情とうさぎの病
mangas.description: At the Engetsuza Shrine, there's a magical tale that's been passed down through each generation about what happens when a male descendant falls in love. The priest's son, Kounosuke, is a very ordinary high school student. Every day he takes care of his childhood friend, Shu, a relax and laid-back guy. When suddenly one morning, Kounosuke realizes he's in love with Shu… and a strange change to his body starts to occur.

mangas.title: The Farthest Love in the World
mangas.titleNative: 世界でいちばん遠い恋
mangas.description:
Ayumu Isuzu lives in a world without sound. He may not hear the world around him, but he knows many things: that "thank you" and "sorry" look just the same in sign language and that he can't just leave this musician where he found him, all beat up like that. What can Touka and his violin bring into Ayumu's life? And what can Ayumu bring to Touka's music?



(Source: Manga Planet)

mangas.title: Ookami-kun wa Hanasanai
mangas.titleNative: オオカミくんははなさない
mangas.synonyms: I Won't Let Go of Ookami-kun
mangas.description:
Several months after becoming lovers, Usami and Shirou are very happy, but...?!



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Lion Gotoki no Kuni Kara
mangas.titleNative: ライオン如きの国から
mangas.description: A boy-meets-boy story about an imaginative boy who loves animals and a Maasai exchange student in Japan!

The weather forecast didn't say it was going to rain but Lee Mokhwa knew it would, that's only one of the things he knew was going to happen. No, he can't see the future, he's actually stuck in a time loop, reliving December 24th endlessly. The only person besides himself who seems to be aware of the repeated time is Choi Gyun, the childhood friend he drifted apart from, but he's avoiding the topic. Gyun must know something he doesn't, he could even be the cause of the time loop, Mokhwa is determined to make him break the chain.

mangas.title: Asatte ni Kiss
mangas.description: Akihisa Hase was bullied for being an otaku, but the chance to change his appearance and start anew in a different school appeared when his father had to transfer. Going around the school, he found a volume of his favorite manga and got so entranced he didn't notice the owner of the manga, Yuu Onozuka, was right there and saw him on full otaku mode. Akihisa thought he had blown his cover, but Yuu was unexpectedly nice to him and they soon became friends. All was well until Akihisa became puzzled by the fact Yuu would randomly kiss him without saying anything.

mangas.title: Deadly Sugar Syrup
mangas.titleNative: 猛毒シュガーシロップ
mangas.description: Mizuki is a modern-day vampire who lives with some debauched eating habits, controlling his bloodlust with a bodily fluid that's a little whiter than blood. He always finds his meals outside his personal social circle, but when he loses control of his bloodlust, he accidentally assaults Sakura, a younger student from his college...! Mizuki's reason and instinct waver as he suddenly discovers a "delicious delicacy." This is an exceptionally addictive debut comic from Machi Suehiro!!

mangas.title: Naked Color
mangas.description:
A florist, intrigued by the vision of a beautiful- yet guarded artist, starts a friends with benefits relationship with him.



Note: The chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Summer of You
mangas.synonyms: You are in the blue summer
mangas.description:
Chiharu Saeki and Wataru Toda are two high school students who share a common hobby: They love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends, until one day, when Chiharu confesses his love for Wataru. Wataru says that Chiharu's confession doesn't bother him, and the boys continue throughout their summer, going to pilgrimages to see film spots from their favorite movies. But the more time he spends with Chiharu, Wataru realizes that he may not only be as unaffected by Chiharu's confession as he claimed to be, but those feelings may also be mutual…


(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: This Wolf Is Not Scary
mangas.titleNative: オオカミくんはこわくない
mangas.description:
In a world where half-humans who evolved distinctly from animals reside, a tough and hardheaded wolf named Shirou is often misunderstood due to his gaudy appearance. Shirou is in love with Usami, a rabbit with eye-catching brown skin. Though Shirou being a carnivore has Usami on edge, after the wolf saves him from a pervert, Usami shows a vulnerable side to Shirou that no one else can see. But then, Shirou starts to want to mate with Usami!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Jealousy Blinds Love
mangas.description:
Once a child prodigy pianist, Shion Kirino is now a burnt-out, bitter shell of himself, lost in grief over his mother's passing and his own dying passion toward the musical career that had defined his connection to her. When he's approached by Kei Takase—a talented younger colleague who professes his admiration for Kirino—he ends up inviting him home for sex, intending on toying with his feelings.



When Takase isn't deterred by Kirino's abrasive exterior, Kirino finds that he cannot deny Takase's unwavering devotion... But practicing piano together and celebrating Takase's successes also stirs up Kirino's own insecurities and distorted sense of jealousy. After a lifetime of loneliness, can he find salvation in Takase without dragging him down?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Tomorrow, Make Me Yours
mangas.titleNative: 明日、きみのものにして
mangas.description:
Yuki is a quiet, average boy who falls head over heels for the confident and cool Hayato in his new high school class. The two hit it off with an easygoing friendship, but when Yuki realizes that a female classmate has a crush on his friend, he tries to put some distance between them. As his feelings come to a head, he finally confesses to Hayato... who confesses right back!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Ex-tra Hot Neighbor
mangas.description:
Finding the perfect guy isn't easy, but looks like Eunseo just hit the jackpot. Seung-hyuk's a handsome, hot hunk with a pretty face that anyone would fall in love with. How could you resist someone like that, especially if they feel so much like Mr. Right? Well, as with any good thing, there is a small catch. Apparently, Seung-hyuk is a friend's ex-boyfriend. Not just any friend, but Eunseo's new roommate, Minjae. What a fix. Eunseo wants to keep on meeting this hottie, but hurting his friend's feelings isn't right, right? Even if the hottie lives next door and they literally run into each other all the time? Right?


(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Koisaku Potager
mangas.description: Yui, a young chef, is secretly in love with Tetsu, the guy that works as a farmer in the neighborhood. But secrets can't be secrets forever, right?

mangas.title: The Beast That Yearns To Be Tamed
mangas.description:
Arata's a college student working as a "big brother for rent."
One day, he meets his new client, Junta, who looks like a total tough guy!!
Arata wonders if this is some sort of trap to get his money, but what Junta wants is for someone to pat him on the head.
Seeing someone this hot go bright red and be so vulnerable is turning Arata on... Junta's just so adorable... what's going on here!!?



(Source: Renta!)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: I'm the Only One Who Knows Your Body
mangas.titleNative: 俺しか知らないカラダ
mangas.synonyms: A Body That Only Knows Me | Oreshika Shiranai Karada
mangas.description:
Will you make love to me? Just once? Ryohei is a guy who cannot commit. He is tired of being asked by the people he sleeps with, "Do you actually like me!?" On the day of their high school graduation, the smartest guy in their grade, Yuma, asks Ryohei for a favor. "Two guys? He can't be serious." Ryohei can't believe what Yuma's asking him to do, but he is intrigued by Yuma's offer of "no strings attached." It's Ryohei's first time with a guy, and he finds himself growing curious as he watches Yuma's sensitive body twist and turn. Even if he doesn't say it in words, Ryohei can tell Yuma has deep feelings for him, which triggers Ryohei's assertive side...!

A tantalizing story about a devoted bottom who awakens something in a stubborn top.

mangas.title: The Degrees Between Us
mangas.description:
Dojin and Yeonwoo are in the same homeroom. Yeonwoo is the class rep and a bright, diligent kid. Dojin looks intimidating but he's actually just misunderstood. For some odd reason, Dojin has been becoming more and more aware of this strange, sprightly kid in his class. As fate would have it, they bump into each other after school one day. Yeonwoo describes to Dojin his most pressing problem in life: he's bored. Dojin makes Yeonwoo a promise that he'll be the freshness and excitement in his life whenever he needs to feel something new. But when Dojin innocently grazes Yeonwoo, there seems to be an electric warmth that shocks him. As these two grow closer and closer, to what degree will their intimacy develop? What will this warmth between them become?


(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Zero Day Attack
mangas.description: A skilled hacker, Jin Kang, falls into a broker's trap and fails his mission. Barely escaping with his life, he can't bring himself to face VX, a genius hacker and team member he greatly respects. Instead, Jin Kang chooses to go into hiding. By day, he works at a café, while at night, he quietly plots his revenge. However, his routine takes an unexpected twist when a mysterious and striking customer, Seo Yi-Yeon, enters the café and makes bold advances toward him. Baffled by Yi-Yeon's unexpected attention, Jin Kang now finds his plans for starting to go awry…

mangas.title: Netkama PUNCH!!!
mangas.description:
Netkama – a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong's gaming career in "Arcadia" a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of "Arcadia" forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Mistaken Lover
mangas.synonyms: ミステイク・ラバーズ
mangas.description:
A love triangle is never straightforward!



As long-time best friends, Jin-Geon has always been there to listen to Hui-Seo ramble about his latest crushes -- and cry about his most recent heartbreaks. So when Hui-Seo asks Jin-Geon to fill in for him at work and make sure no one steals away the adorable coworker he's been eyeing, Jin-Geon readily agrees. There's just one problem: that coworker, Dong-Yeon, is totally Jin-Geon's type! And he doesn't exactly seem to mind Jin-Geon's not-so-platonic advances, either...



When it comes to friendship versus love, which one will Jin-Geon choose?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: This Wonderful Season With You
mangas.titleNative: 素晴らしい季節に優しい君と
mangas.description:
Enoki is practically the poster-boy for what a typical nerd looks like: short and slight, complete with big round glasses and social awkwardness. His main hobby is playing video games, and he's used to not having many friends at school. Then, he meets Shirataki, a former member of the baseball club, and his exact opposite; tall, muscular, and sporty. Despite their many differences, the spark of friendship between the two boys begins to grow into something more...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Musebinake, Junjou
mangas.description:
Bartender Yuki has a secret that he can't tell anyone: he's a beastman. He's in love with the stuck-up Godai, a regular at the bar who hunts beastmen. If his secret gets out, then he won't be able to see Godai again, let alone love him, but after Godai gets kicked out of his apartment, he decides to live with Yuki?!



(Source: Libre, translated)

mangas.title: Thoroughbred wa Nabikanai
mangas.titleNative: サラブレッドはなびかない
mangas.description:
Playboy Shishidou is seen as an enemy by the thoroughbred honor student Shiba. However, it could be said they were close friends before.
When he reached puberty, a desire to submit Shiba grew inside Shishidou, causing their relationship to turn sour.



Since then, they haven't being close at all, but the Shiba who's preached Shishidou about his relationships with women, becomes his partner to let his lust out...?!

mangas.title: Thoroughbred wa Yuruganai
mangas.titleNative: サラブレッドはゆるがない
mangas.description: The thoroughbred, Shiba Toshimasa, and the lion, Shishidou Ouga, are childhood friends and now lovers. But, as the son of a good family, Shiba faces the talk about an engagement to his thoroughbred friend, Touma Rei. Although he asked Touma to reject the engagement, Shishidou finds out about it...?!

mangas.title: It's Just a Dream...Right?!
mangas.description:
Jeong-O Han was just expecting to take on a part-time job as an assistant. What he didn't expect was working inside people's dreams with a cute, but grumpy shaman named I-Beom. And he certainly didn't expect I-Beom to be cursed by a nightmare seedling, with uncontrollable sexual arousal that can only be tamed by acting out his desires!



I-Beom may not be too sure about Jeong-O, but with his prickly personality, he has no one to turn to for help. But luckily for him, Jeong-O is always in a giving mood...



(Source: Tapas, edited)



Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mister-sama ni wa Nakasarenai
mangas.titleNative: ミスター様には泣かされない
mangas.description: Kaito Hibiya is a "fairly handsome" university student. "Of course I'd also be popular at university!" ...is what he thought, but because of the former star Jun Tamaki, he's humiliatingly in second place! In order to make Tamaki lose, Kaito entered the Mister Contest, but for some reason he was kissed by Tamaki?! Even though he's the most irritating partner in the world, he's constantly super cool and inevitably makes Kaito's heart throb. Could this actually be... love?

mangas.title: Seventeen Syrups
mangas.titleNative: セブンティーンシロップス
mangas.description:
A dizzyingly sweet urge he is feeling for the first time. Kentaro, a second-year high school boy, meets Mizuki, a popular senior on campus. One day, Kentaro sees Mizuki with a girl in the infirmary, Kentaro catches Mizuki afterwards and impulsively kisses him....... A possessive junior x a playboy senior!



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Summertime
mangas.description:
Yeo Eunho and Cha Dohyeon have been friends all their lives. After 19 years, Eunho seems to have a good grasp on Dohyeon, even knowing that his "perfect" image at school is a façade. But what Eunho is absolutely oblivious to is the fact that Dohyeon has had an obsessive crush on him for years. Though Dohyeon has been able to keep it a secret in order to slowly ease his way into Eunho's heart, the sudden arrival of a new student named Kwon Yihyeon throws a wrench into his plans. What will Dohyeon do to keep Eunho by his side? And will Eunho ever realize his best friend's feelings for him?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Chotto Matou yo, Harutora-kun
mangas.titleNative: ちょっと待とうよ、春虎くん
mangas.description: Ever since it became known to the people around him that he is gay, Sui, a high school student, hides his expression with a mask and plays a character who is bullied in the student dormitory. He advances to the second year and shares a room with a new student named Harutora. Sui is attracted to Harutora's straightforward personality and the way he devotes himself to his club activities...?

mangas.title: Can't Get Caught! XXX
mangas.description: Some people are just drawn together…literally. Eun Se-eun has never gotten over his first love and eternal crush, the charismatic and effervescent Seo Jeongwoo. Unable to forget him, Se-eun decides to take things into his own hands - by making them the main characters of his hit BL series, Can't Get Caught! XXX. But after returning to his hometown, Se-eun's fantasy just might become reality when he comes face to face with the man of his dreams (and drawings) once again! As the two begin to reignite their friendship from years gone by, Se-eun must do whatever he can to ensure Jeongwoo doesn't find out what he's been up to. He can run, he can hide...but he can't get caught!

mangas.title: Yume nara Doko made Yurusaremasu ka?
mangas.titleNative: 夢ならどこまで許されますか?
mangas.synonyms: How Far Is My Dream Allowed?
mangas.description:
"I've killed someone, please arrest me!"



...is what he said as he rushed into the police station, but it was all just a dream. 27-year-old Kaga Mitsuki has just done something unspeakably embarrassing. Later, Kaga goes to the police station to apologize and is greeted by Seto Kenya, a young police officer who is kind and has great taste. Moreover, Seto tells Kaga, "If you have another nightmare and feel anxious, please come see me!" and they become closer and closer friends... At this rate, Kaga won't be able to resist falling for Seto! From then on, Kaga's nightmares turn into erotic dreams of Seto…



An erotic and heart-wrenching romantic comedy BL featuring a young, dog-like police officer and a corporate slave!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Yi Ke Zhichi
mangas.description: The unspeakable secrets between a handsome dentist and his patient's classmate.

mangas.title: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru App
mangas.titleNative: 運命の人と出逢える恋するアプリ
mangas.synonyms: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru Apuri
mangas.description: One day at school, a friend shows Hiroto Kyono a new app called "Meet your Soulmate". However, Kyono is indifferent to love and doesn't believe in fortune-telling apps...until Kyono meets a guy on the train who looks exactly like how the app described his soulmate! Could this guy really be his soulmate? How can Kyono close the distance between them so they can become friends? And then something more?

mangas.title: Seaside Stranger: Umibe no Étranger
mangas.description:
"There's nothing wrong with liking another guy."


To be in the arms of the person I love... I thought that was an unobtainable dream......... On an island off the coast of Okinawa, two young men meet on a beach. Shun Hashimoto is gay and aspires to be a novelist. He is interested in Mio Chibana, a somber high school student, and starts to flirt with him. Day by day, the two of them grow closer, but then, suddenly, Mio decides to leave the island. Three years later, Mio returns and approaches Shun with the words, "I've thought about it for the past three years. I like you, Shun, even if you're a guy." However, when faced with the prospect of finally becoming lovers with Mio, Shun cannot take the first step towards commitment...


This is a tantalizing love story about a gay novelist and a younger part-time worker. It's a manga that will touch and purify your heart.


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Sugar Dog Life
mangas.titleNative: シュガードッグライフ
mangas.description:
Sakuraba is a college student, though you'd never know it, with his short height and baby face. Certainly police officer Amasawa thought Sakuraba was a minor, and nearly booked him for being out too late after he was returning from a drinking party. But there's something oddly familiar about him, and the two strike up an odd relationship...



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Spooky Love Tale of Gongchan Seol
mangas.description:
This is a mysterious romance between horror novelist Seol Gong-Chan and his downstairs' neighbor.



Ghosts aren't real... right? Gong-Chan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is until he meets Young-Min, a man haunted by the supernatural specters in Gong-Chan's novel! With everything around him suddenly turning into an eerie mess, is Gong-Chan's growing love for Young-Min the reason why his heart is racing? Or is it the bloody ghost behind him?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Far From Romance
mangas.description: Tono Arata has lived in the same sleepy seaside town his entire life. Employed at a small IT firm, each day seems to blend into the next. Yet his quiet life is shaken up when his company announces they've hired a new employee–a gorgeous blue-eyed Brit named Lewis! At first Tono is taken aback by his foreign colleague's touchy-feely mannerisms and blunt manner of speaking, but it quickly becomes obvious to him that there's something unspoken behind those blue eyes that follow him around the office. So when Lewis suddenly asks if Tono remembers him, he's understandably thrown for a loop. Just who is this hunky ex-pat and how does he know Tono?!

mangas.title: Restart After Coming Back Home
mangas.titleNative: リスタートはただいまのあとで
mangas.synonyms: Risutaato wa Tadaima no Ato de
mangas.description:
Hot-headed Kozuka Mitsuomi left his home in the country to try to lead a sophisticated life in Tokyo. Unfortunately, at age 25, he returns home in disgrace, having been fired from his job. As he tries to rediscover himself in the rural area he once called home, he meets Kumai Yamato, a man about his age who was adopted into his community while Mitsuomi was away. The sweet and even-tempered Yamato is hiding his own pain, and as the two men connect, they start a journey together.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Restart After Growing Hungry
mangas.titleNative: リスタートはおなかをすかせて
mangas.description:
Mitsuomi and Yamato fell for each other beneath the endless, unchanging countryside sky. Now, as the days go by in the small town where Mitsuomi was born and raised, and the foundling Yamato made his home, the two men are searching for the shape of their own happiness.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Suspected of Mutual Love
mangas.description:
Akihito Kuze used to have such a radiant smile; his face would glow and the warmth of his grin was contagious. But ever since moving into his parents' manor, that gleaming smile is nowhere to be seen. What's more, every night, there are shady men coming and going, in and out of Akihito's home... Gotaro Sumeragi is the handsome young patrol officer assigned to put an end to any vices occurring in the Manor. And for this purpose, Sumeragi's crafty Superior Officer arranges for Gotaro to move right into the wolf's den: the Kuze Manor! Will things become easier for Gotaro now that his prime subject is quite literally in the next room? Or will cohabiting makes things a little more... complicated? And... will Gotaro ever be able to see Akihito's warm smile?

(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Oh My Hero!
mangas.description:
Inui works part-time as a tokusatsu hero in shows for children when he meets the Mugita family, a father and his son who have a lot of love for one particular ranger. As the Mugita family is always watching his shows with great passion, he gets interested in them and is happy when they invite him to their house. But while he enjoys spending time in their warm company, Inui is troubled because some desires in him awake when he thinks about Daddy-Mugita. Another story included is Aogeba Koishi, where a senpai and kohai from the middle school basketball club meet again as adults.



Note: Includes the one-shot "Aogeba Koishi (仰げば恋し)" and one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Delinquent Daddy and Tender Teacher: Basking in Sunlight
mangas.titleNative: 元ヤンパパ と ヒツジ先生 陽だまり
mangas.synonyms: Moto Yankee Papa to Hitsuji-sensei: Natsu-hen
mangas.description: Hitsuji and Hatoyama are officially a couple! And with Hatoyama's young son Hinata to look after, the three of them have started to settle into a new kind of family life. However, these lovebirds are about to learn that relationships aren't all smooth sailing. They'll soon be tested by awkward family introductions, unexpected illness, and a misunderstanding or two. But love will always win out in the end…right?

mangas.title: Delinquent Daddy and Tender Teacher
mangas.titleNative: 元ヤンパパとヒツジ先生
mangas.description: In high school, studious Hitsuji had a secret crush on one of his guy friends–a friendly delinquent named Hatoyama–but never confessed. Years later, Hitsuji is a slightly anxious but responsible adult who found his calling as an elementary school teacher. One of his young students is upset with a sloppy and nonconformist dad–who turns out to be Hatoyama! When Hitsuji learns that Hatoyama is struggling to raise his son as a single parent, Hitsuji helps him out, first as a teacher and then as a friend who can teach Hatoyama how to clean his home and cook actual vegetables. As the men grow closer, some of Hitsuji's anxieties begin to melt around the welcoming (and grateful) Hatoyama. What will become of the feelings Hitsuji used to harbor for his first love?

mangas.title: Motomete Yamanai
mangas.description:
One day, inconscient Tatsumi came to the cafe where Tsuburaya works. Their relationship was just supposed to be customer and staff but Tsuburaya ends up coming in and out of Tatsumi's house after meeting by chance during the cafe's regular holiday.


After spending time with Tatsumi, Tsuburaya got to know him more and he later starts to be aware of that certain emotion…

mangas.title: Mother's Spirit
mangas.titleNative: マザース・スピリット
mangas.description:
University employee Ryouichirou is ordered by the Chairman to take in an exchange student.



That exchange student, Qaltaqa, is a native from a developing country who can't understand Japanese!! Though he is a warrior of his tribe and a man of great beauty, seeing him afraid of the phone and the TV, and even the toilet, Ryouichirou gets fed up…



But while being called "Ryouichirou" in such a clumsy manner, he has a change of heart!?

mangas.title: Mihanada Pectolite
mangas.titleNative: みはなだペクトライト
mangas.description: Kurihara is always in second place in his year. He is always behind Kawase, the class representative and the top, much to his frustration. Adding his parents' pressure to that, he always felt insecure and invalidated around Kawase. Every time exams are around the corner, Kurihara frequents the school clinic due to his weak physical disposition caused by his small appetite. There, Kawase chances upon him and is made aware of their apparent rivalry. Since then, Kawase can't seem to stop thinking about Kurihara.

mangas.title: Me wa Kuchi Hodo ni Koi to Iu
mangas.titleNative: 目は口ほどに恋という
mangas.synonyms: Me wa Kuchi Hodoni Koi to iu
mangas.description:
Having moved schools frequently throughout his childhood, Fujino has perfected the art of the false smile. Now his fifth school, his well-mannered smile is safely helping him make new friends, but one day, on the school roof, he finds a scarred boy sleeping there. That boy is the "Mad Dog", the student all his classmates are afraid of. While Fujino is observing him, the boy opens his eyes, and then…



A youthful love story between an unsociable yankee and a 'good boy' honour student.

mangas.title: Koi ni mo Naranai.
mangas.description: "That's the first time I've seen crying so beautiful." Tajima finds himself taken in by Koga's crying face, but little did he know, the reason behind those tears was the death of his goldfish at the hand of Tajima's cat (Buuta). While figuring out how to apologize for that, he stumbles across a secret of Koga's.

mangas.title: Koi da Ai da wa Sateoite
mangas.titleNative: 恋だ愛だはさておいて
mangas.description: On the way home from work, Okazaki Taichi finds a man named Fuji, sleeping on a bench one day. Okazaki ends up bringing Fuji to his house, and somehow, he ends up on top of him, and they become friends with benefits. It's the start of an erotic BL between a heterosexual salaryman and a lewd bartender.

mangas.title: Dress Him Up
mangas.description: Yeonwoo's plaid sense of style is a lost cause, but a Stylist for Hire ad just might save his social and romantic life. Designer Jaehee starts the makeover project of a lifetime, but can he transform this walking fashion no-no into a runway model for the graduation show —without falling for his handsome charms?!

mangas.title: Love at First Bite
mangas.titleNative: 君と美味しい愛のコトノハ
mangas.synonyms: Kimi to Oishii Ai no Kotoba
mangas.description:
When Makoto is practicing his professions of love in the park one night, Shiro happens to hear the words "I love you" while passing by. As a monster that consumes words, Shiro finds Makoto's particularly tasty and the two soon find themselves living together.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Kimi to no Dogfight
mangas.titleNative: きみとのドッグファイト
mangas.description: College boy Haruno goes to meet a person he's gotten to know through an online game. He goes expecting for a cute girl, but instead he meets a guy and not just any guy but a very popular ikemen guy that goes to the same college as he does. Maybe this meeting is their fate.

mangas.title: Kimi no Tabegoro
mangas.description: Ayato is the son of a famous and rich househould and has good looks, but has no girlfriend. Instead, he has always been very attached to Kanada, his childhood friend. Very soon comes the much anticipated love confession from Ayato. How will Kanada handle this development?

mangas.title: Every Time We Touch, I Hear That Sound
mangas.titleNative: 君にはふれると鳴るとこがあって
mangas.synonyms: Kimi ni wa Fureru to Naru Toko ga Atte
mangas.description: Touji is an average high school student who is terrible at dealing with people and struggles with physical contact. On one rainy day, all of Touji's struggles come to a head when he encounters Itsuki Yato, a fellow classmate who touches him casually even when they first meet. Even though Touji isn't great at socializing, Itsuki goes out of his way to talk to him and spend time with him. Gradually, Touji starts to want to learn more about Itsuki...

mangas.title: Kimi ga Shuuchakueki
mangas.description: Saki, a university student, meets an older man, Yukimura, at a gay bar he happened to walk into. Saki, who is straight, is flustered when Yukimura suddenly speaks to him, but he just hands him his business card and leaves. Saki had no intention of contacting him, but by chance they end up having dinner together. On the day of the meeting, Saki quickly confesses that he is not gay and is relaxed, but... We bring you the bitter love of adults brought together by curiosity.

mangas.title: Kimi Ga Kawaii Riyuu
mangas.description:
Third year of middle school, fifteen years old. At this age, the mind id full of lewd things. To my surprise, most of the lewdness was done with my best friend.



(Source: yaoiotaku.com)

mangas.title: Engraved on My Heart
mangas.description: Thanks to the scar on my face and I guess my "vibe," I always thought I, Qi Shi (Hiro Qi), would end up forever alone. That is until Nan Jue (Duke Nan) made his way into my life! He's the classmate I saved from bullies (which led to my scar) and it turns out this cheerful, friendly guy works as a wellness guru. Nan Jue's offered to improve my self-image, and help me land my dream job and make new friends. He's even moved in with me! But I'm starting to learn that even the most perfect smile could be hiding a secret...

mangas.title: Living With Him
mangas.description:
Ryota Natsukawa is starting university and he suddenly finds out that his roommate is going to be his childhood friend, Kazuhito Tanaka. Despite Kazuhito's picture-perfect looks, he doesn't have a girlfriend. Ryota is curious about why this is and attempts to point out his faults from a girlfriend's point of view. However, as Ryota gets to know more about Kazuhito, their relationship changes. Will they just remain friends? Or will their relationship blossom into something more?



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: After We Gazed at the Starry Sky
mangas.titleNative: 星空を見つめたそのあとで
mangas.synonyms: We Will Look Up at the Stars, and Then...
mangas.description: It all started with a job. When wheelchair-bound Subaru Miyazawa decides to visit the planetarium after finishing its brochure design, he unexpectedly bumps into Togo Awase, the photographer involved in the project. Although he'd admired his work, he never thought he'd see the man himself—or that Togo would go so far as to carry Subaru down the steps to view the starry night sky up close. Subaru could only hope they would meet again...

mangas.title: Star and Hedgehog
mangas.description:
Outgoing college student Ikumi heads home for the summer, where he meets Harukiyo, a shy gardener with a soft spot for house plants. Despite seeming totally resistant to Ikumi's charms, Harukiyo eventually admits his attraction to Ikumi, and Ikumi is surprised to discover he feels the same way about Harukyo! At summer's end, the pair embark on their first long-distance relationship... Once reunited, Ikumi and Harukiyo stumble together through the early stages of their newfound romance, tripping over the stark differences in their personalities. Can a blossoming love between a shining star and a prickly hedgehog go the distance?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Only the Stars Know
mangas.description:
After suffering a loss both at work and in his personal life, college student Sora feels crushed. A stiff night walk to process his thoughts leads him to a discovery: a handsome man sitting in a secluded spot in the park that's perfect for stargazing. Sora and the man start chatting, and he feels comfortable enough to start talking about his problems–but he's still stunned when the man kisses him! Although Sora initially writes off the night as an unexpected connection with a stranger, this isn't the last he'll see of the man who stares up at the sky.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Depth of Field
mangas.description:
One day after school, Hayakawa decides to stop by his usual secret spot on the roof, where he meets none other than Konno.

Konno is known throughout the school as being hard to approach and intimidating. Some have even called him scary looking. However, when the lens of his camera is focused on its subject, the once scary Konno becomes like any other high schooler enjoying their life.

Respect, envy, jealousy, and even an inferiority complex… All these feeling culminate inside of Hayakawa as the two get closer to one another. I mean, how could they not? After all, Konno has everything Hayakawa could ever want. Who wouldn't be conflicted with such a guy by their side?

The unlikely love story between two ordinary high school students who's paths coincidently cross, comes to life in Enjo's Depth of Field.

mangas.title: Sunny Orange
mangas.titleNative: 陽だまりのオレンジ
mangas.description:
"Can I come here again?"


Nanami is a first-year high school student who hasn't been doing good at school. At the art-prep room, he meets Takanashi -a senior who has placed 3rd in the national-level mock tests- and forces him to help with his studies.



Nanami, who was initially uncomfortable with seniors who had a neat appearance and an atmosphere that kept people away, starts to feel attracted to the gentle, caring appearance and the smile that Takanashi rarely shows in public. ──This relationship has a deadline. What will Nanami, someone who wants to know more about his senior's heart, do?



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

mangas.title: Golden Sparkle
mangas.titleNative: ゴールデンスパークル
mangas.description: Himari Uehara, for a first-year high school boy, knows very little about sex. Without his father at home and having skipped health in middle school, Himari is only confused when he wakes up with his boxers a mess and has no one for advice. Luckily, Himari has Gaku Asada, a new friend from high school who offers to teach him everything and more he missed out in health class.

mangas.title: Roommates
mangas.description:
Kisub is Jinwoo's slacker friend - and secret crush. So when Kisub asks to crash at his place, his heart tingles to be near him everyday. But as the short stay turns into permanent mooch, how long can Jinwoo keep his true feelings under wraps and hold back from confessing?



(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: The Two Lions
mangas.description:
Opposites attract in this friends-to-lovers Boy's love tale!



To escape his reputation as a misunderstood loner, Leo attends a university far from home. His attempts at making friends aren't going so well until he meets someone who recognizes him—friendly and laidback Junpei, who went to the same high school as he did. Can Leo break out of his shell and navigate his new friendship as it grows into something more?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Furimuite Yukino-chan!
mangas.titleNative: ふり向いて、ゆきのちゃん!
mangas.description:
"Have you possibly fallen in love with me?"

"Yukino-chan" helped Arata who wasn't able to attend school. He frequently talks with her on social media despite not knowing what she looks like. Turns out, 'she's' a guy?! Despite being confused, this feeling of love won't stop growing towards Yukino-san who's kind even in real life."

Someday, if Arata's feelings go overboard and a confession slips out... will Yukino-san look back?!

An earnest love that doesn't stop even when hurt.

mangas.title: Mastering the Secretary
mangas.description:
Secretary Han has been working for the same family for years, so he watched the young master of the house grow up and has always doted on him. But now his beloved young master has taken a special interest in him. Unable to say no to his beautiful young master, they start a steamy sexual relationship. However, Secretary Han is in for an unexpected surprise because his master is going to show him what it's really like to be under him.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Dasadanan
mangas.description: Kang Chan and Seyeon have been close friends since they were young after being introduced by their parents. After entering high school, Seyeon suddenly received a confession from Kang Chan and became aware of Kang Chan since then. Meanwhile, Naeun is displeased with their relationship. The trivial and noisy story of their love triangle and those around them...

mangas.title: Darling, Iikagen ni Shiyagare
mangas.titleNative: ダーリン、いいかげんにしやがれ
mangas.description:
About the relationship of the country-raised yankee (delinquent) Haiji Nakata and the young and innocent Kokoro Sakurazaka, who is half Italian and half Japanese.

Kokoro arrives at Haiji's village in Japan and soon breaks the ice with the villagers due to his friendly personality. Haiji looks out for the touchy-feely Kokoro who lacks life-skills despite his lucky financial situation, and soon Haiji can't help but take care of the gentle Kokoro. When Haiji finds out what Kokoro's real reason was to come to Japan, however…

mangas.title: Starting With a Lie
mangas.description: To avoid accepting two simultaneous confessions from Xia Yiyi and Qiu Mang, Tang Tang told them he wasn't into girls. Due to the two girls' unwillingness to back down, they told Tang Tang that he must show them evidence that this was true. To cover up his own lies, Tang Tang decided to seek help from his friend Chen Qingye so they could put on an act to help Tang Tang get away from the unwanted confessions. Though constantly showing restraint, Chen Qingye always ended up accepting Tang Tang's propositions.

mangas.title: Come to Hand
mangas.titleNative: カム トゥ ハンド
mangas.description: Overworked schoolteacher, Miharu, collapses onto the icy roads. Along comes local tattoo artist, Arashi to save the day. However, it being Miharu's first time seeing so many tattoo's up close, he unintentionally makes some insensitive comments. To apologize, Miharu goes to his shop to apologize, where he realizes just how kind Arashi is. He feels comfortable chatting to someone of the same age, but also feels like something doesn't seem right...

mangas.title: Faded Picture Scroll
mangas.description: Years ago, Izumo saved a child named Ryuta from a youkai. After promising to return and adventure with him in the future, Izumo leaves Ryuta and forgets about his promise. By chance, Ryuta meets Izumo again. Over the years, Ryuta never forgot about Izumo and trained hard to prepare for their adventures. Izumo claims to have no memory of his promise or Ryuta, but that doesn't stop Ryuta from embarking on a journey with Izumo!

mangas.title: Asagao wa Yoru kara Saku
mangas.titleNative: あさがおは夜から咲く
mangas.description:
"The boy I love is dead."

Yuugen is a sickly, high school boy with zero motivation in life. He avoids interacting with his classmates, and lives an utterly bland and colorless life. However, there's one boy who always calls out to him every single day. That's Hideto, upbeat and outgoing, loved by anyone and everyone. To this bright individual, Yuugen harbors feelings that he has not told anyone. However, one day, Hideto suddenly passes away. While still grappling with the reality of the situation, Yuugen discovers that the ghost of Hideto has appeared before him. Bound to this world by unfinished business, he enlists the help of Yuugen to help him pass on, but…!

mangas.title: All Night Long
mangas.description: "Why don't you try it out?" These were the words Akashi Noboru's friends uttered to him when he found out that a school hottie, Yagi Tomohiro, was gay. Noboru who was already contemplating the fact that he himself might be gay, egged on by what his friends said, makes the move.
