mangas.title: Kind of a Wolf
mangas.description:
Shiroki just wants a little bit of peace and quiet—time to chill with his cat and relax in between all his university classes. However, his next door neighbor, Hayato, seems unable to do anything without making a racket. Which is the last thing Shiroki wants to deal with on any given day. And so life goes on, until his cat decides to climb onto Hayato's balcony, leading Shiroki to an unexpectedly furry discovery...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Eternal Covenant
mangas.description:
"I didn't follow you, you came next to me."

Ian Gloucester, a paladin of the religious country 'Derwin', secretly traces the source of the rumor for Cardinal Heron, who took him away when he was a child, when rumors of preparations for war in 'Arcaia', a great country with a peace treaty, circulate. Meanwhile, Ian realizes that human trafficking is secretly rampant in his country when runs into 'Sol', who has the same special powers as him. Ian instinctively senses that Sol is a danger to him and tries to avoid it, but the more he does, the more he unintentionally becomes involved with Sol.

Meanwhile, Ian notices that the real purpose of the King of Arcaia's recruitment of special knights is to find someone, not to prepare for war as rumored...

mangas.title: Learning to Love at Your Feet
mangas.description:
In this world, in addition to being male or female, people are divided into two "dynamics": those who yearn to control and those who yearn to be controlled. Kippei's a regular office worker who's always hated being the latter. But, suppressing his desire has stressed him out to the point of making him sick. Finally, he goes to the doctor, who tells him the last thing he wants to hear: he needs to find a partner and get some release! Kippei signs up for a matchmaking program, only to get paired with a guy who happens to be his hot coworker Sota Otomo.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: More than a Play Bite
mangas.titleNative: 甘噛みだけではすまさないっ
mangas.description:
Mikuni is a snake beast folk who was constantly bullied as a child due to his beast nature. His only friend and defender was Nachi, a quarter lion beast folk who always tells Mikuni that he's pretty. Mikuni's feelings for Nachi have always been more than just friends and became stronger as they grew up. Now grown-up, Mikuni is undergoing his shedding phase, which makes him emit pheromones. This proves to be troublesome as it makes any person, beast or not, attracted to him. He's only ever wanted Nachi. When Mikuni learns that his bite may have a chance of bewitching someone, he tries it on Nachi. Will his bite make Nachi want him? Also contains two side stories: "The Sweetest Bite in the World": A story between the Professor and his ward, Takumi, a track team member. "Catch the Goddess by the Tail": The story between senior track member and former ace, Aihachi, and the current track ace, Shunsuke.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Delivery Hug Therapy
mangas.titleNative: デリバリーハグセラピー
mangas.description: Twenty-nine-year-old Kiichi Sakuraba is totally burnt out. After his best friend, who he vowed to remain single with, gets married, Kiichi is done with romance in general. On his way back from his friend's wedding, he gets blackout drunk at one of his usual haunts. When he comes to, the handsome twenty-year-old university student Nao Kijima is right there waiting for him! Thanks to this encounter, Kiichi comes to an agreement with Nao that they will meet once a week for a therapeutic hug session. Could something more spring from this arrangement...?

mangas.title: Chiikawa: Nanka Chiisakute Kawaii Yatsu
mangas.titleNative: ちいかわ なんか小さくてかわいいやつ
mangas.description: The sometimes happy, sometimes sad, and a tad stressful daily life of "some sort of small, cute creature" known as Chiikawa. Chiikawa enjoys delicious food with bees and rabbits, toils hard every day for the rewards of work, and still maintains a smile.

mangas.title: Moonlighting
mangas.description: In a sleepy rural village, the local piano academy is a picture of peace...until the sun sets. Seonwu Jin is the academy's exhausted instructor, living as the "wife" of the charismatic village head, Goh Hui-Jae. But the domestic bliss is a deadly front. Jin is an undercover cop on a high-stakes surveillance mission, and Hui-Jae is the ruthless mob boss who vanished after a bloody power struggle. By day, Jin plays the perfect partner; by night, he does power to ensure he isn't made. But as the organization closes in, the lines between his cover and the truth begin to bleed.

mangas.title: HAPPY Twogether
mangas.description:
Four years ago, the idol group Dream Boy disbanded after being embroiled in some kind of scandal. And now... Jae-Young, formerly known as "Happy" in Dream Boy, was struggling financially and working a part-time delivery job when he heard that the group's leader, Su-Kyum, had passed out drunk at a club, and he rushed to him. Although they share the same stage name, Seung-Min, aka "Happy" and the most popular rapper and producer these days, saves Jae-Young from collapsing from photosensitivity syndrome and suggests they work together...

"You know who I am, right? Let's work together."

mangas.title: Wo Zai Moshi Bu Za Xiang Ni
mangas.synonyms: I Don't Really Miss You, I'm in the Apocalypse
mangas.description: Idiot Alien Tourist x Earthling Workaholic: You XueChun is 3 years into an internship, having never used a vacation day. On the cusp of becoming an official employee, BOOM! Her manager turned into a zombie. Zhang HuoFen sat on the galactic bus for 100 years to finally tick earth off her bucket list. The bad news is, the zombie apocalypse is here. The good news is, no lines at the tourist destinations!

mangas.title: He Might Bite!
mangas.description: Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo's small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae's first love surely can't be Jeongseo himself, since he's a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white!

mangas.title: Familiver Relations
mangas.description: Ku Yeon-Seo is AZ Company's marketing superstar, blessed with perfect looks, sharp skills, and one very inconvenient secret: He is a nine-tailed fox who spent a mere two hundred years growing all his tails. And yet, despite his outstanding track record as a kumiho, he's decided that being a regular human with exams, job hunting, and office deadlines sounded more appealing than becoming a celestial fox. Despite his carefully curated life, everything goes wrong when a single mistake exposes his identity to Yu Min-Hyeok, a straight-laced developer who, to Yeon-Seo's horror, is completely immune to his magic. Determined to protect his peaceful "human" life, Yeon-Seo comes up with a questionable plan to charm his way into Min-Hyeok and his younger sister's life regardless, magic be damned!

mangas.title: Lying Puppies Get Eaten
mangas.titleNative: 说谎的小狗会被吃掉的
mangas.synonyms: A Lying Puppy Will Be Eaten
mangas.description: Rio is a transfer student at a high school full of carnivores. Knowing how dangerous carnivores can be, Rio's older brother advises him to lie about being a wolf when he's actually a small dog. Even though Rio follows the advice, he's immediately found out by his classmate, a cunning and flirtatious fox named Ryu. Ryu says he'll keep Rio's secret, but there's a catch. He won't do it for free...!

mangas.title: Counter Crush
mangas.description: One day, Eun-Chan Jung receives a confession from Seo-Yeon Kwon, a promising junior in Taekwondo who is in a slump. Because of his meddlesome personality, he cannot just ignore the promising junior, so he promises to accept her confession if she wins a gold medal in the next competition. Eun-Chan ignores his feelings, saying that it is a win-win relationship that helps both sides, and begins to pile up actions that he will regret more and more…

mangas.title: Our Sunny Days
mangas.description: Sung Ho's not the kind you'd typically expect to settle down in the countryside. He's in his late 20s, ex-military, and…a single father with a year-old baby his ex-girlfriend pawned off on him. Jobless and without any prospects but a house, Sung Ho hopes the peaceful Nuldongmae village will make a good new home for him and his daughter. Rumor has it that the head of the village, despite his young age, is a real jerk… But he won't have to deal with that, will he? But on the very day he moves in, Sung Ho clashes with a tall, good-looking guy who's got quite the temper and accuses Sung Ho of stealing from his store. This new guy really gets on his nerves, but he does seem to know a lot about the village… Sung Ho's always been a bit of a lone ranger wherever he goes, so will he be able to let someone else in his life for sunny days up ahead?

mangas.title: Kwak Ha-jun's Observation Diary
mangas.description:
Cha In-Woo, who is timid and has no presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-Jun, who looks exactly like his favorite student, among his new friends. While Cha In-Woo is excited to become friends with Kwak Ha-Jun while doing homework together given by his teacher, he suddenly gets caught up in a mean bet by Kwak Ha-Jun...

A fresh and bashful romantic comedy between two high school students!

mangas.title: Sound of a Racing Heart
mangas.description:
On the first snow of that year, Shan Xianchun was asked by her roommate to be a photographer for a cosplay shoot. Unexpectedly she captures a girl with long hair and green dress through her camera. The girl looked at her with complex and affectionate eyes and Shan Xianchun felt as if her heart was scratched...

"May you live forever, and never miss spring".

mangas.title: Carrying My n00b Waifu
mangas.synonyms: The Symbiotic Relationship Between Newbie and Oldbie
mangas.description: Jung-Woo is a Tamer in the MMORPG Karel's Hymn. While selling off items after deciding to quit, he meets a newbie, "Charongrong," who swears loyalty even if "she" becomes popular. He thought it was just a brief, passing connection—but he shouldn't have taken those words lightly.

mangas.title: The Sacred Serpent's Seduction
mangas.description: How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being's seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…?

mangas.title: Fanservice Paradox
mangas.description: Two boy-band members who can't stand each other are suddenly trending all over social media because of a fan-video! Younger puppy-dog boy X Older cool dude?! The shippers are going feral over this pairing! They've never gotten along ever since their debut, but they're now stuck with each other in a fan-pleasing fake relationship…

mangas.title: Off Course, Into You
mangas.synonyms: It's Easy to Fall Into Samcheonpo
mangas.description: After leaving the city behind, Jeong-Won returns to his seaside hometown of Samcheonpo. There, he meets Do-Jin, a runaway college student with a bad first impression and nowhere to go. When Do-Jin ends up staying at Jeong-Won's house under the pretense of teaching him to swim, the two begin an unexpected cohabitation by the sea. As summer unfolds, their awkward start slowly turns into something tender - like the calm waves that bring them closer each day.

mangas.title: DASH
mangas.description: Jeong Ji-Heon, a once-promising swimmer, retired early due to an injury and now works diligently at a sports agency. The hottest topic in the sports marketing world is none other than Kwon Jae-Kyoung, and agencies are fiercely competing to win him over. Ji-Heon's boss orders him to secure a meeting with Jae-Kyoung at all costs. Using a trivial connection from a decade ago when they briefly trained at the same aquatic center, Ji-Heon miraculously succeeds in arranging a meeting. However, when they finally meet, Jae-Kyoung shows no interest in contract terms and instead seems strangely fixated on Ji-Heon's genetic traits…

mangas.title: Rainbow City
mangas.description: Amidst a worldwide zombie apocalypse, genius researcher Doctor Hwa Seok's predecessor has been murdered. Now, Hwa Seok has been assigned the best bodyguard the military can offer, but Major Suhwan Kwak certainly has better things to do than protect a delicate, oddball scientist—like getting him into bed, for example. Doctor Seok can tolerate Major Kwak's brash, crass, and impassioned behavior, but with a murderer at large, can he trust him with his life?

mangas.title: Jiangui
mangas.description: A story about a pretty, ditsy ghost and a cold guy. But wait, how is their first meeting in a bathtub?!

mangas.title: Your Meteor, Hidden in Flowers
mangas.titleNative: 花秘める君のメテオール
mangas.description: Every hundred years, the Monster's Bride is chosen — a sacrifice given to the demonic creature confined somewhere within the country. When Stella's sister is chosen, she volunteers to go in her place. Stella is soon sent to be the bride of the blood-soaked vampire Lavi. But behind the blood and fangs, Stella finds this monster harbors a deep loneliness. Will her affections pull him out of his deadly despair, or is their love cursed from the start?

mangas.title: Youth Report: 1995
mangas.description: Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwoo needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. Perfect-penmanship P.E. major Daehan needs dating lessons so that he can stay in a relationship for at least two weeks. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping!

mangas.title: Alpha Trauma
mangas.description: Woo-Yeon never liked Alphas, not before, and definitely not after he manifested as an Omega. The only person who ever made him feel seen was his tutor, Do-Hyun. Years later, Woo-Yeon follows him to university, hoping for a fresh start. But when they meet again, Do-Hyun doesn't recognize him. Woo-Yeon, however, never forgot—not his voice, his kindness, or the way Do-Hyun still makes his heart flutter. Then he learns the truth. Do-Hyun is an Alpha...

mangas.title: A Lovely Meal
mangas.description: One snowy winter evening, Chang-Deok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Chang-Deok ends up inviting the boy—Jong-U—into his home; after all, Chang-Deok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. So when Jong-U offers to cook him a delicious dinner every night in exchange for a place to stay, he reluctantly agrees. But as their unusual cohabitation begins, Changdeok can't shake this bloody feeling that Jong-U might be hiding something... Hopefully being a good Samaritan doesn't come back around to bite him in the neck—er, butt...

mangas.title: Melting Point
mangas.description:
After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eun-San isn't thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him.

Unlike Eun-San, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can't refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eun-San reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive.

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There's no way this guy actually has feelings for him…right?

mangas.title: Semantic Error
mangas.description:
A Bug in the System

Reason, routine, and rules. These are the tenets that computer science major Sang-Woo Chu lives by, so when the rest of his teammates fail to contribute to their group's presentation, he cuts their names from the project—including that of a complete no-show, whose plans to graduate and study abroad have gone down the drain as a result. Not that that's any of Sang-Woo's business…until he realizes that Jae-Young Jang, the talented design major he was hoping to hire for his video game, is: one, that very same classmate, and two, hell-bent on returning the favor and being the biggest thorn in his side!

Will Sang-Woo be able to debug this semantic error before it upends his entire life?

mangas.title: Day Off
mangas.description: A light and sweet romance story of a resolute yet affectionate boss and his cute and light-hearted assistant. Love with its joys and hassles can turn even the boring office work into an exciting romantic adventure!

mangas.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess
mangas.synonyms: What's Wrong with Being the Villainess?
mangas.description:
Do-Hee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. But it turns out that her new life is not without its perks, as Deborah Seymour is also the richest villain alive. Now, all that's left for her to do is lay low and enjoy her carefree lifestyle... if not for the fact that Deborah is fated to be sent to a monastery! Will this ex-doormat find a way to avoid yet another tragic ending, or will the challenges of being a villainess be too much for her?



(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: Your Letter
mangas.description:
When middle schooler So-Ri Lee stood up for her friend against their entire class, she never expected to become their new target—but that's exactly what happens. So, when her friend decides to transfer schools, So-Ri decides to wipe the slate clean and does the same. Luckily, someone seems to be looking out for her this time, and on her first day, she finds a mysterious letter taped to the bottom of her desk inviting her on a scavenger hunt! So-Ri follows the trail of clues to try and uncover the identity of her benefactor, and as she explores all the curious and wonderful people and places around the school, begins to open her heart once more...



(Source: Yen Press, edited)

mangas.title: Tamen De Gushi
mangas.description:
Sun Jing has a massive crush on a girl she sees at the bus station—feminine, blonde, and absolutely adorable, Qiu Tong is everything Sun Jing desires. But the tomboyish, outgoing Sun Jing cannot bring herself to utter a single word in Qiu Tong's presence. Once she musters up the courage, however, Sun Jing successfully introduces herself and secures a friendship with the cute girl. Although they are only friends for now, Sun Jing will do anything to see Qiu Tong smile; and with her genuine kindness, she might just win Qiu Tong's heart.



(Source: MAL Rewrite)

mangas.title: Magan he Danai
mangas.description: The funny, daily life of a young adult couple.

mangas.title: Inner Beauty
mangas.description:
Min-Jae's been dumped. Fed up with their long distance relationship, his actress girlfriend Hye-Eun left him while he was "finding himself" in Australia. When Min-Jae rushes home and runs into Hye-Eun and her gorgeous new man, Woo-Chan, at the airport, drama ensues. Amidst the chaos, the two love rivals bang heads. Upon waking, they discover they've changed bodies! Why have they switched? How will they cope? Will they ever be able to go back? Find out as Min-Jae and Woo-Chan embark on a journey that takes "self-discovery" to a whole new level!



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Here U Are
mangas.description: Sophomore Yu Yang is a real treasure. He has a cheerful, easy-going, and emphatic personality. Seniors look up to him, and he knows how to stand up for himself. Freshman Li Huan is moody and taciturn, haughty and, at times, outright rude. How will these two manage to get along, and where will it lead them..?

mangas.title: Dream Away
mangas.description: Jihan is a college student with a special ability: he can see the future through psychic dreams. One day, he wakes up from a vivid dream about a guy who gets into a car accident. Jihan feels like it's his responsibility to help this person, but he wasn't able to see his face. Frustrated, he tries to brush it off with a coffee at the cafe near campus, only to realize that the barista is the guy from his dream. Will Jihan be able to save him?

mangas.title: Robber X Lover
mangas.description:
Ji Ho's week has been, to put it simply, quite eventful. He's still getting used to being back in university after a leave of absence, he manages to snag a killer offer for a place to rent in downtown Seoul, and on his first day in the new house, he runs into a robber! The strange thing about this robber(?) is that he doesn't seem interested in any valuables, but is enamored by the story Ji Ho scribbled down in some old notebooks. So enamored that he offers to keep house for Ji Ho so that he can concentrate on writing more. Ji Ho initially refuses that odd proposition, but the more he thinks about it, the less he has to lose...



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Fools: Original
mangas.description: Nothing makes Eun-Gi feel anything anymore. Life is a blur between attending college classes, having meaningless drinks with classmates, and maintaining the nearly defunct guitar club. That is, until one day, he comes across a freshman named Jeong-Woo, who is eager to make a good impression on his senior. Though Jeong-Woo's bubbly personality rubs Eun-Gi in all the wrong ways, Eun-Gi can't help but feel a little warm when he thinks of him. And when Jeong-Woo joins the guitar club, that warmth in Eun-Gi's chest only grows. Has Eun-Gi finally found someone to breathe some life into his jaded indifference?

mangas.title: Snow Fairy
mangas.description:
When famous wildlife photographer Narumi comes to Hokkaido to take photos of the elusive "snow fairies," he ends up stranded in a snow storm. After being rescued, he takes up residence in local farmer Haruki's house for the winter. As polar opposites, sophisticated and outgoing city slicker Narumi and country boy Haruki have a lot to learn from one another.



After Haruki shows an interest, Narumi teaches him about photography... and before he realizes it, he finds himself the sole subject of Haruki's new hobby. After a winter spent so close together, what will the spring thaw bring?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hoshoku-kei Heroine ni Ato 1-nen Inai ni Taberaremasu
mangas.titleNative: 捕食系ヒロインにあと1年以内に食べられます
mangas.synonyms: Destined to Be Eaten Within a Year By the Predacious Heroine
mangas.description:
"I love you, that's why I will eat you, yes."

The one who appeared in front of Ano Taiyou introduced herself as Kagen, a girl who came from the moon!

Staying true to her instincts as a tsuki-jin, Kagen's reason for meeting her first love, Taiyou-kun, was... In order to prey upon him?!

This is the start of a "Predacious" Slice-of-Life Rom-Com!



(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)



Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

mangas.title: Cupid is Struck by Lightning
mangas.description: First-year high schooler Shingo is a one-man information network. For the right price (lunch, in most cases) he'll find out whatever you want to know about your crush, using his top-notch conversational skills and easy-going nature. But Shingo meets his match in the handsome yet terrifying second-year Ao, a boy whose gloomy presence doesn't hurt his popularity one bit. For some reason, Shingo gets tongue-tied around Ao, but when he uncovers a secret about the older boy—one that has nothing to do with the mysterious scar on his face—he notices his feelings starting to change…

mangas.title: Bokura no Tsuzuki
mangas.description: Yousuke and Shuu became estranged after a small accident during their childhood. Years later, due to some circumstances, Shuu moves into his grandmother's house which is located at the shopping district where Yousuke also lived! Things were awkward at first as Yousuke tries to mend their relationship because Shuu was always so cold to him, but as Shuu begins to express his feelings more openly, Yousuke can't help but notice the squeezing sensation in his chest!

mangas.title: Heesu in Class 2
mangas.description:
Hui-Su's world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn't mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn't care if people only know him as "Chan-Yeong's friend." Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there's a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he'll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn't even know what to do about his own crush!



(Source: Lezhin, edited)


Note: Includes one prologue and ten side story chapters.

mangas.title: Under the Oak Tree
mangas.description:
A flawless love story of the flawed.
Stuttering lady Maximilian is forced into a marriage with Sir Riftan, but he leaves on a campaign after their wedding night. 3 years later, he triumphantly returns, ready to cherish her. As life with her husband finally begins, she only has one question — does she deserve this love and happiness?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Nan Hao Shang Feng
mangas.synonyms: Nan Hao & Shang Feng the Odd Couple
mangas.description: A comedy about two ordinary high school boys.

mangas.title: I Shall Master this Family!
mangas.synonyms: I'll Be the Matriarch in This Life
mangas.description:
The great Lombardi family was once at the top of the empire. After the death of its patriarch, the fate of the family and that of Firentia, born from a Lombardi and a peasant, fall to ruin at the hands of her useless and cruel cousins. But when she's reincarnated as her seven-year-old self, she'll work to protect the family's honor, gain her grandpa Lulac's favor, and prevent her own father's death. In this lifetime, there's only one way for her to win: become the head of their mighty household.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Romance 101
mangas.description:
Ba-Reum's planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend's hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: December
mangas.description: One frigid December dawn, Song Yeon-woo meets an injured runaway alpha; inexplicably drawn toward his woodsy scent, he is compelled to help the young man. Despite his aversion to alphas due to trauma in his past, Yeon-woo somehow feels safe and welcomed in his presence. The two part in the moonlight, never to see one another again...but fate has other plans. Two years later, Yeon-woo has finally returned to the city to begin anew—still wary of alphas around him, he has built barriers in nearly every aspect of his life to keep himself safe. But when that a familiar scent begins to pierce through his boundaries, Yeon-woo is unable to stop himself from following them in pursuit of something thrilling...

mangas.title: Hate Mate
mangas.description:
Emboldened by liquid courage, 20-year-old Bang Subin had thought it'd be a good idea to confess to his best friend, Nam Hyeonwoo. That in itself wasn't a problem, except… Hyeonwoo was straight. The only thing Subin's impulse confession did was cause a rift in their relationship. Fast forward three years, Subin is 23, and Hyeonwoo is back. A lot has changed with the flow of time, but for better or worse, Subin's feelings haven't. Can this precarious friendship ever blossom into something more…?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love is in the Heir
mangas.synonyms: 名声による恋愛〜キスしたことあるか？〜
mangas.description:
Born to inherit a hotel empire, Woo Myeong-Seong was raised like a "perfect creation" by his controlling father. To the outside world, he has it all: brains, looks, wealth. But behind closed doors, he's slowly burning out from a lifetime of pressure and expectation. One day, while listlessly going about his routine, he runs into Do Jeon-Su, a high school classmate now working as a chicken delivery guy. Cheerful, awkward, and hopelessly inexperienced in love, Jeon-Su is everything Myeong-Seong isn't.
On a whim, Myeong-Seong offers to teach Jeon-Su the art of dating, but the lessons begin to blur as curiosity turns to something deeper.



"Kiss me... I taught you last time. Let's see if you remember."



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kimi Meku Yoru ni Kogarete
mangas.synonyms: Yearning For A Night Full of You
mangas.description:
At Seiruri Girls School, there are two opposing factions: the "Ruri Gumi," made up of respectable young ladies, and the "Ai Gumi," made up of delinquents with questionable behavior.



Among the Ai-gumi students, Nanase Mitsuki is the one most feared by the Ruri-gumi because of her fierce appearance.
Nanase has mixed feelings about her reputation, until one night when she sees one of the good girls, Yuka Hosho, wandering the streets alone at night…?



This is a sweet and fleeting love story between two people who can only meet at night.



(Source: Comic Amble, translated)

mangas.title: Suzuki-kun's Mindful Life
mangas.titleNative: 寿々木君のていねいな生活
mangas.description:
Kaoru Suzuki is the kind of guy who towers over his classmates and exudes an intimidating presence, but beneath his tough exterior, he's just a student who loves sweets, crafts, and flowers. When a handsome and unexpectedly tough classmate steps in to save him from a drunk on the first day of school, this unlikely duo becomes fast friends.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
mangas.titleNative: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい
mangas.synonyms: My Wish is To Fall in Love Until You Die
mangas.description:
At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it…



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ano Koro no Aoi Hoshi
mangas.description: One day, a mediocre high school girl, Koumoto Umi, falls in love with Segawa Shou, a beautiful girl in her next class. Although she was confused by her feelings, she wanted to get along with Segawa, who had a mysterious atmosphere somewhere...

mangas.title: Yige Guanyu Tangguo De Gushi
mangas.description:
In the hospital convenience store, the blind Bai Xiaoxiao met a girl who smelled of sweets. Their story unfolds in the hospital filled with the scent of disinfectant, as they become dear and help to heal each other.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: Shuangjing
mangas.description:
In the Republic of China, famous Shanghainese author Xu Youyi has everything anyone could want—until the day an anonymous letter arrives, revealing the truth behind her perfect life. Betrayed by both her best friend and her husband, she meets Yan Wei, the outwardly cold but inwardly warm owner of a photography studio. They click instantly, both independent yet in harmony with one another. Growing closer in the turbulent dangers that surround them, the two different women soothe the scars within each other's heart. Will they be able to save each other?



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Shen Wei E Yi Nü Pei De Wo Yang Cheng Bingjiao Nüzhu Hen Zhengchang Ba?!
mangas.titleNative: 身为恶役女配的我养成病娇女主很正常吧？!
mangas.synonyms: It Would Be Normal for a Supporting Villainess Like Me to Raise the Yandere Heroine, Right?!
mangas.description:
Jiang Yang is a game artist out gathering material for the game she was working on when she fell off a cliff and transmigrated into a world of immortal cultivation. She diligently cultivated her way to immortality, and she was about to ascend and return to her own world when a mysterious glitch caused her to transmigrate again, this time into a world of magic (like the start of an otome game). She met the main heroine, who was being bullied by the villainess at the Magic Academy, and that was when Jiang Yang realized that this is the world of the game she was working on? Now her fate is tied to Xin Lu, the heroine of the game. Jiang Yang thought that if she just beat the game, she can finally return home. But as the story progressed, she remembered all the over-the-top plotlines made up by the lousy writers, and she can't stand seeing Xin Lu suffer through it anymore. So she steps in and helps Xin Lu reject the playboy prince, teaches her cultivation techniques to fight off the bullies, and even seduces Xin Lu herself! As they become more intimate with each other, Jiang Yang starts to realize that her fate might intertwine with Xin Lu more than she realized…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Otherside Picnic
mangas.description:
In this sci-fi/fantasy survival thriller, the dangerous and deadly realm of the Otherside--where urban legends, cryptids, and folkloric legends roam--calls to two women, both in search of something. As they set out to sate their curiosity and explore this other world, will the most earth-shattering thing they discover on the Otherside be their feelings for each other?



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Renzao Tiwen 36.7℃
mangas.description: Su, born in prison, has always wanted to see the "crow" from the story her mother told her. On the day she was going to be secretly executed, Gill, an artificial intelligence with a database of everything outside the prison, was thrown into prison for a test run. Su develops a special feeling for Gill, not caring whether her words are programmed or self-conscious, and not trying to tell if she has human emotions. Unable to distinguish her own human feelings... in this small cell, the lonely Su got her first doll--she met a "person" who could comfort her soul.

mangas.title: Ting Xing
mangas.description:
Having failed in her attempts to become a voice actor, Chi Yu no longer talks about it with other people. Now she just listens to yuri drama podcasts in secret. One day, during a university lecture, she discovers that Yu Chen, a girl from another college, has the same voice as the main character in her favorite sexy yuri podcast…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Koi Jigoku de Matsu
mangas.synonyms: Will Meet You in the Netherworld

mangas.title: The Anemone Feels the Heat
mangas.titleNative: アネモネは熱を帯びる
mangas.description:
After failing to get into her desired high school, studious Nagisa is resolved to keep her chin up and move on. That is, until she meets a sickly girl named Mashiro at her new school, who throws a wrench into her plans—as she's the very reason Nagisa flunked her exams in the first place. But Nagisa decides she won't let it get her down, and to upend her negative feelings, she vows to warm up to Mashiro...Delve into this clever but clumsy girl's captivating love story.

(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Cocoon Entwined
mangas.description: Clad in school uniforms practically breathing with life are the girls of Hoshimiya Girls' Academy, their hair long and luxurious. When a certain "incident" rocks the academy, the hidden feelings these girls possess will be entwined in this pure girls' love story.

mangas.title: Sweet Happening
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Koi Ochi Outsider
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Our Paradise Season 3
mangas.synonyms: 青蘋果樂園 第三季 外傳
mangas.description:
The third season of Our Paradise.


Mae-Hwa and Jae-Won are living out their days as a couple to the fullest, and this includes getting steamy and intimate together. But their happy ending isn't here just yet as challenges are always bound to arise in relationships, especially more so after all the hesitation and misunderstandings the two college boys have been through. Meanwhile, their friends, Yeo-Nan and Dal-Guk, are dealing with their own secret love affair. Tensions rise between them as they slowly take things one step further...

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Our Paradise Season 2
mangas.description: The second season of Our Paradise.

mangas.title: Sketch: Synchro
mangas.description: Sketch: Synchro is an official alternate-universe side story of the hit BL manhwa Sketch by Dosak. It reimagines the original main characters, Yikyung and Joobin, leaving behind their realistic college life for a high-stakes, sci-fi Guideverse setting. The series explores their intense, slow-burn dynamic and psychic abilities in a new world.

mangas.title: Kiss the Coming Apocalypse
mangas.synonyms: Kiss at the End of the World | The Ending Kiss
mangas.description: For some reason, no more boys are being born, and humanity faces an apocalyptic crisis. Amidst rampant trafficking of boys and the establishment of shelters to protect them, people continue living in their own ways. Jessica, an actress popular for her sophisticated image, has Valentine, the boss of a human trafficking cartel, as her sponsor. One day, Jin, who claims to be her younger brother, appears before her—a woman who lacked nothing and felt no regret...

mangas.title: Girls' Last Tour
mangas.synonyms: The End Girl Trip | Shojo Apocalypse Adventure | Shōjo Shūmatsu Ryokō
mangas.description: Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. So they hop aboard their beloved Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. But as long as the two are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. For two girls in a world full of nothing, the experiences and feelings the two share give them something to live for…

mangas.title: My Solo Exchange Diary
mangas.description:
Struggling with the idea of living alone and adjusting to the effects of her previous book's success, this follow-up to the award-winning autobiographical comic continues the author's quest for self-acceptance and love.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes three extra chapters and the one-shot "Chika-chan no Yuuutsu".

mangas.title: Wo Zai Shengxia Yujian Xue
mangas.description:
Three years ago, Ye Tang born in the slums yet dreaming of becoming a lawyer to escape poverty fell for Meng Yixing, the masked heir to a crime syndicate who used him before casting him into despair. Three years later, Ye Tang, now a lawyer through forged credentials and stolen identity, reunites with Meng Yixing. He blackmails him into rekindling their past, knowing his history. This time, Ye Tang resolved to turn the tables and exploit Meng Yixing. The two con artists first deceived each other until they had nothing left, then used...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: Curveball and Splitter
mangas.description: A one-night mistake brings Yesol to the doorstep of Hanrim, a cold yet familiar face from his high school baseball team. Only now, Hanrim isn't just cold—he's holding a grudge. What exactly happened between them, and why can't Yesol remember?

mangas.title: A World Without You
mangas.description: There's only one thing that's keeping Han Sekye alive: the blond man in his dreams. No matter how bad it gets, how lonely he is, he can count on the man to come meet him in his dreams and make it all okay. So what is he to do when the man suddenly stops coming? Sekye falls apart and for years, he struggles with depression living on in a world without the man. Then one day, Woo Yijun appears in front of him, looking just like the man in his dreams. And seeing that he is an aspiring actor, Sekye hires Yijun to act out for him the man from his dreams. Sekye knows that it isn't the same, that this can't go on, but he so needs the world that used to be his…

mangas.title: Trapping the Foxy Doctor
mangas.description: Zhi Banyi has a secret. His heart only beats faster when he listens to a streamer called "Dust Under the Light" speak... So, Zhi Banyi decided to go see a psychiatrist. He never could have imagined that his psychiatrist would be the "female" streamer that made his heart beat every night!

mangas.title: The Law of Immutability
mangas.description:
Woo-Ri Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Su-Bin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woo-Ri wakes up back in high school, right beside Su-Bin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Su-Bin's hands, Woo-Ri becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woo-Ri finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Su-Bin's happiness. With just one life left, Woo-Ri sets out to give Su-Bin the happiest life possible.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Trying to Break up With Sex
mangas.titleNative: 別れるために色仕掛けしてみた
mangas.description:
All Makoto wants to do is to break up with his boyfriend, but he just keep getting more addicted to him?! After a night of drinking, Makoto unexpectedly starts dating Yagi. Determined to end things, Makoto has tried to break up over 50 times, but all his attempts have failed. If this continues, he'll have to do whatever it takes to make Yagi hate him. Yagi claims he doesn't like aggressive people, so Makoto tries to use that to his advantage... but everything backfires! And just like that, things take an unexpected turn...?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Broken Bloodline
mangas.description:
Ju Cheong-Do, the thirty-first heir of the Yusim Ju clan, carries a curse cast on him in childhood. Everyone he grows close to meets an untimely death, and the curse is now threatening his own life as well. Desperate to hold on to the will to live, Cheong-Do seeks out Yu Chan-Ran, a man known for solving any problem for the right price, and places his last hope in him. When Cheong-Do asks what it would cost for Chan-Ran to act as his lover, the answer comes lightly but firmly.

"Hey, how much do you charge? For the boyfriend experience, I mean."

"I start at 100,000 won per hour."

mangas.title: Marriage Toxin
mangas.description:
A hitman and a marriage swindler set out on the world's most grueling battle for marriage! Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years. As someone who's never gone to school and lived his life dealing in the dark side of the business, he considers himself to have "no prospects with women" and marriage as "something not for him." However, one day, in fear that their lineage would dissolve, his clan warns Gero that if he doesn't marry and produce an heir, they would have no choice but to…force his little sister into doing "that." Driven to his wits' end, Gero asks the target of his work, a marriage swindler, to…



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: My Final Winter
mangas.description:
"It'll be six months at most."

Just like that, my ordinary life crumbled with a single sentence—a sudden terminal diagnosis I never saw coming. As if that wasn't enough, my best friend of over ten years suddenly confesses: "I've loved you… for more than a decade." Now I have half a year left. Just six months. A brief flicker of time where everything feels both too short and painfully long. What am I supposed to do with a love I never had the chance to notice? How do I hold on to a future that's slipping away before it can begin? In these fleeting days, it's just you and me—stumbling through borrowed time, trying to find meaning in the moments we still have. If our time together is limited… Can love still be enough?

mangas.title: Loveless Momentum
mangas.titleNative: 恋できないのは君のせい
mangas.description:
Reiichi Miyoshi is a professional jazz musician who has a policy of never having a serious boyfriend or girlfriend. He prefers to keep his love life casual with a revolving door of hedonistic one-night stands.When he swoops in to rescue what appears to be a damsel in distress from a group of rowdy men one day, he soon finds out that his latest paramour is no damsel at all, but the crossdresser Sara Aogiri. Sara is determined to have the egotistical Miyoshi all to himself, but Miyoshi isn't going to date anyone seriously without some extreme convincing.



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: Radio Storm
mangas.description:
In a world ravaged by war and a deadly plague, supernatural abilities are no longer just a fantasy. Sak, who was born with an extraordinary sense of smell, sets out to find his caller–the only person who can amplify his powers. When the two finally meet, Sak can't help but feel an overwhelming affection. The catch? Sak's love is one-sided, and his caller wants nothing to do with him. Now Sak must risk everything to bring his caller to safety–both their lives depend on it.



(Source: Tapas)



Notes: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ain't Faded
mangas.description:
Top actor Lu Yi and rising star Gu Jiangyuan were known as rivals, until Lu Yi died in an accident. He wakes up 3 years later in the body of a shamed idol. Reborn, he discovers a shocking truth, Gu Jiangyuan has been in love with him all along.
But things take a darker turn when ghost-hunting missions begin, and Gu Jiangyuan, cloaked in shadows and secrets, might be the one keeping him alive… or trying to end him for good.

mangas.title: The 11th School Trip
mangas.description: Ga-Jun and Sun-Woo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip. After witnessing their friends' deaths, Ga-Jun realizes Sun-Woo's death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sun-Woo, confused, tries to protect Ga-Jun in return.

mangas.title: My New Boss is Goofy
mangas.description:
Forced to change jobs after being constantly bullied by his old boss, 26-year-old Momose Kentaro is understandably anxious about what's in store for him at his new workplace. After all, what if his new boss ends up being just as cruel? However, Momose's fears vanish once he meets Shirosaki Yuusei, a deadpan yet competent manager who is anything but scary. In fact, he's actually a little…goofy!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial serialization starting 2019-02-05.

mangas.title: Illusion Hunter from Another World
mangas.synonyms: The Delusional Hunter in Another World
mangas.description:
Gi-ryeo has a secret: he's really an alien from another world! As High Wizard of the planet Alpha Uri, Gi-ryeo slaved away day in and day out working his soul crushing job. But, after perfecting his transmigration magic, Gi-ryeo escapes into the body of a starved Hunter on Earth. On a new planet, surrounded by more magic than he's ever known, can Gi-ryeo adapt and keep his identity hidden from those seeking the High Wizard?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: FlashLight
mangas.description: Aaron Hunter's got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that'll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron's chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship…?

mangas.title: Sounds Like
mangas.description:
That song… It sounds like my brother's unreleased track! Just before his untimely death, Su-In's beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-In hears one of those tracks on TV, and it's being claimed by his brother's former bandmate. Now, Su-In must take the stage, beat the competition, and take back his brother's songs… all through music.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Monochrome Rumor
mangas.description:
After being involved in a car accident together, Hajin is asked by Sihyeon to take care of Sihyeon's younger sister after his death. Hajin never expected that to mean he would wake up in the hospital in Sihyeon's body instead of his own. Even worse, Sihyeon was an infamous idol who would do anything for money, had multiple sponsors, and was apparently about to abandon the boy band he was a part of to sign a new contract with a larger agency. At first, Hajin believes the public's negative opinion about Sihyeon, but the more he learns about Sihyeon's miserable circumstances, the more enraged he becomes. Determined to get revenge in Sihyeon's stead, Hajin decides to reach out to an old acquaintance for help. However, the deeper he goes into his revenge plot, the more people he becomes entangled with...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: An Insincere Idol's Blank Slate
mangas.titleNative: 초심 잃은 아이돌을 위한 회귀 백서
mangas.synonyms: A Blank Slate Regression for the Idol That Lost His Original Mindset
mangas.description: K-pop idol Yoon Eden has wasted away for years under a mediocre label with an incompetent CEO. He is disillusioned and on the verge of quitting when he's sent back in time to the day of his debut. Now, Eden is determined to use his songwriting talent to rewrite his career and gain some well-deserved fame. Despite his CEO still pushing cheesy songs and tacky concepts, can Eden, with the help of his group members, truly reignite his spark and become a sincerely dazzling idol?

mangas.title: The Rogue Producer Survives as an Idol
mangas.synonyms: The Trashy PD Has to Survive as an Idol
mangas.description:
Seo Hoyoon, the genius producer of a popular idol survival show, is infamous for his sharp tongue and coldheartedness. Cursed by a trainee for it, he wakes up as a member of a flop idol group called "The Dawn." To avoid being stuck in this parallel world forever, Hoyoon must make his group top-tier... but with the competitive industry and challenging tasks, it won't be easy. With his wits, know-how, and a little help from those around him, will this producer-turned-idol make it big?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: When the Third Wheel Strikes Back
mangas.synonyms: What Happens When the Second Male Lead Powers Up
mangas.description:
When Ye-Seo Jung wakes up one day, he finds himself trapped inside the body of Jesse Venetiaan, the ill-fated second male lead of a mega-hit fantasy romance novel "I Quit My Job, then I Became the Princess Bride." It turns out this second male lead is destined to die at war, trying to protect the male lead. Ye-Seo's goal is to avoid getting entangled with the main characters and survive until the war is over, all while searching for a way to return home safe and sound. But the female lead, Christelle, and the male lead, Cedric, keep approaching him…



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: My Life as an Internet Novel
mangas.description:
Every novel has the usual cast: a gorgeous heroine, handsome boys vying for her attention, and a homely best friend at the heroine's side. Dan-I, an ordinary student and avid reader of internet novels, is all too familiar with these tropes. But she never imagined that one day she'd wake up at the center of one herself! Her new fictional world is complete with a beautiful best friend named Yeo- Ryeong, and four impossibly good-looking boys who all happen to be in her class. Dan-I is determined to stay out of the way and not get involved in the twists and turns of the plot. But is she really just the sidekick -- or is Dan-I actually the leading lady? Anything is possible in the world of a novel!



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

mangas.title: Lycoris Recoil
mangas.description:
Japan—a nation where vicious crime and terror have been all but eliminated. And who keeps the peace? Cute schoolgirls, of course! Those uniformed youths you see on street corners and in stylish cafés may just be agents of Lycoris, with pistols in their purses and missions on their minds…



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Barakamon
mangas.description: For a certain reason, a handsome, young calligrapher by the name of Seishuu Handa uproots himself and moves to an island on the westernmost edge of Japan. "Sensei," as he comes to be known, is a city boy through and through, and has never experienced rural life until now. And by the looks of it, he has much to learn! Luckily(?), he has a willing teacher in Naru, the energetic expert islander, to help show him the ropes. But can Sensei keep up with the plucky first-grader, or will he get schooled?! Here unfolds a heartfelt island comedy about a gruff on the outside, soft on the inside urbanite teacher and his new, unfailingly kind island neighbors!

mangas.title: Blooming Sequence
mangas.description: Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing "Dancing in the Rain" while... dancing in the rain. It's a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who's not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat.

mangas.title: The Case Files of Jeweler Richard
mangas.titleNative: 宝石商リチャード氏の謎鑑定
mangas.synonyms: 寶石商人理察的謎鑑定
mangas.description:
When Japanese college student Seigi Nakata rescues a handsome young jewelry appraiser from a group of drunken assailants, he gets more than he bargains for! The appraiser is Richard Ranashinha de Vulpian, a brilliant and mysterious British jewelry expert. Seigi hires Richard to appraise a ring left to Seigi by his grandmother…and the adventures are just beginning. Together, they unlock the secret messages hidden in the hearts of jewels—and those who possess them.


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Ogi's Summer Break
mangas.titleNative: 小木くんのなつやすみ
mangas.description:
On the first day of summer vacation, Haruto Ogi fell in love with legally blind Shinya Tago. All though they connected immediately, Tago was at first utterly unaware that Ogi had fallen for him. For once, Ogi felt comfortable fully being himself; if his crush can't see him, then he's safe from being judged. A sweet love story about overcoming differences and accepting yourself for who you truly are.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Tong Lei
mangas.description:
The abuses suffered as a child will be inflicted again as an adult. Some people will take it out on others, but some people only harm themselves.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: King's Maker: Triple Crown
mangas.description:
The King is back. With the defeat of his father, Wolfgang Goldenleonard has achieved all that he's sought -- the love of Shin Soohyuk, the power of the throne, and vengeance over the kingdom's tyrannical ruler. But, Soohyuk, a "possession" of the former king, views their rocky relationship as one of war trophy and victor, despite Wolfgang showering him with affection. As uncertainty grows in the royal courts, forces beyond their control are preparing a second coup d'etat. Will these two be able to keep a grasp on the throne and on each other? The saga of King's Maker continues in this official second season of the hit BL series!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Melting Strawberry Kiss
mangas.titleNative: ストロベリーキス・メルト
mangas.description:
In this Cakeverse story, Ageha is a regular boy who, after losing his sense of taste, is diagnosed as a "fork." Forks are a type of person deemed dangerous due to their unprovoked attacks on those who are "cakes." Due to the negative stereotypes, Ageha vows to keep his distance from people at his new high school so he won't have anyone awaken his innate fork senses. But when his classmate Kaede approaches him in the nurse's office, Ageha quickly realizes he has regained his sense of taste for the first time in a long while...



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: Susumu×Minoru
mangas.description:
When Susumu, an unpopular manga author, is dropped from the magazine of his dreams, his ex-editor suggests he write boys' love manga instead. Minoru, who works with Susumu at a restaurant and secretly has feelings for him, congratulates Susumu, saying it's amazing that he received an offer to write manga. However, Susumu himself doesn't feel right about it, since he doesn't know anything about boys' love. He even begins to think about quitting drawing and going back to live with his parents. Minoru has always supported Susumu, even cooking for him regularly, but as the risk of being separated looms closer, he suggests Susumu date him to do "hands-on research" for his manga. Susumu thinks it's a fake relationship purely for the sake of research, but he's gradually affected by Minoru's honest attitude...!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

mangas.title: Whispers Through the Willows
mangas.description:
A prince falls for a beautiful lie.



Sangyul's been living a lie since birth. Everyone thinks he's the feeble, omega son of Jodong Pharma's President Han, but in reality, he's as normal as can be. So what's he to do when Korea's sole alpha, Prince Reok, proposes an interesting deal? Will he finally get the ordinary life he so desires?



(Source: Manta)



Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: Project Yuriforming!
mangas.titleNative: プロジェクト・ユリフォーミング！
mangas.description:
In search of new stimulus, the yuri-addict alien Lily sets her sights on two childhood friends, Iori and Runa, who can't be honest about their feelings, to create "real yuri" by her own hands!



(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

mangas.title: Surviving the Apocalypse
mangas.description:
Eun-Su's prescient dreams show him an apocalypse which is confirmed by his awaking powers. To survive, he bonds with Jae-Young, a hidden powerhouse and seemingly guaranteed survivor. As monsters invade and the world unravels with gods, betrayal, and chaos, they must fight to stay alive—together.

(Source: Manta, edited)

mangas.title: D:AZE
mangas.description: In a world where vampires exist, a special undercover agency keeps the rest of society safe by hunting them down. Agent "First" Shin is the best of the best. The only problem is he keeps losing partners, so he's decided to stick to working solo. However, his manager has other plans, and a recruit is assigned to him. The new guy just won't leave him alone, yet annoyed as he is, First also can't ignore his model-like new partner. Is it his potential as a partner... or something else?

mangas.title: 2DK, G Pen, Mezamashi Tokei.
mangas.description: A mangaka and her salarywoman roommate come to realise that their feelings of friendship might actually be something quite different.

mangas.title: My Princess Charming
mangas.description:
Twenty-one year old Yuna is tired of having guys hit on her all the time. As popular as she is, she's been single her whole life. Just when she decides to make herself a boyfriend to fend off guys, she meets a handsome guy who looks good enough to be her boyfriend. But wait, the guy is actually a girl! In fact, rumor says that Min is a lesbian. Nonetheless, the two decide to pretend to be in a romantic relationship.


(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Nappeun Chingu
mangas.description:
"Am I a bad friend to you?"


Ji-Min, who is now in the same class as Ki-Jung, the source of all kinds of rumors and an object of avoidance. Contrary to expectations that it would be a difficult year, ordinary days pass by. Then one day, he spots Ki-Jung approaching a stray cat he was taking care of, and this becomes the opportunity for the two to gradually become closer...


Ji-Min skips school for the first time in his life and goes to a karaoke room. He knows it's an important time, but for some reason, he can't refuse to be with Ki-Jung.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ga Hoeru Tame no Uta wo,
mangas.titleNative: キミが吠えるための歌を、
mangas.description: A girl who is troubled by her voice that doesn't match her appearance, and a girl who feels she has reached her limits in songwriting. The story of two young musicians.

mangas.title: Zenbu Kowashite Jigoku de Aishite
mangas.titleNative: ぜんぶ壊して地獄で愛して
mangas.description:
Kurumi Yoshizawa is the student council president with excellent grades and good manners... but in private, she is stressed by her strict mother and the excessive expectations of her teachers.



One day, Yoshizawa is asked by her homeroom teacher to check on her truant classmate Naoi, but Naoi only scorns Yoshizawa, as if seeing through her true feelings. On the verge of a mental breakdown, Yoshizawa makes a clumsy attempt at shoplifting, but Naoi records the whole thing...



This is a violent coming-of-age story about two people struggling in everyday life with no escape.



(Source: Ichijin Plus, translated)

mangas.title: Common-Sense Monster
mangas.synonyms: Futsuu to Bakemono | Normality and Monsters
mangas.description: Itou, a socially awkward teenager, finds herself jealous of her classmate Takahashi, who seems to get along with everyone. However, one day, she witnesses Takahashi...eat someone whole!? That's amazing! A monster who knows how to blend right in with humans? Itou definitely needs to be her friend now!

mangas.title: Let's Kill Your Husband
mangas.description:
So should we kill your husband?

Your shaky demeanor, the bruises on your face... It killed me to see how you'd changed after getting married. Maybe we should just kill your husband. But how? Will our lives ever be the same again? Fate must have been on our side, because everything went smoother than expected.

(Source: Manta)

Note: This series contains upsetting contents such as murder and domestic abuse. Viewer discretion is advised.

mangas.title: A Love Yet to Bloom
mangas.description: Takamine, a girl who can't seem to find something she likes or even really enjoys, has a chance encounter with Sakura, a student from a different school. When the two accidentally swap books, a connection is made that neither expected. While Sakura enjoys reading and talking about books, Takamine finds she quite likes Sakura's excitement and wonders if she'll ever feel so passionate about something…or someone. A sweet, slow burn romance about two young women and the relationship that blossoms between them.

mangas.title: Wo Zai Jingsong Youxi Li Feng Shen
mangas.synonyms: I Became A God In A Horror Game
mangas.description:
Bai Liu, an ordinary laid-off worker, finds himself drawn into a perilous survival game driven by his craving for money. Within this deadly contest, he not only encounters allies to fight alongside but also rediscovers the lover who has been waiting for him all along...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Surviving Romance
mangas.description:
When Chaerin Eun becomes the protagonist of the romance novel she is reading, she expects a fairytale ending with the novel's love interest, Jeha. But when a bizarre twist makes her realize the story is not playing out as it does in the book, she'll need the help of an unlikely character from her class to defy the new storyline and find her happy ending -- if only she can figure out who this 'Unknown Extra' is first!



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Tsuki wa Hitsuji wo Kazoenai
mangas.titleNative: 月はヒツジを数えない
mangas.synonyms: So fall asleep. Held by thee
mangas.description:
A high school girl is trapped in an unfortunate life, living in despair...

Until one day, when she's suddenly summoned to another world!

The fresh start offers the girl hope for a new life.

The reason for her summoning is… to be the sleeping companion for a handsome cross-dressing princess!



(Source: Comic Newtype, translated)

mangas.title: Someone Like You
mangas.description: When tragedy strikes and tears young Shinwoo's family apart, the charming Han swoops in like a prince and saves the timid boy with his kindness. So it comes as a huge shock to Shinwoo when his new friend and crush suddenly ghosts him after graduation. Initially, Shinwoo just thinks that Han got tired of him due to his fickle ways. But when the two reunite as adults, it turns out that Han has strangely little memory of their time together. As he slowly recalls their past, however, Han realizes that the quiet boy left a surprisingly deep impact on him in all sorts of unexpected ways. And because Shinwoo is very much his type, he's determined to do whatever it takes to win him over. There's just one unanswered mystery lingering in the air between them: why exactly did Han forget about Shinwoo in the first place?

mangas.title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
mangas.titleNative: 私を喰べたい、ひとでなし
mangas.synonyms: A Monster Wants to Eat Me
mangas.description:
"I've come to eat you."

So softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters. To ensure that she matures to the best condition, Shiori seeks to protect Hinako—all so that someday, she can devour every piece of her. What will become of Hinako's feelings as this looming unjust death closes in on her…?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Greatest Estate Developer
mangas.description:
When civil engineering student Su-Ho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book! Su-Ho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Su-Ho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world's magic, can Su-Ho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?


(Source: WEBTOON, edited)


Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hirano and Kagiura
mangas.description: Basketball players. Bad boys who aren't really bad boys. Roommates. Senpai-kouhai BL romance. It all started when Kagiura moved into the school dorms with what seemed to be a bad-boy upperclassman. But after he's left in the tender care of his mother hen of a roommate, Hirano, it's too much to ask for Kagiura not to fall in love…right?!

mangas.title: Moriarty the Patriot
mangas.description:
In the late 19th century, Great Britain rules over a quarter of the world. Nobles sit in their fancy homes in comfort and luxury, while the working class slaves away at their jobs. When young Albert James Moriarty's upper-class family adopts two lower-class orphans, the cruelty the boys experience at his family's hands cements Albert's hatred of the nobility he was born into. He asks the older of the two boys—who has a genius mind and a killer instinct—to help him rid the world of evil, starting with Albert's own family!



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Containment Zone Management
mangas.description: Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

mangas.title: Wicked Spot
mangas.description:
After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Erio to Denki Ningyou
mangas.description: Anjie is an electric doll, and Erio is a human raised by the electric doll. Erio, who has never seen the outside world, set out for an adventure with Anjie. A futuristic yet nostalgic world, feeling mechanical yet still alive. A steampunk adventure set in the near future thus begins!

mangas.title: Hot Nights at the Hot Springs, Secret Trip No. 241
mangas.titleNative: 温泉で秘密のお泊り、241回目
mangas.synonyms: The 241-st Secret Trip to the Hot Springs
mangas.description:
Ishida and Kimura have been seeing each other for twenty years...but only once a month. They manage their work, and head for a hotel or ryokan where they can relax in a hot spring bath. No one, even their closest friends know about their relationship. This month, they are together again...for the 241st time. They soak themselves in hot bath, treat themselves with good food.

"...Hey. Wanna come closer?"

"Okay."

This relaxing trip is what the mature couple live for.

mangas.title: R2R: Run to Red
mangas.description: Living in the slums of District Zero, Ban runs a small errand service, taking on jobs others would rather avoid. One day, he accepts a request from Shinwi, the boss of a rising criminal organization, and stumbles upon the existence of the mysterious "Project W." While investigating the substance, Ban hopes to help Ray, the police officer who once took him in and whom he has secretly loved for years. But the deeper Ban digs, the more he uncovers a hidden truth Ray has long been keeping hidden. As secrets surface, Ban finds himself caught between loyalty, love, and a dangerous conspiracy.

mangas.title: Therapy Game Restart
mangas.titleNative: セラピーゲーム リスタート
mangas.description:
Shizuma and Minato are officially a couple. But Shizuma—now a resident veterinarian—is so busy he barely has time to catch his breath, let alone go on a date. When he finally manages to find time for Minato, the universe intervenes once again, and he learns quickly that his feisty new beau is not to be ignored!



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Pink Heart Jam beat
mangas.titleNative: ピンクハートジャム beat
mangas.description:
College student Haiga, now a senior, has finally moved in with his boyfriend, Kanae, a former classmate and brothel beauty who's since graduated and joined the workforce. And although they're living together, that doesn't mean they aren't both still busy with their own lives—Kanae with work and Haiga with his career aspirations.



Noticing Haiga's job search hasn't been going well—and that they haven't been on a date in a while—Kanae decides to take him out to cheer him up. Unfortunately, even that doesn't go well, and Kanae falls ill. But as the seasons pass, the two affirm and reaffirm their relationship, and before long, it's time for Haiga's final college performance—his graduation concert!



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Our Dining Table: Seconds, Please!
mangas.description:
Yutaka and Minoru have gone from friends to lovers, and made a loving home for themselves and Tane-kun. As their relationship grows, so do their joys and worries, but one thing stays the same: they always have warm meals to share around the table. See how this little family shares love and delicious food in this collection of short stories!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: HONBUL: Flame of the Soul
mangas.description:
The Exorcism Agency is a state-run secret organization whose mission is to protect humans from demonic possession. Taehee Yoon, an exorcist from the Execution Department, is looking for a "genius" who can see and hear ghosts to be his new subordinate. While operating undercover at a high school he meets a mysterious boy...

"By the way, how old are you, buddy?"

mangas.title: Sakamoto Holidays
mangas.description:
Sakamoto and Shin catch a shoplifter, but the shoplifter returns with his gang to ambush them. Can Sakamoto and Shin defend themselves without spilling blood, keep Hana unaware of what's happening, and complete the housework perfectly?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Special Civil Servant
mangas.description: Socially-awkward Ma-Ru Han bombs his fifth attempt at getting a dream job in the civil service. But after a strange creature attacks him in the mountains, he finds himself recruited into the Special Civil Service for the Ministry of Environment. This secret organization is dedicated to fighting nachal, human-devouring demons who appear in clouds of yellow dust. As Ma-Ru struggles in his new job fighting nachal, he must find out why they're mysteriously drawn to him before the prophesied end of the world arrives.

mangas.title: My S-Class Hunters
mangas.description:
Yu-Jin is an F-ranker overshadowed by his little brother, an S-ranker. All he does is get in his brother's way, causing trouble wherever he goes. When a seemingly routine dungeon raid goes wrong and costs Yu-Jin his brother's life, Yu-Jin decides to use the wish granted by clearing the dungeon to reset his timeline. The plan was to lead a quiet life from now on… but now it turns out he can help other people become S-rankers?! Maybe this is Yu-Jin's chance at building his own entourage of powerful metahumans… but it may be easier said than done.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Love Bullet
mangas.description:
In this contemporary world, Cupids solve problems of love not with bows and arrows but with guns! However, when the Cupids get in an argument over how to solve a love triangle…a full on shoot-out occurs?!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: 19 Tian
mangas.description:
A group photo in kindergarten is the start of a lifetime friendship between Jian Yi and Zhan Zhengxi. They grew up together, and met good friends like He Tian and Mo Guanshan on campus.

"19 Days" not only shows the relaxed and happy school days of the four, but is also a story in which the boys come to understand each other and help each other grow up.

mangas.title: Heaven Official's Blessing
mangas.description: 800 years ago, Xie Lian was a pure-blooded and noble Crown Prince, a well-regarded child of Heaven with unlimited potential. But who knew that, after he ascended and became a god with tens of thousands of worshippers, his fate would take such a sharp downhill turn? He was demoted again and again, and fell to rock bottom. 800 years later, Xie Lian ascended again, but this time, without worshippers or and without incense. One day, after returning from collecting scraps, he took a mysterious young man home. And this young man was the Ghost King that made others pale in fear whenever discussed—Hua Cheng.

mangas.title: The Devil: Imjonghada
mangas.synonyms: The Devil: Knocking on Death's Door
mangas.description: After 27 years of a life lived while avoiding death, I met the Angel of Death wielding an axe.

mangas.title: Ladies at Her Service: Hungry Widow
mangas.description:
Cheong-Hwa is married off to a wealthy old man who starves her to "keep her figure trim." Once he dies, she's finally free to satisfy her raging hunger and eat to her heart's content. And now that she's been left alone with her pretty servant, Oh-Weol, food isn't the only thing Cheong-Hwa has a ravenous appetite for...

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Jeulgeoun Naui Jip
mangas.description: Five years have passed since he left his beloved hometown for the city. With no one to depend on, Mihail wanders everywhere, ultimately unable to settle down anywhere and returns home. A remote mountain village where even a cart won't take him. Upon arriving in the village, he visits the cabin of his childhood friend, shepherd Caleb, and greets him warmly. However, all he gets in return is a warning to get out of the village immediately. Mihail tries to win Caleb's heart and settle down in his long-awaited return home, but things aren't as easy as he thought...

mangas.title: OOTD: Overworked and Overloved
mangas.description: When ordinary man Moo-Yeong awakens as an A-rank guide, he is shocked to find out he has been paired with his long-lost first love from high school: the elite S-rank esper Yoo-Hae. Although Yoo-Hae is delighted about their reunion, Moo-Yeong is determined to keep their relationship a professional one. And thus begins an endless amount of "work" as a guide. While it's standard protocol for guides to heal through physical intimacy, Yoo-Hae's demands are obsessively intense, pushing Moo-Yeong to his limits. Is this so-called business relationship going to work out?

mangas.title: The Delinquent and the Transfer Student
mangas.description:
Riri is a transfer student with a unique fascination—she wants the school delinquent, Atsuko, to say adorable things! Despite her fearful reputation, Atsuko goes along with it, thinking Riri is just a harmless weirdo. However, she soon finds herself getting increasingly flustered every time she reads one of Riri's lists of cute words. And she's not the only one whose heart races after each interaction! Will this game bring them closer together and lead to an entirely new relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Started as a self-published web-comic before being picked up for serialization on Web Comic Action on 2021-10-22.

mangas.title: Catch These Hands!
mangas.description: From back alley brawls to bashful bonds, two former-delinquents face their next fight: long-term relationships. During her high school years, Takebe was the top dog at her school. But with her old friends now living as happy adults, Takebe was faced with an impending sense of crisis. Takebe convinced herself to quit delinquency, but then she runs into her old rival, Soramori.
