After losing another fist-fight against Soramori, for some reason or other they reconciled by becoming a dating couple. What kind of relationship did the two of them have back in high school? And will Takebe ever manage to graduate from delinquency...!?

mangas.title: Tabimiman
mangas.description:
Harukawa, an an office worker, loves going on outings. Akiyama, a novelist, just wants to laze about in the house all day. This is the life of two women who live together in Shiga Prefecture, going on laid-back outings that are more relaxed than a trip, but more exciting than a stroll!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Majo to Koisuru 5-byoumae
mangas.synonyms: 5 Seconds Before Falling in Love with a Witch
mangas.description: Sequel to 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love published in the magazine Yuri Hime's 100 issue.

mangas.title: Mi-chan to Airi
mangas.description:
Midori, a corporate office worker, is busy with work day and night. She eats mostly bento from convenience stores, relaxes with cigarettes and alcohol, and spends rough days of no sleep. While on her way home one day, she finds a girl sleeping in a garbage dump. She helps her on a whim, but Airi, who uses mysterious powers and calls herself a "witch", begs Midori to "keep her at home for a while'', and they end up living together...!? The life of an office lady x a fallen witch begins!



(Source: Wings Comics, translated)

mangas.title: NakiNagi
mangas.description:
A quiet witch meets a girl in love. Nakika was once a feared with of the deep sea, but has started a life on the surface to learn about "human emotions." Nagisa is a naive romantic and Nakika's best friend—and although she might not always understand Nagisa's infatuation, her compassion for Nagisa is deeper than the Pacific Ocean! As she uses her magical powers to support Nagisa's quest for love, she gradually learns about "human emotions. Follow the 1000% wholesome story of a girl in love and her watchful guardian!



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love
mangas.synonyms: Majo ga Koi suru 5 Byou Mae
mangas.description: Solitary witch Meg likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for her nemesis, Lilith the Witch Hunter. But when an altercation goes sideways, and Meg turns Lilith into a cat, a cascade of unfortunate events means witch is now responsible for saving witch-hunter! Sparks were flying between these antagonistic ladies before–what will their relationship be like after this cat-astrophe?

mangas.title: Mizuno & Chayama
mangas.description:
Mizuno, the daughter of a mayoral candidate, is desperate to escape the suffocating pressure and scrutiny of smalltown life. Chayama, the heiress of the tea company Chayama-en, is adamantly walking down the path laid out for her, despite being forced to atone for her family's apparent misdeeds. Yet in the bubble of the school's third floor guidance counseling room-away from rumors, watchful eyes, and their feuding families-they're simply Mizuno and Chayama, two teenagers who find comfort and hope in each other. But when the outside world tries to tear them apart, the two must find a way to protect their relationship and, more importantly, themselves…



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to
mangas.description: Two women from different countries find each other in the Philippines. Even if they can't directly communicate with each other, some feelings can be understood without words.

mangas.title: Let Me Fix You
mangas.description:
A heartwarmingly cute yuri manga about a seamstress and a zombie girl. What if your friend became a zombie? What if you were in love with that friend?



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Honto wa Motto, Shitai dake
mangas.titleNative: ほんとはもっと、したいだけ
mangas.synonyms: I Really Just Want to Do More
mangas.description: Note: Released at Comiket 105.

mangas.title: Kekkyoku Sonna Kimi Ga Suki
mangas.titleNative: 結局そんなきみが好き
mangas.description:
A spin-off story from Comic Yuri Hime series Can't Defy The Lonely Girl by the original author. The story is about the couple of Wakana Morinaga and Yuina Minami, who appeared as side-characters in the main series, and their life in college.



(Source: Number Nine, translated)

mangas.title: Hito no Koi to Neko no Koi no
Koko wa Tengoku ja Nai kedo
mangas.titleNative: ここは天国じゃないけど
mangas.description: A woman working at a girls bar encounters an angel that has fallen into a pile of trash.

mangas.title: I Won 300 Million Yen in a Lottery so I Started Raising a Freeloader Pretty Girl
mangas.titleNative: 宝くじで3億円当たったのでヒモ美少女飼い始めました
mangas.synonyms: Takarakuji de 3-oku Yen Atattanode Himo Bishoujo Kai Hajimemashita
mangas.description:
One day, Hino Mariya, an ordinary office lady, casually bought a lottery ticket, won the grand prize, and suddenly became a millionaire!
While dreamily thinking about how to spend her 300-million yen windfall, she accidentally dropped her bankbook.
A beautiful girl named Tenma Tsujido happened to pick up the bankbook, and then asked Hino to become her sugar mommy in exchange for returning the bankbook...?

mangas.title: The Vessel of a Transparent Love
mangas.synonyms: Toumei na Ai no Utsuwa | The Transparent Vessel of Love
mangas.description: Miki Donoue has lived an unlucky life, the embodiment of woefulness since he was a child. He's lived in such a way to never involve others in his misfortune. One night, Miki is asked by a mysterious man, "Can I have your woes?" The man turns out to be a creature called "Akashibito," a type of monster that feeds on the woes of humans to extend their lifespan. He asserts that he lacks sustenance, and will die without Miki's woes. Miki, being a good natured boy, gives the akashibito the name "Shiro", and offers to be his host. Now the two of them will live together. Though Shiro can continue to live with a new host, as Miki grows to feel happiness, Shiro loses his sustenance. With the loss, there is a change in Shiro...? Could this mean the end of his life as he knows it...?

mangas.title: Mr. Right Turned Out To Be A Younger Woman!?
mangas.titleNative: 結婚相手の条件にピッタリだったのは職場の後輩女子でした。
mangas.synonyms: The Marriage Partner of My Dreams Turned Out To Be… My Female Junior at Work?!
mangas.description:
Still single at age 33, Haruki Shiina is standing at the biggest crossroads of her life. While unlucky in love, she's popular among her female coworkers for her laidback and boyish personality. The only one who gives her the cold shoulder is Risa Takagai, a beautiful and capable new hire who is already climbing her way up the corporate ladder. Haruki sees her as her biggest rival and is sure that the feeling is mutual, but why does Risa always seem to be watching her...?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Sarangeun Hangyeolgachi
mangas.description:
Na-Rin prepared an event to spend her birthday with her boyfriend. However, her boyfriend broke up with her on the same day and Na-Rin was left alone at the hotel she had booked. Na-Rin, who did not want to be alone on her birthday, looked through SNS to find someone to meet and then came across her childhood friend Han-Gyeol, who she had lost contact with after confessing to her. Wanting to meet again after a long time, Na-Rin impulsively contacts Han-Gyeol…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

mangas.title: Old-Fashioned Cupcake: episode.0
mangas.titleNative: オールドファッションカップケーキ episode.0
mangas.description:
An 18-page prequel story about Nozue and Togawa before they became superior and subordinate, respectively.



Note: First published in the March 2020 issue of ihr HertZ on January 31, 2020. Released as individual ebook chapter on August 26, 2020.

mangas.title: Sketch: Side Story
mangas.description:
The side stories for Sketch.



Note: Chapters 104-141.

mangas.title: Kaii-san to Asuka-kun no Ohanashi
mangas.titleNative: 怪異さんと飛鳥くんのお話
mangas.description:
"...This is troubling. The more Asuka warms up to me, the cuter he looks—"

Ever since the Kaii-san picked up Asuka-kun's commuter pass, he ended up settling down at Asuka-kun's house…!?

Eating meals together, trying out home gardening, spending Halloween together…

Little by little, the distance between the two of them seems to be shrinking.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Notes:

- Originally self-published on Twitter, later commercially released by Kadokawa on January 10, 2025.

- Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sakurai-kun wa Youkya ni Naritai
mangas.titleNative: 桜井くんは陽キャになりたい
mangas.synonyms: Sakurai-kun Wants To Be a Hottie
mangas.description: Sakurai, who has always been a "shadowy person'' since childhood, decided to break away from that self when he got a job. He was supposed to make his debut as a "positive person'' based on information he had heard on the Internet, but on his first day at the company, he suddenly committed a crime against Toba, who was rumored to be a "demon boss.'' Coupled with self-loathing, Sakurai cries in front of Toba when he runs into her in the bathroom, but something seems strange about Toba? Misunderstanding between a demon boss and a fake positive rookie ∞ A romantic comedy

mangas.title: When a BL Fan Falls in Love
mangas.titleNative: 腐男子も歩けば恋に沼る
mangas.description:
Ruri Orio, known as the Aloof Prince on campus, is the center of attention no matter where he goes thanks to his beauty. He also has a secret. He's a hardcore BL fan! He's serious about his hobby and doesn't want to be laughed at about it. But his precious, secret hobby gets found out by the playboy on campus, Takumi. Takumi sweetly melts Ruri's twisted psyche, body and soul. But Takumi has ulterior motives...?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shimeji Simulation
mangas.titleNative: シメジ シミュレーション
mangas.description: A girl who shut herself in a closet for the last 2 years of middle school realizes she has to go to high school. When she exits her closet for the first time in two years and looks at herself in the mirror, she notices that she grew shimeji mushrooms out of her head.

mangas.title: Tomie
mangas.description: Tomie Kawakami is a femme fatale with long black hair and a beauty mark just under her left eye. She can seduce nearly any man, and drive them to murder as well, even though the victim is often Tomie herself. While one lover seeks to keep her for himself, another grows terrified of the immortal succubus. But soon they realize that no matter how many times they kill her, the world will never be free of Tomie.

mangas.title: MURMUR
mangas.description: Jinah has a secret habit: she can't fall asleep without the explicit ASMR videos of a mysterious YouTuber named NA. It's the only thing that calms her insomnia, even if the creator's voice and trademark lip mole are hauntingly familiar. But when her company hosts a workshop featuring the internet's hottest star, Jinah's digital fantasy becomes a physical nightmare. NA is actually Heo Jina, the high school "friend" who stole Jinah's first love and left her life in ruins. Now, it turns out the woman who ruined her is the only one who can make her feel alive...

mangas.title: Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri
mangas.synonyms: Just The Two of Them in The Nurse's Office
mangas.description:
What kind of secret love is going on in the infirmary today!?



A caring class president and a delinquent who skips class.

A kind intern teacher and a devoted member of the school infirmary committee.

A serious student council president and her devilish vice president.

The ace of the basketball team and her childhood friend, the manager.

The story takes place in the infirmary of a high school for girls,

Featuring girls who fall deeply in love with each other with all their heart,
a sensational adolescent love story!



(Source: MF Comics Flapper Series, translated)


Note: Chapter count includes eight extras.

mangas.title: Light of My Life
mangas.titleNative: ライトオブマイライフ
mangas.description: Back in high school, best friends Aki and Minagi were inseparable. Aki dreamed of becoming a professional football player, while Minagi was seen as a "genius" who was eager to chase his dream of working in medicine. Years later, Aki has taken over his grandfather's hair salon, and Minagi set his interest in medicine aside to work in a host club. Despite the growing tension between them following their high school fallout, Minagi shows up at Aki's apartment one day asking for a place to stay. Can the two men confront their past in order to repair their future?

mangas.title: Scarlet Secret
mangas.description:
Yamato lost his dear childhood friend Shiki, who was sacrificed during a ritual. His unrequited love became an obsession; he refused to believe that Shiki was dead, and many years later he finally managed to search for him in the sacred palace forbidden to men, where he learned a terrible secret.



Shiki was kept alive and made to inherit the superhuman power that will make him the king of the country. Yamato swears to repress his feelings and follow Shiki as his servant, but...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Don't Break Yuri
mangas.synonyms: Don't Break the Glass Work | Donbrick Glass | Don't Brick Glass | Tangled Up In Bad Things
mangas.description:
Jijon City Jijon High School. Yeo Chan-Wook, the school's most tyrannical and unstoppable child, falls in love with his ideal type at first sight.
But his ideal type is... Jijon High School's top otaku, Han Yu-Ri?! Because of his heavy-duty glasses, Chan-Wook can't recognize Yu-Ri. To make matters worse, the two become mentors and mentees as part of a school-based learning program. With detection a sure death, Yu-Ri's dangerous double life begins!

Will Yu-Ri be able to graduate safely without Chan-Wook discovering his identity?

mangas.title: Gimme Some Love!
mangas.synonyms: Give Me Some Attention | Attention, Give That to Me | Please Pay Attention To Me
mangas.description:
The new semester is buzzing with students eager to make friends. Nam Soo-Min, however, has only one goal: survive the year without getting dragged into anyone's business. Enter Lee Jae-Ha, the ultimate social butterfly and Soo-Min's brand-new classmate and roommate. For someone like Jae-Ha, being ignored is unthinkable. And Soo-Min? He just made the mistake of catching his eye. Try as he might to escape, Soo-Min finds himself tangled up in Jae-Ha's wild orbit.

"How much longer are you gonna ignore me? Give me some attention!"

It's the unstoppable force of popularity versus the immovable wall of indifference... and the semester has only just begun!

mangas.title: I Can See Your Stats!
mangas.description:
An estate to manage, a lover to tame.

Following the gruesome death of his family, mage Eyra inherits the Solath Estate and becomes a lord overnight, only to discover that he can suddenly see the stats of everyone he meets. Enter Yanu, a dashing jack-of-all-trades who seems hell-bent on distracting him from his newfound duties...



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Moritat
mangas.description:
With all his memories wiped out, Jesse wakes up in the hospital and in front of him stands a man that suggests he's Jesse's lover. However, the only fragmented memory Jesse has of that man is him trying to kill Jesse. But is his fragile memory reliable? Who's telling the truth and what is actually going on? Why was he in the hospital to begin with? A luxury BL thriller that will keep you wanting for more.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

mangas.title: Delinquent Daddy and Tender Teacher: Four-Leaf Clovers
mangas.titleNative: 元ヤンパパ と ヒツジ先生 よつば
mangas.synonyms: Moto Yankee Papa to Hitsuji-sensei: Yotsuba
mangas.description: Elementary-school teacher Hitsuji has been dating Hatoyama for a year now, spending his days peacefully with him and his adorable son, Hinata. The arrival of another spring ushers in Hinata's third year of elementary school, and this time his teacher isn't Hitsuji! Hatoyama and Hinata are understandably anxious about this, but it seems Hitsuji is grappling with his own feelings about the situation as well. Then, when someone from Hatoyama's delinquent past comes back into his orbit, Hitsuji's insecurities threaten to get the better of him. Will he be able to defend his place at Hatoyama's side?

mangas.title: Try & I Love You
mangas.description:
After being dumped, Takumi rants to his childhood friend Ren, who suggests, "Why don't we try dating?"



(Source: Manga Planet)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Payback
mangas.description:
While other students were preparing to take their CSAT exams, Lee Yu-Han was swept up in an exhilarating lifestyle of crime and debauchery. While working for a loan shark, karma catches up to him when a family member dies from an act of revenge against him. After years of repenting for his sins and trying to turn over a new leaf, he meets a man in the entertainment industry who gives him the opportunity to get his revenge…



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)



Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sleeping on Paper Boats
mangas.description:
Kei Kitahara, a visionary screenwriter who has taken postwar Japan by storm, has made the difficult decision to lay down his pen for good after he realizes the people he's been basing his characters on have all met unfortunate ends. He spends his days in misery, waiting to die, until a reason to live finds him in the gutter, too drunk and beaten to move. Kei can't help but be attracted to his savior's bewitching innocence, and the urge to write about him grows stronger by the day. Knowing he can't take the risk, he vows to never use his pen against him, but will temptation prove too great?



(Source: SuBLime)



Notes:

- Chapters 1 to 8 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Unintentional Love Story: Side Story
mangas.synonyms: 非意図的恋愛談～俺は恋愛なんか求めてない！～外伝
mangas.description:
More episodes of Unintentional Love Story - find out what happens to Won-Young & Tae-Jun, Dong-Hui & Ho-Tae, and cutie pie Bean!

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru
mangas.synonyms: 君の夜に触れる アニメイトセット
mangas.description:
This is an "after-story" about their honeymoon period.



Note: A booklet originally bundled with the Animate edition of the tankoubon.

mangas.title: After the Curtain Call
mangas.description: Soyoung is devastated when her favorite musical actor is swallowed up by the world of TV. Just after she quits supporting him, she discovers charismatic actress Jaeyi in a theater performance of "Macbeth" and becomes a fan at first sight. By meeting Jaeyi after her shows and even doing her a favor, Soyoung goes from a mere fan to her good friend. But when Jaeyi has to work with celebrity actress Hyesun, who she has a troubled past with, it unexpectedly sours their friendship. All Soyoung wanted was to support her favorite actress... so why does this new development bother her so much?

mangas.title: I Married My Female Friend
mangas.titleNative: 女ともだちと結婚してみた。
mangas.description:
Kurumi and Ruriko made a deal: if they were both single in five years, they would marry each other. Five years later, neither woman is attached, so it's time for a wedding! Marriage is full of firsts, especially for two friends, so they have a lot to learn about each other in their newly shared home. But will they continue this arrangement like two especially close roommates…or will a different kind of love bloom between them?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Monthly in the Garden with My Landlord
mangas.description:
Manga editor Asako Suga decides moving into a new home is just the thing she needs to get over a painful breakup with her toxic ex-girlfriend. She finds the perfect place for rent—affordable, spacious, lovely garden included—but there's one catch. The house comes with a live-in landlord! It's disappointing enough that Asako can't have the single life she hoped for, but her cute landlord also seems to be hiding a big secret...Will living together bring them closer, or turn out to be more trouble than it's worth?



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Master of the Fox Bead
mangas.description:
Lee Jinhwa lived an ordinary life until she swallowed a fox bead gifted by a mysterious peddler, mistaking it for a wish-fulfilling marble. Little did Jinhwa know that her actions would lead her to be haunted by Koo Miho, an infamous nine-tailed fox who wishes to retrieve the bead. To add fuel to the fire, Jinhwa soon discovers that she's also become a target for various spirits and demons, and the only way to extract the cause of the issue is for Miho to kill her... or kiss her!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Kieta Hatsukoi Shougekijou
mangas.description:
Kieta Hatsukoi spin-off series is here! A compilation of short stories situated in the Kieta Hatsukoi universe.



Note: Included in volume 7 of Kieta Hatsukoi.

mangas.title: I Want to Be a Wall
mangas.titleNative: わたしは壁になりたい
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Be the Wall
mangas.description:
Any love story aficionado will say that the key to a successful couple is intense desire for one another-but what if the characters in question are an asexual woman with a passion for Boys Love stories and a gay man whose heart forever belongs to his oblivious childhood friend? Although romance will never be in the cards for newlyweds Yuriko and Gakurouta, the bond blossoming between them promises to be a wonderful relationship-the likes of which neither has ever experienced before…



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Haru Tsuzuru, Sakura Saku Kono Heya de
mangas.titleNative: 春綴る、桜咲くこの部屋で
mangas.synonyms: Composing Spring in This Room Where Cherry Blossoms Bloom
mangas.description: On her first day of university, Haruki had a fateful encounter with Sakura in the lecture hall. They were attracted to each other and lived together after graduation, but suddenly they had to part ways. Sakura had disappeared from this world. Five years have passed since then, and it is the fifth cherry blossom season. Haruki, who was still in a state of grief, happened to find a diary. It was the unfinished diary written by Sakura.

mangas.title: Negative-kun to Positive-kun
mangas.titleNative: ネガティブ君とポジティブ君
mangas.description: Extremely negative Fujiwara-kun and overly positive Tachibana-kun are... a couple. While eating lunch hand-in-hand, they have their dates. In the midst of a bustling routine, this duo's carefree tale of love occurs--a small part of which is shared in this book.

mangas.title: The Summer You Were There
mangas.description:
Shizuku is a shy girl who hardly talks to other people. Instead, she loses herself in creative writing, crafting a novel that she never plans to show anyone. But when Kaori–Shizuku's cute, popular classmate–gets her hands on Shizuku's manuscript, everything changes. Kaori is a huge fan, and suggests that Shizuku can get inspiration for her writing if the two of them start dating! Can these very different young ladies create their own love story together?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: I Love Amy
mangas.description:
Bibi is a bubbly girl who's deeply obsessed with Peter, the cutest boy at her high school. So when she sees a random girl talking to him, Bibi invites her to a sleepover with malicious intent... only to have a surprisingly nice time! That's how she makes friends with Amy, a shy and sweet girl who agrees to help Bibi get with Peter. But as they cook up all sorts of love schemes to win Peter over, Amy's place in Bibi's heart grows bigger and bigger by the day...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Therapy Game
mangas.description:
Recently dumped, and very straight, Shizuma tries to drink his sorrow away, only to wake up being spooned by a man! When he explains to Minato, his drunken fling, that he doesn't remember a thing about their night together, Minato secretly vows to seduce him again—and then dump him as revenge! But even the best-laid plans can go awry when Cupid has his way.



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
mangas.titleNative: さんかく窓の外側は夜
mangas.description:
Shy bookstore clerk Kosuke Mikado has the ability to see ghosts and spirits, an ability he wishes he didn't have, since what he sees usually terrifies him. Rihito Hiyakawa, an exorcist whose supernatural powers are as strong as his social graces are weak, doesn't seem to fear anything, mortal or otherwise. When this odd couple gets together to solve the bizarre cases that come their way, their work methods may not be entirely safe for work!


(Source: Sublime Manga)



Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Earl and The Fairy
mangas.titleNative: 伯爵と妖精～あいつは優雅な大悪党～
mangas.description: Edgar Ashenbert claims to be descended from the human ruler of the fairy kingdom, and he urgently needs Lydia's help to find and claim his birthright, the legendary sword of the Blue Knight Earl. Things will never be the same for Lydia as she is pulled into a dangerous quest against dark forces!

mangas.title: TRUMP
mangas.description:
Sophie, half-human and half-vampire. He is transferred to a school called Clan and begins living with other young vampires who are also undergoing their Cocoon periods, or puberty in human terms.
In this world, vampires die like humans. But there is a legend about Trump, the only vampire who has the life of an immortal.

mangas.title: The Black Mirror
mangas.description:
"Should I tell you the truth?" Ever since a traumatic incident caused him to lose all of his childhood memories, Tae-jun has been haunted by terrifying hallucinations and nightmares. While apartment hunting one day, a hallucination leads him to Yeon-woo, a handsome man who recognizes him immediately. But after moving into Yeon-woo's spare room, Tae-jun begins to have recurring nightmares of bloody, disembodied hands groping him… As an unexpected attraction grows between the two men, will Tae-jun be able to uncover the hidden secrets of his past? Or are some secrets better left untold?


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Jibi Eopseo
mangas.description:
Hae-Jun Go, who ran from home, and Eun-Yeong Baek, the problem child who lives in a tent. These two, who met under terrible circumstances, are forced to live together in an abandoned dormitory. This is a story of difficult growth between two people who hate both the dorm and each other.



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Kono Koi wo Hoshi ni wa Negawanai
mangas.titleNative: この恋を星には願わない
mangas.description:
A beautiful and delicate love story in which different kinds of "love" intersect.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Goodbye, My Rose Garden
mangas.titleNative: さよならローズガーデン
mangas.description: England, the early 1900s. Alice, a young noblewoman, has a Japanese maid named Hanako working in her household. The two have a fairly typical relationship…until the day Alice begs Hanako to kill her. As Hanako tries to figure out why her mistress would make such a terrible request, she and Alice grow closer until an entirely new feeling begins to blossom between them.

mangas.title: Best Left Unwritten
mangas.description: Choi Sun-Woo and Ahn Hae-Jin couldn't have come from more different backgrounds. With a renowned linguistics professor for a father and an extremely successful author for a mother, Sun-Woo was perfectly set up for a successful career in writing. Ahn Hae-Jin however, had been left to take care of himself ever since he was in high school, working part time jobs just to survive. The two become unexpected friends as the sole members of the creative writing club, but after a dramatic falling out, Sun-Woo and Hae-Jin lose touch for years until unexpectedly meeting again working for the same publishing company. Sun-Woo and Hae-Jin try to keep things professional, but their sudden reunion dredges up painful memories from the past along with feelings they had both struggled to suppress…

mangas.title: Killer Crush
mangas.synonyms: When the Killer Falls in Love
mangas.description:
A killer only has to do three things. Go on missions. Kill people. Leave absolutely no trace behind. Joo Taeman has 14 years of experience under his belt and he's never let his feelings get the better of him. Never. That is, until Taeman experiences butterflies in his stomach after seeing national sweetheart Kang Dahyeok in person. But as it turns out, Taeman's not the only one smitten on the spot. Dahyeok's been looking for someone who can help him escape his reputation as a hunky heartthrob to live his gritty noir dreams. This killer crush's out to get someone, but who'll be the first to succumb?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation: Mo Dao Zu Shi
mangas.description:
Feared and hated for his sinister abilities, Wei Wuxian–the grandmaster of demonic cultivation–was driven to his death when the most powerful clans united to destroy him.

Thirteen years later, Wei Wuxian is reborn. Summoned by a young man who sacrificed his soul in a forbidden ritual, Wei Wuxian is now bound to seek vengeance on the stranger's behalf or risk the destruction of his own soul. But when an evil entity emerges, a familiar face from Wei Wuxian's past suddenly appears amidst the chaos–Lan Wangji, a powerful cultivator who will help shine a light on the dark truths that surround them.

mangas.title: King's Maker
mangas.synonyms: キングスメーカー〜その皇子、キングメーカーに誓う〜
mangas.description:
Wolfgang Goldenleonard, the 4th Prince of the kingdom, returns to the palace after years of living in hiding. He rejects everything about his new royal life, but is intrigued by the mysterious and dutiful Shin Soohyuk, a catamite of the King. As Wolfgang slowly opens up and learns the ways of the palace, Soohyuk begins to see something special about the wild, unkempt, and stubborn young prince. He might just be the one Soohyuk has been waiting for... the one who could light the flame of rebellion.



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Marugoto Zenbu ni Koishite yo
mangas.titleNative: まるごとぜんぶに恋してよ
mangas.description:
Ran, who loves cute things, is caught by Haruma, the boy he has a crush on, while cross-dressed as a maid. Thinking his love is over, he braces himself for rejection, but Haruma reacts in a way he never expected...!?



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Catch You Later
mangas.titleNative: キャッチ ユー レイター
mangas.description: An indecisive seme and a distrustful uke, a tender and heartbreaking love story between two awkward childhood friends who pray for happiness. [The one I loved has died. He smiled as gently as the spring sun.] Ritsu, a university student, is tormented by loneliness and regret after the sudden death of the person he had a crush on. At the funeral, he is reunited with his childhood friend Hinato, with whom he had a falling out two years ago. When Hinato says he wants to make up, Ritsu accepts his apology, and the two of them grow closer again. However, Hinato has a serious secret—? A story of two people who take a step forward in a new life, where their existence gives each other courage and hope, begins now.

mangas.title: As My Fave Idol Likes
mangas.titleNative: 推しアイドル様のお気に召すまま
mangas.description:
My new roommate is my fave idol?!

Company employee Haruma has two main hobbies: stanning a popular male idol group and playing an online RPG game. When noise complaints from the neighbors force him to find a new place to live, his gaming buddy offers to let him move in as a roommate. Everything is going smoothly... until the day of the move, when he sees the guy in person and realizes he's just moved in with his fave idol, Ryuta! Haruma decides to hide the fact that he's a fan, but that doesn't save him from the overwhelming power of Ryuta's puppy-dog eyes as he pleads for Haruma to help him with the "skin-to-skin contact" he's been missing. Things are escalating quickly in this secret love affair between a super idol and his loyal fan!

mangas.title: Hajimemashite, Ore no Shinyuu
mangas.titleNative: はじめまして、オレの親友
mangas.synonyms: Nice to Meet You, My Best Friend
mangas.description:
Shoutarou Tokitou, a university student, shares a room with his childhood friend Rin Kazama. When they were kids, the two of them went everywhere and did everything together. Shoutarou was always overprotective of Rin, who always followed him around, but after they started living together, Rin's attitude became cold and he started playing around with women... Before he knew it, a gap had formed between the two of them. One day, they got into an argument after Rin brought a woman into the house without permission, and in the process, Rin hit his head and lost all memory of their relationship. The two decided to continue living together as before for the sake of his treatment, but Rin is still as attached to Shoutarou as in the past... but seems to have ulterior motives...!?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Expiration Date
mangas.description: Betrayed by their lovers on the same night, Seoin and Minho part ways—only to meet again years later. Now a pro golfer, Minho won't stop chasing Seoin. But when Gitae and Muyoung resurface, the past they tried to bury comes back to life.

mangas.title: Sandwich Paradox
mangas.synonyms: サンドイッチ・パラドックス
mangas.description:
After spending his childhood in the countryside with his grandmother, Ji-Ho finally moves to the city to attend his dream university. Just one month into campus life, he accidentally walks back into a lecture hall to grab his forgotten wallet - only to stumble upon two men in the middle of a heated encounter. Hoping to slip away unnoticed, Ji-Ho is caught by one of them: the enigmatic upperclassman Yeong-Won. Ji-Ho tries to brush it off and return to normal, but Yeong-Won seems to have other plans…


Why won't this guy leave him alone? And what exactly does he want from Ji-Ho?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: My Favorite Idol Won't Let Go of My Heart!
mangas.titleNative: 推しアイドルが俺の心を離さない!?
mangas.description:
A university student named Haruto Kusakabe is a fan of the famous idol Touri from the group V.Fiz. One day he goes to a house for his house cleaning part time job and is suddenly kissed by the owner, leading to things heating up!? Thinking that the sexy facial expressions and voice seem familiar, he realizes it's Touri himself...! His idol is a god-like existence but the true Touri is very friendly, and spending time together Haruto becomes more enticed by things like his kindness, sweet gestures and words. Is he feeling butterflies because he's a fan...? Or another reason... "I can't help it, you're too adorable." An inexperienced university nerd is being desired by a ditsy beautiful idol!?



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: Shoma Koi: This Ain't Some Shoujo Manga!
mangas.titleNative: 少女マンガなら叶わない恋
mangas.description:
Three best friends—a handsome prince-like guy, an airheaded princess-like girl, and a snappy punk—have been together ever since elementary school. Sunao, the punk, has been doing his best to keep the one-sided feelings he has for Hiroomi, the popular prince, a secret. But recently, tons of blush-worthy situations keep happening to him, making it hard to keep his feelings under wraps... Turns out, Hiroomi's been the one orchestrating all these encounters! He's head-over-heels for Sunao, and ready to win him over!



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: A Lying Novelist And His Fated One
mangas.titleNative: 嘘つき小説家と運命の人
mangas.synonyms: Usotsuki Shousetsuka to Unmei no Hito
mangas.description:
Koutarou Izumi, a love story novelist, has a secret weapon for when he runs out of ideas: the bittersweet diary of his one-sided love for Takaaki Yamamoto, a classmate back in college. When a friend mentions to Koutarou that Takaaki's gotten married, he decides to try out a dating app in order to find a new love, to find new tropes for his novels... and to forget about Takaaki...

On his first date using the app, Koutarou's nervous walking to the meeting point, and who does he see there, waiting for him...!? This must be fate...

mangas.title: Sweet Dream Desires
mangas.titleNative: 甘い夢だけむさぼって
mangas.description:
"What a convenient dream..."



College student Fuyuki sees and feels Umi, his childhood friend and roommate, touching his body, but... it was all a dream, right? While Fuyuki's has had a crush on Umi for a while, he thinks he's ill-suited to someone as kind and capable as his friend. He keeps his feelings under wraps, but one night when he's sleeping, Fuyuki feels something against his bare skin. When he opens his eyes, he sees Umi hovering over him. "Hey, Fuyuki... Let me dream with you!" he begs, as he overflows with uncontrollable desire for his childhood friend.



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Wan to Naitara Kiss Shite Nadete
mangas.titleNative: わんと鳴いたらキスして撫でて
mangas.description:
Notes:

- During serialization, Chapters 1, 3, 5 to 8, and 10 to 11 were split into two parts, while Chapters 2, 4 and 9 was split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume releases.

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love Among Lies
mangas.titleNative: 嘘だとしても愛してる
mangas.description:
"Are we actually dating...?"

When he pretends to have amnesia, the guy he hates starts acting like his boyfriend?!



College seniors Maho and Yuma bicker so much that their classmates call them an old married couple. Upon waking up in the hospital after a nasty fall, Maho decides to get revenge by pretending to forget who Yuma is, only for Yuma to tell him that the two of them are going out! Just when Maho is about to tell Yuma to knock it off, Yuma suddenly begins cuddling up to him like a loving partner. As panic begins to set in about Yuma's extreme transformation, Yuma pushes him down onto the bed with a practiced expression "like he always does"... But they really were on bad terms, right...?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Former Girl Idol, High School Hunk
mangas.titleNative: アイウインクでころがして
mangas.description:
Iori Minase still can't forget about his favorite idol, Chika Izumi, even after she retires.

One day, rumors start swirling about the new super hot freshman transfer student, Chikage Misumi, which Iori couldn't care less about... until he realizes that Chikage's actually the grown-up Chika Izumi in the flesh! The once cute and dainty girl idol is now a tall, handsome young man. Despite his new look, Iori's heart still goes a-flutter when he's around him...! Chikage, on the other hand, loathes the fact that Iori knows his secret, and decides to manipulate the upperclassman's adoration for him to his benefit.

A heartwarming love story of a devilish hunk who has his cute little fanboy wrapped around his finger!

mangas.title: Showered With His Loving Thoughts
mangas.titleNative: アイツの本音がダダ漏れ過ぎて、俺はもうダメかもしれない
mangas.synonyms: Hearing My Coworker's Innermost Thoughts Is Driving Me Crazy!
mangas.description:
Keiichi is a businessman who doesn't get along with his subordinate, Souma, who's always treating him with contempt. But, one day, when Keiichi's down after being dumped by a girl, Souma suddenly kisses him! On top of that, things escalate and they head straight to the bedroom... As Keiichi tries to comprehend how Souma can be so passionate with him... he then suddenly hears Souma's sweet voice as they make love. Keiichi wonders if what he's hearing are Souma's genuine feelings, since they've never gotten along up to that point. With each passing day, Keiichi starts thinking more and more about Souma... This is the story of a top hiding an intense love behind a stoic façade and a bottom who can hear what his partner's thinking when they get intimate.

An unusual love battle begins!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Baa-chelor No More! - The Sheep Who Dreamed of Marriage
mangas.description: Creme has spent his life acting as a guardian to his younger siblings, looking after them until they get married. But by putting his family first, he ends up neglecting his own dream of getting married. Just when all hope seems lost, a marriage proposal arrives. However, his potential partner turns out to be none other than a wolf—a sheep's natural enemy. Despite the risk, Creme sets off to meet the wolf. Upon arriving, he's bombarded with demands and given an unexpected glow-up, before finally coming face to face with Akiya, his future mate. With the sheep trembling in fear before him, Akiya traces Creme's neck with his tongue and asks, "So you've come to be eaten, lamb?" But what are his true intentions...?

mangas.title: My Childhood Friend's Inner Voice Is Overflowing with Love
mangas.titleNative: 幼馴染みの心の声は「好き」であふれてる
mangas.synonyms: The Heart of a Childhood Friend is Brimming with Whispers of Love
mangas.description:
"Hey... Can I kiss you?"

The childhood friend who was supposed to hate him suddenly gives him a kiss that feels so good he could melt...!? High-school students Sota and Ryuji used to be best friends in their childhood. However, something caused the two of them to quarrel. But, bumping heads one day made Sota hear Ryuji's inner voice...!! Plus, despite thinking that Ryuji hated him, what he heard instead was "He's so cute. I wanna kiss him" and other sweet words... The unexpected true feelings of his childhood friend made his heart race...!

mangas.title: My Good-Hearted Darling
mangas.description:
Shy and reserved Lee-Won has admired the charismatic Seo Han-Gun for years, but their unexpected friendship blossoms into first love during middle school. Torn apart by reality, they lose touch for eight years—until a chance reunion in Busan forces them to confront old wounds and lingering feelings. Can love overcome the pain of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Voices in the Sea Foam
mangas.description: For years, Aito thought he was just a normal kid—until the day he fell in love with a boy at school. Suddenly, a flood of memories come rushing back, reminding him of his first life as the tragic little mermaid who risked everything for her prince, only to fade away into foam. But memories aren't all that Aito inherits, as a mysterious power wrenches away his ability to speak or stand before his crush without agonizing pain. Ever since, Aito has sworn off love in self-defense, but a fateful encounter with his charming college classmate Toru might just irrevocably shake up his world…

mangas.title: Off Stage Love Side Re
mangas.titleNative: オフステージラブサイドRe

mangas.title: Surviving as a Player
mangas.description:
Trapped in the gaming world of Elix, Sehyun's once mode of solace is now his prison. Here, one must conquer empires or be conquered. What's more, dying in-game means dying in real life. Stuck in a perilous reality, Sehyun must save his empire while facing the effects of his corrupt past. To do so, he must regain the trust of his Grand Duke, Ruhak. But since he has so much resentment toward Sehyun, the only way to appease Ruhak is to succumb to his needs, no matter how immoral or carnal they are.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Work Love Balance
mangas.description:
Ahn Yiyoung has won big in both his career and love. Not only is the start-up company he started with his college friends thriving, but he's also dating SJ Group's talented director, Kang Daehyung. Well, "former" director, that is. After resigning from his position, Daehyung has been doing everything to be Yiyoung's perfect trophy boyfriend at home. But it won't be long until Daehyung is back to wearing his professional suits, now as the investor and director of Yiyoung's company! How will these two keep things balanced between work life and love life?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Inochigake Dummy Romance
mangas.titleNative: 命懸けダミーロマンス
mangas.description:
"This guy's my lover."

Ryou quit his job after his girlfriend invited him to join a pyramid scheme. One day, when he went to her home, he was worried about her and found a large number of Yakuza! Ryou is in a desperate situation when he is suspected of being in league with his girlfriend, who has absconded with money belonging to the Daikoku clan, and is rescued by Miyoshi, a junior high school classmate who happens to be a member of the Daikoku clan. The two end up living together as fake lovers until the situation cools down, but Miyoshi, who was supposed to be a good friend at the time, is quite cold toward Ryou...?

mangas.title: My Ship Couple Adores Me, But They Got It All Wrong!
mangas.titleNative: 推しカプに愛されて解釈違いです！！
mangas.synonyms: Oshi Couple ni Aisarete Kaishaku Chigai desu!!
mangas.description:
Mio's a BL fanfic junkie AND the leader of an idol group called "TryTrick"... Put those two together and you might notice he's totally shipping the two other members of his group, Nagi and Akira! However, Mio always finds himself getting between the two of them during shows and they both seem to be coming onto him?! Fan service on stage has been getting crazier with touchy moments, hugs, kisses, and more...! Akira Nagi X Mio has been progressing relentlessly amongst the fandom!!!!!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Memai wa Madoi no Tsugai
mangas.titleNative: 目眩はまどいのつがい
mangas.description:
On the day of the earthquake, Hato, an Omega unable to return home, finds shelter for the night in a secondhand bookstore run by a man named Kazumi. "In times like these, I guess you could say we're in the same boat." Touched by Kazumi's quiet kindness, Hato begins to feel a faint affection for him. A few days later, Hato happens to visit a bar where Kazumi works part-time. But as an Alpha, Kazumi instantly senses that Hato is not only an Omega, but also someone deeply compatible with him...!?



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Low Temperature Burns
mangas.description:
I started living alone with my crush.

Lee Tae-Eun, who started living alone as he had always wanted to due to his parents' sudden overseas assignment. However, his joy was short-lived, as he found out that his roommate was Cha Jin-Heon, and he wanted to avoid him at all costs. Jin-Heon was his long-time crush and a childhood friend who had unilaterally cut ties with him. Tae-Eun, who impulsively confessed to him while drunk three years ago but was frustrated when it didn't reach his heart at all and went into hiding, is now in a difficult situation after their unexpected reunion. He begins living together with Jin-Heon without any particular plan, but Jin-Heon is very angry at Tae-Eun and is not easy. He even set a rule of living together that they should never interact privately. And Tae-Eun, who is trying to persuade Jin-Heon in any way, faces difficult days ahead...

mangas.title: KasuRich
mangas.description:
University student Mikado Kasuga lives for his favorite streamer, Zurich (real name: Rihito Nakahara). Convinced he's the only one who truly understands the man behind the screen, Mikado goes to an event to see his idol in person. But their meeting doesn't go the way he imagined—and Mikado soon learns that Zurich also has a peculiar and mutual attachment to him. A unique BL about the twisted, codependent bond between an obsessive streamer and possessive fan.



(Source: Manga UP!)

mangas.title: The Dungeon Raid is Just a Side Quest
mangas.synonyms: You Don't Have to Choose Just One, Right?
mangas.description:
Isca is a promiscuous dark wizard who scrapes by doing guild quests. In a dungeon, he meets Sian, a beautiful priest hiding his looks, and Khalit, a demon prince seeking his lost powers.

Sparks fly, jealousy brews, and an accidental quest to save their world begins!

mangas.title: The Dark Duke's Pet Bird
mangas.description:
What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father's violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Shinigami ni Hanataba
mangas.description:
Jade, a soldier, is abandoned after being taken prisoner, only to be found by Rene, a member of a tribe known as "the Reaper's Messengers." Haunted by survivor's guilt and the voices of his fallen comrades, Jade struggles with the weight of being the only one left alive. But Rene's words and warmth slowly pull him out of his nightmares and back into reality.



As Jade finds himself drawn to Rene, he cannot bring himself to accept the tribe's way of finding joy in death…



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Idol-sama wa Shitsuke ga Warui
mangas.titleNative: アイドル様は躾が悪い
mangas.description: Note: Contains an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Follow That Kiss
mangas.description: Twenty-year-old Kouta works at a local guest house, and when a new part-timer joins the staff, he's mortified to learn it's someone he never thought he'd see again—his junior high classmate, Chizuru. Not only do these two share a past, they've shared a kiss, albeit one that only happened because of a "punishment game." Thanks to that, Kouta assumes Chizuru wants nothing to do with him. Yet the moment these two former classmates are alone together, Chizuru kisses Kouta again, then confesses he took the job just to be with him! Is this another cruel prank, or a chance to start over?

mangas.title: Virtual-kun wa Osananajimi wo Koinegau
mangas.titleNative: バーチャルくんはおさななじみを希う
mangas.description:
Popular virtual character streamer Keita has been searching for someone important to him—someone who vanished three years ago—while continuing his streaming activities. One day, he finds himself harassed by a group of strangers, only to be saved by a man with a voice he recognizes instantly. "This guy is mine," the man declares—and to Keita's shock, it's none other than his long-lost childhood friend, Yasuna! Yasuna had moved to the U.S. due to family circumstances but returned because he wanted to see Keita again. As they reconnect, they realize their feelings for each other have always been mutual, and their hearts and bodies draw closer at an overwhelming pace.

Keita wishes for these happy moments to last forever—but Taina faces a trial he must overcome before they can truly be together…!


(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Our Short-Term Dads are College Students?!
mangas.titleNative: 期間限定パパは大学生～お兄ちゃんと弟くん、拾いました～
mangas.description:
Two junior college students will become fathers today!



In the summer of their third year at university, Keisuke and Rei start raising children as their fathers despite not being married! Keisuke doesn't have many relationships with other people, and his only best friend on campus is Rei, a handsome and popular guy who is kind to everyone. Keisuke was the only close friend that Rei could talk to about his true feelings. However, Keisuke, who had fallen in love with Rei, was planning on confessing to him if the time was right, even though it was an unrequited love. One night, small children were in trouble at a convenience store. Rei says, "I can't just ignore them!" and the two boys end up taking care of the children, who don't want to go home.



(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

mangas.title: My Home as a Filming Location!
mangas.description:
A young beekeeper in the countryside, Yeon-Woo spends his free time drinking out of frustration. That is until he gets too drunk to remember signing a contract to rent out his house as a filming location for a variety show. Now Yeon-Woo finds himself sharing space with kind and handsome star actor Do-Jun Kang. Will this city transplant and country mouse's budding bromance survive beyond 10 days of shooting?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Destiny Ending
mangas.synonyms: Even if It's Not Fate, There's Always a Happy Ending
mangas.description: Influencer Ji-Han has been chasing his first love Do-Jin since high school, after Do-Jin suddenly vanished without a word. Now in college, a mysterious account that always likes his posts might be the clue that leads him back. In a world where love hides in likes and fate rewrites itself in DMs, can Ji-Han and Do-Jin finally hit "post" on their destiny ending?

mangas.title: Card Shark
mangas.description: The world's best poker players are called 'sharks', and the most ruthless among them is known simply as Czar. Kim Yoon and a gang of thugs roam from house to house, seeking this legendary figure - despite rumors that no one ever returns from his domain. One day, a man in a red hoodie warns Yoon, "Sir, you'll die if you keep this up." Ignoring the warning, Yoon leaves to gather money for a new game. Suddenly, he hears the chilling sound of bones smashing and bodies crushing. As the noise fades, Yoon finally comes face to face with Czar…but when he offers Yoon a chance to play, Yoon sees it as a golden opportunity and believes his life is about to change. "I'll try it."

mangas.title: Saseumgwa Majuchin Nun
mangas.description: 'Im Rok' has the nickname 'Lucky Deer', always with good luck. As usual, he won an event and went on a trip with his friends. He is invited to the island of Noah, a handsome and kind man. Luxurious islands and homes, they can't stop at Noah's hospitality. However, oddly enough, each of his friends disappeared, and to make matters worse, Imrok was freaking out underground.

mangas.title: Cradle of Imae
mangas.description: In the demon-plagued kingdom of Jinyeok, a child named Ryujin is born. Upon seeing him, a passing exorcist utters a warning: "Beware of fire." Yet by the time Ryujin is grown, the evil spirts have robbed him of all he holds dear. As his home stands engulfed in flames, the exorcist reappears, telling Ryujin to head for the Exorcism Academy. Here he will learn how to combat the demons that torment him. But on the way, he runs into the mysterious Imae. Henceforth, their bodies and souls become entwined… For Imae is his intense and unrelenting fate.

mangas.title: To Tame a Tyrant
mangas.description:
After transmigrating into his sister's favorite novel, art student Ethan Ji must adjust to the perils of life as a bodyguard in the imperial palace. His plan for survival depends on the novel's main character, ninth prince Jian Mu. But there's just one problem: there's a limit to how friendly he can be before the prince becomes attached. Can he show the prince the right path and earn enough money to leave? Or will taming the tyrant become the very thing that ties them together forever?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Sweet Sweets Boy
mangas.titleNative: スイートスイーツボーイ
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kiss the Abyss
mangas.description:
As a rookie game designer, Wang Zixin never imagined that he'd get sent to hell and back by the game's male protagonist. And the only way to escape this death cycle is by crossing into the game and raising Abyss, the game's male protagonist, healthily. Wang Zixin: "Not only do I have to go through this survival game, but I have to raise a child while doing so??? This isn't even humanly possible..."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Take Me Home
mangas.description:
Min-Hyuk's life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Sun-Woo, a quirky yet irresistibly cute guy he ends up living with by chance. At first, Sun-Woo's antics drive him crazy, but soon, his charm begins to grow on Min-Hyuk. Just as Min-Hyuk starts to enjoy their unusual cohabitation, Sun-woo drops a bombshell confession that turns his world upside down. With his peaceful life in turmoil, Min-Hyuk must navigate his feelings and the unexpected twists that come with living with someone as unpredictable as Sun-Woo. Will he be able to resist Sun-Woo's charms, or is he destined to fall for him?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Chapter count contains 3 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Main Villain-i Kkeomttakjiga Doeeobeoryeotda
mangas.synonyms: The Main Villain Is Stuck To Me Like Chewing Gum
mangas.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the webnovel of the same name.

mangas.title: Swept Away
mangas.description:
Ba-Da never dreamed of getting into a steamy relationship with a celebrity before. Well, until recently, that is. Now, after meeting famous actor Shim Chae-Yoon and getting an offer from the nation's heartthrob to teach him how to be in a relationship, Ba-Da has been having some explicit dreams. Except…maybe they're more than dreams. The line between dream and reality is fading faster by the day…

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Rock'n Roll in Forging
mangas.description: Nam Jungoo, who is the live bar’s most notable newcomer, and Joo Taekyoung, who is his core fanatic, and even plays the role of his manager. Jungoo, who was actually Taekyoung’s underclassman at his art school, was different from Taekyoung. Taekyoung, who had lived in an oppressive GwangGong family, and Jungoo, who had freedom unlike Taekyoung, was approached after finding the confidence to do so, and was rejected. So, his first love ended in vain, as the other can’t even remember him. By a second chance of fate, they meet once more. He decides this time to get closer to Jungoo, by concealing his identity, and ends up becoming his manager. Then one day, after a performance, Jungoo, who was unable to relieve his excitement, recommends that they spend a night together…

mangas.title: Murderous Lewellyn's Candlelit Dinner
mangas.description:
Life on rough, rundown Ira Street isn't easy at the best of times, but a recent string of murders has left the residents traumatized. Not Shavonne, though. He's too busy trying to get by to worry about some murderer. However, that all changes when he meets his peculiar new neighbor. Lewellyn is young and handsome, yet eccentric. Why does he spend all day peeling onions on the apartment stairs until his eyes are red-raw? And what's with those filthy black fingernails? Nevertheless, Shavonne reluctantly accepts a dinner invitation at his neighbor's place. But after he makes a gruesome discovery during the candlelit meal, suddenly the murders feel a lot closer to home…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Do You Really Like Me?
mangas.description: Cha Su-Hyeon has lived day by day without any big events in his life. Then he ends up having a one night stand with Song U-Jin, who sat at the same table at a company colleague's wedding. U-Jin even goes to the same building as Su-Hyeon, in the office across the street... Will Su-Hyeon be able to handle this man who changed ordinary daily life into a highly stimulating variety show?

mangas.title: Ruriiro de Kimi wo Kazatte
mangas.synonyms: Vẽ em bằng sắc lưu ly
mangas.description: Despite attending a prestigious art school and majoring in Japanese art, Shinagawa finds himself without inspiration or motivation to draw. One day, he meets a male nude model with a beautiful body. Shinagawa begs the man to model for him, but is coldly rejected.

mangas.title: Reunion
mangas.description:
"Do you know me?" A simple question was enough to change the trajectory of Lee Ha-kyung's life. Seven years ago, Ha-kyung was struggling to support his family when he was approached by a man with an offer: assume the identity of Han Jiyoung, a girl from his past, for the summer and deceive the chairman of Taewon Group into believing he was really her, and he'd never have to worry about money again. All goes according to plan, until the chairman's grandson, Yoonsung, shows up. One summer spent together forms a seemingly unbreakable bond between the two - and memories that should have lasted forever...



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Love Very Love Gauge
mangas.titleNative: ラブベリーラブゲージ
mangas.description:
Souta Inui, who has a timid personality, has a peculiar constitution that causes him to take on the form of a dog if "certain conditions'' are met. Ryo Kurose, a childhood friend who always helped Souta whenever he got bullied, will also turn into a cat if the same conditions are met.
The two were separated due to family circumstances when they were young, but reunited several years later.



Souta tells Ryo that he's always loved him, but Ryo doesn't take him seriously at all. Even though Souta declares that it is his turn to protect Ryo, he ends up being saved yet again. People love him when he's a dog, but he wants Ryo to like him as a human too.

(Source: Daitosha, translated)

mangas.title: If You Can't Get Hard, Let Me Make You Pant: A Sadistic Playboy's Godlike Technique
mangas.titleNative: 勃たねぇなら俺で喘いどけ～ドSチャラ男の神テク絶頂
mangas.synonyms: 既然硬不起來，就由我來讓你嬌喘吧～抖S輕浮男的絕頂神技
mangas.description:
Yota, a college student, had an earnest request... To cure his ED and enjoy campus life. Watching a porn video during class, hoping things might change if the situation were different, he was approached by Ren, a well-known playboy!! He said, "I jerk off to stuff like that a lot, too. I love it." When Yota opened up to him about his worries without realizing it, Ren started touching Yota, saying, "How about I beat you off?" As Ren made him feel good with his experienced, godlike technique, before Yota knew it, he started getting hard down there...!?



(Source: Mobile Media Research)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Could the Boy Next Door be a Vampire?
mangas.description: Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Woo-Ree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Min-Nee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Woo-Ree believes that Min-Nee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity-- he's completely unaware that Min-Nee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him. While Woo-Ree struggles to get his writing published and protect Min-Nee's "secret," Min-Nee must find a way to confess his feelings for the oblivious Woo-Ree. Will these two be able to reconcile their misunderstandings and allow for a real relationship to blossom?

mangas.title: Nectar
mangas.description:
Leo is host at a nightclub, and he always thought he had no interest in men — until he slept with Takahiro, a sex worker who introduced him to pleasures he'd never felt before. Now, sex with women doesn't satisfy him, and after begging Takahiro to sleep with him again, they agree to a "friends with benefits" arrangement.



But just when Leo thinks he may be falling in love, one of his best customers asks him to sleep with her. Takahiro catches him in the act, and things take a dark turn…



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Open the Door
mangas.synonyms: เปิดประตูสู่มหันตภัย
mangas.description:
"Mr. Esper, I told you already. I'm a B0-grade guide."



Lee Yeoni, a powerful dual-blood, has spent years hiding his striking looks and exceptional abilities while working in a quiet, rural town. But when circumstances force him to transfer to the capital, he finds himself entangled with Tae Hajin—an elite grade-S+ Esper with an intense, domineering presence.



Sensing that Yeoni is hiding something, Hajin becomes determined to uncover the truth. Using every trick at his disposal, he digs deeper into Yeoni's secrets, setting off a tense battle of wits and wills.



Desperate to protect his identity, Yeoni resists Hajin's pursuit—until he realizes he can turn the tables. If he must be exposed to danger, why not use Hajin as his shield? And so, he makes a bold decision…to become Hajin's exclusive guide.



A gripping story of hidden power, dangerous attraction, and the fine line between hunter and hunted.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Chiaki-kun Mimamori Club
mangas.titleNative: ちあきくん見守り倶楽部
mangas.description: On his way to school, high school boy Koma Taisuke is approached by a stranger who says to him, "We finally meet again." Koma is surprised, but later that day during class he is introduced to a new transfer student, Chiaki Kei—the same stranger who approached him on the street. What's more, Chiaki claims to be Koma's childhood friend!?

mangas.title: Amulet
mangas.description: Desperate for his father's love, Un-Hyuk agrees to a suspicious proposal: spend two years in a rural village acting as a protective charm, and in return, inherit the family business. In the village, he encounters Tae-Moon, a mysterious young man rumored to be possessed by a ghost. Despite being ostracized by the villagers, Tae-Moon tirelessly seeks their approval. Haunted by memories of his own painful past, Un-Hyuk finds himself drawn to Tae-Moon's plight and proposes a risky plan—one that could change both their fates and break the curse.

mangas.title: Kirei na Kimi ni Korosaretai.
mangas.titleNative: 綺麗な君に殺されたい。
mangas.synonyms: I Want To Be Killed By Your Beautiful Self
mangas.description:
Hijiri Tomoaki, a university counselor, lives a peaceful yet unfulfilling life. However, his life changes completely after he reunites with an old acquaintance, Amawashi Hajime. The mysterious problems his patients bring to him gradually begin to infringe on his daily life. What is the true nature of the strange phenomena in which they become embroiled, and what is the true purpose of Hajime, who suddenly appears before Tomoaki?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: PUNKS TRIANGLE stitch
mangas.description:
Chiaki, an aspiring fashion designer, and Ai, a charismatic male model, met in a design class and started dating not long after. Chiaki has always admired Ai, so for him, it's a dream come true. But the excitement of their new romance is about to get a wake-up call. While working on clothes for a school festival, Chiaki notices Ai spending more and more alone time with their classmate Rin. Is their love truly timeless, or is Chiaki going to be discarded like a piece of fast fashion?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Shuumatsu, Kimi to
mangas.description:
Gourmet BL. Two people peacefully enjoying meals together against the backdrop of a mysterious zombie outbreak.



Shuuhei is consumed by the promise he made with Tomoya back in middle school.



"Would you eat me?"



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Kimidori no Hibi
mangas.description: Note: Originally released at J. GARDEN 54, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for digital release.

mangas.title: Red Mansion
mangas.description:
A dilapidated mansion sits on the outskirts of Seoul. Among its residents are frauds, murderers, and psychopaths, all seeking refuge in the only place that will accept them. But not every resident of the run-down manor has come here by choice. Kim Sungkyung operates a minimart so that he can afford to take care of his parents, who have come down with a malignant disease. Having been born inside the four walls of the mansion, a life of depravity and deprivation is all he knows. The sole thing that gets him through is his obsession with the building's manager, Kwon Cheong-rim: a cruel and calculating figure seemingly only interested in the preservation of his own wealth and power. So when the enigmatic pretty boy begins to hint at a sort of faint interest in Sungkyung, the latter's obsession begins to grow as a single question echoes ceaselessly throughout his mind: "Why...?"



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Gogo no Midori de Machiawase
mangas.titleNative: 午後のみどりで待ち合わせ
mangas.description:
When Chikage was a child, he had a best friend named Rei, but he suddenly disappeared—and no one but Chikage remembered him.
Now a high school student, Chikage happens to run into Rei again, though he appears in a form unlike that of a human. It turns out Rei isn’t human at all—he’s more like a guardian spirit of the mountains and forests.
Determined not to lose Rei this time, Chikage visits him regularly and they meet in secret, but…?

An elusive “mononoke” (?) boy × a single-minded boy in a long-distance romance!!

mangas.title: Mukatsuku Aitsu ni Motto Naderaretai.
mangas.titleNative: むかつくアイツにもっと撫でられたい。
mangas.synonyms: 짜증 나는 그 녀석이 쓰다듬어 줬으면 좋겠어.
mangas.description:
Yuzuki and his co-worker Ayase, who used to fight all the time whenever they saw each other, are now lovers. They still argue constantly, and sometimes he still hates him...! But when Ayase's hands caress him and he feels Ayase's clumsy tenderness and affection, his face and body melt instantly...



(Source: Splush, translated)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mukatsuku Aitsu ni Naderaretai.
mangas.titleNative: むかつくアイツに撫でられたい。
mangas.description:
Yuzuki, a gay office worker with a severe hand fetish, has a colleague with whom he just can't get along. He is Ayase, the star of the sales department, who's a serious and considerate man, but a jerk to Yuzuki. Yuzuki is working hard at his job, but one morning he collapses at work, and the person who takes care of him is none other than Ayase! And when Ayase's hand touches Yuzuki's body, he feels a pleasure he's never felt before...!



(Source: Splush, translated)



Note: Includes extra chapters.

mangas.title: Daisy Jealousy
mangas.titleNative: デイジージェラシー
mangas.description: Misaki has always loved video games and would do anything to break into the industry. Despite his silly, happy-go-lucky attitude, he's always putting his head down to be the best game designer around. And Misaki's certain he is—at least, until he meets Kaname, a stoic genius who tops him in just about every way. With his skills, smarts, and sweet smile, Kaname has Misaki swirling in a pool of envy, admiration, and maybe even love. Will Misaki be able to overcome his jealousy and learn how to love Kaname?

mangas.title: Believe My Sign
mangas.description:
Soo-jeong is always getting on the self-absorbed Eunchan's nerves since he first appeared before him out of the blue.

Soo-jeong feels the same way towards the socially inept Eun-chan, who is often harsh towards him. Their ironic relationship develops as they try to survive together, even though they don't trust one another.

What should you trust? Your past experiences and memories, or intuition?

mangas.title: Nanka Mou A-Atte Kanji.
mangas.titleNative: なんかもうあーあって感じ。
mangas.description:
Moriya is a popular boy who is caring, honest, and well-liked by everyone. During the night on the school camping trip, he and his classmates decided to play a game of "king", and the one chosen as punishment had to spend the whole day together as lovers. The one who was chosen as the punishment was Tada, who got excellent grades but tended to skip classes and doesn't show much emotion...?



"Lovers... what should we do!?"



The relationship between two teenage boys, one outgoing and flirtatious, the other introverted but devoted.

It's a love story that will make your heart skip a beat.



(Source: EIWA Publishing, translated)



Notes:

- Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the DKxBL: schoolevent anthology.

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Henai Shishi to Mitsuai no Omega
mangas.titleNative: 偏愛獅子と、蜜檻のオメガ
mangas.synonyms: The Lion Lover and the Honey Cage Omega
mangas.description:
Your whole heart will be swallowed up -- Omori Private Academy, where elite beastman alphas attend. Otani Yuu, a human omega, is the only omega scholarship student at this academy. He wears a chastity belt and is used as live bait for the alphas' desires in "Estrus Endurance Training" during his rut season. One day, Mikimoto Shiou, the heir to the lion tribe and dorm supervisor, appears before Yuu...



(Source: MUGENUP, translated)

mangas.title: Itoshi no Shippo-chan
mangas.description: Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Under The Greenlight
mangas.synonyms: 綠色鐫像 UNDER THE GREENLIGHT
mangas.description:
Jin is the most perfectly beautiful man Matthew's ever seen. He's also a high-ranking and violent criminal full of frustrated ambitions and equally frustrated appetites. But Matthew, a sculpture student prodigy, can only see the beauty—not the darkness. One way or another, Matthew will pay the price for his muse, with his body... or with something far more costly.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Comic Party Wonder Love
mangas.titleNative: コミックパーティ ワンダーラブ
mangas.description:
A BL manga about men who love BL manga... and also each other. Fun, heartwarming and tantalizingly sexy, this is a boys love romance series about the world of making boys love comics!

Raizo and TOS are two men who also write BL in their spare time. Raizo is a cool, laidback and handsome guy whose dark BL style is popular, while TOS has a light and fluffy writing style, but is less popular due to his social awkwardness and difficulty communicating. Even though they are complete opposites in everything, they find themselves inexplicably drawn to one another...!

mangas.title: I'm Banging My Rival in a Parallel World!?
mangas.titleNative: 異世界に飛んだらライバルにハメられてました!?
mangas.description:
1-2) Isekai ni Tondara Rival ni Hameraretemashita!? (異世界に飛んだらライバルにハメられてました!?)

Amatatsu is a brash, but normal high school student until he wakes up in the middle of doing it with another guy!! To make matters worse, the culprit is his biggest rival, Sen! Is it really possible he's come to a parallel world where he and Sen are a couple...!?



3) Voice Complex (ボイスコンプレックス)

4) Shinyuu no Tachiichi (親友の立ち位置)

5) Momasete Marshmallow Honey (揉ませてマシュマロハニー)

6) Isekai no Ore ga Rival deshita!? (異世界の俺がライバルでした!?)


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Lovers on the Last Train
mangas.description:
Harue and Fujishima are complete opposites with the same problem: they both work in fast-paced industries and have little time to date. But when they match with each other on a dating app, they take the time to get to know each other and soon, they're falling hard! Could this be their chance at a romantic connection and more?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Nakanu Hotaru wa Ao ni Kogareru
mangas.titleNative: 鳴かぬ蛍は青に焦がれる
mangas.description: Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Koibito Keiyaku-chuu ni Tsuki: Koushin!
mangas.titleNative: 恋人契約中につき 更新！
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Melodramatic Fiction
mangas.titleNative: メロドラマチックフィクション
mangas.description: <i>Note: Includes one extra chapter.<i>

mangas.title: Yarashii Uraaka-kun wa Samishigari
mangas.titleNative: やらしい裏アカくんはさみしがり
mangas.description:
Despite his plain appearance and reclusive lifestyle, Hajime secretly posts suggestive photos of himself on social media using an alternate account. Recently, an older man he's gotten close to online asks to meet up, so Hajime steps outside for the first time in years and waits. But when his contact arrives, it turns out to be Ayumu—the ultra-handsome idol…


(Source: Kadokawa, translated)


Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Approximal Guide
mangas.description: All Colonel Kang Hajeong wants is to retire peacefully from the Esper & Guide Special Forces, but his plans are ruined when he's partnered with a powerful new esper named Kim Muhyeok. Worse yet, a sudden ambush cuts his life tragically short… or does it? Waking up in the hospital years later, he finds himself in the body of Sergeant Kang, a different person who happens to share the same name. But that's not the only mystery to be solved. Strange things are happening at the Esper/Guide center, and his old partner, Kim Muhyeok, still needs his help…

mangas.title: Little Mushroom
mangas.description:
Decades have passed since the Earth's magnetic poles disappeared, changing the balance forever. As the last remnants of humanity huddle in their bases, the remaining lifeforms have mutated into so-called xenogens and taken over the outside world.

In the midst of this war for life or death, a sentient mushroom lived his little life in the forest. That is, until humans came and took something precious from him — his spore. With his life's purpose gone, the young xenogen is ready to risk his life to reclaim it. So, donning a dead boy's face and calling himself An Zhe, the little mushroom makes an attempt to infiltrate a human base.

To get inside, he must first get past the Supreme Judge Lu Feng, whose job it is to detect and kill any mutants who try to sneak through the gate. It is said that nothing can escape his cold sight, which is now locked on An Zhe...

mangas.title: The Apology of Noumi-Senpai
mangas.description:
Noumi Masataka, who's living the self-indulgent university life, joins a book club after being invited by his professor. There, he meets Tan Eito, an underclassman in the same philosophy department. Eito is serious, openly gay, and utterly unconcerned with other people's opinions. Combine that with his striking good looks, and Masataka is very much intrigued. He decides to approach Eito, but how will the superconfident junior react to his easygoing senior when they couldn't be more different?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Wait, My Heart Just Skipped a Beat
mangas.titleNative: 待って、今きゅんとした。
mangas.description:
"We've known each other ever since we were in diapers. I thought I knew everything there was to know about him."



Natsuo attends the same college as his childhood friend Misaki. Campus life for the two has been going swimmingly. And because of their overwhelmingly good looks, these two never have a shortage of girls lined up after them. At a drinking party one night, Natsuo learns that Misaki acts surprisingly cute and spoiled with his girlfriend, a stark contrast to his usual aloofness. Shock soon transforms into obsession, as Natsuo begins thinking about Misaki every waking moment...! When it comes to Misaki, he has to see it all! His cute side, his body...



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: The chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Revenge: Yakimochi Yaitara Dame desu ka?
mangas.titleNative: Revenge ～ヤキモチ妬いたらダメですか？～
mangas.description:
Rintarou is a middle-aged actor, recently gaining popularity thanks to a BL part. How will Sonoda, his manager, react when a titty monster actress appears and tries to seduce the man he loves?



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Loser and the Airhead
mangas.description:
Yoshiro has had hidden, unrequited feelings for his childhood friend, Dai, for several years. He constantly turns down cute girls when they ask him out.

Oblivious to Yoshiro's feelings, Dai envies Yoshiro's popularity with girls, and always makes a fuss about wanting a girlfriend. Yoshiro has no intention of ever telling his airheaded friend the truth and resigns himself to a life of fluxing between appreciation for their friendship and sorrow that they can't be more.

That is, until one day when the two are invited to a mixer, where Yoshiro somehow ends up dragging Dai to a motel and tries pushing him down on the bed...!



This is a tantalizing love story about how a loser with unrequited feelings and his airheaded childhood friend become a couple.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra.

mangas.title: Zenbu, Hajimete
mangas.description:
