Haruto is devastated when he discovers his ex-boyfriend is secretly married. Drowning his sorrows at a bar, he meets a man nursing his own heartbreak. They hit it off, and before Haruto knows it, they're sharing a bed, even though he doesn't even know the man's name. The next morning, Haruto slips away, believing it was just a one-night stand. However, his world is turned upside down when the same man, Hayama Shiori, shows up as his new coworker at his company!


(Source: Core Magazine, translated)


Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Osananajimi wa Mou Yameru
mangas.description:
Madoka has been head-over-heels for Tamaki since childhood. But for Tamaki, now a university student, Madoka is still just a "cute younger childhood friend" and not a romantic interest. As time passes, Madoka graduates high school and secretly enrolls in the same university as Tamaki, even managing to rent the apartment next door. From there, Madoka's determined pursuit begins…!?



(Source: Core Magazine, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Toranoko ga Osu Nanoni Ottekuru Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: トラの子が♂なのに迫ってくる話
mangas.description: I fell in love with the boy I picked up! What I picked up was a mischievous, spoiled and tender tiger boy. But have you ever been courted every day by a tiger that has become a great man? Sweet and warm days with the little tiger, but what awaits me with the adult tiger?

mangas.title: Shitsuren Omega wa Aisaretai
mangas.titleNative: 失恋オメガは愛されたい
mangas.description: Shougo is an omega who is told he doesn't look like one because of the menacing look in his eyes. Shougo's childhood friend An-chan, an alpha, had always told him he was cute, but Shougo is ultimately left with a broken heart. His friend becomes worried about him after seeing how deeply depressed he's become, signs him up on a dating app, and sets him up to meet a guy named "Ichi". Shougo wants to decline, but doesn't know how. So what will happen when the day comes and he heads to the meeting place...?!

mangas.title: Kimi wa Gochisou
mangas.description: In a world where humans coexist with demi-humans, such as vampires, werewolves, and succubi, Hiroto, a university student, meets Rio, a vampire who is looking for a "fated partner." Rio says Hiroto is the one for him, and begs to suck his blood. Hiroto was reluctant at first, but finally decides to offer his blood to Rio. However, when Rio kisses Hiroto, he realizes that blood alone is not enough...?!

mangas.title: Hizamazuite Ai wo Tou
mangas.description:
A world where two sexes exist: Subs, who wants to be a dominated, and Doms, who wants to dominate people. Masami, who works at a sub-only club, is ordered by Yuusei, a transfer student...!?



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Yoake ga Ichiban Kurai
mangas.titleNative: 夜明けがいちばん暗い
mangas.description: Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: I'll Get Rid of the Ghosts, So Please Date Me
mangas.titleNative: 幽霊消すんで付き合って下さい
mangas.description:
"There is no such thing as ghosts." So claims Makise, a physics grad student, even though he can actually see spirits everywhere. One day, a handsome underclassman named Tono joins the same research lab. For some reason, whenever Tono is nearby, the ghosts disappear. Makise starts spending time with him to enjoy a few peaceful, ghost-free moments, but when Tono visits Makise's apartment one day, he suddenly pushes him down…?!



(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shishunki ni wa Me no Doku desu
mangas.titleNative: 思春期には目の毒です
mangas.synonyms: It is a tempting thing for adolescents.
mangas.description:
Shibata, who's not too bright, doesn't get along with Mitani-san, who is handsome but stoic and expressionless.
However, after getting a zero on a test, Shibata ends up taking remedial classes from Mitani-san!
At first he didn't want to go, but when he sees the teacher's smiling face and gets to know a different side of him, he begins to enjoy the time with Mitani-sensei.



(Source: MF Fleur, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Suguru-kun Fight!
mangas.description:
When Suguru, an ordinary high school student, comes home as usual, he bumps into his older sister's friend, Noriyuki! Deciding at first glance that the huge and rugged-looking Noriyuki is the type he doesn't like, Suguru leaves the house to escape from him, but for some reason Noriyuki starts to pester him persistently...!?



(Source: Core Magazine, translated)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Romantic Elegy
mangas.titleNative: ロマンチック・エレジー
mangas.description:
"When you can't forget someone, don't you think alcohol and sex are the best remedies?"



Asuma met his soulmate in college, but for the past ten years, he's been heartbroken and unable to fall in love again. Now a doctor, his lingering feelings refuse to fade. After discovering that his soulmate has had a child, Asuma drowns his sorrows in alcohol. That's when Homare, a stranger resembling his soulmate, approaches him. Caught up in his heartbreak and drunkenness, they spend the night together. The next day, Asuma is shocked to run into Homare at the hospital cafe! Recently dumped by his alpha ex-boyfriend, Homare is heartbroken himself. He suddenly asks Asuma, "Why don't we become friends with benefits?" As they seek comfort in each other, can their relationship evolve into something deeper, or are they destined to remain each other's emotional bandages?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Secret Affairs
mangas.titleNative: シークレットアフター
mangas.description:
"We can't show this to our guests, can we?"



Mashiro is the number one host at Blanc. But then Blanc and Noir, the sister company, merge, causing Mashiro to lose his spot to Noir's number one, Reiya. He's good at pulling in the money, but he's got a nasty and arrogant attitude. This really put a bad taste in Mashiro's mouth, since he's working hard to pay off his family's debt. However, one day Mashiro makes the decision to break the rules and sleep with a customer. But before he can go through with it, Reiya catches him outside the hotel. Mashiro prepares to get fired, but Reiya gives him a wad of cash and tells him, "If you're going to sell your body, sell it to me."



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kiss Kara Saki wa Ad-lib de
mangas.titleNative: キスから先はアドリブで
mangas.synonyms: From the kiss the rest is ad-lib
mangas.description:
Ryotaro, a popular actor whose personal life is a mess, crosses paths with a beautiful young man named Kei, who his girlfriend has just dumped. As they talk, Kei reveals that he often cares for others, sometimes too much, prompting Ryotaro to open up about his own struggles. When a stalker fan discovers Ryotaro's home, he temporarily moves into Kei's room. He finds comfort in Kei's nurturing nature, but everything shifts when Kei unexpectedly sees Ryotaro masturbating one day...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Kon-kon Ton-ton
mangas.description: A manga where nothing happens because neither character will give in to the other.

mangas.title: Sono Hada no Atsusa wo Oboeteru
mangas.titleNative: その肌の熱さをおぼえてる
mangas.description:
Hairdresser Gen has feelings for his older childhood friend Kotaro, who is in love with his older brother Kanade.

One night, after hearing that his brother might get divorced, Gen spends the night with an overly drunk Kotaro in a hotel, and becomes excited, thinking that there might be a chance for him.



However, Kotaro mistakenly thought that he had slept with the brother Kanade, not Gen. Gen is used to being mistaken for his brother Kanade, but when he finds out that Kotaro had mistaken him for his brother Kanade even during the night they shared, his heart swells with discontent... A bitter, one-sided love story between childhood friends, a young, handsome, but troubled hairdresser, and an older, naturally charming, but plain-looking boy.



(Source: Hakusensha, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Nazeka Tsukaima no Usagi wa Boku wo Dekiai shisugiteru
mangas.titleNative: なぜか使い魔のウサギは僕を溺愛しすぎてる
mangas.synonyms: Somehow, my familiar rabbit loves me madly
mangas.description:
Aidan McGuire is a new wizard of the "Guardians of the Order" that protects the country. Guardians are usually paired with a humanoid familiar, so summoning one is essential. However, Aidan, who has zero sense of magic, ends up summoning an adorable rabbit! What's more, he is told that in order for a familiar to unleash its true power, deep contact is necessary...So when he tries to kiss it, the rabbit disappears, and instead a young man who calls himself "Jougasaki Hidetora" appears!? A fantasy BL story set in another world featuring a cute (!?) familiar buddy with a secret and a wizard with vague memories of his past life!




(Source: Kadokawa, translated)




Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Yuru-Gal Take-nii no Katabutsu Romanticist Kareshi
mangas.titleNative: ゆるギャル武にぃの堅物ロマンチスト彼氏
mangas.description:
The first long-awaited spin-off to "Yankee Hana-chan no Neko Kawaigari Kareshi"!



Takemaru Odagiri is a third-year high school student who is about to take his entrance exams. When his family urged him to study for the entrance exam, he reluctantly dropped in at the bookstore and ran into Kazama, who was in the same class as him. When he's suddenly called out, he had piled up a large amount of girls' comics at the cash register. He seems to be embarrassed and is pressed not to talk about it, but Takemaru is interested in the unexpected side of him who is straight-laced and from that day on, he and Kazama lend and borrow shoujo manga. Kazama's true face, which is gradually revealed, is an innocent boy who dreams of a manga-like love...!?



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Through the Rumors
mangas.description:
Solyi Jin, a recently turned Omega, was given the job to find proof of a famous actor's scandal. This famous Alpha actor, Kieun Baek, unfortunately caught Solyi Jin and gave him proper punishment.

Kieun Baek grows closer with Solyi Jin, he soon finds out somebody was plotting against him...



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Hinekure Neko no Amaekata
mangas.synonyms: How to Spoil a Twisted Cat

mangas.title: See You Again Tomorrow, Mr. Policeman
mangas.description:
Haruto's a popular, kind, and reliable policeman. During one of his patrol shifts, he almost gets into an accident, but is luckily saved by a tall, handsome guy named Sakura who catches and carries him off like a princess! Sakura's younger and stronger than Haruto, and he's currently working as a bodyguard for a celebrity. Haruto can't help but be enamored with him, even as another man. When Haruto tries to get close to Sakura, he quietly distances himself from him... It seems Sakura has some kind of trauma when it comes to cops. However, Haruto's cheerful nature eventually gets Sakura to open up. Heart-throbbing events unfold as Haruto starts to discover a side of Sakura that only he gets to see...!



Both of them experience something they haven't in a long time through a mature version of youthful love that's both pure and bittersweet.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: When Pear Blossoms Bloom
mangas.description:
After 13 years away from his hometown, Siu returns, reuniting with childhood friends he hasn't seen since "that incident" drove them apart. Though awkwardness lingers, their warm reception reassures him. But after a night of celebration, Siu wakes up to a shocking discovery—a kiss mark on his neck. Who could be responsible?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kirawaremono no Tenisha wa, Deatta Isekai de Dekiai sareru
mangas.titleNative: 嫌われ者の転移者は、出戻った異世界で溺愛される
mangas.description:
Thirteen-year-old Towa, suffering from a persistent "Chuunibyou" syndrome, is suddenly transported to another world. Although he is a rare foreigner in the new land, he has yet to manifest his "gift"—a unique ability granted only to outsiders. To hide the fact that he lacks this power, Towa puts on an arrogant front, earning the dislike of those around him, including Griz, his own guard knight. Depressed and disheartened, believing that even Griz, whom he considered his only ally, despises him, Towa is attacked from behind. When he wakes up, he finds himself back in his original world, but fifteen years have passed. Haunted by memories of Griz, he now lives as a simple businessman. Yet, for reasons unknown, Towa finds himself drawn back into the parallel world once again...


(Source: Kadokawa, translated)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Onajide wa Irarenai kara
mangas.titleNative: 同じではいられないから
mangas.description:
Notes:

- Chapter 4 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Omega no Orega, Seiryaku Kekkon!?: Alpha no Danna-sama to, Amaama na Shinkon Seikatsuchuu!
mangas.titleNative: オメガの俺が、政略結婚！？～アルファの旦那様と、あまあま新婚生活中！～
mangas.description:
Ryousuke, a third-year Omega university student, has been harboring a heavy secret—he's been arranged to marry the son of one of Japan's top Alpha families, and the marriage is nothing more than a political ploy...!?


(Source: Koubunsha, translated)


Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love Operation
mangas.description:
Min Yeon-U goes on a blind date after being in a one-sided love for ten years. But the blind date … is the person who gave him a plastic surgery consultation a few years ago?!?!?! Will he put an end to Yeon-U's ten years of unrequited love?

"Doctor…! Can you operate on love too?!"

mangas.title: 24-Hour Kiss
mangas.description:
A scandalous office romance about a cool young designer and a moderately annoying businessman! At this cosmetics company, the entire design division shares a common problem, and that problem is Takumi Tokura. A manager with a history in sales and a penchant for sports festivals and living the dream, Mr. Tokura unknowingly pushes impossible tasks on the design team while spewing idealisms at company parties...

In reaction, Ryo Takizawa falls deeper and deeper into a quiet rage. That anger comes to a head after the party when Mr. Tokura announces a mandatory trip to a brothel for all the male employees. Ryo stubbornly tries to go home, but his superior tries to act like a life coach and yells that "sex is important!" This situation leads to a surprising twist! "If you're so insistent, please teach me." This superior and his subordinate mix together like oil and water, but neither can go back once they open the door to new pleasures...!

mangas.title: Wedding Plans for Mr. & Mr.
mangas.description:
Gyeong-Won Yu is a successful wedding planner. Though excellent at planning other people's weddings, he's terrible at planning his own love life and is always falling for the groom. This rings true when his one-night stand, the handsome Gang-U Seo, becomes his new client. Despite their unexpectedly hot first meeting and their endless magnetic attraction, Gyeong-Won now needs to plan Gang-U's wedding. Can Gyeong-Won keep his cool to design the perfect wedding? Or will he succumb to the groom's lustful advances?



(Source: Tapas, edited)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Take The Time
mangas.description: Note: Released at COMITIA150.

mangas.title: Itoshii Kimi to no Shoya Jijou.: Bangai-hen
mangas.titleNative: いとしい君との初夜事情。番外編
mangas.description: 2 one-shot side stories of "Itoshii Kimi to no Shoya Jijou."

mangas.title: I Changed the Law for You, Would You Marry Me?
mangas.titleNative: おまえの為に法律変えたから、俺と結婚してくれ
mangas.description:
Shiro and Sougo have been friends since childhood. One day, Shiro confessed his feelings and asked Sougo to marry him, "I like you, please marry me when we're adults!"

"Don't you know the law says two men can't get married?"

Many years later…

"For you, I changed the law, so, please, marry me!"



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ijimerarekko ga Yarikaesu Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: いじめられっ子がやり返す話
mangas.description:
Kuroide Akito, who was bullied by delinquents because of a grudge against him, is rescued by a transfer student, Kanda Yuki, who offers him a "bullying revenge plan". As they have strategy meetings, Kuroide deepens his friendship with Kanda, but Kanda's true identity is Yuki Obayashi who used to be bullied by Kuroide when they were kids. Kanda's true revenge plan is to sexually bully Kuroide back.



"Come on Kuroide, suck it." One day, Kanda's attitude changed drastically...?



This is a story of love with no place to go, born from despair and regret.



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Satan on Parental Leave and His Fake Hero
mangas.description:
"I'm going to defeat Satan Louie and lead the world to peace!" proclaimed the Hero Jade. But now, he's doing chores every day and raising Mao, the future Satan! While keeping Louie's true identity a secret, they've moved to the peaceful countryside. Jade has his hands full making treats, worrying about what foods Mao likes, and keeping an eye on him so he doesn't sneak away! Everything is for the sake of raising Mao to be a kind-hearted Satan who can bridge the gap between demons and humans. However, Louie is of no help at all! In fact, he's a hindrance with his constant need for attention! Together, can the perfect Satan and the stubborn hero raise Mao to be a good person and bring peace to the world?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Shouganai kedo Itooshii
mangas.titleNative: しょうがないけど愛おしい
mangas.description:
Naoki, who manages an apartment on behalf of his grandfather, is told that his cousin Keigo will be moving in when he starts university. Naoki looks forward to being reunited with Keigo, who had always been fond of him, but he finds that Keigo has grown into a handsome man who is quiet and whose thoughts are hard to read. Although Naoki is confused at first, he begins to feel comfortable with the closer relationship they have as they live near each other... But one day, he finds out that Keigo has been stalking him—?! Naoki just can't bring himself to push Keigo away, and he tries to "correct" his feelings for him somehow...



"If Naoki-nii hates me, how can I live from now on...?"



A pure love (?!) story between a handsome stalker with an intense love and a kind-hearted older man!



(Source: Shueisha, machine translated)



Note: The chapter count includes one extra.

mangas.title: Kimi no Nadekata Shitsukekata
mangas.description:
"You only need to look at me."



After being heartbroken when his girlfriend caught him doing anal masturbation, the bisexual Niyano is left in emotional turmoil. That's when a dazzling, naturally flirtatious prince named Koganei suddenly appears before him.


"Real-life love is too much. I'll just admire Koganei-kun as an idol," Niyano decides... but Koganei melts him with his words and technique alike. Thanks to that, Niyano finds both his heart and body tightly squeezed with overwhelming emotions!


He's already at his limit, but then Koganei goes and declares, "I'm going to win you over with everything I've got"...!?



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

mangas.title: Lullaby of the Dawn
mangas.description:
Night after night, Elva steps forth into the black sea, sword in hand, to drive back the creatures that surge from the waves. Elva is one of the "kannagi," warrior priests chosen by the divine to protect the island. With his snow-white hair, unaging youth, and black-stained limbs—proof of the corruption that gradually takes the life of every kannagi—the local people fear and shun him... at least until his path crosses with that of a boy named Alto. Enraptured by Elva's strength and lonely soul, Alto swears to serve him and free him from his cursed fate.



After eight long years, Alto has grown into a capable and fearless young man, unwavering in his devotion to his kannagi. Elva had long ago resigned himself to an early death—but somehow, Alto's presence seems to be gradually healing him of the black sea's corruption...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Bride of Ignat
mangas.description:
"If life is meaningless no matter where you are..."

Rita, a lonely boy, is chosen as the "Dragon's Bride" by the village custom. The ancient legend of the "Snowy Mountain Dragon" is now nothing more than a legend, but Rita, unable to find his role in the village, accepts the sacrifice while realizing that it is to reduce the number of mouths to feed. Rita, who was left alone and freezing in the snowstorm, is saved by Ignat, a beautiful dragon in human form. Rita's eyes sparkle because the dragon really exists, and he is able to fulfill his role as a "bride", but Ignat rejects him, saying "I don't need a bride". Still, Rita cannot give up, and he learns the secret of the ritual to turn humans into "dragons".

mangas.title: Kyou mo Neko-sama wa Kawaii
mangas.titleNative: 今日も猫様はかわいい

mangas.title: Yowamushi Omega wa Dekiai Saretai
mangas.titleNative: 弱虫オメガは溺愛されたい
mangas.description:
Thoughtful young man (⍺) x introverted creator (Ω)



Love remakes life!!



Luca – creator of the famous character Mimigel – is an illustrator with an introverted personality. Because he was tired of being changed too much, not to his liking, he gave up the copyright to the character Mimigel and took a plane to move to a far away place to live. During his flight, the plane suddenly had a shaking problem. Before he knew it, he found himself in a world where strange words like "second gender," "omega," "sex" were everywhere.



And what will his new life be like?!



(Source: Gentosha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Capricious Cat and a Shy Lion
mangas.titleNative: 気紛れ猫と気弱なライオン
mangas.description: Yasukazu is a scary-faced businessman who adores cats. One day, while in the middle of brooding over how bad he is with the female customers in cat cafes, he happens to discover one with a majority of male customers. While he unwinds with cute cats he starts falling in love with the devilishly sexy Jun who works there! Can love prevail between the scary-looking cat lover and the quirky cafe manager...? Immerse yourself in this steamy yaoi comedy and let the kitties and men wash the stress away!

mangas.title: BLACK BLOOD
mangas.description: Ethan, a battle-weary cyborg soldier, retreats to a tranquil planet in search of peace. There, he meets Mikhail, a gentle botanist whose warm smile and delicate touch seem almost fragile. Ethan finds himself inexplicably drawn to Mikhail, experiencing a restless unease whenever they're together. He longs to touch, to cherish—feelings that are undeniably human. Bewildered by the feelings stirring within him, Ethan begins to question if he truly has a heart after all.

mangas.title: Count Tachibana
mangas.description: During the period of Japanese colonial rule, a young Korean boy, Yong-Hyeon, is invited every summer to a royal residence in the mountains behind his village. The residence of one Count Tachibana. The peculiar Tachibana Sho is a complete mystery, as it seems he's never left his mansion, not even once. But over the summers, Tachibana Sho and Yong-Hyeon have made a strange but solid bond with each other. Now Yong-Hyeon is devising a plan to help Sho escape his mansion but it won't be easy. Adults with their meddlesome ulterior motives and the giant mansion itself all present challenges to their idea. How will the two boys break free and what will they learn about each other...?

mangas.title: Gelände Magic 101-gou
mangas.description: An openly gay man that's trash, a naive romantic, and the mistake of a one night stand after being struck by slope magic.

mangas.title: Kanata no Kimi no Te
mangas.description:
Yuudai, a student preparing for university entrance exams, returns to the town he spent his childhood summers in and unexpectedly reunites with Shun, the friend he used to always play with. A certain buried memory resurfaces to throw Yuudai off, and then suddenly a child appears and says something strange...?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Chocolate is Bad for Dogs
mangas.titleNative: 巧克力于犬是禁止事项
mangas.synonyms: No Choco for Doggo | Chocolates are Forbidden For Dogs
mangas.description:
An unknown streamer Long Jieran fed a stranger on his way home from the supermarket, then he found the stranger got symptoms of food poisoning! Long Jieran, who had originally wanted to leave returned at the end because of the stings of conscience. And he helped the self-proclaimed homeless canine orc Xibo.

"If we can share the rent, everything will be good".

mangas.title: I will go to see you again tomorrow.
mangas.titleNative: 明日もきみに会いに行く
mangas.description:
University student Saku longs to have a fairytale romance, but even though he has no trouble getting with girls, they all break up with him for the same reason: he doesn't make their heart flutter at all! And then there's Misumi, the university's resident heartthrob who's wildly popular with the girls, and who's taken a sudden interest in Saku. He doesn't laugh at Saku's fantasies and listens to them sincerely, and if Saku is nearby, he'll go to him without fail. Misumi seems to always say or do the right things that make his own heart start to flutter a little, so Saku starts to look to him for tips and techniques on how to make his fairytale romance come true. But before he knows it, he's suddenly falling in love with Misumi instead...?!



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Neon Sign Amber
mangas.titleNative: ネオンサイン・アンバー
mangas.description:
An expressionless club doorman meets a flashy boy at one of the many parties the place gathers. As someone who's always been considered quite boring or an emotionless person, Saya-chan with his clumsy personality will make this man a more vivid one.



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Cosmo Sex Fantasy
mangas.description:
Geun-ha wants an ordinary life, an inconspicuous life. However, it has already been 4 years since he worked for an adult magazine. Besides, the nickname in the company is already "Dildo Master" (secret to him).

Geon-ha, who lives a life completely different from his creed, is offered to write a 'Sex Experience' column this time. He was blinded by the upcoming salary negotiations and accepted it, and the first place he went to... a gay bar?!

"It's good if it's fresh and stimulating to try it out."

mangas.title: My Catnip, Meow!
mangas.description:
Pas Liley meets Quin, who smells like catnip, by chance; For he's crazy about Quin's pheromone odor, he's fully attracted to him. Therefore, he tries everything to increase the secretion of Quin's pheromone by finding fault with him. Pas uses Quin as the human shaped catnip, but time after time, they're getting to know each other better. Perhaps things may be different if it's Quin…



(Source: Webnovel)



Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras

mangas.title: Zaijian no Yoake made
mangas.description: Akio Fujisawa was a quiet loner—obviously the total opposite of the sociable and confident Tingyu, a Chinese exchange student who joined his class. But when Tingyu revealed the insecurities behind that confident exterior, a friendship started to blossom. Fast-forward to years after graduation, and that friendship is still going strong. Tingyu's frequent visits to Japan keep their connection alive, all while Akio harbours some more-than-friendly feelings...

mangas.title: Tsukiaitai Kareshi
mangas.description:
Tobari, who always seems to have terrible luck, is in real big trouble now. It all started when Saeki, the most popular boy in school, confessed his feelings for him in front of the whole school.......?



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Sugar Dog Life: Tokubetsu Yomikiri
mangas.titleNative: シュガードッグライフ 特別読切
mangas.description: Special chapter to commemorate the series' live-action drama.

mangas.title: The Monster & The Ghost
mangas.titleNative: モンスターアンドゴースト
mangas.synonyms: 孤獨的怪物與純愛幽靈
mangas.description:
Tsubaki Koton is a monster — a violent delinquent with a chilling past and a terrifying image to match. No other student dares to approach him, not even now he's transferred to a new high school. His anti-heroic acts of selflessness end only in bloodshed and rumors that spiral out of control. But one night, he's followed home by a stranger who sets out to change his life for good. This boy, stubborn and hauntingly beautiful, is the pure-hearted Kabuto Yuuki, with his stunning jewel-like eyes that see past Tsubaki's fearsome charade. But although someone finally sees Tsubaki for who he truly is, Kabuto cannot be seen at all. After all, Kabuto is a ghost.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: About a Love Song
mangas.titleNative: アバウト ア ラブソング
mangas.description:
Band member Hoshina loves music but struggles to write love songs while working part-time at a convenience store. He's drawn to his younger coworker, Seto, but doesn't expect anything to come of it... until the two get caught in the rain and end up spending the night together.

In the morning, Hoshina discovers Seto is a high school senior, and insists that they stop seeing each other until after Seto graduates. Seto wants to explore their relationship further and continues to pursue Hoshina, but Hoshina (awkwardly, earnestly) attempts to keep him at a safe distance. While apart, Hoshina is inspired to write a song about his feelings for Seto, and following Seto's graduation, he sees Hoshina perform the song and the two reconcile their feelings for each other. A sweet, heartfelt love story.

mangas.title: The Pain in My Neck
mangas.description:
Recently something's really been doing a number on Su-Min. No medical test can seem to tell what it is, though. After several unsuccessful checkups, Su-Min walks home to find…his next-door neighbor drinking the blood of a random stranger! Su-Min's thoroughly creeped out, but he soon becomes interested when the vampire claims that he can suck all of Su-Min's pain away. What could possibly go wrong? It'll be worth it if a small pain in his neck will rid him of this mysterious ailment, right? Right?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Sorosoro, Sayonara.
mangas.description:
There's a famous person at my school. He's a young high school student who's a well-known novelist, and he's good looking and smart. There are rumors that he's a little weird, but teachers say that he's quick at learning. It turns out that I have to confess to that famous person, Komaki-senpai, for my friend. That was the start of our friendship, but there's a rumor that Komaki-senpai sleeps with teachers…



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: My Sweet Empty Heart
mangas.titleNative: エンプティー スイーティー
mangas.description:
Porn star Haruma is giving relationship advice to his straight "friend," Makito, who works at his other job at a restaurant. One day, Makito finds a porn video that might be starring the girl he's got a crush on...! While Makito is in despair, Haruma encourages him to watch the video together to check if she actually IS Makito's crush. The inexperienced Makito gets hard watching the video even as he struggles with some mixed emotions! A love story that shows the growth of a pure, innocent virginal boy and a gay porn star who he has inadvertently wrapped around his finger!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Mazuha Oishii Gohan wo Tabeyou
mangas.titleNative: まずは美味しいご飯を食べよう
mangas.description: A delicate story in which a man who is trapped in his own mind gradually expands his world with the help of cooking and love.

mangas.title: Kuro Hyou-sama no Okiniiri
mangas.titleNative: 黒ヒョウ様のお気に入り
mangas.description:
In a world where beastmen and humans coexist, Gaku attends a college that consists of mainly beastman, a rarity in the world. Despite being the subject of his study, he's still not had much close interaction with them... That is until a chance encounter under the tree with Rui. Rui's the resident troublemaker who just so happens to be a leopard beastman. Soon a casual favor quickly leads Gaku into catching the eye of real predator!



(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

mangas.title: Love on the Horizon
mangas.titleNative: あした愛かもしれない
mangas.description:
Art university student Nagi Kitagawa is hopelessly in love with Yuu Yamasaki, his senpai in the folk song club who also happens to be his next door neighbor. Yuu seems to have it all—good looks, a great personality, and he's also super popular—so Nagi can't help but think he'd never fall for a shy, innocent country bumpkin like him. One night, after drinking too much at one of their club get-togethers, Nagi helps a drunk Yuu get home safe—but before he can go back to his own apartment, Yuu wraps Nagi in his arms and falls asleep, trapping Nagi in his embrace. Nagi sneaks out the next morning, careful to not wake Yuu up, and vows to keep the incident a secret. But when Nagi finds himself growing closer and closer to Yuu, his unrequited feelings only grow stronger… And could it be that his love isn't as one-sided as he thinks it is…?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Koi ga Ochitara
mangas.description:
One night, right after he was dumped by his boyfriend, a pair of underwear came falling down upon Ise's head. The one who dropped it was a man named Hishimoto, who Ise couldn't seem to ignore, and they end up working together to bring in the laundry that had fallen onto a tree outside his window.



After being told by Hishimoto that he would like to thank him, Ise goes up to his place. There, he is told that Hishimoto has been thinking about him, and had used the fallen laundry as an excuse. Further more, Hishimoto then flirts with him, asking if he's interested in older men…?!

mangas.title: Shinai naru Gene e
mangas.description: New York in the 1970s. Trevor Edwards is a successful lawyer who just recently broke things off with his fiancée. One night, Trevor realizes that he lost important documents pertaining to a client, and he can't find them anywhere. Just as he's ready to accept defeat and the end of his career, salvation arrives in the form of Gene—a young cleaner who works in the same building as Trevor's lawyer firm—who saw him drop the papers on his way out. After returning them, Trevor discovers that Gene is homeless and invites him to stay at his house to escape the cold winter night. But is that enough to repay the man who saved him?

mangas.title: Tonari no Otoko
mangas.description: Sudou, an introvert who hides the fact he's gay, witnessed Yuki, his neighbor, get into a fight with a woman. Even though Sudou pretended not to see, he was swept away by Yuki's laid-back attitude into a night of drinking...and more.

mangas.title: A Howl of the Heart
mangas.synonyms: The Love That Howls at the End of the Millennium
mangas.description:
Amid war, Tenyoh and Uru are more than comrades-in-arms—they're as close as brothers, or perhaps a pair of mated birds. Living and fighting among their country's elite troops, they share a deep bond of love. But fate suddenly tears them apart when Uru is killed behind enemy lines, leaving Tenyoh with nothing but a kiss and a promise to live on.

Two years later, Tenyoh is tasked with launching a surprise attack on the enemy general, Kakezuki…but this general bears the face of his beloved Uru. Who—or what—is Kakezuki? What really happened to Tenyoh's lost love?

mangas.title: Oretachi Business Tsugai Yattemasu!
mangas.titleNative: 俺たちビジネス番やってます!
mangas.description: Akira (omega) and Keigo (alpha) are a pair, and run a very popular couple's vlog channel. However, the two are only pretending to be a pair for work and their relationship is just an act. Then one day, Akira's heat arrives unexpectedly... Will this fake relationship change into something more...?!

mangas.title: Omamori Shimasu, Dokomademo
mangas.titleNative: お護りします、どこまでも
mangas.synonyms: I Shall Protect You, No Matter What
mangas.description: Akira arrives in Tokyo from the countryside to start a new job but instead discovers that not only has his company disappeared but also his housing. Unemployed and homeless before he's even started life in the big city, life's looking pretty grim but maybe someone's looking out for him after all because who should text him at that moment but his childhood friend Chihiro. Providing a home, cooking meals, and even pocket money - just why is Chihiro doing so much for someone he hasn't seen since he was 10? Why does he consider Akira to be his best friend? And just who are those serious looking guys in suits? There just may be more excitement in the big city than Akira's ever dreamed possible.

mangas.title: Omamori Shimasu Seijo-sama
mangas.description:
"I turned seventeen, and for some reason, people are after my chastity!" A slapstick romantic comedy about a handsome knight (?) and a holy maiden delinquent whose virginity is in terrible danger.



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)



Note: Includes an extra.

mangas.title: Kurosawa wo Sono Ki ni Sasetai Imasaki no Hanashi.
mangas.titleNative: 黒澤をその気にさせたい今先の話。
mangas.description: Released at J.GARDEN54. Takes place after Kouun na Kimi to Boku no Mirai's digital exclusive manga.

mangas.title: Kouun na Kimi to Boku no Mirai
mangas.titleNative: 「幸運な君と僕の未来」番外編
mangas.description:
If you stay by my side forever, I feel like I can overcome anything.

Just as he predicted, Mahiro started living with Yukito after they started dating. Their home life is going well, but an incident from Mahiro's childhood still lingers in his mind...

mangas.title: Generation Z is outside of Chief Sakura's understanding
mangas.titleNative: 佐倉主任はZ世代がわからない。
mangas.description: Sakura is a Millennial who's already been divorced. Despite being the chief of the sales department, he struggles to build a working relationship with Aoi, a new Gen Z employee. One day, while working late, Sakura decides to relieve some stress in private, only to be caught in the act by Aoi! The next day, as Sakura considers quitting out of embarrassment, Aoi surprises him by doing the same thing in front of him to stop him from leaving! Discover how a clueless Millennial and an earnest Gen Zer bridge their generational gap in this heartwarming office romance!

mangas.title: Unfazed by the Disaster in My Life
mangas.synonyms: Saiyaku ni Shite Madowazu: Love in Room Share
mangas.description:
Masato works as a chef at a local restaurant. During one of his breaks, he had a chance encounter with one of his schoolmates, Mitsukuni, who accidentally spills coffee on his lap. In a rush, Mitsukuni immediately leaves, passively giving Masato a cleaning fee and an irritable temper. Worse, Masato's wallet gets in Mitsukuni's briefcase, which had all of his money and keys. As fate would have it, the two meet again later on at the restaurant Masato works at. While Masato perfectly remembers Mitsukuni during their high school days, Mitsukuni barely remembers the former. When Masato's home ends up catching fire, Mitsukuni is nagged by Masato's co-workers to take him in. Now that the two are living together, certain things come to light and unfold between them.



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Chapter count inlcudes one extra and two epilogues.

mangas.title: Syrup
mangas.description:
Their fluids are sweet and become food for humans.

"Shokuyou," a rare creature whose bodily fluids turn into sweet nectar and are used as food for humans. Although it was thought to be extinct in modern times, they have been living quietly among humans. Haru, who looks just like a human, is actually a Shokuyou. He dreams of the day when someone will accept him as he is, but because of the sweet smell emanating from his body, his classmate and a bully, Shigure, unintentionally recognizes him as a Shokuyou and ends up "eating" him……?

Contains three love stories interwoven between humans and Shokuyous.



(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Grapefruit Moon
mangas.titleNative: グレープフルーツムーン
mangas.description: A lover of sweets, college student Kazuki starts working part-time at a small local pastry shop called Fujimura. There, he meets Youichirou, a handsome genius pastry chef who has lost his enthusiasm for his job. To Youichirou's dismay, Kazuki is super clumsy and fails at many tasks. Kazuki soon discovers that Youichirou quit his job at a famous hotel for unknown reasons and has since lost his passion as a pastry chef... This story is about a 19-year-old brimming with happiness for the start of his dream and a 31-year-old approaching the end of his...

mangas.title: Dekisokonai α no Utopia
mangas.titleNative: できそこないαのユートピア
mangas.description: Society has progressed, and Omega rights are respected, while Alphas are mandated to take suppressants. Kunikage, an Alpha who has a disposition of being resistant to suppressants, is socially shunned. Takumi, a Beta, is the only one who stayed by his side for a long time, and Kunikage secretly harbors feelings towards him. One day, Kunikage accidentally inhales Omegan pheromones in Takumi's research lab and goes into rut. Unable to control his long-wished desire to be topped by Takumi, Kunikage, with his rut-clouded senses, yearns for him...?!

mangas.title: Chéri, My Destiny!
mangas.description:
"My chocolate's so good it'll make you grovel on your knees!"

Kaoru is brimming with confidence. After all, he opened a patisserie after studying in France, and is the head chef of his own store. But there's one small problem; his customers are enamored with a local Japanese sweet shop and Soujirou, the attractive and reserved craftsman who makes the treats on offer.

Convinced that stuffy old Japanese confections could never compete with his modern, Western style creations, he decides the only way forward is to prove to Soujirou that his chocolates are the best. But when Soujirou accepts his gift gracefully and even compliments him on his skills, Kaoru's intense feelings take a sudden turn in the opposite direction.

mangas.title: Nete mo Samete mo Omae ni Muchuu
mangas.titleNative: 寝ても覚めてもオマエに夢中
mangas.description:
Five years of snipes and passive-aggressive jabs have turned System Engineer Ryouhei Munataka and Salesman Kanae Honjou's workspace into a full-blown battlefield. But when a major project forces them to collaborate, the constant tension takes an unexpected turn. Ryouhei, thrown for a loop by a vivid dream where Kanae kisses him with surprising passion, starts to see his coworker in a whole new light. Blurring the line between reality and fantasy, Ryouhei mistakes Kanae for his dream counterpart and makes a shocking move that puts them both in a compromising situation!



(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Pudgy Co-worker Is a Snack
mangas.titleNative: まんまる同期に食われたい
mangas.description:
I found myself in a love hotel with my fellow male co-worker, and he started coming on to me. I had no idea he felt that way about me. I'm not exactly a model, after all...

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Soredemo Kimi to Koi ga Shitai!
mangas.titleNative: それでも君と恋がしたい！
mangas.description:
Honda has been with the company for four years and is getting used to his job. His weekly pleasure is...meeting Hazuki, a convenience store clerk at his work every Wednesday. Hazuki is a charming man, with a face that changes frequently when he talks, a smile he sometimes shows, and just about everything else about him is adorable. One day, Honda forgets his room key and ends up staying at Hazuki's place. They talked so that they could get to know each other better, but somehow they ended up having sex before Honda could confess his feelings. Afterward, he told Hazuki how much he liked him, but Hazuki thought he was just trying to be considerate after having sex with him...! Will Honda's feelings reach Hazuki...?



This is an irritating, frustrating, and yet very cute innocent love story!



(Source: Kasakura, translated)

mangas.title: Mou Sukoshi dake, Soba ni Ite
mangas.titleNative: もう少しだけ、そばにいて
mangas.description:
"I want to spend my life with Haruto."



Haruto, a young novelist, and Akira, a salaryman, have been sweethearts since their university days.



Ever since an accident a few years ago left Haruto in a wheelchair, he's found joy in the simple moments of living together with his beloved. But because he cherishes Akira more than anything, Haruto harbors a "small secret"...



(Source: Libre, translated)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated in a BL Manga
mangas.titleNative: 転生したらBL漫画の世界だった件
mangas.description:
After getting stabbed on the bus, the manga artist Tetsuo Tanaka finds that he has been reincarnated...into the BL manga he created?! Although he quickly runs into the sexually adventurous love interest Takumi, Tetsuo has unfortunately been reincarnated as Atsushi, the promiscuous rival to the canon seme. Will he be able to rewrite the plot and find a happy ending with the man of his dreams? Even if he can't, there's sure to be plenty of "fun" along the way!



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: Chase me, Watchdog
mangas.description:
"His worst scandal...is me"

Lay, a former soldier, is the bodyguard of Alex, who is one of the most popular actors praised for his chic style. However, Lay soon finds out that his master, often called as the "perfect prince," is nothing more than a bratty troublemaker. Lay must save and protect Alex's public image, but that mission includes one thing: to take care of Alex's sexual life as his "stress reliever"... The most clingy top-secret love between a younger, super arrogant celebrity and his cool, tanned-skin pretty bodyguard begins!

mangas.title: My Pet Bat
mangas.description:
High school senior Min-Gyeom has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-Gyeom heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: The Betrayer's Love Song
mangas.titleNative: 裏切り者のラブソング
mangas.synonyms: The Betrayer Sings a Love Song
mangas.description:
Childhood rivals Dante and Gino are leading candidates within their Italian mafia famiglia, each determined to claim the seat of the next Don.



19xx Italy. The Gardino Famiglia, a powerful mafia organization that controls the city's ports, is in the midst of selecting its next don. Two strong candidates stand in opposition: Capo Gino, leader of the Pureblood Faction who respects tradition, and Capo Dante, leader of the Radical Faction who envisions a progressive new era. Since childhood, Dante's had a habit of messing with Gino, who sees him as nothing more than an annoying rival. That is, until Dante discovers Gino's biggest secret. Now, with the upper hand, what will Dante demand in return for his silence?



(Source: KUMA)

mangas.title: The Second Hand Ticks With the Sound of Love
mangas.description: You're too clingy. I only saw you as a friend with benefits. With that cruel line and a broken watch, Yudai broke up horribly with Chiaki seven years ago. Unable to forget him even though he pushed him away himself, Yudai keeps Chiaki's watch with care. One day, the two meet again... The time that had stopped starts moving again, together with their lonely hearts.

mangas.title: Otsukare-sama desu
mangas.description:
Masumi Shinonome (aka Massuu), a college student, has the ability to exorcise spirits because he inherited his great-grandmother's power. He spends his days exorcising the spirits that possess his friend Eiwa Mikoshiba, who has a constitution that attracts spirits in an unusual way, but one day Mikoshiba's body is taken over! Moreover, because it was a sexually-oriented spirit, he and his friend end up having accidental sex....



Hino Chihaya sends you a slightly horrifying new BL!



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

mangas.title: Hasuki-kun to Sanmou-kun
mangas.description:
A rare male calico cat was raised in an over-protective environment, which caused him to have no friends. So Sanmou decides to leave home and move into the student dormitory to make more friends at university. He tries to be friendly with his roommate Hasuki, who is a Siberian husky, which is suppose to have a friendly personality…



The start of many "first" experiences with new friends!



(Source: Futabasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kimi to Mimi kara Koi wo Suru
mangas.synonyms: Your voice makes me melt meaning
mangas.description:
Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes one extra chapters.

mangas.title: Gal-kun Will Definitely Fall in Love!
mangas.titleNative: ギャルくんの恋はきっと
mangas.description: The outgoing and stylish Yoshi has taken it upon himself to help his introverted classmate Takayuki gain an interest in romance! This "help" includes practice date sessions where they go out on the town together and experience what stereotypical couples do. Although Yoshi is happy to get his shy friend out of his shell, despite his best efforts, his feelings may be getting deeper...

mangas.title: Kikazaru Hina wa Mada Koi wo Shiranai
mangas.titleNative: 着飾るヒナはまだ恋を知らない

mangas.title: Canis: Dear Mr. Rain
mangas.description: Business is tough at men's haberdashery Dante. A big sale is coming, and they are extremely understaffed. So after getting chewed out by his staff a broken Satoru heads home to find a stray napping in the rain. Ryou isn't your standard American longhair, though. He is a mysterious nineteen-year-old with charisma, good looks and an air of someone with a past, despite their age. After a meal, a nap and a shower Ryou was ready to model for Satoru. But their contract was for just one day. And the reason why Ryou had to go was he had a meeting with the mafia.

mangas.title: Aoharu wa Aishi Aisare
mangas.titleNative: アオハルは愛し愛され
mangas.description: Roommates at a boys' school dormitory, Towa-senpai and Kogaya are a lovey-dovey couple who have just started dating. They had their first sex with Towa-senpai as the bottom, and were living their happy days since then. But today is a special day! Kogaya is eager to do "something" for Senpai's birthday, but... what Towa-senpai asks for is Kogaya's "first time bottoming"! Kogaya is ready to give himself to Senpai, who knows all about the best parts down there, but he ends up getting turned on by his senpai… A needy sweet sex between two teenagers who are constantly curious! A switch lovey-dovey couple with the highest level of moe.

mangas.title: Ryman Meets Host
mangas.titleNative: リーマンミーツホスト
mangas.description:
Shuuichi Katayama is an office worker whose hobby is loving male idols. He has no girlfriend, few friends, and leads a dull life until he happens to stop at a host club and meets the host Yuu Tsukishiro.



A simple businessman and a host on the verge of turning 30. The two men, who were not originally meant to cross paths, gradually build a mysterious "adult friendship" as they share their hobbies and life problems...!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: [Kamikai] Ikemen Haishinsha ni Riatotsu Shitemita
mangas.titleNative: 【神回】イケメン配信者にリア凸してみた
mangas.description:
Reo, a backlash-attractor streamer who is quickly collecting haters, has been visiting the home of "haru", a handsome streamer popular for his talk and game-playing, every day in hopes of collaborating with him.

However, he got annoyingly turned away at the door. Not only was he not taken in by haru, but his listeners also called him a liar at that. But the truth is, the two used to be "friends"...?

mangas.title: Old-Fashioned Cupcake with Cappuccino
mangas.titleNative: オールドファッションカップケーキ with カプチーノ
mangas.description:
Thirty-nine-year-old Nozue went from living a routine, melancholic life of sleep and work to spending his days in bliss with Togawa, his younger subordinate. Now six months into their relationship, the two have graduated from dates at a pancake shop to spending their nights together, but when a coworker spots Togawa wearing one of Nozue's ties to work, it sends Nozue spiraling into doubt about the feasibility of their relationship.



(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Sound of Your Voice
mangas.description: Ethan Hyun is a huge fan of a voice actor by the name of Jimmy Kwak. When he's given an opportunity to work with him, he can't believe his luck. But a series of unfortunate events forces them to live together...

mangas.title: The World's End
mangas.titleNative: 果ての荒野でバカンスを
mangas.description:
A collection of one-shots:



1. Futaribocchi no Ever After (ふたりぼっちのエバーアフター); Magazine BE x BOY 2019-03

A fairy tale about a mysterious young man and a child living deep in an enchanted forest.



2. Kaeru no Ouji-sama (蛙の王子様, The Frog Prince); Magazine BE x BOY 2019-11

Features a young man named Yui Nishino who has remarkable features. However, he feels that his good looks are more of a curse rather than a blessing because everyone close to him is jealous of his beauty. While working as a museum mascot, he spots one of his classmates, who is into prehistoric animals. Will he be the one to discover Yui's inner beauty?



3. Hate no Kouya de Vacances wo (果ての荒野でバカンスを, The World's End); Magazine BE x BOY 2020-04

Shin is on a terraforming mission and keeps in contact with Rukiya, an engineer who is on Earth. Shin feels quite lonesome in outer space, but luckily for him, he has a highly developed A.I. to keep him company. Shin's mission is just about over and when he's scheduled to return to Earth, Rukiya has some terrible news for him.



(Source: Animate International)



4. End roll (エンドロール, Credits Roll)

mangas.title: My Oh My, Atami-kun
mangas.description:
High schooler Atami is living the dream. He's got incredibly good looks, and girls can't help asking him out nearly every day. There's just one problem, though—he's into guys, not girls! His own gorgeous face haunts him, since it's all anyone seems to be interested in. Won't anyone see him for who he really is?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Idol's Escape
mangas.description:
Ainosuke is a gay man who spends his days full of gloominess and regrets. He desperately wishes he could be as cute and gorgeous as Karen, the idol he aspires to. But one night, Karen herself, on the run from an exploitative producer, appears right in front of him! A journey of escape and heart-pounding, fleeting love begins...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Oretachi Majikou Destroy
mangas.titleNative: 俺たちマジ校デストロイ
mangas.description:
Tomo, Niina and Megu are three high schoolers who're determined to become idols. Is it because they want to bring joy to young women all over the country? Because they dream of being top singers and actors one day? It's nothing so pure or so ambitious...These boys just want to get laid!



But to that end, it's necessary to beat all the "real" idols out there and rise to the top in terms of popularity. So they enter "Maji Kou", short for Majima Kita All-Boys High School... And all hell breaks loose!

mangas.title: But You're 2D!
mangas.description:
One day, a mysterious force drags the loner high school student Choi Su-A into a romance comic that he liked. And the person that he meets in this unknown yet familiar place is... his favorite character, the male lead Jeong Ji-Hun?!

A slice-of-life drama of the inexperienced nerd Su-A growing up as he goes through ups and downs with his comic friends.

mangas.title: Otoge ni Trip Shita Ore♂
mangas.titleNative: 乙ゲーにトリップした俺♂
mangas.synonyms: I ♂ Tripped into an Otome Game
mangas.description:
College student Otonari Otoya is a boy who lacks self-esteem and dreams of being reborn into a different dimension. One day while playing a [video] game, he accidentally clicks on an ad, and trips into another world?!?!



He's surprised but delighted, until he realizes that something's strange. A whole group of guys are treating him too kindly, almost like he's a girl! Could it be that the world Otonari was transported into... is an otome game?!?!



Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love Me, Preppy!
mangas.description: Natsume, the son of the company president, has decided to become independent after entering university. However, on his first day of moving in, his neighbor Issei, who claims to be his caretaker, shows up! He is determined to give up his parents' overprotectiveness, but when he runs into trouble, as expected, Issei ends up helping him out. He thought that if he stayed close to Issei, he might be able to find something he could do to help himself! He asked to be Issei's friend with high hopes, but he quickly got rejected! And on top of that, he was told that Issei would be like to be his fuck buddy, if he wants......!?

mangas.title: Kemutai Hanashi
mangas.description:
These two men are not friends, not lovers, not family. But they still want to be near each other. A chance encounter leads to two former classmates living together.

A very relaxed slice of life manga series, trying to break free from the urge to label relationships a certain way.

mangas.title: Yoshida-kun no Namaiki Omocha
mangas.titleNative: 吉田くんの生意気おもちゃ
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Heartbroken Novelist's Tale Of Love
mangas.description:
Novelist Yui Tsubakiyama, winner of a writer's award at the young age of 18, is in a slump. He writes stories vividly depicting young love, and has been nicknamed the heartbroken novelist. He has been writing novels based on his own relationships, but does not expect to meet anyone new... That's when he meets Chiaki, a refreshingly handsome businessman from out of town, who asks him for directions.
An everlasting love that doesn't end in heartbreak between a younger businessman and a heartbroken novelist!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes one volume bonus chapter.

mangas.title: Hanakoi Tsurane
mangas.description:
The self-destructive type, Sougorou is the heir of one of the well-known families in Kabuki world. He has no interests in other actors his age with the exception of Gensuke who he recognizes as his rival and never wants to lose to no matter what. However, fate plays a cruel trick on him and the two of them end up as classmates... How will their relationship develop...?


Note: There are two different endings to this manga. The difference starts in the middle of the last chapter. The tankoubon version is a bit longer and more fleshed out compared to the magazine version.

mangas.title: Osaka Battle Royale
mangas.description: Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kindergarten Wars
mangas.synonyms: ようちえん ウォーズ
mangas.description:
Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she's head-over-heels for good-looking men! 



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Third place at the 9th Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2023.

mangas.title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
mangas.description:
Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. But then, he was pointed out by Hayasameru and Shirai, who works at the library, that he has not returned a book that he borrowed ten years ago. A manga about how Ishidaira went from trying to borrow a book from a library to working there instead.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Once Again, As Clouds Part
mangas.titleNative: ひととせ、ふくくものごとし
mangas.description: Kaede Momose leaves the hustle and bustle of Tokyo for a new life alone in the mountains. On his first day there, he goes to greet his neighbor and meets Riku Tsukumo, who also lives alone in the mountains. Clean air and mountain fare; so begins a cozy mountain-life romance!

mangas.title: Phantom Tales of the Night
mangas.description:
Welcome to the Thundercloud Inn, a curious establishment that opens its doors to the troubled masses, human or otherwise. But to pay for the stay, the equally curious innkeeper takes payment only in the form of one's deepest secrets…Who will come calling today?

(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Medalist
mangas.synonyms: ทอฝันบนลานสเกต
mangas.description:
Inori is a little girl who dreams of becoming a figure skater. Yet, the obstacles to this dream feel insurmountable: Inori's already "too old" (she's 11); she's always had trouble at school; and, worst of all, her older sister's skating dreams ended in failure, so her mother is dead set against putting her other daughter through a similar experience. Still, the rink is the only place Inori can be herself, and she's out on the ice when a fateful meeting takes place. Tsukasa, a frustrated coach on the edge of giving up competitive skating himself, will join Inori to form an unstoppable duo powered by hard work, transcendent joy, and an unshakeable belief that they can prove everyone wrong.



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes:

- Winner of the 8th Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category in 2022.

- Winner of the 68th Shogakukan Manga Award in the General Category in 2022.

mangas.title: Ore ga Mitsuketa, Konbini no Koi
mangas.titleNative: 俺が見つけた、コンビニの恋
mangas.synonyms: I Found Love at the Convenience Store
mangas.description:
"I can't wait for the three minutes I get to see you, and in a moment—it was enough for me to fall in love."



Hanamaru-san is a businessman with a super-shy personality. He thought that his world was just a fantasy, until he fell in love with a man he only met at a convenience store. "When I close my eyes, he is there, when I look up at the sky, I think about him, and on holidays when I don't see him, I feel lonely....I think about him all the time..."



(Source: Overlap, translated)



Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Shape of Your Love
mangas.description: Yo-Han is no stranger to unrequited love. As a child, he watched his older brother suffer that pain, and he knows the person with feelings always loses. So when he spots his senior, Mu-Gyeong, mooning after another boy, Yo-Han decides to step in. Confess or give up is his motto, that is, until Yo-Han's the one with the crush on Mu-Gyeong.

mangas.title: Robotics;Notes
mangas.synonyms: ロボティクス・ノーツ
mangas.description: In 2019, childhood friends Yashio Kaito and Senomiya Akiho are in their last year of high school. Together, they are the only students in the robotics club, which has lost its school funding. Akiho is passionate about robots, and longs to complete building the robot her older sister Misaki began in this same club. Kaito doesn't really care about robots, and is obsessed with video games, specifically "Kill Ballad Online." However, he stays in the robotics club due to his friendship with Akiho. Now, just after Kaito is accused of cheating in his favorite game, Akiho decides to risk her club's existence in exchange for the funding to finally finish her sister's giant robot...

mangas.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love
mangas.titleNative: エクソシストを堕とせない
mangas.synonyms: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love – Egzorcysta nie do wyrwania
mangas.description:
A boy was chosen by god to become the world's strongest exorcist and to face deadly demons in battle. Burdened with the fate of humanity, all he really wants to do is quietly bake sweets, when one day a certain girl enters his life… A story of love and hope blooming during a bloody holy war!



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: Kimi ni Nidome no Sayonara wo.
mangas.titleNative: 君に二度目のさよならを。
mangas.synonyms: Kimi ni Nidome no Sayonara o
mangas.description: Hinata Harusawa, who works as a web designer, receives a call that the body of his best friend, Sora Otonashi, who disappeared in his second year of high school, has been found. He attends the wake with fellow members of the art club that Sora belonged to at the time, Director Hase, Deputy Director Tokiwa, and senior Shinohara... However, Shinohara is caught by someone, and Hinata is also attacked. He desperately resists to protect his painting, but Hinata gradually loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in "that place" on "that day"--!! What is the truth behind his best friend's disappearance and death?!

mangas.title: Majo no Kaigashuu
mangas.description:
An orphan named Aisya has been gifted the incredible power to make paintings that perform miracles just by using her blood. She and her best friend Loki have a wonderful time together, despite her deteriorating health. However, Loki realizes that he's nothing more than Aisya's drawing when he tries to save Aisya one night from an attacker. Aisya sends him on a quest to destroy her paintings and her curse, and to save the people changed by them, but can Loki look past his hatred of humans in order to carry out her wish?



Note: The chapter count includes 1 epilogue chapter.

mangas.title: Surround
mangas.description: Best friends Yamaguchi, Toda, and Tajima are always together. It's not shining but it's also somehow too bright. That is the life of your average slow male high school student.

mangas.title: Tsurune: Kazemai Koukou Kyuudou-bu
mangas.titleNative: ツルネ ―風舞高校弓道部―
mangas.description:
Minato played Japanese archery in middle school, but after a certain incident, he ran away from the sport. In high school, Minato meets new friends, and together as part of their school's archery club they aim to win the prefectural tournament.





(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: Sarazanmai
mangas.description: Manga Adaptation of Sarazanmai drawn by character design Miggy.

mangas.title: Tokyo Aliens
mangas.synonyms: โตเกียวเอเลี่ยน
mangas.description:
Shiny new high school first-year Akira is as ordinary as they come. He's awkward, has terrible grades, and loves manga. In fact, the only thing that really sets him apart from his peers is his staunch determination to follow in his late father's footsteps as a police officer.



But fate has its own plans for Akira. After witnessing a ferocious battle unfold between two strangers with unusual powers on the train—one of whom looks a lot like the tall, dark, and handsome kid in his grade—he finds himself kidnapped...by none other than an alien! And as if being thrust into the occasionally violent and always complicated relations between humans and aliens wasn't mind-boggling enough, nothing can prepare Akira for learning the truth about his beloved father...



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Lycoris Recoil Recollect
mangas.titleNative: リコリス・リコイル リコレクト
mangas.description: The daily life of Takina & Chisato at Cafe LycoReco.

mangas.title: Lycoris Recoil Official Comic Anthology: Reload
mangas.titleNative: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リロード
mangas.description:
Missions, mixers, and midnight snack runs-there's never a slow day at Café LycoReco! Find out what's new on the menu for Chisato, Takina, and company in this official comic anthology!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: How to Discipline a Sexually Frustrated Teacher with Sweetness -Dom/Sub Universe-
mangas.titleNative: イケない先生に甘い躾を－Dom／Subユニバース
mangas.synonyms: Ikenai Sensei ni Amai Shitsuke wo - Dom/Sub Universe
mangas.description:
I'll become your partner.

Yuito Kitaoka, a Sub who works as a teacher, hides his secondary gender from the school he works at due to past trauma. Just when he was troubled by his suppressants not working well anymore, a new teacher who is a Dom, Kagura Ogi, found out that he is a Sub...! Yuito had always been uncomfortable with role-playing, but Kagura's commands are gentle, and being pampered by him feels so pleasant... "Don't hold back, okay?" Drawn in by his eyes, his overwhelmingly skillful touches make the depths of Yuito's body slowly drown in pleasure...

A scheming Dom in his first year of teaching, with an older teacher who doesn't like role-playing — satisfying their desires, they role-play in secret.

mangas.title: Kojirase Doutei wa Akiramenai
mangas.titleNative: こじらせ童貞はあきらめない
mangas.description:
Iku, a self proclaimed long term virgin who dreams of losing his virginity, falls head over heels in love with Mashiro, the handsome manager of a café Iku happened to visit. Iku found Mashiro so attractive that he thought, "Yeah, I can do a guy instead!" and proceeded to pursue him. One evening, after a lovely date, Iku thought his chance had finally come to graduate from his virgin state. But for some reason it was Mashiro who was making him feel good...



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Bad Plan
mangas.description: Lee Joo-hyuk (the team leader) doesn’t understand why his subordinate Park Hwi-rim is only very cold and stiff with him whereas he has good interpersonal relationships with the rest of his colleagues….getting furious, Joo-hyuk decides to approach Hwi-rim with a wicked plan!!

mangas.title: The Benevolent Beast Won't Bite Me
mangas.titleNative: 優しいケモノ(α)は俺を噛まない
mangas.synonyms: Yasashii Kemono wa Ore wo Kamanai
mangas.description:
After losing his job when a new alpha joins the office, Yamato is feeling hopeless. The world isn't kind to omegas like him... Just when he's nodding off on a park bench, a man passing by, assuming all omegas are desperate for money, asks his price. Too burnt out to resist the stranger's advances, Yamato is luckily saved by an alpha wolf named Jin. Not only that, Jin is kind enough to invite him, an omega, into his home...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Tabernacle of Moloch
mangas.synonyms: Moloch's Curtain | The Shroud of Molek | The Veil of Moloch
mangas.description: Cheonglamdo, the land chosen by God. Omega Mael, who married Cheonglamdo's leader Heo Seong-Jin, has been living on this island for 7 years, unable to forget his first love, Shin Young-Ho. One day, he sees the news in the newspaper about 'baseball player Shin Young-Ho's injury'. Mael, who was immersed in sorrow, meets Shin Young-Ho again one day...

mangas.title: Ireon Geol Gareuchiryeodeon Ge Anieosseo
mangas.synonyms: I Wasn't Trying to Teach You This
mangas.description:
Eun-Ho, who is popular for his pretty face and tall stature, is having a flower-like youth, but... is a repeater. Unable to just sit by and watch Eun-Ho like that, his mother asks Seong-Jun, Eun-Ho's childhood friend and one year older, to tutor him. Eun-Ho goes to Seong-Jun to thank him and run an errand for side dishes...


...Huh? What are you doing now?

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

mangas.title: Too Late for Sincerity
mangas.titleNative: 本気になるには遅すぎる
mangas.synonyms: Honki ni Naru ni wa Ososugiru
mangas.description:
Yu and Ryosuke are colleagues who were once friends with benefits. The two lost contact when Ryosuke was posted overseas, but when
Ryosuke returned to Japan, he got into trouble and had to rely on Yu... and for some reason, he ended up staying at Yu's house. He begins a strange life living under the same roof as his former sex buddy, a colleague, but a promise from the past keeps crossing Yu's mind...

"If you get serious, that's the end of it."

mangas.title: Hitsuji no Kawa wo Kita Kemono
mangas.description: Daichi's big sister is getting married and to a super hot guy named Jun Igawa! When they first meet, Daichi's suspicious; what does this accomplished, rich, attractive guy see in his sister? But Jun seems like such a nice guy, and slowly, Daichi starts to drop his guard... is Jun really everything he seems? Or is he a devil in disguise?

mangas.title: Comeback After Fate
mangas.titleNative: カムバック・アフター・フェイト
mangas.description: Eli's boy band VINKS has just made their big debut—and as the youngest in the group, far from having everything handed to him as an alpha, he has to work twice as hard! One day, he participates in a session with Lee Suyoung from the top-ranked, all-alpha group α-code. For Eli, a longtime fan, it's a dream come true. But what's this sweet smell coming from Suyoung? Before he knows it, Eli's mouth is heading for Suyoung's nape… It's only one month until α-code's big comeback. What will they do, now that Eli knows Suyoung's secret?

mangas.title: Reward Me with Your Body, Sir
mangas.titleNative: ご褒美はカラダで払って、社長さん
mangas.description:
Ookami is at the end of his rope trying to find a suitable secretary. In his desperation, he decides to launch the "Rent A Boyfriend" app to enlist the help of Mao, a rental boyfriend. When they meet in person, Ookami realizes that Mao is even more gorgeous than his photos, and finds himself bewitched by the handsome man. Before he can even make sense of what's happening, Mao's tongue is in his mouth as they share a passionate kiss. Ookami's protestations only spur Mao on: "What's with that scary face? You're just turning me on even more." As things escalate, Ookami chides him: "You have no regard for others." But Mao takes no heed, continuing to work Ookami up into a frenzy…



Check out this new, erotic love story between a mistrustful boss and his aggressive boy toy!



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Shackled by Desire
mangas.description:
Revered by his comrades, Seo Seung-Bum was once a man of unwavering strength. But when Hwang Jii-Hyuk uncovers his darkest secret, Seung-Bum becomes powerless against him. Stripped of control, he is forced into a world of torment—drugged, violated, and reshaped under the guise of twisted pleasure. As Ji-Hyuk's cruel obsession spirals deeper, Seung-Bum struggles to grasp what his captor truly wants. Trapped in a cycle of pain and desire, he fights to survive each day… not knowing if escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Secretary Gwanggong's Survival Diary
mangas.description:
Who wouldn't be excited to find themselves transmigrated into a TV show? You get to meet your favorite characters, maybe even have a wayward romance...but for Si-On Baek, it turns out to be more horror than romcom. It's just his luck to end up as the secretary to one of the most ruthless and powerful alphas on TV. Now he has to figure out how to survive while hiding his omega status, which is proving to be quite difficult when alpha Tae-Oh Yoon won't stop getting so damn close…



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Mad Venus and My Honey
mangas.titleNative: マッドビーナス&マイハニー
mangas.description:
Kino, a cheerful boy who gets along with everyone, always finds some way to get all up into Tanahashi's business. Tanahashi may say he doesn't appreciate the other boy's attempts at friendship, but he doesn't really hate it - he actually appreciates it enough to make one big lifestyle change. But how does this concern Kino's crush - the net idol "Hikaru"? A collection of stories that aren't quite what anybody expects.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: One Touch Wallflower
mangas.titleNative: 烏田くんは、疼いちゃうから引きこもる。
mangas.description:
Karasuda, a reclusive shut-in, finds himself unable to go to school because of his overwhelming libido?! A BL romantic comedy about a very caring chairman and a very "sensitive" gloomy boy. Washimi, affectionately dubbed "the best caregiver," is tasked with delivering school printouts to Karasuda. When visiting his house, he finds Karasuda has huddled himself in a corner under a blanket, the picture perfect ""shut-in""! Noticing that Karasuda is acting strange, Washimi goes to touch Karasuda's shoulder and...?! "I did something I wasn't supposed to...," Karasuda says with embarrassment. So he hasn't been coming to school and locking himself in his room to--?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Help! My Lv999 and Virginity were Snatched!
mangas.titleNative: 新米転生者にLv999ごといただかれました。
mangas.description:
Getting all his levels and first time stolen by an undefeated, cheat-skill-using new adventurer?! Dive into a world where everyone has a special skill. Shu uses his Level 999 ability to save a newly reincarnated salaryman from a magical beast. After returning home and chatting over drinks, the salaryman's skill is revealed—he's a strong, top-tier adventurer with an incredible ability! But the way to activate his skill is only by…?!

"Why don't we level up in bed…?"

(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Oracle
mangas.description:
For generations, the power of the Imugi has been passed down to the nation's sacred Oracle—a divine protector of peace and balance. But for the young Oracle Ho-Yeong, that power remains dormant. Cast aside as a failure within the palace, he finds solace only in Chi Woo, the noble heir of the prestigious House of Chi. One night, Ho-Yeong stumbles upon Chi Woo in a forbidden tryst—and with it, awakens a feeling he's never known. As secrets unfurl behind silk screens and sacred duty collides with dangerous desire, Ho-Yeong's path as the Oracle may lead to more than just prophecy… it may unearth a destiny no one saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Love Hug Therapy
mangas.description:
Finally living alone like he wanted! But university student Akizuki has started sharing a room with his friend Hayase. As soon as he moves in, he is bewildered by Hayase, who says he can't imagine life without hugs, and for some reason he ends up hugging him every day...? And if he forgets his duty or doesn't hug him, he has to pay a fine and do whatever he tells him...? Akizuki is gradually getting used to the skinship with Hayase, but...?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Raising a Sacrifice
mangas.description:
"It seems I must kill you, Your Grace."


Inas has always been Duke Nigel Montestein's most faithful knight. But when Nigel is betrayed and killed by Inas, he wakes up a year before his supposed death. Nigel's quick to realize this isn't a mere case of time travel however, and the only one who has answers is the man who betrayed him!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Summoning a BL Fan to Another World
mangas.titleNative: 腐男子召喚〜異世界で神獣にハメられました〜
mangas.synonyms: Fanboy Summoning Shafted by an Otherworldly Beast
mangas.description: Kotone is a fudanshi. One day while he was buying BL manga outside of a manga stand, a truck loses control and kills him with BL manga all over him. To his surprise he wakes up in a Asian ancient looking palace. A man named Nagi, that is half serpent, tells him that he is now his Miko. They need to have sex in order for Nagi to become a higher being and become a Dragon. Kotone knows everything about BL and he realizes that he will be the bottom. Kotone will use his knowledge of BL to not fall in love and not a bottom in this Isekai world.

mangas.title: Younger Taste
mangas.description:
Haneul Yeon is a famous TV producer and the first to enter a same-sex marriage after it was legalized in Korea.
