But... he divorces two years later and has a drunken one-night stand with his childhood friend, leaving him conflicted. Six years later, Haneul takes over a show starring Yul Won, a recently divorced rising chef—also a childhood friend. When they meet again, Yul drops a major confession, but Haneul has "no taste for younger men." Will he accept Yul's feelings or push him away?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Hero Wants to Die
mangas.description: Geon-Ho Kim already saved the world. As the last man standing after preventing the apocalypse, he's ready to pass on and greet his old comrades in the afterlife. But destroying a hero's enhanced body isn't so easy, and Geon-Ho's been sent back to his own timeline where he's still 19, shy, awkward, and hopelessly in love with his classmate, Hae-Jeong. There are 100 days before Geon-Ho's meant to die—it'd be a shame if he found something to live for.

mangas.title: The Male Escort and the Son of Nobility Who Loves Him
mangas.titleNative: ウリ専ボーイと恋する御曹司
mangas.description:
A blissfully ignorant rich kid falls in love with a popular male escort.



It was the first time he ever found someone pretty.



Kichiro Wakamiya's parents run their own company. He works part-time to save money for his grandma's birthday present. While on the job, he's unexpectedly tackled by Natsuo, a male escort. To make up for dragging Kichiro into his miss, Natsuo provides his services. Unable to forget their night together, Kichiro starts looking for Natsuo...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Still, I Like It
mangas.description: A story of three people that begins when everything goes awry.

mangas.title: To. Dominant
mangas.description:
A crazy love between two men who only know how to push away and hurt others! Sungjin Yoon is a man born into wealth who never experienced true love. It's only after he listens to Phillip Jung play the piano that his heart starts beating. But it turns out, Phillip is a deprived, twisted child in the body of a man! The two are at each other's throats as soon as they meet…! Will these two men be able to find true love? The tale of awkward emotions exploding behind a mask called perfection.



(Source: Copin Comics)

mangas.title: Seducing the Top Boss
mangas.titleNative: 最上部長は滾り散らす
mangas.description:
"Let me get you hot and bothered."



A hot and steamy story between the fresh-faced new employee and his serious strait-laced boss. Who can get the other one going first?



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Seeing Double
mangas.description:
Ra-On can't stand men, and he's determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-U is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he's recruited his more confident twin brother, Je-U, to act as his double and approach Ra-On. But as Je-U starts putting a little too much of his own heart into the act, the line between who's courting Ra-On gets blurred. Will the brothers break through Ra-On's hatred of men? And if so, which twin will be the one to win Ra-On's heart?



(Source: Lezhin, edited)

mangas.title: Royal Wedding
mangas.description:
The omega crown prince of the Kingdom of Wistad has been living in hell ever since the day he was tricked into imprinting on Duke Amandaris. This is because while an alpha's pheromone is supposed to be enticing and irresistible, it is nothing but unbearable stench to an omega that has already imprinted. However, the crown prince finally sees a glimmer of hope when he hears that there is an extremely affluent foreigner in the kingdom who is capable of undoing an imprinting. Unfortunately, this rare information doesn't come for free, so can the prince pay the right price to the man who has it all?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Dog Daze
mangas.synonyms: A Dog-Like Midsummer | Midsummer Like a Dog
mangas.description: Best friends for 17 years, Yeoreum and Noeul always kept things platonic—despite Noeul's not-so-secret crush. But one impulsive birthday wish crosses a line they can't uncross. Now Noeul's acting like nothing happened, while Yeoreum is slowly losing it. Can their friendship survive the fallout, or is this the summer that changes everything?

mangas.title: Morpheus
mangas.description:
In a world of blood and chemicals, Jin-Seong's only weapon is his intellect and a massive lie. Spared only because he claimed to be a Beta, he's dragged into the territory ruled by Yi-Jae, the merciless leader of Nyx. As attachment forms, Jin-Seong's secret threatens to cost him everything.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Mine to Begin With
mangas.synonyms: It Was You From The Beginning
mangas.description:
Carefree and house-free, Seo-Ha has spent a long time mooching off of guys in trade for some sex and fun. One day, he runs into Jae-Won, a rich and quiet guy who seems to be willing to lend a helping hand with no strings attached…but are we sure that there's no strings pulling at Seo-Ha at all?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Smoke Screen
mangas.description: Trivial rumors. Joo Eun-hyung was always at the center of them. When I carelessly tossed out a lie, Eun-hyung just laughed as if he found it amusing. It was a smile I had never seen before.

mangas.title: Sensei Datte Yarashii Koto Shitai
mangas.titleNative: センセーだってやらしいことしたい
mangas.description:
After his dream of becoming a professional musician was crushed, Ren was forced to work at the kindergarten run by his parents. Ren's unmotivated and lazy personality clashes with that of the super serious teacher Kiichi, whom he watches closely every day. However, Kiichi's straightforward kindness and purity creates new and unique feelings...



Note: Chapter count includes two extras from the volume release.

mangas.title: You Can Try My Body if You Want!: Sex With a Horny Man on an Uninhabited Island
mangas.titleNative: 俺のカラダ、試してもいいよ？～淫らなお兄さんと無人島えっち
mangas.description:
Minato, a good-natured university student, is taking a ferry back home. On the trip, he finds Izumi, a beauty who gazes fleetingly at the waves. As he's captivated by him, he realizes that he's trying to jump into the ocean...!! Minato rushes to save him, but they both end up falling into the water... and getting washed away to a desert island!? They take their soaked clothes off and sit close together to keep warm... but Izumi looks oddly sexy with his skin exposed. With a suggestive touch, he says, "Actually, I'm into men. Do you want to try it?" As the both of them lustfully jerk each other off, Minato feels a wave of incredible pleasure...!!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: Over the Paradise
mangas.description:
A decade ago, Captain U-Jun Kang, an S-tier Esper, saw "Doc" sacrifice himself to save him—no doubt about it. He never even learned Doc's name. Fast-forward to now, U-Jun's staring down his new S-Tier Guide, Hui-Won Chae, who's a dead ringer for the man he thought was gone. Hui-Won draws a complete blank on Captain Kang. Their paths haven't crossed... or so he thinks. As far as he knows, he was out two months due to an accident. Will they connect the dots, or will this second chance slip away?



(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: A Dominating Prince and His Naughty Habits
mangas.titleNative: プッシーキングさまの悪癖
mangas.description:
The setting is a certain city in a certain Gulf state, the suburbs a ways away from the skyscrapers in the desert. Kadri is busy running grandma Jedda's restaurant when Fati, a famous tyrant of a prince, appears, demanding the closure of the restaurant for a development project underway. His curiosity is piqued when he sees Kadri stubbornly refusing to move out and suddenly suggests settling matters through a particular process. Rather than upset Grandma Jedda, Kadri decides to take on the challenge. He goes to the prince's palace with no bedroom experience to speak of and discovers pleasure for the first time in his life.
He tells himself that it's just a way to protect the restaurant, but can't stop reacting to the liberated prince with the naughty habits...!!A love story about a straight cook and an arrogant prince* Includes four digital-only pages.

mangas.title: Happy Parasite
mangas.description:
An encounter that leads to a pushy parasite?! "Thanks for your help!" "Please leave." The cool, low energy businessman and the super-positive NEET, the worst possible match(?), start living together! "I'll repay you with my body!" One night, Kazuhisa, a company employee who doesn't like getting involved with others, meets Haru, a backpacker lying down on the street. Surprised and annoyed by his decision, Kazuhisa decided to let Haru, who had trouble sleeping, stay with him. Kazuhisa is swayed by the brazenness and energy of Haru, while he tries to take care of him the best he can. To top it all off, Haru tries to repay Kazuhisa with his body...?



(Source: Kaiousha, translated)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love is Found 2 Meters Underground
mangas.titleNative: 恋は地表マイナス2メートル
mangas.description:
Sasayama always liked History, but how different is reading about it from actually getting to hold historical artifacts in his hands? That's what he's begun to find out when his overexcited senior Minami "convinces" him to join their Arch-Research Club. Sasayama insists that part of the reason why he goes along with this isn't because he thinks Minami is cute sometimes, but why are his sudden, frustrating dreams about him painting a completely different story?



(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Niji wa Yakou ni Kirameku
mangas.synonyms: The rainbow will sparkles at night
mangas.description: Nakajima, who enjoys traveling alone, gets lost wandering on a legendary mountain of many rumors. He is helped by Kanzawa, who lives alone nearby. In the midst of his purposeless journey, Nakajima is fascinated by Kanzawa, who lives like a recluse. This is the story of Kanzawa who lives quietly on a secluded mountain and Nakajima who comes from a crowded city.

mangas.title: Steamy Influencer
mangas.titleNative: セックスインフルエンサー
mangas.description:
A pompous supermodel meets a stone-faced shopkeeper. Popular supermodel Akira Kuroaki has his regrets. Surrounded by a greedy, seedy modeling industry, he developed a nasty personality. One day, when he encounters a shopkeeper with a rude attitude, he decides to tease him and drags him into a fitting room. However, even when he initiates steamy activities in close quarters, the shopkeeper doesn't resist, let alone bat an eye. Perplexed, Akira can't get the sight of his o-face out of his mind... This encounter just might turn into love! Don't miss this modern-day love story! An arrogant supermodel and a poker-faced apparel shop staff fall in love under strange circumstances.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Kawaisou na Kimi wa Boku dake no Amayaka na Kizu
mangas.titleNative: 可哀想な君は僕だけの甘やかな傷
mangas.description:
A "fork" cannot suppress its urge to prey on "cakes." One day, Aoi, a high school student struggling with his identity as a "fork," is invited by Mitsuri, a "cake," to temporarily join the cooking club.


(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Friends, Engaged
mangas.titleNative: トモダチ・エンゲージ
mangas.description: I thought my best friend would never love me back…but now we're newlyweds?! A straight man and his friend with hidden feelings start their newlywed(?) life!

mangas.title: Ouchi e Kaerou: Nekomimi Omegaverse
mangas.titleNative: おうちへかえろう -猫耳オメガバース-
mangas.description:
Shiina and Aoi are a romantic Alpha and Omega couple who live happily together with their little son, Noel. Protected and sheltered by his parents, Noel is unaware that his family is different from any other until he one day accompanies Shiina to work and notices something strange. Why is it that he and Aoi are the only ones with cat ears?



Notes: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: If You Want Me, Beg
mangas.titleNative: 抱いて欲しけりゃ啼いてみろ
mangas.synonyms: Daite Hoshikerya Naite Miro | If You Want Me To Hold You, You'll Have To Cry
mangas.description:
"Did you just cum because you're deep throating me? ...You damn perv."

Miyama, 3rd year into his IT sales job, had just been given his biggest job yet, however he just couldn't find a system engineer to assist him with it! The only one who he could possibly ask was the asocial type person—Odagiri. After getting super drunk, Odagiri tells him to "Then, cum for me. Right here, right now." Under Odagiri's freezing cold gaze—so cold Miyama could feel it on his skin, Miyama couldn't help but notice how different being with Odagiri was to being with a girl! So, he attacks him again and again!

It's time for the cool, super sadistic (unaware) and the 100% masochistic, always horny playboy to start their erotic love story!

mangas.title: Love Sprouts from a Misunderstanding
mangas.description:
Shingo works as a medical rep. for a pharmaceutical company. He's introduced by his customer to anesthesiologist Reiji, who works for a large hospital. When they first meet, Reiji has an ice-cold attitude and tells Shingo to get lost. He's a tough customer who's not willing to open up at all. Shingo's efforts pay off, though, as he gets invited to go with Reiji to a conference in the countryside! That night, Shingo finds a chance to get closer to Reiji. One hotel room, one bed, a crumpled robe, and an intense expression. "He's totally making a move here...... right?" Not only is he with a man, but it's that cold, straight-laced anesthesiologist... "Should we have sex? Just what the heck's the right answer!!!!?"



A hot medical rep. and a handsome anesthesiologist, embroiled in an adult affair!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Twilight Sugar Cat
mangas.titleNative: 宵闇シュガーキャット
mangas.description:
A super-elite office worker, Kayahara, does not want to hire any more female housekeepers. Every time he hires, it ends with her confessing her love to him, which is just annoying. And Kayahara does not have good experience with ex-girlfriends. So, when he finds a male housekeeper on the internet, he jumps at the chance to try. Kayahara is pleased to find that the new housekeeper, Sho, is a good cook, and a cat drawing on his message card is so cute. A few weeks later, Sho finds a vibrator under the bed. Kayahara does not know its existence as the toy belongs to his ex-girlfriend. He is embarrassed when Sho hands it out to him, but at the same time he notices something at Sho's reaction. Kayahara starts to wonder if Sho is a gay. And he starts to imagine that Sho might use that item to masturbate...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Strange Tale of the Life Draining Specter
mangas.titleNative: 精気搾取モノノケ異譚
mangas.description:
Nagi had been looking forward to a celebratory dinner on the night of his 20th birthday when an unknown creature suddenly attacked him out of nowhere and molested him. He is saved by the timely arrival of a mysterious man who tears apart the vile creature. As it turned out, Nagi is the son of Nurarihyon, the supreme commander of yokai. To add to his problems, Nagi being half-yokai and his coming of age made him a target for rebellious, evil yokai who seek power by drawing on his vitality. The mysterious man, Toshiro, son of the crow tengu leader under the command of Nurarihyon, was tasked with protecting Nagi. And while Nagi just wants a normal life, he can't deny he needs Toshiro's protection.



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Fukouchuu no Shiawase
mangas.description: Businessman Yaotomi Eiju had been blessed with unfathomable good luck since what felt like forever. He lead an extremely easy-going life. Then one day, his good luck suddenly disappeared, and bad luck started following him at every turn. After being advised to get help, Yaotomi decides to visit a shrine on his way home after work, where he happens upon a crude jizou statue. When he arrives home, a man he has never seen before is standing there…

mangas.title: I'll Educate You on Everything
mangas.titleNative: イチから教えてあげる
mangas.description:
Chiaki left his phone at school, so he goes back that evening to retrieve it. While he's there, he hears soft moaning coming from a nearby room and decides to take a look, only to find Mr. Chiba, the math teacher, taking it from another man... Despite being geeky, all the girls love Mr. Chiba, who in turn constantly nags Chiaki about getting more tutoring. Although hesitant, Chiaki takes this chance to blackmail Mr. Chiba and snaps a picture of the two men in action. The next day, Chiaki shows Mr. Chiba the photo during his tutoring sesssion after school. Instead of freaking out, Mr. Chiba simply smiles and kneels down, then takes Chiaki in his mouth to "bribe" him! This is the start of extra-curricular lessons between a cocky fool and a two-faced teacher!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Boyfriend's Too Pure for His Own Good
mangas.titleNative: 俺の恋人の半分は純情でデキている
mangas.synonyms: Half of My Lover is Made of Purity of Heart.
mangas.description:
University student Yoshiyuki and his boyfriend Yuzu have moved in together, and things are going great. Yuzu's not always the most open about his feelings, but natural nurturer Yoshiyuki is happy to coddle him a bit. There's just one problem!! Yuzu is totally new to dating, and even a single kiss leaves him beet-red with embarrassment, so these two aren't getting anywhere in the bedroom... Dreaming of all the hot and heavy fun they could be having, Yoshiyuki makes a deal with Yuzu to make their one-month anniversary their first night together. When the day finally arrives, will Yuzu be up to the task...?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

mangas.title: Please Bond with Me!
mangas.titleNative: ボクと番になってください！
mangas.synonyms: Please be a Tsugai with Me!
mangas.description:
All his life, Aoi Mikage has always thought of himself as a reject alpha - of course he is, when he can't even smell any of the pheromones that may be around him. Upon his brother-in-law's recommendation, he undergoes second-gender counseling under omega counselor Tomoe Akagawa, but is medical help truly all Aoi can get from his Doctor?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Hold on, Crown Prince!
mangas.description: Hold on, Crown Prince! Why are you doing this to me?! With a charming face and a not-quite-so attitude, not a day passes in the life of a beautiful boy Ray without some trouble. Seeing Ray get repeatedly fired from various jobs due to his fiery temper, Edward lets him in on a must-have item(!) for noble ladies that is sure to bring in a big sum of money. While searching through the forest for the material for the item, Ray is injured, though lightly, by an arrow out of nowhere. He runs away refusing any treatment. The arrow's owner is none other than Crown Prince Lucas of Luvecia. Having saved Ray from his troubles time and again, Lucas makes an offer Ray can't refuse--the terms of which dictate that his life will be spared, should he grant Lucas his wishes.

mangas.title: Takkun to Stalker Danshi: Kyou wa Takkun no Tissue wo Tabemashita
mangas.titleNative: たっくんとストーカー男子 ~今日はたっくんのティッシュを食べました~
mangas.synonyms: Takkun and Stalker Boy: I ate Takkun's Used Tissue Today
mangas.description: Kaneko Takuma is a high schooler with the secret hobby of making cute accessories. Suddenly, he runs into Maki Junpei, an eccentric glasses and mask-wearing classmate. With love letters and eerie stuffed animals as presents, it's getting hard for Takuma to ignore his anxiety over the clumsy stalker. From then on, strange things occur after Takuma sees Junpei's adorable unmasked face. With the ideal pretty face of his that throws Takuma into a turmoil, Junpei forces sex on him in a deserted classroom...?!

mangas.title: Can't Help Myself Around You
mangas.titleNative: 先生、もうダメですっ
mangas.description: When comic editor Masumi Shishio is transferred to a BL magazine, he finds himself out of his depth with this new genre, but he isn't about to let that stop him. He reaches out to an artist who's scary good at drawing the D, secures a meeting, and then finds out that the talented "Miss Akiina" is in fact a businessman named Satoru Akiba. The pair decide to make the most of being a two-man team by doing some hands-on research: photoshoots at love hotels to get the poses right, test-runs of kisses and dates to get the feelings right... even a bit of sex, just to safe!! If they want to sell a million copies, they'll have to really put their backs into it! But what if this editor-artist combo's romance simulations turn into something real...?

mangas.title: Monochrome Limit
mangas.description: Rui, the handsome lead of the popular band Joker Trick, feels a surpassing passion for music only matched by the lack of love that he feels for any woman he is involved with. Much to the exasperated concern of his band mates, he seems unable to know romantic love at all. When one of them hands him an illicit piece of technology that promises to learn to be the perfect lover, he is reluctantly intrigued. Will this android lover show Rui what it is to love?

mangas.title: Would You Let Me Support You With Money and Love? ~Lessons About Pleasure With the No.1 Host~
mangas.titleNative: お金も愛も貢がせて？～No.1ホストの快感レッスン
mangas.description:
Ayumu, a rookie stage actor, is worried about his lack of sex appeal...! However, the role he's currently auditioning for is that of a male prostitute who captivates his clients one after another. In other words, he must have sex appeal... As he is trying to think of a solution, he sees a host trying to seduce a girl on the street! Could this be a chance to learn about sexiness!? He visits the host club, where he meets a Jun, a host so beautiful that he could fall in love with him. After he tells him about his situation, Jun promises to teach him how to be sexy...!! When the action begins, Jun's passionate gaze and his breathtaking kisses could make him come in an instant...!! He stares at his most embarrassing places, and strokes his melting special spot with his fingers...



Follow the erotic lessons of a top host who donates substantial amounts to his favorite artist and a rookie actor who's studying to improve himself.



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: So What If I Work on Yaoi Content at an Anime Production Studio?
mangas.titleNative: アニメ制作会社でBLしてますが、なにか？
mangas.description:
Ryota Ukawa is a production manager at an anime production studio. He takes over on an episode after the previous manager up and quits one day.
He's reunited with Tomoya Kaneshiro, an anime producer Ryota worked with when he was just starting out. Tomoya's as stoic and twisted as ever as he bosses Ryota around. Ryota and Tomoya have a past together, though, that goes beyond the office walls...



A boys' love story set in the animation industry between a younger production manager who's always willing to lend a hand with anything and his complicated, arrogant-but-shy anime producer.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Double Fake: Tsugai Keiyaku
mangas.titleNative: ダブルフェイク -Double Fake- つがい契約
mangas.description:
An omega opening a detective bureau, Idou Jitsuya, has a pair. Kitakouji Kazuhiro, Jitsuya's alpha, is an elite detective from the Metropolitan Police Department. Together they're business partners who made a mutual agreement to become a pair. Jitsuya uses this pair to control his omega constitution. As an "S", Kitakouji uses Jitsuya for insider information. Even though it was meant to be a cut and dry relationship, an omega's body needs to have sex regularly his pair…

Involuntarily, Kitakouji and his omega's body are forced against their will. The most vexing for both of them, the sex with their pair is the best they've ever had. While continuing this distorted relationship, an illegal drug case aiming at omegas is at large!? Raising the curtain on a BL where two men become a pair to mutually use each other!

mangas.title: Dominate Me With Your Power －Dom/Sub-verse－
mangas.titleNative: むさぼるように支配して
mangas.synonyms: Musaboru you ni Shihai shite ‐Dom/Sub universe-
mangas.description:
"I'll become your Dom, just for now."

A twisted Detective Dom who hates using command words, and a secret Sub. Will the Detective be able to save the cute Sub from death...?

mangas.title: I Won't Give Up until You Embrace Me!
mangas.titleNative: 抱かせてくれるまで諦めない！
mangas.description:
"I'm in love with you, Iori."



Haruhiko, a university student with the ability to enter other people's dreams, always sees Iori, the person he fell in love with seven years ago, on the train to school. It may be a one-sided reunion, but the person he admires wearing a suit is still handsome.



After a fateful coincidence, Iori spends the night at Haruhiko's place. Haruhiko enters Iori's dream and sees Iori, embracing another man...!?



I want to make him mine, the sexy Iori that allows the other to pleasure him... A one-sided, young dominant love story between a determined university student and a salary man!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: My Mischievous Hands Can't Resist
mangas.titleNative: いたずらな手は我慢ができない
mangas.description:
Kubo, a university student who works at an adult goods store, is extremely curious about adult toys. One day, the store manager gets sick and Sugiura, a man who had piqued Kubo's interest when he'd been at the store before, comes to cover for him. While stocking shelves, Sugiura picks up a vibrator, and when Kubo casually teases him about using one, the usually expressionless Sugiura gets red and flustered... His subtle sensuality... Does that mean...? Taking a chance while they're alone in the back, Kubo pushes Sugiura against the wall, and...! Brought to the brink by a whirring toy! A wet 'n' wild love story between a simple-minded, arrogant student and a hot-and-cold prince!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Beloved Supper
mangas.description:
Yoru is a vampire, a predator of the night dwelling among humans. But compared to a meal of fresh blood, he'd much rather partake in the culinary delights of the human world—fragrant stews, tasty meat buns, and sweet pastries are all irresistible delicacies to him. Unfortunately, being a vampire means he cannot stomach human food...unless he first drinks blood as an appetizer. Thus, Yoru spends his nights sinking his fangs into criminals and evildoers, all for the sake of the beloved supper awaiting him...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Make You Mine
mangas.description:
Jinwoo Kim, a university student with severe social anxiety, returns to school, determined to make new friends and overcome his conditions. But when his eyes meet Han Choi, the handsome and popular underclassman, he gags and runs out. Humiliated, Han vows to make Jinwoo fall for him. A seductive race between an introvert and prince charming... Who will be the winner?



(Source: POCKET COMICS)



Note: Chapter count includes 6 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Cherry to Unicorn
mangas.titleNative: チェリーとユニコーン
mangas.description: The night before his first day in high school, Souta Kashiyama took care of his pet unicorn, Mahoro, and went to sleep as usual. However, the next day when he woke up there was a stranger in his bed!! Could this man actually be his pet unicorn!?!?

mangas.title: Swit, Agiga Jago Isseoyo
mangas.description: Strict and elite employer Gyuyeon who is works at the head of legal team of the big company, he hurriedly go to the hospital after he heard about his 18th year friend and first love Taewoo's car accident. Taewoo who is having a financial difficulties, because he left with the baby and lost his wife by car accident, Gyuyeon who knows about this offered to Taewoo to live with him at his place for the time being...

mangas.title: Underneath It All, Ren is a Woman
mangas.titleNative: 蓮くんは剥いたらおんなのこ。
mangas.description:
A secret photoshoot with the Lingerie Boy!? I tried to keep a straight face... but when he strips, I can't believe how sexy he is.



(Source: Coolmic)



Notes:

- A long-strip format was simultaneously released along the page format, consisting of 36 chapters.

- Includes two extras from the volume releases.

mangas.title: Suki de Gomen.
mangas.description: For 6 years, Kouta has been harboring a secret crush on his childhood best friend and well-known playboy Haruto. All this time, he's accepted that his crush will stay just that, unrequited. However, one day, it seems like Haruto has noticed...? Little by little, their relationship is changing!

mangas.title: Junai Caricature
mangas.description: Hotaruda is a budding shounen manga artist. His manuscript was rejected after visiting several publishers and was then referred to an ero manga publisher instead. Right after getting the job, he learns that his new editor Kayama is a masochistic pervert.

mangas.title: Youchi na Koi wo Doushiyou
mangas.titleNative: 幼稚な恋をどうしよう
mangas.synonyms: What to do With a Childish Love?
mangas.description:
Haruto Sakurano is a lonely boy who has been surviving on his own since his mother abandoned him. Too small and weak to defend himself from sexual assault and constantly discriminated against for being an Omega, Haruto begins prostituting himself to save money to move out of town. Then one day he meets a boy named Takagi whose calm, non-judgemental nature slowly begins filling the void in his heart.



Haruto's fear and self-loathing keep him from expressing the love he feels, but Takagi's gentle care and persistence brings them emotionally - and physically - closer together. Warmth and tenderness begin to replace Haruto's pain and loneliness, but how can Takagi convince him that he truly is worthy of being loved?




Note: Includes one extra chapter and the one-shot "Yarichin Engage (ヤリチンエンゲージ)".

mangas.title: I Want to Spoil You
mangas.titleNative: もっと可愛くなっていい
mangas.synonyms: น่ารักกว่านี้อีกก็ได้นะ
mangas.description:
Wataru Manaka lands a job with his dream company, only to be transferred to a department managed by the devil himself, Reiji Kenzaki. Wataru is scolded by his new supervisor day in and day out, and he wonders if he'll ever win Reiji's approval. While his co-workers get a reprieve from Reiji when they clock out, that's not the case for Wataru. Due to a financial crisis in Wataru's family, not only is Reiji his supervisor, but he's also his roommate! Through their shared living arrangement, Wataru slowly starts to see different sides to Reiji he never knew existed beyond his cold exterior. But, who knew Wataru would receive the praise he craves from Reiji at work, at home...!?


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Heart Silent
mangas.description: A high school boy whose heart doesn't beat meets a man that stirs up his heart.

mangas.title: I Caught Him Getting Off Online!
mangas.titleNative: ひとりえっちオンライン
mangas.description:
Hayato is getting off to various livestreams when he comes across a man who is touching himself-and finds himself surprisingly into it. In fact, he's transfixed by the man's perky chest and slender fingers, which sport two distinctive moles. At work the next day, he sees the exact same moles on Mamiya, a younger coworker he's hardly spoken to before. At first, he figures it's a coincidence, but the next time he views the livestream, he can't help imagining the man as Mamiya...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Siryeonjungimnida
mangas.description: When Min Gun Lee is rejected after confessing to the upperclassman he likes, he is shocked when his crush's scary twin brother Jo Gan immediately asks him out afterward... and refuses to take no for an answer! With the nickname "Mad Dog" and a reputation for putting a teacher in the hospital, Jo Gan is the very picture of a juvenile delinquent - the exact opposite of his princely, model student brother Jo Han. Will timid Min Gun survive being in a relationship with someone the entire school is terrified of, or will his new boyfriend manage to win his heart with his rough but sincere affection? And how will Jo Han react to the situation? (Source: Anime-Planet)

mangas.title: Falling Slowly
mangas.titleNative: いややいややもすきのうち?
mangas.synonyms: Iyaya Iyaya mo Suki no Uchi?
mangas.description: Who would've thought Masumi, the king of poker faces and a bit of an enigma, had a thing for Yuki? Yuki certainly didn't until Masumi decided to tell him one day. Yuki finds it hard to believe because Masumi is popular with women and is even rumored to have a girlfriend. As Yuki panics, Masumi lets him know that he finds it adorable how expressive Yuki is with his face. Yuki's never been with a guy, so he rejects Masumi at first, but as Masumi keeps confessing his hot, passionate feelings for him, he starts to develop some feelings of his own for the guy...!!

mangas.title: That Time I Became a BL Game Protagonist and My Rival Doted on Me
mangas.titleNative: BLゲームの主人公になったらライバルに溺愛された件
mangas.description:
"We're now in a world...where it's acceptable for dudes to fool around together, right?"



A certain occurrence brings a college student Tatsuya to wander into a parallel universe along with his rival and inseparable (want it or not) friend Wataru. What a place! It was a world mirroring an academy-setting of a BL game! In order to return to his home world, the protagonist, Tatsuya, needs to land a happy ending with one of the main characters(sex!?). But to top it all off, Wataru is also thrown into the mix! Hearing moaning from the adjacent room at the dorm, Wataru catches Tatsuya in quite the arousing predicament. "They say it feels good if you rub them together," Wataru says, reaching out a hand. Stroking in unison, Tatsuya is faced with immense pleasure for the first time! Furthermore, other main characters approach Wataru one after another. Who will join him in his happy ending...? And, will he ever find his way back home!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Takara-kun to Amagi-kun
mangas.description:
Takara Shun, a high school student who belongs to a popular group in the class, and Taichi Amagi, a pure boy who is not a conspicuous type but is liked by people, realize their love for each other. Even though they start dating in secret, it is difficult to be honest.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Hitorijime My Hero
mangas.titleNative: ひとりじめマイヒーロー
mangas.description: Masahiro Setagawa doesn't believe in heroes, but wishes he could: he's found himself trapped in a gang of small-time street bullies, and with no prospects for a real future. But when high school teacher (and scourge of the streets) Kousuke Ohshiba comes to his rescue, he finds he may start believing after all...in heroes, and in his budding feelings, too.

mangas.title: Crossplay Love: Otaku x Punk
mangas.titleNative: 女装してめんどくさい事になってるネクラとヤンキーの両片想い
mangas.synonyms: The Bothersome Emotions of the Emo and Yankee Crossdressers | Crossdressing Has Become a Problem; Emo and Yankee's Unrequited Mutual Feelings
mangas.description: Shuumei has a problem. He's in love with a girl who works at a maid cafe, but he's too cool to go into a place like that without being embarrassed. But girls can go to maid cafes without seeming creepy, right? When he dresses in feminine clothes and transforms himself into "Mei," he can finally walk into the place to meet the girl of his dreams: the lovely blonde Hana. Meanwhile, Hanae is an introverted otaku who's uncomfortable talking to people…unless he's dressed in feminine clothes himself. While decked out in his best dresses, he works at a maid cafe, and finds himself crushing on a young woman who regularly comes to visit him: a cool beauty named Mei! In this delightful LGBT+ romcom, two young people in love are about to find out a lot about each other–and themselves.

mangas.title: Hyung, You're My Idol
mangas.description: As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be... riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore... How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy!

mangas.title: Contradict
mangas.description: A cocky and confident Yajima harbors dislike for Torikai, a cool and talented fellow trainee in the Rescue Team. The two constantly quarrel, but one day they cross the line while squabbling and end up sleeping together. Yajima regrets it, but at the same time he cannot get Torikai's pleading expression out of his head. However, because they have been rivals until now, he just can't bring himself to be honest with Torikai.

mangas.title: Oretachi wa Unmeiryoku ga Tarinai
mangas.titleNative: 俺たちは運命力が足りない
mangas.description: No penetration equals death?! The eldest of the six brothers, Fukakusa Riyuu is an omega who supports his family after their parents passed away accidentally. "Find your destined pair and you'll see a drastic change in your life." says a mystic website he browses. And the following day, just as the site predicts, hot shot alpha Harumi Jou shows up on his doorstep! The two get instinctively attracted and start to mate in order to be a pair, however, no matter how hard he tries, Jou can't penetrate Riyuu!! And then they notice the disclaimer in the mystic website… "In case you fail to become a pair, you both could die." !!!

mangas.title: The Secret Life of Professor Ha
mangas.description:
Jaeyoung is a young, promising professor of Business at K University. A long-time favorite among students for his excellent lectures and kindness, it seems like he has everything a man would wish for. But even he had a little secret - Jaeyoung is a big-time otaku of magical girl animes. Then one day, a student of his, Saewoong, finds him holding a dakimakura, effectively exposing Jaeyoung's otaku lifestyle. Desperate to keep his double life a secret, Jaeyoung agrees on a deal with Saewoong that would shake his life...


(Source: POCKET COMICS)



Note: The chapter count includes 11 extras.

mangas.title: Ao ni Naku
mangas.description: A young man finds an amnesiac guy who's dressed like a pilot, and a (rather confusing) sequence of events begins to unfold.

mangas.title: Oshi no Keima-kun ni Gachikoi Shitemasu
mangas.titleNative: 推しの桂真くんにガチ恋してます
mangas.description:
"All I want is to sleep with you."



Sweet, young, and popular—actor Keima Akizuki has a secret: he's actually a sharp-tongued video game nerd! When a mysterious younger man threatens Keima with that secret, he has no choice but pay the stranger off...with his body! Keima thinks the last he'll ever see of the mystery man until he's introduced to him the very next day! A junior actor at Keima's agency, newcomer Haruto Kanzaki is scheduled to star with veteran Keima in a new detective drama.



Determined and aggressive youth meets sassy but hard working A-lister in this romance that begins with a secret and seems destined to end between the sheets!



(Source: Hakusensha, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Welcome Home
mangas.description:
Masaki lives as a househusband in the Fujiyoshi household with his loving trophy husband and breadwinner Hiromu and their two-year old Hikari, who is too cute for his own damn good. Full of doubt, the support of his family in their day-to-day lives carries Masaki through to a place of accepting himself for who he is.



A feeling, family-oriented BL between a Mr Right and a male beauty who feels like he doesn't size up.



Embracing the good times and the bad, all to be a better today than they were yesterday.



(Source: Manga Club)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Bothersome Hours
mangas.titleNative: めんどーなお時間です
mangas.synonyms: Time to Be Annoyed | Mendo na Ojikan Desu
mangas.description: Extroverted student, Hayato, never really got to enjoy fast-food before since he lived in a wealthy and sheltered household. So he tags along with his not-so-enthusiastic classmate, Kei, to eat out after-school practically everyday. However, fast-food isn't the only thing he wants to indulge on. A usually passive and lazy Kei suddenly gets dragged along with Hayato's pace. And by the end of this. it seems like Kei becomes the spoiled one.

mangas.title: Love in Orbit
mangas.synonyms: 無重力ロマンス〜妊娠してみるか？地球人〜
mangas.description:
Some people win the lottery or find their dream job, but Sohan…has an alien spaceship land on his brand-new house?! To make matters even worse, there's an – admittedly sexy – alien inside threatening to wipe out the entire population. Sihwa has come to earth in search of someone specific and has no qualms about using Sohan to get what he wants. The thing is, things work differently on Sihwa's home planet, and he seems to be expecting things from Sohan that sound downright impossible! Nevertheless, Sohan finds himself making a deal: help Sihwa find the person he's looking for in exchange for the safety of humanity. But will this strange partnership turn into something...out of this world?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Colorless and Odorless
mangas.description: Colorblind comic author Seon Jung meets chef Jihwan Cha while preparing for his new comic. However, the star chef is as arrogant as he is handsome, and has something to do with Seon’s past lover who left him heartbroken…

mangas.title: You Who Wants to Love
mangas.description:
"You're quite a snack, aren't you?"



When a virgin rabbit and his doting wolf subordinate stay late at work one night, things get heated.



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: My First Love Is Ripe for Picking
mangas.titleNative: 初恋が、どエロく実った
mangas.description:
"Do you like me even though I'm a boy?"



A straight BL fan gets sex lessons from a washed up child actor prodigy.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: I Have A Boyfriend
mangas.description:
"A romantic campus love story about a gay soccer star and his regained first love!"



The campus soccer star Hyunho runs into his first love Gyul at the university. Back then in middle school, Gyul saw Hyunho as a friend and never learned about his feelings. Hyunho, still in love with the withdrawn Gyul, lends him a helping hand. Because Gyul's aunt is taking advantage of him, Gyul has to support his younger brother. To thank Hyunho, Gyul helps him navigate university assignments. What starts out as a caring friendship, soon flourishes into a romantic relationship. But then, Hyunho receives an offer to play abroad in the major league. Will Hyunho and Gyul be able to overcome this hardship, too?


(Source: Netcomics)

mangas.title: Megumi and Tsugumi
mangas.description:
When alpha male Megumi hears about a masked man with an iron pipe and a killer glare attacking people, he knows this spells trouble. When he summons the man in question, Tsugumi Yamada, the fearsome delinquent who appears crackles with hostility. Just when they're raring for a fight, omega pheromones drift to the alpha, bewildering him. That's when Tsugumi smugly says the unthinkable: the pheromones are coming from him! An omega is shocking enough, but for an omega to pick a fight while in heat, and without using any suppressants!!? Tsugumi's existence baffles Megumi. He's determined to do something about the heat. Bring on the unprecedented omega problem child!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: You're Wasting A Great Thing
mangas.titleNative: 君はコカンの持ち腐れ
mangas.description:
28 years old. Still never been with a girl. Because of his big problem, girls refuse to take their relationship a step further!



Handsome, nice and smart, but Kaname Kusakabe gets dumped all the time because of his unusually large male organ. He decides to go to counseling. Doctor Minato Momose is extremely sympathetic to Kaname's dilemma. "An impressive specimen, but he's never been with woman!!? I have to help him!" As a doctor, Minato can't help be curious about Kaname's oversized organ. After having it poked and rubbed... Kaname can't help exploding all over the doctor's face. Minato doesn't mind at all, though. He's actually very excited...! Practice love-making at the clinic! An office worker with a big problem and a very dirty doctor!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Stop It, Mr.Wolf
mangas.description:
The overbearing president who is the black wolf king invaded my house, tries to eat me day and night and he also said want to marry me?! The world of beast is too hard to understand! If I really can't oppose of it, I can also secretly enjoy it right?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Memeshii Aku to Azatoi Suu
mangas.titleNative: めめしいアクとあざといスウ
mangas.description:
Hooking up with your sex friends whenever you like and with no strings attached is the best! Playboy college student and advocate of free love, Suu, ends up sleeping with his friend's persistent and clingy boyfriend, Aku. It was supposed to be a one night stand, but Aku just can't forget about Suu after losing his virginity to him and makes Suu the new object of his affection.



(Source: Gentosha, translated)

mangas.title: Love, a Kitten, and a Salty Dog
mangas.titleNative: 恋と猫とソルティドッグ
mangas.synonyms: คุณหมอคนดีพร้อมเป็นแฟนเสมอ
mangas.description:
Okura is a tough veterinarian who works at Kinako Animal Hospital, right near the entertainment district. One day, a kind and earnest college student named Momo brings in a tiny kitten he found on the streets, and the two men grow closer as Okura helps Momo learn about cat parenthood. It isn't long until their conversations turn from petcare to their experiences with romance as Okura finds himself wanting to get to know Momo better. Will their relationship grow into something more with a kiss?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Love Me Divinely
mangas.description:
Min-Ha is no stranger to the unexplainable. As a child, he used to see things that weren't there, and even as an adult the strangest things tend to happen to him. Not a day seems to go by where he isn't tripping over something or crashing into someone. Still, he's managed to stay in one piece...sort of. Until one day he finds himself staring into the light—the headlights of an oncoming car, that is! Assuming this is it for him, Min-Ha braces for impact, only to find himself safe in the arms of a handsome stranger. The strange man, calling himself Do-Un, claims to be Min-Ha's guardian deity, and so Min-Ha informs him that he doesn't care for new-age religions, thank you very much. But there's just something so...believable about Do-Un's story. How does he know so much about Min-Ha, things no one but himself should know? And why does Min-Ha feel safer around him? Perhaps there might just be something divine about him after all...



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Chapter count includes ten side story chapters.

mangas.title: Ω ni dake wa Naritakunai!!: Isekai Tensei Shitara Ane no BL Manga no Naka deshita
mangas.titleNative: Ωにだけはなりたくない!! ～異世界転生したら姉のBL漫画の中でした～
mangas.synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Just an Omega!: I Was in My Sister's Bl Manga When I Reincarnated in Another World
mangas.description:
Aspiring manga artist Taisei Kuji is an assistant to his sister, a popular BL mangaka. One day, Taisei was unluckily run over by a truck and found himself reincarnated into the omegaverse world drawn by his sister!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

mangas.title: Boss, Bxtch, Baby!
mangas.description: Would you rather be the target of a ruthless gang of loan sharks or become the boy-toy of an unhinged corporate heir for a year? This is the predicament Hojin finds himself in when Yoo-Seong, a former one-night stand, wrestles him into a deal that'll solve all his money problems. He'll have to pay a hefty price in return, but Hojin soon comes to learn that his cruel master for a year hides a rather lonely heart. Thus, the two begin to grow closer... Will they actually find comfort in each other or will this year crush Ho-Jin for good?

mangas.title: Cherry Doll Scandal
mangas.description:
"Listen carefully, I'm a bit of a pervert."

"What?"

"So I want Hyung to do as I tell you."

One day, Do Jaewon of the popular idol group "Majors" saw Cheon Eunho, a member of the same group, masturbating using his video. Realizing that Eunho has a crush on him, Jaewon starts a sexual relationship with him out of curiosity. However, before he knows it, he becomes more and more sincere...

What will be the end of the scandal between the two 'Cherry Dolls', who just began to know each other?

mangas.title: Lick Me, Like Me
mangas.synonyms: イケメンペットと同棲はじめました。
mangas.description:
Jooin is a young vet that charms pets and owners alike at his animal clinic. When a puppy and kitten are dumped at his door, he decides to raise them as his own. With love and care the furballs quickly become full-grown ‒perhaps a bit too much as they're now two… hunky humans?! When your pets are this eager, it takes being a 'pet lover' to a whole new level!



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Do Black Cats Dream of Wolf Princes?
mangas.titleNative: 黒猫は狼王子の夢を見るか
mangas.synonyms: Does the Black Cat Dream of the Wolf Prince? | Kuro Neko wa Ookami Ouji-sama no Yume o Miru ka
mangas.description:
In a world divided into dogs (dominants) and cats (submissives), Aoi Natsuyama was one of the most common cat types: a house cat. All he wanted in life was to find the prince of his dreams. The prince he's fallen in love with is a handsome wolf, Yukio, who he's seen in naughty videos. Aoi decides to get a job in the industry to meet him, but it turns out Yukio isn't charming or kind at all!!
A cute, Cinderella love story between a dual-natured wolf and a dreamy-yet-kind-of-pushy cat!

mangas.title: Bokura to Usagi no Koi wa Sensou
mangas.titleNative: 僕らとうさぎの恋は戦争
mangas.description: The ordinary Santarou has an extraordinary secret. And it's that he gives off pheromones to the boys around him. His childhood friend Sukai, transfer student King, classmate Mimi and even Tomomatsu. He's used by them over and over again! B-B-But, this won't do! He's not some sex slave! But it feels so gooood...

mangas.title: Motion Emotion
mangas.titleNative: モーションエモーション
mangas.description:
One day by chance, Ayumu learns his handsome, popular, and younger co-worker Takeru has a crush on someone. Ayumu encourages Takeru to make a move. But every time he does, he notices Takeru standing a little too close to him. Then again, why does his heart pound so much when Takeru stands near him?



As Ayumu wonders how he feels about Takeru, Takeru finally makes a move...on Ayumu!



Motion Emotion also features "Seachange" and Murderous Youth," BL short stories by Thanat!



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Kisses x Kiss x Kisses
mangas.description:
An ambiguous and complex relationship that began with that single word. Reality, dreams, and love are all undecided from the moment the word "Kiss me!" comes out from the mouth of a high school student's best friend! "No way I don't like you..?'' Strong negative is strong positive?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Nee Senpai, Oshiete yo
mangas.description: Hirano Haruto, a freshman, moves into a dormitory and has Morioka Touji, a scary looking upperclassman assigned to him as his guidance manager. Rumors say that Morioka used to bully his junior back in middle school, but is he really as bad as everyone makes him out to be?

mangas.title: Ani to wa Koinaka nan desu ga.
mangas.titleNative: 兄とは恋仲なんですが。
mangas.description:
1-3. Ani to wa Koinaka nan desu ga.

4-5. Shousetsuka no Koi wa Yakkai (A Novelist's Love!)

mangas.title: Whose Baby is it?
mangas.description:
According to the fortune-teller, I was born to be unlucky...was he kidding me?! My child owns the super power that can turn calamities into blessings through dreams! But the bossy president suddenly claimed that he's the natural father of my babe?! And he even kidnapped me and my child?!



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Star x Fanboy
mangas.description:
What if you could talk to your favorite fictional character every day? And what if they make you feel like the most special person in the world? "Good morning," "I was thinking about you," "Sweet dreams," "See you tomorrow"... Some fans dive into their TV/movie/book obsessions on social media by interacting with accounts that take on the persona of their favorite characters. But what if the person behind that fictional account is actually...the very star who played that role?

(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: Ashita wa Docchi da!
mangas.description: Kirara is seen as a cute and girly boy to others, however he wants to be a cool and manly guy! So when two tall and cool boys move in nearby he starts to follow them around to learn how to be manly. As they grow up together, Kirara realizes that his feelings towards the younger brother, Ken, isn't just simple friendship.

mangas.title: Wrong Night Stand
mangas.description:
What does it take for a guy to get laid, you ask? Well, a hell of a lot of tries is the answer. Lee Si-Hyeon is a 21-year-old virgin who has been in the bottom rungs when it comes to getting laid—and it's not the kind of bottom he aspires to be. After four failed attempts at having sex, Si-Hyeon's fifth attempt is finally successful. Kind of. He wakes up in bed with his former-childhood-best-friend, present-arch-nemesis, Han Baek-Kyung. Baek-Kyung may not have been the top of Si-Hyeon's list of eligible boys, but he could be the top Si-Hyeon needs to undo the curse on his sex life.



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Half of Me
mangas.description:
A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn't get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There's just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin's high school in the boy's body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Man's Best Boyfriend
mangas.description:
How long is too long to spend in space?
When astronaut Webber Jones returns to Earth after a 20 year mission, he brings with him an interesting problem. Due to spending the last two decades with nothing but an AI robot dog as company, he's lost the ability to tell the difference between dogs and people. Of course, excitable psychiatrist Benjamin rogers isn't expecting this case to be easy, but he encounters an unexpected problem in the fact that the handsome, mature Webber is exactly his type! The things is, it's hard to treat a man who thinks of you as nothing more than his four-legged friend, and soon Benjamin realizes he may have bitten off more than he can chew…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Prohibited Distance 10M
mangas.description: Nam Joo Won is a high school teacher with a phobia of students. On the first day of classes, Joo Won runs to the faculty bathroom to find shelter from his students but encounters the class delinquent, Lee Tae Gyum. Why won't this kid leave him alone?

mangas.title: Hope You've Been Well
mangas.synonyms: Bie Lai Wu Yang, Don’t Come Near Me You Lamb
mangas.description: Ten years ago, the frustrated Gu Zhuoyan met Zhuang Fanxin, a bright ray of sunshine. Zhuoyan was healed, and Fanxin was moved- but their mutual interest ended due to the distance between them. Ten years later, Gu Zhuoyan finds himself on a blind date with the one that got away. All the feelings he had long sealed away in the depths of his heart awake once again, but how will he win back the heart of his old flame?

mangas.title: Kamisama☆Darling
mangas.description:
University student Satake Aoi wakes up rolled up in a red string and with a stranger inside his house that says he's a god. Aoi scapes, but something is... different... He's now extremely popular and everybody's fighting for his attention. What's the relation between these events and some promise he made with the man that calls himself the god Ookuninushi-no-mikoto and what will happen from now on?



Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

mangas.title: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie
mangas.description:
Sunwoo looks like a harmless little puppy on the outside, but everyone in the office knows he's more of a feisty cat - sensitive and aloof, through and through. Hyunjin, on the other hand, is like a big friendly dog - always ready and oh-so-eager to befriend Sunwoo. After his fruitless efforts to avoid Hyunjin within the office, Sunwoo gives him an ultimatum that results in their unlikely new friendship. Rocky roads await the puss in suit and pup in tie!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Paint Love and the Colors Will Bloom
mangas.description:
It's been a year since Ryuji Honjo graduated high school and started university. And so far, despite being recently dumped, he is having a grand old time. But what would his middle school self think about him now?... Meanwhile, Leo Ichinose, Ryuji's classmate in university, is as cool and reserved as ever. His unintentional glares scare people off. But something about him catches Ryuji's attention. Or... is it Ryuji who's caught Ichinose's attention? Ryuji swears he can feel his stares on him. Will the outgoing and charming Ryuji get along with the distant and unapproachable Ichinose? The two seem like polar opposites at first, but maybe they're not so different after all.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Dive
mangas.description: Once a promising swimmer, Youngwan was forced to abandon his passion when a traumatic incident unleashed an overwhelming aquaphobia. Now, Youngwan is enjoying ordinary college life, taking up studies as an athletic major, and shooting hoops with friends as a hobby. One day, Sunwoo, a brilliant pianist with secrets of his own, approaches Youngwan and asks an unusual favor. "Can I watch you play basketball tomorrow?" Will this budding new friendship help heal the scars of the past?

mangas.title: What We Do When the Curtain Comes Down
mangas.titleNative: 幕が下りたら僕らは番
mangas.description:
This alpha is the only thing I need...


Mitsuki is an idol who hides the fact that he is an omega. In an industry full of alphas, he clawed his way up the ranks and became the top idol at his agency. The next-most popular idol in the game is Mahiro, who is sharp and boasts all the qualities of an alpha. Mitsuki, who doesn't like Mahiro, ends up going on stage with him to help avert an emergency. But, while they are on stage, Mitsuki's medicine stops working and he goes into heat... Mahiro saves the day and the crowd is none the wiser, but Mitsuki is overcome with desires and passions he has never known before...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Nomi x Shiba
mangas.description: They first met at boarding school. After two whole years of living in the dorms, Nomiya can't truthfully say he's ever been in love. Sure, he thinks Mikoshiba's face is kinda cute and girlie, and yeah, his heart skips a beat every time he sees him, but that doesn't mean he's in love with Shiba, all right?! He's into chicks, not dicks, okay?

mangas.title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
mangas.titleNative: やたらやらしい深見くん
mangas.description:
Kaji is perfect. He's dependable, friendly, smart, and always helping others out with a smile on his face. But this perfect boy image is just that—a facade! In reality, Kaji is quick to judge others, especially if they're potential dates, and he's seeking someone worthy of his perfection. But when he's forced to spend the night with the sloppy and quiet IT guy, Fukami, he quickly learns there's more to someone than first impressions! Beneath the baggy clothes and glasses is a man who is surprisingly beautiful and totally Kaji's type. But when it comes to mixing business with pleasure, can Kaji really afford to put his perceived personality at risk? If Fukami keeps making those faces, then… yes!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Yamete Kudasai, Koishii Desu.
mangas.titleNative: やめてください、こいしいです。
mangas.synonyms: Please Stop, I'm Longing for You.

mangas.title: Boku to
mangas.description: "I like you, you like him, and he likes someone else".

mangas.title: No Longer Allowed In Another World
mangas.description:
An adventure in another world with cute girls by your side and video game-like powers–sounds like an anime fan's dream, right? Not so for melancholic author Osamu Dazai, who would quite literally prefer to drop dead. Video games haven't even been invented yet when he gets yanked into another world in 1948. Really, all the fantastical adventure he keeps running into is just getting in the way of his poetic dream of finding the perfect place to die. But no matter how much he risks his hide, everything seems to keep turning out okay. Follow a miserable hero like no other in this cheerfully bleak isekai comedy!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

mangas.title: The Summer Hikaru Died
mangas.synonyms: หน้าร้อนที่ฮิคารุจากไป
mangas.description:
Two boys lived in a village: Yoshiki and Hikaru. The two did everything together...until the day Hikaru was encompassed by a mysterious light. That was when everything changed—Hikaru most of all. Yoshiki still wishes from the bottom of his heart to always stay by his side...but is there even a Hikaru left to be with?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: I Hear the Sunspot: Limit
mangas.titleNative: ひだまりが聴こえる－リミット
mangas.description:
"You rescued me from a world without sound. If it wasn't for you, I never would've known the world was such an amazing place!"



Because of a hearing disability, university student Kohei had made a habit of distancing himself from those around him. But after meeting the exceedingly cheerful Taichi, he gradually begins to embrace a more positive outlook on life. Kohei eventually begins to see Taichi as more than a friend, and after he finally confesses his love to Taichi, the feelings become mutual.



In this new addition to the I Hear the Sunspot series, Kohei continues on as a student, while Taichi makes his way out into the working world to pursue his own calling and the two begin a new life together!


(Source: One Peace Books)


Note: Contains four extras.

mangas.title: My Lovesick Pupil Won't Let Me Die
mangas.titleNative: 弟子の愛が重すぎて死ねない
mangas.description:
Lucas, an elderly sorcerer, drew his last breath with his beloved pupil at his side... At least, that's what should have happened.

When he wakes up, he finds himself in a room with a magic circle drawn on the floor... and his appearance transformed into that of a young boy!

As if things couldn't get any more complicated, his dear pupil, Theo, who was only a child when he passed, appears before him as a grown man.


Theo, driven to despair by his master's death, had used sorcery to bring him back to life. He's beyond thrilled to see his master alive once again, but something seems strange about him...


Love knows no bounds when it comes to this obsessive, lovesick pupil and his beloved master!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: One Day a Gangster
mangas.description:
Top tier gangster! Top tier Alpha! Baek Pil-Seung. A foolish gangster who can't resist anything cute?! He fell for the prickly Maltese Nam Woo-Yoon, who is clueless about the ways of the world. Woo-Yoon, an Omega without a proper registration, learns that his only brother has died and goes to find him, but his life takes a drastic turn when he meets the gangster Baek Pil-Seung.

"I've never seen anyone who looks like you before. You're stuck in my head and it's driving me crazy, what the fuck do I do?"

"......"

"Fucking hell. Fuck me. I'm such a pushover."

"......"

"I'll protect you. I'll find your brother."

"......"

"Let's date."

Can the pushover gangster Pil-Seung win over the prickly Woo-Yoon, who's as difficult as a Maltese?

mangas.title: Lovesick and Tired
mangas.synonyms: Worn Out Love | A Worn and Torn Romance
mangas.description: Seo-Woon is an omega left jaded after countless failed romances. Enter Yi-Jn: an alpha with the face of a model and the personality of a robot. What starts with an instant marriage proposal due to Yi-Jin's desire for efficiency, soon becomes something more. Can this unlikely pair find true love?

mangas.title: Mermaid's Egg
mangas.description:
A rich dandy ended up alone on a deserted island and brought a merman back to life accidentally. The merman is no ordinary but the High Priest of the Deserted Isle Tribe! The arrogant boy, somehow, was trapped on the island and forced to hatch eggs... "I have my self-esteem!" "Ancient tribes are horrible... I have no choice but to trust Mr. Merman with my life..."



(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: The Beast Brings Forth The Spring To Melt The White Snow
mangas.titleNative: 春呼ぶけものは白を溶かす
mangas.synonyms: The beast calls spring melts white
mangas.description:
Shirota lives in a village that is stuck in an eternal winter. One day, he meets an injured beastman, Haiji, and the three children he has along with him. According to the laws of the village, Shirota isn't supposed to approach any beastmen or go anywhere near them, but he can't bring himself to abandon someone who's hurt. So, he invites them to stay with him until Haiji's injuries are healed.

The three beast-children are very cute, while Haiji seems like a kind gentleman. The time the four of them spend together brings them comfort, with delicious food, a cozy home, and more.

Although Haiji is planning to leave one day and go far away, Shirota feels more and more like he wants to do anything to stop him...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: I, a kept man, am the pet of two high-spec men!
mangas.titleNative: ヒモの俺、スパダリふたりに飼われます!
mangas.synonyms: 身為小白臉的我，被兩位極品帥哥豢養！
mangas.description:
Yusuke, who lives as a kept man, suddenly loses his home one day! When he goes to a bar to drown his sorrows, he ends up being caught by debt collectors. To make matters worse, he's injected with an aphrodisiac...?! In this desperate situation, two attractive individuals, the handsome Kaito and the beautiful Haruomi, appear. Yusuke, whose uncontrollable lust doesn't stop due to the aphrodisiac, is taken home by the two of them, and... "Don't look away from me while we're having sex." "Yusuke, you like having your ass messed up, don't you?" Monopolizing the infatuation of 2 high-spec men. The pampered pet Yusuke's overly naughty threesome cohabitation life!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: The Boy Who Grew Up Too Much to My Liking
mangas.titleNative: オレ好みに育ちすぎました。
mangas.description:
After being rejected by a colleague he had feelings for, Shu decided to move for a change of pace and to heal his broken heart. While introducing himself to his new neighbors, he encountered a young boy named Nazuna, disheveled and dressed in old, dirty clothes. Unable to leave the boy in such a state, Shu took it upon himself to care for and watch over Nazuna for the next 10 years. The once brash and conceited boy grew into a dashing young man—everything Shu could ever want in a partner. Yet, because Shu had become a fatherly figure to him, he continued to see Nazuna as the sweet, cute child he once was—or so he thought... "You were my everything," Nazuna confessed! Unable to resist, Shu's decade-long love for Nazuna poured out...



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: The Feisty Omega and His Twin Mates
mangas.titleNative: つよがりオメガは僕らの番
mangas.description:
Takahina Natsuo is an omega who has lived a life pretending to be a beta to protect himself from the predatory alphas around him. Despite his precautions, Natsuo suddenly goes into heat on his way to a job interview and is nearly attacked! Thankfully, a pair of elite alpha twins, Yuya and Tomoya, manage to save him in the nick of time. However, instead of feeling at ease, Natsuo can't resist the intense attraction he feels around these two brothers–which means that he's found his fated mate! Problem is…which one of them is it?!



A sexy BL omegaverse romp where a reluctant omega learns that two lovers are better than one!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Taking Him Back To That Night
mangas.description:
A mobster who never smiles and a cheerful nightclub host live together for a week!



Kotaro's a friendly, positive nightclub host with good looks. One day, a customer disappears after coming to his club, and a scary man locks Kotaro up as a result!! Kaoru, his guard, takes his virginity in a bid to force him to confess where the missing woman has gone. Despite his sullen poker face, Kaoru's a real stud, threatening Kotaro with more unbearable pleasure if he doesn't talk the next day. Worse, Kotaro's happy life will surely end when Kaoru's boss returns from a trip in a week... And he's desperate to get away before then!!



(Source: Renta!)



Notes:

- During serialization, Chapters 5 and 6 were split into two parts, while Chapter 7 was split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume release.

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Lips
mangas.description:
Taekseung is too busy getting through each day to think about the debris lodged in his skull, ready to kill him someday. He has no regrets, but he still wants to experience a happiness that will make him want to fight for his life. Enter Sunyeon, Taekseung's high school crush. Mishaps and miscommunication kickstart their casual, confusing relationship, but still--Taekseung is starting to feel like it's something…more.

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes 39 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kneel Before Me, Hero!!
mangas.titleNative: 勇者よ僕に跪いて媚びるがいいッ！
mangas.description:
Crown Prince Urban Dennish of Rosefillia is blessed with both good looks and wit, and the knowledge that he has been reincarnated inside a computer game. He invites himself to visit Kyle, the prospective hero, to help him level up before the Demon Lord is resurrected one year from now. Seeing how busy Kyle is and realizing he doesn't have the time to raise his level, Urban offers to help out with the housework, and one thing soon leads to another...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Rainbow Donut
mangas.description:
Lee In-Woo will do anything for his family - no matter the consequences. After learning about a potential plot to leak sensitive information, In-Woo travels back to Korea to track his brother's last known location. His search leads him to Dr. Kang Do-Woon, a doctor with connections In-Woo is dying to get his hands on. But, as the two grow closer, both of them fall deeper and deeper into a tangled web of deceit and mystery that neither of them could have anticipated... Chasing this rainbow is bound to lead to something much less pleasant than a pot of gold.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Reiguu Muko Life wo Mankitsu Shiyou to Shitara, Dekiai Route ni Hairimashita!?
mangas.titleNative: 冷遇婿ライフを満喫しようとしたら、溺愛ルートに入りました!?
mangas.synonyms: When I tried to enjoy the life of a neglected husband, I ended up taking the route of affection!?

mangas.title: Changed: The Beta Count
mangas.description: Eleanor, a beta nobleman, finally weds his beloved Fenrir—but his joy is short-lived. Unable to bear children, he becomes a source of shame to the family and, overcome with despair, throws himself from a window. But instead of death, he wakes up as an omega… on the morning of his wedding day. With no idea how or why he's turned back time—or changed sexes—Eleanor must navigate a new reality where his body, instincts, and even his relationship with Fenrir are shifting. As if that weren't enough, three powerful alphas begin circling him with growing interest. In this second life, will Eleanor protect his love… or be swept into an entirely new destiny?

mangas.title: 2nd Virgin no Jouzuna Sutekata
mangas.titleNative: 2ndバージンのじょうずな捨て方
mangas.synonyms: How To Skillfully Lose Your 2nd Virginity
mangas.description: Chiaki ended up being called a dead fish after his first time having sex with his boyfriend didn't go so well. Afterward, he ended up drunkenly calling a gay AV company to apply as a gay actor, and the perfect guy he meets there is...?!

mangas.title: My Cute Teacher
mangas.description:
Middle school English teacher Mr. Miyata is bummed at the idea of having to supervise the kendo club from spring, all because he's bad at getting along with sporty types. At first, he also thinks that Mr. Samehara, the affiliated high school's P.E. teacher in charge of coaching the kendo club, will be a meathead, too. But, he begins to feel that there might be something going on behind his fleeting, fake smile. Unable to resist the urge to find out what he's hiding, Mr. Miyata takes a leap of faith and...



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: No Moral
mangas.synonyms: ノーモラル～弁護士の掟～
mangas.description:
I'll see you in court... I hope!



Yun-Shin Do is a young and compassionate lawyer who gets recruited by a corporate law firm. His boss, Se-Heon Kang, is a domineering partner who prioritizes paychecks and only looks out for himself. Will Yun-Shin be able to prove his worth in court and find a way to melt his boss's ice-cold heart?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Arima Wants To Be An Omega
mangas.titleNative: 有馬さんはオメガになりたい
mangas.description:
Arima Nijo's an alpha working at a top-ranking company. Ever since he was in middle school, though, he's only been able to fall in love with other alphas. Now, he disguises himself as an omega and works as an escort at night. Even if only for a few moments, pretending to be an omega fulfills him...



One day, after a client cancels on Arima at the last minute, he meets Koki Izumi, a man whose appearance is just his type. Izumi's a college student who's also a famous entrepreneur, and while he can be pretty arrogant, he's great in bed. Even though it was a one-night stand, Izumi was Arima's ideal alpha. Three years later, Arima reunites with Izumi and introduces him to... their son, Ayumu! Due to Arima's unique biology, he is able to give birth, and he wants Izumi to take responsibility...

mangas.title: When Holding Out Leads to a Night of Temptations
mangas.titleNative: おあずけは、悪い夜の合図
mangas.description:
A straight-laced student gets caught up in the kind and overwhelming love of an older, cunning student. University student Makoto is currently his boyfriend, Ryohei. They did it all the time when they first started dating, but Ryohei suddenly won't even touch him. One night, he went out with Ryohei's friend, Yuki, when Makoto woke up after a night of drinking--he was getting spooned by Yuki! His sweet words resonated with his frustrated, pent-up body...

"Would you like me to help you relieve some of your build-up...?"



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Hazureta Kubiwa wo Suteru Toki
mangas.titleNative: 外れた首輪を捨てるとき

mangas.title: Isekai de Aisare Sugite Komattemasu!: Isekai BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 異世界で愛されすぎて困ってます！ 異世界BLアンソロジー
mangas.description:
Despite being a misanthropic mage!?? Despite being the best friend of the fallen prince!?? Despite being the villainous son!?? To be adored by the cheat protagonist in another world! The popular BL novel from 'Moonlight Novels' is now in comic form! An otherworldly BL anthology!!


(Source: Futabasha, translated)



Volume 1 (2024-03-08)

Cover Illustration: Potato Yamamori

1. Inkya na Madoushi wa, Heiwa na Sekai de Seikishi ni Dekiai Sareru (陰キャな魔導士は、平和な世界で聖騎士に溺愛される) [Potato Yamamori x Roku Eien]

2. Yamiochi Ouji no Shinyuu ni Tensei Shite Shimaimashita (闇堕ち王子の親友に転生してしまいました) [Korotora x Machibari]

3. Inu ni Tensei Shita kedo Kyou mo Genki desu (犬に転生したけど今日も元気です) [Mochita x Hakidame]

4. Sono Akuyaku Reisoku wa, Nanto Shite mo Ouji to Konyaku Shitakatta dake na no desu. Tada sore dakedatta no desu. (その悪役令息は、なんとしても王子と婚約したかっただけなのです。ただそれだけだったのです。) [Bando x Tentsubu]
