mangas.title: Itsuka no True End
mangas.titleNative: いつかのトゥルーエンド
mangas.description:
"Marry me!"

A world where the war between humans and demons has continued for hundreds or years... The hero was summoned from Earth to be humanity's ace in the hole. Aoi Yamato was a regular university student, but he led them to a sweeping victory and ended the war. However, the softhearted Yamato did not eradicate the demons, declaring that "the hero and the demon lord shall marry" as proof of peace.

Fast forward to a year after their marriage... hero Yamato and demon lord Rei are enjoying a lovey-dovey, newlywed life. Yamato is madly in love with his gorgeous and devoted Rei... while the serious Rei tries his damndest to be a good wife in all capacities.

mangas.title: He Calls Me Every Night
mangas.description:
Sumito Tokitsu moves to the countryside to live with his grandma following his parents' divorce. The story of the Crow Demon has been passed down through generations in this village, and Sumito used to dream about it when he was a child. Waiting for his first day at his new school, a strange shadow starts appearing in the night and touching him. Before long, he finds himself longing for the touch of the mysterious figure. Suddenly, a boy named Gaku Kurama appears at school and tells Sumito they are destined to be together!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My "Toy" is Connected to My Best Friend
mangas.titleNative: 俺のオモチャは親友につながっている
mangas.synonyms: Ore no Omocha wa Shinyuu ni Tsunagatteiru
mangas.description: Jin is the heir to his family's shrine, but he is secretly in love with his childhood friend Misaki. Refusing to admit his true feelings, has led his dreaming mind to wander. To help him let out his pent up energy, a senior club member leds him a toy from his collection. Jin releases his lust for Misaki with the toy everyday, but there's more than meets the eye to his new toy. It moves and feels as if it were real! What's more, by some miracle or curse, it's connected to Misaki! As Jin ravages the toy relentlessly, Misaki is sexually tormented! What will happen with this "miracle" toy? Can it truly connect more than just their bodies?

mangas.title: Boss in My House
mangas.description: Eito, nicknamed "Hawkeye," is an elite secret police officer known for his flawless execution of every mission. However, beneath his professional demeanor, he is a new father struggling with the fact that his young son, Tsubasa, doesn't seem to miss him when he comes home. Despite this, Eito cherishes his life with his loving wife, Yui, and their son. Just as he's beginning to balance his high-stakes career with family life, he learns that someone is targeting not only him but also his beloved family...

mangas.title: Papa x Papa: an Alpha and Omega's Happily Married Life
mangas.titleNative: パパ×パパ~αとΩで夫夫やってます~
mangas.synonyms: Papa x Papa: Alpha to Omega de Sorezore Yattemasu
mangas.description:
Kousuke may be an omega, but he's a tough, blue-collar worker. He lives with his mate Haruka, a gentle alpha who works as a writer and stays home to care for their family, Kousuke and their two children, Marin and Yosuke. Being an omega, juggling work, housework, and parenting... life isn't always easy or fair. Even so, their days are filled with joy and warmth because Haruka, his one and only mate, showers him with endless love every single day.



(Source: Kadokawa)

mangas.title: Turning
mangas.description:
"I thought I had lost my future forever... But the moment I realized that it had returned to me, my hands trembled with both joy and wonder."

Yudrein Ail is a commoner who was bestowed with powers on the night the Red Stone fell. He is also the first omega to rise to the rank of Imperial Trooper, but was accused of a crime he didn't commit and executed soon after - only to reawaken eleven years ago, before the war began. He can't repeat the mistakes of his past…to survive is to save the world. But in order to do so, he must prevent the man he killed from facing his inevitable death.

"The future won't be the same. I'll make sure of it."

mangas.title: Love Me Gently After a Bath
mangas.titleNative: 風呂上がりにやさしく愛して
mangas.description:
The kiss with the guy of his dreams tasted like coffee milk... Sora is a university student who helps out at his family bathhouse, and there was a regular customer who he found himself interested in. That customer comes every Monday night, and Sora couldn't help but follow his every movement with his eyes. One day, Sora spots him warning male customers who were acting suspiciously in the bathing area...

(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Wakarete Yaranai!
mangas.description:
Watase Akira, a high school student, notices that his classmate Watari Fumiya, who sits behind him, is extremely popular with the girls. Out of curiosity, or perhaps even as a joke, Akira decides to try and date Fumiya, thinking it might serve as good camouflage for Fumiya, but turns out...!?


(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: New World Lovetopia Memento

mangas.description:
Once upon a time there was a "great portal" between the other world and the human world, through which various otherworldly creatures came into the human world through the one-way portal. They began to live peacefully with humans. The tribe of angels, unable to return to their original home, keeps searching for a way to open a "return portal," and they find the key is related to a certain young man…?



(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

mangas.title: I Can't Run Away From My Brother-In-Law! I Just Lost My Virginity

Kohaku, a college student who celebrated his 20th birthday while still a virgin, suddenly lost his part-time job and a place to live in one day...!! ! He was in trouble and didn't know what to do, but then, his brother-in-law, Ten, showed up and let him live with him from now on! Kohaku fell asleep on his luxurious, fluffy bed... but when he woke up, for some reason, Ten was putting his hot and big dick in his butt!? "You don't need to jerk off by yourself. mangas.title: Ningyo to Ouji to Usotsuki Akuma

Merol is a beautiful mermaid prince known for his enchanting singing voice. His best friend is Krato, a flapjack octopus who is unfairly labeled as a "devil" by the sea residents.

One day, Merol rescues Will, a human prince cast out to sea, leading to a fateful encounter that changes everything. Despite Krato's warnings about the dangers of befriending humans, Merol's heart refuses to listen, and he finds himself falling deeply in love with Will..?

mangas.title: Pittosporum

Jun-Won is a perfectly ordinary office worker who values routine and predictability above all else. Because of this, he finds himself constantly aggravated by Yi-Jae, a fellow colleague who joined the company at the exact same time. From their work ethics to their basic personalities, Yi-Jae is the complete polar opposite of Jun-Won, making his very presence a daily source of intense frustration.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: My Fave Looks So Precious
mangas.description:
What would happen if two celebrities with major crushes on each other met up...!? This is a super sweet love story between a popular model and a trending live streamer! Natsuhiko's a live streamer who makes horror content and has a total crush on a particular idol. That idol is Yukiharu, a handsome male model who's popular for his mysterious image. Natsuhiko's enjoying a life centered on his work and idol crush, but one day, during a shoot at an abandoned house, it turns out that's where Yukiharu actually lives! Also, Yukiharu says he's also a fan of Natsuhiko and they end up exchanging numbers. Both of them have crushes on each other, but they have to deal with their urgent desires to hook up while also being afraid of appearing too eager......!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Bacio Dolci: Lips Sweeter than Cream

He may be on the mature side, but he's still ripe for the picking, and someone wants a taste!

Chef Saejima runs his own Italian restaurant, and business is not exactly thriving, much to his dismay. Hoping to uncover the secret to his rival restaurant's success, he infiltrates their staff, but his spying is derailed by love at first sight - for Dante, the handsome and just-his-type head chef. Not that there's any way such a gorgeous guy would ever date plain old Saejima... Or so he thought until one night, alone with Dante after closing, he finds himself being passionately kissed, and it doesn't take long for Dante's hand to slide down between his legs! Hagino is like any normal college student. He goes to school, he goes drinking with friends... but everything changes when one day, his upperclassman from high school who was tragically caught in a terrible accident suddenly appears before his eyes. Enomoto, the self-proclaimed "angel" who suddenly showed up while his body is still in a coma, is Hagino's crush's close friend. But the shocking revelation from Enomoto sends Hagino reeling... Enomoto is here to kill his close friend, the very man he tried to protect when he got caught in that horrible accident.

"If I can take the life of my close friend in 49 days, then I can come back to life."

Thus begins their life together as Enomoto brazingly takes up Hagino's living space. Their days almost seem calm... even oddly fun. As the days tick down, Hagino begins to see a somewhat charming side to Enomoto, and just as his heart starts to waver, Enomoto steals a kiss from the sleeping Hagino. Will Hagino and Enomoto's relationship change and bloom within their limited time together...?

mangas.title: The Worst Time Loop Ever

Two men, one straight and one gay, are stuck in a time loop where the same day keeps on repeating. The carefree, handsome straight guy can't stand the loner gay guy, but... The only way for them to get out of the time loop is to make passionate love! Will they keep on repeating the same frustrating cycle, or cave in to their hidden desires?



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Koboreru Ambivalence
mangas.titleNative: こぼれるアンビバレンス

His partner for cleaning activities is Yuugo, a freshman who has been absent from school for some time. Wataru is taken aback by Yugo's cocky attitude, but he can't help but notice the resemblance between him and his childhood friend, and he starts taking care of him. But Yugo has a secret...?

mangas.title: Slow Morning
mangas.description:
A story about two people who had a crush on each other in high school, who meet again as adults.

When Dean, the captain of the swimming club, takes the podium during Pharm's university orientation, something unusual happens. Though the two have never met before, they're unable to hide the turmoil that suddenly wells up inside them as they can't help but feel that this isn't the first time they've laid eyes on each other. Perhaps the red thread of fate links them together from their past lives...


(Source: Yen Press)

Trying to help Hinata get it together on stage, Takaomi kisses him in front of all their fans during the live battle of the bands!

mangas.title: Clueless Dad Finds Love With His Housemate
mangas.titleNative: 未熟なパパはシェアハウスで恋を知る

Shiki Kagino is a 35-year-old bachelor who has no trouble finding company every night. After his sister suddenly loses her life in an accident, he takes in her little boy Kai for six months. Shiki's good at his job, but raising a child is a whole different matter. He moves into a shared house affiliated with a daycare where Natsume, an attractive young man who's an aspiring actor, is a resident. Shiki has always avoided getting too close to people, but upon getting to know Natsume, who's very sincere about his feelings and helps look after Kai, Shiki starts to learn what it's like to care for others.

This is a story about a sexy middle-aged guy and a 20-year-old aspiring actor falling in love and raising a kid together!

mangas.title: The Butterfly Awaits The Flower

I never thought I'd see you again...

Forget our twisted fate and tell me why you keep running away from me.

mangas.title: Mofutte Ii no wa Omae dake

Determined to defeat all canines, Shiro is a cute little white cat with a selfish attitude who's unwillingly picked up off the streets by Kuro's owner. Kuro is the large black dog who vows to protect Shiro, but one day after the two are all grown up, Shiro suddenly goes into heat!



(Source: Libre, translated)

mangas.title: Ikenie wo Otsutome wa,

Once every 10 years in Hikaru's dying town, a sacrifice is offered to the Dog God in exchange for the town's protection and prosperity. As the only young person left in the increasingly depopulated town, Hikaru decides to give himself to the Dog God as a sacrifice. There's only one catch: the Dog God is a tyrannical pervert who lives in a luxury high-rise apartment building in Tokyo!



Note: Includes an extra.

Professional bodyguard Riichi is employed to protect the son of the leader of a large conglomerate and takes his work incredibly seriously. Opening his home to the new employee, Riichi is taken aback by Tachibana's brashness... and his endless flirting! Just who is this mysterious new coworker and what's his problem?

Azumi, an apprentice bartender, has been training his body with just this thought in mind. Naguru once lived a rough life as the leader of a gang, getting into fights in order to protect his friends. When Hirao first met Naguru, he didn't know about the man's gang affiliation: all Hirao knew in that moment was that he wanted to spend the rest of his life with Naguru.

mangas.title: Toratsuki Kaichou, Teawase Negaimasu!!

So starts the odd relationships between two roomates, a rice god looking for a place, and a do-gooder high-school graduate!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Musunda Koi no Tsutaekata
mangas.description:
Happiness continues even if there is no thread of fate...



Kaoru, who can see the red thread of fate that ties people together, has no red thread of his own, which made him give up hope for finding true love.
However, when he meets Hara, he begins to wish he could be with him forever...
They choose a future where they will be happy together, and a new life together begins, but what happens after that?



(Source: drap comics, translated)

mangas.title: Sleep Tight, My Sweet Mashiro
mangas.titleNative: おやすみ、またね。ましろくん。
mangas.description:
Insomniac Mashiro is an introvert who keeps to himself in class.

But, one day, his outgoing classmate Rihito talks to him out of the blue, and his life begins to change...

When Mashiro tells Rihito he suffers from insomnia, Rihito offers to help tuck him in bed at the nurse's office!

Mashiro's amazed at Rihito's kindness, but fails to see the real reason Rihito treats him so well...



This is a soul-healing adolescent love story between an outgoing and popular (but glum) hottie and a cute (and innocent) insomniac



(Source: Renta!)



Note: The original serialization ran for six chapters until 2022-04-19. The serialization was restarted on 2023-04-20.

mangas.title: Double Step Father
mangas.titleNative: ダブルステップファザー
mangas.description: "Say hello to our new son!" Ryo Miyano is an architect and a wonderful cook. He likes kids and wants to be married, yet (for his own reasons) is still single in his thirties. One day, his closest friend, Taiga, comes to ask for help when his apartment is now ruined after a fire. Now, the two of them will live together alongside Taiga's nephew, Ritsu, that he's only recently taken custody of. But Ryo gets more than what he bargained for since his new housemate has harbored feelings for him since they were in college. Now he can't even go a day without being drowned in Taiga's advances! A sweet love-comedy about a man and his best friend/secret admirer dipping their toes into fatherhood.

mangas.title: You're Definitely The Cuter One
mangas.titleNative: 絶対！お前のほうがかわいいくせに
mangas.description:
The non-stop lovey-dovey days of two old friends who fell in love!



Seiji and Kazuki became "lovers" just so they could both lose their innocence, but Seiji's long-time crush finally comes to fruition and they actually become a real couple! Since they'd been roommates for many years, their daily routine hasn't changed, but by going out on dates and meeting each other's families, they create many precious memories...



This is the long-awaited continuation of the "You Know You're Cuter!" series, which is a love story between two working guys―one who's hopelessly in love and the other who's super oblivious!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Oboreru Kiss ni Yowasarete
mangas.titleNative: 溺れるキスに酔わされて
mangas.description:
Yota Inaba is a new employee at an sex-toy company, and his biggest problem is that he can't get results at work.

One day, at a company party, he learned that his boss, Shiba, is a kisser when drunk, and when Yota found himself on the receiving end of a deep kiss, he couldn't help but get an erection!
He rusheed to the bathroom to take care of it, but Shiba caught up to him and said, "Don't be afraid to touch me..." and started playing with him...?



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)



Note: Includes chapter 7.5.

mangas.title: Wakeari Omega wa Nige no Itte
mangas.titleNative: ワケありオメガは逃げの一手
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Shin (alpha) and Mahiro (omega) had a one-night stand when Mahiro went into heat. After that, Mahiro abruptly left university and disappeared. A few years later, the two met again by chance, and Shin mistook Mahiro for a prostitute. Shin told Mahiro, "I'll be your exclusive customer from now on." Mahiro couldn't refuse out of love for Shin, and they indulged in lustful urges, until Mahiro received an urgent phone call. Shin helped to take the upset Mahiro to a nursery school, where he found a toddler who looked just like him...!



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: Omega of the Divine
mangas.synonyms: kind winter sun and smiling blossom
mangas.description:
In lands barren and bare, tradition called for villagers to offer a bride to the cruel sun god… Here enters our bride: Luca, the gentle son of the late village chief, who is one day struck with fevers, fainting spells, and something more. The villagers understand this as a sign, and the young man, his fear held within his mortal heart, understands it as his assignment. He is to be given over to a ravenous god, who in turn, shall bring bountiful harvests to his neighbors. The one Luca encounters, however, may be far warmer, far more precious than the legends foretold, if only fate would steer them from tragedy…


(Source: Kodansha USA)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: 6 to 7
mangas.description: Childhood friends Rokuto and Nanami are boyfriends. To Rokuto, Nanami can be stoic, yet spoils him with his affection. Yet, there are times where Nanami comes off as weirdly disconnected at times that there may possibly be...?

mangas.title: Sosoida Koi ga Michitara Ai
mangas.titleNative: 注いだ恋が満ちたら愛
mangas.description: Hibiki Kitami, a university student who works part-time at Café Futaba. He works diligently and sincerely every day with the goal of taking over the coffee shop run by his grandparents in the future. One day, Ryosuke Fujinami arrives at 'Futaba' as a new part-time worker. Fujinami, a junior from the same university, quickly fits in with his innate cheerfulness, but Kitami, who is too serious, remains out of place no matter how much time passes. However, Fujinami becomes unusually attached to Kitami as well.

mangas.title: Nagahama to Be, or Not to Be
mangas.titleNative: 長浜To Be, or Not To Be
mangas.description:
Nagisa may look like a delinquent, but he's just a typical teen trying to figure out what to do with his life. Nagisa's best friend, Issa, already knows what his own passion is: fish! Issa often skips school to work at the Nagahama fish market, and the two boys hang out near the ocean almost every day. When Nagisa suspects that Issa has a girlfriend, it turns his world upside down. Is he in love with his best friend? Could his best friend possibly like him back?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: The original serialization ran for five chapters until 2023-09-29. It was then restarted on 2025-01-30.

mangas.title: My Erotic Streamings have been Exposed and I'm being Fucked by My Boss!
mangas.titleNative: 俺のエロ配信がバレて上司にハメられてます！
mangas.description:
Tomokawa, assigned to an agency sales department, is constantly yelled at by his demon boss... In order to de-stress, he streams live "Solo Sex." He hasn't told anyone about his hobby but when he gets praised for his messy appearance, he just can't stop...! Takada calls out to him one day showing him his own explicit account asking, "is this you?" His long fingers urgently stir his insides deep until it becomes sticky mess, telling him, "you seemed to like it here in your streams, right?"



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: Koi ni Naru ni wa Yayakoshii
mangas.titleNative: 恋になるにはややこしい
mangas.synonyms: It's Complicated to Fall in Love
mangas.description:
The most popular guy at school has his heart set on someone...and it's me?!



On the behalf of his twin sister, Tsuzumi, Chikage asks Issei out, a popular honor student at his school. Not wanting Issei to date his sister, he approaches him hoping to get rejected. To his shock and dismay, Issei accepts the confession! Furious, Chikage plays along and the two start going out—all while pretending to be Tsuzumi. As their relationship progresses, Chikage learns more about the unexpected sides of Issei, and little by little, he begins to let his guard down around him. Then one day, Chikage discovers the truth behind his confession...!



(Source: Leed, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kitayama and Minamiya
mangas.description: Minamiya has a strange talent. Just by looking at someone, he can imagine what they'd look like when they're super turned on. In fact, he can't really stop. However, there's one exception—for some reason, he can't picture what his cute male coworker, Kitayama, would look like in the throes of passion. Unable to get these thoughts out of his head, a misunderstanding leads to the two men going out. But can the frisky Minamiya handle the real deal?

mangas.title: No Arguing With Mr. Mo
mangas.description:
Xiao Nuo, better known as Secretary Xiao, is the dedicated and hardworking secretary of Mo Yanchuan. Mo Yanchuan, better known as President Mo, is the cold and aloof president and heir of Mo Electronics Group.



Constantly being scrutinized and nitpicked at, Secetary Xiao is convinced that President Mo hates his guts. Little does he know, however, that President Mo's feelings towards him are not what he thinks they are at all. In fact, they may be even more than he lets on...



(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: Three Exorcism Siblings
mangas.description:
Cursed to stand alone against monstrous creatures called Tengu, Mamoru Yamaemori is ready to sacrifice everything if it means keeping his younger brothers safe.



In the mountains above Japan, Mamoru Yamaemori spends his days tending to his family shrine, fighting Tengu— monsters who feast on human flesh—and, making sure his two younger brothers will never have to pick up his mantle. Unable to escape the life forced upon him by his parents and a dark ritual involving Tengu blood, all he knows is that his existence is a curse: he is destined to die young in the service of others.



But to fight monsters, Mamoru must dance that line between loving older brother and mindless beast – or else he risks becoming that which he is sworn to destroy.



(Source: Titan Manga)

mangas.title: Ore no Kareshi ga Ichiban Kawaii
mangas.titleNative: 俺のカレシがいちばんかわいい
mangas.description:
Mahiro, a 2nd year high school student, has loved his childhood friend Kaoru ever since they were children. Yet Kaoru enrolled into the most dangerous delinquent high school in their hometown, dubbed "Scum High"! Recently he's been dyeing his hair, befriending delinquents, and even getting his ears pierced... Mahiro, feeling uneasy, impulsively confesses his feelings!



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Garment!
mangas.description: A subordinate who’s like an insolent dog x a helpful, virtuous superior. Love between salary men in the clothing industry.

mangas.title: I Need to Suck Blood Tonight
mangas.titleNative: 夜分に吸血失礼します。
mangas.synonyms: I need to suck blood tonight.
mangas.description:
Minoru Sayo is an office worker who lives an upright but mundane life. That is, until one day, he turns into a vampire.

Unable to forgo his scruples, he refuses to feed on humans and attempts to soothe his thirst with cat blood. On one such night when he's out prowling for a feline friend, he runs into his coworker in the same department, Yamadera. After a few drinks at a bar, Yamadera falls asleep at the station leaving his vexing neck exposed and vulnerable. Overcome with annoyance and hunger, Sayo takes a bite and discovers...? Will Sayo find a way to become human again? And what really lies behind Yamadera's sweet mask? Take a read and find out in this emotional and twisted tale between a 40-year-old virgin and his sadistic junior colleague!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Tsumasaki no Ajisai
mangas.description:
"I want to be the place you come home to."



Ao and Sou live together in a house a little ways removed from the city. Ao is far too kind for his own good and always gets the raw end of the deal, which frustrates Sou to no end. Despite all this, they eat together and passionately connect their bodies, and soon the days they spend together grow into something so precious that they are afraid of losing it.



See their personal happiness shine bright in this charming daily life shared by two clumsy people.



(Source: Shodensha, translated)



Note: Originally published as a one-shot in onBLUE Vol. 54, it was then picked up for serialization.

mangas.title: My Classmate Ren-kun is Kinda Scary
mangas.titleNative: 隣の蓮君はちょっと怖い
mangas.description:
The aggressive Ren and serious Tadaomi have been inseparable since elementary school. And even though Ren is kinda scary, he instantly melts when he's with Tadaomi. Everyone around them knows what's up...except for the two of them! ♡



(Source: Animate International)



Notes:

- Originally published on Twitter and Pixiv.

- Includes 14 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Oni to Tengoku: Kyuu
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Morishita-kun wa Arimatsu-san ni Muchuu desu
mangas.titleNative: 森下くんは有松さんに夢中です
mangas.description:
College student, Morishita, discovers a high-paying part-time job nearby and eagerly applies. At the café, known for its exquisite coffee and friendly staff, the only employee, Arimatsu is a challenging person. Feeling competitive, Morishita vows to excel in his job. However, as Morishita becomes captivated by Arimatsu's coffee-making skills, an unforgettable sight leaves a lingering impression. Is there a hint of romance between the carefree handsome college student and the cool, strict employee?



(Source: Media Factory, translated)

mangas.title: All About My Two Dads
mangas.titleNative: ぼくのパパとパパの話
mangas.synonyms: The Story of Me, Daddy, and Daddy
mangas.description: Meet Nao and Ai, a couple that has been dating since their university days. The legalization of same-sex marriage spurs them into taking the next step and formalizing their union, along with adopting Hiro, a newborn baby boy. See how these two polar opposites handle sleepless nights, sending Hiro off to his first day of preschool, and managing relationships with other parents. They may even find that being a parent to Hiro teaches them more about themselves than they could have ever imagined...

mangas.title: The BL Editorial Department Dreams at Midnight
mangas.titleNative: 真夜中のBL編集部は夢を見る
mangas.description:
Mashima, a new BL editor, suddenly finds himself in a BL world? In a dream? In order to escape, he ends up having xxx with his boss, Shiba...!



Since returning to the real world, Mashima has been strangely conscious of Shiba, who is good at his job but a bit of a pain in the ass, and he is so nervous that nothing seems to be going right... On top of that, he even got drunk and stayed over at Shiba's house!!



One day, Mashima is assigned to be in charge of a new male BL artist, Megusuri sensei, who comes to bring in his work. But it turns out that Megusuri sensei is a talented artist who "can't draw by himself"!



(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

mangas.title: Sugar Glaze Darling
mangas.titleNative: シュガーグレイズダーリン
mangas.description:
Keiichiro, who is actually the object of Reo's unrequited love, mistakes Reo for a girl and confesses to him. When Keiichiro admits to being bad at dealing with girls, Reo suggests that Keiichiro practice with him, while thinking of him as a girl... An impatient, fiery love story, as sweet as sugar, between a devilish, pampered boy and a straight-laced, super sweetheart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Tabete mo Oishiku Arimasen
mangas.titleNative: 食べてもおいしくありません
mangas.description: A world where demons prevail and humans are rare. Hiyori, a human, is considered to be delicious to demons. However, his classmate, Hodaka, a pushy big-horned demon, found out his secret. On top of that, he kissed and tasted him…Charming a demon---a troublesome situation?! Surrendering to one's instinct and pleasure leads to…

mangas.title: Neko ni Naritai Tamagawa-kun
mangas.titleNative: 猫になりたい田万川くん
mangas.description:
For Tamagawa, volunteering at a cat café is the only relief from his stressful job. The manager tells him to, "relax and learn to be spoiled", but he doesn't know what that means until a new customer, Shindo Rai, comes to the café and tells Tamagawa he wants to keep him as a cat! Enter their strange, but fateful relationship. A pure-hearted and soothing romantic comedy.



(Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Scary and Tough Otoguro, in Love?!
mangas.titleNative: 俺らの乙黒さんが恋愛なんかするわけない！
mangas.description:
"We're against any attempts at Otoguro finding love!!"

The over-the-top Highschool boys' comedy begins!

mangas.title: Inkya na Boku ga Futago ni Aisareru Wake
mangas.titleNative: 陰キャな僕が双子に愛される理由
mangas.description: Hikaru is a BL otaku who has a complex about the color of his eyes. He was childhood friends with popular twins Nagi and Arashi, up until middle school when they started ignoring him! Hikaru is hurt because he doesn't understand why, but one day in high school he gets pushed down by the twins?!

mangas.title: So We're Getting Married
mangas.description:
Twenty-one-year-old waiter Ron has always dreamed of reclaiming the family home he once shared with his late mother. Working tirelessly on a cruise ship, he quietly saves money, completely focused on his goal. However, his tranquil life is disrupted when Charles, the charming heir to the business empire that owns the cruise line, unexpectedly proposes a contractual marriage. Although surprised, the reserved Ron politely declines—he yearns for a genuine, loving relationship rather than an arranged one. Undeterred, the wealthy heir decides to board the cruise himself, determined to win Ron over with his charm within a week...



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Shiguang Dailiren
mangas.description:
In a certain corner of the city, there is a seemingly ordinary little shop — Shiguang Photo Studio. The shop's proprietors Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang can enter a photograph and explore its original time and space. One day, Lin Kai, a rising star in the traditional opera scene, came to the studio and asked Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to find a person in a picture from 10 years ago. There is only one photograph, and there will be only one chance…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Koisuru Idol Ryuusei-kun wa Kujikenai!
mangas.titleNative: 恋するアイドル流星くんはくじけない！
mangas.synonyms: Lovestruck Idol Ryusei-kun Won't Give Up!
mangas.description:
Ryusei, a handsome idol who is rapidly gaining popularity, has a crush on his childhood friend Daichi. However, Daichi is obsessed with the "idol Ryusei,'' and even when he approaches him, he doesn't turn around. On the other hand, Daichi also secretly has a crush on Ryusei, but he hides his romantic feelings for him and supports "everyone's idol Ryusei"...? A love story between a popular idol and a healthy childhood friend, with mutual unrequited love! ♡



(Source: Homesha, translated)

mangas.title: Inside Full Bloom
mangas.titleNative: インサイド フルブルーム
mangas.description:
Haunted by past trauma, Kana has kept his identity as a sexual minority hidden throughout his life. He's never told anyone and has been carrying the weight alone. But when his friend brings him to a college mixer, one of the people sitting among the girls was Keigo, a guy who casually reveals that he's gay. Their first meeting was a disaster. They couldn't have been more incompatible. But as they continue to encounter, connect with, and confront one another, they begin to realize emotions they have never felt before. Time, which had long been paused for these two uncertain young men, quietly starts to flow once more.



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles
mangas.synonyms: MASHLE ศึกโลกเวทมนตร์คนพลังกล้าม
mangas.description:
This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!



(Source: MANGA Plus)



Note:

- Eleventh place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

mangas.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
mangas.description:
Although Yuji Itadori looks like your average teenager, his immense physical strength is something to behold! Every sports club wants him to join, but Itadori would rather hang out with the school outcasts in the Occult Research Club. One day, the club manages to get their hands on a sealed cursed object. Little do they know the terror they'll unleash when they break the seal…



(Source: VIZ Media)



Notes:

- Ranked 1st in Japan's Bookstore Employees Top Manga of 2018.

- Nominated for the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2021.

- Nominated for the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2019.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: One Summer Day
mangas.description:
It's not every day you become a ghost. Han Seowoo thought he had it bad when the sunbae he liked rejected him. But on his way back home with a broken heart, he ends up slipping from the top of a building and plummeting…to his premature death. Then a surprisingly young grim reaper shows up to collect his soul. But luckily enough, the reaper messes things up…and Seowoo is given the chance to stay in the corporeal world for a bit longer. There's just one catch: the reaper is to move in with Seowoo and make sure he stays out of trouble and the lives of the living. Maybe that one summer day, death wasn't the only thing in store for Seowoo…



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: The Dragon's Betrothed
mangas.description:
Being called "Sensei" all the time and having to act worthy of it was too heavy a burden to bear, so I fled to my home town. But amidst the nostalgic scenery, a mysterious man appeared before me...

Rin, the water dragon god to whom Chiharu has been betrothed, can be disarmingly friendly and charming, but inside lurks an animalistic ferocity. Knowing that he can't escape Rin's protective embrace, can Chiharu make himself fall in love with the god instead?

mangas.title: There's Fanfiction About Us?
mangas.description:
It's the fifth anniversary of Rui Tachibana starting his career as a pop star. The girls love his younger bandmate, Hibiki Shinjo, because he's a man of few words and is very aloof, but he normally delights in bugging Rui. Their manager thinks it's sweet, like Hibiki's a little kid... Since Hibiki has a hard time getting up in the mornings, he sleeps over at Rui's one night before an early photoshoot. While Rui is taking a bath, Hibiki does an internet search for their names... even though they've been warned against doing just that. They find a very suspicious-looking, password-protected website, and they can't believe what they see!! In this fan-created manga, the two of them get up to such naughty things...! Rui's imagination starts running wild, and Hibiki makes a suggestion...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
mangas.titleNative: 異世界の沙汰は社畜次第
mangas.synonyms: The Affairs of the Other World Depend on the Corporate Slave
mangas.description:
Once upon a time, in the not too distant past, a holy maiden was summoned. Not just any holy maiden—one hailing from modern Japan. But this story is not her story. This is the tale of the humble accountant, Kondou, who accompanied her and his trials and woes as he accounts in a new world... But no tale is complete without a love interest. And who better to play that role than the handsome knight captain Aresh? Will he begin a personal quest to save said bean counter—who toils around the clock—or is Kondou doomed to be married to his work evermore...?!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Polaris at Dawn
mangas.description:
"You're a student!" "So what?"



During the school sports festival, Ayato Yura is mistaken for a girl and carried like a princess by the school's top playboy, Kousei Haga. Things escalate when Haga kisses him in front of everyone and learns Yura is actually a teacher! After school, Yura tries to discipline Haga, but he playfully keeps flirting. As Haga's feelings turn real, Yura's hot-and-cold attitude only fuels his desire to kiss him. Can their forbidden love ever become a reality?



(Source: MangaPlaza, edited)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Cat Lover
mangas.synonyms: I'll Work Hard as a Cat Today
mangas.description:
I'm a superstar in the making but somehow got turned into a cat. What's worse is that I fell into the hands of my nemesis! Being ignorant of the situation, he petted me, kissed me, and hugged me. Whatever. I'll forgive him for that. B-but it looks like he's after my body too! Despicable! Someone, please come and save me!!!


(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Breathless Momentum
mangas.titleNative: 息できないのは君のせい
mangas.synonyms: It's Your Fault I Can't Breathe
mangas.description:
Jun Shizuki and Yukiji Yano are both in the same woodwind choir. Shizuki is a bartender who plays the sax and hits on anything that moves. Yano is a gifted flute player who is incredibly nice and is well-regarded within the choir.

No one would ever suspect that these guys would have anything in common, but could these two polar opposites actually be in a relationship?!

mangas.title: Fudanshi no Ore ga Youkya Osananajimi ni Semarareteru Ken
mangas.titleNative: 腐男子の俺が陽キャ幼馴染に迫られてる件
mangas.synonyms: I'm a Fudanshi and My Childhood Friend is Coming Onto Me
mangas.description: Haruto, a shy, spoiled boy who loves BL, joined the manga research club that he had dreamed about when he entered university! The beginning of his new life with his new otaku friends…or so he thought. For some reason, his childhood friend, Yosuke, who doesn't even read manga, ended up joining the club as well. Haruto is tired of being teased by Yosuke all the time, but for some reason Yosuke seems to be just like his favorite BL character…?? Is it normal for an otaku to get excited about this even if they don't like it?!

mangas.title: Ron Kamonohashi: Deranged Detective
mangas.titleNative: 鴨乃橋ロンの禁断推理
mangas.synonyms: El misterio prohibido de Ron Kamonohashi
mangas.description:
This unusual duo brings the hidden truth into the light! Ron Kamonohashi, a private investigator with serious issues, and Totomaru Isshiki, a pure-hearted but dim police detective, team up to solve the most baffling mysteries! A thrilling detective story for a new generation from Akira Amano, creator of "Reborn!" and "Ēldlive"!



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: I Cannot Reach You
mangas.description:
No matter how much time we spend together, I'll never become special to you.



Childhood best friends. Two halves of a whole. The cool, smart one who's good at almost everything, and his average, dorky friend who struggles to do anything right­—Yamato and Kakeru. Always by the other's side, but not together in the way they truly want to be. No matter how hard they try, their hearts cannot reach each other…



(Source: Yen Press)


Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

mangas.title: Ripples in the River
mangas.description:
Tanba and Utagawa have been together for over ten years, but Uta still can't believe he's landed such a stud, and Tanba still gets blindsided when his young-at-heart boyfriend switches into adult mode. It's a non-stop whirlwind of love that sends both their hearts skipping!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Originally released as a web comic, the manga was published by Frontier Works on February 15, 2022.

mangas.title: I Want to Be a Big Baddie
mangas.synonyms: I Have To Be A Great Villain
mangas.description:
A true villain needs to be ruthless, evil, and self-destructive! After torturing the protagonist to hell and back, they will exit the scene fabulously with a bang as their work is done. Wang Yi was determined to act that kind of villain. Unfortunately… His male lead could read minds. (:з)∠*)

"You mongrel!" Mr. Yi chuckled as he looked down on the novel's male lead.

Suddenly, a thought bubble filled with cute emojis (⁄ ⁄ ⁄ω⁄ ⁄ ⁄) with the words "You're so cute…" appeared in front of Qin.

Qin: ?



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: My Lover Is Just Too Innocent to Handle
mangas.titleNative: 恋人がウブすぎて困る
mangas.description:
Hasegawa is a bit of a high school nobody. He's plain, quiet, and unassuming...so it's a huge shock when Hiyama, the sunny social butterfly of their class, suddenly confesses to him! But how do you date a classmate you've never even spoken to before? By starting a good old-fashioned diary exchange, of course! Entry by entry, two romance novices find a way to bridge the gap between them—and maybe even discover love along the way...



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ore wo Mamoru to Chikatteyo
mangas.titleNative: オレを守ると誓ってよ
mangas.description:
"Heartthrob idol Shiina Canan accidentally helps Masaomi Mouze; a man who collapsed in front of him. Mouze in a rush of gratefulness, kneels down and requests to "Return his gratitude". When Mouze's manly body and back tattoo caught Canan's eye, he offers Mouze to live with him as his bodyguard to return the favour. A dutiful sense of gratitude X A bitch hidden behind a heartthrob facade."



A dutiful sense of gratitude x A bitch hidden behind a heartthrob facade.

This is a dramatic story about two people with perfect physical attraction.

mangas.title: A Man Who Defies the World of BL
mangas.titleNative: 絶対BLになる世界VS絶対BLになりたくない男
mangas.synonyms: Zettai BL ni Naru Sekai VS Zettai BL ni Naritakunai Otoko
mangas.description: Our straight-as-an-arrow protagonist has figured out that he lives in a BL-manga world. So as a means of evading all the hotties after him for some of that sweet, sweet lovin', he studies every BL manga he can get his hands on to become a master of spotting their tropes. His evasive maneuvers prove effective…for now. But this is the world of boys' love!

mangas.title: Let's Eat Together, Aki and Haru
mangas.titleNative: アキはハルとごはんを食べたい
mangas.synonyms: Aki wants to eat with Haru
mangas.description:
Two boys who share a room and love to make and eat dinner together. Aki is in charge of cooking, and Haru is tasked with cleaning up, and despite their personality differences, they come together over their love of food.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ore no Aoharu wa Susumanai
mangas.titleNative: 俺のアオハルは進まない
mangas.description:
Subaru and Jinnai's first springtime bore fruit in the form of them becoming lovers! However, Jinnai hasn't tried doing anything further ever since they first touched each other at Subaru's house. Subaru now found himself worrying about this especially since the shoujo mangas that he makes his bible don't show anything beyond kissing between lovers...



Then one day, the two got into the hottest mood they've ever been in before but then Subaru, in his nervousness, bluntly said to Jinnai with a smile, "If it's you, I'm sure you can do it smoothly and well, right?"

mangas.title: Sokuseki Ad-Lib Lover Debut!
mangas.titleNative: 即席アドリブラバー Debut!
mangas.description:
A continuation of an unlikely comedy duo's love story! The sequel to "Instant Ad-Lib Lover.”

As their time at the training school runs out, Asahi decides to visit Minase's parent's house before their graduation ceremony. However, Minase and his father seem to be on bad terms...?

mangas.title: Turns Out My Online Friend is My Real-Life Boss!
mangas.titleNative: オンラインゲーム仲間とサシオフしたら職場の鬼上司が来た
mangas.synonyms: Arranged an Offline Meeting with My Online Game Friend, but My Demon Boss Came Instead
mangas.description: Hashimoto is your average office worker—young, and prone to being pushed around by his demon boss, Shirase. His only escape is his favorite online game, and the friends he's made within. But when he plans an office meetup for his party, he gets the surprise of his life...!

mangas.title: Sasaki and Miyano
mangas.description:
Miyano spends his days peacefully reading Boys' Love comics and worrying about how girly his face is-until a chance encounter leads to a scuffle with his senior Sasaki. Intrigued by his feisty junior Miyano, delinquent Sasaki uses every opportunity he can to get closer...

(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
mangas.titleNative: 30歳まで童貞だと魔法使いになれるらしい
mangas.synonyms: 30-sai made Doutei da to Mahou Tsukai ni nareru rashii
mangas.description: Adachi, a thirty-year-old virgin, has developed the power to read people's minds by touching them. After a brush with his very handsome colleague, Adachi realizes the guy has a raging crush on none other than Adachi himself!

mangas.title: My Happy Marriage
mangas.description:
A "Cinderella"-inspired slow-burn historical romance with a paranormal twist set in Meiji-era Japan!



A browbeaten and mistreated daughter is cast out of her family home and sent to audition as a bridal candidate for the heir to one of the most powerful families in the land…

Considered nigh worthless for having failed to inherit the superhuman powers of the bloodlines into which she was born, Miyo Saimori lives her days unwanted and unloved.

She is treated as a servant by her half-sister who, unlike Miyo, is blessed with unusual powers, while her step-mother and very own father have little time or love for their eldest daughter.

Ultimately seen as nothing more than a nuisance and a drain on the family wealth, Miyo is packed off to the Kudo house as a bridal candidate for its heir, Kyoka Kudo.
But whispers abound about the Kudo clan, the most powerful in all the land. Still, will the allegedly cold and cruel house into which Miyo aims to marry prove much warmer than the family she left behind?



(Source: Square Enix)



Eighth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category

mangas.title: Mask Danshi: This Shouldn't Lead to Love
mangas.titleNative: マスク男子は恋したくないのに
mangas.synonyms: หนุ่มใส่มาสก์ไม่ได้อยากมีรักสักหน่อย
mangas.description:
Sayama is a pessimistic guy who always wears a face mask to school. When the most popular boy in class, Saikawa, rips off the mask out of curiosity, Sayama flips out. Despite his harsh words, he's somehow captured Saikawa's interest, who offers to tutor him with a bizarre condition: to let him do as he pleases with what's under Sayama's mask. Sayama hates it when people touch his bare face, lips, and mouth, but he can't resist Saikawa's attention...



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: Neko ni wa Inu wo
mangas.synonyms: ネコにはいぬを ワンもあ
mangas.description:
After a night of drinking, Neko woke up to find another man sleeping naked next to him. His clothes were strewn about and there was a pile of used condoms in the trash. "White liquid stained the sheets but it can't be mine because...I can't get an erection, so there's no way I could ejaculate!"



Neko, a young man with a Kansai dialect suffering from ED, and Inukai, who helps him deal with it.



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
mangas.titleNative: 山田くんとLv999の恋をする
mangas.description: Recently dumped, Akane is just about to quit the game she used to play with her boyfriend, when she meets Yamada in the same RPG. Yamada in real life turns out to be somewhat of a legend. The only problem is - he is ONLY interested in the game. As Akane's feelings grow, will Yamada's focus stay on the game?

mangas.title: Hallelujah Baby
mangas.titleNative: ハレルヤベイビー
mangas.description: The successor of a yakuza family and his bodyguard who's head over heels in love with him — the only pacifist in the wild and violent Ousaki Group is its sucessor, Touka. His bodyguard-slash-friend, Miyako, has dedicated his entire being to protecting him, but it seems he's a tad bit overprotective…?

mangas.title: Skip and Loafer
mangas.titleNative: スキップとローファー
mangas.description: Excellent student Iwakura Mitsumi has always dreamt about leaving her small town, going to a prestigious university, and making positive change in the world. But she's so focused on reaching her goals that she's not prepared for the very different (and overwhelming) city life that awaits her in a Tokyo high school. Luckily, she makes fast friends with Shima Sousuke, a handsome classmate who's as laid-back as she is over-prepared. Can this naive country girl make it big in Tokyo with Sousuke by her side?

mangas.title: Nanbaka
mangas.description:
A super exciting action comedy starring the inmates and guards of the world's most formidable prison.



Note: The tankoubon version includes only the first part of the webcomic, with the final volume #8 released 2018-07-12.

mangas.title: Sunny Days With the Four Seasons Club
mangas.synonyms: A Warm Sunshine and The Four Seasons Club
mangas.description:
Haruno saw Ichise for the first time in front of his high school, looking at the cherry blossoms in full bloom. He was crying. What a weird guy, Haruno thought...but he was the new classmate, and his seat was next to Haruno. The next thing Haruno knew about him was that he loved Japanese way of enjoying the four seasons. He was a returnee from United States. Ichise started the Four Seasons Club, with only one member. Haruno couldn't take his eyes off from Ichise...and he almost accidentally agreed to be a member of the club. But Haruno didn't know that the words he used were misunderstood by Ichise, and they'd become boyfriends.



(Source: Kadokawa)

mangas.title: Minato's Laundromat
mangas.titleNative: みなと商事コインランドリー
mangas.description:
"Minato-san, I have a sex drive."



When Akira Minato inherits an old, run-down laundromat from his grandfather, he sees it as an opportunity to recover from his grueling corporate job and spend his days in laid-back leisure. But all that changes when a new customer comes knocking—one who's maybe a bit too good-looking. Despite their growing closer, Akira is determined not to let high school hottie Shintaro Katsuki find out he's gay...until a casual slip of the tongue gives away his secret.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Chobits
mangas.description: After moving from the countryside into the big city, poor college student Hideki Motosuwa finds himself down on his luck. All he wants is a good job, a girlfriend, and his very own "persocom" - the latest and greatest in humanoid computer technology. Hideki's luck changes one night when he finds Chi - an adorable, but seemingly broken, persocom thrown out in a pile of trash. After taking her home, Hideki discovers that Chi is more responsibility than he expected - and that there's much more to his cute new persocom than meets the eye.

mangas.title: Seaside Stranger: Harukaze no Étranger
mangas.description:
Shun and Mio connected on their small island near Okinawa, leading to a friendship and eventual romance. But Shun's quiet home by the seaside started with pain–he left his hometown after his parents disowned him for being gay. That inescapable fact still haunts him, especially now that his father is ill. Shun is ready to go back to Hokkaido to see his parents again, but this time, he has Mio by his side. Mio has complicated feelings about this himself, as he was devastated by the loss of his own parents and now might not be accepted by Shun's–what will this trip mean for him?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Kagerou Daze
mangas.description:
Shintarou Kisaragi, a NEET–person "Not in Education, Employment, or Training"–has refused to leave the comfort of his room for two whole years. But Shintarou's easy and solitary life is about to take an unexpected turn when his computer crashes and he is forced to venture into the world he was happy to shut out forever…and stumbles into the middle of a hostage situation!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Fate Has a Sweet Scent
mangas.synonyms: The Scent of Destiny is Sweet | Ummei wa Amaku Kaoru
mangas.description:
Subaru, half wolf and half human, is a freshman in university. When he is crouching down feeling sick, his classmate, Kyoya, helps him. Subaru smells a sweet and kind scent unlike anything he's ever smelled before from Kyoya... meaning Kyoya must be Subaru's fated mate! Subaru falls in love with Kyoya, who is kind to him despite him being overly shy. One day, when Subaru smells Kyoya up close, he gets hard... Upon noticing, Kyoya says "You don't mind me touching you, do you?" and they end up pleasuring each other.

A first love between a shy beastfolk and a popular university student that begins with a physical relationship!

mangas.title: Cuffed!
mangas.synonyms: The Dual Voices of Homosexuality | The Hetero-Vocal Homosexuality
mangas.description: Young-Soo has a secret. He hates frogs. No wait, actually his real secret is…that he's gay! But things are looking up because he's finally broken free from his parents' house and gotten a place of his own. There's just one issue. His new apartment actually came with a roommate, his childhood classmate, Eun-Sung! And not only did he get scammed into getting a place with an unexpected roommate, it's the kid who gave him frog trauma in the first place! On top of all this, Eun-Sung's a cop in a unit formed to crackdown on homosexuality. Plus, Young-Soo's longtime friend, Ji-Ho, can't help but give Eun-Sung the side-eye as well… Something's definitely gotta give and someone just might end up cuffed. It's just a matter of whether that's a good thing or a bad thing...

mangas.title: It's Me, the Crazy Side Top
mangas.description:
Everybody knows Yoo Hajin. Richer than the devil with a personality to match, Hajin is infamous… as the crazy side top of a BL webtoon. Or so he once was, until he reawakens with the new soul of a normal and harmless college student. Farewell, obsessive psycho version of Hajin! It's time for a change of pace, and Hajin decides to start by befriending the original main bottom his fictional counterpart used to torment: Seonwoo. They can be normal friends this time, right? …Right?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Carrot and Stick
mangas.description: Top idol Zetty's rare photocard - if Siwu doesn't buy it now, he'll regret it forever! After finally tracking one down, Siwu rushes to meet the seller, only to run into a little cash emergency. Hwiyeon agrees to give it up for a discount, but there's a catch. Siwu's gotta give it up, too…and we're not talking about photocards here.

mangas.title: Wild Roses and Pretenders
mangas.titleNative: 野ばらとプリテンダー
mangas.description:
Desperate to financially support his ailing mother, Noah leaves his hometown to enter into the service of the Reinhardt family. Upon his arrival his new master, Lord Rupert, demands that Noah pretend to be his lover! Lord Rupert wishes to avoid a political marriage, and Noah is determined to keep his job, so the two men work out an arrangement.



However, the more time they spend together, the more Noah realizes that his forlorn master is beset by loneliness—and Noah wants their love to be real. Can Lord Rupert ever see him as more than just a servant?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Top-Ranked Omega Doesn't Believe In Destiny
mangas.titleNative: No.1オメガ様は運命を信じない
mangas.synonyms: No. 1 Omega-sama wa Unmei wo Shinjinai
mangas.description:
An alpha terrified of other alphas meets a proud omega. Their undestined love begins with a fake relationship contract.

Aka, the top-ranked omega at his club, one day gets requested by Soei, a rich heir way out of his element. Aka's more than excited to land a wealthy client, but it all goes downhill when Soei's sympathetic look enrages him instead. In this world, alphas are said to be superior, but Aka is certain that it's the other way around... omegas are the ones who really rule the world!

The two spend a night together, surrendering to their instincts and losing their senses. Soei takes a liking to Aka and, to the latter's dismay, then introduces him to his parents as his fated pair.

It turns out, Soei just wants to get out of an unwanted arranged marriage. He pleads and presents Aka with a lucrative fake partnership contract. Does this mean Aka will finally have to face the one thing he's evaded his whole life ― fate!?



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: God of Seduction in the Bedroom
mangas.description:
Satoru's love life has hit rock bottom. As "The World's Worst Lover," he's been dumped time and again due to his terrible skills in bed. Just when he thinks all hope is lost, the God of Seduction, affectionately nicknamed Ecchan, suddenly appears to turn his fortunes around! Ecchan reveals that the only way to make things right is to find Satoru's perfect partner—a match so ideal that sparks are guaranteed to fly.

Enter Shinya Hoshina, a wildly popular actor and Satoru's supposed soulmate. Satoru manages to get close to Shinya, leading to a night that redefines everything he thought he knew about pleasure. But as Shinya's kindness and sincerity begin to melt Satoru's heart, what started as divine intervention turns into something much deeper.

mangas.title: Yotsuya Ghost Knight
mangas.description:
Exorcism is a messy business... In a world overrun by spirits, an exorcist must know how to handle himself. ♡



Loner exorcist Okuru Yotsuya has plenty of practice in that department. And while "tears" are essential to his profession, Okuru can only produce so many on his own...



When faced with an especially powerful spirit, Okuru is rescued by Naito Fukase, a pornstar known as "The Squirting Squire." Having witnessed this handsome stranger's splashy supernatural abilities up close, Okuru recruits Naito to teach him the secret to squirting...! And if Naito has anything to say about it, the exorcism business is about to get a whole lot messier...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Palace of the Omega: A Snowflower's Tale
mangas.titleNative: 后宮のオメガ 雪花の章
mangas.synonyms: Kouguu no Omega: Yukibana no Shou
mangas.description:
Years have passed since omega Prince Ilia was married off to alpha King Khalid of Hanu as a political bargaining chip. But thanks to the years of hardship and chaos they overcame together, this once political union has turned into a genuine, loving marriage. Unfortunately, their peace is soon sundered when Ilia gets word that King Cyril of Romelidahl—the omega-hating father who sold him off—has fallen ill. Having searched his soul for what to do, Ilia hesitantly decides to go pay his respects to the father who betrayed him.



(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Lonesome Wolf As Sweet As Honey
mangas.description:
This is a heartwarming love story between the class hottie with a heart as pure as gold and a closeted average Joe.

Afraid of being outed, class loner Mitsuru has a goal now that's he's in high school: he wants a boyfriend. He signs up for a dating app, but it isn't long before class heartthrob Jiro catches him checking out other guys. Mitsuru thinks his high school life is over... But it turns out Jiro's into guys, too!

mangas.title: Kanashiki Ningyo
mangas.description:
"You are beautiful and kind... you are my mermaid."

Umi, a tattoo artist who carries a mermaid's curse, was born with a jet black right eye, and hid the right side of his body which carried an ugly birthmark from the curse. In order to hide this birthmark which even his parents despised, he covered it with a beautiful tattoo, and continued to live his life while hiding himself from the world. However, a chance encounter with a swindling spirit medium changed his life.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime love of a young man who was called a monster.

mangas.title: The Top Alpha's Secret Desire
mangas.titleNative: 国宝級α様は身籠りたい
mangas.description:
Ritsu is an alpha who hates alphas. "I want to bear a child," he says as he makes plans to change his sex through the "bitching" process before graduation. But his secret plan to turn into an Omega was found out by Yakumo, a unseemingly, normal F-rank boy. Yakumo presents him with an option to use him for his "bitching" plans. It turns out Yakumo is a lot more than he seems... Pairing with this strong alpha, will it help Ritsu realize his dream?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Odd Relations: Fan Letters From My Fake Mom
mangas.description:
Jae-Hee loves Jeong so much that he stays his friend even after Jeong gets married and has his son, Yoo-Ahn. Hearing little Yoo-Ahn calling his mom triggers Jae-Hee's jealousy, and he tells Yoo-Ahn to call him ""Mom"" when they're alone. Unfortunately, this becomes a kink that makes it impossible for Jae-Hee to be around Jeong and his family, and he ghosts them soon after. But when Jae-Hee runs into Yoo-Ahn 14 years later, Yoo-Ahn not only remembers Jae-Hee's shameful kink but also confesses his love for the older man! Could their impulsive night together be the start of a questionable romantic relationship...?

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Matching! Ujuui Alpha
mangas.description:
Yoon Ji-Eon, trying to forget the pain of a broken heart, uses a dating app while drunk. However, that night, he blacks out and can't remember who the dominant alpha he had a relationship with is...

... I can't forget. I'll definitely meet him again!

(Source: BookCube, translated)


Note: Part of BookCube's Omegaverse Danpyeonseon (오메가버스 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Don't Make Me Addicted To You, Hiruto!
mangas.titleNative: 沼らせないで、ヒルトくん
mangas.description: A popular young boy and an older, average-looking boy find themselves entangled in an unexpected romance. Souta has been struggling with a stalker, so he decides to find a fake lover to deter them. The person who steps up is an extremely handsome guy. Holding hands, hugging, kissing—stealing all of Souta's firsts one after another, leaving his heart in turmoil. Before he knows it, he's swept away into bed! They aren't even lovers yet, but his new companion doesn't hold back his passion and desire for Souta at all...

mangas.title: Be Careful Of The Eccentric Boy
mangas.titleNative: あまい声は最大ボリュームで
mangas.description:
Yuuta Mogami, a junior in his high school club, is a handsome and friendly guy. Every single day, he comes onto his upperclassman, Daichi Seto, who goes to a neighboring university, libidinously, saying, "I masturbated to your voice" without giving up despite getting brushed off each time.

Even though Daichi should be fed up with Yuuta, his direct "lovey-dovey attack" throws him off his pace. In the end, when he sees Yuuta chatting happily with his friends, he gets jealous…

mangas.title: Plumping Him Up
mangas.synonyms: If you go soft, you'll get fat
mangas.description:
Asuka Sumi, who works from home, bumps into his next-door neighbor, college student Rentaro Taniguchi, outside their apartment building one day. Asuka has a bit of a sweet tooth, and, wouldn't you know it, Rentaro works part-time at a cake shop. As Rentaro starts bringing Asuka cakes from work every day despite his glaring lack of exercise, he proposes a rather... unorthodox way for Asuka to get some exercise and satisfy his desire for cake at the same time.



Laughs galore in this romantic comedy BL between a promiscuous younger stud with an especially rigorous exercise routine and his cake-loving slob of a neighbor.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sew in Love
mangas.synonyms: 怪しい社長を知ってる俺は
mangas.description:
Hyeon's stagnant, aimless life takes a sharp turn when he stumbles into a job at the up-and-coming fashion brand "Larguer." But one company dinner later, he wakes up next to the devastatingly handsome CEO, Ian, fully naked. Panic sets in, but Ian, ever composed and charming, shrugs it off and offers to mentor him in fashion design... with some extracurricular activities on the side. Is this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, a dangerously steamy romance, or a disaster in disguise waiting to unfold?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Death Planning
mangas.description: In a world where dying is no longer a tragedy, but a privilege, the rich design their own extravagant funerals resembling weddings. Ceremonies are held not for the deceased, but for those left behind. Han Hee-Jun has lived selfishly his whole life and realizes no one will remember him if he dies. Desperate to leave behind a perfect image, he takes on death planning. But when Kang Ido, a wealthy client with the same deep emptiness, requests a quiet, meaningful death, Hee-Jun's carefully planned world shifts.

mangas.title: The Beasts' Flowers Taken By Storm
mangas.titleNative: ケダモノたちの花に嵐
mangas.description:
Hitman Taiga is saved by Hibiya, a flower shop owner, when he finds himself on the streets after fleeing from his organization. He must hide his past as a hitman, but his love for this gentle man only grows stronger. Then, one day, he gets to see Hibiya's well-built body drenched by the rain!! As he is mesmerized by this unexpectedly muscular body for such a gentle man, Hibiya asks him if he wants to touch him... Then, he gets french kissed...!?

An eventful love comedy between a mysterious flower shop owner and a cute puppy-dog assassin☆



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Honey Bunny Boy
mangas.description:
A cute romantic comedy about a hot but mysterious new student and a tough-looking guy who is actually a cute bunny on the inside☆


In a world where demihumans―humans born with animal traits―live amongst normal people, Arashi Usami, the biggest delinquent in school, has a huge secret. Despite being big and brawny with looks that could kill, he's actually a rabbit type demihuman.In order to keep his identity concealed, Arashi acts like a lone wolf at school. Then, one day comes the cool and cheerful but mysterious hottie, Shizuka Yamada. For some reason, not only does he seem unafraid of Arashi, he even seems to like him! But, after a while, Arashi notices something strange happening. His body's heating up, and there's only one way to scratch this itch...!!

(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: An Idiot and an Alpha's Laboratory
mangas.description: Yota, an omega, drags his alpha best friend, Shigeyuki, into his weird and wacky experiments to become an alpha.

mangas.title: The Marriage of a Tyrant King
mangas.description:
"It'll be simple once we've bed each other. You'll lose yourself to me... especially if this is your first." Ritsu, a normal college student, receives an unexpected letter. It says that he is betrothed to a king in a foreign country per his late grandfather's promise...! With no interest in love, let alone marrying a man, he refuses! Ritsu travels far to arrive at the royal palace where he meets Seren, a king with unparalleled beauty. Seren steals a kiss, claiming "there isn't a living soul who hasn't fallen for me..."



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I'll Help You Develop -Erotic Lessons With an Extremely Popular Senior-
mangas.titleNative: 俺が開発してあげる～爆モテ先輩のやらしいレッスン
mangas.synonyms: บทเรียนรักจากรุ่นพี่สุดฮอต
mangas.description:
Kotaro is a college student who is troubled by his tendency to get extremely nervous around girls. That's when he was introduced to the handsome and super popular upperclassmen, Azuma Takatoh. Contrary to Kotaro's expectations, Azuma was a friendly guy, and after consulting him about his worries, Azuma agrees to help him, but... Kotaro can't stop his heart from pounding in front of Azuma's overwhelming handsomeness...!! On top of that, Azuma tells Kotaro to practice with him, and forces his burning hot tongue into Kotaro's mouth! That was Kotaro's first french kiss, and it made his body melt and his dick hard...



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Perilous Darling Boy
mangas.description:
Kanata's the ex-number one host who's in a dry spell of unpopularity. The newest host to start working there, though, Iori, is currently number one and has been forcing Kanata to drink all of the drinks that clients order for him each and every day... Then one day, Kanata learns that Iori's been giving free advice to hosts who are worried about their sales stagnating. Kanata's willing to give anything a try as he goes and visits Iori's place, but Iori guesses that in order to understand the feelings of his female clientele, Kanata needs to bottom...!? This story features a junior dominating his superior with erotic techniques under the guise of lessons.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: It Doesn't Have to Go In
mangas.titleNative: はいらなくても、いいじゃないか
mangas.description:
Toma is a large man who works doing manual labor, while Hiro is a dainty guy who's very passionate about various causes. They meet at a movie theater and hit it off quickly, going out for a drink afterwards to discuss the movie they saw. From there, things escalate to kissing and eventually they end up in a hotel room. However, Toma is packing more than Hiro could have imagined, so they decide to try other ways to make love other than putting it in directly. While this is enjoyable for both of them, Toma begins to worry that it isn't enough to satisfy Hiro and looks for ways to help them go all the way.

mangas.title: Breed Me, Snakeboys
mangas.synonyms: A Rabbit in Heat and a Snake That Is Good for the Body | Rutting Rabbit, Healthy Snake | Snake Is Good for a Rabbit in Heat
mangas.description:
In a world where elite hybrids are groomed to become the perfect members of society, the prestigious Hybrid Academy trains its students to be poised, graceful, and ruthlessly rational—never swayed by primal instincts. But not everyone plays by the rules. Mo Dan-Bok, 29. Towering at over 190 cm, he's a top-tier bodyguard known for his strength and skill. Though respected in his field, as a branch family member, everything he's built could be taken away with a single word from the main bloodline. Then one day, a command arrives:

"Protect the Sa Clan's direct heirs."

Summoned before the clan head, Dan-Bok is handed a file. Inside—two names, two photos, and two absurdly beautiful faces that look more like artwork than people. But looks can be deceiving. These aren't fragile ornaments—

They're the cold-blooded, unpredictable heirs of the snake-blooded Sa Clan… and Danbok's new job is to keep them alive.

mangas.title: Sunshine Shower
mangas.description:
Seo-Yun Mun's life has been a rollercoaster of heartaches—losing his mom, dealing with his dad's cheating, and abandoning his beloved piano. But one constant has been his best friend, Yeon-Jae U. Surprise, surprise, Seo-Yun's head over heels for him, but Yeon-Jae already has a girlfriend. What makes it spicy? mangas.title: Fated but Flawed
mangas.description: Beom Gyu-Hwa always believed he was an alpha, until one strange night turned everything upside down. Desperate to pay tuition, he accepts a high-paying gig...only to find out it's at Sehan Hotel, a place he swore he'd avoid at all costs. Things take a turn when his body starts reacting oddly, his pheromones feel off, and worst of all, he runs into the last person he ever wanted to see... When instincts take over, Gyu-Hwa is forced to confront a truth he never saw coming. He's in heat.

mangas.title: My Deliciously Guilty Yukito

mangas.description:

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Koi to Seiyoku

Noah agrees to live in his dream Japanese house for a month on the condition that he communicates with the homeowner, who is a hikikomori (recluse). Noah wonders what kind of person he is, but what appears before him is Kei, a taciturn and expressionless young man who is like a cat who is not used to people. Noah had hoped to get by with minimal interaction, but he finds himself unable to leave Kei alone, as he is in such a dangerous situation that he can't believe he's been living alone. Even when I went out at night, I was worried about Kei... When Noah came home late at night and checked on Kei, he heard a seductive voice...!?



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Omega At Dawn -This Cat Doesn't Need A Mate!-
mangas.titleNative: 暁のオメガ～気ままな猫は番（つが）わない～
mangas.description:
Society has discovered that in addition to alphas and betas, some people are born as "omegas." However, omegas face severe discrimination. Abandoned by his parents at birth due to his omega status, Sei grew up in an orphanage, but he escaped as soon as he reached maturity and started living free, like a stray cat, off any man he could find.

One day, Sei bumps into a childhood friend he hasn't seen in forever, Yuki Omiyata, a.k.a. Omi. Somehow, this leads to him moving in with Omi! For the first time ever, Sei's living a wholesome life in a stable home. Not only that, Sei realizes Omi's been harboring feelings for him all this time, and finds himself attracted to Omi, too. But, one day, Sei finds out he's got a baby of his own growing inside him...!
This spinoff weaves a tale of young love, taking place more than ten years earlier than "The Siesta Mates."



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Haru and Rui's Meow-nderful Life!
mangas.titleNative: ハルとルイのにゃんだふるラブライフ!
mangas.description:
Haru, is a stray cat who got picked up by a beautiful lady. After happily going home with her, he sees another cat, Rui, who is bigger and cooler than him! Haru, who sees Rui as a rival, says, "I will never get along with you!", But Rui just chuckles softly. One day, Haru, who had gotten shots at the hospital, suddenly gets a fever. He's thirsty, dizzy, and his penis aches...!! While Haru's body is in heat, the feeling of Rui's large hand is so nice—!? A heart-pounding, erotic BL with anthropomorphic tomcats, a love unfolds between a sweet and gentle fluffy black cat and a naive mischievous cat!

mangas.title: Office Love Story Starting From Friends With Benefits -Make Love to Me Until You Fall In Love With Me-

He thought they could just stay friends, but when he hears a rumor that Miyabi has a girlfriend, he is heartbroken. Still, he loves Miyabi, so he goes out drinking with her whenever she invites him out... When Takahiro wakes up drunk, he finds himself at Miyabi's house!? When Miyabi touches his hand to take off his suit, Takahiro becomes aroused and gets an erection, and for some reason Miyabi ends up jerking him off... mangas.title: My Boss is the Irresistible King of the Night

mangas.synonyms: My Boss Is the King of Night Delicious

"Do you like me no matter what kind of man I am?''



Kusumi is a reserved office worker with a secret crush on his calm and unassuming boss, Inukai. But one night, at his favorite bar, Kusumi uncovers a shocking truth: Inukai, his seemingly plain and gentle superior, is actually the city's notorious playboy—a seductive figure known as the "King of the Night." The revelation is electrifying, and Kusumi can't help but be drawn to this thrilling side of the man he admires. As Inukai discovers Kusumi's hidden feelings, he grows even more fascinated with him. What starts as a quiet affection quickly heats up as the suave "King of the Night" sets his sights on Kusumi. Watch Inukai as he sees through Kusumi's shy feelings that cannot be put into words...!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: A Total Top (Like Me) Won't Get Fucked So Easily!
mangas.titleNative: バリタチ（自称）の俺は簡単には抱かれません！

mangas.description: Kota, a self-centred web designer, is reluctantly introduced to Chitose, a serious, glasses-wearing, quiet-looking man at an informal dinner he attends with his clients. When he prepositioned Chitose, who seemed to be his exact type, he agreed and they quickly found themselves at a love hotel. At first, Kota is happy to see that Chitose is a service-oriented sub who even offers him a blowjob, but... "Why am I being made to cum from getting fucked in MY ass?" Shu, a student who failed his college entrance exam, collapses on the way home from cram school when Yushi, a handsome stranger, saves him. Instead of recovering at the bar, Shu ends up drunk… and winds up in Yushi's place! Words of Yushi's gentle demeanor and beautiful features escape Shu's lips to which he replies: "I can't hold myself back if you say such cute things." His long fingers and kisses on Shu's sensitive body makes him melt to the core…! His tender guidance never ends!



A love story between a handsome college student, a doting strategist, and a naïve, aspiring college student who needs to decompress!

mangas.title: Small Packages
mangas.description: All he wanted was to get wrecked by a hung, handsome octoman... San-Ho's been pouring his deepest desires into octopus fishing (literally), so when he saves the Dragon King's octopus prince and lands and lands an invite to the palace, the first thing he asks for is his very own beastman husband. But instead of the massive, tentacled stud he imagined, he gets Baek-Kyung. No tentacles, no monster size... just a cute, compact little guy. He wanted calamari. He got shrimp. But hey… sometimes small packages pack a big punch.

mangas.title: Brat Tamer / King
mangas.titleNative: ブラットテイマー／キング
mangas.description:
In a world where the secondary sexes of Dom and Sub exist...

Office worker Shino is aware that he doesn't even make the cut for the lowest tier of the Sub population, which wrecks his confidence and makes it hard for him to find a partner. One day, he happens to run into Triple S―tier Dom and super hot model Aoha, whose mesmerizing gaze causes Shino to faint right on the spot.
The two test out their physical chemistry strictly as a means to take care of their health, and Aoha's commands resonate throughout Shino's entire body.
