One day, Mikito collapses from overwork at his exploitative company. When he awakens, he finds himself unexpectedly close to Yanagawa, an elite coworker he barely knew before. He discovers a parallel world where Doms, who thrive on domination, and Subs, who find comfort in being dominated, exist…?!
A story of office life and an unexpected connection between a nurturing Dom and a Sub who's still finding his way!

The two part ways, albeit reluctantly, after an enjoyable night together... only to cross paths again...! Despite Hagiwara's shock, Yuto coolly suggests they become friends with benefits!

mangas.title: Wishing for Love
mangas.description: In high school, Choi Sung-Jae confessed to his best friend Geon-Hu, but was firmly rejected. Despite staying friends and going to college, Sung-Jae is still ardently in love with Geon-Hu and makes a wish on a shooting star for just one chance to sleep with him. The next day he wakes up in the body of Lee Chung-Min, a fellow classmate and...Geon-Hu's lover?! Chung-Min is now in Sung-Jae's body and makes the wild suggestion that they have a threesome. The loss forces him to rebuild his career as a freelancer and for three long years, every face was a blur. One day, he finally recognizes someone, Lee Jin, an assistant writer at a TV station he'd bumped into before having face blindness... whose name is also written on Je-Wan's body! Determined to reclaim his place at the top, Je-Wan proposes a contractual relationship with Jin, but things soon spiral far beyond what either of them expected...

Jung Yoojun, a Beta, recently gains a new roommate named Seo Kihyun who is an Alpha. The two lived normally for a while until Yoojun started releasing pheromones that enticed Kihyun. As an Obtained Omega, Yoojun doesn't want to be hospitalized, so Kihyun helps him in a sensual way.

Whether it's a shy developer revealing an unexpected secret, a longtime friend pushing the boundaries of "just colleagues," or a bold assistant making a move that's way above their pay grade, each story proves that love in the workplace is rarely by the book. 1-5. Gaebal Team (개발팀, Backend Development) [Dae Namueun x Samdukong]

I'm Atsushi, an easily influenced, struggling musician. My hairdresser, Shiki, asked me: "Why don't you come to live with me and my friend?" He isn't just good at his job, he also knows how to make me feel pampered even when I try to play tough, so I'm attracted to him. But, his friend turns out to be my ex-boyfriend, Enraku. I was madly in love with him, but he betrayed me and I never wanted to see him again... "Do you hate me so much...?" he's pushing me against the wall, and I'm about to get overpowered, but...!!?

Succubus, beautiful beings that seduce human males to consume their energy, they are the super idols of the devildom.

mangas.title: Love Potion for a Vampire Boy

Akihiro Hasumi has a fair complexion and a secret: an ancestor of his was a vampire. One day, he's drinking at home with Kazutaka, a guy he's been friends with since they were kids, gets drunk and gives away his secret. As a die-hard occult enthusiast, Kazutaka is dying to see if Akihiro can turn into a scary vampire and begs him to drink his blood. "You were so boring it was hard to watch." Akito, furious over the harsh comments, gives Toma the opening he's always wanted: devise a secret plan to bring Akito back as the best bad-boy idol out there. However, Akito might have misinterpreted the "secret" part of the plan... since when did "secret" mean "sexy favors"?!

mangas.title: Nameru Ijou wa Keiyakugai na node!

In the Cakeverse world, secondary traits are managed just like family registers. There are "Forks" who latently lose their sense of taste, and "Cakes" who are innately delicious-tasting humans. Being pressed, and despite his refusals, Andou could no longer resist this persistent and earnest junior...?!

mangas.title: I'll Meow For You, So Love Me

Next, he thought Tama was a poor omega being forced to sell his body... but he's actually an alpha that just likes having sex! How many more misunderstandings can happen between them?

Realizing something's up, Niyama confronts Setouchi and offers him the real deal.
This story is a first-rate raunchy yet innocent romcom about two men connected, quite literally, through a toy!

mangas.title: I want to feel you because I like you.

With the help of a friendly ghost, Masaki, Ono-sensei can examine his young patient's teeth without much fuss. It seems that only Ono-sensei and children can see Masaki. He doesn't remember much about his past but for some reason, he's very attached to Ono-sensei. So much so that Masaki hangs out around the office and even walks Ono-sensei home. mangas.title: Highkey x Lowkey

Mao finds himself falling in love at first sight with a photograph of a model named Kei. The only place where Mao can find Kei is at an art exhibition of the mysterious photographer named Mel.

mangas.title: Mayakashi no Ai de Mitashiteyo

Since then, he's been satisfying his need for approval through a dating app. One day, he matches with a guy named Shuu, who's handsome, interesting, clever, and even amazing in bed! However, after a thoughtless comment from Mahiro, the two clash and end up having an argument, ending with Mahiro storming out of the hotel vowing never to see Shuu again. So of course he soon finds out that not only do they go to the same university, they now have to work together in the same research lab.

mangas.description:
Hye-Sung just hasn't been the same since the accident. For one, his best friend, No-Eul, can't help but notice Hye-Sung's new tentacles, among other things. Actually, Hye-Sung seems like an entirely different person every other day...and this alternate personality is a lot more forward about his desires for No-Eul. No-Eul would do anything for his best friend, but does that include dating the alien inside him?!

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Sweet Room Escape
mangas.titleNative: スウィートルームエスケイプ
mangas.description:
Globetrotting businessman Haruto has achieved the optimal formula for work-life balance: put in your hours and then party hard off-hours. He makes the most of wherever the job sends him, building rapport in each local gay scene and a bon(e)afide booty-call directory. But the hot shot meets his match against the genteel, winsome Albrecht when en route to France. From airplane rowmates, to an invitation to drinks, to the best sex ever in a luxury suite, it's as if fate itself seems to be green-lighting this opportunity. But now Haruto can't seem to escape that heavenly night and resume his carefully crafted no-strings-attached game plan… Especially when Al seems to be plotting to capture Haruto's heart!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Let Me Touch Your Sexy Tail! -Beastly Gentleman's Loving Sex-
mangas.titleNative: えっちなしっぽ、触らせろ！～ケダモノ紳士の溺愛セックス
mangas.synonyms: 讓我觸摸你色情的尾巴！～禽獸紳士的寵溺性愛～
mangas.description:
"Seeing you writhe under me is super arousing." The beautiful fox demon, Natsume, has a hobby, and it's to play with humans by tricking them with his transformations! Today's target is a good-looking tailor, Takato. Even though Natsume invites him out of nowhere, Takato escorts him elegantly, and Natsume ends up getting drunk! When he woke up, he was at Takato's expensive apartment building. "I've never seen... such a sleek coat before." Natsume's sensitive ears and tail get teased, and with a deep kiss and gentle foreplay, he completely melts in Takato's arms...!!

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: There Is No Way I Would Fall in Love
mangas.titleNative: 恋なんかするはずもない
mangas.description:
Taniya, a member of the accounting department, does not like irregularities and prefers to live a quiet, unassuming life. One day, he is coaxed to attend a drinking party by a colleague where he runs into paperwork resubmission man?! His name, Irobe, and he was someone Taniya would seemingly never be able to get along with, until a conversation between them proved to be unexpectedly, pleasant. On their way home, while Taniya was basking in the ambiance of good vibes, he's suddenly kissed by Irobe. Though Irobe confesses his attraction to Taniya, bitter memories of a same-sex partner in Taniya's past resurface...?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Choose Only Me!
mangas.titleNative: チューズオンリーミー！
mangas.description: Wataru and Ayumu are the office's heartthrobs, charming and successful. On weekends, however, they trade their suits for sweats and dive into video game marathons. Ayumu, secretly head over heels for Wataru, has perfected the art of playing best friend, even swatting away potential rivals to keep his spot. But when a client offers to set Wataru up with his daughter, Ayumu's carefully laid plans begin to fall apart...

mangas.title: Palace of the Omega
mangas.description:
Ilya, the 13th prince of a small kingdom, was born an unexpected—and very much unwanted—omega whose birth brought shame upon his royal family. As the lowest-ranking member and an omega, he is destined for a political marriage meant to improve his kingdom's standing.



Resigned to his fate, Prince Ilya travels to his new faraway home. Upon entering the king's gilded palace, where he's expecting to meet his future husband, he instead finds a mysterious young boy with an unsettling message.


(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Worst Soulmate Ever: Proposal
mangas.titleNative: 運命の番に求婚（プロポーズ）だなんて
mangas.description:
Impatient 29-year-old omega Shishikura has watched all his friends get married while his own romances keep fizzling out. Sparks fly when he starts up an enemies-with-benefits relationship with his alpha coworker Kotani. Despite the clash of their difficult personalities, their romance is undeniable, and the two begin dating. But when Shishikura brings up his desire to get married, Kotani refuses! Shishikura will have to get to the bottom of Kotani's deep-seated issues about omegas before there can be any happily ever after.



(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes "Unmei no Tsugai to Onsen Ryokou da Nante" (運命の番と温泉旅行だなんて, Worst Hot Springs Trip Ever) and an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Heavy Boyfriend
mangas.description:
Karui (bottom) is a playboy through and through despite having a boyfriend.

Said boyfriend, the possessive Shigeta (top) adores him.

They are both university students and members of the same band.

This is their clingy love story.



(Source: DLsite)

mangas.title: Yuru Fuwa Kouhai-kun wa, Tamani Gouin
mangas.titleNative: ゆるふわ後輩くんは、たまに強引
mangas.description: In a workplace full of men, a new pretty boy Usui joins in April. Akazawa can't seem to take away his eyes from him and starts to think he's really cute. What's more, Usui seems to be very fond of Akazawa too. What will happen with those two when a pretty female girl joins?

mangas.title: Koishite Baby
mangas.description: Omega Kiyo is a pole dancer working in a club dedicated to alpha customers. Kiyo's dream is to be his childhood friend, Chii-chan's bride. But Chii-chan thinks of Kiyo like he is his little brother?? Kiyo, a tall and built omega with a complex and Chii-chan, a firm and reliable, shorter alpha, need to find their happy ending!

mangas.title: Hisame Furaba Koi Chigiri
mangas.synonyms: Ngày mưa lạnh đôi mình hẹn ước
mangas.description:
"I'll have you join me in matrimony..."



Toono Itsuki is a university student who majors in folkore studies. He's currently headed towards his grandparents' hometown as part of his thesis' fieldwork. There, a local warned him to "not get close to the mountain on days when the rain is cold". Despite the warning, Itsuki still went towards it and there he met!?



Here's a BL about a local god and a folklore geek!



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kono Koi wa Kitto, Amasugiru
mangas.titleNative: この恋はきっと、甘すぎる
mangas.synonyms: This Love is Surely Too Sweet
mangas.description:
Kento, a weary office worker, meets Sora, a construction worker, at a small candy shop. Sora's friendly smile and comforting presence gradually soothe Kento, leading him to visit the shop more often and become increasingly aware of Sora. Then, one day, when Sora catches him just as he's about to fall, the strength and warmth of his embrace unexpectedly send a reaction through Kento's lower body…!?



A deeply sweet love story between a cheerful, muscular man and an exhausted salaryman!



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Shape of Us
mangas.description:
After eight - or has it been nine? - years of unrequited love for Seo I-Do, Gyeon-Woo has finally had enough of this endless one-sided relationship and decides to take drastic action. He secretly snaps photos of Ido cheating and uses them for blackmail. All Gyeon-Woo wants is just one night with Ido. Their night of passion went as planned, but as Gyeon-Woo turns over in bed, he finds a new guy lying beside him… As Gyeon-Woo is forced to reckon with his new reality, what shape will his love for Ido take on?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Your Romance
mangas.description: As a closeted gay man, Gyulwoo is 28 and single. He has a decent job but he's lacking in the love department, too terrified to come out and ruin his career or reputation. Ready to live the rest of his life hiding his feelings, Gyulwoo is shocked when Hojun, his old friend from high school, appears. In the past, Hojun had revealed he loved Gyulwoo but Gyulwoo wasn't ready to accept his love. Decades later, will Gyulwoo keep their romance secret or will he finally share his heart with Hojun and the world?

mangas.title: The Last Train
mangas.description:
Natsume, a systems engineer has missed the last train home, but wouldn't you know, Miki, an office worker also missed the last train. They both decide to go search for a hotel, but for some reason, they need to stay in the same room?! For Natsume whose face is always buried in front of his computer, this is one of the biggest hurdles he's ever faced, but the calm and friendly Miki convinces him with a smile that it'll be fine. The next morning, Miki tells Natsume, "I want to see you again." How will Natsume respond...?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Omega Bite
mangas.description:
In a world where one's secondary gender determines everything, social status is set from birth. Inu, an alpha from a low-income family, is desperate to secure a future among the elite. To guarantee his success, he resorts to abusing pheromone enhancers…but when the side effects temporarily turn him into an omega, his carefully laid plans spiral out of control. So when Hae-Yeong, a former classmate and a dominant omega from a powerful family, Hae-Young makes an unexpected proposal to cure him of his new-found issue, he has no choice but to consider it. Faced with a deal that could change his fate, Inu must decide how far he is willing to go to rewrite his destiny.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Just love, the monster
mangas.description:
Reiji Kuze is the son of doctors and the new transfer student in his last year of high school. As someone whose socioeconomic background and academic grades are in the top 98th percentile, Reiji immediately stands out like a sore thumb in his new school. And in high school, standing out means you will be targeted. Presumed to be a delicate prince swimming in cash, Reiji gets picked on by the third strongest person in the school... and beats him and his entire gang to a pulp without breaking a sweat. As if Reiji didn't stand out enough already, he seems to have caught the interest of the king of the hill, Akira Ohara, the cat-like lone-wolf that nobody can seem to tame...



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Dreaming of You
mangas.description:
Ike is just your everyday businessman, except he has a secret... He likes yaoi comics. Just reading these comics is all he needs to get through the day. Recently, he has been fantasizing about his colleague, Tokiwa, in sales. Tokiwa is always in a good mood and super kind to everyone. And, to top it off, he's really handsome! He's the perfect top!

"Just being in his presence is more than I deserve, but in a perfect world, I wish my ideal bottom worked here, too..."

Ike's fantasies grow wilder and wilder until one day, he is paired with Tokiwa to work on a new project. The closer they get, the lewder his imagination becomes. And then, one day, he imagines himself as Tokiwa's bottom!

mangas.title: Holesome Romance
mangas.description:
Jung Hyun-ho is an average office worker who is infatuated with his team leader, Seo Doha, also known as Mr. Seo. Despite confessing his love, Mr. Seo remains strictly professional and pays no attention to Hyun-ho's romantic advances. Frustrated and unable to resist his feelings, Hyun-ho purchases a unique adult toy with intriguing instructions. Filled with a mix of excitement and guilt, he begins to indulge in his fantasies, imagining what it would be like to be intimate with his boss. However, at that very moment, a peculiar and unexpected event unfolds, causing a ripple effect on both Hyun-ho and Mr. Seo's lives in ways they could never have imagined.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: My First Love: Big Honey
mangas.description:
A collection of stories about the unexplainable pangs that prickle your heart during the beginning stages of love:



1. My First Love: Big Honey: Tatsunori goes through relationships (and break-ups) like the seasons. He can only date guys that he finds attractive, guys that look like Keito, an old, unrequited love from high school. And as luck would have it, Tatsu and Keito meet again in university, but Keito looks nothing like he used to in high school.



2. Roommates and Physical Bonding: Kensei welcomes John, a foreign exchange student from America, into his apartment as a new roommate, a decision Kensei has regretted ever since, as John is a stickler for tidiness while Kensei is... well... not. Will the two ever be able to coexist peacefully? Or maybe there is some heart behind their bickering?



3. Lovers' Stairway: Masa and Fuji know that everybody is doing it; they even witnessed it themselves in the school bathroom. But all they've ever done is a kiss. What will they do when a golden opportunity arises and they find themselves alone in a locked room?



4. If This Feeling Can Be Called Love: Misono has always been the shining star on a clear path to success. With top grades and social skills in high school, no one was surprised when he graduated from a famous university and entered a big-name trading company. But even on his elite path, there was one person Misono could never win over, much to his frustration. Sakura, the weird outcast of his class and was always unimpressed by Misono's eliteness. What was it about Sakura that made Misono tick? And why is he still frustrated even when they meet again years after high school?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: My Alter-Ego is a Gangster!
mangas.titleNative: 無知な僕とわるいこと。
mangas.description:
A mopey gangster who's as loyal as he is violent and a top-dog delinquent who's a glutton for pleasure! These testosterone-filled teenagers are up to no good, in more ways than one!



Wimpy crybaby Taichi goes to a school full of delinquents, but for some reason, all the bad kids in school think he's their leader!
There's a secret only Taichi doesn't know... the fact that he has an alter-ego who's a ruthless delinquent! And, little does Taichi know, he sometimes regresses to a child-like state. He doesn't even know what touching himself is, despite his body being in the throes of puberty...



Mitsuru Gunji, leader of a rival school's gang, takes interest in Taichi and starts initiating him into the ways of pleasure. After melting in Mitsuru's arms after his first time (mentally speaking), Taichi starts begging for more!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Meteoric Milky Night
mangas.titleNative: メテオリックミルキーナイト
mangas.description:
On the night of a meteor shower, Subaru the penguin, the star attraction at the zoo, is transformed into a human! Stark-naked in his new human body, he tries to escape but is soon captured with another ex-animal guy, Kai, a former polar bear. Under the mysterious zoo director's guidance, Subaru starts working in a host club and quickly becomes successful. When drunken Subaru returns home and teases Kai for being naive about love, they end up having an affair! Subaru's wish on the meteor was "I want to find a partner who only loves me." But what is going to happen to Subaru's love life now that Kai is obsessed with him



(Source: Takeshobo)



Notes:

- Originally published as one-shot and was then picked up for serialization on 2023-10-24.

- Includes two extra chapters and the one-shot "Meteoric Lonely Night".

mangas.title: Lightning in Spring
mangas.description:
Minato is a college student with no future and no ambition. He spends his days goofing off, and his nights sleeping around. One day, he meets a famous prodigy artist named Riku, who attends the same college despite it not being an art school.
Minato's first impression of Riku is that he's a weirdo, but when Minato has no place to stay one night, Riku lets him crash. After Minato sees him paint, urges start welling up inside him. Is he of all people falling in love...?



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Because You're Inexperienced
mangas.description: Shiina, who prefers the company of the innocent and inexperienced, has a policy to just hook up, leave, and never get serious with anyone. That is, until he meets Sota, a hot, inexperienced college student. Shiina happily takes Sota to a hotel for the night, but isn't able to go all the way with Sota after seeing the big gun he's packing. However, Shiina can't let someone so good (a hung inexperienced hottie) get away! Shiina promises Sota he'll be ready the next time, but finds himself drawn more and more to his sweetness!

mangas.title: Yuri on Livestream, Yaoi Behind the Screen
mangas.titleNative: 嘘つき百合配信、ぶちかまされて泣く。
mangas.description:
"Superchats make you feel better, right?"



Is this the start of a raw sex livestream between a gorgeous, high quality actor and a cold, lower class actor!?



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Suki ni Sasete Miseru kara!
mangas.titleNative: 好きにさせてみせるから！
mangas.synonyms: I'll Definitely Make You Fall in Love!
mangas.description:
The college student Hiro Sakurada has a crush on his childhood friend Shun Sakiyama, who lives next door.
Hiro believes that the distance between he and Shun, who used to be like a big brother, is gradually closing.
Now Hiro believes that the time has come, and he confesses his feelings to Shun... but what happens?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: I Don't Need a Script for Love
mangas.titleNative: 愛のセリフはいりません
mangas.description:
An actor and a model walk into a gay bar... This sexy boys love romance takes place in the whirlwind world of TV stars and handsome celebrities! Popular actor Subaru Yuuki meets up-and-coming model Kaiho Kudo at a gay bar, and the two flirt and have a one-night stand. When Subaru's co-star is injured and forced to step down from the drama they're shooting, who should arrive to replace him but Kudo! Despite their recent fling and the obvious chemistry between them, Subaru must resist Kudo's advances because it's his personal policy not to get involved with cast members. Besides, he's not interested in a real relationship; he prefers to keep things no strings attached. Kudo, however, remains undeterred and makes a suggestion: what if, after the show is over, they become lovers?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Bloody Sweetheart
mangas.description:
Yiram is a half-breed vampire. Which sounds pretty mysterious and grand, but it's nothing glamorous. He's a fairly regular guy working as a middle school art teacher, and he doesn't even drink blood. Mostly because he has a teeny tiny trauma regarding blood, but that's not important. Hardly memorable…until Hong Jua, the very root of that trauma, becomes his coworker. There's no way this can go wrong, right?

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Chapter count includes 4 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Irezumi Otoko to Shirigaru Otoko
mangas.description:
Haruma, a gay man, falls in love at first sight with tattooed Tosuke at a club. They spend the night together and Haruma proposes a relationship but Tosuke only wants to be friends with benefits.

Included one-shots: Kouhai ni Mimi wo Nerawareteimasu, AV Danyuu no Otoshikata

mangas.title: Ore wo Shiranai Kyou no Kimi
mangas.titleNative: オレを知らない今日の君
mangas.description:
Ono is an honor student who's only curt with Mikuni for some reason. At first, Mikuni was bothered by this, but became engrossed by the casual smiles and gestures from Ono. However, after witnessing Ono being assaulted by their teacher, he can no longer interact with him the way he used to and avoids him. One night, he learns that Ono committed suicide... Mikuni is in despair, but in the next moment, time has returned to the Friday before Ono died...

br>
(Source: JP Renta!)



Note: chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: A Sigh In Spring, A Love In Summer
mangas.titleNative: ためいきの春に恋の夏
mangas.synonyms: Tameiki no Haru ni Koi no Natsu
mangas.description: Kuniharu Nishio had been in love with his friend ever since high school. He followed his dream of being a stylist, never letting go of these feelings, and while the nature of his work was very accepting when it came to same-sex relationships, he spent his days feeling somewhat gloomy and depressed. That is, until one day, when a new camera assistant named Ruka Nakamine showed up and suddenly confessed his love for Kuniharu. Ruka was very aggressive and annoying to the point that Kuniharu felt that kissing him was the only way to shut him up...

mangas.title: Love Blooms for a Twisted Blossom
mangas.titleNative: ひねくれさくらに恋が咲く
mangas.description:
Sakura has been called 'beautiful' countless times. The only other person to rival him in that aspect is Yukihira. Sakura fell for him at first sight to the point he stalks Yukihira almost every day and attempts to confess despite being socially awkward. When one of his attempts to get closer to Yukihira resulted in a kiss, Sakura may have awakened a different side of the princely Yukihira.

(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: #Don't Let Anyone Know, But I Want Love!
mangas.titleNative: ＃バレたくないけど、恋シたい！
mangas.synonyms: #I Wanna Keep My Secret, But I Wanna Fall In Love!
mangas.description: Arata's 'perfect life' consisted of being in the popular crowd and dating the most beautiful girl at school. But what his friends and his current girlfriend don't know, Arata is actually gay and makes videos of gay porn starring himself in secret. A punishment game leads Arata to dare to kiss a member of an otaku club, where he chances upon a sleeping Yamato Konoe, who is actually a handsome guy without his usual mask. Before Arata could go on with the dare, Yamato woke up and recognized Arata from one of the gay videos he'd watched. Things get steamy; from then on, Arata couldn't get Yamato out of his mind. There's no way he's attracted to Yamato, right?

mangas.title: You Just Can't Beat a Guy With a Double Face
mangas.titleNative: ダブルフェイスには敵わない
mangas.description:
Could the ideal guy be his arch-enemy? Kaname Ando is a high school student who's always dreamed about being a tough guy, though it's about all he can do to snipe at his goody-two-shoes classmate, Katagiri. One day, He is sulking on his way home from school when students from another school pick a fight with him. To his delight, a tough guy named Soma suddenly appears on the scene and saves the day. He's overjoyed, telling Soma he'd been looking for a friend like him, when Soma suddenly kisses him...!! Ando is already feeling dizzy when he discovers that Soma and his boring classmate Katagiri are one and the same. A story about a weakling badass and a "straight A" student who turns bad after school.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Don't Say You Love Me!
mangas.description: At first it seemed like the gorgeous and popular student council president Eiji Tokita, and Oriya Okamoto, your average, everyday student, would never cross paths. But, one day, Eiji starts passionately telling Oriya how much he loves him...! He even proposes marriage, and no matter how cold or violent Oriya is to him, Eiji won't seem to give up...!! A romantic comedy set in high school depicting love between a hot school president who's obsessed with a boy with no traits that make him stand out!!

mangas.title: The Wolf's Bride
mangas.description:
Louie, the sixth prince born from an affair between the king and a maid, has a secret he can't tell anyone. Suddenly, he is sent off by the king to be married to someone in a foreign land as a "princess," being promised that his mother will be safe only if things go smoothly. The kingdom he is being sent to is the neighboring kingdom, where people live in harmony with wolves. However, the evening the ceremony is finished, Louie's new "mate" Prince Zeth soon discovers that he is not the princess he was said to be... Now begins a new story in the kingdom of wolves!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: I Didn't Mean It
mangas.titleNative: そんなつもりじゃなかったんですが
mangas.description:
When Yukiji is approached by his coworker and best friend, Kaname, with concerns about being stalked, he's ready to jump to his friend's aid. But as Kaname details the stalking incidents, Yukiji is shocked to realize that Kaname's "stalker" is none other than Yukiji and his anonymous gestures of care. Fearing he might ruin their friendship, Yukiji wrestles with the dilemma of coming clean. In fear of another visit from the stalker, Kaname asks Yukiji to stay over for the night, and he reluctantly agrees. But the night takes an unexpected turn when Yukiji awakens to find his own hand grabbing Kaname's crotch! Despite Yukiji's panic, Kaname closes in with an unknown intent…



"I put my best friend into this mess against his will!"



When a cunning and obsessive stud latches onto an incredibly square and clueless dork, a rom-com full of hilarious misunderstandings begins!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: The White Deer Speaks for Love
mangas.description:
Saya, son of Louie and Zeth and a part of the Royal family, has fallen for the white deer Yullur. Though they are so far apart in age, Saya has always held on to the playful vow he made as a child to make Yullur his mate. Currently, Saya has been unable to decide on a candidate to be his mate, and is beginning to feel the pressure to find one as he is royalty. Realizing now that he cannot avoid how he has always felt, now might just be the time to confess his feelings. However, Yullur seems to have different thoughts...?



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: My Little Vampire
mangas.titleNative: マイ・リトル・ヴァンパイア
mangas.description: This is a world where humans and vampire have found something to co-exist: artificial blood. Still, it can't really be helped that people would be scared of vampires because of their dangerous nature. Meanwhile, a man who is tired of loneliness after the death of his lover decided to adopt a vampire child. Of course, he had needs, so he calls for sex service every night. What he didn't know is that the kid sees it, and because the kid drinks his blood, he is growing up too fast. Will the man be able to see this vampire as a grown man when he was just an adorable little child yesterday?

mangas.title: Kizudarake no Hakoniwa
mangas.description: Yuito didn't have a good first impression of the new transfer student, Tagasaki Mitsu, who bit him on their first encounter. There are a lot of rumors about Mitsu's violent ways, will Yuito find out whether they're true or not?

mangas.title: The Corporate Slave Wants to be Fucked by the Extremely Sadistic Gangster
mangas.titleNative: 社畜リーマンはドSヤクザにハメられたい
mangas.description:
"Starting today, you belong to me. You'll work for me. I'm saying this nicely, but this is what's going down."



Hashiba, a salesman of a sweatshop-like corporation, bursts into his director's office to turn in his resignation, only to walk in on a shakedown by a gang...! Coming in at the worst possible time, Hashiba is handed over to the leader of the gang, Miki, as a collateral for a debt. What's more, when he finds out Hashiba is gay, Miki tells him to suck him off while forcibly thrusting his cock into Hashiba's mouth...!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Underwear Is Being Held Hostage
mangas.titleNative: 俺のパンツが人質に取られています
mangas.description:
"Are you going commando?" Due to unforeseen circumstances, Ryo Kishimoto winds up freeballing it on the way to school one day... and against all odds, his younger teammate Haruma Nojima winds up with some major blackmail material. From that day on, Ryo is forced to live without underpants. He even has to wear a bra along with other less savory accessories... Haruma keeps ramping up the naughtiness, and despite his earlier reluctance, Ryo starts to enjoy it...! What fate lies in store for Ryo and his underwear? This is a freeballing love story about two high-school students!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Pain, Sweet Pain
mangas.titleNative: スウィート・ペイン・セラピー
mangas.description:
All the women at Yuma Saki's office gossip about whether or not Yuma's got a "dynamic" - an attribute that gives him a need to control or be controlled. He's able to hide it well thanks to his suppressants, but circumstances force him to seek release with a partner. And so, Yuma is reunited with Mao, the first person who awakened him to the pleasure of pain. As soon as Mao kisses him, Yuma's knees buckle as memories of that first bite coming rushing back. He's never been commanded before...!

A romance between a hot office worker and his old classmate who helped him discover who he really is!



(Source: Renta!)



Chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: My Awful Boss Is My Secret Jerk-Off Partner
mangas.titleNative: 嫌いな上司は秘密のオナフレ
mangas.synonyms: イケメン後輩はナイショのオナフレ
mangas.description:
Workplace romances may help workers expand their skillsets...



"My Handsome Junior is My Secret Jerk-Off Partner": Morishita has always admired Kase from afar. How can someone be so perfect? But now is not the time to be distracted; Morishita must focus on his (technically his coworker's) task at hand. It's looking like it'll be another late night for him at the office... with Kase...?



"My Awful Boss is My Secret Jerk-Off Partner": Ever since Momose realized he was gay, he has kept it secret from those around him. Soon, he found himself isolated and unable to communicate with people properly. Momose is the polar opposite of his boss, Chief Uchiumi, who emits the sparkly aura of a beautiful social butterfly. Momose steers clear of him in every and all situation. It's good he won't ever have to interact with Uchiumi outside of work!



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

mangas.title: This Confident Virgin is Weak to Sex!
mangas.titleNative: 強気な童貞はえっちに弱い！
mangas.description:
"Rather, he probably sucks at sex." I never thought this one comment would lead to such things...



Retsu is a college student who loves fashion and dressing up in style. When talking about the popular model "Sho" with his friends, he ends up saying that Sho probably sucks at sex. But then Sho himself had overheard the conversation... He takes and locks Retsu into a room and asks him, "Wanna test if I really suck at it or not?"... Receiving a tongue-intertwining kiss from the extremely good-looking Sho and getting his privates teased... The pleasure of getting touched by someone else makes Retsu dizzy...



This is a modern, erotic love story of a sweet, sadistic, and beautiful model paired with a confident virgin who's weak to sex...!!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Greedy Rui Is Looking For Pleasure -Sweet, Sadistic Sex With a Caring Host-
mangas.titleNative: 欲しがり涙くんのきもちイイこと～溺愛ホストと甘Sエッチ
mangas.synonyms: Hoshigari Rui-kun no Kimochi Ii Koto - Dekiai Host to Ama S Ecchi
mangas.description:
Rui Okamoto who grew up in the countryside, dreams of a naughty life together with a handsome boyfriend in Tokyo! So he heads to a gay bar! On his way there, he meets Kei, the top host of a host club. Instantly spellbound by his beauty, Rui ends up unintentionally walking into his host club...!! "I love cute guys like you." With a deep kiss, forcibly entangling their tongues together, makes Rui's body melt on the spot...!!

A sweet but sadistic top host and a dreaming, pure college student start their lovey-dovey romance together!

mangas.title: Be My Love, My Lord
mangas.description:
This is a world where humans keep beasts and beasts obey humans. Born as the second son of a well-known family, the lonely Reiji has always had his beastman servant, Tsubaki, as an irreplaceable presence since he was a child.

But one day his feelings turn to love, and Reiji playfully kisses Tsubaki, which invites his bestial lust. His sharp bite overflows with his own repressed feelings, but comes with a dark realization — they are different races, different castes. Can they overcome these hurdles and embrace their love?

mangas.title: My Mean Master Makes My Body Melt
mangas.titleNative: イジワル主人の蜜戯にとろける
mangas.description:
A love story between a slightly obsessive young master and a former classmate who's now his maid. Kazuomi Kagami is the center of all the students at a super wealthy private school. For some reason, Kazuomi is attached to Yuito, a normal, average boy. Yuito finds himself becoming friends with Kazuomi, but they go their different ways after graduating high school. Yuito's father goes deep into debt and Kazuomi offers him a job to become his caretaker. Yuito reluctantly agrees to his proposition and ends up in a situation he was not expecting! So begins his days of teasing by his young master, Kazuomi. The hot and heavy spinoff of the hit series Good Job, Young Master featuring Eiji Kagami's older brother!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Ookami wo Karu Housoku
mangas.description:
Based on a Novel "Without Reservations" ("With or Without" series vol1.):



Sometimes love just catches you by the tail.



Chayton Winston is a veterinarian. He is also a werewolf. Much to his Native American parent's chagrin, he has always dreamed of a fair-haired, Caucasian mate. However, he never imagined his mate would be male. As a heterosexual man, he's not quite sure what to do with a male mate, but more than willing to find out.



Keaton Reynolds wakes up, in wolf form, and finds himself with a mate. He's instantly attracted, but not so thrilled to find out the man is straight. Having been in a relationship once before where his partner professed to be "Not gay" left a bad taste in his mouth. Keaton wants to make a break for it and pretend he never set eyes on Chay-but Chay is not ready to let him go.



Together the two work to solidify their shaky relationship and battle the prejudices against homosexuals. Chay must deal with not only his mother's prejudices against gay men but also her hatred of white people.



When Keaton's life is threatened, the two men learn to depend on one another and their relationship to get them through it.

mangas.title: An Excuse to Feel Young
mangas.titleNative: 若作りは恋情のいいわけ
mangas.description:
"Don't Underestimate an Older Man's Desire!" — A Love-Struck Young Man Helps an Older Man Feel Young Again!

Rihito, who secretly has a crush on the handsome older man Maki, whom he met at the station, finds himself invited to dinner. During their conversation, Rihito learns that Maki is trying to feel young again. Eager to help, Rihito initially only intended to offer support but ends up confessing his feelings for Maki. Flustered, Rihito is met with Maki's reaction—"You're just too cute," Maki says as he pulls Rihito into an embrace. Lost in what feels like a dream, Rihito proposes the wild idea of a "younger-man play," and Maki passionately makes love to him all night long.

mangas.title: Koi no Towaltz
mangas.description:
"I'm here to pick you up, will you marry me?"



Yuuichi, a poor college student, spends his days studying for a scholarship and working part-time. One day, the world-famous supermodel Reo Ichinose visits the café where Yuuichi works. As the store goes crazy at the unexpected celebrity appearance, Reo tells Yuuichi, who is completely clueless about fashion trends: "I've come to pick you up," and proposes to him...!? Yuuichi has no recollection of him, but Reo insists he has come to keep his promise to Yuuichi.



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Divorce Me, Mr. Alpha
mangas.description:
Can you have sex with someone else after having sex with me?

A cold, angry omega serves divorce papers to an oppressive, haughty alpha!

This is an omegaverse divorce boys love story about redoing fate!

mangas.title: Hebi no Yomeiri
mangas.description:
1. Hebi no Ongaeshi (へびの恩返し); b-boy Cube 2014-12

After returning from work and being detained by the police, Sasaki meets a white snake in the rooftop garden. What he does not know is that it is his boss, the president of the company for which he works. Kusanagi, the president, reveals his identity after biting Sasaki, declaring that he will be with whom will have his children.



2. Hebi no Yomeiri (へびの嫁入り); b-BOY Do S: Shokushu Tokushuu (b-BOY ドS 触手特集; 2015/03/30)

3. Hebi no Kozukuri (へびの子づくり); b-BOY Do M: Asa made Oshioki Tokushuu (b-BOY ドM 朝までおしおき特集; 2015/07/31)

4. Hebi no Kosodate (へびの子育て); Tokunou b-BOY: Choukyou Tokushuu (特濃b-boy 調教特集; 2015/10/09)

5. Ryuujin no Yomeiri (龍神の嫁入り); b-BOY Love♥: Haranjau yo♥ Tokushuu (b-BOYらぶ♥はらんじゃうよ♥特集; 2016/01/29)

6. Kami no Nie (神の贄); Kemono Jingai BL anthology (獣・人外BL, 2015/06/10)

7. Kami no Hakoiri no Nie (神の箱入りの贄); b-boy Cube 2015/09

8. Hagane no Ou (鋼の王); b-BOY Kichiku 2013-09 booklet

9. Hakui no Fuyoujou (白衣の不養生); Libre Premium 2013: Blue Ocean anthology (Libre Premium 2013 BLUE OCEAN; 2013/11/02)

10. Geko to Uwabami (下戸とうわばみ); Kichiku R18: Nyoudouzeme anthology (キチクR18 -尿道責め-; 2014/06/10)

11. Dappi to Kinun (脱皮と金運); kakioroshi

12. Tamago to Osake (たまごとお酒); kakioroshi



Note: "Hagane no Ou" and "Hakui no Fuyoujou" are side stories of "Shakunetsu no Ou" and "Hakui no Kyouhansha", respectively.

mangas.title: Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee
mangas.titleNative: 孤高けものとおバカヤンキー
mangas.description:
One morning, high schooler Inoda Nagi saves a kitten beastman from being bullied at the park, even though he loses the fight. Later, Mikejima Mao transfers into Nagi's school, and he turns out to be the older brother of the kid Nagi saved. But instead of being grateful, Mikejima makes enemies of Nagi and everyone else in the class. Will these two ever stop fighting?



(Source: Houbunsha, translated)



Notes:

- Contains the extra "Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee: Shitto-hen" (孤高けものとおバカヤンキー 嫉妬編).

- Contains the one-shot "Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee: Dachi-hen" (孤高けものとおバカヤンキー ダチ編)

mangas.title: Yakan: Okitsune-sama no Iu toori
mangas.titleNative: 野干～お狐さまの言うとおり～

mangas.title: Is This the Kind of Love I Want?
mangas.titleNative: こんな恋なら終わりにしたい！
mangas.description:
Uta (who has newly come out as gay) and Ryo (seemingly straight) have been living together for a year and a half. At first, they had their fights. They also slept together. But these days, they're as tranquil as a middle-aged married couple. Only problem is...they haven't had sex or kissed in almost a year. With their lease renewal hanging over his head, Uta is wondering if it even makes sense for them to continue this way. Why would a gay man and a straight man who aren't dating or even sleeping together keep living like a couple?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: My High School Sweetheart, Mukahi
mangas.description:
Aoi, landlord of a share house and a florist, can't keep his mind off his first love, Mukahi. One day, the two bump into each other at a wedding. They realize that they are still in love with one another, and spend a blissful night full of passion. However, Mukahi comes to live at Aoi's share house, and there's no doubt about it... Mukahi is a high school senior?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Wicked Idol's Love is Way Too Much! -We Shouldn't be Having This Much Sex!
mangas.titleNative: 腹黒アイドルの愛が重すぎるっ！～本気えっちはイけません！
mangas.description:
"Did you know that this is how men get off together?" Idol Natsuki is all over his manager Asahi. However, when another idol starts to show interest in Asahi, Natsuki shows his dark side. Natsuki used to just gently lead Asahi everywhere, but now he's after more?! Poor innocent Asahi is suddenly kissed and has his very sensitive body touched and rubbed all over until he cums... but he knows he shouldn't be doing this with his charge Natsuki!! A younger idol with a dark side crossed with a serious, yet easily lead manager! It's time for their super sweet, possessive love story!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Koi no Tsuru wa Hanarerarenai
mangas.titleNative: 恋の弦は離れられない
mangas.synonyms: The Strings of Love Cannot Be Separated
mangas.description:
Yuu practiced archery in his grandfather's dojo until he met Hajime. Both decided to join their school's archery club and aim for nationals, but in reality Yuu has no interest in tournaments despite possessing amazing talent and ability, in fact joining the club was due to Yuu's secret feelings for Hajime.



(Source: Libre, translated)

mangas.title: SMELL
mangas.description:
At a school filled with beastmen, two young pups have an awkward encounter that could lead to something more. Joseph, a young border collie, catches the shy and quiet bloodhound Noi sniffing his shirt one day in between classes. Rather than being put off, Joseph treats Noi with kindness and understanding, and even manages to get the timid bloodhound to open up. Turns out, Noi loves Joseph's scent! With this new revelation, a bond grows between them and before they know it, the pups are obsessed with each other's scent. Are they just messing around, fueled by raging hormones, or is there something more between Joseph and Noi?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Stalker x Stalker
mangas.titleNative: ストーカー×ストーカー
mangas.description:
Getta and Taiyo are college students who were close friends. One day, Taiyo is discovered to have been stalking Getta. However, Getta is also a stalker and has been stalking Taiyo.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kishi-sama (Ikuseichuu) to Doukyo Shimasu
mangas.titleNative: 騎士様（育成中）と同居します
mangas.description:
Ares the Knight, with his red-eyed gaze now fixed upon me, was my favorite "game character" that I casually created based on what came to mind. He should've been just a 2D character I jokingly flirted with, and yet that "Ares" flew out of the screen and right into my room!

He kissed my hand, and then as his face drew near, my heart began to flutter… I can't help it!
He's the perfect character I created, you know!!!
I'm falling in love with this handsome knight who is exactly my type… but is this the time to do it?!

He's supposed to be a knight who you can rely on to destroy monsters in the game world! But a beginner, never-kissed-before knight in this modern world?! My pounding heart is in training too.



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Service Time ga Owaranai
mangas.titleNative: サービスタイムが終わらない
mangas.description: Nanbu develops a tendency called "Lucky Pervert", which always lands him in borderline "happy" perverted incidents. After losing his job due to this 'power', Nanbu goes to work at a deli owned by an old friend who is aware of his condition. One day, a customer, Agano, comes in and, as usual, Nanbu causes a series of incidents, including unintentionally spraying Agano with water, falling down, and burying his face in Agano's crotch! However, instead of getting angry, Agano is kind and caring to Nanbu and he can't help but fall in love with him!

mangas.title: Sabeomnimi Deryeoon Agiga Susanghae!
mangas.synonyms: The Baby Brought by Master Is Suspicious!
mangas.description:
Bouquet? Check. Ring? Check. And most importantly, looking good? Check!

10 minutes before Jeong I-Jun, landlord and part of the family gang, confesses to the handsome and lovely Master of Boram Taekwondo, my sweetie Beom Su-Hyeok... Why am I so dizzy...?

What's with these short and chubby limbs?! ...I've become a baby?!



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Mukuwarenai Koi no Uranaikata
mangas.titleNative: 報われない恋の占い方
mangas.description:
"If you're going to choose a guy, why can't it be me?"



Minami, a gay fortune teller, has had a crush on his schoolmate, Kitahara, since high school. Kitahara, who has been divorced three times, asked to stay over at his house for a while, and so they started living together. Minami was convinced that Kitahara would never fall in love with him, but the new "crush" Kitahara found was, surprisingly, a man. Taken over by his feelings, Minami ended up kissing Kitahara?! This is a clumsy and endearing unrequited love that sways between friendship and love.



(Source: Futabasha, translated)



Note: Includes an extra story.

mangas.title: You'll Be My Wife
mangas.titleNative: おまえは私の妻になれ
mangas.description:
Takara Hatori, an ordinary young man, aims to become a novelist, but he has yet to get anything published. On top of that, he's also burdened with his uncle's debts, and he's worried about his future. One day, when he enters a park to escape a debt collector, he's surrounded by light, and when he opens his eyes, there's a gorgeous man with blond hair and brown skin standing there, saying how much he has missed Takara. He has been transported to an unknown world called the Moor Kingdom!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: It Felt Good from the First Touch
mangas.titleNative: 触れたとこからキモチいい
mangas.description:
"It feels so nice, I can't stop..." Okiya is regarded as both a reliable and kind-hearted senior coworker by those at his company. Okiya, however, has a secret ability up his sleeve. Armed with the ability to read people's emotions based on their aura, he is seamlessly able to build strong relations with his peers. One person that catches his eye, though, is a subordinate by the name of Koga. Though a socially awkward and expressionless member of the team, Koga emits a strong "aura of affection" towards Okiya, making him feel extremely pleasant to the point of wanting to reciprocate. One night, after one drink too many, Koga's aura makes Okiya feel so good that he renders him.... wanting something more...! A clumsy love story between an honest, unabashed subordinate, and his intelligent, beautiful senior coworker who both just want to "feel good".



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Shounen to Kusuriuri
mangas.description: Amane is a young boy living with his mother in a small village. He has always believed himself to be normal, but he has a power that nobody else has. Should he touch a person or animal with his bare hands, he is able to hear their inner voice. Once his friends discover this power, they spread vicious rumours about his monstrousness, forcing his mother to flee with him into the forest. Despite holding onto the hope of a cure, after many years his powers remain strong, and his mother's health starts to deteriorate...

mangas.title: After The Rain
mangas.description:
It only took a moment for his five-year-long affair to end. Broken-hearted, Natsuro is sitting in a park he once frequented with his former love when a man approaches him, reminding him of the one he'd just lost. His name is Tsuyuhiko. Tsuyuhiko practically forces Natsuro to come to his apartment,saying he can't bear to leave a man drowning in his sorrow. Then,exchanging few words, Tsuyuhiko says Natsuro can think of him as a replacement for his former love as they indulge themselves in pleasure. Natsuro can't believe what he's done. But, seeing Tsuyuhiko's innocent smile as he promises to see him again,something starts to change inside him.
Little does he know the complicated issues that plague Tsuyuhiko.

A story about slowly nurturing love between a broken-hearted public servant and an easygoing guy with a bad habit.

mangas.title: Iori and the Beast
mangas.titleNative: 世界は尻尾でできている
mangas.description:
Half-beasts and humans both live together in this world, but species don't usually mix romantically...



Iori is a social worker who helps half-beasts live with humans. He's got a good heart, but he's scared of love. One day he meets the wolf writer, Tsuneaki Gora, in order to introduce him to the orphan wolf boy, Riku. Iori immediately feels something for the wild and hot Tsuneaki, and Tsuneaki seems to like him, too... or, at least his scent, anyway...!!



A heartwarming love story about a shy child wolf and two cute guys who are awkward in love.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Peeper's A Keeper
mangas.titleNative: のぞけない俺でもゆるして
mangas.description:
Moto's childhood friend Hiroaki is a little eccentric, and has no problem blurring the lines in their relationship... What's worse, they both keep saying the opposite of what they mean, and misunderstandings abound! Moto has been nursing a crush on Hiro for years. They've stayed friends even after graduating from college, but as a grown man, Hiro still can't do his own chores. Moto's taken it upon himself as Hiro's best friend to look after him day to day, while hiding his romantic feelings and creeping possessiveness. But, one day out of the blue, Hiro announces that he's dating another guy! Bewildered and full of regret, Moto tries to act like nothing's changed...until he accidentally spies the two of them getting it on, and gets caught by Hiro! Finally, Moto tells Hiro he can't be friends anymore, only to be blindsided again!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Anyhow, the Rabbit Is Infatuated with the Puppy
mangas.titleNative: なんせうさぎは子犬に夢中
mangas.description: Usagi Akira is a twenty-five-year-old introverted office worker who lives for two things: shojo manga and the spare moments when he can log into his favorite MMO, Tail Earth. There, his avatar is a beautiful bunny girl, and he's able to go on adventures with the charming wolf-boy Gakuto. When Gakuto asks if Akira wants to meet up IRL for the Tail Earth fan con, Akira agrees. Sparks fly between the two, despite neither of them being quite what the other expected, and they soon fall hard for each other and decide to date! They don't have much experience when it comes to romance, but this gamer couple is eager to figure it out together.

mangas.title: Ai da Nante Iwanai kara
mangas.titleNative: 愛だなんて言わないから
mangas.description:
Unexpectedly, he crossed paths with his old high school friend, Yachiyo, during his grandmother's funeral. It had been two long years since they last saw each other, right after Yachiyo's wedding. Their friendship had become distant due to a past incident in high school.

"At that moment, I failed to comprehend the significance of it all, and by the time I did, it was already too late—a haunting memory. The emotions that I believed I had let go of resurfaced, engulfing me as we crossed paths once more..."

mangas.title: Sukidesu, Sensei
mangas.description:
A collection of short stories:



1. Suki desu, Sensei (I Like You, Sensei)

2-3. Sangatsu no Kodomo (March Kid)

4. Focus on My Hero

5. Suki desu, Shouta-san (I Love You, Shouta-san)

mangas.title: Boku wa Kimi to Koi ga Shitai
mangas.titleNative: 僕はキミと恋がしたい
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Fall in Love with You
mangas.description: Souta is a handsome high school boy who's always dreamed of being the hero who saves the heroine. So he never imagined that he'd be the one that needs saving. One day, while riding on the usual crowded train, he finds himself at the mercy of groper. Frozen by fear, he's rescued by a dashing older boy, who then gently comforts the shaken Souta. Souta can't stop thinking about this kind stranger, who's the exact ideal he aspired to be. That is, until he meets the gruff new transfer student, Hanagata Sakuma. But wait, isn't that the "Oniisan" who saved him? And why is he acting so mean??

mangas.title: Kabeana Money Hole
mangas.description:
Mitsuru is working in the sex industry at a 'Hole Wall Speciality Shop' to help pay his family's debt, but was accidentally discovered by an old classmate Keita.

Keita swears to help out his friend with the money problems, but when all is said and done, will he still be able to see Mitsuru only as a friend...?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: How to Convince Your Best Friend to Sleep With You
mangas.titleNative: 親友と合理的にヤる方法
mangas.description:
"Do you wanna make some money off gay videos together?"

"Huuuh!?"



With a purpose in mind, Chidori Igarashi makes a proposition to his best friend, Kyousuke Amarai. Although he'd never expected him to accept filming erotic videos even if the money is good, Kyousuke took up the offer with the condition that they split the earnings 60% to 40%.



"Wait, will I really get to do naughty stuff with Kyousuke?"



Chidori only had a brief moment to feel excited about his long-awaited success before the act started to escalate...!!



A secret relationship develops from the premise of "filming erotic videos to earn money"...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Beast Is Currently Being Broken In
mangas.titleNative: ケダモノ、調教中につき
mangas.description:
This is the spiciest of pure love stories you'll ever find, and it's about a popular and beastly club host and a "queen" who preys on hetero men. Nagatora works as a club host and despite the carnivorous look in his eyes, he hates women and has no desire to bed them. Since his job forces him to pimp himself off to his female clients, his days are full of stress... But, when he tells all this to his hairstylist, Reina, the delicate and pretty young man turns into a wolf! He asks Nagatora, "Then, why don't you try men?" and forces him into a motel! Nagatora thinks there's no way he can get hard with a guy... but Reina ends up commenting, "You said you had no desires at all, but you're just as wild in bed as you look!" When Nagatora saw Reina mount him and thrust his hips with reckless abandon, Nagatora's inner desires came to life and he became so much of a beast that he even surprised himself...!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: You've Got a Match - An Elite Businessman and a College Kid With a Secret-
mangas.titleNative: マッチングが、成立しました☆～自称エリートと嘘つき大学生
mangas.description:
Reiichi has a Mount Everest-sized ego that survives on constant attention. But, after his girlfriend accuses him of cheating with eight other women, his life begins to fall apart.
One night, as he's drowning his sorrows, he drunkenly signs up for a certain men-only app.
There, he meets a lovely young man, Hayato, whose undying affection for him is impossible to resist



Will Reiichi ever be able to stop hooking up with him!?
And will they ever become boyfriends...?



Don't worry, there'll surely be a happy ending!
Don't miss this rollercoaster romantic comedy about an unlikely couple brought together through a dating app.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: I'll Make This Yakuza My Prisoner!
mangas.titleNative: このヤクザ、トリコにしてみせるっ！
mangas.synonyms: I'm Going to Make This Yakuza Fall in Love With Me!
mangas.description:
"Do you really think those cute little kisses will be enough to take me down?" Chikage, the son of a yakuza boss, is in love with his father's second-in-command, Aizawa. In order to be close to Aizawa, Chikage wants to join the clan in the future, but both his father and Aizawa are fiercely opposed to the idea. But Chikage's feelings towards Aizawa, who had cared for him and loved him since he was little, had long since turned to love...! He decides that he's going to use his body and anything else he can to sway Aizawa over to his side!! When Chikage desperately tries to kiss him, Aizawa used his tongue to tease him sweetly and deeply, and then slid his hot and naughty hand into his pants...!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Fallen Alpha
mangas.description:
Raie is a beautiful prince with pure alpha blood who lives a life of freedom without a mate. He loves beautiful things, and when he met a pretty young boy named Keisuke Sakaki 10 years ago, Raie decided that he will join his harem when he grew up, so when they parted he promised that he would definitely come for him.



Time passes, and when Raie picks up Keisuke at the age of 18, he is no longer a pretty boy, but a big young man with one of the strongest masculine auras among the alpha males. Raie is shocked, but he gets even more shocked when Keisuke suddenly goes on alpha heat in front of him.



He bites the nape of Raie's neck and tells him "Now you're my mate…" Although alphas are not supposed to become mates, Raie's body gets out of control like he was an omega…?



A gender switch omegaverse story about a possessive alpha student and a haughty Arab prince!



(Source: ShuCream BL)

mangas.title: Secret Note
mangas.description: Itsuki, who's deemed as unknown gender and is expected to be a beta, lost his parents when he was only 15 years old. Since then he tried his hardest and worked hard for his grandma and for himself. Somehow he managed to land a job as a servant under a well-known alpha family, but despite his enthusiasm in working there, he was met by a problem—one of his masters, the younger brother Kaisei, despises all genders and is somewhat hostile, while the older brother, Ujou, is very discriminating towards beta and omega alike. But this isn't the only obstacle Itsuki have to face when his real gender comes to light...

mangas.title: Beloved Succubus Belongs to a Guard Dog
mangas.titleNative: 愛しの淫魔は番犬ワンコが独占します
mangas.synonyms: The Guard Dog Monopolizes the Beloved Incubus | Itoshino Inma wa Banken Wanko ga Dokusen Shimasu
mangas.description: Shiki, who gets randomly hit on by the other guys all the time, has only one male friend, an underclassman Atsuya. Since he can talk and joke around with him like normal friends do, Atsuya has taken a special place in his heart. However, after finding out that Atsuya has a crush on someone, Shiki starts to feel a strange thirst and a burning sensation in his body. Gradually losing control over his growing desire, Shiki kisses Atsuya in a daze. What's the truth behind Shiki's behavior...?!The awkward but loyal watchdog and a guy magnet of a boy's tantalizing love affair with younger top!!

mangas.title: No Spicy Romance Allowed!
mangas.titleNative: 運命でも熱愛は許しません！
mangas.description:
Makoto is as average and ordinary as an omega gets. He's nothing like Rio, the model du jour he's been assigned to manage. Rio is charismatic, popular, drop-dead gorgeous, and most importantly, an alpha—everything Makoto can't stand! Makoto is determined to keep their relationship strictly business, even though Rio seems fixated on winning over his prickly new manager with sweet talk and claims of love at first sight. But when a sudden heat has Makoto riled up on his talent's bed…how long can he keep saying "no comment" to destiny?!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: The chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Good Dog, My Boy
mangas.description: Jaehyuk gets a part-time job experimenting with adult products to fill his empty wallet. However, this dog role-playing experience kit never leaves Jae-hyuk's ears. Jae-hyuk, who had a falling out in high school, appears in front of Jae-hyuk, who is wandering around unable to go home.

mangas.title: My Favorite Member
mangas.description:
When he's attending his favorite idol Alto's concerts, Azusa Kageshima looks like any other idol fanboy, with his glasses and plainclothes - but when he slicks his hair back and dons a three-piece suit, he looks every bit the young yakuza leader he actually is! What happens when he ends up sitting next to a guy in the bar who really looks like the spitting image of his beloved Alto?



(Source: Manga Planet)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: BLT
mangas.description:
Misaki, who likes idols and thus became an idol.

Kousuke, who goes his own way and hopes to be liked by many people.

One day, a producer approached Misaki saying "Let's grow our feelings together" and forced himself on him, thus Misaki cried to Kousuke to save him. Because of this, the two's relationship has become awkward. Two people who were originally full of hopes and dreams, encircled by desires and lies, what will they find in the end?

mangas.title: My Quiet Best Friend's Just Tongue-Tied
mangas.titleNative: 寡黙な親友がただのムッツリでした
mangas.description: For some reason, one day Ohdai woke up with the power to see how turned on people are. He thought to himself "Hey, I could meet horny girls!!", only to notice that his silent and poker-faced best friend's lust gauge was bursting at the seams. Apparently, if the gauge isn't depleted regularly, he could end up becoming a molester...!? He'll be okay if we take care of "it" before the gauge breaks, right!?

mangas.title: Because Love Exists!
mangas.description:
Touma, the next in line to succeed as the head of the Hyuga Group, spends his days beating up street punks and chasing after pretty women.
However, everything changes when his father, the head of the group, assigns him a new bodyguard. His bodyguard proclaims: "I am ready to sacrifice my everything for you no matter what the cost," yet what is he hiding from the young master?

mangas.title: Mitsuru the Provider Stops Providing
mangas.titleNative: みつる君の貢げない春が来る
mangas.synonyms: Mitsuru-kun no Mitsugenai Haru ga Kuru
mangas.description: Mitsuru is a giver. When Shiro, in tatters and collapsed in the middle of the road, calls out to him, he can't help but intervene. Shiro is penniless, but like Mitsuru, he's a giver in his own right. Mitsuru provides him with food, and, sensing that their encounter is fate, allows him to stay the night at his place. Mitsuru soon realizes he's outmatched when it comes to the super-popular Shiro!

mangas.title: My Dear Monster "R"
mangas.description: Kureno Rei, the straight-laced, over-serious president of the student council, is the type of person that treats everybody equally. Day after day, he strives to carry out his duties. Suddenly one day, an evil monster called "Dark Genesis" came flying in from space. His aim is "to obliterate the hero who's occupying the body of a student in the academy". In order to protect the students, Rei let himself be possessed by the monster…! And then, showing up in front of Rei's eyes is Fuwa Minori, a delinquent who had no idea that he's the hero. Rei wanted to clean up the villain in the most amicable way possible, so he approached Minori and deepened their relationship. However, Minori got attracted by Rei and when Minori confessed to him, Rei's body changed into a monster's. The way for him to return to normal is through the hero's kiss…?!!

mangas.title: Koakuma wa Ore no Iinari
mangas.titleNative: 小悪魔は俺のいいなり
mangas.description:
Anthology about the many types of people you can meet within the porn industry and beyond.

• Koakuma wa Ore no Iinari

Kuroya Rui is a talented porn star who does not care how many partners he has on a daily basis or how many he has in bed at the same time. One night, after his filming, he meets Eak who claims to be a incubus wanting to seduce Rui. What will happen when Rui decides to play Eak's game?

• Samenai Yume Nara Nando Demo

College student Hayato wanted to try something different, so he became a porn star. Little did he know that he would be monopolized by his very own porn star teacher.

• Catch up

High school student Rintarou lets men do whatever to his body for money. But what happens when he meets runaway Yuuma from another famous rich school?

mangas.title: Hell Is In The Eye Of The Beholder
mangas.titleNative: 地獄の沙汰も欲目しだい
mangas.description:
At the boys' dormitory at Hadoma High School, Yohei Goshi is a problem child and a constant source of headache for the teachers. Itsuki Ashiba, the new junior captain of the Judo team and dorm leader, is trusted by everyone at school. Yohei tries to break the rules, but Itsuki always outsmarts him and makes things difficult. When Yohei concocts a plan to get dirt on Itsuki to blackmail him into backing off, things don't go quite as planned. Instead, he finds him in an unexpected situation!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: His Voice Keeps Ringing in My Ears!
mangas.titleNative: アンアンコールが鳴り止まない
mangas.description:
Shuto was once a male idol. Now, he's an office worker living an ordinary life... Except his former-bandmate Chiharu, a walking reminder of his broken dreams, is still living in his house and mooching off him! Chiharu is a NEET with no job except for the occasional gig in adult videos. When Shuto couldn't take it anymore and tried to kick him out, Chiharu pushed Shuto over, promising to "make him very happy" in exchange for his hospitality...!



(Source: Core Magazine, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Nicotine and Kissing and Sex
mangas.titleNative: ニコチンとキスとセックスと
mangas.description:
"Don't underestimate a former top host."


An ex-host tries to seduce inexperienced and shy CEO! Even though he is just the CEO of a printing company, Hirotaka helped Minami get out of the host business with exceptional offers. Minami never understood why Hirotaka did so much for him, but he eventually realizes that Hirotaka is actually in love with him. Just a slight touch or a suggestive whisper makes Hirotaka shy and clearly nervous. In spite of that, he runs away when Minami tries to make a move on him... There's no way he can be satisfied with just looking at him when they both have feelings for each other. He wants to try having sex with him. He wants to make love to him and make a mess out of him. Minami forcefully grabs him, pushes him down, and gives him a passionate kiss...!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kono Tabi Osananajimi to Karikon Shimasu
mangas.titleNative: この度幼なじみと仮婚します
mangas.description:
Taichi, who has been freeloading off his girlfriend, gets dumped and has no choice but to go back to his parents' house. The person who knocks on his door is his childhood friend, Ryousuke, who grew up to be a handsome man.

After they met again for the first time in years, Ryousuke suddenly proposes to Taichi. Confessing that he has always loved Taichi since they were kids, he requests that they apply for Provisional Marriage ー a system where couples can try being married for a maximum of six months.

Despite being overwhelmed by Ryousuke's intense feelings, the words "you don't have to do anything, so just be with me" lure him in. Taichi agrees to the provisional marriage like he's just agreeing to be roommates, but then...?



(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Choose Me and Avoid Cat-Astrophe
mangas.titleNative: 崖っぷち猫は指名がほしい
mangas.synonyms: Gakeppuchi Neko wa Shimei ga Hoshii
mangas.description: Sabi, a member of the pussycat race of cat people, works as a waiter at a cat café. His constant attitude toward customers has been causing trouble for the café's owner, and he gives Sabi an ultimatum: "If you don't increase your sales this month, you're fired." To avoid that, Sabi has to bank on more orders off the café's secret menu that provides more "adult" services to trusted regulars. That, however, is a struggle for him... until Hazama, a newer regular, tells Sabi that he'll order him. Turns out, it's to propose a deal that Sabi has little choice but to accept. Even though he thought being with Hazama would be unpleasant, it ends up being the best he's ever had...!

mangas.title: Making My Little Fox Mine
mangas.titleNative: 愛しいあの狐を娶りたい
mangas.description:
San is the only black fox in the pack and detested as a bearer of misfortunes to their village.One day while rescuing a cub caught in a trap, humans spot San and nearly shoot him. After he returns to his village, he is threatened with being kicked out.

Just then, a commanding voice rings out... and says it will marry him!The voice belongs to no other than the pack leader, the beautiful and prideful white fox, Kanae.
What is Kanae planning...?

What will come of the unrequited love of this loyal but forthcoming and prideful pack leader and his detested and desolate black fox?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: That Time I Got Stuck to the Guy I Hate
mangas.titleNative: 嫌いな奴とくっつく魔法にかかる話
mangas.synonyms: 싫은 녀석과 달라붙는 마법에 걸린 이야기
mangas.description:
Kuga is a first-year university student stuck with the worst roommate ever—the surly, disagreeable Igarashi. Whenever Igarashi opens his mouth, it's just to complain, and Kuga can't stand it. But one day, these two suddenly wind up literally stuck together with no way to pull apart. They're desperate to find a solution, except the only way to break this bizarre spell is for them to get closer and more intimate than they ever expected!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ayashi no Hakoniwa ni Ukabu Tsuki
mangas.titleNative: 妖しの箱庭に浮かぶ月
mangas.synonyms: The Shining Moon Appearing in a Mysterious Garden
mangas.description:
"This place is a den for those who are not human"

Yuki Shuri, a high school teacher forced to resign from the school where he was working because of a certain incident, is assigned to a new post at Karasudai private school. On the first day in the new school, he tried to save a bird from a dog's mouth but the dog transformed into a demon instead. What else is going to happen in this school for wild students who are "not human".

A lonely demon and a high school teacher. Two miserable people, one because of a deep scar, and the other from the darkness in his heart. Hanami Hana sensei draws out a mysterious • love story!

mangas.title: Precious Boy Wants to Be Degraded
mangas.titleNative: 掃き溜めの鶴は汚されたい
mangas.description:
"Thats the first time I've ever been called dirty... Say it again!!"



A fetish boy's love between an average, clean-freak janitor and a complete masochist who wants to be defiled!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Kimi to Ikirareru nara Shindemo ii
mangas.titleNative: 君と生きられるなら死んでもいい
mangas.description:
"I can't remember someone important who was always beside me."

Houri, who lives a very ordinary life, is drawn to a crosswalk and almost gets run over by a truck, but is saved by a man who passes by. The moment he sees the man's face, he has flashbacks of his past life, when the two of them were intimate. The two are led by a super-powerful fate to make love, but the next morning, the man declares that he doesn't remember Houri...!? A story of love that returns until death do them part.


(Source: Libre, translated)


Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Cut-Over Criteria
mangas.titleNative: カットオーバー・クライテリア
mangas.description:
Recent graduate Jin has been assigned to help out his upperclassman Seto, a highly competent but somewhat standoffish systems engineer. Though Jin is good at his job, he does seem to have his head in the clouds more often than not... and Seto's eyes always seem to linger on him more than they should!

A fresh new boys' love office romance in which opposites attract!

mangas.title: Come on over, Koda! ~The Dumpee and the Divorcee~
mangas.titleNative: 幸田さん！うち来ましょう！～逃げられ男とバツイチ男～
mangas.description: After almost a year of his ex-boyfriend walking out on him, Hisashi is still trying to move on. Single and lonely, he decides to pour his energy to work, where he meets his senior, Yukio Koda, whose charming personality had Hisashi developing a crush. The two of them make a pair in the office as the duo of luck where coincidentally, good luck came to people who come in contact with them. Unluckily for Koda, he wounds up getting bad luck, much greater this time, when his apartment building burned down. Concerned for his senior, Hisashi offers Koda to stay with him. The two start living together, and Hisashi finds that his crush quickly turns into love.

mangas.title: Sayonara no, Sono Toki made
mangas.titleNative: さよならの、その時まで
mangas.description:
Ryuka lives in a village deep in the snowy mountains. One day he stumbles upon an injured beast man named Velk. He nurses him to health and the two wind up living together. Velk wants to mate with Ryuka but Ryuka is hesitant and wants to keep their relationship vague...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: First Night With My Beloved
mangas.titleNative: いとしい君との初夜事情。
mangas.synonyms: Itoshii Kimi to no Shoya Jijou
mangas.description:
"I promise I'll make our first night together pain-free, okay?"

A loving couple struggles to have sex, but could today be different...?

mangas.title: The Man Who Shattered My World
mangas.titleNative: 俺の世界を破壊する男
mangas.description:
Tachibana is a top, and loves cute and slender men. But, just when he thought he wanted to try something different, he meets Kuzumi. Tachibana believes him when he says he's a bottom, and they go to a hotel room together. When he finally realizes there's something strange going on, Kuzumi tells him with a devilish smile: "I like to turn guys like you into bitches on heat…".



The merciless pleasure received from a suddenly changed man… it doesn't take long for Tachibana to let go of his reason.



Top x top BL love story swaying between pride and desire!



(Source: ShuCream)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Discover My Secret
mangas.titleNative: 君にバレなきゃホントはもっと
mangas.synonyms: Kimi ni Barenakya Honto wa Motto
mangas.description: It's been over a year since Takumi and Aki became roommates. They split housework perfectly, pay their bills on time, and their private lives are smooth sailing... or so Takumi makes it seem. He harbors deep feelings for Aki and hides them at all costs to preserve their harmonious lifestyle. However, Takumi's feelings get out, and now he fears the destruction of their relationship. On his 20th birthday, when he reaches legal drinking age, he drowns his sorrows in a bottle... and the minute he and Aki end up alone together, he makes a serious blunder.

mangas.title: Majime na Anoko wa Tsundere Inma
mangas.titleNative: 真面目なあのコはツンデレ淫魔

mangas.title: Seitenkan Apuri no Tadashii Tsukaikata
mangas.titleNative: 性転換アプリの正しい使い方
mangas.description:
Yota has had a crush on his childhood friend Yushin since childhood. However, Yushin always seems to be more interested in Yota's twin sister, Himari.
Yota wonders if he could have honestly expressed his feelings for Yushin if he were a girl.
Thinking of this, Yota installs a "sex change application" that is rumored to be able to change a person's gender.



(Source: cmoa, translated)



Note: Originally a self-published doujinshi, it was picked up for commercial release on 2023-02-10.

mangas.title: Seitenkan Apuri no Tadashii Tsukaikata [Bangai-hen/Youta Otokonoko ver]
mangas.titleNative: 性転換アプリの正しい使い方[番外編/陽太男の子ver]

mangas.title: Kemono no Gochisou, Hijoushoku
mangas.description:
When he was young, a herbivore named Hakka was picked up by a carnivore named Daiya when he was caught in a trap and was unable to move.
