Daiya decided to keep him as "emergency food," but as they spent time together, they began to feel as if they were family.

Ten years pass and the two become adults.
Daiya still thinks of Hakka as family, but he realizes that Hakka's feelings are different from his own.

mangas.title: XL Ookami wa Hatsujou Host wo Agameti
mangas.titleNative: XL狼は発情ホストを崇めたい
mangas.description:
Reo, the legendary No. 1 host of Kabukichou, has retired, leaving Taiga to claim the title of the next No. 1 host. However, Taiga harbors a secret that could jeopardize his reputation: when he drinks, he loses control of his sexual desires. One night, a boy named "Wolf," who idolizes Taiga as a "god," finds himself in a position to help Taiga ejaculate, leading to an intense and complicated encounter...



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: That's Why I Don't Drink
mangas.titleNative: だからお酒は飲みません
mangas.description: Having always admired his father, Haruto chose to walk the path of a sake brewer. He and Nao, who were born into a family of brewers, were close enough to discuss their futures together. But after 10 years, their situation had changed drastically. They had hoped to support Nao's family's brewery together, but... Nao is no longer the heir?! Haruto is disappointed by his childhood friend's decision, but when he runs into Nao by chance, something seems different...

mangas.title: Usotsuki Jouzu to Banken
mangas.description:
Yuuji Samejima spends his days doing nothing but getting into fights, but one day, his fight ended up damaging an expensive car nearby. To pay back the loan for the damages, Samejima accepts the car owner, Shinichi Uotani's offer to become the latter's guard dog. As a collateral for the loan, Samejima also had to accept 3 extra conditions. One of it is to work as a staff at the cafe that Uotani runs. He felt tricked because this was a lot different from what he imagined his job as a "guard dog" would be but...



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Notes:

- This is a spin-off featuring Samejima who first appeared in "Motoyan Papa to Hitsuji-sensei Yotsuba".

- Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Wooed By A Monster And A Snake Spirit
mangas.description:
The old man who adopted orphan Chiaki Kuroiwa and raised him as his own has died. Knowing he'll be alone on his birthday tomorrow, Chiaki's feeling depressed when a snake suddenly appears in front of him. The next thing he knows, a monster breaks down the door and comes charging in!!



The jock spirit and the seductive snake are both determined to make him theirs, and Chiaki isn't sure he'll be able to survive!!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Ore no Souteishite Ita H na Tensei Life wa Kore ja Nai
mangas.titleNative: 俺の想定していたHな転生ライフはこれじゃない
mangas.synonyms: This Wasn't the H Life I Imagined After Reincarnation!
mangas.description: Note: An extra chapter was released on May 7th, 2021 on GUSH.

mangas.title: How to Repair a Broken Cup
mangas.titleNative: 割れたカップを戻すには
mangas.description:
It's been ten and a half years since Keita and Kippei started dating. But even after all that time, they realize they still have difficulties communicating after Kippei accidentally breaks a sentimental mug. Suddenly, Kippei is struck by a time-twisting phenomenon that gives the couple the chance to reflect on their time together. The eighteen-year-old Kippei wakes up in 2020, and the twenty-eight-year-old Kippei wakes up in 2010! Can the two reignite their relationship and sex lives with their partners from the past?


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Century Plant: We're Partners, Friends, and Sometimes Lovers
mangas.titleNative: センプラ 相方が親友で時どき恋人
mangas.synonyms: A Buddy of the Comedy Duo Who Is a "Boyfriend" Sometimes | Senpura - Aikata ga Shin'yuu de Tokidoki Koibito
mangas.description:
"Let's be lovers only in this room."

Even though they are comedian duo, Takei suddenly stopped talking with his partner Yutaro. To find out the truth, Yutaro agrees to go on a prank show. Yutaro, as a prank, tells Takei to break the duo but Takei starts crying. Yutaro asks him the reason for his tears after the show and Takei confesses to him that he loves Yutaro. To better work out the relationship, Yutaro suggests acting as lovers only in his room until Takei is over with Yutaro. There begins the secret relationship between a comedian duo...

mangas.title: Hibari ga Naitara Tsukamaete
mangas.titleNative: ひばりが鳴いたらつかまえて
mangas.synonyms: Catch Me When The Skylarks Sing
mangas.description:
Enomoto, currently a college student, often finds himself reminiscing the days spent with his childhood friend Shimura, who had always been beside him up until six years ago. Due to a sudden transfer, Enomoto didn't get to ask Shimura where he was moving and he hadn't heard anything from him since.

Until one day, he suddenly reunites with Shimura in his Philosophy class in college. Enomoto is over the moon, but Shimura seems to feel differently...

mangas.title: Kemono wa Oku made Aisaretai
mangas.titleNative: けものは奥まで愛されたい
mangas.description: Haku grew up in the slums, aka the "Management Zone". That's where all the mutts like him live. Now that his father has died, and he's being targeted, Haku manages to escape. An accident happens and Haku is saved by a human, Mibu Eiichi. "Haku, from now on, you're my pet." How will this work out when Haku's heat starts?

mangas.title: A Steamy Romance Blossoms at the Secret Springs
mangas.titleNative: とろとろ秘湯で恋、はじまる。
mangas.description: Iharu is a university student looking for ways to kill time over spring break. In passing, he meets an attractive young man named Shin who invites him on a trip to the hot springs. He accepts Shin's offer and finds himself at an elegant inn with outdoor baths and hidden springs--not to mention luxurious meals and amazing sake... Lost in his happiness, he decides to enter the hot springs with Shin. But when he looks at the young man undressing, he can't believe his eyes... "Even his dick is gorgeous! His butt is so shapely!" Even after Iharu turns in for the night, he can't stop thinking about Shin's amazing body... and growing increasingly horny.

mangas.title: Natsume Wants to be Trained
mangas.titleNative: なつめさんは開発かれたい
mangas.synonyms: なつめさんは開発（ひら）かれたい
mangas.description:
Natsume has a problem that's keeping him single and alone: He's lousy in bed! Frustrated by his inability to keep a lover, he comes up with a plan–become a master of sex and shove his newfound bedroom prowess right in his ex's face! The first step? Hiring a male escort to help him improve his skills. But when the escort, Kou, arrives at his home, Natsume is stunned to find that this man is no stranger. In fact, he's Natsume's own housekeeper!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Kemono wa Oku made Nakasaretai
mangas.titleNative: けものは奥まで鳴かされたい

mangas.title: May Belongs to Me
mangas.description:
Without a stable job or home, Joo May lives recklessly, drifting from one lover's house to another. One day, May passes out, almost beaten to death by an ex-boyfriend he bumped into. When he wakes, he finds himself chained up in the house of Shin Jooin, the clean-cut man who apparently rescued him. But there's something off about Jooin, who treats May almost like a pet* Who is Jooin really, and what is he hiding?

(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: One Little Wolf Falls in Love
mangas.titleNative: 一匹オオカミ、恋をする
mangas.description:
"I absolutely hate going into heat... but will it lure in my true love? Or perhaps the person I've had an unrequited longing for all this time?"



When the sun slips beneath the horizon, Iori's body begins to change. He becomes wolf-like... and why wouldn't he? He is half beast, after all. Iori lives his life hiding this fact from the humans around him. However, there is a beautiful boy on his morning commute who Iori can't help himself from catching feelings for. But Iori feels hopeless -- that no one will ever love him so long as he's this half-werewolf, half-human beast. One fateful morning, Iori goes into heat unexpectedly and collapses on the train platform. His unrequited crush comes to his rescue. Lost in the heat of the moment, Iori turns to his crush and makes a request: "Won't you please fall in love with me?" A love story between a lonely but beautiful boy and a cowardly half-blood werewolf. Neither of them has known true love, but their unrequited longing for one another weaves a touching BL tale...



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Double Marks
mangas.description: Ash, a student at the esteemed Seytan Academy, has been cheating on his exams by copying the answers off his classmate Judah in exchange for "special favors." One day he receives a text message from Isaac, another classmate who recently started flirting with him. The message contains photographic evidence of Ash's cheating. Faced with no other choice, Ash is forced to comply with Isaac's demands, straining his already complicated relationship with Judah, who at the same times begins to suspect something is amiss.
