But the feelings are so good for Saeki that, to his surprise, he asks Kirishima, "Could you put your dick in...?"

mangas.title: I Want You to Keep on Loving Me Forever
mangas.titleNative: 愛にできない恋はイヤ
mangas.synonyms: Ai ni Dekinai Koi wa Iya
mangas.description: Naoki has his heart broken by a straight man and resolves never to love a guy who isn't gay again. Unfortunately, fate seems to be trying to throw him together repeatedly with a straight, cute, sweet man named Yuuma. Yuuma is starting to fall for his new gay friend Naoki, though Naoki is the first guy he has ever felt this way about. One drunken night they can't help but touch each other, but in the morning Naoki angrily tells Yuuma that they've made a mistake. Can Naoki put aside his fears, trust Yuuma, and allow the love between them to grow?

mangas.title: Happy Ending, Together
mangas.titleNative: ハッピーエンドはご一緒に
mangas.description:
Company-man Sakuraba makes himself cute lunches every day, reads girls' comics, and generally loves all things feminine. Sakuraba is speechless when he meets his favorite manga artist, Megumi Nono, at a book signing... because it turns out that his idol is actually his neighbor! He goes to visit him a few days later, only to have Megumi collapse, leaving Sakuraba to care for him. And that's how he becomes friends with his neighbor and idol.....! Feminine top Sakuraba sometimes shows remarkable tolerance towards his tough bottom, who suddenly comes over adorably shy. This heartwarming yaoi manga from noted new star Chito Hanakawa will ruffle your feathers with cuteness!!



(Source: Renta!)


Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Home, Your One-Room
mangas.synonyms: マイホーム ユア ワンルーム
mangas.description:
"It's close to college." For that simple reason, Masato is using fellow student Atsushi's apartment like his second house. In exchange, he helps the always-late Atsushi get up in the morning and makes him breakfast.



His friend Takashi says their relationship is weird and that Atsushi's too into him. While Masato's aware of Atsushi's affection, he always figured it was normal, never realizing that his attitude has been affecting Atsushi's feelings...



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Ichijikan de Dekiru Koto (一時間でできること, What You Can Do in One Hour) and one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shachiku-senpai wa Yutori-kouhai ni Sakaraenai
mangas.titleNative: 社畜先輩はゆとり後輩に逆らえない
mangas.description: At the order of his black-hearted boss, corporate slave, Niwa, works overtime every day without a day off. His heart is without rest these days without a cute girlfriend... However, after passing out drunk, he wakes up in the embrace of his easygoing kouhai, Nagase?! Niwa tries to keep his distance from Nagase, but his body has already been exploited by him.

mangas.title: Blue! Blue! Blue!
mangas.description: When Takiya Kippei, the brother of two older sisters, realises that he desperately needs money to buy a birthday present for his lover, he decides to live and work onsite at a ryokan (a traditional Japanese inn). There, he meets the well-educated Honjou Masumi, a man who is neither too strict nor too lenient, and who has a charm which embodies the word 'mature'. "This is the first time I've met someone like Honjou-san" - as Takiya continues working at the ryokan, he starts to become interested in Honjou…

mangas.title: Rift
mangas.description:
He's always been by my side, and that was as natural as breathing to me. I've never imagined otherwise. Even from now on...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sacrificed to the Shark Clan
mangas.description:
A powerful clan that inherits the blood of sharks meets a sun-tanned man with a unique physique in a fateful encounter!



Avel, son of the Tangata Clan's patriarch, grows increasingly dissatisfied with the Miyaru Clan, which resides on the opposite side of the island. Every year, according to a long-standing and disgusting law, the Tangata Clan presents one young adult to the Miyaru Clan. One day, when he's attacked by a beast, Tukiri of the Miyaru Clan comes to his rescue. Surprised by Tukiri's friendly, kind demeanor, Avel lowers his guard, but the second Tukiri recognizes that Avel is bleeding, his personality flips a switch! He loses his humanity and becomes beastly in a different way, much to Avel's panic. Because for members of the Tangata Clan, thanks to their unique physiques, their first intimate experience determines their gender. If he's taken like a woman, he becomes a woman...! As next in line to become the next patriarch, he fears the consequences, but at the same time, he drowns in waves of pleasure!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hooked on Being Dumped
mangas.description:
He could never tell him the way he feels about him... but getting physical is different!! Keita is on the hunt for love, but he always seems to get dumped and end up fighting. Ryujiro (Ryu) is his friend since high school that he seeks refuge with, who tends to his wounds... the very guy who made Keita develop a habit of falling for straight guys, and Keita has been in love with him forever. Ryu is a nice guy who was willing to oblige Keita when he got drunk and said he might die if he didn't get horizontal with someone. He holds his hand and rocks him like a lover, so sweetly that Keita can't help getting the wrong idea...



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Salvation
mangas.description:
Welcome to Ubrade, your majesty.



After falling into an icy pond, Min-Hu wakes up in an unfamiliar world. He soon realizes he's the prophesied hero who's supposed to bring salvation to Ubrade by marrying Emperor Sioen. Will Min-Hu find his way back to earth? Or will he accept his destiny as the savior?



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Melt at Night
mangas.titleNative: メルト アット ナイト
mangas.description:
Tomoki is an average salaryman with a meek personality. Due to this, he has little confidence in himself, including in matters of sex. One night, he gets himself drunk after an office drinking party and falls asleep on his front door. To his surprise, he gets awoken with a kiss from a call boy named Haru. As it turns out, Haru got the building location wrong and, as an apology, offers Tomoki drinks and a lending ear to all his sex troubles since Haru is a sex pro himself. Tomoki takes Haru's offer, and when he divulges his fear of sex to Haru, Haru readily offers himself to Tomoki as his practice partner to overcome his fear of sex.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Internet Love!
mangas.titleNative: インターネット・ラヴ!
mangas.description:
Tenma's morning routine begins with checking the social networking account of Uno, an ordinary Korean guy. Tenma thought he knew Uno as well as anyone, until he is shocked to find out that Uno has a girlfriend.



(Source: Shodensha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Muchuu ni Naru yo
mangas.description:
Towa and Yamato are twins with very different personalities. Yamato is loud, outgoing, and regularly gets into fights, while Towa is quiet, studious, and always suffering the after effects of Yamato's actions because he's always being mistaken for his brother.



On his way home from school one day, Towa was getting beaten up by the school gang who had mistaken him for Yamato, when he met Mitsuru, a mysterious delinquent. For some reason, Mitsuru can tell the twins apart...

mangas.title: A House Near The Station With A Wizard
mangas.titleNative: 駅近魔法使い付き一戸建て,
mangas.description:
In a real estate agency of an ever so slightly odd shopping street works Tsukasa Amamiya, who has been subject to daily, passionate advances by wizard and potential tenant Mitsuki. After being introduced to several properties that match his criteria, Mitsuki ultimately lays down one final, tricky condition: "If you come live with me, Tsukasa, then I'll decide on this place."
Tsukasa, hoping to prevail in the situation he finds himself in, lies and says he has a partner. But from then on, things around him start taking a turn for the weird...?
A mysterious tale of love between an overly-confident wizard and a seemingly aloof - but secretly sentimental - guy with glasses.

mangas.title: I'm More Than My Face
mangas.description:
For as long as he can remember, the people around Hiroto have always liked him for his face. But being so recognizable isn't always a good thing, so now that he's in college Hiroto would rather hide his face and shut the entire world out. With his masks, it seems like his classmate and only consistent "acquaintance" Mabuchi is doing the same thing, but will he ever get to know the reason why?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: His Alpha Test Subject Helping Him Through His Heat
mangas.titleNative: 被験者αの強制発情記録
mangas.synonyms: The Record of the Testee Alpha and the Heating Omega
mangas.description:
On his first day at his grandfather's pharmaceutical company, Leo Shindo (alpha) meets an omega for the first time ever. The only omega in the company, Amasawa is developing a heat suppressant that would work both on alphas and omegas. Leo passes out from Amasawa's good looks after exchanging a few words with him when they first meet. Leo finds himself smitten with the attractive Amasawa, but is shocked when Amasawa, who usually draws a line between his work and personal life, asks Leo to help test his new suppressant in their private time.



This omegaverse rom-com features a serious-but-hot puppy dog alpha and a never-before-featured laidback-yet-flustered omega!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru: Bangai-hen - Kimi to Aruku Yoru
mangas.titleNative: 君の夜に触れる 番外編 ～君と歩く夜～
mangas.synonyms: 君の夜に触れる 番外編読切 ～君と歩く夜～

mangas.title: My Beloved Bathroom Slut
mangas.titleNative: 愛しのユーレイは、トイレで待つ
mangas.synonyms: 愛しいトイレのビッチくん。
mangas.description:
"Have you heard that rumor about the man's restroom? It's haunted by the ghost of Hanako who appears there at midnight." It's the middle of the night. Seto is an office worker who ventures into a supposedly haunted restroom in the building where he works to see if the rumors about the bathroom ghost are true, but... "Would you like to do... dirty things with me?" Much to his surprise, Hanako turns out to be the ghost... of a man! "If I don't satisfy my sexual urges, I won't be able to move on." Seeing how sad the ghost looks, confused Seto succumbs to his charm... and ends up having sex with him! "Please, use this. Let me move on to the other side." What is the true identity of the slutty bathroom ghost who seduces Seto...!?



(Source: Bookwalker)

mangas.title: Baits
mangas.description: Soonam's always considered himself normal, albeit a bit sheltered. His world consists of regular humans and "hybrids," a half-animal, half-human species that possesses the characteristics of the animal they are. Hybrids are faster, more sensitive, more powerful than regular humans, and the higher up they are in the food chain, the more privileged they are. But all that's got nothing to do with Soonam, right? Well, turns out that's not the case, and Soonam's world turns completely upside down when he encounters Siyeol, an apex predator hybrid in the same department. Siyeol keeps telling him he smells like rabbit, like prey, and he tells him of bigger plans in motion with Soonam at the very center…

mangas.title: The Idol likes to be Touched.
mangas.titleNative: アイドル様は、触られたい。
mangas.description:
"Right there, touch me more..." Haru is an idol who unless he is given pleasure by being touched by a stranger grows frustrated and is unable to function properly in his daily life. One day while he is enjoying some train-groper play, a younger man he's never met before interrupts at the very worst time!! He tells the man he needs to make amends for cutting off the pleasure he was feeling. Under the young man's inexperienced hands, he begins to feel oh so good......!! He wants the young man to make him feel even more pleasure and their encounters soon escalate!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Malicious Butler's Erotic Training - I Can't Oppose This Sadist
mangas.titleNative: 腹黒執事のエロい教育～ドSなコイツに逆らえない
mangas.description:
"You're being forced, but you still feel good. What a pervert."



A new butler, Toudou, appears before a rich college student, Akito. Akito worked the previous butler hard. He's planning to use Toudou as he pleases too, but when he says something unreasonable, it doesn't work on him! If anything, Toudou says, "It's time for your training," and pushes him against the wall while rubbing against his crotch with his knee. Being pushed and rubbed hard, Akito can't prevent his body from twitching. "Could it be that you feel good?" He keeps rubbing him while saying that annoying statement. Before he knew it, his underwear had become wet...!?



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kashikomarimashita, Destiny: Answer
mangas.titleNative: かしこまりました、デスティニー ~Answer~
mangas.description: Continuation of Kashikomarimashita, Destiny.

mangas.title: Neuromance
mangas.description:
"I've been looking for you all my life, but you...you don't remember me?" Within the back alleys of futuristic Jin-gwang district, Kangtae is the ultimate street fighter and task rabbit; an enhanced human with animalistic abilities, he is able to accomplish things most people find impossible. But these powers come with a cost: just like his bestial counterparts, Kangtae is forced into ruts when his wild side takes over. To make matters worse, Kangtae runs into mysterious-yet-alluring Rion—a Virtual World designer who claims to have known him in his youth. As the two explore their history together, they discover a romance nouveau only possible in this new age of humanity...



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes three side story chapters.

mangas.title: You're All Mine Tonight
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Sleep with You Tonight
mangas.description:
Kanzaki is your typical businessman: He's stoic, dependable, and respected by all of his subordinates. But he has a secret he can't tell anyone: Five years ago, he became involved with a male sex worker named Nagi. The more nights they spent together, the more lust gave way to love, and Kanzaki hasn't been able to get Nagi off his mind since. After being sent to work abroad, Kanzaki returns to Japan and meets one of his new subordinates—a young man named Futagami, who looks exactly like Nagi. As the part of Kanzaki's past that was once frozen in time begins to thaw, can the two men find their way back toward each other, or will the passionate nights they spent together remain a thing of the past?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Family Simulation!!
mangas.titleNative: ふぁみりーしゅみれーしょん!!
mangas.synonyms: Micro Tan'i de Kimi ga Suki!!
mangas.description:
Graduate student Asahi suddenly has to care for his sister's five-year-old son, Masaki. Asahi barely has enough money to buy food for the two of them, but while in the supermarket, he bumps into Sora, his childhood friend. Although they haven't seen each other in six years, Sora offers to help out. He ends up moving in with Asahi and Masaki, and so begins their life of playing 'house'. However, Sora gets more and more touchy-feely as the days go by...... 'D-Don't! Masaki's in the next room......!!'

This manga contains the following works: 'Family Simulation!!' and 'I Love You At The Micro Level!!'

mangas.title: This Is Taking Brotherly Love Way Too Far
mangas.titleNative: これもブラコンのうちですか?
mangas.description:
Haruhi's sick of being bossed around by his younger stepbrother, Akito, and tells him he's had enough. Haruhi's too nice, though. Upon seeing Akito's sad expression, he tries to console his brother, only for Akito to kiss him right then and there! Haruhi's never seen Akito so desperate. Akito doesn't hate him!? ...But, why show it with a kiss!? Akito's behavior escalates, and Haruhi's still not sure what's going on in his brother's head. This is a romantic comedy about two stepbrothers in a taboo relationship. One's besotted yet stand-offish, and the other's entirely at his mercy!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Omae no Otouto Ore ni Choudai
mangas.titleNative: お前の弟オレにちょーだい
mangas.description:
Kouya, who runs a host club with his friend since middle school, Akitomo, can't help but think that Akitomo's younger brother, Yuuma, is cute! Kouya decided that Yuuma would be his boyfriend once he turned 20, but lately, Yuuma's been feeling distant...?! On the day of his 20th birthday, it was a huge shock for Yuuma to ask him to introduce him to a guy! He pushes Yuuma down saying, "Your first is obviously going to be me," just to instead be messed up and left panting by the virgin Yuuma!

Yuuma, mistakenly thinking that his beloved Kouya is a bitch dating his older brother, has sex with him, but it's actually Kouya's first time? The outcome of the misguided sex between two people with crushes on each other is...?

20yo virgin university student x 28yo host club manager

Devoted first loves that pass each other by intertwine in a sexy heart-pounding romantic comedy! ♪

mangas.title: Mr. Mitsuya's Planned Feeding
mangas.titleNative: 三ツ矢先生の計画的な餌付け。
mangas.synonyms: Mitsuya Sensei no Keikakuteki na Edzuke
mangas.description:
"This pounding in my chest is more than just admiration!?"



Tomoya Ishida is a newbie editor at fashion magazine Sophia Monthly. After his senior's sudden hospitalization, he's hastily assigned to collect a column manuscript from the famous culinary researcher Ayumu Mitsuya. He pays him a visit soon after, and to his surprise, finds an affable, older man who speaks in a Kyoto dialect. Being asked to wait, Tomoya is served a simple dish that entices his stomach, and soon he finds himself eagerly awaiting their next encounter!



(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

mangas.title: Shouta, Kimi wo Aishiteru!
mangas.titleNative: ショータ、君を愛してる！
mangas.description: One day a pure, naïve college student named Shouta, who can't part from his country bumpkin attitude finds a beautiful American man. Mysterious and overbearing, he takes away his very first kiss?!

mangas.title: Even Dogs Won't Eat Whats Spoilt
mangas.titleNative: 甘ったれは犬も食わない
mangas.description:
The exclusive top, Azuma, fell in love at first sight with Nishio, who joined their company mid-career. Although they were superior and subordinate, the two started dating. As it was Nishio's first time dating a man, Azuma decided "I'll bottom for you first" and bravely offered up his (anal) virginity?!

Compiled in the same volume, a marriage of two fathers?! A love comedy featuring a middle-school boy and girl in the midst of puberty getting caught up in their father's newlywed life.

mangas.title: Raising a Wolf
mangas.titleNative: オオカミを飼っています
mangas.description:
Ino, an expressionless and unsociable office worker, lives with a younger man who is in love with him like a dog with its master. Even though the two of them barely know each other, Taichiro suddenly volunteers himself when Ino and his colleagues put out a drunken call for candidates to be Ino's partner. Ino turns Taichiro down, but because Taichiro has no home to go back to, Ino offers to let him live with him. Taichiro is patient, and although he sometimes can be touchy and steadfast about his love for Ino, he makes sure never to do anything that Ino won't like. One day, after starting to come to terms with his own feelings for Taichiro and his boundless devotion, Ino falls into a suspiciously deep puddle and somehow enters a parallel world. He finds Taichiro there, but in this world, the two of them are complete strangers, and Taichiro's cold demeanor seems to be almost the complete opposite of the man Ino knows and loves...



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ore no Shitsuketa Doutei-chan
mangas.titleNative: オレのシツケた童貞ちゃん
mangas.description: "Don't shake your hips until I say "good", okay?" I'm a virgin who's being trained... every day. Katou, who once was a Bishounen (beautiful boy) Idol has grown to be a man now. He spends his university life hiding from the world, but he was spoken to by his former partner, Aki.

mangas.title: Kosuke's Flight Plan
mangas.titleNative: 榊くんのフライトプラン
mangas.synonyms: 榊昴祐的飛行員攻略計劃
mangas.description:
Kosuke is distressed by his failed love life. Working as a flight dispatcher, every day is hectic, causing the relationships with his boyfriends to turn sour. His pilot friend and work colleague, Ayumu, is a shoulder to lean on, and is also the only one that knows of Kosuke's sexual orientation. One night, mistaking Ayumu for his boyfriend, Kosuke embraces his friend, someone he treasures dearly, but never intended to cross that line with! What will become of their relationship!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Reframing
mangas.description: Yutaka is a designer who does remote work and hates the sun. In fact, the only sunshine he needs in his life is his old childhood friend, Akira, a shop clerk at a glasses shop with an ultra positive spirit. If only Akira knew how much Yutaka yearned for him... But what would that do? Akira is straight... A love story between a straight sweetheart and a successful designer who doesn't know how to open his heart!

mangas.title: Home, Sweet Home
mangas.titleNative: この場所で暮らしたら
mangas.description:
Yuki Wakura has graduated from high school and is now a college freshman.

As he sets out to live on his own, he unexpectedly bumps into a former classmate on his moving day.

He's stunned to discover that he's moving into an apartment that another young man has also rented. It's Shoma Yuki, a high school friend he had a secret crush on...! Just when Yuki has finally gotten over his old crush and decided to look for someone new...

They both have the name "Yuki", and that has confused the elderly landlords...



This is the story of a chance encounter that turns into home, sweet home for two lovebirds!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Cats And Magic Unravel With A Kiss
mangas.titleNative: 猫と魔法はキスでほどける
mangas.synonyms: Neko to Mahou wa Kiss de Hodokeru
mangas.description: Boring magic school student Lucas wakes up one morning with cat ears! Unable to resolve the powerful curse by himself, he turns to his childhood friend and student council member, Dylan, for help. Dylan has changed since childhood. He's now cold and arrogant, but something about the situation weighs on his mind. After some investigation, they discover that the only way to dispel the curse is to sleep with a man, and Dylan bluntly offers to do it.

mangas.title: Shijima no Tsuki
mangas.description:
In order to continue his high school education, Asaoka Miki separates from the person who raised him and returns to his parents' home. Since he has always been compared to his talented and social younger twin, Itsuki, he has a deep inferiority complex towards his twin brother. After meeting and falling in love with Takagi Kazuya, someone who is seven years older than him, Miki's world changed completely. Takagi's love and kindness melts Miki's stubborn heart, and not too long after, Miki's blind faith in Takagi intensifies. For Miki, that was his first once-in-a-lifetime love he's ever experienced.

However, the person Takagi's after isn't Miki, but the boy who harshly rejected him. With Miki, Itsuki's lookalike and replacement, in his hands, will Takagi suddenly close in on Itsuki again....?



A love story between a piece of scum and a brave young man who are a few years apart.

mangas.title: Hitotsu Shikanai Mono
mangas.description:
Haruhi feels insecure because his twin brother is so much more friendly, outgoing and popular compared to him, so he begins to spiral out of control, sleeping with strangers he meets at a bar. Another patron of a bar he frequents sees that he's in trouble and befriends him, and they gradually move from friends to lovers.



(Source: Mangago)

mangas.title: Akuma wa Tengoku ni Ikitakunai
mangas.titleNative: 悪魔は天国にイキたくないっ！
mangas.description: "You think I, a former lust demon, would let an angel love me?!" —After thousands of years, a former demon has reincarnated as a human, Aino Makoto. Though he retains his memories from his previous life, he has sealed his powers and lives as a good person. Suddenly, former angel and rival Minakata Yuu appears in front of Makoto, jokingly calling himself a "disciple of love". Minakata has no memory of his previous life, and has transformed into a complete playboy…Makoto is afraid to get involved with Minakata, but ends up taking him home to care for him after Minakata gets dead drunk. Minakata wakes up and Makoto is about to throw him out, when he sees Minakata's area is reacting and he's suddenly horny!? Don't mate with me…!! The overflowing love and sex from this former angel is too good, could this be…?!

mangas.title: Honjitsu wa Ohigara mo Yoku,
mangas.description:
Asakura Kai has come to the marriage ceremony of the man he once loved. By his side is his former highschool classmate and now sex friend, Iguchi Keisuke. Kai, who was nursing feelings which had no place to go at the time, was offered a relationship which was convenient for both of them by Keisuke.



Ten years have passed, with Kai unable to ask Keisuke about his true feelings. What are Keisuke's feelings, standing by my side right now…….? Touched by his kindness, Kai has fallen for Keisuke over the years, but he also can't bring himself to break off the comfortable relationship they have now.



In the never-stopping flow of time, I experience the end and beginning of love, with you. A sensitive story of overflowing desires.

mangas.title: Ichigo Can't Stop Blushing
mangas.titleNative: まっかなお顔のいちごくん
mangas.description:
Mamoru thought the blushing guy he invited to a one-night stand would be fresh-faced and innocent, but he was completely different in bed!



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes "Konya Kimi to Nemuritai (今夜君と眠りたい, I'd Like to Sleep With You Tonight)", "Kocchi Muite Bitch (こっち向いてビッチ, Look Over Here, Bitch)" and "Suki yo Suki yo mo Hodohodo ni (好きよ好きよもほどほどに, Keep Your Passion in Check)" and one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Seduction of the Deep Sleeper
mangas.description:
Toma Sugawa is a cool-headed, unsociable businessman. For some reason, he's not in a relationship, and he spends his life watching the days go by. One thing that has become a part of his daily routine, is waking up one of the tenants in his grandfather's apartment complex. That tenant is Kaoru Aida. He has countless alarms go off, and still doesn't wake up until Toma comes in to wake him. On top of that, he asks Toma to wake him up the next morning, without a lick of remorse. With an attitude like that, of course Toma is on the verge of snapping. But one day, Toma goes to wake him up as usual, and Kaoru, still sleepy, pushes him down?! Enjoy this clumsy, blooming love story between an inconsiderate guy and a guy still stuck on his ex!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Mahoutsukai wa Furete Hodokeru
mangas.titleNative: 魔法使いは触れて解ける
mangas.description:
Born between a human and a fairy, Liz was regarded as a heretic because he had the ability to absorb the magical power of the people who touched him. He was even isolated at the magic school he entered. By chance he meets Jill, a very strong mage. A miracle-like love story spun by two people who are not "ordinary" in a mysterious world.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Wife is an Alpha
mangas.description:
Two alpha husbands, in a world where anyone can get pregnant. Marriages between those of the same type are common in order to prevent bloodlines getting too mixed up, but even among alphas, there's still someone who is top dog. And where there's a top, there's a bottom...



The venerable Tachigami family is at risk of bankruptcy and falling apart, but are saved by marriage talks with the newly-risen Isaka family. The Tachigamis want support, and the Isakas want the power in a name...



For better or worse, Takaomi and Kazumasa are to be wed. And how lucky they are, because love blossoms between the two of them. Just as you would think everything is going great, though, it's back to the unforgettable problem... They both like to be on top!



(Source: Manga Club)


Includes prologue and epilogue.

mangas.title: Kimi to Unmei ni Tsuite no Hanashi ga Shitai
mangas.titleNative: 君と運命についての話がしたい
mangas.description:
Even if we're both betas and even if we're not a fated pair, it'll be fine. Our relationship won't change, ever.



Hibiki is a salaryman who has been living together with his high school sweetheart, Koushiro, for 10 years. When they had just met each other, they were convinced that they were a fated pair, but their gender tests revealed that they were both beta. Even though other gay couples can be blessed if they are a "fated pair," it vexes them they can't even hold hands in front of people. They tell themselves that if they love each other, all will be fine, but trivial things make them more anxious each day... But they hear about a misdiagnosis of the gender test one day...!?



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Life Plan of The End
mangas.titleNative: 人生計画オブジエンド
mangas.description:
Sosuke Miki is looking for a very specific kind of relationship. All he wants are fun and purely physical relationships without any commitment whatsoever - so what's he supposed to do when his sales department's highest seller, a younger guy named Tohru Kai, will stop at nothing to tie him down?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kawaii Inu wa Yoku Nureru
mangas.titleNative: かわいい犬はよく濡れる
mangas.description: Summer vacation is the best time for sex! Shihara, a university student, is working hard on his favorite professor's lectures and seminars. One day, they had a private lecture at the professor's home, and he gets overwhelmed and confesses his feelings to him...?

The pitcher Yuudai and the catcher Shoutarou have been childhood friends and battery-mates ever since they can remember. The third-years have retired from the baseball team, and now it's time for the the second-year players to step up and prepare for the Koushien tournament! However, just before the autumn tournament, Yuudai suddenly starts to have the yips, which threatens his spot on the team. After chasing the same dream and the same white ball for 10 years, their relationship becomes unsettled... Why is Yuudai feeling so uneasy?

mangas.title: Tokyo M Mesu Hard Boiled
mangas.titleNative: 東京Mメスハードボイルド
mangas.description: Neo Tokyo is a dangerous city full of conflict. A vagabond hit-man, Shin, gets caught up in the rampage of Keith, whom he's partnered with for a job, and has kinky sex with him!

mangas.title: The Love Alliance in Midnight Deep
mangas.titleNative: 真夜中ラブアライアンス DEEP
mangas.description:
1-2. Shouta X Hiroto (ショータ × ヒロト)

Crossdressing top X ex-straight guy!

Shouta is excited to be in a serious relationship, but at the same time he's worried. He decides to cement his relationship with Hiroto by making sure he's sexually satisfied, but then...!



3-4. Masaki X Hajime (まさき × はじめ)

Cheeky junior colleague X closeted lingerie fetishist!

Hajime is happily living his lingerie-loving life with his boyfriend Masaki, when out of nowhere his old friend Tooru shows up. Masaki is concerned, but Hajime convinces him to let him handle this on his own...



5. Yoshio X Tenma: Kiiroi Taiyou (ヨシオ × 天麻 ~黄色い太陽~, Yoshio x Tenma: The Amber Sun)

Gay bar bartender X tough Yakuza leader!

Toshio and Tenma see little of each other because they're busy with work. When Toshio pays a rare visit only for Tenma to fall asleep, Toshio feels a little sad. At the same time, he's tempted by his sleeping lover...



6. Atashi no Otoko (アタシのオトコ, My Man)



This is the second omnibus of love set around Bar Iberis, where all types of love are in full swing!



(Source: Renta!, edited)

mangas.title: Pinup Boy
mangas.description: Note: Published in Qpa Vols. 55, 57.

mangas.title: The Love Alliance in Midnight
mangas.titleNative: 真夜中ラブアライアンス
mangas.description:
1-2. Otoshiana ni Hamerarete (落とし穴にハメられて, Fallen Into a Trap)

Hiroto gets hit on by a cute girl, only she turns out to be a guy! A steamy story about a cross-dresser and a guy who likes to be controlled in bed.



3-4. Pinup Boy (ピンナップ・ボーイ)

Masaki works in a bar with a male-only clientele because the pay is good. However, he's uncomfortable at work and his co-worker, Hajime, is a bit of a jerk. What happens when Masaki discovers Hajime's secret...?



5. Yoru mo Hi mo Akenai (夜も日も明けない, Can't Go a Minute Without You)

Tenma is a rough-and-tumble high student who is constantly fighting with his friend, Yoshio. Growing bored of regular fights, they make a rule that the loser has to bottom for the winner!



6. After Alliance (アフターアライアンス, Midnight Love Alliance)



A love omnibus featuring all kinds of tastes, centered around Bar Iberis, a nightlife hangout.



(Source: Renta!, edited)

mangas.title: Rojiura no Ballad
mangas.description:
On a night when photographer Manabu felt desperate because his work wasn't going well, he found Iori passed out in a back alley.
Manabu was attracted to the bruised but strangely sexy Iori, and found himself snapping away.
When Manabu took him home, Iori tried to offer his body in exchange for his care.
Manabu was tempted, and as he devoured Iori's supple but bruised body, he began to experience a sense of elation and violent desires for the first time.
How far will Manabu's actions escalate?



(Source: &.Emo, translated)

mangas.title: Honey, Maple and More Sugar
mangas.description:
On an SNS-slash-dating site for gay men, Tsumugi posts pictures of his adorable handmade plush dolls as the popular crafter "Bee." Out of all his online followers, he gets along best with fellow crafter "Chitan☆" - his gushing fanboy on the feed and his sexy dom in the DMs! When Tsumugi gathers his courage and offers they meet offline, "Chitan☆" insists that his appearance might set him off - how bad of a face are we talking here?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Absolute Submission - Like Hell I'll Obey!-
mangas.titleNative: 絶対、服従命令～俺が言う事きくわけねェ！～
mangas.description: As the worst delinquent of his grade, Kikuma Teranishi is forced to change dorm rooms after breaking the school rules one too many times. Reluctantly entering his new room, he comes face to face with the dorm superintendent, Takasumi Uryuu, who stirs in him hitherto unknown feelings... Kikuma's body tingles, and he wants to take out his urges on Takasumi... What is going on? The next time Kikuma breaks the school rules, Takasumi lays down a ground rule that sparks their relationship: "If you obey, I'll reward you. If you don't, you get punished."

mangas.title: The Pure-Hearted Puppy and the Erotic Tattoo
mangas.titleNative: 純情ワンコと劣情タトゥー
mangas.description:
"...I was interested in your body from the start."


To prep for his role in his next movie, the young actor Suga visits a tattoo parlor where he meets Hariya the tattooist. Though he knows it's for taking his measurements, Suga's body burns with passion at Hariya's seductive touches and gaze soaking up every inch of him. Then, as if teasing him, Hariya pushes Suga down, saying "I just had to touch you to be sure in the end." Mouth violated by Hariya's hot lips and cold tongue piercing, Suga's ravished by a pleasure he's never felt before...!



(Source: Book Walker)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sit. Good Job.
mangas.titleNative: おすわり、よくできました
mangas.description:
Professional soccer player Itsuki and doctor Shuji are two popular tops at the local men's bar. They constantly clash due to their polar-opposite love styles. One day, when Itsuki finds himself in the bar after a lengthy sickness, Shuji takes care of him. In an attempt to sober Itsuki up, Shuji jokingly commands the other dom to sit. To his surprise, Itsuki drops to the ground. Itsuki isn't only baffled by his body's response to Shuji's commands, but by his desire to receive more of them...!!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Doku ni mo Naranai Propose
mangas.titleNative: 毒にもならないプロポーズ
mangas.description: Wedding planner, Aizawa, stays firm in having hot one-night stands and carefree sex-friends relationships. When approached with an "I like you" it seems he has an eternal rule to reject such bothersome man... or that's how it was supposed to be?! The cool Aizawa is being swayed by a younger puppy-like man?!

mangas.title: From Today on My Idol Will Be My Master
mangas.titleNative: 今日から推しに躾けられます
mangas.description: I want to be dominated by the national treasure-level Dom, Ryunosuke Shiba...! An acting boys' love story in a Dom/Sub universe appears!

mangas.title: Kedamono Arashi: Love me baby!
mangas.titleNative: ケダモノアラシ－Love me baby!－
mangas.description: In this world exist “normal” human beings and those with ears called “beasts.” Beasts have a unique body that experiences heats/ruts and pregnancy between the same sex is possible. Akira, a veterinary specialist, meets Sougo, a beast who has lived an arrogant life based on his instincts, and after many twists and turns, they become a couple. Akira and Sougo are blessed with three cute sons and are living a happy life, but one night, a sad-looking Kazuhisa visits the Kijima family.

mangas.title: Stuck Between a Sexy Rock and a Hard Friend
mangas.description:
For years now, Sakai's been nursing a crush on womanizer Nishimura. Every time Nishimura breaks up with a girl, he comes crying to Sakai, who hears him out... and in turn, has no choice but to "relieve" his stress and frustration by turning to his friend-with-benefits Kitada. One day, not long after Nishimura broke up with his girlfriend, Sakai sees him walking with a new one and can't contain his aggravation! As usual, he works out his feelings by getting with Kitada, but he forgot to lock the door, and Nishimura walks in, catching them in the act...!

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Midnight☆Dancer no Sakuryaku

mangas.title: Yes, My Destiny
mangas.titleNative: かしこまりました、デスティニー
mangas.description: The story tells of a stubborn young master and his loyal servant. Because of their statuses, their love story is at the mercy of fate. Aoi is the heir to his family, but due to some discord between him and his stepmother, he is forced to leave the house. And there to support him is his childhood butler, Miyauchi. After living his days being doted on and served, Aoi finds his position reversed, where he has to work all day. And what has supported him throughout this lifestyle is his unrequited love of 5 years for Jirou, the heir to the Saionji family, a leading automobile maker.

mangas.title: Sharing Little Kitty Nekoda
mangas.description:
Satoshi is a famous novelist under pressure to release another big hit. He consults his friend about having trouble sleeping and is then introduced to a sleep companion, Yoh, who stays with him. Things get naughty fast when his male sleep companion forces himself onto him. Satoshi's editor, Tatsumi, recognizes Yoh and instantly becomes jealous as he secretly has a crush on Satoshi. Despite the age gap, Satoshi is now stuck in a love triangle.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Scratch Blue
mangas.description:
Akito is a high school delinquent who is suffering from nightmares featuring his airhead childhood friend, Ryouta. Akito takes care of Ryouta during the day, but at night in his dreams Ryouta would sadistically blame him, "This is all your fault Acchan…" Will the memories of the past gradually engulf Akitoㅡ?!



(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: You Lied to Me
mangas.description:
Ken is a comic artist who works shut up in his room. His manga don't sell at all, but he has put all his faith into his childhood friend and editor, Yuuma. Though Yuuma holds Ken's utmost trust in his hands, he also has a secret...Ken and Yuuma desire every last bit of each other. A love story that is both pure and utterly dark.



(Source: NTT Solmare)



Notes:

- Original serialization ran for five chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 2 and 3 were combined as Chapter 2.

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Wagamama mo Kimi no Tame Nara Ikura demo
mangas.titleNative: わがままもキミのためならいくらでも
mangas.description:
Playboy omega Mahiro wants to live his life to the fullest before the onset of his first heat. When Mahiro discovers that the shy, awkward alpha Yoneya likes him, he decides to fool around with him. But little by little he begins to think Yoneya's personality is attractive. However, Yoneya is the son of an elite alpha family, different from the world which Mahiro inhabits.



Note: Includes the one-shot "Itetsuku Kosen".

mangas.title: I Didn't Ask You to Eat Me!
mangas.titleNative: 俺を食えとは言ってない
mangas.description:
"I want to touch you so bad, Mr. Inaba."



With a dream to live in a house with his personal custom-designed kitchen, outside of work, a guy indulges in making dinner for his fellow dormmates... Said Inaba is a long-tenured employee ? also known as the "Kitchen Boss". A free-spirited new employee, Kazama, moves into the dorm. And now, he can't get him out of his mind!! For the sake of Kazama ? who found it difficult to eat in large groups ? Inaba separates his meals from the rest of their colleagues, chatted with and took care of him. At the same time, they gradually became close companions... But hey, why is he suddenly being pushed down on the bed!? Isn't this a little too close for comfort!?!? A secret romance between two businessmen in a corporate dorm!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Boku ga Shachiku wo Yametekara
mangas.titleNative: 僕が社畜をやめてから
mangas.synonyms: When I Quit Being a Corporate Slave
mangas.description:
Yonezawa is a gay man who used to work at a black company.

I'm getting a fresh start and having sex for the first time?!

I picked up a hot guy at a cruising spot!

mangas.title: Intellectual Yakuza Who Embraces, Loves and Won't Let Go!
mangas.titleNative: インテリヤクザは抱いて愛して、離さない！
mangas.description:
Kaede was fired from his job at a restaurant for an unreasonable cause. But Rito, who looks like an ordinary salaryman (but is actually a yakuza), happened to be there and offers Kaede a job at his bar. At Kaede's welcome party, Rito gets drunk... and Kaede takes the dazed Rito home. As he puts Rito to bed, Rito pulls him in and kisses him...! The deep kisses that entwine their tongues melt their inhibitions and heat up their bodies. Kaede gets an erection just from kissing, as they drown in the hot, melting pleasure...? Adult love between an intellectual yakuza and a hard-working guy!



(Source: caramel, translated)

mangas.title: Moto Yakuza ga BL Sakka ni Nattarashii
mangas.titleNative: 元ヤクザがBL作家になったらしい。
mangas.description:
A fearless Yakuza named Sudou decides to leave his life of crime when he finds out his clan is disbanding. However, his strong sense of justice and huge tattoos interfere with this goal, and he struggles to keep any job he finds. That is, until an ex-underling gives him the idea to start writing manga.

After becoming a big hit on social media, a company scouts him, and he... somehow ends up working in the BL department?!

Because this ex-Yakuza doesn't know the first thing about BL, a cool-headed, sadistic editor starts to coach him — thus beginning a tough, hands-on training regime...

mangas.title: You Turned 20 And Now You're Mine
mangas.titleNative: 二十歳過ぎれば俺のモノ
mangas.description:
Akito is having a great time in college, going from one party to another. On the eve of his 20th birthday, he was looking forward to spending a fun night with a pretty girl, but he wakes up to realize he's in a bed he doesn't recognize! And, who does he see but his childhood friend, Izumi, approaching him! Akito is even more puzzled when Izumi tells him that they're in their new home. A love story between a straight, happy-go-lucky flirt and his childhood friend who's had feelings for him since preschool!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Baby ★ Love Sitter
mangas.titleNative: ベイビー★ラブシッター
mangas.description: Ever since leaving home, all Akira ever knew was how to be a pretty amazing "male host," aka a call boy. So when he opens the door to a good-looking, well-off salaryman's apartment, it doesn't take long for him to get down to business - but why is this cutie suddenly introducing him to his kid?

mangas.title: Teruteru Bouzu Tere Bouzu
mangas.titleNative: てるてる坊主照れ坊主
mangas.synonyms: He Makes the Buddhist Priest Shy
mangas.description:
Juntoku is a priest who inherited his family's temple, and the one he doesn't want to see the most right now… Appears during a monthly sutra copying session. A big, handsome man named Hasegawa Michi.



That's because Michi was a high school classmate, who then became his close friend, and then… the one he loved. And yet, whether he knows of Juntoku's feelings or not, Michi suddenly reduces the distance between them…!?



An easygoing grill restaurant owner x stoic beauty priest forbidden love!



(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

mangas.title: Tsukiyo wa Ecchi na Okubyou Ookami
mangas.titleNative: 月夜はえっちな臆病オオカミ
mangas.description:
In this world, humans and monsters live harmoniously.



Chi Takuma Tsuda, who has been fooled by her because of his bulkiness, meets Yuta Ogami, a human wolf.
Yuta was shunned by the strength of his power, but since their hobbies matched, they became friends at once.
It was a full moon when Tsuda invites Yuta to his house.
Yuta lost his identity due to his abnormal body and attacked Tsuda-!?



A love story of a giant human x a cowardly werewolf

(Source: Japanese publisher, translated)

mangas.title: Kamisama wa XX ga Osuki
mangas.description:
Kei Tsukishiro was lost in the mountains. What appeared there was a mountain god, Tenpyo Miju Ukajin (commonly known as Tama).
Tama, who felt that his magical power had declined due to the decrease in the number of believers due to depopulation, approached Kei to gain vitality by having sex with him ...! ??



An exotic love between a healthy and savvy mountain god and a kind-hearted young man who wants to regain their magical power through human interaction!


(Source: Media Soft, translated)

mangas.title: Oh, My Dear!
mangas.description:
This is a one-shot focusing on Mikami's Older brother (from "Mikami to Sato wa Mada Yamashikunai") and his childhood friend.

From Magazine Be x Boy 2019-01 issue.

mangas.title: Mikami to Sato wa Mada Yamashikunai
mangas.titleNative: 三上と里はまだやましくない
mangas.description:
Sato is my roommate, and also my best friend. How come I feel like kissing him? I have to stop falling for...



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kimi ni Koisuru Hazu ga Nai
mangas.titleNative: 君に恋するはずがない
mangas.description:
Kitaoji, an elite salaryman, yearns for a shoujo manga-like love. But he's paired up with Arima, a guy he doesn't get along with. Will Kitaoji's earnest wish come true one day…?


Note: Contains the side story "Kitaooji ga Ore ni Yume wo Misugiteiru Ken ni Tsuite" (北大路が俺に夢を見すぎている件について) and the extra "Arima Kyoudai no Hanashi" (有馬姉弟の話).

mangas.title: The Student Council President Wants to be a Manservant
mangas.titleNative: 生徒会長は下僕になりたい
mangas.description:
"If anyone were to see me like this, they'd think I was a total perv."



The sound of the camera shutter echoes in the student council room. Blindfolded, hands and feet bound, chained to a desk... Aroused and panting sweetly, Student Council President Kanade Sanhoin's a narcissist who gets off hard on this kind of fantasy role play. He's into modeling for adult video covers, and today's no exception as he's drunk on his own attractiveness. Things get a little hairy, though, when his lost, adult-photo-filled smart phone is picked up and returned by an aggressive younger classmate!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Imitation Mate
mangas.titleNative: イミテーションメイト
mangas.description:
"I just wanted to make an alpha like you pant."

An omegaverse story where an alpha from an elite family who hates omegas meets an alpha who is too carefree. Tsukasa is the ideal alpha: he was raised in an elite family and now works in his father's company. One day, he happens to meet Yoshiki, a fellow alpha and former high school classmate, who he once saw as a rival. However, he is surprised to discover that the aloof Yoshiki is living a carefree, unprofessional life that is completely atypical for an alpha. They go out drinking to celebrate their reunion, and Yoshiki has a few too many, prompting Tsukasa to help him get home. That's when Yoshiki seizes the chance to entice Tsukasa: "Being with another alpha can be fun, too."

Even though he is against it at first, Tsukasa eventually gives in to the frenzy of pleasure and gets carried away in a relationship that isn't just a one-time thing. He figures that he can stop this kind of infertile relationship anytime he wants...That is, until he notices changes within his body...

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Kojirase Junai Monster
mangas.titleNative: こじらせ純愛モンスター
mangas.description:
"A collaboration where you act out the scenarios I write! In other words, sex?!"



Satake, a screenwriter and casual stalker, hides his identity while chasing after his middle school classmate, Yoshiya, a rising young actor. One day, the video game Satake worked on is set for a drama adaptation, with Yoshiya playing the main character.



While Satake's excited to get up close and personal with his favorite actor (person), it turns out Yoshiya actually remembers him. And to top it all off, Yoshiya gives him a blowjob out of the blue?! A pure and erotic love session between a broody otaku and a bright young actor!

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

mangas.title: Under My Skin
mangas.synonyms: Under My Skin 隱於此身皮囊下
mangas.description:
"How did you manage to hide this lewdness under that suit?" Kudo is a successful elite office worker, but he's always been regretting he didn't know real love. When he meets younger - but daring and intriguing - carpenter Sato, he finds himself unable to resist the pleasure of being possessed by a man, even though, as a supposedly straight man, he feels he should find it demeaning. But, Sato doesn't hide that he's serious about Kudo, and pushes him to go one step beyond the tentative, fake relationships he's tried to build with women until now...?! A grown-up first love story, vividly awaking the feelings you discover when you seriously fall for someone for the first time in your life.



(Source: futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Quiet Life Crisis
mangas.titleNative: クワイエットライフクライシス
mangas.description: On a whim, older salaryman Chihiro is swept up by Taiji, a massage parlor manager in his 20s offering happy ending massages. But after leaving his wallet at the parlor, Chihiro ends up with Taiji as a housemate! What's more, Taiji begins helping Chihiro with prostate massages as a form of payment. What fate awaits these two?

mangas.title: Carnal Desire Overflow -More Than Best Friends, Not Quite Boyfriends-
mangas.titleNative: 劣情オーバーフロー～親友以上、彼氏未満～
mangas.description:
Yoji Tsuchiya's an omega aggravated by his love for Jin Arumi, a beta.

He hopes that one day, he and Jin will be more than best friends... but for the time being, he'll do anything to protect the status quo.
Yoji spends most of his time getting through the gauntlet that is Jin's innocent teasing. One day, though, Yoji goes into heat right in front of Jin...!

He doesn't want Jin to hate him... but... maybe he can use this to his advantage... An omega's true nature wavering somewhere between friendship and desire.

What's waiting for the two once they cross that line...!?

mangas.title: How to Make a Beta Fall in Love With an Omega Like Me
mangas.titleNative: Ωの俺がβと初恋を叶える方法
mangas.description:
It doesn't matter if we can't even become mates! What is the fate of an omega who loves a beta?



Kouichi was born to a family with alpha lineage and is pressured every day by his father to mate with a capable alpha to produce an heir. Kouichi's rock is his childhood friend, a beta named Hiromu. He's always liked him since they were kids, but when considering his family and the fact that he's an omega, he hasn't told Hiromu his feelings.



Meanwhile, when his heat starts, Kouichi masturbates to fantasies of doing it with Hiromu. Disgusted by himself, he takes out his anger on Hiromu, who worries about him. In desperation, he decides that he should just mate with a random alpha and decides to be held by a man who comes near him!? On the other hand, Kouichi's father arbitrarily decides to go forward with betrothing him to an alpha...



(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Nishuume no Koi
mangas.description:
Yamamoto was in love with Minowa, but never confessed to him. After meeting again at a high school reunion, they get drunk and go to a love hotel in the spur of the moment. But when Yamamoto wakes up, he finds himself in his old home, ten years in the past! While he needs to find a way to get back to the present, Yamamoto also wants to lay his regrets to rest.



"This time, I'll say what I couldn't say on the day of the school festival..."



(Source: East Press, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: All I Think About Is You
mangas.titleNative: ただまっすぐに君を想う
mangas.synonyms: You're All That's on My Mind
mangas.description: For as long as he can remember, Kanade had always been with his two best friends - Souma, the popular, cheerful all-rounder, and Yuuji, who's a bit rougher around the edges. They promised to always be together, but the closer they get to graduation, the more that seems impossible...

mangas.title: Good Night, My Little Bird
mangas.titleNative: おやすみ、いとしい小鳥さま
mangas.description: In a world inhabited by both humans and a race born with brilliant, feathered wings, Shu, a human, works at the family estate of the shy and reclusive Rai, a young winged man who struggles to get along with those around him. When Shu accidentally glimpses Rai crying in his sleep, he makes it his mission to get to know Rai better. Meanwhile, Rai discovers the egg of a winged being abandoned outside his home. To everyone's shock, Rai declares that he will raise the hatchling himself—with the caveat that Shu helps him! What will become of the pair's blossoming relationship now that there's a baby in the mix?!

mangas.title: Don't Eat Too Much! -I Picked up an Incubus!?
mangas.titleNative: 喰べすぎ禁止！～拾った男はインキュバス！？～
mangas.description: Mashiro Shimazaki is a 23-year-old college student and he's got the worst luck in the world. He gets mistaken for a groper on the train, a girl asks him out thinking he's someone else... He just can't catch a break. He even ends up stepping on a frighteningly-beautiful "incubus" on his way home......! The incubus - calling himself Nijo - uses unworldly powers to draw Mashiro into seductive pleasures to quench his "hunger." Nijo's tongue drains Mashiro of his strength and he touches Mashiro in places he's never been touched before... With this arrogant incubus and Mr. Unlucky shacking up together, let the pleasures begin!

mangas.title: Happy Ending Kuso Kurae
mangas.titleNative: ハッピーエンドくそ喰らえ
mangas.description:
When Ume was five years old, he fell in love at first sight with his next-door neighbor, Hara-chan. From then on, 20 years has passed, and Ume has found himself becoming a sex friend of his unrequited love. However, Hara-chan's actions and feelings towards Ume have slowly become even more confusing??



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Man on the Other Side
mangas.description:
Sano, who can't seem to connect with anyone at all - not his family, not his coworkers - turns to SNS instead. One day, he decides to finally meet up with one of his mutual followers, "S." His Internet friend turns out to be Narumi, a handsome young actor whose popularity recently shot through the roof! Although Narumi's behavior seems to hint at something bubbling beneath the surface, Sano can't shake off the feeling that he's probably being toyed around with... An emotional, heart-piercing BL between a handsome actor and a salaryman who doesn't do communication.

(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I Fell in Love with Him at First Sight
mangas.titleNative: 恋は語るに、落ちるもの。
mangas.description:
"I've already loosened my ass up…"

College student Ise Natsume may look like an ikemen, but he's just a silent person with a lifeless face. Even though he has only a few friends, let alone lovers, he falls in love with someone he just met. That person is Amano Haru, a classmate who's cute, friendly, and expressive, the exact opposite of Natsume.



As he watches Haru from a distance like a stalker, his friend decides gives him a warning: "That guy has no morals. He's a pleasure seeker who will do anything. In other words, he's a bitch!"



"There's no way someone as cute as him would do that…" is what Natsume believed at first until Haru intrudes into his home and tells him, "They found out that I was three-timing them, so let me stay over~!" After Natsume reflexively pins him down and they have sex, they end up becoming sex friends. Natsume doesn't want just the pleasure, he wants to date Haru, but Haru doesn't agree……



A pure love story about how a slow to mature ikemen and a cute playboy go from being sex friends to lovers.

mangas.title: Kami Ato ni Kiss
mangas.description:
Life is going well for Hidaka. He has good interpersonal relationships, has a nice face and is entrusted with a big project. His life is set on easy mode, hiding behind a facade of his prince-like appearance. That is until one day, Tachibana, a handsome and elite junior joins the company and finds out about Hidaka's true nature! With a devious smile, Tachibana successfully lures Hidaka in with drinks and they end up in bed?!


"Can we keep seeing each other if we're fuck buddies?" A bite mark is the proof of submission? Cunning Elite S Junior x Charlatan Beauty Salary Man.



(Source|: LiQulle, translated and edited)



Chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: Boku no Barber e Youkoso
mangas.titleNative: 僕のバーバーへようこそ
mangas.description: On the wedding day of the best friend he's always been in love with, Iga decided to go to a barber shop to get a long overdue hair cut. A story about a barber and a salaryman with no confidence.

mangas.title: Negative
mangas.description:
The three of us were always together... Until the day we graduated, when I turned down his affections. But it turns out, behind my back they were... "Sea of Regret" and "Beneath the Surface" feature a love triangle between childhood friends that opens old wounds. Next is "Piercings," a story that begins with the allure of gleaming metal... Then there's the new-age style "Restart," and the yaoi story from a female perspective, "We Are the Third Wheel." This is a collection of "negative"-themed short stories showcasing some of Harada's best work!

(Source: Renta!)



1. Koukai no Umi (後悔の海, Sea of Regret)

2. Suimenka (スイメンカ, Beneath the Surface)

3. Pierce Hole (ピアスホール, Piercings)

4. Restart (リスタート)

5. Watashitachi wa Byplayer (わたしたちはバイプレーヤー, We Are the Third Wheel)

mangas.title: This Love is Coming in on the Express Train! My Sexy Train Attendant
mangas.titleNative: この恋、特急列車でまいります！～俺のえっちな駅員さん
mangas.synonyms: 這份戀情，將以特快車送達！～我的煽情站務員
mangas.description:
"Shall I...help you get off?"



Mr. Ameyama is a train station employee whose secret pleasure is to check the ticket of Mr. Hakaze, a "delightful prince" who comes to the station every day. His heart raced plenty enough just from getting to talk to him a little... One day, after becoming his drinking buddy, he ended up going over to his house! As usual, Mr. Hakaze was dazzling, handsome, and smelled great...so, of all things, Mr. Ameyama got an erection. Noticing that, Mr. Hakaze took him into his arms from behind and started stroking it with his fingers...!?



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: One Room Angel
mangas.titleNative: ワンルームエンジェル
mangas.description:
There are a lot of things that Kouki doesn't have—no hobbies, no friends, no lover, no stable job, and no will to live. So when a random tussle with some kids gets him stabbed, he thinks maybe this is finally his ticket out of this crappy life. But just as he's about to pass out he sees a beautiful "angel"... How is Kouki supposed to cope when less than a month later, he's mysteriously healed, has astronomical bills to pay, and suddenly has the same beautiful angel as his amnesiac roommate?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Secret Love
mangas.description:
Shiba Hall is one of the dorms usually reserved for the student activists group 'Rebirth' at Tokyo Shintei University. Yamato and Aki are dormmates of the said hall and are in a secret relationship. They've had their room to themselves up until the present, that is. With a new school year coming, more students have applied to the dorm, and now, they have to share their room with the upcoming students. Due to their busy schedule and organization's duties, their trysts take a back seat, which frustrates Yamato to no end. When the pair almost gets caught due to Yamato unable to control his frustrations, Aki becomes distant, and Yamato is at a loss. Is it all over for them now?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Retro BL
mangas.description:
Taishou romance, unfastened hakama, love and unnoticed postwar fraternity...
A BL of disheveled men in a tainted, bewitching world.



Cover illustration: Mayama Rika

1. Hako no Naka no Ittousei (箱の中の一等星) by Shimaji

2. Himegoto Renbo (秘事恋慕, Secret Love) by Tokishiba

3. Kusuri mo Sugireba Koi to Naru (薬も過ぎれば恋となる) by Haruta

4. Kawataredoki no Yume (彼は誰時の夢) by Mayama Rika

5. Haru ni Shitataru (春に滴る) by Yukimichi Ouji

6. Koi no 100-mankai no KO (恋の100万回のKO) by Mushiba

7. Ano Midnight (あのミッドナイト) by Syundei

8. Akame no Nie, Kami no Akari (紅目の贄、神の灯) by Hareya Umako

mangas.title: Wait, I Love You
mangas.description: Shinozaki Haruto is a successful Tokyo stylist and the boyfriend of up-and-coming actor Kuga Aoi. In spite of their busy schedules, they do their best to make time for each other. When Aoi shares that he's been cast as the star in an upcoming movie being filmed in Hokkaido, Haruto is thrilled for his lover, yet sad at the prospect of spending three months apart. Only minutes after hearing the news, though, Haruto receives his own offer to fill-in as a hair and make-up artist for the same movie Aoi is starring in! Will they be able to keep their relationship a secret? Or will working in such close proximity expose their love to the world?

mangas.title: Your Butt Fetish Is a Pain in My Ass
mangas.titleNative: 尻フェチなんかに好かれてたまるか
mangas.synonyms: Your Butt Fetish is a Pain in My Ass
mangas.description:
Spring. What was supposed to be the beginning of an exciting university life began with a big butt attracting trouble!? On his first day living in the dorms, Amamiya is groped by a pervert on the train, and is rescued by a strong hand. But the moment that hand unexpectedly touches his butt, he moans sweetly......!? Shocked, Amamiya runs away without thanking them. "I have to forget about it......" As he thinks this, the person he sees again at the dorm is......! "To think I want to touch a man's butt......" "I'm a man, yet I get aroused when my butt is touched......" One man with a butt fetish awakened by the luxurious feel, and another with unwavering insecurity about said butt!! Who's to blame for their confusing feelings?



(Souce: Renta!)

mangas.title: Hana Ikeru Doutei-kun
mangas.description:
Tsujido Ei, who is a flower arranger, has struggled living with his step-brother, Natsuki, who he has strong feelings for. But trying to be the "Good Younger Brother" is starting to become harder as Natsuki keeps feeling skin on skin. Out of no where Natsuki in just underwear, hugs onto me, he smells so amazing. "As your older brother, I'll take the responsibility of protecting you..." wait is this a delusion?!


A love comedy that makes the family relationship go crazy!!


(Source: Manga.club)

mangas.title: Countdown to Yes
mangas.titleNative: 親友の「同棲して」に「うん」て言うまで
mangas.synonyms: Shinyu no "Dousei Shite" ni "Un" te iumade
mangas.description: Meet Wataru, an open book who wears his heart on his sleeve, and Minato, a man who always comes across as cool, calm, and collected. Though they're polar opposites, their shared love of photography brings them together in high school, and they become such good friends that they decide to rent a place together in college. It's only when Minato moves across the country for work after graduation that Wataru realizes he's been harboring romantic feelings for the stoic gentleman this whole time. So when they reunite three years later, Wataru hopes they'll be able to reconnect as friends... but now it's Minato who seems to have his sights set on romance! Friends or lovers - which will they choose? The countdown to their final decision is on!

mangas.title: Marriage to Kitsune-sama
mangas.description:
Every few decades, the town of Hokutochou sends a human up the mountain to marry one of the fox spirits who reside above them–and Inaho has always longed for that role. When he comes of age, he ascends to his new home and meets his handsome new husband: a kitsune lord named Subaru. Subaru has been watching Inaho for a long time and is pleased to receive his new spouse. But before this supernatural marriage can enter its honeymoon stage, Inaho learns that Subaru is stuck with an unfortunate curse. This fox spirit wants to eat up his beloved: literally! Can Inaho and Subaru find a way to break the curse and save their relationship?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Juuou Heika to Sunakaburi no Hanayome
mangas.titleNative: 獣王陛下と砂かぶりの花嫁
mangas.description:
Just as Sunakaburi was almost killed by slave traders, he was saved by a snow leopard, the Beast King. Sunakaburi, who did not belong because of his different fur color, was told by the king that he was his "destined mate," and was given beautiful clothes, a soft bed to sleep in, and delicious food to eat instead of leftovers. The king even gave Sunakaburi a lovely name, "Kouran." Overjoyed, Kouran wants to be of use to the king, but Kouran doesn't really know what a "destined mate" is...



(Source: Gentosha, translated)

mangas.title: When The Fur Flies
mangas.titleNative: もふもふ化かし愛日記
mangas.description:
A long time ago, there was a fox and a raccoon who were always mean to each other.
Despite quarreling all the time, they turned into humans and moved in together. Decades later...
The fox is now a bartender at a transgender bar, and the raccoon is mooching off him. They bicker just as much as before, but they have passionate make-up sessions afterwards...



(Source: Renta!)



Note: includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Will a Guy Who Likes Cats Fall in Love with a Guy with Cat Eyes?
mangas.titleNative: 猫好き男子はネコ目オトコと恋に落ちるのか?
mangas.description:
Zenya Kitataka is a college student who grew up surrounded by animals (fluffiness). He hasn't been able to touch anything fluffy since he started living alone and spends his days feeling frustrated. One day, he encounters Takeru Nekoya on campus, who has cat ears coming out of his head. Was it perhaps a hallucination caused by the lack of fluffiness in his life...? When he gives in to the temptation and touches the cat ears, Takeru blushes and pushes him down!! He finds himself unable to stop because the rich deep kisses and feelings of ecstasy are just so good...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Taking Ritsu From Nagisa
mangas.titleNative: 眠れぬ夜は奪いに来てね
mangas.description:
Ritsu's always had a special someone since he was a kitten. That special someone was his kind-hearted owner, Nagisa. To Nagisa, Ritsu's his beloved, irreplaceable cat... Or so Ritsu thought, until he walked in on Nagisa showing someone else his love. He runs away from home out of shock and meets Senju, a stray cat. Senju tells Ritsu he'll make him forget Nagisa. To top things off, he promises Ritsu he'll be his first when his heat comes... Just who the heck is this cat!? This is a comic about a doting prince-like well-endowed cat and a naive and sheltered cat being consensually taken from his owner!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Only Doggy
mangas.titleNative: マイ オンリー ドギー
mangas.description:
Koyabashi may not know how to deal with people, but he does know how to sell sweets - and as the best salesman in sweets company Inujirushi, his talent could be the biggest help to their slowly dying pet food subsidiary. He may have a childhood fear of dogs, but that's definitely not going to get in the way of his work...right!?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Saenai Oji-san to Ore-sama Yankee-kun
mangas.titleNative: 冴えないおじさんと俺様ヤンキー君
mangas.description:
Subaru, a short-tempered young man, is walking one day when he casually saves a dull-looking man from trouble. The older man, two decades his senior, smiles and tells Subaru he's a good boy. For the first time in his life, Subaru is smitten! Even after they part, Subaru can't stop thinking about him... is this really happening?!

(Source: Nebula Club, translated)

mangas.title: Himono, Tokodoki, Shanairenai
mangas.description:
Kimura is well-known for being a 'perfect man', but he has a secret that no one knows. In truth, he is a man that has withered like dried fish, or what you call- a devitalised man! With his worn-out shirt and pajamas, he spends his time in his messy room with his cat and a can of beer. However, after a drinking party, he spends the night with his cheeky subordinate, Nishiguchi, in a hotel. Will that be the end of his peaceful life?!

Included one-shot: Meiga no You ni Koi wo

mangas.title: Mobsters in Love
mangas.titleNative: 恋する極道おにいさん
mangas.description:
A wholesome Boys Love rom-com between a handsome but oblivious mob boss and his young, simplehearted but moody second-in-command!



Akihiro Kashima is the right-hand man of the Sawatari mob, and he has a secret. He's been hopelessly in love for years-with his boss! As a trusted subordinate, he's subject to the head honcho's unintended acts of seduction. But with Akihiro's position in the group at stake, he couldn't possibly reveal the infatuation that plagues him. Stuck between duty and his feelings, something's gotta give!



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Bite Marks and Fluorite
mangas.titleNative: 噛み痕とフローライト
mangas.description:
A non-human thing that lives in the darkness — that which you will someday become.

Mortally wounded trying to prevent what he thought was a mugging, Haru's life is saved by the vampire Akihito, with one small drawback; he is now a vampire too. The transformation takes time however, and while he adapts, Haru is vulnerable prey for other vampires. Akihito promises to keep him safe, and as Haru adjusts to his new circumstances, he also finds himself falling for the man who gave him a second chance at life...

mangas.title: Sekai de Ichiban Kawaii!
mangas.titleNative: 世界でいちばんかわいい！
mangas.synonyms: You are the cutest in the world.
mangas.description: Hajime's friend, Yoshita is a cross-dresser who likes to upload his photos on social media. Hajime, feeling concerned about his friend, volunteered to be the "only audience" for Yoshita's pictures. How will Hajime deal with all of this when Yoshita is actually his first love?

mangas.title: Self-Love and Lingerie How to Love Your Coworker
mangas.titleNative: 自惚れとランジェリー～ハイスペ同期の困った愛し方～
mangas.description:
Haruta is introverted and always wears a bra to protect his sensitive nipples. What happens when his extroverted coworker figures out his secret and urges him to wear sexy lingerie...?!


(Source: Shusuisha)


Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Marrying the Coworker I Hate
mangas.titleNative: 大嫌いな同期を娶ったら、
mangas.description:
Office worker Kaname can't stand his coworker Shinonome, but when a work-related circumstance arises, they find themselves unthinkably entering into a one-year contract marriage?! Expecting the worst, Kaname and Shinonome try to cohabitate, however, after an extended argument, they kiss, in the heat of the moment, and both become extremely aroused! What will happen when the company's famous duo crosses the line on their first day of marriage?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Kosodate Kazoku BL
mangas.description:
Cover illustration: Tadano

mangas.title: Koi wa Kitsune Mouyou
mangas.description: A young boy from the fox tribe comes down from the mountain to attend school and find a mate, and ends up falling for the school's outcast.

mangas.title: Kyou, Sukitte Iimasu
mangas.titleNative: 今日、好きっていいます
mangas.synonyms: Today I will say I love you
mangas.description:
University student, Rintarou, is in love with his rental boyfriend, Asahi. Knowing that it is all pretend doesn't stop his heart from racing when confronted by Asahi's kindness. Every time they meet, his feelings continue to grow stronger. One day, as Rintarou finds himself unable to make another rental appointment out of concern he won't be able to stop his feelings from growing, he stumbles across Asahi in town. While Rintarou is taken aback by the uncharacteristically serious look on Asahi's face, Asahi starts leaning in for a kiss...?!



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Renchin!
mangas.description:
Kami, who is gay, has given up on love. Despite not having anyone to share his cooking with, he always makes a ton of food. And along comes Waki, a good-looking TV announcer who hosts "Waki Travels! Waki's Happy Food Corner!" Although he's got no taste buds, he eats a ton and comments on the food he finds in people's homes. But he takes an interest in Kami's food and even goes to visit him at his workplace. While he's able to slowly open up to the big-hearted Waki, he's still unable to be true to his feelings when he's afraid of getting hurt again...

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Honor Students Know No Fear
mangas.description:
A side story to Yuutousei wa Mi no Hodo Shirazu.

After officially becoming a couple, can Kyojima and Matsuzuki balance both their school life and grades with their relationship and sex...?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Released at J.GARDEN 54.

mangas.title: Kuzu, Omega ni Tensei
mangas.description:
Kanade is a trashy man who has bad manners and no concept of money, but lives by trusting only one face. One day, he runs into his high school junior, Haruka, but his ex-girlfriend who holds a grudge against Kanade stabs them both with a knife. Then, when he opens his eyes, he is in the world of an omegaverse?! Kanade, who became an omega, can't stand it anymore and ends up seducing alpha Haruka with a flushed face...?!



(Source: Libre, translated)

mangas.title: SUPER PINK
mangas.description:
Yano & Shizuki get it on in this Breathless Momentum doujinshi from the creator behind the original series, Zeniko Sumiya!



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 54, was then licensed by Libre for digital release.

mangas.title: Satori-kun to Tsundere-kun: Kokoro mo Karada Dadamore H
mangas.titleNative: サトリ君とツンデレ君 心も体も漏れH
mangas.synonyms: Was sich neckt, das liebt sich
mangas.description: Satori Shin is a male student who can read the mind of those he touches. Having inadvertently peeked into the minds of his classmates, he tries not to ill use this power as he goes about his student life. One day he bumps into fellow classmate Asaba Yoshiki and discovers that he likes him! Aseba who was always so prickly in his words was in fact thinking things like "Satori is so cute" and "I love him"!

mangas.title: Warning! Whispers of Love
mangas.description: Hajime can't wait to make the scene at his high school...but his dreams of coolness are soon dashed by the appearance of the weird and wily Nagura! A third-year elite student with a serious thing for perfect ears, Nagura will stop at nothing 'til he's swabbed Hajime to his heart's content! How long can this pair of almost friends keep their cat-and-mouse game going?

mangas.title: Itoshi no Kemukujara
mangas.titleNative: いとしの毛むくじゃら
mangas.description:
"To those who live in this world, 'a walking total body of shame'." What kind of world is this? Much, much more than others. Shinichiro Tsuji is a freelancer with a complex about his thin body hair. Again and again, he would look at his smooth arms and crotch in the bathtub at home and feel depressed, remembering the teasing of his friends. He would close his eyes and ponder over things as usual. Today, too, his daily routine was supposed to go by like that. When he looked up, he found himself in a foreign palace.


When I looked up, I found myself in a foreign palace. I was mesmerized by the glossy hair fluttering in front of me. And in the blink of an eye, I became a prisoner. Among the people in the royal palace who never saw this, the only one who called out to Shinichiro and touched him was the youngest prince, Prince Falu. His body reacts to the hairy man who touches him as if he is probing him..


(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Itadakimasu, Ookami-san.
mangas.titleNative: いただきます、オオカミさん。
mangas.description:
Even though I'm a wolf, it feels good to be eaten by a rabbit...!



Natsuki, who stands out even among the dominant wolves, is traumatized by a heat he experienced to the point that he can never tell anyone about it. One day, while showing Hakuto, an inferior rabbit transfer student around school he was suddenly taken to an empty classroom. Natsuki tried to escape as Hakuto whispered, "I missed your pheromones..." Then suddenly Natsuki went into heat…?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Me And My Big Pecs
mangas.description:
Literature teacher Makoto Kosaka's gentle personality and voluptuous body has his male students comparing him to the a holy saint. Although he is self-conscious about his large physique, he loves his students and his job, and enjoys the kind attention of the other faculty members, particularly that of Shun Hayami, the fit and cheerful gym teacher. One afternoon, after a long and tiring workday, Makoto finds himself overcome by a sudden urge. With the school seemingly empty, he figures no one will mind if he gives himself some quick relief. That is, until Shun shows up out of nowhere...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: No Messing Around With Your Teacher!
mangas.titleNative: 先生で遊んじゃイケません！
mangas.description:
"I love seeing that troubled look on your face." One night, cram school teacher Akitomo grows worried about a young man who has come into his favorite gay bar for the first time and sit down for a drink with him. He's then suddenly asked to go to a love hotel...!? Fucked deep many times on the bed there, he spends all night long cumming his brains out. Their bodies fit perfectly together! But the guy is so young... so Akitomo figures it will just be a one night stand. However, the new student who shows up at his work place happens to be the very same Yoh he had just slept with the night before...!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Toshishita Osananajimi wa Amaku Semetai Otoshigoro
mangas.titleNative: 年下幼馴染はあまく責めたいオトシゴロ
mangas.description:
