Aoi Minato and Shiraishi Yuki are childhood friends that grew up together like brothers. A decade passes with Minato taking care of and spoiling Yuki... Now that they're in high school, he is suddenly pushed against the wall by Yuki.



"I've always been attracted to you in this way, Nii-chan."



Freaking out at Yuki's sudden confession, he throws Yuki to the ground! But without losing heart, Yuki continues making advances to Minato, using every trick in the book! How does Minato respond to this...?



Funny, steamy, and lovey-dovey! A hyper love comedy between high-schoolers!



(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: Bergamot and Sunny Day
mangas.titleNative: ベルガモット＆サニーデイ
mangas.description:
Every time café worker Riku sees the café's owner, Josh, he's asked on a date.

"He's a talented manager, but how could I go out with such a shallow man?!" Or so Riku thought, but after a bad breakup, Josh comforted him with homemade sweets. After being fully pampered, Riku woke up at Josh's house to find a clean shirt, a BLT sandwich, and a kiss on his way out.

This therapeutic BL features the ideal man who will pamper and spoil his love!

mangas.title: Karamawari Weekend
mangas.titleNative: からまわりウィークエンド
mangas.description:
A love you'll root for spontaneously ♡ 38-page one-shot!!



"Kawanami-san, please fall in love with me." Under the influence of alcohol, Mifune blurts out the feelings he has kept secret from his sempai, Kawanami. And when Kawanami's attitude doesn't seem to have changed after the confession, what is Mifune to do?



Heart-pounding, sparkly sempai x unsociable kouhai with a one-sided love. A fresh debut! From Izui Zui, a tantalizing workplace love that you can't help wanting to cheer on.



(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

mangas.title: I Want to Protect You, Mr. Sawatari
mangas.titleNative: 守ってあげたい佐渡さん
mangas.synonyms: 想要守护你 佐渡前辈
mangas.description:
When perpetually unlucky Sawatari loses the charm that protects him, he resorts to living with Akutsu, his coworker with a lucky streak.



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Wandering Slut Finds Love
mangas.titleNative: 彷徨うビッチは恋を知る
mangas.synonyms: Wandering Bitch Know the Love | Samayou Bitch wa Koi wo Shiru
mangas.description: "The man I fell in love with was my best friend's boyfriend." Torn between feelings of friendship and romance, just what shape will love take for this wandering slut?

mangas.title: Papa to Boku to Kazoku ni Natte yo
mangas.titleNative: パパとぼくとかぞくになってよ
mangas.description:
"Daddy doesn't smile anymore. Do you think he hates me?"



After losing his wife, Tsubasa spends his days with his five year old son Sora whilst trying to balance his job, household chores and childrearing. Wishing to raise his son to be a respected adult, Tsubasa continues to show a strict side to his son and gradually loses his smile. However it is at this moment that the straightforward and sociable Hiro moves into the same apartment. Upon witnessing the demanding life Tsubasa lives, Hiro decides to lend a hand, but for Tsubasa who doesn't know how to rely on others, will Hiro's efforts reach him…?



(Source: Kobunsha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Male Love of a Naïve Baseball Boy
mangas.titleNative: 純朴球児がオトコを知ったら。
mangas.synonyms: 千萬別讓棒球健兒嚐到男人滋味。
mangas.description:
"Please help me to have an erotic body that suits your tastes." Slutty older man x naïve younger boy. The summer sex battle starts now!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: The Devil Eats Love
mangas.description:
"If you can not kiss your first love, you die!" Since his childhood, Woo Jae-yoon has no intention of life because of his illness. One day, a demon appears suddenly, and if he fails to fulfill the terms of the contract, he will die. And the condition is to kiss my first love ...! First-time candidates who continue to appear! Can Daoyun meet a first love and kiss?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: My Personal Weatherman
mangas.description:
Popular handsome man and weather forecaster Segasaki is actually a tyrant at home. Yoh, an ero-manga artist in a tight spot knows this very well. This is because the two of them are living together. More than that, it's because he cooks and cleans for Segasaki! To no surprise, in exchange for being provided food, he must "obey everything that Segasaki says." What comes from such a contract is?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Winner of the 2023 ChillChill BL Awards in the "Best Comic" category.

mangas.title: The Voice Next Door
mangas.description:
I quit my job, became a voice actor, and drastically changed my looks — all to catch the attention of dreamy Jaehyun from work. But he doesn't know I'm me! What he does know is that I dub his favorite animation, and adores the way I sound. On top of that, now he's moved in next door too?! A perfect chance for neighborly love!

(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: Not Fated
mangas.description:
"Even if it's hopeless, I'm not gonna give up! No matter how many times I get rejected or how much I get hurt, I won't stop feeling this way!"



So says the bright and optimistic university student, Shizuku Suguya, about the man that got him out of a spat of trouble: Masataka Kizaki. Shizuku feels it's fate. He tests the waters at the production company that Masataka manages but is turned away without even being able to speak to him.



Determined to make it happen, Shizuku then attemps to stand in for a model in a commercial who is taking a day off from illness...



(Source: Manga Club)

mangas.title: Rabbits Ejaculate in 3 Seconds
mangas.description:
After failing the auditions for a role he'd been preparing for, Lyle takes a trip to Korea for a change of pace. As a black-footed cat-man, he was not able to present himself as a top amongst the larger beastmen, but having travelled to this place with all sorts of small and cute animals that suited his tastes, he thinks he could be a top here. After downloading an online dating app, Lyle starts chatting with a rabbit-man with the handle "Kkyu," and steadily grows fond of him. Finally, the day they meet arrives! However, what appears before Lyle, as his heart pounds, is...a brute-like rabbit...?!

"Is this person...really my Kkyu...?!"

mangas.title: In the Cage
mangas.description:
Haru (omega) is in a relationship with Eiji (alpha), who is also his childhood friend. But Eiji, who is from elite family, already had his fiancé, and Haru always came in second. Renji (alpha), Eiji's older brother and Haru's first love, appeared in front of him. "I came to pick you up." Renji told Haru. Where will this complicated love triangle lead to...?



(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

mangas.title: Wet Dream Aquarium
mangas.description: "I, Yuri Hiroto, have apparently turned into a pervert. I've been having dirty dreams lately—about getting groped by sea creatures! And even worse, these dreams include someone staring at me during my filthy fish time: the marine biology nerd from my class, Ogasawara-kun! The guy is so obsessed with undersea life that honestly, he kinda weirded me out at first. But now that I'm deep in the closet pretending to be "normal," I think it's attractive that he can be true to himself without caring what people think. Of course, the moment I realized I like him, my dreams became even more obscene! Cut to our hang-out at the aquarium, and while I'm looking at fish with Ogasawara-kun, I actually get turned on?! Seriously, what is wrong with me?!"

mangas.title: Witch and Cat
mangas.description:
On the surface, Sudou looks like your average deliveryman—but the truth is that he's a courier for a shady underground transport service where no job is off-limits. One day, bonding with his standoffish neighbor Uno leads to the two sleeping side by side, and Sudou develops feelings a miscreant like him doesn't deserve to experience… But when he later finds Uno caught in a street fight and gets hurt trying to save him, he learns Uno's hiding a supernatural secret that will change Sudou's life forever!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Torano Tantei Jimusho e Youkoso
mangas.titleNative: 寅野探偵事務所へようこそ
mangas.description:
A happy loving life, woven by a beastman, a human, and a half-breed.



After a string of bad luck, Kaisei Yano finds himself without a home, job, or money. He happens to find a poster offering a job with a place to live, but the employer is a scary-looking beastman named Jiu Torano.

He starts working as a secretary for Torano, who runs a detective agency, but this workplace turns out to be full of trouble!　
He also has to help take care of Torano's niece, Yui......



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Oath of Allegiance
mangas.titleNative: オース オブ アレジアンス

mangas.title: Ookami no Bonito
mangas.description:
Ioto is a Japanese man who have traveled to a distant country to study architecture. His destination, Spain, is a beautiful country inhabited by many beastmen. While Ioto is still unfamiliar with the country, he is approached by Leo, a wolf-beastman who works as a police officer.


Finally, he has a friend...! Ioto is happy to finally have a friend, but Leo kisses him. He is puzzled, thinking it is a greeting from a carnivorous beastman, but then he is embraced and asked for his body...! Ioto is passionately persuaded that he is Leo's "pair." A heartwarming romance of destiny in a distant foreign land!

mangas.title: All the Way With Idol-kun!
mangas.titleNative: アイドルくんに抱かれたい！
mangas.description: Cool, confident, and topping the idol charts, Ao is the picture of perfection on stage, but off-camera, he's actually a shy, soft-hearted puppy. Former idol Shinji agrees to coach him on fan service in exchange for a no-strings-attached fling, but Ao keeps holding himself back by being too serious, leaving Shinji increasingly frustrated. Then everything shifts when Ao realizes he's falling in love. But afraid of getting hurt, Shinji tries to walk away before it's too late...

mangas.title: A Kiss for Each Face
mangas.titleNative: ダブルフェイスにくちづけ
mangas.synonyms: A Kiss on Double Face | Double Face ni Kuchizuke
mangas.description: Alex Lowe, a young but ruthless mafia boss falls in love at first sight with Shirai Kanata, a quiet student. However, Kanata is actually the skilled assassin known as "Black Swan" and his next target is Alex! Unlike his previous targets, Alex gives him genuine and sincere love and Kanata's heart is in turmoil...

mangas.title: Tengu Datte Koi wo Suru
mangas.description:
The story of a bird tengu with a soft spot for Kuro, a black dog he picked up one rainy day. But Kuro's true nature is that of a dog tengu, a harbinger of calamity.



"I'll bring you misfortune."

"So what? Stay with me, Kuro."



In his human form, Kuro can't hold himself back when faced with the sweet fragrance of the bird tengu he loves. And so they share their first time and first heats with each other. They won't stop until they're satisfied.

mangas.title: Studio of Longing
mangas.description:
"I want you more, Masafumi." The relationship between Kei Higuchi and Masafumi Tsurumi, which was just for the sake of a single artwork, has slowly started to progress. Are they classmates, friends, or lovers? Kei is unable to ask him, thinking that everything will come to an end if he makes an assertion. Masafumi thinks he their relationship is obvious, which ends up in misunderstanding. What will happen to their relationship which was supposed to just be physical and would eventually end?



(Source: INKR)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles
mangas.titleNative: 運命とはいえこの程度
mangas.description:
1-2. Unmei to wa Ie Kono Teido (運命とはいえこの程度, That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles); GUSH maniaEX 2019-06, 08

Shirato has always had terrible luck, even with the simplest things. When it seems that he might have a bit of luck going to his usual ramen place, it's stumped by the bawling, but very handsome person sitting beside him. Pitying the poor guy, Shirato offers him his handkerchief to comfort him. Turns out, the handsome person was Tatsuki Kurose, a famous actor and with his presence, it seems that Shirato's fortune has gotten better. But when one night reveals that Tatsuki's feelings for Shirato goes beyond friendship, Shirato's not sure if his terrible luck has gotten worse. Did it?



3-5. Unmei nante Iwaretemo (運命なんて言われても, You Say It's Destiny, But I Don't Think So); GUSH maniaEX 2018-12, 2019-04, GUSH pit 2019-02

6. Aisubeki Unmei (愛すべき運命, A Fate One Should Love); kakioroshi



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Ugetsudou Antique
mangas.description:
At a mysterious antique shop that appears only on rainy days, Sou finds the keepsake of his grandfather that he supposedly lost a long time ago. He asks the owner, Tsukiji, who has a different air about him, to hand it over to him, but it's not money that this shop accepts as payment. With a fearless smile, the condition that Tsukiji put forth is "Please give birth to my child"!?



(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Bias Is A God!?
mangas.description:
Mamori, a die-hard idol fan, would do anything for his beloved Kamui, the lead singer of the popular male idol group "Gods." When a chance for Mamori to see his idol live and up close at a concert seems to fall from the heavens, he can't believe his luck. Everything seems like a dream come true, until Kamui looks directly into his eyes... and calls him his "ceremonial vessel"!! In a world where heavenly beings walk the earth, Mamori learns that his bias is quite literally a god in human form... and he wants Mamori to bear him a child! So begins their divinely-ordered cohabitation, but can Mamori really accept that the person he idolized is a god? Was everything Mamori thought he knew about Kamui true, or has his love been built on a lie?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Door no Mukou ni wa Romance
mangas.titleNative: ドアの向こうにはロマンス
mangas.synonyms: Romance Is Over the Door | Romance Is Just Behind the Door
mangas.description: When Kagami calls an escort service to a hotel one night, the guy who shows up at his door turns out to be precisely his type. But his elation at this stroke of luck soon vanishes as he realizes that Minato is, in fact, a food delivery boy who has come to his room by mistake. Unable to pass up this one-time chance, Kagami plants a kiss on Minato as a joke... But when Minato serendipitously shows up to deliver food to his house the next day, Kagami finds himself drawn more and more to this sweet and straightforward boy...

mangas.title: Seitokaichou wa Koi ga Shitai
mangas.titleNative: 生徒会長は恋がしたい
mangas.description:
Perfect student council president x Former delinquent teacher



The otherwise perfect student council president's only flaw, is that he doesn't know what love is…!?



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: On to You
mangas.synonyms: お隣さんのプライバシー〜毎晩ヤりまくる彼の秘密とは〜
mangas.description:
Everything in Yeonwoo's life is fine. He has a great job as an Elementary school teacher and a loving boyfriend. He doesn't have much to complain about... except for the fact that he has the noisiest neighbor ever! Fed up with the awkward noises coming from across the wall, Yeonwoo tries his best to block them out, but to no avail. And if that wasn't enough, Yeonwoo discovers that his boyfriend might have someone else in his life, leaving him hopeless and heartbroken. However, help arrives from an unexpected source - his eccentric and somewhat perverted neighbor. Yeonwoo begins to think that his neighbor might not be as bad as he initially thought, but everything about the bizarre man next door remains a mystery. Could he be hiding something dangerous from Yeonwoo?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

mangas.title: To Break A Guy's Heart
mangas.titleNative: 好きになったら、さようなら。
mangas.description:
High school honors student Soya Furuhashi seems stern on the outside, but his underlying earnestness and naturally airheaded personality have made him well-liked by his peers. One day in the school bathroom, Soya meets a mysterious-looking guy who's drenched from head to toe. Wondering why he's never seen this student before, Soya later finds out that it was Motonari Kuga, the guy who was held back a year after rumors that he seduced other men...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Sentimental Darling
mangas.titleNative: センチメンタル・ダーリン
mangas.synonyms: センチメンタル・ボーイ
mangas.description:
Sentimental Darling (センチメンタル・ダーリン)

Ryosuke and Shun are in their fourth year of college and have been dating for five years.

They've been happy together every day, and it's been smooth sailing... but lately, even when they've had sex, it's just been "good night".

I want to cherish our time together! I want us to be more intimate! So Ryosuke decides to make a plan...?



Sentimental Boy (センチメンタル・ボーイ)

Ryosuke and Shun have known each other since they were children, and they've taken it for granted that they'll always be able to spend time together.

But one day, Sun confessed to Ryosuke about his unexpected feelings for him!



Neko-san Kochira, Te no Naru Hou e (猫さんこちら、手の鳴る方へ)



Plus an special extra chapter for the collected volume.



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: The Toughest Guy in School Is an Omega!?
mangas.titleNative: 最強ヤンキーがオメガなわけない！
mangas.description:
Under the country's law, omegas are obligated to wear a chastity belt. A rumor is going around that there's a key that will unlock the belt, and people are fighting to find this key.



Sashima is the toughest delinquent around. An elite group of alphas, the Snakes, hear about Sashima and come to fight him. The leader of the Snakes, Aoda, is expecting a big, towering man, and while the Sashima standing in front of him has glaring, piercing eyes, he's also short... and an omega!



After telling Sashima that he chooses him as his partner, Aoda suddenly grabs Sashima and starts kissing him. This Aoda is out of control! Sashima's right-hand man, Taketora, has also been pulled into this whole mess. Who's going to be the one to soften the toughest omega?



(Source: Renta!)

Aoi and Yanagi are an affectionate pair of lovers. One day, "Yanagi", an android who looks exactly like Yanagi, arrives. Aoi thinks that something like an android is in bad taste. However, as Yanagi is going far away for his medical treatment, he says that he is leaving behind the android as his stand-in. Despite the android asking, "Would you like to see how it feels to hold me?", Aoi has no interest. The activated "Yanagi" kisses Aoi, but— The year 2055, a world where androids and mankind coexist. The heartbreaking and lovely story of an end and a beginning.

mangas.title: I Can Say "I Love You" in the Afterlife
mangas.titleNative: あの世でお前に好きだと言える
mangas.description:
Unhappy with his life, 29-year-old Kunimi decides to jump in front of a moving train. But, when he wakes up, he realizes he has gone back to being a high schooler! With a lapse in his memories, Kunimi meets a super handsome junior named Gaku. While disappointed that even in this after-life, Kunimi is gay, he gets excited at the prospect of his almost 30-year-old self doing it with a high schooler. When Kunimi finds out Gaku has real feelings for him, he feels bad about having a wet dream about Gaku.


As his memories slowly start to come back to him, 29-year-old Kunimi gets a chance to re-do his high school experience with a genuine and super hot high schooler!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: His Secret Life as a Fake High Schooler
mangas.titleNative: おれの制服を脱がせてよ
mangas.description:
Don't make me take my uniform off...! Haru's number one at the place where he works at. They offer carnal services from "high school boys." Despite his cute looks, when he's behind the tinted mirror, he lets his pink tongue glide over the glass, plays with himself, and uses his hand to pleasure himself while seducing his customers on the other side. For Haru, this is the job he was born to do. He's legally an adult, but he wants to be loved as a high school boy... One day, Takashiro comes to him as a new customer. Takashiro is handsome, good at his work, and popular with both men and women. He's the "perfect" guy that everyone wants to be. Except he has a secret. He can only get excited with high school boys. A love story about Takashiro's obsession with high school boys, and their complicated pasts...

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Tell Me You Like It
mangas.titleNative: 気持ちいいって言ってごらん?
mangas.description:
Worried about his unattractiveness to women, Koichi secretly buys an adult toy to train up his masculinity. But, his plan gets discovered by a man living in his apartment block, Shu, who happens to work in the adult film industry! Right when Koichi thinks he's about to be blackmailed, Shu makes a surprising proposal: He offers to help Koichi draw out his inner manly man and find out what true pleasure feels like! When Koichi starts taking lessons in bedroom intimacy, he finds that Shu's sweet, provocative caresses stir pleasures in him he'd never known...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Praise Me When I'm a Good Boy
mangas.titleNative: いい子にできたら褒めてくれ
mangas.description:
High school teacher Watanabe has a secret—behind closed doors, he's actually a Sub. Enraged when his fiancée leaves him because of his nature, Watanabe hooks up with his former student, lzumi...who just so happens to ooze Dom energy, and is also looking for a place to stay. Where better than at his new Sub's house? Which means Watanabe's going to have to figure out how to survive round-the-clock orders, all so he can be praised like the good boy he's desperately trying to be...



(Source: Yen Press)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Manga Artist's Pen and the Company Ink
mangas.description:
Chiaki Haruno isn't happy. He thought he got into this company as a literary editor, but it turns out he's going to be editing manga! To make matters worse, he accidentally confides in Yuzuru Houjou, the manga artist he's supposed to work with, and tells him how he's using Yuzuru's manga as a stepping stone to get transferred! Now Chiaki has to beg Yuzuru to keep working with him, and Yuzuru's not letting him off easy. This is a seductive tale of a handsome manga artist and his cute editor that's bound to make your mouth water!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Ore wa Senpai no Nan Nandesu ka!?
mangas.titleNative: 俺は先輩の何なんですか!?
mangas.description: A boy with a troubled face and a cheeky senpai who does not remember him.

mangas.title: Leave the Sacrifice at the Gate
mangas.titleNative: いけにえもんぜんばらい
mangas.description: Uzumaki Nanao was born to be a sacrifice. However, when his family delivers him to the god who's supposed to eat him, things don't go quite as expected. The god is more interested in taking it easy than sacrificial offerings, totally ruining Nanao's end-of-life trajectory. Can he convince the god to eat him? Or will he learn that there's more than one way to be devoured by a god?

mangas.title: Playboy Beast
mangas.titleNative: プレイボーイ・ビースト
mangas.description:
In a world where demi-beasts and humans co-exist, Riku Kurobuchi, a panther demi-beast, finds himself facing a dilemma.
He is sociable, good looking, talented at sports, and popular with girls, but for some reason he still hasn't experienced his "heat" like everyone else. After an unexpected transfer, he begins sharing his dorm room with the mature and handsome albino lion demi-beast, Touma Shishigaya. Riku wants to keep his secret hidden from the confrontational Touma, but it's Touma's pheromones that bring about Riku's first heat!!



This is a story of desire between a beautiful albino and an inexperienced demi-beast.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hard to Say I Love You
mangas.synonyms: Submission And Sweet Bites | Fukujuu to Amagami
mangas.description:
Iruma, who has a constitution that allows him to transform into a wolf gets into an accident while in his wolf form and is saved by the veterinarian, Minato. He spends his days being relentlessly doted on by the animal lover Minato, but while he snaps angrily, "Don't treat me like a dog!", he obeys Minato's naughty and teasing orders and is overcome by a sweet, tingling sensation of pleasure and arousal....

The warmth of family and the exciting pleasure of submission - this is the story of a lonely werewolf and his tsundere master-servant days.

mangas.title: Houkago Edge
mangas.description: Tobari's always loved cute and feminine things. Which sparks his eventual venture into drag. One day, while he was out in public dressed as a high school girl, he bumps into fellow classmate, Inui. It's annoying to Tobari how amusing Inui finds it, but at least he's promised not to tell anyone. But with no plans of letting him off for this hobby, Inui proposes something outrageous. He is twisted and unstable, but for some reason, his words are reassuring. A story of a secret love woven with something unnerving.

mangas.title: Sayonara Koibito Mata Kite Tomodachi
mangas.titleNative: さよなら恋人 またきて友だち
mangas.description: That person just wanted to see ... could it be that there shall be love? Kanae, a student was transferred to a quiet country town. The moment they saw Kanae whole class thought of wanting to rape him. This is due to a peculiar condition that has Kanae being an impossible temptation to ignore. Ougi, being the leader of the class, also has the intention to do so and begins his plan. No matter what you think Kanae, it attracts their environment and protecting Ougi follows, but in the end, there was an act of violation of Kanae by a classmate. Lust, love, friendship, jealousy ... crossings each other's opinions are the events that are drawn in this youth BL.

mangas.title: Will You Marry Me?
mangas.description:
Kairi Sasaki, an omega, is a newbie employee working at a marriage counseling company. His problems lie in his client—the handsome alpha, Haruomi Jinguuji—who doesn't seriously look for a marriage partner. What's more troubling is that this elite tries to make advances at him at every opportunity! Now, will Kairi be able to make Haruomi marry someone...?!



(Source: Manga Club)

mangas.title: A Lovestruck Cat Wants to Be Petted
mangas.titleNative: 恋する猫はなでられたい
mangas.description: Sweet and skittish Kotetsu has been stopping by the pet store lately just to see Okazaki! When Okazaki asks to see pictures of Kotetsu's cat, Kotetsu is overjoyed to finally exchange contact info with his crush... but what Okazaki doesn't know is that Kotetsu IS the cat! Having suddenly turned half-human, half-cat, Kotetsu must hide his cute ears and tail as he adjusts to his new lifestyle and pursues a blossoming friendship with Okazaki. But what will Okazaki think when he finds out the truth?

mangas.title: Megunda Koi ni Koiwazurai
mangas.titleNative: 芽ぐんだ恋に恋わずらい
mangas.description:
"I love you, Haru-nii. I want to be with you forever."



Daichi, the son of the restaurant owners from Haru's part-time job, has loved Haru since he was in elementary school. Haru loves him like a younger brother, but when Daichi, now in high school, kisses him like he used to as a child, Haru finds himself unable to accept his "I like you" from Daichi as honestly as he used to. Lastly, Haru couldn't look directly at Daichi naked body now he that he has a body of a grown man and is in high school...!? The story of a young puppy x an indecisive and timid older man that grow up doting on each other☆



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Omega Shunki
mangas.description: (In heat pregnancy x omegaverse) Kumo from the mountain dog tribe was picked up by Kin from the cat tribe and who lives near a wolf tribe doctor of the omegas, Ise. Whether it be Kumo having the characteristics of a dog, he tends to make playful nibbles and licks towards Kin. However, the fact that Ise was pleased with their excellent compatibility makes Kin's heart ache…

mangas.title: Mayonaka no Oyatsu
mangas.description: Fuji Azuma is thrilled to have the chance to spend two whole weeks with his adorable 8-years-younger nephew Taira, head over heels for the kid and the proudest uncle there ever was. But when he learns at the end of their time together that Taira and his mother are moving overseas, he's shocked to receive a parting kiss and a vow that Taira won't return "until I'm taller than you, Azuma-san." Four years later...and Taira's back to make good on his promise.

mangas.title: Nekoka Kareshi no Ayashikata
mangas.titleNative: ネコ科彼氏のあやし方
mangas.description:
Kokonoe is a werecat who turns into a cat when he is excited. Destiny has it that one morning, Kokonoe, runs into Natsume, who seems to have a special relationship with cats. With Natsume's touch, Kokonoe soons finds himself purring and getting excited. However, Kokonoe is determined to keep his cat side and the feelings he has for Natsume under control.

How will their love blossom? A love lesson between a white coat school doctor and a werecat.

mangas.title: Pornographer Playback
mangas.titleNative: 續・ポルノグラファー プレイバック
mangas.description:
Rio, incompetent with technology, usually with a phone on 0% battery, and Kuzumi, a slave to his new job as an advertiser with no time to write to Rio, struggle to work through their long-distance relationship. Rio one day childishly runs away from home and, after a series of events, hurts his arm (again) and starts rooming with the instigator of his injury. Kuzumi, on the other hand, tries to confront Rio to do something about their relationship... but can Kuzumi find him and manage to bring him back?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Tokubetsu na Nichijou
mangas.description: Two boys try to celebrate their one year anniversary, but things don't go as planned.

mangas.title: Pornographer
mangas.description:
Haruhiko Kuzumi's life changes forever the day he rams into novelist Renjiro Kijima...with his bike. A poor college student, Haruhiko can't compensate Kijima for the accident. So, Kijima offers Haruhiko an unusual deal. Haruhiko can transcribe Kijima's latest story as he orally dictates it. Little does Haruhiko know, Kijima specializes in erotic novels. Kijima's alluring voice soon draws him into a world of sensual daydreams.


(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Goodbye to Destiny
mangas.titleNative: グッドバイトゥデスティニー
mangas.description: When Tosaka Eiji stumbles across an omega in a dangerous situation, he knows he needs to intervene. Sure, he might not be able to detect pheromones, but he's not a monster! Mitsuya Jin, on the other hand, has no problem noticing just how tantalizing the young alpha smells. Already falling into heat, Jin takes Eiji back home for a night of passion—only to find out that Eiji has just moved in next door! With a past relationship leaving scars both physical and emotional, can Jin learn to accept this earnest young alpha's feelings, or are they both just too broken after all...?

mangas.title: Pamper Me, My Manly Maid!
mangas.titleNative: あまやかして！雄っぱいメイドくん
mangas.description:
"Welcome to the afterlife, master!"



A corporate slave finds his dying wish of being pampered by beautiful maids fulfilled...except that the maids are men?!



(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kunkou Schale
mangas.description: Both protagonists work making perfumes at the same laboratory, but their relationship suddenly changes because of one of these.

mangas.title: My Boyfriend's a Famous Actor
mangas.titleNative: その男 役者につき、
mangas.description:
Yuma Kawahara's just your regular office worker, and he has a childhood friend he just can't refuse a favor to. His friend, who's a freelance journalist, asks Yuma to go on a dangerous mission to find out some juicy gossip about popular actor Kei Hoshina. So, Yuma enters Kei's place in the guise of a salesman and starts snapping some pictures, only to be caught right away! The initially nice Kei shows a sadistic side, and Yuma soon finds himself bound and helpless...! Thus begins the nightmare that is to be his life...

This is a scandalously cute romantic comedy between a regular office worker and a gorgeous star!

mangas.title: We're Abhorred by Fate
mangas.titleNative: 僕たちは運命に嫌われている
mangas.description:
In this world, people are categorized into one of three secondary genders: alphas, betas, and omegas. Alphas (α) are seen as society's elites. They find success in any endeavor without the need for much effort. Betas (β) are seen as the "average" and most populous, without major alpha or omega traits. Omegas (Ω) are perceived as unfortunate souls, bound to their heats that produce strong pheromones, sometimes strong enough to attract even betas. Hayato Kujo works hard, uncharacteristic for an alpha. But no matter his feat, everybody around him attributes his success to his alpha genes, except for Kaname Yao, a classmate and teammate on his high school's track and field team. Yao views Kujo as a rival and serious athlete, regardless of their genders: Kujo an alpha and Yao the beta...? Wait a minute... Yao was surely not prepared to get all mixed up in this alpha-beta-omega-fated-mate-bond stuff. (Warning: Mentions of sexual assault)



(Source: Futekiya)



Chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: I'm a Dom and I Want You to Stroke My Head
mangas.description:
Naoya Fushimi lives in a world where second genders are labeled as 'dynamics,' generally divided into two types: Doms and Subs. The former desires to dominate while the latter wants to be dominated. Being the only Dom teacher in the school he works at, Naoya has a reputation for being strict and intimidating, and he takes pride in it. As for his more private activities, there is no Sub he left unsatisfied with his plays. Though recently, he finds himself frustrated for no reason. When the new dynamics-specialized nurse, Kei Hoshina, enters the school, Naoya assumes the former as an unassuming Dom, but he couldn't be more wrong.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Kiss Shite Sugar-kun!
mangas.titleNative: キスしてシュガーくん!
mangas.description:
Sato is the star actor of his high school. While he was immersed in rehearsal for a new role, wearing nothing, he was forcefully embraced by Yanagawa, the ace of the archery club. Yanagawa just couldn't get the feeling of Sato's smooth white skin and the shape of his body out of his head! The next day, Yanagawa's pre-tournament slump took a turn for the better, and he was back in top form! Sato, too, seemed to have solved his problems with his role! The two of them hug each other every day as a "spell", but what happens?



(Source: Chara, translated)

mangas.title: The Black Cat & the Vampire
mangas.titleNative: 寄宿舎の黒猫は夜をしらない
mangas.synonyms: The Black Cat in the Dormitory Doesn't Know the Night
mangas.description:
Blanc College is a prestigious all-boys boarding school where the sons of well-respected families from all over the world study and learn to be independent.



Yuki, a first-year attending Blanc College on a scholarship, is the perfect student: at the top of his class, quiet and polite. He's a bit of a loner, keeping others at arm's length — except Jean, the devastatingly charming Head Boy, who seems entirely immune to Yuki's aloof attitude.



Their school days are peaceful until, one day, a student gets attacked, and ends up with a wound on his neck that looks suspiciously like a vampire bite! Yuki doesn't have time for this nonsense. And besides, vampires aren't even real... right?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Chotto Damatte
mangas.description: Saika Dengo is a person with the super-natural power to talk directly to people's minds. One day he gets accused of talking to much in his mind by some random guy . Their first meeting doesn't go well when the guy is rude to Saika. When they meet again the guy tells Saika that he can hear his thoughts inside his head. The guy then confirms that it's only Saika's thoughts that he can hear. When Saika tries to think of why this is happening the guy suddenly kisses him to try to silence his thoughts. The guy then suggests they go out so that hearing Saika's thoughts isn't so creepy. When that goes wrong, Saika feel's bad and decides he also wants to know more about the guy. Finally, Saika asks for the guys name. Find out what happens with these two!

mangas.title: Fated Attraction
mangas.description:
Kaoru has a special gift. He can see "the red string of fate" and cut it, too. In fact, that's his line of business. Unfortunately, because of this, he himself has no red string.
Knowing that destiny will never attach him to anyone, he detaches himself from any chance of true love. That's why when his client Hara professes his love for Kaoru, he has no choice but to push him away.
Hara doesn't give up, though, and Kaoru finally gives in to his love. Wanting to trust Hara's love for him, Kaoru decides to be with him... yet he still can't help but worry about the red string of fate on Hara's pinky...

mangas.title: Stringing You Along
mangas.description:
Kaoru Kamisawa doesn't have your run-of-the-mill job. He makes his living by cutting ties for people by literally cutting the invisible string that connects them to each other. One day, he meets Hara, who comes to him in desparation to get a woman to stop stalking him. Hara is a little skeptical at first, but gradually starts having feelings for Kaoru. But, Kaoru knows it won't last. His special gift also robs him of his own "red string of fate" that connects a person to the partner they're destined for. Kaoru tries to keep Hara away, but can he...?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Yakedo to Tsumeato
mangas.description: Spin-off of Seinen Hakkaten focusing on Manabu's uncle, Koga, and his editor Najima.

mangas.title: The Flashpoint of Young Men
mangas.description: Though he seems completely indifferent to romance, high-schooler Manabu works part-time as a writer for an erotic magazine. One day, right when some classmates were about to pick a fight with him, he was saved by Yamaguma, an underclassman. Apparently Yamaguma, who is popular but unfamiliar with romance, is upset about his older sister working at a nightclub. While trying to desensitize Yamaguma of his excessive reaction to Manabu's erotic writing, they...? The heat of their connected hands is the folly of youth. A bittersweet diary of first love.

mangas.title: That Was Good
mangas.description: Hiroto, a part-timer without a steady job, is on his lunch break in the park when a cute little boy appears in front of him and stares enviously at Hiroto's lunch. The child looks so irresistibly cute and hungry, Hiroto shares his lunch with the boy. When the child's father, Suguru, finally shows up and sees his picky-eater son enjoying a meal, he offers Hiroto a housekeeping job! The father is a pilot and cannot be home all the time, and needs a caretaker for the boy and their beautiful home. Just as things start going well for Hiroto, he begins to fall for Suguru...and learns that the previous housekeeper had to resign because of romantic involvement with the dashing pilot! Can Hiroto keep his emotions in check?

mangas.title: I don't care if it's a performance, just devour me!
mangas.titleNative: 演技でいいから食べてくれ
mangas.description:
Rookie actor Naoto joins a theatrical company following the actor he admires, Non. Moreover, he was chosen to play the role of this lover in their new boys love performance! The characters are "lovers," so there are kiss scenes in the play. He's too nervous to act a kissing scene with the troupe's poster actor well...!!! Nonomiya wants to help him, and proposes that they treat each other like lovers until the performance. Since then, he's been overly sweet and kind... but when they practice kissing, he comes on to Naoto with such wild seductiveness that he feels as if he's going to be "devoured". Seeing Non's manly expression for the first time lights Naoto's body on fire... The way he bites his tongue and sucks on it during kissing, his burning gaze... the curtains to a time-limited love open.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra from the volume release.

mangas.title: Shousetsuka no Shitsukekata
mangas.description:
The unbalanced relationship between a dominating, manipulative erotic novelist and his new editor, who also happens to be his most loyal fan.


1. Shousetsuka ni Koi shitara (小説家に恋したら, If You Fall in Love with a Novelist)

2. Shousetsuka no Shitsukekata (小説家の躾け方, How to Discipline a Novelist)

3. Shousetsuka no Aishikata (小説家の愛し方, How to Love a Novelist)

4. Summer Garden Beach (サマー・ガーデン・ビーチ)

5. Utsukushii Kago (美しい籠, Beautiful Cage)

6. Itsuka no Umi he (いつかの海へ, Someday, to the Beach)

mangas.title: To You, with Love
mangas.description:
The moment Rio meets the boy with the grey eyes and gets kissed by him, he knows that his life is going to change. With a letter in his hand, Rui comes to visit Rio, worried that Rio might be feeling lonely and sad. Rui touches Rio's face as if to console him and kisses him again and again. At first, Rio is confused by the kisses and doesn't know how to react. However, as days goes by, Rio realizes that Rui's desire and kisses are actually bringing him comfort.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Sadistic Editor in Chief's Forbidden Guidance
mangas.titleNative: ドS編集長のイケないご指導
mangas.description:
"What a sweet moan... Do me a favor and commit this feeling to memory, will you?"



When romance novelist Keito Shinohara gets assigned a shrewd new editor, both his writing and his personal life get a whole lot steamier!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)

mangas.title: After-Shoot Snack
mangas.titleNative: 撮影のあとで食べさせて？
mangas.synonyms: Let me eat it after shooting?
mangas.description: The rookie actor Haruki has his first role costarring with the popular actor he's looked up to since he was a kid, Yuito Shinonome. Excited to greet him, Haruki heads to Yuito's dressing room only to find him blue in the face and collapsed on the ground!! As Haruki looks after Yuito, he asks what happened ? and Yuito tells him he can't handle sexually-charged behavior! "Haruki, you're my fan, right? Could you pretend to be my lover?" The moment Haruki agreed to the direct request of his favorite actor, for some reason a kiss falls upon him, sweet and swooning...!?

mangas.title: Sweetie Agape
mangas.titleNative: スウィーティーアガペー
mangas.description:
Father Lucas seems to attract misfortune wherever he goes. It all started with the fire that took his parents' lives. Since then, he has met numerous pickpockets and swindlers. And now? He has stumbled upon a badly injured man, unconscious in the middle of the woods! Lucas, alarmed, brings the man to the nearest church to tend to his wounds. By some miracle, the man wakes up soon after and seems almost completely recovered, even though the doctor said he might be out for another three days. Just who is this beautifully invincible man!? Has Lucas attracted yet another calamity...?



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: α no Ie no Ko
mangas.description:
Nishimiya Kouga is from a distinguished alpha family which puts severe importance on being purebred.

At work, the person he acknowledges as his rival in business performance is Houjou Misaki, who is also an alpha.

Kouga has been putting some distance from his alpha supremacist grandfather, the current head of the Nishimiya clan. But one day, on the latter's orders, the family butler, Harada, visited Kouga with a child.

Haruto, the omega child, is a distant relative and Kouga has been ordered to care for him. Kouga, despite his disgust with how selfish alphas are, felt pity for the meek and frail-looking Haruto and reluctantly complied.

Now, Kouga is struggling to take care of Haruto who to his surprise, turned out to be a really energetic boy. At the same time, Kouga found out that Houjou also sends his child to the same kindergarten that Haruto attends.

And that's when he discovered a shocking truth about Houjou.

mangas.title: Kojika Counter!
mangas.description: Due to his father's transfer, Setoguchi Hotori is forced to attend an unruly school overrun by Yankees, where he is bullied everyday. Finally, after weeks of bullying Setoguchi realizes that the key to his freedom lies in winning over Kuse, the leader of the group. But how far will Setoguchi go...?

mangas.title: Fantasia World
mangas.description: Youngjin joined a Role-playing Game so he could talk to his crush. Who would've thought that he'd be his crush's in-game lover? How long would he keep up the pretense?

mangas.title: One Reason Why He Hates Me
mangas.titleNative: 그가 나를 싫어하는 한 가지 이유
mangas.description: Seo-Woo is head over heals in love with Do-Young, except there seems to be a major problem... Do-Young hates him. After a love fairy visits Seo-Woo, he's given a chance to make Do-Young fall in love with him, but only on one condition- he needs to find out the one reason why he hates him.

mangas.title: Osananajimi no Kao ga Yosugite Sakaraenai
mangas.titleNative: 幼なじみの顔が良すぎて逆らえない
mangas.description: Akane, a high school student who loves pretty faces and is an idol otaku, is being pressed by his handsome childhood friend, Harumi. "Wake me up," "Kiss me," "Stay here." Akane can't resist when he's begging, but he's too thick-headed to notice Harumi's affection for him. They are in a state of "Are they not dating yet?" because they've been really close to each other since they were young. But at one point, Harumi gets serious and approaches Akane...?!

mangas.title: Ikemen no Senpai ga Jitsu wa Doutei de Junjou deshita
mangas.titleNative: イケメンの先輩が実は童貞で純情でした
mangas.synonyms: Ikemen no Sempai ga Jitsu wa Dotei de Junjo deshita

mangas.title: Yankee & Carameliser
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーとキャラメリゼ
mangas.description:
Take one influencer and one bad boy extraordinaire, whisk in a sprinkling of sweets, a scoop of social media, and you get...? Maki and Akito's love story, hot out of the oven! After all, even though Maki might have a bit of a bad rep, the guy must be just as gooey on the inside as the glorious goodies he posts all over social media. So when Akito gets a taste of how dangerously delicious his desserts are, he can't help wanting a taste of the man himself...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: I Can't Get Through the Night Alone
mangas.titleNative: ひとりで夜は越えられない
mangas.description:
Japan, 1950s. Seishiro is unable to sleep alone at night due to the trauma of the war, and lives a dull life.



One day, he meets Jim, a kind American soldier stationed in Japan. Jim falls in love with Seishiro at first sight. This could be the perfect chance to change his life... Their relationship started out of calculation, but as they sleep in each other's sweet embrace, Seishiro's heart gradually melts. However, he cannot imagine a future where they live together...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hands Off My Sub
mangas.description:
Enter the Dom/Sub Universe! Popular host Haruki has been hiding his "sub" nature with suppressants while working at a host club, but the lack of tending to his needs is leaving him drained. He downloads a Dom/Sub matching app to find a partner for a one-night stand. The dom that appears is handsome and gentle, and when he commands Haruki to "Kneel," his body moves involuntarily and he can't stop himself from getting excited. After their night of "play", Haruki leaves feeling satisfied and recovered. But when he arrives at work the next week, the dom from that night, Suguri, shows up to work alongside him as a new host! The man he thought he would never meet again turns to him and says, "I want you to be my partner"...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: You Know You're Cuter!
mangas.titleNative: お前のほうがかわいいくせに
mangas.description:
Kazuki and Seiji live together to save on costs and they've been friends their entire lives... or so it seemed. When Kazuki says he's gonna use an escort to experience his "first time", their relationship totally changes. Seiji says he's willing to help him and, for some reason, they become a couple! Kazuki knows that Seiji also hasn't done the deed, so he thinks Seiji just wants to prevent him from being the first to pop his cherry, but...


(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shirouto Dakedo Ari desu ka
mangas.titleNative: 素人だけどアリですか
mangas.description:
One rainy day, Mitsuhashi, an ordinary office worker, picks up a popular porn actor named Ren. The drenched Ren doesn't have an umbrella, and doesn't seem like he has a place to go. Mitsuhashi couldn't leave him alone, so he decides to let Ren stay with him the night.
When he starts to get an erection from sleeping next to the handsome man, Ren asks him if he wants to "rub one out" for him...!
The seductive porn actor's expert technique causes Mitsuhashi to cum quickly, but Ren's incessant teasing causes him to go into a frenzy...!
The cocky Ren gets giggly at the sight of the masculine desire shown by the plain salaryman...?



(Source: Overlap, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I WON'T MARRY YOU!
mangas.description:
Itsuki a fresh high graduate was ordered by his mother to work as a servant under the Tenmei family.



Little does he know, that he was actually one of the candidates into becoming the bride of Tenmei's young master named Jin.



But competition proves to be fierce as the contenders are all male Omega from well known families while he was only from an ordinary household.

mangas.title: NAZELOVE: When a Student Council Member Educating(?) Their Junior Somehow Turns into a Romantic Comedy
mangas.titleNative: 生徒会役員として後輩を教育（？）していたら何故かラブコメになっていた件
mangas.description:
At Hananomiya Private High School, the Student Council holds ultimate authority. Mizuki is their President and successfully rehabilitates the infamous former problem child Hakaze and the two start dating. Meanwhile, the Vice President's pet project, Takanashi A.K.A. rehabilitation member number two, blossoms into a new romance. What's with all this love?! That is the question on Yuuichi Noda's, Student Council Secretary, mind as of late. Unable to understand the new love in the air, Yuuchi complains to the Student Council's Treasurer, the stoic genius sophomore, Hiroki Matsunaga. As Yuuichi's best and only friend, he offers that they jump on the love train together and see what the hype is all about.

(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: I'm Kinda Chubby and I'm Your Hero
mangas.titleNative: 冴えない僕は、君のヒーロー
mangas.description:
Lights, camera, Boys' Love!



Honjirou is a rookie actor trying his best to land a breakout role, but he fears that his weight stands in the way of his dreams. One day, he's surprised by fan mail full of sweets. The package came from Konnosuke, a local pastry chef–Honjirou's first major fan! As Konnosuke supports Honjirou's work and gives him new confidence to face the stage, will their relationship grow beyond just aspiring star and fanboy?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Ookami-kun wa Suki ga Kakusenai
mangas.titleNative: オオカミくんは好きが隠せない
mangas.synonyms: The Wolf can't Hide His Affection
mangas.description:
This is a world where humans and beast people coexist. The helpful leopard, Tomoru, and the wolf, Hibiki, who goes at his own pace, are childhood friends who live together. One day, Tomoru is told by Hibiki that he likes him, and their relationship changes! Tomoru, who realizes he thinks of Hibiki as more than family, accepts his confession, and the two of them start dating. However, Hibiki changes into his beast form whenever he gets excited. How will he skillfully make out now they're lovers...?!



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Henshin Shichau
mangas.synonyms: Nise x Koi Boyfriend dj - Henshin Shichau
mangas.description: Extra story featuring Soutarou and Meguru from the first story of Nise x Koi Boyfriend.

mangas.title: Nise x Koi Boyfriend: lovely
mangas.titleNative: 偽×恋ボーイフレンド lovely
mangas.synonyms: 弱虫カレシとろくでなし
mangas.description:
The sequel to Nise x Koi Boyfriend between a cute cross-dresser and a plain otaku boy is here!
After all the twists and turns, Satoi and Soutarou are now completely in love with each other,
but fate is not always so kind to them...
Satoi's friend Mifune, a handsome and kind-hearted man, falls in love at first sight with Satoi dressed as a woman!
What's more, Satoi suspects Soutarou of two-timing with a beautiful girl...?
The battle for the timid Soutarou's love begins now!



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Nise x Koi Boyfriend
mangas.description: Soutarou Inugami is a shy and reserved high schooler interested in anime and manga. Although content with his lot in life, Soutarou also wouldn't mind having a fateful encounter with a cute girl someday. Lucky for him, he comes home from school one day to find a girl sitting at his doorstep who he's never seen before, but who happens to have the same red earrings as Meguru Satoi, a cool and good-looking guy at his school.

mangas.title: Kimi wa Itoshi no Liar Boy
mangas.titleNative: きみは愛しのライアーボーイ
mangas.description:
Ryuusei is tasked to be the star in a prank video in an attempt to go viral. His objective? Confess to his friend from his yankee days, Sawami! Ryuusei shies away from the idea of making the man he admires the butt of a joke, but he's intrigued to see how Sawami would react and reluctantly accepts. He tells himself he'll be satisfied if he gets a laugh out of him, but his friend's response is unexpectedly serious!



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Bed of My Dear King
mangas.description: An electrician called to a remote job deep in the mountains discovers the startling reasons behind the behavior of the house's lone occupant, an eccentric young sculptor.

mangas.title: Ookami-sama no Koiwazurai
mangas.description:
A world where humans and beastmen co-exist. Wolf-type beastman Haine falls for Natsuo despite thinking little of "humans" and ends up kissing him. The more he gets to know Natsuo, the more he wants to make him his, so Haine, having come to like someone seriously for the first time, starts pursuing him aggressively?!



(Source: JP Renta, translated and edited)

mangas.title: Ore to Renai Shite Mimasen ka
mangas.titleNative: オレと恋愛してみませんか
mangas.description:
Recently divorced gay company man, Narumi, visits a cafe he used to be a regular at prior to his marriage. There, cafe employee Kida confesses that he has feelings for Narumi, having been comforted by Narumi's words four years ago. Due to past trauma, Narumi has become timid in love, but when Kida proposes, "Won't you try falling in love with me?" their love trial begins!



An obedient younger doggy-type x innocent alpha's bittersweet, too cute, pure love begins!



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hatsukoi ni wa Kanawanai!
mangas.synonyms: I Am No Match for the First Love!
mangas.description:
Though you act cold and unfeeling… I know just how cute you are.



After being transferred back to the branch office in his hometown, Shinokawa coincidentally ends up being next-door neighbors with Kaede, the boy he adored during his student days. One day, a drunk Kaede reveals that he enjoys taking it up the ass…?!



A reunion push-pull romance between a somewhat sly, popular man and his hot-cold, temperamental neighbor.

mangas.title: Glass Syndrome
mangas.synonyms: Glass Taion Shoukougun | Garasu Taion Shoukougun
mangas.description:
Class president Nijou is a talented athlete, popular honor student... and a total people-pleaser who can't stop living up to others' smothering expectations of him. When his teacher asks him to check on Toomi, a classmate who's stopped coming to school, that chance meeting leads to an unexpected connection that neither young man expects. Toomi sees right through his diligent facade, and Nijou can't forget the cool comfort of Toomi's undemanding touch.

But when Nijou discovers the reason behind Toomi's frequent absences — that he's been working as an online cam "girl" — he doesn't know how to react. How can he bring up what he knows? And how will it change their relationship?

mangas.title: Torokeru Kaikan Sokuochi Akuma
mangas.titleNative: トロける快感ソク堕ち悪魔
mangas.description: When trying to do his work correctly as a demon while the others are idling away in the demon world, Alfas goes to the human world and discovers a strong soul that seems delicious. But what will happen when the human he thought would beg for his life asks to have sex with him as his last wish? And what is this pleasure he's feeling!?

mangas.title: Yuurei
mangas.description: Fear and self-loathing coalesce with tragic consequences in this haunting tale of a college boy who is repulsed by his classmate's openly gay childhood friend.

mangas.title: Lovestruck in High School
mangas.titleNative: ハイスクールラララブ
mangas.description:
"I've always dreamed of falling in love at an all-boys school!!" Right when Hinata finally gets accepted to a boys' school, his dad gets transferred overseas and Hinata's sent to live with a family friend. A little nervous, he heads to the address, only to find a guy who's just his type waiting at the door! A lovestruck Hinata forgets all his worries in an instant. Excited, Hinata starts fantasizing about all the ways things might go, getting very turned on. He can't help touching himself, and gets caught red-handed by the guy of his dreams! What will become of his life as a strapping young schoolboy!!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Love Plan
mangas.description:
"Why am I naked in bed with another man…?"

Jae-Woo reluctantly attends his high school reunion and he can't wait to leave. But after seeing someone he thought he'd never meet again, he ends up drinking himself into a stupor. The next day, Jae-Woo wakes up next to Si-Yeon, the boy that was pining after him throughout high school. This is Si-Yeon's chance to pounce! He offers Jae-Woo a deal, one month of dating, after which things can end amicably, no questions asked. But as rumors start spreading about the circumstances surrounding the reunion, Jae-Woo starts becoming suspicious of Si-Yeon's true intentions…

mangas.title: Hanagara Tsumi
mangas.description: Shuu's partner at work is none other than Ayame. His ex-bully, Alpha senior from middle and high school. The same Ayame that used to call him, an omega, out and toy with him over really trivial things. Shuu just wants a peaceful life, but is that really possible now with this reunion?!?!

mangas.title: Loving You When the World Ended
mangas.titleNative: 世界末日也要和你在一起
mangas.synonyms: At the End of the World, I Still Want to be with You
mangas.description:
An apocalyptic event forces two strangers to navigate a world where the old order is shattered. Is it survival of the fittest or survival of the richest? Spoiled Nuowan can't stay alive in this new reality without the help of skilled hotel worker Yu Sen, whom he met only moments before the world ended. Yu's former military training comes in handy but is kissing out of the blue a survival tactic?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Twilight Out of Focus: The Evening Monologues
mangas.description: First-year Shion Yoshino knows exactly what he wants: a boyfriend straight out of a shojo manga! After failing to find Mr. Right in several athletic teams, he settles on the Film Club and announces his intentions, only for retired Vice President Rei Inaba to make a stunning declaration: "There is 100% no way you're going to find a boyfriend here." That very same day, however, it's Rei himself who kisses Shion and asks him out! What does it all mean? Is this really the love of Shion's shojo dreams, or is Rei just a pretty face who won't make room for anyone else in his life? One thins is for certain: Shion Yoshino won't give up without a fight!

mangas.title: Nekura to Gyaruo
mangas.description:
Hana-kun is a tall, introverted boy, and Tomo-chan is an extroverted, flamboyant guy. They had been apart since Hana-kun transferred away in elementary school, but by chance, they meet again in high school...! This is a slightly romantic coming-of-age story in which two high school boys with opposite personalities slowly come to terms with their feelings and each other over time!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for a commercial book release by Kadokawa.

mangas.title: Cover My Scars With Your Kiss
mangas.titleNative: 傷あとにくちづけ sweet time
mangas.synonyms: Kizuato ni Kuchidzuke | Key to My Heart
mangas.description:
Seiichi Kurusu and Nao Seto are officially dating and living together.

Even though they share a home now, their busy jobs have made it difficult for them to spend time together. When Seiichi reveals that his father has been trying to set him up with marriage interviews, Nao realizes that he doesn't want to let Seiichi go. With Seiichi's position as the eldest son set to inherit his father's company, will they be able stay together forever?

mangas.title: Love-Shower for the Twisted Flower
mangas.titleNative: ひねくれ花に愛をそそいで
mangas.synonyms: Hinekure Hana ni Ai wo Sosoi de
mangas.description: When Kyousuke was heartbroken and getting drunk at a bar, he was invited by the refreshingly handsome Touma, and they ended up spending a drunken night together. However, the next morning Touma confessed that he's been watching Kyousuke for a long time. Knowing that Touma is younger than him, Kyousuke, who likes older men, ran away. But no matter how many times he rejected him, Touma continued to show his straightforward love, and drove Kyousuke crazy.

mangas.title: When I See Your Face, I Can't Hold Back
mangas.titleNative: その顔見たら、我慢はできない
mangas.synonyms: When I See That Face, I Can't Hold It Anymore
mangas.description:
From childhood experience, Matsukawa believes that appearances are everything. He makes every effort to keep up his good looks in every way possible. His co- workers respect and look up to him. On the other hand, his junior, Chihiro, is naturally blessed with handsome looks. While Matsukawa is jealous of Chihiro's effortless beauty, he recognizes his junior's diligence and remains the supportive senior. On the other hand, Chihiro looks at Matsukawa as more than just his senior, and Matsukawa is not ready when things get heated fast. How can he even say no to a face like that?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Akame no Nie, Kami no Akari (紅目の贄、神の灯, Sacred Crimson Light)" previously published in the Retro BL (レトロBL) anthology.

mangas.title: Shitsukete Tokashite Abaite Medete
mangas.titleNative: 躾けてとかして暴いて愛でて
mangas.synonyms: Discipline Me. Melt Me. Expose Me. Love Me
mangas.description:
"Senpai, I'll dominate you to the marrow of your bones."



Sumio Tachibana, a resident orthopedic surgeon, has spent his days as a sub controlling his desires to be dominated and controlled. However, he doesn't have a designated Dom, and remaining in this state will damage him both mentally and physically. Because of this, Sumio decides to visit a SUB-only club... There he meets his old high school junior, now a yakuza, Wanizuka Itsumi. Since Sumio doesn't have a designated dom he urges, "Let me become senpai's dom." ?!



(Source: Renta!, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Heat x Beat: A Shut-In Omega Becomes an Idol!
mangas.titleNative: Heat×Beat～引きこもりオメガがアイドルに！？～
mangas.description:
As an omega abandoned by his betrothed alpha mate, shut-in Minoru shares his heartbreak with the world in the form of music. But when one of his songs catches the attention of famous idol Hijiri, Minoru is suddenly swept from the lonely solitude of his room and thrust into the spotlight — as an omega idol and music producer performing alongside his two alpha bandmates, Eiji and Tatsuya!



For any other group, this could prove a recipe for controversy and disaster, but Minoru isn't worried; his lingering attachment to his former mate keeps him from acting on his omega instincts. For a while, he's even able to throw himself whole-heartedly into his new role, learning to embrace the world he'd once retreated from, and even growing closer to his bandmates and fellow idols, especially the frank and affectionate Eiji. But Eiji is hiding a secret of his own — a connection to Minoru's past that might shatter the tentative trust and affection that's been growing between them.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Katsuyoku Scandal
mangas.description:
College student and model, Sari, is really an Omega, but he hates it so much he's decided to live as a Beta. One day, his manager (and older sister) asks him to scout Taiga, another Beta at the same school for a pair modeling session.
The two hit it off from their first meeting and celebrate the end of the shoot. Sari feels comfortable with Taiga, but under some intoxicating force, he goes into heat from Taiga's smell. Although he thought Taiga was a Beta, it turns out that, just like Sari, he's also been hiding his real sex and is actually an Alpha...!?

mangas.title: Sunshine Lovesick
mangas.titleNative: サンシャイン・ラブシック
mangas.description:
The dreamer boy, Taiyo, looks up to the COOL and WAVY dancer, Kunishige Takato! a.k.a. God! When he moved to the capital, he used this chance to join the same dance studio as Takato. The real side of the cold-looking Takato is actually very frank? Moreover, he misunderstood Taiyo's gesture and went for a kiss..!?



Check out this tension-raising love comedy written by Haida Nanako!

(Source: Yaoi Sekai)

mangas.title: Maybe It's Courtship
mangas.description:
Every day, just like clockwork, Hirono Nanami hurries home—because if he doesn't, he just knows that annoying Godai would hunt him down and challenge him to a match again! As it turns out, Nanami can easily beat Godai in all kinds of sports except one, and Godai jumps on the chance...but, feeling bad that he's taken advantage of the one weakness Nanami has, Godai decides to settle things between them with something they've never tried before—by whipping out what, now!?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter and the one-shot "Momoiro no Okite (桃色の掟, The Rules of Pink)".

mangas.title: Only the Flower Knows
mangas.description: Youichi's life at university is going just fine. He isn't having any trouble with his classes, he has plenty of friends, and even a cute girlfriend named Minami. Then the day comes where he meets Misaki. Misaki is a reserved, stand offish fellow but for some reason, Youichi can't seem to get him out of his mind. In fact, he can't seem to stay away. When he lands a job working in the lab with Misaki, it seems more than just the flowers are about to bloom. But will they recognize their emotions for what they are, and have the courage to accept it?

mangas.title: Our Love Will Continue on in the Next Life
mangas.titleNative: 来世の君にくちづけを
mangas.synonyms: My Love Will Last Till The End of Time
mangas.description:
Former prince with memory of previous life x former commoner without memory. "Do you still love me, now that you are reborn?"



Hiroto, a college student, has memories of his "previous life." He used to be the heir to the throne. He was deeply in love with a commoner man. Then, that day, their love was ruthlessly torn apart. Ever since he regained his memories, when he still was a child, Hiroto has been searching for his beloved Mika in this world. He vows that this time, they will find happiness together. Fate brings them together once again, but Mika's reincarnation, Kou, has no memory of his previous life... A reincarnation BL story drowning in past sins and passion!



(Source: ShuCream BL)

mangas.title: Unraveled Cherry
mangas.description:
Chiharu's been doing pretty well for himself recently. He has a fulfilling job he enjoys, and a super-hot boyfriend who picks him up every day on his big bike...what's not to love? What's not to love is that from the very start of their relationship, his younger boyfriend Tomoya has been making up rules for their romance - rules that say they can't go further than hugging until Tomoya graduates from college! Tomoya probably means well, but Chiharu's restraint can't take it any longer...will his plan work?

(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Ten Years' Worth of Love! Eat Up!
mangas.description:
Takayuki is a daycare worker nearing 40 years of age. He meets Shun, a young part-timer, and although this is their first meeting, Shun's smile seems nostalgic for some reason...



During the children's nap time, Shun embraces him and says, "We promised, right? That when I got older, we'd get married." Shun's warm tongue twists and turns as he begins to get hard. "Don't worry. What I want from you is down here..." he says, while stroking Takayuki as he himself starts to get hard...!



The love accidents just keep coming between this easily moved 38-year-old daycare teacher and his former student who tops from the bottom! It's time for a bellyful of love? Eat up!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Paradigm Shift
mangas.description:
Hibiya is born Beta and works as a researcher. One day a new researcher came, claiming that he is a Beta and that he came to the company because he respects him.
While the researchers were preforming experiments with some animals, Hibiya was accidentally stung by a bee and caused hypersensitivity as he is allergic to bee stings, and he had been stung once when he was small.

mangas.title: A Tough Alpha Wants to Be Loved -Cornered by a Young Omega-
mangas.titleNative: 強面αは抱かれたい～年下Ωに責められ掘られ
mangas.synonyms: Kowamote Alpha wa Dakaretai: Toshishita Omega ni Semerare Horare
mangas.description: Ikeya is good at his job, his colleagues look up to him, and he can always be relied upon. He just has one wish: for a guy to top him. He plays with himself every night and is desperate for the real thing, but unfortunately, he's a scary-looking alpha, making it almost impossible to find a partner. One day, Yuuhei Shimamori, who happens to be an omega, starts work at Ikeya's company. He may look like a carefree playboy, but his diligence soon catches Ikeya's attention. However, when the two of them are alone in the office one night, Yuuhei goes into heat! Pheromones overflowing, he tells Ikeya that he needs an alpha, or his symtoms won't stop... Ikeya can hardly control himself, and at his limit, asks Yuuhei to top him!

mangas.title: Kiss de Tokashita Sono Ato ni
mangas.titleNative: キスで溶かしたそのあとに
mangas.synonyms: จุมพิตละลายหัวใจให้นายหันมารัก
mangas.description: By the decision of his parents, university student Aise Hiro is currently freeloading at the house of his friend's older brother, Onosawa Mizuki. Mizuki is a handsome accountant and the ideal husband and Hiro is basking in his good looks. At first glance, their life together is pleasant, with Hiro making meals and waking Mizuki in the mornings. But there's a problem: Hiro is romantically interested in men, and Mizuki is his first love! One day, while feeling horny, the worst happens when Mizuki sees Hiro masturbating. Even worse, everything is discovered, including his posts on social media that he's "taking applications for a boyfriend" and that he was provoked by an erotic message. However, Mizuki says something completely unexpected: "If you're that frustrated, why not have a fake romance with me?".

mangas.title: Yarichin ni Yoru Trauma Kokufuku xxx
mangas.titleNative: ヤリチンによるトラウマ克服×××
mangas.synonyms: A Playboy's Way of Overcoming Trauma by ×××
mangas.description: Shizuka is a university student who has come to hate sex because of his previous boyfriend. Because of his trauma, he decided he wouldn't involve himself with other people any more... Until he was unceremoniously dragged along to a drinking party by his frivolous classmate, Saito. After getting drunk in this unfamiliar situation, Shizuka is brought along to a hotel by Saito... Yet unexpectedly, he is swept away by Saito's good manners, and for some reason the sex that he hated so much is starting to feel different...?

mangas.title: My Brother Left Behind Someone We Loved
mangas.titleNative: 兄が遺した恋のゆくえ
mangas.description:
After his brother Haruki passes away, Kazuki heads to a coastal village to meet Yukito, his brother's omega widow, with the hopes of living with him after their devastating loss. Yukito reluctantly agrees to let Kazuki stay in the shed on the property but insists that he doesn't need any help in his day-to-day life. However, with the side effects from the heat suppressants taking their toll on his health, could living with Kazuki end up being beneficial after all?



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Stray Cat's Dinner
mangas.description:
On his way home from work one day, Shiota, a hard-working businessman, stumbles upon a stranger who's about to pass out from hunger. Surprisingly, the man happens to be a co-worker from a previous part-time job, Suzuya! Unable to just leave his acquaintance be, Shiota puts his years of cooking for himself to good use and whips up a few dishes to share. Although Suzuya leaves satisfied that night, he starts to make a habit of showing up to Shiota's place whenever he's in search of a good meal. Shiota should hate having to feed Suzuya whenever he shows up, but he's actually finding himself getting quite attached to this stray cat that has entered his life...



This volume also contains the age-gap romance stories Slate Blue and The Sky and Gray Blue!



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kochira Seinaru Famiresu, Numa no Soko
mangas.titleNative: こちら聖なるファミレス、沼の底
mangas.synonyms: In Too Deep: Our Hallowed Diner
mangas.description:
A screenwriter is spending Christmas alone at a diner, a fan of people-watching and the atmosphere it provides. When he discovers he's forgotten his lighter, a fellow patron offers him one at the cost of intruding on his personal space. This is the story of two men and the possible beginnings between them on a lonely, holiday night.



Note: Released at COMITIA 146.

mangas.title: Oishii Machiawase
mangas.description:
What should we eat tomorrow?



(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)



Note: Published in ihr HertZ 2022 November issue.

mangas.title: Otameshi to wa Ie, Suki Sugiru
mangas.titleNative: お試しとはいえ、好きすぎる
mangas.description:
Hiroki Okami works at a drugstore, and Shintaro Takimoto is a young man who visits the store at the same time every day. Their short talks was a secret pleasure for Hiroki at work. One day, Shintaro confides in Hiroki, "I don't have the courage to confess to the person I like." In turn, Hiroki encourages him, "It'll be fine, you're so attractive." That was when Shintaro suddenly confesses, "The one I like is Okami-san!?"



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Mitsuketa Boku no Omega-sama
mangas.titleNative: 見つけたボクのオメガ様
mangas.description:
There is nothing left of that proud child... What happened to Daiki Kudou, who had a radical change in his life after learning about the elementary school that was Omega? Now in the university, there is an Alpha that claims to be one of his old childhood friends and that he wants to make it his mate no matter what... Is this a love story?



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Fool and his Gangster
mangas.titleNative: ヤクザの恋人はアホかわいい
mangas.description: "If you want a sucker that bad, I've got something for you..." Joji looks like a violent gangster, but he's actually a kind and caring person. Yuu, on the other hand, makes a living with his body. Ever since he found Yuu beaten in an alley, Joji can't say no whenever the boy begs for food or money. Joji is worried about Yuu and makes him promise to find honest work. But, despite his promise, Joji finds Yuu trying to pick up customers again. Yuu doesn't value his life no matter how much danger he's in, and Joji finds himself acting impulsively...! With a caring gangster and a boy of questionable virtue, this is a romantic comedy with a touch of danger!

mangas.title: Rental Kareshi no Oshiri wo Goshimei
mangas.titleNative: レンタル彼氏のお尻をご指名
mangas.description: University student Iori Kakeru, who works hard at his part-time job as a rental boyfriend, receives a request from a man named Tamaki. His sincere appearance wins Iori over, and he falls for Tamaki's surprising plan...

mangas.title: Hana wo Tadoreba Kimi no Yubisaki
mangas.titleNative: 花をたどれば君の指先
mangas.description: Mayuki meets his first crush ten years later, only to find that he hasn't aged a single bit. He reveals that he is a "god" to Mayuki, whose love for him overcomes his confusion at the situation. And so begins his life with "god"...

mangas.title: An Occupation Unsuited for Secrecy
mangas.titleNative: 秘密には向かない職業
mangas.description:
"You are so dazzling, yet far away."

Yori, the leader of the idol group "D.BUG", and his ex-manager, Mikura, are dating in secret. The company president had approved of their cohabitation and their shared lives were smooth-sailing until one day, Yori gets selected for a stage play by the famous stage director, Ogami. Ogami discovers Yori's potential as an actor as Yori begins to immerse himself in Ogami's play. Watching the relationship between these two develop, complicated feelings start to take root in Mikura's heart...

mangas.title: Occupation Not Suitable for Love
mangas.description: Yori Kashii, the leader of the idol group D. BUG, has had hidden feelings for his former manager, Haruto Mikura. Mikura still treats him specially even after leaving, though Yori knows it's just because of work. However, those feelings finally overflow...?!

mangas.title: Tsubana Kasu Haru
mangas.description: Chiaki has finally found something to look forward to in life-His regular visits to the flower vendor who opens shop once in a few months. When delivering mail to his house, he accidentally stumbles upon his biggest secret, which changes their relationship and gets Chiaki a chance to get closer to Mei.

mangas.title: Hell Brother Heirs
mangas.titleNative: 二代目! 地獄ブラザーズ
mangas.description:
Due to an influx of sinners, the Ten Kings of Hell were granted heirs to support them in the future. The said ten heirs studied together since they were children and were now all grown up. A collection of stories on relationships among them: "Enma's Studies": Enma has always aced his studies, but their recent lesson about 'Eros' leaves him confused, so he asks the frivolous Sotei for help. "Byodo's Unfair Romance in All Fairness": Byodo has always liked Godo since they were children, but the latter has feelings for their other mutual heir, Toshi. Heartbroken, Byodo vents his feelings out to Taizan. "Shinko's Dilemma": Being the heir to the first seat has been a struggle for Shinko, who was known for his gentle nature, contradicting the imposing image of his father. One day, he meets the mysterious 'Blackhat,' to which he can't help but be drawn.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Labradorescence
mangas.titleNative: ラブラド・レッセンス
mangas.description: Shunji Fujishiro, a photographer, wakes up one morning in a hospital bed, where he was transported after losing consciousness during a fall on a staircase.
