He is immediately surprised and irritated by the casual attitude of the physician who looks after him, Mutsumi Higa. Nevertheless,their meeting gives Shunji the motivation and inspiration he needed for his photography projects. As for Mutsumi, he is intrigued by Shunji, whose honest and impulsive character is diametrically opposed to his…

mangas.title: Every Day Is a Good Day
mangas.titleNative: エブリデイ イズ ア グッドデイ
mangas.description: It's been a year since Toki lost his twin sister in an accident. Toki is still dealing with the pain, but while his parents are away on a trip, he must now also take care of his orphaned nephew, who hasn't spoken a word since losing both of his parents. While Toki struggles to raise a child, his friend's younger brother Chihiro, starts giving a helping hand. How will these 3 people become a temporary family?

mangas.title: I Might Be Your Fan, but I'll Never Fall for You!
mangas.titleNative: 推しには絶対ほだされない
mangas.description:
Yuki Miyama is an up-and-coming young star. He has always adored Masataka Kitamura, a modern-day Valentino, and is excited to have the chance to work with the older actor, who ends the session by snorting at his performance. To make matters worse, Yuki gets totally smashed after Masataka toys with him over drinks. The next thing he knows, he's lying in bed... with Masataka! A love story about a naive model who is swayed every which way by a hot, mysterious actor!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Kozure Omega to Boukun Yakuza blooming
mangas.titleNative: 子連れΩと暴君ヤクザ blooming
mangas.description:
Sequel to "Kozure Omega to Boukun Yakuza".



Note: Chapter count includes an extra

mangas.title: Kozure Omega to Boukun Yakuza
mangas.description:
New Omega mother Tatsumi snaps at the yakuza Ryuuga and catches his interest. Cajoled and pampered... the start of a life as a yakuza's wife!



Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

mangas.title: Omega no Mukotori
mangas.description:
A young gang leader, the omega Yoshiharu, is ordered by his boss into an arranged marriage with an alpha from another clan.
However, his matchmaking partner, impatient with the unwilling Yoshiharu, drugged him to put him in heat.
When he is rescued by his second, Makoto, Yoshiharu discovers that Makoto is the one who is his truly destined partner.
Yoshiharu is relieved that his soul mate is someone he could trust, but Makoto refused to consummate the relationship...?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Lying Omega Can't Resist!
mangas.description:
An omega who was pretending to be a beta is suddenly the mate of a top tier alpha!?



It happened one night on their way home from a company drinking party. When Mr. Hashida takes care of the drunken Mr. Hayashi, just a small amount of Mr. Hashida's omega pheromones is enough to drive Mr. Hayashi into a frenzy. Despite his resistance, Mr. Hayashi not only has his body taken, but Mr. Hayashi bites his neck indicating that they've become mates. However, it seems Mr. Hayashi remembers nothing from that night... Mr. Hashida considers himself lucky and continues to pretend to be a beta. He decides to hide that he's his mate forever, but Mr. Hayashi (an alpha) keeps desiring his body!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

mangas.title: Ruby Red wo Kamikudaku
mangas.titleNative: ルビーレッドを噛み砕く
mangas.description:
I want to be "special" to my sensei.



Akane is an Omega who can see people's pheromones as multicolored "crystals". During his school days, when he was lonely because of his peculiar constitution, he meets Makise, a school nurse teacher. 5 years later, they are miraculously reunited, but Makise has a secret...?


(Source: Libre, translated)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Nemureru Mori
mangas.description:
A short story about inappropriate love wandering between dreams and reality.

(from Wasurenagusa)

mangas.title: When You Wake Up Tomorrow
mangas.description:
Hironori and Kento have been live-in boyfriends for three months. One average morning, as Hironori was enjoying a cup of coffee, Kento asked a question, "Can I fuck you during your sleep when you look like you're in good shape?" ー much to Hironori's surprise. While Kento ended up waving it off, Hironori was plagued with the thought for the rest of the day. Hironori then reminiscences over the day he met Kento and the events that led them to their current relationship. One thing is sure, as long as it's with each other, anything and everything is enough.



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: The chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Fall of an Immortal
mangas.description: Tohma Mikado, heir to Mikado Holdings has it all -fame, looks, wits and reputation. He's the dream guy everybody wants and girls fawn all over him. Unfortunately for them, Tohma finds them dull and knows that most of them just want him for his money. One day, Tohma gets ambushed by street goons which leads him to meeting his eccentric savior Fujimi who helps people as a hobby, without asking anything in return. Curious about Fujimi's kindness, Tohma insists that he pay him back and learn more about the man himself. It seems Fujimi is more than what meets the eye.

mangas.title: A Vacation With Passionate Kisses
mangas.titleNative: あついキスはバカンスで
mangas.description: Jun, the successor of a rich family from Tokyo visits Okinawa in the middle of summer to attend a wedding ceremony. However, his father who was supposed to be waiting for him at the venue abandons him, leaving him a letter that says "Work hard at this inn"...!! As Jun is wandering about under the blazing sun, Natsumi, a handsome guy, offers to take him to the inn. As it turns out, he actually works there. Jun's heart starts racing when he hears that that they're going to live under the same roof and work together. "Well, you had this longing expression", Natsumi says after his hot tongue found its way inside his mouth.

mangas.title: Life - The Road That Leads To You
mangas.description:
Practical Akira Ito and child-like Yuki Nishi bump into each other while they each play their own version of "the floor is lava" on a white line on the side of the road. Soon enough, Akira falls in love with Yuki, and he can't help but be frustrated about only getting to interact with Yuki during this game, which is why he ends up kissing him...



A beautiful love story about two teenage boys becoming men as we get to watch them grow older with time. Watch out! You may need some tissues while you read this tear-jerker. Life might change, but love never does.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Yoidore Koi wo Sezu
mangas.description: Thirty-two year old Suwa Misumi is a Master of Sake and has just recently been fired from his job due to causing trouble from being "too friendly" since he doesn't like to refuse requests. At the lowest point in his life, he now finds a restaurant he desperately wants to work at. Only problem is that his latest drunken one night stand is the owner!!

mangas.title: My Private Love Actor
mangas.titleNative: プライベート・ラブマイアクター
mangas.description:
Tsukasa Hirayama works as a voice-over actor, primarily in anime. One day, his manager tells him he has signed Tsukasa up for a live-action movie, and he is to co-star with Kentaro Fujisawa, a handsome, popular actor. Tsukasa has admired Kentaro since he debuted as a child prodigy. His fantasies about being with Kentaro become a reality when the two were instructed to video chat to break the ice, ahead of the movie they'll be filming together!! After confessing his adoration for Kentaro, Tsukasa is convinced he's creeped him out. However, much to Tsukasa's surprise, Kentaro is flattered and interested in getting to know Tsukasa more. A love story between two on-screen and off-screen actors.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Roku to Rui
mangas.description:
Rui Takanashi dreams of a wonderful campus life. One day, the girl he's interested in calls him to meet to confess her feelings! Cheerfully heading there, all Rui finds is his childhood friend, Roku Koga. Looking back, Roku has kept on interfering with Rui's important moments. Like stealing the girl Rui liked or kissing him just to mess around... When Rui finally couldn't take it any longer, the only thing Roku said was just these unexpected words: "But I'm the one who likes you longer, Rui."

"I never knew this side of my childhood friend!!" The exciting love life of Roku, who can't be honest at all, and Rui, who is a beginner in love, starts now!

mangas.title: Tonari no Banken
mangas.description:
Hana and Kiyo are childhood friends who are now university students. They have been together since nursery school and their houses are even next door to each other. It was natural for Hana to be with Kiyo anytime and anywhere without any feelings of discomfort. However, one day, Hana noticed that Kiyo was popular with girls and with that, their relationship suddenly starts to change.



(Source: Renta JP, edited and translated)

mangas.title: Tasogare no Amrita
mangas.description: In a boarding school where talented young boys are gathered together, Tatsumi has the best grades and is the "president's favorite." However, his place was just stolen by the pretty boy Azuma who's rumored to be getting the president's attention. Tatsumi is irritated by this, but is forced to yield to Azuma whose personality completely changed from the harassment he's been receiving. Ever since then, Tatsumi's been scared of Azuma. Tatsumi ends up in the same room as him but slowly realize where his fear comes from...

mangas.title: The Movie Star All to Myself
mangas.titleNative: 人気俳優は憧れを独り占めしたい
mangas.synonyms: Ninki Haiyuu wa Akogare o Hitorijime Shitai
mangas.description:
It's been seven years since Aki Hagino quit acting and became a director... After breaking under the pressure of life as an actor, Aki wants his revenge and he's vowed to make sure anyone with talent is made sure they get the exposure they deserve. For that, he becomes a tough, no-nonsense director. People find him unapproachable, but the one guy who isn't fazed by Aki's gruff exterior is... the handsome and famous actor, Toma Shiraki.

A long time ago, when Aki and Toma worked together once, they (may have) had a one-night stand. Aki thought things would become uncomfortable between them after that, but on the contrary, Toma seems to be unable to stay away from Aki. Aki vows to never make the same mistake again, but...

mangas.title: All You Want, Whenever You Want
mangas.titleNative: 欲しいときだけ、好きなだけ
mangas.synonyms: All You Want, Whenever You Want
mangas.description:
On the surface, handsome Sales Manager Tsubaki is all smiles and professional grace — but underneath, he's a workaholic who bears the brunt of a tyrannical boss and throws himself into work to avoid heartache. When his first encounter with the newest transfer to his division, Makino, results in a clash of personalities, Tsubaki assumes that they might be too different to get along... But the forthright and fearless Makino turns out to be just Tsubaki's type, and attraction sparks between them when they end up as next-door neighbors at the company dormitory!

Tsubaki is determined to listen to his head over his heart and keep clear lines drawn between them, but there's no helping it; Makino's affections win him over despite his best efforts. Even though it might be a bad idea to mix business with pleasure, an impulsive hook-up turns into something more!

mangas.title: Itadakimasu, wa Koi no Aji
mangas.titleNative: いただきます、は恋の味
mangas.description:
A high school boy's lunchbox is filled with excitement! A BL about young love between a picky eater and a cooking fanatic!



Mizuno, a cooking fanatic, is so preoccupied about what other people eat that he even keeps a close eye on his classmates' lunches. He's particularly taken aback by the picky eater, Hashimoto, and worries that someday he'll get sick, and after a certain chain of events, Mizuno gets stuck with making Hashimoto's lunches for him! At first, Mizuno isn't crazy about the idea, but as he watches Hashimoto's face as he eats his perfectly balanced and nutritious packed lunches with gusto, Mizuno starts to enjoy his lunch time as well...



(Source: Live Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Our Sweet One-Room Apartment
mangas.description:
Kaname and Shima have been living together for a year. They have sex almost every day, and things are going well for the couple—at least until Kaname begins to think he's a sex addict and starts avoiding sex with Shima. Shima, on the other hand, mistakenly believes Kaname is bored of him. Will their long-awaited trip to Tokyo resolve this misunderstanding before it snowballs into an avalanche?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Link and Ring
mangas.titleNative: リンク アンド リング
mangas.description:
"If I ever get brave enough to say I like you from the top of my lungs--"


Bessho coincidentally meets Makita in a university lecture they share, finding out that they both like cute things. While Bessho hides his preferences like a dirty little secret, Makita makes no excuses for who he is and what he likes. Despite the twists and turns they encounter along the way, the pair of lovers deal with their possessive and jealous urges on their slow journey to answering the age-old question: what is the best way to fall in love?



(Source: Manga Planet)

mangas.title: Home
mangas.description:
1-3. Home

"When I'm an adult, I'll definitely be back. So, wait for me in this house, okay?"

The novelist Tatsumi finds a boy in his garden one day. Despite not being good to children in general, Subaru was innocent and like a puppy, and Tatsumi became accustomed to the proximity of Subaru as they spent time together. But is not Subaru coming home? Until the puppy becomes a big dog... An extremely sweet love between an innocent child and a twisted adult.


4. Semai Sekai ni (せまいせかいに)

5. ENDLESS WELCOME BACK

6. feel at home


(Source: Closeted Fujoshis)

mangas.title: Akihabara Fall in Love
mangas.titleNative: アキハバラフォーリンラブ
mangas.description:
1-4. Akihabara Fall In Love

Hasegawa was always called an Otaku when he was younger because of his glasses. Because of that, he had to hang out with other Otakus even though he didn't consider himself as one of them. He completely changed his image in middle school and finally landed in a large company after graduating from university. However, he has now been appointed to a local area, Akihabara where he once again finds himself shoulder to shoulder with other otakus.

One day, on his way home from work, he decides to help an otaku looking kid from getting robbed. However, he gets hurt and the next thing he knows is waking up in a strange room and encountering the person he helped in a compromising position.

5. Extra: The Coward's "I Love You"

Haru's childhood friend, Genta, is the new transfer student from America. Since their mothers were classmates in college, they spent most of their childhood together and Haru has loved him since then. But when the grown up Genta tells him that he has someone he likes, how will Haru react?

mangas.title: Sayonara Alpha Bangai-hen
mangas.titleNative: さよならアルファ番外編
mangas.description:
Haruka's short story collection of childhood, high school, and adulthood.



1. Bokutachi no Hatsukoi (僕たちの初恋, Our first love)

Haruka is trying to give flowers to Chinatsu for his birthday. (childhood)



2. Koibumi wa Todokanai (恋文は届かない, Love letters do not reach)

Haruka who can't help but want's to meet Chinatsu...

(1st year high school student)



3. Koibito-tachi no Yoru (恋人たちの夜, Lovers' night)

When Chinatsu returns home, Haruka stands with a scary smile...

(adulthood)

mangas.title: Sayonara Alpha
mangas.description:
A high school boy who's always considered himself to be an alpha finds out that he's an omega?? And his destined partner is a kid?



Note: Contains one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Wolf Me Up
mangas.titleNative: オオカミくんは俺しかいらない
mangas.description:
Taishi Odagiri wishes he weren't so short. Thanks to his height, he hasn't had a girlfriend for 17 years... let alone been intimate with a girl. Deciding to do something about it, Taishi goes to Haruomi Tsukamoto, a tall, unfriendly guy who Taishi feels has all the qualities he's always wanted in himself... but then, Haruomi proposes Taishi be his girlfriend for a while!! Taishi agrees to do this to learn how to "be a man," but on their date that day, Haruomi suddenly kisses him...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Salarymen's Love Hotel Boys' Club
mangas.titleNative: リーマンラブホ男子会
mangas.synonyms: Riman Loveho Danshi-kai | Lehman Love Hotel Men's Association | Office Worker's Love Hotel Guys' Night
mangas.description:
Straight guy Mamori Sendachi gets invited to a "Love Hotel Guys' Night" by his cool co-worker Taichi Ushirogi, but he's a little hesitant. Even so, he still goes with him.

Eat, drink, hang out, and take a bath in the huge tub when you're tired... it looks like Mamori has discovered a whole new way to have fun! But now that he's defenseless, there's a bit more to it -- Taichi has feelings for him!

Mamori notices something is a little off with Taichi... has he noticed how his coworker feels about him?
Their time at the love hotel is a little awkward, but their relationship starts to deepen...

mangas.title: Towa to Hata to Kiss no Yume
mangas.titleNative: とわとはたとキスの夢
mangas.synonyms: Towa, Hata, and Dreaming of a Kiss
mangas.description: Hata has been nursing his one-sided love for his childhood friend Towa ever since middle school. Now at university, Hata begins to slowly work his way up to confessing. But one night, after a drinking party, he wakes up next to his university classmate...

mangas.title: There's No Way This Is Fate. -Newlyweds Arc-
mangas.titleNative: こんなの運命じゃないから勘違いしないで 新婚編
mangas.synonyms: Don't Get It Wrong. This Is Not Such Destiny
mangas.description:
Welcome to the start of a blissful and loving life as newlyweds! Yuuzen is now wife to Kouetsu and Ginga. Their infatuation with him is never-ending, and the trio live happily together... However, sometimes a heaping helping of love can turn the tiniest of misunderstandings into full-blown fights! A simple visit to the park has Yuuzen doubting Ginga's loyalty! Is it time to panic!?

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Frilly Secret
mangas.description:
Aoi Suda is a gloomy, friendless kid, but nobody knows he's hiding a big secret... That is, he loves cute, girly things, and he's always cross-dressing on the sneak at home. One day, Yuto Moriuchi, his good-looking yet slightly intimidating classmate, accidentally finds out about his cross-dressing hobby! What's Aoi going to do...!?

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: There's No Way This Is Fate
mangas.titleNative: こんなの運命じゃないから勘違いしないで
mangas.description:
Yuuzen, Kouetsu, and Ginga have been best friends since preschool, and they're at the top of the pecking order at a prestigious academy for only the most elite alphas. With their good looks, money, and academic prowess, they enjoy life on easy mode... at least, until one day, Yuuzen displays symptoms of being an omega! Unable to resist Yuuzen's pheromones despite the medicine they take, Kouetsu and Ginga give in to their instincts. Taking turns, they force themselves upon a confused and ecstatic Yuuzen...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sonagi
mangas.description:
Little Geuroo was curious about him. That boy from next door who asked him a strange question. The boy, Lee Garam, who always avoided him even though all Geuroo wanted was to get close to him. But before Geuroo could even confess, Garam disappeared in thin air, leaving only clusters of blue light behind. And then, one summer, he appeared in front of Geuroo as if nothing happened...?



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)



Note: Part of Kidari Entertainment's "Yeoreumdanpyeonseon: Some in Summer (~키다리이엔티 여름단편선~ 썸인썸머, Kidari Entertainment Summer Short Story Collection: Some in Summer)"

mangas.title: Oku Made Furete mo Ii Desu ka
mangas.titleNative: 奥まで触れてもいいですか
mangas.synonyms: Can I Touch Your Inside Deeply?
mangas.description: Natsume is a hardworking and serious office worker. Yuuki is almost his polar opposite, and someone that he never expected to get along with. But Yuuki's kindness wins him over, and he falls in love with his carefree coworker. But what will happen when Yuuki discovers Natsume is in love with him...?

mangas.title: Torokeru Tamago to Bed no Naka de
mangas.titleNative: とろけるたまごとベッドの中で
mangas.description:
Yuu and Keigo are a happy couple of 10 years. They spend their days together like any other: wake up in the morning, eat breakfast, and go to work. Even in sickness and in health, you bet they'll be smiling happily (and getting in their sexy time)!



How do these two normal guys face the countless problems ahead and continue to spend their lives together? At the end awaits their future as a couple!



A day in the life of a gay couple living together!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

mangas.title: Futari de Papa Hajimemashita more
mangas.titleNative: 二人でパパはじめました more
mangas.description: After confirming their feelings for each other, Nogi and Aoyama are now living happily together with Tsumugu. At the nursery, a new dad makes his appearance and... Here is the much awaited continuation of the 120% healing and affectionate family love story!

mangas.title: Futari de Papa Hajimemashita
mangas.titleNative: 二人でパパはじめました
mangas.description: Before transferring to New York, Nogi Shinjiro confessed to his crush, Aoyama Yuki, and was rejected for not being gay. Nogi came back from overseas after 2 years and is surprised go see that Aoyama has a kid now. What happened while he was away?

mangas.title: Introduction to the Theory of Love
mangas.description: Doyun followed his high school crush Hosu to university! Hosu gets drunk at the welcoming party, and Doyun tries to help him get home, but Hosu's so drunk they end up having to stay at a Motel. Doyun picks up a condom he randomly found, but Hosu just so happens to wake up at that moment...! Will Doyun be able to confess to Hosu despite his shyness?

mangas.title: Living With Him: Heating Up
mangas.synonyms: Sono Ato: Kare no Iru Seikatsu after story
mangas.description:
As Ryota and Kazuhito get more comfortable with each other, they start trying new things. Their passion for one another unfolds in this bonus story, and it gets extremely hot and heavy in no time! They also go to a summer festival and look stunning wearing yukata!



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 47, was then licensed by Libre for digital release.

mangas.title: Hotaru Dies Tomorrow
mangas.description: Dusty pink hair, red piercings, and a beauty mark at the corner of the mouth. Saneatsu is in love with a book character named Hotaru. One day after class, while he's sleeping in the library, Saneatsu wakes up to see a perfect copy of the character he's head over heels for in the form of Nao. The guy's just a little slutty, much like Hotaru. Saneatsu's putty in Nao's hands for his resemblance to Hotaru. But, he soon realizes he doesn't know anything about Nao himself...

mangas.title: Mayakashi no Cherry
mangas.description: Rei has always dreamed of falling in love with his ideal partner...!?

mangas.title: Propose wa Saretakunai
mangas.titleNative: プロポーズはされたくない
mangas.description:
Sho and Maki are a couple celebrating Christmas together, but...?



(Source: Dear Plus, translated)

mangas.title: Papa no Sukinahito
mangas.titleNative: パパの好きなひと
mangas.description:
Let's be our family!


Tomoya has been bullied since he was little. The only one who protected Tomoya was a good-looking and gentle childhood friend, Kouhei. They reunited for the first time in a few years, and unexpectedly, Kouhei already became a daddy of a child! Tomoya couldn't hide his shock, but he was unable to refuse if Kouhei ask for his help, who struggles to raise a child as a single parent.

mangas.title: We'll Get Our Happy Ending
mangas.titleNative: ドラマにならない僕らの話
mangas.synonyms: Our Story That Won't Become a Drama
mangas.description:
Soma Ishii's a college freshman who stands out for all the right reasons. The coming-out statement he makes during the welcome party for the new students leaves everyone stunned. Wataru Hayashishita, who goes both ways, was secretly hoping he'd say something like that, so he approaches Soma looking to get to know him better, but... Soma coldly cuts him off and crushes his hopes. Some time later, Wataru meets Soma at a party again, but something's off about him...



In this story about young love, we see what happens when two college students still pining for their ex-boyfriends when they first meet keep bumping into each other.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: To Not Be Eaten By The Demon
mangas.titleNative: 鬼の餌じゃありません
mangas.description:
Struggling writer Suoh Kuraha stumbles across a house-sitting job at an old Japanese house in the middle of nowhere where he's told never to open the door to a room in the back. One day, as thunder and lightning strike outside, Suoh hears a sound coming from the room and opens the door to check if everything is okay. Sitting behind wooden bars is a demon demanding to eat his spirit.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Host with a Little Boy and His Overprotective Neighbor
mangas.titleNative: 子持ちホストの過保護な隣人
mangas.description: Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Host with a Little Boy and His Gentlemanly Neighbor
mangas.titleNative: 子持ちホストの紳士な隣人
mangas.description:
Seiya is a nightclub host who is raising his late sister's little boy Tenma with Ibuki's (his neighbor/lover & an author) help. Seiya's days are filled with love and happiness, and he hopes they'll go on forever. But, his problem is that he cant make himself go all the way with Ibuki. Is it natural for lovers to have sex? But, it looks like he'd be the bottom!! Seiya's feeling panicked when Haruto, a popular and handsome actor, declares his love for Ibuki!!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Host with a Little Boy and His Dangerous Neighbor
mangas.titleNative: 子持ちホストの危険な隣人
mangas.description:
Seiya is a nightclub host who is secretly raising his late sister's little boy Tenma as his own. Cute and angelic, Tenma is the only love and comfort in Seiya's life. Late one night, a drunk man suddenly kisses Seiya in the elevator of his upscale apartment building, and the dangerous man turns out to live next door...!! A parenting love story about a suspiciously handsome author and a host who isn't interested in love!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Dear Signal
mangas.description:
"Love", what a nuisance.

Love Allergy a.k.a. Lovesickness Symptoms: Heart-shaped rashes appearing on the body, dizziness, heart palpitations Cause: A reaction to feelings of love Treatment: ... ?

After his heart skips a beat at the sight of his childhood friend, Haname's smile, Arashi somehow awakens in a hospital bed...!? His body is covered in countless heart-shaped rashes.

In order to suppress the effects of the allergic reaction caused by feelings of love (a.k.a. Lovesickness), he was prescribed heart-shaped pills to control his love. Since that day, "love" was stolen from him...

He can kiss and have sex, but he doesn't know how to love...!? Pay attention to the heart-shaped rashes!

Childhood friends restrained from love by a love allergy -- this is their heart-patterned, pure love-sick love!

Includes the backstory of the pair's assigned doctor, Miyoshi-sensei.

mangas.title: Hello, Green Days
mangas.titleNative: ハロー、グリーンデイズ
mangas.description:
The first time his feelings are returned, the first time having a boyfriend and the first time truly being in love... Tomo is a shy botany graduate student who is scared of love. When he sees Yoji, a rather intimidating new lab member, barely making ends meet, Tomo suggests Yoji move in with him. Despite appearances, Yoji is very kind, and Tomo begins to value their time together. Just then, Yoji suddenly confesses to Tomo, and he accepts. Yoji treats him with lots of love and kindness, but this being the first time dating someone, Tomo struggles, not knowing how a boyfriend should act...


(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hello Again
mangas.description:
Onoda is avoiding his childhood friend, Hiroto, because of what he did back in the past while the other is wondering what happened why he is being avoided.



But because Onoda was ignoring a teacher in school, Hiroto had to drag him in to the counselor's office, and that's when their friendship started blooming again. Will Hiroto find out why he is being avoided?

mangas.title: Henai
mangas.description:
1. Henai

A one-shot that describes the "strange love" the two main characters share. Rather humorous, as it often brings up that one is rather adamant about wanting to roleplay and the other "grudgingly" goes along with it.



2. Tomari Ki (Torch)

A man is stabbed and left for dead in an alley, but he is saved by a young man who has a halo and wings who calls for an ambulance. Later, the boy appears at the man's front door and claims to be an angel with broken wings, and states that the only way for them to heal is to make people happy.



3. Messiah no Yakubi (Messiah's Bad Day)

A man known as the Messiah whose tongue technique is said to heal impotence takes up a job to heal a nervous-looking man, but is quite surprised by the turnout.



4. Ore no Doukyuusei ga Binkan Sugite Yabai!

A pair of high schoolers decide to experiment by giving each other blowjobs. One wants to escalate to something more, but the other isn't sure...



5. Ore no Doukyuusei ga Kagen wo Shiranakute Tsurai



6. Kyoushitsu no Yugami

A story regarding the "relationship" between a teacher and his lonely, introverted student. A sequel of Yugami Hajime.

mangas.title: Pink to Mameshiba
mangas.description: Ken is a super fan of the the idol group Planet, or to be precise, a hardcore idol otaku. One day, while pre-ordering the latest idol goods, he noticed that salesperson is a really flashy guy. But that guy turns out to be a student at the school where Ken works! "Please keep quiet about my hobbies," begs the desperate Ken, and his devilish student agrees, but on the condition, "From today on, be my dog."

mangas.title: Before You Fall in Love
mangas.synonyms: Before Being in Love | Koi ni Naru Mae ni
mangas.description: Mr. Mamiya teaches at an all-boys school, and he has a secret. The first time that he had a class as a homeroom teacher, one of his students had professed his love for him. Three years later, Haruma Seta appears in front of him. He's matured, he's become a trainee teacher, and he continues to tell Mr. Mamiya that he loves him. Will Mr. Mamiya be able to resist Haruma's approaches...?

mangas.title: A Sexy Contract of Blind-Love with My Scumbag Boss
mangas.titleNative: クズ社長とえっちな溺愛契約
mangas.description:
"Right now, I want to hold you... can I?"

Harima, who's always short on money, comes across Narutomi, a happy-go-lucky man, being harassed by a thug. "I'll pay you, so save me!" To which he does, leading him to become Narutomi's bodyguard! One day, Harima drinks at a hostess club, making him a drunk mess... "Do you like it, Harima? Where it feels good, the dirty parts?"Narutomi whispers sweetly... He answers with a yes, which leads to a ravenous kiss. And in the midst of the heat, Narutomi's hot length enters deep inside...!? The silver tongued, scumbag boss and the headstrong, delinquent bodyguard. It's an addictive, pleasurable, dirty, verbally humiliating contract of love!

mangas.title: Ore no Koigokoro ga Moteasobareteimasu
mangas.titleNative: 俺の恋心が弄ばれています
mangas.synonyms: My Love Is Being Played With
mangas.description:
In order to drive away his persistent previous boyfriend, Yuzuha, one of a set of twins who are popular influencers, declares he'll start a relationship with the passerby pudgy underclassman Yachiro. Although he was partially caught up in it, the kind Yachiro went along with it and agreed to pretend to be his boyfriend. Yuzuha fully enjoys playing at being lovers with warm and squishy Yachiro. However, when Yachiro loses weight and drastically changes into a gorgeous man, his heart won't stop fluttering...!?



(Source: Gush, translated)

mangas.title: Ichinose-kun wa Itsumo Iinari.
mangas.titleNative: 一ノ瀬くんはいつも言いなり。
mangas.description:
The Ichinose family has served to protect the Saionji family since long ago. Until now, Kimihito Saionji and Takeru Ichinose have been glued at the hip as master and servant. Kimihito's haughty personality is an eyesore to his classmates. Still, as a master, he has to put on airs, no matter how much he wants to openly admire Takeru's coolness as well.



On the other hand, Takeru doesn't mind being ordered around at all. In truth, his master is quite naive and helpless without a servant—and Takeru fully intends to keep it that way. He can abide by whatever command if it means having this unique side of Kimihito all to himself.



(Source: MAL Rewrite)

mangas.title: Sakura-kun no Hatsukoi wa Natsuiro ni Saku
mangas.titleNative: さくらくんの初恋は夏色に咲く
mangas.synonyms: Sakura-kun's First Love Blooms in a Summer Hue
mangas.description:
Ever since he quit his job, Sakura Hare has been a shut-in, and spends his days getting by lethargically. On the other hand, Hare's childhood friend, Takehana Sakura, is an adventurer who travels around the world with a smile on his face.



"Even though he was so timid, I was the one who gave him the push..."



As Hare's thoughts turn more and more somber, Sakura suddenly returns...



(Source: Media Soft, translated)

mangas.title: Imaginary Boyfriend
mangas.titleNative: ご都合シミュレーション
mangas.description: Riku Chitose has a boyfriend. Yaichi Kaga. He is comfortable in social situations and having girls around him dress him up and play with his hair. But Riku knows a side of Yaichi that nobody else has seen: his cool side. Coincidentally, Yaichi Kaga has a boyfriend, too. Riku Chitose. He is always so cool and composed. But Yaichi knows a side of Riku that nobody else has seen: his adorable side. Yaichi and Riku go on dates, hug, and kiss. Yaichi and Riku are merrily in love with their boyfriends. Who knows, maybe one day they'll finally be able to talk to each other.

mangas.title: I'll Make You Cry
mangas.titleNative: 啼かせてやるよヤンキーくん
mangas.description: Kou and Maki have been best friends since preschool. Fifteen years later, they are both delinquents that somehow end up in fights. Kou is cool, stoic, and always hangs around Maki. A running skit among their friends is that Kou and Maki are an item and that Kou is head over heels for his pink-haired partner. But... does that joke hold any truth in reality?

mangas.title: Fanboy Troubles
mangas.titleNative: 拗らせくんはファンでいたい
mangas.description:
An unforgettable memory for Shinobu Ichijou, an employee at a sports company... That is, doing naughty stuff with the high school friend he secretly looked up to. He wants to forget about it, but he even dreams of it and goes to work feeling frustrated.

There, he learns that Soichiro Mikado, a professional baseball player, will be appearing in his company's new commercial! Shinobu can't seem to rejoice at the sight of this star right before his very eyes. That's because Soichiro's... the high school friend he can't get over...!!

Shinobu wants to support him simply as a fan, but his body can't help but lust for him! This is a reunion love comedy between two high school friends.

mangas.title: Osananajimi (♂) to no Arekore.
mangas.titleNative: 幼なじみ(♂)とのアレコレ。
mangas.description:
High schoolers Fumi and Kaichi have been friends for almost 10 years, even though Fumi is dazzling and Kaichi is just an ordinary otaku.



Fumi seems very comfortable with being childhood friends, he often sneaks into Kaichi's bed and loves to be spoiled by him. But Kaichi sees him differently...

mangas.title: Dekoboko Bittersweet Days
mangas.titleNative: 凸凹シュガーデイズ（もう一回！）
mangas.description:
Outgoing, fierce Rui Hanamine and gentle, soft-hearted Yuujirou Matsukaze have been close friends since they were children. Though they were supposed to be nothing more than best friends, eventually they confessed their smoldering attraction to one another and began dating. Now their days are filled with sweetness, leaving them wondering, "Am I really allowed to feel this happy?"

Now with the end of their time at high school and summer vacation fast approaching, what does the future hold for the love-struck couple? Sometimes sweetness comes with a little bitterness...

mangas.title: Kiss The Pride
mangas.description:
Nao Minase's coworker, Chiaki Ookawa, has a strong personality, eye-catching good looks, and secures tons of contracts because of that. It's no wonder Nao sees him as a rival, but he's also in love with him. Ever since entering the company, the two of them have had the same assignments, and their competitive personalities and constant rivalry has made people treat them like a pair. Beyond their stubbornness lies a (supposed) fondness for each other, but they're stuck in the limbo of unrequited feelings?all because they refuse to proclaim their feelings first! On the brink of that battle, a business trip sends the two men to a hotel, where love can't help but run amok!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Falling Blossoms of Love
mangas.titleNative: 花咲く恋がふってくる
mangas.description:
One day, Ritsu Nitta - a boy so handsome he could be the hero of a romance manga - comes falling out of the sky. He is saved by Tomoru, who in response to Ritsu's request to pay him back, asks for his help in his after school job...as a professional girls' manga author. Ritsu agrees to act out scenes from Tomoru's manga, but when he learns he is meant to play the rival character instead of the hero, he grabs Tomoru by the collar and forces a kiss on him...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: 3LDK, Ouji Tsuki
mangas.description: Kanta is a poor art student, but one day as he went home to his apartment, he found out that the apartment he's been living in is being demolished! He was in trouble because he couldn't find a new house. At that time, the famous Touji who is rich and is called a prince suggested living together with him?! But when they arrived at his house, his image changed?!

mangas.title: Fukigen na Kimi to Kimagure na Kiss
mangas.titleNative: 不機嫌な君と気まぐれなキス
mangas.description: Focused on Kunihiko, Yuu's friend from Asatte ni Kiss.

mangas.title: Midara na Ω wa Koi wo Shinai
mangas.synonyms: Indecent Ω Does Not Fall In Love
mangas.description:
Nanao Sakushima is an omega who enrolls at a boarding school. To earn some money for buying medicine, he joins a circle that sells the members' bodies to elite alphas within the school. Soushi Ashiya , an alpha transfer student, bothers Nanao under pretense that he fell in love with him at first sight. Because Nanao thinks that alphas' goals are always sex in the end, he invites Soushi to do it once , but somehow he refuses instead. Isesaki, the circle's sponsor, witnesses that moment and punishes Nanao. Moreover, he even orders Nanao to invites Soushi using the mating period "heat"...! Soushi is agitated by the mating period succumbs to the lust... Even though he doesn't wish for it, his body can't stop yearning for that heat! "I thought I would never fall in love..." A love trap that tricks alpha-hater omega.



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Konna Ore wo Suki to ka Maji ka
mangas.titleNative: こんなオレをスキとかマジか
mangas.synonyms: Is it true that you like me?
mangas.description: Even though cafe owner Mugimaru, is good looking, rumors say he's a playboy. But that doesn't stop the pessimistic, anti-social, and overly serious salaryman, Roku, from going there since he likes how the owner makes his coffee. However, one day the drunk Mugimaru pushes Roku down and says, "Since you like my cafe, that means you like me too, right?" What will happen between salaryman Roku and the psychopathic owner, Mugi?!

mangas.title: Desire Detection
mangas.description: Miki, being the eldest son looks after his siblings by working on several part time jobs ever since their police officer father who raised them single-handedly, died in an accident. One of these days, when panties started disappearing from their laundries, Miki suspects Tsukasa Shinokawa, a stranger who one day barged into their house & proposed to make Miki his bride? But later found out that Tsukasa Shinokawa is a cop who later caught the stalker moreover he is…

mangas.title: Gomen ne♥Idol-kun
mangas.titleNative: ごめんね♥アイドルくん
mangas.description:
Genki has finally made his debut in an idol group, "Sexy Dangerous", attributing to their characters, but really, he's as clumsy as a 15 year old can get.

One day, he walks in on the member he has a secret crush on having xxx with his rival in the music room! Idol-senpai, Suzuhara, notices his broken heart and Genki's emotions start to sway, but it seems that he's only being treated like a child?!

The dramatic youth of these idols to which the rule of love is forbidden to chase after their dreams!

Also written and included is the brute and passionate H-love between Chihaya x Yoshitomo!

mangas.title: To Your Right, You Will See My Boyfriend
mangas.titleNative: 右手に見えますのが、俺の彼氏でございます
mangas.description: It's not like Nobuki works as a tour guide because he enjoys it. And why does he have to work with such a scruffy bus driver?

mangas.title: A Nightingale Awaits the Blooming Love of Spring
mangas.synonyms: Warbler, Sing of Spring | Haru Kakete, Uguisu
mangas.description:
Spring is here—and with it, a new beginning for an old legend.

Third-year brawler Haruka Shirakawa finally claims the title of Top Fighter, only to learn his new Classic Lit teacher, Mr. Narumi, once held it too. Haruka's friends want him to challenge Narumi and surpass the legend, but Haruka just wants to understand him. After seeing a video of Narumi fighting in his prime, the fire in Narumi's eyes ignites something in Haruka too: the blazing desire to grow stronger—and to grow up. And since Narumi won't fight him, the least he can do is teach him to fight... and Mr. Narumi's lessons strike deeper than any blow.

mangas.title: Ryuuku Aiutsu
mangas.description: One night, brash blonde high school student Toraji went to a party with his childhood best friend, Ryuunosuke. At the party, they both got lucky and ended up having a threesome with a cute girl. However, in the heat of the moment, Ryuunosuke leaned over the girl's shoulder and kissed Toraji deeply! What's a yankee boy to do when he realizes his best friend is in love with him?!

mangas.title: Nanase the Idol's Omega Secret
mangas.titleNative: アイドルの七瀬くんがΩなのは秘密
mangas.description:
"Nanase, the cool lead of the alpha idol unit, Cosmic, has a secret he doesn't want anyone to know: he's actually an omega. However, Daichi, another member of Cosmic and a real alpha, tells Nanase face-to-face, ""What if we're destined mates?"" and starts rubbing Nanase's body provocatively...!? Though Nanase controls himself through use of suppressants, the moment Daichi touches him, his entire body is overcome with indecent desires...!!"



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Off Stage Love Side
mangas.titleNative: オフステージラブサイド
mangas.description:
When Tomoya was in high school, he once went to a gay bar while lying about his age, and he has never been able to forget Kei, the mature and sexy man he met there. Inspired by Kei, who told him that he was cute, Tomoya has become a very popular idol with a stadium tour in the works. One day, Tomoya discovers Kei, the man of his dreams, backstage at his group's live concert! It turns out that Kei has been hired to be Tomoya's bodyguard to protect him from a stalker!



(Source: Core Magazine, translated)



Notes:

- Originally serialized under the title "Off Stage (オフステージ)".

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Asahi, the Cheeky Crossdresser
mangas.titleNative: あさひくんは、生イキざかりの男の娘。
mangas.synonyms: Asahi-kun wa, Namaiki Zakari no Otoko no Ko
mangas.description: When I took off his dress and kissed him, I got excited down there...!? The first person I want to have sex with was a "crossdresser."

mangas.title: Secret XXX
mangas.description:
1. XXX Allergy

Growing up in an environment full of all kinds of animals, there's only one animal that Shouhei loves and that's rabbits. Because of his love for rabbits, he sometimes helps out in a rabbit specialist shop. And there, he meets Mito Itsuki, his unrequited love. However, he has a secret he has to keep no matter what. Would he be able to keep that secret in order to stay close to the one he loves…?! A cute and short love story by Hinohara Meguru.


2-3. Secret XXX

After going through many hardships, Mito and Shouhei finally became lovers. Just when their love is starting to bloom, Mito begins to act strange for some reason. Shouhei still doesn't know much about Mito so he can only sense Mito is hiding something from him. One day, Shouhei saw Mito with another guy in his car?! What could Mito be hiding? Can Shouhei keep his faith in Mito.


4-5. Relation XXX


Included extra story: Happily Ever After

mangas.title: XXX Allergy
mangas.description: Growing up in an environment full of all kinds of animals, there's only one animal that Shouhei loves and that's rabbits. Because of his love for rabbits, he sometimes helps out in a rabbit specialist shop. And there, he meets Mito Itsuki, his unrequited love. However, he has a secret he has to keep no matter what. Would he be able to keep that secret in order to stay close to the one he loves…?!

mangas.title: Randen to Saga
mangas.description: Delinquents Randen and Saga are two friends who met by chance. When Saga accidentally gets seriously injured in a fight, Randen licks his wound and he recovers instantly! What is Randen's mysterious ability?

mangas.title: Stigmata -Love Bites-
mangas.description:
The Metropolitan Police Department's Special Investigation Section Six has a secret weapon in their arsenal - rookie detective Minami Asako. Asako has a very special "condition" that causes him to copy the wounds and pains of the dead onto his own body. While Asako's special talent of "becoming" the victim might have helped solve many cases before, will it help this time, when the victim is Kuroiwa's ex-wife?



(Source: futekiya)

mangas.title: Stigmata: Seikon Sousa
mangas.titleNative: スティグマタ─聖痕捜査─
mangas.description:
Asako Minami has a "unique constitution." He senses the lingering thoughts of murder victims, and experiences the circumstances under which they died with his own body in a reaction similar to stigmata. This proves useful in solving difficult cases with the Metropolitan Police Department's Special Investigations Unit Six. Asako's partner is the reserved Superintendent Kuroiwa Hiroto, rising through the MPD ranks despite doubting his own abilities.


Note: This volume was serialized in seinen magazine Grand Jump Premium. The manga has been revived as Stigmata: Aikon in BL magazine .Bloom.

mangas.title: While Being Seen Off by Campanella
mangas.description:
Fresh from a break up with his boyfriend, Kanou is depressed, and he wonders where things went wrong. He thinks of committing suicide by walking straight to the upcoming train on his way to work, but a high school student stops him. Since then, Kanou seemed to always run into the boy who smiles or greets him at the train station every morning. Kanou dubs his savior 'Campanella,' a character from a book he read. Meanwhile, at work, Kanou continues to work hard as usual and finds himself being drawn closer to his boss. Will his new-found feelings bring him happiness, or will it end up in tears again?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Haru to Natsu to Nacchan to Aki to Fuyu to Boku
mangas.titleNative: 春と夏となっちゃんと秋と冬と僕
mangas.synonyms: Spring, Summer, Nacchan, Autumn, Winter, and Me
mangas.description: Shima and Natsuo lives in a normal countryside that you can find almost anywhere. They are normal high school boys that you can find almost anywhere. However, their blissful love is unique only to them and cannot be found anywhere else.

mangas.title: Kakushigoto One Room
mangas.titleNative: かくしごとワンルーム
mangas.description: An author who only finds inspiration after sex and the easygoing friend who's always willing to help alleviate his writer's block.

mangas.title: Boku no Naka ni Kimi Ga Inai
mangas.description:
Memories of you that I lost because I love you.

Subaru, a college student, loses only part of his memory in an accident. It is a memory of him "living together" with a high school classmate, Soushi. At that time, he was sure he hadn't talked to a guy who was cool and popular, unlike himself. Subaru who was discharged from the hospital, started living together and learned about Soushi again. From the surprisingly caring and anxious man, he realized that he was being looked at with a kind gaze he had never seen before…

mangas.title: Yankee no Kareshi ga Dekiru Made
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーの彼氏が出来るまで
mangas.description:
Masaki is a high school Otaku who loves Manga and video games. One day, Masaki is confronted by a delinquent in the hall at school. Masaki thought it was a shakedown for money, but instead, it was a confession. "Hey, you should go out with me."

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

mangas.title: Sensei, Ijiwaru Shinaide Kudasai
mangas.titleNative: 先生、いじわるしないでください
mangas.synonyms: Please Don't Be So Mean to Me, Teacher
mangas.description:
Shiba, a physical education teacher at a high school, is dating Higaki, the school counselor. After school, after office hours are over, they have an adult affair on campus. While Shiba is happy to be able to see his boyfriend at work everyday, he still has one problem. He has never been able to get Higaki to say "I love you" to him. Higeki can be somewhat mysterious and evasive, and Shiba is always having to take the lead both in daily life and in bed. Shiba tries to get Hinokaki to express his true feelings, but...!



(Source: Gush Comics, translated)

mangas.title: How My Daddies Became Mates
mangas.titleNative: しまちゃん家の番事情
mangas.description:
As teenagers, Kuroga Akane and Shirosaki Aoi couldn't have been more different. An alpha and an omega from rival schools, their initial meeting wasn't exactly love at first sight. In fact, it was downright brutal! Fast forward to adulthood, and not only are they mated and married, but they even have an adorable daughter! How did these former delinquents go from wanting to beat each other to a pulp to falling in love?!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Harenai Sekai de Kimi Dake Mieru
mangas.titleNative: 晴れない世界で君だけ見える
mangas.description:
He's incapable of recognizing other people's faces. The only exception to that symptom is a handsome young man who's his exact opposite?



(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hatsukoi no Tonari
mangas.synonyms: The First Love is By My Side
mangas.description: By coincidence, college student Morimoto reunites with his former teacher, Jinno. After having a meal together, Jinno is touched by Morimoto's home cooking, and they end up eating together almost every day! However, sometimes when they're enjoying their meals, Morimoto will have a sad look in his eyes. Jinno may have forgotten, but he'd dismissed Morimoto's confession in the past…

mangas.title: Uwakimono ni wa Horemasen
mangas.titleNative: 浮気者には惚れません
mangas.synonyms: I Won't Lose My Heart to a Cheater
mangas.description:
"I want to hate him, but...I love him after all!"



College student Yuki is at the mercy of his playboy childhood friend. He knows that Kazu, a cheater who wants to be loved, is obsessed with the idea that, "If you fall in love, you lose." Even so, Yuki can't let go of his love for Kazu... A pessimist who longs for devotion, and a study and fluffy cheater who adores anyone who loves him. What lies in store for this one-sided love?



(Source: Libre, translated)

mangas.title: Should I Fall For My Neighbor?
mangas.titleNative: お隣さんに恋をしてもいいですか
mangas.description:
After Kei's colleagues find out about him, he quits his job and moves into an old home. Kei's been blessed to have the nice neighborhood cafe owner Aki and his daughter Matsuri as his next door neighbors. Kei spends his days in peace, wondering about Aki, who smiles forlornly remembering his deceased wife. Kei can't help but secretly fall for his straight neighbor... One day, however, the former friend with benefits he'd cut ties with shows up unexpectedly and outs him to Aki!

Kei nearly dies from the cuteness of the two men fighting in front of him!! This is the love story of a widower with a child and his overly negative neighbor.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Nande Omae ga Ki ni Nannen!?
mangas.titleNative: なんで恋敵が気になんねん！？
mangas.synonyms: Nande Koigataki ga Ki ni Nannen!?
mangas.description:
"But the guy I like should be that one!"



Having moved to Tokyo from the countryside, the gay Azuma met Kyoutarou and fell in love at first sight! He's so happy to have met his type, but Azuma feels a hostile presence behind him. He turns around to see Miyako glaring at Azuma from behind his glasses. Apparently, he too has had a crush on Kyoutarou for many years... Azuma wants to get closer to Kyoutarou, but Miyako keeps annoyingly getting in the way. But, as the three of them spend time together, Miyako's bad first impression, that made Azuma think he was an "sneaky bastard," began to change little by little.



(Source: East Press, translated)

mangas.title: Sand Castle
mangas.description:
Eun-Seong walks in on his crush Ji-U in an empty lecture hall. Their shared secret brings the two closer, but Ji-U is only interested in using Eun-Seong as a means to satisfy his own desires. Eun-Seong grows tired of Ji-U's selfish ways and has a change of heart, just as Ji-U realizes his feelings for Eun-Seong and begins treating him with a fondness like never before. Will this relationship work with the two boys' positions now totally switched?



(Source: NETCOMICS, edited)

mangas.title: The Rule of Standing on Tiptoe
mangas.description: A transfer student enters the class of Kousuke, a second-year in high school. Raku is tall and good-looking, the exact opposite of the shrimpy Kousuke, and very popular with the girls. Kousuke was jealous of Raku at first, until Raku comes clean about a certain secret, and asks Kousuke not to tell anyone. Ever since then, Raku seems to have taken a liking to Kousuke, and all of a sudden, they become really close! This is a high-school romantic-comedy about a mismatched pair!

mangas.title: Flower and Bunny
mangas.description: Our delivery service's regular customer, Aizawa-san in room 411, is always wearing a rabbit head! Why is he wearing something like that in the first place? Pervert? Everyday he sends or receives delivery but you can't see his face, and he's almost mute, there's nothing scarier than this. But one day, still wearing the rabbit head, he grabbed tightly onto my arm, "thank you, I'll see you again tomorrow!" Saying it in such an embarrassed way- My heart beats so fast.

mangas.title: Omega to Akuma no Sefure Jijou
mangas.titleNative: オメガと悪魔のセフレ事情
mangas.description:
Yuuma, the unpopular host, summoned the incubus demon, Airucus, to grant his wishes. The contract's condition, however, was for Yuuma to give birth to Ai's child.

Yuuma is forced into conceiving a child and accepts Ai's body fluids by receiving his semen. But despite the fact that he was unable to become pregnant, Yuuma's body was in excellent condition due to the special nutrients contained in Ai's semen.

Yuuma became clingy after that and began to beg for Ai's semen himself—!?? Whether he gives birth to an incubus demon child or remains an unpopular host—- It's a difficult decision!!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Evening Glow
mangas.synonyms: Kimi wa Natsu no Naka dj - Akane no Koro | A Time of Fiery Red
mangas.description: Short sequel to Kimi wa Natsu no Naka.

mangas.title: The Summer With You
mangas.description:
After graduating from high school, Chiharu returns to Tokyo to start university, and spend another summer with his now-boyfriend Wataru. The two boys might be busy with their part-time jobs and schoolwork, but they're living in the same city again at last, which sets off new sparks and adventures. In addition to their usual weekend movie plans, they shake things up with a night out at a fireworks festival before continuing their summer pilgrimage to a deserted island. And then, when Wataru misses the last train home, he spends the night at Chiharu's. In return, Chiharu asks for just one thing...



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Sayonara no Moment
mangas.titleNative: さよならのモーメント
mangas.description:
"Hey, why did you appear in front of me again...?"



Shunya is haunted by the death of his childhood friend Ryousuke, who died in an accident, when a stranger, Tsukasa, a high school student, appears before him, claiming to be Ryosuke. Apparently, when Ryosuke attempted to stop a suicide attempt, he ended up inside Tsukasa. The three are connected by a strange fate, leading to a mysterious shared life together. Shunya is happy to be able to communicate with Ryousuke through Tsukasa, who lends his body to Ryousuke for Shunya's sake. It seems that the three of them will continue to live together forever, but...?



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

mangas.title: What Boys in Love Want to Do
mangas.titleNative: 大好き同士がしたいコト。
mangas.description:
A sweet love story about a prince of a high school boy and his classmate who adores him like a loving puppy.

Shota and Hiro grew up together, and they love each other so much that they can't help flirting in class. They've been together for more than two years with sleepovers every weekend, but it's still a chaste relationship...!! Figuring that any teenage guy would be interested in getting intimate, Shota wonders if something isn't right, particularly with Hiro's popularity among the girls, and things start getting too awkward for him to stay at Hiro's place...!!


(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Shoulder to Cry On
mangas.description: Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse's office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn't show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It's not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

mangas.title: My Love Mix-Up!
mangas.description:
Mistaken identity leads to a blossoming romance between two boys.



Aoki has a crush on Hashimoto, the girl in the seat next to him in class. But he despairs when he borrows her eraser and sees she's written the name of another boy—Ida—on it. To make matters more confusing, Ida sees Aoki holding that very eraser and thinks Aoki has a crush on him!



(Source: Shojo Beat)



Notes:

- Winner of the 67th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shoujo Category in 2021.

- Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hana Tokidoki Kuma
mangas.description:
A high school student, Sumito, who had just been playing with his friends, is currently absorbed in the coffee shop's notebook. While perusing the notebook, he replies to a comment written out in beautiful characters. From that day on, the interaction between him and his favorite "girlfriend" at the old coffee shop continued without any direct contact, and Sumito's love grew day by day. One day, Sumito learned that the "person from the notebook" would come to the store, and he eagerly visited the store, but what was waiting for him wasn't the pretty girl that Sumito had dreamed of, but someone 190cm tall... It was a huge man, Koguma!



(Source: Kasakura Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: S&N
mangas.description:
Yuta Natori is a junior in high school, enjoying the peace and quiet of his school life when out of the blue, Kazushi Setoguchi, a freshman, asks him to be his boyfriend. Being straight, Yuta declines politely, but ever since, Kazushi keeps showing up wherever he goes... Days of this, and Yuta can't take it anymore. He blows up at Kazushi, thinking he will finally get the message... but uh-oh. Why is he looking at Yuta so adoringly!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Cohabitation Contract
mangas.titleNative: 契約コハビテーション
mangas.description: Hayasaka, a competent yet people-pleasing salesman, decides to let Kumagai, a part-time local convenience store worker, live with him in order to protect a cat he rescued. Although reluctant at first, Hayasaka gradually begins to feel comfortable having Kumagai stay with him and opens up about vulnerabilities he's never shown others. One day, Kumagai, with a sweet look on his face, tells Hayasaka how cute he is which makes Hayasaka catch feelings...?!

mangas.title: Usotsuki to Hatsukoi
mangas.description:
Izumi realizes from a young age that his romantic orientation is towards the same sex. Even when he becomes an adult, he hides that fact, and pretends to be like everyone else. One day, on his way home from a business dinner, he gets embraced by a young man who exclaims "It's you, Kou-kun, isn't it...?! I've always wanted to meet you!" The guy in question is his friend he had lost contact with eight years ago, Shion... Who is also the boy he felt guilty towards for being attracted to, and whom he distanced himself from all those years ago. Questioned why they suddenly lost contact, Izumi blurts out that he always loved Shion, to which Shion replies that he feels the same... They end up dating, and they're lovey-dovey and happy, but sometimes Shion's behavior seems off...?



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: OΣG!!!: Oh My God
mangas.description:
Overtime after overtime, Kanda, a company slave without a decent life, one day comes across a murder scene on his way home. The murderer covered in blood... was his former classmate Lizzie! "It's like a dream," says Lizzie, who's happy to be reunited. Kanda barely remembers him, but since Lizzie doesn't have a place to stay, he can't refuse him and decides to let him stay at his house. What will happen when Kanda's daily life is gradually invaded by this suddenly appearing killer?



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Heat x Beat: I May Be an Omega, but I'm Going to Be an Idol!
mangas.titleNative: Heat×Beat～オメガだけどアイドル始めました～
mangas.description:
Asahi wants nothing more than to be an idol, and when he's chosen as the latest member of boyband B-Marks he's over the moon. Except for one little detail; Asahi is an omega, and one of the other members, Madoka, is an alpha. Insisting on staying unmated to remain loyal to their fanbase, Asahi agrees to a "friends with benefits" arrangement to appease their hormonal urges without commitment. At least, that's what he intends...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Sankaku Twilight
mangas.titleNative: さんかくトワイライト
mangas.description:
Pure-hearted sentimental love depicting the complex love triangle of an emotionless handsome half-Japanese boy and a dedicated Kansai dialect-speaking delinquent high school boy. A new story is born.

Miki, a delinquent who enjoys fights and is feared by those around him, ends up becoming a library committee member with Ikkei, who is his complete opposite. While they clash due to their contrasting personalities, Ikkei learns one day that Miki has a crush on his childhood friend and senior, Watarun. Despite the surprise, Ikkei supports Miki without prejudice and somehow becomes cherished.

Initially, Ikkei couldn't stand Miki, but as time goes on, he starts to find him adorable...?

mangas.title: Henkutsu na Yankee-kun wo Hottokenai
mangas.titleNative: 偏屈な彼がヤンキーくんをほっとけない
mangas.description: While the eccentric Shiki only shines with the fact that he consistently disobeys the school rules, the quiet Yamato delivers top marks in all tests. A collision on the stairs makes the two unexpected friends, but it does not last long before the first big fight. The night after, Yamato dreams of an erotic rendezvous with Shiki. What does that mean? When he catches his friend taking a nap on the schoolbag, he wants to find out ...

mangas.title: Curious Recipe
mangas.description: As a young boy, Jung-Hyuk felt drawn to the tough Tae-Su who often swooped in to save him from bullies. Now after years have passed, it's his turn to make Tae-Su fall head over heels. Will plates of sweets be enough to win over his heart?

mangas.title: Ote, Osuwari, Kiss
mangas.description:
One day, the overworked researcher Koki discovers a "dog" lying unconscious at the foot of his apartment complex and decides to bring it home. The next day, Koki wakes up to an unknown man in his apartment! Is he a burglar?! Amidst Koki's panic, the man transforms into the "dog" he found last night and starts talking…! "Koki, I'm the dog you saved! Thank you, you're really kind!" Thus starts the duo's life in the shared apartment as pet(?) and owner…?! A loving story about the lives of a handsome human-transforming dog and a fussy scientist under one roof!


(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi to Hamu Hamu Shitai no da!
mangas.titleNative: きみとハムハムしたいのだ！
mangas.description:
Kamiya, who loves small animals, discovers that Matsuyuki, a kendo rival from another school, can transform into a hamster...!?

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Souteigai no Sweet Marriage
mangas.titleNative: 想定外のスウィートマリッジ
mangas.description:
"Shall we get married?" — A fake marriage between two men?!



Yuuki Ritsu, a cool-headed and serious office worker, was suddenly proposed to by his colleague and rival Honjou Haruma, due to some special circumstances. With same-sex marriage becoming possible in Japan, the people around the single, 29-year old Ritsu had been constantly nagging at him to get married soon.



On the other hand, Haruma had found himself in a bind due to his uncontrollable popularity. With Haruma's suggestion of a marriage that would benefit both parties, Ritsu decided to accept his proposal in order to escape from the corner he was driven into. Little did he know that married life with Haruma, who loves taking care of others, would be so comfortable… Plus, he gives massages that are out of this world…!



Although it started with a lie, a sweet and delicious marriage love between the two single, handsome office workers in their thirties starts to bloom!



(Source: Overlap, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Fluffy Moody Crush
mangas.titleNative: 吠える犬とくびったけ
mangas.description:
In a world where humans and demi-humans coexist in day-to-day life, Kou is a half-human, half-vampire who works at a cafe. Following a traumatic incident in childhood, he's been avoiding making personal connections with humans, because, well... their blood smells delicious. One day, his childhood friend, Itsuki, reappears in his life and starts working at the cafe.



Itsuki is determined to rekindle their friendship, but Kou must keep his distance to avoid putting Itsuki in a perilous position as he did in childhood. As they grow closer, Itsuki finds himself romantically interested in Kou, and after some push and pull the two admit their feelings to each other and start dating. A sweet, friends-to-lovers romance set in a modern fantasy world!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ireumeul Matchumyeo
mangas.description: Jin and Junghyeok are childhood friends, but they have been in a cold war for years! What happens when their souls swap? One day, both of them found their old name tags from middle school and went to bed with old memories in mind... to wake up in the body of the one that they hate the most! How will they deal with day to day life? Is there a way back?

mangas.title: Heaven and Demon -sai-
mangas.description:
Aoki and Tengoku starts dating and slowly deepens their relationship. But one day, when Aoki is talking with his friend on speakerphone while cooking, he brings up what Aoki said some time ago that he had no plans to marry his current partner. Tengoku hears but says nothing about it. When Tengoku leaves after the dinner, Aoki walks together to the station with a slight feeling of uneasiness. They kiss on the way, on the dark, lonely street at night. When Aoki notices someone passing by see them kissing, he almost unintentionally says "...This sucks". Now Tengoku suddenly changes his tune and walks away, leaving Aoki alone and perplexed. Why does Tengoku leave like that? Their good relationship now seems to be in crisis...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Delivery for You!
mangas.synonyms: Delivery To You | Kimi e Otodoke
mangas.description: Izumi Fukuya is 27 and single. His hobbies are collecting figures and gaming, and 99% of his shopping is done online. He is truly a homebody. Izumi's current fascination is with sexy delivery driver Tsuchiya! With his manly physique and warm smile, the days when he shows up are sure to be radiant. In the hopes of a rendezvous beyond his doorstop, Izumi spends day after day ordering otaku merch as an excuse to see Tsuchiya. This isn't a forbidden love... rather one man's crush on a cool, heroic guy!

mangas.title: Omae wa Hitsuji.
mangas.description:
University student Sahara, with his horrible luck, loses his home when his entire apartment goes up in flames. Luckily, he is able to stay at a friend's place. But he is suddenly mistaken as a suspicious person by his friend's older brother, Masaki. They manage to dispel the misunderstanding, but he is pressured into doing an unimaginable job...


(Source: Yaoi Desire Revolution)

mangas.title: Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata
mangas.titleNative: 恋愛ルビの正しいふりかた
mangas.description:
1-2) Renai-rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Proper Way to Write Love)

"I wanted to see him make this kind of face." I was a gloomy nerd in high school, and at that time I was entwined with Washizawa Natsuo – my dark past. Now, a few years later, we have reunited and Natsuo asked me out. This is my chance. We'll go out, then I'll break up with him, leaving him in tatters!



3) Renai-Rubi no Yarashii Furikata (The Sexy Way to Write Love)



4-5) Hodokeru Kaibutsu (A monster falls apart)

"At best, you get hurt and it's over." One of Natsuo's friends from high school, Hayashida Kan, had a drunk encounter with flashy subordinate Shuuna, and they became fuck buddies. Long before, Hayashida hit his lover. Hayashida, with as many regrets as he has piercings, wonders if Shuuna will hold him forever? (Hayashida Kan also appears in Sabita Yoru Demo Koi wa Sasayaku)



6) Extra Monster Sugar

Hayashida and Shuuna are buying new camera.

mangas.title: Masked Love
mangas.description:
A long time ago, a divine fox saved Mikazuki village from famine. In return, the fox took one of the villagers as his bride. To this day, the villagers hold a marital ceremony every year at the summer festival. The descendant of the fox and the descendant of the bride marry, and then they spend one night together. The villagers believe that this ceremony continues to protect them from disaster. It just so turns out that, this year, those two descendants are Kanata and Kuro, and, this summer, it is their turn to marry and have sex. There's one problem -- unlike Kanata, who believes in their village's customs, Kuro does not seem too keen on his fate. Kuro's apathy hurts Kanata, who always felt that he didn't quite mind, as long as he was with Kuro...



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: New World Lovetopia
mangas.titleNative: ニューワールド・ラブトピア
mangas.description: An earnest young man, Hachi, gets his dream job at "The New World," following the footsteps of his grandfather, Roku-san, who used to work there. He meets all sorts of fantastic creatures there: sylph, dryad, merman, griffin, angels, and demon. Things gets tricky with the inhabitants of the New World… Assigned to a mean and nasty-looking trainer, will Hachi survive his dream job?

mangas.title: Shoushin Otoko ni Haru no Arashi
mangas.description:
"To prefer an old man like me, you're really a strange one."

An awkward honor student and a peevish writer in his 30s. A 200% pure heart-pounding age gap romance.

mangas.title: Idol Kinsei
mangas.description:
Ikuto enrolled in a school with a dormitory to escape the feeling of inferiority to his successful older twin brother, Takuto. There, Ikuto met the idol Sin from the group Double Moon, whom he was a big fan of. Except... Shinnosuke Tsukishima, or Sin, was a completely different persona off stage. He was a super flirty man!



Ikuto felt troubled by Shinnosuke's antics at first, but he started to realize that perhaps he could love him in another way. However, he could never be sure when Shinnosuke was being serious or not. Could real love grow between an honorary student and a popular idol?



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Solo Leveling
mangas.description:
In a world where awakened beings called "Hunters" must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed "the weakest hunter of all mankind," finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U's journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Bend Over Backwards
mangas.synonyms: Run Away, Assistant Manager Ha! | Run, Mr. Ha!
mangas.description: All Joowon has ever wanted is a steady career outside of the spotlight. A single steamy night with an attractive stranger shouldn't derail that plan so thoroughly, except said attractive stranger is Aiden, an international top model. When they meet again on professional terms, Joowon is given a choice: have his steady career destroyed when Aiden turns down a contract with his company, or accept Aiden's offer to become sex partners until the contract period is over. And thus begins Joowon's ventures in bending over in more ways than one to meet Aiden's demands...

mangas.title: Ai oi Focus
mangas.description: Arima, a two-faced honor student, was asked by a teacher to help Mizutani, a delinquent student with poor grades study. However, Mizutani seems disinterested in school, which only agitates Arima. Finally, in a fit of anger Arima reveals his true self. A love story that begins after school hours!

mangas.title: Toraneko no Shitsukekata
mangas.description: The cute-faced but super strong at fights delinquent - Kotarou, and the excellent, sports all-rounder honors student - Yamato. The two are seen as polar opposites, but they're actually in a lovey-dovey relationship. Seeing his beloved Yamato's nape and lips fills Kotarou's mind with "perverted thoughts". But when he's touched, he panicks and throws a punch...?!

mangas.title: Nirameba Koi
mangas.synonyms: Glares at You Because I Love You
mangas.description:
Apart from the fact he's in the student council and has quite strange tastes, Shima is an average, low-profile, quiet high schooler. Therefore, he doesn't understand why Ryuunosuke, a sports student, always glares at him every time they cross paths. Shima doesn't want to draw the punk's attention, but the instinctive hostility of Ryuunosuke towards him troubles him, and he wants to know why the other boy hates him…


Included one-shot:

Volume 1: Omoide Dragon (The Dragon of Memories)

mangas.title: Candy Man
mangas.description: Kyuyeon has an alternative persona in the online game, he pretends to be a female player with a character named "Yorong" only to rip off items from other clueless users. One of "Her" diehard fan named "Yeommin" showers Kyuyeon with gifts day and night. He's happy but at the same time, Kyuyeon feels a bit pressured about Yeommin because he's always asking "Yorong" for a date. To top it all, Kyuyeon finds out that Yeommin is his handsome classmate Kimin Yeom. How is he going to get out of this trouble?

mangas.title: The "Growth" Progress Of The Sexy Helper Dog
mangas.titleNative: えっちなおてつだい犬の性長記録
mangas.description:
Kohaku, a dog beast person, sneaks into a hospital that treats people with his condition. He tries to steal suppressants because his body has gone into heat. But, unfortunately, he's caught and falls unconscious on the spot...! When Kohaku wakes up, he see a doctor at the hospital, Dr. Takatsuji, looking down at him. Even though the doctor gives Kohaku a suppressant, his body's still in heat. As he tries to calm down the confused Kohaku, Dr. Takatsuji starts checking him for abnormalities... Kohaku has his shirt lifted up, his chest groped, and his nipples pinched... Even though he's only being examined, his body can't stop quivering...! Dr. Takatsuji doesn't notice how Kohaku is reacting and his fingers start to dig in deeper and deeper...!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Dekiai Nante Mitomemasen!
mangas.titleNative: 溺愛なんてみとめません!
mangas.synonyms: I'm Not A Doting Lover! | P.D.A. isn't allowed!
mangas.description: It's been half a year since Naoto and his best friend, Toudou, became lovers. After many twists and turns, their relationship is going so well that Naoto stays at Toudou's house every weekend!!! Although their relationship is out in the open, the two decide to have a proper talk with Naoto's mother. However, the situation rolls in an unexpected direction...

mangas.title: Netsuai Nante Ariemasen!
mangas.titleNative: 熱愛なんてありえません！
mangas.description:
Kirishima and Toudou are finally going steady, but with the rocky start they had, it seems inevitable that problems will crop up...



Includes:

Renai Nante Yurushimasen! Otsukiai-hen (恋愛なんてゆるしません! -お付き合い篇-)

Ore no Kareshi wa Sekaiichi Kawaii (俺の彼氏は世界一可愛い)

mangas.title: Renai Nante Yurushimasen!
mangas.titleNative: 恋愛なんてゆるしません！
mangas.description: Kirishima Naoto is handsome, hard-working and popular with his female co-workers, but has one major shortcoming: his extreme adoration towards his younger brother, Hokuto. Swearing off a proper romantic relationship for Hokuto's sake, Naoto frequently spends the evenings with his friend from college, Toudou. Though he knows that Toudou's gay, Naoto has never held it against him... Until one day, when he discovers that Toudou and Hokuto have been texting each other in secret and declares "If you promise not to touch my brother, I will take his place"!?

mangas.title: Brocon Oniisan, Kocchi Muite
mangas.titleNative: ブラコンお兄さん、こっち向いて
mangas.synonyms: Please Look At Me: Brother Complex
mangas.description:
