After his angelic brother's birth 17 years ago, Haruhisa became an extreme brocon the moment he laid eyes on him. He poured all his love into his little brother in their busy parents' stead, putting his own needs aside.

On the day of his precious brother's teacher-parent conference, Haruhisa marches in, ready to evaluate Mitsuhara's worth as a homeroom teacher. A few days later, Haruhisa discovers that his brother has a lover! Moreover, it's a male student from the same high school!? Turning to Mitsuhara to find out the truth, Haruhisa is suddenly kissed for some reason…?

mangas.title: Fill Me With Love 'Til I Can't Live Without It
mangas.titleNative: ダメになるまで愛で満たして
mangas.synonyms: Dame ni Naru Made Ai de Mitashite
mangas.description:
"I'll show you the pleasure of receiving another's devotion."

A widow-like, needy man is passionately wooed by a charismatic foreigner!? I'm being loved so much, I could melt...

mangas.title: Lovin' Your Face
mangas.description:
Yasutaka can't peel his eyes off his classmate Takakura's face - it's just so beautiful and well-balanced, like that of a perfect porcelain doll. But it doesn't mean he likes him or anything - so it means he won't feel awkward when he gets the chance to draw him up close, right?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: My Instructor Won't Yield
mangas.titleNative: 千葉教官はなびかない
mangas.description:
Chiba's kind manner, clear guidance, and pretty face easily make him the favorite instructor of every female student at the driving school where he works. But, while he'll play up his charms to get good reviews, Chiba is diligent about politely—but firmly—rejecting any romantic gestures or advances that may come his way. His well-crafted persona is put to the test when he is matched with the mysterious Yaotome, a new student gaining a reputation of his own as the "Sharp-Suited Prince." Despite his cool looks and demeanor, Yaotome can hardly compose himself when Chiba begins their lesson. Is it just nerves, or is there something more to it...?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Don't Get in the Way of Shun's Romance
mangas.titleNative: 牧田くんの恋路をジャマすると死ぬ
mangas.synonyms: Makita-kun no Koiji wo Jama Suru to Shinu
mangas.description: Kaoru, a high school student infamously known as a fighting-fanatic, gains a sudden fascination with a new transfer student who is rumored to be incredibly dangerous. One day, he witnesses this mysterious underclassman, Shun, in a blood-boiling fight and ends up falling head-over-heels in love... But, when he goes to confess, he's mistaken as another attacker and must defend himself against the younger boy's lethal strikes! While the fight leaves Kaoru beaten and bruised, he suddenly finds himself being kissed...!? As if that wasn't confusing enough, Shun seems endeared by Kaoru's inexperience with love and agrees to date him, kicking off the start of a terrifying romance!

mangas.title: Namae mo Shiranai Machiawase
mangas.titleNative: 名前も知らない待ち合わせ
mangas.description:
1. Namae mo Shiranai Machiawase

Within the two seconds of us locking eyes, I see the invite and follow suit. There are many stories of one-night stands, but doing it in the bathroom at the station to my workplace? That's a new one. And even when I've got a policy to never do the same guy twice, but I just couldn't forget him. Then I meet him again exactly a week later, same place, same time. And we do it in the bathroom again!!


2. Machiawase no Sono Ato de

3. Mars no Shinzou no Hitosukui

4. Ijiwaru na Ko hodo Ijimetai

5. Mawarimichi shite Ano Ko no Tobira

6. Tokete Mazatte Natsu no Niwa

7. Machiawase no Sono Saki de

mangas.title: Lemon Soda Flavor Kiss
mangas.titleNative: レモンソーダフレーバーキス
mangas.description:
"A kiss from my best friend!?"



Rio and Leo have been childhood friends since kindergarten. However, as they start their last year of high school, they're in separate classes for the first time. It's during this first day of the new school year that Leo suddenly confesses to Rio and kisses him... What's going on!?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Tell Me When You're Full!
mangas.titleNative: ご馳走さまが聞こえない！
mangas.description:
"It might be you who gets full, first."



Chief Togawa, most admired businessman in history, is possessed by an incubus?! Utsuse, a humble salesman works vigilantly hoping to someday reach an inch closer to the ace of the company, Chief Togawa. However, the Chief suddenly transforms into an extreme sadist, possessed by an incubus. To save the Chief's life, "You must have sex" orders the incubus with the exact same attire of Chief Togawa. Sadist incubus persona, and the kind, Chief Togawa entangles Utsuse between bed sheets... the office, or anywhere before the magic wears out to eat Chief Togawa alive. A BL romance with a black magic twist.



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Rough and Tumble Hana and His Lovey-Dovey Boyfriend
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーはなちゃんの猫かわいがり彼氏
mangas.description:
Rough-looking Hanamaru Odagiri has started dating his childhood friend,Wataru,who is one year younger than him. For Hana,Wataru was like a younger brother,and as a boyfriend,Wataru's sweet personality is both adorable and frustrating. Why? Because they haven't yet started doing the things that lovers do...! Hana wants to kiss,and more. His older brothers,Kiyo,who goes for what he wants,and the baddy wannabe,Take,give him some advice. Under their experienced guidance,Hana leads Wataru into their first taste of adult love!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sweet Blood
mangas.description:
The man who bought him at the black market auction is a handsome young vampire.



Vampires have taken control and humans have been forced to live in segregated areas. Jinosuke Fukuda is a ceramic artist who's lost his sponsor due to the relationship between vampires and humans deteriorating. Right when Jinosuke is feeling miserable about his sponsor cutting ties with him, he gets kidnapped and sold at a black market auction.

A vampire named Noi wins the bid. He is fascinated with humans and wants to do research on them, so he forces Jinosuke to make an agreement with him to let him suck his blood once or twice a week. The first time his blood is sucked, Jinosuke feels as if his body is on fire with unbearable pleasure. He can't believe that getting his blood sucked could feel so good!



A love story between a curious vampire and an older ceramic artist.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Oresama na Doukyuusei no Kenzoku ni Narimashita
mangas.titleNative: オレ様な同級生の眷属になりました
mangas.description: In a world where human and non-human descendants coexist, Rio is a high school student descendant of vampires. As a result of his race, he's feared by his classmates and he tries hard to go unnoticed. Independently of his intentions, Kairi, a human classmate, is always bugging him. Due to Kairi's tactless words, the girl Rio likes hates him and in his desire to seek revenge, Rio decides to make Kairi his "servant"?!

mangas.title: Punch Drunk Love
mangas.description:
Seon-woo is a pretty unassuming office worker, but he's got a hardcore fetish: he wants some BDSM love from another man who's willing to dominate. Enter his new co-worker, Tae-moon. Tae-moon is really hot, and based on a little snooping, he might be into men–and he's showing signs of being a dom, to boot! Trying to start a sexy relationship at work can be rough, but Seon-woo likes it rough, so game on.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Otome Yankee wa Unmei no Hito wo Matsu.
mangas.titleNative: 乙女ヤンキーは運命の人を待つ。
mangas.description: The school most feared Yankee, Kijima, has a secret. He believes in such things like "fortune-teller" and "fate"— that is to say, he has a maiden's heart. One day, Kijima met with his admired fortune-teller and was told that he would soon meet his destined partner and they will be tied together. To his surprise, the one who appears before him is his classmate, Kousaka, who has always been friendly towards him. "It can't be! This guy is my destined partner!?" From then, he realized that for some reason, the time that they spend together kept increasing. Not only that, but Kousaka's advances on him are also getting more and more intense as the days go.

mangas.title: Secretary To Stage
mangas.description:
Not everyone is infatuated with their boss like Doyoon. Ever since Gang Taehyuk's days as a 2nd gen idol—a pop star from way back—Doyoon has been obsessed. So, what does he do when Taehyuk retires and establishes an entertainment company to nurture new talent? Naturally, he trains to become Taehyuk's personal secretary, landing the coveted role. But Doyoon's life takes another dramatic turn when a member drops out of a new idol group just about to make their debut. There's no one better suited for the role, and Taehyuk wants Doyoon to step up and fill the spot. Besides, Taehyuk is willing to sweeten the deal with a wish, so looks like Doyoon is gonna have to leave the office and step into the spotlight…



(Source: LezhinUS)

mangas.title: Sono Futari, Kaishaku Chigai desu!
mangas.description:
Ryou and Shuu have been lifelong friends since childhood. Although they both hid their otaku sides from each other, they miraculously ended up being next to each other at a doujinshi event and exposed themselves. Since then, they enjoy their otaku activities together as if to make up for lost time, but it seems like Shuu is gradually getting closer to him? Read it all in this new short doujinshi-like stories!



(Source: JP Renta, edited and translated)



Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: An Impossible Marriage
mangas.description:
Once upon a time, a man and a woman from two feuding villages fell in love. Forbidden to marry, they committed suicide, pledging to marry in the next life. Various disasters began taking place as a result of their unfortunate fates, and the people in the two villages began offering a man and a woman for holy matrimony to comfort the souls of the sad couple. And, thus, they had continued to avoid calamities for generations...

Momoki Shirakawa is told about this unbelievable legend and becomes a bride, expected to marry Chikage Kurotaki from the neighboring village. Both young men give in to their family pressure and have no choice but to start living together despite the awkwardness

Will they never be a match!? Find out in this yaoi about an odd marriage that's sure to end up in divorce... or will it?

mangas.title: Zutto Kimi no Turn
mangas.description:
Kou, a party-goer college student, leads a flashy campus life. Yet he's actually an unassuming guy and, secretly, a closeted gay otaku. His goal is to "get a fashionable boyfriend!!!" Unfortunately, he's never met anyone, nor has the courage to come out. Then one day, Tanaka, whom Kou meets at his favorite game store, suddenly confesses to him. Tanaka is a fellow otaku and the two have a great affinity, but what if Kou simply isn't willing to accept his dull and tacky appearance...? The happiest, most bittersweet coming-of-age love comedy, dedicated to all otakus who hate themselves and want to change!



(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Kami-sama wa Chotto dake Ijiwaru
mangas.titleNative: 神様はちょっとだけいじわる
mangas.description:
One day the ordinary beta, Nao, reunites with Nagi, an old alpha friend that moved away long ago. This handsome, perfect, princely alpha Nagi has never forgotten the "vow" they exchanged, even as he grew up. And so we find Nao, whose heart races as he finds himself passionately embraced. However, right in the middle of enjoying this reunion, Nao's body goes through a heat that no beta should experience. It's an indication that his secondary gender, despite the one in tens of thousands odds, has changed...



(Source: Overlap, translated)

mangas.title: Game-ya BL
mangas.synonyms: The Honest Life of a Game Studio
mangas.description:
I, Anan Naoyoshi, joined Last Boss Korin, Co. in pursuit of Nobu-san, the game planner I've long admired. Things, however, are sour between us.

Our strained relationship aside, the two of us went on an overseas business trip. But then whyyyyy are we on a desert island?! And as if that wasn't bad enough, he now tells me we're stuck in a game of his own creation. Wait—we're in a whaaaaat?!

mangas.title: Ochinai Otoko
mangas.description: A story of one horny incubus and his adventures in the human world.

mangas.title: Oni Gal-kun no Hara no Naka
mangas.titleNative: 鬼ギャルくんの腹のなか
mangas.synonyms: Oni Gyaru-kun no Hara no Naka
mangas.description:
Ritsu Kamishiro, a diligent high school student, devotes his days to the restoration of an abandoned kendo dojo. However, he harbors a deep-seated insecurity about his height. One fateful day, a peculiarly attired man with flowing locks materializes before Ritsu, proclaiming himself as a demon. Startled, Ritsu learns that this enigmatic figure intends to reclaim a hammer from him, as he is believed to be a descendant of the legendary One Inch Man. The encounter leaves Ritsu feeling an intense heat and a tightening sensation in his stomach... He finds himself captivated by the man's irresistible allure.



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Private Scandal
mangas.synonyms: プライベート・スキャンダル
mangas.description:
Known as the muse of a renowned designer, Iliyan Moore has achieved almost everything a model could want: celebrity status, money, full bookings…and a reputation as a man-seducing home wrecker. No, scratch that. Iliyan has never wanted this reputation. And above else, it's completely untrue! Stalked by the paparazzi and harassed by an obsessed boss with a jealous wife, Iliyan is on guard against everyone around him. So, one could only imagine Iliyan's shock when a dashing young man by the name of Kyle Hackman manages to effortlessly charm his way past his defenses and into his bed on their first meeting… How will Iliyan manage to avoid this scandal?!



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Pheromoholic
mangas.description:
Cool model Towa is an herbivorous rabbit and clownfish chimera. His partner at his next job is a popular model… However, he's his natural enemy, a first generation carnivorous lion seed chimera. Since his early childhood, he has never been able to forget Towa's pheromones, "I'll feel better after holding you once" he says while approaching him?? Hating his constitution and his heat inducing breeding pheromones, he decided he'd never dapple in romance nor sex, yet his body is unable to resist the pheromones of this first generation beast...!



Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Those Wonderfully Happy Unlucky Days
mangas.titleNative: いとしのアンラッキーデイズ
mangas.description:
Megumi Nishijima is an attentive little brother who helps his divorced sister with her daughter, but he's cursed with the worst luck. In charge of his niece's daycare drop-offs and pick-ups, he exchanges daily pleasantries with her teacher, Tetta; a ray of sunshine with an adorable smile who is extremely popular with the kids, but just as klutzy as Megumi...! Megumi feels a sense of closeness to Tetta. And then, one day, they have a little "accident" that changes their relationship forever...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Prince-Turned-Idol & the Knight Who Stans Him
mangas.titleNative: 転生アイドルとドルオタの騎士
mangas.description:
Takao was a knight in a previous life. Now, after many reincarnations, he works as a successful corporate consultant in modern-day Japan. When he catches a glimpse on screen of Hikaru, a member of the boy band Dumas, the memories come flooding back. Hikaru is the reincarnation of the prince Takao had pledged himself to, and whom he was unable to protect. As if to atone for his failure, he vows to serve Hikaru in his present life. How? Well, as Dumas's manager of course. That way, he can watch over Hikaru closely and ensure his future is bright. But when the "untouchably cool" idol singer offers him a rare smile, Takao realizes that the feelings he bears for him (and his former prince)...may extend beyond fealty and duty...!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Fun, Sloppy Drunk Sex
mangas.titleNative: べろべろゆるゆるたのしいせっくす
mangas.synonyms: Bero Bero Yuru Yuru Tanoshii Sex
mangas.description: A young man creates a sex tape with his aggressive girlfriend. His friends end up seeing the tape and decide to try him out as well.

mangas.title: Talk to Me
mangas.titleNative: フィジカル・トークルーム
mangas.description:
Kaito is a college student who is a total womanizer. He brings home a different girl every night, annoying his next-door neighbor Asami and making him bang on the wall to shut Kaito and his guests up.

One day, Kaito hears Asami talking dirty on the phone...and it turns him on so much he ends up touching himself!

What's worse, Asami comes by to tell Kaito he knows what he was doing...

A love story between a neighbor with a hot voice and a college student with a thing for voices.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Who's Going To Win This Competition!?
mangas.description:
Kurokawa desperately wants his college kendo team to win the team competition. Every day, he pesters Kazuha, his biggest rival from high school, to join the team. Kazuha keeps turning him down, but unable to give up, Kurokawa challenges Kazuna to a match. If Kurokawa wins, Kazuha has to join the team. Kazuha easily beats Kurokawa, and now Kurokawa has to do what Kazuha wants. And what Kazuha wants is to be spanked!



The usually arrogant and snobby Kazuha is into some really kinky stuff! Kurokawa sees another side of Kazuha he's never seen before. Kazuha might just get the better of Kurokawa if he lets his guard down!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Helping Hinata Finish
mangas.description:
Hinata Koga, a university student working part-time at a karaoke place, is put in charge of high schooler and clubber Kai Kimura's training. As they're cleaning up one the karaoke rooms, Kai suddenly asks him, "You're gay, right?" Despite realizing that Kai couldn't possibly know of his orientation, Hinata ends up agreeing to a date so that Kai won't spread the word. Right afterwards, Kai makes a move on him, but then he suddenly adds the strange condition "not to fake pleasure"...!!??



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: My Loyal and Affectionate Shadow Wizard is Being Naughty
mangas.titleNative: 俺のワンコ系闇魔道士が言うことをきかない
mangas.description:
Loyd is a swordsman and leader of his clan. As the leader, Loyd removes his eyesore of a team member, the Shadow Wizard, from his ranks. Shortly after the wizard's banishment, however, Loyd's party faces utter defeat due to power imbalance. Loyd, having been reduced to nothing, has hit rock bottom. It's there where the Shadow Wizard he banished, Mizuha, appears. Oh how the tables turn in this magic-filled BL world.



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Joukakei Kareshi
mangas.description:
1-2. Bandai an Omega, was freshly dumped by his Beta boyfriend who was only after his heat. While walking in the streets contemplating, his heat started to act up. He was saved by Nagaoka a Beta, who offered him a place to stay.



3-6. Shichiku has a complex of being a Beta. Whether at work or home, he was always overshadowed by an Alpha despite having the skills. He is currently seeing Nagisa an Omega, who locks himself up during his heat cause the medication isn't working on his body.



7. Extra

mangas.title: Himitsu ni Shiro yo!!
mangas.description: High school student, Koshika, has liked cute things since he was a child. He also has a secret hobby of cross-dressing as a girl but was accidentally caught by his classmate Oozeki. To prevent rumours from spreading, he decides to keep him under surveillance by following him everywhere he goes.

mangas.title: Abarenbo Honey
mangas.description:
Vol 1: Abarenbo Honey

1-4) Abarenbo Honey

Takuma is a badass Omega delinquent more preoccupied with constant fights for his turf than with being cautious and taking his heat suppressing medicines. One day, when he challenges his archrival Hachi, something strange starts to happen with his body!

5-6) Kakurenbo Honey

Stoic Yakuza Hanasaki Mitsuro was always able to suppress and hide his Omega side. But what will happen to him after ending up on secluded Island with a young Alpha master without the access to the medicines?

6.5) Extra

Vol 2: Kakurenbo Honey
1-3) Kakurenbo Honey

4-6) Abarenbo Honey

7) Kakurenbo Honey + Extras

mangas.title: Shiba and Shepherd
mangas.titleNative: 柴くんとシェパードさん
mangas.synonyms: Shiba-kun and Shepherd-san's Daily Life to be in Love
mangas.description:
Dog-lover Yuuto Shibamoto has recently taken to gazing at the German Shepherd who visits the convenience store he works at every morning. One day, he and the dog's owner, Ouki Inukai, are suddenly drawn together by fate! Why does Yuuto's heart race when he sees a rare smile on the gloomy man's face, and why can't he stop thinking about Ouki's large, masculine, athletic body...? Will romance blossom between this German Shepherd of a man and his little Shiba-Inu-sized friend!?



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

mangas.title: Baby Come On!
mangas.synonyms: Please Let Me Try A Bite!
mangas.description: The knight was originally meant to rescue the princess from the evil villain, however, since the princess had already gotten married with the evil villain, the knight wouldn't be able to ever accomplish his errand. While being in confusion, he incidentally rescued a vampire. What he didn't expect was that the vampire would end up being such a bother! The lustrousness of the knight's blood made it the vampire's favorite food!

mangas.title: Melty Kiss
mangas.description:
Acting like he's a man of the people, Ryo Aihara's a CEO of his own successful production company. He hasn't been seriously involved with anyone in quite some time, though, and is feeling lonely as a result.

One night after dinner with a client, he's drunk and crouched down in an alley when a man in sunglasses approaches him. Behaving as if he were trying to pick up a woman, the man talks to Ryo as if he knows him.

A pissed off Ryo decides to mess around with the man a little and kisses him to shut him up. Ryo calls him out for not only having his hair cut to look like a certain actor, but for looking bad in it.

The next morning, he wakes up at home and turns on the TV to see the actor Riku Amamiya, the man with the sunglasses from last night...!

Secret love in the entertainment industry between a young, attractive, hot-shot actor and a career-oriented CEO who knows how to have a good time.

mangas.title: Ikemen Douryou ga Ore no Juukakin Fan deshita
mangas.titleNative: イケメン同僚が俺の重課金ファンでした
mangas.description:
Unbeknownst to those around him, Shirafuji is a game streamer who goes by "Shirocho" online. At work, he hides his love for games and "camouflages" himself as a nice young man. He also finds it hard to deal with his naturally exuberant and handsome co-worker, Meguro. However, he discovers that Meguro is actually his hardcore top donor fan who has been constantly donating hefty amounts during his streams...?!



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Drama Mitai na Koi Janakute mo
mangas.titleNative: ドラマみたいな恋じゃなくても
mangas.synonyms: Even If It's Not a Dramatic Love | It Doesn't Have to be a Dramatic Love
mangas.description:
Sudou Ginji is a writer who is gay and popular with men. He has never had a proper lover and has mostly had sex friends and one night stands. Most recently, he moved into a house with his senior colleague's best friend, Minamoto Chihiro, who is unaware of Ginji's sexuality.

Now that he is about to enter his 30s, he is determined to leave behind his playboy lifestyle. However, one night, Chihiro accidentally discovers that Ginji is gay.

mangas.title: Puppy Love
mangas.description:
An abandoned puppy saved from the cold by a kind boy. An exhausted salaryman who finds unexpected respite in the warm smile of a pet store clerk. How do these two stories entwine...?



Worked to the bone by his exploitative company, Inukai is at the end of his rope when he happens to pass by a pet shop and befriends Hoshi, a welcoming staff member. Inspired by the adorable puppies and Hoshi's support, Inukai is determined to change jobs and work toward a life where he can have his own dog. But change is hard, and Inukai's dreams are nearly at a standstill when Hoshi approaches him and declares that he'll help, because "I'm the dog you saved all those years ago!"



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Happy End no Kyuuseishu
mangas.titleNative: ハッピーエンドの救世手
mangas.description:
Nao is a college student who draws indie eromanga. The morning after a grueling deadline crunch, he finds a little snakey boi, which invites itself inside his room. During a nap, it starts sucking on Nao's willy and gulping down the seed… and of course Yasu, Nao's kouhai, walks in.
Dismayed as he is by Nao deciding to keep the tentacle as a drawing assistant and manga inspiration, Yasu lets Nao use his hand to jerk off every time it's time to feed the now-named 'Wiggle-michi' its semen.



Truthfully, Yasu has always had a crush on Nao.

Could this sentient tentacle be their cupid?!

(Source: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Yuutousei wa Mi no Hodo Shirazu
mangas.titleNative: 優等生は身のほど知らず
mangas.synonyms: Honor Students Know Not Their Place
mangas.description:
Shougetsu, an honors student at the top of his grade, discovers the wonders of developing his backside. One day, a student from the same grade, Kyoujima, sees him anal masturbating in a classroom after school. In exchange for his silence, Kyoujima tells him to continue what he was doing...?!



A curiosity-filled high-schoolers' pleasure study love!!



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: How to Use Scissors and You
mangas.description: How will Seiji win the hairdressing contest he joined, when his model Nanase is such a pain to work with?

mangas.title: My Cat And My Bed
mangas.description:
Boyfriend service Stray Cat's most popular employee, Haru, is known for his pampering skills. When he gets going, he turns into the sweetest "boyfriend" for his clients. Wanting to learn how to feel good in bed, Hiroki works up the courage to call for Stray Cat's services. That's when Haru appears at his doorstep and shows him a night he'd never imagined...



Hot, steamy action ensues both in and out of bed as this flirtatious night worker and his cute, sensitive client find themselves getting attracted for real...!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kitai Shichatte Ii desu ka!?
mangas.titleNative: 期待しちゃっていいですか！?
mangas.synonyms: Is it okay to expect this!?
mangas.description: Suzuki has been addicted to anal masturbation after watching a gay AV by mistake in high school. The rumor that "a tall man is also has a big dick" has made him become anxious about a tall colleague!

mangas.title: mellow pillow
mangas.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 43, was then licensed by Media Soft for digital release.

mangas.title: Beyond Memory
mangas.description: Won-Jun is a university student who can read other people's emotions by touching them. He hears that Gyu-Han, who he shares lectures with, graduated from the same high school and decides to approach him. However, Gyu-Han gives him the cold shoulder, and no matter how hard Won-Jun tries, he can't seem to read Gyu-Han's feelings. But instead of chasing him away, Gyu-Han's reaction to Won-Jun's touches piques his curiosity instead and makes him continue his efforts all the more!

mangas.title: Uemura is a Good Boy.
mangas.titleNative: 上村くんは真面目ないい子。
mangas.description:
To his teachers, classmates, and parents, Uemura is a model student. But, that is hardly the truth. Beneath his serious exterior, Uemura loves masturbating more than anything else and spends his day thinking dirty thoughts. His facade as a serious student slips when his playboy underclassman, Matsuoka, catches him at school jacking off to dirty panties. Has Uemura finally found someone who can accept his true self?

(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes a one-shot and 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: He's a Better Top Than Me?!
mangas.titleNative: タチの才能、モロ出しすんな！！
mangas.description:
"So you could cum, huh? You're a talented bottom."



Miya has always been a top, and dominates every man he meets on the dating apps. Until he meets up with a shy boy, who turns out to be more than Miya expected. Who will be the top and who will be the bottom? And what happens when the shy boy shows up at Miya's work?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko
mangas.titleNative: 飛んで火に入る夏のネコ
mangas.synonyms: Kochira ga Shin Sekai no Iriguchi desu
mangas.description:
1-2. Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko:



In Gensei, where the ghosts reside, a beautiful bartender and his partner, a black cat named Gin, operate a bar. Amongst those visiting the bar was Natsu (a mythical twin-tailed cat), who makes a living reporting gossip. Despite this, he lives a life in poverty.


One day, he meets a widely popular pornographer, Hyde (Tsuchigumo). While hoping to do a scoop exposing Hyde's mysterious private life, Natsu sneaks in as a housekeeper. However, where he thought he would find a story, he instead finds his own body exposed through punishment with catnip and adult toys――?



3. Kochira ga Shin Sekai no Iriguchi desu

4-5. Yoiyami to Kuroneko to Boku no Kishi

6. Watashi no Shin Sekai e Youkoso

mangas.title: Unexpected Love Serendipity
mangas.titleNative: 想定外ラブセレンディピティ
mangas.description:
Shimizu is tricked by his colleague, the flashy Karasuma, into going to what he thought was a party for old classmates, but turns out to be a mixer with man-hungry women. In an attempt to escape, Shimizu lies and says he's gay and kisses Karasuma in front of everyone. Even after leaving the bar, the women continue to stalk the two, so they run into a nearby hotel! Drunk and swayed by the mood of the hotel, Karasuma, ever curious, says, "Let's do it! Just the tip!" Shimizu reluctantly agrees, so long as he's on top. At first Karasuma complains that it doesn't feel good, but gradually he begins moaning with pleasure, and Shimizu even starts to think he looks cute...!



(Source: Renta!)



1. MANNERIXX; Qpa Vol. 35

2-4. Souteigai Love Serendipity (想定外ラブセレンディピティ); Qpa Vols. 43, 45, kakioroshi

5-7. Kanashimi no Shady (愛しみのシャディ); Qpa Vols. 37, 39, 41

mangas.title: Wakabaryou de, Kimi to
mangas.description: Higuchi is a student dorming at an all-boys school. He's at the age where he wants a girlfriend, but every time he gets one, he gets dumped soon after. The one to console him is his straight-laced roommate, Hidaka. However, once an underclassman from the track team, Kousaka, appears, how will their relationship change!?

mangas.title: Okubyoumono ni I Love You
mangas.titleNative: 臆病者にアイラブユー
mangas.description: Due to his scary face, Shougo has been alone since entering university. But unexpected events lead him to become close with Hina, from the same university. Shougo, elated at the fact he's become friends with the cool and kind Hina, finds out that Hina breaks out into hives when people treat him with affection – a "love allergy"?!

mangas.title: I'll Die If My Boss Finds Out That I Crossplay
mangas.titleNative: 女装レイヤーが上司にバレたらしぬる
mangas.synonyms: 被上司知道我是女裝COSER就死定了
mangas.description:
The thought of spending the rest of his life as a cross-dressing virgin is driving Yuto up the wall! But swooning so hard over getting his photo taken... even worse!



Yuto's just started a new job working under Sayama, his new playboy of a boss. Little does Sayama know, in his private life, Yuto is actually "Yuka," a hardcore online otaku crossplayer with over 500,000 followers. Turns out, Sayama is a huge fan of Yuka, but Yuto feels like he can rest easy because there's no way his boss could ever find out about his big secret... right?
One day, Sayama leaves work early and forces Yuto to work overtime as usual, but at least he can look forward to the photoshoot he has booked for the next day with a photographer he really respects. His excitement turns into total panic as the photographer who shows up for the shoot turns out to be Sayama...!!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: His Extra-Large, Ever-So-Lovely...
mangas.description:
Aoi Yamamoto is 20 years old. Determined to get his first girlfriend, he joined a Nihonshu Club...only to find it chock-full of men. Disappointed, Aoi overindulges, and is taken home by a fellow club member to recover. This club member is also a virgin, even though he's had many girlfriends, and when he shows Aoi why, well...Aoi finds he wants to try it out for himself.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Goshujinsama wa Ouji ga Osuki
mangas.titleNative: ご主人様は王子がお好き
mangas.description: Kiryuu Yoshitsugu, like the predecessors of his family, serves the Saoinji family as a butler and is the primary ward over the household's first and only son, Kaede. Yoshitsugu has held feelings for his master ever since they were children, however, his master wanted a prince - someone he could never be. He has resolved to at least act as his master's knight and keep his feelings a secret while his master goes on to find his ideal. But can Yoshitsugu really keep himself in check when his master comes running back saying that he's met the prince he's been looking for?

mangas.title: The Red String of Fate
mangas.description:
Keiji has the special ability to see red strings of fate...threads that connect when two people are meant to spend the rest of their lives together. One day, he looks down at his hand and sees that his string has finally connected to someone!! But when Keiji finds the person on the other end, he realizes it's... a guy!!!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: All's Fair in Love and War
mangas.description: At a high school full of delinquents, Leo Shishiyama, a boy who looked cute but was the best fighter, is puzzled. Takeru Kurosawa, who had constantly challenging Leo to fights that ended up in a draw, has sent him an eighth challenge letter. Leo likes winning, but he doesn't particularly like fighting, and enjoys gorging on strawberry rice cakes, his favorite snack, much more. He tries to ignore Takeru, but bumps into his beautiful little sister on the street, who shows him kindness. If he can beat Takeru, maybe he can make a move on her! Leo faces Takeru, but who comes out victorious...?

mangas.title: You Are My Princess
mangas.description:
Itsumi Tachibana hates fighting. He's a student at a fancy high school who loves visiting cat cafes and collecting kitty-themed merchandise. Despite that, he looks like a gangster, which alienates him from his classmates, making him a magnet for unsavory characters outside of school. One day, the unthinkable happens: the popular, brilliant, and beautiful student body president, Seima Takajou, professes his love for Itsumi! This is a romance between complete opposites: a popular hot guy and his scary-but-sweet Cinderella!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Bending the Spoon
mangas.titleNative: スプーンが曲がったら
mangas.synonyms: When the Spoon Bends | Spoon ga Magattara
mangas.description: Tomoki Hoshiko is a troubled student who others steer clear of. Hidaka Asai, on the other hand, is the top student in the school, but his quiet bookishness hasn't made him any friends, either... After the two of them get teleported away from school by accident, Hidaka confesses that he has powers to Tomoki. Why did he tell him his secret? Maybe Hidaka is the only one who knows Tomoki's true nature...

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Note
mangas.description:
Shouya, a high school boy whose heart has never known romance, comes across an internet diary filled with wistful whispers of love toward the writer's same-sex crush. A photo posted to the page provides a hint as to the blog's owner: Tsubame, a fellow classmate known for being a lone wolf. Shouya realizes that his friend Ryuu is the object of the diary writer's affections, so he attempts to play matchmaker...but where will his own feelings take him in the process?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: The Second Sales Division!
mangas.description:
Sakisaka, from the second sales division, is in love with his supervisor, Tojo. Naturally, he has no intention of ever letting him know, but when Tojo starts being clingy to the point of it being too much, it almost makes Sakisaka think that he might have a chance! Where will this slow-going love story go?


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Uraomote no Koiwazurai
mangas.description:
Igarashi Ryou has good looks and the perfect job at a bank. He even has a fuck buddy, Takakura Asahi, a charming and stylish older man. They're madly in love—or so Ryou believes—so he decides to take the next step: he proposes!



"I'm not looking for that kind of relationship." He gets totally rejected, shattering his pride and heart!



Ryou throws himself into his work, hoping to forget all about his broken heart. One day, Asahi shows up at the bank asking for a loan—unshaven, disheveled and shabbily dressed, he looks completely different from before. Things get awkward as their relationship teeters between the personal and professional. Even the section chief, Iwasaki, gets involved!



(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

mangas.title: I've Become an Omega Today
mangas.titleNative: 今日からΩになりました。
mangas.description:
One wish. Ever since they were kids, a single desire saturated every corner of Kanade's life. I want to be with Munechika. Despite that, his dream was only a dream-any hope Kanade had of becoming Munechika's was shattered the moment he found out he was a beta. After all, an alpha like Munechika needs an omega… But today, everything has changed.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Boku to Neko to Hatsukoi Kousa
mangas.titleNative: ぼくとネコと初恋交差
mangas.description: Kirishima "Maa-chan" Masao and Kurokawa "Tai-chan" Taisuke have been friends since they were little—both looking out for each other, but when Maa-chan catches his friend being assaulted by a teacher, he can't help but blame himself for always thinking and never acting on his desire to protect his friend.

mangas.title: Renai Kanjouron
mangas.description:
Even if I can see your heart, it's hard to fall in love with you. Ryoma, who has a special constitution, is able to see other people's emotions as symbols. One day, he meets Aoyama, a university student who has a "black blur" of emotions that he has never seen before, and asks him to use it as material for a psychology experiment. Ryoma agrees to be a part of the experiment for a limited time in order to find out what the black blur is, but... what exactly is the black blur? Will it turn into love someday?

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Aoi Hitomi no Bake Mono
mangas.description:
Ever since he was born, Tatsumi Kodama has possessed blue eyes, a familial trait that grants them supernatural abilities. Whenever he meets gazes with someone, he can see every thought that person has ever thought. But forced to live on an isolated island with other blue-eyed family members, this power has only proved itself a curse. His childhood friend is Kei Arima, the adopted son of a family who looks after the secluded members of the Kodama family.

Tatsumi is well-aware of Kei's romantic interest in him, but he refuses to acknowledge his feelings. The burden of bearing blue eyes is insurmountable, and as Tatsumi slowly distances himself from Kei, their bond grows fractured. Will Tatsumi ever be able to meet Kei's gaze?

mangas.title: Kimi to Ishindenshin!
mangas.description: High school student Saika has psychic abilities, and is constantly tormented by people's thoughts. However, after he makes a friend, who happens to be in love with him, he finds it's not all that bad.

mangas.title: Matataki no Ao wo Tadotte
mangas.titleNative: またたきの青をたどって
mangas.synonyms: Follow the Twinkling Blue of the Stars
mangas.description:
One day, Yamato Tsukimachi—who dreamed of becoming a teacher since high school—comes across a familiar name on his class roster: Isshin Komiya, the name of his best friend who fell into a coma during their senior year. Isshin states that he woke up two years ago, did his rehabilitation, and transferred into the class to get a restart on his high school life. After this dreamlike reunion, though now as teacher and student, the two decide to go through their bucket list of things they weren't able to do before they graduated.



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Who Can Define Popularity?
mangas.synonyms: There's Something Wrong With My Popularity
mangas.description:
Si-Won Cha is obsessed with his popularity. Having transformed everything from his weight to his demeanor to remake himself into the perfect popular guy, he loves being the center of attention. What happens when he is challenged by over-eager and equally narcissistic rival Da-Un Hyeong? And why does Da-Un somehow think Si-Won has a crush on him?!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: A Coward Falls in Love
mangas.titleNative: 弱虫男子、恋愛はじめます。
mangas.synonyms: A Weakling Starts to Love | Yowamushi Danshi, Renai Hajimemasu
mangas.description: Kawachi's enjoying another day of watching (more like stalking) his favorite guy, the very nice Yuto Shinozuka, from the shadows. As he's peeping on Yuto putting away some stuff in the gym storage room, something unbelievable happens...! Caught witnessing Yuto showing his true self, Kawachi panics and blurts out that he'll keep quiet if Yuto pleasures him! Kawachi feels terrible because what he's doing is basically blackmail! But, he just can't help himself. A relationship that starts with blackmail... Can it work!?

mangas.title: Pendulum: Juujin Omegaverse Bangai-hen
mangas.titleNative: ペンデュラム―獣人オメガバース― 番外編

mangas.title: Pendulum: The Beastmen Omegaverse Saga
mangas.titleNative: ペンデュラム―獣人オメガバース―
mangas.description:
In a world inhabited by both humans and beastmen, Kai is a young human who has been abandoned by his parents for being born an omega. Luckily, he is taken in by Luard, a wolf beastman and the head of the prestigious Siegfried family. Within the walls of his new home, Kai learns that in order for beastmen to have children, they must mate with a human omega. He dreams of one day becoming Luard's official mate, yet as he matures and waits for his first heat cycle to arrive, Kai finds Luard increasingly distant. The young omega can't help but wonder—what is his purpose if not to bond with the alpha he loves?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Kitto Ouji-sama ga Nante
mangas.titleNative: きっと王子様がなんて
mangas.description: Sakura, who continues to live alone even after reaching the age of 30, decides to marry in order to reassure his parents. But the truth is… he's an otomen who likes cute stuff and is a closet gay man. Keeping these circumstances hidden, he goes to a marriage counselor and reunites with his younger childhood friend Yuusuke by chance.

mangas.title: Oh! My Assistant
mangas.description:
Seonho in an artist, who draws adult webcomics. It started as an easy way to make money, but it's caused some unexpected side effects: he hasn't been aroused for over two years! Exhausted, he hires an assistant. It's just that, he didn't expect him to be so cute! Muyeong is clean, talented, and apparently loaded so...why does he want to work under Seonho? Turns out, Muyeong is Seonho's number one fan…


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Motekei Ouji no Renai Command
mangas.titleNative: モテ系王子の恋愛コマンド
mangas.description: When he was 4 years old, Moegi Masayuki was traumatized by a large dog. Ever since then, he has had a fear of large dogs and a dislike for any dogs. At his sisters insistence, he has to take in her dog to obedience training. There he meets Kurosawa Kanata, a police dog trainer. Soon Masayuki forgets his fear of dogs, blinded by his curiosity towards Kanata-sensei. Will the prince like office worker and the socially awkward dog trainer fall in love?

mangas.title: The Metalhead Next Door
mangas.titleNative: となりのメタラーさん
mangas.description:
Impoverished graduate student Kento nearly freezes to death outside his new cheap (unheated) apartment during a blizzard. Luckily, he's saved by neighbor Soushi, a quiet and somewhat frightening young man who dresses in all black. Although he exudes an aura that screams "keep away," his eyes, hidden behind long rocker hair, plead for something else. Over the following year, the two share meals together, but as the time passes, the closeted Kento finds it increasingly difficult to ignore his growing feelings. Will he choose to maintain the peaceful, happy times he's grown to love or risk it all for the possibility of something more?



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Yuujou Vibration
mangas.titleNative: 友情バイブレーション
mangas.description:
"Can you feel the vibrations from my phone?"


Meet Hishikawa: a plain and lonely boy, and Senzaki: the popular boy whose phone is constantly exploding with notifications. To Hishikawa, the popular boy Senzaki seems like a world away. However, an unprecedented event one day brings them closer together. And on top of that, they end up doing this and that (read: naughty things) with the vibrations from Senzaki's phone. Thus begins their days spent together engaging in activities that make them "feel good"… But is this really friendship?!


A story about youth, deep kisses and dangerous feelings between the class's most popular boy and the pure, dark-haired, plain old glasses boy.



(Source: Renta JP, Translated and edited)



Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Katappashi Kara Zenbu Koi
mangas.description: Out of the blue, childhood friend Takaoka confesses to Iwami! When popular playboy and ladies man Takaoka says "I love you", he doesn't believe it one bit. Is he making fun of the virgin!? A modern high-school boys' adolescent love development!

mangas.title: Until You Unlock the Door
mangas.titleNative: きみが鍵をあけるまで
mangas.description:
With that cold look, he feels this urge growing in his stomach...



Makoto Tsuge and Kyouya Shirane have been friends since their sophomore year in high school. Makoto's friendly and gets along with everyone, but Kyouya's more of a loner who does what he wants and often picks on other people. Despite their polar differences, they've managed to stay friends into their adult years. However, the truth is they've each been working very hard to stay close to one another...


This is the love story between a plain, friendly businessman and a fancy-free, gorgeous beast. Their ten-year relationship will turn into a loving one, and the key to that is their second kiss.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: I'll Kiss You, You'll See.
mangas.titleNative: そんな顔してもキスはだめ
mangas.description:
"I got a perfect boyfriend that looks like my favorite character!"



Tanaka is a college student and an otaku. Suzuki is a guy who's got it all, and is Tanaka's classmate. One day, Suzuki steals Tanaka's first kiss and asks him out. While Tanaka has always secretly admired Suzuki, the pressure from the sudden confession puts him in a panic, and he turns down Suzuki. But Suzuki continues to steal kisses, and it gets Tanaka flustered every time. Tanaka tries to run away from the kisses, but then Suzuki tells him he'll stop trying to kiss him if he starts dating him?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ore no Buka ga Eroi Mousou wo Yamete Kurenai
mangas.titleNative: 俺の部下がエロい妄想をやめてくれない
mangas.synonyms: My Subordinate won't Stop Having Lewd Fantasies about Me
mangas.description:
Sayama, who possesses the power to read people's minds, accidentally sneaks into the mind of his subordinate, Kaneko, during a meeting one day. Inside, there are all kinds of erotic play, such as blindfolds, restraints, and verbal abuse that can't be imagined from the seriousness of his face as he takes notes… And the most shocking thing is the other person is "me"?!

Despite his confusion regarding the reason why the other party is himself, Sayama can't help but to be curious. Even when he tries to avoid running into him, this time, Kaneko appears in his dream…!?



A person who likes to have erotic fantasies x a psychic superior. This is a psychic love with unstoppable lewd fantasies involving bondage, blindfolds, verbal abuse, toys, tentacles, etc.!



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)



Note: Contains three extras.

mangas.title: Our Lucky Future Together
mangas.description:
University student Mahiru lived his whole life utilizing a special power that lets him read the future of anyone he touches. He has always found this power useful, that is until he meets Kurosawa, the newbie at his part-time job. Despite how Kurosawa's looks are absolutely Mahiru's type in every way, for some reason, Kurosawa vehemently pulls away at the slightest touch.



When an accident on the stairs lead to a touch of hands between the two, Mahiru witnesses a future where the two of them kiss! Kurosawa then reveals that he has a power that brings bad luck to anyone he touches... but believes that Mahiru might be the key to lifting the curse!



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Hot and Cold
mangas.description: It was a summer when even breathing was hard due to the heat. The air conditioner in An Kyungsoo's room was long broken. As a replacement, his landlord sent him a humanoid air conditioner that is all the rage overseas, taking form in a handsome male model. As soon as it is turned on, it became so cool that he cuddled it, but he can't help feeling a bit weird. As he was cuddling this temporary replacement of his AC, he pressed a button located "somewhere" and it opened it's eyes. Turns out that not only did his humanoid have a handsome face, he also has a kind personality and a gentle voice… This totally perfect AC's over friendliness gradually included skinship, as well as relieving his sex drive that has been long stifled by the heat…

mangas.title: Setting You Up
mangas.description:
Shinwoo is fed up with people asking him if he's going out with Juho. It doesn't matter what others say or think; he has accepted that fact that Juno always has been - and always will be - nothing more than a good friend…even if Shinwoo wants them to be something more. Sure, he might have been crushing on Juno for no less than 10 years, but that doesn't change the reality of the situation: Juho is simply not interested in men, and their friendship is more important than a little crush. However, a confession by Juho is about to shock Shinwoo to the core: his supposedly straight best friend has…a boyfriend?! But something seems more than just a bit off. Juho is always hanging out with Shinwoo instead of this "boyfriend" of his, and is seemingly hung up on his opinion of his new lover… Is this new turn of events setting Shinwoo up for failure, or could it be fate, setting Shinwoo up with the love of his life?



(Source: Lezhin)



Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

mangas.title: He's a Predator
mangas.description:
Yasuharu has all that it takes to be very popular. His only fault is loving his childhood friend Yuma way too much. Every time Yuma says his pet phrase, "I wanna die," he replies smilingly, "I'll eat you, then," creeping his friend out. But, one day Yuma says something that triggers a change in their relationship...! A stolen kiss, a daring request, forced cohabitation... the exciting story of a possessive love!


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Naeilbuteo Gobaek
mangas.description:
Today's high school's entrance ceremony!

Even after middle school, 'Da-Joon' is still popular. But 'Si-Yoon' feels a strange sense of incompatibility with him...

One day, when Si-Yoon happens to go to Da-Joon's place, what he sees is... his violent side?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

mangas.title: Yuutousei wa Unmei no Akai Ito ni Sakaraitai
mangas.titleNative: 優等生は運命の赤い糸に逆らいたい
mangas.synonyms: The honor student wants to go against the red thread of fate
mangas.description:
One day, Miyanari, a solid honor student, suddenly saw a red thread of fate connecting him to the delinquent Hashiba in the same class. "There is no way that this guy is the one for me!" But the red thread seemed to cause mischief, as Hashiba helped to treat Miyanari's injury, or when they found themselves trapped together in a room. The more time they spent with each other, the more Miyanari recognized Hashiba's kindness, so different from his delinquent image...?



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Notes:

- Originally self-published on Pixiv and Twitter, was then licensed by Frontier Works for serialization.

- Tokubetsu-hen: Sonogo no Valentine's Day (特別編 その後のバレンタインデー) and Shashin (写真) published on Pixiv Comic were not included in any of the volumes.

- Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Nakittsura ni Hug
mangas.description:
Fuwa Masaki suffers from an extreme shyness that forces him to keep an unnecessary distance away from people. He has always wanted to change himself, but never knew what to do. One day, Masaki bumps into Miyatsuka Takeru, a medical student who picks up his cell phone. For some reason, he decides to train Masaki to overcome his illness!



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)


Note: Contains an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Fateful Love Meter
mangas.description:
"The balloons tell me how you feel."

Shizuki, a former celebrity and the school's prince charming, has a problem. He can see balloons above people's heads and understand their emotions from the balloons' shapes. One day, Shizuki is chased by a fan and is rescued by Shinozuka, rumored to be the school's biggest delinquent. Shinozuka, who has actually been a fan of Shizuki for a long time, has the biggest and shiniest balloon Shizuki has ever seen. Confused but happy to receive such genuine affection, Shizuki gradually grows closer to Shinozuka...

mangas.title: Kimidori
mangas.description:
"Can you take a picture of a ghost? For me?"



Shoshin, whose hobby is photography, saw Ei Ubara by himself after school, with tears in his beautiful lime green eyes, drawing a picture of someone without a face. Struck by Ei's appearance, Shoshin found him in school the next day and asked Ei to be his photo model. Ei initially refused, but Shoshin wouldn't give up, so Ei imposed some conditions to be his model...

mangas.title: This Poor Beta Doesn't Know About Love
mangas.titleNative: 憐れなβは恋を知らない
mangas.synonyms: Piteous β is Not Aware of Love
mangas.description:
Suzuharu Seno, a beta, serves Ryousuke Isezaki, an alpha and heir to a big family, as his personal butler. A free spirit, Ryousuke not only brings his omega flings home, but even makes passes at Suzuharu. Suzuharu knows that he's not serious, but his desire builds up anyway...



The long anticipated spin-off from the "Dirty Omegas Don't Fall in Love" series!! An omegaverse story portraying the distorted love of an alpha and beta's master-servant relationship.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Bitter Sweet Sweet Darling
mangas.description: Shi-Woo Jeong is trying to catch his big break when everything falls apart. He gets accused of stalking a star actor and is blacklisted by his high school crush, Tae-Rim Han, who now runs a successful acting agency. Tae-Rim decides to follow up on the disgraced actor only to realize Shi-Woo's life is in shambles. He takes Shi-Woo in to set him straight, but discovers that there may be more to this talentless hack. Can Tae-Rim add such a risk to his agency's roster and make something of Shi-Woo while his romantic feelings resurface?

mangas.title: A Good Dog Gets Down on His Knees
mangas.description:
"Mr. Warden, the face you make when you're getting fucked... is adorable."

He knows he shouldn't enjoy being dominated by a prisoner this much... But in this Dom/Sub universe, the cocksure prison warden can't help falling prey to the dangerous new prisoner...

mangas.title: Fill in Color
mangas.description: Saki Yano, a freelance designer, was hit on by a college student with dazzling red hair named Yu. Saki agrees to date at a smutty movie theater to tease him. His face blushing beet red, Yu invited Saki to do something "afterwards," and Saki ended up lashing out at him with his lustful and somewhat sadistic feelings towards him. The next morning, Yu left behind a note written in beautiful handwriting, and Saki saw him off. Though it seemed to be a one-night stand, in reality they have a much deeper connection...?

mangas.title: practiced liar
mangas.description:
"This world is full of noise."



Due to his innate ability to "read minds", Miura is completely distrustful of people because he is constantly exposed to their true feelings. One day, he meets Abe, his junior at a university club, who is twice as quiet and expressionless as anyone else. But it turns out, Abe is a person who will talk non-stop like a machine-gun about his pure love for Miura (*only in his mind)!

mangas.title: Park Hanhoo's Manager
mangas.synonyms: あいつのマネージャー
mangas.description:
Chansol never experienced friendship before he met Park Hanhoo, a troubled boy who terrifies school gangs and hides his face with an unruly haircut. But when a horrific event turns Chansol's world upside down, he is forced into hiding and reneges on his promise to stay by Hanhoo's side. Now an adult, he's back to resolve old issues, but with the truth about his past hidden behind a world of mafia bosses and shady business, his only option is to infiltrate it as the manager of an unhinged arms dealer. As Chansol sets out to coax information out of his new boss, he realizes that seducing this handsome maniac may just bring him closer to the truth and the friend he used to call Park Hanhoo.



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue

mangas.title: Sweet Like Vanilla
mangas.description:
Juwon's just had the worst breakup of his life. So what does he do to get over his jerk of an ex? Sleep with his best friend, of course. Jiwook's always been there when Juwon's needed someone, always coming right over without question. But then, he has to go and talk about his feelings during their drunken night of sex… But maybe it isn't a bad thing, since Juwon's been starting to look at Jiwook differently since that night, too. Maybe going out with your good-looking best friend won't be that bad at all. Just friends, friends with benefits, or lovers? The tension between the two becomes palpable, and whatever they've become now, it sure tastes sweet like vanilla…



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Chapter count includes a 3-chapter side story

mangas.title: Marchentic Bazooka
mangas.titleNative: メルヘンチック・バズーカ
mangas.description:
My comedy partner is my life partner! This is the 2020's neo-married couple comedy duo!!

Aiming to be top comedians, the comedy duo, Marchentic Bazooka, live together and go to training school while streaming videos. Aki is a disappointing but hot and funny man and has, since the formation of their pairing in high school, liked his "sweet angel" partner Haru, so much that he can't stand it. Though Aki tries terribly hard to show his feelings, Haru won't have anything to do with him...?

A super hot, funny-man weirdo and a not-so-straight straight-man go down the path of being a comedy duo as an actual, ridiculous married couple!

mangas.title: Again
mangas.description: Perhaps karma does exist. Han Nokyoung, an A-list actor with a foul attitude, winds up getting his just deserts when a video of him sleeping with LK Entertainment's CEO, Kang Junil, surfaces on the internet. To make matters worse, Nokyoung soon becomes the victim of an acid attack, ending his career entirely. With even his boss and the man he loves, Jang Hyunjae, leaving his side, Nokyoung feels there's nothing left for him anymore and takes his own life. But instead of waking up in the afterlife, Nokyoung finds himself three years in the past! Now determined to change the future, Nokyoung turns over a new leaf and tries not to get involved with either of the men that led to his downfall. However, when it comes to Kang Junil, Nokyoung's fate might already be sealed…

mangas.title: The Dog Will Not Give Up Unrequited Love
mangas.description:
Yuu Shimazaki, now a senior, is just looking forward to the day he enters college. He spends his time getting intimate with the people he likes. When one almost-sex encounter is interrupted by a younger student, Daisuke Akizuki, Yuu is embarrassed but moves on. That is until he finds out that he and Daisuke now live in the same dormitory. Looking to move the awkwardness away, he talks to Daisuke, whom Yuu is surprised to find taking things smoothly. But when Daisuke suddenly confesses his love for Yuu, things get complicated. For one, Yuu thinks it's just puppy love on Daisuke's part, but the latter is determined to prove him wrong. Is Yuu ready for Daisuke's feelings, especially when he hasn't fallen in love for real before?



(Source: Futekiya)



1-3. Ichizu na Inu wa Akiramenai (一途な犬は諦めない, The Dog Will Not Give Up Unrequited Love)

4-5. Taigan no Inu wo Yonde (対岸の犬を呼んで, The Dog is Called to the Other Side)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Akari to Kare wa Nayamashii
mangas.titleNative: あかりと彼はなやましい
mangas.description: Can you, a straight man, fall in love with me? His two (straight) friends got together. The openly gay high schooler Akari is somehow displeased with that. Is it envy? Or is it jealousy? ……What the hell. Someday I'll definitely find 'someone to love' too…! Having eagerly gone to a gay bar, the one he meets there is an irritating adult wielding a fair argument――!?

mangas.title: Soshite Mata Kiss wo Shite
mangas.titleNative: そしてまたキスをして
mangas.description: Harukawa is hiding the fact that he's gay due to the trauma he experienced in middle school. Although he wanted to forget all those haunting memories, a kouhai from his past has followed him and still possesses the same feelings as before?

mangas.title: Mr. Unlucky Has No Choice but to Kiss!
mangas.titleNative: 不幸くんはキスするしかない！
mangas.synonyms: Fukou-kun wa Kiss Suru Shika Nai! | Fukou-kun Can Do Nothing But Kiss
mangas.description:
Kota is a university student who runs into bad luck wherever he goes. One day, the super-lucky Naoya saves Kota from getting hit by an oncoming car...and through some miscommunication, they start dating?!

It turns out Kota's bad luck gets better around Naoya, so if having to kiss him sometimes is all it takes for his bad luck to disappear, then that's not a bad deal at all! But Kota can't help but start to seriously fall for the naturally charismatic Naoya...

mangas.title: Tantan to Tanto
mangas.description:
Koutarou and Shunpei were classmates, childhood friends, and neighbors. They were almost like brothers, Shunpei even stayed in Koutarou's house while his parents worked.



"But we're not family or brothers, and we haven't been kids for a long time."



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sono Mimi Sawarasete Kudasai
mangas.titleNative: その耳触らせてください
mangas.description: Tomoya, a cool and handsome high school student, secretly loves cute things. One day, he notices a freshman, Aki, who sneezes and grows a pair of fluffy ears from his head!?

mangas.title: Koi wa Etude!
mangas.description: Sora, a young actor who for his charisma and great talent in acting, has had a great increase of popularity. But the real personality of Sora, is a simple high school student, Hishino Rikuto! One day, a classmate from the same school, Kamizaka Kakeru, sees through his disguise of Rikuto and recognizes him as Sora and, to make the boy shut his mouth, kissed him by force. Kakeru was innocent, contrary to Rikuto who was more than used to kissing for his work. Thing, which makes Kakeru upset and confused. But it was that innocence that eventually caught Rikuto's attention. A secret love that no one else should know. Let the play begin!

mangas.title: Tomorrow We Won't Be Friends For Sure, Right?
mangas.titleNative: 明日はきっと友だちじゃない、よね
mangas.synonyms: Ashita wa Kitto Tomodachi Janai, yo ne
mangas.description: High school students Akari and Mikage have been childhood friends since kindergarten. Akari has always had a crush on Mikage, but he doesn't tell him how he feels. He wanted to support his love for his popular Mikage. However, Mikage, who was confessed to by a girl, refuses and says, "I can't because I have someone I like."

mangas.title: Long Period
mangas.description:
Yusei insists he hates his best friend—or at least, that's what he tells himself. Itsuki, his gifted, charming, and impossibly talented friend, seems to be wasting his potential. After all, Itsuki could easily get into any prestigious university or join any sports team, yet he chooses to spend his time with Yusei. Struggling with feelings he can't quite understand, Yusei pretends to despise Itsuki, hoping it will help him overcome his emotions or, at the very least, distance himself from the one person who means so much. But is pretending enough to change Yusei's heart? And what about Itsuki's feelings?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extrachapters.

mangas.title: Ore no Joshi ga Elite nanoni Hetare Kawaii
mangas.titleNative: 俺の上司がエリートなのにヘタレかわいい
mangas.synonyms: My Boss Is So Cute For An Elite
mangas.description:
The appearance of shrewd and capable, but also a handsome young-elite, when he got depressed he shrinks to puppy size. This matter was discovered by his subordinate, instead of spreading the discovered matter, this subordinate put his boss to domestication.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Isso Koe ga Nakattara
mangas.titleNative: いっそ声がなかったら
mangas.description: Rokuse, a janitor who struggles with stuttering, meets Takashina. Takashina is a man who is able to skillfully present himself in front of large crowds of people earns him the admiration of Rokuse. While Rokuse nurses a growing love for Takashina, he stutters out a "Th-Th-Th-Th-Th-That's o-o-okay!" to Takashina's offer. What will you do with a top-notch employee and a stuttering janitor? Their story is bound to be rife with communication hurdles.

mangas.title: Kaoru On An Emotional Rollercoaster
mangas.titleNative: 情緒の忙しいかおるさん
mangas.description:
Kaoru Kurisu works in general affairs at a security company and he's had bad luck with love all his life. He's just gotten out of a terrible relationship with a horrible guy, and doesn't trust himself when it comes to finding a decent one. Then, one day, he meets the younger brother of the president of his company, Shinobu Inoue. He has gorgeous black hair, chiseled looks, and a sculpted body. Not only that, he is a pure-hearted soul who's never been in a relationship... Kaoru tries to suppress his attraction to Shinobu by reminding himself that Shinobu is his boss's brother and that he's only been unsuccessful in relationships, but his feelings for Shinobu finally explode...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Pierce Hole
mangas.description: This is a story between Mr. Usui, an 'ordinary businessman' and another ordinary man working at a massage parlor. However, unknown by the people around him, Mr. Usui actually has many piercings hidden behind his suit and when our protagonist at the massage parlor finds out about this he is quickly intrigued! But are these piercings simply for aesthetics or is there a deeper meaning behind them?

mangas.title: Perverted Boss's Private Porno
mangas.titleNative: 淫乱上司のプライベートポルノ
mangas.description:
Sakai is an office worker who has arranged to meet his favorite male "pet" he found on a dating app. He's looking forward to the night with the sexy guy who keeps showing off his risque underwear and anal plugs, but today's the one day that he's stuck working late...! While he's having a smoke to get away from his boss, Yashima, who's giving him a hard time, he gets an extra sexy selfie from his pet! He's so turned on that he runs to the restroom, where he finds Yashima in an indecent state...!? An erotic love story between two sexually insatiable men: a dominant subordinate who wants to get laid, and a filthy, depraved boss!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Charisma AV Danyuu no Ore ga Omocha Nanka de Iku Wakenai!!!
mangas.titleNative: カリスマAV男優の俺がおもちゃなんかでイくわけない!!!
mangas.synonyms: Karisuma AV Danyuu no Ore ga Omocha nanka de iku Wakenai!
mangas.description: Kotobuki Ryou, popular AV actor with a "handsome face, good technique and perfect dick" boasts on a live online broadcast about how he "would never come from a sex toy." Because of that, he is asked to try out a sex toy company's products. Ryou is determined to give it a try, but he then meets the other company representative – Koga Takayuki – who makes Ryou come using sex toys. From then on, he's not able to forget the sensations….

mangas.title: Change World
mangas.description: Yosuke had a crush on Arimura—an upperclassman from his high school baseball team—for years before he finally confessed his feelings. And even after a year of being his boyfriend, every day still feels like a dream. But when Yosuke is hit on by a work colleague who is unknowingly Arimura's former college upperclassman, the subsequent reunion of the classmates casts a shadow over Yosuke's dream relationship.

mangas.title: Sugar & Mustard
mangas.titleNative: シュガーとマスタード
mangas.description:
Amazing training by a sadistic college student met through a Sadist & Masochist matching system. In a world where matching Sadist and Masochist has become institutionalized. Masachika (M), an office worker, was introduced to a young college student, Seiji (S). Masachika tries to take the lead during sex, but Seiji's Sadist techniques end up turning the tables on Masachika resulting in him cumming hard! Thinking that their sexual chemistry is perfect, Masachika decides to start living together with Seiji. Throughout, Masachika plans to make Seiji more fit for his taste. However, the gap between Seiji's sweetness and masculinity turns Masachika on so hard, giving him a massive heartthrob!



(Source: YaoiCat)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Born to Love You
mangas.description: One day, high school teacher Yoshitake finds a 60's era paper left in the school's old building. Written there are the names Yosuke Haruoki, writer of a short story, and Mikumo Sakagami, the short story's main character. Through an array of strange coincidences, Yoshitake and his colleague, Yahiro, begin to have the strangest hunch: that Haruoki and Sakagami were their past lives.

mangas.title: Your Love Belongs to Me
mangas.titleNative: お前の恋はおれのもの
mangas.description:
Ishio and Mochizuki are sworn enemies, forever at war. One day, Ishio accidentally walks in on Mochizuki naked. When Mochizuki catches Ishio blushing, it gives him the perfect idea for revenge! He decides to wield his sexiness as a weapon, taunting Ishio for maximum public humiliation. At first the plan works… until Ishio starts pushing back! Soon Mochizuki finds Ishio pinning and kissing HIM against the wall instead of the other way around. Maybe flirting with the enemy wasn't a good idea.



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sayonara Game
mangas.description:
Arimura enlists the help of Yosuke—a younger baseball club teammate from his high school days—to tutor his little sister. Yosuke has always been rather brusque around Arimura, but to the older man's surprise, he discovers Yosuke actually looks up to him. But could Yosuke's admiration be masking something more?



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Koi wa Kamen no Uchigawa ni
mangas.description: Zoukiya is a true hero show fan at heart. Wanting to be on the side of justice, he tries to correct those who have strayed from the path of the righteous. But somewhere along the way, the people have written him off as a gangster. But when this is all happening, he happens to meet a suited up part-time actor at a nearby amusement park, who is his ideal type of hero. So he wants to befriend this mysterious man, but...!

mangas.title: Uruwashiki Shuuen
mangas.description: Two highschool boys struggle to survive in the middle of a zombie apocalypse.

mangas.title: Sensei no Sensei
mangas.description:
On the day of the school entrance ceremony, novice teacher Ooji reunites with Yasumi, the counselor who once saved him during his student days. This reunion waters the seeds of his past love...



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Yamete Kudasai, Mabushii Desu.
mangas.titleNative: やめてください、まぶしいです。
mangas.description: Sasano grew up in an all female household and loves pretty things, including Koga, a schoolmate in another class. What happens when Sasano no longer has to stare at Koga from windows but can be beside him?

mangas.title: Koizumi-sensei wa Midasaretakunai
mangas.titleNative: 小泉先生はみだされたくない
mangas.synonyms: Koizumi-sensei Doesn't Want to Be Found Out
mangas.description: A teacher who was bullied in the past, Koizumi plays the role of a good-looking and extroverted teacher to protect himself. Because of that, he's very popular with female students. In truth, he is a gay introverted virgin. Being transferred to a school in the countryside, the unfamiliar environment and stress of lying about his true character make him want to cry every day. On top of that, his intimidating and hard-to-handle colleague, Wanibuchi, finds out who he really is. For some reason, however, Wanibuchi likes him and invites him out every free day they get. He even goes as far as giving him a lewd kiss?! A totally inexperienced Koizumi keeps being teased—?!

mangas.title: Ou-sama α to Puppy Love ♥
mangas.description: Despite being an omega, Souichirou is hardworking and quite efficient at work. He aspires to become a politician. In spite of being rather beautiful he didn't want to fall in love or get married and wants to live his single life to the fullest together with his friends. A major reason for that is him being a severe "neat freak". But fate had something different in store for him… He ends up meeting his destined partner, a handsome hunk who is a king.

mangas.title: RePlay
mangas.description:
Yuuta and Ritsu have been playing baseball together since they were children, but after being defeated in a local tournament over the summer, they must retire from the high school team to study for university entrance exams. Still, Yuuta finds himself unable to give up his lingering attachment to baseball. The one person who can truly understand him is Ritsu, who has been acting worryingly distant since they quit the team. But there's something Yuuta himself doesn't understand... Does he think of Ritsu as his partner in the way that a teammate would, or is the affection between them something stronger?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ore no Aoharu wa Watasanai
mangas.titleNative: 俺のアオハルは渡さない
mangas.description: The cool prince of the school's popular circle, Subaru, is actually a pure boy and a huge nerd for shoujo manga! Using shoujo mangas as his bible, he is constantly working towards becoming the ideal protagonist. One day, his old friend Jinnai, the only one that knows his true nature, transfers into his class! "I won't let you interfere with my plans for my ideal youth!" Yet, for some reason, his heart always pounds like the heroines of his favorite books when it comes to Jinnai!

mangas.title: Sonna Me de Mitekure
mangas.synonyms: Look at Me with Those Eyes
mangas.description:
Mikado -- a narcissistic, spoiled, school-idol type rich boy -- falls in love at first sight with an awkward, plain-looking scholarship student who's completely immune to his charms.



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Neighbor I Desire
mangas.synonyms: เมื่อเพื่อนบ้านของผมคิดไม่ซื่อ
mangas.description:
Soichiro Kominami cannot get a break from men taking advantage of his naturally giving personality. He exhausts himself in both work and "love" only to be betrayed by his lovers time and time again. One day, his nature is put to the extreme test when a random college student appears, sitting outside of the door next to Soichiro's apartment. The result? Well... he invited the mystery man into his home... but only out of the kindness of his heart nothing more than that, he swears! After learning the kind of meals the mystery man, Yuta Mori, has been eating or rather not eating, as a nutritionist, Soichiro. Can't. Leave. Him. Alone! He begins caring for Yuta's meals but is Yuta truly the pure college student he appears to be!?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Originally serialized under the title "Itsumo Tsukiyo ni Kimi to Gohan" (いつも月夜にきみとごはん).

mangas.title: Marry You? Yes, I Will!
mangas.description:
"Do you want to easily make a huge amount of money in one go? Marry me."

Yuseong ended up marrying Jinhyuk when the bride didn't show up on the day of Jinhyuk's wedding. There was too much money involved for him to say no… But somehow, they'll be living together and using only one bed now! What's in store for Yuseong?

mangas.title: 99% in Love
mangas.description: School is hard, but love is even harder—especially when you're as popular as Lee Do-Ha. Fortunately for him, his best friend Seo Jun has been by his side to ward off his worshippers since they were kids. Unfortunately for him, however, Jun has also been harboring a soul-crushing love for Do-Ha since the day they met. So when the two enter high school, Jun will do whatever it takes to keep Do-Ha safe from the swarms of admirers that hover around his every move. Under the pretense of keeping him safe from others' affection, he takes the opportunity to realize his dream of a relationship with Do-Ha—even if it comes in the form of a contract with its own set of terms and conditions. As the two dive deeper into dating, will Jun and Do-Ha add up to be a 100% match? Or is Jun destined to live in love purgatory, always giving 99% of his heart to his one true love?

mangas.title: Play After Call
mangas.titleNative: プレイアフターコール
mangas.description:
Kurashina is a high school student who has a complex about being a Dom. He thinks Isshiki, the student body president with an imposing figure, is a Dom and has a one-sided inferiority complex.



One day, Kurashina finds Isshiki collapsed on campus. Unable to overlook his unusually weakened appearance, he takes care of him. But when Isshiki confides in Kurashina the surprising fact that he is a Sub, Kurashina feels guilty for his behavior because of a misunderstanding that has led him to behave coldly.



Thinking that Isshiki had no particular partner and was feeling ill due to a lack of communication with a Dom, Kurashina then suggested having a light play with him as his way of making amends.



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Nigireba Kobushi Hirakeba Tenohira
mangas.titleNative: 握ればこぶし ひらけば掌
mangas.synonyms: If It's Clutched, It's a Fist. If It's Open, It's a Palm.

mangas.title: Worst Hot Springs Trip Ever
mangas.titleNative: 運命の番と温泉旅行だなんて
mangas.description: Shishikura and Kotani go on their first couples trip.

mangas.title: Worst Soulmate Ever
mangas.titleNative: 運命の番がお前だなんて
mangas.synonyms: I Can't Believe You're My Fated Partner!
mangas.description:
