This could be her chance to break free, but not if Prince Clarke has anything to say about it!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Royal Tailor: Clothier to the Crown
mangas.titleNative: ロイヤルテーラー ―王宮の裁縫師―
mangas.description:
Hana's lifelong dream is to become a tailor and make wonderful clothes for people of all the different fantasy races. However, in a world where humans are discriminated against, even getting work as a seamstress is a struggle. When a handsome, mysterious prince offers her a job, it seems like Hana's fortunes might finally be changing for the better!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Yakuza and His Omega: Raw Desire
mangas.titleNative: 極道とオメガ～剥き出しの渇愛。～
mangas.synonyms: The Yakuza and the Omega: Raw Desire
mangas.description:
Niikura Wakana is a struggling romance author whose latest challenge is to interview Tatara Kunimitsu, the irresistibly handsome and notoriously unattainable leader of the Koukyou Yakuza. Dubbed an alpha among alphas, Kunimitsu is an enigma wrapped in the allure of power. In her daring attempt to reach him, Wakana infiltrates a high-end club as a hostess, only to be ambushed by her first heat. As her dormant omega traits awaken, her pheromones wreak havoc, drawing unwanted attention her way. Just as peril closes in, the very man she came to see rescues her. Will Wakana be able to navigate her burning attraction to Kunimitsu while untangling the secrets of her own untamed heart?


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shindou-kun's Tight Squeeze: Helpless Against His Alluring Touch
mangas.titleNative: 進藤くんは取り扱い注意。 ～後輩が性的すぎて困ってます!?～
mangas.synonyms: Shindou-kun is a Handful: Coping with a Junior Who's Too Sexually Explicit!
mangas.description:
For three years, Omuro Rinko has dedicated herself to her dream job at Yatsuboshi Confectionery. While it hasn't all been cupcakes and mochi, she's proud of her hard-earned skills—until the day her boss assigns her to mentor the new hire, Shindou Ryoma. From the moment they meet, Shindou leaves a bitter taste in Rinko's mouth. His sharp tongue and bad attitude grate on her nerves, and worse yet, he insists he doesn't need her guidance at all. The most infuriating part? He's right. Shindou isn't just competent—he's faster, more efficient, and outshines her at work. But what begins as a clash of personalities soon simmers into something far more intoxicating. After a company dinner, Shindou makes a bold move and asks to go home with her. To Rinko's shock, the arrogant junior proves he's not just skilled in the office—he's devastatingly talented between the sheets, leaving her completely satisfied yet torn.



Now, as both her colleague and her lover, Shindou is pushing Rinko to her limits in more ways than one. If she wants to prove herself—at work and in the bedroom—she'll need to step up her game. But how can she possibly keep up with her insatiable, irresistible junior?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Double the Trouble, Twice as Nice
mangas.titleNative: おしかけ王子は2度美味しい
mangas.description: Already physically and mentally exhausted from long hours at work, bottom-tier corporate slave Yuri Hayama just got dumped by her potential husband-to-be. On top of that, while on her way home, she finds a little boy lying unconscious on the street! Unable to call for help, she takes him home for the night, but next thing she knows, she wakes up next to a hot guy?!

mangas.title: The Kingdoms of Ruin
mangas.description:
For ages, humanity flourished through the power of magic, a gift from witches to aid mankind. But times have changed. The scientific Gear Expansion has made both magic and witches obsolete. In order to liberate humanity from the blight of magic, the mighty Redia Empire began a ruthless hunt to exterminate all witches. Adonis was only a boy when the hunt began, apprentice to a witch he dearly loved. When she perishes at the hands of the empire, Adonis vows revenge. By this furious wizard's power, blood will flow!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: The Failure at God School
mangas.titleNative: 神さま学校の落ちこぼれ
mangas.description: Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for...

mangas.title: Flying Witch
mangas.description: Makoto Kowata, a novice witch, packs up her belongings (including her black cat familiar) and moves in with her distant cousins in rural Aomori Prefecture, in the far north reaches of Japan, to complete her training and become a full-fledged witch.

mangas.title: Sweet & Tart Boyfriend
mangas.description:
My obstinate boyfriend always has a sharp tongue, while all the while, he pampers me. Living with a boyfriend like him fills my life to the brim with surprise and joy. A super popular tart & sweet couple Rom-Com from Twitter & Pixiv!



(Source: MANGA UP!)

mangas.title: Waiting for Spring
mangas.description:
Mizuki is a shy girl who's about to enter high school, and vows to open herself up to new friendships. Of course, the four stars of the boys' basketball team weren't exactly the friends she had in mind! Yet, when they drop by the café where she works, the five quickly hit it off. Soon she's been accidentally thrust into the spotlight, targeted by jealous girls. And will she expand her mission to include … love?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Kanojo ga Kawaisugite Ubaenai
mangas.titleNative: 彼女が可愛すぎて奪えない
mangas.description:
A demon named Shion came to the human realm to compete in a trial that will decide the next king of the underworld. However, the task he must accomplish to prove himself worthy of the title may be too difficult for Shion...?!



Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kiyoku, Yamashiku, Modokashiku.
mangas.titleNative: きよく, やましく, もどかしく.
mangas.synonyms: 純潔, 愧疚, 急不可耐.
mangas.description:
The intimidating gyaru Enjoji is always butting heads with Fujii, the chairman of the school discipline committee, for dressing outside of school regulations. But his disciplinary actions are a bit strange!? Or even perverted!? An action-packed battle between a strict disciplinarian and a strong-willed gal!



Note: Chapter count includes seven volume-extra chapters.

mangas.title: A Kiss, For Real
mangas.synonyms: Bare Naked Kiss | Sekirara Ni Kiss
mangas.description: Chitose is a high-school girl who lives her life wearing a "mask" in order to be liked by everyone. One day, a boy named Itsuki saves her from a pervert. Unable to forget his eyes, she follows him to an art prep school!! But after Itsuki leads Chitose around the prep school, he sees through her façade … This is a sweet, but sadistic, love story between a mask-wearing girl and a free-spirited boy!

mangas.title: Kono Koi wa Fukami-kun no Plan ni wa Nai.
mangas.titleNative: この恋は深見くんのプランにはない。
mangas.synonyms: This love is assumption outside for FUKAMI kun.
mangas.description:
An unexpected love starting from an unplanned kiss. Fukami-kun is a smart, good-looking guy who's popular with the girls. But in actuality, he's a disappointingly stubborn boy who refuses to accommodate anyone else's schedule, leading him to be rejected even after being confessed to. One day, a strange girl, Higurashi Akio, is looking for her cat around the school grounds, and the two of them somehow end up kissing by accident. Unlike Fukami-kun, Akio doesn't seem to care about the accident at all. At first, Fukami-kun is irked by her attitude, but gradually comes to hold an interest in the capricious Akio. A youthful love story between a disappointing boy and a strange girl begins.



Includes 3 bonus chapters.

mangas.title: We Know Nothing About Love
mangas.titleNative: 私たちは恋を知らない
mangas.synonyms: We Don't Know a Thing About Love
mangas.description:
The cool, quiet girl and the airheaded playboy are in their first ever romance!? Welcome to a romcom about two high school students who are a bit slow to pick up on things and haven't ever had their first crush!! During the autumn of their first year of high school, Hayato Kuga is assigned to sit next to Yuki Amano. Miss Amano is basically silent at all times and never smiles. So, Mr. Kuga has to try this and that to get her attention thanks to the wall he senses coming from her. As this is ongoing, even Miss Amano, who found Mr. Kuga annoying at first, is starting to open up to him...!?



(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Chapter count includes two bonus chapters in volume 1

mangas.title: Newton no Tsubomi
mangas.description: Ogi is a sensitive boy with synesthesia; he sees sparkles of color when hearing noises or looking at people. Tachibana is a strong-willed girl whose world is gradually turning grey, afflicted with a severe form of color blindness that's slowly robbing her of her ability to see in full color. When Tachibana saves Ogi from what she thinks is a suicide attempt, two worlds - one bereft of color and one overflowing with it - collide.

mangas.title: Risouteki Boyfriend
mangas.titleNative: 理想的ボーイフレンド
mangas.description:
"You're far from my ideal type and we hardly have any common features. From now on too, we won't get involved with each other that much."



That was what I thought, about what kind of person you were.

mangas.title: Machida-kun no Sekai
mangas.description:
Machida-kun seems like the perfect brother, son, and student because he loves people. Helpful when he needs to be, but puts himself down when he feels like a total failure. However, the people that surround his daily life are there as a reminder as why Machida-kun needs no improvements because the people love Machida.


Notes:

- Winner of the New Creator Prize of the 20th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

- Included one-shot: Kimi wa Ai

mangas.title: I Love You Baby
mangas.description:
You are the "first" of everything for me who is afraid of guys.


A 7th grade girl by the name of Mirei is not allowed to do anything after school due to her strict parents, but one day she goes out on her own after her mom has left for work. That day, she meets a boy that seems to be younger than her. What will become of this meeting.

mangas.title: Koisuru Harinezumi
mangas.description: At school, Hozuki is well known to be the unsociable sort, never fitting in with others, and all too happy to dish out a beating to anyone who tries to get close to him. But Kii thought that he seemed to behave just like a hedgehog with its guard up, and became the latest to try and get close to him.

mangas.title: Suki x Suki
mangas.description: Touka Aizuki is girl who can turn invisible and no one can see her except for one person, Ryoutarou Mimori. Even though she is physically invisible, her love is completely visible!

mangas.title: Kanna to Decchi
mangas.description: Our heroine, Kanna, is the daughter of the famous builder in town. One day a boy with a hammer appears to train under Kanna's father?! The heart pounding love story of a handsome apprentice carpenter

mangas.title: A Business Proposal
mangas.description: After being worked to the bone at her office job, getting introduced to her longtime crush's new girlfriend, and dealing with her family's debt hanging over her head, Hari Shin's life seems to have hit rock bottom. Luckily, her friend Youngseo has a business proposal for her: go to an arranged date in her stead and Hari will receive a hefty compensation. Things grow complicated, however, when it turns out that the other party is Hari's new CEO—and he's dead-set on marrying whoever shows up to the date!

mangas.title: 365 Days to the Wedding
mangas.titleNative: 結婚するって、本当ですか 365 Days To The Wedding
mangas.description: Takuya and Rika are coworkers in a travel agency in Tokyo. They're both single, but they don't mind, since they're introverts with fulfilling lives at home. Unfortunately, now their job is looking to staff an office in Siberia, and non-married employees are the first to be considered. Rika is desperate to avoid the transfer and goes to Takuya with an idea: if they pretend they're getting married in a year, they can stay in Tokyo. The only problem is the two of them barely know each other! If these two quiet coworkers "fake" a relationship, will it turn into something real?

mangas.title: See You in My 19th Life
mangas.synonyms: Please Take Care of Me in This Life as Well
mangas.description:
Ji-Eum Ban has a secret—she can remember the memories of her previous lives...all 18 of them! This means she retains past knowledge, skills, and most importantly, the bonds with the people she cares about. Guided by the bittersweet memories of her last life, Ji-Eum sets out to rekindle the love that was cut short by her tragic death. But little did she know her biggest rival would be her own past self...



(Source: Yen Press, edited)



Note: Include eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Still Sick
mangas.description:
Makoto Shimizu is just an ordinary office worker, blending in seamlessly with her colleagues on the job... That is, until her coworker Akane Maekawa discovers her well-hidden secret: in her spare time, she draws and sells girls' love comics!



Akane is the last person Makoto would think of as a nerd, but as the two grow closer, it starts to seem like Akane may have a secret of her own...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes 3 bonus chapters.

mangas.title: I Have a Crush at Work
mangas.titleNative: この会社に好きな人がいます
mangas.description:
Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi aren't just any coworkers-they totally have the hots for each other. His helpful yet humble attitude makes her giddy, and her cuteness leaves him grinning like a fool. Problem is, they're trying to keep their new relationship under wraps to avoid making things awkward at work. But seeing how they can't keep their hands off each other, they run the risk of spilling their little secret with each passing day at the office.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Doughnuts Under a Crescent Moon
mangas.titleNative: 欠けた月とドーナッツ
mangas.synonyms: Crescent Moon and Doughnuts | Kaketa Tsuki to Doughnut
mangas.description: Uno Hinako throws herself into makeup, fashion, and falling in love, hoping that will make her seem "normal" to the other people at her job. But no matter how hard she tries, she's a self-doubting mess inside, and her attempts at "normal" romance with men just keep failing. When she starts to think she might be alone forever, a new normal presents itself–in the form of her relationship with Sato Asahi, a level-headed woman who works at her company, which starts as respect until it becomes far more intimate.

mangas.title: My Senpai is Annoying
mangas.titleNative: 先輩がうざい後輩の話
mangas.description:
Igarashi is a hardworking young office lady. Takeda, the senpai above her at work, annoys her constantly–and yet she finds herself growing closer to him. Every day is filled with comic mishaps and romantic moments as Igarashi tries to balance work, life, and love.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Notes:


- Comic POOL chapters are included in this entry, as they are included in the print release alongside the original serialization.

- Originally published on Twitter and collated by Ichijinsha for print release.

- Later serialized in Ichijinsha's Comic POOL.

- Contains 56 Bonus Chapters

mangas.title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku
mangas.description:
Narumi Momose has had it rough: every boyfriend she's had dumped her once they found out she was an otaku, so she's gone to great lengths to hide it. When a chance meeting at her new job with childhood friend, fellow otaku, and now coworker Hirotaka Nifuji almost gets her secret outed at work, she comes up with a plan to make sure he never speaks up. But he comes up with a counter-proposal: why doesn't she just date him instead? In love, there are no save points.



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes:

- Includes 29 extra chapters.

- The English edition combines 2 Japanese volumes into one each (so e.g. the first two Japanese volumes are combined into 1 English volume).

mangas.title: The Makeup Remover
mangas.synonyms: The Man Who Cleans Up Makeup
mangas.description:
After years of being told to focus on studying, Yeseul feels lost when she starts college and is suddenly expected to pay attention to makeup. When a chance encounter with brilliant makeup artist Yuseong leads to her taking part in a televised makeup competition, Yeseul begins to question the role that makeup and appearance play in society.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: My Cute Beast!
mangas.synonyms: シベリアウサギと花屋の野獣
mangas.description:
As the saying goes - never judge a book by its cover.



Da-Im is a lovely elementary school teacher, as well as a savage who can rip anyone apart with the fiercest comebacks. On-Gyum is a florist with a heart of gold, who often gets misunderstood because of his intimidating looks. But as incompatible as they seem, their shared love of cats starts pulling the unlikely pair closer together... Here comes an upbeat romantic comedy between a sassy bunny and a sweet beast!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: It Takes Two Tomorrow, Too
mangas.titleNative: ふたり明日もそれなりに
mangas.synonyms: The Two Gets by Tomorrow Too, More or Less.
mangas.description:
Yuya Aida (25) and Rio Aihara (28) are in their second month of living together. More than lovers but less than married, they're still more or less content.



(Source: One Peace Books)



Notes:

- Includes five extra chapters.

- Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

mangas.title: A Good Day to be a Dog
mangas.description: Ha-Na (Hae Na) has made every effort to avoid an inevitable family curse... of turning into a dog after her first kiss. Worst of all, the only way for her to break the curse is to get a second kiss. How will that work when Ha-Na's first kiss is with a guy who is deathly afraid of dogs?!

mangas.title: Secret Crush
mangas.description:
What's the probability of someone you have a crush on having a crush on you? What'll happen to these two secret lovers? Will they ever find out that they are, in fact, in love with each other?



(Source: Lezhin)



Note: 92 Chapters + Epilogue + 22 Extras

mangas.title: Day by Day
mangas.description: A childhood friendship ruined by a confession?!

mangas.title: Relationship Guidelines
mangas.description:
"Ugh! Life's been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It's all her fault, and now she's ignoring me! I can't stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Ji-Won, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she's left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship.


(Source: Tapas, edited)

mangas.title: Something About Us
mangas.description: They consider themselves the best of friends. Others seem to think otherwise. There's something about their relationship that's hard to describe. What will become of these two "friends"?

mangas.title: Super Secret
mangas.description: The boy next door, friends for life, is actually a werewolf!

mangas.title: Insomniacs After School
mangas.titleNative: 君は放課後インソムニア
mangas.description:
Unable to sleep at night, Ganta Nakami is cranky in class and unpopular with his classmates. He discovers that the school observatory, once used by the now-defunct astronomy club, may be the perfect place for a nap—but he's not alone. Fellow insomniac Isaki Magari is willing to share the observatory with Nakami, and a friendship between the two begins as they bond over the most unlikely of things.



(Source: VIZ Media)



Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

mangas.title: Inochi no Tabekata
mangas.description:
Otogiri Tobi, a 2nd grade middle school student, spends his depressing days searching for his missing older brother alongside his inhuman companion, Baku. Tobi used to rarely speak to anyone besides Baku, however one day after his classmate Shiratama Ryuuko suddenly approaches him, his life begins to change...? This is an adventure surrounding the "human" and the "inhuman" that a lone boy faces.


(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Meshinuma.
mangas.description: The culinary daily of an office worker named Iinuma.

mangas.title: Pupposites Attract
mangas.synonyms: Encounter Between Polar Opposites and Their Dogs | Seihantai na Watashi-tachi
mangas.description: Chiharu Kagura is content spending her days with her sweetie of a Rottweiler that probably weighs about as much as she does. Meanwhile, Kiyotaka Tsujii can't get enough of his fluffy Pomeranian that barely comes up to his knees. When these two mismatched pairs chance upon each other at the park, could it be the start of an unlikely friendship—or maybe something more?

mangas.title: Kondo wa Korosaretakunai Azarashi-san
mangas.titleNative: 今度は殺されたくないアザラシさん
mangas.synonyms: Ms. Seal: I don't wanna be killed anymore
mangas.description:
For some reason, Mahiru is able to see people's past life. In her own past life, she was a seal born in the Arctic, in which she ended up savagely eaten by a polar bear. The occasional nightmares about her past life still trouble her until this day.

Then one day, the said polar bear from her past life suddenly appeared before her in the form of a handsome man!

mangas.title: Gazing at the Star Next Door
mangas.synonyms: Stella Next to Me, Tonari no Stella
mangas.description: What do you do when your best friend (and secret crush) becomes a national sweetheart? This is the story of the unrequited love between a girl and her best friend, whose acting career is pulling him further and further away.

mangas.title: Koi wo Suru Hi no Lingerie
mangas.titleNative: 恋をする日のランジェリー
mangas.synonyms: Lingerie for a Day of Love
mangas.description:
The manga centers on Nazumi, a girl whose recent job has just closed shop, and is now between jobs. After her friend gets her a job at a lingerie store, some customers make fun of her chubbiness, but she is pulled out of the situation by Reo, a former middle school classmate of hers who was once a delinquent.



(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: Hug Kiss Hug
mangas.description: Youko Kihara makes the resolution to say goodbye to her longtime affair partner after seeing her friend's marriage. Later on she gets ambushed by him in front of her house, and is saved by Fujiwara, a resident of the same apartment. Fujiwara snuggles up to Youko, who is filled with anxiety, until she falls asleep...? He says he will sleep with her when she is unable to sleep in the future.

mangas.title: Saving Sweets for After-Hours
mangas.titleNative: スイーツは定時のあとで
mangas.description:
Reika has it all – she's a model-tall cool beauty with a high-powered job at her sweets company. But it's precisely because of all that that she's never had a boyfriend…men find her too unapproachable, or beg her to be their mistress, in the S&M sort of way. But when she meets a young coworker, Hasegawa-kun, she happens to find out that they have more in common than just their job, including secrets…



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes a bonus one-shot "Hoshifuruyoru ni Escape" (星降る夜にエスケープ)

mangas.title: I Only Want to Beat You
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Beat You, Oh Roji | I Want to Defeat You, Oh Roji
mangas.description: The male lead, Gi-Go Lee, who has never lost a single time in his life, and the female lead, Ro-Ji O, who defeated him. Who will end up as the victor of this 'bet'?

mangas.title: Majime ni Fujun Isei Kouyuu
mangas.titleNative: まじめに不純異性交遊
mangas.description:
Minami is raised in a strict household, taught to be serious and sincere and prohibited from sexual relationships. Minami has been dating her senpai at work for three months, but their relationship is purely chaste where they haven't even kissed yet. But Minami has a secret that she can't tell to her calm and mature boyfriend… That is, she reads ecchi manga at home and has sexy dreams about them together, in other words she's "a pervert who's acting like a good girl"...!



And then, she accidentally drops one of her ero-manga at work...!?

mangas.title: Hajimete no Kiss
mangas.description:
Behind the school, at the pool and at the staircase outside... In all these corners, someone is falling in love for the first time. Ena, who is always eating by herself, now has to save Tatsumi-senpai from his fans by having secret lunches with him?!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Gap Papa: Daddy at Work and at Home
mangas.titleNative: 職場と自宅でギャップのあるパパ
mangas.synonyms: Shokuba to Jitaku de Gap no Aru Papa
mangas.description: His colleagues at work see him as handsome, cool, and distant…but the moment he's back home, this frosty-looking salaryman shows his true colors as a doting father and husband. Playing silly games with his young daughter, showering kisses on his beloved wife–what a gap between his appearance and behavior!

mangas.title: Our Aimless Nights
mangas.description:
Cheerful, energetic high school girl Chika and shy, reserved boy Waya couldn't be more different. But they have a secret: every Wednesday after 9PM they meet outside the convenience store where Waya works. Bit by bit, under the light of the moon, a unique connection begins to blossom in this enchanting coming-of-age love story!



(Source: Azuki)

mangas.title: Wake Wakanai Kimi ga Suki
mangas.titleNative: わけわかないキミが好き
mangas.description: A young girl falls in love with an otaku.

mangas.title: Okaeri, Hatsukoi.
mangas.description:
At a high school reunion, the shy Yamane reunites with Taguchi, a friend who used to be a delinquent. Have they changed? Or are they the same as ever?



Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization by Pixiv Sylph starting 2022-07-28.

mangas.title: Lucky-La-Kiss
mangas.description:
Luck that gets replaced with a kiss? Mirika Tamao has been super lucky from the moment she was born. And when she kissed the 'Not-so-lucky' handsome Ichinose, her luck got replaced?! A destined love that starts with a kiss.



(Source: Ikemen Guys)



Included one-shot:

Volume 2: Renai Hensachi 35

mangas.title: Pure White Out
mangas.titleNative: ピュアホワイトアウト
mangas.description: Kiyosumi has never had trouble meeting women, so he's in no hurry to find a steady girlfriend. One day, he got roped into a mixer party by a work colleague, and there he met Mashiro. They left the party together and he was planning on a one-night stand then say goodbye to her in the morning like usual. But he got surprised when she took the initiative and told him about their past history together—!? Who will have the advantage in a revenge-love story between a playboy ex-boyfriend and an ex-girlfriend who won't give up so easily this time!

mangas.title: Nemu Youko to Zatsu na Kusatachi
mangas.titleNative: ねむようこと雑な草たち
mangas.description: A story about gardening.

mangas.title: Shiawasena Koi, Atsumemashita.
mangas.synonyms: We have gathered happy love stories.
mangas.description:
Various couples in situations that are, to put it mildly, too precious! We present to you stories of tender and happy love that will surely purify your soul.



(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

mangas.title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
mangas.titleNative: 妖怪学校の先生はじめました!
mangas.synonyms: I Started Being a Teacher for a Youkai School! | Youkai Gakkou No Sensei Hajimemashita!
mangas.description: Rookie teacher Haruaki Abe is as cowardly as they come. It's hard enough for him to handle human students without whimpering-and now he's going to be teaching at a school full of monsters?! It's a classroom of horrors for Haruaki, as his mischievous students use every means at their disposal to prank him! Will this poor teacher be able to get his group of ghouls under control, or is this class destined for failure?

mangas.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate
mangas.titleNative: となりの猫と恋知らず
mangas.synonyms: The Feline Neighbor and the Unversed-in-Love
mangas.description:
Minato Seno's high school life had just begun when his homeroom teacher requested his help with Nekozane, the cat-like chronic napper who sits next to him in class. Timid and socially anxious, Minato has never talked to her or even seen her face. But when he finally musters up the courage to wake Nekozane, she unexpectedly hugs him on the spot! Thus begins a sweet tale of two teens awkwardly stumbling into a new friendship, unaware that their feelings are slowly turning into something more!



(Source: Manga UP!)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication with two volumes collecting the Twitter comics releasing on 2024-03-25 and 2024-04-25, with subsequent serialization in Big Gangan starting 2024-04-25.

mangas.title: The Fox Club
mangas.description:
Meet Sangmok High's Fox Club, home to the prettiest, wealthiest, and most popular girls in school. To ordinary Onyu Park, whose most extraordinary trait is being best friends with the gorgeous Chaeri Shin, the Foxes exist in a whole other world – or so she thinks – until she and Chaeri are suddenly thrown into the Fox Club headfirst! As if adjusting to high school wasn't hard enough, the girls find themselves surrounded by prying eyes, rumors, catty schemes, and budding romance. Will Onyu and Chaeri's friendship survive all of the drama and secrets? Who are the Foxes, really? And does Onyu have what it takes to become one of them?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Hajimete no Samejima-kun
mangas.description: Inori was attracted to Sameshima-kun, a mysterious delinquent who hardly shows up at class. It turns out he's trying hard to become an artist. So despite her friend's objections, Inori offers to model for his paintings to get closer to Sameshima. A love comedy about helping a boy to chase his dream!

mangas.title: Your Smile is a Trap
mangas.description: Ex-idol trainee Gi-Yu has lived his whole life adored by everyone for his good looks. But he dreams of ordinary high school life, so when he puts on glasses to blend in with his peers, he finds that making friends is a lot harder when you don't have your looks to fall back on. Not to mention he's also socially awkward, his new seatmate has a permanent scowl on her face, and his fans have tracked him down at his new school.

mangas.title: How to Grill Our Love
mangas.synonyms: A Rare Marriage: How to Grill Our Love
mangas.description:
Dating can be tough when you nerd out over barbecue. Kenta, a practical pitmaster, looks for a grill-friend in Chihiro, an aloof and faultless business babe…or is she? Scared of being rejected for who they really are, the two of them find comfort in food and each other…and all is well until Kenta must transfer away. With their developing relationship at steak, Chihiro proposes they tie the knot and they marry for better or wurst. Winging a long-distance marriage is one thing, but here's the rub—they barely know each other! It's a rare marriage where all the awkwardness of dating meets a sizzling passion for grilling!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Look Back
mangas.description:
Fujino is a fourth grader who draws a manga strip for the school newspaper. Her art makes her the star of the class, but one day she's told that Kyomoto, a student who refuses to come to school, would also like to submit a manga for the paper...



(Source: MANGA Plus)


Note: The one-shot was compiled in a special volume, released on September 3, 2021.

mangas.title: Parasol Doumei
mangas.description: A boy who is a twin lags behind his overachieving brother in both academics and popularity. He proposes to the girl he likes, herself a twin, but had confused her for her twin sister. Embarrassed and in a compromising position, he agrees to help her to win the affections of the boy she likes, his brother, lest she leaks his botched confession to her sister, hampering his chances with his crush.

mangas.title: Ghost Sweeper Arai-kun
mangas.description: Arai, being a college dropout, could not find a proper job, so he ended up working as a driver and assistant for a high school Ghost Sweeper, Haraizawa. Little did he know, his next job would be coming from the hospital where his old friend is working at.... A supernatural action oneshot where horror and stagnation of life intersect.

mangas.title: Damdam!!
mangas.description: Villagers are disappearing in the mountains of M prefecture. "Something is slicing people apart" was the final message a desperate police officer managed to yell through the radio before disappearing. Specialized in hunting monsters, two highschool girls begin their hunt!

mangas.title: LAWLESS KID
mangas.description: When you're at the limit of your craving, what can you really grasp within your hands...?

mangas.title: Tengoku no Hakoniwa
mangas.description:
A world where humankind was almost destroyed by the nuclear war. Lily, a girl who hides under a cliff, and Selene, an android who serves her. Selene is the only support and love for Lily, who carries the faint hope of living on earth again someday.



(Source: Hero's Inc., translated)

mangas.title: Toki Doki
mangas.description: A heart can only beat so many times in a lifetime. Kokuhaku disease, a rare condition that weakens the heart, leaves the victim with less heartbeats and a shorter lifespan than normal. With the right device, the amount of heartbeats remaining can be measured. When Hato Iijima accidentally walks in on Hatsu Takagi changing her clothes, he sees this device attached to her chest. Hatsu has resigned herself to an uneventful and isolated life to avoid elevating her heart rate. However, she expresses her true desire—to freely and wholeheartedly experience every second she has left. Recognizing her wish, Hato swears to help her enjoy life to the fullest and make her heart beat like crazy.

mangas.title: Liv
mangas.description: The story takes place in a world with humanity on the verge of extinction due to the rise of zombies. A young man named Aoki travels through this ruined world and meets a mysterious zombie girl who does not try to eat him and, further, says his name?

mangas.title: Haru no Minuet
mangas.description: Nao wants to get closer to her deaf classmate, Tobe-san.

mangas.title: Houkago Strongberry
mangas.titleNative: 放課後ストロングベリー
mangas.description: A modern Japanese teacher who finds herself in a gym and discovers her hidden potential in boxing.

mangas.title: Koori no Kimi wo Tokasu made
mangas.titleNative: 氷のキミを溶かすまで
mangas.description: Otaka Touya and Kandachi Rei have been figure skating partners since they were kids and their goal is the top. There is only one rule between them: they are forbidden from having a romantic relationship. Many successful pairs have met failure because they let intimate feelings get in the way of their performances. They swear they feel nothing for each other but how they behave on the ice says otherwise.

mangas.title: Majo ga Koisuru 5-byoumae
mangas.synonyms: 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love
mangas.description: The curse that can be loosened if kissed and the curse that cannot be resolved is just the kiss.

mangas.title: Nante Nasakenai Bokurada.
mangas.titleNative: なんて情けない僕らだ。
mangas.description: A new idol on the rise, Souda Natsumi and her friend from highschool Iiyama Yukiya meet again at a music store. What lies at the end of this unwanted encounter?!

mangas.title: #Tonari no Koitsu
mangas.description: "This person who's always by my side, might be the one I like...!?" Kuroda Kazu 16 years old, Shirakawa Jun 15 years old. Because you're always next to me, I couldn't realize I like you. More than friends, less than lovers. The close distanced love comedy between childhood friends!

mangas.title: Kataude no Amy
mangas.description: Amy is an ordinary girl who lives with her beloved father. However, she is not human, but a doll made up of cloth and cotton. Why was she created, and what does her future hold?

mangas.title: Re-Living My Life with a Boyfriend Who Doesn't Remember Me
mangas.titleNative: 死に戻りの魔法学校生活を、元恋人とプロローグから（※ただし好感度はゼロ）
mangas.description:
Oriana, a seventeen-year-old magic student, suddenly dies alongside her boyfriend, Vincent. However, she returns from death in the body of her seven-year-old self with the memories of her past life intact–except for the knowledge of what killed her. She fantasizes for years about reuniting with her beloved, but when they finally meet, Vincent doesn't remember her! Can she make Vincent fall in love with her again and avoid the death that started this mysterious time loop?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Got 6th place in the 18th Manga Taisho Awards (2025).

mangas.title: Houfuku Kanojo to Koukatsu Kareshi
mangas.titleNative: ホーフクカノジョと狡猾カレシ
mangas.description: Ako is a normal student that suddenly remembers that in her past life was a demon... and the angel who murdered her also was reincarnated in her present boyfriend, Yoshi. With their new memories, Ako decides to retaliate of his mortal enemy, but for his misfortune, she still feels enough attracted by her boyfriend. she get it?

mangas.title: I Fell into a Situationship with the Vampire Count?!
mangas.titleNative: 元婚約者から逃げるため吸血伯爵に恋人のフリをお願いしたら、なぜか溺愛モードになりました
mangas.description:
"I would like you to become my lover." Daughter of a viscount, Freya Villiers was being pressured into taking back her ex-fiance, Nathan, after their engagement was broken off due to him cheating on Freya with her sister. In order to flee her parents, who are all for her reconciliation with Nathan, she visits Count Bloodbury, feared by the nobles as a "vampire." With nothing to lose, she asks him to pretend to be her lover and…?!



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: Refund High School
mangas.description:
Do you want a refund on your life? Start earning karma at The Refund High School to reincarnate as an ideal version of yourself.


(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: My Happy Marriage
mangas.description:
Born to a noble family, Miyo is married off to Kiyoka, a soldier so heartless his prior fiancées fled. With nowhere to go, Miyo slowly starts to open her heart to her cold husband-to-be... Could this be love?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: My Goddess is Precious Today, Too
mangas.titleNative: 私の女神が今日も推せる ～これからも、いつまでも～
mangas.description:
They start off as friends, total opposites who watch each other from afar, or maybe they're locked in a fierce competition. Either way, they can't stop thinking about one another. These fluttery feelings can only mean one thing: first love! Swoon over these budding teenage romances that celebrate girls loving girls.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for serialization starting in comicGaga Vol. 1 on 2022-03-05, republishing the doujin content.

mangas.title: My Father is a Unicorn
mangas.description:
Learning to live with a step-dad can be tough–especially if your new dad is a unicorn!



Issei Uno is still in high school when his mother remarries. His mom's new husband, Masaru, is a nice enough guy, he just happens to be a unicorn. Sometimes in the form of a talking horse, sometimes in the form of a beautiful man, Masaru is determined to run the household while his wife is away and win Issei over. For better or worse, now Issei is stuck teaching this unicorn man how to be a good dad in this idiosyncratic comedy about the magic of family.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Cats and Sugar Bowls
mangas.description:
Collection of stores by Yukiko with the tagline "not your average girls' love".


1. Neko ni Hanare Hito (猫に離人, Cat the Detached Observer)

2. Neko to Saezuri (猫と囀り, Cat and Whisper)

3. Neko ni Denwa (猫に電話, Call the Cat)

4. Sugar Pot wa Kowarenai (シュガーポットは壊れない, Sugar Pot Won't Break)

5. Tsurutsuru (つるつる, Silky)

6. Watashi no Osanajimi Wa... (私の幼なじみは…。, My Childhood Friend is...)

7. Gozen 1-ji no Koirandouri (午前１時のコインランドリー, Coin Laundry at 1:00 AM)

8. Choucho no Himatsubushi (蝶々の暇つぶし, A Butterfly's Spare Time)

9. Oni to Sanjin (鬼と山神, Demon and Mountain God)

mangas.title: KISS IN THE HELL: Taimashi to Haja no Chigiri
mangas.titleNative: KISS IN THE HELL ～退魔師と破邪の契り～
mangas.description:
Mai Shindou, who works at the Tamamori General Store, is a helpful person with an important mission. Her real job is an exorcist, secretly protecting the town from demons and evil spirits. She and her partner, Sora Tamamori, who possesses strong spiritual powers, team up to investigate a haunted property. But when an evil spirit attacks, the two found themselves in big trouble!



"I don't want to hurt you."



They were supposed to be fighting evil spirits. Instead, she was pinned down by Sora as he gazed at her passionately, while bewildering sensations of pleasure courses through her body… The responsible Mai Shindou and the kind-hearted Sora Tamamori must put their bodies (sexually) on the line to protect the peace of their neighborhood!



(Source: ChocoLove Comics, translated)

mangas.title: My Boss Is a Giant: He Manages My Every Need With Enormous Skill
mangas.titleNative: コワモテ上司のXLサイズが入りません！～ちっぱいハムちゃんと絶倫サメくんの開発事情～
mangas.synonyms: The Scary Boss's Extra Large Size Won't Fit!
mangas.description:
Natsumi, also known as "Ham-chan," hustles at a demanding office job like a hamster running in a wheel. Meanwhile, her boss Samejima is more like a shark. He's handsome, sure, but he's also imposing and scary... at least, until he confesses his feelings for her?! Natsumi is a little overwhelmed at seeing a vulnerable side to this gigantic man, especially since she doesn't have a lot of experience in the love department, but she's secretly thrilled to see more. Together, this big boss with a carnivorous appetite and the smaller woman who's hungry for his love are ready to unleash their wild sides!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Home Sweet Home
mangas.titleNative: 柊先輩とおふたりさま
mangas.description:
Tired of having to change schools because of her dad's job, Moemi, a first-year high school student, is allowed to stay behind at her parents' home on the condition that she lives with the daughter of her dad's boss. This girl, however, ends up being…a boy! And not just any boy, but one of the most handsome and popular boys at school! Moemi's formerly humdrum life becomes anything but as she traverses the excitement of living with a hot upperclassman!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Auto Focus Pink
mangas.titleNative: オートフォーカスピンク
mangas.description: In the summer of her second year of high school, Hinoko meets Yoichi, a childhood friend of her best friend Nijika. Hinoko is attracted to Yoichi, but her heart is bitterly broken… when he continues to be single-mindedly devoted to Nijika even though she is unaware of his feelings.

mangas.title: Yell Girl!
mangas.description:
Yuyu, a first-year high school student, is completely mesmerized by the ouendan cheer squad and decides to join.
She finds herself in the same group as her classmate, but for some reason, he's always so moody!?

mangas.title: The Lady Likes a Nerd over Princes
mangas.titleNative: ガリ勉地味萌え令嬢は、俺様王子などお呼びでない
mangas.synonyms: The Noble Girl With a Crush on a Plain and Studious Guy Finds the Arrogant Prince to Be a Nuisance
mangas.description:
Cheerful and free-spirited Sharina first met the studious and somber Riol when he saved her from mortal danger, and she fell in love with him at first sight. Using the adage, "the way to a man's heart is through his stomach," Sharina makes Riol homemade food in hopes it will get him to fall in love with her too. But instead, the delicious aroma catches the interest of the first prince of their country, Leonardo! Fascinated by how she's unlike any other girl he's met before, the prince claims Sharina as his own. Ever the arrogant narcissist, Leonardo can't fathom how anyone could turn him down and his persistence crosses into the realm of harassment. Riol rescues Sharina, but at the cost of incurring the prince's wrath! Can Sharina and Riol figure out a way to get the pompous prince to leave them alone?!



(Source: MANGA UP!)

mangas.title: Kyou no Ashura Meshi
mangas.description:
Omori Sizuka is a high school girl who loves to eat and but gets bullied for her weight. One day, she discovered that Akira Kurose, aka "Ashura-kun," the toughest delinquent at school, secretly enjoyed cooking. The next day at lunchtime, Akira summoned Sizuka to the rooftop and asked her to eat his homemade bento, in exchange for keeping her mouth shut.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Yoru ni Kikasete
mangas.description:
One month after starting high school, Maya Yashiro becomes friends with her classmate Harutaka Ichijima by chance. Harutaka seems to like Maya, but when another friend confesses to him first, he readily accepts, even though they weren't that close.......



(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Haru to Koi to Kimi no Koto
mangas.description: Mishima Hiroka is a girl who has a trauma in regards to anything related to love. Drawn by the rule that forbids dating within the dormitory, she enters that school thinking she'd be able to spend her high school days peacefully... only to discover it was a rule that was loosely imposed. And there she meets Sata Airi, a slightly eccentric but handsome boy.

mangas.title: Kanojo ni Naru Hi
mangas.synonyms: The Day He Becomes a Woman
mangas.description: Miyoshi was always competing and losing against his childhood friend, Mamiya, who was good at everything. One day, Mamiya collapsed from illness and was hospitalized for several weeks. When he returned to school, it turned out he was genetically female, and now he has decided to try living his life as a girl, much to Miyoshi's horror.

mangas.title: A Springtime with Ninjas
mangas.description: Benio is the heiress of the richest family in Japan, and tradition holds that she must marry the first person to kiss her. So that she can attend high school, Benio is assigned the ninja Tamaki as a bodyguard, but he turns out to be quite the player. It's not always easy for a strong-willed rich girl and a smart-alecky ninja to get along in this romantic comedy about a pure young lady and her smoking-hot knight.

mangas.title: Deatta Toki Kara, Koideshita.
mangas.titleNative: 出会った時から、恋でした。
mangas.description: When she saw a junior boy playing in a band on stage at the school festival... On a graduation trip with the fellow club member whom she had always had a crush on... An older co-worker suddenly confesses love to her... Her brother's friend who saw her picture and fell in love at first sight… The feeling that hits for a moment but lasts forever. This is a series of short stories with 200% pure love, a love that begins on first sight before you can blink!

mangas.title: Sabishisugiru Onna Shachou ga Lesbian Fuuzokujou ni Byou de Ochiru Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: 寂しすぎる女社長がレズビアン風俗嬢に秒で落ちる話
mangas.synonyms: A Story about a Very Lonely Female CEO who Falls for a Lesbian Prostitute in Seconds
mangas.description:
Money, status, fame.

She had it all, but it didn't help her loneliness.

How can she find fulfillment......?



So the lady CEO decided to call on......

"A lesbian prostitute"!?

And as soon as they met, she fell in love......?



(Source: ComicWalker, translated)



Note: Originally published online in 15 chapters, the collected volume consolidated them into four chapters, plus one bonus epilogue chapter.

mangas.title: Can I Kiss You Every Day?
mangas.titleNative: 毎日キスしていいですか？
mangas.synonyms: Mainichi Kiss Shite Ii Desu Ka?
mangas.description: Kurumi lives under one roof with her father and her overprotective brother, Ataka. One day, she reunites with Nagio, her childhood friend. Now a young man, Nagio doesn't hesitate making advances—much to Kurumi's dismay—kissing her out of nowhere and telling her how he has always liked her, in the process totally wrapping her around his finger. And while Kurumi is put off at first, she eventually finds herself head-over-heels for Nagio … This childhood-friend romance starring a black-hearted-yet-loving (?) boy is filled with sweet and passionate kisses!

mangas.title: Jewelry: Hane to Kotori no Subarashiki Hibi
mangas.titleNative: Jewelry－はねと小鳥の素晴らしき日々－
mangas.description: Hane is finally starting high school after being in and out of hospitals throughout most of her childhood. On her first day, she musters up the courage to greet one of her classmates, Kotori, only to witness him fist-fight upperclassmen. Seeing the fight, Hane faints and is readmitted to the hospital, and while she's recovering, Kotori surprisingly comes to visit her. Could this delinquent be more than meets the eye? "A sparkling new love story"!

mangas.title: Satou-kun ga Shinde kara
mangas.titleNative: 佐藤くんが死んでから
mangas.description: That boy is… a walking corpse! Sato-kun, who met an early demise in a traffic accident, came back to school as a zombie. That popular guy who'd light up the room, is now silent and expressionless and barely manages to trace the habits of his old life. Hozumi, a girl in his class, is worried for him. Experience this mysterious and youthful romance between a reticent zombie and a shy girl!

mangas.title: Let's Kiss in Secret Tomorrow
mangas.titleNative: 明日、ナイショのキスしよう
mangas.synonyms: Let's make a secret kiss tomorrow
mangas.description:
Popular Saya and shy-guy Yûto started dating in middle school after they discovered their shared love of a popular online game. But when Yûto's high-school debut is too successful and he becomes the hottest guy in school, Saya panics and pretends they aren't going out, so as not to be harassed by his conniving hangers-on. But can their relationship last through the secrets and the beauties?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: The Whole of Humanity Has Gone Yuri Except for Me
mangas.synonyms: All of Humanity is Yuri Except For Me
mangas.description:
Marika Uruuno is just a normal girl in a normal world. She'll fall in love normally, get married normally, and have a normal family- or that was the plan anyway. But when she suddenly wakes up in a version of reality filled only with women, she finds herself questioning what exactly "normal" means and why it's so important to her. And as Mariko discovers something even more precious, she's faced with a choice-will she find a way back to her previous life…or will she stay in this strange new world?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Yamase wa doko e Itta?
mangas.synonyms: Falling love with a double-A side boy!
mangas.description:
Yamase, the mischievous joker of the class, suddenly confessed love to Kidou Aina in front of everyone. When she refused, Yamase reeled in shock and fell down the stairs! When Aina visited him in the hospital out of sympathy, what does she see there…?



(Source: Margaret Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Haru to Arashi
mangas.description:
A "tsundere love story" where a sadistic but handsome boy falls in love.



(Source: Anime News Network)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Salon Diana
mangas.description:
"Girls who like to lie, come to my salon."



Arisue Rio firmly believes in the principle that "the outside is the most important." When she says that to male nail technician Irima Yoshitsuki, he puts a specially made, cursed gem on her nails and told her: "If you kiss a boy you don't like, then time will rewind."



Rio didn't believe it; but after being confessed to by a super cute kouhai, they started dating and even kissed! After they kissed, time rewinded to the day before?

mangas.title: Saihate no Polaris
mangas.description: Even if she says it's for my sake, my mother's words and hugs hurt me... but, in the middle of the night, I found a light. Takaoka-kun, with red dyed hair. Can I be stronger by your side? I want to be a different person in high school.

mangas.title: Seishun Note
mangas.description: Due to changing schools constantly, Hime has been unable to make any friends. Now, at a brand new school, Hime sets out to celebrate her youth and live a dream high school life.

mangas.title: Charai Hayama ni Kyun to Kita
mangas.titleNative: チャラい羽山にきゅんときた
mangas.description: Asahina, a member of the library committee is made to supervise her kouhai, Hayama, who is on probation for hooking up with a fellow student. As time passes, they become friends and maybe more...?

mangas.title: Shiny Doll
mangas.description: Akari is an unfashionable first-year high school student who just moved from the countryside to the big city. While taking pictures of "Nana-chan," a huge mannequin at the mall, Akari accidentally bumps into into a handsome boy who compliments her on her eyes. Little does she know that the boy who has taken a fascination with her is actually Kanda, an extremely fashionable model and the heartthrob at her new school! What happens when he decides to make Akari stylish enough to land on the front cover of a magazine?

mangas.title: Kantan Dakedo, Mendokusai
mangas.titleNative: カンタンだけど、めんどくさい
mangas.description: Love is troublesome! But, I can't stop. Even a second after I fall, trouble starts. How is that love!? Yuuha (senior high school 3rd year) falls in love with anyone who is kind to her or shows her some affection. She is currently, secretly dating Kouno, a university student and a senior at her part-time, gasoline stand job. One day, she hears from her scary junior at work, Kiryuu, that Kouno has another girlfriend? Even though she gets hurt when she falls in love instantly, why did Yuuha go and fall in love yet again...!?

mangas.title: Sparkling Blue
mangas.titleNative: スパークリングブルー
mangas.description:
"Don't you know how to rely on others?"



Hikari was a high school student juggling several part-time jobs in order to fulfill her dream of going to art school. She never really had a good impression of her classmate, Segawa, who was part of her class's popular clique. However, after stumbling upon him surfing early in the morning, they start to grow closer...?! Family, future dreams, and first loves... A summer-colored love story filled with heart-warming moments.



(Source: Shueisha, translated)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Usotsuki Ambivalence
mangas.titleNative: 嘘つきアンビバレンス
mangas.description:
Amamiya Ichika, a girl with excellent grades, has a rival she detests: the top-scorer and cold-hearted student council's vice-president, Kizaki Tsukasa. While Ichika, in a flashy disguise, is working hard at her part-time job which is against school rules, Kizaki appears! Ichika introduced herself as Futaba to deceive Kizaki, but to think Kizaki fell in love with Futaba at first sight ★


Is this the start of a double life that can't be exposed...?!
The curtain is raised on this misunderstanding-filled school romance!



(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Koisuru nante Kiitenai
mangas.titleNative: 恋するなんて聞いてない
mangas.description: Matsumoto Kanna is an office lady at a critical point(?) in her life, but for some reason she ends up being taught work by her contemporary, the boring, plain-faced Noda Haruki.

mangas.title: Chiaki-Sempai no Iu Toori
mangas.titleNative: 千秋センパイの言うとおり
mangas.description: Anna, a second-year student, works on the Culture Festival's Executive Committee together with the school's famous Chiaki-senpai. However, everyday, she's forcibly swung about by a self-confident, flashy, lazy, and ultra-insincere Chiaki-senpai--!

mangas.title: Tomokoi
mangas.description: A high school debut with a classmate. A Kabedon from a cram school friend. A date with a hobby friend. A love confession from a childhood friend. This is a collection of four love stories between friends! Experience a dreamlike love from a male friend that will fulfill a girl's desire for a pounding heart. This is the first omnibus by an up and coming shoujo mangaka!

mangas.title: My Love Story!!
mangas.description:
Takeo Goda is a GIANT guy with a GIANT heart.

Too bad the girls don't want him! (They want his good-looking best friend, Sunakawa.)

Used to being on the sidelines, Takeo simply stands tall and accepts his fate. But one day when he saves a girl named Yamato from a harasser on the train, his (love!) life suddenly takes an incredible turn!

Takeo can hardly believe it when he crosses paths with Yamato again, and he finds himself falling in love with her… But with handsome Sunakawa around, does Takeo even stand a chance?

mangas.title: The Concierge at Hokkyoku Department Store
mangas.titleNative: 北極百貨店のコンシェルジュさん
mangas.synonyms: The Concierge at Hokkyoku Department Store
mangas.description:
Working retail is tough enough with regular human customers, but what about when they're owls, wolves, koalas…and a woolly mammoth? Welcome to the Hokkyoku Department Store, where new employee Akino's customers are talking animals–including extinct species! Just like any shopper, each has their own complicated request that Akino must strive to satisfy. From a wealthy laughing owl searching for the perfect present to delight his wife to a thespian sea mink attempting to find a gift for a long-awaited reunion with her father, Akino must learn to meet their needs, while also dealing with her challenging coworkers and elusive floor manager.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Gomen ne Hatsukoi
mangas.description: Junior high school junior year, winter. Chiho and the friendly Sosuke kindly accept Mahiro, an out-of-season transfer student. Chiho and Sosuke are childhood friends who live next door to each other. They are not family, but they are special to each other - and Mahiro yearns for their relationship. These feelings eventually turn into her first love for Sosuke…

mangas.title: Come Rain or Shine
mangas.description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school's abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn't meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school's club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise?

mangas.title: Todono Tsumarino Uchouten
mangas.titleNative: とどのつまりの有頂天
mangas.description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school's abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn't meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school's club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise?

mangas.title: Hello, Melancholic!
mangas.titleNative: ハロー、メランコリック！
mangas.description:
Asano Minato is a tall but stooping first-year high school student. Though she's an awesome trombone player, she does everything she can to fade into the background. Despite her best efforts, however, Minato catches the attention of her bubbly and charismatic upperclasswoman Hibiki, who wants Minato to join the band she's forming at school and won't take no for an answer! Will Minato be able to let go of the past and play in a band again? Can polar opposites harmonize through music? Slow jam your way into this dulcet yuri series!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes 4 bonus chapters.

mangas.title: My Secret Recipe
mangas.description:
When Han-Na struggled as she looked for a job, she found comfort in a certain bakery's citron cream pastry.



She sent a letter to the baker, in both gratitude towards him and curiosity about the recipe, to which he responds. From there, they continue sending messages to one another.



And even though the two don't know each other's faces, they begin developing a relationship that feels strange but special.



Then comes the long-awaited first meeting with the baker! But… the baker is so cold?!



(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

mangas.title: Luminous = Blue
mangas.description:
Kou Tarumizu transfers to the high school of her idol and 2 time photography contest winner, Uchiho Hayama, only to find that the photography club has been disbanded and Uchiho is in a photographic slump. To revive the club and get Uchiho out of her slump, Kou decides to enter a photography contest and chooses her classmates Nene and Amane as her subjects. But it turns out that the two of them used to be a couple...



Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: If I Could Reach You
mangas.titleNative: たとえとどかぬ糸だとしても
mangas.description:
In this heartwrenching new yuri manga, a teenage girl comes to terms with her own sexuality through her crush on her brother's wife. Hopelessly in love, high schooler Uta must navigate living with her brother and Kaoru, her crush … and sister-in-law. Desperate to get over her unrequited feelings, Uta pulls away, but when the cracks in her brother's marriage begin to show, Kaoru begins to confide in her new teenage sister, which just makes matters worse!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Strawberry Fields Once Again
mangas.titleNative: ストロベリー・フィールズをもう一度
mangas.description:
"I am your future amore-your lover!" With these words, Pure Sakurasaka crashes into Akira Kouno's life. As if it wasn't wild enough that she says she's come from six years in the future, Pure insists that in her time, she and Akira are engaged to be married! It's an impossible claim, especially since Akira has sworn off 3D romance, content to immerse herself in 2D dating games. Besides which, why would someone as cute as Pure be interested in a loner like her…?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Our Wonderful Days
mangas.description:
On the first day of high school, Koharu is struck speechless at the sight of the beautiful new transfer student, Mafuyu. It turns out that Mafuyu and Koharu have a deep connection, one going all the way back to their childhood. As the two friends reconnect, their feelings start to grow into love. This sweet love story that first gained popularity on Pixiv is now a series!


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra omake chapters.

mangas.title: Shoujo Manga Shujinkou x Rival-san
mangas.titleNative: 少女漫画主人公×ライバルさん
mangas.description:
Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that... though it's not the kind of problem you'd usually expect from this scenario.



Notes:

- This is the serialized version published in Gangan Joker

- Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Butterfly Love Effect
mangas.synonyms: Butterfly Sound | Nabisori | The Sound of a Butterfly
mangas.description:
Bullied at school and abused at home, Sul-Bi, a high school senior struggling with her interest in other girls and her dull life, is on the verge of ending it all. That is, until she runs into an odd girl, wandering the streets with no memory of who or where she is.

Instantly falling for this mysterious girl who has no memories and doesn't feel any pain or hunger, Sul-Bi gives her a new name, Gu Seju, meaning "Savior". The only clue of Seju's identity is a mysterious note that appears in her pocket each day. Sul-Bi sticks with her, determined to help and solve the mystery that is Seju. However, as the mystery unfolds... Sul-Bi discovers a secret beyond anything she could imagine: Seju is her future girlfriend who has traveled back in time to see her??!!!!

mangas.title: Kyuuketsuki to Yobaretai
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Be Called a Vampire!
mangas.description:
Aoi wants to go to the same school as her childhood friend Yuuna so she transfers to Vlad Academy, but everyone except Aoi is actually a vampire!?



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Koushin Koinu ni Koibumi wo
mangas.synonyms: A Love Letter for the Marching Puppy
mangas.description:
The stage is a modern school that fosters female officers, "Girl's Only Army School".
A girl, Indou Shinobu, who came out from the countryside, meets Kagami a high-class senior student.
Contrary to her high-handed attitude, Kagami occasionally shows kindness to Indou.

mangas.title: I Can't Say No to the Lonely Girl
mangas.titleNative: ロンリーガールに逆らえない
mangas.description:
In this juicy yuri manga, the goody-goody high school girl Sakurai meets a lonely girl—and ends up entangled in a web of blackmail that might just lead to romance. It's hard to keep up with school when you can never say no to a devious classmate!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Chapter count includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hana to Hoshi
mangas.description: Hanai is a junior higher and the best at table tennis. She's never lost, and she's won many tournaments, but after some freshman she's never heard of beats her like it was nothing, she starts losing every game after that and she can't get rid of that feeling of defeat. Now it's her first day of high school and she's decided to quit table tennis and live an ordinary high school life, but on the first day, she runs into the very girl that first defeated her. It turns out that she's also quit table tennis, but this girl always has a cold expression on her face and Hanai can't help but feel that this girl is always looking down on her and trying to mess up her perfect high school life. One day the girl falls asleep in class, and Hanai reaches over to wake her up. As she does so, the girl, still half asleep, looks up at her with a smile and almost kisses her. The girl later tells Hanai that she was having a dream about her, but Hanai coldly brushes it off thinking she's just messing with her and walks away - as the girl behind her looks down while blushing...

mangas.title: Oneshot Romance
mangas.titleNative: ワンショットロマンス
mangas.description:
An omnibus-style romance series. The first chapter, Hitomi no Shutter wo Oshite, tells the story of Shiho Meguro, a competitive girl starting her first year of high school this spring, and Narita, a senior in the photography club she happens to join by chance.



(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka Sareteimasu
mangas.titleNative: 塩対応な私が甘やかされています
mangas.synonyms: 塩対応のモブ子ちゃんシリーズ
mangas.description:
"Why are you being so nice to a girl like me… It's kinda weird!!" An older salaryman, a soccer club ace, and a childhood friend… It's handsome sweet boys vs cynical introverted girls, in a new story collection that will make you laugh and make your heart flutter.




Contains 4 one-shots:


1. Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka Sareteimasu (塩対応な私が甘やかされています; My cold self is being spoiled)


2. Osananajimi Renai Ron (幼馴染恋愛論; The childhood friends' dispute)


3. Tadashii Heroine no Tsutomekata (正しいヒロインの務め方; How to be a proper heroine)


4. Baito Senshi wa Shizuka ni Kasegitai (バイト戦士は静かに稼ぎたい; The part-time worker wants to earn money)

mangas.title: Mr. Bride
mangas.description:
Hayami is the it-woman at her job—she's cool, confident, and admired by all. But her has-it-all exterior belies a dark secret...her house is a mess, and she's no good at taking care of herself! Enter Yamamoto-kun—her colleague who thinks the world of her, and who refuses to let her slobbish behavior slide. Soon he's over at her house often enough that she asks him to move in with her! Where will this roundabout relationship take them?!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes:

- Originally a one-shot published in Kiss Magazine 2018 June issue, it was picked up for full serialization starting in the 2019 April issue.

- Includes three extras chapters.

mangas.title: Konbini de Hajimaru Koi no Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: コンビニではじまる恋の話
mangas.synonyms: A Story about a Gyaru Working at a Convenience Store Who Gets Closer to a Customer She's Interested In
mangas.description:
Eima Saitou is a convenience store worker who becomes interested in one of her regular customers.



Notes:

- Originally released under the title "Konbini Baito no Gal ga Kininaru Kyaku to Chikazuku Hanashi (コンビニバイトのギャルが気になる客と近づく話)".

- Released at COMITIA144, COMITIA145, COMITIA150.

mangas.title: Kimi no Yokogao shika Mirenai
mangas.titleNative: 君の横顔しか見れない
mangas.synonyms: I Can Only See Your Side Profile
mangas.description:
The popular Fujimori Sachi never faces Kishimoto Arata, who sits next to her in class. No matter how hard Kishimoto tries to see her face, she brilliantly turns away from him. As a result, he has only ever seen her side profile. But she talks to him normally otherwise. This mysterious girl seems to have a secret...?

A cute school romantic comedy about a girl who only shows her side profile VS a boy who won't give up ♪



Originally a web manga released on the author's Twitter account since May 7, 2019. Official serialization began in Comic Gene on August 16, 2020.

mangas.title: Kuchibiru ni Kimi no Iro
mangas.description: In this colourful world, I lost all of my colours... Then the boy shining in gold arrives to change it?

mangas.title: Umarekawattemo Mata, Watashi to Kekkon Shitekuremasu ka
mangas.titleNative: 生まれ変わってもまた、私と結婚してくれますか
mangas.synonyms: Will you marry me again if you are reborn?
mangas.description:
Toranosuke fell in love with his servant Kaoru. For twenty years, they slowly developed their love for each other, thus a Showa couple of clumsy husband and muscle brained wife was born. They spend a lot of time together, and they begin to talk in a nostalgic manner in Toranosuke's hospital room.
Gentle memories of a deeply in love husband and wife.



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: A Witch's Love at the End of the World
mangas.titleNative: 世界の終わりと魔女の恋
mangas.synonyms: The End of the World and a Witch's Love
mangas.description: In a world where sorcery rules from the shadows, young women adept in magical arts train at a mysterious academy. These budding witches diligently study, driven by generations of resentment after witch hunts decimated their kind long ago. Star student Alice has always strived to live up to the great expectations placed upon her, but her world is turned upside down when Mari, an inept recruit, enters the school...and her heart!

mangas.title: Senpai wa, Ijiwaru ni Tsuki.
mangas.titleNative: 先輩は、イジワルにつき。
mangas.description: The first-year high school girl Moe has a crush on the second-year Hikaru. But the cool prince Hikaru already has a beautiful and talented girlfriend. When Moe tried to confess anyway, that was when Hikaru's friend Kouki intervened…

mangas.title: Himitsu no Recipe
mangas.description: The only first-year of the cooking club has a problem. She is thinking about having a relationship with someone that is beyond her touch. But this "someone" seems to be very serious about cooking club activities since she is the president. However Wakatsuki, the new member, tries to win her heart by learning how to cook. What will happen when she overdoes things and drives her mad?

mangas.title: Hana & Hina After School
mangas.description:
Hana and Hina are two high school girls working at the same character goods shop, but they are completely different from one another. Hana is petite, uncertain and shy, while Hina is tall, confident, and trendy. Yet they share a secret: their school has a strict policy against taking part-time jobs. They also discover that both of them share an irresistible attraction to things that are cute, be it the uniforms at their all-girls' school or…each other! Just how long will Hana and Hina be able to keep their afterschool jobs, and their feelings for each other, a secret?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Secret of the Princess
mangas.description:
Fujiwara is the school's most admired student and captain of the volleyball team, but her reputation is at risk when she accidentally breaks the principal's most prized possession, a priceless vase. Fellow student Miu witnesses the accident, and Fujiwara begs her not to tell. In exchange, she'll do whatever Miu wants. It turns out that what Miu wants is to date Fujimaru! Although this wasn't an arrangement that either girl expected, the two soon discover that breaking the vase may have been destiny's way of bringing them together.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Toshishita no Otokonoko
mangas.description: Nanakusa Mihoro, a second year high school student, helps to look after her four younger brothers at home. One day on the way to school she came across Miyao Chiei, her kouhai, in need of help...

mangas.title: No Matter What You Say, Furi-san is Scary!
mangas.titleNative: となりの布里さんがとにかくコワい。
mangas.description:
Furi Youko definitely looks like a delinquent: she's got a tough-girl image that wouldn't be out of place in a gang. When Taira Namito finds himself sitting next to her in his high school class, he's immediately afraid of her. But as it turns out, Furi's rough-and-tumble exterior hides a wholesome, totally cute person underneath–and she's got the hots for Taira. (Not that he has any idea, of course.) One misunderstanding leads to another in this romantic comedy about a clueless dude and the adorable, slightly terrifying affections of the tough girl by his side!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Shiki no Zenjitsu
mangas.description:
Compilation of 6 stories with a realistic feeling to them:



1. Shiki no Zenjitsu

Two people spend the last day of their cohabitation together before she gets married.

2. Azusa Nigou de Saikai

A father visits his daughter when her mother isn't at home.

3. Monochrome no Kyoudai

Two twin brothers reunite for a drink after ten years.

4. Yume Miru Kakashi (1st part)

A man who left for the city ten years ago returns to his home town for his younger sister's wedding.

5. Yume Miru Kakashi (2nd part)

The returning brother reminisces about their childhood in the countryside.

6. Juugatsu no Hakoniwa

An unknown high-school girl moves in with a struggling writer.

7. Sorekara

A cat observes the actions of her mysterious and rude owner.

mangas.title: Mermaid Prince
mangas.description:
A collection of stories:



1-2. Ametsukigahara (アメツキガハラ); Wings 2014-11, 12



3. Yuki no Hi (ゆきの日); Wings 2014-06



4-6. Ningyo Ouji (人魚王子); Wings 2015-08~12
Mugi moves to an island in southern Japan, but he can't get used to it. That's why Matori, his classmate, won't leave him alone for a second. One night, Mugi spends the night at Matori's house. That's when her grandmother tells him a story about sirens who are able to fulfill any wish...

mangas.title: Kisses, Sighs, and Cherry Blossom Pink
mangas.titleNative: くちびるためいきさくらいろ
mangas.description:
Both volumes are a collection of seven short stories each, revolving around an all-girl's school. The first, fifth, sixth, and seventh chapter from the first volume and the first five chapters of the second volume feature the same protagonists.

This entry will reflect the Futabasha edition (published in April 2012), which has some chapters re-ordered compared to the previous (incomplete) Ichijinsha edition.

Volume 1:

1. Tomodachi ja Nakute mo (Even if We're Not Friends)

About two girls who were friends in junior high but end up going to different high schools.

2. Tengoku ni Ichiban Chikai Natsu (The Summer Closest to Heaven)

Tells the story of a ghost who accidentally possesses a girl, then takes advantage of the situation to interact with the woman she loves.

3. Kiss to Koi to Oujisama (A Kiss, Love, and a Prince)

The main character is kissed by her sempai, who is playing opposite her in the school play, and freaks out because she always imagined her first kiss would be with a boy, preferably a dashing prince.

4. Itsuka no Kono Koi (This Love From I Can't Remember When)

Tells the story of one girl's unrequited love.

5. Kusuriyubi ni Kiss Shitara (If I Kiss Her Ring Finger)

Nana wants to take things farther with Hitomi, but Hitomi doesn't seem interested. Meanwhile, Nana's failed her midterms, and she uses the make-up tests as an excuse to avoid Hitomi.

6. Chocolate Kiss Kiss

Valentine's Day is coming up, bringing both sweet and sad memories for Nana and Hitomi.


7. Tsuki ni Negai wo (Wishing on the Moon)

Can Nana and Hitomi manage to balance their relationship with the other demands on their time?

Volume 2:

1. Naisho no Koibito (Secret Girlfriends)

2. Classmates

3. Arashi no Mae (Before the Storm)

4. Honki no Iede (Running Away...For Real)

5. Watashi-tachi no Monogatari (Our Story)


6. Kuchibiru ni Cherries (Cherries For Your Lips)

Tells the story of a girl who's in love with her best friend.


7. Honto no Kimochi (Real Love)

About a pure-hearted writer who is baffled when an underclassman suddenly confesses her feelings to her.

mangas.title: Getting Closer to You
mangas.titleNative: 棗センパイに迫られる日々
mangas.description: For Kaho, a man's muscles are all that matters. She's sports-agnostic, type-agnostic—all she cares about are that those abs, pecs, biceps and delts look good. She thinks she's found her perfect Muscle Prince in Natsume-sempai...that is, until he finds out what a muscle-freak she is. But instead of ridiculing her, he instead suggests she becomes manager of the basketball team—the one he just so happens to be on? For a muscle-lover like Kaho, there's nothing to lose...and everything to gain.

mangas.title: Tsukarekitta Onna ga Shinuhodo Iyasareru Tame ni
mangas.titleNative: 疲れきった女が死ぬほど癒やされるために
mangas.description:
An angel suddenly descended upon my messy life!



Chihiro Sakai, 32, is a novelist in the midst of a slump.
Under the terrible pressure from her editor, she hasn't slept for three nights and can't even think straight or move her fingers....



"How am I supposed to write anything?"



Chihiro was about to fall over from exhaustion, when she meets a stranger (26 years old) at the pet store and brings her home!



It's the start of a life together between two women that will give your weak heart strength....



(Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Sugar na Papa to Salt na Musume
mangas.titleNative: シュガーなパパとソルトな娘
mangas.synonyms: A Sugar-Sweet Dad and A Salty-Sour Daughter
mangas.description:
This charming new manga follows the father and daughter of the Sugisaki household, with its vain, gorgeous, and very doting father, and his equally stylish, cool, but far drier daughter - but can two different generations of shoujo main characters inhabit the same house?



Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Springtime by the Window
mangas.description:
Cool and collected second-year Yamada is in love with his childhood friend, Seno. His classmates Akama and Toda are also starting to think about romance, though neither of them realizes yet that they might actually feel the same way about each other...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Kirai ni Narimasu, Sayama-kun!
mangas.titleNative: 嫌いになります、佐山くん！
mangas.description:
