mangas.description: Nan's ex, the popular Internet personality "Yi Wan," runs into his former college classmate "Wu Shi" and hires him to be his personal assistant. For Wu Shi, Yi Wan is just a college senpai, but actually their relationship goes back much further!? Memories that Yi Wan had almost forgotten are re-awakened one by one when he sees the old photographs hidden away in Wu Shi's room.

mangas.title: Play Me Softly
mangas.titleNative: ドルチェな僕らの恋について
mangas.description:
Aihara, a straitlaced office worker who plays in a concert band on the side, is having a hard time moving on from his first love. But one day, Hayama, the very classmate who'd first stolen Aihara's heart in high school, joins the band. Reunited with an old flame, Aihara's feelings are sure to be rekindled, especially when they share a passionate kiss. After Hayama pins him to the ground, Aihara won't be able to resist the aches of his heart—and his body! Two men share a sweet refrain from their youth in this dramatic reunion romance!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Koiwazurai wa Shigoto no Ato de (恋わずらいは仕事のあとで, Leave the Lovesickness for When the Work Day's Done)", and an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Voice of Love
mangas.description:
After experiencing a traumatic incident involving a previous lover, Jiho is too afraid to tell his classmate Soohan that he likes him. Thankfully, Soohan can hear other people's thoughts and asks him out first. But, as we all know, love isn't always that easy. Will Jiho and Soohan really get their happily ever after?

(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: H&H Roman Company
mangas.description: With rapid developments to the human civilization, the need for God and his angels have decreased at a significant rate. Thus, the angels are experiencing a historic unemployment crisis! With this problem in hand, God decides to start a company that will reduce the unemployment rate in both Heaven and Hell. He hereby founds the company, H&H Roman Company!

mangas.title: Hatsukoi
mangas.description:
Ryuuji and Ushio haven't seen each other for 15 years. It was supposed to be a happy reunion between childhood friends, but because of something that happened long ago, the relationship between the two is strained…?!

Taking place in the worn down apartment, "Haitsukoiwa", four omnibus stories that make the heart flutter are unfolding.

mangas.title: Trapped
mangas.description:
Chae-a Han and Yunsu Park may be perfect angels at church, but Chae-a is really a foul-mouthed ex-convict, and Yunsu is… a vampire? When Yunsu blackmails Chae-a with a murder she didn't commit, she begins searching for ways to escape the situation until the perfect opportunity presents itself. With Yunsu's life now at her mercy, the two begin a life-or-death game of cat and mouse, only to find themselves falling deeper and deeper into each other's traps...



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Dawning
mangas.description: Dawn, who lost his parents when he was young, visits the address of a letter from the past to know the circumstances surrounding the death of his parents. There, he met 'Hames' and lived with him. After a while, he felt affection for him. One day, as he spends his peaceful days with him, Dawn finds out that the person who killed his parents was Hames himself...

mangas.title: Sofure Buka!
mangas.description:
"Please no more...Save me, Nakamuraaah...!"


With the stress from work and his girlfriend, Seta's body, mind and spirit are all reaching their breaking point. Then along comes his subordinate--body pillow fanatic--Nakamura, who proposes that they become sleep buddies (friends who sleep next to each other). With his mental state stretched to its limits, he decides to try it; but seriously, with a guy?! Buuut...why does it feel so nice to be enveloped in the strong arms of his brash subordinate?


Includes One Shots: First Bite (ファーストバイト), Katappashi kara Zenbu Ai (片っ端からぜんぶ愛)

Includes Side Stories: Bed wa Futatsu Irimasen (ベッドはふたついりません), Yokuasa no Dekigoto (翌朝の出来事)

mangas.title: Capture Me With An Expert Kiss
mangas.synonyms: Takumi na KISS de Juchuu Shite
mangas.description:
The classmate I used to despise became a sexy older man! Hirose, the heir to a large company, wanted to compete based on his abilities, so he joined a cosmetics company midway. However, unlike his ambitions, he was running in circles and found himself struggling. Then one day, at a work site, he reunites with Adachi, his high school classmate and club friend. Adachi, now a young vice president of a construction company, was still perfect and charismatic, was deeply trusted by his subordinates and still a perfect and cool man. Hirose had hated Adachi since the old days. Now that Adachi has become his business partner, Hirose tries to assert his superiority somehow, but—

"How is this guy so good at everything?!"

Falling for my All Rounder Frenemy!

mangas.title: I Never Agreed to This!
mangas.titleNative: ここまでヤるとは聞いてないっ！
mangas.description:
Handyman Maki has taken in a guy called Naru who helps with work in return for a roof over his head. The pair are roommates, work partners, and friends with benefits! Naru may complain a lot, but he'll do whatever Maki says because he's deeply in love with him. He can't seem to accept that they only have a physical relationship, and finds his heart racing whenever Maki touches him. One day, Naru meets a client who happens to be someone from Maki's past... Can these two really stay purely physical considering how they feel about each other? This is a chaotic comedy involving work and romance between a stoic, fearless dom and his devoted but volatile pet!!

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Entwined
mangas.titleNative: 愛してほしいと言ってくれ
mangas.synonyms: Aishite Hoshii to Ittekure | Raku no Otoko
mangas.description:
Self-made lawyer Yukitoshi Nakaso is reunited with Tomoe Gojou, his former college classmate, in court. After being headhunted by the law firm's director, Tomoe begins working at the same firm as Yukitoshi. However, after drinking too much at the welcoming party, they return to their office together, where Tomoe passionately gazes at Yukitoshi and makes advances on him. Unable to control himself, Yukitoshi bends Tomoe over and things escalate from there.

Can love save the man chained down by his past? This is an office love story between a self-made man and a beautiful son from a rich family who is afraid to love!

mangas.title: Twilight Out of Focus: Afterimages in Slow Motion
mangas.titleNative: 残像スローモーション
mangas.synonyms: Afterimage Slow Motion | Zanzou Slow Motion
mangas.description: Jin, third-year director, lead actor, and president of the film club, and second-year director Giichi see eye-to-eye on very little. Jin is flashy, flirty, and focused on keeping everyone happy, while Giichi expects the best from himself and others, and will compromise nothing to see his vision through. Constantly at each other's throats, the two can hardly stand to be in the same club. But what will happen when family trouble forces them to share the same dorm room? Will their common interests bring them closer as friends, push them further apart as rivals—or something else entirely?

mangas.title: Kyou, Aitsu (♂) ni Kyunto Shite Shimaimashita...!!
mangas.titleNative: 今日、アイツ（♂）にキュンとしてしまいました…!!

mangas.title: The Seven Princes of the Thousand Year Labyrinth
mangas.description:
A young man, Ewan Juno, awakens to find himself imprisoned in an unknown place, surrounded by stone walls and seemingly endless corridors. Ewan learns that he is one of eight young men, all sent to this strange place--the Thousands Years Labyrinth. Each of them is a candidate to be the next emperor, but only one among them will have the power to choose whom it will be. As each man struggles to survive, Ewan must navigate the shifting landscape of the labyrinth and its multitude of traps, if he is ever to escape and learn the truth behind the labyrinth's dark secrets.


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Hopelessly Devoted
mangas.synonyms: A Blessing on Your House | Omairi Desu Yo
mangas.description: Yuuji isn't your usual Buddhist priest - he's young, good-looking, and his natural charm makes him a hit with everyone in the shopping district! Unfortunately for his leagues of adoring admirers, though, he says he's all but sworn off love, dating, and marriage, and that his life is devoted to the practice of his faith. There's just one thing he isn't telling anyone: Yuuji does have someone he loves, but they can never date or marry - his childhood friend, Saburou!

mangas.title: Toritan: Birds of a Feather
mangas.description:
Inusaki, a detective and unwitting jack-of-all-trades for his neighborhood, has the unenviable ability to communicate with birds…and hates it. Yet when he runs into a crow that knows his name, he can't help but befriend him, naming him "Kuro." Later, when Inusaki seems to hear Kuro's voice, he finds only the landlord's son. Why do they sound so similar, and why can't Inusaki stop blushing whenever Kuro the crow crosses his mind?!


(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Fortune Favors a Smile
mangas.synonyms: Good Fortune Comes To The Demon Who Smiles | Warau Oni ni wa Fuku Kitaru
mangas.description:
A week after Emu Ikariya's father died, a debt collector showed up on his doorstep. His late father left behind a debt of $40,000. Now, Emu has to pay up.

Emu grew up poor. He's not particularly fond of smiling or other people. No one understands him and all he's ever known is bad luck.
There's no way Emu has the money to pay back his father's debts. That's when the debt collector suggests he sell his body at a secret gay club. Just then, a high school classmate of Emu's named Nenji Fukutomi appears out of nowhere and proclaims, "I'll buy Ikariya!" What on earth is he talking about?!

mangas.title: Color Collection
mangas.titleNative: カラー・コレクション
mangas.description:
Graphic Design major Saiki had always wanted to be an artist, even if he hasn't thought of himself as one recently. When both an intimidating class project and an unexpected meet-cute bring him closer to Amano, an artist whose work he'd always admired, Saiki just might find himself finding the words to describe his own art – and his own feelings, as well.

A collection of stories about life and love at a certain art university which also includes the budding romance between a sculptor and his muse, and a late-blooming artist and his new teacher.

mangas.title: Warui Otona ni Narimashite
mangas.titleNative: 悪い大人になりまして
mangas.description:
After breaking up with his girlfriend, Natsuno is homeless and spending nights in his office. At a mutual acquaintance's wedding celebration he meets up with his old school friend Ui, who had confessed to Natsuno just before graduation, been rejected by him, and drifted out of contact. Now an accident has left Ui with amnesia, and his first words to Natsuno are "Who are you?" Hoping to charm the other man into lending him a place to crash for a while, Natsuno lies, "I'm your ex"...!?


(Source: Rain Over Paradise)

mangas.title: Kodoku na Taka wa Hitokoishikute
mangas.titleNative: 孤独な鷹は人恋しくて
mangas.synonyms: The Lonely Hawk Which Longs for Company
mangas.description:
"Senpai, I want you to fall for me."



When Hotaka, his junior at high school, suddenly confessed to him during their student days, Yuu felt so embarrassed that he gave him the brush-off. He was brusque with Hotaka, but even now, he regrets hurting his cute junior he cared about more than anyone. However, when they happen to meet each other again after several years, Hotaka has turned into a devilish man who's bent on seducing a drunk Yuu….

mangas.title: Under One Roof With the Beast
mangas.titleNative: ひとつ屋根の下のケダモノ
mangas.description:
Daigo is starting college in the spring, joining his twin cousins, Jin and Shin. Daigo always had a crush on Jin since he was a child, but Shin was always the one who couldn't leave him alone. Shin finds out that Daigo has a crush on Jin, and aggressively presses Shin about it, telling him to pick him instead of Jin. Since Shin and Jin are identical, Daigo gets confused. His heart starts beating faster as he looks into Shin's eyes and…?!


(Source: Manga.Club)

mangas.title: Daiji na Koto nanode, Nido.
mangas.titleNative: 大事なことなので、二度。
mangas.synonyms: Because this is the most important thing.
mangas.description: "There's no way I will marry you" were the bitter words handed back to Ryuuji after his marriage proposal to his girlfriend. Heart broken and pissed off at the way he was dumped, Ryuuji visits his best friend, Tomoya, to look for some comfort. However, Tomoya's indirect confession of "I'm glad you didn't marry her," evokes new feelings and desires Ryuuji never knew he had.

mangas.title: The Downstairs Resident is Mr. Fudanshi
mangas.description:
Sokabe is a salaryman whose apartment is far from his workplace. He could have found a closer place but one reason stops him from moving: his feelings for his downstairs neighbor, Motoi. Going home one night with his belongings stolen, he knocks to the caretaker's door to ask for spare keys when Motoi steps in to help. Curious of the books scattered around Motoi's room, he is surprised to find that they were books on BL. Motoi catches him snooping which makes Sokabe panic and leads Motoi to assume that Sokabe is like him - a fudanshi - when in fact, Sokabe is actually gay. Now, Sokabe has to keep up the pretense of being a 'fudanshi comrade' while hiding his true feelings for Motoi.


(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Colette Decides to Die
mangas.titleNative: コレットは死ぬことにした
mangas.synonyms: Colette's Decision | Colette wa Shinu Koto ni Shita | Colette's Decision
mangas.description: When exhausted workaholic apothecary Colette jumps into a well, instead of dying she finds herself caring for a new patient: Hades, Lord of the Dead. As Colette goes back and forth between her world and the underworld, new patients of every kind arrive daily!

mangas.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts
mangas.synonyms: Princess of the Sacrifice & King of the Beast
mangas.description:
A young girl has resigned herself to being he next sacrificial meal for the Beast King...but the king is no mere monster! Love is more than skin-deep in this gorgeous fantasy manga.



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Chapter count includes 15 extras.

mangas.title: I Tamed My Ex-husband's Mad Dog
mangas.synonyms: 元夫の番犬を手なずけた
mangas.description:
As soon as Reinhardt Lincke wakes up 15 years in the past at her father's funeral, she stabs her husband, the crown prince, in the leg. Even though he is the one at fault, Reinhardt is the one who is punished. But fate seems to smile upon her when, during the rocky journey to her place of exile, she encounters Will Cohlonna, her husband's "mad dog" and war hero from her previous life. Thirsty for revenge, Reinhardt decides to give Will a new name and use him for her revenge. This time, Reinhardt has the joker, and she's playing to win.



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Suki ni Sasete Miseru kara! second step
mangas.titleNative: 好きにさせてみせるから! second step
mangas.description:
College student Hiro Sakurada has finally fulfilled his wish to be in a relationship with his childhood friend Shun Sakiyama.
However, Shun, who is new to romance, doesn't seem to understand the special feeling "between lovers".
On their first date, Hiro asks Shun if he could sleep with him, but...!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time
mangas.synonyms: Your Majesty, Please Don't Kill Me Again
mangas.description:
Following the emperor's unjust massacre of her family and her own miserable death, Laliette Bellua wakes up to find that she is in the body of her 12-year-old self. She immediately sets her sights on a single goal: suck up to Emperor Rupert Edgar Laspe Vellelum and save her family. Laliette's plan is foolproof, except for one tiny detail… In her present timeline, the future emperor is still masquerading as a princess named Rapertte! With only a single suitcase and some change in her pocket, she sets out for the capital to become the princess's closest and most beloved attendant. Can Laliette prove her ability to keep a secret? And more importantly, will she be able to win the favor of the cruel and sadistic Rapertte?



(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

mangas.title: I'm the Tyrant's Secretary
mangas.description:
To save my family from certain doom, I offered to become the Emperor's secretary in place of my clumsy brother. I excelled at work in my previous life… to the point of overworking myself, but that's beside the point! I know I got this. I served the tyrant emperor perfectly, down to a T, so now I can quit working and the plot can continue on. But when I asked to resign, he retorted, "Do you want to die?" Your Majesty, you've always been disinterested in people, why are you holding me back? Please let me live the rest of my life peacefully!



(Source: Tapas)



Note: chapter count includes 7 side-stories and a prologue.

mangas.title: The Hunting Game
mangas.description:
"Teacher, I know your secret crush. It was my dad, wasn't it? If you want me to keep it a secret, then become my lover." That threat threw Ye Qing's life into chaos. When he was 19, Ye Qing had a crush on his private tutor. 18 years later, all those repressed feelings were revealed, and Ye Qing was forced to play a lovers game with his teacher's son. Despite their 18-year age gap, he felt powerless under the younger man's aggressive tactics.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Soredemo Kimi wo Shiawase ni Shitai
mangas.titleNative: それでも君を幸せにしたい
mangas.synonyms: Still, I want to make you happy
mangas.description:
Kouya is reunited with Aihime, a girl he used to play with when they were little, for the first time in nine years.

Even though they've lived far apart, Kouya's feelings for her have been growing through their social media exchanges, and he decided to take the opportunity of their reunion to reveal his feelings to her!

But she has a secret...?



(Source: Manga Cross, translated)



Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Seduced by the Demon King: A Sensual Rebirth
mangas.titleNative: 転生したら魔王様に溺愛されました
mangas.synonyms: When I Reincarnated, I was Doted on by the Demon King
mangas.description:
Haruka's life has hit a dead end—her career is stalled, and her love life is nonexistent. But everything changes when a shooting star crashes at her feet, revealing a sinfully handsome man who claims to be the Demon King. Even more shocking, he insists Haruka was once his sworn enemy, a saint, in a past life. Though she has no memory of their shared history, he seems to know everything about her.



Bent on revenge, the Demon King vows to take Haruka on a journey of exquisite ecstasy, only to plunge her into the depths of despair. His motives may be dark, but the offer of passion and adventure is far more enticing than her mundane reality. Is she ready to embrace the pleasure—and the peril—that comes with surrendering to a demon's touch?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Sweat and Soap
mangas.description:
Asako's living her dream, working at the toiletry maker Lilia Drop. Little do her coworkers know, the reason she loves the company so much is that she's ashamed of her body odor, and their soap is the only thing that does the trick. So when the company's lead product developer, a perfuming genius, approaches her in the lobby and wonders what "that smell" is, she's terrified … but could it be … that he likes it? And, even more surprising to Yae … does she like him?



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes: Includes 13 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Savor the Taste
mangas.description:
Can a princess's food save a kingdom?

Luana is reborn as an illegitimate princess inside a book. Resigned to her fate, she decides to spend her days cooking. Not long after, the cursed Duke Legion arrives and sacks the kingdom, but instead of falling for the princess, he's bewitched by Luana's food. He orders her to cook for him or die!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Padoui Sontop
mangas.description:
Anto lost his mother at sea due to bad weather when he was younger. His father alludes to a "curse" while refusing the idea of him approaching the sea. While looking for his mother, he loses his consciousness. But when he wakes up, who the hell is that half-naked guy next to him?



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Jia You Hei Mao x Mo Fashi
mangas.description:
"The two things I like the most… catnip and you!"



A cat wants to return a favor?! A passionate and devoted kitty makes a confession!



Yan Kai owns a pet supplies store. On a stormy night, he kindly takes in a black cat to save it from a typhoon. But the cat's identity is actually a human, Yu Ran! Not only that, but he's a magician whose powers have only ever been heard of in legends. As it happens… Yu Ran has been secretly peeping on Yan Kai while in his cat form for a long time, but he never imagined Yan Kai would bring him home himself! It's a perfect scenario, so Yu Ran decides to take the initiative and launch an attack on Yan Kai… An attack filled with passion and love!



(Source: Tong Li, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

mangas.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
mangas.titleNative: 可愛いだけじゃない式守さん
mangas.description:
Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be… but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes:

- Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kodansha for serialization.

- Won 5th place in Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

- Includes 25 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Florist no Koi wa Saku
mangas.titleNative: フローリストの恋は咲く
mangas.synonyms: Shachiku na Ore to Sakushi na Kouhai
mangas.description:
Collection of stories:

1-3) Florist no Koi wa Saku (The Florist's Love Will Bloom)

4) Shachiku na Ore to Sakushi na Kouhai

5) Hitomi no Oku no Yokubou (The Desire in Their Eyes)

6) Kare no Seiheki Ore no Kurou

7) Ete… Fuete…?

8) Honne wo Kikasete

mangas.title: The Horizon
mangas.description:
A world where everything has been lost. A boy and a girl alone together. A spark of hope kindled between them. All they can do is move forward. But against broken adults and devastating despair, how long will they be able to keep going...?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Sono Aka wo Watashi Ni
mangas.description: Haru is the handsome upperclassman admired by all the female students. When she leaves the archery club, Suzuki decides to gift her with a tube of lipstick, but she's unable to when Haru leaves with her girlfriend, the beautiful Towada.

mangas.title: Koi yori Aoku
mangas.description:
Takamine, who can't find anything that interests her, and Sakura, who loves books, met by chance and started spend their after-school hours together. Are they friends? Or is it another kind of youthful relationship that they are weaving together?



(Source: COMIC OGYAAA!!, translated)

mangas.title: Take Your Time
mangas.titleNative: テイク ユアー タイム
mangas.description:
Shijima's younger coworker says they're in love with him. This is weird because they confess that Shijima forgot to slick his hair back today. This is unbelievable because this "younger coworker" is the cool and collected Takito - who's also a dude! Shijima says this is just a bug in Takito's emotions, and he'll get over him in time, but how can he insist when Takito's just so smitten with him?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Caster & Mild
mangas.description:
1-3.5) Caster & Mild

One morning after a drunken blowout, Kei opens his eyes to an unfamiliar ceiling and to a valiantly over-helpful man who he also doesn't know, Asahi.

Asahi says he's a friend of Kei's friend Rio, and he tells Kei straightforwardly that he's been interested in him for a while. Even though he's not Kei's type at all, to Kei's amazement, Asahi seems rather attached to him. Since the person he was living with has thrown him out and he has nowhere to live, he accepts Asahi's hospitality...

4) Otona no Kodomo (Adult and Child)

5) Nakimushi Kemushi, Ame, Ajisai (Crybaby Caterpillars, Rain, Hydrangeas)

5.5) Caster & Mild after

mangas.title: The Scandalous Saeki Wants to Fall in Love with Him
mangas.titleNative: 噂の佐伯は彼と恋がしたい
mangas.synonyms: Saeki, Famous for Rumors, Wants to Fall in Love with Him
mangas.description:
Yuzuki's goal of being an upstanding class president is put to the test when he's asked to look after Saeki, a bad boy who's reputation precedes him.



(Source: Animate International)

mangas.title: The King and the Paladin
mangas.synonyms: The Predatory Marriage between King and Paladin
mangas.description:
Ezekiel is a gentle and noble paladin who commands the Order of Silver Knights in Panroem City. But when the new ruthless tyrant of Alfensiad, King Calliope, orders him to join Duke Heilich's family as his successor, he has no choice but to comply in order to save his powerless city-state. Little does he know that what he thought was a diplomatic mission would lead him into a forced marriage with "The Bloody Calliope" herself! It's even more of a shock when Ezekiel discovers that Calliope is actually someone he knew in the past... and with the grudge she holds against him, it looks like he's in for a tense marriage. Can the unlikely couple clear up the misunderstandings between them and make something of their relationship, despite its rocky beginnings?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: The original version was completed with 31 chapters. On October 15, 2022 an expanded R19 version was released with a total of 37 chapters

mangas.title: Garden of Silence
mangas.description: From losing her family to being mistreated by her in-laws and executed for crimes they forced her to commit, life was cruel to Guinevere Le Pur… Pitied by fate, Guinevere is given the chance to go back in time and learns that she was cheated out of her husband's bequeathed wealth. Now, she's determined to take back her stolen fortune and make sure her tormentors get absolutely nothing. But will Guinevere get her revenge, or will she walk down the fiery path of misery once again?

mangas.title: The Flower That Will Never Bloom
mangas.description: Hiroshi Asamizu is 27 years old. When he moves into a new apartment for a new job, his neighbor turns out to be his first love from high school - Takehito Sakuraba. Hiroshi doesn't want to see Sakuraba again. He doesn't want to be in love anymore. He doesn't want to be disturbed. That was what he thought, but he can't help looking at him, and his heart can't stop pounding. Can you stop your heart from being attracted to someone?

mangas.title: Kimi wo Someru Asayake ni
mangas.description:
"You are like a storm."



Photographer Shun visits Enoshima for a shoot and witnesses a young man with sunset-colored hair falling into the sea. He rushed to help Kengo, a young man who smiled like the sun. Even though they parted ways afterwards, they soon meet again by chance at a shop. Kengo suggests that Shun, who has not decided where to stay, to come stay at his house...?


(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Merry on the Rocks
mangas.description:
The gentle dance of snowflakes as they fall to the ground. Sparkling lights twinkling in the frigid night air. Couples holding hands and sharing in joyous laughter. While most people anticipate the Christmas season, for Noel Alan Brown it is nothing but an inevitable annual annoyance. Making his way through the gaudy streets of New York in pursuit of some semblance of enjoyment, he arrives at a club and meets Lee June: mysterious, seductive, and utterly irresistible. But after a night of intensely playful passion, June is nowhere to be seen…leaving nothing but another reason to add to Noel's Christmas hate list. Returning his focus to a crucial upcoming presentation, Noel tries his best to erase the alluring June from his mind to no avail. Luckily for him, he'll have a chance to see his disappearing lover again - because June is working for the competition! Tensions won't be the only thing rising as the two go at it in both the board room and the bedroom.



(Source: Lezhin US)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Shinobeba Koi
mangas.description: Toranosuke, 16, tired of the monotony of everyday life, takes a walk one night and is beckoned over by the leader of the town's motorcycle gang. Riding behind Tetsuya is his pride and jpoy. But a gang with the rule of "no favorites", after being doted on by Tetsuya, Toranosuke finds the trouble brewing between himself and some members of the gang...

mangas.title: Spend Wisely
mangas.description:
Makoto Kanekura works hard every day to pay off his father's debt. One day, the black-market lender Manami Godai hooks him up with a lucrative job. "Every time you sleep with me, I'll slash $300 off your debt." Makoto steels himself for the worst, but it turns out he's not the bottom...! This is a money-driven romance about an innocent young man and a loan shark who loves to bottom!

(Source: Renta!)


Included one-shot: Magic Banana.

mangas.title: Super Platonic
mangas.titleNative: スーパープラトニック
mangas.description: Takagi, the store manager of a flower shop, does a favor for his younger sister by going to an Idol concert to check out a man she met online. However, it turns out that this online friend is actually Toraji, a part-timer who works for Takagi.

mangas.title: Shitsuke ga Nattenai!
mangas.description: One night, Kazuho, a hotel worker who possesses a rare blood-sucking constitution, helps a drunk man he found lying on the side of the street by giving him a place to spend the night. The next day, instead of waking up to the man he brought back to his apartment, Kazuho unexpectedly finds a dog sleeping in his bed!

mangas.title: Unmelting Words
mangas.description:
Police officer Nohee is an Unliar: she is completely unable to lie. But telling the truth gets tricky when she meets the wanted criminal Yeonho. As a Word Wraith, Yeonho can make others do whatever he wants just by speaking – he can even kill them. Because of this astonshing ability, he's now a suspect in the murder of his adoptive parents. Yeonho insists he doesn't want to kill people, and asks for Nohee's help in evading capture. Can she trust this accused murderer and uncover the truth behind Yeonho's case? The world of riveting hit series "340 Days" expands with a suspenseful new thriller.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: You Can Give Me My Reward Tonight
mangas.titleNative: ごほうびは夜にちょうだい
mangas.description:
"How is it? Sweet, right?"



One day on her shift as library assistant, Hinano finds ultra-popular ladies' man, Haruna Iori, sleeping amongst the stacks. Not only does he tease Hinano relentlessly, he also somehow ends up stealing her first kiss! Hinano decides to pretend it never happened and goes home -- only to find Haruna at her house, too? That's when Hinano's mother breaks the news to her: she'll be living with Haruna for the next six months! Hinano's heart is sure to beat out of her chest sharing a space with the free-spirited Haruna, whose advances only grow sweeter and sweeter!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Flowers Bloom as the Night Unravels
mangas.titleNative: 夜がほどけて花が咲く
mangas.synonyms: Yoru ga Hodokete Hana ga Saku
mangas.description: At the beginning of his last year in college, Shizuka meets Izumi, his new professor's assistant. Shizuka is drawn to Izumi's black hair, pale skin... and seemingly lonely expression. However, he realizes one day that it's the professor who is the target of Izumi's gaze. "...The person I like has someone they like. And that someone has a wife." It's so painfully pure and maddeningly sad. It's a romance between guys that cultivates love with great care.

mangas.title: Gone with the Bubbles
mangas.description: As an unexpected descendant of a cursed family of mermaids, Eun-Woo's only hope of survival is to never fall in love. For years this was easy enough, until one day he's forced to confront his childhood friend and first kiss, Tae-Ho. But why has he come back, toying with Eun-Woo's heart? Can Eun-Woo resist Tae-Ho's pull or will he succumb to his hidden feelings, and ultimately, disaster?

mangas.title: Fall In You
mangas.description: Min-Jae finds Jin-Hyeok, the breathtakingly handsome and personable new employee, very likable. After Min-Jae gets drunk during a company dinner, Jin-Hyeok helps Min-Jae solve a little problem he has...

mangas.title: Frozen Terrain
mangas.titleNative: 僕らはまだ氷河期の途中
mangas.synonyms: We Are Still in the Middle of the Ice Ages | Bokura wa Mada Hyougaki no Tochuu
mangas.description: Iroha works at a small family bakery downtown, and she has her eyes on the cute, younger part-time staff member, Ippei. He looks a little... actually, very scary, but once you get to know him, he's a total sweetheart. Iroha's always smiling and being nice to people, but deep down, she's hiding her true feelings. Ippei's kindness envelopes her and gradually warms her up... A cute, sweet, and warm love story with a younger guy!

mangas.title: Unrequited Love Limited
mangas.description:
Mihiro falls in love with her home tutor, Naoki Ebisawa. But, it turns out Naoki's in love with her sister, Makina...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Orikou Yajuu Niwa Aragaenai
mangas.titleNative: おりこう野獣にはあらがえない
mangas.description:
Uyama Shun is novelist who is very shy and tries his best to avoid human interaction... that is until one day when he is forced to share a room and cohabitate with Kiyomi Eiji for two weeks at a camp!


Note: Originally serialized under the title "Renai Kyuushuujo" (恋愛教習所).

mangas.title: Lustful Aquarium
mangas.description: As expected, Iseya's performance is the most beautiful ..." Sakurai, a novice dolphin trainer, fell in love with the experienced orca trainer Iseya. An underwater BL featuring an orca trainer x dolphin trainer!

mangas.title: Kono Kiss wa Kiji ni Dekinai
mangas.titleNative: このキスは記事にできない
mangas.synonyms: This Kiss Can't Be an Article
mangas.description:
A cunning actor with a cult-like following x toyed-with paparazzi photographer!



Manato, a reporter who shot the scandal of the super popular actor Ryuu Honda, is caught by said actor. The man has an appearance and personality that even men will love. However, beneath that veneer of elegance lies a cunning individual. "This is how you beg," Honda boasts. Unable to resist, Manato loses his virginity to the practiced actor. Furthermore, someone took a photo of them in the act?!



(Source: Shodensha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hana to Unmei Chuudoku
mangas.description:
Yoshida Hana has only one goal in life: to find her soulmate.
Dreamy, distracted and hopeful, she wants to find someone to share those feelings with; no luck though. After several love affairs with no future, he does not lose sight of his ideal and share that desire with others. Therefore, he doesn't bother trying to convince his subordinate, Takada, that soul mates do exist and that he will find his own one day… Which Takada isn't really interested in, nor does he believe there is. In this unique senpai-subordinate relationship there is something that neither dares to say out loud, until one day they see each other outside of work at Takada's house. Pancakes and a hidden longing! What will happen between Hana and Takada on an unexpected night?

mangas.title: I'll Make You My Number One Idol!
mangas.titleNative: 俺の最推しをキミに捧ぐ！
mangas.description:
When daydreaming part-timer Chihiro gets forced to order from a random maid cafe for a punishment game, he's expecting sweet, delicate maids to cater to his every whim... so why is this tall, buff dude wearing a frilly maid outfit and calling him "Master"? Mako may not look like the ideal pretty maid, but Chihiro's about to find out what happens when you judge a maid by their muscles!



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Toretate Crazy!
mangas.description: An encounter in the spring, the budding of spring. What do you think of an agricultural otaku? The comedy between beauty VS agricultural otaku will now start!

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Wazurai
mangas.description: High school student Hotaru has never been in love. To her, it's a mysterious feeling, despite the advice of those around her, and she finds herself wishing she could experience it for herself... That is, until she meets Shinri—handsome, popular, and a shameless flirt—who offers to teach her about love. Could this be her chance to understand the mysterious feeling at last? And what, exactly, are Shinri's intentions?

mangas.title: Sonna Me De Minaide
mangas.description:
The student Honami leaves her worshipers in turn flash off, because it is clear to her that her boyfriend must wear glasses. When her childhood friend Kazuma moves to her school, she realizes to her surprise that he has become a cool wearer of glasses. But on a date he reveals to her that he is emigrating to America soon and his glasses are just fake...



In addition, two short stories are included.
One is about Miho, who is unfortunately too attached and therefore constantly abandoned. Maybe she finally finds happiness now?
In the other story, Hiro and Mimi have a long-distance relationship. Suddenly Hiro distances himself. Does that mean something bad?

mangas.title: Ride Your Wave
mangas.description:
New college student Hinako, who moved to a small seaside town to surf and have fun, finds herself falling in love with firefighter Minato after he saves her from a fire. Their young romance comes to an abrupt end when Minato drowns…but in her grief, Hinako discovers that singing a song they used to perform as a duet summons Minato into the nearest body of water–be it a puddle, glass, or bathtub. Will Hinako be able to reach Minato again?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Kogetsu no Yume
mangas.description:
I'm not a woman, man, human, nor animal.

I am me, and—I'm only here to protect.

A completely new work set in the same universe as Reimei no Arcana.

mangas.title: I Love my Best Friend
mangas.description:
"Is this how you always get? I had no idea."



Yoichi and Shige have been best friends since elementary school. Yoichi used to be in love with Shige, but in order to stay friends, he was supposed to have thrown those feelings away... However, Shige suddenly flips their relationship on its head when he suddenly asks, "Hey, Yoichi. Let me eat your dick." In just an instant, Yoichi suddenly has his dick in Shige's mouth...!! Yoichi was supposed to have given up on Shige, but Shige's passionate blowjob backs Yoichi's heart and body into a corner... And the moan he accidently lets slip from his mouth only eggs Shige on, leading the situation to escalate! A forgotten love is rekindled in this possessively passionate love-story between two friends!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Henkutsu Shousetsuka wa Koi ni Irozuku
mangas.titleNative: 偏屈小説家は恋に色づく
mangas.synonyms: He Who Knows the Color of Love
mangas.description: The misanthropic and antisocial novelist Kiriya is currently in a slump. A gardener named Torai Sotetsu comes to Kiriyas house. Torai's flashy and delinquent looks is the type of person Kiriya has the most problems with. Kiriya takes a brusque attitude towards Torai, but Torai manages to open up the narrow-minded Kiriyas heart with his unfazed attitude.

mangas.title: Kafuka Koufukuron
mangas.description:
A 5 million debt suddenly befalls on cash-strapped student, Kamijou Yuuki. It's because of his father that he went through many hardships, and he goes to drink in desperation but…When he comes to, he's on a bed full of ￥10,000 bills and a half naked man――?!
After waking up, the man even says "I'll give you the money".
Confused, Yuuki escapes and goes home, but he re-encounters the mysterious man, Nao.
"I'll give you the money, so let's have sex. Think of it as physical labor." Nao says, but what does Yuuki do…?



(Source: michiruzuki)

mangas.title: Villainess in Love
mangas.description:
So I've become Yunifer Magnolia, the villainess who's crazed with jealousy that Duke Ishid Lucrenze, the devastatingly handsome hero, has eyes only for Raelle, Yunifer's best friend. Yunifer torments Raelle so much that Yunifer's killed off at the end. But... I'M Yunifer now. UGH! Good news is, I've reincarnated a year before her tragic end, so there's time to make sure Ishid and Raelle have a fairy tale ending (and I stay alive). Bad news is, I got drunk and woke up with Ishid next to me. Crap.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Chijou 100 meter de, Aimashou
mangas.titleNative: 地上100メートルで、逢いましょう
mangas.description:
A rendezvous through the glass window between a young president and a window cleaning worker! Hakuhou Tamaki is the young president of Hakuhou Foods, one of the leading enterprises in Japan. He had given up on things called family due to his father's continued marriages and divorces, and until now thinks that he doesn't need a romantic relationship in his life. However, the moment he met the eyes of the window cleaners Yashiro Jin over the window, his world completely changed!

"I want to talk to you who smiles on the other side of the beautifully polished glass."

From that day, Tamaki begins his first-ever romantic approach…!

mangas.title: Hubae Soneun Yakson
mangas.description:
"Sunbae, what have you been up to these last few nights?"



Taeyoung, who is living with his hobae(his buddy), Junghoon, has a problem. He relieves himself while thinking of Junghoon every night, but can't finish. But what is..?! While they're drinking together, Junghoon offers to lend his hand...!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Otona Gokko
mangas.description:
1. Otona Gokko (おとなごっこ)

Mitsuru goes out night after night looking for strangers to have sex with. Rumours are flying around school that he's a prostitute, but this is fine with Mitsuru, who prefers to be alone. Transfer student Hasegawa is irritated by this attitude and begins to follow him around. Will Mitsuru's loneliness finally be abated as Hasegawa keeps forcing himself into his life?



2. Yoru ga Akete Koi no Rinkaku (夜が明けて恋の輪郭)



3-5. Neko no Tawamure (猫の戯れ, Cat's Play)

Yoshihiro is captivated by with his unsociable and gloomy-looking Modern Literature teacher, and becomes determined to find common ground so that he can strike up a conversation. Fujita sensei's love for cats accords him just such an opportunity, and then...



6. Hasegawa-kun to Tokuma-sensei no Hanashi (長谷川くんと徳間先生の話)

mangas.title: Dame na Yatsu Hodo Kawaii
mangas.titleNative: ダメなやつほどかわいい
mangas.description:
One day, Arata was forced to take in a freeloader by the request of his friend. That man, Narumi, almost burns everything when he cooks, and can't get into the bath on his own; in other words he's a hopelessly clumsy man.

Arata is at a loss, but he just can't leave Narumi alone!?

mangas.title: Konya Bed de Matteiro
mangas.titleNative: 今夜ベッドで待っていろ
mangas.description:
Childhood friends, Kagetora and Haruta, are a super lovey-dovey high-school couple! After finally going steady with Haruta, who he has always liked, Kagetora is on cloud nine!!! ... Or he should be, but for some reason, he keeps desperately avoiding all of Haruta's "invitations". The reason is because Kagetora's *beep* is *beep*?!



(Source: Taiyohtosho, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ore to Joushi no Kakushigoto: Tsuzuki no Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: 俺と上司のかくしごと つづきのはなし
mangas.description:
It's been a month since Mikado, an idol otaku worked to the bone by the design company he's employed at, has started dating his superior Anezaki. Even though they've finally gotten consecutive days off, since it feels like they're sex friends as they've just been holed up having sex, he wants to go on a date like normal lovers! Anezaki seems dissatisfied, but then he and Mikado go on a hot springs trip together.



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Unluckily Lucky
mangas.description:
What will happen when the luckiest and
unluckiest boy alive meet and try switching their lucks?!

mangas.title: Riht
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Yuu and Asa thought they'd always be together. However, one day, their once-natural dynamic falls apart. Yuu doesn't believe they can continue the way they are now that he's realized his feelings for Asa go beyond friendship. As things continue to evolve and put him on the brink of a decision, Yuu begins to think his love for Asa is inconveniencing the people around him. So, to forget his love for Asa, he decides to preserve his role as childhood friend... But acting against love proves harder than he thinks.



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Make It Only Love
mangas.titleNative: メイクイットオンリーラブ
mangas.description:
"Suddenly, a kiss with someone you admire!?"



Nakamura Oto, a model who gets nervous even shooting promotional pictures is thinking about quitting his job. That's when Shion, a cameraman, tells him that an acquaintance of his is looking for a model. Unable to refuse, he decides to meet with the client... but when arrives at the meeting place, Ryou, a makeup artist he admires is there?! Moreover, he's kissed by a half-asleep Ryou!?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Toshishita Yankee wo Oseru Ken
mangas.titleNative: 年下ヤンキーを推せる件
mangas.description:
A dangerous love comedy between a brilliant high school student and a younger delinquent starts! Nachi, a fan of a cute male character of a social network game, decides to make use of her abilities as the top student of her grade and becomes a part-time tutor in order to earn money and pay for items in her game. However, her student, Soushi, is not only younger but also a delinquent with red hair! Tutor Nachi, who is even prepared to face even death, starts to see Soushi's cute side...?!



(Source: Kodansha, translated)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Tokieda no Kakushiaji" (時枝さんのかくし味).

mangas.title: Angel Buddy
mangas.description: To others, Soo-Ho might appear a little strange. But to Soo-Ho, there's much more to "life" than the average person may ever know. And that's because Soo-Ho sees spirits. At first he thought his "abilities" were limited to the average ghost-y here and there, but one day he witnesses a real life angel floating in midair and staring at him. And then he promptly breaks said angel's wing on accident. Soo-Ho's had many a ghost follow him around in his short life, but he's never had to take of an angel… nor a spirit quite so handsome as Taker.

mangas.title: Haru to Midori
mangas.description:
Midori isn't good with people, and at 31 years old, she feels like she has no place in life.


One day, she attends the funeral of a close friend of hers from junior high school, Tsugumi. Unable to forget about her, she has a vision of the young friend she knew standing above her — only it isn't the girl she once knew, but her daughter, Haruko.



This is the story of the relationship between a woman without a place and a child without a mother.



Note: Chapter count includes the bonus chapters "Haru and Midori Special 1" and "Haru and Midori Special 2."

mangas.title: I Wanna Be Your Girl
mangas.titleNative: カノジョになりたい君と僕
mangas.synonyms: The Woman You Are and Me
mangas.description: Hime Sakuragaike has secretly been in love with her childhood friend Akira Yonezawa since they were kids, but Hime only recently found out that Akira identifies as female. Although surprised, Hime offers her full support, and this is initially kept a secret between them for a few years, but Akira decides to start living as a girl full-time upon starting high school with Hime. However, since Akira garners a certain amount of attention, Hime takes it upon herself to aggressively stick up for Akira whenever necessary. Not wanting Akira to be singled out as an object of ridicule, Hime decides that her only option is to put herself in Akira's shoes.

mangas.title: Lonely Castle in the Mirror
mangas.synonyms: The Solitary Castle in the Mirror
mangas.description:
Kokoro is a junior high school student—but after years of bullying, she's become so anxious that she no longer goes to school. One day, she's pulled through her full-length mirror into a castle in another dimension by a girl in a wolf mask. The mysterious girl tells Kokoro and six other kids that they are all competing in a scavenger hunt. If one of them finds a key that unlocks a secret room, that person will get one wish granted. As long as they observe the rules of the world, they can come and go as they please. The seven kids gradually grow closer as they explore the castle, but the scavenger hunt is never far from anyone's mind. After all, only one of them can win and receive their heart's desire.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Spring Horse
mangas.description: A young woman flees a corrupted kingdom, always expecting her family to come after and kill her. A surprising, simple story of finding light in darkness.

mangas.title: Shuuden Elegy
mangas.description:
Volume includes:


1. Gyakusou Escape (逆走エスケープ, Reversed Escape)

2. Alone Again

3. Kuuki no Kyoukai (空気の境界, Boundary of Atmosphere)

4. Aka to Ao (赤と青, Red and Blue)

5. Shuuden Elegy (終電エレジー, Last Train Elegy)

mangas.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
mangas.synonyms: Josie, der Tiger und die Fische
mangas.description:
College student Tsuneo loves the ocean and the creatures it harbors, and he dreams of studying abroad in faraway waters. All he needs is enough funds to go, so when a girl in a wheelchair suddenly barrels into his life, he readily agrees to work part-time as her caretaker. Getting close to the prickly Josee is easier said than done, but before he can give up, an impromptu trip to the beach shows them both that sometimes, they must take that first plunge to see the wonders that await. The hit animated film based on the striking story by Seiko Tanabe has been beautifully illustrated by Nao Emoto and collected in this single omnibus edition!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: The chapter count includes an epilogue.

mangas.title: Odagiri-san ni wa, Kirikirimai
mangas.titleNative: オダギリさんには、キリキリ舞い
mangas.description:
"I know I am no match for him, but these feelings are overflowing out…!!"

Four girls have fallen in love with boys older than them: the four Odagiri, each one with their own great personality.

To be avoided, to love, and to be loved too much (!?)… This is the start of four love stories, of four girls who can't hold back their feelings and are making their way to the adult world!

mangas.title: Tokubetsu ni Naritai.
mangas.description: It's only during rainy days that Kae can get closer to Ichi, the most popular guy in the school, because he always gets under her umbrella. But Kae wants to be close to him everyday, not only during rainy days. What can she do to be special to him?

mangas.title: Shoujo, Shoujo, Shoujo nano.
mangas.titleNative: 少女、少女、少女なの。 佐藤ざくり短編集
mangas.description:
A collection of one-shots centering on first love.

1. Shoujo, Shoujo, Shoujo nano.

2. Tengaikodoku-kei Girl

3. Under Heaven

4. Hanbun wa Ai de Dekitemasu.

5. On the Bed

6. Plastic no Kiss

mangas.title: Kimi ga Tonari ni Iru Dake de: Aisubeki Doubutsutachi
mangas.titleNative: 君がとなりにいるだけで ～愛すべき動物たち～
mangas.synonyms: As Long As You're By My Side
mangas.description:
Anthology of stories by different Shoujo/Josei Authors


Cover illustration: Youko Nemu

1. Borderline (ボーダーライン) [Youko Nemu]

2. Akatsuki no Stallion (黎明のスタリオン) [Chie Shinohara]

3. Ashita no Nyaata (明日のニャータ) [Keiko Nishi]

4. Hibi Kore Neko Jitsu (日々是猫日) [Akiko Hatsu]

5. Bokura Shinbun (ぼくら新聞) [Meiko Ousaka]

6. Sorekara (それから) [Hozumi]

7. Neko ni Umare Kawatta Boku wa (猫に生まれ変わった僕は) [Asuka Sakurawa]

8. Kyou wa Shuppatsu no Hi (今日は出発の日) [Eiko Oouchi]

9. 04992 [Est Em]

mangas.title: Kimi to Wonderland
mangas.description: Morimura Nobara, 15 years old. Because of a fall from the cliff three years ago, she can hear the voices of animals. Once she got used to it, she notices that there's a guy's voice that says 'I can hear you clearly'.

mangas.title: Miho to Yuuko
mangas.description:
These are the lives of the cool, composed Miho and the gentle, easygoing Miho!



Miho and Yuuko are complete opposites, but they're the best of friends. They fall in love with people together, they worry together, they cry and laugh and get mad together. They're girls you can find anywhere, but their daily lives, friendships, and romances are just a little bit different. No matter how harsh the world might be, they'll keep strutting on in their heels!



Included one-shot:
Seifuku Play☆Dreamer

mangas.title: My Purrfect Boss!
mangas.description: Sunwoo is thrilled to be starting his new job! Full of energy and enthusiasm, he's eager to please Manager Kang. The problem is, he keeps making dumb mistakes and getting in trouble. Things come to a head one night after work when he pours soju all over his boss. Typical! But hang on… Why is Manager Kang blushing like that? And what are those cat ears sprouting from his head?! After discovering his boss' secret, it isn't long before Sunwoo has him purring with pleasure…

mangas.title: Kimi ni Happiness
mangas.description: Bouyant girl Aizawa Yume falls for the cool boy in her class, Kashiwagi Kou—who tickles people’s noses with a sweet scent and only smiles from time to time. Slowly, Yume develops feelings for Kou-kun... but one day after school, she catches him with Hitohana-san, the girl with a bad personality and equally bad reputation!

mangas.title: Yiska
mangas.description: Set in a rural area of South America, a lone young boy decides to accompany an old man to the Mexican border in exchange for money, while also learning about each other on the journey.

mangas.title: One-sided Love x Alliance
mangas.description:
Akito fell in love the moment he saw Kiriya, a part-time math instructor, while on the school's rooftop. Even though they have never talked, Akito looks forward to every time he can spy on Kiriya from the rooftop. One day when Akito sees Kiriya, Akito rushes in to see why this math teacher is crying alone. In a panic, Akito asks Kiriya to teach him math. As they spend more time together, Akito realizes Kiriya is in love with another teacher at their school. Akito refuses to give up on Kiriya, though, and proposes they enter a One-sided Love x Alliance!



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Glasses Cloth and Playlist
mangas.description: Two people in the catalogue department fall in love, get quickly married, and emigrate to another country, leaving their positions to be filled by new recruits "Bada Lee" and "Seomin Hyun." While Bada manages song playlists, and Seomin hoards glasses cloths, the two are competing rivals.

mangas.title: Teacup Toy Boy
mangas.titleNative: ティーカップトイボーイ
mangas.description:
17-year-old Kento Toi awakes one morning to find he's shrunk down to the size of a doll, but his doctor says he's in perfect health... Except for one thing: Kento's love for an older boy at school has made his heart grow bigger, which could be perilous! Now, he's got to either get a boyfriend or get shot down, or the swelling could be his doom! Talk about an awkward first crush! Not to mention, his childhood friend Yuki seems to have something in mind for Kento as well... A thrilling, fantastical love story! This manga also contains the following works: "Happily Ever After, Prince-Style" and "How to Discipline a Bad Boyfriend"



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: I Love You the Most in the Entire Universe
mangas.titleNative: 宇宙でいちばん君が好
mangas.synonyms: I love you the best in the galaxy
mangas.description:
One day while harvesting vegetables, Minoru catches a young boy munching away on his family's tomatoes. The boy introduces himself as Sora and claims to be an alien looking for his bride. Minoru takes in the seemingly lost child, but Sora grows up rapidly and starts to court Minoru..?



Includes one shot: Koisuru Kaori (恋する香り)

mangas.title: Hot Retribution
mangas.description:
What would you do if everything you worked for, everything you were promised was just suddenly taken away?



I, Heyun Jiang, worked my entire life to lead the multinational company built from the ground up by my late father and his best friend. Cheng Ding, you were given controlling stakes in this company through awful betrayal and broken vows. There's a fire between us that can't be denied, but I cannot let you claim what is rightfully mine!



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: From Here It Is A Secret
mangas.titleNative: ここからはオフレコで
mangas.description: Minehito is a professional interviewer covering the famous idol group Strobe ☆ Light, which means he often interacts with the group - especially the group's so-called 'Prince Charming' Rui Shina. When the group was starting, it was Rui's charm that caught Minehito's eye on stage, to which the latter decided to help the group kick off to stardom. To Minehito's surprise, Rui was not the prince charming he expected. Instead, he was faced with a talkative and loud persona - Rui's real self, which is constantly kept secret by the group and their manager in vain. Minehito is unfazed, though. After all, everyone has a secret, including himself: his hobby is crossdressing. What happens when Rui, of all people, finds about his secret?

mangas.title: Hand in Hand
mangas.synonyms: เมื่อไหร่จะรักฉันสักที
mangas.description:
A freshman at Yuasa's college who's studying craft & design - Satoru Arimura - is a seriously perverted hand fetishist. Their hands accidentally brushed in the library, and now he thinks it's fate! He says Yuasa has "the hands of his dreams," and keeps coming to see him (well, his hands) every day, bugging him for photos, sketches, and studies!! While annoyed at first, Yuasa realizes how serious Satoru is about his craft, and ends up letting him sketch his hands. One day, Satoru sees Yuasa cut his finger, and insists on licking the wound to "disinfect" it... which makes Yuasa's heart race! Although, Yuasa does freak out at the bulge in Satoru's pants while he's going down on his finger!! Satoru's laser-focus on Yuasa's hands starts changing to an interest in Yuasa himself, while Yuasa's getting frustrated at Satoru's fixation on his hands...... Will their relationship take a turn for the romantic......? Find out in this love story spiced with freaky fetishism!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Five Senses
mangas.titleNative: ファイブ センシーズ
mangas.description: Living as a lecturer at a university, Sumi Keisuke, finds himself drawn to a college student, Shiromoto Kotarou, who soon becomes his newest muse. Keisuke ends up obsessively desiring the boy, clinging onto him with his all his five senses.

mangas.title: 8-gatsu no Loss Time
mangas.synonyms: The Loss Time in August, Hachigatsu no Loss Time
mangas.description:
A collection of short stories.

1. Tonari no Bijinsou (隣りの美人草); Lynx 2018-03

2. 8-gatsu no Loss Time (8月のロスタイム); Lynx 2018-05

3. Ochiba Afurete (落ち葉あふれて); Lynx 2018-07

4. Kareki ni Tsubomi (枯れ木に蕾); Lynx 2018-09

5. Fuyu Kitarinaba (冬来たりなば); Lynx 2018-11

mangas.title: Sweet Bitter Sweet
mangas.titleNative: スイート・ビター・スイート
mangas.description:
Mashiba's one reprieve from overwork is buying jewel-like chocolate from a shop he once found by chance. After a long stretch of going without his sweet treat, work finally gives him time to stop by. However, the shop closes right before he arrives, leaving him dejected. Thanks to prince-like chocolatier Minemura's kindness, however, Mashiba receives the opportunity to taste test new products. The sweet taste of chocolate and kindness makes him cry. Anyone would blush from the combination of sweet treats, a kind, handsome man, and a warm, consoling hand to rub their back. But, one day, Minemura makes things physical when the two of them leave his shop...!



(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: It's a Beautiful Day
mangas.titleNative: いっつあびゅうてぃふるでい
mangas.description: The one-shot tells a story about the late Kenji Endō, the real-life musician that was the inspiration for Kenji from 20th Century Boys!

mangas.title: Dame na Watashi ni Koishite Kudasai
mangas.titleNative: ダメな私に恋してください
mangas.description: Michiko is an unemployed 30-year-old. She has just broken up with a younger boyfriend whom she supported financially until she drained all of her savings. Michiko then has a chance meeting with a former boss she used to dislike.

mangas.title: Koi wa Inamono Komarimono
mangas.titleNative: 恋は異なもの困りもの
mangas.description:
One day, Takeda, an overly serious model student, suddenly received a passionate confession of love from his rival Fukamachi, a frivolous elite who's top tier in looks, brains and athletic abilities. Takeda has only ever seen Fukamachi in a hostile manner and he's been going all out in rejecting the latter's persistent advances.



Then one night, he got dragged into helping Fukamachi who was out helping his private detective brother to look for a lost cat. That's when Takeda saw an unexpected side of Fukamachi who he always thought he would never be able to get along with...



This is the bumpy high school romance between a carefree, frivolous and handsome natural genius and an overly serious and straightlaced model student who just don't get along.



(Source: Kaiosha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ijiwaru Killer Tune
mangas.titleNative: いじわるキラーチューン
mangas.synonyms: The killer tune which he sings is magic
mangas.description:
Komugi Shirai wakes up every day at 4.30 am, to help in her sister's bakery. At the same time, her neighbor Kirato, a seemingly philandering musician, often returns home... when Komugi goes to a club to watch her best friend's band's concert, the girl finds herself in front of Kirato's band.


(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Sora wo Kakeru Yodaka
mangas.description:
First year student Kohinata Ayumi is asked out by her crush, Shiro! While waiting for her first date with Shiro she receives a mysterious call from one of her classmates, Umine Senko. She then witnesses Umine fall off a building?! What on earth is happening...?!

(Source: Paper Dolls Project)

mangas.title: Mashikaku Rock
mangas.description:
1-3. Mashikaku Rock (マシカク・ロック)

Miyako's living her life diligently following rules, just as her deceased father wanted her to. But one day Azuma Koutarou sees her play guitar and blackmails her to join his band. How will she face it up?

4. Tonari no Hanako-san (となりのハナコさん)

Hanako-san who sits next to me has passed away. I don't know her that well, but for some reason she's always on my mind...

5. Sayonara Sankaku (さよなら さんかく)

I though I would have no trouble having two guys as my childhood friends, but it turns out we are in an unrequited love-triangle.

6. Tsui Me de Otteshimaimashita. (つい目で追ってしまいました。)

His blonde hair stands out so much, it's annoying that it always enter my field of vision. But why do I always notice it?

mangas.title: Kiss Him, Not Me
mangas.titleNative: 私がモテてどうすんだ
mangas.synonyms: Boys Please Kiss Him Instead of Me
mangas.description:
Kae Serinuma is what you'd call a "fujoshi." When she sees boys getting along with each other, she loves to indulge in wild fantasies! One day her favorite anime character dies and the shock causes her to lose a ton of weight. Then four hot guys at school ask her out, but that isn't exciting to her at all — she'd rather see them date each other!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

mangas.title: Shortcake Cake
mangas.titleNative: ショートケーキケーキ
mangas.description:
Ten Serizawa has a two-hour commute through the mountains to high school every day, so she can't spend much time hanging out with her friends in the afternoon. She decides to move into the local boardinghouse, where one of her friends and three other boys are living. Ten's friends consider her to be as oblivious as a rock when it comes to noticing boys and falling in love, but will she be able to keep her calm and steady heart in her new living situation?



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Behind the Desks
mangas.description: On his first day working as a new teacher at his alma mater, Sunny Day Boys High School, Lee Taesung is welcomed by the bright and sunny smile of Seo Sunny, a warmhearted chemistry teacher. Feeling immediately drawn to Sunny, who resembles his first love from high school, Taesung tries to hold back his feelings by keeping his distance. But still, Taesung can't help but be pulled in by Sunny's irresistible charm.

mangas.title: The Baker on the First Floor
mangas.description:
Sun Hwa is a BL artist using his room as a secret base to draw his work. One day, he gets caught working on his comic by a handsome blond man. Later, he finds out that this man is the new baker on the first floor. But there's just more to this man than simply his looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Hanatte Okenai Aitsu ni Tsuite
mangas.titleNative: 放っておけないあいつについて
mangas.description:
1) Hanatte Okenai Aitsu ni Tsuite (Can't Leave Him Alone)

1.5) Sono Go no ni Hito to Yujin Hitori (Then Two People and One Friend)

2) Haru to Junai (Spring and Pure Love)

3) Katakoi Symmetry (Single Love Symmetry)



4) Ijiwaru Shinai de extras

4.1) Tsumekiri (Nail Clippers)

4.2) Date no Owari ni (After The Date)

4.3) Chotto Kuyashii (A Little Bit Annoying)

4.4) Serizawa-san to Mushi (Serizawa-san and The Bug)

4.5) Katou-kun to Serizawa-san to Onsen Ryokan (Katou-kun and Serizawa-san at The Hot Springs)

mangas.title: Just Between Friends
mangas.titleNative: 幼馴染みの下半身事情
mangas.description:
You've got a secret... down there? Just tell me, 'cause I can't hold back anymore!!


Satoru's just started going out with his best friend from elementary school, Aya. They're happy together, but it's about time they took things into the bedroom. Satoru makes the first move, kissing Aya and reaching into his pants, only to get... rejected...!?

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Boku wa Kimi dake no Mono
mangas.description: A playboy who has learned jealousy and an honor student who becomes more and more desirable the more he is embraced. Friends with benefits, lovers, and beyond... A story of a couple whose feelings and distance deepen.

mangas.title: Wild And Willing
mangas.description:
Bau is a handsome, hardworking woodcutter living deep in the mountains, brewing rice wine and praying for just one thing: a partner. He begged the Mountain God for a soulmate, but all he got was a thieving water deer trashing his fields. That is, until he finds a man passed out naked next to a broken jar of wine. With sharp fangs and a body built like a god, Bau is certain his prayers have finally been answered and he wastes no time in seducing his guest. What follows is a chaotic, sweet, and incredibly steamy cohabitation. As Bau leads the way with his relentless charms, the two must navigate their new life together and the surprising consequences of their "divine" union.

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Osananajimi ga Do M de Tsundere Nan desu ga
mangas.titleNative: 幼なじみがドMでツンデレなんですが
mangas.synonyms: บทเรียนรักฉบับสาย M
mangas.description: Suzume is a total and utter masochistic bottom. He blows his nights having fun with guys, no strings attached. His crazy lifestyle then catches the attention of his childhood friend, Momo. Suzume knows this and also the fact that Momo likes him, but he pretends to be oblivious. But one day, Momo tells him that he's always loved him, but...

mangas.title: Long Night Sweet Porno
mangas.titleNative: ロングナイトスイートポルノ
mangas.description:
Working in a general store, Asami doesn't have any luck with men. Disadvantaged by his nature of taking care of people and responding to people telling him "I like you," lunatics, sugar babies, and abusive men lined up for him, one after the other.



The next one will be a normal partner... As Asami thought this, a beautician named Shitara appeared before him.



He is dumbfounded when Shitara approaches him with a flirtatious "Do you like me?" He firmly rejects him, but Shitara isn't discouraged in the slightest. Despite Asami thinking that he can't have a straight man as a partner, one day, he learns of Shitara's lonely past...?

mangas.title: Sweet Spot
mangas.synonyms: スイート・スポット
mangas.description:
Geonyeong Yoon is the ace pitcher of the professional baseball team, "Embo Elephants". One day, the team mascot, Funz the Elephant, starts to bother him.
The strange war of nerves between the two slowly transforms into something else.

(Source: Lalatoon)

mangas.title: Finally Living With My Hater
mangas.synonyms: Finally Living Together with My Anti-Fan | Zhongyu He Hei Fen Tongjule
mangas.description: The "lovely" daily life between an idol and his pro hater!

mangas.title: A Kiss that Stains the Innocence
mangas.titleNative: イノセントを穢すキス
mangas.description: Ombra is a rough type who lives alone in the mountains. One day a man asks him for help: Prince Sirius, the son of the king and his concubine. It's been ten years since the king razed Ombra's village to the ground, killing his parents and anyone he's ever loved. Now he's consumed by emotions, conflicted by his desire for revenge and perhaps something else. Meanwhile Sirius, who can't remember his past, doesn't recognize Ombra's internal struggle, only aware of his growing feelings for the man...

mangas.title: Yurufuwa-kun ni wa Wake ga Aru
mangas.titleNative: ゆるふわくんにはワケがある
mangas.description:
Rintarou and Natsu are childhood friends who have always been together since they were small. Even after becoming high school students, Natsu is still a crybaby and Rintarou is still affected by his crying face. However, one day Natsu consults Rintarou about a female stalker and asks him. "I want you to pretend to be my lover. Rintarou agrees in order to protect Natsu but he's perplexed by Natsuk's "lover's appeal" everyday... Moreover, they even do lewd things to set the mood. The excitement is too much and when faced with the male side of the Natsu he doesn't know. Rintarou ends up not knowing what to do..



(Source: Gush, translated)

mangas.title: LOVE and nosebleed
mangas.description:
1-2, 6. Ai to Hanaji (愛と鼻血)

"LOVE and Nosebleed": The moment Aoba has been dreaming about is finally here… But for some reason, Aoba can't… Instead, he (involuntarily) expresses his excitement about having sex with Mano… with a gushing nosebleed. Does this mean he'll never be able to be intimate with the man of his dreams… EVER!?


3-5. Onaji Hikari wo Mitai to Negaeba (同じ光を見たいと願えば)

"If I Wished to See the Same Light": Sceneries. That is what art student Shinozaki prefers to paint. Even though he specializes in painting sceneries, he knows himself that these pieces are lacking in something… but what?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Sore wa Are da, Ai Kamo ne
mangas.titleNative: それはアレだ、愛かもね
mangas.description:
Izaki is a young lad who loves cakes and currently enjoys being able to work at the cake shop that he deems has "flavor that can't be unrivaled!" But, Takara, the patissier who makes the cake is an abnormally unsocial guy. Since Takara is the son of the world famous patissier, he completely distrusts others because he is used to being compared to his father and being used by others.

Takara is completely charmed by Izaki who honestly tells him "I have no interest in you, but the cakes that you make are superb!"

Takara confesses his feelings to Izaki, but instead Izaki is completely turned off by it…!?

mangas.title: Kuroi Inu
mangas.description:
Kei had been pining for his childhood friend Kuro, who was a year younger than him. Other people teased him that they are like owner and dog.

Tired of spending all his time with Kuro, Kei was about to join a drinking party to try to find a girlfriend, when Kuro confessed love for him!

This is a love story about the hidden obsessions of the younger childhood friend.



(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Savile Row no Yuuwaku
mangas.titleNative: サヴィル・ロウの誘惑
mangas.description:
Tell me how you show your sex appealㅡ

Shoemaker Jin has one problem, it's that he can't make shoes with ornate and glamorous design due to his serious and stubborn character. Although when he asked his childhood friend Kei for his help, Kei suggested giving up his virginity in order to bring out Jin's sex appeal. But even before he loses his virginity, Kei held him andㅡ?!


A tailor made love story between two young artisans.

(Source: SaltyPotatoesTrans)

mangas.title: Smell Fetish
mangas.titleNative: スメルフェティッシュ
mangas.description:
Shirogane, a high school boy who suffers from extreme sensitivity to odors, finally discovered a certain aroma that can soothe his painful everyday life: uptight, glasses-wearing, Toguro's scent. They used to fight like cats and dogs. But one day, Shirogane became aware of his feelings...



(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

mangas.title: Our Encounter
mangas.description: "Even in another world, I will only love you. Someday you will come there and find me. I will wait for that day." After coming home from work, Myung Shiwoo unexpectedly finds someone in historical clothing lying outside his door. Is there such a thing as destiny?

mangas.title: Kirakira-kun to Imaichi-kun
mangas.titleNative: キラキラくんとイマイチくん
mangas.synonyms: You're Shining Star, I'm Clumsy Boy.
mangas.description: Hotta couldn't find a proper job even after graduating college two years ago, so he's still working part time at the same convenience store, he also has no friends. One day, a new part timer joins, Ryouta Kashiwagi, a young and handsome college freshman. Ryouta is popular and promising, he's on a different level, that's why Hotta is surprised to hear his sudden confession.

mangas.title: Wakarazuya no Renai Houteishiki
mangas.titleNative: わからずやの恋愛方程式
mangas.synonyms: สมการรักเดิมพันหัวใจ
mangas.description: Nishihiro the boy who is bad in human relationships, secretly harbour romantic feeling towards his one and only friend, Nakano. Eventhough he never intended to reveal his feeling, he's caught by the playful Kutou. Then as a joke Kutou expressed that he likes Nishihiro and he can depend on him next time. Although he refused Kutou's suggestion, because of Nakano, he's unconsciously clung to Kutou's side.

mangas.title: Threads of Love
mangas.description:
Katsuyuki returns to the town he lived in as a child after being away for ten years, but he's faced with nothing but trouble. In order to try warding off evil spirits, he goes to a shrine to pray. There, he meets an oddly-dressed child with furry ears and a tail, who only Katsuyuki can see. The child follows him home, asking to "feed," and proceeds to kiss Katsuyuki and swallow his spit... "What the? Did he just get taller...? And now he wants to mate with me...!?" The threads of fate interweave in this mysterious anthropomorphic fantasy!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Kainarasu Hazuga Aegasarete Komattemasu
mangas.titleNative: 飼いならすはずが、喘がされて困ってます。
mangas.description:
"I think I've found a great way to relieve stress"

Naito Akira: Works at a design office. 29 years old. Work is tough. His subject of romantic interest: men. He has a policy - to never go to bed with the same person twice. After meeting the sexually inexperienced Seo at a bar, he begins giving him sex lessons to kill time. This straight man was meant to be his to ravish, but things aren't going as expected? A young, earnest ikemen and a beautiful man, romantically hurt in the past, engage in sex lessons on Friday nights.

mangas.title: Outside Flower
mangas.titleNative: アウトサイドフラワー
mangas.description: Masamoto, a 29-year-old guy. He has serious problems relating to people, in addition to being single. But, to change that, one day he decides to go to a gay meeting place and get a date. But, while he was hesitating whether to go in or not, a high school student appears who seems to be lost, Sakuya, and he catches his eye. This action immediately caused him to run away from the place. But one day, the two of them meet again at the cinema. After talking for a while, both realize that they have similar tastes. But then, Sakuya-san says he'll help Masamoto get a partner...?!

mangas.title: Kamatte Hoshi no?
mangas.description: A freshman in college, Amano, is taken a liking by a mysterious senpai, Kamishiro, who raises chicks. When Kamishiro hugs him out of nowhere in their first meeting, he thinks this senpai is crazy, but as he spends more time with him he sees how kind he is. But one day, while Amano is playing with the chicks, Kamishiro kisses him out of nowhere! An airheaded research student and a kuudere freshman's love story.

mangas.title: Little Bird, Want To Fall In Love?
mangas.description:
In love with their respective brothers, high school students Yoh and Tatsuki pretend to date. Their plan is to make each other's brother jealous... until one day, the act starts to become real. Now that Tatsuki is starting to think Yoh's purity is cute, he absentmindedly kisses him! He's all in and offers to teach Yoh the ins and outs of steamy kisses. The little bird is more than willing to accept.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Love Awakening x Syndrome
mangas.description:
College student Sano, who is curious about love but has never felt it, decides to go to associate professor Kigami, who's famous for doling love advice out to his students. When he's mistaken for a part-time assistant, however, Sano gets roped into cleaning the Archaeology department's room for Kigami instead. Impressed by his work, Kigami gives him advice in exchange for his trouble and suggests Sano be his teacher's assistant for real. But would his advice still successfully snag Sano a girlfriend, even though Kigami's only ever liked guys?


(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Motto! Hinekure Chaser
mangas.titleNative: もっと！ひねくれチェイサー
mangas.description:
"The hero I've been longing for has finally become my very own hero... It was meant to be!"



Hozumi and Yamato finally were able to communicate with each other and start dating. They decided that, during the summer holidays, Hozumi would stay over at Yamato's –although their relationship didn't progress much because of Hozumi's ignorance.



On top of that his father finds out about their relationship and takes Hozumi back home...



The sequel of Hinekure Chaser! The love story between two people that can't be honest and detour in love!



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Renai Nante Itashimasen!
mangas.titleNative: 恋愛なんていたしません!
mangas.description: Featuring Hokuto, Naoto's brother from Renai Nante Yurushimasen, and his lover.

mangas.title: Kawaii Obaka-kun
mangas.description:
A gaudy young man named Taiichi, captivated by big boobs, accidentally dented the high-class car of a Yakuza member. In order to pay for repair fees, he ends up having to make a post online, selling himself to prostitution. At the Love Hotel he was called out to, he was met with an unfashionable man with messy hair. However, this lame man told him, "I'll give you money in exchange for your obedience."
