At his wit's end, Taiichi was prepared to lose his anal virginity, however----…



Also, the slapstick love comedy about a College student who took in a man with an amazing dragon tattoo on his back, and other short stories are compiled together.

mangas.title: Paramour
mangas.description:
A family misunderstanding leaves Merry and his mother to live on an island away from the city, and away from Merry's father. Twenty years later, Merry's mother falls sick, and she asks Su-Ho to help care for them. Believing Su-Ho is his half-brother, Merry can't understand his aversion to touching. But there's a family secret yet to be revealed, and Su-Ho is having a hard time keeping himself away from Merry...



(Source: Lezhin, edited)

mangas.title: The Walls Between Us
mangas.description:
"If you want a boyfriend that bad, I'll go out with you." Growing up next-door neighbors, Reita Kikuchi and Makoto Sakurai's parents are friends, and the two of them have known each other forever. But one day Makoto is suddenly thrown into a relationship with that narcissistic and self-absorbed playboy, Reita—her old childhood friend! Follow Makoto's adventures as she navigates the ups and downs of dating the egotistical boy-next-door in the first installment of this romantic comedy!


(Source: Kodansha USA)


Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Namaiki Kareshi
mangas.description: Kashiwagi plans on asking his girlfriend to marry him. When he catches her cheating on him with another man he's left in shock. Despairing over his misfortune, he gets drunk at the small pub he frequents only to wake up naked and in bed with the owner's nephew, Izumi, who's only eighteen!?

mangas.title: Tadatada Suki to Iu Dake de
mangas.titleNative: ただただ好きというだけで
mangas.description: Totoki, a delinquent by circumstances, has fallen in love with Yoshizawa who is the only person to ever show Totoki any kindness. And, while Totoki is too shy to confess his feelings and always ends up running away, Yoshizawa unexpectedly takes the lead?! What will become of the two now?

mangas.title: Itonaga-kun no Koi no Ito
mangas.description:
Itonaga was bullied during middle school because he had unusually small eyes which gradually made him socially awkward. At college, when he finally thought of starting things anew, he came across his ex-bully, Sanada, popular and sociable.

With his dark past coming to haunt his present, he tries to avoid Sanada at first but finally gives up. But things unexpectedly took a shocking turn soon after? What are Sanada's true intentions? What is he really aiming at?

mangas.title: Miwaku Shikake: Amai Wana
mangas.titleNative: 魅惑仕掛け 甘い罠
mangas.description:
Amami’s a low-man on the totem pole at a tiny start-up firm—and his superior Hachidori really seems to have it out for him. They’ve got history themselves, which helps nothing, but one evening, Amami learns Hachidori’s deepest, darkest secret…which tilts his impression of the guy on its head.



Includes side story: Konya wa Pajama Party★ (今夜はパジャマパーティー★)

mangas.title: Konya mo Nemurenai
mangas.description: Shy freshman college student Rikiya knows he likes guys, but has never been in a relationship, only able to look on without expressing his feelings. Living on his own for the first time he decides to try and change his life and joins a gay dating site. Everything seems perfect until he finds himself about to be attacked with nowhere to turn yet desperately hoping for help, when a guy crawls through the wall and says, "There's no helping it. What's your wish?"

mangas.title: Outsider Communication
mangas.titleNative: アウトサイダー・コミュニケーション
mangas.description:
Seki, who hangs out with the slacker students at his high school is discovered working part-time by the elite student Iwashiro. Despite not knowing each other, they fight, and while Seki is trying to get rid of him, he accidentally makes Iwashiro fall down the stairs. Having sprained his ankle, Iwashiro forces Seki to help him. What will happen when these two with completely different personalities start spending time together?



(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Sweet Heart Trigger
mangas.titleNative: スイートハート・トリガー
mangas.description:
Cole, a gay college student, has a crush on the boy next door, Alex Rodriguez. Cole can only watch Alex from a distance, all the girls flocking to the one he wants while being forced to satisfy his urges alone. Then one day, that distance starts to disappear when a drunken Alex falls asleep in Cole's bed. Emboldened, Cole goes to a costume party in hopes of talking to Alex and ends up confessing his true feelings. Alex is used to this kind of thing, casually brushing it off, but Cole doesn't know what to do and comes up with...!



A dark-haired hunk and an average blonde gay guy; two polar opposites meet in this homosexual-romance slice-of-life drama!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Senpai, This Can't Be Love!
mangas.description:
Friendly, confident, amazing at his job...All words applicable to veteran CG designer Yanase who was asked to teach the hardworking new hire, Kaneda, the ropes! Although excited about the prospect, he begins to lose heart in the face of Kaneda's frosty indifference. However, on the inside, Kaneda's been struggling to play it cool whenever Yanase so much as pats him on the back...



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: My Starry Sky
mangas.description:
Just when Yeonduk thought he was finally going to be free of his tormentor (and family friend and crush, might we add), Seo Skyler – coolest kid in school – saunters his way into the same classroom. Skyler might look blessed (his sister's even in a girl group), but he's got some family issues that only Yeonduk can understand. Yeonduk is more than just star-struck, though, and when Skyler starts acting nice and walking to school with him, he can't help but hope there might finally be more between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Konyakusei
mangas.description:
Hanaoka Sanchi married Saionji Koichi from the same high school because of the recent death of both her parents. But will they truly fall in love with each other along the way?


Included chapters: 0.



Included one-shot:

Volume 2: Sayonarakakushi

mangas.title: Hinekure Chaser
mangas.description:
"My hero alone...is how it was supposed to be! Why is that guy always by his side?!"
Hirokawa Hozumi was saved by Odajima Yamato, whom he then fell in love with, but because Yamato's childhood friend Misaki is always by his side, Hozumi becomes frustrated. Every day he takes out his anger on Misaki and Yamato gets angry with him. Although he is glad about any kind of feelings Yamato has for him, Yamato one day punishes him with a kiss...?

A story about two people who come together even though they're not honest with each other, and their long road to love.

mangas.title: A Trace of You
mangas.description: After a terrible fire all but consumes Si-Hu's home, his life has finally gone back to normal except…he has no memories. An amnesiac, he can't remember much beyond his own name and the café he works at. Then, one day, his former classmate Ye-Seong Min walks in and helps Si-Hu remember everything that ever mattered: they were in love. From the ashes of his life, comes an old flame.

mangas.title: Can't Take My Eyes Off You!
mangas.description: Taeho's barely scraping by after moving out of his parent's home when he catches just the lucky break he needs: an easy, overpaid job as the manager of top celebrity, Wooyeon (overpaid being the key word here). The job starts to take a weird turn when Taeho notices that people tend to like Wooyeon a little too much... Fans are one thing, but the adoration Wooyeon ignites is something else. And why is everyone at Wooyeon's agency related to him? Meanwhile, Wooyeon can't figure out Taeho doesn't adore him like everyone else. How long will it be before Taeho discover's Wooyeon's secret...?

mangas.title: I Want to Do What Lovers Do.
mangas.titleNative: トモダチ以上のこと、シたい。
mangas.description:
Suga and Hara have been close friends since junior high and became housemates in university. Hara, a cool guy and popular with girls, is completely unaware of his own popularity, and Suga is proud to have him as his closest friend. Although Hara makes him feel uneasy by how much he looks after him if Suga's honest he actually slightly enjoys it...... Suga ends up developing feelings towards Hara that go beyond friendship, but he's happy with the way things are between them. It's just nice for him to be by Hara's side. One night, Hara tells him that he'll be coming home late. Suga, who's finally able to spend some time at home alone, finds Hara's jacket lying on the sofa. As he takes it in his hand, Suga's scent pervades the air, and Hara gets unwittingly turned on...



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Biting the Tiger
mangas.description:
Yun-Ho is a vocalist of a rock band with a painful past of losing all of his family in a car accident when he was just a little boy. One day, Yun-Ho went to a gathering to hear that his beloved Gyeong-Hun, who has always consoled him in his dark days, had fallen in love with another man.

Yun-Ho runs out from shock and bumps into a mysterious man, Han-Ul who happens to be a mythical tiger. When they run into each other, Han-Ul senses a sweet scent coming from Yun-Ho, and although Han-Ul has never been interested in humans he finds himself intrigued by Yun-Ho.

mangas.title: Tied Up In Twins
mangas.description:
Sarang loves Jinwoo, Jinwoo loves Woojung, and Woojung loves… you get the idea. But after a mix-up of affections and tangled signals, can they find a happy ending stuck between love and friendship, or will even family bonds be lost in heartache?

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Wolf in the House
mangas.description:
After ending an on-again, off-again relationship of 10 years, Min-Suk decides to foster a Siberian husky named Bexan to mark the start of his new single life. He can't wait to cuddle with his new furry roommate, take him on walks, and play fetch. But Bexan is no ordinary dog...and when night falls, Min-Suk is in for a surprise.



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Dekoboko Sugar Days
mangas.description:
Yuujirou Matsukaze has been close friends with Rui Hanamine since the two of them were children, and at that time, Yuujirou was the one who stood up for and took care of his adorable, soft-hearted friend. But as it turns out, Yuujirou's childhood dreams end up growing a little too big to handle — or, rather, too tall!

At over six feet in height, the cheerful and happy-go-lucky Rui towers over his would-be protector... and still has no idea Yuujirou's had a crush on him since they were kids!

mangas.title: Back to School
mangas.description: Chi-Woo's got issues. Upon returning to school after the "incident" last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyu-Jin - class president and model student - won't stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Ji-Hyun, a tattooed hunk from Chi-Woo's dark past. It's gonna be a tough year…

mangas.title: A Guy Like You
mangas.description: Go Si-Won's dreams are constantly visited by the clever, beautiful Kang Jin-Ha. In the dream, Jin-Ha keeps on mentioning this "incident" that happened between them but Si-Won can't remember anything! And how can it feel so real? Luckily for Si-Won, hints about the "incident" start to appear and Si-Won is able to regain his memory bit by bit. How will their relationship change at the end of it all?

mangas.title: Out of Control
mangas.description:
Yuri, one of the school's most handsome guys, and Jae-Rim, one of the school's ugliest, collide!...or don't they...Can't understand what's going on between these two! It's Out of Control!!

(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kimi ni Koi Shite Ii Desu ka.
mangas.titleNative: キミに恋していーですか。
mangas.description: Chigira Ruiji is a man born with the face of a demon. Trouble follows him wherever he goes. However, he just wants to live a normal high school life and make some friends, and even fall in love...

mangas.title: Mad Dog
mangas.description: Some people thirst for power while others want nothing more than to live low. Ha-Min has always been resentful of the label that comes with being his father's son—he didn't ask to be born into a mob family! After much trial and error, Ha-Min finally breaks ties with his family and begins to live the life he's dreamed about. That is, until he gets kidnapped and finds himself under the protection of a certain Kwon Se-Hyeok. All Ha-Min wants is his "normal" life back, but Se-Hyeok is as far from normal as a person can get...

mangas.title: Strawberry Love
mangas.titleNative: その恋はいちごのように
mangas.description:
20-year-old university student, Sara Moritani, rushes back to the countryside to help her grandfather with his farm after he's been injured. There, she meets a veteran strawberry farmer named Minori Sugiura, who is 13 years older than she is. He teaches Sara the ropes of strawberry farming. At first, she was frightened by Minori's intimidating demeanor. But after discovering many surprising sides to him, she could feel love taking roots within her heart. On the other side of the relationship, Minori finds himself attracted to Sara. But due to their age difference, he finds it difficult to express his feelings to her... Thus begins a pure and touching love story between these two awkward lovebirds.



(Source: MANGA UP!)

mangas.title: Sayonara, Nanashi no Violin
mangas.titleNative: さよなら、ナナシのバイオリン
mangas.description: This series takes place in an alternate world where objects with names become living creatures, from cats to dogs and even humans. As it so happens, a 2nd year college student who breaks his violin ends up purchasing a "named" violin that can transform into a human. The violin falls in love with Sosuke's playing, but no matter how much they practice, they can't get a decent sound! They'll have to discover a solution to that problem...

mangas.title: Liquor & Cigarettes
mangas.description:
Theo runs the town liquor store—too bad he's a total lightweight! His lifelong best friend, Camilo, runs the cigarette store across the street, and recently, he's been making his attraction to Theo quite clear. Unsure of how he feels about dating a man, Theo accepts Camilo's offer of a trial run at dating, and with a little liquid courage and a lot of heavy petting, Theo sees a whole new side to his childhood friend. Will these new experiences clarify his feelings or only serve to further muddy the waters of love?


(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Wolfull Moon
mangas.description: Tootsuki Yaya can see things nobody else can. One day, she is attacked by a monster-spider, and a puppy comes to her rescue. But when she unties the strange ribbon around its neck, it turns into the Wolf King of the demon world! Finally free after a thousand years, he's out to get the holy maiden who imprisoned him in a canine body for so long. And guess who is her reincarnation...?

mangas.title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim?
mangas.description:
Vice Chairman Youngjun Lee and Secretary Miso Kim have been the star duo of their company for nine years... until Miso suddenly decides to quit! But Youngjun is smart, rich, and used to getting what he wants — and he wants Miso to stay. So when he discovers she's leaving in order to find a husband, the only logical way to keep her at his side is... offering to marry her?! Too bad she's just not that into him!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Hoshi to Kuzu: Don't Worry, Be Happy!
mangas.description: Anzu is poor but very ambitious and aims for a bright future. Her first step is to be student council president but that chance is destroyed by the equally ambitious and egocentric Yamabuki. She just has to settle for being the vice-president.

mangas.title: Uchuu no Hate no Mannaka no
mangas.titleNative: 宇宙の果ての真ん中の
mangas.description: Mirai who has entered in highschool is always alole. Such like a dream, her classmate Twinkle Shinba Rin has invited her to the astronomical departament!! In the club room there is a group of four handsome classmates ☆ The world of dreams will change with this!

mangas.title: Koi ga Michitara
mangas.description:
From a chance encounter due to fallen underwear, Ise and Hishimoto are now dating. Since moving in together, both work and private lives are being lived to the fullest. However, Hishimoto starts to get busy at work, and opportunities to spend leisure time with his lover gradually start to disappear...!



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Canis: Dear Hatter
mangas.description: After taking him in on that rainy day, the mysterious Ryo now lives with the mad hatter, Kutsuna. With his stellar staff's help, business has been booming. However, one fateful day, Kutsuna's rival and long-time friend Gotou informs him that he has been entered into New York Fashion Week. Initially Kutsuna was hesitant to travel, but over time he steels his resolve. Once in New York, Kutsuna encounters some of Ryou old acquaintances...

mangas.title: In My Closet
mangas.description:
When Su-A met Jung for the first time, that's when he knew he liked boys. As the founder of the famous band Attack, Jung was Su-A's idol and more. Years later Su-A follows in his idol's footsteps to become a star but, little did he expect his new manager to be Jung?! Terrified to reveal his true feelings, Su-A spirals deeper into depression and refuses to work until Jung begins working closer with him. He promises to keep training so long as Jung rewards him…



(Source: Tapas)


Note: From Season 3 (chapter 65) the series becomes Mature (R19), Season 1 and 2 are All-Age (R15) even on the full version. Chapter count includes 16 special episodes.

mangas.title: Legend of Exorcism
mangas.description:
Tianbao Period. Kong Hongjun, a young man who was ignorant of worldly affairs, came to Chang'an with three important tasks and entered the Great Tang's Exorcism Department. Inside the department, he led a ragtag group of yao-vanquishing experts together with Li Jinglong, commander of the Longwu Army. And this, is the story of how they wrote out the Great Tang's Yao-vanquishing Records.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Includes prologue and four bonus chapters.

mangas.title: The Tyrant's Only Perfumer
mangas.synonyms: I Became The Sole Perfumer of A Tyrant
mangas.description:
A young woman sick with an incurable illness closes her eyes for the last time, only to wake up as Ariel Winston, an antagonist of the novel she had loved reading before her death. Knowing that death lies before her if she continues down the path the real Ariel has been going towards, she quickly breaks up with Duke Cedric Evans, who is not only the protagonist of the novel, but a man who is cursed with a condition which causes him to become bloodthirsty when he does not smell a specific scent constantly. However, Cedric, who had been forced to date Ariel due to her status as his personal perfumer, suddenly seems reluctant to distance himself from her. Just what is wrong with this man, and how will this change the events of the novel? Will Ariel be able to live the life she wants?



(Source: Copin Comics)

mangas.title: The Monstrous Duke's Adopted Daughter
mangas.synonyms: The Monster Duchess and Contract Princess
mangas.description:
The Speràdo family line possesses a secret: shadow magic. But it's been 100 years since someone last wielded it. When Marquis Speràdo tries to sacrifice Leslie for her favored sister Ellie, little does he know that this awakens the power of darkness in her instead. To escape her family's greed and abuse, Leslie's out to make a deal with the Monstrous Duke: adopt her, and her powers will be at the duke's disposal. Will Leslie escape her parents' cruel grip, or succumb to their evil exploits?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Chapter count includes 20 extra stories.

mangas.title: Pirouette into My Heart
mangas.description: Known as "the little swan" of his ballet studio, Shen has big dreams of leaving the humble farming town he grew up in and shooting to stardom. Though soft-spoken and timid, he meets his match in the stoic, wealthy, and equally as intense Jinyi, who pursues boxing next door. An unlikely pair, they cheer each other on and raise each other up through thick and thin. Determined to achieve their separate ambitions in the midst of their personal troubles, will their deep connection be strong enough to endure the journey and take flight?

mangas.title: The Code of Silence
mangas.description:
The life of an assassin is many things: dangerous, lonely, short... and above all, ill-suited for love. Those were the rules Joaquin agreed to and accepted without question until the fateful day a young man named Davion saved his life. But the life of an assassin is no fairy tale. In an odd twist of fate, Joaquin ended up ripping away everything Davion held dear, and has since taken it upon himself to train the young man on how to get his revenge against everyone involved... including Joaquin himself.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Just for a Meowment
mangas.description:
Orphaned at birth and bullied at work, Myohee has been through countless trials in life. But when she gets scammed by her only friend and ends up bankrupt, Myohee feels as though she'll never find the silver lining to her cloud. She decides to end her own life by jumping from a building, but mid-air, the grim reaper halts her descent, saying her time isn't up yet. She's ordered to live for 100 more days…as a cat! Before she knows it, she's taken to the home of her handsome, aloof boss, Mr. Cha. It seems like the perfect chance to receive the love and care she never had in life…if only Myohee can remain a cat!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: I Was the Male Lead's Ex
mangas.synonyms: I Am the Male Lead's Ex-Girlfriend
mangas.description:
The original Erica was written as the pitiful ex of the novel's male lead, Reo. Now that I'm her, I refuse that pathetic side role, and I'll cast him aside first! But then again… the way he looks at me, with those gentle eyes… No! I must stay strong. All the male leads fall for Juliana anyway. I can't compete with her (she's the protagonist!), but it feels like these men are throwing me into the ring! Should I let the plot run its course or save a few broken hearts and give my destiny a rewrite?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Chapter count includes 15 side story chapters.

mangas.title: My Dress-Up Darling
mangas.titleNative: その着せ替え人形は恋をする
mangas.synonyms: Sono Kisekae Ningyou wa Koi wo suru
mangas.description:
Traumatized by a childhood incident with a friend who took exception to his love of traditional dolls, doll-artisan hopeful Gojou Wakana passes his days as a loner, finding solace in the home ec room at his high school. To Wakana, people like beautiful Kitagawa Marin, a trendy girl who's always surrounded by a throng of friends, is practically an alien from another world. But when cheerful Marin--never one to be shy--spots Wakana sewing away one day after school, she barges in with the aim of roping her quiet classmate into her secret hobby: cosplay! Will Wakana's wounded heart be able to handle the invasion from this sexy alien?!



(Source: Square Enix)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: If You Give Me Flowers, I'll Give You Myself
mangas.synonyms: If You Give Me Flowers, I'll Give You Me
mangas.description:
Haewon's ambitious dream is to discover a rare new flower and be forever remembered in botanist history. Eunseong just wants to get away from the drawn-out fight to inherit control of his father's company, seeking solace in a simpler existence. When these two cross paths in the vast Mongolian desert, the attraction is near magnetic. But no romance is ever that simple, especially not when Haewon is terminally ill and dying. She's desperate to keep her illness a secret just long enough to fulfill her dream. But Eunseong is not willing to let her go, and returning to the life he ran away from may be the only way to save her now. With both of their lives on the line, what does fate have in store for them?



(Source: TappyToon)



Note: Includes two side stories.

mangas.title: My Next Life as a Villainess Side Story: On the Verge of Doom!
mangas.titleNative: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった… 絶体絶命！破滅寸前編
mangas.synonyms: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグ スピンオフ…絶体絶命！破滅寸前編
mangas.description:
What if, when Katarina Claes was reincarnated in the dating sim from the original series, she didn't regain the memories of her past life until she was fifteen? With less than a year to go before her destruction, Katarina must find a way to avoid all possible bad endings!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sica Wolf
mangas.description:
On a mission to find the two most important people in her life, Sica steps foot outside the Magician's Tower for the first time ever! She soon meets Karsus, a mercenary swordsman who looks like her first love. Despite being confused for someone else, Karsus offers to help find the people Sica's looking for if she helps him with his work. Thus the two begin their adventure ― one that will change not only the fate of the Empire, but also their hearts! First love or Karsus… who will Sica choose?

(Source: TappyToon)

mangas.title: This Villainess Wants a Divorce!
mangas.description:
We all hate the greedy villains hell-bent on sabotage. Enter Carnelia Easter, the awful secondary villainess of the romance I'm reading, who trapped the prince in marriage at the behest of the evil empress. I didn't shed a tear when her head's lopped off, but now I'm Carnelia! I gotta play this smart and convince him to divorce me instead! Still, between the prince, the empress, the heroine, the second prince, my terrible health... this story's getting unpredictable. Will I survive after all?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Ginger and the Cursed Prince
mangas.synonyms: Virtues of the Villainess | Virtue Bestowed by the Villainess
mangas.description: For hopeless romantic Ginger Torte, getting engaged to the man of her dreams is a fairy tale come true. It isn't long before she realizes the gut-wrenching truth — her fiancé has been seduced by her rival! The heartbroken Ginger finds solace in a new book that recounts the tale of a young woman and a cursed prince… But to her horror, the protagonist turns out to be none other than her beautiful nemesis, Lerazie! As reality unfolds according to the book, both ladies fall in love with the handsome prince at first sight. Ginger vows to steal both the spotlight and the prince's heart! But, does this story harbor a sinister secret?

mangas.title: The Villainess Turns the Hourglass
mangas.description:
Aria Roscent mercilessly bullied her stepsister Mielle and paid the ultimate price for her misdeeds—but not before Mielle revealed that she'd manipulated Aria into harassing Mielle in the first place! Instead of dying, Aria is sent back in time and gifted a strange hourglass with mysterious powers. Now, Aria's just got one goal: to embrace her role of villainess and utterly destroy Mielle's life!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Villainess Lives Again
mangas.description:
From childhood, Artezia Rosan's happiness was dependent on ensuring the success of her brother. As a master manipulator and schemer, she became his most valuable ally in seizing the empire's throne. That's exactly why her brother's betrayal cut so deeply when Artezia was imprisoned as punishment for all of her crimes. Soon after being rescued by Grand Duke Cedric Ebron, she vows to help him overthrow the cruel new emperor by sacrificing her own life with forbidden magic. Now waking up several years earlier back in time, she will forsake her own family to help Cedric at all costs. They say that blood is thicker than water, but can Artezia destroy her brother while her own romance blossoms amidst the chaos?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢は隣国の王太子に溺愛される
mangas.synonyms: The Villainess Is Being Doted on by the Crown Prince of the Neighboring Country
mangas.description:
On the day before her downfall, Lady Tiararose Lapis Clementille recalls that she is in an otome game that she had once played in her former life. She used to adore the main love interest Prince Hartknights Lapis-Lazuli Lactomuth, but unfortunately, she was not reincarnated as the heroine, but rather as is his worst enemy—the villainess fiancée.



At their graduation ceremony, without blinking an eye, Hartknights condemns Tiararose for alleged crimes, breaks off his engagement, and proclaims the heroine Akari as his new bride-to-be. No matter whether Tiararose is innocent, he banishes her from the kingdom. But before her sentence can be carried out, a shocking figure appears. Aquasteed Marineforest, the prince of a powerful neighboring country, has been harboring feelings for Tiararose for quite some time, and announces his intention to marry her!



Adored by the prince of another kingdom, what awaits the villainess on her path to a happy ending?



(Source: MAL Rewrite)

mangas.title: Atashi no Bambi
mangas.description: Haruko Nanase wasn’t always the brightest student, but through sheer hard work she successfully entered a prestigious high school and is at the top of her class. While riding the train one day, she witnesses a fight involving a guy wearing the same uniform as her. When the fight is over, he demands that she pay him a fee for watching it but she escapes. The escape is not to last though, because the next day the guy turns out to be in the same class, and worse, his seat is next to hers.

mangas.title: Sugar*Soldier
mangas.description:
Makoto is determined to step out of her model sister's shadow and have her own high school debut, but when Makoto's sister shows up at her school unexpectedly things go awry.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Hapi★Supi (はぴ★すぴ)"; Ribon Special Vanilla 2013-Summer.

mangas.title: Nekota no Koto ga Ki ni Natte Shikatanai.
mangas.titleNative: 猫田のことが気になって仕方ない。
mangas.description: Amane Mikiko, better known as Mikki, is an elementary school student who moves a lot and has to transfer schools often. As soon as she makes friends, she has to painfully say goodbye to them. She is determined to not make any new friends at her new school, but it doesn't exactly go her way... especially when she meets a boy with the head of a cat! But hold on... he only looks like that in her eyes?!

mangas.title: Haru x Kiyo
mangas.description:
Although Koharu is a little taller than the average person, she's a 15-year-old girl who lives a much simpler life than the average person. Having no experience with love, she thought she'd spend her days peacefully with her group of ordinary friends. However, a destined encounter will change Koharu!

(Source: Summer Rain)

mangas.title: Houkago x Ponytail
mangas.description: Natsuki, an otaku high-school girl who'd rather spend her money on manga than pretty dresses, accidentally injures a creepy-looking mangaka named Kiritani Taichi. To repay him, she agrees to be his character model until he fully heals. Kiritani turns out to be a popular shoujo mangaka under the name Ichijou Kiriko, who is also Natsuki's favorite author! Plus, underneath that disheveled hair Kiritani is actually a good-looking man! What will become of these two?

mangas.title: Suki ni Naranai yo, Senpai
mangas.titleNative: 好きにならないよ、センパイ
mangas.description: Falling in love with a painting while at a school's festival, Iku is able to meet the gentle high schooler who created it. She falls in love at first sight and with that feeling in her heart, decides to enroll in that high school! But, what happens when she joins the art club and discovers her gentle prince has disappeared and a sleaze ball has taken his place?!

mangas.title: That Wolf-Boy Is Mine!
mangas.description:
After some traumatic experiences, Komugi Kusunoki transferred from the city to start a new life in rural Hokkaido. But on her first day of school, the school heartthrob Yū Ōgami blurts out, "You smell good!" Despite the hijinks, Komugi tries to adjust to her new school, but it's not long before she stumbles across Yū dozing off under a tree. When she attempts to wake him up, he transformed…into a wolf?! It turns out that Yū is one of many other eccentric boys in her class year–and she's the only one who knows their secret … !



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Ne Ne Ne
mangas.description:
Married off to a man more than twenty years her senior, Koyuki has no idea what her new life has in store for her. She's so in the dark, in fact, that she hasn't even seen her husband's face! But Koyuki isn't alone in fumbling through the intricacies of wedded bliss. Mask-donning Shin might have many years on his young wife, but as it turns out, he's just as naive as she is! Will this pair of innocents ever get past their awkwardness (and the age gap)?!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Umi no Cradle
mangas.description: Set sail in this shipboard drama set in the Age of Exploration from amazing mangaka Nagano Mei. The time is the Industrial Revolution, the location England. Monica, a young girl living in the slums, was making a good living as the nursemaid of Evan, a young child of a wealthy household. But when her master's ship goes missing, she's cut loose. A year later, while visiting his coffin, she happens to see Evan, the child she once took care of. She decides to abduct him and take him away with her on a ship.

mangas.title: Defying Kurosaki-kun
mangas.titleNative: 黒崎くんの言いなりになんてならない
mangas.description: "I demand absolute obedience." Yu Akabane has worked hard to reinvent herself for high school, and there's only one step left in her plan to leave her plain Jane days behind: asking out her idol, the "White Prince" Shirakawa-kun. When circumstances lead to Yu moving into the school dorm where Shirakawa-kun boards, she thinks she's found her lucky break. But unluckily for Yu, "Black Devil" Kurosaki-kun, the boy everyone at school (including the teachers!) is afraid of, lives there too—and when Yu defies him, he's all too eager to punish her…

mangas.title: Boku wa Uchuujin ni Koi wo Shita.
mangas.titleNative: ボクは宇宙人に恋をした。
mangas.synonyms: I Fell in Love with an Alien
mangas.description: Tomonaga Kairi is the top student in his year and and a skeptic when it comes to the universe. But one day, he accidentally gets involved with the eccentric Nanbu-senpai, president and the only member of the Space Research Club. What will happen to Tomonaga when she tries to get him to join her club before it gets abolished...!?

mangas.title: Laughter at the World's End
mangas.synonyms: Una Sonrisa hasta el Fin del Mundo
mangas.description:
In an era of ruin, mankind lives in fear of those branded with the 'Devil's Mouth' – immortals who are demonised, hunted and killed, only to return and exact vengeance on those who have harmed them. Amid the endless cycle of hatred, a young boy and girl appear in a distant town, offering to bury an undead that has been tormenting its people. But who is this boy who bears the mark of their enemy? Could they be the key to humanity's salvation?


(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

mangas.title: Kira-kun Today
mangas.description: For one short year, haplessly awkward, cockatiel-toting Nino has to keep watch over class joker and nextdoor neighbor, Kira-kun. Can Kira-kun—who harbors a terrible secret—find it in himself to open up and learn something new from Nino, or will she be consumed by his world? Find out in this touching tale of two fates that intertwine to become the "closest love to Heaven."

mangas.title: Tsubaki-chou Lonely Planet
mangas.titleNative: 椿町ロンリープラネット
mangas.synonyms: ขยับหัวใจเข้าใกล้นายมาดเข้ม
mangas.description:
Fumi Oono, second-year high-school student. Stuck with the debts of her father, she needs a job—fast. While she did indeed manage to find one as a housekeeper for THE Akatsuki Kibikino, it leaves much to be desired. After all, the novelist has a mean glare and an even worse attitude...And on top of that, she has to live with him?!


(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes 8 extra chapters (from which two are Hirunaka no Ryuusei extras, released with this series).

mangas.title: Strobe Edge
mangas.description: Ninako's friend Daiki throws her for a loop when he expresses romantic interest in her. She cares for him, but can she return his feelings? As she tries to sort out her confusion, Ninako realizes that there are many different facets of love—strange and wonderful sides…

mangas.title: The Case Study of Vanitas
mangas.description:
Rumors revolving around The Book of Vanitas, a clockwork grimoire of dubious reputation, draw Noé, a young vampire in search of a friend's salvation, to Paris. What awaits him in the City of Flowers, however, is not long hours treading the pavement or rifling through dusty bookshops in search of the tome. Instead, his quarry comes to him...in the arms of a man claiming to be a vampire doctor! Thrust into a conflict that threatens the peace between humans and vampires, will Noé cast in his lot with the curious and slightly unbalanced Vanitas and his quest to save vampirekind?



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Ran and the Gray World
mangas.description: Ran Uruma can't wait to grow up and become a sorceress like her mother, so with the help of a magical pair of sneakers, she transforms into an adult and sets off! Her father and older brother Jin try to keep her home safe, but Ran is determined to advance her powers and have adventures of her own!

mangas.title: orange
mangas.description:
Everyone has regrets in life. So who wouldn't take the chance to change the past if given the opportunity? When sixteen-year-old Takamiya Naho receives a mysterious letter, claiming to be from her twenty-seven-year-old self, her life is suddenly thrown into flux. The letter tells her that a new transfer student by the name of Naruse Kakeru will be joining her class, and to keep her eye on him. But why? Naho must decide what to make of the letter and its cryptic warning, and what it means not only for her future, but for Kakeru's as well.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)




Included series/one-shot:

Volumes 1-5: Haru-iro Astronaut (春色アストロノート , Spring-Colored Astronaut); #1: Bessatsu Margaret 2011-06, #2: Betsuma sister 2012-01, #3~5: kakioroshi

Mami and Tomoki have always shared everything in life, they are identical twins, yet so different in character and personality: Mami tender and helpless, courted by boys to whom she doesn't never "no" for excessive kindness, Tomoki with a strong sense of duty and a great spirit of sacrifice, would do anything to see his sister happy. But there comes a time, however, when one realizes there are things that cannot be shared, especially when it is something extremely rare and unique... just like an alien?!

Volume 6: Mirai (未来)

Volume 7: Suwa Hiroto (須和弘人)

A side story focusing on Naho and Suwa's lives in the world where Kakeru passed away at age 17.



Notes: Nominated to the 20th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

mangas.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
mangas.description:
Hatori Chise has lived most of her short 15-year life full of neglect and abuse, and devoid of love. With no familial warmth, she's had more than her share of troubles and pitfalls. Just when it seems like life can't get any worse, she's now being sold at a slave auction! When a cloaked man, with the head of a beast' skull and wielding strange powers, purchases her, Chise's life will never be the same again.



The man is a a sorcerer of great power, a kindly magus who frees Chise and then makes a bold statement:
Chise will become his apprentice–and his bride!


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Nominated for the 8th Manga Taisho Award.

mangas.title: Komi Can't Communicate
mangas.titleNative: 古見さんは、コミュ症です。
mangas.description:
Timid Tadano is a total wallflower, and that's just the way he likes it. But all that changes when he finds himself alone in a classroom on the first day of high school with the legendary Komi. He quickly realizes she isn't aloof—she's just super awkward. Now he's made it his mission to help her on her quest to make 100 friends!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Notes:

- Winner of the 67th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2021.

- Includes 37 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Red Limit
mangas.description: “If you ever develop feelings for me, then show me the face behind the blindfold…” Baek Myeongdo has never been particularly good with people but, fortunately, he’s also never really cared. Relationships are confusing, messy, and Myeongdo would really rather just avoid them all-together. Still, he finds it awfully hard to resist a beautiful pair of hands when he sees one... When Chung Oak accepts his proposition to meet him in a hotel one night, Myeongdo’s plan is to never see him again. However, Oak finds this mysteriously blindfolded man far more intriguing than he’d anticipated. Soon, their “one night only” becomes many nights and often, but just what will it take for Oak to make it beyond Myeongdo’s self-imposed limits?

mangas.title: Garden Flora
mangas.description:
“Sir, you touched me earlier, right? Well, then I’m going to touch you too.”
“Get out. Don’t interfere with business.”

College student Choi Nan-young falls in love at first sight with Tae Seung-min, a “gangster” who saved her from a part-time job scam.
A few years later, Nan-young reappears as a headstrong part-time worker in front of Seung-min, who has become the owner of the flower shop .
Despite Seung-min’s firm words setting boundaries, his hands—meant to push Nan-young away—seem to linger just a little longer.

However, Seung-min’s shadow from the past, Mi Seok-woo, begins to reach out toward Nan-young.

“I can do more for you… than that guy.”

The scent of blood hidden beneath the fragrance of flowers.
A persistent, one-sided love that burrows deeper the more he pushes it away.

Will Seung-min truly be able to resist Nan-young until the very end?

mangas.title: Secondo Piatto
mangas.description:
Save room for the main course.
Hyunwook is a coward when it comes to his longtime crush Heesun, who suddenly announces that she’s getting married. He helps her plan her wedding at a restaurant called Secondo Piatto. There he meets Wonyoung, an old friend of Heesun’s fiancée. But why is Wonyoung crying on the day of the wedding?

mangas.title: Oil On Canvas
mangas.description: After an embarrassing run-in with auctioneer Luca Orsini at a Carnevale party, art restorer Dojin finds himself entangled in an unexpected restoration project. As secrets unfold and hidden motives come to light, Dojin must navigate a web of deception, art, and an unspoken connection that keeps pulling him back…

mangas.title: Magic Soup
mangas.description:
“Please be our slave… No, I mean our castle’s chef!”

To grant the last wish of his mother, Romiard left for the Larmanilla’s Ice Castle where an ice magician, who’s notorious for his beauty and cruelness, lives. Taken by a bear with snowy white fur, he reached the Larmanilla’s Ice Castle, but… The ruthless wizard orders Romiard to make a Magic Soup out of the blue! Succeeding in winning the heart of the magician with his soup, Romiard happens to sign an employment contract as a castle’s chef with the Larmanilla’s Ice Castle. The beautiful fantasy between a cruel magician who has a heart of stone and a friendly, warm chef now starts to unfold against a fairytale ice world.

mangas.title: Kanariya Irui Konin Tan
mangas.description:
Born into a fallen aristocratic family, Sakurako is forced into a political marriage with Karasukada Touya, a powerful member of the Serpent God clan. However, on the day of her wedding in the spring when she turns 18, Sakurako has a premonitory dream in which she is brutally murdered by her husband, Touya. At this moment, Sakurako awakens to an extraordinary ability to foresee "dangerous futures" through the manifestation of the spirit beast "Kanariya." Knowing that the contents of her dream contain the cause of her future misfortune and hold a clue to avoiding death, Sakurako...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Teetee Sasete yo Akira-kun
mangas.titleNative: てぇてぇさせてよ秋良くん

mangas.title: The Condemnation and Revenge of the Villainess Gloria von Cordwell
mangas.titleNative: 悪役令嬢グロリア・フォン・コードウェルの断罪と復讐
mangas.synonyms: Akuyaku Reijou Gloria von Caldwell no Danzai to Fukushuu
mangas.description:
Gloria, the daughter of a duke, was betrayed by her fiancé and family and executed for a crime she never committed. But when she awakens, time has turned back to when she was ten years old!?
Given a second chance at life, she smiles coldly.

"I’ll make those fools taste hell."

Her unfaithful fiancé. The father who sold out his own daughter. The self-righteous saint…
She will forgive none of them.

With her status, her reputation, and the memories of her previous life, along with the knowledge of the reincarnator that once clung to her soul, she will expose their true natures and make them atone for every sin.
A merciless tale of revenge by a true villainess begins!

mangas.title: Ryuu ga Metoru wa Saika no Musume
Kanchigai da yo ne? Seo-kun.
mangas.titleNative: 勘違いだよね？瀬尾くん。

mangas.title: 112.5 Meter no Kokoro
mangas.description: When she starts to investigate the infidelity of her best friend's boyfriend, what will she find…?

mangas.title: Ore no Kareshi ga Yurei ni Narimashite
mangas.titleNative: 俺の彼氏がユーレイになりまして

mangas.title: Neko ni Matatabi, Mata wa Hakoiri
mangas.titleNative: 猫にマタタビ、又は箱入り
mangas.description:
Nekomiya Shion, a second-year high school student, is spending her days bored. Then, a sheltered young lady with love on the brain, Kami Rurika, transfers to her school. As she is led around by the unpredictable young lady, her school life begins to change little by little...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Kasumi no Hana wa Ao ni Hodokeru
mangas.titleNative: 霞の花は蒼にほどける
mangas.description:
After finishing her life as a human, Saika is reborn as a fairy in the world of immortals. However, she is unable to adapt to the world of immortals, so when she descends to the human world, a man suddenly appears. This man, Kouzen, whose life was saved by Saika when he was a boy, declares, "I will never leave your side for the rest of my life"!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

mangas.title: Mahoutsukai no Saku Niwa
mangas.description:
The Blanket Kingdom and the Laculus Empire are rival nations. Toto, the princess of the Blanket Kingdom, and Rayona, the princess of the Laculus Empire, both become apprentices to the great wizard Ozuno. But after three years as his apprentice, all he's taught them is the magic to produce a little salt water and a little wind...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Oshi Atteru Futari
mangas.synonyms: Admiring Each Other, Falling in Love

mangas.title: At 0:00 A.M., I Picked Up a Delinquent.
mangas.titleNative: 午前０時、不良を拾いました。
mangas.description:
Kayamori, who is living alone due to certain circumstances, comes across a handsome, ragged delinquent at the garbage dump one night. Seeing the lonely-looking boy, the words slipped out of her mouth: "Would you like to come over?”

The two awkward friends begin living together.

mangas.title: Ikenie Hime no Koufuku: Kodoku na Nie no Shoujo wa, Mamono no Ou no Hanayome to naru
mangas.titleNative: 生贄姫の幸福 孤独な贄の少女は、魔物の王の花嫁となる
mangas.description: Born and raised as a sacrifice to be offered to the Demon King, a young girl named Lydia has spent her entire life inside a cage. She was never even permitted to exchange words with another living soul. For the sake of the Kingdom, fulfilling the duty imposed upon her was her only hope... Then, the fated day finally arrived. While the people cower in fear before the appearing Demon King, Louis, Lydia alone is full of spirit as she presents herself, eager to be eaten as a delicious meal?!

mangas.title: Unmei no Ban to Kekkon Shitara, Tenshi Musuko no Mamahaha ni Narimashita
mangas.titleNative: 運命の番と結婚したら、天使息子の継母になりました

mangas.title: Chizu ni Nai Koi wo Shita
Toukakan Dake Muri Shite yo
mangas.titleNative: 十日間だけ無理してよ
mangas.description:
Asakuma is a literary editor. He's swamped with work, but by chance he ends up modeling for famous hair and makeup artist Kozuki's makeup. After completing the project "A Tired Old Man Transforms with Kozuki's Makeup," Kozuki invites him to his house and confesses his feelings, saying, "I've got my eye on you."

Will Asakuma's lifestyle and skin improve, and will his dreams come true? A story of a tired male editor's makeover!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
mangas.description:
"I just want to live my life listening to someone's orders and being praised..."

Is that a sinful, unrealistic dream? Yet, that was the sole wish of ordinary high school student Akira Tamanoi. Days without dreams or motivation... One day, as punishment for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council and meets the intelligent and beautiful student council president, Makoto Miyauchi. And then, something unexpected happens. Miyauchi constantly asks Akira for favors. "Please... thank you!" "You can't do it? You did well!" Without understanding the meaning of the comfort given to him by Miyauchi, Akira becomes completely engrossed in this suddenly realized dream... There he was, my wonderful master.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Kanpeki Choujin Cinderella
mangas.description:
Despite the various demands of her stepmother and stepsisters, Cinderella manages to run her days perfectly with her incredible household skills and insight. She's no mere victim of bullying. She's a "perfect superhuman" who anticipates, plans, and completes everything!

A new interpretation of the Cinderella tale, where wisdom and honesty carve out her own destiny.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Ai wo Chikau ni wa Hayasugiru
mangas.titleNative: 愛を誓うには早すぎる
mangas.synonyms: It's Too Early to Swear Our Love

mangas.title: #B ga L Suru: 4 Page Anthology - Konna ni Suki de Dou Shiyou!?
mangas.titleNative: ＃BがLする 4ページアンソロジー ～こんなに好きでどうしよう!?～
mangas.description: A collection of light BL short stories by 26 super-talented authors, each depicting "doting love" in just four pages!

mangas.title: Mazuwa Shinyuu kara Yoroshiku Onegaishimasu
mangas.titleNative: まずは親友からよろしくお願いします

mangas.title: I'm Watching You
mangas.titleNative: アイム・ウォッチング・ユー

mangas.title: Nusunda Kajitsu wa Amakute Nigai
mangas.titleNative: 盗んだ果実は甘くて苦い
mangas.synonyms: Stolen fruit is sweet and bitter

mangas.title: Gaman Shinai de Furete Mina yo
mangas.titleNative: 我慢しないで触れてみなよ
mangas.synonyms: Stop holding back. Give in and touch me.

mangas.title: Gokudou Reijou, Neko wo Hirou.
mangas.description:
One day, Akira, the granddaughter of the head of the Momiji gang, brings home a ragged young man named Sora who she finds collapsed in a garbage dump. At first, Sora shows a rebellious attitude, saying "I won't accept charity from the yakuza," but gradually he begins to call Akira "boss" and become attached to her...

The story depicts the misunderstandings that surround Akira and Sora as they live together.

mangas.title: Premier Remarriage
mangas.titleNative: プレミア・リマリッジ
mangas.description: Rize was married to her co-worker until she caught him cheating on her. She decides she'll focus on her career as a manager at a department store until her cute younger coworker starts sweeting on her. Will Rize be able to find love so immediately after divorce?

mangas.title: Ikenie Miko wa Oshi no Ryuujin ni Aisareru
mangas.titleNative: 生贄巫女は推しの龍神に愛される

mangas.title: Sekai de Ichiban Shiawase!
mangas.description:
The series follows ex-shut-in Koutarou Sano, who, thanks to his favorite minor idol, is able to enter society. Through a chance encounter, Koutarou runs into his favorite idol at a beef bowl restaurant. Kei is retired from the entertainment business now, but that doesn't stop him from making an unbelievable request.

(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: Koukoku no Souheki: Kizumono no Hanayome Gaiden
mangas.titleNative: 皇國の双璧　傷モノの花嫁 外伝

mangas.title: Kore wa "Suki" ja Arimasen
mangas.titleNative: これは「好き」じゃありません
mangas.description:
Mitsunaga, whose older brothers are a star athlete and a famous actor, finds himself somehow being worshipped by Minase—the beautiful and well-known girl at their school—just like his brothers are. When he asks Minase if that means she likes him, she shoots back, “This isn’t liking you—it’s worship!” …!?

A fresh new kind of romance ⇔ worship!? An oshikatsu love comedy♡

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Originally a one-shot published in The Hana to Yume 3/2026, it was picked up for continuing serialization 2026-04-20.

mangas.title: Hare Akira-sama no Ossharu Koto ni wa Heian Inyo Shinryoroku
mangas.titleNative: 晴明様のおっしゃることには 平安陰陽診療録
mangas.description:
Watanabe Harunobu strives to become a full-fledged samurai, despite harboring a certain secret. One day, feeling unwell, Harunobu meets the mysterious onmyoji Abe no Seimei, who is able to pinpoint the cause of his condition. Furthermore, in front of Harunobu's eyes, Seimei extends the lifespan of an aristocrat who had stopped breathing after falling into a pond. When Harunobu asks Seimei about his mysterious power, Seimei reveals that it is "medical arts." Seimei then uncovers Harunobu's secret and pressures him to become his assistant...

This is a Heian medical fantasy in which an onmyoji and his troubled assistant exorcise illnesses.

mangas.title: Ryuuzaki Tenon (Mata wa Fujii Misuzu)-san ni Tsuite
mangas.titleNative: 竜崎天音（または藤井美鈴）さんについて
mangas.description:
A friend I became close to through our shared love of our favorite idols was murdered. She was a very important friend, someone I could confide in about anything... Until I learned that her name, address, everything about her was a lie. Who was the murdered friend, Fujii Misuzu (a pseudonym)? Why did she have to be killed?

As Kiryu Kokoro is consumed by suspicion, he receives a direct message. The sender is...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Sweets: Cakeverse BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: Sweets ケーキバースBLアンソロジー
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Sorato
1. Ashita mo Kimi to Hare. 2 (明日も君とハレ。2) [Sorato]
2. Touka no Nigami ga Mitasu Mono (糖花の苦みが満たすもの) [Koke Seta]
3. Mata Mou Hitokuchi (またもうひとくち) [Tonini Azuma]
4. Taste Me Darling (テイスト・ミー・ダーリン) [Yuu Hazawa]
5. Amakute Enjirarenai (甘くて演じられない) [Komehana Sakuraba]
6. Himitsu no Chaahan (秘密の炒飯) [Cko Mimino]
7. Hone no Zui made 2 (骨の髄まで２) [Yuko Inari]

mangas.title: Kanzaki-san, Tsuno Detemasu!?
mangas.titleNative: 神崎さん、ツノ出てますっ⁈

mangas.title: Cinema Star yo Ai wo Shire
mangas.titleNative: シネマスターよ愛を知れ
mangas.description: Asahi, a womanizer and a total jerk, ends up co-starring in a BL film with Saiga, a junior in the theater club with whom he can’t stand… After being told his performance wouldn’t be believable unless he looked like he was actually being taken, Asahi learns by chance that Saiga is gay and suggests they have sex for the sake of their acting…!?

mangas.title: Unmei wa Yaku ni Tatanai
mangas.description: One day, red threads appeared on the fingers of all humans worldwide. Since those bound by that thread were destined for lasting relationships, it became known as the "red thread of fate," and a new era dawned where thread-based romance became the norm. While all this was happening, a red thread suddenly appeared on the finger of the protagonist, Tsumugi, who, incidentally, just happens to despise "thread-based love"....

mangas.title: Junkyoushu no Kiss wa Hana yori Amai
mangas.titleNative: 准教授のキスは花より甘い

mangas.title: Matsukaze-kun no Atsu sugiru Karada
mangas.titleNative: 松風くんの熱すぎるカラダ

mangas.title: Kingoku no Hanayome: Noroware Shoujo wa Onmyouji-sama ni Chouai Sareru
mangas.titleNative: 禁獄の花嫁－呪われ少女は陰陽師様に寵愛される－

mangas.title: Hakuzuiguu no Oryouriban: Isekai no Kamisama to Meshi-tero Slow Life wo Mankitsu suru
mangas.titleNative: 白瑞宮のお料理番〜異世界の神様と飯テロスローライフを満喫する〜

mangas.title: Kouryaku Taishou ja Arimasen!
mangas.titleNative: 攻略対象じゃありません！

mangas.title: Wakeari Takanashi-kun to XX shitai
mangas.titleNative: 訳アリ小鳥遊くんと××したい
mangas.description:
Nika is a second-year high school student who moved from Tokyo to the Kansai region. She is the type of person who is comfortable being alone, and she had hoped to spend her time peacefully at her new school without getting too involved with anyone. However, on her first day at the new school, she meets Takanashi Yura, the son of a gangster who wants to make friends but doesn't have any.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Haru Koi Reset
mangas.description: Sakuto Somei is a third-year middle school student. She likes her classmate, Yoh, but she can only watch him from afar... But she plans to confess her feelings after the graduation ceremony! ...But then she gets into an accident and is transported back to the world of one year ago!? A time-traveling love story that happens on the last day of middle school!

mangas.title: Shinigami Ikona to Furoufushi no Kaibutsu
mangas.titleNative: 死神イコナと不老不死の怪物
mangas.description:
Soul Collector No. 157, nicknamed Ikona. As a Grim Reaper, her job is to collect the souls of dead creatures and send them to heaven. But now she has one last request as a Grim Reaper, and it's from an immortal monster...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Kohaku no Yume de Yoimashou Cheers!
mangas.titleNative: 琥珀の夢で酔いましょう Cheers!

mangas.title: Kimitachi Ai ga Omo Sugiru.
mangas.description:
It's spring. 30-year-old Kana witnesses her boyfriend, whom she was thinking of marrying, cheating on her with a junior colleague at work. She decides that she "doesn't need a man anymore" and decides to move away, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Imouto ni Subete wo Ubawareta Moto Saikou Seijo wa Ringoku no Koutaishi ni Dekiai Sareru
mangas.titleNative: 妹に全てを奪われた元最高聖女は隣国の皇太子に溺愛される

mangas.title: Shiro-sama wa Nuigurumi no Mama de Ite Kurenai: Nuikatsu OL, Kamisama ni Dekiai sareru
mangas.titleNative: シロさまはぬいぐるみのままでいてくれない～ぬい活OL、神さまに溺愛される～
mangas.description:
After being dumped by her boyfriend and hitting rock bottom, Momoka, a thirty-something office worker, becomes addicted to an otome game called "Kamiroma," where you fall in love with a god. Her favorite character, Shiro-sama, cheers her up, but the app suddenly shuts down! Still, Momoka's love for Shiro-sama continues, and she begins collecting stuffed toys. One day, when she kisses a stuffed toy, Shiro-sama appears in human form, and her favorite character falls in love with her!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

mangas.title: Kitayama-kun to Minamiya-kun: Otsukiai 1-nenme
mangas.titleNative: 北山くんと南谷くん ―お付き合い1年目―

mangas.title: Oshikake Ningyo no Koiwazurai
mangas.titleNative: おしかけ人魚の恋煩い
mangas.description:
“You, have sex with me.”

Taichi, a college student, was feeling down after a disastrous blind date.
But on his way home, he managed to pick up a stunning beauty who was exactly his type.
Excited, he took her back to his place—only to discover that the beauty was actually a man… and not just any man, but a mermaid!!
For Taichi, who loves girls, men are out of the question as romantic partners—and a mermaid is completely out of the question.
As Taichi tries to kick him out right away, the merman—who introduces himself as Shinju—demands they have sex—!?

Playboy College Student × Sex-Seeking Merman
A heart-fluttering fairy-tale romance between this mismatched pair.

mangas.title: Fujunsura Junjou
mangas.synonyms: Even Impureness is Pure | Even Impurity Can Be Innocent
mangas.description: Hitoko Usui, a high school sophomore, is still an outcast even though it’s been a month since the new semester started. One day, when she agreed to take on a committee assignment for someone else, she found out her partner was Minato—a popular, outgoing guy she didn’t get along with. Thinking she’d rather just do the work alone, Hitoko blurted out, “I’m a total masochist, so I’m fine with this! Leave it to me!” Then Minato said, “Here’s an order from me. Since you’re a masochist, you’ll obey, right?” And then…!?

mangas.title: Isshou, Omae to Waratte Ikitee wa
mangas.titleNative: 一生、おまえと笑って生きてえわ

mangas.title: Koko kara Saki wa Ad-lib de
mangas.titleNative: ここから先はアドリブで

mangas.title: Shirogane Shiro no Shitsukekata
mangas.titleNative: 白銀シロのしつけかた

mangas.title: Shinigami wa, Mata Koi wo suru.
mangas.description:
Ichika has shut herself off from love ever since an incident in her past. But now, an “unconventional visitor” appears before her to determine her fate, as she is forced to break out of her stagnant life…?

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

mangas.title: Koi ni Mongen wa Arimasen!
mangas.titleNative: 恋に門限はありません！

mangas.title: Shuumatsu Zombie Camp
mangas.description:
Towa Kujou, an illustrator who was secluded in the mountains for her hobby of solo camping, discovers upon her descent that the world has been overrun by zombies. The story depicts Towa gathering leftover food and enjoying gourmet meals in this post-apocalyptic world.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Yankee ni Deshiiri Saremashite.
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーに弟子入りされまして。
mangas.description:
Urara is an ordinary high school girl who loves cats and is loved by them. Today, seeking solace from cats, she visits her secret hideout where she can interact with many stray cats. There, she is approached by Hyuuga Izumi, a delinquent covered in blood, who asks to be certified as a "kitty master" and become her apprentice...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Hanayome to Maou: Kegareta Shoujo wa Teito no Guardian ni Metorareru
mangas.titleNative: 花嫁と魔王～穢れた少女は帝都の守護者に娶られる～

mangas.title: Your Body's Still Warm
mangas.titleNative: 君の死体はあたたかい
mangas.description:
"I wanted you to keep touching me like this." But the only time he can touch his late childhood friend is in the dead of night.

Itsuki, Sota's first love, has died. Unable to even tell him how he felt, Sota spends his days consumed by lingering attachment and regret, sometimes even thinking, "Maybe I'd rather be cursed by him instead." Perhaps that twisted wish was answered, because one night, Itsuki appears before him as a ghost. But something about the way he looks is strange. Could it be that Sota's own ugly desire has turned him into a vengeful spirit? And yet, when the boy he had always longed to touch appears right in front of him, Sota can no longer keep his thoughts under control...

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Puchitto Kireta Reijou Patricia wa Jinsei wo Ouka suru Koto ni shita
mangas.titleNative: ぷちっとキレた令嬢パトリシアは人生を謳歌することにした
mangas.synonyms: Lady Patricia, Having a Tiny Outburst, Chose to Live Her Best Life

mangas.title: Yankee ni Koi to Ikuji wa Muzu sugiru R
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーに恋と育児はムズすぎるR

mangas.title: Harahara Dantori SOS
mangas.description:
Stranded in the snowy mountainside!! And to make matters worse, she's stuck with that annoying boy…!?

Note: Originally published in Margaret magazine 2026 No. 6.
