mangas.title: Keiyaku Shite yo, Sumi-senpai
mangas.synonyms: Make a Blood Contract With Me, Sumi-senpai.

mangas.title: Urekko Mangaka wa Roommate Oshi
mangas.titleNative: 売れっ子漫画家はルームメイト推し
mangas.synonyms: The Bestselling Mangaka Is in Love with His Roommate.

mangas.title: Warau Hebi to Niramu Inu
mangas.synonyms: When the Snake Laughs, the Dog Glares.

mangas.title: Tekikoku α no Shuuchaku ga Kikakugai de Nidome no Konyaku Haki ga Dekimasen
mangas.titleNative: 敵国αの執着が規格外で二度目の婚約破棄ができません

mangas.title: Omega-sama wa Heat wo Shiritai
mangas.titleNative: オメガ様は発情を知りたい

mangas.title: No Senpai, No Life!
mangas.titleNative: ノーセンパイ、ノーライフ！

mangas.title: Kamisama to Hatsukoi
mangas.description:
A romantic comedy about Momota Matsuri, who has the ability to see non-human things, and her first sexual encounter with Kousou. After her marriage was called off due to her unique condition, Matsuri visits the village where her relatives live for the first time in 10 years. There, she reunites with Kousou, but discovers a secret about him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Twilight Snap
mangas.titleNative: トワイライト・スナップ

mangas.title: Gozen 1-ji no Fake Lover
mangas.titleNative: 午前1時のフェイクラバー

mangas.title: Fubin na Bocchan to Fubin na Bodyguard
mangas.titleNative: 不憫なぼっちゃんと不憫なボディガード
mangas.synonyms: The Unfortunate Young Master and the Unfortunate Bodyguard
mangas.description:
Garo, a lone wolf with a tough-guy image, became the personal bodyguard of Hitomi, the heiress in his class, right after he enrolled.

Their life as bodyguards began with the promise that it would be “just for the three years of high school.”
As he spent time with Hitomi—who was curious and hardworking— friendship and a faint crush began to blossom in Garo’s heart, and Hitomi felt the same way.
He was determined to gently and manly embrace Hitomi on their first night together!!! —Or so he had planned.

“I want to touch Garo’s manly chest to my heart’s content.”

Before he knew it, Hitomi’s fingertips were melting him until his whole body was a gooey mess—!?

A young heir who wants to explore his body × A lone wolf, martial arts-loving high schooler.
[Me, the one being taken!?!?] A school romance featuring a size difference where “the bigger one is the uke”!!!

mangas.title: Hata-sensei to Kaji-sensei
mangas.titleNative: 秦せんせいと梶せんせい

mangas.title: Kusottare Baby: BABY LOVE
mangas.titleNative: クソッたれベイビー BABY LOVE

mangas.title: Super Ultra Extra Chou Chou Chou Kawaii Kimi.
mangas.titleNative: スーパーウルトラエクストラ超超超かわいいキミ。
mangas.description: Note: Published in Daria 2026 April issue.

mangas.title: Melty Chocolate ni Amagami
mangas.titleNative: メルティショコラに甘噛み
mangas.description: Note: Published in Daria 2026 April issue.

mangas.title: Suki Bare Sunzen no Kiss
mangas.description:
Yuusuke, a college student, is friends-with-benefits with Kazuomi, a senior he's secretly in love with. But when Kazuomi tells him, "It's over once you get serious," he has no choice but to keep hiding his feelings...!?

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

mangas.title: Drunkards' Night Error
mangas.titleNative: ドランカーズ・ナイト・エラー
mangas.description: Note: Published in Daria 2026 April issue.

mangas.title: Kirigaya-kun Motto Mite
mangas.titleNative: 桐ヶ谷くんもっと見て
mangas.description: Note: Published in Daria 2026 April issue.

mangas.title: Mayonaka no Ore wo Mite: Bangai-hen - Mayonaka ni Yume wo Mite...!?
mangas.titleNative: 真夜中の俺を見て 番外編 ～真夜中に夢を見て…！？～
mangas.synonyms: Mayonaka no Ore wo Mite Bangaihen: Mayonaka ni Yume wo Mite...!?
mangas.description: Note: Published in fromRED Vol. 36 ver. B.

mangas.title: No One Told Me the King of Beasts Was Such a Slacker!
mangas.titleNative: 百獣の王がヒモだなんて聞いてない！
mangas.description:
"I'll move in a bit... Just a bit longer..." is the spark that kicks off an interspecies relationship between a lazy lion and an overly-altruistic human guarding his heart in this cute-yet-erotic romantic comedy!

In this world, "animacodes", a species with both human and animal characteristics, coexist alongside humans. Ryusei, who works in a facility that takes care of animacodes, has long admired lions for how cool they are, but his idealized image crumbles when he is tasked with caring for Raul, a loafing lion animacode. Although exasperated, Ryusei looks after Raul, but... he had no idea lions were packing! Ohhh, shiiit!

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Osamaru Ie: Iida Chiaki Sakuhinshuu
mangas.titleNative: おさまる家　井田千秋 作品集
mangas.description:
“I want to come home to this house.”

I lose myself in daydreams. I read books. I eat. I sleep.
I just sort of exist there.
It all falls into place.
This is a very comfortable, special place.

In addition to seven doujin works, it's packed with newly drawn comics and essays! The first collection of everything by Chiaki Iida, the person who loves houses.

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

mangas.title: Yotte Saku, Koi no Hana
mangas.description: Note: Published in Daria 2026 April issue.

mangas.title: Bouai Baby Doll
mangas.description:
Amemine, who uses his outstanding good looks as a weapon to hit on girls left and right, absolutely hates Fuyumi, a classmate of his. With his medieval-style features and love of cosmetics, Fuyumi tends to side with the girls, which has led to frequent clashes with Amemine, the heartbreaker. As his frustration with Fuyumi mounts, Amemine schemes to find a way to hold something over him.
Just then, he stumbles upon Fuyumi’s shocking secret—!?
A handsome, cynical womanizer with a terrible track record × a straight-A student with a secret cross-dressing side account—a love conflict where they expose each other’s true natures.

mangas.title: Sugitaru Ai wa Moudoku
mangas.synonyms: Love is Poisonous If Taken Too Much

mangas.title: Mushiro Kakko Tsukanai Kimi ga Suki!
mangas.titleNative: むしろかっこつかない君が好き！
mangas.description:
Kaoru Kirishima hates guys who are just putting on a show and looking cool. Hoshino, the most popular prince at school, is no exception and she hates him too! But when she sees Hoshino crying, what is the true nature of the feelings that well up inside her for the first time...? When you're in love, you can't pretend to be cool!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Chikyuu ga Owarurashiinode, Ima kara Kimi wo Kankin Shimasu.
mangas.titleNative: 地球が終わるらしいので、いまからキミを監禁します。
mangas.description:
Wakatsuki Shino, 29, is your average office worker in her 30s who's about to marry a colleague. But... the morning after drinking with her boss, she finds herself "confined" in his apartment under the pretext of "protection." The reason: the Earth is about to end... Boss, are you serious?

A slightly strange romantic comedy for adults.

mangas.title: Omae no Sei de Ω-ka Suru Nante!
mangas.titleNative: おまえのせいでΩ化するなんて！
mangas.synonyms: Omae no Sei de Omega-ka Suru Nante!

mangas.title: Tensei Shitara Last Boss Kei Akujo datta!
mangas.titleNative: 転生したらラスボス系悪女だった！
mangas.description:
I was reincarnated as Diana, a villainess destined to be the final boss, and I was living with the Ice Duke, with whom I was already in a political marriage, and his daughter, who feared me. My fate was to one day be defeated by my daughter's heroic lover—but I refused! I'll shower my daughter with love, improve my relationship with my husband, and aim to avoid becoming the final boss!!

The story of a quirky duchess escaping her villainous status begins in grand style★

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Hikameku Kimi to Kiss wo Shite
mangas.titleNative: ひかめく君とキスをして
mangas.synonyms: A kiss with the shining you

mangas.title: Saran to Recipe.: Koi no Hajimari wa Kankoku Gohan kara
mangas.titleNative: サランとレシピ。～恋のはじまりは韓国ごはんから～
mangas.description:
One day, 30-year-old Matsuoka Ayumi witnesses her boyfriend cheating on her. While drunk with grief, she meets a young man who works at a Korean restaurant...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Suki Suki Diasuki Aishiteru kara ne
mangas.titleNative: 好き好き大好き愛してるからね
mangas.synonyms: Love love love you, I have mad love for you.

mangas.title: Stray Cat no Yoake wa Hare
mangas.titleNative: ストレイキャットの夜明けは晴

mangas.title: Koi wo Oboeta AI-kun wa Seigyofunou!?
mangas.titleNative: 恋を覚えたAIくんは制御不能！？
mangas.description:
“If I’m going to date anyone, it has to be Watanabe—no one else is even worth considering.”

Rikka Watanabe, who is far too sensitive, and Akira Ichimura—who’s so calm, collected, and exceptionally brilliant that he’s nicknamed “AI-kun”—are complete opposites. They were two people whose paths would never have crossed—until Akira suddenly confessed, “Will you go out with me?” and launched a full-scale romantic offensive, drawing on all his knowledge!
Though Shō is usually a flawless, genius high school student—almost like an AI—he’s clumsy when it comes to love… but no one can stop his single-minded, sincere devotion…!

You’re sure to get butterflies from the uncontrollable advances of “AI-kun,” who’s just discovered love! An unpredictable romantic comedy featuring two polar opposites!

mangas.title: Ao no Hitomi no Ryuu no Hime
mangas.description: A young man living peacefully in a seaside town meets a prince who has come looking for his absolute truth—?!

mangas.title: Channel Vampire
mangas.titleNative: チャンネル・ヴァンパイア

mangas.title: Hirotta Koi ga Nakitagatteru
mangas.titleNative: 拾った恋が泣きたがってる

mangas.title: Happily Ever...Dead?! (Bonus Story)
mangas.titleNative: 冥婚―花嫁くんは転生前夜―【番外編】
mangas.description:
"Keiichi's gonna stay dead" is actually a declaration of love for this newlywed-and-also-dead couple in this bonus story!

Ex-human Keiichi is as bound as ever by the overbearing love of the devil Asmodeus. The two of them go on a date to a mysterious rock called the Judgment Stone, which is said to be able to reincarnate those that wish it. However, the outing takes a chaotic turn when they meet a devil with the power to reincarnate people. And what's more, he seems to take a liking to Keiichi and tries to reincarnate him without even asking him first...!

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Mirumo de Pon New~
mangas.description:
Mirumo confronts a crisis that befalls the fairy world. After completing his training in the human world, Mirumo returns to the fairy world and leads a busy yet fulfilling life. One day, a mysterious black cloud appears in the fairy world and attacks the fairies. In the midst of the chaos, Mirumo's wife, Rirumu, is kidnapped...

The story follows Mirumo's struggle to get Rirumu back, alongside his rival Yashichi and his younger brother Murumo.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: ∞Otona Mode
mangas.description: Sarasa, a 10-year-old fashion-loving girl, casts a spell to wish she "became an adult!" and a sparkling fairy appears, transforming her into an 18-year-old...?!

mangas.title: Ryuusei no Liberty
mangas.description:
In a certain land where magic-users are oppressed, Luca—a descendant of magic-users who endures grueling servitude in the belief that one day he will be free—encounters a fellow magic-user named Meteor and becomes captivated by his power to command the stars.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Juu to Shirayuri
mangas.description:
Shido Yukari is the granddaughter of a political don. Her life is in danger every day, and her bodyguard is a dangerous man with a terrible mouth and attitude!?

A proud young lady and a foul-mouthed, skilled bodyguard. The obsessive love story between these two, who are terribly incompatible, begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

mangas.title: Numao ni Oboreru BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 沼男に溺れるBLアンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: Numa Otoko ni Oboreru BL Anthology

mangas.title: Uso demo Koi ni Narurashii
mangas.titleNative: ウソでも恋になるらしい
mangas.synonyms: Guess even a lie can turn into love.

mangas.title: Maou-sama, Kekkon desu!
mangas.description:
Hino Komako is a marriage counselor who'd given up on her own happiness, until she was suddenly transported to another world! “Could it be... me with this hottie!?” Komako's heart soared at the sight of the handsome Demon Lord waiting for her, until he asked her to help with matchmaking instead!? But the Demon Lord seems to have a secret he won't tell Komako…? A fresh take of an isekai romantic comedy.

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

mangas.title: Mahiru to Bara no Mahouron
mangas.titleNative: まひると薔薇の魔法論
mangas.description:
Five years ago, Mahiru's best friend Yukinojou stole her magical powers, leading her to Heliogabalus, a special magic academy at the forefront of magical research.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Meguro kara me ga Hanasenai!
mangas.titleNative: 目黒から目が離せない！

mangas.title: Momomiya-kun wa Mujikaku desu
mangas.titleNative: 桃宮くんは無自覚です

mangas.title: Gal to Couture: Ariake Momo wa Fuku wo Tsukutte Yuushou suru Koto ni shita
mangas.titleNative: ギャルとクチュール～有明モモは服を作って優勝することにした～
mangas.synonyms: Gyaru to Couture: Ariake Momo wa Fuku wo Tsukutte Yuushou suru Koto ni shita
mangas.description: The story is based on the Fashion Koshien (National High School Fashion Design Championship) held in Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture. Ariake Momo, a gal who grew up in a snowy area, meets Ujyou Ren, a boy her age who aspires to be a designer, and they try their hand at making clothes to express the "cute" that only they can find inside of them. Momo and Ren then team up to aim to win the Fashion Koshien.

mangas.title: THE JINGAI: Ishukan BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: THE JINGAI―異種間BLアンソロジー―

mangas.title: Watamaki-kun no Koi ni Furetai
mangas.titleNative: 綿巻くんの恋に触れたい
mangas.synonyms: I want to touch Watamaki-kun's love

mangas.title: Tanin no Meshi
mangas.description:
Former detective Iijima, who retired after being shot and injured by a barricaded criminal, is currently staying at his colleague Tsukioka's house. To repay the favor, he cooks meals every day. One morning, after learning Tsukioka's favorite food is soft-boiled eggs, Iijima suggests “Fluffy and Creamy Omelette Rice” for dinner. Tsukioka is overjoyed and declares, “I'll definitely leave work on time!” But...!?

(Source: Homesha, machine translated)

mangas.title: Tame ni Naranai Renai Seppou
mangas.titleNative: タメにならない恋愛説法

mangas.title: Suki no Hitotsu mo Ienai Kuse ni
mangas.titleNative: 好きのひとつも言えないくせに
mangas.description:
29-year-old manga artist Hiiragi Riko is shocked to learn that her former editor, whom she admires, has gotten married, and is drinking alone after the ceremony. One day, a handsome man who was also attending the wedding appears before her, and the two end up spending the night together. Since that day, Riko has tried to move on and focus on her work, but then she meets the handsome man again in an unexpected place...

This is a love story that begins with what was supposed to be a one-time rendezvous.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Konyaku Haki kara no Dekiai Seikatsu Ryuuto Koutaishi no Ban ni Erabaremashita
mangas.titleNative: 婚約破棄からの溺愛生活　竜人皇太子の番に選ばれました
mangas.description:
The moment Prince Daymond, the second prince, broke off their engagement, Christiana regained her memories of her past life.

Just as she decided to live life on her own terms, she receives a marriage proposal from the Dragonkin Crown Prince. Furthermore, the bloodline she inherited from her deceased mother is that of a descendant of Aquitaine, a family with the right to succession to the throne of all nations… Christiana's future is fraught with turmoil!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: Kekkon no Katachi: Swap Kon
mangas.titleNative: 結婚のカタチ～スワップ婚～
mangas.description:
Two couples living in a certain apartment building, rumored to be the "ideal couples," have a secret. It's a swap marriage—a fake marriage between two same-sex couples. A "lavender marriage" allowing you to live freely with the person you love, should have nothing but advantages, but...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Watashitachi, Jibun wo Matta Tsuma nanode
mangas.titleNative: 私達、自分を持った妻なので

mangas.title: Kinketsu Wanko wa Koi dake Oazuke
mangas.titleNative: 金欠わんこは恋だけおあずけ
mangas.description:
[A Rich Guy with Slightly Kinky Tastes × A Good-for-Nothing Guy with No Luck with Money: A Steamy, Heart-Fluttering Romance That Starts as a Pet Arrangement!]

Kenta, who had broken up with his ex-boyfriend because of his careless spending habits, was drowning his sorrows at a bar.
That’s when Kyoya—a regular at the bar whose looks were right up his alley—approached him, and they ended up drinking together.
As they chatted, they realized they were both attracted to men, so they headed straight to a hotel.
They ended up having sex on a whim, and while it felt good—and Kyoya even stroked his head affectionately, making Kenta feel pretty good about it—he soon realized…

“You’ve got a nice coat. Be my pet.”
“…………Huh?”

He’s handsome, charming, and they’re physically compatible… but Kyoya is a guy with some questionable kinks—!?

mangas.title: Shinigami-sama ni Hiawase na Yomeiri wo
mangas.titleNative: 死神様に幸せな嫁入りを

mangas.title: Hotokeno-kun wa Hajimete no Kuse ni
mangas.titleNative: 仏野くんはハジメテのくせに

mangas.title: Shiitagerare Reijou, Henkyou no Iro Boke Roujin no Gosai ni Naru Hazu ga, Bibou no Henkyou Haku-sama ni Dekiai Sareru Nante Kiiteimasen!
mangas.titleNative: 虐げられ令嬢、辺境の色ボケ老人の後妻になるはずが、美貌の辺境伯さまに溺愛されるなんて聞いていません！

mangas.title: Yomei Ichinen no Kokoro Yomi no Reijou wa Reikoku Hidou to Uwasa Sareru Koutei ni Dekiai Sareru: Kare no Honne wa Ama Sugimasu
mangas.titleNative: 余命一年の心読みの令嬢は冷酷非道と噂される皇帝に溺愛される～彼の本音は甘すぎます～

mangas.title: Tekikoku de Reiguu sareta Koujo-sama wa Otto no Ai ni Kizukanai
mangas.titleNative: 敵国で冷遇された皇女様は夫の愛に気づかない
mangas.description:
Princess Mira of the Casparia Empire married into the enemy kingdom of Edelgard, enduring all kinds of mistreatment in the name of peace. However, her hopes were dashed when her homeland was destroyed and she was ordered to divorce. On the day of their separation, just as she was about to return the wedding ring to her husband, Prince Klaus—a man who never loved her—she somehow time-leaped back to their wedding day!?

As she searches for a way to save her homeland once again, she uncovers many unknown sides of her husband!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Supadari Ouji-sama no Kurui Ai
mangas.titleNative: スパダリ王子様の狂い愛

mangas.title: Mahou Shoujo ni Naritakunai!!
mangas.titleNative: 魔法少女にゃなりたくない！！
mangas.description: It's a TS mahou shoujo (shounen) manga! "Fight on, magical girl (else you'll never go back to being a boy again)!"

mangas.title: Samayou Fuufu: 3-nen me no Crisis
mangas.titleNative: さまよう夫婦～3年目のクライシス～
mangas.description:
"Could it be that we've been unknowingly going down different paths...?"

Saho Shintani, 32 years old. Married for three years. She had no visible complaints about her work or family life, and her husband, Shinichi, was always calm and kind. On their wedding anniversary, Saho casually brought up the topic of trying to conceive, but Shinichi responded with a distant, detached "Saho, you're the one who's going to have the baby, so you can decide..."

Saho longed to talk things through, but Shinichi wanted to avoid conflict. And as Saho struggled with the difference in their attitudes towards trying to conceive, another "unusual event" struck. Meanwhile, Shinichi's ex-girlfriend, whom he once had feelings for, reappeared... Where will the two of them go, wandering with unanswered questions?

A human drama depicting the realistic regeneration of a married couple.

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

mangas.title: Shino-kun no Koubutsu wa Senpai desu
mangas.titleNative: 四野くんの好物は先輩です

mangas.title: Ryuuzoku to Reijou no Ban Omo Sugiru ni Sennen, Dekiai
mangas.titleNative: 竜族と令嬢の番 重すぎる二千年、溺愛
mangas.description: This is an otherworldly romance story centering on Elna, a girl with mysterious scales on her body. Having lost her only loving mother to illness, she is scorned by her father, stepmother, and stepsister, treated like a servant. The only thing that sustains her in her loneliness is her longing for the dragon lord who lives in a powerful kingdom in the sky.

mangas.title: Gunjou ni Shoki Shoudou
mangas.description: The setting is Tsukigashima, a small island three hours by boat from Tokyo. Nozomi, a high school girl attending Tsukigaoka High School, which is attended by locals, is interested in Ten, a boy who attends Hoshijima Marine High School, which is attended by people from Tokyo. Nozomi, who always acts before she thinks, meets Ten by chance, and the two end up going to the sea together.

mangas.title: Renai Fushin na Reijou wa Reikoku Kishi-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai
mangas.titleNative: 恋愛不信な令嬢は冷酷騎士様の溺愛に気づかない
mangas.synonyms: A Love-Distrusting Noble Lady Doesn't Notice the Cold Knight's Devotion
mangas.description:
One day, Countess Rosalie witnesses her lover, Hayden, cheating on her. Heartbroken, Rosalie becomes timid about love. However, she is then proposed to by the dashing future Marquis, Rufus…!? A school romance story between a love-challenged young lady and a notoriously cold knight!

(Source: Flex Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Apocalypse no Hoshi wo Daite
mangas.titleNative: アポカリプスの星を抱いて
mangas.description:
“Everything but you is a lie—!”

[Ambitious Hacker × Secret-Holding Heir]
A near-future BL story that transcends social class, weaved by two people surviving in a cold, cyborg world—now begins!

The year is 2575. In a post-nuclear war world, humanity has been driven into underground cities.
Francisco, a young man living in the lowest level, “Grey Base,” works as a host in a virtual space, while spending his days hacking to steal customer information and make money.

“I’ll definitely move up to the top level, ‘Core Haven’—”
One day, as he struggles desperately, an extraordinary request arrives from a major conglomerate.

The target is a mysterious young man named “Chisei.”
Living alone in a lavish mansion, Chisei is an eccentric who, for some reason, collects paper books—a rarity in this era.

As Francisco serves him as a host, despite his confusion, it is revealed that Francisco and Chisei share a fateful connection…?

mangas.title: Ouji to Majo to Himegimi to: After the tale
mangas.titleNative: 王子と魔女と姫君と～After the tale～
mangas.description:
Twelve years have passed since high school graduation, and Subaru and the others are living their lives in different ways. At a class reunion, they are reunited with the former princess and other familiar faces after a long time...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Imasara Suki toka Waraehen
mangas.titleNative: 今さら好きとか笑えへん
mangas.synonyms: Saying you love me now isn't even funny.

mangas.title: Hyper Shou!
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: 3-nenme no Oretachi
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Nonbiri Yururi to Futari
mangas.titleNative: のんびりゆるりとふたり
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Koko Hotte Wanwan
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Cute Aggression
mangas.titleNative: キュートアグレッション
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Anata to Tanoshii Mainichi wo
mangas.titleNative: あなたと楽しい毎日を
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Happy Un Birthday Chitose-kun
mangas.synonyms: HappyBirthdayちとせくん 番外編
mangas.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 59, was then licensed by Homesha for digital release.

mangas.title: Saki ni Ochita no wa
mangas.description:
After getting fired from his part-time job, Arashi Hayakawa is on the hunt for his next gig. A friend recommends him for a position as a housekeeper, but there's a catch: the employer is Chikage Yuzuki, his high school classmate, with whom he never got along. Nervous but determined, Arashi begins working for Yuzuki. His former classmate is just as arrogant as ever, yet occasional glimpses of his softer side leave Arashi completely flustered. Then, one day in Yuzuki's room, Arashi makes a shocking discovery: a photo of himself with some adult toys...

(Source: DLSite, translated)

mangas.title: Tokuten
mangas.description:
A collection of bookstore bonuses (excluding paid bonuses) and web comics from Anzen de Nai Bokutachi wa and Mata Ashita Aeru yo.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 59.

mangas.title: Osoroi ni Nare ya Shinai Bokutachi wa
mangas.titleNative: お揃いになれやしない僕たちは
mangas.description:
Side story to Himitsu Ariki no Bokutachi desu ga.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN59.

mangas.title: Vanilla to Orange
mangas.description:
"Will you kiss me? I'll die if things stay like this..."

Kai, a high school girl, encounters a couple who have broken up over a trivial matter at her part-time job. Just as she was thinking that she wanted to be careful and cherish her own love life, she unexpectedly reunites with Azuma, who had been dumped, at a committee meeting!? While feeling uneasy around Azuma, she is flustered by his help, and then she encounters him again when he is being dumped by another girl...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Koisuru Kaichou wa Mendokusai
mangas.titleNative: 恋する会長はめんどくさい
mangas.description:
Suou is the perfect student council president, handsome, academically gifted, and athletically talented—everyone admires him. However, he has a hidden side: his approach to the secretary, Nagi, is heavy and annoying! Despite Nagi's cold and dismissive responses, the president relentlessly pursues her.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Hinata: Cute, Sincere, and Very Gyaru
mangas.titleNative: ちょろかわギャルの陽大くん
mangas.description:
"I'll love you until the day I die," is the confession that pierces his heart. "If you say something like that, I can't help but to fall in love with you!!"
A school rom-com BL starring an introvert who refuses to show his eyes and an outgoing boy who's into gyaru fashion!

Lately, there's someone who's caught the attention of social butterfly Hinata. That person is no other than Yuki, his gloomy classmate who hides his eyes behind overgrown bangs. "I have to get a glimpse of his eyes!" With that goal in mind, Hinata begins to close the distance between them. After a few months, and the two firm friends, Hinata takes a look beneath those bangs... only to find out that Yuki is a stud?! Stunned by his friend's face and heart beating fast, Hinata impulsively says, "Should I let myself be swept away?"

mangas.title: One More Time Lover!
mangas.titleNative: ワンモアタイムラバー！

mangas.title: Kawaiku Naite ne, Onodera-san
mangas.titleNative: 可愛く鳴いてね、小野寺さん

mangas.title: Saikyou Henkyou Haku ni Hirowaremashita, Kotori (=Akujo?) desu
mangas.titleNative: 最恐辺境伯に拾われました、小鳥（＝悪女？）です

mangas.title: Ao no Mama, 2500km Kita e
mangas.description:
High school graduation day.
Satoru, who had decided to go off to college in Tokyo alone to put an end to his feelings for his classmate Yuzu, gently slips a note into Yuzu’s uniform that simply reads, “I’ve always liked you.”
However, the blazer is blown away by the wind and gets caught on a truck bound for Kushiro, which drives off with it.
Satoru laughs it off, but Yuzu announces she’s going to Hokkaido to find out what Satoru put in her pocket…

mangas.title: Igyou no Ai wa Hodoke na
mangas.description:
This is a world where various races live as they please.
Kurosaki, a socially awkward human part-timer, lacked confidence in everything he did and spent his days getting fired from one part-time job after another.
One day, while at a loss because he hadn’t found his next job, he accidentally bumped into a man on the street and spilled his coffee on him.
In that instant, tentacles shot out from the man’s body!
The man, Takamiya, was actually a member of the “Tentacle Clan,” a race that is reviled in this world.
Having discovered his true identity, Kurosaki is taken to Takamiya’s massive mansion without really understanding what’s going on…?

mangas.title: Futago no Ouji ni Futago de Konyaku Shita kedo "ja Nai Hou" dakara Yami Mahou wo Kiwameru
mangas.titleNative: 双子の王子に双子で婚約したけど「じゃない方」だから闇魔法を極める
mangas.synonyms: The Twin Princes got Engaged to Twins, but Because I'm "The Other One" I Decided to Master Dark Magic
mangas.description: Shuri, a half-beast of the Cat Clan and prince of Ryuepen, was constantly being compared to his twin brother, Ryuka. Whether it was appearance, fur color, intelligence, or magical ability, Ryuka was superior in every way. Not only did their parents praise Ryuka, but so did the people of the kingdom. Compounded by the ominous superstition surrounding black cats, Shuri was continually looked down upon as “the lesser one.” One day, Shuri and Ryuka were transferred to an academy in the neighboring kingdom of “Lindenberg” to marry the twin princes of Lindenberg, Siegfried and Gilbert. “The throne of Lindenberg will be inherited by the more capable of Siegfried and Gilbert. Since Siegfried and Gilbert’s abilities are nearly equal, wouldn’t the throne be decided by the quality of their ‘spouses’—” Having overheard this by chance, Shuri began to devote herself wholeheartedly to her studies—both to ensure that Siegfried, her fiancé-to-be, would become king and to prevent him from abandoning her. However, no matter how hard she tried, the gap between her and her genius younger brother only continued to widen—

mangas.title: Senrihin Reijou Cheryl wa Jibun wo Korosu Otto wo Rouraku Shitai
mangas.titleNative: 戦利品令嬢シェリルは自分を殺す夫を籠絡したい

mangas.title: Tomoshibi
mangas.description:
Who did you kill?

Hinata Yoshizumi, pregnant and without a job or home, collapses in front of the house of a woman named Asumi Inogai and ends up stowed away inside. Hinata begins to trust the kind Asumi, but then Asumi confesses, "I've killed someone..."

A story of two women with no way out, and their struggle over a child.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Mienai Template
mangas.titleNative: 見えないテンプレート
mangas.description:
A proper marriage, a proper life. To achieve that, one must first start with love. As his peers and younger brother get married, Iida solidifies his resolve and, exhausted by the process of finding a partner, meets a woman. He tries to arrange a second date with Nagashima, with whom he has a pleasant conversation, but she tells him, "I'm not good with men, so please wait before you touch me"...?

A powerful work depicting one way of being for men and women, who wander in search of a way out while trapped in invisible templates.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Totte Kuwanaide Tokiwa-kun
mangas.titleNative: とって喰わないで常葉くん
mangas.description: Mizutani, a high school boy who can see non-human beings, meets "Tokiwa-kun" after saving him from a supernatural phenomenon. Tall, a little gloomy, lonely, clumsy...and honest, Tokiwa-kun makes Mizutani increasingly interested in him. But one afternoon after school, in a classroom trapped by something... "It's okay not to be scared, will you kiss me?" Tokiwa-kun suddenly changes...!?

mangas.title: Kimi no Manimani, Suzuki-kun.
mangas.titleNative: 君のまにまに、鈴木くん。
mangas.description:
Notes:
- During serialization, Chapters 1 to 4 were split into two parts while Chapter 5 was split in three parts, all later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Punctum
mangas.description:
Ukawa, a first-year oil painting student at an art university, is blessed with promising talent, yet feels a disconnect between his own attitude towards romance and that of those around him, leading him to spend his days alone. He is drawn to the beauty of Kou, an upperclassman he meets at university, but keeps his distance due to Kou's apparent womanizing. However, after a chance encounter, Ukawa learns that Kou harbors a secret desire to be embraced by a man, and makes a proposition to him...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Konyaku Haki Sarete Jiyuu wo Teniireta Onna Hakushaku desu ga, Chishiki wo Ikashite Shisho ni Nattara Ou Otouto Denka ni Mitomerare, Senzoku ni Narimashita
mangas.titleNative: 婚約破棄されて自由を手に入れた女伯爵ですが、知識をいかして司書になったら王弟殿下に認められ、専属になりました
mangas.description:
After breaking off her engagement with her fiancé, Karliana makes a fresh start and becomes a librarian at the royal library. One day, a seemingly frivolous, handsome young man named Dietosius appears before her. Impressed by Karliana's intelligence and thirst for knowledge, Dietosius asks, "Would you like to become my personal librarian?"

(Source: Compass, translated)

mangas.title: Usotsuki Ookami wa Ai wo Kataru
mangas.titleNative: 嘘つき狼は愛をかたる

mangas.title: Chorokawa Ω wa Shitakunai
mangas.titleNative: ちょろかわΩはシたくない
mangas.description:
My Neighbor Alpha Is Just Perfectly Compatible Physically—But That’s the Only Thing!?

Nagi Takamiya, an Omega, was dumped by his boyfriend because of their physical compatibility. Today, once again, intense moans are coming from the room next door…
“I can’t take this anymore!” he thinks, and goes to complain. Just then, a woman bursts out of the room, hurling insults at a man before storming off. Nagi stands there dumbfounded, but the moment the man appears—he experiences his very first heat…! !
Unable to resist the unfamiliar pleasure, Nagi gives in to his impulses and has sex with his neighbor. Then, the man starts aggressively pressuring him, saying, “I want you to be my boyfriend!”
Even though he thinks, “I’m done with romance…,” he just can’t forget that sensation, so he decides to start a casual sex arrangement with his Alpha neighbor—

A relentless, insatiable Alpha × a heartbroken Omega who refuses romance—a sweet yet frustrating Omegaverse BL story about two people whose physical chemistry is just too perfect!

mangas.title: Cream Night Baby
mangas.titleNative: クリームナイトベイビー

mangas.title: Saigo no Koi wa Boku ni Shite
Kimi wa Amai Ude no Naka
Watashitachi ga Mita Mono wa
mangas.titleNative: わたしたちがみたものは
mangas.description:
A certain village in N Prefecture, 2010. Ao—who moved to the village with her family for a redevelopment project—has settled into rural life, spending her days energetically alongside her best friends, Mitsuru and Sayoko. As "Yui-gaeshi"—the annual village festival—draws near once again, Ao utters a single phrase: "I want to see the true identity of Lord Yui." With those words, their peaceful days begin to crumble. Was it a curse? A calamity? What exactly was it that we witnessed on that fateful day? A tale that asks: What constitutes true horror? The curtain rises on this countryside horror saga.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

mangas.title: Dakareta-gari no Mao-senpai
mangas.titleNative: 抱かれたがりのまお先輩

mangas.title: Koisuru nara Yubisaki made
mangas.titleNative: 恋するならゆびさきまで

mangas.title: Shachiku Majo Rutta wa Shukufuku Ouji no Okiniiri
mangas.titleNative: 社畜魔女ルッタは祝福王子のお気に入り
mangas.synonyms: Rutta, the Corporate Slave Witch, Is the Blessed Prince’s Favorite

mangas.title: Mandragora tte Baretara Toubatsu desu ka? Hana no Majo no Hohoemi wa Kanchigai no Tane wo Maku
mangas.titleNative: 魔物ってバレたら討伐ですか？ ～花の魔女のほほえみは勘違いの種を蒔く～
mangas.synonyms: 魔物（マンドラゴラ）ってバレたら討伐ですか？ ～花の魔女のほほえみは勘違いの種を蒔く～
mangas.description: Having met an unfortunate end, Misaki is reincarnated as an extraordinary mandrake that transforms into a deadly monster just by screaming! Determined to finally enjoy a happy (human?) life, she manages to take on a human form, but her inability to speak causes all sorts of misunderstandings, leading people to worship her as the "Flower Witch"... While dreading being hunted if her true nature is revealed, she struggles to achieve a peaceful life!!

mangas.title: Wana ni Kakatta Villain-kun
mangas.titleNative: 罠にかかったビィランくん
mangas.synonyms: The Villain Caught in a Trap
mangas.description:
The story follows Chihiro, a high school girl determined to help her friend Yuzu achieve her first love. One day—sparked by the idea of a double date—Chihiro approaches Akamine, a boy who happens to be on good terms with the object of Yuzu's affection, and asks for his cooperation in bringing the two together. However, he flatly turns her down, retorting, "Why don't you just leave them alone?" and "You're such a busybody." The story follows the romance that unfolds between these two individuals, whose personalities and mindsets couldn't be more incompatible.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Ryuujin-sama no Futago no Tsugai
mangas.titleNative: 龍神さまの双子のつがい
mangas.description:
Born into a branch family of the prestigious Asagiri family, which bears the role of the "Dragon God" protecting the imperial capital, Hanamura Tsubomi has been oppressed as an outcast. In contrast to her younger sister Saki, who is favored by their parents, Tsubomi's existence is not acknowledged by anyone. But one day, she meets Homare, the next head of the Asagiri family. The moment their fingertips touch, a glowing "Dragon Seal" appears!? Homare declares, "I will take you as my bride." However, due to the machinations of both families, her younger sister Saki also ends up living in the main house as a "bride candidate"...

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

mangas.title: Majin Koushaku to no Himitsu no Keiyaku: Densetsu no Dai Akujo no Umarekawari desu ga, Majin ni Dekiai Sareteimasu
mangas.titleNative: 魔人公爵との秘密の契約～伝説の大悪女の生まれ変わりですが、魔人に溺愛されています～

mangas.title: Nyanpani!
mangas.description:
Hinata is a high school girl who is always working on self-improvement. Popular with both boys and girls, she meets two popular upperclassmen at school, Kizuna and Nagisa. Hinata falls in love with the kind and gentlemanly Nagisa, while Kizuna is cold and aloof. Then, one day, she saves a cat, and her exciting school life begins.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Okaa-san to Issho!: 40-sai no Mitori to Koi
mangas.titleNative: お母さんと一緒！～40歳の看取りと恋～
mangas.description:
Erina is a 40-year-old single woman who has worked hard in both love and her career. One day, she receives a call from her mother with an unusual tone, only to learn that she has stage 4 colon cancer. Furthermore, she hears that her single friend from college, Tani, is getting married...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Black Roudou Mahou Shoujo
mangas.titleNative: ブラック労働魔法少女
mangas.description: A “monster” born from people’s negative emotions. The protagonist, Kokoro, became “Pure Heart,” the magical girl everyone looked up to who protected everyone from the town’s crises—but the working conditions for a magical girl were absolutely outrageous…!? On call 365 days a year, with a salary of zero yen. Just as Kokoro was about to quit—she’d had enough—a high school student named Shirosaki, who idolized her, appeared before her. It was decided that he would take over the role, but…?

mangas.title: Mikami-kun no Adeyakana Himegoto
mangas.titleNative: 美神くんの艶やかな秘め事
mangas.description:
En Shiozaki is nicknamed the “Walking Pillar Of Salt” by other people because of her cold, aloof demeanor. One day, a new transfer student named Mikami joins her class — an oblivious but incredibly handsome and attractive guy who’s practically oozing pheromones!! Just as she was planning to live a peaceful school life all alone by herself, her plan is suddenly turned upside down by Mikami…!?

(Source: Ribon, translated)

mangas.title: Garden in the Closet
mangas.titleNative: ガーデン・イン・ザ・クローゼット
mangas.description: Koki is a big, burly high school student who fits in well with the boys. But deep down, he's confused by the topics of conversation and can't honestly talk about his knowledge of plants. One day, a transfer student named Misaki arrives in his class. But for some reason, Koki is the only one who can't see him... A story about living for tomorrow, drawn by up-and-coming artist Itono Kei.

mangas.title: Kitchen no Ohime-sama One More Plate!
mangas.titleNative: キッチンのお姫さま　ワン・モア・プレート！

mangas.title: Watakushi, Makemasen Node. Seiryaku Kekkon wa Reijou no Tashinami
mangas.titleNative: わたくし、負けませんので。 政略結婚は令嬢のたしなみ

mangas.title: Haruka-kun wa Make Heroine ni wa Naranai!
mangas.titleNative: 春楓くんは負けヒロインにはならない！

mangas.title: Vapor Trail no Ushiru
mangas.titleNative: ベイパー・トレイルのうしろ

mangas.title: Kuchibiru ni Uso no Uwanuri
mangas.titleNative: くちびるに嘘の上塗り

mangas.title: Akuma to Boku no Koufukuron
mangas.description: Yukito grew up as the second-generation member of a cult. Unable to touch women due to a traumatic experience, he was unable to fulfill his mission for the cult. Driven to the brink, he summoned—a demon.

mangas.title: Zoku Torano Tantei Jimusho e Youkoso
mangas.titleNative: 続・寅野探偵事務所へようこそ

mangas.title: Gansaku no Daijuuban
mangas.description: Beethoven's Symphony No. 10—the unfinished masterpiece of the century. A new "destiny" is set in motion, revolving around the existence of a handwritten score that has been declared a forgery…!!

mangas.titleNative: 輪廻婚 ～大正ロマン恋慕～
mangas.description:
A love story of reincarnation between a man and a woman who meet by chance across time.

Kaoru Tachibana, who dropped out of graduate school to pay off her deceased father's debts and decided to work, meets a handsome man, Aoi Fujinami, on her way to school to complete the withdrawal procedures. Kaoru is puzzled to find that she is fine with Aoi touching her, despite being fastidious with men. But the next moment, Aoi, whom she has only just met, tells her, "You are my wife..."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Yona Yona Bokura wa Machiawase
mangas.titleNative: 夜な夜な僕らは待ち合わせ
mangas.description:
Kou Nishito, a graduate student suffering from insomnia, and Yoiko Ichijo, who has been unable to sleep due to loneliness since becoming independent, are discovered to be "compatible" individuals with a highly compatible sleep gene, "Nemunoki." They begin a cohabitation experiment to achieve stable sleep. Though hesitant, they fall asleep in the same bed, and drift into a deep sleep they haven't experienced in years...

The feeling of having someone beside you. The curtain rises on a strange and heartwarming story of two awkward people.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: My President: Ore no Kareshi wa Seitokaichou
mangas.titleNative: My President 俺の彼氏は生徒会長
mangas.description:
Even though I’m supposed to hate him, my heart just won’t stop racing—!

Gan challenged Tin—the school’s top student and most popular kid—to a head-to-head race in the student council president election.
However, the result ended in a complete defeat for Gan.
At the after-party, Gan—who’d already been teased by his friends and was feeling utterly defeated—fell asleep due to an accident.
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unfamiliar room, with a naked Tin right next to him!
Gan is confused about having ended up in a physical relationship with his archrival. On top of that, at school, he ends up facing unreasonable treatment because of Tin, the new student council president.
Annoyed by Tin’s cool and arrogant attitude, Gan rebels against him, but…

The long-awaited manga adaptation of the original novel for the smash-hit, heart-fluttering Thai BL coming-of-age drama is here!

mangas.title: Ano ne, Amu ne
mangas.description:
Ayumu, a sugar baby who goes by the name “Amu,” shows up in front of Godai, a gruff scaffolder with a menacing look. After a mix-up where Ayumu’s sugar daddy mistakenly thought he was a honey trap, Ayumu somehow ends up crashing at Godai’s place!

“I have nowhere to go,”

“Gou-chan’s place is best,” Ayumu says, clinging to him with childlike innocence. In exchange for letting him stay, he proposes a physical relationship.

“I’m not into that,” Gouda says, trying to kick him out, but when Ayumu clings to him so defenselessly, he loses control of his rationality…!
A mysterious young man with zero sense of decency or common sense—he calls his dad over to someone else’s house without permission and brings in all sorts of cute knick-knacks and furniture.
Though Gouda is fed up with him, he can’t bring himself to ignore Ayumu, who’s foolishly innocent yet has a somewhat lonely look in his eyes…?

mangas.description:
I'm your hostage, so you can have your way with me.
A stubborn older king and a devoted noble prince navigate their love in this fantasy BL!

Prince Lim has offered himself as a hostage to the palace of the neighboring kingdom of Suyarvilette, all so he can meet his first love, Finn, the man who was once in charge of his education. No matter what Lim does, he can't shake the complicated feelings he has for the man who took such good care of him as a child. Lim tries to close the distance between them using his status as a hostage as an excuse, but Finn refuses to budge and begins making preparations to send Lim home. Lim can't stand to be away from his beloved, and, in an attempt to get Finn's blood pumping and seduce him, invites him by saying, "I'm an adult now"...

(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.description:
The moment she awakens, Lady Cassandra Wendel realizes she has been reincarnated as the villainess from "The Tale of the Saint of Light's Salvation," a book she read in her previous life. If things continue as they are, she is destined to be condemned by the summoned saint and the men who flock to her.
The villainess, who rose to power through wicked means in her previous life, decides to defy the script and condemn them.

"I'll show you what a true villain is!"

The villainess's reversal of fortune begins here!

mangas.title: Yume no Tsuzuki de Mattete
mangas.description:
Hinagiku Nomura has always been treated as a strange girl by her family and friends because of the prophetic dreams she’s had since childhood. Determined to spend her school days with the "destined woman" who keeps appearing in her dreams, she takes the plunge and transfers to the all-girls boarding school — Minazuki Girls’ Academy — in her second year of high school!

Shortly after moving in, she runs into trouble and can’t get into her room, so she ends up staying in the room of a mysterious beauty named Tsubaki. As they spend time together, Hinagiku realizes that Tsubaki is the person of her dreams. But the continuation of the dream she had on her first day of school leads to a shockingly intense scene…?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ni Atta Sandome ni
mangas.description:
"I never thought we'd meet again."

Ototsuji, who gave up his dream of becoming an opera singer and now works as a music teacher, is reunited with his college crush, Misato, at his new school. Feeling inferior around Misato, who knew him back when he was still chasing his dreams, Ototsuji is flustered by Misato's unchanging kindness as his old feelings begin to resurface.

The time that had stopped for the two of them slowly begins to move again...

(Source: G-Walk, translated)

"Save the world with my 'love'!"

Raira, the daughter of a witch, has lived in the shadow of her great mother, acting the part of a “pure and innocent beautiful girl.” But, fueled by a momentary spark of lewd curiosity, she accidentally opens the gate connecting the human world and the demon world...!! And the key to saving the world she has betrayed turns out to be the “impure true feelings” she has kept hidden――!?

mangas.title: REMEMBER ME
mangas.description:
Originally shared on social media as a pioneering entry in the “old man yaoi" genre, this is a heartfelt story of two lives that continue to find their way back to each other.

After transferring to a new high school under difficult circumstances, Hisaki meets Akito, a bright and sociable boy who will one day become his partner. Where Akito is warm and open, Hisaki is withdrawn and weighed down by his past. Though Hisaki resolves time and again to cut ties, fate brings them back together at key moments throughout their lives. Now, after decades of distance, reunion, and quiet longing, the two have finally found a place to rest-together. After thirty years, their connection is far too deep to be called a beginning.

An adventure that takes place in an all-girls school and involves time travel, directly connecting them to the future!!

The story begins when Natsuno, a boy joining the high school's art program, is forced to stay at the home of Mashiro, due to family circumstances. When he sees her sketchbook from middle school, he tells her, “Don’t bother talking to me unless the house is on fire or someone’s dead.” Mashiro decides he’s impolite and annoying and tries to kick him out, but…

(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Anti Love Conflict
mangas.titleNative: アンチラブコンフリクト
mangas.description:
A beastman Omegaverse story featuring a masked Alpha wolf with a secret past and a Sheep Omega who hates Alphas with a passion—two people who can’t stand each other!

Born as a herbivorous Sheep Omega at the bottom of the food chain, Nao has had strong pheromones since childhood.
He’s often gotten caught up in trouble, and those experiences have made him deeply hate Alphas.

At college, Nao befriends a group of herbivorous Omegas and, while desperately wishing, “I absolutely don’t want to lose this place,”
Yuma—a carnivorous wolf Alpha at the top of the food chain—suddenly infiltrates the group…!?

Nao is desperate to kick Yuma out of the group, but his efforts keep backfiring, leading to a string of failures.
Then one day, as Nao is stewing in frustration, Yuma appears—but he seems different from his usual self—?

Will this worst-case scenario turn into “love”? A seesaw game between two kindred spirits!

mangas.title: Flash Your Eyes
mangas.titleNative: フラッシュ・ユア・アイズ
mangas.description:
“I’m being burned—by the blinding flash of the camera and by your gaze.”

Sakitaro, a college student studying stage design, had a secret: under the pseudonym “Taro,” he posted risqué cosplay photos on a private social media account.
What started as a bit of fun has now turned into a serious exploration of “erotic” expression for the earnest Sakitaro.

One day, a friend asks him to help edit footage for a solo exhibition being held by Kazuki, a student in the film department.
Although Kazuki came across as aloof and unapproachable, Sakitaro was struck by the sincerity with which he praised his skills, so he decided to accept the request.

As they worked together, Sakitaro began to feel at ease around Kazuki, realizing he wasn’t aloof at all—just clumsy.
However, while editing at home, Kazuki caught him looking at a selfie he’d taken in a compromising pose—!?

That shutter sound lays his heart bare.
A tongue-tied aspiring photographer × a stoic, good-natured guy with a secret social media account—
An artistic love story where two clumsy souls are drawn to each other through the lens!

mangas.title: Fuyuki-senpai wo XXX de Wakarasetai!
mangas.titleNative: 冬木先輩を×××でわからせたい！
mangas.description:
Guh… so cute… my d*ck’s driving me crazy~~!!!!
A no-nonsense, wild romantic comedy starring a clumsy, shy underclassman and a grumpy, bespectacled upperclassman!

“You’re going to play my girlfriend.”
“W-w-w-why me―――!?”

A university lab. Nojima has a crush on Fuyuki, a pedantic upperclassman who’s anything but cute.
Fed up with Fuyuki always cornering him with logical arguments, Nojima lets his guard down and blurts out,
“Can you even maintain your grades if you have a girlfriend?”

To this, Fuyuki replies, “I’ll prove it to you,”
and—having seen right through Nojima’s feelings—proposes the unexpected “pretend dating” game—!?

“…Even if it’s just pretend, being lovers with you would make me so giddy.”

Seizing this once-in-a-lifetime chance, Nojima launches an all-out offensive! Can he melt the “grumpy senior”—who blushes bright red at a single kiss— until she’s so weak she can’t even stand?
A wild, logic-defying romantic comedy!

mangas.title: Boukyaku Go no Aletheia
mangas.titleNative: 忘却後のアレーティア
mangas.description: Aletheia, a member of the Magic Corps, 1st Division, possesses a rare magical power known as “Forgetting Magic.” Even the notoriously cold and ruthless Division Commander Christoph treats her with kid gloves, and she finds comfort in their ambiguous relationship. However, something is about to shatter her peaceful life…!?

mangas.title: Mother Trap: Mama Tomodachi ga Ochiru Made

mangas.title: Haru wa Kumo no Ue
mangas.description:
Fifteen-year-old Souta Tanaka is the kind of boy who quietly blends into the background, to the point that even his classmates struggle to remember his name. Still, hidden behind his ordinary days is a secret crush on Karen Kozakura, a famous influencer with over 100,000 followers on social media. Souta never thought someone like Karen would ever cross paths with him in any meaningful way. But after a chance encounter brings them together, he ends up listening to her worries about love...

A romantic comedy centered around a background character unfolds in the kindest way imaginable!

mangas.title: First Pierce
mangas.description:
[A Low-Key, Mobb-Like Guy with a Chilly, Seductive Charm × A Weak-Willed, Easily Led Boy]

Suzuki, who’s been longing for the “earrings” that are all the rage in his class, was about to pierce his own ears because he didn’t have the money— when he was stopped by Tōdō, a plain-looking guy with zero presence.

After school, when he’s invited to Tōdō’s house… there’s a super-hot guy with flashy earrings waiting for him!?

“I’ll pierce it for you.”

His unusual aura and practiced closeness make Suzuki’s heart race for some strange reason.
And just as he offers to thank him, Todou steals his first kiss—!?

With his ear still throbbing and the sensation of those feverish lips lingering, Suzuki heads over to Todou’s place the next day—
“…I want you to pierce my ear again.”

One day, a high school boy named Eishin—who looks just like her favorite character—tells her, “You’ve got to fall for me,” and… before she knows it, he’s dragged her to the volleyball club at an all-boys school!? Could it be that her real-life high school romance has just begun…!?

mangas.title: Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban
mangas.description:
"Witches lurk among these girls."

It was supposed to be Ema's first day of high school. But instead of waking up in her bed, she found herself in a dark prison cell. She found herself suddenly trapped in an island prison, isolated in some unknown, distant sea. In her confusion, an owl informed Ema of her new situation:

"You have been identified as a potential witch — a threat to the world. Thus, you will live here as a prisoner for the rest of your life."

The life Ema had taken for granted had suddenly collapsed. As she began her new life as a prisoner, Ema got to know the other girls in her situation. Her fellow witch candidates. However, one day, the owl gathered the prisoners for a shocking announcement:

"We will be holding a witch trial."

One by one, the girls would have to single out a witch among the thirteen of them...

In other words, they would have to vote out the next candidate to be executed. It was the beginning of a cruel game indeed...

mangas.title: Why Abusing Power to Indulging in Pleasure on the Bed?
mangas.synonyms: Heyi Nong Quan Ta Shang Huan
mangas.description:
The Scheming Fake Eunuch X The Madly Infatuated Prince.

Reborn and returned, they don masks for their own purposes—mutually distrustful yet irresistibly drawn to each other. Amidst suspicion and testing, they soberly succumb to their attraction.

mangas.title: False Moon
mangas.description: To pay off his debts, he dresses as a woman, only to accidentally cross paths with a gang’s top hitman—and, through a series of misunderstandings, ends up becoming his partner. Forced to live together, this unlikely pair finds themselves caught in a tug-of-war between lies and growing feelings…

mangas.title: Yeren de Hunli
mangas.description: This is the story of an unlucky guy and a dark, domineering CEO living like wild men in the mountains. It includes elements of mystery, family drama, raunchy jokes, and crime.

mangas.title: After Becoming the Villain's Puppet
mangas.description: Sword cultivator Wen Sanjiu was injured in a fierce battle. When he woke up, he discovered that he had somehow become a puppet created by the dark cultivator Seventh Laugh. To his even greater surprise, this puppet looked exactly like him. What on earth is Seventh Laugh trying to do by creating this puppet?!

mangas.title: Yu Di Gong Mian
mangas.description:
Warrior Ulysses is sent back in time 50 years to save the world, but finds himself entangled with the very person he’s supposed to protect. A decorative heir to the throne x a dutiful warrior from the future

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Zhuang Guai Bei Chaichuan Hou, Shuangzi Baojun Jiang Wo Suo Zai Wangzuo Xia
mangas.titleNative: 装乖被拆穿后，双子暴君将我锁在王座下
mangas.description: Although Omega Sindel was poor, he was very ambitious; however, his peaceful life was turned upside down after he met the prince and his brother, who were Alphas.

mangas.title: The Importance of Joining the Company
mangas.description: Kitae hurriedly found a part-time job to earn tuition, but... the boss at the company he joined is asking for something unusual?!

mangas.title: Pick Me, Love Me
mangas.description:
Appearing in a film by the talented director Hyeon Jung-Hui is every actor's dream. Yeon-Woo, a longtime fan, gets a chance to audition for Jung-Hui's new film by accident. But the audition was actually a setup by the casting director to offer Jung-Hui sexual favors. Unaware of this, Yeon-Woo, hearing Jung-Hui's mocking words telling him to seduce him, naturally assumes it's acting and obediently climbs on top...

“What? You didn't prepare? You want me to undo your belt too?”

A romance where a prickly older man peels away layer after layer of a cheeky young man's charm.

mangas.title: Wintertime
mangas.description: Ever since being disowned by his religious parents for being gay, Kwon Yi-Hyeon has been all alone. After nine years, he believes he has gotten used to this life until he runs into Gu Seung-Hyeok, an old wound from high school. Now a ruthless gangster, Seung-Hyeok is just as cold to Yi-Hyeon as the winter they have reunited in. But when Yi-Hyeon enters a contract deal with Seung-Hyeok due to his financial troubles, perhaps their frosty relationship could turn into hope of a spring to come...

mangas.title: A Hot Spring Trip With Friends
mangas.description:
“How are you supposed to handle two of them? Just stay put.”

Yun Ju-Won, a job seeker about to graduate from college, ends up going on a hot spring trip at the urging of his twin friends Cha Cha-Hyeon and Cha Cha-Yun, whom he's known for ten years. But this trip feels strangely off. The pension they booked by chance is eerily quiet, and instead of taking the bath they were told to, the twins become fixated on Ju-Won's inverted nipples...

mangas.title: Diopter
mangas.description:
After completing his residency, Seol-Won opened an ophthalmology clinic in his hometown of Seosan. While visiting home, he decided to spend the holiday at a mountain villa with old friends from his hometown. However, his friends had to postpone their visit to the villa until the next day, leaving Seol-Won to spend the night alone at the villa. What woke Seol-Won from his sleep was the sound of an unfamiliar intruder. Filled with fear, Seol-Won tried contacting his friends and the police, but...

"I'm really sorry. We can't get the car in right now."

"Caller! Due to heavy snowfall, access to the mountain is currently difficult!"

...He was isolated. And that too, alone with the unfamiliar intruder, Alpha Gu-Ju.

mangas.title: Open Up!
mangas.description:
Drunk as a skunk, transfer student Moon Yeon-Su stumbles home and accidentally enters the apartment below his only to find the door code matches his. There, he witnesses his department teaching assistant, Yun Do-Ah, and his classmate, Hong Yi-Jae, in the act. The night passes amid this shocking scene, and the next day, Yeon-Su belatedly realizes his misdeed...

"... What the hell? Isn't that the pervert from yesterday?"

But unable to forget the pleasure of that night, Yeon-Su encounters the pair again, and thus begins his chaotic, lewd college life!

mangas.title: Goodnight, Sweet Dream
mangas.description:
Ryu Su-Ho has trouble falling asleep every night. The only voice on Channel "J" that helps him sleep disappears one day. His insomnia returns, and he stops by a convenience store hoping to finally fall asleep tonight. He hears "J," the voice he thought he'd never hear again. He can't let go of the only person who can cure his terrible insomnia. In his haste, Su-Ho blurts out a few words to him...

"...Mr. J, right?"

mangas.title: Orbit of the Crooked
mangas.description:
Beom Tae-Gyu's violence began in the summer. A good son, good grades, a good university. Seon-Woo Jung, who spent his days suppressing his emotions under his parents' pressure for good grades, felt an intense jolt when he was unexpectedly assaulted by his classmate Beom Tae-Gyu. Just as he was secretly enjoying violence as his sole solace and escape...

“Fuck. Did you... get a boner...?”

He was caught. By none other than Beom Tae-Gyu.

mangas.title: Bad Beat
mangas.description:
Lee Yeon-Jun is burdened with profound guilt, watching his older brother, Lee Yeon-O, sacrifice everything to support him due to his frail health. Desperate to free Yeon-O from this lifelong obligation, Yeon-Jun intentionally pushes his brother away with harsh words and sets out for Las Vegas. His goal is to survive on his own terms by fulfilling a lifelong dream: defeating Dius, the undisputed king of Texas Hold 'em poker, and securing the astronomical prize money.

However, Yeon-Jun's grand plan for independence takes a horrific turn on his very first night in the city of sin. While navigating the neon-lit streets, he accidentally stumbles into a dark alleyway and witnesses the brutal murder of a mysterious man named Anapa. Suddenly, Yeon-Jun's desperate quest for financial freedom transforms into a dangerous game of survival, where the stakes are far higher than any poker tournament he could ever play.

mangas.title: Nuga Deo Keo?
mangas.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Office Hero
mangas.description:
Reborn in South Korea in 2026, former hero Yong Sa-Jun struggles to adjust to a world without magic or dragons. After surviving a brutal job market, he finally lands a position at a major corporation - only to come face to face with the man he once loved in his past life: the prince he failed to save. Haunted by memories of tragedy, Sa-Jun tries to keep his distance. But when he discovers that the prince has been cursed, Sa-Jun resolves to save him once again…even if it means juggling deadlines and danger alike!

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Demon King's Bride is a Little Big
mangas.description: The Demon King 'Kashuriel,' who declared his intention to marry the princess of the human realm, sets out to take her back to the demon realm. However, the Demon King becomes deeply captivated by the strong, imposing 'princess' who fights him on equal footing. At the end of their battle, the princess's true identity is revealed: he was actually a massive, muscular knight who had been guarding the real princess like a shadow. The story then follows the pure romance that blossoms between the Demon King and this broad-shouldered knight.

mangas.title: Tale of the Black Tortoise
mangas.description: The Kingdom of Hyeonhwa. A nation where the Four Guardian Deities, led by Hyeon-Mu, ruled alongside the human king, achieving thousands of years of prosperity. Jin-Heon, seated upon the throne of the court, seeks to seize the power of the divine beast Mok-Hyeon and establish a realm ruled solely by humans. However, Jin-Heon is deprived of the moment to take Mok-Hyeon's power due to the existence of Jae-Hyeon. Yeon-Hwi is a young man who passed the highest imperial examination, a talented scholar. Yet, his father, displeased that the illegitimate son Yeon-Hwi surpassed the legitimate heir, poisons him. Having lived his entire life seeking his father's recognition, Yeon-Hwi, on the brink of death, harbors a hatred as fierce as his desire to be loved. And Mok-Hyeon answers that hatred. Muk-Hyeon finds Yeon-Hwi and brings him to the palace. After stripping him of his human name, he bestows upon him the name of a divine beast (Ja-Hyeon) and intends to keep him by his side...

mangas.title: Again, the Sun!
mangas.description:
Yang-Hui, who had secretly loved Tae-Young since childhood. Following Tae-Young's father's dying wish to take good care of his son even if he wasn't around, he never even dreamed of confessing and distanced himself from Tae-Young to sort out his feelings. Just as his constant tension and avoidance during Tae-Young's military service began to ease... One day, he wakes up to find himself completely naked, sleeping next to Tae-Young...?!

“No, we can't do this...!”

mangas.title: Scum Carnage
mangas.description:
In a world where guides have no human rights, the only being Shio must protect is his younger brother, Ter. Having struggled to escape the fate of being a ‘selected one’—little better than an Esper sex slave—Shio heads to the Esper house, a place akin to hell, when his brother becomes selected.

“Who left their guide behind?”

But unluckily, Sio encounters Esper, Erutio, before his brother. Sio tries to escape him, but...

“Coming here smelling like this? You want me to eat you, don't you?”
“I, I came to find my brother...!”
“Then crawl nicely. Beg for your brother's life with your guiding.”

The arrogant Erutio violates Shio without restraint, cruelly holding him captive. Time passes, and Shio grows accustomed to this life. Days flow by neither happy nor unhappy, but Erutio seems oddly off.

“Tell me about yourself.”

Suddenly trying to have a conversation?

“I want to kiss you.”

After starting with sex, now demanding a kiss? How on earth am I supposed to appease this utterly capricious Esper?

mangas.title: Rural Rivalry
mangas.description: Ju Sung-Hyeon has it all: the looks, the grades, and a flawless reputation. But his fast track to a golden future hits a massive speed bump when his family drags him to a middle-of-nowhere village. The uniforms are tacky, the locals are worse, and to top it all off, someone else is sitting in his throne as the school’s top student! Enter Park Chan-Woo, a born-and-bred country boy who doesn’t care about Sung-Hyeon’s city prestige. But when Sung-Hyeon confronts his new rival to reclaim his pride, Chan-Woo offers a deal he never expected: "If you want to talk, help me with the harvest first."

mangas.title: The Difficulties Faced by a Married Couple
mangas.description:
Long, long ago, deep within the towering forest, there existed a world inhabited only by humanoids. Among them, two adjacent mountains were home to the Fox Tribe and the Wolf Tribe, living separately. The beastmen from these two tribes fought constantly, like sworn enemies, and caught in the crossfire was the small village of herbivorous beastmen nestled between the mountains.

“Please stop fighting! If this keeps up, we'll all pack up and move away!!”

Finally, the furious herbivore-type humanoids declared a strike, forcing the Fox Tribe and Wolf Tribe to prepare a wedding for peace. Thus, Hwang Mi-Ho of the Fox Tribe and Jang Woo-Rang of the Wolf Tribe were chosen as representatives of their tribes and bound in matrimony.

“What?! You have no shame?! How could you...”

“What's so terrible about spending the first night together? Ah, could this be your first time?”

They intended to create harmony through marriage, but will this truly lead to a happy ending... for everyone?

mangas.title: I Decided to Kill Seong Ji Seung
mangas.description:
My first love murdered my family.

“...Why on earth did you do that?”

“I did it for you.”

Facing Sung Ji-Seong, who was released early after receiving a special pardon without even serving his full sentence, Jo Ye-Seong resolves to kill him with his own hands. But stabbing Ji-Seong, his first love, with his own hands isn't easy...

“No one else would have done more for you than I did.”

Even knowing those words were nonsense, I kept wavering, unable to kill Ji-Seung.

mangas.title: Collage
mangas.description:
In a season when cherry blossom petals scatter on the dry wind, I fell in love with a pale faced poet. My first experience of unrequited love was like a fever.
Each time I suffered from it, I caught my heated breath and quietly sank into misery. Yet that spring was undeniably the most lyrical season of my life.

Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.

mangas.title: Tasty Boss
mangas.description: One day, a Hongdukke suddenly appears. He tries to indulge in the bosses' lewd side…

mangas.title: Love Order
mangas.description:
Born gay, born single Kang Woo-Jin. He's been secretly in love with Choi Yi-Tae, the transfer student he met in his second year of high school, all the way to his current age of thirty. Kang Woo-Jin couldn't betray the friendship he shared with Choi Yi-Tae during their youthful days, convincing himself it was okay to remain just friends. But when Choi Yi-Tae starts pestering him to move in together, Kang Woo-Jin finds himself facing an unavoidable dilemma.

“I'm gay.”

“What does you being gay have to do with us living together?”

Dragged into cohabitation, Kang Woo-Jin begins living with him. Months later, an incident finally pushes him past the line of friendship.

“Kang Woo-Jin, how do you have sex with a guy?”

There was no way he knew. He'd tried with other men, but never followed through. He could only think of this guy right in front of him. It had been 13 years of unrequited love. Now that we've crossed the line of friendship, what exactly are we?

mangas.title: Musaegui Bit
mangas.description:
Seo-Jin, colorless and odorless, unaware of favorite music or colors, encounters Ju-Hwan, radiant with five-colored hues. The moment Seo-Jin sees Ju-Hwan, he falls in love, yet Ju-Hwan's heart remains unknowable. Just when he thinks they're growing closer, he pulls away; when he can barely see him, he returns to his side. Seo-Jin can't make sense of it.

Obsessed with Ju-Hwan, he stops attending school and squanders his tuition money, only to be caught by his parents. As punishment, Seo-Jin is sent into a kind of exile during the vacation. Waiting at his destination is the enigmatic owner of the mansion, Sa-Yun. Seo-Jin enters Sa-Yun's daily life, accustomed to solitude. Just as their life together begins to feel natural, Ju-Hwan arrives at the mansion. Watching them closely, Ju-Hwan senses a subtle shift in the atmosphere...

A mansion where past and present intersect, and the precarious drama of three men!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

mangas.title: TRICK or LOVE!
mangas.description:
Morán, a man whose only asset is his face! Just as he was dumped by his live-in lover and faced homelessness, he falls for Ho-Su's sweet talk when he appears claiming to like him.

“Hyung, you won't have to worry about money anymore.”

Well, for a while, I guess I'll live in a nice place with this young, rich, cute boy. Morán thought it was nothing but a lighthearted idea, but he gradually became entangled with Ho-Su, who showered him with passionate attention and affection...

This young boyfriend... something about him feels off...?

mangas.title: Winter, Only Once!
mangas.description:
My first love, who helped me find my dream, turned out to be my shy anti-fan. Yet I can't bring myself to hate him... Why is that? The drama they starred in together as child actors, Once Upon a Winter, and the affectionate Tae-Won were Yi-Hyeon's first love and his entire world. Holding onto his words that she might be good as a singer, Yi-Hyeon became an idol and reunites with Tae-Won upon hearing news of Once Upon a Winter 2's production. But behind his gentle smile, Tae-Won seems somehow hollow. The moment he chased after him to stop his sudden departure he witnessed Tae-Won inside an open car with a strange man.

“Need someone to play along? Then keep filming, hyung. I'll do it.”

As the plot twists into an increasingly complex mess,Yi-Hyeon and Tae-Won's relationship becomes tangled too...!

mangas.title: Day&Night
mangas.description:
Gung-Mak, a clown from a traveling troupe that roamed the eight provinces of Joseon. Just as he faced a tragic and unjust death, he was reborn as a modern K-pop idol. Was it fate's cruel joke? It seems the noblewoman Lee Sun he loved also reincarnated... But Gun-Mak is now a failing idol group on the verge of disbandment, while Lee Sun is the executive investor deciding the group's fate? Skipping the afterlife, the Joseon clown Gun-Mak reincarnates as Gen-Z idol Logan.

This is the story of his timeless love and his sweet potato-eating, cider-drinking escape from a failing idol group—a tale of growth.

mangas.title: Double Down
mangas.description: Ji-Han’s carefully constructed life shatters over a single, misplaced secret. Caught harboring an unspoken crush, his downfall arrives in the form of Kim Sin-U, part glittering celebrity, part masterful manipulator. Sin-U offers a ruinous ultimatum: a sexual favor (or two), or total exposure. But when a lethal threat from a stalker forces Ji-Han out of the shadows and into Sin-U’s penthouse as his personal bodyguard, the boundaries of their twisted contract blur. Trapped in the orbit of a beautiful tyrant who delights in breaking his stoicism, Ji-Han must survive a dangerous game where the price of losing isn't just his reputation...but his control.

mangas.title: Hubae Wirohaneun Seonbae
mangas.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saekya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Rental Brothers Service
mangas.description:
“I heard you were a Beta, but you're an Omega?”

Peace, whose surname changed three times—from Seo Peace to Yoon Peace to Lee Peace—due to his famous actress mother's free-spirited nature, leaves home ahead of his mother's remarriage. With nothing but the beautiful face inherited from his mother, he hides his traits and barely scrapes by doing dating part-time jobs through a rental app. One day, he gets matched with a mysterious man who called for a Beta and there he encounters none other than Lee Tae-Kang, the son of her mother's prospective new husband. Is this match a coincidence or fate?

mangas.title: Rental Trash Service
mangas.description: Beta Jung Yi-Seo, the sole heir and CEO of a clothing brand who had everything to envy. His perfect life tragically crumbled with the manifestation of Omega. To resolve this shitty situation, he swallowed his pride and summoned Alpha Yun Kang-Hyuk through a rental app—little did he know then. that he was bringing into his life the beautiful trash that would utterly ruin everything he had built.

mangas.title: Taming the Alpha Dog
mangas.description:
Born a natural-born alpha with a silver spoon in his mouth, Hui-Won had been living a carefree, debauched life that was the envy of all. Escaping his father’s gaze, who wanted him to take over the family business, he flees to a small village, where he meets a handsome young man named Yi-Ji. Contrary to Hui-Won’s expectations of seducing Yi-Ji for a steamy night, Yi-Ji brings his dog food and a leash himself, introducing himself as the “director of a dogfighting training camp”…

“I thought you were some kind of mutt, but you’re just a dog in heat, aren’t you?”

mangas.title: A Novice Con Artist Catches a Bear!
mangas.description:
Min-Jae, an ordinary college student, is swindled by his only friend. Just as he’s about to lose everything, including his organs, with no family to turn to! A third-generation heir to a conglomerate, who claims to be Min-Jae’s first love, appears and saves him. But his joy is short-lived. It turns out he wasn’t his real first love after all... On top of that, for some strange reason, Min-Jae finds himself engaging in shameless flirtation whenever he meets Il-Hyeop.

Will Min-jae be able to keep up the charade until the end without getting caught?

“I’m supposed to be taking advantage of this third-generation chaebol heir... so why do I keep turning into a pervert?”

mangas.title: My Trash Partner
mangas.description:
“Do you like me?”

In eighth grade, Hwi-Min gets caught with a photo of his crush, Jung-Won, and ends up receiving unwanted attention. Whether it was luck or misfortune, the commotion quickly died down thanks to his already-existing status as a total outcast. Time passed indifferently, with no entanglement between the popular, cool Jung-Won and the nerdy, awkward Hwi-Min. After enough time passed for what once felt like a life-or-death situation to become a nostalgic black history, the now-adult Hwi-Min lives a peaceful, ordinary life as an unknown band member juggling multiple part-time jobs...

Until one day, he finds Jung-Won in an alley... or rather, he ends up picking him up?

“Can I stay at your place?”

“I'll pay you back with my body in exchange for a place to sleep.^^”

mangas.title: Be Honest and Bold
mangas.description: Tae-Oh, who had secretly loved Hae-San since elementary school, worked tirelessly to raise his college entrance exam scores by two levels. He finally enrolled at the same university as Hae-San, determined to confess his feelings once he became a confident adult. At the freshman welcome party, Tae-Oh bumped into Hae-San as if by chance and impulsively confessed. The two began dating as if by accident. Now, Tae-Oh is utterly intoxicated with the joy of finally being able to do all the XX things he'd only ever imagined! But can he really subdue Hae-San, who claims his ideal type is someone devoted and pure, with all these XX acts?

mangas.title: Nogada Romance
mangas.description: Ki-woo, who lives alone, doing odd jobs at an apartment construction site, occasionally becomes close to Han-gyeol, a college student who stares at him intently. One day, Ki-woo ends up drinking with Han-gyeol, and as they chat, he discovers that Han-gyeol is a virgin who has never even kissed. Ki-woo unknowingly lies to Han-gyeol, pretending to be more experienced, and Han-gyeol begs Ki-woo to teach him how to kiss…

mangas.title: I Got Screwed by My Friends
mangas.synonyms: I Was Fucked by My Friends
mangas.description:
Taehyeon, recalling the time he had first confided his feelings for Hayul to him and then burst into tears as he threw herself into his arms, picked up Hayul’s tie—which had been carelessly tossed on the floor—with a complex, subtle expression.

“Hold out your hands. I’ll tie them for you.”
“Okay….”

Si-yoon held out both hands toward him as instructed, and Tae-hyun gathered Si-yoon’s hands together and tied them tightly with the tie.

Si-yoon glanced at his bound hands and smiled faintly, then raised his hands above his head and gently swayed his hips.

“Huh… Ooh… Ha, don’t… do that… Don’t move… Uh… Haa…”

Si-yoon quietly looked up at Ha-yul, who was furrowing his brow in a mix of pleasure and pain, his lips trembling, and said to him with a smile.

“Ha-yul. What are you going to do if you cry already? The real fun is just starting…”
“What… Haaah!! Huuuh! Haa… Ugh…”

mangas.title: Stand By
mangas.description:
Once a beloved star, actor Yujin’s world crumbles overnight after a casting couch scandal. Swept up in false rumors and left with nothing, Yujin eventually realizes acting is his only true calling.
