During this low point, a chance encounter at a bar leads to a one-night stand. The man is none other than Taehoon, the managing director of the industry giant, SB Entertainment. Exploiting Yujin’s heat cycle, Taehoon offers a tempting deal: a sponsorship and a path back to stardom.

Desperate to return to the screen, Yujin eventually takes Taehoon’s hand. But life doesn’t improve as expected, and Taehoon’s obsession and control only tighten under the guise of their partnership. Then, Hail—a photographer who has long watched Yujin from afar—appears and begins to stir Yujin’s heart.

To reclaim his stage and his life, Yujin must face his hardest choice yet.

In a world tangled with love and desire, what decision will he make?

mangas.title: Pale Lighthouse
mangas.description:
Warden, a police officer dispatched to a remote island to investigate the disappearance of a colleague. While interviewing the island’s residents, he encounters “Skol,” an outsider in the village. Skol is despicable, completely lacking in consideration for others, and seems to look down on everyone except himself. Yet, despite his clumsiness—which betrays the fact that he knows something—Warden continues to seek him out. Then, at Skoll’s house, he discovers evidence suggesting his colleague may have been murdered...

“I wonder how you’re different from Baltran. If you sleep with me once, I’ll tell you everything.”

How much of Skoll’s words should Warden believe?

mangas.title: Focusing
mangas.description:
For as long as he can remember, Yun Jeong-Wu has been the backbone of his struggling family, working tirelessly to support a younger brother plagued by chronic illness. During those long, grueling years, Jeong-Wu happened upon a newspaper feature about a prodigious young Baduk player named Cha Ji-Han. Perhaps it was because Ji-Han shared his brother’s age, or because the athlete had successfully overcome his own past health struggles, but Jeong-Wu found himself projecting his brother’s image onto the boy, eventually becoming his most devoted fan.

Years later, Jeong-Wu has secured a position as the youngest staff member at a professional photography studio. It is there that he finally comes face-to-face with his idol, who has now expanded his career into modeling. The professional reunion takes a dark, bewildering turn that night. After a staff dinner, a drowsy Jeong-Wu retreats to his bedroom, only to be jolted awake by the sensation of wandering hands. Terrified, he stares into the darkness at the intruder. "Ch-Cha Ji-Han?"

mangas.title: Galateo's Project
mangas.description:
Jun is the greatest scientist among the current spacefaring humanity. As a member of the 17th generation of spacefaring humanity who abandoned Earth to roam the cosmos, he succeeds in developing a vaccine for space sickness. The sole purpose of his research was to awaken Kendrick, a first-generation space human from the 1st century who had been cryogenically frozen after dedicating his life to eradicating space sickness... but as Jun conducted his research, he secretly developed feelings for him. After the vaccine was developed and Kendrick finally awoke, something seemed a little off?!

“Jun, I’ve been waiting for you.”

A single sentence uttered by Kendrick, who had been cryogenically frozen 16 generations ago.

“How does Kendrick know my name?”

Even as He thought, “That can’t be possible…” her heart raced as Kendrick approached him without hesitation. Thus began a romance transcending time and space between the two of them.

mangas.title: Childhood Friend and a Hypnosis App
mangas.description:
Han Seogyeom and Ki Taehyun have been childhood friends for ten years. One day, Seogyeom hypnotizes Taehyun using a hypnosis app.

“Bark.”
“Woof.”
“…This is crazy. One more time.”
“Woof, woof.”

Seogyeom stared blankly at Taehyun, who was barking like a dog in front of him. That flawless guy—on his knees, acting like a dog. He rubbed his eyes, but it wasn’t an illusion.

“I’m… your bitch.”
“……”
“And Ki Taehyun, you’re… my owner. My owner who dotes on me.”

Seogyeom ends up unleashing the desires he had kept hidden all this time…

mangas.title: BL's Success Challenge
mangas.description:
“I” am “Su,” the protagonist of this BL manga you're reading. But in the flood of countless works, it's hard for a mediocre all-ages manga to survive. One day, a voice from the sky makes me realize something.

“I might just kill everyone and end it all.”

To save my own life, I must make this work 19+! Even if it means sacrificing this one hole… Wait… a hole?!

mangas.title: Receive the Aura
mangas.description:
“Criminal Hyun, come forward.”

A sinister rumor is spreading through the town. It is said that any criminal taken by the magistrate never walks out on his own two feet again. Rumor has it that this magistrate indulges in homosexual acts... Hyun, a bandit, has fallen into the hands of such a magistrate. But contrary to expectations, not only does he return alive and well, but he also receives an unexpected proposal from the magistrate: to become his “right-hand man” in the fight against corrupt nobles.

mangas.title: Monthly Noir: Ring
mangas.description:
Kang Seong-Ho’s wedding ring, which had fallen into his hands by chance. It would have been over if he had simply returned it. But on a sudden impulse, Choi Yun-Jae hides the ring’s whereabouts and finds himself confronting a darkness he must never let his older brother see. Is it loyalty, or obsession? Or perhaps a desire he cannot even admit to himself?

What exactly awaits at the end of this dangerous relationship?

mangas.title: B1
mangas.description: After drinking a single bottle of wine while intoxicated, Hyun-Jun finds himself entangled with Ki-Yeon, a vampire. Until he can break the contract, he is forced into an awkward living arrangement with Ki-Yeon… What will become of this story—of Ki-Yeon, the vampire searching for a true partner, and Hyun-Jun, the human who has become hopelessly ensnared in Ki-Yeon’s trap?

mangas.title: Drunk on Your Pheromones!
mangas.description:
Ji Seo-Ha could sense pheromones even as a beta. Though he senses the feelings of Lee Yu-Sung, who has been by his side since childhood, he deliberately keeps his distance, worried that his emergence as an Omega might be a burden to him. Some time later, the two meet again at Yu-Sung’s graduation ceremony. That night, while thinking of Seo-Ha, whom he hadn’t seen in a long time, Yu-Sung is caught masturbating by him…

“Hyung… Please help me. I can’t get it down.”

mangas.title: Preferred Interest Rate Customer
mangas.description:
“Hello.”
“You come here often.”
“If I keep saving like this, do you think I’ll be able to live with you someday?”
“Here he goes again.”

Jeong Han-il, the teller at Window 1 of the Baekhwa Village branch of Saedongne Bank, is once again locked in a standoff with his preferred-rate customer today.

“Huh? You’re here?”
“…….”

But the moment his preferred-rate customer—who had visited him every single day for the past ten years—walked over to the window next to his, something inside him began to crumble.

“You smile at other people but ignore my greeting!”

He didn’t think he’d ever actually smiled at him. But the preferred-rate customer decided to let Jeong Han-il delude himself as much as he wanted.

Now that the cuckoo has started to sing, the tables are about to turn.

“Sir. It’s January 1st now. Do you know what that means?”
“Oh—Happy New Year, kiddo. So, starting this New Year, you’ll go back to Window 1—”
“It means I’m an adult now. I’m not a kid anymore.”
“Huh?”

Having walked right into enemy territory like that, will Han-il be able to survive his battle with the preferential interest rate customer?

mangas.title: I Had a Crush on a Murderer
mangas.synonyms: I Fell In Love With a Murderer
mangas.description:
“If you get hard, I’ll let you live today.”

Baek Yujin follows Ki Jeonghu to confess his feelings, only to stumble upon something he never expected. Not only is he caught witnessing the scene, but his attempt to confess is exposed as well. Now, faced with the threat of being killed by the very murderer he’s been secretly in love with, Yujin has no choice but to obey his command to survive…

mangas.title: A Modern Romance
mangas.description:
“Want to sleep over?”

Choi Su-Hyeok, the movie star next door, goes full steam ahead from the very first meeting. As a result, Jeong Se-Yeon finds himself swept up in the whirlwind, unable to keep him bearings, and has lost count of how many movies he’s made that blur the line between romance and comedy.

A modern-day romance where a handsome guy meets an even more handsome guy, and both get swept up in the chaos of work and love!

mangas.title: Immortality For You
mangas.description: Saul, a solitary and lonely archmage who lives an eternal life possessing the power of radiant miracles. He takes in Hale, a young dragon abandoned and dying in a barren valley. Although Saul truly loved Hale, he heartlessly sends him away to become independent and leaves. Returning to the valley after a long journey of 100 years, Saul senses an unsettling atmosphere in the village but faints from poison. When he regains consciousness... a man with chilling white hair, having completely shed his youthful appearance, was waiting for him. Saul did not immediately recognize the grown man, and the man's face contorted with tears. "...I was not in your memories, was I?"

mangas.title: The Serpent
mangas.description:
Moon Sanyeol, an apothecary running a small herbal shop on the outskirts of Hanyang, receives a request. In exchange for a large sum of money, he is to obtain a rare ingredient known as the “Serpent’s Horn”—a substance said to make infertile women conceive.
Having long been worn down by poverty and dreaming of sudden wealth, Sanyeol eagerly scours Yeongsan Mountain high and low.
At last, he finds a serpent’s den.
But his brief moment of triumph is cut short—a chilling presence creeps up behind him.
“How vulgar. Do you desire to carry a child that badly?”
The owner of the voice reveals himself: Lee Hwan, a hornless serpent who despises humans.
Panicked, Sanyeol tries to salvage the situation, but before he can even offer an excuse, he is slammed to the ground.
“You’ll only get one chance… so try your best to take it.”
Hwan climbs over him, his crimson eyes glinting with something eerie.

mangas.title: Three Hundred Hearts of Offerings Rice
mangas.description:
In a chaotic nation, beautiful youths known as "Lambs" are raised as living sacrifices to ward off disasters, while a temporary exorcist organization called the Cheongnyeongdae is deployed to defeat rampant evil spirits.

Ha-yun is a Lamb conditioned by this nation to aspire to be the perfect sacrifice. In contrast, Seo-an is an elite Clear Spirit Order exorcist who has long distrusted the country's altars and fabricated dogmas.

After meeting Seo-an, Ha-yun awakens to the cruel injustice of his fate, yet he is still ruthlessly pushed toward the sacrificial altar.

This is a romance of mutual salvation where curses, souls, and hearts become inextricably bound. It follows Ha-yun, a boy raised to die for his country, and Seo-an, the exorcist who resolves to become his living talisman.

mangas.title: Midget
mangas.description:
“Hey, do you know me?”

“How the hell would I know you?”

A tall, pretty-faced guy who’d just appeared in front of Do Geon-U, a man who’d led a rough life, suddenly started hitting on him right to his face. As he lay there, overwhelmed by this persistent guy who’d followed him all the way to a hotel room, the face of that kid, whose lips had drooped like a rain-soaked puppy under the streetlights in early summer, overlapped with his own.

“Why are you having sex with some other guy after drinking the booze I bought you?”

Only then did Do Geon-U realize it. He had lived his life forgetting that he had been that kid’s first love back when he was young—that little midge flitting around the orange glow that night.

mangas.title: Musojonjae
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Do-Hyeon and Han-Gyeol had feelings for each other, but before they could confess, Do-Hyeon suddenly passes away. To Jeong-U, whom he met in the hospital while battling his illness, Do-Hyeon left a request: to scatter his ashes into the sea along with Han-Gyeol...

Jeong-U and Han-Gyeol meet at the funeral home. Between them, Do-Hyeon’s feelings—which were never fully conveyed— begin to gradually come to light.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The second story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

mangas.title: Infirmary Bed Battle
mangas.description:
The year is 2001. At Yujung High School, known as a gathering place for troublemakers, a bloody battle rages daily between students vying for the top spot and the Disciplinary Committee trying to stop them. Amidst this chaos, there is one sanctuary where peace can be found... the school’s very own paradise: the “infirmary.” Having toppled the previous leader, Jang Jin-Tae, the Tiger, became the school’s new boss. Just when it seemed he had finally taken over the infirmary and secured absolute power, a suspicious-looking, womanizing transfer student, Sin Jong-U, was already casually occupying the space.

“Who… are you?”

Jin-Tae boldly ordered Jong-U to get out of the infirmary. But all he got in return was a sharp slap from Jong-U. Having fallen from the top spot to second place in just 13 minutes, Jin-Tae challenges Jong-U once again to reclaim the infirmary and his position as the top dog, but Jong-U seems to have some other ulterior motive...?

The Playboy Transfer Student X The Bulldozer School Leader A full-on school-based romantic comedy where bodies collide and hearts clash, The Battle for the Infirmary Bed!

mangas.title: Record of Rawon
mangas.description:
In a world where gods and humans coexist, there is a land called Rawon (羅園). The gods here survive by feeding on the reverence of humans, and in return use that power to protect them. Humans, meanwhile, live their lives under the gods’ grace, bound together in a “cycle of reverence and blessing.”

Yusa, the river god of Cheongyugang, has refused human reverence for nearly a century after losing his beloved human disciple, Tan’eo. Whenever he comes close to losing his divinity and fading into a lesser creature, he barely prolongs his fragile existence by borrowing divine power through “hapshin,” a union with the mountain god Gaho, who secretly harbors feelings for him.

Meanwhile, Dajin, the son of a great general whose entire clan was slaughtered by an evil god, longs to become an “Inje” — a human emperor chosen by the gods — for the sole purpose of revenge. Confident in his exceptional martial skill, he asks to become Gaho’s disciple, but Gaho sees through the vengeance consuming his heart and rejects him. Driven into despair by the belief that the gods abandoned both his parents and himself, Dajin ultimately throws himself into the Cheongyu River.

Wishing that no more humans connected to him would die, Yusa saves Dajin by passing on the last of his remaining divinity through a kiss, exhausting his own strength in the process. When Dajin awakens, he dismisses Yusa’s actions as mere whimsy and lashes out in anger. Demanding that Yusa take the divine power back, he impulsively kisses him in return.

In that fleeting moment of contact, the two share each other’s wounds and true feelings, unintentionally forming a master-disciple contract. Through “hapshin,” the act of exchanging divine power, Yusa gains the vitality needed to survive, while Dajin obtains the strength he needs for revenge.

A god unable to escape the scars of the past, and a human willing to risk his life for vengeance. As Rawon’s greatest competition, the Jeseonje (帝選祭), approaches for the first time in a hundred years, their desperate yet sensual tale of salvation begins.

mangas.title: A Blessed Night
mangas.description: Kim Eun-Chong is the definition of a devoted church boy - in fact, his name literally means “Blessing.” But one heartbroken, drunken night of regret shatters his pristine reputation. He wakes up with a massive hangover and a scandalous secret -  he slept with a man. Even worse, the mystery lover is one of his two best friends from church: Ju Hyeon-U or Shin Ian. Eun-Chong prays that he can bury his mistake forever…but then a blackmail text featuring explicit photos of that sinful night hits his phone. One of his best friends has now turned into his biggest enemy, and returning to his peaceful life of faith is nothing but a pipe dream unless he can catch him.

mangas.title: The Temperature of First Love
mangas.description:
“Ju-Won, I’m getting married.”

After 15 long years of harboring a secret crush on Lee Hyun, Ju-Won ends up being rejected without ever having the chance to confess his feelings. He cuts off contact with Lee Hyun as if fleeing, and though he tries to forget him, he simply cannot bring himself to do so. Then one day, he receives a call from a drunk Lee Hyun. Ju-Won lets the heavily intoxicated Lee Hyun into his home, and the feelings he’s buried for so long resurface…

“Look closely. See who I’m kissing right now.”

Lee Hyun is Ju-Won’s first love and the object of his unrequited affection, a secret he’s kept hidden from everyone. Will the two of them ever be together?

mangas.title: A Midsummer Winter
mangas.description:
Lee Chan left without a word, and Seo-Ho was left alone without even having time to ask why. Now that they’ve met again as adults, Seo-Ho finds himself torn once more. Seo-Ho tries to avoid bringing up the past, and Lee Chan, in the end, can’t bring himself to say anything. Even now that they’ve reunited, there are still so many things left unsaid between them.

“Seo-Ho, being left alone feels really lonely. Did you feel this way too?”

mangas.title: The Junior Who Went on Vacation Mith Me got Dumped
mangas.description: Han Tae-Yang was out on a rare vacation, enjoying a drink, when he received a message from his junior colleague, who was also on leave. He’d been dumped by his girlfriend. At those words, Han Tae-Yang rushed over to where his junior, Cha U-Jin, was without a moment’s hesitation. He didn’t know it then. He had no idea that this junior would be the first to take advantage of him.

mangas.title: The Name of Spring
mangas.description:
One spring day when the cherry blossoms were in full bloom. So-Seol confesses his long-held feelings to Hong-An. However, Hong-An responds by setting fire to So-Seol’s family home, then vanishes without a trace. After wandering for seven years in search of him, what appears before So-Seol is Yeo-An, who is identical in every way, from his breath and smile to his gait, but whose only difference is the color of his eyes. A tense standoff ensues between So-Seol, who is convinced that Hong-An and Yeo-An are the same person, and Yeo-An, who steadfastly denies it...

Will So-Seol, finally hear the answer to the feelings he confessed that day?

mangas.title: DELETE
mangas.description:
Kang Eui-Jun wakes up in the hospital after an accident, having lost his memory. The only person by his side is Eun Jae-Hyeon, who introduces himself as his boyfriend. Amidst his confusion and resistance, Eui-Jun gradually opens his heart to Jae-Hyeon’s tender care. But something feels off. Whenever he asks about the past, Jae-Hyeon subtly changes the subject, and at every crucial moment, he evades the question.

What is Eun Jae-Hyeon hiding? And what truth remains in his erased memories?

mangas.title: Perfect Match
mangas.description:
A village inhabited by artisans blessed with natural talent, Bert, a resident of this village, is a craftsman capable of creating models modeled after his own buttocks. Struggling financially, Bert, hoping to strike it rich, tried to sell adult toys shaped like his own legendary buttocks, but couldn’t sell a single one. Just as he was drinking and feeling dejected, a man named Rick, a real hunk, happens to show up. Drunk, Bert ends up having a one-night stand with Rick, and he’s tormented by his inability to forget him...

“Please sleep with me just one more time, Rick!!!!”

mangas.title: No Jae-Min Zone
mangas.synonyms: [소프트 BL 단편선] 사춘기 : 너를 생각하는 봄
mangas.description:
“A kiss… Why are you kissing??!!!”

Middle schooler Han Si-U is happily dating her boyfriend, Park Geon-U. One day, his next-door neighbor, elementary schooler No Jae-Min, catches Si-U and Geon-U kissing. Shocked, Jae-Min starts following Si-U around from that day on, yelling at him to break up with him…!

Where did that cute little kid go who used to follow him around saying he liked her big brother? Why is only this little demon left? The bickering daily life of Si-U, who’s annoyed by Jae-Min meddling in his relationship, and Jae-Min, who’s possessed by rage because he doesn’t want his big brother taken away!

“What the hell are you two gross homos doing in broad daylight?!!!”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The tenth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

mangas.title: Love Comes On a Moonlit Night
mangas.description: “Psyche,” the most beautiful woman in the world. When the praise heaped upon her began to threaten the gods' authority, Aphrodite ordered her son, Eros, to curse Psyche. Just as the god's arrow was about to strike her, Eros discovered Psyche's “secret.” Enchanted by her beauty, he made the mistake of letting the arrow pierce him. Eros becomes curious as to whether the power of the golden arrow would affect him as well. “Is this love I have bestowed upon her a lie, or the truth?” He tries to approach Psyche every night, but a man who lingers around her even during the day appears...

mangas.title: Unspoken
mangas.description: Lee Jeong-Yeon lost everything the day his lover died saving a stranger. A stranger none other than, Ki Seo-Hyeok, the boy Jeong-Yeon once taught. Drowning in grief and haunted by the unfairness of his loss, Jeong-Yeon seeks out the Seo-Hyeok, driven by a desperate need to see the life that was bought with his lover's blood. But as Seo-Hyeok begins to fill the empty spaces in Jeong-Yeon's life, the mourning teacher realizes that some debts are paid in ways more dangerous than death.

mangas.title: Climax Training App
mangas.titleNative: 절정 조교 어플 - 동생 모유 편
mangas.synonyms:
"H-hyung.. You see, I... I'm going on a date with my girlfriend today...”

On a quiet weekend morning, Jang Choi-geon freezes at the bombshell his stepbrother just dropped. Desperate to ruin the date, he opens the 'Peak Conditioning App.’

The more he uses it, the faster his guilt fades replaced by a dark, consuming pleasure as he watches his brother driven to the edge…

mangas.title: Pity is Not an Option
mangas.description: High school student Kang Jae-Yeong’s biggest worry is  how to get by on just one meal a day.  His secret is sneaking off to a free meal center to fill his stomach. That day, Kang Jae-Yeong stopped by the meal center to eat, only to accidentally witness two students from a nearby prestigious high school kissing. The problem is that they’re both boys. Caught in an embarrassing moment, Yeon Min-Gyeol angrily demands that a stunned Kang Jae-Yeong  keep his secret in exchange for money. After their disastrous first encounter, the two keep running into each other for some reason.  Although Yeon Min-Gyeol gets on his nerves, their meetings continue—meetings that are hard to refuse.

mangas.title: Who Torments That Farmer Every Night?
mangas.synonyms: A 100-Night Challenge Between a Farmer and a Worm Asking to Share Yang Energy
mangas.description:
The only occupants of a shabby, one-room thatched hut were the farmer Nongbu and a white dog. Nongbu made a living by renting land from a well-known local landlord, and after another long day of plowing his fields, he returned home and wrapped up his day.

“Haah….”

Exhausted from farm work, Nongbu fell into a deep sleep... But suddenly, a strange, moan-like sound echoed through the room. The odd thing was, he was the only person inside. Kicking off his worn blanket, the only one he owned, mended by the wife of his neighbor and only friend Gaecheol, the farmer twisted in distress.

“Mm….”

It was impossible to tell what was tormenting him. Soon, the ties of his thin undergarment came undone, exposing his bare skin. Tossing and turning across his bedding, the farmer broke out in a cold sweat, letting out soft moans again and again. Just who is tormenting 22-year-old Hong Nongbu every night? To answer that, we must go back to the daytime, ninety-nine days earlier.

mangas.title: After Buzzer Beater
mangas.description:
There were always geniuses ahead of me. A wall I could never overcome no matter how hard I tried: Mun Jung-Min. He was the reason for all my defeats in school and the name I hated the most. But strangely enough, now that I’ve become a professional basketball player, I find myself thinking of him. Amid memories filled with jealousy and anger, perhaps I’m actually hoping to meet him again.

The story of a man who has endured by hating a genius.

mangas.title: How to Kill a God
mangas.description:
Hajun despises cults with every fiber of his being.
That’s because his grandmother—his only guardian—wasted their family fortune on a cult and eventually passed away.
Barely scraping by through grueling manual labor, Hajun encounters a barefoot child wandering the streets one winter.
Unable to leave the child alone in the cold, he brings them home—only to discover that the child is actually the god of the very cult that drove his family into ruin.
The god pushes Hajun to his limits, and Hajun sets out to find a way to kill a god. Yet at times, the god reveals emotions Hajun cannot understand...
What kind of connection could possibly exist between the two of them?

mangas.title: Rude Bastards
mangas.description: Han Jitae, the beloved youngest son of Chairman Han of AK Group, has always been pampered. Now a dominant alpha, Han Jitae has just turned twenty and begun dating Joo Kangwoo, an omega who is four years older than him. This doesn’t sit well with Woo Hyunseung, a beta who has been Jitae’s bodyguard for the past eight years. Not only has Hyunseung practically raised Jitae with his own hands, but after Jitae became an adult, those protective feelings gradually turned into romantic ones. To make matters worse, the omega claiming to be Jitae’s boyfriend seems like nothing but bad news—someone who only drags Jitae down and treats him like a toy. Meanwhile, Joo Kangwoo also can’t stand Hyunseung—the thug-like bastard Jitae trusts even more than his own older brother. Jitae’s boyfriend, Kangwoo, quickly becomes his first lover, and Hyunseung, blinded by jealousy, ends up taking his virginity as well. And standing before these two shameless men, Han Jitae—who seemed innocent and naïve—turns out to be even more outrageous. “I like Hyunseung hyung just as much as I like Kangwoo. So I want the two of you to get along.” These three men recklessly throw themselves into a fiery relationship without realizing how dangerous it is— Will they really be able to reach Jitae’s dream ending of happily living together in harmony?

mangas.title: [BL Anthology] Rut and Heat
mangas.description:
1-6. 3-cheungui Black and Blue (3층의 블랙 앤 블루) [Dakto]
7-11. Alpha-ga Neomuhae (알파가 너무해) [Hanse]
12-16. Side Effect (사이드 이펙트) [Wabaek]
17-19. Hantang (한탕) [Matseoltang]
20-25. Gajja Alpha Sodong (가짜 알파 소동) [Eun-Ju Han]
26-30. Dwaeji Delta Seonsaeng (돼지 델타 선생) [Dagama]

mangas.title: Dog on the Hanging Cage
mangas.synonyms:
Jung Heeyeon, an Omega, had lived his entire world within his grandfather’s mansion until the age of nineteen. For his grandfather, who bought and sold Alphas and Omegas, Heeyeon was no different from livestock, raised only to be sold off at a high price. In a world where even resignation was a luxury, what finally dragged Heeyeon outside the mansion was a kidnapping carried out by someone who held a grudge against his grandfather. Left alone for hours inside a dark, empty container with no windows, the only person who appeared before Heeyeon was Yeon Daepyo, an Alpha who did not react to him being an Omega.

“Then should I correct it and call it a deal?”
“A deal?”
“I need you, after all.”

The man, who had dismissed Heeyeon as a “mongrel”, began to change his attitude after learning about Heeyeon’s background, eventually going so far as to make proposal to him…

mangas.title: The Law of Inevitable Failure
mangas.description: Seo Geon, a pro gamer who has never been defeated by anyone. However, he always crumbles before the one person in particular, Yuan. His relationship with Yuan, the savior who saved him, is gradually changing, and the emotions he has kept hidden under the name of brotherhood eventually cross the line. Seo Geon, trying to escape a relationship destined for failure, and Yuan, determined not to let him go no matter the cost. Will the two ultimately be able to choose each other?

mangas.title: Unmoral Romantic Comedy
mangas.description:
Shin Eui-Jeong had been relieving the stress he faced at work and at home by partying hard at gay clubs. That day, Eui-Jeong went to the club to blow off some steam as usual, where he met Kwon Cha-Kyung, a man with the muscular build and handsome face he was looking for, but...

“You slut, you like this?”

Oh, I picked a crazy son of a bitch...

What are the odds that a one-night stand is a thug who just got out of prison? Realizing that Cha-Kyung is a dangerous man, Eui-Jeong tries desperately to escape this danger, but it seems being the mistress of a thug just suits him...

mangas.title: The Black Steed
mangas.description:
A large-scale coup d’état took place in Arenbar, the Land of the Golden Tree. Evon Lake, the leader of the rebels and a knight who had served as the late king’s closest bodyguard, sought to atone for his sins by sacrificing his own life, but a man who suddenly appeared at the execution site cut the rope, saving him from death.

By the hand of the missing prince, ‘Marsagar Sagrund’, whom he had sent away as a hostage.

mangas.title: Wolf and Thug
mangas.description: Delinquent Han Yu-chan. With no money and no powerful connections, he lived carefully, constantly keeping himself in check so he wouldn’t make enemies anywhere he went. But one day, despite all his efforts, Han Yu-chan is kidnapped and imprisoned by someone… Inside the cold room where he is being held — a room without even a single window — there is a wolf with silver-gray fur tied up nearby. Thinking he has been thrown in there as food for the wolf, Han Yu-chan causes a commotion. The beautiful wolf simply watches him quietly, as if observing and studying him. When Han Yu-chan feels the wolf’s gaze fixed on him and turns around, the wolf that had been there just moments ago has completely vanished. In its place stands a man wearing a collar, staring back at him. More precisely, a man with wolf ears and a tail. And he has the face of Go Shin-woo — the actor who mysteriously disappeared one year ago.

mangas.title: Instant X Love
mangas.description:
Nam Min-Seong, who lives by the motto “Men are gold,” gets hit with a Frappuccino during his first meeting with Geon-Hyeok, whom he met on a dating app, and is then told to leave by Geon-Hyeok, an executive, while out with his running crew. Confused and humiliated, Min-Seong starts to get angry...

"He said he liked me on the app, so why is this jerk treating me like this?"

mangas.title: Sunbae, Is This Really Research?
mangas.description: In a society where shapeshifters and humans coexist, Kim Ga-Il faces even more prejudice and hatred as a fox shapeshifter. After falling for a gangster he spent a night with while drunk, Ga-Il discovers that he is actually Kang Shin, a model student and senior in the Shapeshifter Research Department. Fascinated by this cool yet sexy senior, Ga-Il eventually decides to become the subject of Shin's research...

mangas.title: This Kind of Sponsor
mangas.description:
After nearly a decade of struggling as an unknown actor, Seo Yun has been plagued by a string of bad luck and setbacks. Finally, at his agency’s urging, he reluctantly agrees to accept a sugar daddy, only to run into her ex-boyfriend, whom he’d broken up with years ago, right there on the spot...

What? You want me to take money from that jerk?!

mangas.title: Small Dick Curse
mangas.description:
Lee Changyeon is a trashy top whose hobby is “opening up” even virgins to the point of anal sex, and whose life motto is never looking twice at a man he’s already slept with. But then, something strikes him like a bolt from the blue. Every time he climaxes, his dick gets smaller because of a curse…!! And the way to break this damned curse is… receiving semen all the way in his ass??

Fine. Whatever. Sex is sex anyway, right? What’s the big deal about getting fucked?

As Changyeon immediately sets out searching for someone well-endowed, a cute and tiny-looking man named Boo Silhan appears before him. Silhan confidently claims he can break Changyeon’s curse, but Changyeon pushes him away because he seems far too small and delicate. Completely unaware that Silhan is actually hiding the very “huge package” Changyeon has been searching for all along…

A fiery and ridiculous romance between Silhan, who wants Changyeon’s heart, and Changyeon, who only wants a big dick!

mangas.title: Rut Partner
mangas.description:
Seo Jian transmigrates into a novel called Rut Partner. When other people transmigrate, they struggle for a bit and then go on to live comfortably—so why is he the only one suffering in poverty? While lamenting his exhausting reality, one day he ends up becoming someone’s rut partner almost against his will.

“Everyone else is allowed, but I’m not? There’s no way that’s true.”

Was it physical attachment, affection… or perhaps even love?

After the relationship suddenly comes to an end, Jian is left with an inexplicable sense of emptiness.Then he meets Choi Eden — a man who somehow reminds him of the person hidden in the darkness…

mangas.title: Deep Plan
mangas.description: Jay suffers from a severe compulsion to control everything, believing that “everything must go exactly as he wants.” He satisfies this compulsion by treating Gu-Jin, who is loyal to him, like a dog. But one day, Gu-Jin begins to slip out of Jay’s control, and for the first time, he feels the urge to defy Jay’s orders...

mangas.title: Darts Match
mangas.description:
Kathy, a freshman at a New York university, runs into Asher, a fellow orphanage resident who once tried to kill him before disappearing without a trace, at a party. He decides to become his sexual partner in order to get revenge on him for forgetting him...

“Our beginning was nothing but lies, and even though so many emotions are swirling inside me... I still truly love Asher.”

mangas.title: The Hole Bride
mangas.description:
There is one open secret in the influential Redhill family. Polan, the heir to Redhill, suffers from severe mysophobia and refuses to have any physical contact with women. While Gawain was worrying about his son, Etti, a mere servant, offered to help.

“I’m sure I’d be the perfect partner for the young master’s nighttime lessons...”

The opening nestled beneath his manhood was unmistakably that of a woman—

mangas.title: Winterbound
mangas.description:
For the grave sins of pride and insatiable greed, the majestic God of Winter is stripped of his divinity and cast down to the mortal realm as a cruel punishment. Stranded in a weak, fragile human body, he is desperate to reclaim his rightful place among the heavens. However, the path to restoring his godly status is paved with a singular, horrific condition: he must consume the living heart of the person he loves most.

As the fallen deity navigates the foreign emotions of mortality, he unexpectedly finds himself falling deeply in love, binding his fate to a human soul. Now, trapped in a agonizing paradox, Cheong-Hwi must choose between his eternal ambition and his newfound devotion to his lover, Gaeddong. To become a god once more, he must destroy his own salvation by plunging his love into a cold, bloody tragedy.

mangas.title: Cigarette Ash
mangas.description:
“Act like I’m the only one, Tae-ju.”

Due to an unjust theft incident that occurred during a part-time errand job, Tae-ju was burdened with loan shark debts as he ended up working as a serverand host at the Maehwa bar. Despite his ambitious determination to pay off his debt and leave this place, Tae-ju’s situation only gets more complicated.

Meanwhile, after meeting the VVIP Beom-ho of Maehwa, who beats people to death without blinking an eye, Tae-ju becomes increasingly attached to the unusually large tips he gives…

mangas.title: The New Employee of the Toy Development Team
mangas.description:
“Then, I’ll get you hard first.”
“Huh? What? I’ll do that myself…”

I looked up at Juwon with a surprised expression as he delivered this announcement while gripping my penis. Although seeing others’ naked bodies and touching them was a daily routine for the development team, I was simply astonished that he would grab a stranger’s penis and make them erect as casually as saying, “Let’s eat.”

“We need to check your sensitivity, Seo Yejun, so it’s better if you get an erection with someone else’s hand.”
“I-Is that so? Then I’ll leave it to you…”

I didn’t exactly agree with what he was saying, but I was a newbie and he was the team leader. No matter what he said, it was only natural that he was right.

Yejun lay back down on the bed, which he had slightly raised, and raised both hands to cover his face. He didn’t have the courage to watch him rub his penis, nor did he want to show his face relaxing from being stimulated by another man.

mangas.title: Ex-Sponsor
mangas.description:
Cheong-Yeon asks Do-Heon for a divorce, putting an end to their three-year marriage.

“I feel like I’ve seen everything there is to see by now, so let’s just end it here. Please grant me a divorce, Mr. Do-Heon.”

And so, Yu Cheong-Yeon, a high school graduate from a working-class background, now finds himself labeled a divorcee. He struggles to restart her acting career, which he had given up due to Do-Heon’s opposition, but his ex-husband seems to be acting strangely.

“A sugar… daddy?”

Eventually, Do-Heon even offers Cheong-Yeon a sugar daddy arrangement.

“Once a week. You’ll meet me every Friday night.”
“Why should I accept a sugar daddy arrangement from you, Mr. Do-Heon?”
“Because I can get you a role in that drama. As the lead, of course.”
“Fine. As long as there’s no physical contact. It’s not like you’re making this offer just because you want to sleep with me anyway.”
“Why do you think I wouldn’t ask you for sex?”
“Of course sex is included. Isn’t that a basic condition of a sugar arrangement?”

mangas.title: My Puppy's Separation Anxiety Recovery Story
mangas.description:
There are many ways to describe the relationship between Yu Mu-Gueon and Go Seo-Won. From childhood neighbors who lived next door, to seniors and juniors at the same high school, to coworkers at the same high school, and even as lovers. But the happiness that seemed like it would last forever was short-lived.

“Seo-Won, don’t push me away. Don’t hate me—you still love me, right?”

Mu-Gyeon, who had been wagging his tail playfully, announces their breakup just before their 1,000th day together, and a rift begins to form between them...

mangas.title: Regarding Aspiration
mangas.description:
Ju Yi-Hyeon, the sole heir to the Juseong Group. On the very day his father, the chairman, goes missing, he manifests as a fervent Omega. Intending to hide his nature for the rest of his life, Yi-Hyeon urges Jun-Seong, his personal assistant who has been by his side since childhood, to embrace him as an Alpha and conceive a child with him...

As their relationship takes an unexpected turn, another Alpha, Hae-Won, appears, making the situation even more complicated.

mangas.title: Orbital Slip
mangas.description: For ten years, Seon-U has lived in complete isolation from society. By his side is Young-Shin, a perfect and devoted Olympic gold medalist. Within the secluded paradise Young-Shin has built, Seon-U’s frozen time seems eternal. However, when Do-Hyeon, a genius physicist and Seon-U’s former lover, returns, cracks begin to appear in this once-perfect world. A chilling intrusion that forces everything back onto its former course. Is he a steadfast savior, or the most bizarre tormentor? The moment the time that has been frozen for ten years shatters, the cruelest form of salvation and obsession collide.

mangas.title: Drinking Every Last Drop of BJ Bunny Peach Juice
mangas.description: Han-Se began streaming as an adult broadcaster to rebel against a life that forced him to follow a predetermined path. Every night, he becomes “BJ Rabbit Peach,” receiving both insults and generous donations from anonymous viewers. To celebrate his first anniversary on the platform, Han-Se puts his first night up for auction among viewers, and the auction closes in an instant at the astronomical price of 1 billion won. The person who won BJ Rabbit Peach’s first night was none other than a well-known loyal viewer, “Breathing Werewolf.” Seeing him, who looked exactly like the alpha from his imagination, Han-Se couldn’t control his trembling heart. Avoiding the viewers watching the first-anniversary broadcast, he quietly whispered to him, “...Actually, this is my first time having sex.” Will BJ Rabbit Peach’s 1st-anniversary broadcast actually go off without a hitch?

mangas.title: No Applause Allowed
mangas.description:
Born into a family of shamans and gifted with spiritual powers, Kang Hangeon has tried every possible method to avoid undergoing a shamanic possession ritual and accepting his fate.
His habit of having one-night stands with men even began as an attempt to stop seeing ghosts. Unfortunately, the wandering spirits that refuse to pass on still won't leave him alone.
Then one day, Hangeon encounters a malevolent spirit with such an ominous aura that even he is shocked. Worse, he nearly falls victim to the man possessed by that evil spirit...
“Are you hurt anywhere?”
At the critical moment, he's rescued by Seo Chaseong, a kind-hearted busybody who seems to appear out of nowhere.
In that instant, Hangeon witnesses something incredible: a guardian spirit standing behind Chaseong devours the evil spirit.
Realizing this, Hangeon comes up with a plan.

mangas.title: Love Me More
mangas.description:
Si-Yul, who had worked hard to save up a security deposit for rent so he could leave the orphanage and live on his own, was swindled out of his savings. To raise the money again, at the urging of his best friend and fellow orphanage resident, he reluctantly takes on a dangerous, high-paying part-time job delivering drugs. While making a delivery to a club as usual, Si-Yul is caught by U Hyeon-Se, the club’s owner, who is famous for his good looks. He begged and pleaded for his life and barely managed to escape that situation, but it wasn’t long before he was caught again. As if by a twist of fate, during their third encounter, he ends up owing him a huge debt.

“You say you don’t have any money, so what else can I do? You’ll have to pay me back with your body.”

Their relationship began with a casual remark that sounded like a threat but wasn’t quite one, but before he knew it, a strange chemistry began to develop between them…

“What if I refuse?”
“I’ll probably make things a little more annoying for you than they are now, Kwon Si-Yul.”
“Are you saying you’ll torment me?”
“I’m saying we’ll see each other more often.”

mangas.title: Tinder Box
mangas.description:
“As long as you’re still breathing, you’ll have to spread your legs for me alone.”

Isaac, a soldier born of a witch and a human, lives the life of an ordinary citizen while hiding his true identity as a witch. Meanwhile, Prince Kaian, who suffers terrible agony every new moon night due to a curse passed down through the royal family, lives with the sole goal of eliminating every witch in the world. One day, three brazen cats (witches) appear before Isaac and propose a deal, asking him to fetch a tinder box. As a result, Isaac finds himself unexpectedly entangled with Kaian. Although he is constantly gripped by a sense of danger, as if his head might be severed from his neck at any moment, Isaac, a clumsy and carefree young man who is willing to do anything for the prince, the most handsome man in the kingdom, wonders if he will truly be able to find his own happiness and fulfill the prince’s wish…?

mangas.title: Cross-color Point
mangas.description:
Kang Tae-Seo works multiple part-time jobs to pay off the debt his father left behind. As poverty slowly engulfs him, Tae-Seo thinks of a certain man. The son of South Korea’s most powerful chaebol family. And his first love from high school, Lee Seo-Hyeon. On a day when his only consolation was that his younger sister Min-Seo, unlike him, was doing well in college, Tae-Seo, feeling overwhelmed by a loan shark’s notice that interest rates were going up, sends a text to a number that might no longer be in service.

[Can you lend me some money?]

“Sure. I’ll give you 10 million won every time we sleep together.”

And so, Tae-Seo gives himself to Seo-Hyeon, the heir to the very corporation that drove his father to his death.

mangas.title: I Came to Save Your Pepper!
mangas.description:
Nam Gyu-Hyeok is versatile, exceptionally handsome, and wealthy. But even this seemingly perfect man has one fatal flaw. He’s still a virgin. One day, the “Fairy of Big Ones” appears before him.

“I am the Fairy of Big Ones! I’ve come to save your dick! "

And so, the fairy’s lesson in losing his virginity begins, and Gyu-Hyeok, almost forced into it, even resorts to using a sex toy to gradually learn “how to use his penis”… But something feels off. This sensation is far too vivid to be coming from a simple toy. Is this… really just an ordinary sex toy?

mangas.title: Anna's Kkikki
mangas.description:
Anna was dumped by his ex-boyfriend because he didn’t express his love well enough. On the night of the breakup, he gets drunk and satisfies his desires alone. Meanwhile, Kkikki, the monkey doll who had been guarding Anna’s bedroom, fulfills his wish to become human and try all sorts of naughty things, and turns into a human. Anna, who enjoyed his first encounter with Kkikki, pretends to give in and begins living with him. Kkikki seems to obey Anna at first, but soon begins demanding more extreme acts, as if to stimulate his hidden desires.

Meanwhile, Kkikki must hear a “confession of true love” in order to live as a human forever. Unaware of this fact, Anna gradually begins to develop feelings for Kkikki as a lover— beyond just a sexual relationship…

mangas.title: Pedal to the Metal
mangas.description:
Su-Ha, who once dreamed of becoming a race car driver, was forced to give up his dreams after suffering an accident caused by a sudden onset of hypersensitivity. On an ordinary day, just like any other, he helps a man named Chris, who is unlike anyone he’s ever met, and his whole life is turned upside down...

“Thanks for your help, but… are you… getting an erection right now?”

mangas.title: Something Like You
mangas.description:
After spending 34 years dating only women, Jeong Yi-an suddenly becomes curious about what it would be like to be with a man. At a high school reunion, he unexpectedly meets Kim Soo-hyuk, a quiet and awkward old classmate who looks exactly the same as he remembers. Thinking Soo-hyuk might be the perfect partner for a one-night experiment, Yi-an acts on impulse.

But the night does not go as excitingly as he imagined, and Yi-an plans to forget it as a simple one-time mistake. However, Soo-hyuk contacts him first, determined to try again and promising that “this time will be different.” What starts as a casual reunion slowly turns into something more complicated, bringing back old feelings, hidden longing, and a relationship neither of them expected.

mangas.title: To You at Dawn
mangas.synonyms: As the Dawn Breaks, to You
mangas.description:
A laboratory filled with nothing but chaos and silence, devoid of any warmth. [BU-001 Experiment Commencing.] All Hui-Su wants is death.

“I don’t want to live anymore...”

One day, Seung-Hyeon, the ideal guide, appears before Hui-S, a Sentinel who has become so numb from heartless, painful acts and unwanted experiments that he can no longer feel pain or even emotions.

“So it’s you, my guide.”

Unlike the other violent guides, Seung-Hyeon treats Hui-Su with care, as if he were a fragile being, and watching him, Hu-Su begins to feel a strange emotion he’s never experienced before...

“I’ll always be by your side, so rest easy, Yeomyeong.”

"Hui-Su... Not Yeomyeong—Hu-Su. Do Hui-Su.”

With Seung-Hyeon’s arrival, colors begin to be added one by one to Hui-Su’s life, which had always been like a black-and-white film.

mangas.title: Hexagon Love
mangas.description:
As soon as Do-Hyeon returned to civilian life after his military discharge, he was faced with the threat of the breakup of “Prism Noise,” the band he had been part of since high school as a composer and bassist. The trouble began when Seon-U, who appeared on the music variety show “Eco Star,” covered a Prism Noise song and the cover version ended up becoming more famous than the original. Compounding the problem, the drummer and guitarist both announced their departures one after another, ultimately bringing Prism Noise’s activities to an end. A troubled Do-Hyeon happens to find a drunk Seon-U and takes him back to his hotel…

This incident leads the two to start keeping in touch, and they become confidants who listen to each other’s worries. Upon learning of this, Jae-Hun begins to show signs of insecurity toward Do-Hyeon and Seon-U, and the conflict between Do-Hyeon and Jae-Hun, who were once a couple, escalates out of control. Eventually, Do-Hyeon and Jae-Hun end their relationship, but Do-Hyeon and Seon-U, comforting each other’s wounds, develop a deep bond.

mangas.title: Temporarily Fostering Melon
mangas.description:
Lee Ru-Han, who cares about nothing but money, has made escaping his semi-basement apartment his life’s greatest goal. One day, he receives an unexpected offer from his older sister: if he temporarily takes care of a chameleon for two weeks, she’ll cover his moving expenses. The night after taking in this unwelcome creature, Ru-Han wakes up from the intense heat to find a huge, unfamiliar man standing right in front of him...

No way... Could that giant spouting nonsense right in front of me actually be that chameleon?!

“Master, it’s really hot down here. I want to get inside you, Ru-Han...”

mangas.title: Kakegurui Twin
mangas.description:
As a first-year student of the renowned Hyakkaou Private Academy, Mary Saotome knows her future is set for a one-way cruise to the top... That is, until an encounter with an old-classmate-turned-housepet throws the newbie princess into the world of gambling! Can a normal girl like Mary make friends and survive debtless through only wit and luck? Find out in this prequel to the mega-popular Kakegurui!


(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Bite of a Wolf
mangas.description:
New and budding actor, Yu Nian, never imagined that his idol, the top actor in the industry, would one day walk down the red carpet with him. This single event then stirs the scandal of the century. However, that's not all. Yu Nian finds out an even more baffling secret. A-list actor, Xie Youjun, turns into a wolf during a full moon. Besides that, this stunning star even ends up biting him and tells him that he has the smell of an Omega. Out of the blue, Yu Nian finds himself taking a step into the mysterious Omegaverse.



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Love for Sale
mangas.description: "Will this make you happy?" Nam-Woo wakes up one night to find bills sprawled all over his room - along with the hazy memory of a handsome stranger. Even in his wildest dreams, all Nam-Woo wants is to have enough money to survive each month. Si-Eon, on the other hand, has everything he could ever want except happiness. Intrigued by Nam-Woo's humble wishes, Si-Eon offers him the money he wants - the catch being, he has to date him.

mangas.title: Perle
mangas.description:
Jean Erhardt debuted in Joachim Empire as a successful capitalist infamous for buying his noble title. Despite his seemingly innocent intentions, Jean yearned to spark a revolution from within high society. But first, he must gain a powerful friend. A chance encounter with Maximilian, the hedonistic Crown Prince of Joachim, presented Jean with one such auspicious ally. This proved tricky as Maximilian knew of Jean's past as an escort and the prince hungered for Jean's return to decadence…


(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Fake Slackers
mangas.description: When the classroom rosters were announced, the school's two most notorious boys Xie Yu and He Chao were not just placed in the same class, but became desk-mates as well. Even though they're obviously smart, they pretend to be delinquents, always acting out, fighting to be last in class rank. They may look like they're playing games and slacking off every day, but they actually study hard in private. So what's the deal with these two guys who are always at the bottom of the class on every test?

mangas.title: The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low
mangas.synonyms: The Hunter Wants to Live Quietly
mangas.description:
Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.

Former S-Rank Hunter Ui-Jae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sa-Yeong, peace isn't on the menu!

mangas.title: The Wolf in the Flower Shop
mangas.description:
Riku Kirishima, a rough-looking high schooler, is a lover of romantic comic books who takes care of his family in place of his late mother. He has a younger brother, who he cares for deeply. One evening, he is suddenly embraced by a man in the park who offers him $300 to spend the night. Riku runs away, but soon learns that the handsome pervert who approached him is actually the guardian of his brother's friend! Enjoy this love story between a handsome florist and a romantic high school tough guy!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Little Bird Sleeps by the Sea
mangas.titleNative: 雛鳥は汐風にまどろむ
mangas.synonyms: The Little Bird Dozes Off by the Sea
mangas.description:
Left devastated after the tragic death of his parents and sister, Yuuichi Tachibana adopts his seven-year-old nephew, Ayumu. Seeking a new beginning, he chooses to move them to a new house with a view of the ocean, hoping for a peaceful setting where they can concentrate on their healing.



There they meet Ryou Kurebayashi, who owns a neighborhood deli, and become regular customers. As Ryou and Yuuichi grow closer, learning about each other's unfortunately similarly tragic pasts, they begin to support one another ― and Ayumu ― day by day, building a little family of their own by the sea.



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: 10 Years That I Loved You the Most
mangas.synonyms: The 10 Years I loved you the most
mangas.description: I've loved you the most for most of my life. Now I am a piece of crumpled paper in the corner you would never glimpse. I thought you would be my today and all of my tomorrows. I imagined that someday you would turn around again and stare at me with all your love. However, when our love is gone, I'll just pick a sunny afternoon with gentle wind, put on my coat and leave for good...

mangas.title: One-Week Family
mangas.titleNative: ワンウィークファミリー
mangas.description:
Up-and-coming superstar Ren Fujimaru's only weakness is that he doesn't like children. To overcome this vulnerability, Ren's manager suggests that he lives with his co-star in an upcoming project, child actor Yuu Kusaka, for one week! On their first day living together, he meets Yuu's manager Kei Haruo, a former child actor himself. He is the one who inspired Ren to get into acting, so why did he quit...?



This week will be one that changes all of their lives forever...



(Source: Animate International)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
mangas.titleNative: フードコートで、また明日。
mangas.synonyms: Food Court de Joshikousei ga Shaberu dake
mangas.description:
To their classmates, Wada is a quiet rich girl while Yamamoto is an intimidating lone wolf…but what they don't know is that Wada is a mobile game addict in a passionate love-hate relationship (with a 2D character) and Yamamoto has a penchant for urban legends with eyes only for her favorite YouTuber. And their biggest not-so-secret secret—these unlikely friends meet at the food court every day after school to rant, rave, and learn what makes each other tick!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Originally published as a Twitter webcomic. It received a 15-chapter serialization in Comic Newtype between 2020-03-10 to 2021-01-12. Additional serialization resumed on 2022-09-06.

mangas.title: Sheep Princess in Wolf's Clothing
mangas.titleNative: 狼の皮をかぶった羊姫
mangas.description:
Aki Rikujo, a Wolfa, works as a butler at the royal castle in the land of Sheepa. Her quiet and peaceful days get shaken up when she saves the life of Princess Momo Shiudafaris. The shy sheep princess immediately latches onto Aki who, before she knows it, becomes the princess's private tutor. Momo wants more than just math lessons from Aki, and even sneaks into the wolf-woman's bedroom to seduce her! Aki soon realizes that, under the timid woolly exterior, Momo is a wild animal!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Ring My Bell
mangas.description:
Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she's struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It's hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what's up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break?


(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy
mangas.titleNative: カナン様はあくまでチョロい
mangas.description:
Kanan, a female demon, infiltrates a high school with the goal of devouring some delicious human souls. She sets her sights on the perfect target, a teen boy named Kyogi Yoji, and goes for the kill—only to somehow end up in a relationship with him instead?! Kanan's never been in love before, and this oddly innocent demon creates absolute chaos as the two venture into romance with a first date and beyond!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Introduction to Virginity Studies
mangas.description:
Yeowoon is a hopeless virgin fetishist.
Sex with someone completely inexperienced! Guys who know nothing, who stiffen their tongues when kissing, who can't even put on a condom properly and awkwardly try their best—those earnest efforts turn him on.
For someone with such a ridiculously twisted preference, the university's socially isolated students are perfect prey.
The problem is that after he's toyed with them a few times because of the thrill of their virginity, they start making him the center of their entire world.
But getting rid of them is easy enough. Nothing works better than pretending to be nice.

“I'm sorry... It was a mistake. We're good friends, right? You'll keep being friends with me, won't you?”

Today, once again, Yeowoon finds another virgin—and cuts ties with another former virgin. A fit, handsome loner... in other words, a nerd. Finding one is harder than it sounds.
Not a loser—a nerd.
Were perfect guys really impossible to find? Just as he was growing exhausted from the relentless affection of awkward virgin boys, he met Kim Doyoung in a general education class. Doyoung was exactly his ideal type.

mangas.title: Hypnosis Pure Love App
mangas.description: An office employee is caught making out with the sibling of his employer, the young man who works for him is also his boss’ younger sibling. This leads to him being publicly harassed by his superior who is powerful and openly hates (same-gendered) relationships. Because of this, he suffers repeated incidents of harassment until he comes across an application for hypnosis that seems to help improve his life. What starts off as a reckless way to get even with the boss will eventually devolve into a strange game of manipulation, control and unfulfilled romantic desire. As he continues down this path, he will question whether he is in control or if he has become an unwilling participant to someone else’s intrigue.

mangas.title: Dear Anti-Fan
mangas.description:
Kang Hae-Yeong is a die-hard anti-fan of Lee Hyeon, the lead singer of a popular band. He spends his days following Lee Hyeon’s every move and picking fights with him—a truly pathetic existence. Then one day, he finds himself drawn to a stranger with a voice similar to Lee Hyeon’s and ends up having a one-night stand with him... But this guy... now that he looks at him, it’s not just his voice that’s similar—he’s Lee Hyeon himself, isn’t he?!

“If you were going to write something like that... you should at least tell me if you really hated me that much.”

mangas.title: In Love With an NPC
mangas.description:
Do-Ha, an otaku who likes 2D better than people, coincidentally discovers Jae-Ik, a convenience store worker who looks exactly like his favorite Jake. And that night, a 3D Jake appears in Do-Ha's fantasy?! That he has to master the monster level to marry Jake?! After spending a passionate night with Jake, Do-Ha becomes addicted to the pleasure he has never felt before, and after that, perhaps because of Jake's curse, Do-Ha's body becomes horny all the time. But no matter how hard he tries on his own, his desires are not relieved, and in the end, Do-Ha shows up in front of Jae-Ik, who is working at the convenience store, with a toy stuck in his mouth…

Will Do-Ha be able to fulfill his fantasy with Jake in reality?

mangas.title: Yasashiku Sasete yo Ore no Ω
mangas.synonyms: Let me be sweet to you my Omega
mangas.description:
Omega Motoya ended up becoming mates with Alpha Asuka—even though they’re still high school students—due to a heat triggered by his own carelessness.
The more Asuka—whom he’d viewed as a rival since middle school—treats him kindly, the more Motoya’s sense of guilt grows.
Though they come together physically during his heat, their hearts only drift further apart.

――I want Asuka to mate with someone he truly loves. But at the very least, until the graduation ceremony a year from now…

Just then, Motoya notices that the bite mark—the proof of their bond—is fading!?

mangas.title: My Middle-Aged Next Door Neighbor Is in My Wet Dreams
mangas.synonyms: In My Wet Dreams, Only You Always Appear
mangas.description: For as long as Han Young-Hae can remember, his neighbor, Yim Tae-Hwan, has always taken good care of him. But when Young-Hae starts having wild dreams about his hunky father-figure, he grows conflicted over his feelings. On the other hand, Tae-Hwan is plagued by prostate issues and buys a bunch of toys, thinking they'll help him. When Young-Hae walks in on Tae-Hwan using those toys, it's just like a scene from one of his dreams and he pounces! Will Young-Hae and Tae-Hwan be able to figure out their messy future together?

mangas.title: ASMR, Romance
mangas.description:
Do-Yun, a returning college student, is forced by financial circumstances to rent a room in a cheap apartment building rumored to be haunted. However, he is relieved to discover that what people mistook for ghostly noises were actually the erotic moans of the man next door… but the daily “moaning terror” leaves him sleepless night after night. Furious, Do-Yun goes to the next-door apartment to complain, but when he sees his neighbor Jay’s good looks and shy demeanor, he loses his nerve and simply gives him a mild warning before turning away. As Do-Yun turns away, he tears down a flyer stuck to his door and cuts his hand on the paper, letting out a faint moan… At that moment, Jay, the neighbor who had seemed so innocent, suddenly changes his demeanor, lunges at Do-Yun, and makes a crazy request: “Please, let me record that moan.”

“Excuse me! I’m obsessed with your moans—please let me record them—”

A full-on perverted moaning ASMR live stream featuring two men from next door—care to tune in?

mangas.title: Bunny ON!
mangas.description: Choi Geon-Woo has had a crush on Yoon Bo-Na since childhood. Finding it increasingly difficult to hide his feelings, he decides to confess to Bo-Na just before enlisting in the military, planning to run away if she rejects him… but to his surprise, Bo-Na accepts his feelings. Before long, the day of his enlistment approaches, and as Bo-Na ponders what kind of surprise to prepare for Geon-Woo… she recalls how he always called her his “bunny girlfriend” and decides to buy a “bunny girl costume.” However, the moment Bo-Na puts on the outfit, real rabbit ears and a tail sprout from her head, and when she finally reads the instruction manual, she finds a hint stating that rabbits have a strong sex drive…

mangas.title: Wish Upon a Star
mangas.synonyms: Pray to the Stars, Byeoregae Bireo
mangas.description:
Cheong-Hwa, who grew up with a curiosity about the stars, runs away from home and forms a mentor-student relationship with Hae-Seok, an astronomer. After spending a long time with Hae-Seok, Cheong-Hwa develops feelings for him and confesses, but Hae-Seok coldly brushes off her feelings.

“If only he’d give me an answer…”

That night, a heartbroken Cheong-Hwa climbs onto the roof with the neighborhood dog to gaze at the stars and vents her frustration. “I wish I were a dog so he would like me,” she says. At that moment, as if the stars had heard her, they twinkle!

mangas.title: Wolf Declaration
mangas.description: Beatrice, the eldest daughter of a noble family, moves into the home of her fiancé, Fenric, to live with him, following her family’s orders. However, the affectionate boy she once knew is nowhere to be found, and as Beatrice struggles to win his heart, she discovers by chance that Fenric is a werewolf…

mangas.title: It's Mine
mangas.synonyms: It's Mine เธอเป็นของฉัน
mangas.description:
There's nothing that Yo-Han Do doesn't know about his crush, Da-Jeong. Where she sits in class, works after school... and even where she lives. But unable to approach her, he watches her every move from afar and will do anything to protect her. Anything.



"What can I do to get closer to you?"


Today, just like yesterday, Yo-Han Do is watching.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: A Tough First Love
mangas.titleNative: 周成一的初恋过于坎坷
mangas.synonyms: Zhou Cheng Yi's First Love was Too Bumpy
mangas.description: Zhou Chengyi is a bossy president. He finally falls in love with a girl when he is 27 years old. However the girl he loves is a straight man who just wears women's clothes. The man is a online celebrity model. Turning from a die-hard fan to a sasaeng fan of him, Zhou Chengyi is confused about what true love is.

mangas.title: Inaho-kun wa Nise Kanojo no Hazu Nano ni
mangas.titleNative: 稲穂くんは偽カノジョのはずなのに
mangas.synonyms: Inaho-kun Is Supposed to Be a Fake Sweetheart
mangas.description: Shintarou Mori, a first-year high school boy, is teased by his friends for wanting to find a beautiful girlfriend and having a sparkling social life. His classmate Inaho Sawatari is regarded as the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. The two of them shouldn't have anything to do with eacher, but when they're inadvertently mistaken for a couple, Inaho proposes: "How about we pretend we're really dating?" They act like a couple in public, but it turns out the most beautiful girl in the school is actually a very cute boy...!

mangas.title: Kawaihara Senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
mangas.titleNative: 可愛原先輩はかわいい（早乙女くん）がすき！
mangas.description:
Saotome is a short boy who's not very good at sports. He thought that he would at least be able to get good grades, but starting high school, he is far from the top rank, and he feels depressed because he has nothing else to offer. He is consoled by Kawaihara-senpai, the beautiful student council president who is like a "perfect girl" that excels in sports and academics.
She tells him that she has been at the top of her class since the entrance examination, and she offers to help Saotome study. However, as a condition for her help, she wants him to wear a girl's sailor suit uniform when studying with her…



After school, a secret study session begins.



(Source: Natalie, translated)

mangas.title: Jing Ji Zhi Xin
mangas.description:
One day, Liu Hai unexpectedly finds a beat-up book of magic. When she tries to draw a magic circle from the book, she accidentally summons a monster girl named Chi Xiaoliu. Xiaoliu has been imprisoned to provide the source of power for the Kingdom of Chi. She had wanted to escape for a long time and finally succeeded in escaping, just as Liu Hai was drawing the magical circle in the human world… and that's how the two girls met.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life
mangas.synonyms: The Ranker's Guide to Live an Ordinary Life, A Guide to the Right Life for Rankers
mangas.description: In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she's the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity's bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

mangas.title: The Saintess has a Showdown
mangas.description:
The Saintess of the Sea Concubine Palace, in her summoning ceremony, summoned the lowest ranked companion as her soul pet- the water elemental. "But how could a Saintess only summon a water spirit? It must be something better, like the powerful water emperor!" "I'm really just a normal rookie! Why'd you pick pick me to be your Saint?"


(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Odd Girl Out
mangas.description:
Nari who just wants to blend in ends up forming a squad with the three prettiest girls on her first day of high school.


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Player
mangas.description:
Through posting a "Best Comment", I somehow became the main character of a webtoon!

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: The Classmate
mangas.description:
Eun-Ha's high-school life takes a dramatic turn when her bullies force her to perform a ghost-summoning ritual that brings Hae-Su, a charming yet unsettling spirit, into her life. Claiming to be her friend, Hae-Su starts exacting revenge on Eun-Ha's tormentors. However, his violent methods concern Eun-Ha, and she begins searching for answers to uncover the past and his true identity.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Killing My Love
mangas.description:
Lovers have been dying in the cruelest way possible. Victims were sliced up into pieces, as if their bodies had exploded. Andrea and Ian were mere bystanders to this spectacle until a misunderstanding throws them into "Killing My Love" (KML)!



This is a game that uses love to fuel murder. Each team of pairs are given targets that they must kill… or else. All the while, a sadistic gamemaster watches from the shadows.



KML is a game with no end in sight, but one thing's for sure… this hell is just getting started.

(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes a prologue and two CNY bonus chapters.

mangas.title: My Sadistic Master
mangas.synonyms: マイ・サディスティック・マスター
mangas.description:
Jin Yu-An is a shy, sweet-faced sub who's never actually tried any real SM play. He's never had a partner or a lover—mostly because he's way too busy, kind of a scaredy-cat, and hasn't found anyone who fits his taste. One day, while browsing a BDSM app, he stumbles upon a profile that makes his heart race… only to realize the guy hasn't logged in for years. Still, hoping against hope, Yu-An starts sending him cheerful messages. And then—a reply.



[You got a death wish?]

[Can't you see my age?]



Oops. He missed the guy's age. And the terrifying attitude in the response? Yikes. But somehow, Yu-An gets stubborn and insists on meeting him. The guy is exactly his type—intense gaze, scary tattoos, and an aura that screams danger. BDSM? More like organ theft??


Still… should he give this scary-sexy dom a shot?"



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Submission Time! Yes or Yes?
mangas.description:
Jian Le, a powerhouse manhua artist, had never missed a day of work. And yet recently, she'd been dragging her feet on deadlines and releasing fewer pages... A deadly artist's block had her in its grip!



Faced with the platform's release pace and metrics demands, her editor, Ren Qinghe, started getting on her case. That included the proposal of a way to appeal to a wider audience... In a fury, Jian Le announced a hiatus. Her good friend Mo Caicai suggested that she take the time to experience life, such as through throwing herself headfirst into a relationship. It was then that a new resident on the floor below her caught her eye. But she couldn't have foreseen what this attraction would lead to...



(Source: Baiheverse)

mangas.title: Kiss Me Redeem Me
mangas.description: Riley, a wandering artist disguised as a maid, gets caught stealing at Hilland Manor. As guards whip her, the lady of the manor, Yasmin, unexpectedly shields her. Riley couldn't believe her luck at the noble's kindness until Yasmin tended her wounds and revealed hidden desires and schemes. This "rescue" was a trap all along!

mangas.title: My Lips Are Targeted
mangas.titleNative: 俺の唇が狙われています
mangas.synonyms: My Lips are Being Targeted | Ore no Kuchibiru ga Nerawareteimasu
mangas.description:
At Pororo Academy, a school full of boys with special powers, there's one with a different ability called "Blue Line". Said ability "enhances the abilities of the person he kisses".

A school-life romantic comedy (with a dash of fantasy) that starts with an inevitable kiss!

mangas.title: Oni Ure Idol ga Kyou mo Watashi wo Oshitekuru
mangas.titleNative: 鬼売れアイドルが今日も私を推してくる
mangas.description:
Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki's life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!!



(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

mangas.title: Mr. I, the Office Worker Who Always Ends Up in Erotic Situations
mangas.synonyms: Mr. I, an Office Worker Who Somehow Gets Tired
mangas.description:
After unknowingly helping a mysterious elderly woman, a hardworking company manager finds his life spiraling into a series of absurdly suggestive, romantic-comedy-style situations that seem pulled from an erotic webtoon. What begins as an embarrassing coincidence slowly turns into a supernatural curse, or perhaps a blessing, as his professional and personal relationships become increasingly complicated.

(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Excuse Me Dentist, It's Touching Me!
mangas.titleNative: 歯医者さん、あタってます！
mangas.description: A human drama between a villany-faced yakuza and a dominant dentist! Give it a read and maybe your "wall" will be broken down...?!

mangas.title: Trick or Treat
mangas.description:
Shi-hyuk truly had it all. He was good-looking and could get any woman he wanted. But all that changed when one night, he just couldn't get it up! What's going on down there?! Defeated, all Shi-hyuk can do is take his L for now. But then, at home, something strange has begun to happen. A weird sensation has started to come over him, like somebody is aggressively touching his junk…! Visibly aroused, Shi-hyuk can't let his roommate, Hyunwoo, see him in such a vulnerable state. But wait, could it be? Those trick-or-treaters last Halloween… Was their "trick" a hex?!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: A Bad Case of Junioritis
mangas.description:
Teen angst in full swing.

U-Jeong's hopes for a normal sophomore year are dashed after a run-in with Se-Ra, a foul-mouthed troublemaker, who has a few choice words for him. What starts out as a simple accident snowballs into a big misunderstanding, and now U-Jeong finds himself tangled up with a bunch of depressed juniors!

mangas.title: Nyangnyangjjikjjik!
mangas.description: Geum Hae-mi transforms into a hamster. Go Woo-young transforms into a cat. The only way to break the curse? Physical touch?! An electrifying campus romance between predator and prey, packed with comedy!

mangas.title: I'm Only Shy in Front of You
mangas.synonyms: I am Only Embarrassed in Front of You
mangas.description: Eun Dan-Ah, a girl raised on an island, loses the bucket list she'd been keeping in anticipation of her first day of school. It was a mysterious classmate named Cheon Se-Hwa who found the notebook. Dan-Ah develops feelings for Se-Hwa and approaches him, but Se-Hwa finds her burdensome. The more she spends time with him, the more her face flushes, her chest tightens, and she feels uncomfortable. But somehow, she doesn't hate it.

mangas.title: Wish You Were Gone
mangas.description:
Chrissy—Chrysanthemum—Han met the love of her life as she hit rock bottom. Her boyfriend cheated with another woman and, worst of all, she was cute! When the other woman decides to pay off the debt of Chrissy's ex boyfriend, Chrissy can't help but slowly fall for her. Can a love like this last or will she wish she was gone like all the rest?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Good Night, See You in My Dreams
mangas.description: A long corridor bathed in red… A ghostly figure lurking in the shadows… Dozens of hands, their long, spindly fingers grasping at your throat… Sounds like the stuff of nightmares, right? But it's not the kind of thing that troubles Seongha. She's just your average high-school kid with a head full of exam stress. Her classmate Isu, on the other hand, has been plagued by that very dream for years. And it's taken its toll, leaving her exhausted and alone. So one day, when Seongha finds herself inside Isu's dream, both girls know that something seriously freaky is going down. Can Seongha save Isu from her nightmares?

mangas.title: All You Need is Perfection
mangas.description: College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the "prettier" Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse.
