Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

mangas.title: Kuai Ba Wo Ge Dai Zou
mangas.synonyms: Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai!
mangas.description: What's your brother like? To Miao, her brother Fen is someone who would tease her and make her explode 100 times a day; not a peaceful day as the two are fighting every single minute. However, when troubles come, Fen will become a caring, loving brother who protects his little sister at all cost.

mangas.title: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
mangas.titleNative: 茉莉花ちゃんの好感度はぶっ壊れている
mangas.synonyms: Le Love Meter infernal de Marika
mangas.description:
Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Garden of May
mangas.description: After her parents' death, Lady Vanessa is left with only two things—a mountain of debt and a marriage. Her greedy uncle is all too willing to sell her off as a fresh bride to an aging earl. To escape this arranged fate, she needs a scandal. A truly horrible, ruinous scandal.

mangas.title: Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence
mangas.synonyms: The White Holy Woman and the Black Priest
mangas.description:
Saint Cecilia is beloved by the townspeople—not only is she elegant and composed, she benevolently shares her wisdom with all who seek it. That is, until the last person has left—at which point she becomes totally hopeless! Only Pastor Lawrence, is keeping the Saint put together enough to do her duties...and though she may test him, it's all in a day's work!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: vs.LOVE
mangas.description:
Rival gang leaders, kept apart by senseless fighting between their schools. But everything changes when the leaders finally meet each other. An unexpected love blossoms between them and suddenly, everything is thrown in disarray! Will these enemies to lovers find peace in their new love or will it destroy everything?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kimi wo Miokuru
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Miss Not-So Sidekick
mangas.description: Hye-Jung loved to read to escape her daily stress. But that's before she woke up inside the bizarre world of her favorite novel! Instead of the main heroine who courts three eligible men, she is now Latte Ectrie – a minor villain that everyone hates?! One way or another, it's a chance to live out her most beloved storyline, with popcorn in hand to watch all the drama! Taking charge of the narrative takes on a whole new meaning!

mangas.title: Cute War
mangas.description: Si-Hong is a prodigy on track to make a splash in the world of engineering, until mysterious alien creatures named yomis, as adorable as they are bloodthirsty, invade Earth. Three years later, he's confined to his apartment as the outside world goes to hell, surviving on weekly rations handed out by the government. One day, he is visited by a talking squirrel-like creature who asks him to help end the invasion by killing his mother—the leader of the yomis who is masterminding their takeover of Earth, disguised as the popular human K-pop star Hyo-i…

mangas.title: Alluring Hunk in Women Wonderland
mangas.titleNative: 这里的妹子都想攻略我?!
mangas.synonyms: I Eat Soft Rice in Another World
mangas.description: After witnessing a once-in-a-century blood moon event, Zhang Hao loses consciousness and awakens to a world turned upside down. Gender norms and beliefs have been completely reversed, where women are now expected to pay dowries and propose to men. Women have taken on the role of breadwinners, while men are expected to be stay-at-home husbands. In this society, women without cars or houses face social stigma and struggle to find partners. It has become the norm for women to pursue men, while men making the first move on women is considered taboo. "I won't depend on women to support me! I will reclaim my true masculinity as a real man!" Follow Zhang Hao's journey as he navigates an inverted world filled with enticing challenges and temptations, all while striving to hold onto his identity as a man.

mangas.title: Returned by the King
mangas.description:
In a world where one's worth is determined by how powerful their skill is, Taehyeon is 35, unawakened, and barely able to scrape by as a pack bearer for monster hunters. But when a mysterious being calling itself "the King" gives him a skill of his own, Taehyeon gets a second chance at life. Now he's back in high school and armed with Gluttony, a skill that allows him to block and absorb the skills of others!



(Source: Webtoons)

mangas.title: Singwahamkke Doraon Gisawangnim
mangas.synonyms: The Knight King Who Returned with a God
mangas.description:
I returned to Earth after hunting demons in the otherworld for three hundred years. But I did not return alone.

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Shin no Jitsuryoku wa Girigiri Made Kakushite Iyou to Omou
mangas.titleNative: 真の実力はギリギリまで隠していようと思う
mangas.synonyms: I think I'll hide my true ability to the last minute
mangas.description:
A world where you can contract with God and gain skills. Born as the third son of a famous knight family, Yuno was so busy controlling his innate power that he was eventually called "incompetent." However, in the magical knight academy, who was enrolled for some reason, he fulfilled his fateful encounter with an unnamed god who was despised as "incompetent" like himself. Yuno, who contracted with the goddess and named her "Athena," secretly decided to make her the highest god, and decided to get a little more serious.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: My F-Rank High School Life
mangas.synonyms: My School Life Pretending To Be a Worthless Person
mangas.description:
The world discovered the essence of the human soul, Ideia, and found a way to materialize it. The stronger one's Ideia, the more power one has. In a society where hierarchy is determined by this power, F-rank Park Jinsung has always been his school's punching bag. In reality, though, he is an S-rank with extreme bloodlust, which he has been hiding to keep others safe. With only two years left of high school, will Jinsung be able to hide his killer side and prove rank isn't everything?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Regression of the Close Combat Mage
mangas.titleNative: 2周目の大魔導士は近接魔法で無双する
mangas.description:
When Vidrak the Death God invades and the fate of humanity hangs in the balance, the greatest mages of the realm stand in defiance… only to find that their spells have no effect, as the dark overlord effortlessly picks apart their attacks. Overwhelmed by a horde of monsters, long-range mage Setsuna Cromwell uses his last resort, the Amulet of Resurgence, to travel 10 years into the past. Now a freshman twice over, Setsuna must go against the grain by studying melee magic, known as the least prestigious domain – and the only one with a chance of defeating Vidrak.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Moduga Geunyeoreul Saranghae
mangas.description:
Kang Min-A's daily life is completely turned upside down by the sudden acquisition of the ability to . Now, what unfolds before her are irreversible events caused by a single moment of choice. In the midst of anger, confusion, and suppressed sense of justice, Min-A begins a new journey, wondering where to use her power. In what direction will her power flow, and what choices will she make?

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: To Each His Own
mangas.description:
Sang-Nam lives by one unshakable dating philosophy: "before you commit to it, you must hit it." If the chemistry isn't right, he won't even consider a relationship. The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That's when he notices Da-Ol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sang-Nam casually suggests that he might consider dating Da-Ol if he can "fix" him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Da-Ol agrees. What Sang-Nam doesn't know is that Da-Ol has a secret preference of his own…and one he definitely hasn't told anyone yet.


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Player Hides His Past
mangas.description:
The real world is suddenly ambushed by rifts that threaten to spill out monsters from the VR game "Chronicles of Arcana." These rifts can only be closed by "players," people who have awakened as their in-game characters with all the same stats and skills. Unfortunately for protagonist Lee Ho-Yeol, his awakening is the opposite of cool as his avatar happens to be the one he made during the height of his awkward phase in middle school, giving him all the mannerisms and speech of an absolute cringelord. Just how will he go on to become the hero humanity needs most?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Ultimate Shut-in
mangas.description:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jae-Hyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch -- he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade
mangas.description:
For decades, the brave warriors of the Northern Heavenly Sect fought to keep the world safe from the evil Silent Night. But when the fourth generation leader is accused of colluding with the enemy, he is forced to disband the sect and commit suicide to protect his son, Moo-Won. With no family and allies left, Moo-Won leads a dreary life under close surveillance... until a surprise attack from the Silent Night gives him a chance to escape to the mountains. There, the young warrior trains to master the fighting techniques of his predecessors, before the mysterious disappearance of a loved one brings him back to the mainland. Follow Moo-Won as he embarks on a journey to avenge his father's death and take down the villains who threaten to plunge the world into darkness!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: The World After the Fall
mangas.description:
Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world? When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters. On the brink of death, they can choose to use a "regression stone" to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever. Stubborn Tower Walker Jae-Hwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
mangas.description:
Yuuki wakes up to find herself wearing a maid's uniform in a strange manor. After wandering into the dining room, she comes across five other girls, each in the exact same outfit. Soon, the girls learn that the manor is brimming with lethal weapons and an array of deadly traps…and that they can only escape by playing the most gruesome of games. As the terrifying truth sets in, each girl's face goes pale—except Yuuki's. Why? Because this isn't her first go-round. That's right—Yuuki is a professional death game player who lives off the prize money she collects from winning brutal killing competitions, and she's not about to let this chance pass her by.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Paper Plane
mangas.description:
During their first meeting, the five-year-old Tang Junhe started to view the six-year-old Yang Xuan as his hero, and he willingly became Yang Xuan's little follower. Yang Xuan once said, "There are 12 ways to fold a paper plane. You didn't know that, did you? Let me teach you." Ten years later, the 17-year-old Tang Junhe lived in Yang Xuan's house as his younger brother. The grievances of their past remained unresolved as the two young men fought constantly. "The first one to fall is the loser. I knew that, yet I willingly fell into it."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Yingye Duixiang Ta Bu Tai Dui
mangas.description:
Okay, I'm listening. What? You're saying the business partner you found for me bailed? Then who is my current business partner on the show?! Help...it's actually getting more and more popular!!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: My Gorgeous Fiance
mangas.description:
Woojoo's parents have always been a little kooky, but this time they've clearly outdone themselves!

When Woojoo begrudgingly comes back home after running away for the Nth time, he finds out he has a fiance. Lucky for Woojoo, he now has to share his room with the guy - a fairytale prince, yes, but a straight one.



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: We're Not Brothers At All!
mangas.description:
Sheffield lets his emotions take over him when he hears that his stepfather's illegitimate son, Randol, wants to reunite with the family. On a whim, he decides to give his "big brother" a little welcome "gift" - spending a passionate night with him...

(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Intoxicated Love
mangas.description:
Having a secret crush is just like drinking a bottle of hard liquor. You clearly know that it will make you light-headed, lose your cool, and suffer. Yet, just like a moth to the flames, you endure the pain knowingly. "You stop right after having a sip of it but, as for me… I'm drunk in love."



However, inevitably, you finally sober up after being drunk. This is a story about doing everything possible just to continue having a secret crush and learning to love someone.

mangas.title: Desharow Merman
mangas.description: Desharow, a student of marine biology, goes on a research voyage with his mentor Rhein to study the merfolk. In the waters off Iceland, they manage to capture a mysterious black-tailed merman. This terrifying and fascinating creature quickly captivates the research-obsessed Desharow. Unbeknownst to him, he has long been marked as prey…

mangas.title: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Devouring the Seas
mangas.synonyms: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Swallow the Sea (Poyun 2: Tunhai)
mangas.description:
Wu Yu, a newcomer to the Public Security Bureau, is gentle and frail. He doesn't care about the difficulties posed by Bu ChongHua, his strict boss, and only wants to stay in the background and be paid on time with enough to sustain himself. However, no one knows that he is being targeted by top drug traffickers for a large bounty, or that this courageous young man had previously slaughtered the dragon of the abyss. With a chain of interlocking cases, a series of troubles come one after another. Can these two work together to survive the difficulties?


(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Breaking Through the Clouds
mangas.description:
Three years ago, the operation leader Jiang Ting made an error in judgment, a chain explosion occurred at the scene, and there were heavy casualties in the unit. Three years later, he, supposed to have died in duty, returned to the world, doing everything he could to bring forth the bloody, bizarre truth. Heroic souls resting in death, the ones behind it all closely approaching, sentiments built fighting side by side in blood and fire…

"I used all of my luck in this life, to exchange for you. Thank you for bringing me back to this world, Yan Xie."

mangas.title: Precious Thing
mangas.description:
Ji Geon-Woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn't greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Ye-Shin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-Woo infiltrates Ye-Shin's home as a bodyguard. At first, Ye-Shin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-Woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Ye-Shin grows possessive, and Geon-Woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him. But when Ye-Shin discovers Geon-Woo's true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-Woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Ye-Shin. Meanwhile, Ye-Shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-Woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Mission: Save the Hunter
mangas.titleNative: 유언 때문에 죽는 건 잠깐 미뤘습니다
mangas.synonyms: I Delayed My Death Because Of a Will
mangas.description:
Death delayed due to scheduling difficulties.

Chaeyoon, once a famous hero, now lives as an unknown hunter, fulfilling the odd dying wishes of ex-colleagues before he can end his own life. Haunted by the past and drawn to Jihan, a skilled hunter he meets, Chaeyoon questions whether fulfilling last wishes and finding his own solace is possible.

mangas.title: Living With Mr. Predator
mangas.description:
I just want a male mother! College student Song Fu, had 3 babies overnight and fell into a [child-rearing hell] — In order to solve this problem, he decided to hire a professional nanny. However, to his surprise, the person knocking on the door turned out to be a [Super tall, muscular bodied] man?!

Note: Chapter count includes five extras.

mangas.title: My Neighbor Always Stares at Me
mangas.synonyms: Wo De Linju Zong Shi Dingzhe Wo
mangas.description: A stalker and a detective walking the edge of the law?! Detective Peng Yanqing suspects he is being watched. The neighbor he suspects, Yi Fu, suddenly appears at his precinct as a major suspect. The tension between them starts to build, while strange cases quietly close in…

mangas.title: Against All Odds
mangas.description: Haunted by guilt, detective Jeong Hae-Il flees his past in Daegu, seeking refuge in his hometown of Seoul. But the city isn't as forgiving as he'd hoped. Soon, he's forced to confront the ghosts of his trauma when he crosses paths with his old flame, Jun-Seon, now tangled up in a dangerous new drug. Just when things couldn't get more complicated, a mysterious ally named Han-Gyeol emerges from the shadows—but can Hae-Il really trust him? In a city filled with secrets, can any of them overcome the odds?

mangas.title: A Doomed Girl Group's Do-Over
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Leader of a Girl Group Destined to Fail
mangas.description: Solo idol Baek Nokha sees her world crumble the day her mother dies while she's busy accepting an award. So, when a strange creature offers her a second chance, she accepts readily. But she never imagined she'd have to restart from the bottom as Yoon Chung, a trainee in an idol competition show! To see her mother again, she has to grant Chung's wish of debuting in first place. Armed with nothing but her voice and her knowledge of the industry, can this superstar climb her way back to the top?

mangas.title: Welcome to the Yandere Cafe
mangas.titleNative: ヤンデレカフェへようこそ
mangas.description:
At a certain yandere cafe, customers can safely indulge in the fantasy of being the object of dangerously obsessive love. For yandere-obsessed high schooler Kuraki, having a cast of professional yanderes performing terrifying acts of devotion on him is a dream come true! But as the staff begin to fall for Kuraki's natural charm, their "performances" start to feel a little too real…?!



A comedy about an oblivious yandere-loving boy and the yanderes he unintentionally creates!



(Source: Manga UP!)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization .

mangas.title: Con Cafe Girl Wears Love
mangas.titleNative: コンカフェ嬢は恋を着る
mangas.synonyms: Con Cafe Jou wa Koi wo Kiru
mangas.description: Tsumugu Aisaka, is a huge fan of clothes and aspires to become a fashion designer. One day, she meets a con cafe girl in Kabukicho and ends up working as a new cast member. What happens when she can only "talk about clothes" with people she meets for the first time?

mangas.title: Can't Back
mangas.description: Akira falls in love at first sight with Hokujou, a shop assistant at a vintage clothing store that he happens to go into while waiting for a friend. Ever since that day, Akira starts going to the store and buying clothes that Hokujou recommends. Having just had his heart broken by a straight man, Akira has no intention of getting involved with Hokujou, but then Hokujou unexpectedly shows up at Akira's usual gay bar...?

mangas.title: Maou-sama, Re Re Revenge!
mangas.titleNative: 魔王さま、リリリベンジ！
mangas.description:
The junior-high girl Mada Ooma recalls a past life as the Demon Lord. She (he) has but one lingering regret about her previous life: that she wasn't able to confess her love to Lili, her attendant. A love that would never come true... or so she thought, until Lili somehow appeared in front of her eyes in her new life...!? A bright and pure romantic comedy weaving together the past and present lives of a former Demon Lord, who's now being taken for a ride by the one she loves!



(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

mangas.title: I'm Nothing Like Your Fave, Is That Okay?
mangas.titleNative: 推しキャラに似てないけどいいですか？
mangas.synonyms: Oshi Character ni Nitenai kedo Ii desu ka?
mangas.description:
Tanumura (real name Masumura) and K (real name Keiichi) are both BL fans who are fans of the same ship from a hit manga. They share the same favorite characters and interpretations of the series. Keiichi is a massive fan of Masumura's fanfiction, which happens to suit his tastes perfectly. He also likes Masumura himself...in a sexual way. When they meet face-to-face for the first time at a collab cafe, his heart is set ablaze: Masumura's face and personality are both exactly his type! There's only one problem: Masumura's fave is a sweet, innocent bottom who couldn't be more different from Keiichi. A twisted love story with lots of complications about two men who love boy's love!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Win like Xiao He
mangas.description:
Xiao He, a famous player in an online game, once defeated a female thief in the game. Surprisingly, the female thief is a former top-class e-sports player! What makes her end up like this? The two strangers always come across each other without knowing it. What will happen to them in the digital life?



(Source: Pocket Comics)



Note: Originally considered complete with "final chapter" published in 2021-05-12. An epilogue was published in 2022 and a third season was announced for continuation starting Jan. 2023.

mangas.title: Streaming My Second Life
mangas.description:
Twenty years ago, legendary player Lee Suhyeok was killed by a trusted friend during a tower raid. Now he's back, reincarnated in a much weaker body and forced to restart from level one. Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there's no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming. As his stats rise with his view count, Suhyeok turns his revenge into a viral spectacle that no one, not even his killer, will ever see coming.

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Hito ni wa Sorezore Ura ga Aru
mangas.titleNative: 女にはそれぞれ裏がある

mangas.title: Tsumi ni Oboreru Crime Yuri Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 罪に溺れるクライム百合アンソロジー

mangas.title: Suki tte Ittekurete mo Ii yo?
mangas.titleNative: スキって言ってくれてもいいよ？
mangas.description:
Kanade's life was a symphony of blissful silence...until Masaya, a blast from his elementary school past, transferred in. Masaya's the kind of guy who shines so bright, he's impossible to ignore. Kanade, on the other hand, craves nothing more than a little peace and quiet. But for some mysterious reason, Kanade can't seem to shake him loose! Get ready for a hilarious romantic comedy about a handsome good-for-nothing that just wants to relax and a charming yet self-absorbed whirlwind!


(Source: Homesha, translated)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Pure Love Terrorism
mangas.description:
"Bam! It was nothing short of a catastrophic entrance."

A single car that suddenly barreled in was enough to turn Ju Han-Nan's daily life upside down in an instant. What he found amidst the perilous accident was a man bound head to toe. The man he had saved on the spur of the moment.. Huh? Far from crying, he wore a carefree expression and acted suspiciously.

This guy... what is he? This man, who exuded a dangerous aura... You're saying he's dating my sister? And now he wants to live with us?! You're lying!!

mangas.title: Blue Spring in Your Eyes
mangas.description:
"They're so blue and clear. They look like they're shimmering." He was the only person who would describe the eyes Sowa hates so much like that.

Sowa doesn't have any friends. His sharp, cold eyes attracted only delinquents to his side. He lives his days filled with fighting, tussling, and pain. But one day, the basketball club's vice-captain, Kyoshiro, approaches him. The dependable, popular, and all-smiles senpai is the direct opposite of everything Sowa is. He tries everything to avoid the glowing beam of sunlight that is Kyoshiro, but...

The caring, handsome senpai x the aloof and clumsy lone-wolf kohai.

mangas.title: SUMMER MOON: THE QUPRIDS
mangas.description:
Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: I'd Like to Write About Love
mangas.titleNative: できれば 愛 をつづりたい
mangas.description: Keito, an author troubled by his inability to sleep, has taken an interest in a man named Furukawa who works for a bedding manufacturer. Though they start out as patrons at the same cafe, they eventually get closer and start spending time together on a personal level. The sociable yet secretive Furukawa keeps Keito on his toes, yet his good looks make it impossible for Keito to stay away... But what will he do when Furukawa proposes cuddling in the same bed as a way to cure his insomnia?!

mangas.title: Koukou Jidai ni Gouman Datta Joou-sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igai to Ikigokochi ga Warukunai
mangas.titleNative: 高校時代に傲慢だった女王様との同棲生活は意外と居心地が悪くない
mangas.synonyms: Living together with the queen from my high school days
mangas.description:
Late at night, while working part-time at a convenience store, college student Yamamoto reunites with his former high school classmate, Megumi Hayashi. Back in school, she was known as the class's most beautiful girl, yet also a proud and arrogant "queen." Though the two didn't get along in high school, Yamamoto discovers bruises on her wrist and, intending it to be just for one night, shelters her from her abusive boyfriend. Before he realizes it, however, a strange cohabitation begins.



Confused by the situation, the two gradually come to see sides of each other they never knew before. What was supposed to be the worst living arrangement turns out to be surprisingly comfortable…!?



A frustrating yet heart-fluttering romantic comedy about cohabitation between a wounded "queen" and an emotionally detached young man.

mangas.title: Ramen-ya ni Narabu Onii-san-tachi wo BL ni Shitai Hanashi
mangas.titleNative: ラーメン屋に並ぶお兄さん達をBLにしたい話
mangas.synonyms: ラーメン屋に並んでたお兄さん達の漫画
mangas.description:
Notes:

- Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv under the title "Ramenya ni Narandeita Onii-san-tachi wo BL Kankei ni Shitai Hanashi (ラーメン屋に並んでいたお兄さん達をBL関係にしたい話)".

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kyou, Eki de Mita Kawaii Onnanoko.
mangas.titleNative: 今日、駅で見た可愛い女の子。
mangas.synonyms: Cute Girl I Saw at the Station Today.
mangas.description:
An observational comedy about an older man curious about the beauty products of a seemingly perfect girl(?!).



Kameyama, an ordinary salaryman, can't help but wonder what that pretty girl at the train station is wearing. That Milbon scent is lovely! Her glowing skin... must be some kind of treatment! Which brand's cosmetics is that? All of those "cute things" he used to obsess about, now appearing before him in person!



(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

mangas.title: Rockstar Never Die
mangas.synonyms: ロックスター・ネバー・ダイ
mangas.description:
Jung-Seo reunites with Hyo-Sin, the boy he once admired in high school, only for a drunken accident to leave Hyo-Sin with a broken nose and under Jung-Seo's roof. As they begin living together, Jung-Seo realizes Hyo-Sin is nothing like the person he once idolized… and decides to help him find the courage to chase his dream again.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Venus in December
mangas.description:
When 29-year-old illustrator Kei quits his job to rethink his future, his editor friend gives him a bizarre request: move in with the brilliant but notoriously difficult 32-year-old novelist Hijiri Saionji to keep him on schedule—and draw his portrait while he's at it.

With no idea what to expect, Kei travels to the upscale neighborhood and arrives at the doorstep of Hijiri's massive house, only to be met with blatant annoyance and a cold shoulder from the reclusive author. Refusing to back down from this new chapter in his life, Kei resolves to face the prickly writer head-on. But as the two men begin to share a space, Kei discovers there are hidden reasons behind Hijiri's frozen exterior. Can a stubborn artist melt the heart of a reclusive writer?

A cohabitation BL featuring a novelist with zero social skills and an illustrator rediscovering himself!

mangas.title: Haikei, Arishihi ni Saku Hanatachi e
mangas.titleNative: 拝啓、在りし日に咲く花たちへ
mangas.synonyms: Dear Flowers That Bloom in Days of Yore
mangas.description: Kasumi, a serious girl who has just started at an all-girls school, discovers a letter tucked into an old book she found in the library. The letter's writer yearns to have a special relationship with another girl, like how it was described in the book… A romance about the the old-school "S" kind of girls-love.

mangas.title: Asumi-chan is Interested in Lesbian Brothels
mangas.titleNative: 彩純ちゃんはレズ風俗に興味があります！
mangas.synonyms: Asumi-chan wa Lesbian Fuuzoku ni Kyoumi ga Arimasu!
mangas.description: Sweet but awkward college student Asumi never got over her childhood crush on her old friend Mai. She's mortified by the memory of their first kiss, which couldn't have gone worse. When she discovers that Mai may be working at a nearby brothel, she sees her chance for redemption. There's only one catch: none of the girls on the brothel's website use their real names. Goaded along by a more experienced friend, Asumi begins a journey of exploring her sexuality, trying new fetishes, and getting comfortable in her own skin as she sleeps with the brothel's women one at a time in her search for Mai. Is it possible Mai is searching for her out there, too? And when they finally reunite, will Asumi be experienced and confident this time?

mangas.title: Romantic Mystery
mangas.description: Go Yi-Young, a mystery game enthusiast, is walking down the street while leaving a review for the popular mystery game The Sin of the Blue Silhouette when he fails to avoid a bicycle and gets hit by it. When he regains consciousness, he realizes that he has entered the mystery game he was playing just a moment ago, and in order to survive, he tries to prevent the murder of the culprit he saw in the game, Cha Gyeon-Woo...

mangas.title: Return of the Gods
mangas.description:
U-Ju Hyeon dreams of living the ordinary life of a high school student, but his dream will never come true as he possesses special powers that others don't have. One day, after being chased by an evil spirit, he is taken to the School of the Tiger and learns that he has a dragon orb in his body. Will U-Ju be able to protect himself and the dragon orb from evil spirits?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Saha
mangas.synonyms: ソワカ～僕を愛してくれますか?
mangas.description:
Sa-Ha is a wife with a secret: he's actually a man who has been married in his sister's place. His ill husband has no idea because he has not had the health to touch Sa-Ha at all, and the secret is safe for now…but will it stay a secret in the face of his dashing brother-in-law, Hee-Su?



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)



Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Tonari no Douki no Renai Jijou
mangas.titleNative: となりの同期の恋愛事情
mangas.description:
Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
mangas.titleNative: 魔入りました！入間くん
mangas.description: Iruma Suzuki has always been eager to please, even at the cost of his well-being. Worst yet, he's the son of two selfish parents who end up selling him to a demon. Thanks to their totally irresponsible actions, Iruma has found himself living in the Netherworld, where he must live and attend school as the grandson of an older demon. Luckily, his new, doting grandfather is there to help, but Iruma will have to figure out how to blend in with his demonic classmates or risk getting eaten. All he needs to do is subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and do other typical demon things while never revealing that he's human… Piece of cake, right?

mangas.title: Aelhelice
mangas.description: The corporate drone dies and is reborn as a witch, only to be immediately ensnared by the white-haired vampire Alice, who binds her in a blood pact! In her loli form, she's clingy and adorable, the only one you can rely on. In her mature form, she's fierce and protective, her combat prowess maxed out. The bond forged through shared blood is sweet enough to make you dizzy. Yet dark currents already churn beneath the city's surface. Beneath the blood pact lies an unsolvable mystery—their meeting was never mere coincidence...

mangas.title: Miss Ghost, No Sticking Allowed!
mangas.synonyms: Nu Gui Xiaojie, Jinzhi Tie Tie!
mangas.description:
Lanting, a Taoist priest, was trying to exorcise a thousand-year-old female ghost when she inexplicably formed a love-bond with her! Now the girlie ghost hugs and kisses her every day and tells Lanting that she smells nice? What's going on, a Taoist priest is letting a ghost molest her every day?! Aren't Taoists suppose to be above worldly affections? Is it really okay to be so affectionate with a ghost?

Lanting: Why are you running away? Aren't you coming to bed with me?

Jiang Si: I thought you said that humans and ghosts have separate destinies and can't be together?

mangas.title: The Demon Maid Only Wants to Be Bullied by the Villainess
mangas.titleNative: 恶魔女仆只想被恶役千金欺负
mangas.synonyms: Emo Nüpu Zhi Xiang Bei Eyi Qianjin Qifu
mangas.description: Sharan, a pious girl, found a high-paying job as a maid. Her task is to serve a haughty and sadistic noble lady named Lynette. However, her job won't be an easy one…

mangas.title: Sesame and Rice Cake
mangas.description: Sesame saves Rice Cake in the park, and they part ways. Rice Cake saves Sesame in the park, and this time, they become friends after Rice Cake's owner takes in Sesame. They become friends, but will that friendship progress to something more? Oh, and they're cats.

mangas.title: Fukakouryoku no I Love You
mangas.description: You can't get away from the devilish senpai! Enjoy the start of a love affair where you will be pushed around all the time!

mangas.title: Wind Through Young Reeds
mangas.description:
"There's no way a lady this gorgeous could be the villainess! And she's going to end up as part of the OP MC's harem?! Absolutely not, I refuse! I'm going to change the outcome of this story!" The weak and pathetic—but with a large stomach!—transmigrator Hu Xiaoman quietly made up her mind.

"You look so focused, silly." The villainess, reborn in the New Game+, thought that this girl was very~ interesting.

Transmigrator x New Game+ character, who's the one really hiding a secret side to herself?

Wait, the OP MC has nothing to do with this story anymore?

mangas.title: Only For Her
mangas.description: My ex-girlfriend, with whom I had a precipitous breakup five years ago, is causing a scene at my blind date? The docile and obedient girl I remember now sports striking pink hair, a cigarette between her fingers, and an aura of mystery and danger. She arrives with a burning desire for revenge and to subdue him, only to find that the once-respectable "Teacher Zhang" has long since lost his youthful edge. But why is this seemingly inevitable confrontation spiraling out of control?

mangas.title: Man Ji Chuanyue De Wo Weisheme Shi Mushi Xiaojie A
mangas.titleNative: 满级穿越的我为什么是牧师小姐啊
mangas.synonyms: I Am a Max-level Priestess in Another World
mangas.description:
A top-level player accidentally transmigrates into the game character "he" was playing, a max-level priestess. She will team up with a dragon-maid to venture into this brand new world! However — why do all these girls keep looking at her in this funny way?!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Crying Demon, Hide Your Tears
mangas.titleNative: 爱哭鬼, 请藏起你的眼泪
mangas.synonyms: Aikugui, Qing Cang Ni de Yanlei
mangas.description: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety to confess to Lin Dai Xue, on the other side Dai Xue keeps making opportunities for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other well but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

mangas.title: You Er
mangas.description: The fish circle the bait beneath calm waters of a lake. Inside the club, Jiang Rang follows Qingzhou's invisible "fishing line" into a private room. Qingzhou plays prey, but he's the hunter. As passion ignites, a hidden camera rolls and intimate sounds reach a third listener. Blood fades in the dark water. Who's really the catch in this deadly game of seduction?

mangas.title: Shashou Shechu Lian Ai Shouce
mangas.description:
Disguised as a high school student, the killer Xie Yan had just finished dealing with the "rats" in the shadows when, on his way home, he was unexpectedly "scammed" by a drunk neighbor! "Hey uncle, it's very dangerous to take a nap anywhere..."



(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: Boyfriend From Scratch
mangas.description: What should I do if my same-sex junior colleague keeps confessing to me? Not only was he confessed to, but voice actor Mingsen unexpectedly found out that the junior was actually the fan artist of his book?! Under these circumstances, the two of them have to work together to voice a gay radio drama...

mangas.title: Wo Siduitou Zhongyu Pochanle
mangas.synonyms: My Perfect Enemy Is Finally Broke
mangas.description:
When he woke up, Ji Ran, the son of a rich second generation, found himself lying beside his arch-nemesis from his school days, Qin Man!



Despite reluctantly agreeing to a sponsorship agreement with the green tea black belly enemy, Ji Ran finds his lonely and stubborn heart gradually melting by the occasional tenderness displayed by Qin Man.



(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

mangas.title: Fail A Mission Fall In Love
mangas.synonyms: Renwu Shibai Jiu Yao Tan Lian'ai | Task Failed, Fall In Love
mangas.description: As a professional villain, Mei Yuan has to be an intimidating foe. But he also has to act like a mother figure, watching over the protagonist at all times, changing roles left and right, all to make sure the protagonist will barely win out. The final battle should've grand clash between good and evil. Instead, the protagonist confessed his love for the villain! Is he going to fail his mission at the 99% completion mark?! This villain is very confused, when did the protagonist fall for him?

mangas.title: Apex Predator
mangas.description: Shen Dai, a gentle and rational Omega got himself into an arranged marriage for the money to pay back his debts. Little did he know that he was getting married to Qu Moyu, the wealthy S-class Alpha that he has a crush on. However, Shen Dai is aware that "Apex Alphas are heartless." He is captivated by Qu Moyu's kindness, but also acutely aware of the contrast between them.

mangas.title: Pay attention to me
mangas.description:
There are two top students in this particular city. One was a studious, friendless recluse who doesn't date. The other only ever wanted to have a beautiful and soft-spoken partner. Rumor has it, one day, these two top students ran into each other.



Jiang Yao: Brat, don't I treat you well?

Jiang Yao: The brat is kinda cute.

Jiang Yao: Hey, Brat...

Yin Che: Get lost.



Friendly Big Bad Wolf Jiang Yao VS Reclusive Little Bunny Yin Che




(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Yao Mo Mo Weiba Me
mangas.synonyms: Do You Wanna Touch My Tail?
mangas.description:
Merman Ye Ming falls in love at first sight with the handsome human Lu Chuan while performing at the aquarium. After receiving help from Lu Chuan, his feelings grow stronger, and in the blink of an eye he brings him home with him. The next day he suddenly reveals that he's a merman?!



What?!



Use your little merman brain! What are you going to do now?!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Two Way Trial
mangas.synonyms: Two Way Crossing | Shuangxiang Dujie: Qingchun Ji
mangas.description: The daily lives of middle and high school students.

mangas.title: Straight or Not
mangas.description:
He is a sunny, hilarious, positive and obscure actor. He is a composed, generous and graceful general manager. Because of a strange request, they began a long journey of attracting each other. What should they do? Nonsense, of course becoming lovers.


(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Lop-Eared Butler
mangas.synonyms: Everlasting Love | Attendant With Dangling Ears | Chui Er Zhi Shi
mangas.description: Yan Yi is an exceptional omega, possessing a rare tier-3 gland cell. But when it comes to compatibility, numbers are everything, and his compatibility with the alpha Lu Shangjin is too low a percentage. Eventually bored with Yan, the alpha removes his mark and breaks their bond, but Yan Yi never stops loving him. So when Shangjin finds an omega with more compatible glands, the choice to undergo a risky transplant surgery seems obvious, but will it be enough to restore the love they once shared?

mangas.title: The Merman's Dilemma
mangas.description: White lion, the tactical commander and pace-setter mermaid, they are the experimental body of the research institute before. They depended on each other but they used each other too. Because of a misunderstanding, the white lion was injured by the mermaid, and said that the next meeting would be revenge. But the next time they meet, he can do nothing but protect his mermaid...

mangas.title: My Beloved Fool
mangas.synonyms: Yet You Love a Guy Like Him
mangas.description:
Jian Suiying instantly falls in love the first time he sees Li Yu, his half-brother's alluring best friend. Consumed by obsession, Jian stops at nothing to win over this icy heartthrob - but just as he thinks he's succeeded, he discovers that he's been the pawn all along. Will Jian be able to overcome the pain of betrayal? And what about Li Yu? Can these two "188" guys ever find true love amidst the tangled web of desire and deception?



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Qiang Jin Jiu
mangas.description:
During the Xiande period of the Great Zhou Dynasty, Lord Shen Wei of Jianxing was defeated at the Chashi River in the northeast, which nearly resulted in the loss of six central provinces. His son Shen Zechuan was taken to the capital in disgrace, despised as the son of a loser. Xiao Chiye, the youngest son of the Lord of Libei, rushed to the capital at the news, and nearly beat Shen Zechuan to death. However, the weak-looking Shen Zechuan fought back fiercely, and even bit Xiao Chiye until he bled. It was the start of a fierce feud between the two. Unexpectedly, during their endless conflict, they accidentally discover the real reason for Shen Wei's defeat.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Mayu no Uta
mangas.description:
"I'll be your mother."



After losing her biological mother, Mayu Kanda was abused by her guardian uncle every day, and could barely eat properly, but she just laughed it off. Until she met a mysterious beauty, Kamakura Komachi, who suddenly appeared.



Is she, who acts like a mother, a ray of hope for Mayu? Or...?



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Genius Bastard of a Noble Dark Clan
mangas.description:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn't stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I've become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn't enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I'm a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: RuriDragon
mangas.description:
Well, a half dragon. Her mom admits Ruri inherited her draconic traits from her father, who, yes, is actually a dragon. As if dealing with curious classmates wasn't already challenging enough, Ruri and her dragon genes literally turn up the heat in the middle of a lecture. Her ordinary life is about to be anything but!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Notes:

- Chapters 1-6 were published in Weekly Shounen Jump from June 13, 2022 until the series went on hiatus in August 2022 due to the author's health. It resumed with five weekly chapters from March 4 to April 1, 2024, then switched on April 22, 2024 to a bi-weekly publication on the digital Weekly Shounen Jump and Shounen Jump+.

- Ranked 1st in the Nationwide Bookstore Staff Recommended Comics 2023.

- Nominated for the 2023 eBookJapan Manga Award.

- Ranked 9th in the Male Readers' division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2024 guidebook.

- Ranked 2nd in the Web Manga category of the 2024 Next Manga Award.

- Winner of the Setting Award at the 4th Magademy Awards in 2025.

mangas.title: Black Sheep
mangas.description:
To all the black sheep, resist your fate.

Shizunaga Rei, the son of a powerful yakuza boss, lives as a regular high school student. But one day, his father is attacked by hostile forces, and Rei is suddenly appointed as the acting leader. Unexplainable events begin to unfold around Rei, and alongside his secretary, Ouga Masumi, Rei witnesses the reality of the organization's society—?!

mangas.title: Imouto wa Siscon Ani ga Mendokusai
mangas.titleNative: 妹はシスコン兄がめんどくさい
mangas.description:
Yui Hasegawa, an unattractive high school student, has an older brother, Yu, who is both a literary and martial artist, cool, and called the most handsome guy in school.



The two are so unlike each other that it is hard to believe they are brother and sister.



There are even rumors that they don't get along, Yui, who has a "perfect brother," is troubled.



It is...the fact that her brilliant and talented older brother is actually a severe siscon.



A hilarious home comedy about siblings who are complete opposites!

mangas.title: Josou Danshi wa Skirt wo Nugitai!
mangas.titleNative: 女装男子はスカートを脱ぎたい！
mangas.synonyms: The Crossdressing Boy Wants to Take Off His Skirt
mangas.description:
Uichiro, a junior high boy, has a secret that he cannot tell his childhood friend Tama-chan. He has been dressing up as a girl for her sake because of her phobia of men. A thrilling and agonizing romantic comedy about a coming-of-age boy who continues to cross-dress for the girl he loves!



(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

mangas.title: Josou Danshi to Dansou Joshi wa Oniai Couple
mangas.titleNative: 女装男子と男装女子はお似合いカップル
mangas.description:
The beautiful (male) girl Shion and the handsome (female) boy Yukari are a couple! It's a romantic comedy about the daily life of this perfectly matched pair, full of unexpected contrasts!



(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

mangas.title: Under Doctor
mangas.description:
If you want to live, find him. If you don't want to die, don't go near him. He is the greatest doctor and the strongest hero, the legend of the underworld--Under Doctor Haiji. Medical drama x heart-pumping action!



(Source: MANGA Plus)

mangas.title: When Love Ends, So Do You
mangas.description:
A girl who can see ghosts. "Baekjeok," a ghost who has followed her from the past, speaks of love, yet his gaze is fixed on someone else.

As I become the prey of love, I gradually lose myself.

A romantic thriller where the boundaries of self are distorted, caught between affection and obsession.

mangas.title: Isekai de Fumetsu no Ai wo Sasagemasu: BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 異世界で不滅の愛を捧げます BLアンソロジー
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Shinobu Takayama

1. Kokuou Heika no Ochaire Gakari (国王陛下のお茶入れ係) [Okaka x Saki]

2. Bijin Sugiru Daiyon Ouji wa Yomeiri Mae ni Shojo wo Sutetai (美人すぎる第四王子は嫁入り前に処女を捨てたい) [Mochita x Omochi DX]

3. C-kyuu Boukensha wa Maou-sama no Marking Zumi (C級冒険者は魔王様のマーキング済み) [Amama Akatsuki x Kirin Tsunoda]

4. Haru ni Kataomoi no Kimi to (春に片想いの君と) [Peco Morishima x Mia Suiju]

5. Isekai de Musou Shiteru Osananajimi kara Tegami ga Kita (異世界で無双してる幼馴染から手紙がきた) [WA:WA x Mameko]

mangas.title: You Are My World
mangas.description: Childhood friends Ju-Hyeok and Su-Ah once promised to stay together forever, but when their secondary genders manifest in reverse, their worlds drift apart. Years later, Ju-Hyeok's dream of Olympic gold is on the line, and Su-Ah might be the only one who can help him reach it. What follows is a story of fate, pride, and a love that refuses to yield.

mangas.title: Love After the Break
mangas.description:
Landon forced Zayden to go from Alpha to Omega. Zayden endured the pain, the rejection, and finally walked away after the divorce. Only when he was gone did Landon realize... he'd made the biggest mistake of his life.



(Source: WebComics)

mangas.title: Okawari Itadaketa Darouka?
mangas.titleNative: オカワリいただけただろうか?
mangas.description:
Suzu Yotsuya is a high school girl who loves to eat. While eating by herself in the cafeteria like usual, she is invited to eat with Majima-san, a tall and popular classmate. However, there are some suspicious rumors going around about Majima-san…⁉



(Source: Comic Action, translated)

In the game, he plays as a strong character nearing the level cap. However, in real life, Lu Siqi is a highschooler with nothing left to live for. Only thinking about what is the meaning of being alive and death.

Operating as a meek female character in the game, in reality, Shi Liu is a self proclaimed sentient beast who is finding his next interesting prey behind the monitor screen.

The new update in《Fantasy ONLINE》added many new high level equips in the medium difficulty instance "Deville Labyrinth", which attracted many players to form groups.

Just like that, 647 who is planning to challege the instance, and Sixteen_16 who is looking for a new prey, met each other at the entrance of the instance—

mangas.title: To Not Die
mangas.description:
A high school student, Im Da-Joon is used to being bullied at school. Right before he was about to end his own life, he saw the interview of a friend killer on TV by chance. He got impressed by the interview and decided to seek revenge. His revenge was successful, but his life went in the wrong direction… Im Da-Joon quit school and joined the group of teenagers who ran away from their homes. Da-Joon is now free from school bullies, but now he has to survive against the street gangs who are much tougher than school bullies.



(Source: YLAB)



Notes:

- Includes four extra chapters.

- Belongs to Blue String universe.

mangas.title: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
mangas.synonyms: The Swordmaster House's Youngest Daughter Is an Archmage
mangas.description: Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire's legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered in her past life. Will Rosette's knowledge of both magic and the future be enough to rewrite a tragic destiny and change fate itself?

mangas.title: Zodiac Girls
mangas.description: Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

mangas.title: The Gardener in a Hunter World
mangas.description:
Jiha is living a relatively quiet life, gathering resources after raids and selling potions from his general store as a worker-class hunter. Little did he know, taking a nap on top of an ancient text would completely change his life. He is transported to a magical forest, where he gathers rare ingredients to create never-before-seen potions and meets mythical creatures that help him on his adventures. Soon, he starts to build up his abilities to become a skilled alchemist, and high-level hunters start to see him in a different light. How will Jiha make use of his newly acquired skills?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Hero, the Demon, and the Villain
mangas.description:
The three arts of swordsmanship are all that swordsmen seek to master in this world. Eager to learn, some will take dangerous paths, others will trick, and some will even kill. Serena R. Lavail, a possible hero, is one of those who seek to master the arts to save her family. To do so, she embarks on a mission that starts right in the enemy's lair. There she meets the villain, Kane S. Ronald, who has a mysterious past and a mysterious lost skill. Heroes, villains, foes, and friends... what will be the fate of these two?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Mikoto to Rei
mangas.description:
Mikoto, the free-spirited gal, and Rei, the serious student council member.

Rei is completely at the mercy of the free-spirited Mikoto…!?

But it seems like she doesn't mind it all that much.

Take a peek into the cute—and slightly naughty—daily lives of these two?

mangas.title: Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi.
mangas.synonyms: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend.
mangas.description:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."



Working at a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? The is the start of an workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Goshujin-sama shika Katan! Light BL Anthology: Bokutachi Kedamono Goshujin no Koi Mimamori-tai
mangas.titleNative: ごしゅじん様しか勝たん！ライトBLアンソロジー ～ぼくたちケダモノご主人の恋見守り隊～
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Akira Caskabe

1. Beaver tto Koishite (ビバっと恋して) [Suuji Hanabusa]

2. Kimi to Koisuru Sankakkei (きみと恋する三角形) [Mato Yamamoto]

3. Wanko to Ookami-kun no Love Letter (わんことオオカミくんのラブレター) [Shimajirou]

4. BIG CAT LOVE [Ayu Sakomoto]

5. Iwakuma-kun wa Neko Mishiri (岩熊くんは猫見知り) [Kusege]

6. Shiba to Omawari-san (柴とおまわりさん) [Shino Nihonmatsu]

7. Zoo tto Oshi (Zooっと推し) [Hono Ichizen]

8. Aiken Bell wa Joubutsu Dekinai! (愛犬ベルは成仏できない！) [Suguri Yamaguchi]

9. Wai no Mission (ワイのミッション) [Hamasaki]

10. Toto no Rival (トトのライバル) [Ichiko Tanno]

11. Kawaii Kimi ni Pink no Hanabira (かわいいキミにピンクの花びら) [Kiyo Date x Mai Sakurazaka]

12. TOBI'S TIME [JIN]

mangas.title: The Evil Ring
mangas.synonyms: ブラックチョーカー・神の子の逆襲
mangas.description:
Born in the ruthless Exile Land where his next meal was never guaranteed, Moon has always aspired to no longer be a worthless human stuck at the edges of society. And while a once in a lifetime opportunity may pay out enough money to let him live his dreams, his road to riches is paved with games of death and survival. Can Moon survive long enough to see better days?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: A-Lan Doesn't Know How to Love
mangas.description: How to have a romantic relationship with someone who doesn't know anything about romance?

mangas.title: Where the Clouds Stop
mangas.description:
Time is wrong. It isn't flowing the way it should.

The person she killed the day before yesterday—their body was already rotting, putrid. But the next day, when she got home, they were standing right there, beaming at her.


What the hell is going on?

My doctor... he promised me. He swore that if I just took the medicine, I would wake up.

Where am I? What is this place?

And you... who are you?

mangas.title: Xian Chan Nu
mangas.description:
Liu Shiqing is a playful daughter born to a family of armed escorts. One time while sneaking out on another one of her adventures, she finds herself kidnapped by bandits. Moments before it all seemed to be over, Xian Chan Nu suddenly shows up and swoops her off her feet, saving her and stealing her heart. This is a story of humans and demons, masters and slaves; a tale of revenge and a tale of loyalty only beginning to unfold.



(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hei Xue, Bai Yue, Yongsheng Hua
mangas.synonyms: Black Snow, White Moon, Eternal Blossom
mangas.description:
For what reason, do they continue to live? For what reason, do they continue to eat? They put on the most beautiful masks and commit the cruelest acts. White moon, Black snow, Withered maiden, Eternal blossom. Vicious X Evil, Tyrant X Unhinged, Maiden X Maiden, Hunter X Prey. This is a poem of self-reflection, or a stimulating speech for this numbing world...



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Unaware His Majesty Is a Girl
mangas.description:
The new emperor, Qi Nian, acceded to the throne many years ago. He kept refusing the requests by his officials to choose a consort, brushing them off by saying "I am busy with work. The affairs of state are more important." But Qi Nian finally relented as rumors that "the emperor is impotent" began to spread.

Yu Dingdang is a rather dim-witted girl, but born to a prestigious family. This led many to say: "Miss Yu exchanged her brain for her looks". Nobody expected that she would be chosen by the emperor to be his empress consort? Yu Dingdang acted surprised on the outside, "Who? What? Me?" But inside she was thrilled, because she has wanted to become Qi Nian's bride ever since she was little. When she successfully marries her crush, that is when a slapstick comedy breaks out in the palace, when she finds out that the haughty emperor is actually a woman?!

mangas.title: Lian Ai Rang Wo You Le Chao Neng Li
mangas.description:
Art student Zhong Shenxiu runs into a problem during a portrait sketching class. She couldn't "truly see" Xu Ke, a top student and the subject of the portrait session… She can't draw her subject if she can't see her clearly. Zhong Shenxiu puts down her pencil and wonders, maybe if she became a better student, she would be able to get closer to her, right? And if she could get closer to her, then she could truly see her, right? Until she gets so close that the distance between them is almost zero — like they're almost face-to-face. Phew! Now she can truly see her clearly! But! This is... a little too close! Help! What should she do now!!!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)


Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Slightly Sour Secret
mangas.description:
Have you ever been confused about love? In the end what is "true love" like? Our female lead now is standing at a fork in the road. On one side, her close childhood friend is waiting for her reply. On the other side, there stands her college friend whom she cannot just let go. Where does this love triangle lead to?


(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Nüdi? Wo Zhi He Niangzi Tan Lianai
mangas.titleNative: 女帝？我只和娘子谈恋爱
mangas.synonyms: The Empress? I Only Date My Wife
mangas.description:
Gu Ning, a love novice and galgame loser, travels to a supposedly hardcore court intrigue game called "Above the Empress," becoming the perverted commander of the Jinwu Guard. She knows she must protect Empress Jiang Yuelin and conquer the lands to unify humanity. Despite possessing a system and knowledge beyond her time, she's still terrified because this wacky intrigue game actually has options, and whenever she chooses, she always picks the wrong one!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Lu Ming Yan
mangas.description: Inside the luxurious pavilion, human desires flow like water, and morals are extinguished like ashes. The courtesan Qin You receives a lady visitor, who offers her a large sum to buy her freedom. She claims that she can see the future, and she asks Qin You to come with her to help save the world.

mangas.title: My Yandere Female Student Became My Boss
mangas.titleNative: 病娇女学生成了我的上司
mangas.synonyms: Bing Jiao Nü Xuesheng Chengle Wo de Shangsi
mangas.description: Lin Shuo, the dreaded "Devil Teacher" who is feared by everyone, finds herself blushing in private when teased by one of her former students.

mangas.title: Don't Touch My Ears
mangas.description: Ruan Ning is a sophomore at Hongcheng High School. She is the class president, the number one student in her grade, and the most popular girl at school. But she has a secret, she's a beast-person, and nobody can see her ears or tail, at least until a beautiful new transfer student comes along.

mangas.title: Siche Jojakdol
mangas.description:
Ours, a small idol group with talent but low recognition, recruits visual member X to enter the music charts. With X's appearance, Ours explodes in popularity! They are truly at the peak of their career. However, X dies in an unexpected accident... The protagonist, Luan, who can control corpses, must use his powers to protect his position as a top idol!

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: This Life's Universal Superstar
mangas.synonyms: In This Life, the Greatest Star in the Universe
mangas.description:
Hard-pressed to find good luck in this universe, Sun Woo-Joo gives up on his dream of becoming an idol in favor of living a normal life. That is, until he finds himself waking up from a car accident on his exam day! But as luck would have it, Woo-Joo can now copy any move exactly as he sees it, and his two left feet that kept him from debuting are now moving to the beat! With this newfound skill, will Woo-Joo be able to turn things around and become the star that shines the brightest on stage?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Constellations Are My Disciples
mangas.description:
300 years ago, the invincible warrior Hyeon-Oh Kim brought down the Tower of the End, preventing the world's demise. Though he should have died the moment the Tower of the End collapsed, Hyeon-Oh is reborn 300 years later in the body of a 17-year-old boy named Ju-Hyeok Kim. Meanwhile, he discovers the existence of the Constellations, who were once his disciples 300 years ago but were born during the time when he did not exist in this world. Will he be able to find them again and train them?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Start by Becoming Your Strategy Target
mangas.titleNative: 从成为你的攻略对象开始
mangas.synonyms: Cong Chengwei Ni De Gonglüe Duixiang Kaishi
mangas.description:
An ordinary college student, Lin Chao, accidentally got trapped in a game world. The system told her that she could only return to the real world if she wins over the female protagonist with maximum affection level. Unfortunately, the system assigned her the role of a villainess who would be eliminated by the protagonist right at the start.

"I better think of a way to get in with the protagonist, fast…"

mangas.title: Lan Yue, Chao Ming
mangas.synonyms: The Moon Rises With The Tide
mangas.description:
While in middle school, Zhou Chaohai accidentally took in a baby octopus. Years later, they meet again—only for the octopus to confess to him?! Outer God, Chaos, Whispers, the Abyss... Entanglement, complications, turmoil, demands... Ahem, shhh~~ Buried in debt, Zhou Chaohai finds himself forcibly bound, sinking deeper into the entanglement with each step.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: Nemuro-kun wa Kao ga Ii!
mangas.description:
Nemuro-kun, sits next to me. Always hiding his face behind his bangs, and most people at school don't know his true appearance. One day, Takamura happened to know his face, and she couldn't take his eyes off Nemuro-kun! I love Nemuro-kun's face. But that's all I know. A school romantic comedy unfolds, starting from their faces as they gradually get to know each other!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Return of the Genius Player
mangas.description:
The Hunters League is a sport where only those with supernatural powers may compete, promising fame, glory, and incredible prizes. Changhyeon Lee had it all, but faces an abrupt downfall during his slump. Cast aside by even his own team, his world crumbles… but fate deals him an unexpected hand when a fatal encounter with a 10-ton truck ends his life, only to send him back in time to the day he discovered his powers. Armed with a second chance, Changhyeon is determined to reclaim and transcend his former glory in the Hunters League.


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: This Wasn't My Plan
mangas.description:
In a twist of fate, Ro-A finds herself thrown back a decade in time. This isn't just a trip down memory lane. She's faced with a younger, naive Si-Hyeon, the future superstar who would brutally wrong her. Armed with knowledge of what's to come, Ro-A sees a golden opportunity: a chance to rewrite their history. Can she resist the allure of revenge and change Si-Hyeon's destiny before he becomes her nightmare?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

mangas.title: My Deer Friend Nokotan
mangas.titleNative: しかのこのこのここしたんたん
mangas.description:
Girl meets elk-girl—and chaos ensues!

No one knows Torako used to be a delinquent. All of her classmates only know her as the perfect student. But everything changes when Nokotan, a transfer student with antlers, enters her life. Antlers aren't the only thing strange about Nokotan. Her deer nose can sniff out Torako's secret past! Whether it's at school or the zoo, chaos follows this doe-eyed girl's every step. Torako has so many questions! Is Nokotan a deer, a girl, or something in-between?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Weapon Creator
mangas.description:
Here, try this sword. Jun-Seo Shin is a master weapon creator doing menial jobs to keep a low profile in a world teeming with monster dungeons. But his habit of lending weapons to those in need exposes him to mega guilds and covert figures out to kill budding heroes from his past life. Can Jun-Seo craft his way out of trouble and uncover the conspiracy that followed him to this life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)


Note: Includes one prologue.

mangas.title: Does Anybody Here Know How to Tame a Wolf?!
mangas.titleNative: 誰かオオカミさんのしつけ方知りませんか！？
mangas.synonyms: Dare ka Ookami-san no Shitsukekata Shirimasen ka!?
mangas.description:
Ookami-san has arrived at school.

Himura Akane, a sophomore and member of the discipline committee,
is very studious, but also sincere, petite, and adorable, making her beloved by everyone at school and very popular.

One day, the principal asks her to be the tutor in charge of the education of Ookami Ren, the daughter of the board chairman.
Since Akane's goal is to enter college on a scholarship, she decides to accept the assignment.

However, Ren turns out to be much bigger than her physically and, on top of that, a troublesome girl with a cunning mind full of bad ideas...?!

A girls' comedy starring a small and adorable senpai and a big and difficult-to-handle kouhai begins!

mangas.title: Too Many Losing Heroines!
mangas.titleNative: 負けヒロインが多すぎる！@comic
mangas.description:
Plain, boring, and friendless Nukumizu Kazuhiko has witnessed something completely baffling: popular girl Yanami Anna was friend-zoned by her childhood friend and crush! In fact, all the popular girls around him are getting similarly rejected by the boys they like. Without realizing it, Kazuhiko becomes entangled in the relationship drama where all the leading heroines are losing out on love! Can he keep their spirits up and help them find happiness?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Show me your bust
mangas.description:
Ever since Jiho saw her best friend Woohee's perfectly shaped breasts in a bar bathroom, she couldn't stop thinking about them. To her surprise, an exasperated Woohee lets her see and even touch them after this confession... but the more Jiho fondles them, the more they seem to unlock her Pandora's box of raging hormones. One minute, she's squeezing Woohee's breasts in her dorm, and the next, she's hooking up with her longtime crush Yeonwoo, whose true feelings are a complete mystery. It's clear that Jiho finds them both hot, but which of them holds the key to her heart?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Suhee0
mangas.description:
Suhee is an average office worker. Her boss seems to hate her, and she shoulders the burden of looking after her two young siblings and aging father. After making an impromptu appearance on her brother's livestream, Suhee discovers her potential as an internet broadcaster. To improve her family's financial situation, she dives into the exciting yet mysterious world of internet fame, as fans and industry figures show support for her. Her new career seems promising, but is everything too good to be true? Can Suhee lift her family out of poverty and change her life?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Apothecary Prince
mangas.synonyms: The Crown Prince That Sells Medicine
mangas.description:
In a twist of fate, the life of a doctor of Korean medicine flips upside down in a single night. Doctor Han Lee is reborn as Lachiel, the sickly Crown Prince of the Empire of Magentano. Han is now armed with medical knowledge and skills found nowhere else in this new world -- but can he heal an empire and mend his own body at the same time? Witness his journey of self-exploration and resilience as he maps destiny's meridian, in pursuit of the acupoint that can reverse his fate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Space Cheon-ma 3077
mangas.description:
Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Executioner
mangas.description:
A hero should never kill anyone, not even the worst of villains. Gangyu could never understand why his team of heroes lived by those words, but he tried his best to do the same… until the villain who wiped out his squad killed his brother in prison. Gangyu breaks his vow and enters Ruculus with permission to kill as the prison's executioner. Now, he must fight his way through the villains to kill the worst of them all.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Villain to Kill
mangas.description:
There are two kinds of people with special abilities: villains, who are driven by their evil desires, and psykers, who pursue justice and work against villains. Cassian Lee is a very powerful psyker with a good heart. But one day, when he visits his friend in Greece, things take a wrong turn. Following an unexpected chain of events, Cassian ends up in the body of a Korean high school boy... who has just become a villain! Will his sense of justice win in the end or will he end up becoming a cold-blooded villain?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Academy's Genius Swordsman
mangas.description:
Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Tatakai Shika Shiranai Onna Kishi wo Amayakashi Tsuzuketa
mangas.titleNative: 戦いしかしらない女騎士を甘やかし続けた
mangas.synonyms: I kept spoiling a female knight who knew nothing but fighting
mangas.description:
Nothing is more adorable than a cool lady knight acting all cute and affectionate!



(Source: Ganma!, translated)

mangas.title: Reforming Jerks Into Good Men
mangas.titleNative: 快穿之好好改造重新做人
mangas.synonyms: Quick Transmigration: Properly Reformation to Start a New Life
mangas.description:
There are all kinds of jerks in the world, acting as jerks in their own way. Devious and cunning, they toy with people's emotions. True feelings have no value to them. Nothing else matters to these guys besides fame and fortune. The system raises his arms and cheers: A good reformation for them to become good men! Karma is always watching. When these jerks are given a chance to be reborn, they will start on a path of forced reformation.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: I'd Rather Believe
mangas.description: In addition to human beings, this world also contains fairies, spirits, ghosts, and monsters, the supernatural and the strange. When Zhang Quan, a man with the ability to see "demons" encounters Shen Qing, who's being harrassed by a "demon"... A rowdy, day-to-day excorcism begins!

mangas.title: Zhi Yin Zhi Yang
mangas.description:
Why is the college student having strange dreams all the time? Why are the people on the street ignoring the cries of a little girl? Is that mysterious Taoist priest for real, or a fraud? An accidental encounter, and a wild plant, will lead two people into danger… Ghost that can't be seen, a maze with no exit, a thousand-year old Taoist temple shrouded by supernatural incidents. Who is behind all of this? Who is the one whispering in your ear?



(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: The Fire of Darkness
mangas.description: (1v1) Ling Zhuo is a popular idol with great looks and strong professional skills. His journey since his survival show debut had been smooth sailing—until his manager pushed him into a film crew, where he crossed paths with the yandere big boss, Lu Chixie. The big boss aggressively closed in, snatched Cupid's arrow away from Ling Zhuo and someone else, and lured Ling Zhuo into his territory step by step, trapping him there. He then posted on Weibo to announce to the world: "This person is mine.”

mangas.title: Lang Jun Xiang Dui Wo Fu Ze
mangas.synonyms: The Wolf Lord Wants to Take Responsibility for Me
mangas.description:
Fang Li was marked incompletely by a beastman as a child, and has been troubled by his heat periods and pheromones. Years later, a wolf, Karnal, came forward to take responsibility. Fang Li immediately recognizes and fears Karnal as the culprit who often appears in his dreams. An evil ravenous beastman from his dreams or a fervently loyal doggo, which one is the real him?!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Meitain Du Xiang Rang Jiao Wangzi Shesi
mangas.titleNative: 每天都想让病娇王子社死
mangas.synonyms: Everyday I Want The Yandere Prince Die
mangas.description:
Big crisis for the face-chasing lover! Sunny local dog Jiang Jiaojiao (straight man) fell in love with Zhong Minyu (male) at first sight! An accident turned the originally unattainable cold-faced nobleman into a spoiled and fragile "Lin Daiyu", and used his beauty to win the other party's favor!! But as they got to know each other better, Jiang Jiaojiao gradually discovered Zhong Minyu's yandere nature, and the huge secrets hidden behind his family and two generations...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Muyuan Qiuse
mangas.description:
Li Jian, the adopted son of a mob boss, has been forcefully locked up in a cemetery by Min Zhao, the son of a deranged killer.

"Are you after some ransom money? Just call my wife, she'll pay whatever you ask."

"To the rest of the world, you're already dead. I can do whatever I want with you."


Li Jian raised his hands and struck Min Zhao. Wincing in pain, Min Zhao retaliated by slapping Li Jian across the face.

"Do you really hate me this much? I saved your life, and this is how you thank me?"

"Do you expect me to be grateful, you psycho?!" Li Jian fires back.

"No matter what, you're not leaving me. You're safer here."



(Source : Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Timbre in His Heart
mangas.description: Freshman Lin Qingji was just about to enjoy his new life in university when he knocked an old school teacher into ground. As a compensation, Qingji had to joined a horrible rock band as a fill-in bass player. He then encountered the last person he wanted to meet in the world, the guitar player who was a campus bully. But Qingji kept confusing him with another boy in his childhood. What would this sullen, defensive and jet-black-hair guy bring to Qingji's life?

mangas.title: Lonely City
mangas.description:
Zi Le disguised himself as a female dancer and tried to get close to Zuo Yicheng—the licentious Counselor-in-chief, but Zuo saw through him and pinned him down on his bed! Zi Le yelled, "Get down! Get off me!" And Zuo Yicheng said, "Alright, you can get on me." Then a blow landed on Zuo's face, and Zi Le shouted in anger, "Piss off!"



(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: Wo Pianyao Zhuang
mangas.description:
To assassinate his target, Meng Shiyu, assassin Xia Ran rents a house to observe him day and night. An unexpected entanglement leads him to become Meng Shiyu's bodyguard. Xia Ran begins to learn to protect people, thinking he is protecting the innocent. However, he doesn't realize that from the moment he accepts the assassination mission, he has fallen into Meng Shiyu's trap...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: We've Been Reincarnated, There's No Way I'm Giving You My Mana Again!
mangas.titleNative: 都转生了，我才不要再给你补魔！
mangas.synonyms: Du Zhuansheng Le, Wo Cai Buyao Zai Gei Ni Bumo!
mangas.description:
