In her past life, she wore shackles for her. In this life, she received a wedding ring from her.

"I'll be the one to take care of you this lifetime!"

A wolfkin princess reborn from the flames x a reincarnated saint bound by her destiny... A forbidden love story that renews across time and space!

mangas.title: Reijou VTuber wa Maid no Yashoku ni Juurinsareru: Kindan Gohan de Shokureposei Haishin
mangas.titleNative: 令嬢VTuberはメイドの夜食に蹂躙される～禁断ご飯で食レポ生配信～
mangas.description: Mashiro, the daughter of the president of a major food company, secretly streams as a VTuber as a tomboy character, the complete opposite of her true self, in order to change her introverted nature and become independent from her father. However, her subscriber count is not growing... Then one day, a new maid, Kozue, arrives to work at Mashiro's home—. Kozue, a skilled cook of mysterious skill, will tempt Mashiro with all sorts of "forbidden" late-night snacks!

mangas.title: Haimiya Is Scary Cute
mangas.titleNative: 灰宮先輩は怖くてかわいい
mangas.synonyms: Haimiya Senpai is Scary but Cute
mangas.description: At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!

mangas.title: Toying with Magic
mangas.description:
After a hard day's work, Heesu wants nothing more than to go home and have a relaxing time with his…toys. He's amassed quite a collection over the years so he's not lacking for options. But one day, things start to oddly go missing from his house. His shampoo, his remote, his half-eaten apple and his most precious toy! Maybe he's just absent-mindedly misplacing things these days, he is stressed out at work after all. That's what he thought anyway, until one day he came home and caught the thief red-handed! The only problem is, this thief isn't just your plain old neighborhood cat burglar, in fact he's not from Heesu's neighborhood at all! This thief is from another dimension and now Heesu is trapped there too. Hm, this thief is kinda cute…but no more toying around, Heesu's gotta get back home anyway he can!



(Source: Lezhin)



Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

mangas.title: I'm in a One-on-One Relationship!
mangas.description:
Jun-Ho, a perennial nerd, becomes friends with the kind and handsome Do-Yul, who takes classes in the same college. Jun-Ho falls in love with the affectionate and angelic Do-Yul. However, Do-Yul has a twin brother, Do-Ha, who is a brat, and Do-Ha begins to interfere with Jun-Ho and Do-Yul's relationship. When things don't go his way, Do-Ha disguises himself as Do-Yul and tramples on Jun-Ho's feelings, and even reveals his and his brother's secrets...

A love triangle romance between a man with multiple personalities who loves his own personality and a man who falls in love with two of those personalities.

mangas.title: The Perfect Senior's Secret!
mangas.description:
Tae-Hyeok, the perfect, top-of-the-class senior who's kind and friendly to everyone. But is there a crazy, unpredictable jerk hiding beneath that perfect facade? The only girl among his classmates who knows his secret. And the crazy, unpredictable jerk who's becoming increasingly obsessed with her.

The slightly complicated college life of these two attractive students begins.

mangas.title: Possessing My Venus
mangas.description: Xue Rui once harbored an unhealthy possessiveness toward "Big Sister," and this secret has somehow come to the attention of the university representative, Xiang Xiaoyuan. Will Xue Rui be able to maintain the image of the "good girl" she has cultivated over the years?

mangas.title: Wan Chao
mangas.description:
Xiang Wan, who travels from ancient times to the modern era, enters the voice acting industry on the advice of Yu Zhou, who takes her in. Here, she meets Chao Xin, a gentle yet resilient senior. Starting with a chance invitation, the two grow closer and develop more ambiguous feelings for each other.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Who's That Girl?
mangas.synonyms: Today's Han Yoil Is a Woman
mangas.description:
Sang-Hyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sang-Hyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!


(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Sini Naerin Topstar
mangas.description:
Kang Yeon-U, who was born with a natural talent to become a shaman or entertainer, gains the ability to live longer after overcoming a near-death experience by resolving his grudge. After that, Yeon-U's life completely changes after meeting top star Kwon Seong-Hyeon while resolving a request...

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: The Students of Illip Arts High
mangas.description:
Meet Sol Han, the human photocopier who can replicate anything she sees with precision! One day, she stumbles upon a mysterious genius's drawing in a VR game, igniting her passion for art. Curiosity leads her from a quiet countryside to Illip Arts High School, the epitome of artistic excellence. Amidst challenges and tangled friendships, Sol's journey, a captivating tale of youthful growth and camaraderie, unfolds in the picturesque halls of Illip.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Otherworldly Genius Method Actor
mangas.synonyms: I Was Mistaken As a Monstrous Genius Actor
mangas.description:
Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he's pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character's experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Lady of the Devil
mangas.description:
Would you make a deal with the devil to get a second chance at life? After her family was framed and executed, Ayana spent the last 13 years desperately trying to exact revenge, only to lose her life at the hands of her nemesis. But just before death's door, a "loyal knight" appears with a strange proposition. Is he truly her knight or is she truly alone? Will Ayana be able to save her family from doom and finally get her revenge, or is she dancing to the devil's tune?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Count's Secret Maid
mangas.description:
For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Return of the Blossoming Blade
mangas.synonyms: Return of The Mount Hua Sect
mangas.description:
When Cheong-Myeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheon-Ma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheong-Myeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheon-Ma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheong-Myeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru
mangas.titleNative: おそらくカノジョは俺の兄貴を狙ってる
mangas.description:
A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he'll never trust a girl again.



But then, a pretty girl in his class suddenly starts talking to him a lot. Is she just trying to get to his brother too…? Or does she actually mean something else?


(Source: Manga Park, translated)

mangas.title: I Got My Wish and Reincarnated as the Villainess (Last Boss)!
mangas.titleNative: 念願の悪役令嬢の身体を手に入れたぞ！
mangas.synonyms: I got the body of a villain's daughter (last boss) of my dreams!
mangas.description:
A sickly girl named Elizabeth has been reincarnated as an otome game villainess! She begins her life anew, blissfully unaware that her fate is to be killed by the heroes. She might enjoy a healthy life now, but will she be able to turn fate on its head?!



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: Akira Failing in Love
mangas.titleNative: 百瀬アキラの初恋破綻中。
mangas.synonyms: Momose Akira's First Love is a Failure.
mangas.description: Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

mangas.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
mangas.titleNative: 真夜中ハートチューン
mangas.description:
When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by "Apollo." However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn't know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school's broadcasting club. That's where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four's dreams pan out?



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: My Girlfriend's Not Here Today
mangas.titleNative: 今日はカノジョがいないから
mangas.description:
Pent up and tired of her apathetic girlfriend, Asahina Yuni turns to an anonymous online account to let it all out. It's just another day of doomscrolling after class when Asahina gets swept away in conversation with the beautiful, outgoing Taki. When Taki turns out to be following Asahina's private account, it's cute…right? Taki would never blackmail Asahina…right? With every new lie, the web of secrets and erotic desire grows ever-tighter!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Convenient Semi-Friend
mangas.description: "What if we became friends with benefits...?" Suuna, a gloomy high school student, leaves home to live in a dorm. But when she nervously enters her room, she finds her roommate, Ruka, feeling up another girl! She finds out Ruka needs a "friend with benefits," so Suuna takes charge and proposes they form a "(semi) friends with benefits" contract...?

mangas.title: Kaguhara-san no Fetish Note
mangas.titleNative: 香原さんのふぇちのーと
mangas.description:
Kaguhara Ririka is a high school girl in her first year at Fu Eichi High School. She has an ordinary appearance, no personality to speak of, and no friends. However, she has a unique hobby that she keeps secret. She loves exploring all kinds of embarrassing "fetishes" of cute girls, and she keeps a diary of her observations of those girls trying to keep their fetishes to themselves! As Ririka seeks out the sweat, smell, and flesh of cute girls and record them writhing in shame, who will be the object of her observation tonight?



(Source: Gamma Plus, translated)

mangas.title: I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl
mangas.titleNative: 恋する（おとめ）の作り方
mangas.synonyms: I Turned My Childhood Friend (♂) Into a Girl
mangas.description:
It's a familiar story: a popular high school student gives their plain friend a makeover and transforms their life. But this time, the path to a new life isn't quite so straight and narrow. Kenshirou Midou has loved cosmetics all his life, keeping his obsession secret from almost everyone except for his childhood friend Hiura Mihate. One day, Kenshirou gets permission to practice applying makeup on Hiura, and the results are earth-shattering: Hiura's appearance transforms from a plain, undersized boy to a pretty, petite girl, and Kenshirou discovers just how freeing it is to apply his passion! Yet he's not the only one who finds the process liberating. Hiura likes the makeup, and the subsequent "dress-up" in feminine clothes, and decides to start wearing the girls' uniform to school. Kenshirou doesn't understand if he's unlocked something in Hiura, or if he's simply seeing a new side to his childhood buddy that he never noticed before. What are these feelings bubbling between them now–is this attraction truly new?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



This series was originally self-published to Pixiv and was later serialized in Pixiv comicPOOL.


Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

mangas.title: The Academy's Undercover Professor
mangas.description:
Machiavelli and Gerrard are just one of the many names the new professor of Ceoren Academy uses to disguise his identity, and now he can add one more to his list, Professor Ludger Cherish. The real Ludger Cherish dies on board a train during a terrorist attack, making him the perfect target for a new identity. Little does the new professor know, Ludger Cherish was involved in something deep and secret. The new Professor Ludger has to be careful to not get caught by the school and the dangerous secret society.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Novel's Extra
mangas.description:
Wouldn't it be a dream to wake up in a world of your own creation? For Kim Hajin, it's nothing short of a nightmare. With no clue how or why he's been transported into his web novel — as a mere extra, no less! — Hajin has little choice but to see his story through until the end. Lucky for him, as the author, he knows this perilous world like the back of his hand. But when discrepancies in the plot begin popping up left and right, Hajin soon realizes that things aren't quite so simple, after all…

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Maniju
mangas.description:
Radel, a normal human, had a special transformation after an accident 50 years ago. He saves Sien from a life-threatening situation caused by Veron, and the two decide to live together to search for Shakia, who holds the key to the accident 50 years ago. Their relationship is initially based on mutual needs, but subtle feelings quickly develop between them.

"I just... feel good when I touch you."

mangas.title: Sonkkeute Danneun Jeom
mangas.synonyms: The Point that Touches the Fingertips
mangas.description:
Straightforward guy photo and college student Kang Chan X prickly former pianist Ye-Jun. A love story that is louder than music begins!



Kang Chan was forcibly dragged to his nephew's piano recital as a cameraman. The moment he was bored while holding the camera—
delicate fingertips, eyes that you can't take your eyes off, overwhelming melody. His eyes, his heart, stopped at the man playing the piano on stage.
"Please be my photo model!"


Straightforward from their first meeting. Manners? None. The mood? Smashed. Of course, Ye-Jun rejects him outright! But Kang Chan doesn't know how to give up. He immediately enrolls in a piano academy and starts to hover around Ye-Jun. Bickering, excitement explosion!


A love story clearer than a camera, starting now.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: The Reason for Existing
mangas.description:
"Lee Yu," who has lived a life of insignificance, longs to become someone special, even just once. However, at the moment of his final resolution, frustrated by constant frustration, a mysterious being appears before him. And it grants his every wish...

The mysterious "being" and the "Lee Yu" who summoned it!

mangas.title: The King of Home Dating
mangas.description:
After being dumped by his boyfriend of 10 years, Jooyeong starts fresh at the only place that will hire him: a failing academy full of flunking students. When the director asks him to go on a show called "The King of Home Cooking" and promote the academy, Jooyeong dutifully agrees. What he doesn't expect is to run into Jonghan, the show's producer and his high school classmate who was much more than a friend. Their chance encounter sparks a heated fling behind the scenes, but all the while, the unresolved tension between them lingers like a ghost from the past...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Paji
mangas.description:
Humanity is divided into three races: the 'Nut', whose bodies are extremely enhanced; the 'Alma', who inherit a unique bloodline; and the 'Haman', who mediates between the two. The blood of the 'Alma', who lives in the desert, is used as a cure for the madness of the 'Nut', who lives in the western part of the continent. One day, Seok-Ha is hunted by 'Alma' and ends up in an unfamiliar land. While struggling to return to the desert, he meets Eden, whose identity is unknown. What begins as a threat takes longer than expected, and Seok-Ha becomes suspicious of Eden, who is trying to obstruct his return...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: A Love That's Not Me
mangas.description: Ga-Ram is a half-breed between a demon and a human, requiring periodic absorption of sexual desire to stay healthy. However, his constitution only allows him to absorb male sexual energy, which he finds utterly repulsive. After enduring it for so long that his health deteriorates, he gets scolded by his older brother. Terrified by his threat to hand him over to a perverted old man if he doesn't consume someone's sexual desire, Ga-Ram promises to try consuming the sexual desire of the classmate sitting next to him at the academy he'll soon attend. But wouldn't you know it, that classmate happens to be Jae-Chan, his childhood friend he's grown distant from...?

mangas.title: From Me to You
mangas.description: Seung-tae's not sure he's lived the best of lives. He's 70-years-old and still closeted, with no one left at his side to hold his hand when he's diagnosed with Alzheimer's. But maybe all that could change… with the help of his old diary. Turns out he can reach out to his 19-year-old self in the past via its magic. And talking to his younger self, all these memories keep coming back… Of how he was in love when he was so young, and how there was this serial killer on the loose in his neighborhood…

mangas.title: My Perfect Boyfriend
mangas.description:
Ahn Cha-Woo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Cha-Woo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair.

"Forget it. I am done with dating."

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Do-Ha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Do-Ha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Cha-Woo quickly crushes his own interest. Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, "Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?" A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

mangas.title: Jopokdo Toesaga Doenayo?
mangas.synonyms: Can a Gangster Leave the Gang?
mangas.description: Hyeongwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with Seongjin... But who is really Seongjin?

mangas.title: Garden of Kindness
mangas.description: Yun I-So, a twenty-seven-year-old lunchbox owner raising a seven-year-old child alone, finds herself in a difficult situation. One day, Hae-Jun, a man who suddenly appears in her life, hovers by her side like a friend or a lover. I-So, who has been living a peaceful life, eagerly accepting Hae-Jun's affection, begins to feel anxious about losing his present happiness when the past relationships that shook his life upside down seven years ago reappear. As time passes, he begins to realize that there's something strange about Hae-Jun, who used to protect him... Was it a mistake to step foot into his garden in the first place?

mangas.title: Love Train
mangas.description:
On the first day of school, six students felt their hearts flutter all at the very same moment in time! This is the story of each of them pursuing and being pursued out of their earnest wishes for love.

(Source: Naver, translated)


Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 42 side stories.

mangas.title: Accidental Baby
mangas.description: Doh I-Hyeon is the ultimate corporate workaholic, but he hides two secrets: he's a somewhat defective omega and he suffers from prosopagnosia—the inability to recognize faces. After a blurry, drunken one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, I-Hyeon decides to keep the baby and brave single parenthood in secret. But his carefully constructed walls start to crumble when his superior, Seo Jeong-Un, begins a relentless pursuit. Jeong-Un is charming, persistent, and strangely familiar, but to a man who can't recognize a face, his flirtations are just another workplace distraction. Can Jeong-Un break through I-Hyeon's "iron wall," or will I-Hyeon's condition keep the father of his child a mystery forever?

mangas.title: Eye of the Storm
mangas.description:
Hwan Woon-Ryong and Beom Pung-Ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world's two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they're poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-Hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them. Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-Hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn't exactly easy when you'd rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty. As Beom-Hae's giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-Ryong and Pung-Ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world's most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down?

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming.

mangas.title: Purely Delinquent
tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First
mangas.description: Cheonga's first love turned out to be something of a player, and she simply refuses to fall for that type again. Yet somehow, she finds herself in a fake relationship with Seokjae Ban, who is exactly the kind of man she was determined to avoid. He is smooth and careless, and his reputation as a womanizer precedes him. And yet, he seems to be mostly disinterested in others, but is unable to keep his distance from Cheonga. Is he just messing with her, or could this be the start of something more serious?

mangas.title: Unstoppable Young Lady
mangas.synonyms: I Can't Handle the Young Master
mangas.description:
The boy in your class you have a crush on turns out to be a butler at a butler cafe! Bang Go-Woon's struggle to win his heart with 999% sweet desserts!

A romantic comedy combining sweet desserts and innocent love.

mangas.title: My Ancestor is Watching Me!
mangas.description:
Su Da-Won, a freshman who can see the ancestral spirits by everyone's side. All she wanted was a normal college life. But then, the enigmatic president of the occult club, Sa Da-Ham, appeared before her. For some reason, she can't see anything about him?!
On top of that, even the spirit she worships warns her to stay away from him...

Is it fate, or a trap?

A spine-tingling yet heartwarming romantic tale of two young people!

mangas.title: Kun Kankanui Namja
mangas.description:
One day, Korean Kim Du-Jo wakes up in the desert. He was saved from dying of thirst, but when he came to his senses, he saw people carrying bricks from the labor yard to build the emperor's pyramid!



People say that when you travel through time, you gain mystical abilities: you can see the future, and hang out with beautiful women!
Then why can't I have a sip of Coke? And why do I have to be whipped? It's been a long time since I've suffered so much.



Emperor Kun Kankan comes to inspect the construction site of his pyramid, was notices Du-Jo. What will Du-Jo's fate be, when he's caught by Kun Kankan, a sodomite who enjoys being humiliated by strong, rough, and rude men in private...?!



(Source: Ridibooks, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Atmosphere of the Novel Is in Crisis
mangas.synonyms: The Mood of the Possessed Novel is in Crisis
mangas.description:
I was transmigrated in a novel that was written by my older sister. But... the atmosphere of the novel is a little strange?

After my older sister got in a car crash, I was granted an opportunity to fulfill one wish in honor of her good deeds. So I wished to become the character my older sister cherished the most in a novel. But I then ended up possessing an antagonist named 'Satin' instead!
But the complications didn't stop there... The main character 'Cain', a holy knight, keeps interfering with me. Even though I was not really a big fan of novels. I still tried to dig into the uncovered mysterious secrets of the novel, and play the 'faithful villain.' But... my relationship with Caine started to become deeper than anyone else's... And now everything's spiraling out of control!!

mangas.title: Engaged to the Blind Duke
mangas.synonyms: I Got Engaged To The Blind Duke
mangas.description: Broke and desperate, Marin talks her way into a job assisting Gerald von Vines, the blind and temperamental duke. Her plan is simple: earn enough to rebuild her life and return to normalcy with her mother. But a moment of kindness backfires, landing her an unexpected promotion to fiancée. Now she is stuck managing a stubborn man who rejects help yet finds his only peace by her side. As their arrangement turns personal, will Marin and the Duke discover that some things are better felt than seen?

mangas.title: Our High School Music Genius is Paganini's Reincarnate
mangas.synonyms: High School Musical Genius Is Paganini Reincarnated
mangas.description:
They called him the Devil's Violinist in another life, but now he's just a student trying to blend in. As a reincarnation of Paganini, Juwon has spent years suppressing his extraordinary talent to live as an ordinary teenager. But when a twist of fate lands him in an arts high school, his silent strings begin to scream for attention. Surrounded by rivals and expectations, the genius who was once forced into silence must decide if he is ready to reclaim his throne. The legend has returned, and the world isn't ready for his encore.


(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: PASSION : RAGA
mangas.description:
When Yuri Gable first pulled the young Ling Xinlu out from the ocean, he didn't expect the two of them to ever meet again, especially not at gunpoint. Danger always seems to follow their encounters, though it isn't until Xinlu messes with the wrong psycho and loses both his first love and an eye that the two men finally find the chance to open up to each other. But how will their relationship progress when Xinlu has no memory of Yuri saving him before and only recalls a man who seemingly left him for dead underwater?

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Once Upon a Deal
mangas.synonyms: Story Telling Business | A Folklore Business
mangas.description:
Ju Yun-Seong thought getting a job at JH Soft was the start of a normal office life—until he noticed his cold, intimidating CEO, Baek Ha-Jin, glaring at him every time they crossed paths.

"Why is the boss always staring at me? Did I do something wrong on my first day?"

Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yun-Seong keeps his head down… until he stumbles upon a mysterious employee ID and uncovers a secret: his boss isn't just intense—he's a nine-tailed fox. And to make things worse? Ha-Jin's fox bead ends up lodged inside Yun-Seong's body. Now the CEO won't leave his side, and "normal" has left the building.

"Mr. Ju, you have two choices: stick close to me and do as I say, or I cut you open and take it back."

Excuse me?! Are those really my only options?!

mangas.title: Couple Breaker
mangas.description: All's fair in love and war. Two couples will need to battle it out for love and money! But who knew they'd swap partners before doing so? Tae-Rin and Ju-A are both friends and studying fashion at the same university. So why is Ju-A going on a couple's show with Tae-Rin's boyfriend? And why is Tae-Rin going on the same show with Ju-A's boyfriend?!

mangas.title: Peach's Favorite Toy
mangas.synonyms: Peach Under Lace, Peach's Pitch Tail
mangas.description:
Ji-Woon, who decided to date the younger man Joo-Hyung, seemed to be having a smooth love life, but...

"I think your butt tastes just like a peach right now."

Joo-Hyung is obsessed with butts and keeps finding new sex toys from somewhere! But Ji-Woon's heart is also pounding for some reason...

mangas.title: Let Loose
mangas.description:
Jacqueline grew up in a forgotten land at the border of three nations, where survival was never guaranteed. In a world that gave her nothing, her younger sibling was her whole world. But everything changed the day her sibling awakened as a rare "special beastkin." Taken away by the state in the name of protection, they were torn from Jacqueline's side. Left with nothing, Jacqueline was forced to take on one more burden from the very person responsible for separating them—Margo, her sibling's guardian. This time, it was a mysterious young bird beastkin named Demi. Years later, fate brings Jacqueline and Demi together once again... but their reunion may change everything.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: I'm No Heroine!
mangas.synonyms: I Will Politely Decline the Male Lead!
mangas.description:
A girl obsessed with a novel suddenly finds herself transported into the thick of the plot. The problem is, she has taken on the role of the villain in the story. And she knows how this ends…it's off with her head! Maybe she'll just let this play out and wake up back in reality… But after a few too many deaths to no avail, it's finally time to go off-script. She's going to have a little fun with this tale. She's made up her mind…to live!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Aiming for the Alimony
mangas.description: Reincarnated as the heroine of a dark fantasy novel who meets a tragic end, Ibelin is determined to avoid her fate. After being forced into a marriage with the cold and indifferent Dyffrin, she resolves that, no matter what, she would divorce him in two years, taking a hefty alimony with her in the process. However, as she begins to put her plans to take control of her destiny into action, controlling one's feelings proves harder than expected for both Ibelin and Dyffrin as their relationship takes an unexpected turn.

mangas.title: Mythic Item Obtained
mangas.description:
In a world where technology and magic are almost indistinguishable from one another, monsters and creatures of myth and legend reign terror upon mankind. In humanity's darkest moment, individuals with special god-like powers emerge to save the day. They are — the Awakened. Meet Jae-Hyun, a feeble Awakened human Raider, who struggles to make ends meet until one day a series of confounding events allow him to claim a powerful item that will change the course of history forever…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Overprotective Butler
mangas.synonyms: My Butler Is Overprotective of Me!
mangas.description: Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Se-Jin, young heir Lee Han-Eul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface. Why does Se-Jin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Han-Eul's view of the world—and his feelings for his butler.

mangas.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
mangas.description:
Beautiful and intelligent, So-Myeong Gil has tirelessly strived to fulfill her mother's vision of the perfect daughter. However, when her less-than-perfect younger brother is tragically found drowned in a river, doubts plague So-Myeong's heart. She begins to suspect that their mother might be responsible for the unspeakable act. From then on, her paramount goal becomes escaping her mother's grasp, while all her mother wants is for So-Myeong to experience the perfect life she herself was denied. Will So-Myeong ever truly find her freedom?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

mangas.title: Lavender in June
mangas.description: Chic Si-Yeon and bubbly Yu-Ra couldn't be any more different, but after a whiff of lavender scented clothes and an unexpected encounter at Dahan Art Academy, they become inseparable best friends. Now that they're adults stepping into the real world, Si-Yeon and Yu-Ra start exploring exciting new opportunities and pursuing their artistic passions. But when they start catching each other at bad timings and misunderstandings start to accumulate, their friendship is put to the test. Will Si-Yeon and Yu-Ra be able to keep up with their own personal lives and maintain their friendship intact?

mangas.title: Acting Gangster
mangas.description: Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong's life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

mangas.title: Please Pat Her
mangas.synonyms: Stroking the Transfer Student | Please Give the Transferee a Pat
mangas.description:
"Pretty person! I like you!"

A 17-year-old dog-type who moved to Seoul from the countryside to find a new best friend, 'Yuu' meets 'Robin', a cat-type who is beautiful from head to toe, on the first day of school and makes a 100% straightforward confession.

The two part ways without even exchanging names due to the annoying ringing of the bell, knowing Robin's pounding heart. Yuu follows her scent to meet her again and debuts as a student council worker…

The straightforward dog-type Yuu and the proud lover Robin's crazy school life begins now!

mangas.title: Jinjjaro Bakkwojwo
mangas.description:
Due to a misunderstanding caught on camera in a live program, rumors spread about a fight between two of the members of the girl group DOT. To cover up the scandal, the company launches a master plan... Those involved will have to pretend to be in a relationship!



Note: Chapter count includes 2 extra chapters

mangas.title: Your Portrait
mangas.description:
"The girl my girlfriend had a secret crush on came in as my new roommate!”

Due to problems at work, Sehyun and Sunwoo became a long-distance couple. To fill the void left by Sunwoo and ease the financial burden, Sehyun decides to look for a roommate and finds Jina. While Jina was looking around Sehyun's house, she stops in front of a portrait of Sehyun drawn by Sunwoo.

Without thinking, she remembers Sunwoo, a schoolmate who drew her during high school, and Jina shows Sehyun an old portrait of herself. Suddenly, Sehyun remembers Sunwoo when he saw Jina's drawing.

'I only draw for people I like.’

What will be the relationship between Jina and Sunwoo? Will Sunwoo and Sehyun's love survive the wave called Jina?

mangas.title: Lion's Heart!
mangas.description:
"I'll approach you with all my courage!"


A teen romance that celebrates individual tastes, kicking off with a mischievous plot involving Leo, a flirtatious narcissist, and Bunny, a total outsider!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note:
- Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

- Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: How to Avoid a Debut
mangas.description:
"But I don't wanna be an idol!"



Ha-Hyeon is a dancer who's just graduated high school. At the desperate request of his producer uncle, he ends up participating in Survival ID, an idol audition program. The plan was to have him eliminated early on, so how is he making it through every stage?!



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Debut With You
mangas.titleNative: 내 새끼 데뷔시키려다 내가 데뷔하게 생김
mangas.synonyms: I Tried to Debut My Kid, But Ended Up Debuting Myself
mangas.description: With her weird talents and weirder personality, idol trainee Yoon Hyesung can't help but catch everyone's eye, even though that's far from what she wants. She's actually a fangirl from a different future with one goal in mind—help Na Yeonwoo debut as an idol! Now as Yeonwoo's friend, Hyesung is determined to get Yeonwoo the top spot on an idol survival program with the help of an oddly supportive game system. Can Hyesung help Yeonwoo debut, even if it means she will too?

mangas.title: Insaeng 2-hoecha Idol-ui Lucky Plan
mangas.synonyms: The Lucky Plan of An Idol In His Second Life
mangas.description:
Won Yu-Ha, a trainee who was unfairly robbed of the chance to appear on a survival program that was expected to be a huge hit, became a 'loser'. After six years of struggling to lead the members who had no motivation, a series of scandals among the members and a sudden traffic accident resulted in him being declared ineligible for a comeback.

"If I were born again, I would never become an idol."


Just when he was about to give up on life, determined to never dream of such a life again, "Appearing on Design Your Idol. You'll give it to me, right?" He returned to six years ago when he missed the opportunity of a lifetime... ?


『Tutorial: The Crossroads of Life! Spin the Roulette and Decide Your Life!』


And what is this thing that just popped up before his eyes?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

mangas.title: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
mangas.description: Baek Hyeon sacrificed everything to become the best actor in the industry. So when he's about to die in a plane crash, he makes a desperate wish for another chance to live. Hyeon's plea is granted, but who said anything in life was free? Reborn as his younger self, Hyeon must first become a successful K-pop idol if he wants to be an actor again. Can Hyeon make it in the cutthroat world of fierce competition, demanding schedules, and fake smiles? Or will he fail and lose his second shot at fame?

mangas.title: My Comeback as the Youngest Member
mangas.synonyms: I Became the Youngest Top Idol
mangas.description: After being disqualified from the famous boy group survival reality show Stardust Project, Seo-Han finds himself stuck in a mundane life of part-time work, unable to achieve his dreams of debuting. But then, an unexpected twist of fate catapults him eight years back in time, just before the inception of the show. Now equipped with years of experience, Seo-Han is determined to rewrite his story and fulfill his dreams with this second chance. With the many challenges and dark sides of the music industry, will he finally succeed in debuting as a member of a boy band this time?

mangas.title: Assistant Manager Kim Hates K-Pop Idols
mangas.description: Assistant Manager Yi-Wol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing "stand-in stanning" for his boss's daughter's favorite idol group, Spark. During yet another Spark-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister's death, Yi-Wol must debut as a member of Spark himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he'll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

mangas.title: Fancy Mate
mangas.description:
The pure fool + pervert Lim Tae-O dreams of a loving relationship. Because he's gay, he is estranged from his parents and at odds with his friends. Even the men he's dated can't overcome Tae-O's obsession, so he's been dumped many times. Thinking it's his last chance, he wants to finds a roommate to be his FWB... But then he meets Choi Hyeon, a roommate who suits Tae-O's taste more than he could have imagined! Like fate, he falls in love at first sight.

The strange co-habitation of Tae-O, who needs love, and Choi Hyeon, who needs attention. ♥

Can this love be successful?

mangas.title: Privacy Check
mangas.description:
Society is corrupt, but no society is as corrupt as Hanbit High School. Cha-Seong, a student at the bottom of the school's social hierarchy, struggles to survive… until he unexpectedly gains a mysterious ally who claims that together, they can uproot it all. But how? No one knows, but one thing is certain, Cha-Seong's secret WeTube channel is about to go viral.



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: I'm a Level D Student
mangas.description:
In a world where powerful beings are ranked by abilities, Key Academy is a battleground for the elite. Jelack, a mysterious new student, comes in as a bottom-tier Level D student. As students regularly spar to flaunt their powers, keeping her low rank a secret becomes increasingly difficult. Jelack trains in the shadows, aiming to rise above her D status. With unknown reasons for her transfer and her past shrouded in secrecy, she must uncover her true potential to survive the fierce hierarchy of the academy. Every day is a fight for recognition and respect, and Jelack is determined to prove her worth.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: They Say There's a Ghost in the Club Room
mangas.description:
I met a friend who disappeared a few years ago, and it turns out he's now an exorcist?!

Jisang often speaks nonsense or acts dangerously out of nowhere, and sometimes experiences memory lapses. His friend and underclassman, Taeju, shares a concern that he has: When the club members enter the club room, they fall victim to strange phenomena.

Believing it to be the work of a ghost, Taeju calls an occult specialist to resolve the situation. Unexpectedly, the specialist turns out to be Jisang's childhood friend, Ham Leerae.

Jisang then learns that his symptoms weren't due to an illness, but were caused by spiritual possession. Determined to keep Leerae around, Jisang offers his body to assist with exorcism requests.

"That's how I can make you stay. So you can't escape now."

And the solution to free him from possession is...kissing?!

mangas.title: Guiding the Lead Out of His Trauma
mangas.synonyms: I Healed the Male Lead's Trauma
mangas.description: When the reader wakes up in a novel as Liliope, a guide who tragically dies because of the unstable male lead, Octaeon, she has her work cut out for her. Liliope's death traumatizes Octaeon in the original novel, but the female lead helps him recover, and the two fall in love. However, Liliope's brother, Hyacin, despises Octaeon for killing her and morphs into the novel's villain. Refusing to let her death drag him into darkness and despair, Liliope decides to rewrite her ending. However, as she weaves her new fate, she realizes her ending isn't the only thing that's changing.

mangas.title: Genius Archer's Livestreaming
mangas.description: Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life?

mangas.title: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
mangas.titleNative: アカデミーの剣術指南になった
mangas.synonyms: The Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
mangas.description:
When a failing web novelist drops dead at his desk, he's granted a wish in the underworld... and uses it to enter a novel. But instead of becoming the main character, he possesses Kang Shin-Hyuk, a total extra! Now set to be the protagonist's future teacher, Shin-Hyuk's out to use what he knows of the original plot to borrow the hero's power-ups for an easy, carefree life. But in a world of monsters and danger, can Shin-Hyuk really rest easy? Or will he be made to buckle down and hustle once more?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Night Shift in Another World
mangas.description:
Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: My Brother and His Gift
mangas.description:
After losing his parents in a tragic car crash, college student Lee Si-Hyuk is left alone to raise his baby brother, Si-Ha. In order to do so, Si-Hyuk decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a translator. While working to apply for the job, he suddenly finds himself knowledgeable about things he's never learned and starts to gain recognition as a translation prodigy! But even with his mysterious new ability, can Si-Hyuk really balance work and school, all while raising a 3-year-old?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I Killed the Main Player
mangas.description:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he's just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu's abilities, everything's going smoothly - until Corin discovers Sihu's been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game - only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he's determined to kill Sihu and take on his role - defeat the final boss and save the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Proof of Dignity
mangas.description:
Geon-Yeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geon-Yeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Big Slick
mangas.description: After his parents passed away in an accident during his school days, Yoon Seo-Ho borrowed money from a loan shark and got into a big debt. He is currently paying off his debt by helping with fraudulent gambling at an illegal casino run by the loan shark Jang Sa-Jang. A high school classmate who happened to see Seo-Ho like that proposes a plan to free Seo-Ho by beating Jang Sa-Jang at gambling...

mangas.title: Pick Me Up
mangas.description:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
mangas.description:
Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-In isn't just another fan—she's the voice behind the band, a secret she can't afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Oh! Dangun
mangas.description:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.



'Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Do You Want Me to Lend You a Lighter?
mangas.synonyms: Can I Borrow the Lighter? | Would You Like Me to Lend You a Fire?
mangas.description: Actually, I didn't want to be a teacher. I gave up my dream and was about to take responsibility for the path I chose, when a cocky boy said, "Would you like to lend me a light?". My life as a teacher seems to be going awry as I get entangled with this cocky kid who has genius talent, overflowing wealth, and fame. A story about school life intertwined with dreams, talent, and love.

mangas.title: Regas
mangas.synonyms: レガス ～僕と呪われた王子～
mangas.description:
Blessed with dragon's blood, a royal is born every generation with the creature's legendary might. But with that might comes a dragon's cruelty. Thus, each royal is assigned a Regas, a dragon tamer capable of quelling the raging hearts of those with the dragon's blessing. Abel has been trained in the ways of a Regas, but can he withstand the lunacy of the latest blessed prince?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Ctrl+Alt+Resign
mangas.description: Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

mangas.title: Nebula's Civilization
mangas.description:
Seong-Un Choi is the top-ranked player in the game "Lost World," being the only player to have completed all its achievements. However, his triumph is short-lived as a mysterious message transports him to the real "Lost World," transforming him from a mere gamer to a contender for godhood. Amidst others vying for divinity, will Seong-Un be able to achieve true godhood and reign supreme in this new realm?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: One-way Crush
mangas.description:
"Please let me off, CEO!" The seductive bar singer in his embrace, is the bespectacled boy who had a one-sided love with him for years. He wouldn't want to meet this boy again, but this boy became his assistant on the second day?! He felt ridiculed... This boy in disguise, is it to avoid an old flame, or some other reason?



(Source: WebComics)



Note: Includes 7 extras.

mangas.title: Don't Touch My Tail
mangas.synonyms: Just Not the Tail! | Zhiyou Weiba Bu Keyi!
mangas.description: Ruo Li receives a mysterious gift from his brother, Rou Ji: a severely injured red fox. He tenderly cares for it, which surprisingly transforms into a human once healed. This human, named "Bai Ye" reveals he is a fox spirit training for ascension but was subjected by his master to three earthly trials— resentment, separation, and unfulfilled desires-to achieve celestial transcendence. What Ruo Li doesn't realize is that he is not just Bai Ye's caretaker, but also his destined trial.

mangas.title: Shenqiu Ru Dong: Bomu Pian
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapters.

mangas.title: Bait
mangas.description: Prosecutor Hyeon Taesik is assigned to the infamous "Haemu Serial Murder Case," the same case in which his twin brother, Hyeon Minsik, was brutally killed. During the investigation, Taesik encounters Mu Inhui, a priest and the prime suspect. Despite his growing suspicions, Taesik finds himself inexplicably drawn to Inhui. Unbeknownst to him, everything has been orchestrated by Inhui—and Taesik is walking right into his trap...

mangas.title: Lilith
mangas.description:
As far as anyone can tell, Jae-Hee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jae-Hee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Hui-Lin. But when Sul-Hwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jae-Hee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: 666DOPES
mangas.synonyms:
Love me, scars and all.

It hit him like a freight train — the most intense case of love at first sight imaginable.

A ring, a choker, black nails, ears full of piercings — Akane is the wild, untamed bassist of obscure band 666DOPES. Hiruki is the guitarist and vocalist who fell hard for him and never looked back.

Akane keeps hurting himself and seeks out sex that leaves bruises, and though Hiruki is shaken, he can't stop looking after him — desperate to understand what's really going on inside Akane's heart. But every time he gets close, Akane slips away, and one day Hiruki lets something slip: "If you just want someone to worry about you, then stop."

Akane smiles — a lonely smile. "So that's how I look to you."

The more they love each other, the more they wound each other.

Between Thanatos and Eros, two souls alone together play their love like a chord — Sex, love & rock 'n' roll!
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Pure Intentions
mangas.description:
For seven years, Seo Hyeon-Jin, a Korean literature major, has nursed a secret crush on his upperclassman Soon Jeong-Wook. Unfortunately, Jeong-Wook only sees him as a cherished junior, leaving Hyeon-Jin's love life at a standstill. Everything changes when Heo Chan-Yeong, who perfectly matches Jeong-Wook's type, transfers in. To make matters worse, Chan-Yeong boldly confesses his feelings for Jeong-Wook to Hyeon-Jin, explaining that he wants to sleep with him. As if that weren't enough, Chan-Yeong even asks Hyeon-Jin to help him win Jeong-Wook's heart. Determined to protect the man he loves, Hyeon-Jin finds himself caught in a battle of wits against Chan-Yeong, who only wants Jeong-Wook out of curiosity.

But when Hyeon-Jin realizes Chan-Yeong's "interest" might not be so fixed after all, he starts to wonder…could the rival he's trying to fend off become something else entirely?

mangas.title: Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji: Lanxi Zhen
mangas.synonyms: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei: Lanxi Town
mangas.description:
Lanxi Town tells the story of Laojun, Xuanli, and Qingning during the war. It shows a different world of demons and gods.



(Source: Beijing United Publishing, translated)

mangas.title: When I Close My Eyes, My Heart Beats
mangas.description: Seong-Won, a new employee and a gold digger, falls in love with team leader Yang Haru as soon as he joins the company. Seong-Won, who wants to hear the team leader's voice even if it's just an auditory hallucination because he's in love with her, ends up hearing the team leader's voice as an auditory hallucination! But is it really just an auditory hallucination? Or??

mangas.title: Entangled!
mangas.synonyms: I Got Caught Up in a Magical Youth | I'm Wrapped Up in a Magical Young Man
mangas.description: Magical Boy Maple has one goal and one goal only: to protect the land from the evil hordes that seek to conquer and destroy it. Any lewd thoughts are just…a byproduct! He's dedicated to his cause, that's for sure, but his powers have yet to fully develop. That is, until the dark leader Daisy comes into his life. One look at those thick thighs and bulging pecs and - poof! - Maples magic comes in. And when the magical gods gift you tentacles, what else are you supposed to do if not use them…?!

mangas.title: Zhi Zhuizhu Mengxiang de Ni
mangas.synonyms: To You Who Chased Your Dreams
mangas.description:
'The Other Family's Kid' and dreams buried deep in my heart.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Shao
mangas.description:
Xiao Zhou, a fledgling photographer's assistant, felt captivated when she saw the model Lan Shan at a bar. Lan Shan doesn't get angry when she notices Xiao Zhou taking pictures of her surreptitiously, but instead, she is struck by the aura that comes out in the photos. They fall deeply in love at first sight, as their destinies become intertwined.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Shangsi Ta Dui Wo Tu Mou Bu Gui
mangas.synonyms: My Boss, She Plotted Against Me
mangas.description:
On the first day of her internship, Xu Nian has already annoyed her boss Jiang Zhi — what terrible luck! Fortunately, Xu Nian has a cute, gentle, and considerate online girlfriend who is helping her with advice on how to deal with her devilish boss. But… why?! How did her online girlfriend and her devilish boss turn out to be the same person?! So Jiang Zhi scolds her waifu to tears during the day, then turns around to comfort her at night, and she even has to pretend to get mad at herself! When she discovered the truth, Jiang Zhi couldn't help but facepalm and let out a long sigh.



(Souce: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Zhizhusi
mangas.description:
A mysterious serial killer could be hiding in the darkness, silently observing their prey! Or, they could be completely indifferent, passing by innocent civilians... They might greet you with a friendly smile, but then suddenly swing a knife! Or another possibility is... that you are the one who's the killer...


(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Xin Yi Shou Zhang
mangas.description:
Zhan Chuyi, who has been spoiled by her wealthy family for two decades, finally decides to work seriously to build a career, in preparation for taking over the family business. She sets her sights on a nearly bankrupt entertainment company as her training ground. It just so happens that her new neighbor is the top actress of this company, so naturally, she tries to help her out as much as possible.



Need a dress? Wear mine.

Need an investor? Take my money.

Need a famous guest? Sure, I'll go!

Need someone to… take the cat to the vet? Well, I guess I could do that, too.



The acquisitions turned out great… so successful that she even acquired a girlfriend in the process.



(source: Billibilli, translated)

mangas.title: G.G.
mangas.description: This is a story about a girl who likes another girl and tries her best to pursue her!

mangas.title: Idol Manager In Another World
mangas.description:
Top-tier idol manager Le Qiu accidentally traveled to another world. To return to her reality as soon as possible and help the farm girl, Ella, save her village, fate led Le Qiu to bring six beautiful girls of different races and personalities together into a girl group. While she spreads the idol culture, she is also… saving the world.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Youdao Gonglüe
mangas.description:
As a behavior coach, Cheng Ran is good at finding human weaknesses to guide other people's behavior. He thinks he knows people's hearts very well: "The reward I want is... to kill you." Cheng Ran knelt on the ground, his hands and chin resting on Han Qi's knees, looking up at Han Qi's eyes like a puppy. "Start a fire, I will hold your body and burn it to ashes along with this house. Our ashes and the ashes of this world will be mixed together and can no longer be distinguished." Cheng Ran was confident that what he said at this moment was the love words that Han Qi wanted to hear the most. Han Qi was really stunned. "You can't burn a person to ashes by burning a house."



Han Qi stroked Cheng Ran's head with his hand, like comforting a puppy. After thinking for a while, he slowly said: "Put the body in the incinerator and burn it at a high temperature of 1000° for one hour, then use a hammer to break the calcified bones, and finally grind it finely to become ashes." Cheng Ran was surprised at Han Qi's understanding of the incineration process, and even more surprised that his thinking direction seemed to deviate from expectations. "Okay."



Han Qi looked into Cheng Ran's eyes seriously. Okay? ! Cheng Ran was shocked. What's good? I was just talking nonsense! I didn't really ask you to do it! Cheng Ran thought he was using the physical game to open the other person's heart, but he didn't expect that the other person was willing to accompany him into this taboo game.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Crossover Actor
mangas.description: Lu Wen, an eighteenth-tier actor, is handsome, hot, and has a natural flair for acting. However, he has low EQ and lacks the ability to make discerning judgments. On his first day of joining the production crew, he accidentally offends Qu Yanting, the most famous screenwriter in the industry. Later on, he thinks the latter is exacting revenge on him through his position, sponsoring a young male actor, and working on a silly web drama for the sake of money. Watch him slowly change his tune about Qu Yanting over time!

mangas.title: Shuang Sha
mangas.description:
Cheng Sunian is the captain of the SP club. One day, a superstar player unexpectedly transferrs to the club, shocking half of the e-sports community. Feng Can has a bad reputation, because although talented, he is not a team player and fights alone.

Let's look at the two-man team of a ruthless master player and a novice wolf cub.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Don't Let Your Heart Beat Challenge
mangas.synonyms: Bu Xindong Tiaozhan | Try Not To Flinch Challenge | No Heartbeat Challenge | Don't Challenge the Heartbeat
mangas.description: How do you get over a rejection? Let the 90-day Don't Let Your Heart Beat Challenge begin! Can you really suppress the beating of your heart? There's no way! The only way you can break the barrier of a two-way crush is through my Love Lab app!

mangas.title: I'm Not a Drag Queen!
mangas.description:
What happens if a modern, straight guy time travels to an ancient world where women are superior to men? His new, powerful mother had been expecting a daughter but ended up giving birth to him. So, guess what? He's been forced to be a drag queen ever since!



(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: Rebirth Two Lives - I Still Love You
mangas.synonyms: Jiangjun Zong Ba Ziji Dang Tishen
mangas.description:
Mu Zhiming fell in love with a scumbag in a previous life, and was tortured to death on the road to exile. After being reborn, he swore to never let history repeat itself. But as he was devising plans, he discovered that the cold general Gu Heyan was actually warm-hearted and sincere. Mu Zhiming fell into a once-in-a-lifetime love.

But on the wedding night, Gu Heyan said to him: I know that I'm just a substitute. Mu Zhi Ming pushed him onto the bed without a word.

Gu Heyan: What are you doing?

Mu Zhiming: We're! Sleeping! Together!

mangas.title: His Wolf
mangas.synonyms: Diao Zhi Shaoye Hui Jia | Kidnapping a Wolf Home | Hook a Young Master Home
mangas.description: The young master Tan Shao has never been in love in his twenty years, until he fell in love at first sight. To pursue to his love interest, Tan Shao tried to get to know the cold Pei Anwu, not realizing that Pei is the "girl" that he fell in love with. As they spend more time together, their relationship began to change…

mangas.title: Don't Pick up Boyfriends From the Trash
mangas.titleNative: 不要在垃圾桶里捡男朋友
mangas.synonyms: Buyao Zai Lese Tong Li Jian Nan Pengyou
mangas.description:
Chi Xiao Chi, born into a fourth-rate background, became a three-time award-winning film emperor with a second-rate personality and first-class looks. He started overcoming the hardest obstacles and paved his way to becoming the winner of life. Then, he was struck into a coma by a falling chandelier.

061: "Hello, here's a brief overview of the scumbag recycling system. This system will measure the remorse statistics of a scumbag. For every 100 remorse points collected, you will be able to immediately enter the present world..."

mangas.title: Prejudice
mangas.description: He's a boy band idol who appeared to be a cold beauty, struggling to restrain himself to stay in character. He seems like a young and innocent pretty boy on the outside, was actually completely different from that… Despite looking down on each other, and arguing in every possible situation, they were compelled to pair up in order to achieve the popularity that they needed?!

mangas.title: Pavlov's Dog
mangas.description:
I come as soon as I hear you ring the bell, because I'm your most loyal dog...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

mangas.title: Supporting Actor's Survival Game
mangas.description:
Experienced an unexpected death, Qi Yan was forced to bind a fast time travel system which enables him to time travel across various different worlds to win the targets' hearts. For Qi Yan, this is just a task that has to be accomplished. It is just a game that does not involve emotion and feelings. He is confident that he can withdraw unscathed and unemotional. But the experience in every task is so real, even if he tells himself over and over that it's all illusions, he still can't completely isolate himself from those feelings...



(Source: WebComics)

mangas.title: Unseen Immortal for 300 Years
mangas.synonyms: Haven't Seen You For Years | Bujian Shang Xian Sanbai Nian
mangas.description: There are thousands upon thousands of demons in the world, and half of them reside in Zhaoye City. As for the other half, they all died in northern realm of Canlangli, under the control of the Celestial Immortal Xiao Fuxuan. Only one demon remained alive there, imprisoned for the last twenty-five years. He is Zhaoye City's former lord mayor, Wu Xingxue.

mangas.title: Double-faced Anchor
mangas.description: The excellent game player is a part-time model in real life?! The senior he respects most is his hard-core fan?! His double identity is going to be exposed... What should he do? Admit it or guard the secret with his life?

mangas.title: Pixiu's Eatery, No Way Out
mangas.description:
When the old demon Pixiu went out to take out the trash, he ended up with a male ghost falling into his lap. This male ghost had flawless features and had an incredibly low body temperature, which made him the perfect bolster for Pixiu who struggled with a natural curse of an unbearably hot body. Pixiu swore to the heavens that he would only use this ghost as a bolster, nothing more! Yet nobody believed him. He would go on to declare, "Even though the strings of fate have been tied on me, I will remain single." Pixiu often said that as long as he sorted his trash well, a good wife shouldn't be far as well. This comic is also named: I went dumpster diving for a wife (not).



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: How to Train Your Demon King
mangas.description:
While exploring the wilderness, Yan Wenan discovered a mysterious village being attacked by hundreds of demons. He accidentally got caught in a magical formation that was meant to kill the Demon King, Zhuo Yu, and somehow obtained a portion of the Demon King's soul. Since then, the Demon King has been forced to live a modern life with Yan Wenan and blend into human society.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Zhongqing
mangas.description:
The low-level guide Qin Yun was forcibly marked by the god-level sentinel tyrant Mosheli. The hot-tempered girl-hearted top x the serious and honest bottom started a shameless life as a couple, and conquered the entire universe while they're at it.

(Source: Manga Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: I Want to Hear You Say That You Like Me
mangas.synonyms: Xiang Ting Ni Shuo Xihuan Wo
mangas.description: Xu Yuan unwittingly discovers that his best friend has fallen in love with him and is now running away from that realization...

mangas.title: The Cultivator and His Contract Demon
mangas.description:
In the world of the Cloud Pact Sanctuary, magic cultivators and contract demons coexist in harmony. After being recruited by the sanctuary's founder, the young cultivating prodigy, Xie Tong, begins his journey as a superstar among his peers. But things take an unpredictable turn! Xie's stoic facade crumbles when he meets a weak fox demon named Zhiyi who will do anything to please him... anything but cultivate magic. Can this couple overcome their power differences to form a contract—and more importantly, a deeper bond?



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Liming You Xingchen
mangas.description: A funny but dramatic story about the growing romantic relationship between Li Ziming and Xin Cheng.

mangas.title: Pheromone Impossible
mangas.description:
Peach-pheromone Luo Zhiyu and tangerine-pheromone Xiao Yan have had an ongoing feud since they were 3 years old. The both of them have a 0% pheromone match, yet they're always together. When they graduated, they finally realized that they were blinded by their scientism…



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 5 extras.

mangas.title: Dragon Boys' Love Affairs
mangas.description: What? Need to have dragon babies with each other so that we can go back to heaven? But we're all male!!!

mangas.title: Antidote
mangas.description: Cheng Ke quit his job, moved away from his rich family in pursuit of arts. He is a sand painter who creates stunning pieces of art using sand. He becomes Jiang Yu Duo's tenant who's a gang leader and takes care of his sister's apartments. Their worlds collide as they move from mutual rejection to mutual understanding. Through hard work and struggles, they each achieve success and move towards a better future.

mangas.title: Han Yuan
mangas.description:
This is a story of Little Princess Luo trying to make a friend. Luo Linyuan is born with a silver spoon in his mouth and a pretty face. Yu Han is "straight", and he sleeps only three hours a day. Yu Han doesn't want Luo Linyuan to get close to him, but Luo Linyuan wants otherwise.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)


Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

mangas.title: It's Not As If I Wanted to Dress Like a Woman
mangas.synonyms: It's Not That I Want to Wear Women's Clothing
mangas.description:
For a tripled salary, Lin Zicheng, a straight man put on a woman's dress to go to work. He just did not expect Gu Fang, a CEO who never liked women would fall in love at first sight with his cross-dressed self!



Wasn't it rumored that the chief's orientation is questionable, since he never approached women?



"Where's your modesty, chief?!"



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Notes:

- Chapter count includes 7 extras

- Originally published under the title Bing Bushi Wo Xiang Chuan Nü Zhuang (并不是我想穿女装, It's Not Like I Want to Dress Like a Woman), which was later changed to Bing Bushi Wo Xiang Dang Mishu (并不是我想当秘书, It's Not Like I Want to be a Secretary)

mangas.title: The Story About You x Me
mangas.description: The school's famous troublemaker—— Gu Ze! Originally only on 30-day class duty, student union vice president Ye Ruchuan 'changed it a little', making it 300 days... Two people fighting a battle of wits for whether to be on class duty or not! As the shocked bad guys go their separate ways, Gu Ze and Ye Ruchuan gradually start to get to know each other in the middle of a hateful godlike manipulation, and slowly cultivate an understanding of each other..... delinquent vs. vice president! The daily life of a 17-year-old trying his best to skip class duty!

mangas.title: I Married My Father-in-law
mangas.description:
"Why? Obviously, I married a lovely girl, but I have to share my bed with my cold father-in-law?!"

A story of a straight idiot dentist and his arrogant president father-in-law! The life of them is full of accidents. And it seems not to be just a supernatural transformation. There are even more unknown secrets of the past...

"Perhaps our story had begun earlier than we thought."

mangas.title: Meet Me After School
mangas.description:
Yu Le took the blame for someone else's mistakes due to a favor that he had to repay, deeply offending the most handsome guy in school, Gu Yan. He's been on Gu Yan's radar ever since he started school. Gu Yan stops Yu Le after school and bothers him every day in order to take "revenge" on him. He originally wanted to teach Yu Le a lesson, but as time passes, "revenge" turns into something else. Gu Yan begins to take a liking to Yu Le and finds it harder and harder to hurt him...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Fell in Love with Girlfriend's Brother
mangas.synonyms: I Fell In Love With My Girlfriend's Brother | Wo Ai Shang Le Nu You De Di Di
mangas.description: To prove whether he was a homosexual, Qiu Zinan decided to dress like a woman and go to a bar. There he "was seduced to the bedroom" by a handsome stranger. Feeling reluctant on the bed, Zinan revealed his true identity, but all they could hear later were the hard breath of one another, and that was how the game began!!

mangas.title: I'll Wait for You in 1999
mangas.synonyms: I will be waiting for you in 1999
mangas.description:
I want to protect you forever... Because you and I have no other loved ones in this world.


The coming-of-age story of two orphans who become best friends.

mangas.title: Pieta to Transi
mangas.description:
Transi is a smart girl who transfers to Pieta's class, a high school girl living an ordinary life. Transi has a constitution that triggers murders around her, and she is also a detective who solves the cases. Pieta falls in love with her and offers to be her assistant. As people around her die one by one, Pieta, the person closest to Transi, somehow stays alive.



This is a story of two girls who celebrate their own lives even if the world is dying.

mangas.title: Second Try Idol
mangas.description:
Seo Hyeon-U is a member of an idol group that's about to debut. On the day of their profile photoshoot, an accident left a hideous scar on one side of his face, causing his dream of debuting to collapse. Fortunately, he became an idol trainer with the recommendation of his manager, but he still spent his shabby days in sorrow. One day, he got on a plane with the idol group in charge of going abroad, but an unexpected incident caused his plane to crash!!


When he woke up, realized that he has been transported to back when he was 19 years old; when he was preparing to join the debut team.



Seo Hyeon-U, an idol in the body of a 19-year old boy but who has been strengthened by his experience as a trainer. This is the story of his growth to become an idol once again!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ga Inakunatta Fuyu no Umi
mangas.titleNative: キミがいなくなった冬の海
mangas.synonyms: The Winter Sea Where You Are Gone
mangas.description:
Shuu and Sena have feelings for each other, but they are afraid to express them.
While their relationship is in such a fragile state, a car accident occurs at the beach.
Shuu wakes up in the hospital when he heard the sirens of an ambulance in the distance. Ignoring his aching body, he rushes to Sena's hospital room,
There he found Sena, who starts calling Hiiragi by his surname, "Kutsuna"?

"I just want to see 'you' once again, by that dazzling sea."

mangas.title: Creatures in the Mist
mangas.description: A thick layer of mist shrouds the world and turns people into zombie-like monsters. Without knowing its cause or the solution, the only way out is to sneak into the capital city built for the privileged. While struggling for survival, Hayeon, a talented biologist, finds out that his crush Myung Woon has something to do with the virus...

mangas.title: Himeno-kun wa Hime ni Naritakunai
mangas.titleNative: 姫野くんは姫になりたくない
mangas.description:
Himeno just wants to be one of the guys at his all-boys school, but with a name like "Himeno" and his feminine features, everyone treats him like a precious princess! When Yurine Himekawa transferred in, Himeno thought the new "hime" boy with the delicate face and elegant stance will take over his role as the princess of the school. But who'll really be the prince and who will be the princess…?



More than just friends, but not quite BL!? It's a new kind of daily-life comedy about two boys with princess features!



(Source: Gangan Online, translated)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Shape of Your Love (Side Story)
mangas.description: Side story of 'The Shape of Your Love'. Set after 'The Shape of Your Love' and 'The Shape of Sympathy', this story follows a brief moment in Yohan and Mukyung's university life.

mangas.title: Blood Time
mangas.description: Yeon-woo can't help stumbling into pervy situations. What a creep would call a blessing is her curse. Case in point: going through an alley one night, she walks in on a couple making out. Except this time it's worse—the couple is actually a vampire and her victim! The vampire, Hayang, is willing to let it slide… for some of Yeon-Woo's blood! Could this be the start of a bloody good time?

mangas.title: Happy Birthday
mangas.description:
Going on with our lives after having lost someone is always painful. What does it mean to move on without forgetting them? This is a story about survivors struggling to find happiness within their guilt and grief.



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Our First Day
mangas.description:
"It'll be great if hyung can see me as an adult", worried Se-Hyun. There was no progress in the relationship with his seven-years-older lover, 'Gyeong-U'.

Following his sister's advice, though, he made a plan to appeal maturely to Gyeong-U, it had not worked out well… At last, can they spend a lovely first day together?

mangas.title: Magical ☆ Useless Gift
mangas.description:
One day, as they were celebrating each other's birthdays and exchanging useless gifts like an annual event, Cheong-Hee discovered that the strangely shaped toy he had given as a gift smelled like Ha-Hyun.

"...Show me how to use my gift."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: Pomegranate: Seongnyu
mangas.description:
Je-Young is dissatisfied with the existence of Jay, who was suddenly brought in by his adoptive father who remarried his mother when he was young. Despite this, Je-young acts as a good older brother for the sake of a happy family relationship, but he feels deep love and hatred for Jay, who only does bad things, such as stealing his girlfriend. Then one day, Jay suddenly confesses his love to Je-young...?

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)
