mangas.title: Friends With Benefits
mangas.description: Se-Han wasn't expecting to be turned on...but after catching a glimpse of Chan-Hyeong in bed with another man, he can't shake the curiosity. As Se-Han begins to grow closer to Chan-Hyeong, Jin-Wu, who's always had feelings for Se-Han, starts to suspect something. Fueled by jealousy and a few too many drinks, Jin-Wu confronts Se-Han one night. Se-Han's response? He makes an unexpected proposition…one that blurs every line between friendship and desire.

mangas.title: Angelic Partners
mangas.description:
Hyeon-Jin is a devil—literally. But not a very well-fed one. Without a proper source of spiritual energy, he's constantly starving. At a broadcast station party, his luck finally seems to turn when two smoking-hot celebrities—top actor Seon-Wu and elite model Ha-Jun—start flirting with him. Jackpot, right? Desperate, Hyeon-Jin gives in, hoping to drain a little energy and dash. Except…

"You're a demon, aren't you?"

Uh-oh. Turns out Seon-Wu and Ha-Jun are actually angels. Sexy, powerful, and way too smug about it. Instead of smiting him, they offer Hyeon-Jin a deal he can't refuse—one that involves lots of close contact, a suspicious amount of cuddling, and... were those feathers?? Now stuck between two heavenly bodies with very unholy intentions, Hyeon-Jin wonders: Since when were angels this into corrupting demons?!

mangas.title: Yesterday's Crown Prince, Today's Male Bride
mangas.description:
The deposed Crown Prince Leopold, who fell victim to his half-brother's schemes in the succession struggle. He is subjected to the humiliation of being developed into a "male bride" and sold at auction in a lewd state... Paris, the Western Merchant Guild Leader, Dmitri, the Eastern Mage Tower Lord, and Ian, the Northern Grand Duke...

Amidst these three men approaching Leopold with differing intentions, who will ultimately become the master of the "male bride"?

mangas.title: Mine
mangas.description:
Choi Sung-Hyun looks like the perfect catch, handsome, brilliant, and effortlessly privileged. In truth, he's barely getting by, clinging to a carefully crafted illusion funded by the wealthy men he dates. That fragile life begins to unravel when Kang Joon reenters the picture. Unable to accept being forgotten, Joon's fixation turns dark. His presence closes in, his control deepens, and before long, Sung-Hyun finds himself trapped in an obsession he can't escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: An Exorcism With My Childhood Friend
mangas.description: Before heading off to college, best friends Do-hui and Hui-Yeong visit an abandoned mall rumored to grant wishes. The place feels like a dud until Do-Hui returns home and begins experiencing terrifying nightly visitations. What starts as ghostly touches soon escalates into overwhelming, carnal sensations he can't ignore. Driven to his breaking point, Do-Hui begs his "reliable" friend for help. He thinks he's found a safe harbor, but he's actually walked right into a trap. In this game of shadows, the ghost isn't the one Do-Hui should be afraid of, it's the friend who's been waiting years to finally make his move.me!

mangas.title: Melting Lover
mangas.description:
A collection of short stories that explore the shadowy territories of love.



A bond of love is a beautiful thing, but what happens when outside pressures force it into forms both strange and strained.



1. Torokeru Koibito (とろける恋人, Melting Lover)

A lovesick youth encounters a mysterious shapeshifter with the ability to take on the appearance of his beloved.



2. Tengoku no Soko (天国の底, Bottom of Heaven)

A hitman forswears pleasure, but cannot shake the fun-loving angel determined to follow him on his assignments.



3-4. Circus mo Yahan-sugi ni wa (サーカスも夜半過ぎには, The Circus After Midnight)

Two circus performers keep explosive secrets from one another while sharing the trapeze.



5. noisy jungle

An android finds himself malfunctioning under the gaze of his pet human.



(Source: KUMA, edited)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ten years later, I married my Nemesis
mangas.titleNative: 十年后，和死对头结婚了
mangas.synonyms: Ten Years Later, I Married My Nemesis
mangas.description:
After 18 years together, freshman Han Shen and childhood friend Su Qian have been admitted to the same university. After Han Shen got struck by lightning, he became confused. He claimed to be from ten years in the future, and that he and Su Qian were married! For the boy who claims to be a husband and the girl who isn't sure about her feelings, they find their relationship can't help but change…



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: Destined to Meet on the Trends
mangas.description: Top Actor Lu who was knee-deep in bad press was suddenly revealed to be seeing an unknown minor star. This sent shockwaves throughout the entertainment world and thus begin an annual retainer to stay on the hot search charts... As the manager said, "This is an agreement for 3 years! You're not allowed to fall for each other for real!" Three years later, the top actor announces, "Thanks everybody, we're celebrating our third anniversary."

mangas.title: Rise To Stardom
mangas.description:
I didn't mean to exploit your popularity and fleece you! An unpopular celebrity, Ran Lin, is barely surviving in the entertainment industry. However, after a huge misunderstanding, he is thrust into the spotlight because of Lu Yiyao, one of the hottest celebrities. For the first time in his life, Ran Lin's name has appeared in the top searches. On the other hand, Lu Yiyao deeply regrets his hug at the airport. One knows that he's in the wrong, while the other is utterly disgusted. Never in their wildest dreams would they expect their fates to be irreversibly intertwined after that variety show...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Lala
mangas.description:
Xia Yuxun's presence at school never fails to draw attention. She has a mature beauty about her, always poised, and exuding confidence in class. Being admired so much by her classmates, one would think she's a well-respected senior but in truth, it might be because she's a repeat student. Xia Yuxun has more to her elegant facade.



(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Once More
mangas.description:
Back in high school, Xun An and Yang Muli's relationship fizzled out before it even had a chance to begin. After graduating college, they reunite back at their old high school, but this time as teachers. As they rekindle their long-lost affection for one another, secrets from their days as high schoolers also begin to emerge... A love story between a gifted, but devious math teacher and a passionate, but hot-headed P.E. teacher.



(Source: Comikey)



Note: Chapter count includes 22 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Debussy Lover
mangas.description: You Lu, who was about to start a new job at an animation studio, tore off the skirt of a man disguised as a woman at the comic con. When she showed up at the studio the next day, she found out that the cross-dresser she exposed was her new boss!

mangas.title: My Charm, Your Karma
mangas.description:
Michelle, the real daughter, reunited with her birth parents, but they only favored the fake daughter. She pleased her family, hoping to be loved, but all she got was neglect and ridicule. Eventually, she died of a terminal illness. Upon rebirth, she obtains the "Luck" system and decides to stay away from them and her fiancé to complete the system's tasks and live! But her first task is to approach the bad-tempered heir of the Fu family and become his friend?!



(Source: WebComics)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love Like Cherry Blossoms
mangas.description:
He knows her secret. She knows his secret too. He is the coolest guy in school. She is the curve wrecker of class. They make a deal in exchange to keep each other's secret. They should be strangers after that promise. But he offers to help her confess to her crush at the same time. Is that true? Is he just teasing her? Or...?



(Source: WebComics)

mangas.title: Ta De Pingguo
mangas.description:
That ordinary high school girl is actually the daughter of the red-haired witch — her life should be like easy like a max-level adventurer! Instead, she was hounded by a handsome but flirtatious bully of a prince from another world in pursuit of her mother's debts. In the name of repayment, he'll tease her and make her heart pound, as the countdown begins...



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: Closer Heartbeat
mangas.synonyms: Asymptotic Heartbeat | Gradually Close to the Heart | Jian Jin de Xintiao
mangas.description: Su Ye never thought of her perfect childhood friend Zheng Shu in a romantic way until recently. Normally standoffish and introverted, she isn't sure what to do with these unfamiliar feelings. Even when they hang out like they always do, it doesn't feel the same anymore... For now, all Su Ye can do is try to become better at communicating with people!

mangas.title: My Wife Is from a thousand Years ago
mangas.titleNative: 我家老婆来自一千年前
mangas.description:
Jiang He, a girl from the Tang Dynasty, jumped a thousand years into the future and appeared in front of Xu Qing. The love that spanned a thousand years brought them together as if by fate. Everything she knew had become ancient history. Relatives, friends, and enemies have all been left 1,200 years in the past. The boy will do anything to help this girl start a new life. Pain, confusion, cheers, and laughter will be made anew in the modern world.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

mangas.title: God, Please Make Me a Demon!
mangas.synonyms: Lord, Please Turn Me Back Into a Devil!
mangas.description: At a glance, high-schooler Moran Baek appears to be a beautiful girl who's perfect in every way… or so it would seem. In reality, she is an exiled demon who has been trapped in a human body for over 5,000 years. When she learns that she is still unable to use her demonic powers despite finishing her exile, Moran despairs and struggles to find a way to become a demon again. One day, she accidentally discovers that doing a good deed restores her powers, and sets out to find a way to keep doing good deeds so she can return to her devilish ways.

mangas.title: Ningen Maid Robot Meruru
mangas.titleNative: 人間メイドロボめるる
mangas.description:
The story takes place in the near future, when technology has advanced to the point where "Maid Robots" are widely used. Yashiro, a salaryman for a black company also has a maid robot named Meruru, however she has a dangerous secret that even Yashiro doesn't know?!



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Makoto-senpai no Mae de wa Kakko Tsukerarenai!
mangas.titleNative: 真先輩の前ではかっこつけられない！
mangas.synonyms: I can't be cool in front of Makoto senpai
mangas.description:
Jun, a good-looking tomboy, is a popular figure at her all-girls' school. She tries to always act in a stylish and gentlemanly manner to maintain her reputation, but when she gets into trouble, the "true handsome girl," Makoto-senpai, is there to save the day…?



A short romantic comedy between two handsome girls!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Nakimushi Ouji(♀) no Izumo-kun wa Joshikou no Oujisama to Yuri ni Naru Kamoshirenai
mangas.titleNative: 泣き虫王子（♀）のいずもくんは女子高の王子様と百合になるかもしれない

mangas.title: Somewhere in Time
mangas.description:
Our protagonist, Shen Jun, is the lead singer and guitarist of the band Triumph of William, who fails to be cool at the very beginning. Another protagonist, Yu Zhixing, a little-known painter, is obsessed with his neighbor Shen Jun, but unfortunately, has nohas no chance to interact with himafraid to interaction with him. As he tries everything to talk to his neighbor, there it is, Shen Jun's cat is outside of his door?! He finally finds an excuse to talk to Shen Jun?



(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: Ancient House
mangas.synonyms: Find a BF in a Horror Game, Ancient House Strategy
mangas.description: At first, Yu Xia thought he had just entered a horror game inside an eerie ancient house filled with resentful creatures. Later, he found out that in addition to the horrors of the game, he also had to deal with hindering teammates and skills. Even later on, however, his teammates began to think that the real hindrance was finding a boyfriend in the game.

mangas.title: Do Not Disturb! Grumpy Priest Is On Duty
mangas.synonyms: Wu Rao! Baozao Shenguan Zhiqin Zhong
mangas.description: What should I do if my sweet childhood friend became a simp? An Weilin, a recently promoted priest, ran upon Chi Xiao, one of his boyhood buddies he hadn't seen in years, during the shapeshifter hunting operation. He had no idea that his childhood pal had turned into the subordinate of his Family's Murder! What's worse, Chi Xiao had gone from sweet and gentle to strong and paranoid! An Weilin had to cope with Chi Xiao who had changed drastically while looking for the truth about his parents's murder. What he didn't expect was that all the clues would lead back to himself!

mangas.title: AWM: PUBG
mangas.description: When a superstar and a newbie gamer team up, sparks will fly and a legendary gaming duo's story will be forged! The flames of old will never die, will the young will continue to carry the torch! This is a story of how a superstar gamer helps an amateur rise in ranks and how they spark a story of drama and emotion. Despite some friction between the two, they will eventually become the most well known names in the gaming industry!

mangas.title: This Sweet Online Date is a Disaster!
mangas.description:
I was helping my sister win the heart of the game's top-ranked player, but it turned out to be a total disaster! I was even ridiculed by that gaming master!!! I guess no one can defy Murphy's Law! Just as the game was loading... Ding! Notice: Your husband is now online!


(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Strictly Honest
mangas.description:
To Yang Juan, He Lang seems to be just an Internet Cafe Manager who lives frugally and saves up money to buy dresses. In the world of an online game, Yang Juan portrays a naive, adorable, and soft girl - at least that's what He Lang thinks. The honest Yang Juan was entrusted by his roommate to control a female character's gaming account and use it to expose a cheating, in-game partner. By day, he's a serious and studious scholar. But at night, Juan Yuan goes online to play a gentle girl. And every day, he tries his absolute best not to expose himself.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes 13 extras.

mangas.title: Seobeo 1-wi Hilleojiman Hireun Motamnida
mangas.synonyms: I Am the #1 Healer on the Server, But I Cannot Heal
mangas.description: Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Player <3 Player
mangas.description:
College student Doori's greatest passion is playing Battle Legend, an FPS Battle Royale game. He's been grinding to level up for years and his technical game is... good! Determined to win an inter-collegiate Battle Legend Co-Op tournament, Doori finds the perfect partner in Noah, an incoming freshman. Noah is just... a natural. Elegant, smooth, and they move together so well. YES! Noah agrees to team up with Doori, but only in exchange for... kisses~!


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Seonuiui Gyeongjaeng
mangas.synonyms: เด็กใหม่ห้องคิง
mangas.description:
Seulgi was no.1 in her old suburban school. Now, having transferred to the prestigious Chaehwa Girls' High in Seoul, she must engage in fierce, friendly competition with her rich and talented rival Jay.



(Source: YLAB)



Note:
- Belongs to Blue String universe.

- includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Plaza Wars
mangas.description:
As the toughest fighter in the world of crime, Gijun claims victory in a battle that ends the long power struggle between Seoul's gangs. But when his brother Giseok rises in rank within the enemy group, Gijun decides to slash his own heel and leave the business to avoid fighting him. Just when all seems at peace 15 years later, Giseok is mysteriously ambushed and killed in cold blood right before his own retirement. Filled with a chilly rage, Gijun sets off on a one-man hunt to track down everyone involved in his brother's death. And he has a feeling he doesn't need to look far to find the main culprit... With revenge and old gang rivalries factoring into the equation, Seoul's underbelly is in for yet another grisly bloodbath!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Tiki-Taka
mangas.description:
Harang is a rising star in women's handball… until she isn't. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women's futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women's national league, here we come…?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: On-Air
mangas.description:
On social media, A-Yeong Oh has a perfect life. Her vlogs on the popular video-sharing platform MeTube command the adoration of thousands of fans as she regularly posts vlogs with her loving boyfriend, Ji-Hun. However, when Ji-Hun abruptly breaks up with her and disappears one day, her livelihood and MeTube fame are threatened. As A-Yeong struggles to maintain her online celebrity status and delves into the mystery behind Ji-Hun's disappearance, she gradually begins to uncover the sinister truth behind Ji-Hun's real identity. Will A-Yeong manage to find out who her ex truly was, or will her obsession with fame consume her first?



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: Horang's Nightmare
mangas.synonyms: The Ghost in the School Stairwell
mangas.description:
Have you ever gotten that eerie feeling that someone's watching you? That when you turn off the lights, you're not alone? Read these terrifying ghost stories and try not to scream.



A collection of stories by Korea's master of horror, Horang:



1. The Ghost in the School Stairwell (학교계단 귀신)

2-3. The Ghost in the Fridge (냉장고 귀신)

4. The Street View Ghost (거리뷰 귀신)

5-6. The Ghost in the Elevator (엘레베이터 귀신)

7. The Ghost of Turtle Playground (거북이놀이터 귀신)

8. The Ghost on the Highway (동서로주유소 귀신)

9. The Ghost of Oksu Station -Remastered- (옥수역 귀신 - Remastered -)

10. The Ghost of Bongcheon-dong -Remastered- (봉천동 귀신 - Remastered -)



(Source: WEBTOONS)

mangas.title: Scroll if You Dare
mangas.description:
Think you can make it to the end? Blood-thirsty spirits, vicious curses, and sickening twists haunt these individual horror stories from 29 different creators. Scroll if you dare. But whatever you do, don't scroll alone!


(Source: WEBTOON)



Stories featured:

1) Neulpureun yoyangwon (늘푸른 요양원 - Evergreen Nursing Home) by Ryoung)

2) Gosulsa (고술사 - The Shaman) by Hwang Jun-Ho

3) Bidulgi (비둘기 - Pigeon) by Hoodbird

4) Jasing nongsa (자식 농사 - Raising a Success) by Mangsoon

5) Boinda(보인다 - I See You) by Kim Lee-Yeon

6) Junggogeorae (중고거래 - Buying Used)by Kingsnal/Jui-Joo

7) Geugeotdeul (그것들 - Them) by Cyclops/Kim Do-yeon

8) Uri gajok (우리 가족 - My Family) by Su Ri-bu

9) Gongpoui Saengdongseong (공포의 생동성 - The horror of Vitality) by Jin Ja/Jeong Saeng

10) Sungnyeokkeseoneun Bimireul Sireohasinda (숙녀께서는 비밀을 싫어하신다 - The Lady Hate Secrets) by Go Tae-ho

11) Angwi (안귀 - The Eye Phantom) by Aeon

12) Hum (훔 - Hum) by Lee Su-Min

13) Back Rooms no.0605 (Back Rooms no.0605 - Backrooms no.0605) by Won Ju-Min

14) Mimi (미미 - Mimi) by Im Mok-won

15) Mising (미싱 - The Sewing Machine) by Huinari

16) Sikkeureoun Jip (시끄러운 집 - Noisy Tenants) by Digeut

17) Meori (머리) by Sam-Chon

18) Mongyubyeong (몽유병) by bunny

19) Hosu Gongwonui Yeoja (호수 공원의 여자) by Spring

20) Popi Mom (뽀삐맘) by Gong Yuk

21) Geokkuro Seoneun ja (거꾸로 서는 자) by Dan-woo

22) Doro Wiui Angma (도로 위의 악마) by Lee Daeyang

23) Gyedan, Mureup, Dalmasian (계단, 무릎, 달마시안) by Mapache

24) Suhagyeohaeng (수학여행) by Seo Irae/ Yeong-I Yeong

25) Misikga (미식가) by 247

26) Inganui joe (인간의 죄) by Seon Taek-gil

27) Mijiwaui Jou (미지와의 조우) by Kim Yong-Ki

28) Bulchibyeong (불치병) by Rangddo

29) Busan Noraebang Gwisin (부산 노래방 귀신 - The Busan Karaoke Ghost) by Horang

mangas.title: Potaemaeul Hogu
mangas.description:
Ki-Heon Woo, a phony medicine salesman, appears in a rural village. He is a seemingly innocent rural alpha bachelor who has become a resident of the Bible's house, and while he's at it, he's also sold out of his phony medicine! But this guy eats all the medicine in one day and then he goes into a coma...?

(Source: BookCube, translated)


Note: Part of BookCube's Omegaverse Danpyeonseon (오메가버스 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Villain-ui Sajeogin Bimil
mangas.description:
One day, a villain appears in a peaceful city. Tate, who was suffering from overtime work today, hides the villain who was being chased by the hero, but when the hero appears, he sees the villain getting strangely excited and makes a proposal…

(Source: BookCube, translated)


Note: Part of BookCube's Omegaverse Danpyeonseon (오메가버스 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Koishita Aite ga Otoko datta: BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 恋した相手が男だったBLアンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: I fell in love with a man BL anthology
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Tomo Kurahashi

1. Matteiru Otoko (待っている男) [Kazuki Natsume]

2. Futari no Oku no Te (ふたりの奥の手) [Mikuro Noichi]

3. Uso da yo ((嘘だよ) [Moegi Yukue]

4. Koi wa Choukyori de (恋は長距離で) [Riko Sakura]

5. Gift (ギフト) [Udo]

6. Tadanaranu Kankei (Miman) (ただならぬ関係 (未満)) [Toworu Miyata]

7. Good Bad Timing (グッドバッドタイミング) [Yorocu Tsuyuki]

8. Cafe Tenin-san wa Kyou mo Mabushii (カフェ店員さんは今日もまぶしい) [Nmura]

9. Koi wa Sainan (恋は災難) [Eiji Nagisa]: Spin-off of Kabukichou Bad Trip

10. Tomodachi Doushi (友達同士) [Tomo Kurahashi]

mangas.title: LIVE: Guest
mangas.description:
Yoon Tae-Kang, the perfect alpha student council president. Turns out he has a secret hobby!? Someone is watching him from the other side of the monitor and feeling catharsis…

(Source: BookCube, translated)


Note: Part of BookCube's Omegaverse Danpyeonseon (오메가버스 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Heisi
mangas.description:
Ezio had a one-night stand with a man named Heisi. The next day, he was transferred to the National Criminal Investigation Agency's Criminal Record Management Team, and when he went to work, his wallet had been stolen!? What's worse, the prime suspect turned out to be someone he was in charge of...

I'm going to catch Heisi Rinotti!

(Source: BookCube, translated)


Note: Part of BookCube's Omegaverse Danpyeonseon (오메가버스 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: It Starts With Stalking
mangas.description: Taeha, who works as a cook at a restaurant, always lives alone without anyone approaching him due to his bully-like impression. Then one day, he meets Joowon, a part-time worker, at a cafe he went to on a coffee errand, and unlike himself, there are many people around him and he feels a feeling of admiration for him for being kind. In the end, he secretly takes pictures or spies on social media, and he becomes more and more of a stalker and soon gets caught by Joo Won... Taeha, who works as a cook at a restaurant, has the impression of a gangster.

mangas.title: I Cross-Dressed for the IRL Meetup
mangas.titleNative: 女装してオフ会に参加してみた。
mangas.synonyms: I (♂) Crossed-Dressed for the IRL (♀) Meetup
mangas.description:
"Cocoa" has made three best friends in her online game, and she's excited to meet them in real life at a dessert café for the first time. The only problem: She's actually a man who's been lying to them. What begins as a tense manga about online life quickly turns into a lighthearted comedy about friendship, gender, and forgiving yourself and others.



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!
mangas.titleNative: 現実もたまには嘘をつく
mangas.synonyms: Hanging Out With A Gamer Girl
mangas.description:
Kaoru Terasaki is a gamer who's into MMORPGs, and he's finally meeting up with someone he's been friends with in-game for a long while—this time, offline and in person. He's worried that his friend will be disappointed to see Kaoru is a guy, unlike his female character in the game. But he's the one who's in for a surprise when, instead of another guy, his friend turns out to be a cute girl, Nanami Ousaka. On top of that, Nanami told her parents that she would be bringing a friend over—a female friend. Even worse, Nanami's dad is the super overprotective type who won't allow any guys near his daughter. There's only one solution to this dilemma: Kaoru has to cross-dress as a girl! Will Kaoru's efforts pay off in the end?! Will Kaoru and Nanami remain just friends, or will their time together IRL change everything? Follow their romantic-comedy adventures to find out!



(Source: J-Novel Club)




Notes:

· Originally self-published on Pixiv and Twitter, was then compiled and licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

· 25 extra chapters are included.

mangas.title: On and Off: Work-Life Imbalance
mangas.titleNative: 会社と私生活－オンとオフ－
mangas.synonyms: Company and Private Life -On and Off-
mangas.description:
A lolita boy and a punk girl form a fashion-forward bond without realizing they already know each other from work!



There are two sides to every working adult: one they show when they're on the job, and one they show when they're off the clock. For coworkers Sotaro Amata and Akira Hanku, this holds doubly true. Outside the office, these fashionistas don outfits that metamorphose them into completely different people!



So what happens when they form a connection after hours…without recognizing who the other person is?



(Source: Square Enix)

mangas.title: Kaisha To Shiseikatsu
mangas.description: Two co-workers who cross-dress outside of work accidentally bump into each other.

mangas.title: Blood Night Market
mangas.titleNative: ブラッドナイトマーケット
mangas.description: Step into the pulsating heart of Blood Night City, a metropolis teeming with vampires thirsty for blood and humans eager to sell. In this dark urban landscape, Sotetsu toils as an employee of the Blood Control Bureau, an organization determined to stamp out illegal vampire activities. But when he crosses paths with the enigmatic Mozu, a self-proclaimed vampire gourmand, Sotetsu's world is suddenly turned upside down. For the first time ever, a vampire craves his "undesirable blood," but could there be more to Mozu's desires? As their destinies intertwine in a web of blood, prepare for a gripping tale of seduction, intrigue, and salvation unlike any other!

mangas.title: Happy Antimoral
mangas.titleNative: ハッピーアンチモラル
mangas.description:
“I might be more into you than I thought…”

While prowling the entertainment district looking for women, Yoichi mistakenly approaches a long-haired boy named Misao, thinking he’s a girl. With a friendly smile and a Kansai dialect, Misao teases him: “Hey mister, wanna give me a try?” Yoichi goes along with it without expecting much, but Misao’s every reaction is so irresistibly cute that he finds himself unexpectedly hooked. Misao spends his days in a room overflowing with art supplies, saying he feels inspired to draw attractive men—and now he insists on drawing Yoichi too. Yoichi tries to keep things as just a one-night stand, but he can’t look away from Misao’s recklessness and the unfathomable charm that Yoichi himself lacks…

An underground age-gap love story between a detective and a painter, who meet in a corner of the red-light district.

mangas.title: The Wolf & Red Riding Hood
mangas.description: One day I became a werewolf! Living like this is too hard for an 18-year-old high school student...

mangas.title: Dating 101
mangas.description:
"Once I grow up, I am going to marry you, Yi-Chan!"

From childhood, Seo Eu-Na adored his next door neighbor Kang Yi-Chan with absolute devotion. He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen. To Yi-Chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Eu-Na's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped. Three years pass, and Yi-Chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class. There, in his major lecture, sits a bright eyed freshman, smiling directly at him. Seo Eu-Na. He has grown up, followed him to the same university, and looks more determined than ever. This time, Yi-Chan might not be able to run.

mangas.title: Ureonggaksi
mangas.description: A web comic derived from a traditional Korean folk story about a maiden who came from a snail shell and an ordinary female college student living together.

mangas.title: Ghosts of Greywoods
mangas.description: Welcome to Greywoods, a beautiful mansion isolated deep in the countryside. Its main inhabitants? The Viscount Rose, his daughter Lady Eileen, the housekeeper, the butler, and... a new maid, Marie. As Lady Eileen and her newest (and only) companion begin to open up to each other, do their hearts follow close behind? Now, don't mind any lingering ghosts still haunting the grounds, they're not real! Nor are there any enduring secrets, deep-rooted betrayals, or an air of mystery... just trust me.

mangas.title: Mwodeun Da! Jo A-Yeong
mangas.description:
Jo A-yeong is a university student who is a celebrity on social media, but who worries about other people's opinions. She meets Kwak Ju-Hyeon, an underground rapper who doesn't care what others think of her. The two become friends and later girlfriends, facing various challenges and adventures in university life.


Note:
-Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Was published by KakaoPage on 2023-03-09.

- Include two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kill Switch
mangas.description:
"Don't ever, ever get involved with her."



The warning Jeong Won receives is clear - stay away from Kim Jisoo at all costs. But the thing is, there's just something so…intriguing about the other woman. Try as she might, Jeong Won can't seem to tear her eyes away whenever Jisoo Is in the room. One night, Jeong Won misses the bus, and the only way to get home is the back of Jisoo's motorcycle. It's a thrilling ride, that's for sure, but Jeong Won can't say for certain whether it's the rushing wind or the woman in front of her that's making her heart race. As they get closer, Jisoo doesn't seem like the bully she's painted to be. Could the warnings have been a lie all along, or is Jeong Won in for the ride of her life…?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: What Does the Fox Say?
mangas.description:
As the newest hire of a game dev studio, beautiful Seong-Ji draws all the attention of her coworkers — but it's her bossy and blunt team leader Su-Min that intrigues her. Love is a whole new game for Seong-Ji, and with company president Se-Ju breaking (or was it laying?) down the rules, this new girl's got her work cut out for her if she wants to win. Will she be able to give Su-Min what she wants?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

mangas.title: Blue Light Journey
mangas.description:
Dian is a writer who struggles to make a living. One day, a famous singer, Eda, shows up and asks for the return of the blue leather described in Dian's novel. Dian, a fan of Eda, tries to return the leather she returned when she rejected his proposal, but hears that her fiance has already left on a journey with the leather and the pain of heartbreak.

When they are about to part ways, her aunt, who is urging her to get married, comes and suffocates Dian... Dian sees Eda's hand reaching out to her like a sip of oxygen, and she takes her hand to go on a journey together to find the leather.

Dian, who wants to succeed as a writer despite being a woman, and Eda, who is obsessed with leather and the sea. As the nights they spend together grow longer, the two begin to fall in love with each other's stories and eyes...

mangas.title: Lime Herbal Tea
mangas.description: Gu Gu, a shy girl, meets Xing Xing, an extroverted basketball girl. Xing Xing is everything Gu Gu wants to be - have lots of friends and live a happy, carefree life with dreams. Gu Gu is organized; she lists out a long to-do list for herself. But how does that help her get closer to Xing Xing? Wait, maybe Xing Xing is trying to get closer to Gu Gu too...

mangas.title: Kowaku no Kowai no
mangas.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 July issue.

mangas.title: Shikabane-doushi
mangas.description:
It's a bloody but pure yuri love story!



(Source: Author's Twitter, translated)



Note: Semi-Finalist at the 4-Hour Speed Manga Contest at Comitia 141.

mangas.title: Entwined Branches
mangas.description:
In order to prevent the villainous princess from bringing doom upon this world, Jiang Xu—who transmigrated into her imperial sister-in-law—does her very best to nurture Her Highness into a virtuous and well-behaved ruler, despite her own frail health. However, when she grew up, the haughty yet alluring princess unexpectedly pins Jiang Xu down onto the bed.

"If you can love my brother, why not me, too? Won't you have a look my way, my dear sister-in-law?"

Jiang Xu: …If you think I've lived long enough and want to drive me mad, just say so!

mangas.title: Lily
mangas.description:
This is a school love story where Yi Lin bumps into the tomboy Ruo Xi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms. "Is that true? I, fall in love with a girl?" "Why every time I saw her my heart is beating faster?" "How many times does she notice my burning face?" Yi Lin and Ruo Xi both need an answer to go on.



(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Seeing The Spark Again
mangas.synonyms: Seeing Xinghuo Again | Yòu Jiàn Xīng Huǒ
mangas.description: Through an old camera in the club's storage room, Gu An saw something that should not exist. She was a shooting star from three years ago named "Xinghuo." Why do you stay in the night sky? Why am I the only one who can see you? Gu An, who usually follows the crowd, wants to investigate and take the initiative for the first time in her life. As an observer and "the most important friend," Gu An and Xinghuo set on a journey to find the former club members and fulfill their dreams from three years ago. "It's... been exposed." "But, I'm really happy. Thank you, Gu An."

mangas.title: What Should I Do If I've Signed a Marriage Contract with the Elven Princess
mangas.titleNative: 和精灵公主签订婚约了我该怎么办
mangas.description:
Nan Yue was only in transit in the Kingdom of Elven. But she found that she signed a marriage contract with Ah Sha, the elven princess. Wait, I am a girl! How could I marry the princess? Wait, why am I wanted by the world after I sign the marriage contract?? To survive, I have to take the princess for a leap of faith:



"As expected of an uptown girl, you are pretty hot!

"Get lost, you perv!"!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)




Note: Chapter count includes 20 bonus chapters

mangas.title: Reaper Of Romance
mangas.synonyms: I'm a Grim Reaper, but I want to be Cupid!
mangas.description:
Kang Seo-Rim dies from overwork, only to be reassigned as a grim reaper. Sick of taking lives, he stumbles upon Cupid at work and realizes there might be something better than death: love. After all, why reap souls when you could reap romance? Cupid, however, is far from thrilled about someone challenging his divine purpose, and before long, the two are locked in a strange dance of rivalry, irritation, and an attraction neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Yeonggwangui Haeillo
mangas.description:
Halo, the greatest musician of his time, gets into a car accident on his way to the Grammy Awards. When he comes to, he finds himself in the body of a young Korean boy named Noh Hae-Il. He is left in a place where the surroundings and the times are different. After confirming that Noh Hae-Il's English name is Halo, he feels a strong sense of destiny. Halo enters Hae-Il. He demonstrates his genius even in this era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Nado Incubus Hallae!
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Be an Incubus Too!
mangas.description:
In the summer of 202X, a crisis befalls the majority of demons who have been absorbing human souls to fuel their magic. As more and more humans become more demonic than demons, there's no longer any need to sell their souls for demonic help. To overcome this employment crisis, demons prepare to change careers(?) into "mongma," capable of absorbing human energy without human consent. (Main character) Upir is no exception, but it's not as easy as he thinks. Eventually, (Main character) Cheol-Ho, a detective who is completely blocked by Upir, who tried to become a mongma through illegal means, appears...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Xiao Ba Wanglian Fanchele
mangas.synonyms: School Bully's Online Dating Got Overturned
mangas.description:
【Clingy Tsundere School Bully Who Always Blows His Own Horn (but is secretly cute) X Cold, Obsessive, Possessive Top Student】



Yu Yang thought he'd charmed a cool and shy little girl online. However, when they finally met in person, his online sweetheart turned out to be a towering school bully from the new campus! What's worse, this bully was the very nemesis who had witnessed his numerous embarrassing moments!



Yu Yang: I treated you like my mortal enemy, but you want me?



When the two school districts merged, their long-distance online relationship became a next-door classroom situation. Yu Yang would head to the restroom as soon as class ended, pretending to casually pass by his boyfriend's classroom window next door.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Are You Throwing My Game?
mangas.description: As an e-pal, it took Chi Yu an entire year to snag the top spot on the e-pal platform. Then, he met the most difficult rival of his career, who struck him down from his throne. However, he never expected that his rival would be...

mangas.title: Miun Jebi Saekki
mangas.description:
During their school days, Jae-Woo and Hyun-Min were each other's equal. Hyun-Min receives a special gift from Jae-Woo and is convinced that it's a green light for both of them. However, when Hyun-Min witnesses Jae-Woo giving the same gift to another girl, Hyun-Min becomes convinced that Jae-Woo is just a swallow who flirts with anyone and distances himself from him. Six years later, the two reunite at a class reunion, but Hyun-Min still feels uneasy about Jae-Woo. But...

"Senior. The last train has already left. Can you let me stay for just one day?"

What kind of shameless kid is this?


(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: Naui Cheon Sseomsseomoksu
mangas.description:
Her secret hand fetish that can't be denied!


Ok-Su, a college student who has been living alone due to the failure of her first love, falls in love with Seol-Hwa's hand at a meeting and fantasizes about her even after finding out that she is a woman. After that, Seol-Hwa and Ok-Su meet again by chance at the school library and begin a close and unusual relationship...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

mangas.title: Are You From Dealpop?
mangas.description: Seon-Woong's just trying to make a buck, so why is the guy buying his guitar so clingy? He doesn't remember the steamy night they spent together two years ago, and he doesn't know why a celebrity athlete like Jae-Hwan Cheon won't stop following him around! All Seon-Woong knows is he's got hospital bills to pay, possessions to sell, and an infinite cycle of part-time gigs to work. He doesn't have time to fall in love with Team Korea's handsome taekwondo darling!

mangas.title: Taste of Illness
mangas.description:
Not having any friends is bad enough, but being swallowed by mysterious black sludge in the middle of class? The worst. Yijun is no stranger to solitude, until a school project plants the seed for a delicate bond with another loner, Suni. But friendship is a frustrating puzzle for those who are used to being alone, especially when one of them claims to control a black goo that only turns hostile when the host is gripped by anxiety. Will Yijun and Suni be able to open up and make something of their budding friendship?



(Source: WEBTOONS)



Note: It was one of five winners of the Today's Comic Award in 2019.

mangas.title: Yeonyeonbulmang
mangas.description:
Ji-An and Han Jeong-Won, best friends since their school days. The two naturally developed into lovers as adults, but Ji-An realizes at some point that the future she thought would always be happy is not the girl she knows...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

mangas.title: Yeokgwangwang
mangas.description: Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Memoirs of an Exorcist
mangas.description: Ji Tae-Bom, a gifted exorcist in training, enrolls in the academy with his devoted friend Chun Hae-Su.Though they've always been close, Tae-Bom starts noticing an awkward distance between them. Just as the shift begins to weigh on his mind, he wakes one night to an eerie touch and soft lips brushing against his skin—only to find Haesu, flushed and possessed, staring at him with an unfamiliar intensity...

mangas.title: Warau Hebi to Niramu Inu
mangas.description: Note: Published in fromRED vol.32 ver.A.

mangas.title: Racy Retro: Heartbeat Fuse
mangas.description:
To save his future, Dong-Ha's parents hire a private tutor to live with them. Dong-Ha is stunned when his childhood friend, Ye-Byeol, appears at his door in a school uniform. The sight of his first love, now strikingly grown up, triggers a desire he cannot control. Dong-Ha finds himself watching her every move and unable to think about anything but her. Can he survive these private lessons without crossing the line?

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Petty Fetish
mangas.description: Yoo-Jin is bad boyfriend material. It's partially because he never takes anything seriously, but it's also because he's never had a great time in bed with anyone. After being publicly dumped, he's approached by Hyeon-Soo, an old high school classmate who also happens to be Yoo-Jin's first love. After a round of drinks, they spend a heated night together that might have been a great time, but Yoo-Jin remembers none of it. Torn between denial and desire, Yoo-Jin has to decide whether he's serious about Hyeon-Soo... which would be a lot easier if they could ever have a proper conversation.

mangas.title: Kitsy8
mangas.description: Aoko, Alice and Soujuurou at the beach.

mangas.title: Tsukiji Tobimaru Toiu Hito
mangas.synonyms: The Man known as Tsukiji Tobimaru

mangas.title: HANA
mangas.description:
The story of Hana, a genetically engineered mouse who escapes from a laboratory.



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Secret Alliance
mangas.description:
Eun Si-An, otherwise known as Shanshan by her good friend Hyunee, is popular with all the girls at school. Which would be great if she swung that way, but she doesn't. It just happens that she's terrified of men, and her mother is obsessed with protecting her from all men. And suddenly, Yu-Ri, the prettiest girl at school, has admitted to Si-An that she has feelings for her. Now Yu-Ri won't stop following Si-An around, which would also be fine by Si-An, except it seems like Yu-Ri wants Si-An all to herself... and who knows how far she'll go to make sure that happens.



(Source: Lezhin, edited)

mangas.title: Wo Qinai De Liewu
mangas.description:
After Wen Li, a social animal, witnessed his lover Chi Haoye killing someone, he was entangled by Chi Wuye. However, it seems that the real abnormality is not his lover, but this world?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Lessons for Your Pet Human
mangas.description:
Pet humans are kept for the amusement of the gods. While other gods treat their pet humans as mere toys, Ouranos takes a more loving and compassisonate approach to rearing his "companion human," as he calls them. But when Ouranos is called out of town for a long period of time, he has no choice but to leave his pet human in the care of Erebos, the god of darkness. Erebos finds the human's spoiled attitude dispicable and decides to teach him a few lessons…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: La Mèche
mangas.description:
Hwa-Seon, who desperately sought to overcome his severe appearance complex by saving up money, visits a plastic surgery clinic. Driven to despair by the annoying low-balance alarm, he visits a loan shark, his last hope. There, he meets a handsome, angelic-looking man named Shi-Gyeon.

"Even if I have to go, I have to lend him money at least once."

mangas.title: Holiday Film Collage
mangas.description:
"Merry Christmas."


When I opened my eyes after that unexpected drenching, an old friend stood before me, unrecognizable. Dan and Jerry, the wild duo who had attended every party during their college days, were friends who were so similar and well-matched, yet they drifted apart due to a certain incident. Ten years later, on a White Christmas Day, Jerry, who was gambling at a casino, was kidnapped by Dan. Dan then proposed a chess game to Jerry, making it a bet.

"If I win, let's go to 'that forest'."


As they played chess, recalling that incident they both wanted to forget, a tense atmosphere hung between them. In this uncomfortable situation, as Jerry tried to escape, Dan pointed a gun at him. And seeing Jerry, who could have killed him but didn't, Dan finally voiced the question buried deep in his heart...

"Back then, you..."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Dirty ♥ Vibration
mangas.description: Best friends Yeong and Nohae thought it was a joke when they downloaded the infamous "cursed" app. It's said to command the user to perform…sexual acts and punishes those who disobey or delete it. It started with making them kiss. When they disobeyed its order…the punishment was anything but a joke. Yeong is just a mild-mannered twenty something. Nohae is an award-winning male model, superstar, and now, thanks to the app, sexual deviant. Can they survive the app's dirty commands? Or will it continue to shame them or even worse…

mangas.title: Heavenly Bodies
mangas.description:
Obsessed lab hermit Han Woo-Jin has a scandalous secret: his passion for science is literal. When he hits a breakthrough, his body reacts with an uncontrollable, physical intensity that has earned him the nickname Mad Woo-Jin. Driven by cold logic, he treks to Deokmu Mountain to debunk rumors of a gold-granting goblin. Instead, he finds Baekbaek, a breathtaking god of wealth. Forget the gold, Woo-Jin has found the ultimate specimen...and he's ready to experiment until they both reach their limit.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Noryeogui Gyeolgwa
mangas.description:
Jae-Kyung, who grew up under a perfectionist father, must keep first place in the entire school.



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Aporia
mangas.description: The safe word is "cafe latte." After meeting at a VVIP club lounge, Gyum and Ja-Wook agree to enter a dom/sub relationship. What Ja-Wook fails to mention, however, is that he's not actually a masochist, and that he's just doing this because he fell for Gyum at first sight. Unfortunately for Ja-Wook, Gyum is a known sadist among the club circles with a smile that's hazardous to the heart - and now, the clueless first-timer finds himself coming up with safe signals and waking up with bruises after intoxicating nights with his dom.

mangas.title: Sukidesu, Futte Kudasai!
mangas.titleNative: 好きです、フッてください！
mangas.description:
Kurata Hikaru has fallen in love with her classmate Kira Kairi at first sight. Now, she's too lovestruck to concentrate on her studies. Her plan? Get Kairi to reject her so she can focus again.



Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2024 May issue.

mangas.title: Welcome to Rose Manor
mangas.description:
Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! Koushiki Comic Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 私の百合はお仕事です！公式コミックアンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: Yuri Is My Job! Official Comic Anthology

mangas.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...
mangas.titleNative: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ！（※ムリじゃなかった!?）
mangas.description:
Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako's total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai's romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they're destined to be lovers. Let the love games begin!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Tonari no Seki ga Suki na Hito Datta: Gakusei Yuri Anthology
mangas.titleNative: 隣の席が好きな人だった 学生百合アンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: A Student Yuri Anthology About Liking The Girl Sitting Next To You
mangas.description:
New semester, seat change.

If only I could be seated next to the girl I like...

This yuri anthology is filled with the thrill of adolescence.

All 8 stories are newly drawn originals!



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: The Tale of a Fox's Love
mangas.description: Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

mangas.title: The Last Passage
mangas.description:
Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Hui-Seo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Hui-Seo asks: am I in hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: The Baby Fairy Is a Villainess
mangas.synonyms: The Baby Fairy Is a Villain
mangas.description:
Since awakening as a fairy, Lichesia the Enchantress was constantly on the run from fairy hunters wanting to sell her. Now, hoping to learn who was really behind the hunters, she poses as 5-year-old Chesha to infiltrate the mysterious House Basillian... by getting adopted! But Count Basillian and his three sons are a peculiar bunch, and while they spoil Chesha, the count seems to be plotting something sinister. Can the Enchantress get her revenge and make it out of this strange house alive?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games
mangas.titleNative: 対ありでした。～お嬢さまは格闘ゲームなんてしない～
mangas.synonyms: GGWP. ~Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games~
mangas.description:
Kuromi Girls' Academy is a refined, elegant school that expects the very best in deportment from its young ladies. Aya got into this peerless rich-girls' institution on a scholarship, and hopes to grow as lovely as her fellow student and idol Shirayui. But Shirayui hides a terrible secret: she's a trash-talking, combo-chaining, newbie-stomping, ruthless hardcore gamer! Could a mutual indulgence in no-holds-barred video game combat grow into a deeper rapport between these two girls?


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Star Ginseng Shop
mangas.description: A story about how I conveyed my feelings to her through a restricted caller number. A rustic yet fresh 2000s era.

mangas.title: Sistervention
mangas.synonyms: I Need to Raise My Sister Right
mangas.description:
Her favorite character's fate is in her hands.



A woman's dream comes true when she transmigrates into the body of Rachel Agnes, sister of Liz Agnes — her favorite story villain. Her mission? Ensure that Liz goes down a better path. Yet, things become more complicated than expected, especially when a notorious archduke is thrown into the mix...



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Side Characters Deserve Love Too
mangas.synonyms: You're a Supporting Character, Just Love Me
mangas.description:
Geum-Ja Kim is the biggest (and only) fan of Kyle du Vilteon, a side character in the fantasy novel King Maker. Her never-ending search for Kyle content is forever changed when she dies while rereading the book… and somehow awakens in Kyle's bedroom to a new life within the novel's pages! She is then shocked to learn that Kyle can also hear her thoughts—luckily, only if she thinks of his name. Still, there's no time for this fangirl to daydream because Kyle is doomed to die. Can she save the apple of her eye... and in the process, become his?



(Source: Tapas, edited)



Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

mangas.title: Shino & Ren
mangas.description:
The tomboy and the quiet girl don't seem to have much in common at first glance, except that they're head over heels in love. Ren is loud, brash, and possessive—a far cry from Shino's calmer, more reserved demeanor. But hey, sparks fly in the most unlikely cases, and this couple can barely keep their hands off each other. Between Ren's aggressive flirting and Shino's adorable personality, if one of them isn't blushing, whoever's reading along with them sure will be.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau: Koushiki Comic Anthology
mangas.titleNative: ささやくように恋を唄う 公式コミックアンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: Whisper Me a Love Song Official Comic Anthology
mangas.description:
The first official "Sasayaku You ni Koi o Utau'" comic anthology is here! Talented authors with unique styles tell stories that begin with a crush at first sight.



[Participating Authors]



COVER: Aono Nachi.



ILLUSTRATIONS: Yosuke Kaneda, Miman.



MANGA: Aotsubaki Toto, Aono Shimo, Ito Hachi, Inui, Utatane Yuu, Sikusiku, Torii Shizuku, Nekotarou, Haruhana Aya, Mukunoki Nanatsu, Yuama, Yukiko.



(Source: Amazon, translated)

mangas.title: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka
mangas.titleNative: 幼馴染は、にゃあと鳴いてスカートのなか
mangas.description:
Natsume Ichika is a very ordinary high school girl who once had a close childhood friend, Maki Saihara.
However, the two became estranged and have not spoken to each other for more than a year.
When they both end up in the same class and both become members of the gardening committee, Ichika sees an opportunity to make up with Maki. However, Maki still refuses to even make eye contact with her…



Until one day, when Maki suddenly comes over to Ichika's house.
She wanted to show Ichika something unexpected: cat ears growing out of her head!



A high school girl who loves cats and a childhood friend who has become as carefree as a cat herself.

A story about a slightly mysterious "curse" is about to start!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Meririrarariri
mangas.description:
When she loses her calm, she is unable to use magic. In order to become a great witch, Merrily has lived her life according to her mother's teachings, keeping her mind clear no matter what. Then one day, Merrily meets a boy named Danka. As she interacts with him, Merrily's heart changes...



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Love Thy Neighbor
mangas.description: Doyeon can't sleep at night, and it's all because of her mysterious neighbor. It's not just the loan sharks constantly banging on the next door apartment, but it's the crying that keeps her up at night… Despite knowing she should stay away, Doyeon can't help but wonder about her lonely neighbor who cries herself to sleep. Then one day, when the loan sharks are just about to kick down her door, an older woman comes running out of there and Doyeon ends up hiding her in her apartment. They say "love thy neighbor," but they didn't tell you doing so would come at a price…

mangas.title: Killing Me!
mangas.description:
Vampire hunter Saki Fujimiya is the epitome of poise and finesse—that is, when she's not around Miyoko Kujou! Why does Miyoko get such a rise out of her? Well, to begin with, Miyoko's a campire—Saki's natural enemy—but that's not the only reason Miyoko gets under Saki's skin. Despite Saki's best efforts to kill Miyoko, something keeps stopping her from biting the bullet and ending it all for good. It's hard to tell who's really the prey in this love comedy packed with bite!

Note: Killing Me! was announced to be discontinued on 2018-07-28, with only one collected volume that included Chapters 1-9 and an "Extra Story".

mangas.title: Inotte Tamaruka
mangas.synonyms: Yokoryari Mengo Shinsaku Yomikiri Series Vol.1
mangas.description:
Yokoyari Mengo depicts the intense emotions of women × women!! This is the story of that beautiful girl who I loved and wanted to protect.



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: Ijimekko ni Fukushuu!
mangas.description: Because of his gloomy appearance, Shinoyama Mei is treated like a loser by his classmates. In order to take revenge on the head of the bullies, Enoda, asks his occult-loving sister to make a poison(?). However, the poison turns out to be a love potion instead!!

mangas.title: Ichiya de Ochiru Koi nante
mangas.titleNative: 一夜で堕ちる恋なんて
mangas.description:
Yorisue, who works at a lesbian bar, falls in love with a beautiful customer, Wasa.
Yorisue tries to tempt her into a one-night stand, and Wasa is willing to go with the flow.
The next morning, after a very satisfying night together, Yorisue is shocked to see Wasa's different appearance in the morning!
This is a romantic comedy about falling love while accepting the gap between the day and night faces!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Hana Monogatari
mangas.description:
The manga centers on Hanayo, an elderly woman whose husband of many years has only recently died. After finishing a Buddhist service for her husband, she finds herself walking out in town alone for the first time in a long time. She stumbles onto a cosmetics store, and meets a beautiful woman named Yoshiko Doujima, and falls in love at first sight. Hanayo had long given up on makeup after her husband nagged her about it, but putting some on with Yoshiko's help brightens her heart.



(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
mangas.titleNative: 限界OLさんは悪役令嬢さまに仕えたい
mangas.description:
Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she's suddenly laid off. But just as she's feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she's currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game's cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who's trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she's psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: The Main Duties of the Vice President
mangas.description:
There are two people who are always in the student council room.
Me, the president of the student council, and Namida Kurishita, the vice president. At first, there were other officers, but they all stopped showing up because the VP takes care of all the work. She is usually a beautiful and well-behaved honor student, but... she likes to tease me in strange ways when we're alone!?

Girls' love gone wild under the guise of ladylike behavior...!

This is a slightly naughty romantic comedy that takes place in secret in the student council room!

mangas.title: Dungeons and Crayons
mangas.synonyms: The Chick Hunter Is Being Filial!
mangas.description: At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

mangas.title: How Do I Turn My Best Friend Into My Girlfriend?
mangas.titleNative: どうしたら幼馴染の彼女になれますか！？
mangas.synonyms: How Do I Get Together With My Childhood Friend?
mangas.description:
Minami and Yuzu have been inseparable since elementary school. But now that they're in high school, Minami just can't accept that Yuzu may someday get a boyfriend. How come some random guy gets to wake her up in the morning, feed her lunch, take baths with her…? It doesn't take long for Minami to realize that her feelings can't quite be described as "friendship" anymore, but how can she get Yuzu to see her the same way?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Dame Inu Kanojo
mangas.synonyms: Dumb Mutt Girlfriend | Useless Dog Girlfriend
mangas.description:
Sakurako Kuramochi has totally remade herself into a more popular girl since her debut in high school.
However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like.
One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into another girl, who turns out to be that girl who rejected her in the past!
For some reason, she proclaims that she's fallen in love with Sakurako at first sight, and asks if they can meet again.
Sakurako gets angry at the girl for not recognizing her, and comes up with a plan to get revenge...?

mangas.title: Crowning a Spoiled Prince
mangas.synonyms: Second Life of a Trash Princess, The Older Sister of a Maniac
mangas.description: After losing her father, bratty brother, and the Elias Empire to her traitorous fiancé's schemes, Princess Legina makes a wish upon a magic ancestral stone and returns to when she was 15. With one last chance to right everything, she comes up with a plan: train her spoiled sibling to be the next ruler by becoming an even bigger brat and get Aaron Vestein, the most beautiful man in the empire, to replace her fiancé! But will just wits, resolve, and a new suitor be enough to change Legina's fate?

mangas.title: Catulus Syndrome
mangas.titleNative: 猫娘症候群(かとるすしんどろーむ)
mangas.description:
Shirakaba Yuki is a girl with the Catulus syndrome, which afflicts her with cat ears and a tail, plus some behavior like a cat. In the middle of her high school entrance ceremony, Ayano Riko - who is also a first year - comes in with a mountain of cats on her back. Apparently she's a cat magnet.

They become friends.

mangas.title: Black Black Lotus
mangas.titleNative: ブラック・ブラック・ロータス
mangas.description:
Renna, just transferred to Fuyou Girls School, meets Kyouko, who is called "Black Rose" and respected by everyone.
Black Rose is beautiful, mysterious, and seems to know Renna. She tells that it's Renna's voice that attracts her, and that was why she saved Renna when they were in grade school.
Suddenly Renna remembers...the reason why she had to change school and move to a remote place four years ago. It was something she forgot to protect herself.
Renna is devastated when she knows that Black Rose is dead...she was supposed to see her on the day she was killed!
When Renna receives a black card that invites her to "Black Black Lotus", a murder matching website, she finds out that someone who used her name killed Black Rose. Who is that!?

mangas.title: Anata Mitai ni
mangas.description: Office worker Kanna Kurisa struggles to achieve results at work. One night meets a woman who seems to embody her own longings...

mangas.title: Adachi and Shimamura
mangas.description: The second floor of the gym. That's our spot. Class is in session right now, but they don't hold class in a place like this. This is where Shimamura and I became friends. What is this feeling? Yesterday, I dreamed of kissing her. I'm not like that, and I'm sure Shimamura isn't either. But…when Shimamura thinks of the word "friend," I want to be the first thing that comes to her mind. That's all.

mangas.title: The 11th Cat Is Nene!
mangas.description:
Pointy ears, check. Furry tail, check! Here goes nothing—Nene's life as a cat starts now!


A meek little mouse from the rodent island of Konoshima, Nene smuggled herself into the land of catfolk and arrived at Rairai Teahouse looking for work…but found it already staffed by ten older cat girls! Surrounded by pretty faces, sharp claws, and even sharper eyes, Nene's ready to give work all she's got—after all, she can't afford to be one paw out of place!

(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Love Is War!
mangas.description: Lee Si-Yeon and Lee Si-Eon are fraternal twins and lifelong enemies. Constantly at each other's throats since a young age, these two have competed over everything with older twin sister, Si-Yeon, usually coming out on top. From stealing his toys to stealing his girlfriends, Si-Yeon has always taken everything her little brother, Si-Eon, called his own. That must have been what motivated him to try to and steal her object of interest, Seo Tae-Hyeon. Determined to turn the tables on his sister, Si-Eon bets Si-Yeon that he can get their classmate, Tae-Hyeon, to ask him out before she can. And so, the war for Tae-Hyeon's love began. While gender preference would usually be a deciding factor, Tae-Hyeon has a traumatic secret that levels the playing field for the twins. Unless he can get over his painful past, it's truly anyone's game and the loser will have to quit school, leave home, and never show their face in front of the winner again. But, with everyone toying with each other's emotions and prying deeper into their private lives, will anyone really come out a winner?

mangas.title: Sixth Sense
mangas.description: Kind, charismatic and mystic Taeo and the solitary and mysterious Ho, the two are secretly dating. But then Taeo is confused by Ho's unfamiliar behavior and how different he is from the one he knew. Between two people who are in danger of breaking up. How will these two hearts end up burning dangerously?

mangas.title: Dangeum and Jigyo
mangas.description: Our story begins with Ji-Gyo, the crown prince, having recently been exiled from the palace with a guard, Dan-Geum, and the man who raised him, Chunggeum. The three are forced to pass their remaining days in a quiet village made up of mostly elderly residents. This leads to a listless and lonely Ji-Gyo, who begins pressing Dan-Geum to relieve his traditional post as a voiceless shadow, and the two quickly grow closer. Hints of a bloody conspiracy, Dan-Geum's mysterious origin, and Chunggeum who seems to know more than he's letting on - just how are these three characters connected, and what will happen to them during exile?

mangas.title: Mr. A and Mr. B
mangas.description:
Mr. A is a mild-mannered salary worker. Mr. B is a lazy college student slouch. When a night out drinking ends with Mr. B passed out on Mr. A's doorstep, the two somehow get along. Friends or more? They may be opposites but, like opposites, they attract.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Netkama Punch!!!
mangas.description:
What would you do if your e-girl was a boy? Find out Hee-Jae's reaction!



One year ago, I was a world-class player in the game Arcana. However, everything I built up was destroyed by Hee-Jae Shin as easily as a sandcastle. I sold my account at a high price and decided to never set foot in the game again... Even if I quit now, it doesn't mean I quit for good though, right? One year later, I made a new account just like following a homing instinct.



The Grand Mage comes back as a young girl!

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

mangas.title: Do You Know a Fairy?
mangas.description: Eun-Oh is always alone because of his peculiar ability to see fairies. But one day, Jae-Hwi, a transfer student, comes up to Eun-Oh without hesitation! "When I'm with you, I feel good," he said, shaking Eun-Oh's heart.

mangas.title: Choose Your Heroes Carefully
mangas.description:
Stuck in a game with a lousy hero? Me too!

Min-Jun, a normal office worker, wakes up inside the game he was reviewing for his friend. It's not his fault the trailer was so boring it put him to sleep! Bewildered, Min-Jun is tasked with summoning a hero to guide. The hero certainly looks strong, but he seems to be less useful than expected.

mangas.title: My Hot Friend Is Glowing
mangas.synonyms: 僕の友達がイケメンすぎて無理
mangas.description:
When someone is aesthetically pleasing, people usually say things like... "She looks absolutely divine," "He looks like a million bucks," and "They're glowing." Of course, it doesn't mean that they're literally glowing... But I know someone who is like that! That's right. My friend is so stunning that his face literally shines.



(Source: POCKET COMICS)

mangas.title: The Chain of Youth
mangas.description:
Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two!



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: How to Train Your Healer
mangas.synonyms: Raising a Newbie to Grind Them
mangas.description:
Asta Chronicles, the cornerstone of MMORPGs, has surged into the stagnant gaming market like a blazing comet. On the day of the highly anticipated 'Mythic' difficulty raid update, the largest in recent memory, JJA (Sung Chahyun), the leader of the renowned guild 'Haste'—ranked first across all servers and boasting the most first clears—is thrilled. However, his excitement is dashed when he logs in to find that his partner healer is enlisting in the military that very day! Unable to tackle the new raid without his crucial partner, JJA posts a recruitment notice for new team members. Yet, is able to pass the most difficult requirement of them all: a one-on-one interview. After a day of meticulously managing his block list and flooding the chat with ♡♡s, a surprising newcomer appears—a perfect partner seemingly sent from the devs themselves! Can JJA nurture this adorable newbie, HealTeaser, into a raid-ready healer?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Dragon's First Crush
mangas.description: Webtoon work of "The Prince of the Dragon", a web novel of the same name! "Loo", who has just reached adulthood, squeezes his fathers into the magic school. Lou falls in love with "Ian", Prince of Peloders at first sight, and Ian is also somewhat attracted to Lou, but... Lu is actually a hidden child of a dragon who lost his life to the Emperor of Peloders long ago, and Ian They learn magic and try to hunt dragons... Can the two share their love while hiding their secrets?

mangas.title: Sweet Caress
mangas.description:
Woojin is so good with animals you could call him human catnip!

But, thanks to his gloomy appearance and shy personality, he has a hard time connecting with other people.

On the opposite end of the spectrum is Sangyoon, the kind, bright and handsome owner of an animal cafe.

He meets Woojin by chance and is enthralled by the way he immediately bonds with animals.

He ends up inviting Woojin to come work for him at the cafe.

Woojin falls for him at first sight but is unable to work up the courage to make a move!

Will Woojin ever end up with Sangyoon who he so longs to be with?



(Source: Lezhin)

mangas.title: One Take
mangas.description:
Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seung-Min's lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he's also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyeon-Je. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyeon-Je has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seung-Min knows it, he's become yet another Ha Hyeon-Je fanboy. Seung-Min's satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyeon-Je, but... Why is Hyeon-Je so interested in Seung-Min? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened 7 years ago have to do with anything?



(Source: Lezhin US)



Notes: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Head Over Heels
mangas.description:
Woo-Hyun is rich, good-looking and popular… but he also happens to be a total bully. His punching bag is Ha-Yan, a stuttering and amenable girl in his class. Woo-Hyun likes nothing more than harassing her… The weird thing is, Ha-Yan actually seems to crave his attention, feeding off it. As they each spin a web of deceit to ensnare the other, who will end up getting caught? And could romance bloom from this tangled, thorny mass of obsession?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Senpai is an Otokonoko
mangas.description:
Can true love really overcome any obstacles? Saki, a high school student, confesses her feelings to Makoto. Taken aback, Makoto reveals his secret, but the sudden discovery doesn't seem to bother Saki who is already head over heels for him. After being rejected, Saki asks Ryuji, Makoto's childhood friend, for some advice on how to win his heart. A love triangle unfolds when Ryuji realizes that he might also have some feelings for his old friend.



(Source: WEBTOON)

mangas.title: I Think Our Son Is Gay
mangas.titleNative: うちの息子はたぶんゲイ
mangas.description:
Despite belonging to a family of four, the Aoyama residence is typically home to three due to father Akiyoshi's job. While he's away at work, mom Tomoko and her two beloved sons Hiroki and Yuri go about their everyday lives--going to school, making dinner, doing homework, etc. But now that Hiroki's in his first year of high school, his thoughts are turning ever so slightly to sex and romance...and his mom can't help but notice his slips of the tongue when he's talking about who he likes. Supportive Tomoko has an inkling Hiroki might be gay, but she's going to let him figure it out for himself. Unfortunately, Hiroki has little talent for keeping his "secret," so he might die of embarassment before all is said and done!



(Source: Square Enix)



Note: Originally published on Twitter and collated by Square Enix for print release.

mangas.title: Daytime Star
mangas.description: A struggling, no-name actress of seven years, Yu-Ra Hwang. She barely lands a minor role in a movie that's bound to be a success. A celebrity's celebrity, Seung-Hyeon Kang, keeps running into Yu-Ra, who always seems to be shedding tears every time he comes across her. As these two reunite in the new movie, "Time," will Yu-Ra finally seize the moment to make her name known? And will Seung-Hyeon figure out why he can't get Yu-Ra out of his mind? Only time will tell.

mangas.title: Suyo Webtoon-ui Na Kang-Rim
mangas.description:
Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him.



The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her.



(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: The Boxer
mangas.description:
You've got the raw talent. Or you're the underdog. But do you have the heart? Do you have what it takes? Let's see what you're made of. The real fight starts now!



(Source: WEBTOON)



Note: Includes 30 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Modern Wizard Hunting Project
mangas.description:
The protagonist, a modern wizard (male), has lived for 168 years. He has always lived alone and strictly adhered to refraining from contact with human beings. Living such a life has naturally resulted in him being single. But one day, a dashing blond man appears at his company and inexplicably launches a passionate pursuit of him. What will he do?



(Source: Pocket Comics)

mangas.title: YOVE
mangas.description:
A talented art student, a drama queen who gets a kick out of spending on what she likes, befriends an outgoing young model who lives a thrifty life. They grow to appreciate and learn from each other, progressing along the way.


(Source: Wecomics)

mangas.title: 45 Seconds
mangas.description:
Siyeon, who returns home after studying abroad for college, finds out about the 'Understanding Wine' course that her younger sister has picked for her.

It's very popular because it's about tasting wine, but Siyeon is a lightweight that can't drink alcohol!

When she decides to correct the course and attended it, she is reunited with her high school friend Eunha... !?

mangas.title: Whenever Our Eyes Meet...: A Women's Love Anthology
mangas.titleNative: あの娘と目が合うたび私は 社会人百合アンソロジー
mangas.synonyms: 當我和她眼神交會時 職場百合精選集
mangas.description:
For those who devote themselves to their careers, love sometimes has to take a back seat. Yet, it can strike when you least expect it, whether it's with a coworker or a kindred soul at the bar after hours. What will tomorrow bring? Whether it's romance, loss, regret, or just another day at the office, these are the stories of women who find love as they follow their dreams.



1) "Masking Lady" by Harukawa Haru

2) "The Women at a Certain Company" by Mikanuji

3) "Everyone's Missing Out" by irua

4) "Fish and Water" by Kanarashi

5) "Stopped Meter" by Seta Seta

6) "Waiting at the Blue Bells" by Kuwabara

7) "You did Well" by Saya Fuyume

8) "Head-to-ead Reunion! Flirty Battle" by Esu Esu

9) "Rainy Day-dream" by Tamamushi Oku

10) "Oblivious You" by Mizu Aso

11) "In My Studio-Apartment Palace" by Satsumaage

12) "Saccharine Beauty" by Suzuki Senpai

13) "I Want to Make my Workplace Senpai Moan!" by Kurukuruhime

14) "Hand-delivered Love Letter" by Yuki Yukiko



(Source: Yen Press, edited)

mangas.title: Syrup: A Yuri Anthology
mangas.titleNative: シロップ 社会人百合アンソロジー

Cover illustration: Fly

mangas.title: The Girl I Want is so Handsome
mangas.titleNative: イケメンすぎです紫葵先パイ！
mangas.description:
When Hinami bumps into an older girl named Shiki, she falls head over heels. Shiki is sexy, easygoing, and has an amazing undercut. In order to get closer to Shiki, Hinami starts lurking around the basketball club. But though Hinami's crush is obvious to everyone else, it goes right over Shiki's head. When Hinami tries to confess her feelings to Shiki, Shiki thinks Hinami wants to become the club manager! Can Hinami get Shiki to understand her true feelings?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Risuka to Kiba
mangas.description:
On Christmas night, after being dumped by her boyfriend, Hiyora suppresses her emotions by cutting her arm. As her arm and heart ached from the cold, a girl jumps in, aiming for her arm. In an instant, she licks Hiyora's arm and says, "Delicious." To her surprise, the girl is a vampire! The vampire praises the confused Hiyora and her arm, which is dripping with blood.



A vampire romance that begins with an encounter at rock bottom begins!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi ni Naretara
mangas.description: A girl-meets-girl story about an idol and an otaku high school girl who switch bodies.
