mangas.title: Kakure Ookami to Nagasare Kohitsuji
mangas.synonyms: the wolf hiding its true nature and the lamb being deceived
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Kore ga Koi ni Chigainai
mangas.synonyms: This must be what love is all about
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I'll Make You Hate Me
mangas.description:
The hot new guy in Min-Soo's department turns out to be none other than his childhood friend, Jun-Won. But Jun-Won thinks of Min-Soo as more than a friend. Finally craving into Jun-Won's persistent advances, Min-Soo agrees to go out with him for one semester. While Min-Soo's plan is to make Jun-Won grow sick of him during that time, will Min-Soo succeed? Or will Jun-Won manage to win Min-Soo over?



(Source: Pocket Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and seven extras.

mangas.title: We Are Not Friends
mangas.description:
There are two men who will start fighting once they see each other. They won't be friends anyway. So what kind of relationship will they have? The cold and proud high-class boy meets with a rebellious and edgy lad. They got an unsolved grudge during high school. Just when they thought they would never see each other again, they became neighbors who would meet every day at university! What will happen to them this time? What stories will they create?



(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: Kawaisou na Kimi wa Boku dake no Amayaka na Kizu: Bangaihen
mangas.titleNative: 可哀想な君は僕だけの甘やかな傷・番外篇
mangas.synonyms: Kawaisouna Kimi wa Boku dake no Amayaka na Kizu Side Story
mangas.description:
The story of Aoi, a fork, and Mitsuri, a cake, right after they started dating.


(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: More Than Brothers
mangas.synonyms: Lin Jia Didi Tai Nan Guan La
mangas.description:
The boy next door was as cute as an angel when he was a child, but after returning to his hometown after many years, he's not that cute little boy anymore. The gentle older boy Lan Tian tries his best to keep his "rebellious" childhood friend Bai Yun in line. What he doesn't know was that Bai Yun just wants to tell him: "You treat me like a little brother, but I don't want you to just be a brother!"

Can the long-time unrequited crush finally blossom?

mangas.title: Just the Type I Hate
mangas.description:
Jeong Ah-Hun, a bright and cute part-timer with a slight quirk, is a bit of a jerk. Seeing Ah-Hun being kind and lovable to everyone, Im Seung-Hu diligently builds a wall around him, saying that he dislikes him exactly. Ah-Hun begins to show his affection for Seung-Hu at every opportunity, but Seung-Hu accidentally reads his diary and misunderstands Ah-Hun. He realizes that Ah-Hun only approached him to sleep with him. Feeling betrayed, Seung-Hu, in a fit of rage, proposes a one-night stand to Ah-Hun...

"Didn't you want to sleep with me? You don't like it?"

mangas.title: The Secret
mangas.description:
"Nice guy" Yuta has been burned by yet another girl. After getting wasted at a bar, he's invited by the owner to a special place...a lounge where men dressed as beautiful women make their guests' wishes come true! Yuta is introduced to the mysterious "Mitsu," who confuses him and piques his curiosity at the same time. Before he knows it, he's indulging in pleasures he never would've believed possible!



A story about a cool and beautiful crossdresser and a pushover who's unlucky in love.



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Pizzicato!
mangas.description:
Ju-Hyuk is an ordinary office worker getting into a lot of trouble. First, he gets dragged into playing guitar for a band. Then, he clashes with Hee-Jae, one of his bandmates, relentlessly. After that, he gets rental scammed and kicked out of his home. And the cherry on top of this sweet train wreck: he moves into a new place...as Haee-jae's roommate. It would be great if the trouble stopped there, but things are about to get really, really harder.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Sono Kuchibiru wa NG de
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Yakuza in Love
mangas.synonyms: When The Yakuza Falls In Love
mangas.description:
Min Joon thought studying abroad in Japan would mean the beginning his fabulous gay life. But instead, he's scammed by his boyfriend, loses his passport and is basically screwed. What's worse, a kid comes up to him calling him "Mama" and before he knows it, he's being kidnapped by the yakuza. Then the hot yakuza boss makes him an offer he can't refuse… so now it's either be "Mama" to his little kid or to not live at all. What to do, what to do? And this yakuza boss is just too hot for his own good…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Sugar Rain
mangas.description:
One day, after two months of working cleaning bathrooms at a hotel, Johan's predecessor asks him to leave because he's coming back. All Johan has left is his younger brother, Philip.



A man says to Johan that he resembles someone he knew well, and suddenly offers him a job. Maybe it's a scam or something dangerous, but it pays $5,000 a month.



Johan now lives in a shabby, crumbling hut far away from the ridiculously huge mansion, but he's happy. That is, until he meets Herbert...



(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Indulgence
mangas.synonyms: Tan Huan | Frenzied Pleasure: Caught in the Allure of Vanity
mangas.description:
The famed erotic novelist, Duan Jinghong, had a secret: with just a touch, he could foresee the intimate encounters of others. He avoided physical contact at all costs—until the notorious General Shen Tinglan, a man he'd never met, appeared uninvited at his door, demanding to share his bed.

To Duan Jinghong's horror, his vision revealed an impossible future: tangled in passion with none other than the general himself… the same man betrothed to a royal princess.

mangas.title: Frenemies: Thicker Than Blood
mangas.description: Friends, rivals... Lovers? Yeo Haon and Baek Rigon have clashed since the very first moment they met. For years, they straddled the line between enemies and friends, ignorant to what feelings had been developing deep below the surface. Yet just as soon are their eyes open to how much they mean to one another, events transpire to try keep them apart...

mangas.title: Campus Conspiracy Theory
mangas.description: Yeon-Ho, who was living a life of fame and fame that he had never enjoyed before, suddenly appears in front of Yeon-Ho, a nerdy guy named Man-Gil, and shakes up the image of 'Lee Yeon-Ho, who gets along well with everyone'. Then one day, Man-Gil sees Yeon-Ho's face without his glasses...

mangas.title: Internet Love! Bangai-hen: Checking. after that
mangas.titleNative: インターネット・ラヴ！番外編 Checking. after that
mangas.description: Note: Published in onBLUE Vol. 69.

mangas.title: Kimi ga Terasu Koi no Hikari
mangas.titleNative: 君が照らす恋のひかり
mangas.description: A little short story about a man who is falls in love at a planetarium.

mangas.title: Kokuhaku Shitekita Yatsu no Seiheki wa
mangas.titleNative: 告白してきた奴の性癖は
mangas.synonyms: The One Who Confessed to Me Has a Fetish
mangas.description: When the one who confesses to you has a fetish, you either roll with it or…get off on it? Watch as these two high school students learn about each other on a far, far deeper level.

mangas.title: Portrait
mangas.description: Two friends in denial about their mutual affection.

mangas.title: Seventeen Maple
mangas.titleNative: セブンティーン・メイプル
mangas.description: Yukichi confesses his love to the clumsy Sane, who tends to lose things. The aftermath of confessing in impulse and love is…?!

mangas.title: Love Your Love Enemy
mangas.titleNative: ラブ・ユア・ラブエネミー
mangas.description:
"I hate him, but I want this face all to myself!" Yousuke and Daichi, students at the same university, are romantic rivals for Mitsuru. However, as a result of a stratagem of Mitsuru's, they get locked in a room and can't leave until they have sex! The two love rivals. Yosuke kisses Daichi in an attempt to tease him, but to his surprise, Daichi has such a sexy reaction…!?



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Ijimete Aishite
mangas.description: Asuna, who runs a detective agency, meets Seiji, a coffee shop worker near his new office. Seiji has a rebellious attitude, but also a charming aura... Asuna is intrigued by him and frequently visits the coffee shop. Seiji, who runs the store by himself, gradually begins to open up his heart to Asuna, who has become a regular customer. One night, noticing this, Asuna touches Seiji in an obscene manner as a thank you...

mangas.title: Nakimushi Ooya no Mikuru-chan
mangas.titleNative: 泣き虫大家のみくるちゃん
mangas.description:
"I want to live in a town with a view of the sea."



In order to make this dream a reality, 28-year-old Aoba left everything up to the real estate agent and gets saddled with a shabby apartment without even inspecting it. Aoba is baffled by the apartment, as it is different from what he'd been told, but the landlord, Mikuru, who has a short hairline and bottle-bottomed glasses, desperately tries to convince Aoba to stay. Aoba eventually decides to stay because of the beautiful view of the ocean from his room, but when he goes to tell him about his decision, he is shocked by the adorable sight of Mikuru, who takes off his glasses and weeps with relief. Aoba finds himself charmed by Mikuru's dedication in running the apartment, and Mikuru begins to contemplate a way he can be useful to Aoba.



(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

mangas.title: Ike Oji ni Iyasareru Anthology Comic
mangas.titleNative: イケおじに癒される アンソロジーコミック
mangas.description:
It's time to start appreciating older men!

Cool men, dandy men, elegant men.

They each have a secret, hidden side—.

In this anthology, you'll see the "cute" side of these guys, and it'll surely make you swoon!



(Source: Bookwalker, translated)

mangas.title: Brazenly In Love
mangas.description: Ryono Kitagawa, the sales department superstar with the reputation of being the most handsome guy in the company, has a secret he can't tell anyone about. He's a scaredy-cat who blushes from unexpected events. One day, he realizes he can calm down in front of Ryo Natsume, his strict senior colleague who's the hope of the R&D department, and someone he didn't like. For some reason, he feels relieved whenever Ryo's around. Ever since then, he's become attached...! On the other hand, though Ryo's irritated by Ryono's unconscious behavior, he also had a secret. He's totally into guys and has had his eyes on Ryono ever since Ryono joined the company four years ago...! A slow business man with erythromania and a workaholic.

mangas.title: Yankee to Carameliser: Second Bake
mangas.titleNative: ヤンキーとキャラメリゼ Second Bake
mangas.description:
The story depicts Maki and Yasokawa's romantic relationship after they graduate from high school.



(Source: Author's Twitter, translated)



Note: All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization.

mangas.title: Yameru Toki mo, Sukoyaka naru Toki mo,
mangas.titleNative: 病める時も、健やかなる時も、
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Safety First
mangas.description:
Tae-Ho is in charge of Se-Jun, a newbie at the construction site. Tae-Ho warns him to be careful because the site is dangerous, and he's worried about the strangely over-eager Se-Jun. To top it off, he is troubled by Se-Jun, who keeps sniffing him and following him around. No way... is he fully aware and doing it on purpose...?

"Hyung... Are you in heat?"

mangas.title: High Clear
mangas.synonyms: HIGH CLEAR〜お前のハートにアタック〜
mangas.description:
Han Juwon has the worst habit ever. He's an average guy with an average college life, but his facial expression and words become terrifying the second he feels shy. Although he's trying his best to fix it, Juwon realizes he messed up yet again when he says something rude to his hoobae, Jeong-min. And not only that, but he also keeps unintentionally touching Jeong-min's chest every time they meet! Juwon knows he has to find a way to apologize to Jeong-min, but even while he feels guilty, he can't stop thinking of what he accidentally discovered about Jeong-min's chest… Turns out Juwon's soft-hearted interior and gruff exterior aren't the only things that are completely inverted…



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes two extra chapter.

mangas.title: Officer Takano Doesn't Know How to Be Loved
mangas.titleNative: 鷹埜巡査は愛され方がわからない
mangas.description:
"I've got no privacy, and the junior officer with isn't cute at all... I gotta get out of this police dorm...!!"



Takano is a patrol officer with an oddly stern look on his face that he can never turn off. He spends his days working at the station alongside a charming but loud and energetic officer named Soma. One day, Takano sees his high school crush after so many years, only to hear him make a joke of the confession he made so many years ago, but as Soma comes to be there for him something begins between the two of them...!



"I would do it with you, you know..."



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Good Night, Liang Xiao
mangas.description: To me, it was love at first sight. To you, your love grew with time! As corporate slaves in the finance department, they always work overtime and stay up all night together whilst love develops along the way! Liang Xiao: "Senior, you're destined to be loved by me."

mangas.title: Revival Blue
mangas.description:
It was the summer of 2009 when it all started for Minato. Fourteen years old and preparing for his high school entrance exams, he meets Naoki Okisaka, the long-term guest of a small guesthouse inn Minato's mother runs. Naoki, a Tokyo resident who once used to live in Minato's town, immediately intrigues the young Minato who dreams of someday going to Tokyo and exploring the world outside of his small hometown. Minato drags Naoki along on his shenanigans with his best friend Akiyoshi all summer. But eventually, the time comes for Naoki to go back to Tokyo and for everybody to return to their realities... but nobody really forgets the summer of 2009. Not even years after when Minato and Akiyoshi have grown up to be full-fledged adults.



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: TAKE OFF
mangas.description:
Jaekyung, who has a hard time forming deep relationships with people, takes charge of the remodeling project for an amusement park and hotel enterprise. While taking a look around the park to gain a better understanding for the project, he comes across lighthearted Taehee who is dressed as a bear mascot, and is drawn to him despite not wanting to be. Taehee approaches the typically detached Jaekyung, and proposes a no-strings-attached relationship for the two to enjoy. However...

(Source: BomToon, translated)

mangas.title: Aioi Musubi
mangas.description:
The story of a young owner of a long-standing small eatery and a puppy-like laborer.

Kota attaches himself like a puppy to Makoto, who has been like a fatherly figure to him. Even after they have grown up, he still smiles and proclaims proudly that Makoto's food tastes just like a mother's does!

The two get along as well as a family, but one day, a customer arrives who is a thorn in Kota's side. The two appear friendly and Makoto shows expressions that Kota has never seen him make, and he acts differently than normal. Kota is plagued with dislike and worry that he can't shake off.

mangas.title: The (Pet) Detective Agency
mangas.titleNative: 探偵事務所の飼い主さま
mangas.description:
At the Sako Detective Agency works the reliable Rou Nakamura. Despite his rugged looks, intimidating glares and pink hair, animals seem to adore him, making him the perfect candidate for finding lost pets. Rou is also in love with his boss, Detective Fumika Sako. When he isn't helping Fumika out on a case, Rou is always on the lookout for a chance to sneak in a kiss!



(Source: Kuma)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Nirameba Koi: Juunen Go
mangas.description:
This is a story set ten years after the events of Nirameba Koi. Two characters from the spin-off Shinobeba Koi also appear.



Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 53, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for digital release.

mangas.title: Biting a Vampire
mangas.titleNative: バンパイアいただきます
mangas.description: Momoichi Kuroda just wants to become stronger. He may have won all the fistfights he's ever fought, but he just can't help but think there's a way to be even stronger than this. When he sees his classmate Shirato in a compromising position, he gets to witness his deepest, darkest secret - and the rare kind of "strength" Kuroda could only dream of having. So the question now is, will Shirato turn him into a vampire already!?

mangas.title: Shinitagari no Vampire
mangas.titleNative: 死にたがりのヴァンパイア
mangas.synonyms: The Vampire has a Death Wish
mangas.description:
The university student, Yuuki, is a ghost painter who paints pictures on behalf of his father, who is a famous painter.


One day, a beautiful vampire youth named Leo appears.


Carrying a sad past, Leo wants to kill himself.
While Yuuki is attracted to him, he could only paint his pictures.


Eventually, providing a kiss as a substitute for blood gradually escalated...


With a youth who has lost his "color" and an immortal vampire who is desperate to die, each day is sad but vivid.

mangas.title: Bring A Wolf Home
mangas.synonyms: Invite a Wolf into the House | Yin Lang Rushi
mangas.description: There are many reasons why Xia Xu and Bai Li should not be together. For one, Xia Xu is a poor half-vampire, while Bai Li is the werewolf CEO of the prestigious White Wolf Group. But things take an unexpected turn when Bai Li's young nephew, Luo Bo, gets lost while heading to the CEO's office. Xia Xu takes the helpless wolf cub back home with him, not knowing that the boy's furious uncle is on his way to completely destroy the vampire's house in search of him. Now having no place to go, Xia Xu begins to live with the two werewolves until his place gets repaired. And with a playful pup between them, the two men from different worlds begin to grow closer and closer…

mangas.title: Cure Blood
mangas.description:
"You're the only one in this life where I can't die." A storyteller that will touch your soul is born. This is the story of a doctor who gives blood and a vampire who doesn't age.

The new doctor, Tadayuki, suddenly underwent a transformation. He desperately wanted blood like a vampire, and his aging process had slowed dramatically. Tadayuki attacked his senpai Juji, disappearing after telling Juji that he had died. But Juji sought out Tadayuki and offered him a helping hand, telling him, "I'll examine you and give you blood, too." They never could have imagined that it was the beginning of a secret they would keep for decades.

mangas.title: Vampire Taboo
mangas.description:
Bai Yao had just became an intern as the assistant of the big-headed celebrity, Ji Chen. Even though he had thought that this was already unfortunate enough, never would he have expected that Ji Chen was a vampire! What's more is that, the way to break the blood-sucking taboo was a k...kiss?!



(Source: Webcomics)

mangas.title: Kowagaranai de, Soba ni Ite
mangas.titleNative: こわがらないで、そばにいて
mangas.synonyms: Don't Be Afraid, Stay With Me
mangas.description:
I thought it would go well for you and me from here on after. "Let's pretend it never happened. From the very beginning."



Ono Shizuka is a baker who got into an argument with his partner Sakai and fell off the stairs. The accident caused him to forget about Sakai entirely. However, he now is very interested in the beautiful but lonely man.

mangas.title: Spun Together
mangas.description:
A young yarn shop owner, Mao Rong, was raised to believe love could touch people's lives. That all changed when he met Yang Yusheng, a popular but rude artist disgusted by the touch of other people. After accidentally injuring Yang Yusheng's hand, Mao Rong promises to nurse him back to good health. Cooking, cleaning, Mao Rong does his best to make things right despite Yang Yusheng telling him he's doing everything wrong. Little does he know Mao Rong's touch is the first that makes him feel… good.

Can Mao Rong knit Yang Yusheng back together? And why is Yang Yusheng afraid of skin contact? The strings of fate have been tied together!

mangas.title: Sensei, Anata ni Chikadukitai
mangas.titleNative: 先生、あなたに近づきたい
mangas.description: Takamine finally got his dream job as a high school teacher with his crush , Natsume. Now the two of them will be together, not as teacher x student but as teacher x teacher from now on. But does Takamine have an ulterior motive for becoming a teacher?

mangas.title: lie cry like
mangas.description:
Towada Nozomi is a popular actor, and ranked as the Number 1 Most Beautiful Man. But because of his arrogant behaviour in contrast to his looks, he has always driven away the people around him. One day, after a word from Towada, Tani is made to become Towada's personal hair and make-up artist and take care of everything around him. Before he realises it, he can't take his eyes off Towada's every single move...



(Source: Media Soft, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Touno-kun wa Kachou no Wanko
mangas.titleNative: 遠野くんは課長のわんこ
mangas.description:
Kotaro Touno, 25 years old, is currently working overtime. All for the sake of Tachibana, the boss that he respects and loves...!!



It was supposed to be just a one-sided crush. However, in the empty office, Tachibana find Touno masturbating to the smell of his chair...!? Now the manager that Touno admired so much is taking him into his mouth...! Is this a dream...?



"So what would you like to do with me?"

A loyal puppy of an office worker and his closeted boss in the fancy suit. Late night in the office, the unrequited love begins to be realized…!



(Source: Gilbert, translated)

mangas.title: Love Trap
mangas.description:
Llewyn Winston is a humble man who lives to serve crown prince Helion Andres Ischeny. Thanks to a blessing cast on his bloodline, Helion never gets sick – so, when one day he suddenly collapses, Llewyn is tasked with finding a cure. Distraught, Llewyn goes to the royal library uninvited…when he is caught by none other than third in line for the throne, Helion's brother Esteban. Annoyed at the thief that invaded his property, Esteban is ready to have Llewyn killed. In a desperate attempt to save himself, Llewyn kisses Esteban to distract him. After the kiss, the unwieldy prince reveals to Llewyn that he is cursed. The only way to break the spell is for the two to sleep together…and Esteban won't let him leave until that happens. Is the prince telling the truth? Or could this be a love trap…?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kimi no Oto ga Nari Yamanai.
mangas.titleNative: 君の音が鳴り止まない。
mangas.description: Sanjou, the popular guy who always gets the girl in the small country town he's from, actually likes to talk about his hobby, which is listening to techno music. However, there's no one around him who is interested in it. One day, he learned that his favorite DJ will be playing at a venue near him and faking his ID, he snuck into the club. To his surprise, his classmate Igarashi is there as a DJ!! In this classroom of music, my body will be violated by the sounds played by this dark-eyed guy.

mangas.title: Yamada and the Boy
mangas.description:
On his way back from work on Christmas night, Yamada (26) discovers a drunk and crying high school boy and takes him home. That boy was mulling over being in love with someone of the same sex.
A straight adult and a gay high-schooler.

It is a piece that sets gender aside as their hearts grow ever closer. This is Mita Ori's long-awaited series.

mangas.title: Code of Misconduct
mangas.description:
Imari Shuuya (26) works at a high school with a strict new policy: "In-school romance is forbidden—break this rule and you're fired." As a serious professional, he figures teachers shouldn't be wasting time on love when they have students to look after anyway. But his convictions are shaken when the school's new and strikingly handsome nurse, Yotsumi Rio (22), begins pursuing him with alarming devotion!

A cat-and-mouse BL romance between a straight-laced, bespectacled teacher and the yandere school nurse who's determined to make him fall!

mangas.title: Himeno-kun wa Tokimekitai
mangas.titleNative: 姫野くんはときめきたい
mangas.description:
Himeno Yui, the oddball of the class, finds his "shounen manga artist who's on the edge of the cliff" side exposed by the class prince, Ouji Hinata! Meanwhile, Ouji harbors a secret of his own: he is a devoted "shoujo manga lover." Tensions rise as Himeno teases him about romantic relationships. However, when the editor who works with Hinata suggests that he try writing shoujo manga, he decides to take the plunge and shouts to Ouji, "Teach me shoujo manga!"



From that day on, the two opposites embark on a secret journey of "heart flutter lessons," exploring their different worlds and the budding connection between them!



(Source: Shodensha, translated)



Note: The chapter count includes an extra.

mangas.title: Oaiko.
mangas.description: <i>Note: Includes one extra chapter.<i>

mangas.title: Sakasama no March
mangas.description: The soft and sweet story of two childhood friends with neighboring shops.

mangas.title: Hello
mangas.description:
Due to a particular incident, second-year high school student Izumi transferred schools and took his first year twice. He's not interested in getting along and making new friends, but his classmate Riku won him over, and they become each other's best friend... So now that Izumi had fallen in love with Riku, he chooses to hide his feelings to protect their friendship. But what happens when Izumi's former schoolmates out him in front of Riku?



(Source: Futekiya)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: A Crazy Elf Gets a Dragon
mangas.description:
Born with a limitation that prevents his mana from growing any further, the elf Lifrill storms into a dragon’s lair in search of reawakening—only to fall straight into the clutches of the middle-aged dragon Alberion Hawey.
In his desperate attempt to obtain a single sip of dragon’s blood for his reawakening, Lifrill endures all kinds of exploitation at Alberion’s hands. And at the very end of it, with the dragon’s blood he barely manages to obtain, he finally attempts his reawakening…
A chaotic, explosive romantic comedy about the half-elf wanderer Lifrill and the middle-aged dragon Alberion Hawey!

mangas.title: A Lucky Coin
mangas.description: High school dropout Hank Yan has a lot of hobbies. Studying, live streaming his day to day, and beating up bullies as a hero vigilante?! One day, Hank saves a young man named Junior. Shy and suffering from a dark past of abuse, Junior is a lot like Hank. Both barely have parents, if they are alive at all, both are interested in one another. Is it luck that they met or…fate?

mangas.title: Han Beonman Deoyo, Hoewonnim
mangas.description:
One day, Hae-Won, an ordinary college student, gets hit by a task and accidentally rips a stranger's shirt. To make matters worse, Hae-Won buried his face in his spacious chest!
Uh? It's kinda big... Is that guy a fitness trainer?



Hae-Won, who just registered at the gym, is feeling strange, can it be connected to U-Jin?



(Source: PeanuToon, translated)

mangas.title: Nakayoku Shiyou ne Otonari-san
mangas.titleNative: 仲良くしようねお隣さん
mangas.description:
A nightlife worker and a public server, two opposite poles living as neighbours. Before noticing it, they started spending time together and, unintentionally, they start caring for the other.



Mukojima, a police officer who has some suspicions towards his neighbour, lives alone in an apartment which reminds you of the Showa Era. One night, Mukojima faces a crisis inside his apartment and the one who came to his rescue was none other than Mikoshiba, his neighbour. By taking his invitation, Mukojima ends up in his neighbour's apartment, where they share some drinks.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

mangas.title: Netsujou Drawing
mangas.description:
Daiki is an illustrator and has a preference for male bodies. Actually, the role distribution is clear: The model poses and Daiki draws. But his latest model Yusuke has a completely different view, he has his own wishes and thus messes up the purely professional relationship between these two!


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Sweet, Husky Daddy
mangas.titleNative: マンバ マイスイートハスキーパパ
mangas.description:
Hearing how his lightly-colored eyes match his lightly-colored nipples makes him nervous. Is his heart racing because of the alcohol...? Seichi Hasuki is a designer and single father whose son suggests he find a new wife. He tries going to singles' mixers, but he has a habit of fawning over how great his teenage boy is and ends up driving the ladies away. He's been unable to find the new love of his life. One day, though, at yet another mixer he spots Inukai, a young and successful man. The two hit it off and become quick pals... Seichi's been working his butt off trying to be a great dad, but in actuality he wants someone to spoil him a little. Lured in by Inukai's charm, Seichi experiences pleasure like he's never known before. They even confess to each other their deepest concerns... This is a heart-throbbing love story between a scheming, career-oriented top and an innocent, mature, husky bottom.


(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Soushite Boku wa Koi wo Shiru
mangas.titleNative: そうして僕は恋を知る
mangas.description:
After losing his life as a soccer player to an accident, Hinata Shogo works at a patisserie run by his benefactor and long-time crush, Hanagiri Akira. Unable to convey his feelings, he thinks that being by the side of calm and gentle Akira is enough -- until one day, he witnesses Akira fighting on the streets in the middle of the night like a completely different person. After his true character is revealed, Akira attempts to avoid Shogo.

"I want to know the things I don't know about you!" "I don't want things to remain the same!" With these revelations, Shogo pushes Akira down…?! "What should I do, Akira-san? I want to make love to you no matter what."

A story about a determined love, featuring a hot-blooded, pure-hearted young man X ex-gangster patissier. Includes an extra chapter showcasing Akira's gap-moe*!!

mangas.title: Day-care Pick Up
mangas.titleNative: 先生は仏頂面してやってくる
mangas.synonyms: Sensei wa Bucchoudura Shite Yatte Kuru
mangas.description: There's one man Yura despises at the day care his nephew attends: Mr. Kaji, the super cold and unfriendly day-care teacher. He's nice to the kids, but he doesn't even smile for the parents and guardians. To make things worse, Yura is traumatized from a past relationship, and Mr. Kaji sees right through him. But then, one day, this teacher Yura can't stand protects him when Yura's ex is being a complete jerk... by pretending to be his boyfriend...!!

mangas.title: Yubunam Sangsaege Gobaekgonggyeong Munjega Doelkkayo?
mangas.synonyms: Would It Be a Problem to Confess to a Married Boss?
mangas.description:
Assistant Manager Lee Jae-Yoon, who had a one-sided crush on Deputy Manager Choi Ji-Hak from the HR team—the only person who treated him kindly when he struggled to adapt to the company. After submitting his resignation, he visits an autumn foliage festival alone, only to unexpectedly run into Choi and his family. Unable to hide his feelings for the married deputy manager, Jae-Yoon impulsively confesses and, in a moment of panic, steals his wedding ring before running away—leading to a disastrous day at the festival.


(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type Fall Anthology ([BL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 가을).

mangas.title: Bakashite Damashite
mangas.description: Honda, a gym trainer with a dry love life, can't help but be attracted to Konno, a man whose face is his ideal type. When he finds out that Konno is gay, he gets turned on by him, and finally realizes that he is in love. However, Konno has been in an unrequited love with someone for quite some time... A pure and lewd love story of two clumsy men.

mangas.title: Rational Pervert Romance
mangas.titleNative: 理性的パーバートロマンス
mangas.description:
Sho knew from a young age that he was gay, and everyone around him knew it and had generally been very supportive. He was also very clear that he had a specific fetish: a beautiful, red blush! Sho always thought he had a preference for the cute, blushing type, so he was surprised when he felt electricity flow through him at the sight of Nao blushing on stage while being forced to wear women's clothes as part of a college event. Once Sho set his target on Nao, he thought he was extremely clear and upfront about his feelings for Nao, but it took Nao a little time to realize that Sho wasn't joking at all – He really wanted to pin Nao down and have his way with him at any cost!



(Source: futekiya)

mangas.title: Can You Turn Down Freshly Baked Bread?
mangas.titleNative: 갓 구운 빵을 거절할 수 있나요?
mangas.description:
Oh Seong-Hwan, the owner of a bakery called 'Ppang Ppang Village' in a small provincial town. Since he was young, he has been linked up and down with all the gays in the neighborhood in search of true love, but has yet to meet someone he likes. Then one day, Seong-Hwan is insulted by his boyfriend and they break up. The scene is caught by Kim Ji-Woo, a part-time worker and disciple of the bakery. Ji-Woo immediately starts to confront Seong-Hwan, who is flustered, asking how he is?!

"I can do better...! Please date me!"

mangas.title: Joou to Shitateya
mangas.description: It is said that if you wear the suits from that store situated at the antique street, SHIDA, you will achieve success. During a break in his work, interior designer Jouno Oumi visits the store and meets a frightening and blunt man. He is the legendary tailor, Shida. Seeing the appearance of Shida who takes pride in his work, Oumi begins to feel a longing for the man, and an attraction starts to form... This is a love story between an obstinate interior designer and a hard-faced man.

mangas.title: BY MY SIDE
mangas.description: Kei and Chiyo have been each other's best bros for the past ten years, and now they're living in neighboring apartments as adults. Chiyo thinks that after spending most of their lives together, he knows everything there is to his friend...until he walks in on Kei, moaning his name in the dark.

mangas.title: Flip Flip Slowly
mangas.titleNative: フリップ・フリップ・スローリー
mangas.description: In a rural country town where nothing exciting ever happens, a new face suddenly appears at the library: a man from the city who starts to show up every week without fail. With each visit, the librarian, Hagiwara, can't help but notice little things about this new regular, Yabumi--his punctuality, his demeanor, his strangely methodical approach to reading every single book by a single author... Slowly, without realizing it, that simple observation blooms into a deeper interest that draws Hagiwara in, until he can't help it! He wants to get to know Yabumi better. But how will be bridge the distance, when there's no talking in the library?

mangas.title: Pretty Wimps
mangas.description: Yukihira has been in love with his teacher, Abe Hiroshi, for a long time and wants to confess before graduation, but doesn't know how to go about it. Confused, he ends up stalking Abe and discovers his biggest secret.

mangas.title: The Secret Tales of a 30-Year-Old Gay Bachelor
mangas.description: Wei Qiuyu is seen as a calm and reliable executive, but he is keeping his gay sexuality a secret. At the behest of his mother, he gets into a blind date with a woman, but meets Fu Yicheng instead. Though Qiuyu finds Yicheng an annoyance, he can't help but be drawn to him every time they meet.

mangas.title: Koisuru Taka wa Tsume wo Kakusu
mangas.titleNative: 恋する鷹はツメを隠す
mangas.description: On one hand there's Takumi. He's scary looking,strong in fights and respected by his juniors but in fact he's sensitive to the point of crying at every opportunity. On the other hand there's Natsuki, the "protector" appointed to Takumi. He's always around to prevent him from getting into trouble. The two boys are childhood friends and ever since Takumi came to his aid, when they were kids, Natsuki has been in love with him. He has no intention of ever revealing his true feelings but due to a strange combination of circumstances, Natsuki ends up stealing Takumi's first kiss! When an innocent Takumi suddenly becomes aware of his feelings and publicly asks Natsuki to go out with him, his surprise has no bounds…!

mangas.title: Omune-chan no Sainan
mangas.description:
1-3. Omune-chan no Sainan (おムネちゃんの災難); Kinniku BL Kiwami anthology, Charles Mag vol.11, vol.23

4. Iya!shi, Iyasare!? (イヤ！し、癒され!?); Kaihatsu BL: Hajimete no xx anthology

5. Ki no Mi Ki no Mama Iya!shite Iyashite♥ (着の身着のままイヤ！して癒して♥); Chakuero BL anthology

6. Coming!; Ureoji BL anthology

7. Come Over; Ureoji BL: Uke anthology

8. Untitled; kakioroshi

mangas.title: An Innocent Puppy Meets a Two-Faced Cat
mangas.titleNative: 無邪気なわんこと猫かぶり
mangas.description: A mild-mannered gentleman, good at his job, and reliable; Naohito's been wearing his mask of "perfection" for so long it's become as easy as breathing. That is, until he meets HIM. At the behest of a childhood friend, Naohito grudgingly attends a singles party for twenty- and thirty-somethings. With zero interest in mingling with the crowd, Naohito sits off on his own - and meets a much younger man, Tohru Akasaka, who clings to him like a puppy. Naohito's barely able to cope with Tohru's youthful energy, and they go their separate ways... but in a twist of fate, end up meeting again. Naohito's life is flipped upside down by his companion. Will he give in to this young man and let his mask drop!?

mangas.title: Vampire Heart
mangas.description: On the night of a full moon, Do-Gyeong runs into a vampire with blood dripping from the corners of his mouth. Haunted by the encounter, he tries to dismiss it as a dream...but not only does the vampire go to the same school as him, he begins following him around everywhere! Do-Gyeong is horrified of course, but as time passes, he discovers some peculiar quirks about the creature: he prefers his meat well done, flinches at the sight of cats, and loves to cuddle. Who is this mysterious vampire, and why is he so fixated on Do-Gyeong?

mangas.title: The Ramparts of Ice
mangas.description:
Koyuki Hikawa isn't great with people and always puts up a wall between others. She had been spending her high school days alone, but one day meets the overly friendly Minato Amamiya. The loner, Koyuki, the popular girl, Miki, the guy with no personal space, Minato, and the laid back member of the basketball team, Yota... The story of these four somewhat awkward students in their bloom of youth begins!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: Neighborhood Story
mangas.description: Welcome to Happy Berry! No, this isn't a fruit stand, but the label dreamed up by aspiring fashion designer Mikako Koda. In her quest to make a name for herself in the fashion world, Mikako enters Yazawa Arts Academy, a prestigious art school, alongside her strictly platonic childhood friend Tsutomu. But there's one problem—Tsutomu's uncanny resemblance to a rock star skyrockets him to popularity and leads him to date the prettiest girl in school. Now Mikako can't help but wonder if what she feels is jealousy.

mangas.title: Clover
mangas.description: Kazuhiko is a young, but already deeply wounded black ops agent of a baroque, retro-tech future - pulled out of retirement to escort Sue, a mysterious waif, to a destination she alone knows. Suu and Kazuhiko have never met . . . yet she knows him, having grown up since the age of four with her only human contact being two distant voices: that of her elderly "grandma," General Ko, and of Kazuhiko's dead girlfriend, Oruha. And Suu has been kept in that cage all these years because of what she is, and what the Clover Leaf Project found her to be -- a military top secret, and the most dangerous person in the world.

mangas.title: Alpen Rose
mangas.description: Lundi is a young boy who lives with his aunt and uncle in Switzerland in the early 1930s. One day while walking around the Alps, Lundi finds a little girl who is the only survivor of a plane crash and has lost all her memories. She is named Jeudi by his uncle and both of them are raised together. As they grow up together, Jeudi and Lundi develop a deep friendship for each other. A few years later Jeudi wants to find her past. Her only clue is a song that she is constantly hearing in her head, a song called Alpen Rose. At the time of World War II, Jeudi and Lundi set on a journey to discover Jeudi's past and in the process learn the depth of the love they have for each other.

mangas.title: Yojouhan Ouhi: Marie-Antoinette Tensei Ouhi no Yarinaoshi
mangas.titleNative: 四畳半王妃 ～マリー・アントワネット 転生王妃のやり直し～
mangas.description:
"Marie-Antoinette appeared in my room that day..."

A Lolita-loving high school girl and the tragic Queen Marie-Antoinette in modern Japan.

Born and raised differently, the encounter between these two girls changes history.

mangas.title: The Story of Witches and Cats
mangas.description: When witches turn thirteen, they summon a guardian "cat" who stays with them and supports them their entire life. This is a story of witches and cats, a story of four friends at magic school -- Suzu, Kei, Mary, and Nina -- who all learn something about life as they turn thirteen and meet their cats.

mangas.title: My Dear Detective: Mitsuko's Case Files
mangas.titleNative: きみは謎解きのマシェリ
mangas.synonyms: Kimi wa Nazotoki no Ma Chérie
mangas.description:
Hoshino Mitsuko is a determined and hard-working woman living in the 1930s, where career women are a rarity and looked down upon. Despite rampant sexism and pressure to "stay home," she's determined to prove herself as a successful detective no matter what. One day, she's approached by the handsome waiter Yoshida Saku, who presents Mitsuko with her very first solo case. Together, the two work closely to solve the mystery, and Mitsuko finds Saku quite capable—but very curious—and takes him on as her new assistant. Can this duo tackle cases and the turbulent atmosphere of the Showa era?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Swan
mangas.description: Masumi Hijiri is a 16-year-old ballet student attending a small school in Japan. When she unexpectedly recieves an invitation to attend a special ballet competition, and later gains admission to a renowned ballet academy, she embarks on a grand adventure of friendship and hardship. She is the weakest of the students, and as such encounters several challenges, but her determination and faith in herself help guide her through the fierce world of ballet.

mangas.title: Yuki and Matsu
mangas.description:
On a dark and freezing night, Dr. Sho-an drags home the body of a beautiful man he found buried in the snow. Corpses fetch a high price when turned into medicinal ingredients, and the doctor hopes to rake in a tidy profit to support his practice. Much to his dismay, Dr. Sho-an discovers the man is still alive, and he brings him back from the brink of death. But the doctor's disappointment melts away when his corpse-cum-patient shows him the many delightful uses of a living body!

Although Dr. Sho-an only knows his patient is ex-yakuza, the doctor gives him the name Yuki and tells him to make more corpses for him. Instead, Yuki moves in with the doctor and defends their home with his body and sword.

mangas.title: Bokura no Issho Kurashi
mangas.titleNative: ぼくらのいっしょ暮らし
mangas.description: Yuma, a decently popular novelist who lives alone in a large house for some reason, decides to live with distant relatives the Nezu brothers. Three people living together, starting out awkwardly, develops a family-like atmosphere.

mangas.title: A Delinquent's Life Hacks
mangas.titleNative: 通りがかりにワンポイントアドバイスしていくタイプのヤンキー
mangas.synonyms: One Point Yankee | Toorigakari ni One Point Advice Shiteiku Type no Yankee
mangas.description: Sakurai-san, who looks like a delinquent, is the type of person to give short advice as he passes by. Although people tend to be intimidated by him at first, his warm heart and thoughtful advice quickly make his friend circle grow. He is kind, caring, knowledgeable, and even athletic! While ticking all the boxes of what a delinquent should look like, and with a huge gap between his looks and personality, Sakurai-san is ready to make someone's day a little brighter with some advice!

mangas.title: Cat Companions Maruru and Hachi
mangas.titleNative: ツレ猫 マルルとハチ
mangas.description: Maruru lived a pampered life till one day, he ran after a flock of sparrows and couldn't find his way back home. He encounters Hachi, a tough stray, who says he doesn't need a spoiled house cat on his territory and chases him away. But then Maruru helps Hachi out of a jam, and they team up to face life on the street together.

mangas.title: Afterlife Diner
mangas.description: Lee Kang-Jin has just inherited an entire building in the affluent Gangnam neighborhood of Seoul. The only catch is he has to run the diner in that building for five years, but little does he know that he has to serve ghosts too! From 11 p.m. to 1 a.m., ghosts who carry resentment in their hearts come flocking to the diner in search of their comfort foods that remind them of what life was like. Can Kang-Jin handle both the culinary and personal demands of his undead customers for five whole years?

mangas.title: Yuusha no Ore-sama ga Madoushi Nanka ni!
mangas.titleNative: 勇者の俺様が魔導士なんかに！
mangas.description:
Leo, a mage, is expelled from the heroic party by Kane, the brave, because he just can't get on with. However, after Leo leaves, the party continues to lose. Kane asks Leo to return to the party, but Leo fed up with Kane's unmannerly attitude, asks Kane to get down on his knees... Kane's pride is shattered, and when Kane shows tears for the first time, Leo feels a certain excitement...?



(Source: Libre, translated)



Notes:

- Chapter 13 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release. "Stretch (ストレッチ)" published in Pixiv Comic was not included in any of the volumes.

- Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Tameshi ni Command Itte Mita: Bangai-hen
mangas.titleNative: ためしにコマンド言ってみた 番外編
mangas.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 57, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for digital release.

mangas.title: Papa, Me & Ayumu-chan
mangas.titleNative: パパとわたしとあゆむちゃん
mangas.description:
Even if it's not fate, I still want to be with you the rest of my life.



Ayumu, an omega who works at a real estate company, is struggled by the fact that his pheromones are extremely thin and unattractive. One day, he stumbles and fall in love to Ren, an extremely beautiful alpha working at a brothel, at first sight. When he finds out that he is living an unstable life with his cute daughter named Rui, he gets worry and starts to takes care of them. Ayumu is moved by the unreliable sexual side of Ren, and his feelings for him grow stronger. However, this triggers his pheromones to grow stronger because of the incident, and he unknowingly seduces him...!?



(Source: Frontier Works)

mangas.title: Midori no Kaze ni Kimi wo Hiraku
mangas.description:
A house surrounded by lush, overgrown greenery, and a beautiful, but distant man - this is what the gardener Nishikigi finds at his new workplace. He's not sure what to make of the master of the house, Kuraoka, especially when he asks to observe him and his work for his new children's novel. Nishikigi is only certain that the two of them are from different worlds and see everything differently - maybe even irreconcilably so. But just like the light and wind start to come in once he tames the overgrown garden, so love begins to flow into their hearts.



And thus, a slow and beautiful romance begins between two complete opposites.



(Source: Libre, translated)



Note: Includes an extra chapter.

mangas.title: Itoshii Bokura
mangas.description:
"The reason I'm here right now is thanks to you."



Ryuu, with a complex about his looks, lives unable to stand up to his classmates who pick on him. One day, his classmate who's as beautiful as a celebrity, Fukuda Ema, calls out to him.



Ryuu rejects him saying "we're from two different worlds," but they were actually childhood friends back in first grade.



Ema, who used to be insecure about his looks just like Ryuu, has grown not just physically but mentally, says it's all thanks to Ryuu and quickly starts to close the distance between them...



(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

mangas.title: Ao ni Hatsukoi
mangas.description: Rookie police officer Shiomi meets his senior officer, Chief Sano, on his first day of work. Shiomi initially feels uncomfortable around Chief Sano, who is always looking out for him, but one day he realizes that Sano is watching over him with warmth, and gradually opens up.Shiomi is drawn to the friendly and reliable Chief Sano, and his feelings grow stronger.Then, in his second year on the force, Shiomi's wish finally comes true and he becomes Sano's partner. However, his joy is short-lived when he receives the news that "Chief Sano is getting married. "

mangas.title: An Extremely Haphazard and Weak-willed Kiss
mangas.titleNative: 滅法矢鱈と弱気にキス
mangas.synonyms: Meppou Yatara to Yowaki ni Kiss
mangas.description: Yokosuka is a high school boy who gets the result of alpha in his secondary gender test. This is a big surprise since his parents are beta, so he is forced to attend the dating party for the marriage interview proposed by the city council. There, he meets many cute omega girls, but will he be able to find a nice girlfriend...?! Motivated by this, Yokosuka decides to undergo the compatibility diagnosis, and the kind of partner who was on the other side of the door with whom he obtained a maximum percentage of 92% was someone rather gruff with a look of unfriendliness that turned out to be... A MAN??!!

mangas.title: Tokumu Deka Omega Punch
mangas.titleNative: 特務刑事オメガパンチ
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Yoru mo, Asa mo
mangas.synonyms: I want to be with you for the rest of my life
mangas.description:
Shouma and Fuji have been together since their school days. It has been two months since they started living together. Their daily rhythms do not match due to their different lifestyles, but they are enjoying their life together. They are happy to have someone waiting for them when they return home, and get excited by the little things... The two are weaving their happy moment into a life together, but...?



(Source: drap, translated)



Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: Suki to Okaeri
mangas.synonyms: I love you and welcome home
mangas.description:
Let's laugh together, stumble a little along the way, and slowly, enjoyably, turn our "friendship" into "love".



Souta had been living in a share house with a few part-time job friends since his student days, but one by one they moved out to chase their dreams or get married. Before he knew it, the only ones left were Souta and Ryou, who happened to be the same age. When Souta clung to him, whining, "I'm lonely! Don't leave me too~" Ryou confessed: "I won't. I like you, you know." Wait, what kind of "like" is that?! Souta is confused, but…



(Source: Futabasha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Jianle Dongxi de Lang
mangas.description: A story about a wolf, his encounter with a small puppy, and their life together following.

mangas.title: Stalker Stalks Stalker
mangas.titleNative: ストスト～ストーカーがストーカーされてる話～
mangas.synonyms: ストーカーがストーカーされてる
mangas.description:
University student Itaru Hachimori obsessively stalks his crush, Yamato Mitsunaga.
But Mitsunaga only has eyes for HIS own target, Hiromasa Tate.
And Tate? He's secretly stalking the one he likes...who turns out to be Hachimori?!
A twisted love-hate triangle between three stalkers who attend the same university—disastrous for them, entertaining for onlookers!



(Source: Manga UP!)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization.

mangas.title: Papa and Daddy's Home Cooking
mangas.titleNative: パパと親父のウチご飯
mangas.synonyms: 爸爸與父親的家庭食堂
mangas.description:
Sengoku, a chiropractor, was left with a child by his willful ex. Harumi, a manga editor, gained custody of his child after a rough divorce. Each struggling to raise their own child, they decide to share an apartment in the suburbs... What twists and turns await their new family life?!



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: Marrying the Dark Knight (For Her Money)
mangas.titleNative: 崖っぷち令嬢は黒騎士様を惚れさせたい！
mangas.synonyms: I want to make Black-Knight fall in love with me!
mangas.description:
Clarice's younger sister is her whole world. In a world of monsters, born into a noble family that's gone broke, there's nothing Clarice wouldn't do for her. So when she gets sick, and there's only one way to save her, Clarice doesn't blink! She agrees to an arranged marriage with the Dark Knight, a ferocious warrior who goes everywhere in magical armor—even their wedding! Afterward, Clarice is ready to consummate the marriage and charm her new spouse into paying to save her sister's life. There's just one problem: The Dark Knight won't let her into the bedroom! And Clarice finally finds out why...she's secretly a woman! With female knights forbidden, the Knight seriously lacking in social graces, a household full of servants scared out of their wits, and monster fights breaking out constantly, Clarice realizes that this wedding of convenience is going to be more inconvenient than she bargained for!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Yuureiyashiki Love Romance
mangas.titleNative: 幽霊屋敷ラブロマンス
mangas.synonyms: Love Romance in a Haunted House
mangas.description:
A medium meets his soulmate, but he's a earthbound spirit, and a boy to boot!



"An absolute angel!"

"I'm a ghost!"



The ghostly boy, who has always been shunned by society, is gradually swept up in the young man's advances. This is a slightly terrifying, yet very funny, slapstick love comedy perfect for summer.



(Source: Number Nine, translated)

mangas.title: 100dB Pouring into You
mangas.description: Kanata leads a peaceful, if not slightly dull, life in rural Hokkaido. The boredom is only compounded by the fact that Kanata's favorite utaite (online singer), Hyte, has stopped uploading new music. Enter Utagawa, a new transfer student from Tokyo. Kanata can't help but be drawn to the mysterious boy even though he insists he wants to be left alone. But when the class has to sing during music class, Kanata feels as if he's been struck by lightning when he hears the new student's voice...! Why is it so familiar...? Could Utagawa possibly be—?

mangas.title: Futari Yogari na Melty Charm
mangas.titleNative: ふたりよがりなメルティチャーム
mangas.description:
"Wait, why the hell am I kissing this guy right now?!!"

The story is set in a certain magic school. Eve, a dog beastfolk, is excited about the "Buddy Selection Ceremony". The moment his Buddy is announced, everyone is in an uproar.

That is because his Buddy is none other than "Aura", a genius wolf beastfolk who has some dark rumors surrounding him! (Just who is this guy?!)

Even so, Eve approaches him to try and become friends with him, but Eve coldly rejects him with an "I don't have the energy to talk to you"! He's harsh and their magics are the polar opposites of each other, so they couldn't be a worse match...

Can you really live together with someone like that...?!

A fluffy, chaotic Buddy BL!! Mysterious Lone Wolf x Cheerful Puppy!!

mangas.title: Kimi to Natsu no Naka
mangas.synonyms: 君と夏のなか 番外編
mangas.description:
Originally released as booklets bundled with the limited edition release of the Kimi to Natsu no Naka volumes.



1. Aru Natsu no Hi no Yoru to Asa (ある夏の日の夜と朝, A Certain Summer Night and Morning)

2. Bonus story about Chiharu and Wataru's overnight stay at an inn.

mangas.title: Ieneko Nora wa Oogataken ga Nigate
mangas.titleNative: 家猫ノラは大型犬が苦手
mangas.description: The main character, Riku Kuyama, who had worked hard as a student after losing his parents, decided to live in a boarding house. And there is a handsome but misanthropic programmer geek, Tosaka Akimichi. In fact, he has another side to him that Riku has never imagined!

mangas.title: Kimi Arite Shiawase
mangas.description:
Set in the Taishou era, Heigo Kurasawa, the son of a trading company president, reunites with Isamu Sakaguchi, his childhood friend from 10 years ago.



They both used to play together like brothers but now they are master and servant. Heigo is left feeling lonely because of Isamu's now unfamiliar politeness. In order to restore their past relationship, Heigo tries to treat Isamu not as a servant but as a friend instead. However, one day, Isamu discovered old love letters addressed to Heigo from a man. Heigo was upset by this discovery and when Isamu comes to hold him in his arms, he whispers...

"I will never tell anyone about this. So, please let me be the only one you open up to about this worry..."

mangas.title: Baby, We Need To Talk
mangas.description:
Always fighting, yet somehow friends, they ended up causing trouble. Do-Ha is an Alpha, Geo an Omega, yet they've been childhood friends since they were little. One day, a rut hits Do-Ha, and just then, Geo happens to drop by his house and runs into him...

With his memory of that night hazy due to the Rut, Do-Ha watches Geo retching and thinks. It seems he ended up on top of Geo, but seeing no sign of a condom...

"So... I'll... take responsibility...!!"

Please, just talk it out... No, Let's have a talk!

mangas.title: Full Moon Alchemist
mangas.description:
By the king's order, Ennid, a genius alchemist, needs to develop a potion that shows one's future companion. While experimenting, he sees a man in the mirror and then a boy... The test has failed, or so he thinks. But, soon, he meets the boy and saves him from slave dealers. Later, the man in the mirror appears in place of the boy and defeats assassins who follow the boy. Ennid can't take his eyes off the man named Glunn, who is wearing no clothes.

"Wait a minute. is that huge thing between his legs..?!"

Can Ennid break the curse of Glunn, who may be his future companion?

mangas.title: Nani Sore Ai ka yo
mangas.description:
The spin-off of the popular series, Ao to Midori!



Two straight guys, completely off each other's radar as potential romantic interests. Yet somehow, they became the first person the other thought of—every single time.



Yoshida, a florist, and Iida, who works for a big company, meet through their mutual friend, Ao. Initially, they see each other as sharp-tongued and cunning — people you can't easily trust. But when Yoshida proposes a partnership to co-manage the flower shop, the "most formidable duo" is born. From bitter rivals to reliable partners, and then, somewhere along the way...


(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)


Notes:

- Chapters 1 to 8 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Your Perfect Little Pets
mangas.description:
The man steps into a secret club shrouded in mystery, a place he had only heard about in whispers. Inside, he finds a hidden world where countless beastmen exist to fulfill every imaginable desire. As he is drawn into the unfamiliar stage performances and a private encounter with a catman, the club manager appears with an innocent newcomer, a cowman. After introducing him and giving the guests a small taste, the manager makes a dramatic announcement. The man has been chosen as the one who will be the first to claim and shatter that innocence everyone has been craving…



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Part of Lezhin's Bimilkeulleom Danpyeonseon (비밀클럽 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Kawaikunai ne, Kouhai-kun
mangas.titleNative: 可愛くないね、後輩くん
mangas.description:
"You're really not cute!!!"



Akutsu is still only an underclassman but he's got all the girls' attention. Plus, not only is he good in his studies, he's also the ace of the baseball club.



Even though Ida doesn't want to have anything to do with Akutsu but somehow they're often together...?



"Don't tell me he actually likes me!?"



(Source: Comic Fleur, translated)

mangas.title: T-sensei
mangas.description: My Teacher, Mr. T is semi-autobiographical based on the daily exploits of Mr. T, who works in real life as a kindergarten teacher. He appears to be a mix of male and female teacher, which helps him win the kids' hearts.

mangas.title: Hinatama
mangas.description: Amano Hinata, a high-school boy, lives a quiet life in the country. One day, a light-haired transfer student, Kazama Ayato, arrives from Tokyo. In such a small town, it's not long before Hinata runs into the laid-back, absent-minded Ayato, along with with his lively younger siblings: Hayato, Ikuto, and Chiyoko. It's going to be quite a challenge for the Kazama family to assimilate into their new community out in the country!

mangas.title: Hankei no 15cm no Hatsukoi
mangas.description: A story of a bright and straightforward high schooler and his pure, devoted childhood friend. Keita and Tomoya are childhood friends living in adjacent apartments. They always thought they'd remain friends forever, but one day Tomoya suddenly announces that he's moving and reveals his long-held feelings.

mangas.title: Isekai Omotenashi Gohan
mangas.titleNative: 異世界おもてなしご飯
mangas.description:
Akane, an ordinary office lady, gets summoned to a different world along with her younger sister and pet dog. There, she ends up treating rare guests one after another with hospitality through meals!! Can she satisfy the citizens of a different world with home cooking...?!



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kyou, Orenchi Yotteku?
mangas.synonyms: Why Don't You Stop By My Home, Today?
mangas.description:
Kikuchi is a laid-back, thickheaded, yet softhearted high school boy. He regularly hangs out with his close friend, Seto, at either of their houses after school. One day, after Kikuchi got aroused by porn, Seto suggests helping the other get off. Kikuchi gets hooked on Seto's—who's gay and is apparently used to these things—blowjob and offers to return the favor to show his gratitude (?). When Kikuchi thinks that Seto is hitting it off with a female classmate, he feels a pain in his chest for some reason...?



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)



Notes:

- Originally self-published on Pixiv under the title "Danshi Koukousei no BL (男子高校生のBL)".

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Notes of Springtide ~14 and 16~
mangas.description:
"I want to keep watching you grow..."



With the start of a new school year, Haruka starts high school and Shu starts his second year of junior high. It has been a year since Shu said he had something to tell Haruka once he had grown to the same height as him. The height difference is narrowing, and they are getting closer step by step...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Notes: Includes ten extra chapters.

mangas.title: Notes of Springtide ~With You, in Full Bloom~
mangas.description:
Haruka is now in his second year of high school and Shu is in his third and final year of junior high school. Haruka, considering his future profession, decides to study abroad. But he cannot tell this to Shu because Shu is busy preparing for his last baseball tournament in junior high school. The two boys think deeply of each other. And in their fourth spring, when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom, their heights are no longer different...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

mangas.title: Notes of Springtide
mangas.description:
Haruka Wakamatsu, a third-year Junior high school student, meets a freshman from the same school at the station. He is wearing an oversized uniform, and well asleep on the bench. Haruka is a caring person, so he cannot leave the bottom of the student's trousers dragging and getting damaged. He tries to roll them up... This is how he becomes acquainted with Shu Hachiya. Gradually, the two boys begin to fall for each other.



(Source: Takeshobo)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I Hear the Sunspot: Four Seasons
mangas.titleNative: ひだまりが聴こえる－春夏秋冬
mangas.description:
Kohei Sugihara, college student with hearing loss, and Taichi Sagawa, his ever-optimistic former classmate, met in a chance encounter that ignited an undeniable spark that would eventually blossom into love.



Now it's spring and as Kohei nears graduation, his search for a job begins. Meanwhile, Taichi finds himself in charge of someone new at work. Life is busier than ever, but all in all, things seem to be looking up for the pair. That is, until the sudden appearance of Ena, one of Kohei's old flames.



(Source: One Peace Books)

mangas.title: Mata Ashita Aeru yo
mangas.description:
After a night of drinking alone, Kimura wakes up in a house he doesn't recognize. The owner, Kunishima, had found him passed out and taken him in to recover. Kunishima's calm presence and comforting home give Kimura a sense of peace he hadn't felt in a long time. When the two unexpectedly reunite at work as partners on a new project, they begin to grow closer. Little by little, Kunishima becomes irreplaceable to Kimura, but...



(Source: Homesha, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: How I Ended Up Babysitting My Boss
mangas.titleNative: 俺の上司が若返っちゃいました。
mangas.description:
His stern, strait-laced boss has suddenly become a little kid?!



Soon after starting his job at a realty office, Shimizu discovered that the infamously unfriendly boss Mr. Ueno actually did pay careful attention to his employees. Since then, Shimizu has been unbearably fascinated with the man, and yet equally unable to grow any closer to him. When he idly makes a wish on a meteor shower one night, and Mr. Ueno calls in sick the next day, Shimizu goes to check in on him only to find out that his boss has somehow turned into a preschool-aged boy...?!



This romantic comedy starring a big puppy of a realtor and his surly but earnest boss will cleanse your soul with its pure sweetness



(Source: MangaPlaza)


Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Scent of You
mangas.description:
Your kiss smelled of lemons.



When Ga-Min steals a kiss from his sleeping classmate, Kang-Go, he's positive he'll never get caught. But what he doesn't know is that Kang-Go has a unique gift — he can smell emotions. Now, Kang-Go's on the hunt for the identity of his secret admirer, whether Ga-Min likes it or not.



(Source: Manta, edited)



Note: The chapter count includes 7 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Kimi wa Beta
mangas.description:
Asahi Hiyama a beta, Seiya Domoto, an alpha, have first met each other in elementary and as time proceeded, they became close friends. Later in the spring, a little while after they began college, both of their parents had decided to get a divorce and remarry. They soon found out they would be step-brothers… Although surprised by the suddenness of the situation, little by little, Asahi began welcoming Seiya as "family". Suddenly he mistakenly gets exposed to a Omega pheromone scented perfume—-?!

"The smell is so sweet, I just want to bite into it--"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Anata to Taberu Shiawase: Maki to Hanazawa
mangas.titleNative: あなたと食べるしあわせを‐槙と花澤‐
mangas.description: Maki, a dedicated cook, lives with his boyfriend, Hanazawa and their pet rabbit, Pyon. The cute and carefree Hanazawa is regularly hit on by the handsome pastry chef from the sweet shop they frequent and Maki clashes with him often, but their days pass by peacefully... For the most part.

mangas.title: Real Person Romance
mangas.description: Jung Taeyoon, a member of a popular K-pop idol group, is stepping into the world of acting after six years since his debut. While he's adored by fans everywhere, Taeyoon has a secret: he's the ultimate fanboy of another actor, Yoo Eunjae. Taeyoon's room is practically a shrine to Eunjae, filled with his merchandise. Finally, at the first table-read for a new movie he's set to star in, Taeyoon's dream comes true as he gets the chance to meet Eunjae in person for the very first time...

mangas.title: Naisho no Stalker-san: Sonogo
mangas.titleNative: ないしょのストーカーさん その後
mangas.description: Note: Published in BE-BOY GOLD 2025 August issue for their 30th anniversary special.

mangas.title: Love Nest
mangas.description:
A brokenhearted Masato moves into his friend's second home looking for some peace and quiet, but instead he finds a man who's very much not his type already occupying the space. Can this messy, ill-tempered intruder help mend his broken heart?



Masato just wants some peace and quiet on his day off, but the kids upstairs continue to make that impossible, so he escapes to his friend Naruse's gay bar. Sympathetic to his ongoing plight, Naruse recommends Masato just move into his second home since he's not using it. But upon his arrival, Masato find a gruff, untidy older man already living there. Does this real-life odd couple stand a chance as roomies…and perhaps something more?



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: Links
mangas.description:
A collection of intertwining stories covering four not-quite lovers as they find what links them together.



Akiba plays the piano and reminisces about Yahiko, a friend with benefits he can't quite bring himself to call his lover, despite how freely the man cares for him.



Despite their constant bickering, Sado and Nakajo appear close enough to be lovers. But Nakajo has convinced himself he can never have Sado, which leads him to stay by his side while simultaneously looking for ways to hate him.



Shibata is an overly friendly older man who rather insistently hits on Sekiya, a socially awkward radio DJ. Even with his radio DJ persona, Sekiya has a hard time expressing the roil of emotions within him.



Kameda and Ogikawa get to know each other thanks to a stray cat. The two spend lazy days together, eating, drinking, and playing with their cat, all without calling it love.



(Source: SuBLime)



Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: I Adore You, Teacher
mangas.description:
Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Kiss wa Sousa no Ato de: Again
mangas.titleNative: キスは捜査のあとで アゲイン
mangas.synonyms: love is too far away, kissing is too close, again!!!
mangas.description:
Shiono, a tsundere junior detective, and Takoi, a humanistic detective in his 40s, are now united both physically and emotionally. Shiono's transfer has made their relationship long-distance, but they are still in love, thanks to the efforts of Shiono, who is a doting man who is always in love with the person he falls in love with! But Takoi's frustration is heightened by the arrival of a high-spec handsome man named Date, who calls Shiono "Shu"!



(Source: J-Publishing, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Hiraeth Remained
mangas.titleNative: 散り損ないのヒラエス
mangas.description:
Sanayama Kazura, a girl who just wants to be loved, discovers that the girl she had been spending all of her money on to look her way has betrayed her. In her moment of despair, she is approached by Yoshibe Kinka, who asks if she would like to die with her. Together, they head to the top of a high-rise apartment bulding and jump off it. However...



A story of two women at a crossroads in their lives, facing the feelings they've kept deep inside their hearts.


(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: Yuusha ni Zokkon Issun Ouji
mangas.titleNative: 勇者にゾッコン一寸王子
mangas.synonyms: The prince is completely in love with the hero
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: I Wanna Savor You
mangas.titleNative: 君をおいしくいただきます
mangas.synonyms: I wanna taste you in a good way
mangas.description:
Kanon is a handsome werewolf who always finds himself in trouble with vampires, who appreciate beauty by nature. They cannot help but tempt him wherever he works. As a result, he loses his job and struggles to make money. One day, Neiro, the owner of a vampires' blood bar, talks to him. Neiro buys blood from all species. It looks shady, but Kanon decides to sell his blood to support his family. The analysis reveals that his blood matches Neiro! Neiro is allergic to all types of blood and is always starving. He happily starts to savor Kanon's blood, with his consent, of course... But at a night of full moon, Kanon suddenly turns into a different person and climbs on top of Neiro! "Your moans... sound adorable."



A fantastic boys' love about a handsome werewolf and a hungry vampire!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Crow's Ballad at Dawn
mangas.description:
"You paid for me, so touch me however you please..."



Office worker Akito is taken away by a tofu boy yokai and steps foot into red-light district exclusive to yokai! There he meets the beautiful male prostitute Suiren—a tan, black-haired tengu. A story of pure love between a male prostitute and a customer unfurls in a dazzlingly luxurious red-light district!



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Tales of the Hundred Monsters Next Door
mangas.description:
Katagiri Jinpachi is a man plagued by mysteries, and the only one who can help him is the mysterious Harada Oriza, a famed painter of ghost and yokai portraits. These two men share the same peculiar fate, and their wicked tale of the ghastly and the curious, the strange and the shocking, all begins here.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: As Fish to Water: Where the Forest Meets the Sea
mangas.synonyms: Fish and Water are in the Woods | Sakana to Mizu no Mori
mangas.description: Van is a mermaid who has lost everything—his voice, his family, his very place in the world. Forced to work as a slave in a mansion located in a town by the sea, he dreams of the day when he can return to the water. One day he meets Jens, the sole inhabitant of the cursed island of Fiska, a young man who proves to be kinder than any human Van has ever met. As the two grow closer, Jens is determined to buy Van's freedom and bring him to his island home. But in order for this to happen, Van and Jens need to become more than just good friends… they need to fall in love.

mangas.title: Sworn Brothers on the Farm
mangas.description:
Io used to be the top earner at the host club he worked at and Anii used to be in the yakuza. Now they're both turning over a new leaf working as tomato farmers! As these two city boys get used to country life, Io decides to use his considerable charm to make Anii fall for him. But Anii turns out to be a challenge: one moment he's nice and protective of Io, the next second he's acting cold and trying to push Io away. Can Io and Anii put their shady pasts behind them and build a future together?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Notes:

- Originally published as a one-shot in Dear+ 2024 July issue, was then picked up for serialization.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Miserable in Love
mangas.description:
Aspiring novelist Kim Woojin has been a side character all his life. He can't write stories that are his own, and he's not even his boyfriend, Minho's, priority. But like every cloud has its silver lining, Woojin's comes in the form of an aspiring stage actor, Taehwan. However, Taehwan is not without his own problems: he suffers from terrible stage fright that keeps him from taking lead roles.



A friendship blossoms between Woojin and Taehwan, with each helping the other overcome their fears. Will this newfound friendship remain just that or could Taehwan be the spark that gets Woojin's creative juices flowing again? And could they both muster up the courage to become the protagonists of their own stories?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Second Dawn
mangas.synonyms: รุ่งสางที่สอง
mangas.description:
For the past ten years, Baek Ha-Yeon has been living in guilt for ruining the life of his love, Yoon Yi-Han. Because of this, he feels he has no right to object when Yi-Han wishes to continue their relationship despite getting married. At the same time, Yi-Han's cousin, Yoon Jin-Woon, has been using their secret as leverage to get Ha-Yeon to sleep with him since he also has feelings for him.



Just when the lives of these three seem to have gotten so irreversibly tangled, Ha-Yeon is sent ten years into the past before the biggest regret of his life occurred. Though he is determined to alter the course of this timeline and save Yi-Han's life, he wants to keep ignoring Jin-Woon's blatant feelings for him.



However, when Jin-Woon offers to help Ha-Yeon avoid the very cause of his problem, the two become entwined all over again…



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Kawaii dake ja Manzoku Dekinai
mangas.titleNative: 可愛いだけじゃ満足できない
mangas.description:
The spin-off story to Osananajimi ja Gaman dekinai!

Kouichirou, a college senior who likes to accept all comers, is invited to a gay bar where he meets Juri, a gay high school student. Despite his cute appearance, Juri has a cocky attitude, and they get into an argument the first time they meet. But Kouichirou is intrigued by Juri and begins to frequent the bar. One day, Kouichirou runs into Juri on the street, who seems to be feeling unwell, and takes him to a love hotel to take care of him...?

mangas.title: Tell Me Love Me
mangas.description:
When Hyun-Woo's reckless brother wrecks an expensive car, Hyun-Woo scrambles to find money to clean up the mess.
Jae-Yoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Sangunnimgwa Cheonnuneul
mangas.description:
Ecologist Nang Se-Hyeon discovers traces of poachers while conducting a bird watching in a deep mountain that she has been doing every year since late autumn. She expresses her concerns and suddenly encounters Kang Ji-Ah. Se-Hyeon mistakes Ji-Ah for a poacher and attacks her with pepper spray, but Ji-Ah claims that she is an official hunter who has received permission from the mountain owner to hunt harmful birds. However, he loses her pouch containing her permit and contact information after rolling down the mountain path, so there is no way to confirm her identity. Se-Hyeon becomes anxious, suspecting Ji-Ah's true identity. Since the mountain is far from a base station, cell phones do not work well, and it takes a whole day to get to a house, she cannot send Ji-Ah back immediately. In the end, Se-Hyeon decides to stay with Ji-Ah until she recovers while still being suspicious.
