Ji-Ah follows Se-Hyeon around as she continues to observe birds, and begins to show curiosity about her work.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

mangas.title: Good Hair & Bad Habits
mangas.description:
When he drinks, he ends up wailing in tears or kissing the first person he sees... Kai Hoshino is a terrible drunk.

When Kai decided to become a hairdresser, just like the man who changed his life, this newbie stylist finally lands a job at the same salon as his idol, Sena! Although Sena was sweet and kind to Kai when he was a customer, working-Sena is anything but! He is mean, orders Kai around, and is a total jerk. Talk about being disillusioned!

But before the shock even had time to settle, Kai is invited to a welcome party, where he meets his worst enemy...alcohol. Knowing his horrible drinking habits, Kai tries to avoid drinking too much, but nothing seems to go poor Kai's way.

When a tad too much alcohol leaves Kai a bumbling, rambling mess, Sena sees a new, much cuter side to the newbie. The heat turns up as the spice grows stronger...will Kai's bad habits send him deeper into even more trouble with this handsome hairdresser?

mangas.title: It's Strictly Business
mangas.synonyms: I'm Just in a Faux BL
mangas.description:
College boy Kiyo has one thing on his mind—girls, girls, girls! But after struggling for-EVER to get the ladies swooning over his every move, he figures he's gotta try a new trick. Enter his smolderingly sexy clubmate Issei…a stud muffin who'll act as the perfect foil for his Mr. Refreshing vibe. However, after being tragically friend-zoned by all the gals as their best gay buddy, he soon realizes he may be in over his head when it looks like Issei intends to turn faux into beau…



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Gal Joshi BL Anthology
mangas.titleNative: ギャル女子BLアンソロジー
mangas.description:
Cover Illustration: Same Zarame

1. Kikazaru Hina wa Mada Koi wo Shiranai: Bangai-hen (着飾るヒナはまだ恋を知らない 番外編) [Same Zarame]

2. Oji no Shin-chan (叔父の慎ちゃん) [Zozo Hoshikura]

3. Oshi Couple Watching (推しカプウォッチング) [Roca Katou]

4. Love Happy ♡ Ganbare Amehiko! (らぶハピ♡がんばれ雨彦！) [Deko Yamano]

5. Onii-chan wa Yuzurenai (お兄ちゃんはゆずれない) [Kouji Setsu]

6. Oshi no Meinichi (推しの命日) [Nuis Bonno]

7. Osananajimi (おさななじみ) [Men Watanuki]

8. Ani ga Shinpai (兄が心配) [Hiyo]

9. Uchi Miru Kirakira (ウチ見るキラキラ) [Umako Hareya]

10. Yuusha to Maou to Gal (勇者と魔王とギャル) [Kana]

11. Runa no Daisuki na Hito (るなの大好きなひと) [Maiji]

mangas.title: The Sleeping Monster Forest
mangas.synonyms: Sleeping Beast of the Forbidden City | More Terrifying Than Ghosts
mangas.description: In a world where monsters appear and the climate changes rapidly, the only place that maintains the form of a nation is the 'Special City'. There is the infamous esper unit 'Baekgun' that is dispatched to kill monsters and absorb the outside population. Baekgun's esper Shin Hwa-Jin lives being ignored because of his origin and weak abilities. Then one day, when he hears that his twin brother, a guide, was exploited and killed by his teammates, he goes on a rampage, kills his team, and jumps off a cliff. However, when he opens his eyes, he is in the 'Library' village where he is hiding from the Special City. Shin Hwa-Jin, who lost his memory due to the shock of the jump, is saved by Tan, a man who leads the library. Tan, who lost his home and family in the Baekgun's attack, dislikes Shin Hwa-Jin who speaks the Special City dialect, but he gradually grows affectionate towards him as he loses his memory and acts innocently, naming him Hima. As he spends time with Tan and deepens his feelings and contact, Hima gradually regains his original abilities...

mangas.title: Deep Pivot
mangas.description: Luck has only been on Yeon-Woo's side twice in his life: when he and his brother were saved by an esper named Seo-Joon, and when he reunites with Seo-Joon as a 20-year-old guide. Unfortunately, Seo-Joon doesn't seem to remember saving Yeon-Woo. Not only does the older man see Yeon-Woo as a kid, but he also makes it clear that he doesn't want to get attached to any guide. However, there's no telling what'll happen when their sync rate is so high and Yeon-Woo has had a crush on Seo-Joon for years...

mangas.title: Low Fever
mangas.description:
Kwon Taejung, the youngest son of Taesung Group and a dominant alpha known for causing trouble, is sent to the redevelopment zone "Daram-dong" after sparking controversy with a road rage incident. His assignment is to complete the demolition quietly within three months and clear out the remaining residents.

The biggest obstacle in front of him is Yeon Leekyeom, the last resident of Daram-dong and an omega. Burdened by relocation fraud, his grandfather's hospital bills, and private loan debt, Leekyeom lives a precarious life under constant threat from thugs. When the documentary team behind Nightmare of the Demolition Village attempts to cover Leekyeom's story again, Taejung approaches him under false pretenses to prevent any report that could interfere with the project.

Leekyeom mistakes him for the new manager of a security team, and Taejung allows the misunderstanding to continue while offering calculated kindness for his own purposes. However, drawn in by Leekyeom's faint scent, Taejung begins to take an interest he never planned on having.

Though he approached him with hidden motives, even those motives begin to fade. Yeon Leekyeom, who is sick and tired of Taejung, the "thug", yet cannot help but crumble in front of the gentleness he shows, finds himself drawn closer day by day…

mangas.title: Muchaegim
mangas.description:
Kidnapped by an unfamiliar organization, Yeo-Woon is subjected to brutal torture under the pretext of interrogation. The one who rescues him is a murderous man, Gun-Hyeok, who appears to be part of the organization. Feeling responsible for Yeo-Woon's plight, Gun-Hyeok disobeys orders from his superiors to kill him. Traumatized, Yeo-Woon, physically and mentally exhausted, begins to open up to Gun-Hyeok's care...

"My dear, Yeo-Woon. You're dead. If you're scared and want to give up, leave it to me. I'll save you."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Nemuri Otoko to Koi Otoko
mangas.description:
1-2. Nemuri Otoko to Koi Otoko (眠り男と恋男, A sleeping man and a loving man)

Jude and Royce have been long-term business partners and housemates. Things were going well for the platonic life partners, one of whom is openly gay while the other is straight; that is until a mysterious sleeping disease befalls Royce...


3. Yasashii Dinner (優しいディナー, Sweet dinner)

Chef Kirino reconditions Aoi-kun, whose issues with food began during a previous relationship.


4. Yoru wo Nigeru (夜を逃げる, Run from the night)

Afraid of the dark and afraid of attachments, Haru has emotional scars from childhood trauma. When his relationship with Hugo starts to turn into something more than just sex, Haru is conflicted.


5. Taiyou to Himitsu (太陽と秘密, Sun and secrets)

Kaito has an intense affair with Cody one summer, and feels betrayed when Cody suddenly announces he's returning to his family. But now Cody is back, and wants to pick up where they left off.


6. Matsu Hana (待つ花, A waiting flower)

"A sacred place, a forbidden deed. Such a thing, though I understand that it is not allowed."


7. Nemuri Otoko to Koi Sonogo (眠り男と恋男ーその後, A sleeping man and a loving man -epilogue-)
Royce goes out of town on his own, forgetting something important.

mangas.title: The Zombie and the Vampire
mangas.description:
The silly zombie Lord who enjoyed peeling garlic fell in love with a dummy-sweet vampire who hates garlic the most. And their biggest habit is lying next to each other in a coffin? This sweet romance will brighten up your world!


(Source: Webnovel)

mangas.title: Majimak Zombie
mangas.description:
Da-Jeong has lived with Dr. Lee Seh-Yeon for as long as he can remember, but his memories are muddled and don't go back very far. All he knows for certain is that the doctor must give him an injection every day, his diet can only consist of raw meat, and he is forbidden from venturing outdoors. He is, in fact, the last surviving zombie from an outbreak that humanity managed to contain a decade ago, and was the product of an experiment that Dr. Lee managed to rescue him from before he could be disposed of. The doctor knows that he can't keep Da-Jeong hidden forever, just as he knows that Da-Jeong's questions about why he is "sick" will one day need to be answered. He slowly begins introducing Da-Jeong to the outside world, but things become more complicated when his undead patient begins to fall in love with him.



Notes:

Chapter count includes a prologue.

Winner of the third MrBlue Comic Contest.

mangas.title: 10 Years
mangas.synonyms: The Third Decade, Ten Years of Death
mangas.description: Death comes to Gwon Young by scent. Every ten years, the person Young loves most dies. Hoping to escape the curse, he moves away. But then he meets An Ji-Ho, a man who seems to be quietly waiting for the end of his own life. Their connection forms fast and deep, filling the emptiness they both carry. But with another ten-year mark approaching, Young can't shake the scent of death on the air.

mangas.title: Yeoreumsonyeonga
mangas.description:
33 years have passed since the world filled with zombies. However, a boy named Lee Ji-Seung, whose blood can heal zombies, appears. For this, he is worshiped as a guardian angel to his people. Ji-Seung, who admires the Zero era (when there were no zombies), is strangely attracted when he is near a man who has just been awakened from his dream and who goes by the name of Jeon Ho-Gyeong.



(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Sinhonbubu
mangas.description:
"How can it be this good?"


It's as if someone has messed with his head. One day, Yoon Sung-Hyun hears about a self-hypnosis app at work. Curious about the app that hypnotizes himself and helps him diet and improve his grades, he tries to download the app. However, surprisingly, the app is already installed on his phone, and when he runs the app, a shocking message pops up. [Content: Yoon Sung-Hyun goes to the mart with his wife to buy groceries and asks for sex] And countless similar message files pop up along with it. As soon as he sees the file, countless, absurd memories start to pop up in his head...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Finders Keepers
mangas.synonyms: Midnight Tag, Chaser in the Night
mangas.description: After his shaman grandfather passes away, Yoon Dam suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts—a gift he would rather not have. The only solution? The power of a goblin. Enter Lee Do-Han, who claims to be exactly that. But there's a catch: every time Do-Han tries to harm Yoon Dam, mysterious wounds appear on his own body instead. Intrigued by this bizarre connection, Do-Han proposes a deal: "Why not just let me be your tutor?" Bound by strange circumstances and their own hidden agendas, the two set off on a journey neither of them could have imagined…

mangas.title: Candy Yum Yum
mangas.description:
Childhood friends Do-Jin and Hyun-O end up at a group blind date, where they get heavily drunk and unexpectedly spend the night together. While Hyun-O clearly remembers what happened, Do-Jin seems to recall nothing... However, following this Do-Jin starts pursuing Hyun-O without hesitation.

Does he actually remember...?

mangas.title: Kiss wa Shita kedo Tomodachi da yo na!?
mangas.titleNative: キスはしたけど友達だよな！？
mangas.synonyms: We kissed, but we're still just friends, right!?
mangas.description:
Why is this guy so good at kissing…!??



Hinata and Hayato, two college students with a long history, are stuck living together in a cramped apartment. During a drinking game of King's Orders, at a party where they'd hoped to lose their virginity, the two are given a shocking command... a passionate kiss between guys!!



"It's all slippery inside his mouth...!" As Hinata suddenly slips in his tongue, Hayato desperately tries to catch his breath, but Hinata's gaze is deadly serious...!? Annoyed at being thrown off by Hinata, Hayato challenges him to a revenge match. But then, Hinata kisses him even more intensely than before...! From that night on, the two are left grappling with unfamiliar emotions. A side of each other they never knew, despite being together all this time. Is our relationship really so fragile that a single kiss could break it...!?



A reckless romantic comedy that starts with a steamy kiss!!



(Source: GOT Corporation, translated)

mangas.title: STARGAZER
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 53.

mangas.title: Alphega
mangas.description:
It really seems like the guy next door is a completely insane, crazy bastard.

Baek Gang-Hyeon, the fourth son of the chairman of the Baekcheong Group and its hidden successor, has one secret: he possesses a rare genetic trait—99% alpha characteristics and 1% omega. He has lived his whole life as an overwhelmingly dominant alpha, but then a storm named Kwon Hae-il enters his life.

"I think I'm gonna die from how much I like you, Baek Gang-Hyeon."

mangas.title: Night of London
mangas.description:
Martin Scofield's a lone werewolf who was born a highly breedable "snow." To avoid being used, he spent years on the run, taking odd jobs to survive. On the other hand, Daniel Sinclair was lovingly raised by two phantom vampires until a certain hunter killed them in cold blood and left him orphaned. When the two unknowingly reunite centuries later, Martin's mission to avoid love and Daniel's mission to avenge the only love he knew get sidelined as something much deeper develops between them.



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Rabbit Hole
mangas.description:
One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woon-Ha, the person I've quietly loved for years. At least… that's what I believed.


"Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn't…"


"If not me, then who were you expecting?"


Turns out, it wasn't Woon-Ha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko-San. Ko-San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he's pulling me into his chaos without even trying. Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko-San deliberately keeping me within arm's reach? One thing's for sure. Whatever this is, it's not going to be simple…and I can't even look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: D-Day 8 (D-8)
mangas.description:
Marketing team representative Lee Yu-Ju, who couldn't sleep and failed one project after another, slept with Hae-Sung from the sales team whom he met by chance at a drinking party, and slept so soundly that he was late in the morning..? After finding out that Hae-Sung's soft chest was the cause, Yu-Ju ends up using Hae-Sung as a means of treating her insomnia..

"Hae-Sung, be my pillow"

mangas.title: Poolside dream
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 58.

mangas.title: Macguffin
mangas.description:
"What kind of person do you think I am?"

"…A stranger."



Lee Su-Ha, who has been locked up in an unidentified facility for a long time, is dragged out by strangers one day. He meets a man and starts living with him, before discovering he himself is an Omega who was sold to an Alpha.



"Alright, be like that. Just know that what kind of person I become from now on is up to you."



He is concerned about the fact he has no heat cycle and is unable to conceive due to his abnormal physical condition, but the man doesn't seem to care that Lee Su-Ha is not fulfilling his role as an Omega.



"You hate it when I treat you kindly. That's why I'm doing my best to accomodate you."



What the man's true feelings are, the hatred he feels towards him, the feelings of déjà vu... Lee Su-Ha becomes more and more confused as the number of inexplicable things keeps increasing...



(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Same Difference
mangas.description: From their offices high in a corporate skyscraper, alpha males Ozaki and Tsuburaya make all the girls swoon. Ozaki's known for his irresistible pheromones, while Tsuburaya's a noble, worldly genius. But when these rivals end up in bed together, who will prove to be top dog? It's seme versus seme - and much more than pride's on the line!

mangas.title: Lasker Trap
mangas.synonyms: ラスカートラップ〜ためらうな、先手を打て〜
mangas.description:
Yun Su-Hyeon, the ace of the vampire hunter team. Traumatized by a childhood accident, Su-Hyeon is not only an outsider within the team, but even his teammates shun him.


"There we go again, you know?"


Then one day, the man Su-Hyeon, who insists on never sleeping with someone you've slept with twice, joins Alpha Team as his successor. And what's more, they have to live under the same roof?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Kiss the Scumbag
mangas.description:
Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin's was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Off The Record
mangas.description:
Kangjin, an unremarkable idol, seizes the chance to star alongside A-list actor, Heegwon, in a cliché-ridden cop movie. Though they start off on the wrong foot, when Kangjin's secret crush on a fellow group member is on the verge of being exposed, Kangjin is forced to beg Heegwon to pose as his lover.



(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: The Method Messiah
mangas.description:
Famous actor Kim Seong-Jae follows a suspicious man claiming to be his temporary manager, only to arrive at a remote village he escaped from at fifteen - the compound of a cult that once consumed his life. As Seong-Jae attempts to flee the place haunted by his past, a fatal mistake leaves the cult leader dead by his hand. Moments later, the followers arrive, forcing Seongjae into an irreversible decision to survive. Trapped on a stage where faith, violence, and performance blur, Seong-Jae realizes the man who led him here has been directing everything from the shadows. Once the cameras begin to roll, there is no cutting the scene short.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Nine to Nine
mangas.synonyms: ก้าวสู่รัก
mangas.description:
When your secret high school crush becomes your new boss, things can get complicated. Na-Min Kwon hasn't seen Mr. Jeong since that fateful day at school when he lost control. Does his new boss remember him? Hate him? Desire him? It can be hard to tell sometimes. But spending time together, from client dinners to business trips, just might shine a light on the truth—no matter how unexpected.


(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

mangas.title: Spring Is Coming
mangas.description:
He Wei lived a peaceful life in this border town with his good friend Wanjun. But suddenly two boys moved in from the big city who don't fit in: He Qiuzhan, the step-brother who caused He Wei to leave home, and Bai Lin, the childhood friend who had a crush on him. Their arrival will change He Wei's life forever, as all the secrets gradually emerge......



(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

mangas.title: Isipse
mangas.description:
Lee Hyo-Min, the very embodiment of debauchery, relying solely on his looks to secretly throw parties while his wife is away.
One morning, suffering from a hangover as usual, he encounters his new son, Choi Hyuk, for the first time in ages.
Just as he marveled at how quickly his child had grown, with this unfamiliar build and expression, Hyo-Min felt strange after drinking the water Hyuk offered him. Only then did Hyo-Min notice the unnatural glint in his son's eyes...


"I bought this because you drink this stuff often."


"It's only natural for a father to love his son."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Master, Please Leave a Mark
mangas.description:
What if your perfect boyfriend showed up at your front door? Not as a date, but as a delivery? Everyone else has an android to make their lives easier, but Ha-Joon can't afford it—he can barely afford to keep the loan sharks off his back! So, when his best friend drunkenly gifts him an unnecessarily hot and scarily powerful android, Ha-Joon feels obliged to sell it. But Ha-Joon needs a little love in his life and this android is committed to serving his every need.



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Outside the Door
mangas.description:
Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble. Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him.

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn't: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name. As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing.

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

mangas.title: Self-indulgent Vanilla
mangas.titleNative: ひとりよがりのバニラ
mangas.description:
Around campus, Ikuse is a notorious bookworm, focused solely on literature. Kazami, a master of none, simply wants to enjoy his college life. One day in the cafeteria they strike up a conversation and their friendship takes off. Kazami learns of Ikuse's interest in BDSM, and they begin to explore the fetish. Lost in pleasure, Ikuse blurts out his true desire, but he is turned down. Unable to face Kazami, Ikuse severs his ties with him. Years later, he still can't forget about him. Now, an editor, what sits on his desk is none other than Kazami's manuscript. Can Ikuse look beyond the past and nurture Kazami's talent as his editor? Can they move forward, or are they doomed to repeat the past?



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Death Defying Princess Creates a Yuri Harem to Survive
mangas.titleNative: 死に戻り王女は生き延びるために百合ハーレムを作ることにした
mangas.description:
As queen, Marie had it made: she spent her days in luxury and her nights bedding multiple beautiful women. Alas, her tyrannical ways eventually caused her downfall, and her people sent her to the guillotine. Yet when the blade drops down, Marie doesn't die. Instead, she wakes up one year in the past! Stuck in an endless loop, nothing she tries seems to change her fate. Her only chance of avoiding certain death is to win over the countless women who have it in for her…by seducing them one by one! A brand-new bawdy yuri comedy!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: From the Day I Gave Up on My One-Sided Love
mangas.synonyms: The Day I Forsook My Unrequited Love
mangas.description:
For 6 years, Seung-Chae has had a crush on his childhood friend's older brother, Yoo-Geon. However, after hearing that Yoo-Geon applied to a hospital in the countryside, Seung-Chae decides to give up his hopeless crush. That day, Yoo-Geon appears in Seung-Chae's dream. Seung-Chae thinks this is his last chance and attacks Yoo-Geon... This lewd dream, which seemed like it would end in one go, continued for over ten days.

But is this really a dream? Why does it keep feeling real?

mangas.title: Morbid Attachment
mangas.description:
"An Alpha being in love with another Alpha is taboo!", "Perverts", "You sick people!"...That's what people would say if they knew about the relationship between Ji Wang, a self-restrained Alpha actor, and Qi Boyan, a flamboyant actor and singer, who claims to be an Omega but secretly loves to dominate other Alphas. A mishap tore their relationship apart six years ago. But when fate puts them together again as co-stars in a popular movie, they are forced to face the burning temptation while resolving their past misunderstandings...



(Source: INKR, edited)

mangas.title: Koukyuu no Kemono wa Ai wo Haramu
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: DIE LOVE
mangas.description:
In-Woo has been liking Ha-Jun Kwak, who lives next door, since he was little. However, Ha-jun Kwak has a different vibe from In-Woo and is more popular, so they even play in different groups at school. The only connection between In-Woo and Ha-Jun is that they live next door. They were able to become friends because they lived next door, and their relationship continued, but once the college entrance exam is over and they become independent, this relationship will naturally end—In-Woo thinks so.

"I wish I could be a senior in high school my whole life."

"That crazy kid."

"Really… "

However, on the day of the college entrance exam, a sudden scream and the sound of someone running away echo through the previously quiet hallway…

mangas.title: Lengku de Wo
mangas.description:
As a zombie with memory loss, school life is still a must! While fighting with his instinctive hunger for humans, he also falls in love with his destined one. But it seems like not only does his lover know how he became a zombie, but he was also a schemer behind the scenes. In this SM danmei, the truth of the zombie gradually emerges.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)



Note: Includes a prologue.

mangas.title: Looks Like I'm His Number One
mangas.titleNative: どうやらアイツの一番は俺のようでして
mangas.description:
Everyone knows Natsuki Tachibana is handsome, has a great personality, and is popular with the ladies?including himself. His childhood friend Toshifumi Oda is right up the ranks with him, but Toshifumi consistently turns girls down by saying he's already in love with someone. Curious to know who it is, Natsuki challenges his circle of friends to a dare, and whoever loses has to ask him out. When he loses, he summons Toshifumi to the school roof to ask him out. But, when he starts to admit it's a joke, Toshifumi responds and says he loves him, too...!



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: Capture Target! You're OOC!
mangas.titleNative: 攻略对象！你人设歪了啊！
mangas.synonyms: Gonglüe Duixiang! Ni Ren She Waile a!
mangas.description:
"Why can't you like me…brother?"

"Don't call me brother, it's disgusting."

…So now that we're in a dating game, why is this non-capture target who looks like my brother always pestering me?!

mangas.title: The Drag-Queen Hasn't Gotten a Proposal Yet
mangas.titleNative: 女装大佬今天也没有被求婚
mangas.description:
Jin Chuan is transported into a love game while he is dying in real life. In order to have a second life, he has to date three men at the same time who are his boss, a straight guy who doesn't like him, his first crush who he thought was a girl back then, and his brother who hates him. During the difficult choices which might either blow his cover as a female or lead to having sex with a man, Jin Chuan gradually finds out that these men's feelings for him are not just about clearing missions in the game...


(Source: Webnovel)


Note: Chapter count includes 12 extras.

mangas.title: Tuzi Buxiang he Ni Shuoha
mangas.synonyms: Rabbit Doesn't Want to Talk to You
mangas.description: A die-hard fan of a game climbed into the Boss's bed through a guide.

mangas.title: Yes, No, or Maybe?
mangas.titleNative: イエスかノーか半分か
mangas.synonyms: Yes ka No ka Hanbun ka
mangas.description: Kunieda Kei is a popular TV announcer known for being a cool and flawless professional. But on the inside, he's the opposite: brash, hot-tempered, and as prickly as can be. Still, Kei juggles his private and professional personas successfully until one day, the unthinkable happens: stop-motion animator Tsuzuki Ushio from work sees him at the grocery store with his real personality on display! Now Kei has to figure out how to navigate a relationship he didn't expect. But is that really as scary as the possibility that someone might love both sides of him?

mangas.title: Seichoutsuu
mangas.description: Note: Includes the one-shots "Hone to Kawa to ga Hanareru Oto (ほねとかわとがはなれるおと)" and "mouth to mouse", and one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Raw
mangas.description:
Kang Tae-Hwa's first crush came to him like a fever. And ten years later, that fever is still running high when he reunites with his once privileged and untouchable love, Moon Cheong-Hyeon. But the tables have turned now, as Tae-Hwa has gone from being a poor street kid to the gangster boss of his own money-lending business, and Cheong-Hyeon is his latest customer. Cheong-Hyeon knows the violent and foulmouthed Tae-Hwa is no good for him, but he is drawn back to him anyway. And hearing this, Tae-Hwa becomes determined not to lose his first love a second time...



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Mint Candy Love
mangas.description: At first glance, Yeong-Han seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he's actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeong-Han is displeased, and Yae-Joon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other's walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

mangas.title: I Was the Final Boss
mangas.synonyms: I Used to Be a Boss
mangas.description: Baphomet is the ruthless, dispassionate lord of the Abyssal Tower, a mysterious, monster-filled dungeon plaguing the human world. Many Hunters seek to defeat him and bring the tower down to no avail. Despite his demonic power, Baphomet grows curious about humanity. One day, Baphomet is defeated by Raven, the strongest Hunter, and realizes that his true wish is to be just like the humans he previously looked down on. In death, he is granted his wish, as he awakens as a human – without his powers!

mangas.title: Helseureul hapsida!
mangas.description:
Min-Woo, who has a complex about not having any muscles on his body, enrolls in a men-only gym. Min-Woo, who believes that if he follows the gym's "special program," he will build muscles like the trainers. He tries to get used to developing his butthole...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: This Darling Man has a Fastidiously Strong Love! ~The Man of My Dreams is Obsessed with Me!?~
mangas.titleNative: このスパダリ、とびきり愛が重い！～理想の男は執着ヤバめ!?
mangas.synonyms: 這位完美男神的愛極其沉重！～理想的男人竟然是偏執男！？
mangas.description:
University student Sakura wants love, but always ends up being a friend with benefits… That's when Mama from the gay bar introduces him to a sexy man holding red roses called Yonezawa! Whispering loving words like a skilled escort, Sakura's completely smitten on this date of his dreams. Before he realized, his body's melting under the sweet kisses and long fingers…! "We're lovers now, aren't we?" Does he finally have the man of his dreams!? This is a love story between a perfect man who's madly in love and a university student who's terrible at romance!



(Source: Mobile Media Research)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Sweetest Man
mangas.description:
My friend of 15 years Hyung-Woo has always been secretive about things. But one hazy night, he's bitten my lips because... he was a vampire all along! "I'm a vampire and now... so are you!" Why do I suddenly feel... thirsty?



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Thanatos
mangas.description:
Unable to endure the abuse at his orphanage, Tae-Ju murders the director and flees with nothing. Desperate to end his life, he stumbles upon a church of the Hwasin Faith to confess his sins before dying. It is there that Tae-Ju discovers his true identity: a god of death. In his new life as a god, Tae-Ju is joined by Jeong-Hu, a god-hating elder of Hwasin. Together, they navigate their complex destinies and unravel the mysteries of their divine roles.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Legal Drug
mangas.description: A drugstore that deals in medicine ... and danger! Kazahaya Kudo has a gift. When he touches a person or an object, he sees visions. With no money and no place to stay, Kazahaya was out of luck until fate brought him to the Green Drug pharmacy. Now, in exchange for working in the store, he gets room and board. But in order to make ends meet there's a catch ... he must take on 'special' assignments from his boss that can only be handled by someone with Kazahaya's gift. With the help of his co-worker and roommate Rikuo, who has unusual powers of his own, Kazahaya finds himself on missions most surreal.

mangas.title: Pinang
mangas.description:
Deadly enemies join forces to solve a case.



In Meng Zhao's eyes, Lu Shichen in the past looked like a paper sack wrapped in skin, looking calm from a distance but terrifying up close. So, at that time, everyone was chasing Lu Shichen, but Meng Zhao found him so fake that he hated him. Meng Zhao never expected that one day he would be able to meet Lu Shichen, and even less that he would become the prime suspect in a murder case... And it turns out that the person who is in charge of resolving this case is none other than Detective Meng Zhao.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: The Keystone Romantic Combination
mangas.description:
"Wholesome Romantic Comedy Of The Baseball Genius And The Baseball Mediocre!"



Youngjun's life's been all about comparing himself with the Baseball Genius, Hyun; who totally set the standards for Yongjun's baseball life 7 years ago.
Youngjun hated him just a few encounters after. Insecurities were too strong to beat, and it was easier to doubt Hyun's kindness and push it away. Hyun has never lived a mediocre life, and that was enough reason to hate.
Although this time, Youngjun can't take his eyes off of him, and Hyun has never left. After all, they are the Keystone Romantic Combo.

mangas.title: Hosaka-san to Miyoshi-kun
mangas.description:
Miyoshi has been hit on by the older Hosaka, and he liked this fluffy relationship. However, on the Christmas night just before the university entrance exam, when presented with the spare key and asked by Hosaka, "Will you come live with me when you become a university student?" Miyoshi suddenly suffered from various anxieties and lost contact with Hosaka. And eight months later, the two met again...?!



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Hanger
mangas.description: In Neo-Tokyo, crime is rising rapidly in the wake of a new generation of super-drugs capable of enhancing the user's physical and mental abilities. Hajime Tsukomo is a new recruit on a federal task force trained to go after these powered-up criminals. Now he must team up with Zeroichi, a so-called Hanger looking to reduce his own jail sentence in exchange for helping to take down these chemically-boosted bad guys.

mangas.title: Laughter in the Sunshine
mangas.titleNative: 太陽はひだまりと笑う
mangas.description:
Taiyo Kiriyama knew he wasn't allowed to have pets in his apartment. But when he comes across an abandoned cat, he can't help but try to smuggle the sweet creature in! Unfortunately, he's immediately caught by the building manager, Asahi Taira. After Taiyo begs, Asahi agrees to let him keep the cat for a month while he finds it a home—but in exchange, Taiyo will have to become Asahi's errand boy.



It's not an easy gig, but after getting to know Asahi, Taiyo finds that the other man has a hidden charm and begins to enjoy the time they spend together. While Taiyo's feelings for Asahi begin to grow, he soon learns that Asahi is in love with someone already. Can he help Asahi find his happiness and love, or will Taiyo's own emotions get in the way?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Includes two chapters of "Higashi Mado no Omukai-san (東窓のお向かいさん)" and one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Genius Puppeteer Loves the Holy Knight Fiercely
mangas.description:
As a high-ranking general captured after the end of a war, the Holy Knight Gilbert braces for execution... when at the last moment, his life is saved by Chris, the enemy nation's master artificer and puppeteer. An arrogant, wickedly playful man who surrounds himself only with dolls of his own making, Chris claims to admire the beauty of Gilbert's soul and intends to use him to create his newest masterpiece.



When Gilbert refuses to go along with Chris's plan, he is forced to choose between certain death and forsaking his faith to become an immortal doll. Hoping to buy enough time to make his escape, Gilbert instead offers himself up to Chris as a slave. But if that's the game this knight wishes to play, then Chris fully intends on toying with him until Gilbert breaks to his will...



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, His Rival?!
mangas.titleNative: 当て馬キャラのくせして、スパダリ王子に寵愛されています。
mangas.description:
"I've always...wanted to touch you."



The dashing prince meets me, the loser rival love interest. Although we should be fighting over the heroine...why does the prince have his sights set on me?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Such a Good Boy
mangas.description:
"You told me to remember your scent wherever I go, so I did. You still smell sweet."

In childhood, Hee-Won had treated Gun-Woo like a pet dog. Now after years of separation, Gun-Woo has reappeared as a subordinate in Hee-Won's company. But no matter how fiercely he's pushed away, Gun-Woo lingers like a puppy with gentle eyes.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Ookami-kun wa Yuzuranai
mangas.titleNative: オオカミくんはゆずらない
mangas.description:
Usami Kuroto and Hosaki Shiro went to the same university. Seeing Shiro working hard to become a teacher, Usami was intrigued and joined the film club to find out what he wanted to do. However, Shiro is wary of Inuzuka Nao, the club's only carnivorous senior, and so he decides to come along to summer camp. While Usami is annoyed by Shiro's worrywart nature, he is bothered by Inuzuka's concern for Shiro... Also included is an overnight trip with Shishido and Shiba, and an episode about Usami and Shiro as working adults.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: How the Broken Love
mangas.description:
After discovering he's an omega, Yoontae runs away when his mother tries to pimp him out. A seemingly kind man offers him food and shelter—then abuses him. With nowhere else to go, Yoontae ends up in the very life he tried to escape, trading sex for survival. He convinces himself love can be bought or borrowed, until an abusive relationship leaves him broken once more. When his ex attacks him in public, a stranger named Wooseok steps in. Is this the start of something real—or just another trap?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Sissy
mangas.description:
Obsessive playboy x Gentle cutie.



Ever since he was little, Li Chengxiu has faced all the difficulties life could offer, when he just wanted to be loved. Shao Qun is the heir of a wealthy family. His boisterous and unruly personality was at its worst during his high school years. From curiosity to bullying, then becoming attraction. It was the wrong time for these awkward feelings, only destined to hurt each other. They thought they'd left it behind and moved on. But when they meet again, will their encounter be the beginning of happiness or the continuation of pain?



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

mangas.title: I Can I do
mangas.synonyms: I Can Do It!, I Travel So That I Come
mangas.description:
At just seventeen, blue-haired streamer Jian Rong, alias Soft, had already built a name for himself with his amazing mechanics and even sharper tongue. He’s roasted nearly every pro in the scene… except for one, and if someone so much as says one bad word about them in his stream, he makes sure to drop down the ban hammer without hesitation.
That person was Road, the legendary jungler and calm-faced ace of China’s top LoL team, as well as Jian Rong’s longtime secret idol.
One day, a random email flipped Jian Rong’s world upside down, and he suddenly found himself standing on the center stage, shoulder to shoulder with Road.
And while he remained that trash-talking gaming prodigy who wowed esports fans everywhere, another side of him came out just in front of his idol. That swagger melted away, replaced with flushed cheeks. He said, “I won’t run my mouth again. I promise…”

mangas.title: Twice Upon a Time
mangas.description:
A once-glorious life ends in betrayal, and a desperate wish is granted. Waking up in the present, Song Si-Woo finds himself thrust into an unfamiliar world seemingly filled with echoes of his past. Whilst he soon discovers that fate still binds him to old friends, bitter enemies, and a beloved lover, nothing is as it seems—especially when reincarnation plays tricks with gender! Can he navigate these renewed connections and unravel the mysteries of his twice upon a time...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Yahadeon Sai
mangas.description:
Lee Chan, who started living with his best friend Ban Hwi-Seo on the condition that he watch over his sleepwalking. At night, Hwi-Seo calls himself Do Yu-Shin and lusts after his body, causing Lee Chan to fall into a confusing yet stimulating relationship...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: My Brother's Lover
mangas.description:
Jin-Ha meets his deceased brother's former roommate and lover, Won, at his brother's funeral, and falls for him instantly. Despite Jin-Ha's estranged relationship with his brother, he and Won share a passionate moment and embark on a romantic relationship. Won becomes Jin-Ha's only escape from the tragedy surrounding him. However, Won's charming demeanor begins to crack and reveals his possessiveness and manipulation, which seep into every aspect of Jin-Ha's life. As their relationship intensifies, Jin-Ha will have to face the reality of Won's dark side, or he might find himself trapped in something much more poisonous than he ever imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: Hard-Boiled Love
mangas.description:
When ex-mercenary Gyuwon Kim returns to Korea after his retirement, he has just one goal in mind: earn enough money to get plastic surgery. While having a face that is capable of making even a grown man cry in fear came in handy as a mercenary, what Gyuwon really wants is to be the one crying himself at the hands of a ruthless master. The perfect opportunity comes when Gyuwon is hired as a bodyguard to protect the precious youngest son of the Yoon Clan, Hwayoung Yoon, from a recent stalker. Unbeknownst to Gyuwon, hidden behind Hwayoung's pretty face is actually a sadistic dom who already has plans to make the vicious-looking man his new pet.



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Keyaki Shopping District's Sakura Bathhouse
mangas.titleNative: けやき商店街 桜ノ湯
mangas.description:
Tatsumi Azuma, a sociable third-year student at Keyaki High School, crashes into second-year Shunpei Eguchi and fractures his hand. But the stone-faced Shunpei is no ordinary student—rumor has it he'll kill anyone who so much as looks him in the eye! Afraid of retaliation, Tatsumi tells Shunpei he'll do anything to make up for his blunder. Thus, Shunpei puts him to work by making him help out at his family's bathhouse, Sakura-no-yu!



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: The Blurred Lines Between Us
mangas.synonyms: รักนี้ไม่สนกรอบ
mangas.description:
With a perfect older brother, Yim Ju-Hyeong's inferiority complex has always driven him to be better than other people. Everything goes well until a new transfer student named Yim Se-On shows up. Despite being superior to Ju-Hyeong in every single way, Se-On, for some mysterious reason, seems intent on devoting himself to taking care of Ju-Hyeong. Even though Ju-Hyeong should hate it, he doesn't understand why he can't push Se-On away.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)


Note: Includes three extra chapters.

mangas.title: The Boss in the Bedroom
mangas.description:
Director Gu, leader of Sales team 3 at Yeong-rong Corporation, is very adamant about keeping his personal life and his private life separate. At the office, he's a notoriously no-nonsense boss who can't stand sloppy work, especially from employees who got into the company using personal connections. When he's off the clock, he becomes Yeong-Jo; the college aged, regular customer at S&M lounge bar who loves being degraded and abused in the bedroom. On a night out, he hooks up with an alluring, extremely wealthy party boy who turns out to have sadistic sexual tendencies. After thoroughly enjoying a night filled with pain and pleasure, he returns to work the next day to find a nightmare situation awaiting him. Who knew the sales team 3 latest recruit would be the company CEO's son. And to make matters worse, he's the same man from the night before who had Yeong-Jo crying out and moaning the word "hyung…"

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Mata ne, Kamisama
mangas.description:
Ryo is in love with his beautiful classmate Kotaro. The two gradually become closer, but one day Ryo hears a rumor about Kotaro's family from a classmate. When Ryo visits Kotaro's house, he sees Kotaro offering his body in a "ritual".



(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

mangas.title: Kudaranakute, Kirei de.
mangas.description:
Juri and Hana have been best friends since university. Lately, it feels like their relationship is slightly off...!?



(Source: Mystery Bonita, translated)

mangas.title: Kimi wa Natsu no Naka
mangas.synonyms: 君は夏のなか 小冊子
mangas.description:
Originally released as a booklet bundled with the first limited edition release of Kimi wa Natsu no Naka. Contains two bonus stories:



1. Kimi to Natsu no Ato (君と夏のあと, After My Summer of You)

2. Kimi to Kimi (君と君, You and You)

mangas.title: Dead Core
mangas.description: Once a rising star in the popular band Rookie, Connie suddenly vanished from the spotlight after a fellow member stole one of his songs. He quit the band without explanation and disappeared from the public eye. Five years later, after constant persuasion from his longtime fan Louie, Connie reluctantly joins a band at his college called Dead Core, and instantly becomes the talk of campus. But things get complicated when his mysterious roommate Mika, who seems oddly familiar, begins inserting himself into Connie's life. From day one, Mika insists they'd make the perfect graduation project partners…and he's not taking no for an answer.

mangas.title: Alpha, Disqualified
mangas.description: In a society where only alphas and omegas matter, beta Kim Min-Jun has spent his life being overlooked. Everything changes when elite alpha Bae Yu-Ri, desperate to escape his role, asks Min-Jun to act as his stand-in. What begins as a simple business arrangement slowly turns intoxicating, as Min-Jun discovers how it feels to be the one giving orders and Yu-Ri finds himself responding like the omega he always wished he could be. In a world with such strict social hierarchies, can they resist the pull of a desire that breaks every rule?

mangas.title: Codename: GHOST
mangas.description: In a world with supernatural abilities, those with powers can be registered as "special humans" and are assigned missions shrouded in mystery. Hoyeon, one such person, lives a seemingly ordinary life as a college student while keeping his powers a secret from those around him. When he begins a new job as a tutor at the Special Human Resource Administration, he meets Moonsung, an agent who just so happens to be taking his class. A simple teacher-student relationship, there's nothing more to it - that is, until a single touch from Moonsung causes Hoyeon's powers to spiral out of control. As their connection deepens, Moonsung soon realizes there's more to his tutor than meets the eye…but will he be able to unravel the mystery of the connection between the two of them?

mangas.title: Ryuu Ou Heika to Tensei Hanayome
Motoyan Papa ni Koishite imasu
mangas.titleNative: 元ヤンパパに恋しています

mangas.title: Koori no Yuusha wa Koi ni Naku
mangas.synonyms: The Icy Hero is Yearning for Love
mangas.description: The tavern owner's son, Ilya, often experienced the same dream. A dream in which he played in the village orphanage with his childhood friend, a boy whose appearance resembled an angel's. A dream where he made soap with olives and soup with leftover vegetables. But the moment Ilya laid eyes on the picture of the "Icy Hero," he realized that those dreams weren't dreams at all; rather those were the memories of his past life. Most importantly, that "Icy Hero," Riley, wasn't angelic anymore?!

mangas.title: Pitter-Patter
mangas.description:
As old feelings resurface and tension builds, the path to a reunion seems possible—but it won't come without its challenges.

(Source: Lalatoon)

mangas.title: Revolutionary Girl Utena
mangas.description:
Utena Tenjou had a tragic childhood - her parents died when she was young, and she almost drowned, had it not been for her prince who came and rescued her. Because of the impact this prince had on her life, Utena strives to be just like him - to grow up to be a prince, not a princess, and to spread nobility, ultimately finding her prince and bringing revolution.



(Source: Anime News Network)

mangas.title: The Importance of Good-byes and Welcoming Someone Home -Won't You Teach Me About Love?
mangas.titleNative: さよならおかえり愛しさに―恋について、教えてくれないか―
mangas.synonyms: Sayonara Okaeri Itoshisa ni - Koi ni Tsuite, Oshiete Kurenai ka
mangas.description: Sosuke is down in the dumps after suddenly being cast aside by his girlfriend. As he drinks his sorrows away in a bar, Tsukasa, an attractive bartender, agrees to watch over him for the night. Back at Tsukasa's place, a drunk Sosuke begs Tsukasa to give him some love advice. However, nothing could've prepared him for the response he's about to get... What's gonna happen to this straight guy who's clueless about love when he meets a charming bartender? A love story featuring a versatile couple with a big age gap.

mangas.title: Psychedelia
mangas.description: Mizoshiri Shohei has just been assigned to the organized crime division and has already developed a crush on his senpai, experienced detective Hino Toranosuke. But when Hino gets shot, Mizo feels responsible and decides to take drastic measures.

mangas.title: The High School Life of a Fudanshi
mangas.description:
Ryo Sakaguchi has a deep, dark secret: he's a fudanshi—a boy obsessed with BL. While he has trouble understanding how others don't find the same bliss he does from his unusual hobbies, that doesn't make it any easier for Ryo to buy his precious manga from the "girls" section of the store, or any simpler explaining the world of boys' love, shipping wars, and doujinshi circles to his best friend Nakamura. Will Ryo find other fanboys to share his hobby with, or is he doomed to sit alone on his throne of BL romance?


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: HEALING PARADOX deeper
mangas.titleNative: ヒーリングパラドックス deeper
mangas.description:
Kazuma's obsessive love now dives even deeper into Naoto. If they are in an ambiguous relationship without words, is it just a friendship of benefit? Naoto does not know how to describe his relationship with Kazuma, but he continues to have love affairs with him. Kazuma wants him more and more. When he discovers that Yokota, a cameraman, accidentally touches Naoto's chest while they are making an advertisement, Kazuma's obsessive love intensifies even more and starts to overflow...



(Source: Takeshobo)



Notes:

- Volume 2 includes "#Junjou to wa (＃純情とは, #Pure Love is...)" from the self-published manga "Ijou ga Nichijou (異常が日常, Unusual Becomes Normal)".

- Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Sonna ni Iu nara Daiteyaru
mangas.titleNative: そんなに言うなら抱いてやる
mangas.synonyms: そんなに言うなら抱いてやる【20P小冊子】
mangas.description: Includes exclusive comics originally bundled as bookstore bonuses for the paperback release.

mangas.title: Naui Gyeongchal Ajeossi
mangas.description:
"Mister... It's me, mister..."


Jae-Hyuk, the police officer in charge of her parents' hit-and-run accident, came to see 10-year-old Eugene, and 15 years have passed since Jin began to rely on Jae-Hyuk. Eugene often shows excessive affection to Jae-Hyuk as his heart grows, but Jae-Hyuk feels uncomfortable because he thinks that he shouldn't be like that. One day, when he opens the front door to the sound of a knock, a drunk Eugene suddenly attacks Jae-Hyuk...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Youyou Koizakura
mangas.description:
Tadaomi, a demon exorcist, is reunited with Outarou, a demon he has been searching for since he first met him as a child. Outarou coldly rejects him, but he begs him to have sex with him for just once...? A reunion love between a tsundere demon and a devious demon exorcist.



(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

mangas.title: Pieces of Us
mangas.description:
The simplest of choices can shape our lives forever. Returning to college after a break, Kwon Yoonho decides to take a pottery class. But what he doesn't know is that his instructor will be Lee Suyeon: a professor with a reputation for favoritism whom all the students go out of their way to avoid. Yet from the moment Yoonho lays eyes on his new teacher, he recognizes the same quality of isolation and solemnity that has been ever-present in his own life. The two begin to mold a deeper connection as their lives become intertwined; but when Suyeon's ex-boyfriend – and first love – Choi Gyeol makes a sudden appearance, an unbridled sense of jealousy and possessiveness becomes impossible for Yoonho to ignore. Will this unexpected interruption cause the foundations of their love to shatter? And if it does, who will be left to pick up the pieces...?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes five extra chapters.

mangas.title: Thigh High: Reiwa Hanamaru Academy
mangas.description:
The hunks at Hanamaru Academy are putting the boot (and booty!) to expectations. Instead of wearing drab blazers, these studs are obsessed with the length of their skirts and the size of their chests as they try to navigate high school. This high-energy comedy takes being cute and being cut to a whole new level!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Includes 2 bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Killer-wa Yeogosaeng, Geurigo Gae
mangas.description:
Su-Ji, the loyal dog of the Sedo Group and a promising top killer, has changed owners. The new owner demands something unimaginable from Su-Ji...

(Source: Naver, translated)

mangas.title: Stigmata
mangas.description:
Stigmata—bodily scars that appear on the same places where Christ was wounded. Rescued from his old village that underwent a terrible massacre of the residents, Sion suffers from memory loss. It seems Sion's troubles have come to an end now, with him living his days out peacefully as an apprentice priest. But things take another turn when he's accused wrongly of taking something from "the Holy King" Siennas Del Mayee, and dies a gruesome death...only to be reborn in the body of the king himself. Now Sion must navigate his way through living as royalty with only Pavel at his side, the very handsome but rather untrustworthy high priest...



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Until I Love Myself: The Journey of a Nonbinary Manga Artist
mangas.synonyms: I want to say I love me
mangas.description:
A bravely blunt autobiography about confronting the tangled traumas of gender dysphoria and workplace sexual harassment.



Nonbinary manga artist Poppy Pesuyama is excited when forms offer the option to choose "neither" for gender and thrilled about their new job working as an assistant for mangaka X! But then he sexually harasses them, treating them first like a girl and then like something less than human. It only lasts a few months, but in some ways it never ends.



Born into a body they hate and still reeling from the abuse they faced seven years ago, Pesuyama begins to rail at their past, their friends, and even their mother as they try to come to terms with who they are and what happened to them.



(Source: VIZ Media)

mangas.title: Love Nest 2nd
mangas.description:
Masato, once bitter and alone, used to spend his time wreaking havoc on other people's happy relationships. But now he's too busy being a homemaker with his roommate-turned-lover, Asahi. Unfortunately, their secret relationship seems to have secrets of its own, and Masato just might find himself missing the predictability of single life.



Masato and Asahi went from odd-couple roommates to live-in lovers and are now enjoying their honeymoon phase to its fullest. But Masato can't help but feel frustrated that he's unable to share with his family and friends that Asahi is his special someone. And Asahi isn't helping matters by acting so suspiciously! Just where is he sneaking off to?!



(Source: SuBLime)

mangas.title: CHATTERBOX
mangas.description:
Seo-Wu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yi-Jin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet… they talk far too easily.

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

mangas.title: Special Effects Pheromone
mangas.synonyms: Extra Concentrated Pheromone | Te Nong Xinxi Su
mangas.description: You Zhao, OMEGA, rose-like appearance, hot pepper-like personality, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives himself an injection when he is in heat. Qu Jing, ALPHA, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives an injection to anyone who is in heat. You Zhao and Qu Jing, usually spend 99% of their time and energy on work, not love but money. Until one day, they got married.

mangas.title: Not for the Faint of Heart
mangas.description: Joo Sungwan is working as a fake ghost in order to pay back for a broken laptop, but instead of scaring customers, Sungwan is the one being scared! Even worse, there's an actual ghost living in the haunted house?! With his job on the line, Sungwan ends up in a dating contract with the ghost — in exchange for the ghost scaring visitors, Sungwan must give him three wishes and be his boyfriend.

mangas.title: Paid to Fondle
mangas.titleNative: 富豪のたわわに甘えるお仕事
mangas.description:
"Are you tired? Want to massage my chest?"



A wealthy oil magnate discoves an unexpected treasure--his chest?! Shams, the heir to an oil empire, decides to broaden his horizens by studying abroad in Japan. He hires Taiyo, a struggling student, to be his caretaker. However, Sham finds himsef captivated by Taiyo's radiant smile, which glimmers like an oasis. Feelings gush forth like an oil field! That is when Shams learns that his chest has the power to heal and bring fortune…! Thus begins the heartwarming tale of a pure-hearted billioniare and a hardworking troubled young man! With Shams's caramel-toned skin, huge chest, and unwavering love, both heart and loins are on the verge of exploding!!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: Bloodbound
mangas.description:
"Fabian is a seemingly ordinary man who suddenly manifests abilities as an Esper one day. On top of dealing with his newfound powers, he must deal with Konrad: his S-class guide who treats him with an unusual level of care and attention. Initially confused, Fabian finds Konrad's purpose for openly treating Fabian with such benevolence is to take advantage of his S-class abilities, his healthy body, and... blood?!

"Yours is the best I've ever tasted."

Can Fabian defend himself against a guide who wants both his body, his brawn, and his blood?"

mangas.title: My Demon Boss, Mr. Gokudera, Wants To Be Exposed!
mangas.titleNative: 鬼上司・獄寺さんは暴かれたい。
mangas.synonyms: My Demon Boss Gokudera Wants to Be Exposed
mangas.description:
Shouji's new boss is a merciless beast. He might be great for the bottom line, but he's definitely done a number on Shouji's work-life balance - and his love life! One fateful weekend, Shouji sees his fearsome boss, Mr. Gokudera, in the flesh, coming out of a women's lingerie store. Recently heartbroken, Shouji thinks it's unfair that his boss gets to have a girlfriend - but is all that lingerie really for someone else?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: A Strategic Partnership
mangas.description: Omega Taekwondo star Tae-Hyun must find a "partner" before his final Olympics to help control his hormone levels. That partner is none other than Se-Jin, a fencer he took care of 4 years ago. As their relationship continues to develop in unexpected ways, can he break his jinx and finally win gold?

mangas.title: 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40
mangas.synonyms: Yonjuu Made ni Shitai Juu no Koto
mangas.description: Suzume Tojou is just three months away from turning forty and realizes there's so much he hasn't done with his life! So, he makes a plan: create a private list of things he's always wanted to do and check them off before turning the big four-oh. It's a rather simple list, filled with goals that should be easy to accomplish, like a takoyaki party, enjoying a parfait out in a café, and spending his birthday with a lover. Except, that last one comes with a major problem—Tojou hasn't had a lover in ten years! But when Keishi Tanaka, Tojou's handsome junior at the company, discovers the secret list, he's determined to help Tojou check off every single item—starting with the "lover" part!

mangas.title: Single Not Ready to Mingle
mangas.synonyms: 非婚主義ですが！？～本格異世界性戦～
mangas.description:
Once upon a time, in a land far away…lived the ordinary and painfully single high school literature teacher, Bu Taekwon. Ordinary, that is, until he found himself transported into one of his students' comic books. But this wasn't your typical comic book adventure, and Taekwon never anticipated the unconventional genre awaiting him. To his despair, he was now trapped in a hardcore BL fantasy world, where sex-crazed maniacs - dudes no less! - were ready to enact unspeakable acts upon him. The last thing the forever-single Taekwon desired was to…mingle with the men of this insane realm. But can he really manage to fend off their advances and safeguard his virginity?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Shoot for the Stars
mangas.description:
Falling star to superstar!



Forced to give up on his dream of becoming an idol, Yoo-Sung laments having to spend the rest of his days working as his crush's manager. That is, until he wakes up as a trainee! How did he go back to the past? What are these mysterious skill bars only he can see? Could they be the key to success?



(Source: Manta)


Note: Includes 25 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Iroiro Tsurezure
mangas.description: A manga essay about Sakae Kusama's work mixed with a classical BL office romance.

mangas.title: Isabella Sunyeoui Siljong
mangas.description:
Recently, rumors have been circulating that the nuns are being seduced by the demon. Isabella, who has been living a devout life of faith, has never had difficulty maintaining her chastity until she became a nun, so she considers those who are swayed by the demon's temptation foolish. However, the demon notices the desire hidden deep inside Isabella. That night, Isabella's fellow nun Marianne suddenly comes to visit and confesses her feelings and kisses Isabella. Isabella, for some reason, cannot push Marianne away…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

mangas.title: Yuki, I love you!
mangas.synonyms: ぼくらはずっとあの頃のまま
mangas.description:
Haru and Yuki, two childhood friends turned lovers, now share their lives under the same roof. They've been inseparable since they met, and their love for each other knows no bounds. Haru, a big softy, often tries to show off a cooler side to impress Yuki but always ends up fumbling in the most endearing ways. Yuki, however, adores Haru just as he is and knows exactly how cool he can be. Despite their blissful relationship, Yuki begins to worry about their future and how they fit into society's expectations. Together, they embark on a tender journey of love and self-discovery, finding the courage in each other to build a future filled with joy and acceptance.



(Source: MangaPlaza)



Notes:

- Originally self-published on Pixiv under the title "Kawaii Seme to Otokomae Uke no Osananajimi BL (かわいい攻めと男前受けの幼馴染BL)" later changed to "Bokura wa Zutto Ano Koro no Mama (ぼくらはずっとあの頃のまま)." This was then licensed by Kaiohsha for serialization.

- Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Domestic Beast
mangas.titleNative: ドメスティックビースト
mangas.description:
The story of Kuramochi Family's Biter, Youjirou and the person that the branch family left in charge of him, Ooba Isshin. This is a spin-off of Smoky Nectar
set two years after Renew.

mangas.title: Love Stories
mangas.description:
When Yuji accidentally hears his classmate Yamato confessing to another friend that he's gay, his perspective shifts. Seeing Yamato in a new light, Yuji does his best not to let prejudice color his view, but he still finds himself overthinking his classmates' interactions now. He especially notices the way Yamato looks at one particular boy: Yuji's own best friend.

Even though he tells himself not to get involved, Yuji finds he just can't help it: watching Yamato's one-sided love draws him in a way he never expected. At first, it's empathy, knowing that the boy Yamato has his sights on is definitely straight and has no idea. But as his own friendship with Yamato develops and the two of them grow closer through a mutual study group, Yuji comes to truly care about Yamato as a person, regardless of his sexuality.

mangas.title: Oboreru Netsu ni Furenaide
mangas.titleNative: 溺れる熱にふれないで
mangas.synonyms: Don't Let Me Indulge in Love With You
mangas.description:
Thanks to having to juggle multiple part-time jobs, gloomy student Yura Itokura is on the verge of repeating a year. Kairi Seto, the very class president he detests, becomes his tutor, and he is forced to reluctantly invite him into his home. However, when Kairi's hand unexpectedly brushes against his ear, Yura lets out a sound that he never thought he could make. His body trembles from the pleasure of Kairi's relentless caressing, and though he wants to resist it, he can't help but melt into his touch...?



(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Subordination
mangas.description:
Falsely accused of treason and cast out from his noble lineage, Do-hwa finds himself with nowhere to turn—except to his childhood friend, Sung-mook. To protect him, Sung-mook offers shelter...by disguising Do-hwa as his personal concubine. But the ruse doesn't end with just makeup and dresses. To keep up appearances, Sung-mook insists Do-hwa serve him in the bedroom, too. What starts as merely an act turns into something far more complicated...and far more intimate. For when desire and deception collide, who's really in control?



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Night of the Hunt
mangas.description:
Yu Seolu is an anomaly of an omega with no pheromones, which is why he never expects any alpha to show interest in him. Certainly not a royal alpha like Baek Doha, any less. But once he's caught Doha's attention, Seolu can't seem to escape from it. And then one night, after he finds himself pregnant with Doha's child, Seolu finds the chance to flee from Doha's obsession once and for all…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Covert Hearts
mangas.description: When Detective Yoon Yeoul tries to catch a groper on a crowded train, he instead nabs Jeon Tae-Heon, a prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutor's Office. After a rocky first meeting, they hope to never see each other again, but are then unexpectedly made the faces of a PR collaboration between the police and prosecutors. As they navigate their new roles, all kinds of tension flare between them. With sparks flying and their pride at stake, can Yeoul and Tae-Heon put aside their differences and unravel the mystery behind their puzzling new assignment?

mangas.title: Wanna Be My Dress-Up Lover?
mangas.titleNative: ねえ、おんなのこにしてあげる
mangas.synonyms: Hey, You Wanna Be a Real Girl?
mangas.description:
Manabe Shiro has a stressful job managing a travel agency, and when the workday is done he blows off steam by working as a "maid" at a cross-dressing café. The café is Shiro's safe place, until one night his sardonic subordinate Nabatame Kuro comes in! Though the two might not get along at work, now that Kuro knows his secret, Shiro is willing to do whatever it takes to make sure Kuro keeps his mouth shut. Can this fraught relationship become something fulfilling for both men?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Yours to Claim
mangas.description:
Nothing crazy ever happens to Ju-In. He's just your average college student, keeping his head down and flying under the radar. Ya-Hwi, on the other hand, is drop dead gorgeous, super popular… but also kinda mean. So why has the campus heartthrob taken an interest in a total nobody? There must be an ulterior motive, but it's hard to care when faced with those killer looks. Will Ju-In become a slave to his desires? Or perhaps he'll become the master himself…



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

mangas.title: Home Sweet Home
mangas.description:
The last thing Jungyeon expected was for his mom to ask if she could remarry. The new man was kind, considerate, a perfect match for his mother but there's a catch: he has a younger son. Sunwoo is an introvert. He's shy and has trouble opening up to others, until he meets Jungyeon and finds himself opening up for the first time. As their parents get closer to marrying, they become close, too close, and that's when Sunwoo learns Jungyeon is already seeing another man.

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: The Blurry Viewfinder
mangas.synonyms: Guang Jing Chuang Nei Bu Jujiao
mangas.description: After an accident that made him unable to distinguish people's faces, the main character is shocked when he sees the new transfer student, and thinks he's found the one.

mangas.title: Xiu de Shenme Gou Badao
mangas.synonyms: What Kind of Rubbish Are You Cultivating?
mangas.description:
The young wolf cub and his bad-tempered sect founder have an improper monastic life. The wolf cub is very upset because his sect founder, a male mother, flirts with him every day. What should he do?



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: River of Bondage
mangas.description:
"The kind of play I prefer is a little too hardcore for newbies."

Seo-Ha, a university lecturer, is a natural submissive with deeply ingrained masochistic tendencies. Yet, fear of being outed has kept him from ever pursuing a real partner, leaving him to indulge only in fantasies. When the fellow professor he has been secretly admiring announces their engagement, Seo-Ha is devastated. In a moment of impulsive rebellion, he turns to a BDSM community to find a one-night play partner, hoping to finally experience the domination he's always craved. But this leap into the unknown may lead him down a path far more intense—and dangerous—than he ever imagined.

mangas.title: Rock a Bye Baby
mangas.titleNative: ロッカ・バイ・ベイビー
mangas.description:
Year 20XX. The economy collapsed, and public order worsened. Asahi, who was on the verge of ending his life in a dirty alley, is rescued by a young man who introduces himself as "Rin". Initially, Asahi, who intended to die, lashed out at Rin, but since his true desire to live was exposed from the depths of his heart, he has come to forgive Rin.



He may not be stable, but he doesn't seem deceitful either. While treating him as if he were much younger, Rin, who occasionally wears a surprisingly lonely expression, made Asahi's heart tremble for the first time. That's when he thought he wanted to know more about Rin, no matter what kind of sorrow he carries.



(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

mangas.title: Reizouko ni Negi ga Atta Kamo
mangas.titleNative: 冷蔵庫にネギがあったカモ

mangas.title: Cherry Cake
mangas.description: Soo-Hyeon's peaceful life in the countryside, running a quaint general store and tending a garden, is upended when rumors spread of a luxury hotel project—and the arrival of Tae-Yeon, a gruff yet oddly charming director from S.W. Construction who looks more like a mob boss than a businessman. Despite warnings from the village grandmas to steer clear, Soo-Hyeon isn't intimidated, even as Tae-Yeon's attempts to "bribe" him with sweet treats start melting his defenses. But when an unexpected moment reveals Soo-Hyeon's biggest secret, what starts as a clash of personalities turns into a tangled mix of sweetness, spice, and chaos that neither of them saw coming.

mangas.title: Into the Thrill
mangas.synonyms: イントゥ・ザ・スリル
mangas.description:
Gifted violinist Moon Haewon has been avoiding deep connections after his mother's tragic death. But his life takes a turn when his only friend Taeshin commits suicide, leaving Haewon guilt-ridden for ignoring his calls. At a police interview, Haewon encounters Hyeon Wujin, a special prosecutor and the subject of Taeshin's unrequited love. Haewon's life spirals further as he's drawn into an assault case, and he seeks Wujin's help. Their interactions intensify, with Wujin challenging Haewon's emotional barriers. Swayed by Wujin, Haewon confronts a tangle of guilt, passion, and fear of true connection.



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Like it Ruff
mangas.description:
There is no one in the world Choi Euncheol loves more than his dog Jong-gu. Having been there for him through heartbreak and happiness alike, the pup is as loyal as can be. The two are best friends, and more alike than they look…because Euncheol loves a little bark and bite in the bedroom. But when Jong-gu mistakes a little nighttime pet play for an attack on his masochistic master, he valiantly rushes to his defense and bites the "assailant" square on the buttocks! Euncheol decides to end things with his lover, and is now left with no one but his precious pet to help him grieve his relationship. When he awakes the next morning, however, Jong-gu has gone missing! In his place is a cute guy who seems strangely familiar, but Euncheol can't quite put his paw -er, finger- on why…



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Trapped Beast
mangas.synonyms: กับดักอสูร
mangas.description:
With his back against the wall, Crispin Tadelville, the last surviving alpha of the Tadelville family, disguised himself as an omega to escape death. Now, forced to bide his time as a plaything for the Ethelanian nobles who slayed his people, Crispin waits for the perfect opportunity to exact his revenge. His only obstacle? The prince of the Ethelanian empire he seems to have mistakenly marked.


(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: I'll Train You Sexually and Love You -Dom/Sub Universe-
mangas.titleNative: やらしく躾けて愛してあげる－Dom／Subユニバース－
mangas.description:
"Bad boys like you need some punishment."

Manato Mochizuki, a Sub who has broken up with his partner, is becoming increasingly frustrated. That's when his friend Yoh advises him to use sex services. Although anxious, he waits for his escort at a hotel. The one who shows up is the most popular escort, Seiya, a handsome man with a well-proportioned face. Seiya's gentle character makes Manato comfortable enough to start their role-play, and his soft touches and the commands he whispers are simply too sweet... but something makes him change completely!! "You actually prefer your partner to be strict, don't you?" Ordered to expose his innermost self, a sweet pain and an unknown pleasure mix up, making Manato crave punishment instead!

mangas.title: Secret Relationships
mangas.description:
Smart, clever, and resourceful, Daon worked hard to overcome being poor. But his cheap ways are getting on the last nerve of his coworker, Sung-Hyeon, who hates him! After an incident with his own impoverished parents, Da-On is suddenly growing closer to Sung-Hyeon while balancing feelings for his former tutor, Jae-Min. With mixed emotions and unspoken secrets, will Da-On be rich with love or fall back into poverty?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.

mangas.title: Sweet Not Sugar
mangas.description:
For all his life, Lee Dan has often found himself abandoned. It began with being left in a box outside as a baby and most recently when his boyfriend and roommate cheated on him. While feeling lost on the streets, he is picked up by Yeo Jeongheon, who allows Dan to stay at his place for as long as he requires. Since Jeongheon is an alpha, his intentions of bringing home Dan, an omega, seem obvious. But when Dan offers to repay him with his body, Jeongheon firmly rejects him and instead tries to care to his every need. This confuses Dan as the only alphas he's encountered are ones who tried to take advantage of him. Perhaps Jeongheon has some other hidden motives, or he actually could be the sweetest alpha Dan has ever met…



(Source: Tappytoon)


Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ikemen no Senpai ga Jitsu wa Bukiyou de Donkan deshita
mangas.titleNative: イケメンの先輩が実は不器用で鈍感でした

mangas.title: Ryuu to Ryuu no Kekkon
mangas.description:
After a long war, Lycoris, a princess of the Wyvern Kingdom, and Raika, a princess of the Dragon Kingdom, are to be married as a sign of peace. Former enemies, the two begin a new life together…



Lycoris has complicated feelings about the political marriage, but she can't help becoming attracted to Raika, who seems so lonely, despite her outward indifference.



Two girls who do not know how to love, bond with each other as they heal each other's broken hearts.



(Source: Shiori-on, translated)

mangas.title: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko
mangas.description: Kisaki has a mysterious disease from childhood that turns her into half-tree, half-human.

mangas.title: Nikaidou Kou Tanpenshuu: Arigatou tte Itte
mangas.titleNative: 二階堂幸短編集 ありがとうって言って
mangas.description: Your first ever girlfriend, the teacher you loved back in school, your friend's mother whom you've always looked up to, the colleague at work that somehow interests you etc... People like us who just started loving someone else, lead such strong, beautiful and refreshing lives. The scenery which you vividly remember will be changed with your aspirations. An omnibus of precious short stories.

mangas.title: Hungry for You: Endo Yasuko Stalks the Night
mangas.titleNative: 遠藤靖子は夜迷町に隠れてる
mangas.description:
