In a gloomy town, where three girls have gone missing, high school girl Shizue witnesses an attack on a fellow classmate. The assailant appears to be none other than fellow student Endo Yasuko, a striking beauty who declares to Shizue that she is starving, and only Shizue can sate her hunger! Is Endo Yasuko a vampire, a serial killer–or just plain weird? And what does she really want from Shizue…?


(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Shutline
mangas.description: Shin is barely making ends meet, hustling as a rogue mechanic on the mean city streets. Problem is, work never comes easy and the dough is nothing to shout about. But when Jake pulls up with car trouble one day, it's obvious that there's money to be made: he's tall, blond and dressed like a million bucks. Jackpot. And after such a handsome payday, Shin is reluctant to let this sucker go. Little does he know that giving Jake his number may be the biggest mistake he's ever made. And it isn't long before Jake wants more than his car fixing…

mangas.title: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!
mangas.synonyms: To the Fans, Not to Me
mangas.description: For Yoo Jae-Min, debuting as an idol is everything, but his skills are outshined in particular by Jung Woo-Hyung. The other boy's laid-back attitude, especially toward their fans, irks Jae-Min, but their dynamic shifts when they become roommates and Woo-Hyung starts noticing cute sides to Jae-Min that he hadn't before. The fans notice this change and Jae-Min focuses all his attention on them and their love, which bothers Woo-Hyung. Will their group, 4ever, hit it big, or will Woo-Hyung and Jae-Min's tumultuous relationship lead to its downfall?

mangas.title: I Didn't Mean to Fall in Love -double-
mangas.titleNative: 恋をするつもりはなかった-double-
mangas.description:
Rou and Yoshino have spent their days blissfully in love and by each other's side at every moment. But now that Rou has graduated university, it's time to become a proper working adult! Which means his time with Yoshino is decreasing and making Rou frustrated. Between this and learning to work with his new colleagues, Rou may not be up for the task of the working world—especially if it puts his relationship at risk!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

mangas.title: Ai da Koi da no Kiku Mae ni
mangas.titleNative: 愛だの恋だの効く前に
mangas.description: Sudou, the apartment manager, possesses a strange ability: anyone who hears his voice is immediately charmed by him. However, things take an unexpected turn when Inose, a charismatic host from a local club, moves into Sudou's building. For the first time ever, Sudou's voice seems to have no effect on someone...

mangas.title: Perfect Propose: Bangai-hen
mangas.titleNative: パーフェクトプロポーズ 番外編
mangas.description:
Hirokuni and Kai are still living together now that they're dating. However, they end up spending their first New Year's Eve apart. Hirokuni notices something off about Kai, who has been visiting his former boss' family. It seems like he's expected to take over the restaurant...?



(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)



Note: A special one shot released in GUSH's Februrary 2024 issue to commemorate the work's live-action TV drama.

mangas.title: Slow Damage Clean dishes: leveret
mangas.titleNative: スロウ・ダメージ Clean dishes -leveret-
mangas.description:
Shinkoumi, a special administrative region of Japan ruled by the Takasato Group, is a city of rampant crime propelled by the country's crippling recession. Here, fights and murders are a daily occurrence. In such a city, a certain presence is vital. Enter "Clean Dishes".



"Clean Dishes", also commonly known as "Sara-ya," is a cleaning service that tidies up the rooms where people have died, by suicide or by other means. The story revolves around Baku, a worker at Clean dishes, and his partner Shiro, who is eager to die.

mangas.title: Men's Wear Store and "Her Royal Highness"
mangas.synonyms: Nan Zhuang Dian Yu "Gong Zhu Dian Xia"
mangas.description:
Zihao Zhang, a brilliant cross dresser who always knows how to pick the killer skirt to wear, just got dumped ruthlessly. What would happen when he accidentally catches the eyes of Yuze Shao, a super straight guy who always assumes himself to be "unbendable"? Suit? Lolita dress? Hanfu? All pieces of cake for Zihao Zhang!



(Source: WebComics, edited)

mangas.title: Come Be My Teacher
mangas.description: Fresh out of college, Jiha Lim is basking in riches as a successful BL doujinshi artist of the megahit webtoon "Hot-Blooded Academy" by Art Kang. One day, Jiha snatches up a once-in-a-blue-moon opportunity to work for Art as his prized assistant. Little did he know he would fall for Art's blinding good looks at first sight. And thus begins Jiha's diabolically intricate plans to win him over... and also get him to play for the other team!

mangas.title: My Perfect Omega
mangas.description:
Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. The moment their eyes meet, Nick is hit with an overwhelming surge of pheromones. He knows instantly: Owen is his Omega. When terrorists launch a sudden attack on Owen, Nick steps in without hesitation. Grateful and intrigued, Owen invites Nick to his secluded estate. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he's a "monster Omega," ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He's spent his life in strict control… until Nick's bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses. As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn't just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself. And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what's his.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Mr.Miss
mangas.description:
After being outed by his first love in high school, Juho has been struggling in his romantic endeavors ever since. One evening after a distasteful phone call with a cheating ex, Juho sees someone has been staring at him. Juho recognizes Kang Jaemin, an old high school classmate. Juho and Jaemin briefly catch up on each other's lives when Juho makes a surprising offer for Jaemin to stay the night at his place to which Jaemin agrees.



(Source: Pocket Comics)



Note: Chapter count includes 8 side stories.

mangas.title: pop one's cherry
mangas.synonyms: ポップワンズチェリー
mangas.description:
"'Please let me go, Master!' If you can say that sweetly, I'll let you go."



The two are considered perfect alphas. The two, who are not particularly close to each other, have been childhood friends since they were small and have a bad relationship. It changes when Sakuma goes into heat and starts groping himself while sniffing the scent off of Renji's uniform. Renji is said to be an honor student by the people around him, but in reality, he is a genuine Sadist who loves to tie up and bully his partners... Not only was it found by the guy who he didn't want to find it out the most, but he is now also tampered with and disturbed by Sakuma's...!?



(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

mangas.title: Foul's Start
mangas.description: When Hae-Il drowns saving a boy at sea, his final thought is of Pa-Do, the childhood crush he could never forget. Instead of sinking into darkness, however, Hae-Il wakes up with an impossible second chance. But this new life is far from perfect—Pa-Do is cold and distant, and Hae-Il's body dissolves into seafoam with every sting of rejection.

mangas.title: A Love Too Captivating
mangas.titleNative: たまらないのは恋なのか
mangas.synonyms: Is It Because of Love That I Can't Resist?
mangas.description: Misuzu was branded a delinquent when a small incident left him isolated. But one day, he sees the top student, Kitahara, get surrounded by bullies and decides to help him out. That sparked Kitahara's interest in the lonely boy, but Misuzu pushes Kitahara away. "If you get involved with me, you'll get ostracized by everyone else too." But it won't take long for Misuzu's resolve to falter...

mangas.title: Not Bad
mangas.description:
Sun-Woo Koo lives his life like a crow, selling his body in the pursuit of shiny trinkets. After firing a clingy client, he ends up finding a new customer, Mo-Yoon Jeong, an idol star on the rise with a taste for men. What starts as a drunken one-night stand quickly evolves into something more...

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Why Is My Manager So Straight!
mangas.synonyms: My Agent is Too Hard to Tease | My Manager Was Bullying Me All Day
mangas.description: Jing Tao has been secretly in love with Lu Yi Zhou for ten years, but it's just so hard to make Lu get the hang of it! Just when Jing Tao was about to give up, Lu Yizhou started to woo him. "Wait! Didn't you see me as a brother?" "Just because we're close as brothers, I'm discussing with you about something deeper~"

mangas.title: Interi Onii-san to Toshokan Shokuin
mangas.titleNative: インテリお兄さんと図書館職員
mangas.description:
Hasumi the librarian has trouble expressing himself in front of others, and is secretly admiring Shiraishi, a person with an elegant smile that often comes to borrow books. Shiraishi's personality is exactly what Hasumi wants to become, but...



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

mangas.title: The Odds of This Love
mangas.synonyms: What's the Probability of A Successful Love?
mangas.description:
What are the odds of running into a one-night stand on the street?

Jitae can't muster the courage to tell his straight friend Kyunghoon that he's had a crush on him for a long time. Much to his dismay, Kyunghoon announces his engagement to his pregnant fiancée.

Shattered, Jitae has a one-night stand with a random guy he meets at a gay bar. As if congratulating a years-long crush on his wedding day isn't hard enough, Jitae runs into the one-night stand who happens to be the bride's brother! But Haejoon doesn't seem to want to remain a casual sex partner to Jitae. He comes on to Jitae with a hint of threat and an offer hard to refuse.

"Don't do it. Choose me, instead. I'll make you get over him."



(Source: NETCOMICS)

mangas.title: Swim in the Scent
mangas.description:
The cutting words of Lee Seok-Jun's first love during his school days left a scar that still follows him into adulthood. His fear of intimacy and emotional distance have turned breakups into a recurring theme in his life. One night, while venting about yet another failed relationship at a bar with friends, Seok-Jun crosses paths with Yae Ji-Hoo—a notorious bar regular with a reputation for living like a gigolo. Enticed by Ji-Hoo's bold offer of a "crash course in adult technique," Seok-Jun narrowly escapes an awkward situation just in time. But Ji-Hoo's wounded pride refuses to let the matter rest. When he learns that Seok-Jun works as a swimming instructor, Ji-Hoo begins plotting an elaborate revenge scheme.



(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Tit For Tat
mangas.description:
On his first day after being promoted to CEO, Gu Qingpei is tasked with taking care of the Chairman's son - an arrogant and unruly military guy who seems to clash with him. But if Gu Qingpei couldn't handle this unruly child, how could he expect to lead his employees? Days go by with tension and conflict between the two. However, their relationship begins to evolve in an unforeseen manner…



(Source: INKR, edited)

mangas.title: Projection
mangas.description:
Se-Ju lives every day weary as a member of a crime ring that he joined to avenge his younger sister's death. However, one day, he encounters a boy, Se-Jin, and reminded of his dead sister, takes him in. From there, what was supposed to be a temporary arrangement grows into something far more.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Merry Memory!
mangas.description:
Potts has always admired the beauty of human emotions... However the first human he speaks to has none.



(Source: Lalatoon)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 16 extras.

mangas.title: The Dashing Zaddy and His Icy Protégé
mangas.titleNative: イケオジモンスターと絶対零度男子
mangas.synonyms: Ikeoji Monster to Zettai Reido Danshi
mangas.description:
The second sales division at Gosei Trading Company is headed up by Mr. Takanashi, one of the firm's top performers and a charismatic knockout at age 40. One of his subordinates is the equally hot, cool and calculating 26-year-old, Hiwatari. Practically every woman at the company has attempted to stir up an office romance with the magnetic Takanashi, but this dashing zaddy has turned them all down, because...he secretly has ED! Meanwhile, Hiwatari seems like a scary robot on the outside, but he's actually looked up to Takanashi since he started working with him four years ago. When Hiwatari gets a chance to spend the evening with Takanashi, he reveals more than he means to!

An irresistible love comedy between a hot older man with a shameful secret and a cunning underling who becomes an unlikely confidant in his quest to once more stand proud and, ahem...erect!

mangas.title: Play it Cool, Guys
mangas.description:
Enter: a bunch of cool guys who look like they got that unapproachable swag. But let's be real—that's not the true them. They're just a bunch of dorks who've got the act down pat. So sit back, grab some popcorn and enjoy watching a bunch of goofy guys try to look cool all day every day.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Goddess of Jealousy
mangas.synonyms: Universe's Most Jealous Goddess | The First Jealous God in The Universe
mangas.description: The innocent starlet Xiao Fengyu got the chance to work with the cold-faced superstar He Yunhan in a variety show as mentor and trainee. It seems like a great chance for Fengyu to get in with the goddess, but how come it feels like she's always running into trouble with her?

mangas.title: Madou Soshi
mangas.description: Japanese manga adaptation of the Chinese novel Mo Dao Zu Shi.

mangas.title: Secret Therapy
mangas.description:
Yoon Jaesung is handsome, rich, popular, and at the top of his class. Well, he was, until Lee Hyun returned to school and took his place as number one. Jaesung can't stand the fact that his spot has been overtaken, especially by a loser like Lee Hyun. And to make matters worse, Jaesung recently began having trouble getting an erection. Unlike Jaesung, Hyun must work several part-time jobs just to afford school and stay afloat. One of Hyun's gigs includes secretly moonlighting as a streamer for the infamous gay steaming site, "Cake," where users donate money to have their requests fulfilled. When one of Jaesung's friends suggests "Cake" as a form of treatment for his penile problems, Jaesung comes across a special streamer who's tantalizing solo show solves Jaesung's impotence in an instant. Jaesung is so stunned, he'll do whatever it takes to meet the guy who made his flag fly at full mast again…


(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes eight bonus chapters.

mangas.title: Riding Your Wave
mangas.description:
Despite living on an island, Do-Hyun's fear of the ocean after his father's drowning has kept him from learning how to swim. An energetic, ocean-loving tourist named Ji-Ho appears, throwing Do-Hyun off balance. They're opposites, but when disaster nearly strikes Do-Hyun finds himself getting caught up in Ji-Ho's current...

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Please Take Me Back
mangas.description:
"You're telling me a ghost possessed you and punched me in the chest?"

After seeing that his favorite junior, Mugeol, was possessed by a ghost, Ha-Jun decided to secretly perform an exorcism on him. But performing an exorcism requires physical contact…

I was secretly in love with him and had decided to back off on my own, so why is he coming closer to me!

mangas.title: Number Call
mangas.description:
High schooler Eighto Tachibana has always hated his name, and the "8" jokes that came with it. One day, he meets a classmate named Tomoya Hatta, aka Hachi—the Japanese word for "8." What begins as casual greetings and small talk in the hallway soon becomes something much deeper, and Eighto realizes that it's more than just a similar nickname that draws him to Hachi. Could the number that Eight resented for so long finally bring him something he'll love?



(Source: Kodansha USA)

mangas.title: Naui Idol
mangas.description:
Hyun-Oh, formerly an idol trainee. Although he never achieved his dream, he's already been an idol's road manager for a year. But this youngest, Kang-Woo, has been staring at Hyun-Oh suspiciously! Unwilling to notice, Hyun-Oh tries his best to ignore it... But then, Kang-Woo, the youngest, receives a drama offer and asks Hyun-Oh to practice a kiss scene with him, a shocking request?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)


Note: The first story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: Doing XX With a Fansite
mangas.description:
Im Do-Gyu, main vocalist of the group Runners High. One day on his way to a music show, Do-Gyu spots a male fan calling out his name. Realizing romantic relationships (!!) are happening within the group, Do-Gyu feels resentful that he, being gay, can't even meet a single guy. Then, he runs into the male fan who called his name in private. In a fit of anger, they end up sleeping together...

Only to find out later, this guy? He's not even my fan?!

mangas.title: Marked
mangas.description:
To the rest of the world, Ju Ha-Ram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Ha-Ram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Ha-Ram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Triangle Lovers: XXX
mangas.description:
Thanks to his false bragging, Geon-Woo's friends think he has lots of experience in the bedroom when he's actually a virgin who hasn't even kissed anyone before. When Han-Eul, the pretty upperclassman Geon-Woo admires, asks to sleep with him, Geon-Woo is nervous but on cloud nine. However, Han-Eul's intimidating friend, Ji-Ho, is waiting for them at the place of their hookup. Not only that, but Han-Eul insists on having a threesome with Geon-Woo and Ji-Ho, claiming it's the only way he can be satisfied! And so, poor Geon-Woo is trapped in a dangerously filthy throuple with no way out...

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Perfect Liar
mangas.description:
Georgia 2066, in a world overrun by a zombie epidemic, Ryu Kai has always admired Croix. He thought that their paths would never cross, but suddenly he is assigned a mission with him !! The implications will be more than unexpected….

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Words & Kisses
mangas.description:
Just as I was about to get into another ambiguous, half-hearted relationship, I met her. Hyun-Jin Go. I couldn't take my eyes off her. I had been treading a dull path, and she knocked me right off.

Then I felt it — a little piece of my heart, breaking off and slipping away.

"She's so pretty..."



(Source: Manta comics)

mangas.title: PREDATOR
mangas.description:
Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher. With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes. And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, "Right here, this is where our baby will be born."



Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Superlight Hands-Free Undies ver 2.0!
mangas.description:
Beom-Yeol has spent every Christmas alone, a shy virgin whose only thrill is secretly admiring Jun Sang, the tough gangster who protects his little shop. And this year is no different...or so he thinks. While indulging in a slightly too vivid fantasy about Jun Sang, Beom-Yeol suddenly comes face to face with a strange creature he has never seen before. The being introduces himself as Ddobomi No. 8291, also known as ""the God of Lust"", and claims he has come to help Beom-Yeol with his tragic lack of a love life. His gift?
A pair of Bluetooth underwear that links Beom-Yeol's senses directly to the most intimate parts of whoever he touches. With this outrageous invention and a long standing crush inches away, Beom-Yeol might finally escape his lonely Christmas curse.



The real question is… will he survive the experience?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: In Cold Love: Side Story
mangas.description: Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Newbie Starting Today
mangas.description:
Han-Eul, exhausted from a long job search, is suddenly visited by a stranger who introduces himself as "God."

"God" says that if he works as Han-Eul's representative for a certain period of time, he will be released and help him land a job at the company of his choice. Having experienced various strange things, Han-Eul begins to worry. Is he really God? Even if he isn't God, is there anything he can do if it's not this? After all, isn't someone who seems so kind a bad person? Amidst the confusion, one thing is certain: the person before him is no ordinary human. So, should he pretend to be crazy just for once and believe?

"Representative... How does that work?"

mangas.title: Ittousei no Yoru
mangas.description: Story that takes place about one year after Ryunosuke and Naoki graduate from high school. Ryunosuke goes to Naoki's house to see Naoki, and finds him sleeping in the room wearing only an apron...

mangas.title: This Slut's in the Midst of a Hot Love Scandal!
mangas.titleNative: ビッチは熱愛スキャンダル中！
mangas.description: "I'll give you special permission to cum inside me today." Nanami is a reporter who uses his own lascivious body to get scoops for his weekly magazine. Nanami, who's a bit of a show-off around work, is assigned as a mentor to their new employee, Shiose. Nanami's not a fan of the pure and honest Shiose, and tries to expose his true nature by giving him his signature passionate blowjob, but Shiose tells him to "value himself more". Nanami harassed him, so why is Shiose acting like he's worried about him? And why does that make Nanami's heart pound!?

mangas.title: Stray Dog's Night
mangas.description:
One night, a shady aphrodisiac drug gets injected into police officer Eric's bloodstream. He may be an alpha, but that doesn't mean he can endure the urges the drug had awakened in him any longer...just his luck that beta doctor Lean Greyson passes by and takes him in for the night. Can they fulfill Eric's urges even without an omega in sight? And how much of this meeting is actually a coincidence?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: mouth to mouse
mangas.description:
Wanting to forget something that had happened, Hikaru jumps off a building. Right before he hits the ground, a monster in a human shape breaks his fall. The creature's frightful appearance makes Hikaru cower, but as it continues to stay by his side without saying a word, Hikaru starts to question what its motives are...



A deeply moving BL that resonates with the heartbreaking feeling of being left behind.



(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

mangas.title: Diamond Game
mangas.description: The beautiful vampire with long, silver hair Daia never attacked a human. He is constantly being watched by Kuro, a vampire hunter, and, because of this, he is always trying to run away. He eventually ends up in Japan and meet a merchant named Shishou, who then gives him a job and a place to stay. Daia is charmed by Shishou's kindness... Daia, who was always alone, starts to think about to drink Shishou's blood and make him a vampire as well.

mangas.title: The Dangerous Convenience Store: Eui-joon's Dream
Gentle Mode Off
mangas.description: Shy Tae-Young never thought he'd date his crush, Seung-Joo. Kind, patient, and nothing like his past flings—Seung-Joo says he'll wait as long as Tae-Young needs. But when their first night finally comes... Seung-Joo isn't so gentle anymore. What's he hiding beneath that sweet smile?

mangas.title: Love or Marriage
mangas.description:
Ryu Jin is famous for being the CEO of an entertainment agency that looks more like a celebrity than a celebrity.
Although he lacks nothing, he has one problem. He continues to receive rejected proposals from his lover and fellow actor, Cha Hyeonwook! In response to a proposal that has already been rejected for the nth time, Jin comes up with a trick. Seeing Jin like that, Hyunwook opens new eyes... "Hyung, wait a minute. Take it off with your mouth, not your hands."



(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

mangas.title: Want More Than Just A Peek?
mangas.titleNative: 覗いたくらいで満足しないで、
mangas.description:
"I'll give you a chance to make amends for spying on me."

Businessman meets businessman in this romantic comedy between a hard-working senior employee and his moody subordinate!



Mr. Kanzaki is the ideal leader, and yet his junior Mr. Shiina seems to hold a mysterious grudge against him. All attempts to bridge the gap between them seem to backfire, and to make matters worse, they happen to live in the same building. While pondering the issue, Mr. Kanzaki notices a hole in his wall. He decides to take a peek when he hears someone calling his name on the other side, only to discover...Mr. Shiina rubbing one out?! He lets his voice slip out in surprise, revealing his presence to Mr. Shiina. "Finish the deed for me, dear leader." Wait, if he hates Mr. Kanzaki so much, why is he suddenly straddling him...?!



(Source: Coolmic)

mangas.title: His Majesty the Grand Prince's Master
mangas.synonyms: The Master of the Grand Prince | Your Majesty the Great King's Master
mangas.description: Sakwol, who was of lowly status, was taken in by Grand Prince Sibaek, and became close to him as a servant and companion. Sakwol admired Sibaek and followed him, but one day he was suddenly abandoned. After that, a great upheaval occurred, and the world was in chaos due to ghosts, and the previous order and rules collapsed. Sakwol awakens as a strong 'guardian' and deals with ghosts, and the people follow him instead of the king. While eliminating the incompetent royal relatives, Sibaek is captured in front of Sakwol. "I make this Sibaek my slave." Sakwol's hatred shows its teeth.

mangas.title: Room Attendant to a Naughty Novelist!
mangas.titleNative: イケナイ作家と仲居クン！
mangas.description:
Iori Tachibana has never had any problems with women. He made his debut as a romance novelist with stories based on his own experiences, which both made him quite famous and started his extravagant spending habits. Now, for reasons he doesn't wish to disclose, Iori has writer's block, so he travels to a secluded inn in the mountains looking for a cure... The inn is run by his old friend Madoka, and she assigns cute, young Souma as his room attendant. But, Souma's a guy! Iori had been hoping for a girl... In particular, he'd been hoping for the beautiful female dancer he briefly saw outside. He thinks she might just be able to cure him... With that, he starts searching for her, but has no luck actually finding her. As a last resort, Iori asks Souma about the dancer, but while Souma knows her, he won't tell Iori anything... Could she have something to do with Souma's secret...!?



(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: The Cute Temptress in Room 109
mangas.titleNative: 109号室には、かわいい色乞いが出るらしい。
mangas.description:
Just after entering university, Junya's room caught on fire, leaving him stuck with having to go to another room known for having some shady history. Nervously entering the room, there was a very cute older classmate in the room. They ate delicious food and his new roommate treated him very nicely. Wait? Could this be a good thing?! When he finally goes to sleep, he notices something strange—"This room is full of sensual requests!" as his older classmate comes on to him. When Junya goes to seduce him, his new roommate starts to act very strange...



(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: REVERSIBLE
mangas.description: Note: Released at J.GARDEN 55.

mangas.title: My Dashing Delivery Driver
mangas.titleNative: セックスセールスドライバー
mangas.description: Former office worker Isshin quits his office job to do hard physical labor in the delivery business. As the daily grind wears down his body and soul, his only solace is working with his beloved coworker Haze. Haze has it all - good looks and excellent occupational skills. One day, just when Isshin's starting to feel like Haze's titillating presence makes his job worthwhile, he makes a mistake during a delivery and Haze has to pick up after him. On top of that, he gets blackout drunk and makes a total disgrace of himself. When he wakes up, he finds himself with no clothes on, and Haze by his bedside asking if he remembers what happened last night... That one moment of despair might be the catalyst that brings them together...

mangas.title: Even So, I Will Love You Tenderly
mangas.titleNative: それでも、やさしい恋をする
mangas.synonyms: Still, I Will Love You Softly
mangas.description: Onoda is a straight guy and he is three years younger than Harumi Deguchi. They have nothing in common and at first, they were just friends. But that's not enough for Harumi- he wants more from Ryo and he realizes that he has fallen in love with him. Feeling anxious and emotional, he wants to tell him how he feels… but he can't. Fearing rejection, he'd rather be just friends and not ruin what he has with him. Here- we have a story of pain, sorrow and happiness of being in love.

mangas.title: This is But a Hell of a Dream
mangas.titleNative: これはあくまで夢なので
mangas.synonyms: This is Just a Salacious Dream
mangas.description:
An inexperienced middle-aged incubus's intensive sex training! Despite being an incubus, Forni is not good at sexual matters, so he passes out in the street because of starvation and gets rescued by host Harumi, who takes him home. That night, Forni sneaks into Harumi's dream to have a meal (his semen), but it's his first time and he doesn't know how to do it, so Harumi ends up teaching him instead...!



"When it feels good, say it, okay?"



So, to help Forni get used to "sexy things," they start living together—a life full of sweet excitement and first-time feelings...!



(Source: ShuCream, edited)

mangas.title: To Dear, My Sorrow
mangas.description:
Shouma Tsuji was on his way home from work when he finds a drunk man plastered all over a garbage heap. Pitying the man's state, he decided to help and brought the man to his home. He lets the man use his shower, and once the stranger is all sober and cleaned up, Shouma's surprised to find that the man he helped was Takeru Ashida, a school mate from his middle school days. Takeru was well-known back then, and his gay reputation didn't exactly endear him to his Shouma's peers.

Now, looking at an adult Takeru, Shouma is left with mixed feelings. Takeru reassures him that he doesn't really remember much though he points out that Shouma has a kind nature for taking him in. He also shared that he was drowning his sorrows due to another rejection. Takeru then takes advantage of Shouma's kindness, which leads to more things than one.



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: YES OR NO
mangas.description:
Despite his pretty face, Woo-Jin has a sharp tongue. One day, he agrees to accept a mysterious package on behalf of a fortune teller, only to run into a customer named Ming-Yu. Smitten by Ming-Yu's voice, Woo-Jin decides to revive his past experience working at a tarot café and offers to read his fortune. Using the tarot reading as an excuse for subtle touches, Woo-Jin flirts with Ming-Yu, who becomes flustered when Woo-Jin suggests a YES or NO tarot reading.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)


Note: Part of Lezhin's Hachankong Danpyeonseon (하찮공 단편선) Collection.

mangas.title: 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 (Short Story)
mangas.description:
My first morning and my first Christmas after turning 40.

A special one-shot that takes place the day after the final chapter.

mangas.title: Let Me Suck In
mangas.synonyms: Let me suck in〜ヴァンパイアの僕が扱うのはそっちじゃなくて⁉︎〜
mangas.description:
Vampires are beings that are close to beings of the demigod. They live by blending in with human society. Edward (nickname: Eddie), a vampire with weak supernatural powers, approaches Joshua, a nerd who seems easy to hunt. Seeing Joshua following him obediently, Eddie is filled with anticipation that he will finally succeed in hunting, but Joshua misunderstands that Eddie is going to suck his X?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: UNDEAD: Finding Love in the Zombie Apocalypse
mangas.description:
Nineteen-year-old Hikaru Asahina lost everything the day the world ended. Everything, that is, except his childhood friend Ai Kosaka, who has always taken care of him. Now the two of them, along with other survivors, struggle to stay alive in a post-apocalyptic world filled with man-eating zombies. And when Ai confesses to feeling something more for Hikaru, it changes everything. After all, the more precious someone is to you, the harder it is to lose them. In a world like theirs, is something like love even possible?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

mangas.title: No Love Zone: Side Story
mangas.synonyms: Rabbit Story: No Love Zone Side Story
mangas.description:
Eun-Kyum, a short-eared rabbit, takes care of his two younger siblings and makes a living by growing carrots. Then one day, his younger siblings pick up a cat. However, upon closer inspection, he discovers that it is not a cat, but a baby tiger?! He tries to send the tiger back, but his siblings keep nagging him, so he ends up living with the tiger. However, when his siblings leave the house, the baby tiger transforms into a human! What's more, it is not a baby, but an adult tiger... Eun-Kyum, who is helpless against this tiger that attacks him every night, demanding that he give birth to a baby tiger, tries to chase Ji-Hyuk away every day. However, unlike his fellow rabbits who usually left Eun-Kyum alone because of his short ears, Ji-Hyuk begins to show a small rift in his heart as he pours all his affection into him. And it seems that Ji-Hyuk has a hidden past of his own...


A romance between Eun-Kyum the rabbit who tries to chase away Ji-Hyuk the tiger and the tiger who is obsessed with the rabbit!

Who will be the winner between the two?

(Source: OrangeD, translated)

mangas.title: I'm Straight, But My Friend Gets Me Hard
mangas.titleNative: ノンケの俺が、親友の前でうっかりたっちゃいまして。
mangas.description:
Atsushi can't rise to the challenge with his girlfriend and starts panicking. Could it be that he's run into a medical condition already!? Looking for help on the internet, he finds an article recommending a certain kind of stimulation that's apparently very effective... Unfortunately, just as he's trying it out, his best friend comes back home and finds him in a compromising situation. To Atsushi's surprise, Tsukasa rushes to the rescue and helps him achieve what his girlfriend couldn't... But, Atsushi is straight, isn't he!? How is this going to change their friendship...?

(Source: Renta!)

mangas.title: My Little Alpha
mangas.description:
In the prestigious Lee family, only Alphas are ever born—and 8-year-old Lee Mun-Ho is no exception. So when he's suddenly married off to Han Wol-Ah, the elegant 16-year-old heir of the famous Omega Han family, it's the talk of the town. At the wedding, poor Mun-Ho is a bundle of nerves… until Wol-Ah gently calms him down. Cue instant puppy-love. But the moment the ceremony ends? Prince Charming disappears. "Massage my legs," Wol-Ah commands. And just like that, Mun-Ho's honeymoon becomes housework. From that day on, Wol-Ah treats him less like a groom and more like a very tiny servant. Years pass in comedic misery until finally—Mun-Ho's coming-of-age ceremony arrives. He's taller. Stronger. Still hopelessly in love. But now the tables might just turn...



Will Mun-Ho get revenge? Or will he fall even harder for the bossy Omega who stole his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Smoky Nectar Renew
mangas.titleNative: スモーキーネクター Renew
mangas.description:
Writer Mitsuru Hasegawa and Annaka Yuusei (a.k.a. Anna), who runs a real estate business, are childhood friends and lovers. They have a secret: Anna is a "biter" who feeds on human blood, and Mitsuru is a "nectar" whose blood the "biter" likes. The two signed a "symbiotic contract" in which they could not live without each other's blood.
Anna, who had a crush on Mitsuru since he was young, was as happy as having his dream come true. However, at the same time, Anna also felt guilty for what he did to Mitsuru...



(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Two's Company, Three's a Good Time
mangas.synonyms: วิกฤตรักของสามเรา
mangas.description:
To spice up their stale relationship, Hye-Seong and Seung-Ju decide to bring a third man into the mix. But things take an unexpected turn when their guest turns out to be I-Nu - Seung-Ju's junior from college and his longtime secret admirer. As Hye-Seong grows jealous of the tension between Seung-Ju and I-Nu, things heat up in more ways than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Foster Care
mangas.description:
Si-Wu doesn't do relationships — just low-maintenance hookups with no strings attached. So when Hui-Won, a younger classmate with no apparent sex drive, a great body, and a frustratingly handsome face, starts hanging around, Si-Wu figures he's found the perfect arrangement.

"Hyung, you're more good-looking in my eyes... You're so handsome…"

But Hui-Won barrels in without hesitation, and the emotional walls Si-Wu built so carefully don't stand a chance. As Hui-Won keeps crossing lines and closing distance, Si-Wu keeps telling himself the same thing:

"It'll be like taking care of a stray dog... I'll just offer him foster care until someone better comes along."

mangas.title: The Fox And Mouse Have A Photo Shoot
mangas.titleNative: キツネとネズミの撮影会
mangas.description: Note: Originally bundled as a bonus booklet with the special edition of Gochisou Ω wa Chuu to Naku Volume 2.

mangas.title: The Fox And Mouse Play Hide And Seek
mangas.titleNative: キツネとネズミのかくれんぼ
mangas.synonyms: The Fox And Mouse Play Hide And Seek: The Foxy Mouse's Romance Special Booklet
mangas.description:
Sachio's in heat for the first time since he and Shinobu officially paired. He's not sure he should tell him, since he's worried it might make him sound too needy... like he's begging Shinobu to scratch that itch. Keep reading to see what happens between the sheets after the two finally become an item!

(Source: Renta!)


Note: Originally bundled as a bonus booklet with the special edition of Gochisou Ω wa Chuu to Naku Volume 1.

mangas.title: Hallelujah and The Succubus!
mangas.description:
A veterinary student, Hallelujah Tendo is an honest person whom everybody calls "the angel of the veterinary faculty." One day, he helps a mysterious creature with bat-like wings, but it turns out to be the super cranky demon, Lucif! Lucif has been purged from the heaven by the angel Micha, with the succubus seed implanted inside his body. Touched by Hallelujah, he is instantly turned on and from the extreme hunger, orders Hallelujah to "Put your semen...inside of me now." Unable to grasp the situation, Hallelujah is robbed his virginity and even worse, he is tied with Lucif by magical collars and chains. His new life begins and he must frequently provide Lucif with his semen... As Lucif gradually recovers his power, his fellow demon, Baal Belial senses his presence and appears at Hallelujah's place to bring him back to the Hell.



(Source: MangaPlaza)

mangas.title: My Insatiable Demon
mangas.description:
Kim Anon, a superior demon with murderous intent, barges into Jae-Kyung's restaurant, demanding what is rightfully his. Powerless before such a prestigious demon, Jae-Kyung can only submit and oblige the stranger. First, the stranger takes his money, then his food, his shoes, and more and more with breathtaking entitlement. Even so, Jae-Kyung finds himself dreaming that this stranger will take also take him!

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: On Doorstep
mangas.description: Jimmy, a small-time thief, is caught pickpocketing by a middle-aged guy named Reese. Instead of handing him over to the police, Reese makes him slog hard for a day at the book store where he works. Wanting to get back at the other man for humiliating him, Jimmy breaks into Reese's apartment, only to find evidence that he's a retired cop. A bit spooked now, he leaves in a hurry, determined to put it all behind him and carry on as usual... But getting Reese out of his head proves to be tougher than Jimmy could ever have imagined.

mangas.title: How to Become an Alpha
mangas.description:
Jinha is an Omega with an Alpha phobia and Tae-Oh is his boyfriend who hasn't awakened yet. Tae-Oh has tried many methods to awaken his Alpha traits, but something inside him is preventing it. While Jinha tries to be strong for Tae-Oh, shady figures lurk to take advantage of his phobia.



(Source: INKR)

mangas.title: LOVE, POKER AND YAKUZA
mangas.titleNative: 極道セックスポーカー
mangas.description:
"Whoever comes first, loses. Shall we do it?"



A naughty romance between a naive yakuza grunt and an impish gambler star in this story you won't want to put down! When tough guy yakuza Ginpei, also known as Unbeatable Silver, corners the cheating Ryota, his captive challenges him to a dirty game. Ryota has a clear advantage, but reveals his weak spot! How far is Ginpei willing to go? First to say "I love you" loses! Thus begins this BL romance with the only thing more dangerous than money: Love!



(Source: cigarillo)

mangas.title: About How I'm Limp Down There
mangas.titleNative: 俺の×××が元気がない件について
mangas.synonyms: Ore no XXX ga Genki ga nai Ken ni tsuite
mangas.description:
His behind is now alive after experiencing some super skilled fingers!

This is the story of a handsome and skilled massage therapist and a ditzy, cute, and young office worker.

Tiny!! Impotent!! Boring!! That's what Tomoya's girlfriend said when she dumped him.

Since he's worried that he's limp because of exhaustion, Tomoya consults his big brother, who introduces Tomoya to his massage therapist friend, Hayato (who's said to possess "golden fingers").

As Tomoya's letting himself enjoy a nice massage, Hayato's fingers go in an unexpected place...

This is something right out of an adult story!!!

Will Tomoya's little friend be able to regain its strength thanks to the golden fingers!?

This is a hot and ditzy yaoi story with a lot of sweetness and absurdity!

mangas.title: Sasaenggyeolpan!
mangas.description:
I'm Chang-Ju Lee, 26 years old, on the verge of graduating from college, and about to be crushed to death when a building collapses.



It's all because a junior I met in my liberal arts class asked me to go to an exhibition in this building. All my friends told me to avoid him because he's a murderer, but I didn't believe them. From an objective point of view, X is handsome and has a cute personality, so how could he be a murderer?



But... Should I have believed them...?



(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

mangas.title: Did You Do Naughty Things with My Voice?
mangas.titleNative: 俺の声でえっちなことしてた？
mangas.description: "Will you touch yourself slowly just like that?" From his headphones he heard sweet whispers that seemed to arouse his instincts. He moved his fingers just as he was told and, touching his hard you-know-what, he came from just that voice alone...! This is the story of a cheerful salesman at a world-class company and a gloomy company designer; an office romance in which the designer is made to come over and over again from a man's sexy and slightly sadistic voice! Naoki Tachibana is a company designer who suffers from insomnia. On the recommendation of a junior colleague, he begins listening to soothing ASMR. One day, he discovers a naughty broadcast by a streamer he likes...!! Naoki gets addicted to pleasuring himself to the sexy commands being whispered into his ears as his heart races. Meanwhile, the man behind the voice was his coworker Satomi Suwa, an elite worker on the fast track to success! When Naoki responds to the sound of Satomi's voice in a conference room, Satomi throws Naoki into disarray in both body and mind...

mangas.title: Period
mangas.description: Two childhood friends enjoy sparring over a fighting game on the day their lives would be irrevocably changed.

mangas.title: A Man of Virtue
mangas.description:
What's it like spending your whole life coming in second place?

Ask Nam Jinwoo, he's been living in the shadow of his rival, Ma Sangtae, his whole life. From high school to college, and now in the office. But passion is strange, it can start as envy or hate and turn into something… erotic. Now Jinwoo's head is filled with the dirtiest and most erotic thoughts, none of which are in his control. More than anything, he wants them to stop. But the only way to stop them might just be the last thing he wants to do…

mangas.title: Heat Protectant
mangas.description:
Su Seong-Hyeon, a successful hair designer, has been secretly in love with his best friend, Jeong Jun-Yeon. One day, Jun-Yeon asks Seong-Hyeon to tutor his younger brother, Jae-Yeon. While Seong-Hyeon believes Jae-Yeon to be a Beta, he starts to faintly sense pheromones from him. Then, one day, Seong-Hyeon discovers a piece of clothing soaked in pheromones among the gifts he received from Jae-Yeon. Overcome by the pheromones, he experiences an unusual heat. At that moment, while on a call with Jun-Yeon, he ends up pleasuring himself to the sound of his voice...



"What kind of insane Omega spreads their pheromones like this?!"


(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Be My Baby
mangas.description: Dr. Lee Sun-Woo is one of the nation's finest scientists, who dreams of a world where every human (including men) can conceive a child. Unfortunately, he eventually has to shut down his project. During his now ample free time, he happens to run into an old crush, a friend's older brother, Eun-Gyo. In any other world, this situation may be normal, but not when Sun-Woo's (extremely vocalized) desire is for Eun-Gyo's sperm!

mangas.title: Who's the Liar
mangas.description:
Prince Kaim, who's being held as a hostage in an enemy's country, has received a piece of advice in exchange for helping a suspicious old man. He was told to be careful of someone close to him since that person is trying to deceive him. Kaim then begins to doubt Zion, his old friend and also the enemy's knight...


(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

mangas.title: Business as Unusual
mangas.description: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind...

mangas.title: Ballboy Tactics
mangas.description: After retiring from gymnastics, Han Ji-Won thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jung-Woo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Ji-Won thinks he has Jung-Woo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

mangas.title: Cheeky Habits of My Rabbits
mangas.description: My bride, Neungso, has so many wonderful qualities! He's as pretty as freshly fallen snow, as big and strong as a mountain, and has a hu... HUGE summer squash between his legs! I thought having a bride meant having someone to take care of and make happy, but it turns out he knows just how to make me feel good. I wish I could make him happy too, but I'm not the special moon rabbit he's looking for, so I know he'll leave me one day. Maybe it would've been better if Habibi never brought my bride home. Maybe then, I wouldn't have to feel this pain…

mangas.title: Machi no Yakuza to Panya-san
mangas.titleNative: まちのヤクザとパン屋さん
mangas.description: Hatori, an intellectual Yakuza, has a secret hobby of visiting bakeries. He discovered a certain bakery that is open late at night run by the baker Ayase, and engages in a lively discussion about pastries. But when he woke up, he discovered that he's being "eaten" by Ayase...?! A "delicious" and "dangerous" relationship between a baker and a yakuza.

mangas.title: Hyperventilation
mangas.description: Myongi and Sunho haven't seen each other since they were 18 years old. Now 27, they run into one another at a high school reunion, and the romantic feelings they had for one another come rushing to the surface. But are they the same people now that they were back then?

mangas.title: Lighten Up
mangas.description: Kim Hyunwoo is a freshman in university and like every other freshman, he should be enjoying his college life to the fullest. But forget about university friends, his dark and gloomy aura makes him so unapproachable that not even his sunbaes want to go anywhere near him. Enter the kind and popular Seong Jiho, whose presence lights up the whole room. One could say he's the complete opposite of someone like Hyunwoo. When a classmate who is mentoring Hyunwoo asks Jiho to take over, he reluctantly agrees. However, things get complicated when, after a night of drinking, Jiho wakes up in Hyunwoo's bed to an...unexpected situation. Despite being creeped out by Hyunwoo's dark presence, the more Jiho gets to know him, the more he feels attracted to him. Maybe now, Hyunwoo will finally find a way to lighten up...

mangas.title: Kiss made Ato 3 cm
mangas.description:
1-4. Kiss made Ato 3 cm
5-6. Renai+Hannou
7. Kiss made Ato 3 cm Bangaihen

mangas.title: Young Boyfriend's Love Management Habit
mangas.titleNative: 年下彼氏の恋愛管理癖
mangas.description:
"Young Boyfriend's Love Management Habit": Izumi and Satoshi are university students, friends, and recently, like an owner and a pet. Izumi comes by Satoshi's work desk almost every day to make sure he is fed and rested, like an owner. And Satoshi is always getting caught up in trouble and in need of rescuing, like a vulnerable pet. What if one day Izumi can't take it anymore and becomes Satoshi's trouble? (Warning: sexual assault) "Your Hand Please, My Prince": Mineo has just recently been dumped by his girlfriend, and the only thing keeping his little heart going is magazines with pictures of cute idols. So when his professor tells him to show a literal Prince around the school, Mineo is less than enthusiastic. But perhaps this is exactly what he needed to fill that gaping hole in his heart. "Offering Sadism to You": Recently, Kyoya Misumi has been getting cast as the sadist lover because of his fierce looks. But those characters couldn't be farther from his truth: Kyoya Misumi is a huge masochist. In cases like these, it's the manager's job to take care of their actor, right?



(Source: Futekiya)

mangas.title: Uwaki na Candy
mangas.description: My Senpai was both lustful and cute. But I have enough of his repeating unfaithfulness!!

mangas.title: The Killer
mangas.description:
When Yuuya receives unwanted attention from a customer at the bar where he works, one of the bar's regulars, Haibara comes to his rescue. Yuuya falls in love with Haibara, but how will he be able to confess his feelings when Haibara sees Yuuya's attitude towards him as nothing more than an act?


(Source: The Zero Alliance)

mangas.title: Laundry.
mangas.description: Doing laundry in the dormitory's utilities room can be fun if your partner is a naked Adachi-senpai.

mangas.title: Ikenai Mousou Fudanshi
mangas.description:
From Nakama:

As someone who does things like secretly reading BL manga, Satou finds himself imagining "entanglements" with men on a daily basis. However, since he also has a girlfriend, Satou convinces himself that this is a mere hobby, and he himself is not gay. Suddenly, he then finds himself roommates with his perfect, ideal handyman type, a man called Arihara. Imagining more and more indecent things, after a war with himself, Satou eventually comes to accept the romantic feelings in his heart. A BL story about complicated fudashi tendencies, with slightly tortured and realistic characters. *heart* Also, this compilation includes a pure love story of a librarian with glasses and a flashy high school boy!!

mangas.title: Harem Manga no Shujinkou daga Gay nano de Mainichi ga Tsurai
mangas.titleNative: ハーレム漫画の主人公だが同性愛者〈ゲイ〉なので毎日がつらい
mangas.synonyms: I'm the Main Character of a Harem Manga, but I'm Gay So Every Day Is Hell for Me
mangas.description: Touge Yuugiri is a chick magnet. Without lifting a finger, girls vie for his attention, "accidentally" topple on him, or even invite him to spend some special time alone—it's almost as if he is the protagonist of a harem manga! But Touge could not care less about the attention, as he is gay and feels nothing towards the opposite gender's affection. Yet all his attempts to escape, reject, or scare them away have the complete opposite effect, only intensifying the girls' admiration—as if some cosmic interference was at work. Bombarded by nonsensically perverted situations and unwanted sentiments, Touge's life spirals into a living hell, truly reflecting how one man's dream can be another's nightmare.

mangas.title: Sekai wa Kimi de Mawatteru
mangas.description:
A collection of stories:



1-2) The World Revolves Around You, The World is in Your Arms

"Maki-kun, you really are cute!" That's what my very good-looking classmate Fukamachi said to the definitely plain looking me. Since then Fukamachi kisses me, touches my skin, and follows me around. Even if I run away or cry, he chases me persistently, eventually even doing indecent things... An average guy with a beauty complex getting agitated by a good-looking guy in the title story, and other short-stories which hadn't been published till now, are collected in this anthology. Newly drawn pictures are also included.



3) The False Barber Manga

During breaks, the chemistry lab becomes a barber shop for students, run by Yuushi who is the son of a barber. Every morning, Tadachika visits the lab to get his hair done because it's so unruly. One morning Yuushi kisses him while clipping his hair, and soon the 100 yen fee is replaced by a kiss. Tadachika isn't so sure about this strange relationship of "friends, but something more"... but then he finds Yuushi's barber room closed and goes to find him.



4) Stupid and Beautiful

Harumi is a boy who "is stupid with a bad personality" and the only good thing about him is his strikingly gorgeous face. Ryouhei is his classmate - the top student who acts like a big brother to everyone - who helps Harumi with studies and notes. Harumi thanks him with a kiss which he offers as thanks to everyone, but maybe Harumi's reason for kissing Ryouhei is more than just thanks...



5-6) Cheap Soul, A Bright Future

Rumour has it that Satomi will give his ass to anyone who asks, so Yousuke asks. For 100 yen, Satomi goes with Yousuke and they sleep together... but it turns out the rumour isn't exactly true. Satomi was a virgin. But why did he accept so easily then? They continue to sleep with eachother, for 100 yen a round... where is their relationship going to end up?
And then, 10 years later....



7) Gokujou Dessert (Excellent Dessert)

Two boys in a class receive sweets from admirers very often.

mangas.title: Be Mine
mangas.titleNative: 俺のモノになりなさい。
mangas.description: Kei is a super-popular, charismatic model with an attitude. He could have anyone he wanted, but he has his heart set on Nanami, his awkward cousin and roommate! Nanami can be harsh at times, but Kei sees that deep down, he's actually a sweetie who worries about people; he just can't express it. Kei thinks that's just adorable, and he's tried so many times to make Nanami his, but there's a reason his cousin never takes him seriously...! Starved for true love, this ultra-possessive supermodel is both beauty and the beast

mangas.title: Hanazono no Kioku
mangas.description:
Chris, a beautiful young man whom he met at a bar and Yuu, who had a drunken marriage with him. And the matching tattoo on his ring finger was also meant as a joke... "We're married, so we've gotta stay together." Persistent and possessive, he uncovers everything about Yuu's past. They happily drown in that drunken passion, but...!? A troubled tale of love that will move you to tears... has been drawn!


(Source: Hoshi Kuzuu)


Included one-shot: Kuroneko to Futarigurashi

mangas.title: Datte Asobi desho?
mangas.description: When I woke up in a hotel room that morning, I, Yoshiki, found myself before a naive coworker, a guy named Sunohara. Even if, at first, I was determined to cut ties with him after that single night, I remain strangely intrigued each time I pass him by at work...

mangas.title: Ame no Mukou, Kimi to
mangas.description:
Fumiya is always laughing, even when he's sad. That's how he's chosen to present himself and he continues doing so even when he's left the country, but a man named Lionel has the ability to see beyond his emotional facade and bridge the infinitely fractured distance between them.

A lyrically written love story that chronicles the times happily spent together by a couple.

mangas.title: Sunao ni Love
mangas.description: When his twin sister dies, a young boy decides to confess to the man he likes, but with a strange twist.

mangas.title: Love Like a Game
mangas.description: Very determined Kaji decides to become an apprentice shoemaker with rumored is the best in the field. Mao accepts it after verifying the sincerity in Kaji's words regarding his intention of wanting to learn. Mao shows your "castle" in making the shoe making, there Kaji gets his first kiss under the context of "If you stay here you have to do the work of an adult."

mangas.title: My Honey Express
mangas.titleNative: マイハニーエクスプレス
mangas.description:
After Umashika Distribution's skilled salesman, Aikawa Mitsuru, confessed to his truck driver kouhai, Takahashi Youji, it was supposed to be the start of their bright love life. However, with the sudden transfer notice, what will Aikawa do?!



With pure determination and the sake of love, something will be done for their happy and romance filled love life!

mangas.title: Shinon
mangas.description:
A bitter sweet tale of unrequited love and the universal fear of rejection.


Although high school student Yutaka is in a casual relationship with his best friend Daisuke, he's in love with Shuuhei who regards him a sex friend. Yakuta couldn't tell Shuuhei his real feelings because he knows Shuuhei is in love with his own step brother, Tamaki. Daisuke also nurses feelings for Yutaka, but chooses to remain as a sex friend as well, instead. [CJ]

mangas.title: Radical Blood Monster
mangas.titleNative: ラジカル・ブラッド・モンスター
mangas.description: Sagara Yuichi is an aspiring writer who was caught in a convenience store robbery. Despite having the chance to escape, he lingered to gain writers experience, and ended up getting stabbed. During his last breath, a strange guy appeared claiming it was fate. A few hours later he awakens and finds himself sleeping naked next to that strange guy. Then that strange guy tells him that his blood is "S-Class" and that he's going to be Yuichi's lifetime "partner". Will the pragmatic novelist be able to wrap his mind around all this...?!

mangas.title: Detested by the Demon Lord
mangas.titleNative: だってまおうさまは彼が嫌い
mangas.description:
"I was born to defeat you. Just give up and let me take your body."

Mao is the descendant of an ancient demon lord. Whenever he makes eye contact with someone, they're his to command! Mao's spent his whole life ashamed of his lineage, but one day, he meets a man named Kamiko who claims to be the legendary hero that will defeat him. When it comes to how Kamiko plans to beat him... Mao is in for the shock of his life...

mangas.title: Colorful Line
mangas.description: Shousuke always takes the role to comfort his best friend, Tomoki, who tends to fall in love and then gets dumped several times. One day, Shousuke was drinking with Tomoki and was listening to his whining as usual. Tomoki cracked some jokes and confessed to Shousuke telling him "I love you~" since Shousuke has always listened to him, but Shousuke let his true feelings out and asked Tomoki "Which one do you love more, me or your ex?" Tomoki answered he can't choose and started crying. Shousuke got shaken up and kissed Tomoki without thinking…!? The day when an airhead, cry-baby man who easily falls in love, and a normal guy who has negative connotations about love became more than friends!

mangas.title: I Hate the Dentist!
mangas.titleNative: 歯医者なんてキライだ！
mangas.description:
Moriya Daiichi is a man who absolutely HATES dentists! After a very traumatic visit when he was young, Daiichi has done his best to brush and floss to the extreme so as to avoid a dreadful visit. While in college he receives a shock that has him neglecting his teeth and thus cavities formed. A friend forces him to finally make an appointment and Daiichi is then treated by the one and only Hara-sensei, an extremely young and handsome dentist whose only interest lies in well-kept teeth... And Daiichi's teeth are perfect!



Source: MAL

mangas.title: Soumatou
mangas.description: Note: Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the Tokyo Senritsu Kitan (東京戦慄奇譚) anthology Volume 3.

mangas.title: Poguga Geuchineun Nal
mangas.synonyms: The Day When the Heavy Rain Stops
mangas.description:
Lee Do-Hyun hides his identity and is deployed to prevent the spread of the zombie virus. The moment he learns of the warm side of his boss Kwon Hyuk, whom he thought was rough, Do-Hyun discovers that his body fluids are antibodies to the virus after seeing him bitten by a zombie...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

mangas.title: Kumogami-sama no Ω
mangas.description:
You must never return to that town.



Alpha with inhuman powers x Ordinary male student Ω.



A rural town hiding a big "secret".

Third year of high school, his last summer vacation, the omega Hikaru goes on a trip with his classmates. Their destination is the seaside town Hikaru's grandfather lives in. Hikaru used to live there too, but ever since he moved with his parents to Tokyo, they have forbidden him to go back to the countryside. He must never return—and he will come to understand why.



(Source: Fusion Product, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Ichigo no Yume: Shimatsuya Risuke no Kaii Jikenchou
mangas.titleNative: 一期ノ夢 始末屋・利助の怪異事件帳
mangas.synonyms: Dream of a Life Time: The Ghost Story Collections of Shimatsuya Risuke
mangas.description: The story is set around shimatsuya (person who collects unpaid debts for prostitute houses) Saitou Ritsuke who is asked to look into ghost rumours surrounding one prostitute house.

mangas.title: Kkochui Manchan
mangas.description:
Lee Seonho, who took care of his parent's store while they were on a trip, meets Yoohwa, a customer that visits one day.



After their first meeting, he discovered that he had a gentle personality and his job was growing flowers.
But one day, he discovers that his boyfriend needs to eat people to live? What kind of crazy...?!

mangas.title: Hone to Kawa to ga Hanareru Oto
mangas.titleNative: ほねとかわとがはなれるおと
mangas.synonyms: The Sound of Bone and Skin Separating
mangas.description:
That day, a beautiful young man visited the detective agency, troubled by strange, mysterious noises of unknown origin. Detective Sakagami, driven by ulterior motives, offers an overnight investigation, but time passes by without any clues. Yet, something feels off…



(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

mangas.title: Miroui Haengjingok
mangas.description: One month after dating, the maze suddenly disappeared. Hyo-eun has been waiting for him, believing that he will return the maze that has disappeared without a word. Why did you leave by yourself? Hyo-eun is in a maze, wandering looking for the answer. The broken cell phone left behind by Labyrinth, there is something in it. Hyo-eun pledges not to return for a long time and leaves the house following the traces of the maze.

mangas.title: I Think You Are-
mangas.description:
One year after the end of the zombie outbreak that swept through Korea, Doyoung, who lost her younger brother to a zombie, one day accidentally meets Jion, a student who closely resembles the zombie that bit her brother.

A friendship full of suspicion between two people that continues in a risky manner. Can this relationship last?

mangas.title: Kaii-bu: M-ken Y-shi no Kaigenshou ni Tsuite
mangas.titleNative: 怪異部～M県Y市の怪現象について～
mangas.synonyms: Kaiibu ~ M-ken Y-shi no Kai Genshou ni Tsuite~
mangas.description:
When transfer student Sakura Sakuraba arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Uzu Andou, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club. Their strange "club activities" are about to begin!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Pound of Flesh
mangas.description:
Sharing flesh for lunch? Very normal.


A world where people share their flesh. I give mine to others, and they carve a piece for me. It's toxic corporate culture on another level — how long could you last in a workplace like this?

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: Torture Princess: Fremd Torturchen
mangas.description:
I AM THE TORTURE PRINCESS, ELISABETH LE FANU.
I AM THE PROUD WOLF AND THE LOWLY SOW.



A beautiful woman appears before Kaito Sena following his tragic death and rebirth into another world. Introducing herself as the Torture Princess, she orders him to become her loyal servant. Naturally, his response is..."Hard pass." And so Elisabeth presents him with two choices-become her butler or be tortured to death. After rethinking his hasty decision, Kaito is forced to wait on Elisabeth hand and foot, as well as aid her in her mission as the Torture Princess, which is the subjugation of the fourteen ranked demons and their contractors. But there's a catch. Once her mission is complete, Elisabeth is fated to die alone-forsaken by heaven, earth, and all of creation.



(Source: Yen Press)



Note: Includes volume 7.5.

mangas.title: Yuujin no Shikijitsu: Ruu 1mm Sakuhinshuu
mangas.titleNative: 友人の式日 るぅ1mm作品集
mangas.description:
1. Nanashi no Koibito (ななしの恋人)

2. Yuureiyashiki Love Romance (幽霊屋敷ラブロマンス)

3. Frankenstein no Tomodachi (フランケンシュタインの友人)

4. Yuujin no Shikijitsu (友人の式日)

Shun died.

Kazuya's friend came back as a ghost with no memories from when he was alive, so they set out on a journey to uncover the mystery behind his death.

mangas.title: Castehate
mangas.description: Living the high school life, being admired by all the other species in his school, Rurikawa (Wolf. Alpha. Male.) meets a lower species, Kyougokuin (Rabbit. Beta. Male.) As soon as their eyes meet, Rurikawa thinks, "I want to breed this beautiful creature." He's suddenly unable to control his urges as he's turned on. In a world where men can also become pregnant, this series tells the story of high school boys being led around by their instincts and fate.

mangas.title: Mori Shuguang
mangas.description:
In the year of 2013, the tide of zombies outbreak exploded in everyone homeland, humanity launches a large-scale battle in the endless nights awaiting for the arrival of the dawn.



The end is approaching, is there going to be a way out for them?



Their faiths were shattered into pieces and buried in ashes in the raging fire.



But within the blazing fire, a newborn hope arise once again.

mangas.title: High-End Player of Mystery
mangas.description: When he opened his eyes one day, Yuyu found that he had entered a strange game world filled with monsters, and if you die, your death is broadcast live. To survive, you must beat the game. Fortunately, Yuyu meets the game's cold-mannered god, Yunze. Caring more about his life than his image, Yuyu clings to Yunze for help.

mangas.title: Moonchild
mangas.description:
Since childhood, Bak-Ha has been able to see "things" that others can't. On the first day at his new school, Bak-Ha meets Jin-Do, and due to the sickeningly sweet smell Bak-Ha has, Jin-Do notices he is different, just like himself. As they get closer, Bak-Ha finds out that he was the moonchild, the mythical creature who ruled the spirits in the past, and realizes that this is why the ghosts and demons are after him.



(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

mangas.title: Edzuke wa Yahan, Ano Heya de
mangas.titleNative: 餌付けは夜半、あの部屋で
mangas.description: Shinya owns a special shop named, Omoiro, that serves both humans and vampires known as "bats". There is a secret the shop owner has been holding for the past 10 years; it is to give blood to the man who has been his caretaker, Sunakawa Sanshirou, since the time he was a high school student. Since suddenly being attacked by a vampire while heading to a dinner, Sunakawa has became a "bat". Shinya decided the best way to stay connected to Sunakawa's is by making their relationship that of a Master & servant by giving him blood, hoping it would keep him by his side.

mangas.title: Flame Train
mangas.description: The clue to a missing person's case is hidden behind a child who is both beautiful and sinister.

mangas.title: Formless
mangas.description: Hui-Woon has what he thinks is an innocent little obsession, following (some would call it stalking) his fellow classmate Seo Kang-Woo around. Pure curiosity is all it is. Plus, Kang-Woo is super popular and good-looking and this is just for fun. But when things don't go according to plan and Hui-Woon gets caught red-handed, his life is about to change forever…

mangas.title: No Way, Vampires Don't Exist!
mangas.description:
Four college housemates — Ju-Won, Eun-Ho, Seon-Jae, and Gyu-Min — are in desperate need of a fifth person to fill a vacant room in their place. But their main concern isn't about paying rent: they're ravenous vampires, dying to sink their teeth into a fresh, live human! So they can't believe their luck when Dong-Ha, who grew up isolated from society, eagerly moves in with no idea of what awaits him. To the vampires' dismay, however, Dong-Ha doesn't weigh enough for them to suck his blood! As they shower their unsuspecting new housemate with food and attention to fatten him up, have they gotten too attached to their would-be prey? And is there more to sweet, naive Dong-Ha than meets the hungry vampires' eyes?



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)



Note: Chapter count includes 18 extra chapters.

mangas.title: Jaega Naerin Bada
mangas.description:
After the death of his family, Yoo Hae-Min suddenly developed hearing loss and was unable to play the piano, forcing him to give up on going to college.
While listening to an unfinished song he found in an old laptop, he hears a scream from upstairs and saves Shin Je-Yeon from being assaulted. The two, who grew closer through this incident, realize that their parents' sudden deaths and their obsession with music are similar and feel an inexplicable attraction to each other...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

mangas.title: SILENT HILL f
mangas.description:
An adaptation of the SILENT HILL f video game with a new ending written by the original scenario writer, Ryukishi07. It will be published on Kadokawa's web manga site, Young Ace UP.



(Source: official Silent Hill Twitter account, translated)

mangas.title: Dawn After Dark
mangas.description: Seung-hyun, who went to Hong Kong to become a stunt actor, encounters Director Yu Chun-hwa, a young man who has achieved success. However, due to his team leader's scheme, Baek Seung-hyun is taken to Yu Chun-hwa's lodging and forced to entertain him, causing Yu Chun-hwa to look at him with disdain. Amidst the growing misunderstanding, Yu Chun-hwa discovers Baek Seung-hyun's true character and acting skills, and begins to feel increasingly intrigued by him…

mangas.title: Lady Black Is Depressed
mangas.description:
All Margo wanted was some peace and quiet, even if she had to kill her husband to get it. She thought she'd gotten away with it too. She never expected the snowstorm or to be trapped in her house with suspicious eyes watching her every move. Margo's fate lies in the hands of a strange maid, Peggy, who catches her in the act of destroying evidence. But what will Margo do when the touch of those hands makes her tremble with pleasure? Will she find her respite, or be forced to kill again?

(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Follow the Sheep in the Abyss
mangas.description:
Due to a friend's betrayal, Yang Yo-han falls into the Abyss, the worst dungeon imaginable. In this monster-filled dungeon, Yo-han encounters Lee Hyun-mook, an Awakened Being who disappeared into the Abyss years ago and was once considered the strongest in Korea.

"Mr. Lee Hyun-mook, you can't kill me, you know? I'm... a human."
"Human..."
"That's right, I'm human... And Mr. Lee Hyun-mook, you're human too."

However, Lee Hyun-mook has been driven half-mad by the Abyss's influence.Yo-han struggles to survive in the Abyss, treating wounds and finding food alongside Lee Hyun-mook, who occasionally regains his sanity.

"Here, a phenomenon occurs approximately every few decades.And I call it a 'deluge.'"
"A deluge?"
"As the deluge approaches, the corruption and madness worsen... just as I was until a moment ago."

But due to the sudden approach of the deluge, Lee Hyun-mook completely loses his mind...

"You're a lamb, why aren't you crying?"
"I'm not a lamb, I'm Yang Yo-han..."
"My little lamb."

Between the harsh environment of the Abyss, the festering wound on one of his legs,the terrifying monsters that attack with howls, and now, the bizarre actions of the deranged Lee Hyun-mook...Thanks to all this, Yo-han's escape story from another world has him crying every single day!

mangas.title: Tied to You
mangas.description:
Si-Won and Beom-Woo had been friends since childhood. Therefore, the news that Si-Won had suddenly left to study abroad without a word deeply hurt Beom-Woo. Six years later, a familiar voice sharply pierced Beom-Woo, who had been living a dissolute life...

"Are you a slut?"

As if to prove that much had changed in their relationship.

mangas.title: Guiding Me Mad
mangas.description: Su-Won is an S-class Guide with a notorious temper and a strict "no-touching" rule. After beating up one too many Espers who tried to get handsy, he's given one last chance to save his career: a month-long live-in contract with the powerful Esper Gong Ian. There's just one problem. Ian is the same pervert Su-Won caught grinding against him on the bus earlier that day! To make matters worse, Ian isn't just a creep, but a massive masochist who gets off on Su-Won's violence. Su-Won came to guide him, but he might end up beating him into bliss instead.

mangas.title: Three Nights
mangas.synonyms: Three Nights, We Really Do It
mangas.description:
Hangyeol loves music, but for some reason, he just cannot write love songs. Desperate for advice, he visits a fortune-teller, only to receive the strangest solution imaginable: ""If romance is too hard,"" the old man tells him, ""then at least try sleeping with someone. Anyone."" Leaving with more questions than answers, a flustered Hangyeol somehow ends up surrounded by three very different men…in more ways than one. Caught between inspiration, temptation, and pure confusion, Hangyeol must figure out whether he can finally lose his innocence - and maybe find his muse along the way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Friend or Faux
mangas.description: After being framed for bullying his bully, Seon-U is forced to transfer to a new school. All he wants there is a peaceful life, but that flies out the window when he meets Sion, who seems friendly on the outside but has a few glaring red flags. Despite Seon-U's efforts to avoid him, Sion becomes his friend with an odd persistence and is obsessive, touchy-feely, and manipulative. Even so, Seon-U wants to trust the only person who seems to see his true self... but can he really let his guard down around him?

mangas.title: Beast of Blue Obsidian
mangas.description: In the year 3574 of the Lista calendar, the world started moving toward destruction. In this already decaying world, 500 years later, the black-robed-elf Ariman Campbell takes over an Orc-female beast, Eve, by accident. Their meeting set the wheel of fate in motion, which could lead to a major storm...

mangas.title: [Live] The Hunt Begins
mangas.description: When Hwieon survives his brother's demonic attack, a grim reaper leaves him one cryptic mission: find the living Hungerwraith. Now a reluctant ghost-hunting streamer, he crosses paths with Gyeol — the worst possible ally, and the one person he can't seem to walk away from.

mangas.title: Yuri Wall
mangas.description:
"As an outsider, I want to silently protect and watch over the love between women…," said a yuri fanatic that got hit by a car and reincarnated as a wall in a certain apartment! And for some reason, the residents of the apartment room are always two girls in yuri relationship… Let's support these cute and heartwarming couples together with the passionate wall in "Yuri Wall"!



(Source: Manga.club)

mangas.title: The Ghost of You
mangas.synonyms: ゴースト・イン・ザ・タウン
mangas.description:
In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jin-Yeong and Seo Ji-Su prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jin-Yeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Ji-Su as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: The Shaman's Dwelling
mangas.description:
