Once celebrated as a gifted shaman, Kwon Hae-Eon has fallen far from grace. Having lost his divine power, he survives by scamming clients and pretending his abilities still exist. Then one night, Mun U-Jin, a devout Christian man possessed by an unknown entity, bursts into the shrine and jumps him. The moment their bodies intertwine, Hae-Eon's long dormant spiritual power suddenly returns.
Sensing an opportunity, Hae-Eon manipulates the unlucky, possession plagued U-Jin into staying at the shrine. Each night, using U-Jin's body as a medium, he engages with the mysterious being inside him, restoring more of his stolen energy. But when morning comes, U-Jin remembers nothing. All he sees are the unmistakable remnants of intense, forbidden intimacy that occurred while he was unaware. For a man who has lived his life with strict faith and purity, the truth feels like a divine punishment.



"How much worse can my luck get, Lord? Why must I endure this torment?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Ingwaeungbo
mangas.description:
Joo-Heon and Seo Kang-Woo met at a university drinking party, were drawn to each other, and became lovers after a one-night stand . Kang-Woo expected a normal relationship, but Joo-Heon's rough and unruly behavior, seemingly devoid of emotion at crucial moments, ultimately leads to a breakup.

"You're the kind of person who can't love anyone, so live alone and never see anyone again."

Joo-Heon tries to appear calm, but Kang-Woo's absence makes him increasingly worn out, and he finally seeks out Kang-Woo in a precarious state and holds him captive.

"I'll fix that, even though I was sometimes harsh. I won't do it again... Just stay like this for ten minutes, no, just one minute."

Kang-Woo can't refuse Joo-Heon's desperate plea, almost pathetic, and ends up accepting him. The painful regret and intense love of two people who have lived completely different lives— and the law of cause and effect.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: 50% Interest Rate
mangas.description: Rookie director Lee Suh-Rim is at his wit's end. Lee Su-Noh, the hottest star around, joined Suh-Rim's project but keeps skipping production meetings. Soon, the whole production might fall apart before it can begin. Out of options, Suh-Rim decides to cash in on a secret only he knows about the actor. Years ago, he paid Su-Noh for something special... something that Su-Noh has not yet delivered. So now, Su-Noh owes him... with 50% interest. Will this leverage help Suh-Rim? Or will it be the final nail?

mangas.title: Inferior Cream
mangas.description:
Cool chill tsundere streamer x naive multiracial rich beauty



Li Naiyou ran away from home. He streams his company's most popular game every day but has zero viewers until he meets a cool streamer. The cool streamer invites Naiyou to stream with him, but Naiyou doesn't know why. Li Naiyou isn't doing anything, but the cool streamer seems to think he's poor.



One day, the presidential suite Li Naiyou lives in gets flooded, and he's depressed about having to switch houses. He posts "I'm so sad... my house got flooded. My new house feels so small and foreign ;-;" Five seconds later, the cool streamer response. "If you're in a difficult situation, I actually... have a spare room."



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

mangas.title: Moonquake
mangas.description:
One day, the moon crashes into the heart of the city, and nothing is ever the same again. Half the city lies in ruins, and in its wake, people begin awakening strange new powers. These espers soon split into two factions: those who serve the city as government-licensed protectors, and those who live among the fallen moon, wielding their powers by their own rules. When government golden-boy Kang Jin-Woong finds himself suddenly reliant on none other than Jae-Heo, the rebellious leader of the moon-born resistance, everything he thinks he knows starts to come into question. Enemies by fate, drawn together by something deeper…can their connection survive a world on the edge of collapse?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Wimpy Demon King and Tsundere Hero
mangas.titleNative: ヘタレ魔王とツンデレ勇者
mangas.description:
Prince Ike embarked on an epic quest with one goal: defeat the evil Demon King of Mano and free his kingdom from fear. Disguised as a woman, Ike hopes to feign being kidnapped and get closer to the king. Things almost go according to plan, but right before Ike can make the deadly strike, he's knocked out by the Demon King's retainers. When he comes to, he discovers that he's not chained up or being kept a prisoner and is instead treated to a meal! Still full of fight, Ike declares he won't be going anywhere until he defeats the Demon King.

Unfortunately for Prince Ike, the supposedly great and powerful Demon King is actually a huge wimp! Every time Ike tries to attack him, the demon just runs away or hides. It becomes a daily occurrence, and before Ike knows it, he's actually learning a lot about this Demon King. Like how he treasures all of his houseplants, and he's quite a worry wart over everyone—even Ike! As the two spend more time together, will this lead to something unexpected?

mangas.title: To My Dear Horror
mangas.description:
When hardworking student Wan ends up covering his father's job at a wealthy estate, a run-in with the sprinklers leaves him soaked — and catches the eye of Jung-Hoo, the ruthless heir who's never been denied anything. One look, and Wan's fate veers off course.

(Source: Manta)

mangas.title: An Email From My Dead Lover
mangas.synonyms: An Email Comes From a Dead Lover
mangas.description: Hui-Su Lee was shocked to see an email from his boyfriend who died in a tragic accident a year ago. He told himself it was a prank, but the ghostly visits every night were impossible to explain. With no one else to turn to, he reached out to the internet and connected with I-Hyeon Baek. Once I-Hyeon realized the dangerous situation Hui-Su was in, he agreed to help. But nothing seems to be able to stop the ghost from coming each night, and it's getting more and more violent with every visit…

mangas.title: What a Catch!
mangas.description:
From the creator of Hook, Line, and Sinker comes its hilarious sequel!

Now that Kye-Soo and Myung-Tae are free of Kang Shin-Joo, he has his eyes set his next target - Myung-Tae's older brother, Young-Joo. And while Young-Joo doesn't exactly reciprocate the interest, he's having a hard time forgetting the particularly…perky aspects of Shin-Joo's undeniably flawless physique. Will the smarmy schemer Shin-Joo be able to use his charisma to reel in his bait this time? Or is this relationship dead in the water before it even begins?

mangas.title: One Plus One Delivery Service
mangas.description:
"All I ask for is your evenings."

Soaked from the rain, Joo-ahn steps into a stranger's penthouse and enters a world of seduction, secrets, and a contract sealed with desire. He needs money, but what he gets is a man who wants far more than just his time.

mangas.title: Me, Fall For You?
mangas.description:
His personality aside, Kiki, a medical student, is the perfect, most desirable bachelor. None of his relationships ever seem to last long, as he goes from one boyfriend to the next, but he's growing tired of this kind of life. Hikage, the waiter at Kiki's favorite café, openly shows disdain for him, unlike everyone else. But, one night, when Kiki returns to the café after closing to get his backpack, he catches Hikage pleasuring himself to Kiki at his usual table!



Hikage has always wanted to be with a man, and since Kiki's the only other gay man that he knows, he's been fantasizing about him. This unexpected naughty side of Hikage gets Kiki's engine going, so he gives Hikage one heck of a first-time experience, making him climax over and over again. To top it all off, he promises to meet Hikage there every Thursday and sleep with him...



A good-looking scumbag overtaken by his desires and an awkward beautiful man with a feisty personality. Are they both only into each other for their bodies!? This is a bittersweet love story that starts from being friends with benefits!



(Source: Renta!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: Last Dot
mangas.description:
Ju-Won is a new hire in the product development team of a tea manufacturing company, quietly nursing a crush on his handsome and composed supervisor, Assistant Manager Yul. Content to admire from afar, Ju-Won keeps his feelings to himself—until one day, Yul suddenly frowns and asks, "Did someone wear perfume in the office?"


Ju-Won denies it, but Yul insists there's a scent that only seems to linger when he's around. Intrigued, Yul starts leaning in close, sniffing Ju-Won during every encounter under the guise of a "smell check." What begins as an awkward misunderstanding turns into a daily ritual—one that leaves Ju-Won flustered, especially as his body begins to react to Yul's warm breath and closeness. Caught between the sweetness of unspoken affection and the thrill of their strange new routine, Ju-Won wonders…


Could Yul be picking up more than just a scent?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: We're Not Cut Out to be Lovers
mangas.titleNative: 俺たちは恋人に向いていない
mangas.description:
Introducing the noisy neighbor of your nightmares: a Youtuber.



It's been six months since broody auto-mechanic Kumazawa moved in next door to Koichi, a streamer who claims to be an expert on love. After one too many loud recordings, Kumazawa finally snaps and shows up at Koichi's door... only to shut him up with a passionate kiss!



Kumazawa has no interest in pursuing a straight guy, but Koichi stops by night after night and won't leave until he's "satisfied." Coming off the heels of a traumatic breakup in which his partner cheated, Kumazawa is convinced he and Koichi won't work out, but Koichi is determined to persuade him otherwise. Can a physical relationship between two people who are totally NOT "meant to be" turn into something real...?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Happy of the End
mangas.titleNative: ハッピー・オブ・ジ・エンド
mangas.description:
Dazed and confused, Chihiro awakes on a pile of garbage with memories of wedding still fresh in his mind. When out of the blue a young man named Keito appears before him. Instantly, he then recalls the night he spent with this person. The booze! The hotel! The punch to his face!



Chihiro may not have a place to call home currently and Keito may not be a good person by any means, but maybe the two of them could be happy together.



(Source: KUMA)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

mangas.title: Degenerate
mangas.description: While pursuing a case, Detective I-Eum Kim of the Violent Crimes Unit rescues a man collapsed on a mountain trail. Stricken with amnesia, the man believes himself to be a child... Thus begins I-Eum's dangerous cohabitation with a mysterious stranger.

mangas.title: Yeousanyang
mangas.description:
Eun Seon-Myeong, a hunter and exorcist with two curses on his body, forms an alliance with Shim Yi-yul, a fox who he went to kill on a request, and begins living together. They get along well despite being wary and disgusted with each other, but after spending a night with Shim Yi-Yul during his mating season, driven by instinct... they become a little different...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

mangas.title: Can You Love an XL Like Me?
mangas.titleNative: 大きい俺でも愛してくれますか？
mangas.synonyms: Ookii Ore demo Itoshite Kuremasu ka?
mangas.description:
"Show it to me and I'll keep it a secret!"



Sakakima is in charge of training new employees. However, Arashida, who has just joined the company, does everything perfectly, so Sakakima is in no position to teach him... One day, a party is held to celebrate Arashida's completion of a big job, and Sakakima gives him a drunken ride home. When Arashida arrives in his room, he collapses onto the bed, his clothes half off. When Sakajima looks down at his Arashida's crotch, he finds a secret that is too big to hide...? As much as Sakajima can't stand his coworker's perfection, he still longs to see the perverted expression on his face...

mangas.title: Love Me Like You Owe Me
mangas.description:
In order to pay off his mother's crushing debt, Woo Min-Jo finds himself delivering coffee in high heels to a construction firm run by the notorious gangster, Chu Gio. What starts as a misfortune spirals into a bizarre fate, as Gio quickly takes an interest in Min-Jo. And before he knows it, Min-Jo goes from a broke errand boy to the unlikely "bride" of a thug...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Blood Poker
mangas.description: After reawakening from a C-rank to the strongest A-rank Esper, Ha Jae-Il is pushed to the brink by insomnia and unresolved trauma, unable to endure even the slightest touch. His only match is Seung-Hyeon, an A-rank Guide with a 98 percent compatibility who comes from the lawless District 13 and lacks all formal guiding skills. With no other options, the Haon Division orders an extreme solution: the two must share a bed twice a week. But when Jae-Il wakes to unfamiliar hands in the dark and sees Seung-Hyeon looming over him, he realizes that something else has awakened as well - and it is already guiding him.

mangas.title: Dear Stranger
mangas.synonyms: To Me Who Doesn't Love You
mangas.description: After surviving a car accident that left him in a months-long coma, Lee Soo-Han wakes up with no memory of his past. Standing by his side is a mysterious man who claims to be his husband—Jo Yeon-Seo. Although they're supposedly married, the emotional distance between them feels insurmountable. Soo-Han grows wary of Yeon-Seo, yet he can't help but be drawn to the man's steadfast devotion. Just as Soo-Han begins to feel a connection, Yeon-Seo shatters his expectations with a shocking revelation: he's ready to give Soo-Han a divorce—for his own good. The more his young husband pulls away, the more genuine Soo-Han's feelings become. Determined to break through Yeon-Seo's guarded heart, Soo-Han takes matters into his own hands.

mangas.title: Let Dai
mangas.description:
Is this desire for freedom the very thing that entrapped us?

Let Dai is a tragic tale of forbidden love and unforgivable betrayal.

Set in a soulless neo-Seoul ruled by young punks and pleasure seekers, an amoral teenager named Dai is the living embodiment of the city's beauty and cruelty.

As the leader of the vicious Furies gang, Dai seduces everyone who lays eyes on him, only to blind them to his own barbaric nature. When an honest schoolboy named Jae-Hee rescues a beautiful girl from being mugged by the Furies, he can't possibly realize how this brief encounter will plunge him into a downward spiral of unbridled passion and unfathomable pain.

From his brutal gang initiation to an unspeakable act committed against his girlfriend, Jae-Hee wavers uncomfortably between revulsion and fascination. And in Dai he finds a tender, caring friend one moment and a heartless sociopath the next, awakening strange and unhealthy desires in Jae-Hee that he could never before have imagined.

mangas.title: Tied to You
mangas.description: It's only sleeping together while holding hands, nothing else. That's what Shin Wooseo tells himself when a red ring that ties a person to their soulmate appears on his finger one day. Once two people get tied by the ring, they cannot fall asleep unless they're physically together. However, his destined partner isn't his long-term friend and secret crush, Kang Jiseok, but rather his older brother, Kang Jigeon! And so starts the tragedy of loving one brother but having to share beds with the other. Although, it might not entirely be a tragedy, as Kang Jigeon doesn't seem so disappointed about being tied to his younger brother's best friend…

mangas.title: TEN
mangas.description:
Min Ji-Ho's idol career as a member of a mid-tier K-pop group member ends in emotional turmoil and disappointment. Ready to leave the industry behind for good, Ji-Ho unexpectedly finds himself filling in on a variety show…only to cross paths with Kang Tae-Yeon, the A-list actor he's long admired. A lighthearted moment on set quickly spirals into a headline-making scandal: the first same-sex "incident" in the industry. Though the rumors fade as quickly as they came, Ji-Ho's quiet exit is once again delayed. When an awkward reunion with former groupmate Park Hyeon-Do pulls him back into old tensions, Ji-Ho is forced to confront not just his past, but the unresolved wounds he thought he left behind with his life as an idol. In a world where appearances are everything, can Jiho uncover what he truly wants…and who he wants to stand beside him when the cameras are off?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Shameless for You
mangas.synonyms: ความอับอายเป็นของหวาน
mangas.description:
Five years into their relationship, Gong Min-Jae and Yoon Jae-Hyun are still in love, but Jae-Hyun can no longer be satisfied by ordinary intimacy. When a reckless encounter sparks something new, Min-Jae draws him Jae-Hyun into bolder, more provocative experiences, as he discovers a pleasure that's impossible to resist. As their desire intensifies, so does the thrill of crossing lines.
Is it wrong to want this much... or is love meant to be shameless?


(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

mangas.title: Jirai-kei Kareshi Suzu-kun
mangas.description:
Completely shutting out the outside world with a mask!!! One day, Suzu, a gloomy college boy with no friends and poor communication skills, loses his one-of-a-kind, precious mascot, "Kappa-chan." While looking around desperately, the one who picked it up and called out to him was the popular and handsome playboy, Sasamuro Aiji, with pretty girls in tow. Though he wanted to get it back quickly and flee the scene, Aiji deliberately teased him and wouldn't give it back, making Suzu cry.



Suzu managed to get Kappa-chan back, but on top of dealing with kind of person he most disliked, Kappa-chan was damaged, sending him into a depression. The next day, Aiji gets involved with him again by using him as an excuse to run away from his fans. With no concern for Suzu's feelings of dislike, Aiji demands his thanks for picking up Kappa-chan. But when Suzu bluntly told Aiji, "A cheery person like you is a land mine!" Aiji suddenly kissed him through his maskー!!!?



The handsome, popular, and outgoing guy x Timid, gloomy boy with no friends and poor communication skills. The love between two polar opposites tied together by the cute and mysterious "Kappa-chan."



Notes:

- Originally a five-part serialization completed on 2021-11-24. It was restarted in 2022-05-23 and again on 2023-11-24

mangas.title: Hajimete no Otomodachi wa Zombie deshita
mangas.titleNative: はじめてのお友達はゾンビでした
mangas.description:
"The zombie world might not be so bad!"



Eko-chan, a bullied girl, enjoys the devastated post-apocalyptic world with her first friend (who has become a zombie). It's a survival adventure with a friend who is slowly losing her humanity!



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: You Dirty, Sweaty Boy
mangas.titleNative: 君はやらしい汗っかき
mangas.description:
"Ahhhh… Sweat is the best!"



I'm a profuse sweater, and the colleague I fell for just happens to have a sweat fetish?! Stop sniffing and licking me...!

(Source: Coolmic)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

mangas.title: The Unexpected Neighbor
mangas.description:
Ja-Yeon, a recessive omega, gets into Hankuk University to find the mysterious "Gong Ju" who saved him when he was in middle school. He immediately finds Gong-Ju, but it turns out his savior has a twin! Ja-Yeon tries to figure out which alpha twin helped him and believes it to be Gong Ju-Eun. Convinced of his savior's identity Ja-Yeon asks Gong Ju-Dan to help him win over the icy twin, but Ju-Dan won't do it for free.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Slow Damage: Zenjitsutan
mangas.titleNative: スロウ・ダメージ～前日譚～
mangas.description: In near future Japan, protagonist Towa lives a self-indulgent lifestyle in the Special Administrative Distract of "Shingoumi," and has a hobby of "painting human desires." Allowing their desires to be hurled onto him, he channels the experience through his brush. To him, it need not matter if he or the other party are gravely wounded in exchange for the fulfillment of their desire. Because the very act itself, is what brings the other party their "happiness"...

mangas.title: Baby, Light My Fire
mangas.description: Myung-Sun lives for lazy days, dating apps, and dodging work at his family's BBQ joint. He's on the hunt for a buff guy to fulfill his fantasies—so when a ripped part-timer appears, it feels like fate. But when they both turn out to be tops, things start getting heated!

mangas.title: Omertà
mangas.description:
After losing his mother to the mafia, Ro-Wan goes undercover to destroy the organization from the inside. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets its enigmatic leader, Raphael Valentino…a man he should loathe, but can't seem to ignore. Determined to bring the seedy underbelly of New York down - whether as Rafael's hunting dog or as someone powerful enough to crush it from above - Ro-Wan spends years as a member of his gang. But the more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to draw the line between duty and desire. In a world built upon lies and vengeance, can this tangled relationship end in love…or will it all fall apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: Eighteen's Bed
mangas.description:
There are people in the world who particularly catch others' attention. Jun Kang, who lived as the 'good model student' while secretly hiding his miserable one-sided love, finds himself entangled with Yohan Go, a classmate he now shares a class with in the second year... What if he had liked Yohan Go instead?

"Jun, how is it? The taste of first love."

mangas.title: Yoosu, You Shouldn't Eat That!
mangas.description: A house covered with unidentified plants. Yoo-soo, who endured picking the fruits of a plant in a collapsing house, finally made a call. The meeting with Jae-hee, a special agent who came! What kind of relationship will lead to the first meeting between the two that wasn't just Yuquera?

mangas.title: Flower of Allure
mangas.description:
I-Yeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics… and lies: "I'm your wife."

Can she survive the man who doesn't remember her—or what he did?

mangas.title: Nei You Equan Qing Xiaoxin
mangas.description:
By chance, the exorcist Xiaoyu was forced into a living arrangement with Heiyao, the succubus who killed her foster-father. But Heiyao seemed to have lost her memories!? Xiaoyu didn't trust Heiyao, so she decided to stay and keep an eye on her. Heiyao didn't mind, as she tried to tease and seduce Xiaoyu in order to feed her hunger… They might fight all the time, but they both know there are other dangers lurking, with whoever was behind Xiaoyu's father's murder, whoever sealed away Heiyao's memories, and something else…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

mangas.title: Lovesick Dog
mangas.description:
"About 14,000 years ago, certain wolves caught a disease called "lovesickness." And when they met people, they became their companion dogs."



If one word could encapsulate Noh Ye-gyum, it would be "lovesick." Despite him loving people with all his heart, Ye-gyum finds himself trapped in an endless cycle of being used, betrayed, and ultimately abandoned. This time proves no different for him, as the family of his current ""master"" Jooyung drives him away to pave the path for Jooyung's advantageous marriage and future spouse. Alone once again, Ye-gyum is left to gather his belongings and leave. Or is he? Suddenly, a mysterious man named Jooin appears, sweeping Ye-gyum away to his home. There, he is fed, clothed, and showered with an overwhelming amount of affection. As Ye-gyum senses the telltale signs of his lovesickness resurfacing, an uncertainty lingers: will this man also leave him, or could he finally hold the cure to this lifelong affliction?



(Source: Lezhin US)


Note: Includes eight side story chapters.

mangas.title: Psychedelics
mangas.description: This is a series of doujinshi. As Psyche Delico says, it's not a sequel for the series mentioned/worked in them. They are self parodies of her works released as doujinshi; both hilarious and smutty.

mangas.title: Merman in My Tub
mangas.description: What happens when an intruder from the sea stakes claim to your bathtub? A cool yet demure teenage boy named Tatsumi must learn to live with the self-obsessed and playful merman, Wakasa, in a small Tokyo Apartment. These two dissimilar young men will learn what it takes to deal with one another in their everyday lives. Of course, impromptu visits by Wakasa's ocean friends―an anthropomorphised octopus, jelly fish, and hermit crab―do not make things easier. Welcome to Tatsumi's bathtub. It's getting crowded.

mangas.title: Childhood Sweetheart
mangas.description: Exhausted mentally and physically, Song Liaoliao is ready to leave it all behind. She couldn't have anticipated that the new director is her past sweet– No, her old classmate. It should simply be a reunion of old friends, but Song Liaoliao unexpectedly finds herself slowly falling into Pei Yu's love trap...

mangas.title: Contractual Marriage to a Surly Duke
mangas.description: Tragedy strikes when Selene's parents pass away, and her family loses everything. With no other option at her disposal, she works multiple jobs to provide for her siblings. Luckily an opportunity for financial security arises; all she must do is marry the duchess's son, Armand, and produce an heir. But the home situation Selene enters is complex, and Armand, once a great commander, is housebound with a mysterious condition. She's determined to find the root of his illness, but she might drudge up some skeletons in the closet instead...

mangas.title: Crush of a Lifetime
mangas.synonyms: The Omniscient Point of View of an Unrequited Love
mangas.description:
Hye-Ji is a famous SNS star with over 100,000 Instagram followers. Due to her popularity, Hye-Ji has received many confessions, but despite that, she doesn't really have much dating experience. One day, Hye-Ji received an invitation to go out on a date with another popular SNS star whom she secretly admired. On the day of the long-awaited date, Hye-Ji couldn't stand the subtle light coming from the karaoke bar, so she decides to use her feet to take a selfie. But due to an accident, Gi-Seong, who was a part-timer at that time, ended up seeing her in an embarrassing position.

After such a disastrous date, Hye-Ji decided to end her first-ever relationship. However, on her first day at school, she meets Hae-Ri, the person who gave her that embarrassing memory!

mangas.title: A Friendship So Impure
mangas.description: Siyeong and Jihoo are "just friends." At least, that's what Siyeong tells herself before they share a steamy night that redefines their relationship forever. How was she supposed to know that the guy who invited her to work at his company, hasn't dated anyone in almost a decade, and has been pining for her since college might want more? Still, being upset with her lying boyfriend was no excuse for the drunken night she had with her pseudo-friendzoned boss. Now Siyeong is torn between the man she's loved for the past nine years and the one who was by her side through everything. Can she find the will to forgive the very person who sent her running into the arms of another man, or will she fall head over heels for her longtime friend and risk losing him forever?

mangas.title: Yokohama Shopping Log
mangas.titleNative: ヨコハマ買い出し紀行
mangas.description: Set hundreds of years in the future after an environmental catastrophe, Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou (also known as Yokohama Shopping Log) centers on the simple life of Alpha, an android who runs a small coffee shop in coastal Japan. Alpha stands witness to chronicle the end of humanity's days with coffee, a slice of watermelon, and the sound of her moon guitar backed by distant seagulls. Quiet and bittersweet, this tale is about the melancholy beauty that can be found even as the end approaches.

mangas.title: Daughter of the Archmage
mangas.description: Mabel's been mocked her whole life for her nonexistent magical ability, but when she finally meets her true father, it's the all-powerful archmage, Raquiel! Forced by an imperial pact to let her go long ago, he can now welcome her into his home, with his half-wolf butler, three nymph sisters, a fox halfling, and a kind disciple to watch over her. But dark secrets from his past threaten to catch up with them. Will his magic be enough to protect her? Could she even come into power all her own?

mangas.title: Darling, Why Can't We Divorce?
mangas.synonyms: Honey, Why Can't We Get a Divorce?
mangas.description: After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?

Since being identified as a Guide at the age of five, Choi Tae-Hun has spent his life searching for his destined Esper, but has never found one. Now 28 years old, he unexpectedly meets his match at an autograph signing for top celebrity Ji Gwan-Yeong, after being persuaded to attend by his younger sibling. As they begin working together due to their unique connection, Tae-Hun struggles with the unexpected intensity of their bond. He insists that their relationship must remain professional, denying any romantic involvement, while Ji Gwan-Yeong remains confident and unfazed, teasingly suggesting that their connection will evolve into something more. Despite his reluctance, Tae-Hun finds himself increasingly drawn to Gwan-Yeong, leading to a complicated and tension-filled relationship.

mangas.title: Don't Be Too Nice
mangas.description: Just four years ago, Rustica Genas was the most gifted knight in the Caleta Empire and one of the emperor's most trusted servants. But after challenging his will one too many times, all of her fame, glory, and power were stripped from her. Then what can poor Rustica do but shamefully fade into obscurity? Well, when the rival empire's ruler sets his sights on winning her heart and freedom, she might have a chance to reclaim more than just her reputation. What could be waiting for her just beyond the Great Barrier?

mangas.title: A Simple Guide To Surviving as a Stepmom
mangas.titleNative: 계모인데, 죽음을 피하는 게 너무 쉽다
mangas.description: When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true?

mangas.title: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre
mangas.synonyms: Adopting the Male Protagonist Changed the Genre
mangas.description: Nobody understands why the wicked Belinda Blanche is giving special treatment to her child servant. They don't realize she's actually from the modern world, and her servant's the hero of her favorite childcare game! All Belinda wants is to give the hero the love he deserves, but the game keeps twisting her words to make her sound like a third-rate villain. Can Belinda beat the game and figure out how to fangirl without saying a single kind word? Or will she be forced to play the bad guy forever?

mangas.title: Baby Dragon to the Duke's Rescue
mangas.description: After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He's prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille. Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast… until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability. Will Acille change Edenver's life for the better in more ways than one?

mangas.title: Carefully Choosing a Husband
mangas.synonyms: Be Careful When Choosing a Husband
mangas.description: After her mother's death, Elrose Basellan was cast out by her father for 14 years. With news of his passing, Elrose rushes to claim her inheritance, but can't do so unless she's married! Desperate, she prays for a husband, and the mysterious Rakshan seems to fall from the sky! They agree to a temporary union that benefits them both, but unexpected issues keep delaying their plans for divorce. Will this fake marriage become something more? Or should Elrose have chosen her husband more carefully?

mangas.title: A Marriage Alliance for Revenge
mangas.description: Empress Olivia knows happiness is the last thing she deserves, but when she finally becomes pregnant with the emperor's child, she thinks things might finally be taking a turn for the better. Alas, Olivia realizes how naive she was when her husband poisons her tea, killing both her and their unborn child. When Olivia opens her eyes again in the body of an unknown woman in the slums, she vows to take vengeance against the emperor. To do so, she forms a marriage alliance with her former fiancé, Duke Lucas Viterpan, the true heir to the empire who was deposed in a coup. Will this man and woman who had everything taken from them succeed in getting revenge?

mangas.title: Please Stop Following Me, ML!
mangas.description:
One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist's friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything… but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it. It should've been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was… into men?! Now, he's launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

"…Your voice is quite unforgettable."

…Yep. My life is officially over.

mangas.title: Breaking News: I'm Married to the Grand Duke?!
mangas.synonyms: [Breaking News] Marriage with the Archduke, I Know Now
mangas.description: Libelle Ibella, a viscount's daughter, works undercover as a reporter to repay her father's gambling debt. ⁤⁤While covering a story, she accidentally discovers her fiancé's love affair. Devastated and heartbroken, she drunkenly proposes to Systain von Diranta, a stranger at a bar. ⁤⁤To her surprise, she wakes up with a marriage approval letter signed by the grand duke himself. ⁤⁤Overnight, Libelle finds herself thrust into the role of grand duchess, struggling to balance her new duties with her secret life as a reporter. ⁤⁤And little does Systain know that she's the reporter behind a scandalous article questioning his manhood...

mangas.title: A Happy Ending for the Young Villain
mangas.synonyms: For the Young Villain's Happy Ending
mangas.description: When Ahn Dohwa finds herself in an unfinished novel as Archmage Reina Heart, she resolves to lie low until the story reaches a resolution. However, unable to turn a blind eye to the abuse inflicted upon the story's villain, Prince Kevenriak Heteroven, she takes the young prince under her wing and begins training him as her pupil, hoping to change his destiny. But when everything starts to deviate from the original story, Reina's resolve wavers... Can she protect everyone's happy ending?

mangas.title: 'Cause Calypso Can
mangas.description: At age 3, Calypso Aquasiadel is the most outstanding genius her family's ever seen, and no wonder... She's actually a modern girl who's been reborn into the same novel thrice! This time around, Calypso's determined to harness the powers of the mysterious dragon duke and send herself back home. The only problem is, she'll first need to earn the respect of her hardened family to survive until then! Can Calypso win their approval and even their hearts? Or is this life doomed for another do-over?

mangas.title: Azure Night, Waltz of Rapture
mangas.synonyms: Azure Night, the Waltz Oh Rapture
mangas.description: When a night out to a piano recital turns into a literal nightmare for Seo-Yun, she's unceremoniously inducted into a world of horrifying beings. There, she meets Hui-Won, a charming "superbia" who informs her that she is nothing more than food for these creatures born of sin. Now, she must succumb to the likes of vampires and incubi as they feed on her for sustenance. Can she escape the darkness that lurks under the cover of night, or will she find a reason to stay inside this sinister realm?

mangas.title: Disobey the Duke if You Dare
mangas.description:
You must never see the duke's face.

After her second husband's death, Lily is forced into a third marriage by her father. Her new husband is rumored to be a monstrous warmonger, but to Lily's surprise, the Duke turns out to be a kind man and husband. There's just one catch... she must never see his face.

mangas.title: Childcare Diary With the Villain
mangas.description: Mary didn't know what to expect of the afterlife, but it certainly wasn't becoming the evil, murderous nanny of the novel she was reading. Her circumstances become secondary concerns when she realizes that no matter what, Briel must remain safe. It's the only way to keep his uncle, Count Kentryle Chalant, from the path of revenge. Can she keep her new charge safe and change the entire plot, or will the true villain get the best of them all? And is she going to find love on the way?

mangas.title: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family
mangas.synonyms: Adoptée par la famille des Assassins
mangas.description: After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle's house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick. Will she be able to keep her healing powers secret in this notorious family of assassins and find true happiness and love in her new life?

mangas.title: A Wicked Tale of Cinderella's Stepmom
mangas.description: We all know the fairytale: the glass slipper, the not-so-pretty stepsisters, and a night with the prince until the clock strikes midnight. I have been reincarnated into that classic story, not as Cinderella, but as her "wicked" stepmother! Widowed twice by age 37 and with three daughters, my goal is to make sure all will have suitable partners and their own happily ever afters... and maybe a nice future for me as well! But who is this handsome young baron that keeps approaching me?

mangas.title: Being Raised by Villains
mangas.description: Neglected by her family, Cha Mi-So dreams of life in her favorite novel as the beloved main character. Then one day, she wakes up inside the novel, but as Eileen Etam, a downtrodden side character who will be kicked out of her home! To avoid further neglect, she plots to leave before that occurs. But when Erno Etam, the crazy heir to House Etam, claims that Eileen is his daughter, her plans are foiled, and Eileen finds herself in the middle of a conflict between House Etam and a cast of villains.

mangas.title: A Match Made in Mana
mangas.description: Lilienne Islar died an abusive mother, a neglected wife, and a cast-off stepsister. So when she suddenly opens her eyes again as her younger self, she decides to set things right with the people in her life. Luckily, her stepbrother's a secret softie who's easy to win over. Her fiancé, on the other hand, is a magic-powered war machine doomed for insanity. With an illness draining her mana daily, will Lilienne have the strength to save her future husband and maybe even the whole empire?

mangas.title: Becoming the Dark Hero's Daughter
mangas.synonyms: How to Be a Dark Hero's Daughter
mangas.description: Duke Kallen de Lewelton is bloodthirsty and ruthless when it comes to killing criminals, but a total sucker when it comes to his new daughter! Peasant girl Lae learns this herself when a fateful run-in with the duke results in her adoption into the Lewelton home. Armed with a sharp mind and the knowledge from her past life, Lae makes the perfect addition to the family's quest to quell injustice. But as the mysteries of the capital's underbelly rise to the surface, will she and her new family withstand the return of a true criminal mastermind?

mangas.title: The Annex Never Sleeps
mangas.synonyms: The Light in the Annex Does Not Go Out
mangas.description:
She stumbled into the annex by chance.
The man was completely naked, not a single thread on him.
Lee Seo’s jaw dropped.

……Oh my God.

The thick pillar between the man’s legs—even though it was hanging limply downward—was as thick as a person’s forearm.
A languid voice flew like an arrow and pierced her ear.

“You’re staring too much. Does my dick look that good to suck on?”

mangas.title: Dramatic Scandal
mangas.description: After years of friendship and one reckless night, Hae-In ghosted A-list actor Woo-Hyun. Three years later, she's the writer of his new drama—and his dirty secret living one floor away. As the lines between script and reality blur, can they navigate friendship, romance, and the mess of mixing work with personal life?

mangas.title: Breeding Protocol
mangas.description:
Researcher Se-Ha and the Five Breeders' Seductive Romance

Se-Ha lands a job at the research institute as both a researcher and a breeder. Assigned to five male breeders for gamete collection, she gradually develops a seductive and precarious relationship with them...

mangas.title: Despite the Risk
mangas.synonyms: Even Though You Know It's Crazy
mangas.description: "Could you sleep with me?" The moment Min Seolha accidentally lets that question slip to her boss, Cha Jeongmu, she believes she is done for. Yet to her surprise, her superior and crush of three years agrees, even adding on a condition that they won't have a limit to the number of nights they spend together. And so begins the CEO and secretary's steamy love affair after work hours. But unbeknownst to them, a shared tragic past could end up jeopardizing their already-risky romance...

mangas.title: A Demon's Wish
mangas.description: Doya Seo, a demon, is one day captivated by a mysterious dream. That same day, he happens upon Wish So, a new freshman. Curiously, each moment their paths intersect, Doya finds himself engulfed in a perplexing whirl of emotions and physical sensations that his demonic sensibilities fail to decipher. Meanwhile, Wish finds herself amidst a flurry of events after being invited to the home of famous actor Jaehyeon Woo. In a world where the supernatural coexists with humanity, and caught between the devilish charm of Doya and Jaehyun's allure, will Wish be able to navigate her school life without trouble?

mangas.title: All Hail Lady Blanche!
mangas.synonyms: The Villainess Is Worshipped by the Family
mangas.description: To Blanche, everything seemed hopeless. Until she realized it was all a game. One she made, to be exact. Now she has a goal: Become the villain's right-hand man! But wait. Why is she the one saving him...?

mangas.title: Crazy Like a Fox
mangas.synonyms: The Princess Pretends to Be Crazy
mangas.description: When the emperor declared that his children must battle to become the last remaining heir, the only way Princess Lisbelle could survive was by becoming a mad woman. Feigning insanity kept her out of danger for years, but with only three children remaining, Lisbelle now finds herself a target. In a moment of danger, she discovers powers gifted to her by the goddess Hellare and suddenly finds herself in the company of a charming magician. But whether he's friend or foe has yet to be determined…

mangas.title: Zero Side
mangas.description: Chung-Won, a narcotics officer, goes undercover to stop "Pink Out," a new drug in Korea. The dealers slip away, leaving only Yeong. Every test comes back clean, yet after much doubt, Chung-Won takes home the bewildered 21-year-old who is so unworldly, it's as if he's been shut away his whole life.

mangas.title: The Symbiotic Relationship Between a PD and His Writer
mangas.synonyms: The Symbiotic Relationship Between Producers and Writers
mangas.description:
Webtoon artist Seol U-Young decided to try his hand at BL after seeing positive reactions on social media. To gather proper research material, U-Young heads to a gay bar, where he runs into Jun-Hyuk. Though he genuinely wanted to help Jun-Hyuk, who was asking for assistance in a tough spot, Jun-Hyuk mercilessly tramples on U-Young's kind intentions.

'How could I have been charmed by such trash!'

Feeling pathetic, U-Young ends up having the worst day ever. Then one day, U-Young receives notice that his assigned PD is changing. A few days later, at the meeting that follows, he finds himself face to face again with Jun-Hyuk, that piece of trash not even fit for recycling.

"PD-nim?! I'm having a hard time..."

"I'm still lacking. We need mutual satisfaction for a symbiotic relationship. Right, Writer?"

But how did we end up in this kind of relationship?!

mangas.title: The Weight of Accumulated Snow
mangas.synonyms: The Accumulated Snow Is Incredibly Heavy
mangas.description: Joo Yoon is tired of his classmate, Hyun Jaekyung, who often picks fights and bothers him for no apparent reason. Joo Yoon isn't the type who deliberately says mean things to others, a lot of resentment was built up in a short period of time. In a way, Hyun Jaekyung made him like this. But... was Joo Yoon being too harsh? When Joo Yoon visited to check up on him after the other had left in a hurry, he found Hyun Jaekyung with a puffy and flushed face as if he'd just been crying. Maybe it was just a hangover. Come to think of it, that kid always skips school the day after fighting with him. Hyun Jaekyung is an annoying brat who gets angry over every little thing, but strangely enough, it worries Joo Yoon when he's not around and it drives Joo Yoon crazy... Meanwhile, Jaekyung's looks alone are enough to drive him crazy. It's clear that nobody except Joo Yoon would ever seriously consider being with him for life. 'I disliked him so much, but somehow, I'm now stuck with him. And when I thought we were finally getting closer, he distances himself from me. What am I supposed to do with this bastard?’

mangas.title: Mousetrap
mangas.description: Cheon Yu-Hyeon is so close to inheriting the family business when his ailing father presents one condition: he needs to give his father a grandchild. It shouldn't be too hard for an omega like Yu-Hyeon, as long as he can find himself a suitable alpha that isn't his childhood friend and company rival Lee Hyeon-Do. But Hyeon-Do has been suffering a decade-long crush on Yu-Hyeon and desperately wants to be his baby daddy. And Yu-Hyeon is finding it harder to resist his friend's flirty tactics to get him in bed...

mangas.title: Mask Play
mangas.description: Lee Han, an unknown actor with crazy acting skills but never seen the light of day. He saves the lead actor Kang Tae-Yoon on a filming set where an accident occurred and dies in his place, but when he wakes up, he has become 'Cha Si-Han' with the beauty of the other world... "The ratings, the articles, the reactions, they're all the best. The drama that was on the verge of failure has come back to life, thanks to Si-Han." Si-Han, who suddenly gained attention in a drama where he appeared as a supporting role, is suddenly subdued by someone with great force on his way home. "Mr. Cha Si-Han. You know me, right?" His breathing stopped as his heart dropped. The man, Kang Tae-Yoon, was looking at him and smiling brightly.

mangas.title: We Are Young
mangas.description:
Since the old days, mystical creatures have existed to help humans. However, now that the times have changed, they suddenly receive a warning from their god: "Prove that you are still needed."

While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers.

Meanwhile, university student Park Geu-Ru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Si-Han...

This is a story about the daily life of these young mystical creatures, exploring the human world in order to avoid their own extinction.

mangas.title: 2Gether: The Series
mangas.description:
What if this incredibly hot guy becomes my boyfriend...?

Now that he's a college student, Taein's interest is solely focused on getting a pretty girlfriend. In reality, he not only gets a confession of love from a dude, Green, but he just can't get rid of him! After searching for ways to get rid of him, Taein and his friends find one solution, which is to date the most popular guy in his university: Soohyuk Yoo. Taein finally approaches Soohyuk without realizing the two of them are getting closer than he had expected...

mangas.title: For You Who Grieves
mangas.description: Doyoon Kim should've died in the car crash, but fate had other plans. He wakes up in the hospital, trapped in a bruised and unfamiliar body. Upon returning to university, he crosses paths with his old friend, Hangyeol. However, Hangyeol is unrecognizable. He is consumed by grief and unwilling to engage with Doyoon. Yet, a haunting familiarity tugs at Hangyeol, as if this stranger is an uncanny reflection of the dead man he still loves...

mangas.title: Continued Love
mangas.description: After enduring a long period of resentment and coldness from his partner, Cheng Jin decides to let him go following their bankruptcy. However, destiny intervenes when his lover suddenly loses his memories and falls in love with Cheng Jin once again. Although Cheng Jin is overjoyed, he is also anguished as he anxiously awaits the arrival of the inevitable "limited time" for their love.

mangas.title: A Guide Out to Succeed
mangas.description: Everything Jae-Chan did was driven by his selfish one-sided obsession over his partner esper, Woo-Jin. It's only in his dying moments after a dangerous mission that he regrets getting in the way of Woo-Jin's happiness. So when he's sent six years into the past by an unexpected supernatural event, Jae-Chan decides to use his knowledge of the future and his guide powers to help Woo-Jin from behind the scenes. But the more Jae-Chan tries to distance himself from Woo-Jin, the less the esper will leave him alone! Can Jae-Chan truly give up on Woo-Jin and succeed at his selfless mission?

mangas.title: As the Heart Leads
mangas.description: Yijae Kang seems to have the worst luck. She's an orphan, can see ghosts, and can't go near water. To make matters worse, she reincarnates as Hailey Duncan, a noblewoman who took her own life before her marriage to King Rodrick of Kaien--who happens to have evil spirits attached to him! To help ease his burden, Hailey's days are spent exorcising these spirits. The more they spend time together, the better Rodrick seems to feel…could he be falling for her?

mangas.title: Gimme That Pacifier!
mangas.description: Betrayed and executed by her pupil, magician Hela Sylopia finds herself in the body of the neglected infant granddaughter of a rivaling nation's duke. To make matters worse, her family doesn't remember her name, and the maids don't care what happens to her! But when she discovers that having her pacifier in her mouth can expand her mind, Hela uses that to her advantage to survive, get rid of those who stand in her way, and start plotting her revenge. Will Hela succeed, or will she wish she'd never been given a second chance?

mangas.title: Falling For It
mangas.synonyms: I Want to Be Fooled, I Want to Be Deceived
mangas.description: Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

mangas.title: A Kind Intruder
mangas.description: After I-Han Jeong's mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chi-O Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, I-Han suddenly finds herself living with Chi-O under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness of freshman life, I-Han meets Yu-Jin Seo, a champion judoka at their university who is the spitting image of her late brother. And now he's moving in next door?!

mangas.title: Kaze no Iro made Oboeteru
mangas.description:
The first year of high school, in spring. Mori, who has just entered school, learns of his classmate, Michioto, who is rumored to be the "treasure of the boys' school." Mori volunteered to ask for Michioto's contact information on behalf of a friend who was too scared to talk to him. Mori headed towards Michioto without really thinking about it, but the moment Mori sees him, it's love at first sight...



(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

mangas.title: Love on the Menu
mangas.description:
As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eun-Seong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eun-Seong accidentally stumbles upon his regular's secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Ho-Yeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eun-Seong can't decide whether he's annoyed… or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

mangas.title: I My Me Mine
mangas.description:
"Let's make high school unforgettable."

"No! Leave me alone!"



What happens when the strongest delinquent boy falls in love? Akira Izuki is an FJK who dreamed of having 100 friends, but one day she saved Amamiya, a delinquent neighbor, from an incident and became recognized as his "favorite"...! Akira thought that her high school life was over, but as Amamiya demanded her attention, she found herself unable to look away...



(Source: Shueisha, translated)

mangas.title: To Mend a Heart
mangas.description: Jang Han-Eul lives on his family's chicken farm in the countryside and the few friends he had moved away after graduation. Then a boy named Na-Mu comes from Seoul to visit his grandmother. Han-Eul is excited to make a new friend but is crestfallen when Na-Mu treats everyone kindly except him. Han-Eul wants them to be closer, but after Na-Mu drunkenly kisses him, Han-Eul becomes confused about what he actually wants.

mangas.title: A Punk, Devoted to Pure Love
mangas.description:
Yu-Jin, the model student who dreamed of medical school, threw off her pace with a brief high school romance and blew her college entrance exams. While retaking them, her thug ex-boyfriend Jun-Ha reappears before her eyes. Is he trying to sabotage her exams again? Or is it genuine lingering affection?

A sexy campus romance between two people so different they can't help but be drawn to each other.

mangas.title: Tell Me, Dear Butler
mangas.description:
"If you understand, don't cheat on me, dummy."



Kikyo has been in unrequited love with her butler, Hanayanagi, since the day they met. No matter how many times she tries to get his attention, it doesn't seem to have any effect on him…?



(Source: K MANGA)

mangas.title: A Delinquent's First Love
mangas.description: Shy and lonely college junior Do-Rae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Hae-Won Cha, who's just as handsome as she remembers. When Hae-Won suddenly confesses his feelings, Do-Rae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Do-rae's friend, and two, he believes he's still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Hae-Won is stuck in the past and determined to make Do-Rae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

mangas.title: Without Love, I Can't Be an Idol
mangas.titleNative: 愛がなければアイドルできない
mangas.description:
Noa worships Ibuki of the popular idol group ILY as a god. A chance encounter leads to an unexpected miracle...?

"I'm sorry to be an otaku's love, but from today on, I'm going to be a special presence of a god idol!"

mangas.title: Yoru no Katasumi de Kimi to Ice wo
mangas.titleNative: 夜のかたすみで君とアイスを
mangas.synonyms: Ice Cream with You in the Corner of the Night
mangas.description:
Haruka is an ordinary, tired working woman like any other. Her only pleasure is buying ice cream from a vending machine in the park she stops by on her way home from work. She also enjoys talking about silly things with a young man she always meets there, who she thinks is younger than her. Haruka works hard, looking forward to talking with him, whose name she doesn't even know, but one day she finds out that he has a crush on a woman - and before she knows it, she realizes that she has fallen in love with him too. A love story set in a park at night, where unrequited love crosses paths.



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

mangas.title: Being Loved for the First Time
mangas.synonyms: First Time as a Loved Youngest Child
mangas.description: After sacrificing herself to save the world over 99 different lifetimes, Anastasia Enderblanc starts her 100th life with frustrated resignation. Born as the youngest child of House Enderblanc, she expects another abusive family that fears her power, but is confused when they shower her with love instead. Their genuine affection surprises her, but she keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop. Can Anastasia accept the Enderblancs' love, or will she be disappointed and betrayed once more?

mangas.title: Kami ni Koi Nado Hayasugiru
mangas.synonyms: Too Soon to Fall in Love With a God
mangas.description: Asa, the god of love, is on a mission to make humans fall in love. With only one arrow left, she searches for a suitable man or woman, and discovers a beautiful boy. But the "arrow of fate" shot by Asa didn't work...!?

mangas.title: Daydream Darling
mangas.description:
Daydreamy Iroha is too shy and anxious to talk to her high school classmates, so she finds solace in confiding in upperclassman Sou, who is always encouraging and supportive. With such a great friend by her side, Iroha just may have found a dream come true!

Iroha avoids the awkwardness she feels around her classmates by sitting outside and talking to Sou, the handsome boy she met at the library. However, one day, a boy from her class discovers the secret she's been keeping from everyone. Has Iroha found her perfect match in Sou, or just an illusory love?

mangas.title: Meet in The Middle
mangas.description:
"I can make your life more fun."

A mysterious young man appeared one day in front of Yeo-Reum, who is living a dull life as a 30-year old! The way he acts straight-forward and to-the-point is very strong, kind of cute, but maybe a little overboard? What the hell do you want from me?! It's a heart-pounding, back-and-forth romance comedy!

mangas.title: I See Your Face, Turned Away
mangas.titleNative: きみの横顔を見ていた
mangas.description:
A manga about four teenagers and their four stories of unrequited love. When you don't want to lose a friendship but long for something more, the only thing you can do is gaze at your beloved's face, turned away...



One might call Hikari extraordinarily ordinary. One day, she takes up a new hobby—imagining what a romance would be like between her pretty friend Mari and the cute guy in their class, Otani. It's all in harmless fun, until the roles start to get tangled in Hikari's mind. Does she really have to be just the best friend in this love story? And just who is on Otani's mind when his eyes drift?



(Source: Kodansha USA, edited)


Notes:

- Includes four extra chapters.

- Winner of the 48th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shojo Category.

mangas.title: Karina's Last Days
mangas.description:
Though gifted with an ability to bring her drawings to life, Karina Leopold spent her years in the shadow of her famous siblings, forced to be the good daughter her parents wanted. But when she's told that a deadly disease will kill her in a year, she offers a deal to her fiancé, Milian Pastellio, with the goal to live the remainder of her days far from her family's reach. Much to her surprise, their encounter proceeds to change them both in a way she never imagined…



(Source: Tapas)

mangas.title: Be RF Savvy or Die
mangas.synonyms: If You Don't Know the Novel, You Will Die
mangas.description: What could make a romance fantasy superfan happier than getting pulled into a fantasy world? But Daline Este's dreams of being the protagonist in her story come crashing down when reality sinks in. She hasn't been pulled into one of her favorite novels like she dreamed—instead, she's landed in a world on the cusp of crisis as several novels tangle together and threaten to tear it apart. Now, Daline must use her expertise to set the stories straight before her happy ending goes up in flames.

mangas.title: The Youngest Has Much To Hide
mangas.synonyms: The Youngest Hides a Lot of Things
mangas.description: Amid the chaos of war, young Rubian realizes a shocking truth: she's trapped in a novel where the hero dies suddenly, plunging the world into disaster. Luckily, fate leads Rubian to enter the hero's household—giving her the perfect chance to stick close, prevent his death, and leave once the crisis passes. Yet the warmth and affection she receives from his family are unlike anything she's ever known, making it harder to remember that she's there to stop a tragedy… not start a slice-of-life!

mangas.title: Orchard of Temptation
mangas.description:
Peace and nature are the only things Se-Yeon expects to enjoy while staying in the countryside with a family she knows. So she's startled when she runs into the family's son, Jeong-Wook, who was her childhood friend. The two of them haven't seen each other since drifting apart in their teens, but that doesn't stop Se-Yeon from checking out Jeong-Wook's pecs. Once they catch each other in some suggestive situations, things heat up quickly between them. When the aloof Jeong-Wook suddenly confesses his feelings, it's up to Se-Yeon to decide where to take their secret fling in the orchard...!



(Source: Tappytoon)

mangas.title: Unnie tte Yonde mo Ii desu ka?
mangas.titleNative: オンニって呼んでもいいですか？
mangas.description: A super cute adult yuri story about a K-pop idol × a fan!

mangas.title: #MyFirstLove
mangas.description: I-Sol Yeon, the school's top student and biggest outcast, gains the ability to see people's true feelings about her through the Hashtag Lens, which she acquires after making the ten‑quintillionth wish. Through the lens, she discovers that Shin-U Seong, her former middle‑school best friend she had a painful fallout with, has tagged her as "#my_first_love_and_trash." Can I-Sol mend their broken relationship and overcome the pain of being betrayed by her first love?

mangas.title: Greedy
mangas.description: After five years of devotion, Yu-Ju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He's wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill. When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yu-Ju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love. Will Yu-Ju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

mangas.title: Kokoro no Program
mangas.description:
The boy Usami Ko met the robot girl Ichiko, who joined his family to help with the housework and for her to learn human emotions. What will await them as they live together? It's a boy meets robot girl story!


(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

mangas.title: Sakura, Saku.
mangas.description:
A mysterious boy comes to Saku Fujigaya's rescue when she falls in on a train, but he leaves before she can thank him. After this experience, Saku never ignores strangers in need of help to emulate the boy who helped her.



Saku would like to thank the boy who helped her, but all she has is a note signed "Ryosuke Sakura." She discovers that a boy in her high school, Haruki Sakura, has an older brother named Ryosuke. She asks Haruki to deliver her thank-you letter to Ryosuke, but why does he refuse?



(Source: Shojo Beat)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Otome no Itari" in volume 5, plus prologue and epilogue chapters.

mangas.title: Naeildo Joahae
mangas.description: After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what's on his mind.

mangas.title: King the Land
mangas.description:
Gu-Won's upbringing was straight from a storybook—he was the prince of his own world, surrounded by opulence and luxury. Yet, beneath the façade of grandeur, his life was a tapestry of loneliness and betrayal.



With a father who pits him against his own sister, Gu-Won's world is icy and devoid of joy—until he meets Sa-Rang, the sunny daughter of a humble servant. Her friendship and radiant smile begin to thaw his frozen heart. But tragedy strikes, tearing them apart and leaving Sa-Rang orphaned and adrift. As their paths diverge, bitterness and longing fuel their journey onward. Can these once inseparable friends navigate their way back to each other?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)



Note: This is a prequel of the tv drama of the same name that aired in June 2023.

mangas.title: your name.
mangas.description:
A story of two people determined to hold on to one another. Mitsuha, a high school girl from a town deep in the mountains, dreams of an unfamiliar life in Tokyo. Taki, a high school boy from Tokyo, dreams that he is a girl living in the mountains. As the two begin swapping lives, a miraculous story is set in motion.



(Source: Yen Press)

mangas.title: Cooking Sorcerer
mangas.description: Yu-Jeong Seo is a hardworking tattooist who loves nothing more than to eat good food while reading her favorite novel during her downtime. One particular day, she is doing exactly that when she suddenly hears a strange voice coming from outside her apartment. She steps out to see what's going on but loses her footing and falls down a flight of stairs. When she regains consciousness, she finds herself in a whole new world and in the body of someone completely different. As it turns out, a fairy, who was dimension traveling, was responsible for Yu-Jeong's accident and revived her as a botanical sorcerer out of guilt. Yu-Jeong adapts quickly and names herself "Sylvia Arbor" to fit in and avoid any suspicion. But soon, "Sylvia" learns that she had in fact been revived in the world of the novel she was reading right before she died; and in this novel, the main character, Felix, suffers from ageusia as a result of years of abuse by his stepmother. Will Sylvia's love of food and ability to use magic be Felix's salvation...?

mangas.title: Cannot Help It
mangas.description: I-Tae Jung, a Beta, suddenly finds himself being pursued by Dan Ge-Um, a rich and famous Alpha from his school. They say an Alpha can never truly be attracted to a Beta, but considering the strange offers Dan keeps making to get closer to I-Tae… Is it just a hormonal malfunction, or could it be real love?

mangas.title: Place to Be
mangas.description:
Chi-Yeong, who hid his sexual identity and spent a quiet school life, once mustered great courage to confess his feelings in high school—and failed. Over a decade later, Eui-Geon, his long-ago crush, happens to visit Chi-Yeong's small gopchang restaurant as a customer with his friend Jun-Young. Eui-Geon's gaze, seemingly unaware of Chi-Yeong, still fixates on someone else. Chi-Yeong realizes Eui-Geon is also carrying on a failed crush...?

"...But you like that person, right?"

"He seems quiet and gentle... Don't you sometimes hear that he's different from what you expected?"

mangas.title: Can't Get Enough of You
mangas.synonyms: I Can't Wait To Eat You
mangas.description: After losing his parents in a tragic car accident at a young age, Tae-Jun Kim vows never to forgive those responsible. Now, as an adult, fate reunites him with So-Eun Han, the daughter of the driver who took his parents' lives. Young, powerful, rich, and handsome Tae-Jun is hungry for revenge and will bully So-Eun until he feels satisfied. However, complications arise when love enters the equation, blurring the line between resentment and affection. A story in the making, in which "I will never forgive them!" turns into "I think I like you...".

mangas.title: Baby Tyrant
mangas.description: Gyeoul Yoon is no stranger to tragedy, having lost everything -- even her life -- because of her good-for-nothing father. When she reawakens after death, Gyeoul finds herself in the body of a newborn baby -- she is now Princess Mabel of the powerful Ermaneau Empire! With her doting new family and the empire's might at her disposal, Mabel has everything she's ever wanted. Upon learning that she's the subject of a prophecy with the world's salvation at stake, Mabel quickly realizes that there are people who will stop at nothing to destroy her newfound peace.

mangas.title: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash
mangas.description: Romance fantasies were my happy little refuge. I've read countless novels and left tons of top comments in RF forums, and where did that lead me? To getting hit by a reincarnation truck! Now I'm stuck in a zero-star rated story fighting for my life! My father, the vile Duke Phaeraton, abandoned me. I'm barely surviving, no thanks to my thieving uncle, Marquess Tarenka. I'm not even the heroine of this novel! But what's this? "QUEST COMPLETE. ABILITY ACTIVATED." Is this my ticket out of here?

mangas.title: Beta Off Not Dating
mangas.description: Ju-Hyeok is a clueless beta who is thrust into the messy world of alpha-omega dynamics when he leaves his wholesome beta college to work at a more diverse company. There, a full-on fistfight and loud makeup knotting in the bathroom isn't "workplace violence" and "sexual harassment," but just your run-of-the-mill lovers' quarrel. Repulsed by the pheromones that trump common sense in this crazy environment, Ju-Hyeok swears himself off dating until he saves up enough money to move to a faraway haven for betas. Unfortunately, fate seems to be working against him when he somehow attracts both the flirtatious alpha director and the cute omega junior at his company without lifting a finger. Can Ju-Hyeok flee the clutches of the dating world with his sanity intact, or will he fall victim to the pesky palpitations of his heart?

mangas.title: A Lady's Risqué Hobby
mangas.description: Eileen Hamilton's brother, Stephan, is at a loss to find her a match. No suitor can overcome her love of reading or insistence on marrying for love. But Eileen has a secret—she's an author of erotic romances, and finding a cure for her inexperience and chronic writer's block is far more pressing than her prospects. Certain everything is ruined when her secret is revealed to her brother's friend Alexander, she's shocked when he offers to help. How could she refuse her crush?

mangas.title: Charming the Duke of the North
mangas.synonyms: I Will Seduce the Northern Duke
mangas.description: Rinha, Korea's most beloved actress, gets into an accident while on set. When she regains consciousness, she realizes she has traveled to the Kingdom of Iklein and meets the northern duke Calcion, who saves her from a demonic beast. Calcion asks her to be his fake lover so she can get into socialite and discover the conspiracy happening in his castle.

mangas.title: Hatsukoi Mint Blue
mangas.titleNative: ハツコイ・ミントブルー
mangas.description: The innocent first love of two childhood friends who have not kept in touch with each other since the start of middle school.

mangas.title: Ano Ko ga Watashi wo Onna ni Suru
mangas.titleNative: あのこがわたしを女にする
mangas.synonyms: This Girl Will Make Me a Woman

mangas.title: Finding the Way
mangas.description: What if one little misunderstanding led to the biggest mistake of your life? Lee Kang, dominant alpha and the heir to the Se-ryong foundation, first helps out Yeo Juheon because he feels sorry for him. But the more he gets to know him and the closer they get, Kang starts to fall for the beta for real. They could be a thing, or so Kang thought… His whole world comes crumbling down when he finds out Juheon is already someone else's. That's already 7 years ago now, but Kang's still reeling from the hurt… until he figures out maybe he was in the wrong after all. After years of hurt and misunderstanding, can Kang find his way back to the love of his life?

mangas.title: 'Til Debt Do Us Part
mangas.description: Su-Bin's mom routinely pays for matchmakers to set her up on dates. Su-Bin turns them all down, one after another. One day she runs into an old friend from school, and things start to get complicated when he suddenly asks her to marry him. Is he the answer to her prayers or a devil in disguise? Will she take this chance to clear her debt?

mangas.title: As You Wish, Prince
mangas.synonyms: Majesty, What Do You Want To Be?
mangas.description:
"If you wrote me, then you can give me the throne!"

Yoonsoo is the successful author of a popular fantasy series. Just as she's about to start work on a new series, Imperial Prince Kyte Einzen, the worst villain she created has kidnapped her into the world of her own story?! Can she mold this nightmare into a story that will turn both their fates around? Based on the hit novel.

mangas.title: Choose Wood and Dwell
mangas.description: Eight years ago, the innocent, rich heir Jiang Yumian pursued his tutor Qin Heng; eight years later, the roles are reversed. The noveau rich Qin Heng reunites with his first love Yumian by chance. This time, he decides he will hold tight to him and not let go.

mangas.title: A Common Story of a Lady's New Life
mangas.description: Valerie thought she'd be a genius mage in this world. But when her magic can't get past basic and her teacher shares a prophecy of a tiger coming to attack(!!), she opts to enjoy an ordinary life. Everything's fine until she's engaged to none other than Duke Kylus Dwello. It's just one thing after another—the mysterious Serena, the servants who ship the duke and Serena, a prince who doesn't understand boundaries, and even the duke looming over her bed! Can she get back to her nice, quiet life?

mangas.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp
mangas.description: Jihyun is a master surgeon at the peak of her medical prowess. She's made it her life's mission to save lives in order to atone for the sins of her past life, but her dreams are cut short when her plane crashes in the middle of the Pacific. When Jihyun wakes up, she finds herself back in her first life as Elise de Clarence - the haughty nightmare of a girl who brought on her own tragic end. The new Elise, however, still has time to set things straight - with her newfound medical knowledge, the reformed Elise sets out to right the wrongs of her tragic first life!

mangas.title: A Villainess for the Tyrant
mangas.synonyms: A Villain Is a Good Match for a Tyrant
mangas.description: "I would rather just go out with a bang!" For Princess Cecile, being married off to the emperor of a neighboring empire was unavoidable. But wait, isn't this the same Emperor Estian who's notorious for being a heartless sadist? In order to maintain her final shred of dignity, the fearless Cecile demands that her future husband carry her all the way from the carriage to the wedding chapel! If this is her fate, she might as well put up a fight before dying at the hands of the handsome emperor. After all, the only way to fight fire is with… more fire?! Can Cecile become a villain even more fearsome than her tyrant husband? Based on the hit novel.

mangas.title: Black Tide
mangas.description:
Lazy & Cool "Daddy-Type" Older Man × Dark & Unhinged Younger Guy

In order to survive, Xie Liao took a risk to entice the man who could kill him at any moment, only to accidentally discover that physical contact with him could actually cure his illness!

As their contact grew deeper, Xie Liao, who originally thought merely surviving was enough, developed a greedy new desire...

"Do you regret it?" Smiling, Xie Liao reached out his hand, cracked from his illness, hooked Xie Fengtong's uniform, and gently pulled him forward. The next second, however, Xie Fengtong lifted him up and placed him onto the desk...

mangas.title: Stuck Doing an Assignment With a Junior I Hate
mangas.description:
I could tolerate taking the same class as her—but ending up on the same team for an assignment too?! The night before the presentation, because of Sohee’s “intentional mistake” (?), the project files are lost.

The two end up spending the night at Sohee’s tiny one-room apartment.

“I’ll just try putting it in… here.”
“Are you insane? W-what are you talking about?”
“There’s something I need to check

From the day Sohee’s heated gaze landed between Gitae’s legs, every night became restless, with his hands and lips constantly occupied.

Shim Sohee—called a loser, an outcast, a clueless virgin. Every time he looked at her plain face behind those glasses, the desire only grew stronger. And once she was undressed, he realized— no, felt it explode—that beneath it all, the attraction was overwhelming.

mangas.title: The Thrilling Temptation of a Boyfriend
mangas.synonyms: A Male Friend's Thrilling Temptation | Irresistible Friend
mangas.description:
“We’re thirty-two. The age we said we’d start dating.”

Top singer in South Korea and a friend of 17 years. The so-called too comfortable guy friend, Kim Do-kyung.

“If we’re still single at thirty-two, let’s just date.”

“Im Ji-yoo, are you really sure about that?”

Who would’ve thought he’d still remember those words spoken as a joke 12 years ago?

“Are you crazy? Me and you? Ugh, that’s ridiculous…”

“Ten minutes. I’ll seduce you in ten.” Do-kyung picked up his phone and pressed the stopwatch.

As Ji-yoo flinched in surprise, he pulled her waist as if to say, don’t be nervous. Then, he devoured her lips.

The alarm rang, signaling that ten minutes had passed—and Do-kyung paused for a moment.

“Girlfriend? Friend? Choose.”

The guy friend who had always felt like a brother…turned out to be an homme fatale.
