His sexy, beast-like touch—she didn’t hate it.

No, in fact, she liked it.

mangas.title: Teach Me More Incubus
mangas.titleNative: もっとおしえて淫魔様
mangas.description: A naive wannabe summoner with no talent tries to brute-force his way into obtaining a strong familiar by cutting a couple corners. When his efforts bring him face-to-face with a mischievous incubus, he finds out why summoning demons is NOT something you should try at home.

mangas.title: I'll Keep Your Secret
mangas.author: Babsot
mangas.description: "I'm hot-tempered, but I'll try to be rational.”

mangas.title: Love: Zero
mangas.author: Lee Boon Hong, 8garak, Seokho
mangas.description:
Hunter and Ji-yu, neighbors in a luxury apartment building on Manhattan’s Upper East Side.

Ji-yu, a “shy girl” who loves to sit quietly and read, and Hunter, a “popular kid” and promising tennis player who can’t sit still for a moment, are complete opposites in every way.

The meeting of a boy and a girl who lived in different worlds. Although they were brought together by their mothers, Ji-yu soon becomes indispensable to Hunter.

“I need to check something. Whether you’re really my winning jinx or not.”

As Hunter wins every match Ji-yu cheers for, he begins to firmly believe that she is his “jinx.” Tired of Hunter asking her to come to every match, Ji-yu comes up with a little trick. She simply writes his name on her palm and lightly touches it with her lips—and the very next day, Hunter returns holding the championship trophy.

As they become increasingly entangled under the label of “jinx,” their relationship deepens, but a great tragedy strikes Ji-yu once she becomes an adult.

“Ji-yu Parker, I just sold you for $100,000.”

Ji-yu uses Hunter to survive, and Hunter uses Ji-yu because of the “jinx.”

In tennis, “love” means zero.
A game of love played out between the two amid warm childhood memories, the innocent flutter of feelings that blossomed at the tail end of adolescence, and a relationship tangled with love-hate emotions born of misunderstandings and missed connections.
Who will ultimately emerge victorious?

mangas.title: Black Tea and Sanskrit
mangas.author: KANG Ji Young, Byeokpe, Rock, Metatoon
mangas.description:
“Suck it for me. You can at least do that much for me, can’t you?”

“Song Beom-jin, don’t you regret it?”

“Why would I regret it?”

From the very beginning, this relationship had no expiration date.
Only a usage period.

From the age of six until the end of their lives, the two of them were each other’s instruction manuals.

Song Beom-jin (29), a basketball player for Moonyoung Black King. A massive physique over 190cm tall. Hong Cha-hee's gentle and easy-to-handle errand boy.

Hong Cha-hee (29), a world-renowned painter and designer with a unique aura. A free and lonely soul who is incredibly haughty. However, she has been devoted to Beom-ja since childhood.

mangas.title: Fortune Bringer's School Life
mangas.author: Liang Azha
mangas.description: Student Prosperity Cat (Zhaocaimao/Maneki Neko) needs to earn a lot of money from the human world within the deadline to graduate! But this is mission impossible for Ling Shan, because his human benefactor... is super poor!!!

mangas.title: Stars-struck Masquerade
mangas.author: Teno Amatsuki
mangas.description:
“You look innocent… but you like it dirty, don’t you?”

“My idol would never do this sort of thing!!”

Issa is a huge fan of Nero, a masked idol whose face is kept secret from the public. One day, at a members-only nightclub he was drawn into a V.I.P. room by a guy who seemed like a player. Issa tried to resist, but the moment he heard a whisper in his ear, his mind was blown— the voice was just like Nero’s. Even though this guy isn’t at all like Nero, the voice that he loves made him irresistible…

“If it’s not Nero, then you don’t care?”

Will a romance really start between this mysterious man who has the voice of an idol and an idol obsessed college student after teasing his ears!?

mangas.title: Swallow My Dog
mangas.author: Chu (秋)
mangas.description: Female DOM × Male SUB. He's a delicacy on the dinner plate, gradually swallowed by her.

mangas.title: Serendipitous Delight
mangas.author: Jsm_mim
mangas.description: Luca is a Beta – somewhat peculiar – spoiled and accustomed to privileges, whose world crumbles when her allowance is cut off due to her irresponsibility. To regain his luxuries, he needs to find a job, but what he didn't expect was to fall in love with his boss, Natanael, an alpha 12 years older than him.

mangas.title: Memoirs of a Witch
mangas.synonyms: A Witch's Memoir, Tales of a Witch
mangas.author: imyeon (이면)
mangas.description: Lily, a black witch who was brought to the castle during a witch hunt when she was young and is still used by the king for her power even as an adult. She lives each day enduring both fear and scorn. Then one day, she meets a new court jester. Unlike other jesters, she is disliked for his flattery, but the jester shows favor to the witch. Why does the jester show favor to the witch? Can the witch ever get her free life back?

mangas.title: Path to You
mangas.author: Sinran
mangas.description: When almost college dropout Jensen attempts to drink away his problems, unemployed Nathaniel suddenly pukes on him and ruins his night. As an apology, Nathaniel offers to help Jensen with his studies. Despite Jensen's difficulties in getting along with people, the two become friends and something deeper begins to grow between them…

mangas.title: Kiss the Rose Gently
mangas.synonyms: The Tiger Sniffs the Rose, Hu Xiu Qiangwei
mangas.author: Liu Beili (六倍利)
mangas.description: How to refuse a hateful childhood friend who persistently pursues me? Since he's so good at taking exams, let's give him some love tests and let him work on raising his score!

mangas.title: Don’t Worry, the Baby Pope Has Defeated the Fanatics!
mangas.titleNative: 광신도는 아기 교황님이 물리쳤으니, 걱정 말라구!
mangas.author: Moon Si-hyun
mangas.description: I woke up inside a dystopian game… A world with no dreams, no hope, and definitely no mercy. My assigned mission? Track down the fanatics and bring peace back to the world. But… “How am I supposed to save the world in a three-year-old’s body?!” The order is on the verge of collapse. I rescued the pitiful protagonist of the game… only to somehow end up taking his place. Now I’m the Pope. But this place is crawling with fanatics secretly worshiping an evil god, and spies from the royal court. Even the holy knights who are left… have completely lost it. “Daddy! Call me Daddy, Master!” “I told you, I’m the Pope, not Master!” “You’re so cute! You need to eat a hundred meals a day!” “Shut it.” As both a healer and the Pope, I need someone to play the role of my “Daddy” and protect me. The problem? Every single one of my Daddy candidates is completely unhinged. And even the male lead I let go so he could live a happy life… “As long as I have you, I don’t care if the world burns.” …seems to have come back not quite right in the head. Can our crumbling order really survive and bring peace to the world? Watch the Baby Pope sweat it out to save the world!

mangas.title: Beyond Your Pheromones
mangas.author: Han Chengxiu (漢城宿)
mangas.description: During their heat, Alpha and Omegas will release their pheromones to attract each other and form a mark, but betas do not have pheromones. But the beating of the heart tells the body where it belongs; thus, everything becomes irrelevant, no matter our gender or pheromones.

mangas.title: BLUR LENS
mangas.author: 香蕉 yue
mangas.description: Transfer student Jiang Nan Yu seems to be particularly concerned about Lu Wang, who is bullied at school. He repeatedly intrudes into Lu Wang's life, which Lu Wang doesn't understand after a long time of living there. It seems that an unknown answer is calling out before it appears. Unexpectedly, the transfer student confessed to him, and Lu Wei was startled. Jiang Nan Yu's behavior of scheming is like having long harbored feelings for him. So, in the end, is it love at first sight, or is it a long-standing scheme?
